Quest.name: Attribute_and_Skill_Redistribution
Quest.notes: talk to the heads for 18 each
Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|Game mechanic I|Coordinates|84.5S, 0.0E I|QB|53 stamps P|Introduced in «The Slumbering Giant» and «The Iron Coast» events, **Attribute and Skill Redistribution** allows you to change your starting attributes and skills post «Character Creation».
P|**Note:** You must be at least level 25+ to enter the redistribution temples.
H2|Redistribution Timers P|**Quest Update:** There are no longer any timers on the Skill and Attribute Gems. Go wild at Asheron's Castle and use the Temples for the easy stamps!
TH|Start Location Timers TR|Specializing Skills Untraining Skills Redistributing Attributes TR|To Specialize: «Qalaba'r» To Untrain: «Cragstone» To Reset: «Eastham» None Gems 1 - 4: None Gems 1 - 9: None TR|Gems 5 - 8: 6 Days Gems 10 - 18: 6 Days TR|Gems 9 - 16: 13 Days Gems 19+: 13 Days TR|Gems 17+: 20 Days TE
H2|Walkthrough H3|Before you begin L|1|•|Before you start redistributing «skills» and/or «attributes», be sure to purchase a few «Spell Components¦Herbs» from your local archmage, you must have some to enter either of the two Temples. L|2|•|**Tip:** Pick one type of herb and buy a few of them. Its best to buy a few, in case you accidentally hand the wrong component at the wrong time. You can keep clicking the Temple Guardian until it requests the herb that you picked. L|1||Guardian of the Temple of Forgetfulness tells you, "Bring me the essence of Malar and I will let you pass." TH|Spell Word Component Spell Word Component Spell Word Component TR|Boquar «Mugwort» Cruath «Ginseng» Equin «Mandrake» TR|Feazh «Damiana» Helkas «Wormwood» Jevak «Myrrh» TR|Kenrak «Amaranth» Malar «Hyssop» Ozhur «Frankincense» TR|Puish «Saffron» Quavosh «Dragonsblood» Roiga «Yarrow» TR|Shurov «Comfrey» Tugak «Vervain» Uthoi «Henbane» TR|Volae «Eyebright» Yanoi «Bistort» Zojak «Hawthorn» TE
H3|To Specialize a Skill L|1|1.|Head to the «Temple of Enlightenment» at 84.5S, 0.0E L|2|•|**Route:** From «Qalaba'r», take the «Land Bridge Villas» portal at 74.8S, 17.8E. You'll need to stay on the land bridge until 85.5S 0.8W where it slopes down to the shore. Head east to find the «Guardian of the Temple of Enlightenment». L|1|2.|Speak with the «Guardian of the Temple of Enlightenment» to obtain a riddle. L|2|•|{TIP} Each use of the Guardian will generate a new riddle. This means you can keep clicking until you get the riddle you want. L|2|•|One stamp for each component (15): L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentBistort⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentSaffron⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentMandrake⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentMugwort⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentGinseng⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentHyssop⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentMyrrh⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentEyebright⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentVervain⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentComfrey⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentDamiana⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentWormwood⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentDragonsblood⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentHawthorn⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleEnlightenmentYarrow⟧ L|1|3.|Solve the riddle by handing the «Guardian of the Temple of Enlightenment» the spell component that corresponds with the keyword in the riddle (see above «#Before you begin¦table»). L|1|4.|From the drop, keep either all the time left, or all the time right, and jump into a few pits with golems. L|1|5.|In last pit, enter the Inner Sanctum portal L|1|6.|Talk to the Servant of Enlightenment (NE corner central room). He will give you a «Token of Modification». L|1|7.|In the 4 side rooms, different Wardens of Enlightenments are located. Select them to identify what skill they represent (more or less alphabetically ordered) L|1|8.|Hand the Warden of your choice the Token, to receive a Gem of Enlightenment. L|1|9.|Use it, and if you have enough skill credits available, you can specialize a trained skill.
H3|To Untrain a Skill L|1|1.|Head to the «Temple of Forgetfulness» at 88.8N, 0.0E L|2|•|**Route:** From «Cragstone», take the Far Horizon Cottages portal at 26.2N, 46.3E. L|1|2.|Speak with the «Guardian of the Temple of Forgetfulness» to obtain a riddle. L|2|•|{TIP} Each use of the Guardian will generate a new riddle. This means you can keep clicking until you get the riddle you want. L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessBistort⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessMugwort⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessSaffron⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessGinseng⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessHawthorn⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessEyebright⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessDamiana⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessWormwood⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessDragonsblood⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessVervain⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessMyrrh⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessComfrey⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessYarrow⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessHyssop⟧ L|2|•|⟦TempleForgetfulnessMandrake⟧ L|1|3.|Solve the riddle by handing the «Guardian of the Temple of Forgetfulness» the spell component that corresponds with the keyword in the riddle (see above «#Before you begin¦table»). L|1|4.|From the drop, keep either all the time left, or all the time right, and jump into a few pits with golems. L|1|5.|In last pit, enter the Inner Sanctum portal. L|1|6.|Talk to the Servant of Forgetfulness (NE corner central room). He will give you a «Token of Modification». L|1|7.|In the 4 side rooms, different Wardens of Forgetfulness are located. ID them to identify what skill they represent (more or less alphabetically ordered). L|1|8.|The first time you pick up a Gem of Forgetfulness you will receive ⟦ForgetfulnessGems1⟧ L|1|9.|The fourth time time you pick up a Gem of Forgetfulness you will receive ⟦ForgetfulnessGems2⟧ and ⟦Forgetfulness6days⟧ L|1|10.|Hand the Warden of your choice the Token, to receive a Gem of Forgetfulness and it will inform you on the state of your timers (see «#Lore & Dialog¦Lore & Dialog» for examples). L|1|11.|Use it to despecialize, or untrain a skill.
H3|To Redistribute Attributes H4|Gems of Lowering L|1|1.|Head to the «Temple of Forgetfulness» at 88.8N, 0.0E and gain entrance to the Inner Sanctum. L|2|•|**Route:** From «Cragstone», take the Far Horizon Cottages portal at 26.2N, 46.3E. L|1|2.|Talk to the Servant of Alteration (SW corner central room). He will give you a «Token of Modification», and inform you on the state of your timers (see Lore & Dialog for examples). L|1|3.|In the central room, different Wardens are located. Talk to the warden for that Attribute which you want to lower. L|1|4.|You will receive a Gem of Lowering . L|1|5.|The first time you do this you will receive a stamp ⟦AttributeGems1⟧
H4|Gems of Raising L|1|1.|Head to the «Temple of Enlightenment» at 84.5S, 0.0E and gain entrance to the Inner Sanctum. L|2|•|**Route:** From «Qalaba'r», take the «Land Bridge Villas» portal at 74.8S, 17.8E. You'll need to stay on the land bridge until 85.5S 0.8W where it slopes down to the shore. Head east to find the «Guardian of the Temple of Enlightenment». L|1|2.|Talk to the Servant of Alteration. He will give you a «Token of Modification», and inform you on the state of your timers (see Lore & Dialog for examples). L|1|3.|In the central room, different Wardens are located. Hand the token to the warden for that skill, which you want to raise. L|1|4.|You will receive a Gem of Raising L|1|5.|Combine the two halves to obtain an Attribute Transfer Gem: to > Gem L|2|•|Gem of Lowering Endurance Gem of Raising Coordination Attribute to Attribute Gem L|2||You combine the gems into an Attribute Transfer gem. L|1|6.|Using this Gem will transfer 10 points from one of your innate attributes to another.
H3|Reset Options at Asheron's Castle H4|To Reset all Skills L|1|1.|To untrain all skills and have the experience and credits refunded in one click, you can speak to «Fianhe» in «Asheron's Castle». L|2|•|Route: From the «Town Network», take the north hall to «Eastham» and run to the portal at 17.9N, 64.3E. At the drop take the Portal to Asheron's Castle. L|2|•|⟦UsedFreeSkillReset⟧ L|2|•|⟦UsedSkillReset⟧ L|1|2.|The catch is that you only get one free skill reset per character. Each additional reset will cost you and is on a 27 day timer. L|2||You only get one free skill reset per character. Each additional reset costs MMDs and Luminance. Would you like to continue with your free skill reset? L|2|•|Note: XP for racial skills will be refunded and the skills set to trained if specialized (sister skills and racial specialized skills will not be changed). L|2|•|Note: If you used augmentation gems to spec tinkering skills, they will seem to be lost, but after you train them again they will automatically be specialized.
H4|To Reset all Attributes L|1|1.|Head to «Asheron's Castle» L|1|2.|Talk to «Chafulumisa». He will warn you that you only get a free change of your attributes once. After that it will cost MMDs. L|2||You only get one free attribute reset per character. Each additional reset costs MMDs and Luminance. Would you like to continue with your free skill (sic) reset? L|2|•|⟦UsedFreeAttributeReset⟧ L|2|•|⟦AttributeReset30Day⟧ L|2|•|⟦30MinAttributes⟧ L|2|•|⟦UsedAttributeReset⟧ L|1|3.|If you choose YES, you will have 30 minutes to grab as many raising and lowering attribute gems as you wish (from the nearby pillars). L|1|4.|These gems work identically to the gems from the temples. (raising or lowering by 10)
H3|Important Notes H4|Timers L|1|•|Though the «Token of Modification» for untraining and redistributing attributes share the same name, they do **not** share timers. This means you can actually get 4 untraining gems, and still get the full 18 attribute gems if you have never done this before. L|1|•|Timers listed above don't apply when using the reset options at «Asheron's Castle».
H4|Tinkering Skills L|1|•|Tinkering skills can only specialized using «Augmentation Gems» and they cannot be unspecialized using Gems of Forgetfulness.
H4|Fixed Skills and Attributes L|1|•|Even though you cannot untrain fixed starter skills such as Arcane Lore, you can use the Gems of Forgetfulness to recover all experience that you have spent on them. L|1||Although you cannot untrain your Arcane Lore skill, you have succeeded in recovering all the experience you had invested in it. L|1|•|You can never raise an attribute above 100 innate, or lower it below 10 innate using the Gems of Alteration. L|1||Your innate level of [Attribute] is already as low as it can be. You may not reduce it any further.
H4|Mistakes L|1|•|If you choose the wrong gem and want to get another instead, you can give the gem to either the «Servant of Alteration» or «Servant of Forgetfulness» to erase the mistake. This does not apply to Gems of Enlightenment (specializing) as there is no timer or limit to the gems.

Quest.name: Bronze_Statues_Quest
Quest.notes: do all of them once for cragstone turn in and again for xarabydun turn in
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Mannikin Foundry», «Effigy Foundry», «Mammet Foundry» or «Colossus Foundry» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|A quest to gather pieces from the statues found in each of the foundries for experience and/or decorative housing items.
L|1||Quest Bonus Stamps: Need to two runs for all available stamps. Once for the House items and another for the XP turn in.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Go to either the «Mannikin Foundry¦Mannikin», «Effigy Foundry¦Effigy», «Mammet Foundry¦Mammet» or «Colossus Foundry¦Colossus» foundry (view each foundry's page for a list of coordinates). L|1|2.|Kill the creatures you would like a statue of until it drops a statue piece, the piece is different depending on which dungeon you go to. I|Level|10 I|Rec. Level|10-50 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Facility Hub Portal Gem» I|Starts At|«Facility Hub» I|Repeat|Non Repeatable I|Kill Task|False I|Contracts|«Contract for Facility Hub» H2|Quest Overview P|This is a series of previously existing quests, points of interest, and dungeons that have been linked together via the «Facility Hub» with new rewards in order to provide new players with a leveling route from 10 to 50. P|To enter the hub, use the innate spell of the «Facility Hub Portal Gem». All new characters are given one of these devices on creation, and new orbs may be obtained from the Society Agents (see «Exploration Society Letters» for locations). You can hand back the gem to learn «Facility Hub Recall». A portal to the «Facility Hub» is also available in the «Town Network». P|The Facility Hub is divided into three wings: L|1|•|East: Wardens and portals for «#10+ Quests¦10+», «#15+ Quests¦15+», «#20+ Quests¦20+», and «#25+ Quests¦25+» quests. L|1|•|West: Wardens and portals for «#30+ Quests¦30+», «#35+ Quests¦35+», «#40+ Quests¦40+», and «#45+ Quests¦45+» quests. L|1|•|North: Portals to additional side quests and hunting areas for levels 15 - 40. This wing is further divided into three sections: L|2|•|East: Portals for the first 8 «Tusker Tusks». L|2|•|West: Portals for the first 5 «Olthoi Pincers». L|2|•|North: A portal to Dryreach, for access to the «Tumerok Banners Quest».
L|1|•|For the most efficient order to complete the tasks in, see «Facility Hub Quests/Tasks by Efficiency». L|1|•|For those interested in maximizing their allegiance experience, the experience that the wardens award you does not pass up.

Quest.Wiki:

L|1|•|**Note**: though many of the skills became non-existent after the «Master of Arms» event, the Skill Puzzle Pieces sold by the «Bestower Representative» have not been updated. However, each now corresponds to the updated weapons skills, so it is still possible to use each one.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|To start this quest go to one of the three Bestower Tents (see infobox for coords), and pick up a «Skill Puzzle Base Piece». L|2|•|⟦BestowerBasePiece⟧ L|1|2.|In each town there is a «Bestower Representative»; a vendor that sells the Bestowers' Guild puzzle skill pieces (see below) for 10,000 pyreals and a «Handbook of the Bestowers' Guild» for 5 pyreals. L|1|3.|You will need to pick which puzzle skill piece you want, and you will need to be trained in that skill in order to combine the Skill Puzzle Base Piece and the Bestowers' Guild Puzzle Skill Piece. L|1|4.|After you purchase a skill piece, simply use the base piece on it to create a completed skill puzzle. L|1|5.|Give the completed skill puzzle to the «Bestower Examiner» for your rewards.

Quest.name: Rynthid_Training
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Rynthid Assessment Crystal» I|Starts At|62.3S, 66.2W I|Route|«Rynthid Recall» or «Mansion» to «Dangerous Portal Device» to Center of the «Obsidian Plains» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Rynthid Training» H2|Overview P|The «Curator of Torment» is looking to test Isparians through a series of 'tests'.
L|1|•|5 tests must be completed in order to reach the rewards room. Each test is chosen randomly from the collection 7 tests. This quest will therefore vary each time it is completed. This also makes retrieving a corpse problematic, as there is no guarantee you can easily return to the same test.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|To begin this quest, talk to the «Rynthid Assessment Crystal» located at 62.3S, 66.2W. The «Rynthid Assessment Crystal» will portal you to the beginning of the tests. L|2|•|Route: «Rynthid Recall» or «Mansion» to «Dangerous Portal Device» to Center of the «Obsidian Plains» L|2|•|⟦RynthidTrainingStarted_1013⟧ L|1|2.|The first room contains a portal to the first of the tests. This portal is randomly generated upon entry to the dungeon. The sequence of the tests is random. L|2|•|{WARN} Take note of the color of all portals you enter, starting with this one. The color of the portals will determine the color-coded levers at the end of the quest. L|2|•|⟦ColoredPortal⟧ L|2|•|There is a stamp for each color and ordinal of portal. You can fail the levers at the end to retake the test TH|Blue Green Orange Red White Yellow TR|⟦ColoredPortal1Blue⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal1Green⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal1Orange⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal1Red⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal1White⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal1Yellow⟧ TR|⟦ColoredPortal2Blue⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal2Green⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal2Orange⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal2Red⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal2White⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal2Yellow⟧ TR|⟦ColoredPortal3Blue⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal3Green⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal3Orange⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal3Red⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal3White⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal3Yellow⟧ TR|⟦ColoredPortal4Blue⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal4Green⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal4Orange⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal4Red⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal4White⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal4Yellow⟧ TR|⟦ColoredPortal5Blue⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal5Green⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal5Orange⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal5Red⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal5White⟧ ⟦ColoredPortal5Yellow⟧ TE
H3|Drudge Test L|1|1.|Kill drudges to open the doors. L|1|2.|Take the colored portal to the next test.
H3|Mite Test L|1|1.|Kill the «Troublesome Mite»s to the north, west, and east. All «Troublesome Mite»s are accompanied by three «Fiesty Mite»s. L|1|2.|Loot «Key I», «Key II» and «Key III» that will unlock the doors to the south. L|1|3.|Take the colored portal to the next test.
H3|Training Dummy Test L|1|1.|Move past the Training Dummies that cast lightning spells across the room. L|1|2.|Hug the right side of the wall until you reach the next colored portal.
H3|Rock Jumping Test L|1|1.|Jump up the many rocks until you reach the next colored portal at the top. L|2|•|Beware of lightning damage on the floor during this test!
H3|Portal Jumping Test L|1|1.|Jump up the multi-colored portal platforms using shift jumps. L|1|2.|Take the portal at the top of the chamber.
H3|Moars Test L|1|1.|Defeat a series of five spawns of «Raging Moar»s and «Enraging Moar»s. The moars hit with fire damage and spit acid damage. L|2|1.|Two «Raging Moar»s L|2|2.|Three «Raging Moar»s L|2|3.|One «Enraging Moar» L|2|4.|Three «Raging Moar»s L|2|5.|Three «Raging Moar»s L|1|2.|The door will open to the east. Jump across the pit and take the next colored portal.
H3|Margul Test L|1|1.|Defeat a series of three margul spawns. L|2|1.|? Margul L|2|2.|? Margul L|2|3.|? Margul L|1|2.|A success message will be displayed and the door at the end of the hallway will open. L|1|3.|Jump across the short gap and proceed to take the next colored portal.
H3|Gurog Test L|1|1.|Proceed through a series of rooms with «Gurog Bruiser»s to reach the next colored portal at the end. L|2|•|Each room has a maze of horizontal portals which appear and disappear. These portals will drop you back at the start of this test. Avoid them as you move through each room.
H3|Assessment Chamber L|1|1.|Now you will be required to use the colored levers that correspond with each colored portal you previously entered. L|2|•|⟦ColoredPortalLeverPull⟧ L|1|2.|Pull the levers in order. L|2|•|⟦ColoredPortalLeverPullCompleted⟧ L|1|3.|Once you receive the green message to do so, speak with the «Rynthid Assessment Crystal» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦RynthidTrainingCompleted_1013⟧

Quest.name: Gauntlet
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Society Rank|Initiate I|Type|Locked Fellowship I|Starts With|«Gauntlet Ticket Vendor» I|Starts At|«Celestial Hand Gauntlet» «Eldrytch Web Gauntlet» «Radiant Blood Gauntlet» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Time|1 hour H2|Overview L|1|•|Enter either the «Celestial Hand Gauntlet», «Eldrytch Web Gauntlet» or «Radiant Blood Gauntlet» L|1|•|**Important:** «Rare» gems are not allowed - you will not be able to enter the Gauntlet if you have a «Rare» gem in your inventory. Any active creature, or life magic rares will also be dispelled upon entry;Item magic rares (ex: «Pearl of Blood Drinking») will not be dispelled. However, you can enter with «Spectral Rares». L|1|•|There are three distinct dungeons accessed in front of each society stronghold but you can enter any one of them irrespective of what society you belong to. L|1|•|You may also enter if you do not belong to any «Societies¦Society», however you will not be able to access the «Gauntlet Bosses». L|1|•|To initiate the event one must be in the society hosting the event rooms. L|1|•|Each «Society» may have two concurrent groups attempting the event at the same time for a total of six possible concurrent groups. L|1|•|There are «Gauntlet Bosses» that can be accessed after you complete a certain number of stages. L|1|•|Required «Category:Slayer¦Slayers»: «Virindi», «Tumerok», «Mukkir», «Olthoi», «Shadow» and «Burun».
L|1||NPCs L|1|•|«Gauntlet Ticket Vendor» L|2|•|«Gauntlet Ticket Vendor (Celestial Hand)» L|2|•|«Gauntlet Ticket Vendor (Eldrytch Web)» L|2|•|«Gauntlet Ticket Vendor (Radiant Blood)» L|1|•|«Master of the Gauntlet» L|2|•|«Master of the Gauntlet (Celestial Hand)» L|2|•|«Master of the Gauntlet (Eldrytch Web)» L|2|•|«Master of the Gauntlet (Radiant Blood)» L|1|•|«Gauntlet Vendors»; L|2|•|«Zabien» - Vendor of the Blood L|2|•|«Wreen» - Vendor of the Hand L|2|•|«Vellum» - Vendor of the Web

H3|Notes P|Here is a rough set of notes. Note that some spawn information is incomplete and so is the detailed breakdown of the spawn waves:
P|Most stages have 4 waves of spawns. An exception is stage 5. Recommended group composition is as many missile and void hybrids as possible, with secondary consideration to specialized life mages.
L|1|•|**Note:** You must use the exit door to have completed a room. For example, killing the spawn in room 2 then using the door and entering room 3 counts as having beaten 2.
P|**Stage 1** P|Spawn 1 - «Hollow Pawn»s, «Corrosive Archer» P|Spawn 2 - «Hollow Pawn»s, «Virindi Rival», «Corrosive Archer» P|Spawn 3 - «Virindi Rival», «Tumerok Savage» P|Spawn 4 - «Tumerok Savage» P|Kill priority: «Corrosive Archer» >«Tumerok Savage» > «Virindi Rival» > «Hollow Pawn»s L|1|•|Tumeroks are extremely vulnerable to lightning damage. CS melee and missile weapons are very effective and recommended over slayers. L|1|•|Virindi are vulnerable to lightning and fire.
P|**Stage 2** P|Spawn 1 - «Virindi Rival», «Hollow Pawn»s, «Corrosive Archer» P|Spawn 2 - «Lugian Launcher» P|Spawn 3 - «Virindi Rival», «Lugian Launcher» P|Spawn 4 - «Hollow Pawn»s, «Lugian Launcher» P|Kill priority: «Lugian Launcher» > «Virindi Rival» > «Hollow Pawn»s L|1|•|Lugians have very high magic resistance. It is recommended all mages use spectral life rares, and then imp and lightning vuln. Missile/Melees should use CS lightning weapons, or a rend.
P|**Stage 3** P|Spawn 1 - «Torment Wisp»s, «Corrosive Archer» P|Spawn 2 - «Torment Wisp»s P|Spawn 3 - «Torment Wisp»s P|Spawn 4 - «Torment Wisp»s, «Corrosive Archer» P|Kill priority: «Corrosive Archer» > «Torment Wisp»s > «Hollow Pawn»s L|1|•|Wisps should be imperiled and pierce vuled (slash does comparable damage). Melees and archers should us a slash or pierce AR weapon. L|1|•|Adding an acid vuln to increase summoned pets' effectiveness is recommended.
P|**Stage 4** P|Spawn 1 - «Lugian Launcher», «Corrosive Archer» P|Spawn 2 - «Tracking Fireball», «Vicious Remoran Sapper» P|Spawn 3 - «Hollow Pawn»s, «Vicious Remoran Sapper» P|Spawn 4 - «Vicious Remoran Sapper» P|Kill priority: «Vicious Remoran Sapper» > «Virindi Rival» > «Hollow Pawn»s L|1|•|Do not stand in SW corner as a group of remoran spawns there. L|1|•|Remoran stand still and chain-cast war spells. Bring lots of dispell gems for this room. L|1|•|Remoran should NOT be vuled; they should be imperiled. L|1|•|Melee/Missiles should use a blunt or fire rend. Mages should focus on imperils, and then use arcs (void) or TuskerFists (war).
P|**Stage 5** P|Spawn 1 - «Pike Grievver», «Grievver Darter» P|Kill priority:«Pike Grievver» > «Grievver Darter» L|1|•|Upon entering, your group will be split (at random) between two separate rooms. You will only be able to return to the same room you started in if you die or recall so each group is responsible for clearing their own room. L|1|•|Grievvers should be imperiled and slash vulned. Melee/Missiles should use a slash Armor Rending weapon. War mages should use CS slash. L|1|•|The door is triggered by killing all of the «Pike Grievvers» in each room. When a «Pike Grievver» dies two «Grievver Darters» spawn. You can ignore them. L|1|•|The room is small, and has a central column. Flame waves shoot along the outer edges of the room so don't stand there.
P|**Stage 6** P|Spawn 1 - «Vibrant Shadow», «Virindi Rival» P|Spawn 2 - «Vibrant Shadow», «Virindi Rival» P|Spawn 3 - «Vibrant Shadow», «Virindi Rival» P|Spawn 4 - «Hollow Pawn»s, «Vibrant Shadow», «Virindi Rival» P|Kill priority: «Vibrant Shadow» > «Virindi Rival» L|1|•|Void mages should focus on the shadows using slayer the whole time. L|1|•|Shadows should not be imperiled or vuled as they counter protect. Even so, all damage types besides nether and offensive life magic appear to do little damage. L|1|•|War mages, melees and archers should kill the Virindi and Hollows, then use sladow slayers wands and offensive life magic on the shadows.
P|**Stage 7** P|Spawn 1 - «Mukkir Predator», «Ruuk Ranger» P|Spawn 2 - «Mukkir Predator», «Guruk Grunt» P|Spawn 3 - 2 «Guruk Grunt»s, 2 «Ruuk Ranger» P|Spawn 4 - 2 «Guruk Grunt»s, 2 «Ruuk Ranger» P|Kill priority: «Mukkir Predator» > «Ruuk Ranger» > «Guruk Grunt» L|1|•|Guruk Grunts are resistant to all damage unless they become vulnerable, which appears to occur at random. A level up animation plays, and there is a green chat message. Everyone should switch on them at this point and ignore other spawns. L|1|•|Guruk Ruuk cast a high damage bludge volley (forward cone attack). It does 250-300 damage. A level up animation is played, and there is a chat warning when this occurs. L|1|•|Void mages should focus on the burun at all times, Ruuk until Guruk becomes vulnerable and then switch to Guruk. Use burun slayer and nether blast. L|1|•|Burun are immune to life vulns and destructive curse. L|1|•|Non-mages should use Burun slayer wands and offensive life magic (tugaks and hecatombs) on the burun, which have no magic resistance when vulnerable. War mages should use Soul Bound (or another rend). Void mages should also use Burun Slayer wands with void blasts/rings/arcs. L|1|•|Due to extremely high health (~150k) the burun take a very long time to kill. Unclear if there's a better strategy.
P|**Stage 8** P|Spawn 1 - «Crazed Olthoi», «Hollow Pawn»s P|Spawn 2 - «Crazed Olthoi» P|Spawn 3 - «Crazed Olthoi» P|Spawn 4 - «Crazed Olthoi», Virindi P|Kill priority: «Crazed Olthoi» > «Hollow Pawn» L|1|•|Mages should Imperil and bludge vuln all olthoi. Melee/Missile should us CS blunt weapons L|1|•|All magics do very little damage, and should focus on imperil/vulns and the virindi/hollows.
P|**Stage 9** P|Spawn 1 - «Tusker Heaver»s P|Spawn 2 - «Tusker Heaver»s, 1 «Tundra Tusker», 2 «Defensive Crystal»s P|Spawn 3 - 2 «Tundra Tusker»s, 2 «Defensive Crystal»s P|Spawn 4 - 4 «Tundra Tusker»s, 2 «Defensive Crystal»s P|Kill priority: «Tundra Tusker» > «Crystal Shard» > «Tusker Heaver» L|1|•|Crystal Shards have 50k HP and cannot be Tusker Fisted L|1|•|Tundra Tuskers are vulnerable to void and offensive life magic. All chars should focus on them until they're all dead before killing the Crystal Shards and/or Baby Snow Tuckers.
P|**Stage 10** P|Spawn 1 - «Stinging Armoredillo»s P|Spawn 2 - «Stinging Armoredillo»s P|Kill priority: «Stinging Armoredillo»s L|1|•|Armordillos have extremely high magic resistance. A spectral life magic rare is recommended for all non archer/melees who should focus all their effort into landing an imperil L|1|•|Armordillos appear to have a shield-like effect when being hit in the front. Arranging your fellow so half of your archers/melees are always hitting them in the back is recommended.
P|**Stage 11** P|Spawn 1 - «Wight Sage»s P|Spawn 2 - «Wight Sage»s P|Spawn 3 - «Wight Sage»s, «Vibrant Shadow»s P|Spawn 2 - «Wight Sage»s, «Vibrant Shadow»s, «Stinging Armoredillo»s, «Lugian Launcher»s, «Torment Wisps» P|Kill Priority: «Lugian Launcher»s > «Torment Wisp»s > «Vibrant Shadow»s > «Stinging Armoredillo»s > «Wight Sage»s L|1|•|Wight Sages have low-AL shields L|1|•|Armordillos have extremely high magic resistance. A spectral life magic rare is recommended for all non archer/melees who should focus all their effort into landing an imperil L|1|•|Armordillos appear to have a shield-like effect when being hit in the front. Arranging your fellow so half of your archers/melees are always hitting them in the back is recommended.
P|**Stage 12** P|Spawn 1 - «Blade Lieutenant»s P|Spawn 2 - «Blade Lieutenant»s, «Blade Captain»s P|Spawn 3 - «Blade Captain»s, «Blade Champion»s P|Spawn 4 - «Blade Captain»s, «Blade Champion»s, «Crazed Olthoi» «Vicious Remoran Sapper», «Guruk Grunt», «Ruuk Ranger», «Tumerok Savage» P|Kill priotity: «Blade Lieutenant»s > «Blade Captain»s > «Blade Champion»s

Quest.name: Olthoi_Weapons_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|See walkthrough I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Due to events surrounding the «Ancient Olthoi Queen», Olthoi activity on mainland Dereth increased greatly. Previously undiscovered deeper catacombs appeared ins everal of the older Olthoi dungeons, and these deeper catacombs all connected to an even deeper dungeon, the «Catacombs of Opposition». Elysa sent scouts to investigate these new tunnels, and the scouts left notes behind for adventurers to find. In the deepest catacombs a group of Isparian Olthoi fighters were found, having been cut off from the outside world since the days of «The One Queen». These fighters were adept at crafting weapons from the remains of Olthoi.
P|**Note:** It will take two runs to get all the stamps. Follow the guide on the first run. On the second run, just collect the three trophies needed to finish the multi-part turn in stamps.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H4|Deeper Catacombs L|1|1.|Enter one of the dungeons below. L|1|2.|Make your way to the end of the dungeon, and enter the Deeper Catacombs. L|1|3.|At the end of the Deeper Catacombs, pick up the «Note from a Scout». L|2|•|Note: For the «Lair of Death», the note is found at the end of the first dungeon, and not in the deeper catacombs. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpOlthoiScoutNote1⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpOlthoiScoutNote2⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpOlthoiScoutNote3⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpOlthoiScoutNote4⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpOlthoiScoutNote5⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpOlthoiScoutNote6⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpOlthoiScoutNote7⟧ L|1|4.|Repeat steps 1 - 3 for any other notes you wish to obtain.
H4|Catacombs of Opposition L|1|1.|From any of the Deeper Catacombs, make your way to the end where you will find an entrance to the «Catacombs of Opposition». L|1|2.|Traverse the dungeon to reach the Olthoi Fighter resistance camp. L|1|3.|Along the way, kill Olthoi and search for special trophies on them that can be handed in to the fighters in return for crafted Olthoi weapons. L|2|•|«Leather Gauntlets» - Purchase before you start quest or found on «Olthoi Soldier»s L|2|•|«Quarter Staff» - Purchase before you start quest or found on «Olthoi Swarm Eviscerator»s L|2|•|«Olthoi Femur»: ⟦PickedUpOlthoiFemur⟧ - found on «Olthoi Soldier» L|2|•|«Olthoi Stab Claw»: ⟦PickedUpOlthoiStabClaw⟧ - found on «Olthoi Guard» L|2|•|«Olthoi Long Claw»: ⟦PickedUpOlthoiLongClaw⟧ - found on «Olthoi Vanquisher» L|2|•|«Olthoi Crest»: No stamp - found on «Olthoi Advance Guard» - Attention: you need 2 «Olthoi Crest» L|1|4.|You can find several «Small Olthoi Grub»s by following the corridor east from «Ripper», take the east passage and follow it all the way to a dead end. L|1|6.|Speak to «Scout Luzumin Abigwei» to receive «A Note from a Scout». L|2|•|⟦GaveOlthoiScoutNote8⟧ L|2|•|**Note:** Don't know why this stamp starts with Gave and not PickedUp. L|1|7.|«Olthoi Acid Katar» : Give «Olthoi Crest» (⟦GaveCrestToNanoc⟧) and «Leather Gauntlets» (⟦GaveLeatherToNanoc⟧) to «Nanoc, Basher of Bugs» to receive your katar and ⟦GotOlthoiKatar⟧ L|2|•|**Note:** The stamps for this turn-in are bugged. L|1|8.|«Olthoi Atlatl» : Give «Olthoi Femur» (⟦GaveFemurToDanta⟧) and «Olthoi Stab Claw» (⟦GaveStabClawToDanta⟧) to «Pincer Danta» to receive your atlatl and ⟦GotOlthoiAtlatl⟧ L|2|•|**Note:** The stamps for this turn-in are bugged. You will only receive the stamp for the first thing you turn in, so you must do this quest twice and on the second turn-in, hand in the item for the stamp you don't have first. L|1|9.|«Acid Olthoi Axe» : Give «Olthoi Crest» (⟦GaveCrestToNarg⟧) and «Quarter Staff» (⟦GaveWoodToNarg⟧) to «Narg» to receive your axe and ⟦GotOlthoiAxe⟧ L|2|•|**Note:** The stamps for this turn-in are bugged. You *must* turn in the Olthoi Crest first and then the Quarter Staff to receive both stamps. If you turn in the Quarter Staff first, you will only receive the stamp for the Olthoi Stab Claw. L|1|10.|«Olthoi Spear» : Give «Olthoi Long Claw» (⟦GotOlthoiSpear⟧) to «Teela» to receive your spear L|1|11.|Bring any notes you have collected to the «Royal Guard (Olthoi Weapons Quest)¦Royal Guard» in «Cragstone» for your «#Rewards¦rewards». H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "Hail, adventurer! There are dire events unfolding beneath the soil of Dereth and Queen Elysa requires your aid in uncovering the details. This is of great import and has delayed the Alliance she has strived to form. The Queen had dispatched scouts to a number of Olthoi lairs but they have gone missing. If you were able to go investigate these lairs you would have the Queen's gratitude."⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "The scouts were ordered to leave documentation of their findings as they progressed- if they have been captured we might yet find these. If you should come upon any documents or notes the scouts had left please bring them to me and I shall reward you."
L|1||Handing in Note from a Scout⸩ ⸨You give Royal Guard Note from a Scout.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "Ah, this is valuable information!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 133,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Royal Guard Note from a Scout.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "Thank you. The Queen will be grateful to know this."⸩ ⸨You've earned 300,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Royal Guard Note from a Scout.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "Thank you, I am anxious to know what is happening down there."⸩ ⸨You've earned 800,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Royal Guard Note from a Scout.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "Thank you. With correct information perhaps we may yet counter this menace."⸩ ⸨You've earned 1,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Royal Guard Note from a Scout.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "Thank you. This is indeed a note from one of the scouts!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 1,200,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Royal Guard Note from a Scout.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "The Queen will much appreciate having this information!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,500,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Royal Guard Note from a Scout.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "Ah yes! This is a note from one of the scouts!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 3,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Royal Guard A Note from a Scout.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "Thank you. Knowledge is strength, ignorance leads to defeat."⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "This may make the difference."⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,153,202 experience.
L|1||Scout Luzumin Abigwei⸩ ⸨Scout Luzumin Abigwei tells you, "You found us! Did the High Queen send you? We came across this group of Olthoi fighters and decided to stay and help them keep the Olthoi at bay. All the portals in the deepened lairs appeared to lead to these catacombs. Perhaps the Olthoi are re-grouping!"⸩ ⸨Scout Luzumin Abigwei tells you, "Please deliver this note to one of the Queen's Royal Guard."⸩ ⸨Scout Luzumin Abigwei gives you A Note from a Scout.⸩ ⸨Scout Luzumin Abigwei tells you, "I will stay and help fight the Olthoi if you could deliver the note."
L|1||Scout Nytani Strongbow⸩ ⸨Scout Nytani Strongbow tells you, "It is fortunate you have arrived. Without help these valiant fighters might be slaughtered after having held out for so many years. The Olthoi seem to be on the move!"
L|1||Scout Tel al-Arat⸩ ⸨Scout Tel al-Arat tells you, "I am pleased to see you. Did you find notes I left on the way? There are Olthoi in tunnels all around us. We have been helping defend this area but we may be overrun soon."
P|Olthoi Fighters
L|1||Rat Nose⸩ ⸨The big man does not speak, only looks at you with eyes that seem no longer human.⸩ ⸨Rat Nose tells you, "Hey, they call me Rat Nose. Because I bit off a rat's nose once. None of your business, but I was hungry if ya must know. Or maybe I just wanted to. Anyway, I'm glad ya brought weapons."⸩ ⸨Rat Nose says, "Breed all ya want ya bugs. We'll kill more! Oo hah!"
L|1||Narg⸩ ⸨Narg tells you, "We been here for years fightin' off the bugs. We kills 'em when they sleep sometimes. And sometimes they does the same to us."⸩ ⸨Narg tells you, "Hey, ya bring me a Olthoi crest and I make ya a fine axe. Nothin' busts bug shell like bug shell, I always say. Need some wood too though, and that's rare here. An old quarterstaff might do if ya got one. A plain, old wood quarterstaff."
L|1||Handing in Olthoi Crest⸩ ⸨You give Narg Olthoi Crest.⸩ ⸨Narg tells you, "Yeah this should do but I still need a quarterstaff, if ya take my meaning."⸩ ⸨You give Narg Quarter Staff.⸩ ⸨Narg tells you, "Yeah this is good. I'll cut it down. I get to keep the rest, see?"⸩ ⸨Narg fashions an axe from the materials. It is crude but sharp.⸩ ⸨Narg gives you Acid Olthoi Axe.⸩ ⸨Narg tells you, "I already made ya a axe. Why you not out there kickin' chitin an' takin' claws?"
L|1||Teela⸩ ⸨Teela tells you, "Well, honey, it sure is nice to know there's others fighting the Olthoi with us here. Can you really kill 'em with that? I use a nice spear myself. Goes through bug shell like butter. Of course, it's been years since I've tasted butter... Get me a bug's long claw and I might make you one. Make sure the long claw is nice and pointy. And freshly killed."
L|1||Handing in Olthoi Long Claw⸩ ⸨You give Teela Olthoi Long Claw.⸩ ⸨Teela tells you, "This should work."⸩ ⸨Teela makes a spear out of the Olthoi long claw.⸩ ⸨Teela gives you Olthoi Spear.
L|1||Nanoc⸩ ⸨Nanoc, Basher of Bugs tells you, "I smash bug. You need something smash bug with? Give bug crest to Nanoc. Give leather gauntlet too. Nanoc need leather. I make something you punch bug with. Punch bug dead, bam!"
L|1||Handing in Olthoi Long Claw⸩ ⸨You give Nanoc, Basher of Bugs Olthoi Crest.⸩ ⸨Nanoc, Basher of Bugs tells you, "Good crest. You go bash bug, make Nanoc happy."⸩ ⸨Nanoc fashions a crude yet effective katar.⸩ ⸨Nanoc, Basher of Bugs gives you Olthoi Acid Katar.⸩ ⸨Nanoc, Basher of Bugs tells you, "You punching bug? Punch bug or Nanoc mad."
L|1||Pincer Danta⸩ ⸨Pincer Danta tells you, "Hi, I'm Pincer Danta. Glad someone finally came to help us. We got us a nice place here. Want to see my pincer collection? Every time the bugs come and try to take 'em back I get more."⸩ ⸨Pincer Danta tells you, "I made a nice atlatl out of pincers. Seeing as how you're here fighting the bugs with us, if you get me a bug's stabbing claw I could carve it into an atlatl for you. Also need an Olthoi femur. That's the top part of the leg, in case you don't know. You been around Olthoi as much as us, you get to know a lot about 'em. Femur and a stabbing claw, that's what I
L|1||Handing in Olthoi Stab Claw⸩ ⸨Pincer Danta tells you, "Say, got any grub bites?"⸩ ⸨You give Pincer Danta Olthoi Stab Claw.⸩ ⸨Pincer Danta tells you, "You found a stabbing claw. Maybe you outsiders aren't so dumb after all. I'll need a femur too, like I said..."⸩ ⸨You give Pincer Danta Olthoi Femur.⸩ ⸨Pincer Danta tells you, "This should work."⸩ ⸨Pincer Danta fashions an atlatl from the materials you gave her.⸩ ⸨Pincer Danta gives you Olthoi Atlatl.⸩ ⸨You give Pincer Danta Small Olthoi Grub.⸩ ⸨Pincer Danta turns the grub inside out and prepares a delicacy with practiced skill.⸩ ⸨Pincer Danta gives you Grub Bite.⸩ ⸨Pincer Danta tells you, "Want a grub bite? They're tasty and about all we get to eat. Okay, maybe not so tasty."
L|1||Mandible⸩ ⸨Mandible tells you, "Yeah that's right we tear 'em up. Never did find no way outa here though. Portal disappeared, got us trapped way back when. We got good at fightin' the bugs. There's more of the bugs now, though. Guess you got down here in your fancy armor. Well, maybe you ain't leavin' either. Maybe we ain't leavin' too. Kinda cozy down here."⸩ ⸨Mandible tells you, "Ooo hah! I love the smell of burnin' chitin in the morning. But down here ya never know when it's morning."⸩ ⸨Mandible tells you, "Yeah, I'm tough but I sure like to eat grub bites. Nothin' better than grub bites. 'cept maybe the foot races we used to have back home. Those was fun. Here we just run from bugs. But then we turn and ambush 'em. Yeah that's right we tear 'em up."

Quest.name: Castle_of_Lord_Mhoire_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|125 I|Rec. Level|200 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Shade of Antemy» I|Starts At|«Mhoire Castle» I|Route|«Graveyard» at 64.6S, 44.1W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Mhoire Castle» H2|Overview P|Access to the floating «Mhoire Castle» has finally been achieved. Secure the wards of three guardians in «Graveyard» before entering the castle to complete several trials, after which you are able to enter the Great Hall and confront the «Shade of Lord Rytheran».
L|1|•|This guide breaks down each trial individually (by tower). If you have completed the quest more than once, you can do each of the trials in any order you choose. L|1|•|There are additional miniquests inside the castle that can be carried out while doing the trials. L|2|•|«Noble Remains Kill Task» L|2|•|«Guardian Statue Kill Task» L|2|•|«Spectral Fountain Quest» L|2|•|«Oubliette of Mhoire Castle Quest»
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|Complete «Guardians of Mhoire Castle».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Entering the Castle L|1|1.|Use west gargoyle statue at 64.6S 44.1W to summon the portal to Mhoire Castle. L|1|2.|The portal will drop you in the ruins of Mhoire Castle up on the hill. There are various portals around the ruins which go to the different towers of the castle. L|2|•|Note: For first timers, the only portal which works is the northeast tower portal. Once you've completed the quest for the first time, you can use the individual portals around the castle to access each tower trial quickly. L|1|3.|Enter the northeast tower and speak with «Shade of Antemy». He assigns you three trials to complete, one in each of the remaining three towers. L|2|•|⟦CleansingTheThroneStart_1209⟧ L|1|4.|{OPT} Speak to the «Shade of Fordroth» and the «Shade of Ormend» to flag for two additional kill tasks. L|2|•|⟦StartedOublietteBoss_0112⟧ L|2|•|⟦KillTaskGuardianStatue⟧
H3|Part 1: The Trials H4|Southeast Tower - Flames of Courage L|1|1.|{OPT} If you plan on using a flame protection rare, it is recommended to complete the Southeast and Southwest trials together, so you can benefit from the rare in both trials. L|1|2.|From the Northeast tower drop, stick left until you reach a large room; take the SE corner door then stick left into through to another large room; take the NW door then stick left to the first test. L|1|3.|Talk to the «Guardian of Mhoire» statue in the middle of the room to receive a «Mhoire Sword of Courage». L|2|•|⟦mhoireSEgotsword⟧ L|2|•|Note: The room filled with «Flame Guardian»s and high damage «Flaming Skull»s. If you get hit by one, heal immediately as a 2nd hit will likely kill you. L|2|•|{TIP} Watch the patterns and you can avoid most «Flaming Skull»s. L|2|•|{TIP} If you use an «Inferno's Jewel» (flame protection rare), the Flaming Skulls will not harm you at all. L|1|4.|Once you've received the sword, kill 10 «Flame Guardian»s and loot a «Crystallized Blue Flame» from each of their corpses. L|2|•|Note: The corpses (indicated by a yellow dot on the map) only last 1 to 3 seconds, so you must loot after each kill. L|1|5.|Once you've collected 10 flames, speak to the Guardian of Mhoire Statue to complete the trial. L|2|•|⟦mhoireSEportalflag⟧ L|2|•|⟦mhoireSEpass⟧
H4|Northwest Tower - Rite of Wisdom L|1|1.|From the northeast tower drop, stick left to a large room and take the NW door then stick left through to another large room; take the SE door and stick left to the next test. L|1|2.|For this test you will be harassed by several «Guardian Statue»s that respawn as fast as you can kill them. They spam war magic, so you will need to be quick or have someone else heal you while you solve the puzzle. L|1|3.|Talk to the «Guardian of Mhoire» statue in the middle of the room to receive a block of green text similar to the following (**Each clue is different**): L|2|•|⟦mhoireNWcounter⟧ L|2|•|QB Note 1: One stamp per clue (16 total). Keep using the statue until you have stamped all 16. L|3||⟦mhoireNWe1⟧ ⟦mhoireNWe2⟧ ⟦mhoireNWe3⟧ ⟦mhoireNWe4⟧ L|3||⟦mhoireNWn1⟧ ⟦mhoireNWn2⟧ ⟦mhoireNWn3⟧ ⟦mhoireNWn4⟧ L|3||⟦mhoireNWs1⟧ ⟦mhoireNWs2⟧ ⟦mhoireNWs3⟧ ⟦mhoireNWs4⟧ L|3||⟦mhoireNWw1⟧ ⟦mhoireNWw2⟧ ⟦mhoireNWw3⟧ ⟦mhoireNWw4⟧ L|2|•|QB Note 2: There is a fail stamp. Fail an attempt then use statue for a new set of clues. L|3|•|⟦mhoireNWfail⟧ L|2||DJZZKKE FBKV PTJ EKZCABKN MTNK KLZB OJLNE CV TNEKN CD PTJN ZBTNK XBK WCNDX XTJZB FCVED FBKNK WLMZTVD **DTLN** - Air (West) XBK VKUX BKLN ZNLDBCVO FLHKD TV **DBTNK** - Water (South) XBK XBCNE DKKQ ELIZCVO WMLIKD XBLX **NTLN** - Fire (North) XBK MLDX WCVE DXNTVOKDX ITJVXLCV **ZTNK** - Earth (East) RLVCDBIKVX WTN L ZBTCZK ITDX ATTN DJZZKDD LVE XBKV C ILNQ XBK ETTN L|1|4.|Use each of the four stationary statues located around the room that correspond with the clues above. L|2|•|{WARN} You must use the statues in the order that you read them in your clue. If you use the statues out of order (you will be portaled to the start), or run out of time, simply talk to the statue again and you will be given a new order and the task starts over. L|2|•|{OPT} After receiving your clue, run to the side hallway so you can safely identify the order of the statues you need to use. L|2|1.|«Guardian of Fire» is the **North** statue. L|2|2.|«Guardian of Water» is the **South** statue. L|2|3.|«Guardian of Earth» is the **East** statue. L|2|4.|«Guardian of Air» is the **West** statue. L|1|5.|If you use all 4 statues in the correct order, you will receive a message stating that you have completed the task, and been awarded the title reward. L|2|•|⟦mhoireNWpass⟧ L|2|•|⟦mhoireNWportalflag⟧
H4|Southwest Tower - Flames of Virtue L|1|1.|From the drop of the northeast tower, stick left to a large room and take the NW door. From here, stick left to another large room; use the SW door then stick left to another large room. Finally, take the NE door and stick left to find the third test. L|1|2.|You will enter a room with high damage «Flaming Skull»s (similar to the Southeast tower). These skulls can one or two hit you, so be careful to avoid them! L|2|•|{OPT} If you use an «Inferno's Jewel» (flame protection rare), you can avoid taking damage from the skulls. L|1|3.|Talk to the «Guardian of Mhoire» statue in the middle of the room to receive a «Mhoire Sword of Virtue», and a green message dictating which flame to drop it in. L|2|•|QB Note: There seems to be a total of 8 patterns and each one has a corresponding stamp. L|3||You can fail the test and restart until you stamp all 8. It's random so could take some time to stamp all 8. L|3||⟦mhoireSWflame1⟧ L|3||⟦mhoireSWflame2⟧ L|3||⟦mhoireSWflame3⟧ L|3||⟦mhoireSWflame4⟧ L|3||⟦mhoireSWflame5⟧ L|3||⟦mhoireSWflame6⟧ L|3||⟦mhoireSWflame7⟧ L|3||⟦mhoireSWflame8⟧ L|2|•|Note: The map (see right) shows the names and locations of the flames. L|1|4.|Drop the sword into the flame that corresponds with the message you received. If you're correct, you'll receive yet another message, indicating where to drop the sword next. L|2|•|Note: It is possible to receive the same statue twice in a row. L|2|•|⟦mhoireSWcounter⟧ L|1|5.|Once you've dropped the sword into a number of correct flames, you will receive a message telling you to bring the sword back to the Guardian of Mhoire statue. **Talk** to the Guardian to complete the trial. L|2|•|Note: If you hand the sword to the wrong statue, simply speak with the Guardian of Mhoire again to get a new sword and start again. L|1|6.|Return the sword to the Guardian of Mhoire, and if you've done the test correctly, you will receive a message indicating you have passed the test and been awarded the title reward. L|2|•|⟦mhoireSWportalflag⟧ L|2|•|⟦mhoireSWpass⟧
H3|Part 2: The Great Hall - Cleansing the Throne L|1|1.|Talk to the «Shade of Antemy» at the northeast tower drop to flag for the Mhoire Castle Great Hall Portal (across the room from him). L|2|•|⟦MhoireGreatHall⟧ L|2|•|⟦MhoireTrialsComplete⟧ L|1|2.|Enter the Mhoire Castle Great Hall Portal and you'll be in a series of rooms with various doors. Take the following: L|2|1.|South double door L|2|2.|NE double door L|2|3.|East then North corner L|2|4.|NW double door L|2|5.|NW double door L|2|6.|North then West corner (killable doors) L|2|7.|SW double door L|2|8.|Head south through the double door (killable doors), and enter the Mhoire Throne Room L|1|3.|Use the «Ancient Throne» to spawn the «Shade of Lord Rytheran» and a horde of his «Wight»s. L|2|•|⟦UsedMhoireThrone⟧ L|1|4.|Each person in your group must loot a «Rytheran's Jeweled Ring» (drops 9) from his corpse. L|2|•|⟦RytheranJeweledRingPickup⟧ L|2|•|Note: For ranged characters this is solo-able, use the Throne and hop onto a pillar. L|2|•|{OPT} The Shade of Lord Rytheran (Undead, weak to fire/acid/pierceSB) will spawn along with numerous GY creatures. The various GY creatures will respawn reather quickly in the spot they are killed. Make use of doors in the vicinity as you see appropriate. L|1|5.|Head back to the Northeast tower and speak to the «Shade of Antemy» to receive your rewards. L|2|•|NOTE: If you are doing this for Paragon Weapon quest DO NOT talk to Antemy as he will take Rytheran's Ring. L|2|•|⟦CleansingTheThroneWaiting_1209⟧ L|1|6.|Use the keys in the the legendary chest room located with the «Sealed Treasury Vault»s beyond the Mhoire Throne Room. You must go back to the Great Hall and beyond the throne to use the keys. Also note that the legendary chests are in separate rooms for each type of chest (Armor, Weapon, Magic).
P|Notes L|1|•|**Important:** If you die while fighting the «Shade of Lord Rytheran», you will not be able to respawn him on your own. If you speak to the «Shade of Antemy», he will tell you that you must abandon the quest and try again in two weeks, or else go with someone else to spawn him. At this point, your best bet is to get someone else to spawn the boss, and simply loot «Rytheran's Jeweled Ring» when you've killed him. L|1|•|Similar to how ghosts used to not always drop bodies, the same issue seems to be true for the «Flame Guardian»s, when they are winding up to cast and are killed there's no corpse. L|1|•|The ring has a 2 week timer on pickup, but you must complete the three tower trials again before the Shade of Antemy will reward you for repeat runs. That is you can pick up the ring, but if you have not completed the three trials and used the throne, you will not be rewarded by Antemy (you can do the trials and use the throne after picking up the ring if you forget). L|1|•|If you use the «Ancient Throne» but fail to kill Lord Rytheran you can run back (slow respawn), but you cannot activate the Throne to spawn him again. You must either get another character to spawn Lord Rytheran by using the Throne or talk to the Shade of Antemy to reset your quest entirely.

H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|The Colosseum Bosses are located within the «Colosseum». L|1|2.|To access them you must first be flagged by reaching a certain arena in the regular Colosseum. Then simply use their statue to enter their personal chamber. L|1|3.|When you kill the boss and any remaining creatures, a door will appear leading back to the Colosseum drop point. L|1|4.|Colosseum Bosses drop tokens that can be turned in to the «Master Arbitrator» for experience and items.

Quest.name: Dire_Champions
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|100+ I|Type|Solo I|Kill Task|False H2|Quest Overview P|A wide variety of creatures in the «Direlands» have a small chance of spawning a Champion upon death. These champions will always drop a «Dire Champion Token» that can be given to «Aun Javhalrea» south of «Ayan Baqur» (by the «Uziz» portal) for an xp reward. You are given a unique title for each creature type. L|1|•|{WARN} If you are going for the individual dire champion titles/stamps, be sure to gather and turn in one token. L|2||Hunt down a Dire Champion, loot token, and immediately turn it in. If you register a second Dire Champion kill then you will not receive the title. The token will only count toward your total.

Quest.name: Elysa's_Favor_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|20 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Sir Tenshin» «Dame Tsaya» «Sir Rylanan» I|Starts At|32.8S, 73.3E in «Shoushi» 21.0S, 0.8W in «Yaraq» 41.6N, 34.2E in «Holtburg» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|During the «Elements of Revenge» story arc «Martine» attacked the starter towns where new Isparians first land on Dereth. He destroyed all the starting locations except for «Holtburg», «Shoushi», and «Yaraq». In response Queen Elysa increased the defenses at the three remaining towns. In this quest you have to aid the local guards at all three of the towns then attack Martine's base of operations. The plot was to create Simulacrums to infiltrate the Queen's Guard and assassinate «Borelean Strathelar», the Queen's son.
P|The quest can be started in either Holtburg, Shoushi, or Yaraq. The order of the quest varies by where you start it: L|1|•|Shoushi > Yaraq > Holtburg L|1|•|Holtburg > Shoushi > Yaraq L|1|•|Yaraq > Holtburg > Shoushi
P|**Leaftide Quest Bonus**: To get all the stamps you'll need two runs, one total and one partial: L|1|•|**Run 1**: since Shoushi's task is the least difficult, followed by Yaraq, and then Holtburg, that is the order this guide presents. L|1|•|**Run 2**: start in Holtburg, followed by Shoushi (after you add in the note for Shoushi guard you will have all the stamps).
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Shoushi L|1|1.|**Start:** Speak with «Sir Tenshin» at 32.8S, 73.3E, in the «Advocate Tower» near «Shoushi». L|1|2.|**If started in different town:** Give «Sir Rylanan's Letter to Sir Tenshin» to «Sir Tenshin». L|2|•|⟦ShoushiGreetingGiven⟧ L|1|3.|Go to the farm house at 37.4S, 75.5E where the «Ostentatious Farmer» lives and use the trap door in front of the fireplace. You will be portaled into the «Farmer's Basement». L|1|4.|Use the candle on the wall to reveal a passageway behind the fireplace. L|1|5.|Run down to passageway until you come to two rooms with 2 «Swamp Rat»s. L|1|6.|In the room on the left you will find an unlocked Storage Chest with a «Folded Guard's Uniform» and «A Folded Note». The uniform is the item you need to continue the quest. L|2|•|⟦UniformRegicidePickUp⟧ L|2|•|You can can run back to the trap door and use it return to the farm house. There is a candle lever on the other side of the fireplace that opens it from the other side too. L|1|7.|Return to «Sir Tenshin» and hand him the Uniform to receive experience and 3 Golem Hearts. L|2|•|⟦RegicideUniform⟧ L|2|•|⟦ShoushiComplete⟧ L|1|8.|Tenshin will give you will give you «Sir Tenshin's Letter to Dame Tsaya» to take to the next town to continue the quest. L|1|•|**Run 2**:Starting at Holtburg then Shoushi ⟦LetterTsaya2Given⟧
H3|Yaraq L|1|1.|**Start**: talk to «Dame Tsaya» at 21.0S, 0.8W, in the «Advocate Tower» near «Yaraq». L|1|2.|**If started in different town**: Give «Sir Tenshin's Letter to Dame Tsaya» to «Dame Tsaya» L|2|•|⟦YaraqGreetingGiven⟧ L|1|3.|Go to the house at 23.7S, 2.8W where the «Stranger in Town» lives and talk to him. L|2|•|⟦YaraqRegicideBanditGreeting⟧ L|1|4.|Talk to «Dame Tsaya» again. L|2|•|⟦PortalDarklightPermissionGiven⟧ L|1|5.|Go to the «Darkened Halls» at 20.7S, 0.7E L|1|6.|Travel through the Darkened Halls till you reach a room filled with «Hollow Minion (23)¦Hollow Minion»s and a «Captured Adventurer» suspended by energy between 4 pillars. L|1|7.|In the room is a level 30 «Hollow Minion (30)¦Hollow Minion» that drops a «Storage Key» and «An Unsigned Message». L|1|8.|Behind the Captured Adventurer is a «Storage Chest» that you can unlock with the Storage Key. Inside the chest is a «Human Husk». L|2|•|⟦HuskRegicidePickUp⟧ L|2|•|There is a hallway out of the room with the chest that leads right to a surface portal. L|1|9.|Return to «Dame Tsaya» and hand her the Husk to receive experience and 3 Golem Hearts. L|2|•|⟦LetterRylanan2Given⟧ L|2|•|⟦YaraqComplete⟧ L|2|•|⟦RegicideHusk⟧ L|1|10.|Tsaya will give you will give you «Dame Tsaya's Letter to Sir Rylanan» to take to the next town to continue the quest.
H3|Holtburg L|1|1.|**Start**: talk to «Sir Rylanan» at 41.6N, 34.2E, in the «Advocate Tower» near «Holtburg». L|1|2.|**If started in different town**: give «Dame Tsaya's Letter to Sir Rylanan» to «Sir Rylanan». L|2|•|⟦HoltburgGreetingGiven⟧ L|1|3.|Go to the «42.8N, 29.5E - Reformed Bandit's House¦house» at 42.8N 29.5E and kill the «Hollow Minion (23)¦Hollow Minion»s in the basement. One will drop a «A Cryptic Note». L|2|•|⟦NoteRegicideHoltburgPickUp⟧ L|2|•|{OPT} Talk to the «Reformed Bandit» outside the house after you loot the note to watch him portal recall away. L|1|4.|Return the Cryptic Note to Sir Rylanan who will direct you to the «Asuger Temple» at 45.1N, 30.4E. L|2|•|⟦PortalAsugerTemplePermissionGiven⟧ L|1|5.|Make your way through the dungeon until you find «Hollow Minion (23)¦Hollow Minion»s and hallways that are colored red. This means you are near the end. L|1|6.|Kill the level 30 «Hollow Minion (30)¦Hollow Minion» boss and loot the «Storage Key». L|1|7.|Use the key to open the «Storage Chest» and loot the «Glass Spherule». L|2|•|⟦SpheruleRegicidePickUp⟧ L|1|8.|Return to «Sir Rylanan» and hand him the Spherule to get experience and 3 Golem Hearts. L|2|•|⟦RegicideSpherule⟧ L|2|•|⟦LetterTenshin2Given⟧ L|2|•|⟦HoltburgComplete⟧ L|1|9.|Rylanan will give you «Sir Rylanan's Letter to Sir Tenshin» to take to the next town to continue the quest.
H3|Fort Witshire L|1|1.|After you complete the quests for each of the Guards you will return the town where you started. L|1|2.|Give the Guard your last letter and he/she will direct you to «Fort Witshire» and flag you to use the Underground Passage which is really just the «Witshire Dungeon». The Guard will also give you a «Copy of Witshire's Key». L|2|•|From Cragstone, take the Meerthus Square settlement portal at 26.3N, 46.3E and then run north to 25.0N, 37.8E. L|2|•|⟦PortalRegicideWitshirePermissionGiven⟧ L|1|3.|Travel through the Witshire Dungeon until you reach the Fort Witshire Surface Portal. In the dungeon keep going up until you reach a door that leads to an area with red virindi walls. There is a level 29 «Hollow Minion (29)¦Hollow Minion» near the surface portal. L|2|•|{WARN} The drop from the surface portal is very hot with about a half dozen «Hollow Minion»s. L|1|4.|From the drop go to the door of the house in the fort and open it with the key. L|1|5.|Use the trap door in the house to be portaled into the «Hall of Hollows». L|1|6.|Go down through the dungeon until you reach a huge room with a named Hollow Minion: «Dranith Menacet». L|1|7.|Kill Menacet and loot «Menacet's Orders» off his corpse. L|2|•|⟦LetterRegicideMenacetPickUp⟧ L|1|8.|Return to the Guard and give them Menacet's Orders for your reward. L|2|•|⟦RegicideComplete⟧
