We of the Strathelar Guard owe you a great debt for warding off what would have been a terrible tragedy--especially for Elysa and Asheron."⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya gives you Elysa's Favor.⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya gives you Sturdy Iron Key.⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya gives you Sturdy Iron Key.
L|1||Speaking to Dame Tsaya after completing the quest⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya tells you, "You are still remembered well among the Guards. Such service to the crown does not go unnoticed, comrade. There have not been any new developments for me to relate, but come back in a day--I am sure we have not heard the last from Martine."⸩
H3|Starting in Holtburg P|⸨;Sir Sylanan's Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "I've recently been assigned to Holtburg to build a garrision and be on the lookout for suspicious happenings. There is one fellow on the outskirts of town that I've been keeping my eye on. He's just moved here from Marae Lassel and sometimes comes into town for provisions. He says he's been "reformed", but I can spot a bandit when I see one! Townsfolk say they've spotted shady-looking guests coming and going from his house at odd hours. Could you go check on him? His house lies to the northwest of town, past the Holtburg West Training Academy."
L|1||Speaking to Reformed Bandit⸩ ⸨Reformed Bandit tells you, "Greetings, stranger. I've done many things to be ashamed of in the past, but I've come here to make a new start near the fair town of Holtburg. I enjoy the peace and quiet of these parts. Would you mind if I asked you to be on your way? I am entertaining some important guests, and I don't want them to be disturbed."
L|1||Speaking to Reformed Bandit after killing the Hollow Minions⸩ ⸨The "reformed" bandit has an extremely guilty look on his face. He even looks as if he might run for the hills.⸩ ⸨Reformed Bandit tells you, "Look! Behind you! Is that the white bunny?!" P|⸨Reformed Bandit says, "Shurov Thiloi!"⸩ L|1||Portal magic swirls around the Reformed Bandit, who disappears for about one minute.
L|1||Returning to Sir Rylanan⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "You're back! How did your interview with that ex-bandit go? Did you find anything of note in his house?"
L|1||Handing in A Cryptic Note⸩ ⸨You give Sir Rylanan A Cryptic Note.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "You say you found this note in that bandit's house? Surrounded by a pack of Hollow Minions? I knew that fellow was up to no good! Look here...it refers to Asuger Temple, up to the north. Last I heard, the temple was just a Banderling hideout...harmless really. I wonder what sort of trouble might be brewing up there? Find out what is going on, and I'm sure I could find something in the Guard's coffers to reward you with."
L|1||Returing to Sir Rylanan⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "I see you've returned from Asuger Temple in one piece. Did you find anything out of the ordinary while you were there?"
L|1||Handing in Glass Spherule⸩ ⸨You give Sir Rylanan Glass Spherule.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "What a strange object! Perfectly round, and perfectly smooth!"⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan holds the spherule up to the light and stares into the milky glass.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "What substance could possibly be swirling around in there? Looks like portal space energy, doesn't it?"⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan starts to shake the spherule but suddenly thinks better of it.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "I am out of my depth here...the mages of the Arcanum might be able to fathom this object's purpose. I will send it to the Arcanum for analysis."⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "I believe Sir Tenshin would be very interested to hear about your discoveries. He is heading up the garrision down in Shoushi. This letter will serve as your introduction to him--I have chronicled your discoveries, as well as the contents of the note you found earlier."⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan gives you Sir Rylanan's Letter to Sir Tenshin.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "I should now reward you for your aid in investigating this matter."⸩ ⸨You've earned 50,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan gives you Wood Heart.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan gives you Wood Heart.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan gives you Wood Heart.
L|1||Spearing to Sir Rylanan again⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "You have helped me a great deal my friend--have you taken the letter I gave you to Sir Tenshin in Shoushi? He should be updated on what has transpired here."
L|1||Sir Tenshin's Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin tells you, "Greetings. Sir Rylanan mentioned he might be sending updates to me from Holtburg every so often. Might he have sent one with you?"
L|1||Handing in Sir Rylanan's Letter to Sir Tenshin⸩ ⸨You give Sir Tenshin Sir Rylanan's Letter to Sir Tenshin.⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin reads the letter from Sir Rylanan with no small amount of amazement.⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin tells you, "A glass spherule encapulating what looks as if it could be portal space energy? For what purpose? They say that Dereth is full of wonders...but if Hollow Minions are playing around with portal space, no good can come of it. Mark my words..."⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin tells you, "Come to think of it, I've remarked on some suspicious characters lately myself. Perhaps you can help me. There is a farmer who lives a little ways past the Shoushi South Outpost. He's been a normal townsmember for a very long time, but no one can speak for how he's come into so much wealth recently. Normally it's a cause to celebrate when one's neighbor moves up in the world...but why is he acting so distantly when he comes to town to stock up on provisions?"⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin tells you, "Could you go and check in on him? I am sure there is nothing amiss, but I just want to be sure..."
L|1||Ostentatious Farmer (All interactions)⸩ ⸨Ostentatious Farmer tells you, "Welcome to my grand opening! You are welcome to peruse my wares...but please, stay to the front of my shop--the heat from the fire is very strong, and I don't want you to get burned."⸩ ⸨Ostentatious Farmer tells you, "A fine choice. I have recently come into...an inheritance, so I can keep my prices lower than the other shops around town."⸩ ⸨Ostentatious Farmer tells you, "Why, I don't mind if I do. I have plenty of ready cash these days."⸩ ⸨Ostentatious Farmer tells you, "Thank you for your patronage. Now please be on your way, I have much work to do."⸩ ⸨Ostentatious Farmer tells you, "How dare you nose around my house, when I expressely asked you not to? Ok, you can buy something, but after that, get out, GET OUT!"⸩ ⸨Ostentatious Farmer tells you, "Yes, that's a good one. Take one, take them all, just hurry up with your shopping and leave my shop!"⸩ ⸨Ostentatious Farmer tells you, "Alright, alright, alright! Give it to me and get the dickens out of my shop!"⸩ ⸨Ostentatious Farmer tells you, "Like I said, LEAVE! GO! OUT! NOW!"
L|1||Returning to Sir Tenshin⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin tells you, "There you are! Have you found out what that farmer's secret is? Let me know if he's been hoarding anything that could be considered...unusual in his house."
L|1||Handing in A Folded Note⸩ ⸨You give Sir Tenshin A Folded Note.⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin tells you, "My instincts were correct. I wonder who his new patron is? Here, you may have this back. I have already committed it to memory."⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin gives you A Folded Note.
L|1||Handing in Folded Guard's Uniform⸩ ⸨You give Sir Tenshin Folded Guard's Uniform.⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin tells you, "You say you found this Guard's uniform in a hidden room in the farmer's basement? What's more, he had many of them? And he's stockpiling a large armament as well?"⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin tells you, "How could he have found access to these uniforms? These are the sole property of Her Majesty's Guard--and are dispensed only through our headquarters. They must have been stolen whilst our quartermaster was in his cups...I will alert our Queen of this affair immediately."⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin tells you, "I believe Dame Tsaya in Yaraq should be alerted to this affair as well. Please take this letter to her--I have included your recent discoveries. I'm sure she will be highly interested to hear of what you have found."⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin gives you Sir Tenshin's Letter to Dame Tsaya.⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin tells you, "Thank you for your help--here is your reward."⸩ ⸨You've earned 100,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin gives you Copper Heart.⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin gives you Copper Heart.⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin gives you Copper Heart.
L|1||Speaking to Sir Tenshin again⸩ ⸨Sir Tenshin tells you, "Good to see you again! Have you taken my letter to Dame Tsaya yet? I think that she really ought to be informed of your discoveries here."
L|1||Dame Tsaya's Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya tells you, "I am mentoring Sir Tenshin in the responsibilities that come with being the leader of an important garrison. Did he send any letters for me along with you? I do like to keep track of his progress."
L|1||Handing in Sir Tenshin's Letter to Dame Tsaya⸩ ⸨You give Dame Tsaya Sir Tenshin's Letter to Dame Tsaya.⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya quickly glances over the letter from her comrade in Shoushi.⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya tells you, "What a disappointing happenstance. Not only has a farmer been allowed to stockpile an arsenal in his basement, but he is concealing stolen Guards uniforms as well? And Rylanan is having his own share of suspicious behavior up in Holtburg too...I wonder what trouble could be brewing now?"⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya tells you, "Nonetheless, perhaps you could aid me as well. Queen Elysa recently appointed me to lead the garrison here in Yaraq. She was deeply grieved when the 12 Training Halls were destroyed and wants to ensure that no harm will come to her subjects here."⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya tells you, "To that end, I have a small task for you: We have heard that a newcomer to this town has moved into a villa that has lain abandoned for many years. No one knows where he came from, although it is said he speaks with a Northern accent. Would you stop by his residence, and find out more about him? He lives to the east, past Lubziklan al-Luq's house."
L|1||Speaking to Stranger in Town⸩ ⸨Stranger in Town tells you, "Greetings, my friend, greetings! Welcome to my humble home. The hurly-burly of Marae Lassel proved too much for me, so I've decided to move here and call Yaraq home. Blend in. Make some friends among the peaceful townsfolk. In fact, I've made a good friend over in the Darkened Halls. He's recently moved here too. Why don't you pay him a visit as well? I'm sure he'd be happy to meet you and make you feel right at home."
L|1||Returning to Dame Tsaya⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya tells you, "The stranger actually asked you to visit his new "friend" down in the Darkened Halls? That dismal place has always been just the lair of some lowly Drudges, to my knowledge...perhaps you should investigate this matter. If you find anything out of the ordinary, I'd appreciate it if you brought it to me for inspection. Something just doesn't sound quite right."
L|1||Returning to Dame Tsaya⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya turns to you gravely.⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya tells you, "Yes, what did you discover up in the Darkened Halls?"
L|1||Handing in An Unsigned Message⸩ ⸨You give Dame Tsaya An Unsigned Message.⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya tells you, "What's this? Planting? Crops? Harvest? Old Man Witshire had a farm? This requires more thought. Here, you should keep this, I have already memorized it."⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya gives you An Unsigned Message.
L|1||Handing in Human Husk⸩ ⸨You give Dame Tsaya Human Husk.⸩ ⸨Appalled, Dame Tsaya gingerly handles the human husk and covers it with a linen cloth.⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya tells you, "You found this in the Darkened Halls? Poor soul. I can only wonder what he went through in his last tortures. What dark intent could spur the Hollow Minions into committing such an atrocity? No wonder that stranger asked you so nicely to visit his comrades in those Halls--he must have been seeded here to send weak, innocent victims to their deaths--luckily he failed in taking your measure. I must write Sir Rylanan immediately and alert him to the crimes being committed here."⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya tells you, "Please take this letter to Sir Rylanan in Holtburg. He must know immediately of the terrible crimes that are being committed here in Yaraq."⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya gives you Dame Tsaya's Letter to Sir Rylanan.⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya tells you, "I must now reward you for your discoveries here today."⸩ ⸨You've earned 200,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya gives you Obsidian Heart.⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya gives you Obsidian Heart.⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya gives you Obsidian Heart.
L|1||Speaking to Dame Tsaya again⸩ ⸨Dame Tsaya tells you, "Thank you for your assistance in this matter, my friend. If you haven't already, you should take the letter I gave you to Sir Rylanan in Holtburg. What I learned today worries me a great deal. I fear for the people of this peaceful town, now I know what lies up in the hills of Yaraq..."
L|1||Sir Rylanan Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "I see you've just come over from Yaraq. Did Dame Tsaya send a letter with you? She has always been so good about updating her reports."
L|1||Handing in Sir Rylanan's Letter to Sir Tenshin⸩ ⸨You give Sir Rylanan Dame Tsaya's Letter to Sir Rylanan.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan reads the letter from Dame Tsaya with great interest and growing concern.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "I think I am beginning to discern a pattern here. The Hollow Minions are creating their Simulacra by inflating these human husks they've been collecting with concentrated portal space energy..."⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan shudders and continues.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "And they've been paying that ridiculous farmer down in Shoushi to stockpile an arsenal of stolen Guards uniforms and weapons...they must have a plan to garb these new Simulacra in our uniforms to infiltrate our ranks. Could they be making a gambit to reach our Queen? Those miscreants! But where could their headquarters be?"⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan thinks for a moment.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "You know...Fort Witshire has been abandoned for quite some time now, but our scouts have found that a group of Hollow Minions have claimed it and barricaded themselves inside so no one may enter. I'll bet you that's where they are."⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "We know that Fort Witshire was built on the ruins of an old Empyrean prison and prepared the portal beside me to penetrate the fort by using the underground passages underneath. You seem like just the person to help us with this. You may need this key once you enter Fort Witshire--it was found among Witshire's effects after he left the fort. Find out what those Hollow Minions are up to, the kingdom is in danger!"⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan gives you Copy of Witshire's Key.
L|1||Returning to Sir Rylanan⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "Back so soon? Have you infiltrated their plot?"
L|1||Killing Hollow Minion in the Underground Passage⸩ ⸨Hollow Minion tells you, "I may be undone, but my facsimiles will consume your kind!"
L|1||Killing Dranith Menacet⸩ ⸨As Dranith Menacet's dying sighs fade into the stillness, a crumpled note, worn and creased from many readings, tumbles from his broken frame.
L|1||Returning to Sir Rylanan⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "You are safely back from Fort Witshire, I see! Were my suspicions correct? Did you find any more clues to this plot?"
L|1||Handing in Menacet's Orders⸩ ⸨You give Sir Rylanan Menacet's Orders.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan unfolds the note and reads it carefully.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "So...this was all a plot to kill our Queen's son--through us, her own Guards! We, who have sworn to protect her heir! I hope you gave those evil doers a good thrashing! Martine will pay for this some day! Let me reward you--you have done the kingdom of New Aluvia a great service on this day. We owe you a debt of gratitude."⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan gives you Elysa's Favor.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan gives you Sturdy Iron Key.⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan gives you Sturdy Iron Key.
L|1||Speaking to Sir Rylanan after completing the quest⸩ ⸨Sir Rylanan tells you, "Thank you for all your help, traveler. The kingdom is grateful for all you have done. I have not seen anything overly suspicious recently; however, we can never be too sure. Come back in a day--there may be trouble again."⸩

Quest.name: Lady_Aerfalle_Quest
Quest.notes: need to do each level range styles to complete all
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Low & High: 45 Uber: 150 I|Rec. Level|Low: 50 group / 100 solo High: 100 group / 125 solo Uber: 200 I|Type|Fellowship/Solo I|Starts At|«Crater Caves Dungeon» at 66.7N, 12.5E I|Route|«Glenden Wood» to «Highland Manors» portal at 27.9N, 29.5E. Next run to «Crater Pathway» at 60.6N 15.7E and take all paths up to the surface portal. I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
L|1|•|{WARN} Only Uber version gives Enlightened Coins and Enlightenment Tokens. L|1|•|There are three versions of this quest: L|2|•|Low: Defeat «Aerfalle's Weakened Apprentice» in «Aerfalle Keep». This most closely resembles the original difficulty of the quest. L|2|•|High: Defeat «Aerfalle's Apprentice» in «Aerfalle Keep». This has an increased difficulty for the final room. L|2|•|Uber: Defeat «Lady Aerfalle (730 Creature)¦Lady Aerfalle» in «Aerfalle's Sanctum». This is an additional dungeon beyond the original quest for higher level characters. L|1|•|If leading a group, the first portions of the quest can be completed solo. Everyone must be present when the Relic Watchman is killed to enter Aerfalle's Keep. L|1|•|There is a separate 20 hour timer for the each chest key so you can do the different versions without having to wait out the timer. L|1|•|Lockpick is required inside Aerfalle Keep.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Preparation P|These steps can be done alone or with a smaller group, there are no rewards and participation is not essential to being a part of the later sections of this quest. L|1|1.|At the bottom of the «Crater Caves Dungeon» near the forges, take the «Pyreal Forge Bellows» laying on the ground. L|1|2.|Travel to «Aerlinthe» island by handing a D Note to «Garaena the Emissary» at 87.6S, 65.6W, just East of «Candeth Keep». L|2|•|Note: You can also hand a C Note to «Faladha the Emissary», an undead NPC located inside «Chalicmere Castle» or use the «Aerlinthe Recall» spell if you have completed the Lady Aerfalle quest before. L|1|3.|From «Aerlinthe Island», follow the inner harbor beach around to the harbor's northwest corner (87.7N 44.4E). Go due west up the slope to 88.0N 43.4E then follow the ledge that wraps around the mountain to the north and enter the «Tenkarrdun Foundry» at 88.8N 42.8E. L|1|4.|Retrieve the «Sluice Gate Bar» from the Foundry. **«Lockpick» is required**. L|2|•|Note 1: See «#Maps¦map» for location of the «Sluice Gate Bar». L|2|•|Note 2: You can take any surface portal to exit the dungeon with the bar, however one portal in particular drops at 88.6N 42.4E, near your next destination (see «#Maps¦map» for portal's location). L|1|5.|Run to the «Aerlinthe Reservoir» at 85.5N 43.4E. L|1|6.|On the way down, stop and pick up one «Sacrificial Dagger» if you will be doing the standard/low version of the quest. It is behind a locked door just before you get to the large downward sloping room. Only one person needs to pick up a dagger and if you are doing the high version it is not needed at all. Most people pick it up just in case. L|2|•|⟦GalaeralDagger⟧ L|1|7.|At the bottom of the reservoir behind a locked door (322) is a portal to the «Aerlinthe Lower Reservoir», use this portal. L|1|8.|Run to the bottom of the Lower Reservoir and hand the «Sluice Gate Bar» to the «Repair Golem». If the golem is NOT there, that means the quest is in progress, or someone has killed the watchman within the last 3 hours. L|2|•|Note: There is an important jump near the end, when you come to a shaft facing west. There is a small grate you need to hit or you'll fall to the very bottom of the shaft and there is no way back except running back to the dungeon from Aerlinthe drop. To hit the grate, jump normally towards the SW corner of the shaft, you'll slide down the corner and hit the grate. L|2|•|⟦AerlintheSluice⟧ L|1|9.|Back up onto the ramp next to the «Repair Golem» and jump through the left wall opening to get to the exit portal. This officially starts the quest and causes the «Smithing Golem» to spawn. L|2|•|{OPT} There is an unlocked «runed chest» up the ramps next to the «Repair Golem». L|2|•|⟦ChestQuestUnlockedHighPOIG⟧ L|1|10.|Run back to the «Tenkarrdun Foundry» 88.8N 42.8E. and at the very end give the «Pyreal Forge Bellows» to the «Smithing Golem». Retrace your steps (use floor lever to reopen door) and use the exit portal in the broken bridge room. L|2|•|⟦AerlintheBellows⟧
H3|Part 2: Tenkarrdun and the Relic Town L|1|1.|Handing the bellows to the Smithing Golem causes the «Tenkarrdun Hellfire» to spawn after 5-10 minutes in the Tenkarrdun crater near 90.3N, 46.3E. L|1|2.|Kill the Hellfire and loot a «Red Fire Infusion». L|2|•|⟦RedFireInfusion⟧ L|2|•|{OPT} See **Part 2b** below on how to retrieve the other two infusions. L|1|3.|Go to «Relic Town» at 86.5N, 45.4E with your entire fellowship. L|1|4.|Kill the «Relic Watchman» and loot «Ring of the Watchman». L|1|5.|Upon the death of the Watchman, a portal to «Aerfalle Keep» will appear at 86.4N, 45.4E. L|2|•|{WARN} The portal lasts for 5 minutes. L|1|6.|Use the portal to enter the keep. L|2|•|Note: The watchman normally spawns nearby, but can spawn anywhere in the town. Like the Behemoth, the spawn is random (~10% per minute). So sometimes he appears quickly, but sometimes it takes a while.
H4|(Optional) Part 2b: Retrieving the Sword of Lost Light Infusions and Black Boulder P|Killing the first Hellfire causes the «Relic Watchman» spawn check to begin, and the «Mount Esper Firestorm» to spawn. Killing the Mount Esper Firestorm will then cause the «Mount Lethe Hellfire» to spawn. L|1|•|{WARN} If you do not intend to complete the Lady Aerfalle quest, be sure to go to relic town afterwards to kill the Watchman, this allows the quest to reset properly for the next fellowship.
H5|Red Fire Infusion and Black Boulder L|1|1.|The first infusion is dropped by the «Tenkarrdun Hellfire» that spawns at 90.3N, 46.3E. L|1|2.|Defeat it and loot a «Red Fire Infusion». L|2|•|⟦RedFireInfusion⟧ L|1|3.|Just south of the Hellfire spawn is the spawn spot for the «Behemoth of Tenkarrdun» at 90.0N 46.3E. The spawn is independent so it may or may not be there right away. L|1|4.|Defeat the Behemoth at 90.0N 46.3E. L|1|5.|Loot a «Black Boulder». L|2|•|⟦blackboulder⟧
H5|White Fire Infusion L|1|1.|The «Mount Esper Firestorm» is located at 66.0N 13.0E in the middle of «Crater Lake». L|1|2.|Defeat it and loot a «White Fire Infusion». L|2|•|⟦WhiteFireInfusion⟧
H5|Blue Fire Infusion L|1|1.|The «Mount Lethe Hellfire» is located at 34.4S 84.9W in the middle of the «Mount Lethe» crater. L|1|2.|Defeat it and loot a «Blue Fire Infusion». L|2|•|⟦BlueFireInfusion⟧
H3|Part 3: Aerlinthe Keep and Lady Aerfalle L|1|•|Note 1: Lockpick is required for this part L|1|•|Note 2: In order to get the main rewards everyone needs to be at Relic Town when the portal opens. L|1|•|Note 3: A five minute portal opens upon the death of the «Relic Watchman» that leads to «Aerfalle Keep». Once you take the portal, you have **90 minutes** to complete the quest.
H4|Low Version L|1|1.|Hand the «Sacrificial Dagger» to the «Ghost of Dylaeral» to trigger the low version of Lady Aerfalle. L|1|2.|Kill «Aerfalle's Weakened Apprentice» and loot «Ashen Key». L|2|•|⟦KeyAerfalle⟧ L|1|3.|Use the key to unlock «Lady of Aerlinthe's Chest» located in the earlier room with the levers and «Inferno»s. L|2|•|Token: ⟦AerfalleTokenPickup⟧ L|2|•|Robe: ⟦PalliumObtained⟧ L|2|•|Staff: ⟦AerfalleStaffObtained⟧ L|2|•|Recall: ⟦aercyno⟧ - shared by all three versions
H4|High Version L|1|1.|Head straight to the NE room of «Aerfalle Keep» (high version is the default). L|1|2.|Kill «Aerfalle's Apprentice» and loot «Ornate Ashen Key» and «Sheets of Paper» (optional lore item). L|2|•|⟦KeyAerfalleUber⟧ L|1|3.|Use the key to unlock «Lady of Aerlinthe's Ornate Chest» located in the earlier room with the levers and «Inferno»s. L|2|•|Token: ⟦AerfalleOrnateTokenPickup⟧ L|2|•|Robe: ⟦UberPalliumObtained⟧ L|2|•|Staff: ⟦UberAerfalleStaffObtained⟧
H4|Uber Version L|1|1.|Hand the «Nexus-keyed Mana Shard» to the «Ghost of Galaeral». The shard is located on an altar in the chest rewards room (go down, get shard, backtrack to give shard). L|1|2.|Go down the the NE room of «Aerfalle Keep» where Lady Aerfalle normally appears. There will be a portal to «Aerfalle's Sanctum». Use the portal (it cannot be walked through) to enter the sanctum. L|1|3.|The dungeon is no log, if you log out or disconnect you will be sent to your lifestone and will be unable to rejoin the quest. L|1|4.|The dungeon has several side routes that are dead ends, you want to get to a jump that leads down to a room with «Lady Aerfalle (730 Creature)¦Lady Aerfalle». L|1|5.|Note: Lady Aerfalle is high health and many debuffs. She also counter-vulns and dispells, so you should use rends. L|1|6.|Kill Lady aerfalle and loot an «Embossed Ashen Key» (drops 9), and «Lady Aerfalle's Charm» (drops 9) from her corpse. L|2|•|Note: «Ghost of Galaeral» despawn after 5 min so be sure to turn in right away. L|1|8.|Use the key to unlock «Lady of Aerlinthe's Embossed Chest» behind the Ghost of Galaeral for your rewards. H2|Dialog P|⸨;Giving Sluice Gate Bar to Repair Golem⸩ ⸨You give Repair Golem Sluice Gate Bar.⸩ ⸨The golem turns and fuses the bar into the Sluice Gate. Somewhere below, you feel a grinding vibration through the ground... The fires of Tenkarrdun have been redirected to the ancient Yalaini forges.
L|1||Giving Pyreal Forge Bellows to Smithing Golem⸩ ⸨You give Smithing Golem Pyreal Forge Bellows.⸩ ⸨The golem, obeying ancient directives, turns and ignites the forges. Far below you, a tremor runs through the earth. The decayed machinery groans, shivers, and grinds quickly to a halt. Mount Tenkarrdun has become active again!
L|1||Killing the Tenkarrdun Hellfire⸩ ⸨As smites the Hellfire, the flame-creatures sigh, and begin to disappear back into the vents and fumaroles they surfaced through. But, from the base of the mountain's slopes, you hear the whisper of falling ash, and the clacking of petrified bones...
L|1||Killing the Relic Watchman⸩ ⸨Just before scatters the petrified bones across the ash of the port, it attempts to cast a portal to retreat! The ancient port of Aerlinthe is peaceful again... or at least as peaceful as it ever gets. But now the party has only ninety minutes to find and destroy the Lady of Aerlinthe!
L|1||Ghost of Galaeral⸩ ⸨Ghost of Galaeral tells you, "The songs of my sisters echo across eternity and I am left to rot; bound through the arts of ill-wind taught by sisters who had fallen to the call of the twisted dark. Thousands of years bound against my will to a tether not of my making, bereft of power and ability to purchase a final release, I have waited and watched within the walls of this prison.⸩ ⸨Ghost of Galaeral tells you, "The skein of her life now draws taut as she is stirred to action, re-exerting her command over these halls and drawing on the lives of those she once imprisoned. Through the countless years, most that were bound here against their will have become lost and slipped into madness, the echo of their lives now scattered dust and formless agony. Not I.⸩ ⸨Ghost of Galaeral tells you, "I recall the device, the tool used to pull the blood of my heart into a vessel that held my precious vitae long enough to rip free my soul and lock it within the walls of this keep, evermore a servant to her will. But my years of servitude draw near an end, and through the voices of elder sisters who sang to the deep and refused to sell our secrets to the Dericost, I am given a moment of clarity to find my freedom. Yet the walls ever remain my prison.⸩ ⸨Ghost of Galaeral tells you, "Aerfalle has changed. She has grown her flesh anew and taken the glamour of her youth. But all this imagery is false. She risks more power at the cost of those bound in these halls. My fallen sisters seek not redemption, but through their folly they will give me mine. Aerfalle's strength lies in tunnels long crushed by the weight of time, halls within this keep that you cannot traverse, halls which I can still travel.⸩ ⸨Ghost of Galaeral tells you, "But I cannot lessen her strength without an instrument of sacrifice. The blade that drew my heart's blood must be used to stab at her crusted heart and weaken her strength.⸩ ⸨Ghost of Galaeral tells you, "Bring me the dagger and I shall take my revenge and aid you in her destruction.⸩ ⸨You give Ghost of Galaeral Sacrificial Dagger.⸩ ⸨A haunting voice echoes in the halls of the Keep. "Light is not lost on this world yet. I shall enact my part of this bargain, outlander. Seek vengeance for the countless years, the suffering and the agony of those she has destroyed. Blessings of Ithaenc go with you."
L|1||Defeating Lady Aerfalle⸩ ⸨On far Aerlinthe Island, an intrepid band has found the lair of the Dark Lady Aerfalle, at whose whim the earth itself does shake. But the bold has driven her back into her hidden crypts, and the ground stills... until she next awakens.⸩ ⸨The withered corpse of Aerfalle hisses in rage as it is hewn in twain... "I shall not be sent to a final rest by primitives like thee, !" her severed head says from the stones. "Enjoy this insignificant victory, child. For I have walked this world for over ten millennia, and I shall walk it long hence your little race has returned to the dust that birthed thee!"
L|1||Handing in Ashbane to Leikotha⸩ ⸨You give Leikotha Ashbane⸩ ⸨Leikotha releases a dry, rasping gasp⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Ashbane... mine own sword.⸩ ⸨Leikotha examines her sword, feeling the weight of the blade in her hands⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "I had dropped this on the hill of Ayn Tayan... My rage had so blinded me. Ferah, had played me for the fool...⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Spinning lies in my mind...⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "What I did...⸩ ⸨A sound slowly builds within Leikotha, until finally an unearthly scream emanates from her. You feel the din about to deafen you when the scream stops⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Why... why...⸩ ⸨Leikotha stares silently at the blade of the sword⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "How... where... ai, thy mind tells me that thou has found in one of Aerfalle's caches. Foul magus that she is. I shall reward thee for thy efforts.⸩ ⸨You've earned 13,765,337 experience
L|1||Handing in Aerfalle's Token to Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator⸩ ⸨You give Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator Aerfalle's Token⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi squints as she reads the inscription on the token⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "This seems to be an inscription from Rytheran to Aerfalle, promising his undying love.⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator snickers⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "Undying love indeed...⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "I know people who would be interested in this. Please, allow me to reward you for bringing this to me.⸩ ⸨You've earned 15,000,000 experience

Please, allow me to reward you for bringing this to me.

Quest.name: Geraine's_Hosts
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Rec. Level|200 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Mhoire Soldier (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Soldier» I|Starts At|«Graveyard» at 65.4S, 44.0W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Geraine's Hosts» H2|Overview P|House Mhoire wants to take the offensive against «Geraine».
L|1|•|If your fellowship obtains and hands in all 7 of the hearts within 10 minutes (each heart has a decay timer), the NPC, «Mhoire Lieutenant (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Lieutenant», will spawn in «Wai Jhou». Talking to him rewards you with special titles and a spell buff. L|1|•|The «Mhoire Lieutenant (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Lieutenant» disappears after a 5 day period (increased in «The Risen Princess» to ??).
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You must have completed the «Mhoire Infiltration» quest before you can start this quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak with the «Mhoire Soldier (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Soldier» in the Graveyard recall bunker, right next to the NPC for the Mhoire Infiltration Quest.
H3|Fiery Refuge (Book 1) L|1|1.|From «Singularity Caul», run to the «Fiery Refuge» at 95.3S, 94.1W (located in the «Caulcano»). L|2|•|Note: Dungeon is a hot drop. L|1|2.|From the drop, take the east ramp down, and head south until you reach a room with several floating platforms. Jump onto the platform on your right, then full power shift jump to the nearby platform above you. At that point you should be able to jump fully onto the big ledge to the south. L|1|3.|Use the platforms (shift + jump) to reach the ledge at the top, and continue heading south until you reach Geraine. L|1|4.|Kill Geraine, and loot «Geraine's Tome (1)¦Geraine's Tome» from his corpse. L|2|•|⟦GerainesBodiesBookOne0412⟧ L|2|•|Note: The slayer can also loot «Geraine's Still Beating Heart», which is on a 10 minute expiration timer. L|1|5.|Return Geraine's Tome and Geraine's Still Beating Heart to the «Mhoire Soldier (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Soldier» for your reward. L|2|•|⟦GaveGeraineHeart1⟧ L|1|6.|If you are part of a simultaneous heart turn in go quickly to the «Mhoire Lieutenant (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Lieutenant» in «Wai Jhou» for a title reward (Updated for ILT 8/16/2024 patch-notes) L|1|7.|Each simultaneous stamp is flagged when you hand two of the same heart to the «Mhoire Soldier (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Soldier» within 10 minutes of each other while in a fellow. L|1|8.|The Stamps are only actually given afterwards by the «Mhoire Lieutenant (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Lieutenant» in «Wai Jhou» L|1|9.|I found it simplest to imagine each dungeon as a single quest in a chain. Treat them like they all must be individually completed before you can do the next in the chain L|1|•|⟦Geraineheart2⟧ L|1|•|⟦Geraineheart3⟧ L|1|•|⟦Geraineheart4⟧ L|1|•|⟦Geraineheart5⟧ L|1|•|⟦Geraineheart6⟧ L|1|•|⟦Geraineheart7⟧
H3|Charged Refuge (Book 2) L|1|1.|Enter the «Charged Refuge», located at 86.8S, 10.5E. L|2|•|Route: From «Arwic», take the «Artifice Cottages» portal at 32.9N 59.6E and run to 86.8S, 10.5E. L|2|•|Note: Dungeon is a hot drop. L|1|2.|Hug the left wall until you find a down ramp, which leads to a large room with Geraine inside. L|1|3.|Kill Geraine, and loot «Geraine's Tome (2)¦Geraine's Tome» from his corpse. L|2|•|Note: The slayer can also loot «Geraine's Puncutred Heart», which is on a 10 minute expiration timer. L|2|•|⟦gerainetome2⟧ L|1|4.|Return Geraine's Tome and Geraine's Puncutred Heart to the «Mhoire Soldier (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Soldier» for your reward.If you are part of a simultaneous heart turn in go quickly to the «Mhoire Lieutenant (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Lieutenant» in «Wai Jhou» for a title reward. L|2|•|⟦GaveGeraineHeart2⟧
H3|Frozen Refuge (Book 3) L|1|1.|From «Eastwatch» run to the «Frozen Refuge» at 93.9N, 45.4W. L|1|2.|From the drop, Go NorthEast, West, South, South, West, South. L|2|•|Note: Make sure you have full health when making the jumps. You will take massive cold damage when jumping across the pits. L|2|•|Note: West wall for ramp up if you fall L|1|3.|Continue around the corner and up the ramp until you reach a room with Geraine inside. L|2|•|{WARN} Make sure everyone is at the end before attacking Geraine, as the doors close once he is attacked. L|2|•|{OPT} Have two people hold the doors, and have one person drag Geraine down the hallway. Once he is beyond the doors, your party can back down the hallway, leaving the spawn behind. L|1|4.|Once attacked, several protectors will spawn, including Wight Sorcerers, Wight Captains, and Glacial Guards. L|1|5.|Kill Geraine, and loot «Geraine's Tome (3)¦Geraine's Tome». L|2|•|⟦gerainetome3⟧ L|2|•|Note: The slayer can also loot «Geraine's Crushed Heart», which is on a 10 minute expiration timer. L|1|6.|Return Geraine's Tome and Geraine's Crushed Heart to the «Mhoire Soldier (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Soldier» for your reward. If you are part of a simultaneous heart turn in go quickly to the «Mhoire Lieutenant (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Lieutenant» in «Wai Jhou» for a title reward. L|2|•|⟦GaveGeraineHeart3⟧
H3|Acidic Refuge (Book 4) L|1|1.|Head to the «Acidic Refuge», at 59.0N, 65.8E (just west of «Black Death Catacombs»). L|2|•|Route: Take the «Olthoi Lands Portal Device» at your mansion to «Black Death Catacombs», and run west to 59.0N, 65.8E. L|1|2.|From the drop, take the first right, and follow the linear dungeon to the end. L|2|•|Note: There are two acid pools that do a good deal of damage. Jump across and take the ramps up as quick as possible. L|1|3.|Eventually you will come to Geraine, who is standing down in the acid. L|2|•|Note 1: There is no ramp out of this pool and no safe floor. L|2|•|Note 2: Once you attack Geraine, the doors will close, but you can still perch. The floor does rather high damage, so melees either need to stock up on kits and potions, or have a designated healer. L|1|4.|Kill Geraine, and loot «Geraine's Tome (4)¦Geraine's Tome» from his corpse. L|2|•|Note: The slayer can also loot «Geraine's Halved Heart», which is on a 10 minute expiration timer. L|2|•|⟦gerainetome4⟧ L|1|5.|Return Geraine's Tome and Geraine's Halved Heart to the «Mhoire Soldier (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Soldier» for your reward. L|2|•|Note: At this point, if you have collected the first four books, you can can complete the quest with «Mhoire Soldier (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Solider» in «Graveyard» for a reward or continue on for all 7 books for a bigger reward. If you are part of a simultaneous heart turn in go quickly to the «Mhoire Lieutenant (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Lieutenant» in «Wai Jhou» for a title reward. L|2|•|⟦GaveGeraineHeart4⟧
H3|Cavernous Refuge (Book 5) L|1|1.|Head to the «Cavernous Refuge», located at 7.3S, 13.4E. L|2|•|Route: From «Al-Jalima», take the «Jackcat Canyon» settlement portal at 5.7N, 4.3E. Immediately head east to 0.3N, 9.3E and gain access to the mountain top, then run to 7.3S, 13.4E. L|2|•|This dungeon is one of the few which has a safe drop L|1|2.|Take any of the 4 paths down until you come to a ledge (no monsters for this part) L|1|3.|Geraine and his minions are located in the pit below. L|2|•|Note 1: This Geraine is Undead, not human. L|2|•|Note 2: There are «Ember»s at the bottom of the dungeon that cannot be attacked. They will shoot random «Flame Wave»s which are deadly. L|2|•|Note 3: The floor casts random lighting ring spells. L|1|4.|Kill Geraine (Undead) and loot «Geraine's Tome (5)¦Geraine's Tome» from his corpse. The slayer may also loot «Geraine's Decaying Heart» from the corpse. L|2|•|⟦gerainetome5⟧ L|2|•|Tip 1: Before attacking Geraine, jump down and stand on his head. This will keep you off the floor, and you will naturally evade the flame waves and electric rings. L|2|•|Tip 2: Debuff Geraine's attack skill quickly, as he can one-hit you with his melee (bludgeon) attacks. If you are part of a simultaneous heart turn in go quickly to the «Mhoire Lieutenant (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Lieutenant» in «Wai Jhou» the for a title reward. L|1|5.|Return Geraine's Tome and Geraine's Blackened Heart to the Mhoire Soldier for your reward. If you are part of a simultaneous heart turn in go quickly to the Mhoire Lieutenant in Wai Jhou for a title reward. L|2|•|⟦GaveGeraineHeart5⟧
H3|Shadowy Refuge (Book 6) L|1|1.|From «Tou-Tou», run to the «Shadowy Refuge» at 26.8S, 96.0E. L|2|•|This dungeon has a hot drop, and is full of void-casting shadows. L|1|2.|From the drop, head SW until you reach a pit. L|1|3.|Jump across the pit (you can't see the ledge but its there). L|2|•|Note: If you fall into the pit, you can easily Shift+Jump back up onto the ledge. L|1|4.|Head south and jump into the next pit, where you will find Geraine (Shadow). L|2|•|Note 1: Attacking Geraine also spawns «Formless Shadow»s and «Tenebrous Guard»s. L|2|•|Note 2: The shadows can move through doors. L|1|5.|Kill Geraine and loot «Geraine's Tome (6)¦Geraine's Tome» from his corpse. L|1|6.|⟦gerainetome6⟧ L|2|•|Note: The slayer can also loot «Geraine's Blackened Heart», which is on a 10 minute expiration timer. L|2|•|Tip 1: Shadow slayer works on Geraine (Shadow) L|2|•|Tip 2: Kill Formless Shadows first, they are easy to kill and do the most damage. L|2|•|Tip 3: Perch healers on the ledge before the jump, and drag Geraine out toward them. L|1|7.|Return Geraine's Tome and Geraine's Blackened Heart to the «Mhoire Soldier (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Soldier» for your reward. If you are part of a simultaneous heart turn in go quickly to the «Mhoire Lieutenant (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Lieutenant» in «Wai Jhou» for a title reward. L|2|•|⟦GaveGeraineHeart6⟧
H3|Twisted Refuge (Book 7) L|1|1.|From the «Center of the Obsidian Plains», run to the «Twisted Refuge» at 62.7S 64.9W. L|2|•|Route: «Rynthid Recall» L|2|•|Route: Use the «Dangerous Portal Device» at your mansion if you don't have «Rynthid Recall» L|2|•|Note: This dungeon has no monsters in it, and has a safe drop. L|1|2.|From the drop, head North, and take your first left, then first right, and then first left again. L|1|3.|Run down a ramp and jump into the pit in front of you. L|1|4.|Head East out of the pit, pass the next pit (don't jump in it), and then take your first left, up a ramp. L|1|5.|You will come to a room with platforms and portals. One of the platforms is holding Geraine (Undead). L|2|•|**Infinite Leaftide Note: treat this portion like Aerbax fight. Use an unbuffed weapon to DPS slower (like a Weeping, Hollow etc...).** L|2|•|Note: If you miss, you will be portalled into the center of the «Graveyard», at 65.6S, 44.1W. L|2|•|{OPT} Because the doors close when you attack Geraine, you may also wish to camp bows/mages in the door. This will allow people to get back if they die. The door will open up after approx. 30-35 minutes. L|1|6.|Attack Geraine (Undead) until he portals away (similar to «Aerbax»). L|2|•|Note: When you attack, Geraine will summon a variety of elemental defenders onto each on different platforms; Kill them. L|2|•|{OPT} It is recommended that you NOT jump around with Geraine. Simply have ranged attackers kill him. If you move to lower platforms, other mobs will jump down at you and it is VERY easy to get overwhelmed. L|1|7.|Once he portals, Geraine will spawn a crystal of each element («Acid Crystal», «Ice Crystal», «Fire Crystal», «Electric Crystal») on each platform: L|2|•|Note: Bludgeon works on all the crystals and they die fairly quickly. L|1|8.|After killing the crystals, Geraine will appear again on one of the 4 platforms. L|2|•|Note: Each of the 4 times Geraine appears, he is at 100% health, but with lower max health (200,000, 166,000, 133,000, 100,000). L|1|9.|Repeat this process, until finally, you kill Geraine (Undead) and loot «Geraine's Tome (7)¦Geraine's Tome» from his corpse. L|2|•|Note: The slayer can also loot «Geraine's Rotting Heart», which is on a 10 minute expiration timer. L|2|•|⟦gerainetome7⟧ L|1|10.|Return Geraine's Tome and Geraine's Rotting Heart to the «Mhoire Soldier (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Soldier» for your reward. If you are part of a simultaneous heart turn in go quickly to the «Mhoire Lieutenant (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Lieutenant» in «Wai Jhou» for a title reward. L|2|•|⟦GaveGeraineHeart7⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|There does not seem to be any level restriction on using the «Mhoire Lieutenant (Geraine's Hosts)¦Mhoire Lieutenant» to acquire the «Vigor of Mhoire» +20 Health buff. L|1|•|Once you have acquired all 7 hearts the backpack they reside in gets renamed to "Contents of Corpse of Geraine". L|1|•|When you acquire all 7 tomes, turn them into the Mhoire Soldier for additional rewards. L|1|•|⟦GerainesBodiesCompleted0412⟧

Quest.name: Soul_Stone_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|80+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Nuhmudira's Hidden Cottage» at 20.8S, 22.5E I|Route|«Uziz» to «Djebel al-Nar Cottages» at 24.9S, 29.8E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|{TIP} Two runs to get all stamps. There are three failed stamps for the Ghosts puzzle.
P|Quest to gain the «Soul Stone» which, wrapped with a «Bloodied Burun Hide», turns into a «Burun Soaked Soul Stone». P|This gives «Noble Weapons» the «Burun Slayer» attribute. These weapons can again be turned into «Regal Weapons» by completing the «Burun Kings» quests. P|In addition, after completing the quest, you get all Salvage Spells (self and other), and, if you damned «Nuhmudira» before and completed all 3 dungeons, the «Gem of Ardent Loyalty».
P|How many parts you have to do to get the rewards, depends partially on if you saved or damned «Nuhmudira» during the «Gelidite Library Quest».
L|1|•|If you saved her, you just need to do the «#Hand-Written Journal¦Hand-Written Journal» L|1|•|If you never made a choice, you need to do «#Hand-Written Journal¦Hand-Written Journal» and «#Burial Urn¦Burial Urn» L|1|•|If you damned her, you need to do «#Hand-Written Journal¦Hand-Written Journal», «#Burial Urn¦Burial Urn» and «#Remains of Xi Ru¦Remains of Xi Ru».
P|(Note that these are not the only things that influence your steps required, and your requirements may differ from the above.)
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to «Nuhmudira's Hidden Cottage» at 20.8S, 22.5E. L|2|•|Route: «Uziz» to «Djebel al-Nar Cottages» at 24.9S, 29.8E. L|1|2.|Once at the cottage, go inside and use the «Open Journal (Numuhdira's Hidden Cottage)¦Open Journal». L|2|•|⟦RoadsJournal⟧
H3|Part 1: Xi Ru's Chapel L|1|1.|Go to «Vesayen Islands» to use the «Portalling Device» at 83.4S, 89.8E to «Xi Ru's Island». L|1|2.|From (hot) drop, run into cathedral, kill Sclavus Lords, run up up, jump on platform, turn 180 degrees, and run to the "balcony", there's the portal to «Xi Ru's Chapel» where you will find «Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student». L|1|3.|Talk to «Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student» L|2|•|⟦RoadsNuhmudira1⟧ L|2|•|⟦RoadsNuhmudira2⟧ L|2|•|⟦RoadsNuhmudira3⟧ L|1|4.|Talk to the 3 "ghosts"(transparent NPCs) L|2|•|⟦RoadsJifLoz⟧ L|2|•|⟦RoadsKirLoz⟧ L|2|•|⟦RoadsHevkLoz⟧ L|2|•|**Note:** To get Full QB you'll need **to fail the questions** then return (after 20 hours) to complete the rest. You get 1 QB each for talking to the Ghosts, one QB each for failing their questions, and another QB after you **touch the correct items and talk** to the ghosts again. L|3|•|⟦RoadsFailedJifLoz⟧ L|3|•|⟦RoadsFailedKirLoz⟧ L|3|•|⟦RoadsFailedHevkLoz⟧ L|1|5.|The left ghost, «Jif Loz» has busts, choose «Bust of Nali Valind». L|2|•|⟦RoadsSuccessJifLoz⟧ L|1|6.|The middle one, «Kir Loz» has statues up the ramp, choose «Statue of Aurlanna». L|2|•|⟦RoadsSuccessKirLoz⟧ L|1|7.|The right one, «Hevk Loz» has paintings, choose «Portrait of Geraine IV». L|2|•|⟦RoadsSuccessHevkLoz⟧ L|1|8.|Talk to all ghosts again. L|2|•|⟦SanctumXiRuJif⟧ L|2|•|⟦SanctumXiRuKir⟧ L|2|•|⟦SanctumXiRuHevk⟧ L|1|9.|Open door on the upper level. L|2|•|⟦SanctumXiRuEnter⟧
H3|Part 2: Hand-Written Journal L|1|1.|Go left, lever, door, portal to «Xi Ru's Library». L|2|•|Route: Straight, button & door, room, a lever to the E-side of room opens door at opposite side, up ramp, right, room with books, right, go over a small catwalk, more rooms, a catwalk with a book, more rooms again, a door with a button, behind it a big room, use middle lever to open door on opposite side, go right, left at next intersection, button with door, L|1|2.|behind it pedestal with the «Indecipherable Book» (click it to get the «Hand-Written Journal») and portal back to «Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student». L|2|•|⟦RoadsTask1⟧ L|1|3.|Hand Camryn the book.
H3|Part 3: Burial Urn L|1|1.|Door up ramps again, straight this time. you really NEED 2 people here (or a very very high jump skill). L|1|2.|Lever to go through door & portal to «Xi Ru's Crypt». L|1|3.|At first intersection, go right and immediately left up a ramp. Doors, buttons everywhere. Room. another ramp, left, go up ramp, big room. L|1|4.|Here's the trick: Before you enter the room, there are two buttons. Open the door to the room, let someone go to NNW corner room, push other button, person 1 goes in, opens door for person 2, and runs to NEE corner room. Person 2 runs to dead end, there's a trigger plate there to open door NEE. L|1|5.|Always check if door is opened, otherwise you can start all over. L|2|1.|So: person 1 stands in front to-be-open-door, steps in, opens door for person 2, goes to next door. Person 2 runs to trigger plate, opens next door, runs back to big room. Rinse repeat. L|2|2.|Door sequence: 1. NNW; 2. ENE, 3. WSW, 4. NNE, 5. SSW, 6. WNW, 7. ESE, 8. SSW. L|2|3.|Last trigger plate will open the door in the middle of S wall. Person 1 gets in. To open door for person 2, the button is UP. L|1|6.|To get up, you need to shift jump 3 stepping stones that fade in and out vision the whole time. No worries, they are there all the time. Up there, person 1 opens door for person 2. L|1|7.|Fight your way to the portal. On the other side, over a half-invisible catwalk, is the «Urn». Click it to get the «Burial Urn». L|2|•|⟦RoadsTask2⟧ L|1|8.|Return the urn to «Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student».
H3|Part 4: Remains of Xi Ru L|1|1.|Again, door, this time right. Also here, 2 people needed. Lever, door, portal to «Xi Ru's Remembrance». L|1|2.|Go right, ramp, open door with button, you're in a big room with platforms and a catwalk up in the air. go underneath either of the platforms and fight your way up. There's a small room with a lever. 1 person stays there. The other goes on, opens door to platform, and in the middle of the catwalk is the next door. person 1 opens that door with the lever. L|1|3.|Little shift jump to get from catwalk through door. Wait on other side near button for lever puller. Right, down ramp, down again, right, down ramp again, a door with 2 buttons. Kill the Moarsmen, use both buttons to open both doors. Room with paintings and crypt. Door to crypt can be opened simply by double click. double click «Sarcophagus of Xi Ru» to get the «Remains of Xi Ru». L|2|•|⟦RoadsTask3⟧ L|1|4.|Portal, and back to «Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student». L|1|5.|Hand «Remains of Xi Ru» to «Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student». L|2|•|⟦RoadsComplete⟧ L|2|•|⟦RoadsUndercoverAntius⟧
H3|Part 5: Epilogue L|1|1.|Talking to «Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student» after completion will get you the «Soul Stone» which, wrapped with a «Bloodied Burun Hide», turns into a «Burun Soaked Soul Stone». L|2|•|This gives «Noble Weapons» the «Burun Slayer» attribute. These weapons can again be turned into «Regal Weapons» by completing the «Burun Kings» quests. L|1|2.|Additionally, if you only had to do 1 or 2 of the steps, you will receive the «Nuhmudira's Enlightenment» and «Nuhmudira's Wisdom» spells (levels 1-7) when talking to Camryn along with a «Gem of Arcane Corruption». L|1|3.|If you had to do all 3 steps, you will need to talk to «Guard Chandler Hammett» in Lytelthorpe, «Royal Guard Gabrielle¦Guard Gabrielle» in Rithwic, or «Ydnew¦Emissary Ydnew» in Yanshi to receive the "normal" Salvage Spells (Arcanum Salvaging, levels 1-7). You will also receive the «Gem of Ardent Loyalty», which adds a +12 Melee and +12 Loyalty cantrip to «Noble Armor».

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student⸩ ⸨Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student tells you, "Though Nuhmudira is unaware of your exploits she is not without mercy. If you desire the stone that much she will grant you the device, if you undertake a set of small tasks for her."⸩ ⸨Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student tells you, "The first is a book found in the library, the second is an urn from the crypt. Collect these and return them to me in the order I have listed and you shall be rewarded."
L|1||Jif Loz⸩ ⸨Jif Loz tells you, "Child of another sun, your coming to this place will inspire another work of art. Your three leaders shall grace the walls of the chapel. Their busts carved by my own hands. My name is Jif Loz, it is all I retain of my life before. Nothing can halt the ruination of my memory. It is a position of grace that I gladly accepted in a time when all who walked in Light were not lost. Ages have past, the only telling of those ages lies in the art that I create. You wish, as the one who has come before you, to enter this chapel and learn what my brothers and I have recorded as these ages have past."⸩ ⸨Jif Loz tells you, "You must know of what has transpired before you may enter."⸩ ⸨Jif Loz tells you, "In the age of the Yalain, one came to Ithaenc and laid waste to the sisters there. All were slaughtered, none survived, light was drawn thin as darkness continued to slip into the hearts of the guardians. Who lead that slaughter, who gave the orders to murder the sisters of Ithaenc Cathedral?"⸩ ⸨Jif Loz tells you, "I have carved and polished three busts along the wall of this room, each represents an individual from that time. Choose your answer wisely and you shall be given leave to enter this place. Fail and you will need to learn more of the secrets of this world before entering."⸩ ⸨Jif Loz tells you, "With a sword soaked in the blood of people with whom she once claimed a kinship, Nali Valynd fell upon the sisters at Ithaenc. They who followed a path bathed in Light lay broken by the Nali of the Northern Church. Misguided crusaders loyal to the Nali visited mistress Aurlanna and knelt before her with proud voices proclaiming victory over the -heathens- that dwelled within Ithaenc Cathedral. Nali Valind, not amongst them, was spared incineration and returned to her home amongst the Yalain."⸩ ⸨Jif Loz tells you, "You have proven to me that you are aware of what has transpired on this world. I give you my word that you shall see the halls beyond. Speak to my brothers and prove your worthiness to them. If you succeed the door to this chapel shall be yours to open evermore."
L|1||Hevk Loz⸩ ⸨Hevk Loz tells you, "Child of another sun, your arrival shall herald a new age. I shall paint the world that you will create in images that shall grace these walls and hold the history within. My name is Hevk Loz, my name and painting are what endure from my life. This path was my choice. I, like my brothers, record history as it transpires and form it into art that can retain the knowledge of those times. You wish, as the one who has come before you, to enter this chapel and learn what my brothers and I have recorded."⸩ ⸨Hevk Loz tells you, "You must know of what has transpired before you may enter."⸩ ⸨Hevk Loz tells you, "Three sons have driven the course of this world. From birth, each had a destiny not their own. Death for two and life for three. But only one has enjoyed the gift of life and of death given by the hands of those who once walked this world as our sisters. Which of the sons is this?"⸩ ⸨Hevk Loz tells you, "Three portraits show these sons. Choose the answer to my question wisely and you shall be given my blessing to pass into this chapel. Fail and I shall need you to rethink the purpose of your task within and ask that you return when you know more of this world."⸩ ⸨Hevk Loz tells you, "Sickly from birth, Geraine IV, was taken by sisters who had stepped aside from the path and brought into a state that would forever sustain his body, soul and mind. Geraine in turn taught his people, but the sisters were not so foolish to not enter this state themselves. Many sleep, while in waking dreams, they think their time nears as a new singer raises her voice. But what of Geraine? His life is over, but still he endures, watches and waits. His death began his life anew."⸩ ⸨Hevk Loz tells you, "You have proven to me that you are aware of what has transpired on this world. I give you my word that you shall see the halls beyond. Speak to my brothers and prove your worthiness to them. If you succeed the door to this chapel shall be yours to open evermore."
L|1||Kir Loz⸩ ⸨Kir Loz tells you, "Child of another sun, your coming to this place will inspire works of art. In time, the three races that now strive for peace shall be known in statues across this hall. I shall carve likenesses with my own hands and offer them for future generations to see. The Age of the children from another sun shall be born in that vision and there shall be memory cast within that stone. My name is Kir Loz, my name and art are all I retain from the time when I lived. But this was a path I chose freely. I, like my brothers, record history as it transpires and form it into art that can retain the knowledge of that age. You wish, as the one who has come before you, to enter this chapel and learn what my brothers and I have recorded."⸩ ⸨Kir Loz tells you, "You must know of what has transpired before you may enter."⸩ ⸨Kir Loz tells you, "Forsaking her children and Au, she laid waste to the crusaders that scoured the halls of Ithaenc clean. Her will crushed, she went beyond the stars one last time. She has yet to return. Who is she?"⸩ ⸨Kir Loz tells you, "Along the landing of this room I have placed the statues of three such beings. Choose the answer to my question wisely and you shall be given my blessing to pass into this chapel. Fail and I shall need you to rethink the purpose of your task within and ask that you return when you know more of this world."⸩ ⸨Kir Loz tells you, "Alighting on wings, head hung in grief, looking down one last time on her aerie, watching as her children looked up, Aurlanna flew into the heavens and beyond the stars never to return. Her heart was shattered when she found that those that she had once called sisters had been killed by zealots blinded by the purpose of a throne that had forsaken its true path for power. She felt the urge to join with madness within her and so she left Auberean, hopeful that its defender would rise and take his place."⸩ ⸨Kir Loz tells you, "You have proven to me that you are aware of what has transpired on this world. I give you my word that you shall see the halls beyond. Speak to my brothers and prove your worthiness to them. If you succeed the door to this chapel shall be yours to open evermore."
L|1||Handing in Hand-Written Journal⸩ ⸨You give Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student Hand-Written Journal.⸩ ⸨Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student tells you, "You have done well thus far. Now bring the urn and I shall see this off to Nuhmudira and give you your reward."
L|1||Handing in Burial Urn⸩ ⸨You give Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student Burial Urn.⸩ ⸨Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student tells you, "All is complete. I will write a report to Nuhmudira and see that she is made aware of all that you have done for her. Here is your reward."⸩ ⸨Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student gives you Soul Stone.⸩ ⸨You've earned 3,423,117 experience.⸩ ⸨Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student tells you, "You must now find a sample of Burun blood. Soak the stone in the blood and it will take on properties that are the antithesis of the Burun. Apply that stone to the -Noble- weapons and it will become a Burun slaying weapon."⸩ ⸨Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student tells you, "In addition, your previous service to Nuhmudira makes you deserving of a reward. I will now teach you the spells that Nuhmudira has devised to assist you in your salvaging efforts."⸩ ⸨Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student gives you Gem of Arcane Corruption.⸩ ⸨Camryn, Nuhmudira's Student tells you, "As a final reward, Nuhmudira had decided to make this gem available to those who have aided her. It will enhance the -Noble- armor with an ancient power that allows your mind to focus more ably. It is decidedly more effective than those gems which the High Queen's lack-...that is...servants...give as rewards."⸩

Quest.name: Dereth_Exploration
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|150 (to obtain 100 markers) I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Sean the Speedy» I|Starts At|«Holtburg» at 42.3N, 33.7E I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Overview P|The goal of this quest is to find Exploration Markers that have been placed at different locations all over Dereth and its surrounding islands. Some Markers belong to a particular theme (ex. they are found near «Festival Stone»s) but some are completely random locations.
P|The quest culminated in 100 total markers during the 10th anniversary patch. The reward for all 100 is a global with your name plus a 30 slot backpack.
P|{TIP} **Quest Stamps** - To get all stamps you don't need to visit all the markers. One marker per group (A-J), and one marker per special group will get you all but two of the stamps. The final two are collected by visiting all markers of a group and all markers of a special group. Visiting all of Group A will get you the final two.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speaking with «Sean the Speedy» will allow you to start using the markers. L|2|•|⟦FoundSeantheSpeedy⟧ L|1|2.|Find the «Exploration Marker»s. L|2|•|First Marker: ⟦ExplorationMarkersFound⟧ L|1|3.|Return to Sean once you find all 10 in a group of markers for your rewards. Explorer titles are rewarded for every 20 markers, and special titles are rewarded for finding themed markers (listed in brackets). L|2|•|All 10 in a group: ⟦ExplorationMarkersGroups⟧ L|2|•|All markers for a theme: ⟦ExplorationMarkersThemes⟧
H3|Special Marker Stamps L|1|•|Crater Crashers: ⟦ExplorationMarkersCraterCrasherFound⟧ L|1|•|Daredevil: ⟦ExplorationMarkersDaredevilFound⟧ L|1|•|Mountain Climber: ⟦ExplorationMarkersMountainClimberFound⟧ L|1|•|Party Goer: ⟦ExplorationMarkersPartyGoerFound⟧ L|1|•|Sky Diver: ⟦ExplorationMarkersSkyDiverFound⟧ L|1|•|Spelunker: ⟦ExplorationMarkersSpelunkerFound⟧
H3|Markers by Patch P|For a listing of markers by location / efficient route rather than by month, see «Dereth Exploration/Markers by Efficiency».

Quest.name: Gateway_to_the_Deep
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|130 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Shuthoth» I|Starts At|60.1S, 87.7W in «Ayan Baqur» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|This Quest is also known as Vissidal Flagging or 130 Flagging. Completing this quest provides you with access to «Vissidal Island».
P|You need to collect 4 items before you start on your way. If with a fellowship, everyone will need each of the 4 items: L|1|•|«Yellow Jewel» L|2|•|Yellow Jewels are dropped by Virindi. Any place you can hunt Virindi will work, e.g. around Ayan Baqur. L|1|•|«Sezzherei's Lair (Portal Gem)¦Sezzherei's Lair» portal gem L|2|•|Sezzherei's Lair portal gem is dropped by any of the Fallen creatures, which are rare spawns found on the «Singularity Caul» and in the «Valley of Death». The portal gem has a 100% drop rate. L|1|•|«Pyreal Bar» L|2|•|Pyreal Bars are crafted from Pyreal Motes, which are dropped by any golem. L|1|•|«Swamp Stone» L|2|•|Swamp Stones are dropped by most Mosswarts. Places to hunt for one include: «Fort Aimaru», «Saadia's Retreat», or the «Moss Chamber».
P|If you have already completed the quest and are helping players, you do not need the items and can instead simply use each statue to continue.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Shuthoth» (60.1S 87.7W in Ayan Baqur) will give you a «Watcher Token». L|1|2.|Travel to «Aerlinthe» (by going to Candeth Keep and Paying a D Note to an Undead just southeast of Candeth Keep) and follow the beach east then north to 87.3N 51.2E and give the «Watcher Token» to the «Devastated Watcher» statue on the beach (if you have previously given a token, simply use the statue). The statue portals you inside the «Devastated Falatacot Temple». At the end of the dungeon is a portal to the «Gatekeepers». L|2|•|⟦DevastatedWatcherTokenGiven⟧ L|2|•|⟦DevastatedWatcherFlagged⟧ L|2|•|{WARN} There is a secondary watcher, the «Ruined Watcher» on the west beach of Aerlinthe (87.3N 41.6E). It will send you to the «Corrupted Falatacot Temple», a mirror image of the «Devastated Falatacot Temple» though not the same place. Both have the portal to the «Gatekeepers» at the end. You can return to «Shuthoth» for a gem to access the other dungeon once you have reached Vissidal. Both of the Falatacot Temple dungeons have one of the mana fields for the «Menhir Research» quest. L|1|3.|Speak to «Shemza», then give a «Yellow Jewel» to «Shemza», you will be portaled into the dungeon «Gateway of Shemza». You will need to use a candle stick shown on the map to open a door half way down. There is a free «Black Marrow Reliquary¦BMK» chest by the jump. At the end kill the «Radiant Crystal» (melees work well with Imperil) and pick up one of the «Radiant Shard»s. Use the exit portal to return to the «Gatekeepers». L|2|•|⟦GateKeepersFlagComplete⟧ L|2|•|⟦ShemzaYellowJewelGiven⟧ L|2|•|Open BMK: ⟦ChestBlackMarrowGateWayShemza0205⟧ L|1|4.|Give the «Radiant Shard» to «Lurza», then give Lurza a «Sezzherei's Lair (Portal Gem)¦Sezzherei's Lair Portal Gem». You'll be portaled into the dungeon «Gateway of Lurza». There is another BMK on the way down. When you come to the end of the acid floor, shift jump up onto the grate then kill the «Dazzling Crystal» and pick up a «Dazzling Shard». Use the exit portal. L|2|•|⟦RadiantShardGiven⟧ L|2|•|⟦LurzaSezzhereisLairGiven⟧ L|2|•|Open BMK: ⟦ChestBlackMarrowGateWayLurza0205⟧ L|1|5.|Give the «Dazzling Shard» to «Dmesne», then give Dmesne a «Pyreal Bar» to be portaled into the dungeon «Gateway of Dmesne». At the end is the «Brilliant Crystal» that drops «Brilliant Shard (Vissidal)¦Brilliant Shard»s. L|2|•|⟦DazzlingShardGiven⟧ L|2|•|⟦DmesnePyrealBarGiven⟧ L|2|•|Open BMK: ⟦ChestBlackMarrowGateWayDemesne0205⟧ L|1|6.|Give the «Brilliant Shard» to «Rhujun», then give a «Swamp Stone». You'll be portaled to a small island, speak to the «Flame Guardian» near the drop who tasks you with killing five «Water Golem (Level 150)¦Water Golem»s. Speak to the Guardian again when done. L|2|•|⟦BrilliantShardGiven⟧ L|2|•|⟦RhujunSwampStoneGiven⟧ L|2|•|⟦StartedWaterGolems⟧ L|2|•|⟦TotalWaterGolemDead⟧ L|2|•|Frist Kill: ⟦TotalWaterGolemDead⟧ on first completion! L|1|7.|The «Flame Guardian» sends you to «Abandoned Mines Mirror», a dungeon very similar to subway. Head to the bottom and kill «Bur Lizk» who summons a portal on death. L|1|8.|You are sent to another small island, similar to the previous one. Speak to the «Water Guardian» who instructs you to kill five «Fire Golem»s. Speak to the guardian after doing so and you will be given a «Watery Token» and portaled to 70.3N 65.4E. L|2|•|⟦StartedFireGolems⟧ L|2|•|⟦TotalFireGolemDead⟧ L|2|•|Frist Kill: ⟦TotalFireGolemDead⟧ on first completion! L|1|9.|Give the token to the «Watcher of the Deep». You are now flagged for «Vissidal Island», there is a portal just south of the statue on the beach. There's also a lifestone, however there is a lifestone on the island itself if you use the portal (at 80.2N 59.4E). Portal gems to Vissidal can also be purchased from «Archmage Moldurg» at 79.9N 59.2E. L|2|•|⟦VissFlagComplete⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Shuthoth tells you, "Welcome, friend. I seek warriors in search of great adventure. I represent one who would grant the Isparians of this world much power, much knowledge."⸩ ⸨Shuthoth tells you, "She has found something. Something powerful beneath the waves of this world. A city, ancient and doomed. The blue-skinned King did his part to raise it from the deep, but I daresay he could not have done it alone."⸩ ⸨Shuthoth tells you, "Now that the island exists, the lady would ask Dereth's hunters and adventurers to explore its mysteries."⸩ ⸨Shuthoth tells you, "If you seek such a challenge, I bid you take this gem and place it within the empty eye of one of Aerlinthe's Watchers. The Watchers will tell you what else you must do."⸩ ⸨Shuthoth tells you, "You have the spark of adventure within you. Good luck, my friend."⸩ ⸨Shuthoth gives you Watcher Token.
L|1||Using the Devastated Watcher⸩ ⸨The Watcher looks down on you, a glint in its one good eye. There appears to be something missing from the other eye socket.
L|1||Giving the Watcher Token to the Devastated Watcher⸩ ⸨You give Devastated Watcher Watcher Token.⸩ ⸨The gem clicks into place within the Watcher's empty eye socket. The statue hums to life and looks down upon you. You hear a whisper in your mind, "Appease the Gatekeepers," then all grows quiet.⸩ ⸨⸨Devastated Watcher teleports you with Devastated Access.⸩
L|1||Shemza⸩ ⸨Shemza tells you, "A warrior! A warrior comes! Brothers, feast your eyes on one who would give their lives willingly to the great lord!"⸩ ⸨Shemza tells you, "You seek to bask in the glory of Grael, do you not? You seek to join us in the worship of he who is more powerful, more glorious, than all who have come before? My brothers and I, we were the first to join his side. We were there when he led us to victory over the old ones. We helped him slay the mages and lay waste to their cities. We were there when he led an army upon the heretics of the light."⸩ ⸨Shemza tells you, "When defeat fell upon us, we knew that our ascendance was only delayed. One day, we knew that our god would rise from the depths and claim that which is his. And we knew that ones such as you would seek to free him from his chains."⸩ ⸨Shemza tells you, "And now you are here. You seek to barter with us who have given our souls in exchange for life eternal. Those of us who have lengthened our lives for the sole purpose of delivering warriors unto him."⸩ ⸨Shemza tells you, "Yes. You are here now. And now you will aid me. And then you will aid my brothers."⸩ ⸨Shemza tells you, "I seek a boon. One small boon. The masters of the portal carry a token of golden hue. A token that I would claim as mine own. Find it and deliver it to me. Then the first part of your quest shall begin."⸩ ⸨Shemza tells you, "I have altered your body. You may now use our portal near Ayan Baqur."
L|1||Handing in Yellow Jewel to Shemza⸩ ⸨You give Shemza Yellow Jewel.⸩ ⸨Shemza tells you, "Seek out the Radiant Crystal. Bring a shard to my brother Lurza. Then he will treat with you."⸩ ⸨⸨Shemza teleports you with Radiant Access.⸩
L|1||Handing in Radiant Shard to Lurza⸩ ⸨You give Lurza Radiant Shard.⸩ ⸨Lurza tells you, "Long have we waited, trapped within these crystalline forms, waiting for those who would join him in his quest. And now you come. You come seeking our approval. But are you worthy?"⸩ ⸨Lurza tells you, "There is something I seek. The key to one who once followed our cause. A traitor who makes his home among the winged demons of the dark. Bring the key to this fallen lord, and I will grant you passage."
L|1||Handing in Sezzherei's Lair to Lurza⸩ ⸨You give Lurza Sezzherei's Lair.⸩ ⸨Lurza tells you, "The demon Sezzherei once called himself our brother. But when he betrayed our lord to the ancient mages, he fell from Grael's favor. Our brother Tursh slew Sezzherei on the battlefield, or so we all believed. Now he claims the dark as his master, and seeks to appease its twisted whims."⸩ ⸨Lurza tells you, "Sezzherei will once again know the taste of his own blood. When Grael rises and marches across this land, Sezzherei will kneel once again."⸩ ⸨Lurza tells you, "Now find the Dazzling shard, and give it to my brother Dmesne."⸩ ⸨⸨Lurza teleports you with Dazzling Access.⸩
L|1||Handing in Dazzling Shard to Dmesne⸩ ⸨You give Dmesne Dazzling Shard.⸩ ⸨Dmesne tells you, "There is a metal, a pure metal of great power. You use it to strengthen your arms, barbarians that you are. One bar is all I ask. One bar and you shall have my blessing."
L|1||Handing in Pyreal Bar to Dmesne⸩ ⸨You give Dmesne Pyreal Bar.⸩ ⸨Dmesne tells you, "Within this chamber lies the Brilliant Crystal. Take a shard to my brother Rhujun, and you will be escorted to the isle of water."⸩ ⸨⸨Dmesne teleports you with Brilliant Access.⸩
L|1||Handing in Brilliant Shard to Rhujun⸩ ⸨You give Rhujun Brilliant Shard.⸩ ⸨Rhujun tells you, "There are those of wet skin and barbaric means. They carry the meanest of stones, a stone whose power is unknown even to them. I would have it, little one."⸩ ⸨Rhujun tells you, "I would have it now."
L|1||Handing in Swamp Stone to Rhujun⸩ ⸨You give Rhujun Swamp Stone.⸩ ⸨Rhujun tells you, "The cousins of these young ones make their homes on the bones of the ancients. They know not the power that surrounds them. Such simple creatures they are."⸩ ⸨⸨Rhujun teleports you with Fire Island Access.⸩
L|1||Flame Guardian⸩ ⸨Flame Guardian tells you, "Welcome to my lonely isle, little one. You seek the mysteries of Vissidal, do you not? Many have come before you. Many will follow in your footsteps. The power which once lay dormant beneath the waves has surfaced. I fear the new rulers of this world will regret their meddling before all is done."⸩ ⸨Flame Guardian tells you, "You seek a boon from me, do you not? You seek my permission to further your quest?"⸩ ⸨Flame Guardian tells you, "You must prove yourself, little one. You must bathe in the cleansing waters of the deep. You must destroy the spirits of Water that lay claim to this isle."⸩ ⸨You have killed 5 Water Golems! Your task is complete!⸩ ⸨Flame Guardian tells you, "The waters of the deep cover your flesh. You have been cleansed. I sense the spirit of Grael about you. I deem you worthy, little one."⸩ ⸨⸨Flame Guardian teleports you with Abandoned Mines Portal Sending.⸩
L|1||Water Guardian⸩ ⸨Water Guardian tells you, "You have done much to reach this point. You have appeased the Gatekeepers. You have been bathed in the waters of the Deep. You have bested the warrior Bur Lizk. And now you seek my blessing."⸩ ⸨Water Guardian tells you, "As you were bathed in the waters of the deep, now must you be cleansed by its fires. Slay the spirits of Flame. Bask in their glory."⸩ ⸨You have killed 5 Fire Golems! Your task is complete!⸩ ⸨Water Guardian tells you, "You have been cleansed by the spirits of Flame. The essence of Grael wraps about you like a lover's embrace. Soon, you will be his."⸩ ⸨Water Guardian tells you, "Give this to the Watcher of the Deep, and then you shall know glory."⸩ ⸨Water Guardian gives you Watery Token.⸩ ⸨⸨Water Guardian teleports you with Northeast Coast Portal Sending.⸩
L|1||Handing in Watery Token to Watcher of the Deep⸩ ⸨You give Watcher of the Deep Watery Token.⸩ ⸨You feel a low rumble, and the statue looks down upon you. You hear a whisper in your mind, "The isle of the deep is yours," then all grows quiet.⸩ ⸨You've earned 190,000,000 experience.⸩

Quest.name: Oswald's_Dirk_Quest
Quest.notes: several are unknown and dont give credit for finishing. unsure of how to get the ulgrim wants cider
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Aaminah» I|Starts At|60.0S, 87.8W in «Ayan Baqur» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Quest Chain|The Heart of Innocence I|1|Oswald's Dirk Quest I|2|«Heart of Innocence Quest» I|3|«Elemental Caverns Quest» H2|Overview L|1|•|You must have «Lockpick» to complete this quest. L|1|•|If you are flagging for the «Heart of Innocence Quest», you are flagged once you enter the «Fir Tree» portal. No «Lockpick» is required up to this point. L|1|•|Two run to get all stamps.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Access to the Secret Lair (The Fir Tree) L|1|1.|The Quest begins in Ayan Baqur. L|1|2.|Head up to the roof of the building behind «Aaminah» and pick up the «Empty Mug», «Half Empty Cider», «Strands of Silk», and «Sweet Smelling Bark». L|2|•|⟦BarkOswaldTaken⟧ L|2|•|⟦SilkOswaldTaken⟧ L|2|•|⟦MugOswaldTaken⟧ L|2|•|⟦CoveOswaldTaken⟧ L|1|3.|While in Ayan, hand the «Half Empty Cider» to «Ulgrim the Unpleasant» at 59.7S, 88.0W. L|2|•|⟦OswaldStep1⟧ L|1|4.|Now head to «Sawato» and speak with «Ro Bi-Jor, Apprentice Tailor» at 28.5S, 59.2E. L|1|5.|Proceed to show «Ro Bi-Jor, Apprentice Tailor» the «Strands of Silk». L|2|•|⟦OswaldStep2⟧ L|1|6.|Now pick up the «Dusty Sollerets», located on the floor next to «Ro Bi-Jor, Apprentice Tailor» and hand them to her. L|1|7.|Head to «Rithwic» and find «Celcynd the Dour» in the bar at 10.7N, 58.1E. Hand him the «Empty Mug» and the «Sweet Smelling Bark». L|2|•|⟦MugOswaldGiven⟧ L|2|•|⟦OswaldStep3⟧ L|1|8.|Now, from «Glenden Wood», run to 32.1N, 25.6E and use the «Chunk of Wood», lying on the ground. L|2|•|⟦OswaldLair⟧ L|1|9.|Once you have your «Wooden Tablet», you're flagged to enter the «Fir Tree» portal, located at 80.0N, 45.5W. The tablet has no further use and can be discarded. L|2|•|Route: From «Stonehold», take the «Woodshore Cottages» portal at 69.6N, 20.2W. L|2|•|Alternate Route: Take Town Portals to Mayoi, run to 61.0S, 80.4E and take the Lady Maila Estates Portal and run NE to the Fir Tree (this is a shorter run). L|2|•|⟦HeartofInnocence⟧
H3|Part 2: Trials H4|Trial #1: Trial of the Vagabond L|1|1.|From the «Fir Tree» drop, enter the «Trial of the Vagabond» portal to your left. L|1|2.|Buff your «Lockpick» and use to the «Puzzle Box (Trial of the Vagabond)¦Puzzle Box» nearby. If your skill is high enough, it will portal you to with «Vagabond Passed». L|2|•|{WARN} If you fail the skill check, the «Puzzle Box (Trial of the Vagabond)¦Puzzle Box» will drain your health with «Heart Rend» several times. It can kill you! L|1|3.|If successful (passed the skill check), you'll be portaled to the next trial, the Test of Cunning.
H4|Trial #2: Test of Cunning L|1|1.|This trial consists of Rolling Ball of Deaths. Starting to your left (West), jump up on the platform and then work your way across the suspended jumps until you reach the far side. L|2|•|{WARN} If you fall, you'll be killed and will not be able to recover your body. You do drop «Death Items» in this dungeon, so don't carry anything you can't afford to lose! L|1|2.|Once you reach the other side, jump against the back wall and then enter the «Eagle's Sight» portal to access the next trial.
H4|Trial #3: Eagle's Sight L|1|1.|From the drop, you'll notice a «Target (Creature)¦Target», directly across the room to the North. Using a «Critical Strike» weapon, continue to attack the Target until you land a Critical Hit. L|2|•|{WARN} This is a hot drop, and you'll be attacked by Invisible Assailants continuously until you've passed the trial. L|1|2.|Once you've landed a critical hit, you'll be instantly portaled to the next trial, «Bobo's Babysitter».
H4|Trial #4: Bobo's Babysitter L|1|1.|Speak with the «Babysitter» and you'll receive 4 balls: «Blue Ball», «Red Ball», «Green Ball», and «Yellow Ball». L|2|•|{OPT} You can complete the quest then run back to Fir Tree and run the puzzles again giving a wrong ball to pickup the incorrect stamp. L|3|•|⟦OswaldLogicWrong⟧ L|1|2.|Hand each ball to the appropriate statue of Bobo's kid: L|2|•|«Blue Ball (Oswald's Dirk)¦Blue Ball» goes to the statue of «Cao Cao». L|2|•|⟦CaoCaoRight⟧ L|2|•|«Red Ball (Oswald's Dirk)¦Red Ball» goes to the statue of «Shim Shim». L|2|•|⟦ShimShimRight⟧ L|2|•|«Green Ball (Oswald's Dirk)¦Green Ball» goes to the statue of «Mu Mu». L|2|•|⟦MuMuRight⟧ L|2|•|«Yellow Ball (Oswald's Dirk)¦Yellow Ball» goes to the statue of «Po Po». L|2|•|⟦PoPoRight⟧ L|1|3.|Once you've handed all 4 balls to their respective statues, talk with the «Judgment Statue» on the North wall to complete the trial. L|1|4.|If you're correct, you'll receive «Oswald's Key» and be portaled to «Oswald's Room».
H3|Part 3: Oswald's Room L|1|1.|From the drop, open the door to your left (West) and use «Oswald's Key» to open «Oswald's Chest», where you'll find «Oswald's Dirk» and a «Magnificent Bracelet». L|2|•|Note: The chest only has a 700 difficulty, so with it it can be picked with high enough skill, allowing you to obtain more than one dirk (managed to pick with «Vagabond's Gift» and 433 skill). L|2|•|⟦MagnificentBraceletPickupTimer⟧ L|1|2.|Take the bracelet to «Aaminah» in Ayan for an experience reward. L|1|3.|{OPT} Loot the «Heart of Innocence (Text)¦Heart of Innocence» on the desk nearby. L|1|4.|{OPT} Using your «Lockpick», you can optionally open the several locked chests nearby for some poor man's loot.

But bless you, you found it!"⸩ ⸨Celcynd the Dour tells you, "It smells of Ayan Baqur, I've caught the scent before, the desert and dirt and the dirty pyreals.
