Indeed that is where this came from. Somewhere near the city and surrounded by firs. May I keep it?"⸩ ⸨Celcynd the Dour tells you, "Oh thank you. It reminds me of the area near the Glenden Wood Prison the trees there smell so nice throughout the year."
L|1||Obtaining Wooden Tablet⸩ ⸨Chunk of Wood gives you Wooden Tablet.⸩ ⸨You pick up a sliver of the bark. As you do another appears in its place.
L|1||Attempting to use the Fir Tree if not flagged⸩ ⸨You seem to have some odd preoccupation with rubbing trees. Perhaps you should speak to someone about this.
L|1||Entering the Fir Tree⸩ ⸨I see you've found my lair. Well... good for you. If you've come to join me all you need do is pass my tests, alone. You do that and I just might take you on as an apprentice in the less savory arts. You fail and well anything you drop will be mine.⸩ ⸨Perhaps if you are an astute observer you'll find my true intentions at some later time. Either way I congratulate your efforts thus far.⸩ ⸨You're a brave one aren't you? Well I guess we'll see how savvy you are too. The only way to leave this room, aside from being a yellow coward fleeing to the lifestone, your home or your master's mansion, is to solve the puzzle there on the pedestal. But you'll need to be an accomplished vagabond to finish that puzzle. Oh and one more thing, the puzzle box has a built in failsafe to see that unaccomplished vagabonds are punished for trying to be something that they are not.
L|1||Passing the Trail of the Vagabond⸩ ⸨⸨Puzzle Box teleports you with Vagabond Passed.⸩⸩ ⸨You've done well thus far--but now comes the test of cunning. There are two ways out of this next room: Death and out through the portal you can see across the length of this chamber. Good luck.
L|1||Passing Eagle's Sight⸩ ⸨⸨Target teleports you with Bullseye.⸩⸩ ⸨You made it through three of four, but now lies the most difficult. There is only one right answer here. There are four little tuskies here; the fifth, much larger one is their baby-sitter. You'll need to talk to the babysitter and decipher his riddle or be sent away from this place for a time; shall we say a week? There can be no mistakes now... think really hard on this one.
L|1||Babysitter⸩ ⸨Babysitter gives you Blue Ball⸩ ⸨Babysitter gives you Red Ball⸩ ⸨Babysitter gives you Green Ball⸩ ⸨Babysitter gives you Yellow Ball⸩ ⸨Babysitter tells you, "These are four funny tuskers. Each likes to play with a ball, but they will only play with a ball of their favorite color. Speak to them to learn whose favorite color is which. But be warned⸩ ⸨Babysitter tells you, "One is a liar, One always tells the truth, one alternates between the truth and fiction and the last, whose rules for telling the truth when he makes three statements are different than the other three tuskies.⸩ ⸨Babysitter tells you, "One final Note: The tuskies like the color of the balls dependent on their age. The youngest likes the green ball. The oldest likes the blue ball. The second oldest likes the red ball. The second youngest likes the yellow ball.⸩ ⸨Babysitter tells you, "When you think you have figured out the puzzle hand the balls to the children. Then use the statue on the other side of the room to see if you are right so you can pass into the master's room.
L|1||Cao Cao⸩ ⸨Cao Cao tells you, "Only one of Shim Shim's statements is false."⸩ ⸨Cao Cao tells you, "The tuskie who lies, is two births younger than the truth telling tuskie."
L|1||Mu Mu⸩ ⸨Mu Mu tells you, "Shim Shim is older than Po Po"⸩ ⸨Mu Mu tells you, "Po Po always tells the truth."
L|1||Shim Shim⸩ ⸨Shim Shim tells you, "Mu Mu alternates consistently between truth and lies."⸩ ⸨Shim Shim tells you, "Mu Mu is not the youngest."⸩ ⸨Shim Shim tells you, "Po Po does nothing but lie."
L|1||Po Po⸩ ⸨Po Po tells you, "Mu Mu's second statement is true."⸩ ⸨Po Po tells you, "Cao Cao is the youngest."
L|1||Judgment Statue⸩ ⸨Judgment Statue tells you, "You must first attempt the riddle."⸩ ⸨Judgment Statue tells you, "You have done well. You've made it into my room and you should be rewarded for your efforts. So take this key, and open my chest. Take what is inside. It'll help you out in your travels I am sure of that, oh and look around the room for some other clues, you might find something of interest."⸩ ⸨Judgment Statue gives you Oswald's Key.⸩ ⸨⸨Judgment Statue teleports you with Oswald's Room.⸩
L|1||Handing in Magnificent Bracelet⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "I had no idea he had gotten me such a beautiful bracelet. I've never seen it before now."⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "Thank you so much for bringing me this, I will miss that wonderful man."⸩ ⸨You've earned 24,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Aaminah gives you 2 Trade Notes (250,000).⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to collect the bracelet again.⸩

At one time there were stores of these parts cached about the land, but now, with the chaos of the times and your meddling, intrusive ways, Isparian, who knows where the parts may lie?"⸩ ⸨Undead Mechanic tells you, "But find them, and bring them to me, and I will reward you."

Quest.name: Aerbax's_Prodigal_Lugian
Quest.notes: Failing the mind trial might give qb, need to test
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 | Recommended Level = 200+ (solo) I|Type|Small Fellowship/Solo I|Starts With|«Oswent the Pale» I|Starts At|25.7N, 49.2E in «Cragstone» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|In order to start this quest you must have completed the «Bur Recall Quest» also given by «Oswent the Pale». If you have not done the Bur Recall quest recently you may need to repeat it. L|1|•|Note: It's suggested to run the trials one character at a time, moving through the trials with multiple characters is buggy. If you can't get a Shadow Kresovus to spawn, try leaving to TN and starting from the beginning. L|1|•|Note: If you are completing this quest to get access to the Prodigal Lugian dungeon for T10 flagging, make sure to get the harmonic while in the dungeon doing this quest or you will have to wait 20 hours to enter it again.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Chambers Beneath Linvak Tukal and Entering the Trials L|1|1.|«Oswent the Pale» will give you «Royal Summons». L|2|•|⟦AerbaxsProdigalLugian_Start!⟧ L|1|2.|Head to «Linvak Tukal». You can find a portal to there in «Town Network» (Annex). While you are there you can speak to «Kifandal the Imbuer» and buy some «Linvak Tukal Portal Gem»s. When you are ready head up to «Lord Kresovus» and present him with the Royal Summons. L|2|•|⟦AerbaxsProdigalLugian_Flag⟧ L|1|3.|Now use «Kresovus' Lockbox» and you will be portaled into a dungeon similar in layout to the dungeon from the Bur Recall quest. In the first room is Lord Kresovus. L|1|4.|Kill the guards and take down the door and then portal in to the next area. In this next room, you will find an «Altar» with a «Pristine White Mattekar Hide» (piece of Balor's hide) on top of it - it is guarded by various Virindi and Shadow creatures. Take the hide and then use the altar to open the nearby door. Work your way through the halls, fighting the «Abyssal Shadow Lugian»s to enter the portal to the first trial.
H3|Part 2: Trial of the Arm L|1|1.|You will again enter a hallway leading to a large room. In the center of the room is a large «Boulder». It is attackable, and when destroyed a hallway is revealed underneath it. Right below the boulder in the hallway is the «Corpse of Phlynt», the lugian Oswent sent to spy on «Shadow Kresovus». Open his corpse and loot the «Phial of Chorizite» and the «Hidden Note». Then continue down the hallway. You will find a large room with «Shadow Kresovus» and some of his minions. L|2|•|Note: The Phial of Chorizite is also dropped by «Shadow Kresovus (Trial of the Heart)¦Shadow Kresovus» in the room with the energy cage. L|1|2.|When you defeat this «Shadow Kresovus (Trial of the Arm)¦Shadow Kresovus» enter the portal in the hallway behind him to enter the next trial. L|2|•|⟦TrialoftheMind_Flag⟧
H3|Part 3: Trial of the Mind L|1|1.|Once again you are portaled into the same style chambers. Head down to the open room for your next task. In the center of the room is the «Pillar of the Mind». Read it's description closely, as you will need this information to solve the puzzle. When you are ready, use the pillar to begin your first attempt. You have 5 minutes to attempt the puzzle, and 3 attempts total. If you fail, using the portal will teleport you to the beginning of the Trial of the Arm, but you can run through that dungeon to get back to this puzzle. L|2|•|Use Pillar: ⟦TrialoftheMind_Attempts⟧ L|1|2.|When you use the pillar, the following objects/items will spawn near the pillar: L|2|1.|Three «Bag of Stones» L|2|2.|A scale with two «Bucket»s L|2|3.|Four «Red Stone»s (weighing 3 stones each) L|2|4.|Three «Yellow Stone» (weighing 2 stones each) L|2|5.|Two «White Stone» (weighing 1 stones each) L|1|3.|You must use the stones provided to make each bag contain one color and "maintain its current weight in stones". You then must use the remaining stones to balance the scales correctly. L|1|4.|Where by "current" they mean the initial weight. The bags already contain some stones, and you can use the bag to see what stones are currently in it. Initially the bags contain the following stones: TH| West Middle East TR|Red - 1 1 TR|Yellow 1 1 2 TR|White 1 1 2 TR|Initial Weight 3 6 9 TE L|1||5. Give each bag one color of stones until it only contains stones of that color (the other colored stones will pop out and be put in your inventory), and the weight of the stones will be the same as the initial weight. L|2|1.|Give 2 white stones to the western bag. L|2|2.|* ⟦StoneBagComplete⟧ L|2|3.|Give 2 yellow stones to the middle bag. L|2|4.|Give 2 red stones to the eastern bag. L|2||Failure Stamp: Give 1 White to western bag. L|3|•|⟦GaveColoredStoneExcess⟧ L|1||6. You should have 3 red, 4 yellow, and 3 white stones left. The description of the north bucket says "Progressive numbers, equal weight", and the one on the south bucket says "This bucket must contain an equal number of any stones within it." L|1||7. So the scale must balance, the south bucket must contain even numbers of each color, and the north bucket will have 1, 2, and 3 stones of each color. L|2|1.|Give 3 white stones, 2 yellow stones and 1 red stone to the scale's northern bucket. L|2|2.|Give 2 yellow stones and 2 red stones to the scale's southern bucket. L|3|•|⟦BucketsBalancedComplete⟧ L|1||8. Use the Pillar again to complete the puzzle. L|1||9. When you have solved the puzzle, enter the door and head down the hall to the next portal. L|1||10. Another «Shadow Kresovus (Trial of the Mind)¦Shadow Kresovus» will appear, this time with Virindi minions. Destroy him and you will be allowed to enter the portal to the next trial. L|2|•|⟦TrialoftheHeart_Flag⟧
H3|Part 4: Trial of the Heart L|1|1.|In this next dungeon you will find the «Pillar of the Heart». L|1|2.|You must answer its question before you may advance. It asks you to pick the thing which Lugians value most. L|1|3.|Enter a nearby hallway lined with rooms. L|1|4.|Each room contains several items which a lugian may value. When you think you have found the correct item, use it and return to the pillar: L|2|•|«Bastion of Tukal (Aerbax's Prodigal Lugian)¦Bastion of Tukal» L|2|•|«Bolt of Velvet» L|2|•|«Chalice of Morkindmity» L|2|•|«Chorizite Pea» L|2|•|«Crest of Kings (Aerbax's Prodigal Lugian)¦Crest of Kings» L|2|•|«Crown of the First King» L|2|•|«Cutters Cup» L|2|•|«Energy Cage» L|2|•|«Gauntlets of Power» L|2|•|«Hammer of the Ages» L|2|•|«Helm of the Crag (Aerbax's Prodigal Lugian)¦Helm of the Crag» L|2|•|«Painting of the Building of Linvak Tukal» - **Correct item** - ⟦UsedPaintingTrialofHeart⟧ L|2|•|«Pyreal Bar (Aerbax's Prodigal Lugian)¦Pyreal Bar» L|2|•|«Robes of Grey Dawn» L|2|•|«Sack of Black Opal» L|2|•|«Sack of Brass» L|2|•|«Sack of Fire Opal» L|2|•|«Sack of Granite» L|2|•|«Sack of Green Garnet» L|2|•|«Sack of Iron» L|2|•|«Sack of Steel» L|2|•|«Scepter of Might (Aerbax's Prodigal Lugian)¦Scepter of Might» L|2|•|«Spear of Purity (Aerbax's Prodigal Lugian)¦Spear of Purity» L|2|•|«Staff of Clarity (Aerbax's Prodigal Lugian)¦Staff of Clarity» L|2|•|«Treasure (Aerbax's Prodigal Lugian)¦Treasure» L|2|•|«Ulkra's Sword» L|1|5.|The correct answer will open the large door in front of the pillar. Head down the hallway and you will find «Shadow Kresovus (Trial of the Heart)¦Shadow Kresovus» and the real Kresovus trapped in an energy cage! Defeat this Shadow, then hand the Phial of Chorizite to the real Kresovus to remove the energy cage. Then talk to him this will set him free. L|2|•|⟦TotHeartEnergyCageDown⟧ L|1|6.|Now enter the final portal and defeat «Shadow Kresovus (Trials Graduation)¦Shadow Kresovus» at last. L|1|7.|This «Shadow Kresovus (Trials Graduation)¦Shadow Kresovus» has some powerful war spells, including a wave spells, heavy rings, and a health draining vortex. He will also summon Virindi, shadow, and shadow Lugian minions to defend him. When you defeat him loot the «Sigil of Linvak Tukal». L|2|•|⟦SigilofLinvakTukalPickupTimer⟧ L|1|8.|Then return to Linvak Tukal and present «Lord Kresovus» with the Sigil to receive your rewards. There are also additional rewards available, «#Rewards¦see below» for details. L|2|•|⟦AurutisItemUpgrade_Flag⟧ L|2|•|⟦AerbaxsProdigalLugian_Wait⟧ L|2|•|⟦AerbaxsProdigalLugian_Repeat⟧ L|1|9.|Show «Pristine White Mattekar Hide» to «Lord Kresovus» L|2|•|⟦AllowBalorRobe⟧ L|1|10.|Bring «Pristine White Mattekar Hide» to «Yi Yo-Jin» for «Balor's Robe»
P|Notes L|1|•|When repeating the quest, you must speak to Oswent again. L|1|•|You will not have to repeat the trials. Using the chest sends you directly to the final room. L|1|•|You're only able to get Balor's Robe once. L|1|•|You can upgrade one item from the «Arm, Mind, Heart» quest every time you complete the quest.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale tells you, "You've investigated the matter of the Lord Kresovus impostor to my satisfaction."⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale tells you, "I have another mission for you that may prove far more dangerous, but your people need you."⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale tells you, "Deliver this Royal Summons to Kresovus. He will have to accompany you if he wishes to keep his cover. When you and the imposter are away from Linvak and alone you must dispose of him."⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale gives you Royal Summons.⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale tells you, "Have you delivered the Royal Summons to the Lord Kresovus imposter?"⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale tells you, "Be sure that you have him alone before you attack. We wouldn't want the Lugians of Linvak Tukal believing we were trying to assassinate their Leader. I believe once the imposter is dead we can prove to the Lugians their Leader has been missing since the attacks on Linvak Tukal began."
L|1||Giving the Royal Summons to Lord Kresovus⸩ ⸨You give Lord Kresovus Royal Summons.⸩ ⸨Kresovus reads the summons. You suspect you see a small smirk flit across his face.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "I cannot speak of this here. There is a spy in my court and I fear for my life. You must meet with me in secret below. Use the chest here to access the chambers beneath Linvak Tukal. I will meet you there.⸩ ⸨You place your hand on the chest, and it rumbles open, revealing the purple light of portalspace...
L|1||Imposter Lord Kresovus⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus says, "I can't believe they thought you would be able to remove me from Linvak Tukal! Was it Oswent? He only found out about my meeting place here because I needed a distraction in order to fulfill an agreement my master made with the undead. A certain animal was painstakingly modified for them."⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus says, "Your interference is at an end. Just like the spy they sent to watch me you will never be found."⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus says, "I won't even bother dealing with you myself."⸩ ⸨Kresovus waves his hand and a number of Lugian Guards file into the room.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus says, "Kill him."⸩ ⸨Kresovus portals further into the dungeon.
L|1||Using the Altar beneath the Mattekar hide⸩ ⸨You notice some deep gouges in the stone. Virindi implements are scattered about matted with blood and white fur.
L|1||Shadow Kresovus (Trial of the Arm)⸩ ⸨Shadow Kresovus tells you, "So you've found the Lugian Trial Rooms have you? Funny thing, that spy they sent me didn't last too long down here. Perhaps you think you can do better? Let's see how you handle these."⸩ ⸨Shadow Kresovus tells you, "Feeble human! You cannot fight the dark."⸩ ⸨Shadow Kresovus says, "You have won this small victory, but I am hardly defeated. Continue at your own risk human."
L|1||Shadow Kresovus (Trial of the Mind)⸩ ⸨Shadow Kresovus tells you, "You're proving to be more resourceful than I expected... I will make you pay for the trouble you have caused me."
L|1||Shadow Kresovus (Trial of the Heart)⸩ ⸨Your blow knocks a small crystal from Shadow Kresovus' pocket. It falls to the floor and shatters in a bright flash. The energy cage surrounding Lord Kresovus seems to wane.⸩ ⸨Shadow Kresovus says, "Why won't you just die?!"⸩ ⸨Shadow Kresovus growls in frustration and leaps through the portal to the next room.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus says, "Free me!"
L|1||Giving Phial of Chorizite to the Energy Cage⸩ ⸨You give Energy Cage Phial of Chorizite.⸩ ⸨The energy cage surrounding Lord Kresovus bursts apart in a magical discharge.⸩ ⸨Kresovus heaves a sigh of relief and gives you an appraising look.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "Thank you. I must ask that you defeat my imposter alone. I am not strong enough to fight him now. Please follow him and insure he troubles us no more."⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "Good luck my friend."⸩ ⸨Kresovus makes a sweeping gesture recalling to his lifestone.
L|1||Shadow Kresovus (Trials Graduation)⸩ ⸨Shadow Kresovus grins, his black teeth grinding, "Congratulations on completing the Trials of the Arm, Mind and Heart human. Perhaps you would make a better Lugian than I, but we shall never find out. For now it is time that you die."
L|1||Defeating Shadow Kresovus (Trials Graduation)⸩ ⸨Shadow Kresovus says, "I can't believe it. You defeated me? Me!"⸩ ⸨Shadow Kresovus says, "You've ruined everything! Oh, but you'll see. The Master will not be happy. You and your kind will be payed back in full."
L|1||Giving Sigil of Linvak Tukal to Lord Kresovus⸩ ⸨You give Lord Kresovus Sigil of Linvak Tukal.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus heaves a great sigh. "Thank you for freeing me . I owe you a great deal."⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus gives you Powdered Chorizite Pea.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "Take this Chorizite Pea. I have also given permission to Auritis to upgrade any of the armor or weapons of the Arm, Mind and Heart that you may have. Speak with him to find out more."⸩ ⸨Kresovus chuckles lightly to himself.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "Long have I trained the best of my people in the three paths we Lugians brought with us from the old world. You have not only seen the Trials of the Arm, Mind and Heart, but you must have bested each of them to save me from the cowled ones and the shadowy imposter."⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "Had a human ever asked to take the trials I would have denied them such a presumptious request, but you have proven your Strength, Clarity and Purity beyond doubt."⸩ ⸨You've earned 162,415,717 experience.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus clears his throat, "All who may hear my words. I am proud to bestow the honor and duty of 'Guardian of Linvak Tukal' on . Their honor and dignity continue to prove the wisdom of our friendship and loyalty to the Humans.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "Thank you for freeing me human. My people and I owe you more than can ever be repaid."⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "The Guardians report they have been unsucessful [sic] in removing the darkness from the last of the chambers below. I suspect we have not seen the last of this Shadow Kresovus."⸩ ⸨Return in 13d to fight Shadow Kresovus again.
L|1||Showing Pristine White Mattekar Hide to Lord Kresovus⸩ ⸨You allow Lord Kresovus to examine your Pristine White Mattekar Hide.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus grips the hide of his old pet and drops his head in silence.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "I raised him from a little Mattie. He was my best friend."⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "I will miss you Balor."⸩ ⸨Kresovus loosens his grip on the hide.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "Balor would want to be of use. He was always so brave..."⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "Take it and go. I wish to be alone with my thoughts."
L|1||Handing the Pristine White Mattekar Hide to Yi Yo-Jin⸩ ⸨You allow Yi Yo-Jin to examine your Pristine White Mattekar Hide.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Pristine White Mattekar Hides.⸩ ⸨Yo-Jin holds the hide up reverently and looks a bit scared.⸩ ⸨Yi Yo-Jin tells you, "Well, I have Kresovus' permission to craft this hide now, but I'm still not sure I want to. You must be pretty important for Kresovus to allow this."⸩ ⸨Yo-Jin hesitates and then begins his work, deftly cutting Balor's hide in the pattern for a robe.⸩ ⸨Yi Yo-Jin gives you Balor's Robe.⸩ ⸨Yi Yo-Jin tells you, "Here you are. I don't mind saying that this is some of my best work. Be careful with this, I'm not sure Kresovus would be so giving if you let it come to harm. Oh, and be tactful, don't wear this around Kresovus."
L|1||Attempting to have the hide crafted without showing it to Lord Kresovus first⸩ ⸨You allow Yi Yo-Jin to examine your Pristine White Mattekar Hide.⸩ ⸨Yi Yo-Jin rubs the fur between his fingers and peers closely at it.⸩ ⸨Yi Yo-Jin tells you, "This is a rather unusual Mattekar hide. Hmm, the last time I saw fur like this was when I visited Linvak Tu..."⸩ ⸨Yi Yo-Jin tells you, "No, No, No! I am not going to be responsible for making a robe out of this hide."⸩ ⸨Yi Yo-Jin tells you, "What are you doing, trying to get me killed?"
L|1||Oswent the Pale (Quest Repeat)⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale tells you, "You fought valiantly against the Falatacot that imprisoned Asheron on Bur, didn't you? I have seen council reports on your bravery. I commend you for your past service, and I would ask for your assistance once more in a very sensitive matter of utmost importance to the realm. Some of us have reason to believe that Lord Kresovus, the leader of our Lugian allies, is... not what he seems."⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale tells you, "Please venture to the Lugian stronghold of Linvak Tukal and discreetly investigate Lord Kresovus' quarters. It could be that there is some evidence there of what has happened to him."
L|1||Giving Sigil of Linvak Tukal to Lord Kresovus (Quest Repeat)⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "Welcome back Guardian. The other Guardians report trouble in the lower levels. It would appear that Shadow Kresovus has returned. Do your duty and destroy this mockery in my name.⸩ ⸨You give Lord Kresovus Sigil of Linvak Tukal.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus shakes his head in wonder, "He keeps returning. When will that imposter learn that Guardian's like yourself will never allow him back?"⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus gives you Powdered Chorizite Pea.⸩ ⸨Lord Kresovus tells you, "Take this Chorizite Pea. I have also given permission to Auritis to upgrade any of the armor or weapons of the Arm, Mind and Heart that you may have. Speak with him to find out more."⸩ ⸨You've earned 7,500 Luminance.
L|1||Giving an Arm, Mind and Heart item to Aurutis for the enhanced version⸩ ⸨You allow Aurutis to examine your Bastion of Tukal.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Bastion of Tukals.⸩ ⸨Aurutis gives you Bastion of Tukal.⸩ ⸨Aurutis tells you, "Here you are Guardian. Thank you for your part in defeating that vile imposter of Lord Kresovus."⸩

Quest.name: Crystalline_Adventurer
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|50, 70, 90, 110, 130 I|Rec. Level|60, 80, 100, 120, 140 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Tokashi Ando» (Optional) I|Starts At|«Crystalline Crag» at 14.6S, 62.2W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Crystalline Adventurer» H2|Overview P|This quest is a series of dungeons of increasing difficulty to collect special trophies at the end of each one.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Crystalline Shards (50+) L|1|•|Kill various wisps throughout the «Crystalline Crag» and its dungeons. L|1|•|Wisps will randomly drop a yellow-colored «Crystalline Shard». L|1|•|Hand them to «Tokashi Ando» for 50,000 xp each. L|2|•|⟦crystallineshardturnin⟧ L|2|•|Note: Unlike with the other shards, there is no pickup timer and they are giveable. Any character of level 50+ can hand them in for the xp reward.
H3|Rare Crystalline Shards (50+) L|1|1.|On the Crag, and inside the dungeon, there are randomly spawning «Crystal (Object)¦Crystals». Use the crystal to spawn a pack of various «Crystalline Wisp»s. L|1|2.|Once you've killed the spawn, open their corpses for «Rare Crystalline Shard»s. Each «Crystalline Wisp» spawned by the Crystal will hold one Rare Shard (as well as a chance at a regular «Crystalline Shard»). L|1|3.|Once you collect 10 Rare Shards, return them to «Tokashi Ando» for your reward. L|2|•|⟦rarecrystallineshardturnin⟧
H3|Crystalline Dungeon (70+) L|1|1.|Enter the Crystalline Portal dungeon at 17.0S 61.2W. L|1|2.|Once inside, find and kill an «Aggregate Crystalline Wisp». L|2|•|There are various spawns of them around the dungeon, but you will find 2 near the portal at the end of the dungeon. L|1|3.|Loot an «Aggregate Crystalline Shard» from its corpse. L|2|•|⟦aggregateshardpickup⟧
H3|Icy Crystalline Dungeon (90+) L|1|1.|Enter the Crystalline Portal at the bottom of the 70+ Crystalline Portal dungeon. L|1|2.|Once inside, find and kill an «Intense Aggregate Crystalline Wisp». L|2|•|There is a room with many of them near one of the crystals for the «Marker Crystals¦Marker Crystals quest». There are also many in the honeycomb section near the portal at the end of the dungeon. L|1|3.|Loot a «Large Aggregate Crystalline Shard» from its corpse. L|2|•|⟦largeaggregateshardpickup⟧
H3|Fiery Crystalline Dungeon (110+) L|1|1.|Enter the Crystalline Portal at the bottom of the 90+ Crystalline Portal dungeon. L|1|2.|Once inside, find and kill an «Intense Aggregate Crystalline Wisp». L|2|•|They spawn primarily in the final magma-floored rooms before the portal at the end. L|1|3.|Loot a «Giant Aggregate Crystalline Shard» from its corpse. L|2|•|⟦giantaggregateshardpickup⟧
H3|Progenitors' Lair (130+) L|1|1.|Enter the Crystalline Portal at the bottom of the 110+ Crystalline Portal dungeon. L|1|2.|Run up the ramp into the large room at the top. L|1|3.|Speak to the «Shade of Ja'qu» located in the center of the dungeon. L|2|•|He will give you two kill tasks. You must complete both of these tasks in order to access the Progenitors above. L|3|•|One task is to kill 25 «Intense Corroding Crystalline Wisp»s and «Intense Incalescent Crystalline Wisp»s. Both count toward this objective. L|3|•|The other task is to kill 25 «Intense Shivering Crystalline Wisp»s and «Intense Voltaic Crystalline Wisp»s. Both count toward this objective. L|2|•|⟦KillTaskIntenseWispsCorInca⟧ L|2|•|First Kill: ⟦KillTaskIntenseWispsCorInca⟧ on first completion L|2|•|⟦KillTaskIntenseWispsShiVol⟧ L|2|•|First Kill: ⟦KillTaskIntenseWispsShiVol⟧ on first completion L|2|•|⟦ProgenitorIngotStarted⟧ L|1|4.|Hit the two levers in the room with the «Shade of Ja'qu». L|1|5.|Enter one of the doors that opened to the North or South. Either door is fine; the primary difference is the South hallways lead toward Acid/Fire Wisps and the North hallways lead toward Frost/Lightning Wisps. Kill all the wisps along the way to complete the kill tasks. L|1|6.|Go up a couple levels until you find a room with two kinds of wisps (either Acid/Fire or Frost/Lightning) and a lever door in the middle of the wall in front of you with two hallways on either side of it. L|1|7.|Go through one of the hallways and use the lever you find at the end right before the bridge. L|1|8.|Go back to the room with the lever door and go through the other open hallway until you find another lever. Use the lever and return to the lever door which should now be completely open. L|1|9.|Go through and use the lever on the other side of the door. That lever will open up the doors to 3 of the Progenitors you need to kill. L|2|•|Note: You must have completed the kill task assigned by Ja'qu to activate the levers (25 Acid/Fire Wisps or 25 Frost/Lightning Wisps). The kill task needed corresponds to the wisps in the lever room. L|2|•|If you have completed the task the lever will say: ":The lever responds to your touch.". L|1|10.|Kill the 3 Progenitors you can now access and loot their Progenitor Crystals: L|2|1.|«Acidic Progenitor Crystal» L|3|•|⟦progenitorcrystal1pickup⟧ L|2|2.|«Burning Progenitor Crystal» L|3|•|⟦progenitorcrystal2pickup⟧ L|2|3.|«Chilling Progenitor Crystal» L|3|•|⟦progenitorcrystal3pickup⟧ L|1|11.|Run back down one level the way you came and make a circle around until you find another way up that will bring you to a similar room with the other two kinds of elemental wisps and a lever door. Activate all three levers as you did in the previous room to access the 3 other Progenitors. L|2|1.|«Lightning Progenitor Crystal» L|3|•|⟦progenitorcrystal4pickup⟧ L|2|2.|«Shadow Progenitor Crystal» L|3|•|⟦progenitorcrystal5pickup⟧ L|2|3.|«Prismatic Progenitor Crystal» L|3|•|⟦progenitorcrystal6pickup⟧ L|2|•|Note: On return trips, or if you have already finished both Intense Wisp kill tasks, you can run to the top and jump around the bridges to access the levers directly to the Progenitors to avoid running through each side for full access. This requires a minor degree of jumping prowess, however. L|1|12.|Combine the Shadow Progenitor Crystal with the Prismatic Progenitor Crystal to create «Force Progenitor Crystal». L|1|13.|Combine the Burning Progenitor Crystal with the Chilling Progenitor Crystal to create «Combined Thermal Progenitor Crystal». L|1|14.|Combine the the Lightning Progenitor Crystal with the Acidic Progenitor Crystal to create «Combined Alkalemic Progenitor Crystal». L|1|15.|Combine the Combined Alkalemic Progenitor Crystal with the Combined Thermal Progenitor Crystal to create .«Elemental Progenitor Crystal». L|1|16.|Finally, combine the Force Progenitor Crystal with the Elemental Progenitor Crystal to create the «Progenitor Ingot». L|1|17.|Hand the ingot to Ja'qu for your rewards. Once you hand in the Ingot, you will be able to use the lever in front of the door east of Ja'qu. L|2|•|⟦ProgenitorIngotTurnIn⟧ L|2|•|⟦ProgenitorIngotWait⟧
H3|Crater and Facility L|1|1.|In the Progenitors' Lair, head through the door that the newly-available lever opens and head through into the crater above. L|1|2.|Enter the Facility through the tunnel in the ground opposite where you exited the Progenitors' Lair. L|1|3.|Open the «Essence Lock»s in the «Facility». The locks can be found beyond locked doors that can be unlocked using various keys in the dungeon. (See «Marker Crystals¦Crystalline Markers» for full details) L|2|1.|«Eastern Gate Key» L|2|2.|«Southern Gate Key» L|2|3.|«Western Gate Key» L|2|4.|«Northern Gate Key» L|2|•|You will need to activate all 4 Essence Locks per kill of the Array. Be prepared to run back through the dungeon if you have a group of more than 4. L|1|4.|Use the Essence Lock in the Crater to spawn a «Crystalline Essence Array». L|2|•|Northern Gate Essence Lock: ⟦EssenceLockUsed⟧ L|1|5.|The Array spawns with 6 «Crystalline Array Satellite»s and many, many «Crystalline Wisp»s. L|2|•|The Array has huge health but has no regen. However, the Wisps that spawn heal it extremely quickly. The Wisps are linked to the Satellites and will die if the Satellites are killed. L|2|•|The best route is to kill the Satellites first. Archers can go full speed on whatever they attack. You will have about 60-90 seconds before the Satellites respawn. It is best to use a high-quality bow regardless of your character type, mainly because of attack speed. L|2|•|The Array is extremely difficult, if not impossible to destroy alone unless you kill the Satellites before focusing on the Array itself. L|1|6.|Once the Array is dead, loot the «Crystalline Array Fragment» from the ground (4 drop per kill). L|2|•|⟦CrystalFinalPickup0509⟧ L|1|•|You can now run up the hill on the north side of the crater to up get to the rim and jump off, allowing you to run back to the «Resonant Portal» to the east instead of a lengthier run back.
H3|Wrapup L|1|•|Head back to «Tokashi Ando» to hand in all of the trophies you collected. You will receive xp for each trophy, titles for each of the Aggregate Shards, and a «Braced Mana Forge Key» for turning in the «Crystalline Array Fragment».

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Tokashi Ando tells you, "I've been sent to head up the research in this area however I am not able to make significant advancements on my own."⸩ ⸨Tokashi Ando tells you, "It's been decided that I should bring others in to assist with the exploration and research about the creatures and crystals in this region."⸩ ⸨Tokashi Ando tells you, "I've also been able to recover crystalline shards in the remains of the wisps. They'll assist our research and I'll reward you for bringing them to me."⸩ ⸨Tokashi Ando tells you, "If you find any unique wisps they may have unique crystalline shards that I'd be able to grant you a greater reward in exchange for it."⸩ ⸨Tokashi Ando tells you, "There are also a few locations that I have not been able to reach on my own. If you can reach these places you may find great reward there."⸩ ⸨Tokashi Ando tells you, "Return to me with any objects you may find. Talk to my associates about any other rewards."⸩ ⸨Tokashi Ando tells you, "Now get out there and have an adventure!"
L|1||Giving Crystalline Shard to Tokashi Ando⸩ ⸨You give Tokashi Ando Crystalline Shard.⸩ ⸨Tokashi Ando tells you, "This crystal contains the remaning essence of the wisp it was recovered from. I thank you greatly and here is your reward."⸩ ⸨You've earned 50,000 experience.

L|1||Giving Large Aggregate Crystalline Shard to Tokashi Ando⸩ ⸨You give Tokashi Ando Large Aggregate Crystalline Shard.⸩ ⸨Tokashi Ando tells you, "This is a very unique crystal indeed. It seems to have the combined properties of all these wisps combied! Here is a reward for you adventurer."⸩ ⸨You've earned 100,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Tokashi Ando tells you, "I bestow you with the title of Frozen Fighter."
L|1||Giving Giant Aggregate Crystalline Shard to Tokashi Ando⸩ ⸨You give Tokashi Ando Giant Aggregate Crystalline Shard.⸩ ⸨Tokashi Ando tells you, "This is a very unique crystal indeed. It seems to have the combined properties of all these wisps combied! Here is a reward for you adventurer."⸩ ⸨You've earned 125,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Tokashi Ando tells you, "I bestow you with the title of Burning Soul."
L|1||Shade of Ja'qu⸩ ⸨Shade of Ja'qu says, "I failed them... I failed them all..."⸩ ⸨Shade of Ja'qu tells you, "It has been so long. Time means not to me now. The taste of life I can no longer remember. I ran the experiments here, I created this prison for myself as I locked down the facility."⸩ ⸨Shade of Ja'qu tells you, "How have you come to be here? Quest.name: Training_Academy_Quest
Quest.notes: Need 2 Chars, one to skip academy and one to complete for full qb
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Character Creation» I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Overview P|Complete the Training Academy to learn the basics of «Asheron's Call», gain useful starter equipment and level up from 1 to 5.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Entering the Academy L|1|1.|Speak with the «Society Greeter», hand her your «Calling Stone», then use the door to the East. L|2|•|⟦CallingStoneGiven⟧ L|2|•|{OPT} If you wish to skip the tutorial, take the door to the North and speak with «Jonathan» to receive an «Academy Exit Token». Hand it back to him to exit the «Training Academy». L|2|•|{OPT} Read the text «Letter From Home» in your inventory. L|2|•|{OPT} Read the «VIEW CONTROLS» sign. L|2|•|{OPT} Pick up and read the text «Restoring the Training Academies». L|1|2.|Speak with «Samuel», then find all 3 pieces of armor and return to him. L|2|1.|«Leather Cap (Training Academy)¦Leather Cap» - South Room L|3|•|⟦CapAcademyPickup⟧ L|2|2.|«Leather Gauntlets (Training Academy)¦Leather Gauntlets» - North Room L|3|•|⟦GauntletsAcademyPickUp⟧ L|2|3.|«Leather Leggings (Training Academy)¦Leather Leggings» - South Room L|3|•|⟦LeggingsAcademyPickUp⟧ L|1|3.|Use the door to the East and speak with the «Training Master». L|2|•|{OPT} Read the following signs: «WIELDING ITEMS», «COMBAT BAR», «STATUS BARS», «BASICS OF MAGIC», «SPELLCASTING», «MAGIC TIPS». L|2|•|{OPT} Pick up and read the following books: «Combat and Spellcasting Guide», «Guide to Healing», «Guide to Raising Skills and Attributes», «Tinkering (Text)¦Tinkering». L|2|•|{OPT} Find the three «Treasure Chest (Training Academy)¦Treasure Chest»s in the Sparring Golem room and take the «Potion of Healing», «Stamina Potion», and «Mana Potion». L|1|4.|Kill a «Sparring Golem», loot an «Academy Token» from its corpse, and return it to the «Training Master». L|2|•|⟦AcademyTokenGiven⟧ L|1|5.|Enter the «Central Courtyard» portal to the right and speak with the «Academy Foreman». L|1|6.|Take the passage to the West and kill a «Carpenter Wasp». Loot a «Carpenter Wasp Wing» from its corpse and return it to the «Academy Foreman». L|2|•|Wing Pickup: ⟦CarpWing⟧ L|2|•|Wing Turn-in: ⟦WaspWingDone⟧ L|1|7.|Speak to the «Academy Blacksmith» to the South, head through the South passage and kill a «Thieving Thrungus» to retrieve «Bellows». L|2|•|⟦BellowsNewbiePickedUp⟧ L|1|8.|Return them to the «Academy Blacksmith» to receive an «Academy Library Key». L|2|•|⟦BellowsNewbieTurnedIn⟧ L|2|•|{OPT} Find the «Treasure Chest (Training Academy)¦Treasure Chest» in the Thrungus area and take the «Potion of Healing», «Stamina Potion», and «Mana Potion». L|1|9.|Use the «Academy Library Key» on the door to the East and speak with the «Academy Researcher». L|1|10.|Purchase the «Oil of Rendering» from the «Academy Researcher», and apply it to your «Training Weapon» to create an «Academy Weapon». L|1|11.|Head up the stairs. L|2|•|{OPT} Speak with the «Wordsmith» to receive the text «Guide to Chat». L|2|•|{OPT} Speak with the «Academy Crier» for some tips. L|2|•|{OPT} Speak with the «Academy Shopkeep» to buy and sell items. L|2|•|{OPT} Find the three «Treasure Chest (Training Academy)¦Treasure Chest»s and take the «Potion of Healing», «Stamina Potion», and «Mana Potion». L|1|12.|Speak with the «Senior Guard», then take the portal to the «Outer Courtyard». L|1|13.|Speak with the «Sentry (Training Academy)¦Sentry». Take the stairs down then enter the Olthoi Tunnels. Kill the «Adolescent Olthoi» and loot a «Protection Orb». L|2|•|⟦ProtectionOrb⟧ L|1|14.|Return the orb to the Sentry and you'll be given an «Academy Coat» and a «Facility Hub Portal Gem». L|2|•|⟦SentryTaskComplete⟧ L|2|•|{OPT} Read the «LIFESTONES SIGN». L|2|•|{OPT} Find the «Treasure Chest (Training Academy)¦Treasure Chest» and take the «Potion of Healing», «Stamina Potion», and «Mana Potion».
H3|After Leaving the Academy L|1|1.|Speak to one of the four «Lifestone Greeter»s to learn about the «Lifestone» and receive a starter quest contract and advance one level. L|2|•|⟦LifestoneFound1111⟧ L|2|•|⟦ToTheBarkeep⟧ L|1|2.|Using the information in your contract panel (quill icon in the lower right corner), speak to «Bartender Greeter» inside the local tavern. L|2|•|⟦BartenderFound1111⟧ L|2|•|⟦ToPathwarden⟧ L|1|3.|They will tell you a little about «Contracts» and the local Barkeep who sells contracts for the nearby «Starter Quests». He will also give you enough xp to advance one level and another mini-quest which he gives you the contract for. L|1|4.|Talk to one of the four «Pathwarden Greeter»s who are found near the Lifestone to complete the "Find the Pathwarden" contract and earn another 12,500 xp. L|2|•|⟦PathwardenFound1111⟧ L|1|5.|Give your «Pathwarden Token» to the greeter to receive a «Pathwarden Supply Key», the key unlocks the «Pathwarden Chest» that contains race specific starter armor and a robe. L|2|•|⟦PathwardenComplete⟧ L|2|•|«Thorolf» - «Holtburg» - Plate Armor L|2|•|«Pathwarden Thierra Molanti» - «Sanamar» - Diforsa Armor L|2|•|«Pathwarden Koro Ijida» - «Shoushi» - Yoroi Armor L|2|•|«Pathwarden Qanara bint Qolosh» - «Yaraq» - Scale Armor L|1|6.|Non Repeatable you have found better armor and no longer need the pathwarden armor, you can turn it back in to one of the «Pathwarden Greeter»s for other useful items. Don't forget to wield the «Pathwarden Trinket» to increase experience earned by 4%. L|1|7.|See «Starter Quests» and «Facility Hub Quests» for more quests aimed at helping new explorers level up.

Quest.name: Advanced_Colosseum_Arena
Quest.notes: Starts at round 6, complete regular to start from 1.
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 I|Type|Locked Fellowship I|Starts At|«Colosseum» I|Route|«Yanshi» to 11.3S, 37.6E I|Repeat|1 Hour I|Time|1 Hour I|Contracts|«Contract for Colosseum» H2|Overview P|The most important thing any group will need for a successful colosseum run is a group of 9 players who can work well together and follow directions. There are no set rules to beating the colosseum.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Exchange five MMDs or one tier 1/2 rare gem for a «Colosseum Ticket» from the «Colosseum Ticket Vendor». L|1|2.|Hand the ticket to the Master Arbitrator to flag the fellowship to enter the arena. L|1|3.|Enter the Advanced Colosseum arena using the door to the right of the Master Arbitrator. L|1|4.|Progress through as many rooms of the arena as you can in 1 hour. See player guides below on how to beat each of the rooms of the Colosseum. H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog L|1||Iron Blade Warmaster Task⸩ ⸨Atamarr tells you, "I have a task in which you may be able to aid me. I have managed to subvert a small number of Gear Knights in the Iron Blade's invasion, and they have identified a Gear Knight in a position of influence within the forces whose loss would slow the expansion of the Iron Blade"⸩ ⸨Atamarr tells you, "There is an Iron Blade Warmaster who has recently arrived from our home realm. My spies tell me that he is a gifted tactician, and if his skills were given time to be exercised, it could spell trouble for us."⸩ ⸨Atamarr tells you, "You will find the Warmaster deep within the excavations that the Iron Blade have made in the heart of the area they control in the Direlands."⸩ ⸨Atamarr tells you, "I would expect he will not be easy to kill, so take care in this mission. I have also been told that he stays on the move, speaking with the troops and formulating plans, so he may be difficult to find. Search in the deepest areas of the excavation, and I am sure you'll find him soon enough. Once he is dead, return to me."
L|1||Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander Task⸩ ⸨Atamarr tells you, "I have a task in which you may be able to aid me. I have managed to subvert a small number of Gear Knights in the Iron Blade's invasion, and they have identified a Gear Knight in a position of influence within the forces that may be convinced to end his involvement with the Iron Blade."⸩ ⸨Atamarr tells you, "The Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander they have recruited is known to me, and I believe him to be a very honorable and rational Gear Knight. I would approach him directly, or send one of my spies, but the Iron Blade Commanders have spread many stories about the Isparians manipulating and controlling those of us who have been recently repaired. I believe it'd be far more convincing to have one of your people deal with him directly, so he may judge for himself."⸩ ⸨Atamarr tells you, "You will find the Knight-Commander in the excavations that the Iron Blade have made in the heart of the area they control in the Direlands."⸩ ⸨Atamarr tells you, "I would expect he will demand some sort of proof. I ask that you follow his requests, and let him come to understand your people as I have come to. Once you complete whatever tasks he sets before you, return to me."
L|1||Copper Cog Craftsmaster Task P|Dialog needed
L|1||Silver Scope Spymaster Task⸩ ⸨Atamarr tells you, "I have a task in which you may be able to aid me. I have managed to subvert a small number of Gear Knights in the Iron Blade's invasion, and they have identified a Gear Knight in a position of influence within the forces that may be convinced to end her involvement with the Iron Blade."⸩ ⸨Atamarr tells you, "There is a Silver Scope Spymaster who has recently arrived from our home realm. She is a very skilled Spymaster, and I believe she already suspects that the information being imparted by the Iron Blade may be less accurate than it should be. With a little help, she may be convinced of the truth, and aid us in ending this invasion. I wish you to go and tell her about the Apostate Virindi, their Simulacra, and how they are framing your people in this war."⸩ ⸨Atamarr tells you, "You will find the Spymaster in the excavations that the Iron Blade have made in the heart of the area they control in the Direlands."⸩ ⸨Atamarr tells you, "I would expect she will demand some sort of proof. I ask that you follow her requests, and let her come to understand your people as I have come to. Once you complete whatever tasks she sets before you, return to me."
L|1||Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander⸩ ⸨Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander tells you, "I do not know why you have come. Speak quickly, lest I call down the guard."⸩ ⸨You quickly explain about the Gold Gear Primus, the Apostate Virindi and the Simulacra, and how the Apostates are endeavoring to frame the Isparians for the deaths and disappearances of the initial Gear Knights through the Gate.⸩ ⸨Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander tells you, "I do not know if I believe your words, even though your voice rings of truth. However, there may be a chance for you to prove it."⸩ ⸨Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander tells you, "There are a group of beings that appear to be of your race, camped out over a set of excavated ruins, north of here. They have been cutting down our soldiers, and carting off the bodies."⸩ ⸨Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander tells you, "I would send my own forces to deal with them, but the Iron Blade are preventing those from outside their house from engaging that camp, and they will not answer as to why."⸩ ⸨Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander tells you, "If these beings are Simulacra, as you say, then I wish for you to go and kill their leader. I am told he is called General Takaris."⸩ ⸨Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander tells you, "Bring me proof of his death, as well as proof that he is not one of your own, and I will trust your words."⸩ ⸨You give Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander Empty Skin.⸩ ⸨Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander tells you, "What is this? Some sort of bag?"⸩ ⸨You explain to the Gear Knight that it is the outer skin of General Takaris, and it is how the Simulacra are formed.⸩ ⸨Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander tells you, "Well, this is indeed something unexpected and profound. Thank you. I will take this to my brethren, and we will discuss how to proceed. My guess is that we will confront the Iron Blade Commander about this, but if there is duplicity at work here, I am not sure what that will cause in response."⸩ ⸨Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander tells you, "It may be that some of us will be leaving here soon, and seeking out Primus Atamarr, to offer our apologies and support to his endeavors."⸩ ⸨Bronze Gauntlet Knight-Commander tells you, "Tell the Primus what has transpired between us, and that we may be seeing him soon, under a banner of truce, to hear his words."
L|1||Copper Cog Craftsmaster⸩ ⸨Copper Cog Craftsmaster tells you, "I don't know why you're here, but you seem peaceful enough, for one of the body-thieves."⸩ ⸨You quickly explain about the Gold Gear Primus, the Apostate Virindi and the Simulacra, and how the Apostates are endeavoring to frame the Isparians for the deaths and disappearances of the initial Gear Knights through the Gate.⸩ ⸨Copper Cog Craftsmaster tells you, "I don't know if I believe your words, but I believe I can test your truth through your actions."⸩ ⸨Copper Cog Craftsmaster tells you, "There are a group of beings that appear to be of your race, camped out over a set of excavated ruins, north of here. They have been cutting down our soldiers, and carting off the bodies."⸩ ⸨Copper Cog Craftsmaster tells you, "The Iron Blade won't let anyone outside of their House near this camp, though they battle with the body-thieves there constantly."⸩ ⸨Copper Cog Craftsmaster tells you, "I've heard one of the scouts mention a being that matches the description of this Virindi you mentioned, entering the ruins. Bring me something of its that I may examine. There may be a great deal of info about our enemies I can learn from it, if this story is true."⸩ ⸨You give Copper Cog Craftsmaster Apostate Overseer's Mask.⸩ ⸨Copper Cog Craftsmaster tells you, "So, this is from that Virindi creature? Let's see what we can learn from it..."⸩ ⸨The Copper Cog Craftsmaster attaches a pair of small devices to the mask, and fiddles with small gears that protrude from the devices surfaces.⸩ ⸨Copper Cog Craftsmaster tells you, "Well, this is interesting. It seems some of the creatures memories are stored in this mask, and that they can be deciphered with some effort."⸩ ⸨Copper Cog Craftsmaster tells you, "I will bring my findings to the Commanders. I know they will see reason. We may have good cause to be in this realm, as our brethren have indeed been taken, but we may be after the wrong beings here."⸩ ⸨Copper Cog Craftsmaster tells you, "Tell the Gold Gear Primus what has transpired between us, and that we may be seeing him soon, under a banner of truce, to hear his words on this."
L|1||Silver Scope Spymaster⸩ ⸨Silver Scope Spymaster tells you, "I know why you're here. I have seen Atamarr's spies, but have left them be, for now. Now, tell me what Atamarr has sent you here to tell me."⸩ ⸨You quickly explain about the Gold Gear Primus, the Apostate Virindi and the Simulacra, and how the Apostates are endeavoring to frame the Isparians for the deaths and disappearances of the initial Gear Knights through the Gate.⸩ ⸨Silver Scope Spymaster tells you, "I have heard some of this before, along with many reports that your people are trying to foist your guilt off on other beings. There is, however, a way for you to prove your words."⸩ ⸨Silver Scope Spymaster tells you, "There are a group of beings that appear to be of your race, camped out over a set of excavated ruins, north of here. They have been cutting down our soldiers, and carting off the bodies."⸩ ⸨Silver Scope Spymaster tells you, "My attempts to get Silver Scope Scouts into the area have been thwarted by my superiors. I am honor-bound to obey them, but nothing in my oaths says I cannot send you in for me."⸩ ⸨Silver Scope Spymaster tells you, "See if you can find one of their messages. A group that size, taking orders from elsewhere, as you say, would need a line of communication open. I have not seen messengers entering or leaving, but the Portal Magic of this realm can explain that lack, easily enough. Any messages they have will likely be deep inside their encampments. Bring me one, and we'll talk further."⸩ ⸨You give Silver Scope Spymaster Apostate Message Shard.⸩ ⸨Silver Scope Spymaster tells you, "Is this how they communicate? Interesting."⸩ ⸨The Silver Scope Spymaster places the crystal into a small device, which seems to be pulling out and translating the information within the crystal.⸩ ⸨Silver Scope Spymaster tells you, "Not too different from the Aetherium encoded messages my people sometimes use, though the language may take a little bit. Also seems a few defenses in the crystal to be overcome."⸩ ⸨Silver Scope Spymaster tells you, "Once I have unlocked all of the information in that crystal, I'll see what I can do about getting the truth out to the troops. I have a bad feeling what I learn from the crystal is already known by the Iron Blade Commanders, and that worries me on several levels."⸩ ⸨Silver Scope Spymaster tells you, "Tell the Primus what has transpired between us, and that I may be paying a visit to him soon."

H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Go to Xarabydun and speak with «Cypher the Apprentice» who will give you an «Aligned Mana Stone». L|1|2.|Travel to the «Empyrean Facility Upper Level» 46.2S, 71.8W, the portal is tiable and summonable. -there is a portal in subway. L|2|•|Route: Short run from the VoD lifestone (take the «Obsidian Rim» portal at Caul drop or after Aerfalle drop portal). L|1|3.|The dungeon is divided into three levels. Your task on each level is the same, only the creatures differ. TIP| If the masonry golems prove too difficult to deal with, lure them to the pits to get them off of you. L|1|4.|You start in a large room that has five smaller rooms with doors on all sides placed within the larger room. One in the middle and ones to the north, east, west, and south. Enter each of the side rooms, one by one, and kill the four wisps that are present inside the rooms. Once they are dead, walk to the middle of each room to the colored mana fountains inside each one. Use the «Aligned Mana Stone» and you should get a message ending| "A shiver moves across your body up into your chest and quickly down through your feet.". L|2|•|Note 1: If you have already completed this room (and killed the four wisps on a previous visit), the third line of the message will say "you feel no change.". L|2|•|Note 2: If you don't get the message, make sure all spawn are dead (they can get pulled out of the room if there are other players in the dungeon). Wait another 15 seconds or so after your first attempt, then try again (for some reason, the first attempt often fails, even if the spawn was killed correctly). If it still doesn't work, you need to find and kill the spawn, which has probably wandered outside the room, and then return to the room to retry using the «Aligned Mana Stone». Wisps often get stuck in the pits when accidentally dragged outside their rooms; check there first. L|2|•|⟦EFULEastManaFieldUsed⟧ L|2|•|⟦EFULNorthManaFieldUsed⟧ L|2|•|⟦EFULSouthManaFieldUsed⟧ L|2|•|⟦EFULWestManaFieldUsed⟧ L|1|5.|Once you've gotten the message in the north, south, east and west rooms, go to the middle room and stand in the mana fountain next to the portal (be careful not to accidentally go in! You will not be able to portal recall back to the previous level, and must re-enter the dungeon from the surface portal (if level 225+ only) or via your hard tie if you got it earlier). L|1|6.|On the upper level, using your «Aligned Mana Stone» at the final mana fountain opens the 75+ blue slot (next to your head on your paper doll inventory) and gives you the «Aetheria Mana Stone» and a green message. This is a permanent tool you hang onto and you use it on any Coalesced Aetheria you find as creature loot or in chests to cause a random sigil to appear (ID to see what Set and Surge the revealed «Aetheria» possesses). L|2|•|⟦EFULCenterManaFieldUsed⟧ L|1|7.|Take the Middle portal and repeat the same sequence described above, this will open the 150+ yellow slot. L|2|•|⟦EFMLCenterManaFieldUsed⟧ L|2|•|⟦EFMLEastManaFieldUsed⟧ L|2|•|⟦EFMLNorthManaFieldUsed⟧ L|2|•|⟦EFMLSouthManaFieldUsed⟧ L|2|•|⟦EFMLWestManaFieldUsed⟧ L|1|8.|Take the Lower level portal (note a hot landing) and repeat, this will open the 225+ red slot. Once all three slots are opened you are done. L|2|•|⟦EFLLCenterManaFieldUsed⟧ L|2|•|⟦EFLLEastManaFieldUsed⟧ L|2|•|⟦EFLLNorthManaFieldUsed⟧ L|2|•|⟦EFLLSouthManaFieldUsed⟧ L|2|•|⟦EFLLWestManaFieldUsed⟧

Quest.name: Portal_Space_Time_Travel
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|50 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Mar'uun» I|Repeat|Non Repeatable I|Time|4 days H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest is broken up into 4 days. You must wait 20 hours after completing one part before you may move on to the next. L|1|•|While on this quest, you will have the option to complete the older «Portal Space Research» quests. L|1|•|Upon completing this quest, you will have access to a restored Mar'uun, and the «Portal Space Rifts» quest within. L|1|•|There is some degree of divergence based on your choices, which can net you additional dialog and an extra title. L|1|•|Static «Resonant Portal» near «Ayan Baqur» at 60.6S, 87.3W
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Flagging L|1|1.|Enter the portal at 10.6S, 17.1E to enter «Mar'uun», which will be in a destroyed state. Merely entering the portal is all that is required to flag to enter the randomly spawning Resonant portals through-out Dereth. Once you have done this, you can skip to Day 1, or explore inside. L|2|•|Route: «Al-Arqas» to «Al-Nosaj» settlement portal at 33.5S, 13.1E. Then run to 10.6S, 17.1E Alternatively, run from «Samsur» L|2|•|Use Portal: ⟦MaruunStarted⟧ L|1|2.|{OPT} While in the destroyed «Mar'uun», collect the «Scrap of Paper (Mar'uun)¦Scrap of Paper». It is located where «Kaywin» was, in the area behind the researchers next to the «Stabilizing Machine»s. To reach it, go to the portal research area, climb the stairs to the west and find a hole on the wooden floor. Jump down and pick up the Scrap of Paper. This will be worth experience in day 3 or 4, so hang on to it. L|2|•|⟦MaruunScrapPickup⟧
H3|Day 1 P|This portion takes place during «Coldeve, 20 PY» (February 2009, «Unfinished Business») when Mar'uun was first introduced. Marcus and Wren are conducting the original experiments. The Virindi Jean and Luc are not present, neither is Kaywin the machinist. L|1|1.|Locate and enter a «Resonant Portal (Portal Space Time Travel)¦Resonant Portal» (no level restrict, no summon/tie/recall). L|2|•|Best location is the static «Resonant Portal» near «Ayan Baqur» at 60.6S, 87.3W L|2|•|Known locations include the western Direlands (i.e. Ayan, Lethe areas). L|1|2.|Use the portal to travel to Mar'uun in the past. L|1|3.|Proceed to the portal space research area north of the main loop and across the bridge. Speak with «Wren the Curious» and «Marcus Manfried». L|2|•|⟦MarcusTalkWeek1⟧ L|1|4.|Talk with Marcus a second time. During your interactions with Marcus, you are presented with the option to reveal to him about the arrival of Jean and Luc via a Yes/No Dialog Box. L|2|•|Yes: ⟦MarcusWarned⟧ L|1|5.|Talk with Wren a second time (after yes/no). L|2|•|⟦WrenTalkWeek1⟧ L|1|6.|After making your choice, you will be told to come back in a day's time. L|1|7.|Talk to Wren a third time. L|2|•|⟦MaruunWeek1Done⟧ L|2|•|⟦MaruunTimeout⟧ L|1|8.|Once you've talked to the NPCs once and have left, you cannot return for 20 hours. L|1|9.|{OPT} The Test Portal can be used for 1 million experience if you didn't do so prior to Mar'uun's destruction. The Test Portal sends you to the wooden platform above it, but in the present day destroyed Mar'uun. Make sure you do everything you want in this version of Mar'uun before you do this. L|2|•|⟦MaruunTestWeek1⟧
H3|Day 2 P|This portion takes place during «Wintersebb, 20 PY» (March 2009, «Who Watches the Virindi?»). Marcus is next to the Enhanced Test Portal, which is unstable, and Wren has moved to the back room. The Virindi Jean and Luc are now present, but Kaywin is not. L|1|1.|{OPT} Return to the destroyed Mar'uun and collect another Scrap of Paper, as described in the Flagging section. This is for additional experience on day 3 or 4. L|2|•|{TIP} For a free trip to the Resonant Portal, do this step after Marcus gives you the Research Notes - then just go out the Mar'uun exit portal and it's right there) L|1|2.|Locate a «Resonant Portal (Portal Space Time Travel)¦Resonant Portal». L|1|3.|{OPT} Talk to «Jean» and «Luc» at the portal drop. A dialog box will appear asking "Would you like to confront the Virindi about their presence in Mar'uun?". You can answer Yes or No. Answering Yes gives additional dialog. L|2|•|{WARN} This appears to interfere with earning the Virindi Informer title! This step is not necessary and should probably be avoided. L|2|•|Yes: ⟦MaruunVirindiConfronted⟧ L|1|4.|Proceed to the portal space research area. You'll notice Wren isn't in her usual spot but rather inside the nearby room staring at the wall. She doesn't say much when you talk to her. Also, the Test Portal is now the Enhanced Test Portal. L|1|5.|Talk to Marcus to receive the «Research Notes (First Notes)», which he asks you to take to an «Arcanum Researcher». L|2|•|If you told him about the Virindi yesterday, he will award you 1,000,000 xp. L|2|•|If you didn't tell him about the Virindi yesterday, he will award you 750,000 xp. L|2|•|⟦MaruunWeek2Done⟧ L|1|6.|{OPT} Hand the Research Notes to Jean or Luc. They will just examine them and give you some dialog. L|2|•|**Note:** This step appears necessary to earn the Virindi Informer title. L|2|•|⟦MaruunInformer1⟧ L|1|7.|Take the «Research Notes (First Notes)» to any «Arcanum Researcher» in any one of the capital heritage libraries. The Arcanum Researcher will examine them and direct you to give them to «Ned the Clever» in «Zaikhal». L|1|8.|Give the Research Notes to Ned and he will give you «Aetherium Research Notes (First Notes)¦Aetherium Research Notes». He directs you to give these to Marcus. Hold on to these notes for tomorrow, when you may enter Mar'uun again.
H3|Day 3 P|This portion takes place during «Morningthaw, 20 PY» (April 2009, «What Once was Lost»). Marcus and Wren are next to the Enhanced Test Portal. Kaywin is now in town. L|1|1.|{OPT} Return to the destroyed Mar'uun and collect another Scrap of Paper, as described in the Flagging section. This is for additional experience on day 3 or 4. L|1|2.|Locate a «Resonant Portal (Portal Space Time Travel)¦Resonant Portal». L|1|3.|You now have two different ;divergent; set of steps you can follow. L|2|•|Path One - Informer: L|3|•|Hand your «Aetherium Research Notes (First Notes)¦Aetherium Research Notes» to Jean or Luc. They will keep the notes so you will be unable to turn them into to Marcus. They award you 250,000 xp. L|4|•|⟦MaruunInformer2⟧ L|3|•|Talk to Marcus and he will award you 750,000 xp and give you «Research Notes (Second Notes)¦Research Notes». L|4|•|⟦MaruunWeek3Done⟧ L|2|•|Path Two - Non Informer: L|3|•|Hand the «Aetherium Research Notes (First Notes)¦Aetherium Research Notes» to Marcus for 1 million xp and the «Research Notes (Second Notes)¦Research Notes». L|4|•|⟦MaruunWeek3Done⟧ L|1|4.|{OPT} Give your Scraps of Paper to «Kaywin» who is at the Stabilizing Machine behind the portal space research area, near where you found them in the destroyed Mar'uun. L|1|5.|{OPT} Allow Jean or Luc to examine the «Research Notes (Second Notes)¦Research Notes». They will not keep the Notes. L|2|•|⟦MaruunInformer3⟧ L|1|6.|Take the Research Notes to «Ned the Clever» in «Zaikhal». He will hand you «Aetherium Research Notes (Second Notes)¦Aetherium Research Notes» to deliver to Marcus tomorrow.
H3|Day 4 P|This portion takes place during «Solclaim, 20 PY» (May 2009, «Secrets of the Apostates»), before the town is destroyed. L|1|1.|{OPT} Return to the destroyed Mar'uun and collect another Scrap of Paper, as described in the Flagging section. This is for additional experience on day 3 or 4. Note that this is the last time you can do this. L|1|2.|Locate a «Resonant Portal (Portal Space Time Travel)¦Resonant Portal». L|1|3.|You now have two different **divergent** set of steps you can follow. L|2|•|Path One - Informer: L|3|•|Hand your «Aetherium Research Notes (Second Notes)¦Aetherium Research Notes» to Jean or Luc. They will keep the notes so you will be unable to turn them into to Marcus. They will award you 250,000 xp. If you handed **all** of the previous Notes (Research Notes and Aetherium Research Notes) to the Virindi then they will give you the title Virindi Informer. L|3|•|Talk to Marcus and he will award you 750,000 xp and the title Timeless Adventurer. L|4|•|⟦MaruunWeek4Done⟧ L|2|•|Path Two: L|3|•|Hand the «Aetherium Research Notes (Second Notes)¦Aetherium Research Notes» to Marcus for 1 million xp and the title Timeless Aventurer. L|4|•|⟦MaruunWeek4Done⟧ L|1|4.|{OPT} Give your Scraps of Paper to «Kaywin» who is at the Stabilizing Machine behind the portal space research area, near where you found them in the destroyed Mar'uun. This is your final chance to turn these in.
H3|Beyond Day Four L|1|•|Using the Resonant Portal at 10.6S, 17.1E will send you to a Mar'uun that has avoided destruction. You will now have access to the «Portal Space Rifts» quest. L|1|•|«Kaywin» in this version doesn't know what to do with the «Scrap of Paper» but she gives the «Machinist's Gloves Quest» as usual. L|1|•|You will be unable to enter the random Resonant Portals in the Direlands.

You are helping us right?"

Quest.name: The_Temple_of_Kivik_Lir
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60-79, 80-99, 100 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|38.1S, 47.3W I|Route|«Mansion» to «Portal to Kivik Lir's Temple» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|This quest has three level ranges: 60-80, 80-100, and 100+.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Temple of Kivik Lir Entrance L|1|1.|Take Kivik Lir mansion portal device and run to 38.1S, 47.3W. L|1|2.|Go into temple and jump down into pit. Use «Odd Looking Vine» to enter dungeon. L|2|•|{WARN} Do not talk to the Watcher of the Dead! L|1|3.|Talk the Guardian statue. L|2|•|⟦StatueKivikLirGuardianAntechamber⟧ L|1|4.|Take the West hall, go WEST at the fork. When you get to a dead end room, look for a «Fragment of Charred Wood» on the ground. L|2|•|⟦GlyphKivikLirShardWood⟧ L|1|5.|Go back the way you came, and this time continue straight (EAST) where you originally went west. L|1|6.|When you come to another dead end room, look for a «Fragment of Solidified Blood» on the floor. L|2|•|⟦GlyphKivikLirShardBlood⟧ L|1|7.|Combine Wood and Blood to make «Emblem of Blackened Blood». L|1|8.|{OPT} Collect the other two framents in the North and South rooms. L|2|•|⟦GlyphKivikLirShardSerpentine⟧ L|2|•|⟦GlyphKivikLirShardAmber⟧ L|1|9.|Go back the way you came, to the statue where you first portaled in. L|1|10.|Hand the the «Emblem of Blackened Blood» to the statue one at a time (go slow to avoid bugs).
H3|Part 2: Haven of Kivik Lir L|1|1.|Take the SOUTH hall, and take a RIGHT at the fork. Continue to hug the wall to the LEFT all the way until you find a ramp up to a big room. L|1|2.|Use the lever on the NORTH wall, which opens a door on the SE side of the room (You can also take the door on the west side if you prefer). L|1|3.|Continue up the ramp until you get to a portal device (Watch out for flying daggers). L|1|4.|Use all 4 eyes (one in each direction) ONE TIME. Then use Strange Device on North wall. Do all this quickly, or the device won't accept you. L|2|•|⟦EyeKivikLirHaven1⟧ L|2|•|⟦EyeKivikLirHaven2⟧ L|2|•|⟦EyeKivikLirHaven3⟧ L|2|•|⟦EyeKivikLirHaven4⟧ L|1|5.|**DO NOT TALK TO STATUE** or do anything once inside the next part.
H3|Part 3: Trials of Kivik Lir L|1|•|At this point in the quest, the leader must split from the group in order to complete another section of the quest (the Trials) and rejoin with the fellow in a few moments. L|1|•|There are 3 Trials, which are on a 15 minute timer. If you don't complete it in time you have to disband your fellow, and recreate it in order to start over. L|1|•|The person doing the trials (and only them) should talk to the statue at the drop ONE time.
H4|Trial #1: The Jumps L|1|•|You should be a decent Jumper to do this part. Its the hardest trial. Its best to do this one first because the timer starts after you complete your first trial. L|1|•|If the platforms are fading in and out, they are safe. If they are solid, you can fall through them. L|1|•|If you fall during the jumps, head to the back of the room and complete the last 3 steps of the trial to get back to the start.
L|1|1.|Head to the North. Jump up on the platform to your right side and then up again twice more to the top platform. L|1|2.|You'll need to make several jumps to the little room ahead of you. L|1|3.|Now jump out the back door to the platform in the far back of the room where you'll see an Eye. Use the eye to start the timer and complete the first trial. L|1|4.|Jump down onto the level below you. You'll see a lever on the wall, which will open a nearby door. L|1|5.|Run through the door and hang all lefts until you see another lever, which opens a nearby door. This door opens just above where you started the trial. L|1|6.|Jump down to the starting platform and head south back into the waiting room.
H4|Trial #2: Bag of Bones L|1|1.|Head into the East hallway and take a left at the split. Talk to the eye on the wall and you will receive a sachel. L|1|2.|Run back the way you came and go straight at the split. Use the «Offering Urn» to get a «Brittle Bone». L|1|3.|Put the bone in the «Empty Satchel» and return it to the eye on the wall.
H4|Trial #3: Bloodstone Emblem L|1|1.|Head into the west hallway and talk to the statue at the end of the hall twice to be portaled into a dungeon. L|1|2.|You need to kill 3 creatures (1 of each species) in here, each one drops a piece of a Bloodstone Emblem: «Small Bloodstone Shard», «Sharp Bloodstone Fragment» and «Small Bloodstone Fragment». L|1|3.|Once you have all 3 pieces, head back to where you portaled in and talk to the statue to be sent back to the beginning. L|1|4.|Combine the small fragment and shard to create a «Fused Bloodstone Chunk». Combine the fused piece with the sharp fragment to make a complete «Bloodstone Emblem». L|1|5.|Hand the emblem to the statue at the end of the West hallway. L|1|6.|Now that you've completed all 3 tasks, talk to the statue in the middle of the waiting room to be portaled into the last part.
H3|Part 4 L|1|1.|Use all 4 eyes ONE time, then use the portal device. Once you go in: **DO NOT MOVE FORWARD**. L|2|•|⟦EyeKivikLirTrial1⟧ L|2|•|⟦EyeKivikLirTrial2⟧ L|2|•|⟦EyeKivikLirTrial3⟧ L|2|•|⟦EyeKivikLirTrial4⟧ L|1|2.|The person with highest creature/life magic skills will be in charge of debuffing the Boss (The Special Burun in the middle). Use Cold/Slash debuffs. L|1|3.|Its also a good idea to have the lowest couple people be healers. L|1|4.|If you have a mage with Tusker Fists, have them TF the wall behind the boss while everyone else kills him. Once the wall drops, the spawn dissapears. L|1|5.|Once the boss and the wall are down, head through the opening, up the ramp, and use the statue at the end of the hall to be portaled into the treasure room L|2|•|⟦KivikLirBeaten⟧ L|1|6.|Use the «Sarcophagus of High Matriarch, Kivik Lir» to receive your main reward and then choose 1 additional reward by using one of the daises around the room. L|2|•|Sarcophagus: ⟦ReceivedKivikLirArmor⟧ L|2|•|Second Reward: ⟦KivikLirCompleted⟧ P|Notes L|1|•|When using the sarcophagus to obtain your leggings, you'll get 2 nasty debuffs cast on you that cannot be dispelled. They last an hour, so if you have the «Enduring Enchantment» augmentation, you'll have to sit it out. Otherwise you can suicide to get rid of them.
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Temple of Kivik Lir Entrance» 38.1S, 47.3W -- «map:0272¦0272» TR|«Lyceum of Kivik Lir» N/A -- «map:0272¦0272» TR|«Haven of Kivik Lir» N/A -- «map:0275¦0275» TR|«Trials of Kivik Lir» N/A -- «map:0276¦0276» TR|«Arena of Kivik Lir» N/A -- «map:0276¦0276» TR|«Triumph Against the Trials» N/A -- «map:0276¦0276» TR|«Gallery of Kivik Lir» N/A -- «map:0277¦0277» TR|«Crypt of Kivik Lir» N/A -- «map:0272¦0272» TE
H2|Rewards H3|Items H4|Main Reward L|1|•|«Ancient Armored Leggings»
H4|(1) Additional Reward
P|Manacle of Biting Pain Tears of Jvikti Kheval Scroll of Lesser Conjurant Chant Scroll of Conjurant Chant Scroll of Greater Conjurant Chant Scroll of Superior Conjurant Chant Scroll of Lesser Artificant Chant Scroll of Artificant Chant Scroll of Greater Artificant Chant Scroll of Superior Artificant Chant Scroll of Lesser Vitaeic Chant Scroll of Vitaeic Chant Scroll of Greater Vitaeic Chant Scroll of Superior Vitaeic Chant Scroll of Lesser Hieromantic Chant Scroll of Hieromantic Chant Scroll of Greater Hieromantic Chant Scroll of Superior Hieromantic Chant Scroll of Lesser Conveyic Chant Scroll of Conveyic Chant Scroll of Greater Conveyic Chant Scroll of Superior Conveyic Chant
L|1|•|«Conjurant Chant» = Creature Enchantment L|1|•|«Artificant Chant» = Item Enchantment L|1|•|«Vitaeic Chant» = Life Magic L|1|•|«Hieromantic Chant» = War Magic L|1|•|«Conveyic Chant» = Mana Conversion
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Guardian (Temple Entrance)⸩ ⸨Guardian tells you, "The Lady of this temple, Kivik Lir, has deemed it closed to visitors. Only her students may pass through the gates beyond. Should the student present a glyph bearing the union of blood and shadow, the doors of knowledge shall open. Those without the glyph of the Lady Kivik Lir shall be turned away from this temple, for her knowledge is not for you."⸩ ⸨Guardian tells you, "Heed my warnings. I shall sup upon your blood and send you from this place should you speak with me again, or should you fail to present the correct glyph."
L|1||Handing in Emblem of Blackened Blood⸩ ⸨Guardian tells you, "Welcome to the halls of Kivik Lir's temple, child. I will now transport you to the staging area. You will be able to prepare yourself there before continuing further in your training."
L|1||Guardian of the Trials⸩ ⸨The Guardian of the Trials speaks into your minds.⸩ ⸨Welcome, young initiates. You have found your way beyond the guardians of the Tomb of Kivik Lir. You have done well to reach this point. By the Watcher, you shall awaken the High Matron. But there are still spirits to defeat and still challenges that you must complete to prove your worthiness."⸩ ⸨Within this very hall lie several such challenges. Each must be completed by you within a set period of time. When you have completed all of the tests, and only then, return to me. If you have succeeded, you shall be granted passage deeper into the halls of Kivik Lir's temple."⸩ ⸨Should you fail... then I shall be forced to rid these halls of your presence. Pray to the Iakvi Liviliakti that you do not fail."
L|1||Eye of the Watcher⸩ ⸨The Eye of the Watcher shudders for a moment and settles. Without warning, a voice with the sound of metal scraping on metal chimes into your mind.⸩ ⸨The Lady Kivik Lir has a fondness for Sacrificial Urns. In her time, she collected quite a few of them. In the Antechamber, she keeps six stacks of Sacrificial Urns. Within her personal chambers, she keeps three stacks of Sacrificial Urn. And here, in these halls, she keeps five stacks of Sacrificial Urns. If the Lady Kivik Lir were to put them all together, how many stacks would she command?"⸩ ⸨Eye of the Watcher gives you Empty Satchel.
L|1||Guardian of the Arena⸩ ⸨The Guardian of the Arena speaks into your minds.⸩ ⸨Beyond these walls lie the arenas of Kivik Lir. Within these blood spattered walls, the students of Kivik Lir tested their will against others. Those who were deemed champions were presented a Bloodstone Emblem, symbol of might in combat."⸩ ⸨Those who present a Bloodstone Emblem will be judge worthy and permitted to continue further in the Lady's temple."⸩ ⸨A warning to those who are unworthy, presentation of anything but the Emblem will result in punishment."⸩ ⸨Those who wish to test their mettle against other students should now speak to me once again."
L|1||Conveyor of the Arena⸩ ⸨The Conveyor of the Arena speaks into your mind.⸩ ⸨Prepare yourself, for I shall now ferry you back to the master of the trials."⸩ ⸨If you are victorious and wield the Emblem of Victory, present it to the Guardian of the Arena."
L|1||Guardian of the Trials (On completion of all three trials)⸩ ⸨The Guardian of the Trials speaks into your minds.⸩ ⸨You have done well children. You may proceed further towards our sleeping mistress, Kivik Lir."
L|1||Using the Sarcophagus of High Matriarch, Kivik Lir⸩ ⸨Despite your better judgement, you look over the sarcophagus for trinkets.⸩ ⸨Sarcophagus of High Matriarch, Kivik Lir tells you, "Defiler! You seek to ruin my slumber and my home? Suffer for your insolence!"⸩ ⸨Sarcophagus of High Matriarch, Kivik Lir cast Kivik Lir's Venom on you⸩ ⸨Sarcophagus of High Matriarch, Kivik Lir cast Decay on you⸩ ⸨Sarcophagus of High Matriarch, Kivik Lir gives you Ancient Armored Leggings.⸩ ⸨Tears of Jvikti Kheval gives you Tears of Jvikti Kheval.⸩

Quest.name: Bleeargh's_Gratitude
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Bleeargh» (optional) I|Route|12.1S, 42.6E in «Yanshi» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Return all of the items that were stolen from Bleeargh's kin.
L|1|•|The location each item is kept increases in difficulty as you go on. Once you hand in an item, you gain the ability to use «A Carved Mosswart Statue» mansion house item (obtained from the «King Toad Idol Quest»). The statue teaches you all «Item Magic» spells of a certain level depending on what items you return to Bleeargh. L|2|•|«Spear of Kreerg» = Level I spells L|2|•|«Vagurat's Hand» = Level II spells L|2|•|«Necklace of Leerargh» = Level III spells inc. «Lifestone Sending» L|2|•|«Eye of Drageerg» = Level IV spells L|2|•|«Mire Witch Loincloth» = Level V spells L|2|•|«Mosswart War Paint» = Level VI spells
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Spear of Kreerg (No Restriction) L|1|1.|Go to «30.8S, 74.1E - Drudge Camp¦Drudge Camp» at 30.8S, 74.1E near Shoushi. L|1|2.|Kill Drudge Prowlers for «A Musty Key» (drops 5 of them). L|2|•|⟦MosswartExodusSpearKey⟧ L|1|3.|Use the key on the Mosswart Chest and loot the «Spear of Kreerg». L|2|•|⟦MosswartExodusSpear⟧
H3|Hand of Vagurat (10+) L|1|1.|Enter «Banderling Hovel» at 32.0S, 72.8E near Shoushi. Hug the right wall and retrieve «Hand of Vagurat» (respawns quickly) from the pedestal. L|2|•|⟦MosswartExodusHand⟧
H3|Necklace of Leerargh (20+) L|1|1.|Enter the «Mossy Cave (Yanshi)¦Mossy Cave» at 14.1S, 46.0E near Yanshi. L|1|2.|Kill a «Burun Ruuk Scamp» for «A Smelly Key» (note that the scamp that drops the keys can be found only at the midpoint of the dungeon). L|2|•|⟦MosswartExodusNecklaceKey⟧ L|1|3.|As you proceed through the dungeon, when you hit the third square room, go up a ramp in the opposite direction from the ramp you entered the room from. You will be in a rectangular room with two exits. Once you have the key, proceed back down the ramp to the square room and out the same-level hallway toward the the end of the dungeon to retrieve the «Necklace of Leerargh» from «An Old Chest (Mossy Cave)¦An Old Chest». (Lockpick 999 Difficulty) L|2|•|⟦MosswartExodusNecklace!⟧ L|1|4.|There is a runed chest in the back left corner of the dungeon that can be accessed for a stamp. L|2|•|⟦ChestQuestUnlockedLowPOIA!⟧
H3|Eye of Drageerg (30+) L|1|1.|Next you need to go to the «Dark Mosswart Hall» at 74.2S, 83.6E near «Kryst» on the Vesayan Isles. L|1|2.|When inside the hall take all rights until you come to a ramp up where you will find the «Eye of Drageerg» on top of a pedestal guarded by Mosswarts and Shadows. L|2|•|⟦MosswartExodusEye⟧ L|1|3.|Take the exit portal behind the room with the Eye of Drageerg.
H3|Mire Witch Loincloth (30+) L|1|1.|From outside the Dark Mosswart Hall, run to the «Umbral Hall» nearby at 75.8S, 83.1E. L|1|2.|From the drop you will find 4 passages in each direction, take any direction up to the room with portals. Inside this room is a side passage on the left hand wall in between two of the portals. Head down the passage and jump into the pit, from there continue on into a room with an Idol in front of a smaller room. There you will find the «Mire Witch Loincloth» on the floor. L|2|•|⟦MosswartExodusCloth⟧
