Quest.name: Carenzi_Plague
Quest.notes: several phases best to target one type of carenzi per run
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|Varies I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Aun Teriona» (required) I|Starts At|41.3N, 75.3W near «Bluespire» I|Repeat|None H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|«Aun Teriona» (flag required) will tell you a specific type of Carenzi to hunt based on your level, however you can hunt any of them. See each creature page linked below for spawn maps. L|2|•|Talk to Aun Teriona: ⟦AunTeriona_Flag⟧ L|1|2.|Kill Carenzi until one drops a liver (it drops on the ground beside the corpse). L|1|3.|Use the liver (nothing is actually picked up), and a 2 hour timer will begin (continues to count down even if you are logged out). Continue killing the same type and using livers as they drop. L|2|•|First Liver (any): ⟦CarenziPlagueStarted⟧ L|1|4.|When you finish with one of the liver types you will receive a message. Then, you can return to Teriona or continue with a different type within two total hours of the timer. L|2|•|5 livers from the «Polar Carenzi» on «Corcosi Island» L|3|•|First Liver: ⟦DiseasedPolarLiver_Counter⟧ L|3|•|⟦DiseasedPolarLiver_Completed⟧ L|2|•|35 livers from the «Carenzi Stalker» on «Marae Lassel» L|3|•|First liver: ⟦DiseasedStalkerLiver_Counter⟧ L|3|•|⟦DiseasedStalkerLiver_Completed⟧ L|2|•|29 livers from the «Feral Carenzi» on «Marae Lassel» L|3|•|First Liver: ⟦DiseasedFeralLiver_Counter⟧ L|3|•|⟦DiseasedFeralLiver_Completed⟧ L|2|•|15 livers from the «Carnivorous Carenzi» on «Marae Lassel» L|3|•|First Liver: ⟦DiseasedCarnivorousLiver_Counter⟧ L|3|•|⟦DiseasedCarnivorousLiver_Completed⟧ L|2|•|19 livers from the «Mangy Carenzi» on «Singularity Caul» L|3|•|First Liver: ⟦DiseasedMangyLiver_Counter⟧ L|3|•|⟦DiseasedMangyLiver_Completed⟧ L|2|•|13 livers from the «Tainted Carenzi» on «Singularity Caul» L|3|•|First Liver: ⟦DiseasedTaintedLiver_Counter!⟧ L|3|•|⟦DiseasedTaintedLiver_Completed⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|You get an XP reward as soon as you finish each type, but you must return to Aun Teriona to receive one Writ of Refuge and a new title for each carenzi type.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Aun Teriona appraises you closely.⸩ ⸨Aun Teriona tells you, "Greetings, human - hear the kah of the carenzi. While they are fierce creatures and sometimes infest burrows that they should not, by and large they exist in harmony with Palenqual. I have heard a troubling report, though - that the touch of Wharu infests some carenzi and inflicts a terrible disease."⸩ ⸨Aun Teriona tells you, "To prevent the plague from overtaking the land, you must seek carenzi which bear plague and destroy both them and others of their kind in that immediate area. Examine their livers to identify whether the carenzi are diseased. If you have culled the diseased carenzi already, show me the liver that I may see the evidence of the infection."⸩ ⸨Aun Teriona tells you, "Know that only those carenzi which burrow upward to the light are afflicted. Those which exist forever in the ground are not susceptible to the illness."
L|1||Polar Carenzi⸩ ⸨You've slain all the sick Polar Carenzi that you needed to in order to prevent the sickness from spreading!⸩ ⸨You've earned 141,050 experience.⸩ ⸨Aun Teriona tells you, "Greetings, budhi. The plague has spread too far, and you have condemned a portion⸩ ⸨of the carenzi population to horrible, slow, painful deaths.⸩

Quest.name: Jester's_Lost_Marbles
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|160 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Jester (NPC)¦Jester» I|Starts At|«Graveyard» at 65.7S, 43.8W (Use «Summoning Stone») I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|The «Jester» in the «Graveyard» has lost his marbles, return them to him and then complete his test in the Mhoire Armory.
L|1|•|The summoning gems for «Spectral Weapons» can be obtained in part 2 of this quest. Spectral Weapons are Ghost Slayers and can be made permanent (Soul Bound) by purchasing a «Spectral Binding Stone» from «Hurnmel the Smith» in the «Graveyard».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Jester's Marbles and Markers L|1|1.|Go to 62.8S, 45.1W to get up onto the cliffside. Follow the ledge around to 65.1S 43.7W and pick up the «Jester's Marbles». L|1|2.|Return the marbles to «Jester» and he will open a portal to the «Mhoire Armory». L|2|•|⟦found9jestermarkers⟧ L|2|•|⟦jestermarbleturnin⟧ L|2|•|{TIP} If you miss it there is also a fixed location portal at 64.8S 44.3W inside a bunker. This same portal can be used to get back if you die, or when repeating the quest. L|1|3.|Explore the armory and find all 10 of «Jester's Marker»s. L|2|•|{WARN} The dungeon is filled with very high level ghosts such as «Corrupted Maiden»s that hit extremely hard but are slow moving. If you are running past them, as long as you avoid getting close they won't sticky melee and are too slow to catch up to you. Fighting is probably counterproductive, the ghosts are both high health and highly resistant. L|2|•|First marker found: ⟦found9jestermarkers on first completion⟧ L|2|•|⟦foundjestermarker1⟧ L|2|•|⟦foundjestermarker2⟧ L|2|•|⟦foundjestermarker3⟧ L|2|•|⟦foundjestermarker4⟧ L|2|•|⟦foundjestermarker5⟧ L|2|•|⟦foundjestermarker6⟧ L|2|•|⟦foundjestermarker7⟧ L|2|•|⟦foundjestermarker8⟧ L|2|•|⟦foundjestermarker9⟧ L|2|•|⟦foundjestermarker10⟧ L|1|4.|There are many locked doors that are one way locked (can be opened from the other side). There are two options here, you can either use lockpick skill (doors are 330 difficulty) to pick doors (fastest) or there are Armory Captains at the top of each armory wing that drop a 8 hour keys that open the doors for that wing. You can get to each captain without LP: L|2|1.|«East Armory Key» L|2|2.|«North Armory Key» L|2|3.|«West Armory Key» L|2|4.|«South Armory Key» L|1|5.|There are 2 markers in the West Armory, 3 markers in the North Armory, 2 markers in the East Armory, 1 marker in the South Armory, and 2 markers in the Forge (bottom) area (see map). L|1|6.|When you use the 10th and final marker, a «Jester's Marker» will be put in your pack. Bring it to the Jester in GY (southern «Summoning Stone» again) for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦jestermarkercomplete⟧
H3|Part 2: Mhoire Armory Forge L|1|1.|In addition to the markers (can skip markers if you do not want the xp or title rewards), there is a «Forge Golem» that drops 10 «Forge Vault Key»s to the nearby «Forge Vault». He is on the Forge level, all paths that do not involve passing a destroyable door lead to his room. One way to go is from the Forge portal drop, take the south passage, go past a round room on the left, go left at the next Y intersection, then stick right until you come to a large room, the golem will be in the middle. (A lot in the room, some prefer to go into north tunnel then lure golem and fight there.) L|2|•|⟦forgevaultkeypickuptimer⟧ L|1|2.|After looting keys from the golem, go north and use the key to open the «Forge Vault» that contains a «Spectral Ingot» and may also contain GY cards and one or two Mhoire coins. Just past the vault is another version of «Hurnmel the Smith» (he says he comes here during the day, though he is always there). L|1|3.|He sells the Spectral weapon stamps. These are summoning gems that when used put the weapon in your pack, the weapon will last 3 days and then expire. However it's possible to convert the weapon into a Soul Bound version that is permanent. Do this by adding a «Spectral Binding Stone» sold by «Hurnmel the Smith» in Gravyard for 15 «Ancient Mhoire Coin»s. L|2|•|{WARN} The weapons are drop on death, so wait to use the stamp until you have the binding stone if you don't want to risk losing it. L|2|•|{OPT} On the table by Hurnmel is a «ToDo List» (misc lore item).
P|Notes L|1|•|If you do not want the title or xp rewards, you do **not** need to find the markers. L|1|•|When repeating the quest, you do **not** need to give the marbles to Jester. L|1|•|You cannot log in the dungeon, it will send you to the Lifestone when logging back in. The dungeon is a "No item drop on death" dungeon, even «Dropped on Death» items will not drop. The dungeon is large and extremely dangerous. The markers show up when using "Find Next Item".

Quest.name: Clutch_of_Kings_(Kiree)
Quest.notes: Must do multiple times random riddle need to get all riddles
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Guard Fassel» I|Starts At|21.7S 47.6E I|Route|«Yanshi» to «Swamp Temple Place» at 10.3S, 45.7E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Clutch of Kings: Kiree» H2|Overview L|1|•|{WARN}: Talk to the Cragstone NPCs before running this a 2nd time, or you won't be able to pick up the hide at the end. L|1|•|This is the second of six quests in the «Clutch of Kings» series. L|1|•|Frost weapons are recommended.
P|{TIP} Multiple runs needed to gather all clue stamps. I suspect the clues on the ground are static. So remember what you picked on previous runs and grab a different one on each run.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Depth's of Ixir Zi's Temple L|1|1.|Speak to the «Watcher of the Dead» to be portaled into the «Depth's of Ixir Zi's Temple». L|1|2.|Jump down and take the South exit. From here, hug the wall left for the rest of the dungeon, with the only obstacle being a lever activated door in the first large room: L|2|1.|In the first large room you come to, open the Southeast door by entering the room on the East wall and pulling the lever inside. The entrance to the East room is activated by floor plates on either side of the door. L|1|3.|When you reach the end of the dungeon, use the Portal Gateway to be sent to the «Secrets of Ixir Zi's Temple».
H3|Part 2: Secrets of Ixir Zi's Temple L|1|1.|From the drop, pick up a «Clue Card» from the floor. Upon picking it up, you will receive a clue in green text. L|2|•|⟦ClueCardPickedUp⟧ L|2|•|and one of these: L|3|•|⟦ColorPuzzleBlueRiddle⟧ L|3|•|⟦ColorPuzzleGreenRiddle⟧ L|3|•|⟦ColorPuzzleIndigoRiddle⟧ L|3|•|⟦ColorPuzzleOrangeRiddle⟧ L|3|•|⟦ColorPuzzleRedRiddle⟧ L|3|•|⟦ColorPuzzleVioletRiddle⟧ L|3|•|⟦ColorPuzzleYellowRiddle⟧ L|1|2.|Use the clue to determine the answer, then pick up the colored ball that matches it. L|2|•|⟦ColorPuzzleBallPickedUp⟧ L|2|•|Note: If you pick up the wrong ball, you will have to wait 2 minutes while your timer expires. L|1|3.|Hand to Clue Card and the colored ball to the «Arbiter» to pass the test, then take the exit portal to be sent to «Ixir Zi's Temple». L|2|•|⟦ColorPuzzleCompleted⟧
TH|Clue Ball TR|It's also a fruit. «Orange Ball» TR|It's that thing you read me yesterday, between me and you. «Red Ball (Kiree)¦Red Ball» TR|The answer comes to me when I yell "OW!" «Yellow Ball (Kiree)¦Yellow Ball» TR|The answer is at the short end of the rainbow. «Violet Ball» TR|The answer is green. «Green Ball (Kiree)¦Green Ball» TR|The answer is sad. «Blue Ball (Kiree)¦Blue Ball» TR|The answer starts after you ... «Violet Ball» TR|What is: I doing. «Indigo Ball» TE
H3|Part 3: Ixir Zi's Temple L|1|1.|From the drop, head East and hug the left wall all the way to the end, you need to go down a ramp,there are no levers or misdirections in here. L|1|2.|At the end, you'll find a hallway on the East wall, which leads to a «Portal Gateway». The device leads to «Kiree», the boss. L|1|3.|Before using the device, there are several things to know before going into the fight with Kiree, review these tactics: L|2|•|Do not debuff him, he counters most debuffs. L|2|•|Disband your fellowship before going into battle. Kiree casts Fellowship Debuffs, so you lessen the chance to be debuffed when not in a fellowship. L|2|•|If you are swallowed (portaled into Kiree's stomach), quickly switch to a «Critical Strike» weapon, and attack his «Stomach Wall» on full speed. You have only have a percent chance of escaping his stomach when you land a critical hit. L|3|•|{TIP} If you're a mage, use wall spells for a greater chance to critical hit. L|1|4.|Once everyone is ready, use the Portal Gateway to be porataled into the «Center of Ixir Zi's Temple» (hot drop).
H3|Part 4: Center of Ixir Zi's Temple L|1|1.|When you portal in, you'll immediately be attacked by Burun, and «Kiree» is just to the North. L|1|2.|Kill Broodu using frost weapons/bows and «Tusker Fists» or Frost Wall. L|2|•|Note: Do not debuff Kiree, he will counter. See above for tactics. L|1|3.|Once you kill Kiree, loot «Kiree's Hide» from the floor. L|2|•|⟦KireeBeaten⟧ L|1|4.|Head to «Cragstone», and speak to «Guard Fassel» at 25.7N, 48.8E for your XP, «Mana Forge Key» (125+), and random reward. L|2|•|⟦KireeComplete⟧ L|2|•|⟦KireeKilled⟧ L|1|5.|{OPT} Hand Kiree's Hide to Guard Fassel for the title of Kiree Killer. L|2|•|Note: Hold on to the hide if you are trying to obtain the Kingslayer title. See the «Clutch of Kings» for more information.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Guard Fassel, Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Guard Fassel tells you, "You have not recently beaten King Kiree, return to me when you have accomplished this feat. You will need to have room for your reward when you speak to me."
L|1||Watcher of the Dead, Opening Dialog (below level req)⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "You are too frail to aid me in this creature. Return when your bones are equal to that of sixty."
L|1||Watcher of the Dead, Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "My purpose is plain, I watch the dead that reside within the halls of this temple. I have stood this vigil since my sacrifice over thirty thousand years ago, when the world cooled and the darkness made war upon all. The weight of time has long crushed my bones to dust and left with me with this incorporeal form. Yet, I serve my purpose with the same vigor that I did in life."⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "Within the halls of High Matriarch Ixir Zi's resting place grows a threat long thought gone. When first the worlds were closed and we passed through tunnels of sound and light we wrested the world from their grasp. They seek vengeance upon those who no longer draw breath."⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "Their avarice knows no bounds and they will not rest even though their greatest foes lie vanquished, crushed by the weight of time. Enter these halls and destroy them lest they draw the life from this world and turn all to ruin."⸩ ⸨⸨Watcher of the Dead teleports you with Depths of Ixir Zi's Temple.⸩
P|Using the Portal Device inside the Depths of Ixir Zi's Temple⸩ ⸨A violent hum sounds in your head and you are drawn unceremoniously into portal space.⸩ ⸨⸨Portal Gateway teleports you with Secrets of Ixir Zi's Temple.⸩
L|1||Using the Arbiter⸩ ⸨You notice a spherical indentation in the statue and a slot where a clue card could go.⸩ ⸨Arbiter tells you, "Retrieve a clue from the ground, then return to me the sphere which corresponds to your clue. You may choose a new clue if you return your clue card to me."
L|1||Returning clue card to Arbiter⸩ ⸨You give Arbiter Clue Card.⸩ ⸨You deposit your clue card in the slot.
L|1||Giving correct answer item to Arbiter⸩ ⸨You give Arbiter Ball.⸩ ⸨As you place the ball on the statue, the ball disappears from your hands.⸩ ⸨Arbiter tells you, "You may proceed."
P|Using the Portal Device inside Ixir Zi's Temple⸩ ⸨A violent hum sounds in your head and you are drawn unceremoniously into portal space.⸩ ⸨⸨Portal Gateway teleports you with Center of Ixir Zi's Temple.⸩
L|1||Defeating Kiree⸩ ⸨ has struck a deadly blow to Kiree! As the behemoth falls to the ground lifeless, several bits of his flesh fall to the ground.
L|1||Guard Fassel, Reward Dialog⸩ ⸨You've earned 56,184,660 experience.⸩ ⸨Guard Fassel tells you, "This is for your efforts against the Burun Kukuur, King Kiree. You will need to wait a day before returning to me for another reward. If you wish to change your title and you have a scrap of Kiree's hide I will accept the hide and name you to Kiree Killer!"⸩ ⸨Guard Fassel gives you .⸩ ⸨Guard Fassel tells you, "I am now authorized to reward more experienced adventurers with mana forge keys and you qualify. Best of luck to you."⸩ ⸨Guard Fassel gives you Mana Forge Key.
L|1||Guard Fassel, Post-Reward Dialog⸩ ⸨Guard Fassel tells you, "I have given you a reward for your recent victory over the Burun Kukuur, King Kiree. Please wait a day before returning to me for your reward. If you wish to change your title and you have a scrap of Kiree's hide I will accept the hide and name you to Kiree Killer!"
L|1||Guard Fassel, Hide Dialog L|1||Handing in Kiree's Hide⸩ ⸨You give Guard Fassel Kiree's Hide.⸩ ⸨Let it be known that has faced and defeated Kiree! Let it be known that from this day forth shall be known as Kiree Killer! Huzzah! Huzzah! Huzzah!
L|1||Watcher of the Dead Dialog, After Defeat⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "My purpose is plain, I watch the dead that reside within the halls of this temple. I have stood this vigil since my sacrifice over thirty thousand years ago, when the world cooled and the darkness made war upon all. There is no threat to the inhabitants within. Your service is not needed."⸩

You will also receive the texts, «Note to Torgluuk» and «Of the Burun». L|2|•|⟦BurunIngressDirelands⟧ L|1|2.|Use the «King Toad Idol» statue at 39.3S, 51.1W to enter the dungeon. Follow path around the unusable toad statues to the ramp down directly behind the big rock with toad king on to the bottom of the ramp in each direction to obtain scrolls 3 each(IV,V,VI) on the floor in front of 3 statues: L|2|•|**North:** Missile Defense (IV, V, VI) L|3|•|⟦FellowMissileDefense4⟧ L|3|•|⟦FellowMissileDefense5⟧ L|3|•|⟦FellowMissileDefense6⟧ L|2|•|**South:** Melee Defense (IV, V, VI) L|3|•|⟦FellowMeleeDefense4⟧ L|3|•|⟦FellowMeleeDefense5⟧ L|3|•|⟦FellowMeleeDefense6⟧ L|2|•|**West:** Magic Defense (IV, V, VI) L|3|•|⟦FellowMagicDefense4⟧ L|3|•|⟦FellowMagicDefense5⟧ L|3|•|⟦FellowMagicDefense6⟧ L|2|•|**East:** Magic Defense, Melee Defense, & Missile Defense (VII Only) L|3|•|⟦FellowMissileDefense7⟧ L|3|•|⟦FellowMeleeDefense7⟧ L|3|•|⟦FellowMagicDefense7⟧ L|1|6.|In the room at the end of the West ramp, you can use the «Mosswart Enchantment Idol» to retreive a «A Carved Mosswart Statue» housing item for a «Mansion») L|2|•|⟦MosswartIdolItem⟧ L|1|7.|Return the «Unusable Scroll»s to «Translator Aun Laokhe» at 33.5N, 56.8E in «Arwic» to obtain the learnable version of each.

Quest.name: Olthoi_Queen_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|70 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Marescent Plateau» I|Route|«Timaru» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|Part 1 of this walk through can be done ahead of time by someone who has «Lockpick». **You will need someone with the skill along for the kill or you cannot reach the Queen normally.**
L|1|•|During the Olthoi Swarm on the «Marescent Plateau», certain «Olthoi Brood Noble»s will drop «Tesserae», which can be turned in for a point in the specified skill. L|1|•|The rings will remain broken until the queen is killed, so if someone drops bells only to collect Tesserae, you will have to kill the queen to reset the quest. So if you go to the fifth ring and it stays broken for more than a day, it's safe to consider the quest abandoned and you can go in and kill the queen.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Crafting Bells P|**Note:** One person with «Lockpick» is required to complete this part of the quest.
L|1|1.|Obtain 5 of each of the following parts at their respective locations (Lockpick required): L|2|•|«Piece of Curved Metal» - «East Fork Dam Hive» - 48.5N, 76.4W - 50+ L|2|•|«Sheet of Curved Metal» - «48.3N, 80.5W - Olthoi Dam Structure» - 48.8N, 80.6W L|2|•|«Pyreal Mace» - «North Fork Dam Hive» - 51.4N, 76.0W - 70+ L|2|•|**Note:** All three parts are attuned, so you will need «Lockpick» to obtain them. The bells can be given once assembled, however. L|1|2.|Combine the «Piece of Curved Metal» with the «Sheet of Curved Metal» to create a «Broken Pyreal Bell». L|1|3.|Combine the «Pyreal Mace» with the «Broken Pyreal Bell» to create a «Pyreal Bell». L|1|4.|Repeat this process 4 times to create 5 Pyreal Bells. L|2||"The pieces of metal fit togetherThe loop of the pyreal mace attaches to the bell, allowing the item to serve as a clapper. The bell can now be rung!"
H3|Part 2: Breaking the Rings (35+) P|{WARN} Make sure that the designated killer is **NOT** one of the people handing in Bells. L|1|1.|5 people must each have 1 «Pyreal Bell», and wait at their assigned «Menhir Ring». L|1|2.|Hand a Bell to the Aun Drummer to break the Menhir Ring. L|1|3.|Each ring must be broken in order as follows: L|2|•|**Ring #1** - 53.0N, 73.3W L|2|•|**Ring #2** - 49.2N, 74.6W L|2|•|**Ring #3** - 46.5N, 75.8W L|2|•|**Ring #4** - 44.7N, 80.9W L|2|•|**Ring #5** - 50.1N, 80.4W L|1|4.|It will take a few minutes after dropping a Bell before the next drummer spawns (used to be 15 minutes, changed during ?? patch). L|1|5.|One toon can only drop one (1) bell every 3 weeks. If you try within the 3 weeks, you will obtain the title "Stonebreaker". In addition, any character that drops a bell will not have access to «Timaru» for 3 weeks. L|2||{OPT} At this point olthoi will begin swarming on the plateau. This event lasts from the time the last bell is dropped until either the Queen dies or all teserra bearing «Olthoi Brood Noble»s have died in all five regions. See «Tesserae» for details, it can take hours to advance the swarms to the tessera dropping stage so if you just want the queen, skip this.
H3|Part 3: Mount Elyrii Hive (Getting Sprayed) (70+) L|1|1.|Go to «Mount Elyrii Hive» at 48.5N, 81.7W L|1|2.|One party should trigger floor plates to open doors, the others take the NW ramp down and wait at first door. L|2|•|The trigger team takes the SW ramp down and follows a short hallway. Jump down a pit, then run past the exit portal into a large room. The trigger plate is in the far NW corner of this room. L|2|•|The trigger team takes exit portal and re-enters dungeon. L|1|3.|The main party goes in, and at least one persons either bugs the door, or waits at the trigger plate a bit further down. The rest of the main party moves further down to the second lever door. L|2|•|The trigger team takes, from drop, the SE ramp down, then jumps down into the pit. The trigger plate is at the end of the hallway to the N. Backtrack, take the ramp and follow the corridor until you reach the pit from the other side. A small running jump should get you back. L|1|4.|One person bugs the second door until the trigger team and the bugger of the first door have gone through. L|1|5.|Shortly after the second door, a large room with two ramps down to the S and the N can be seen. L|1|6.|Everyone should kill «Olthoi Eviscerator»s until they get the message of being sprayed, then not kill any more. L|3|•|⟦CentralHivePortalOK⟧ L|2|•|The spraying flags you for 1.5 hours to enter the «Royal Hive» L|1|7.|Once everyone is sprayed, have the whole group run back to the beginning (past both floor plate doors; the plate to re-open the first door you come to is in the alcove south of the door). At the start, take the NE ramp down. Jump into the pit and continually head NE to reach the Royal Hive portal. L|2|•|Anyone not sprayed will be unable to enter.
H3|Part 4: Royal Hive P|{WARN} You will need a Lockpicker to get through this dungeon normally. If one is not present, you must get one quickly. L|1|1.|The whole group runs up the hill to the center of the room. Leave at least one person at the top to hit the floor plates for the group. L|1|2.|The main group heads down the ramp in the floor and turns left at the T to reach the locked door. Have the Lockpicker open the door and proceed past it. **Leave one person here to open the door for the one(s) hitting the floor plates.** L|2|•|The lever person/team heads back down each direction from the top of the hill to the ramps in the floor. There is a floor plate in the middle of the room at the bottom of each ramp. L|2|•|Once all 4 (North/East/South/West) are hit, head back to the top of the main room and follow the directions of the other group. L|1|3.|Jump down the pit and head either northwest or southwest to reach an unopenable door. When it opens, run past and into the room to the north/west. Wait at the next door to the northwest of that room until it opens. L|1|4.|Run past the door (once it opens) into another room and into the east hallway to the final door. Once it opens, run just past it and wait for the lever hitter(s). One person may need to run back and hit the floor plates to open the doors that would have closed behind the group; they are at the hallway openings leading to the respective door. L|1|5.|Once the group is together, head southeast to the final pit. **Wait to jump.** Perform a final body and buff check here. L|1|6.|Have the higher level/stronger characters jump down first to clear the room. **DO NOT attack the Queen yet.** When clear, have everyone that has not yet jumped join the group in the southeast corner of the room. Designate 2 people to pin the Queen or simply form a wall to block her from the group. Also be sure you have your designated killer established. L|1|7.|Once the wall/pinning team is assembled, have 1 person shoot the Queen until she dies. It does not matter who. L|1|8.|The 'real' Queen will spawn now. After full debuffs, have **only** the designated killer attack until she reaches 45% or less, then have the rest of the non-wall team attack. Once the queen is killed, a global message will broadcast on the server. L|2||"In the darkest depths of Marescent Plateau on far Marae Lassel, the party of the bold has slain the young queen of the island's Olthoi brood! As one, the Olthoi swarms recoil from her final burst of terror, and slowly begin to withdraw back into their hives." L|1|9.|Make sure that **ONLY THE KILLER** loots the «The Queen's Head». Nobody else will get credit for turning it in. Decide who will get «Olthoi Carapace»s (9 on corpse) and Eggs as you wish, then head back to «Timaru». L|1|10.|Hand the Head to Aun Hareltah for 40 million XP and the «Queenslayer Title Token», which can be handed back for the Queenslayer title. The Eggs can be used in cooking, and the Carapace is handed to the «Olthoi Hunter» for an «Olthoi Cuirass». L|2|•|Looting the «The Queen's Head» ⟦InvasionQuest08⟧ L|2|•|Looting the «Olthoi Carapace» ⟦InvasionQuest10⟧ L|2|•|Note: If the killer handed in a bell in the pre-quest section, the Head cannot be handed in for credit.

Quest.name: The_Temple_of_Hizk_Ri
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60-79, 80-99, 100 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Hizk Ri's Temple Entrance» at 51.5S, 67.9W I|Route|«Obsidian Rim» portal I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|This is a fellowship quest, if you're not part of a fellowship when attempting to use the Sarcophagus at the end for your rewards, you will not receive anything. So, although this quest is soloable you will need to create a fellowship before starting. L|1|•|This quest has three level ranges: 60-80, 80-100, and 100+. The entrance splits into three sections for these ranges. You can only use the Guardian portal at the end of the section appropriate to your level, although you can help other characters reach that Guardian.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Hizk Ri's Temple L|1|1.|Each member of the fellowship must pick up the «A Carved Plate» on the southeast corner of the temple. L|1|2.|Jump down inside the temple and hand the plate to the south pillar to be teleported into the «Hizk Ri's Temple Entrance». L|1|3.|The leader should talk to the Guardian statue and pick up the four plates. Give the plates to the appropriate pillars (as listed below), and then talk to the Guardian again to open a door to the south. L|2|•|⟦HizkRiEntrance⟧ L|2|1.|«A Carved Plate (Distant Star)¦A Carved Plate» (Distant Star) - West Pillar - ⟦HizkRiEntrance4⟧ L|2|2.|«A Carved Plate (Rez'arel)¦A Carved Plate» (Moon, Rez'arel) - North Pillar - ⟦HizkRiEntrance3⟧ L|2|3.|«A Carved Plate (Au)¦A Carved Plate» (Sun, Au) - East Pillar - ⟦HizkRiEntrance1⟧ L|2|4.|«A Carved Plate (Alb'arel)¦A Carved Plate» (Moon, Alb'arel) - South Pillar - ⟦HizkRiEntrance2⟧ L|1|4.|Go through the open door quickly before it closes. L|1|5.|Use the Sealed Door appropriate to your level to open it (Left (60-80), Middle (81-100), Right (100+)). L|1|6.|Use the torch at the end of this dungeon to open a door to a Guardian statue, and use the statue to be teleported to the «Well of Tears».
H3|Part 2: Well of Tears L|1|1.|Talk to the Guardian to enter «Hizk Ri's Well of Tears». L|1|2.|Get the «Ancient Enchanted Philter», L|2|•|⟦PhilterHizkRiTaken⟧ L|1|3.|Use it on the «Well of Tears» to get «A Phial of Bloody Tears» L|1|4.|Hand that back to the Guardian to be teleported to the «Hizk Ri's Test».
H3|Part 3: Hizk Ri's Test L|1|1.|Now you must jump around the room using platforms and use four eyes to be flagged to enter the next dungeon. There are eyes for each of the three level ranges, and if you use the wrong one you will be teleported to the beginning of the jumps. L|2|•|⟦HizkRiEye1⟧ L|2|•|⟦HizkRiEye2⟧ L|2|•|⟦HizkRiEye3⟧ L|2|•|⟦HizkRiEye4⟧ L|1|2.|If you fall, jump down the hole to the south. From there, run east to the wall, turn south, then east up the ramp, finally taking west at the split. The rest of the path to the starting platform is linear. L|1|3.|If you have used an eye and fall, you do not need to return to it and use it again. L|1|4.|One you complete the test and reach the Strange Device, use it to be teleported to «Hizk Ri's Sewers».
H4|Optional Jumping Guide (100+ version) P|This series of jumps take you to the SW, NW, NE, and SE eyes, in that order. It works well for a wide range of jumping skills. I'm sure a picture of the route would help. L|1|1.|Go to the NW corner of the starting platform. 3/4 shift jump NW. L|1|2.|Move directly east of the eye, and do a full jump west to the eye. L|1|3.|Move to the north edge, and do a full shift jump north. L|1|4.|Use this eye. (1) L|1|5.|Move to the NE corner of the platform and do a full shift jump NE. L|1|6.|Move to the NE corner of this platform, and do a 3/4 jump NE, aim for the NW corner of the platform that holds the big portal device. (There is a platform that you're likely to hit if you don't aim correctly.) L|1|7.|Move to the NW corner of the portal platform, and do a 1/2 shift jump west. L|1|8.|Move directly east of the eye, and do a full shift jump west. L|1|9.|Use this eye. (2) L|1|10.|Tap shift jump north. L|1|11.|Move east, and do a full shift jump east to the portal platform. L|1|12.|Move to the east side of the portal platform, and do a 1/2 shift jump NE. L|1|13.|Move directly west of the eye, and do a full shift jump east. (Maybe less than full if your jump skill is high - I've ended up on top of the eye once.) L|1|14.|Use this eye. (3) L|1|15.|Tap shift SW. L|1|16.|Move to the SE corner, and do a full shift SE to the platform near the wall. L|1|17.|Move southeast, and do a full shift jump south toward the eye. L|1|18.|Use this eye. (4) L|1|19.|Move north, and do a full shift jump north. L|1|20.|Move to the NW part of this platform, and do a 1/3 shift jump west. L|1|21.|Do a 1/2 shift jump north. L|1|22.|Move to the west edge, and do a full shift jump west to the portal platform. L|1|23.|That's it, use the portal!
H3|Part 4: Hizk Ri's Sewers L|1|1.|Fight your way through Burun to a large room. L|1|2.|Use the lever to open the door to the Guardian statue. L|1|3.|Use the statue to be teleported to the «Patriarch Zixki» dungeon.
H3|Part 5: Patriarch Zixki & Sarcophagus of the High Matriarch L|1|1.|Once inside, do not cast on the creatures or go any closer until you are ready to fight. The final fight is against eight «Tormented Patriarch»es and «Zixki». L|1|2.|There are eight cells around the room. During the fight, Zixki will randomly teleport players to one of these cells. When this happens, either someone in the main room can open the door, or else the locked up player can use the torch to open the inner door, kill the «Tormented Patriarch», and loot «A Worn Prison Master's Key» to use on the cell door. Contrary to the notes on the map, the hallways do not do any damage. L|1|3.|Once Zixki is dead, run through the door that opens on the north wall (opens for 15 seconds), and use the Guardian to be teleported into the reward room, «Hizk Ri's Crypt». L|2|•|⟦HizkRiBeaten⟧ L|1|4.|Use the «Sarcophagus of High Matriarch, Hizk Ri» to get «Ancient Armored Gauntlets» and «Ancient Armored Long Boots». L|2|•|⟦HizkRiSarcophagus⟧ L|1|5.|Use one of the other items to get your choice of reward. L|2|•|⟦HizkRiComplete⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Finn Skigg⸩ ⸨Finn Skigg tells you, "Good day! I see that you're an adventurous sort. So am I, my dear friend! I must admit that I have been in better spirits than I am at the moment, but the sight of another adventurer has caused a smile to spread across my face."⸩ ⸨Finn Skigg tells you, "You see, I have just finished a jaunt across and all around Dererth. I managed to make the walk in about eighty days. I've only recently settled here in the pleasantly arid air of Candeth Keep. I had a particularly nasty run-in with some foul undead near the southern entrance of the Valley of Death."⸩ ⸨Finn Skigg tells you,"While making my way into a valley, I was accosted by these foul looking undead beasts. They gave me such a fright that I lost a collection of rare plates I'd received from Baron Eli von Schreft back on Ispar. They're priceless, and I would certainly be pleased if someone were to bring them back to me. If you find them, please bring them here."
L|1||Hizk Ri's Temple Entrance Guardian⸩ ⸨Guardian tells you, "You have entered the halls of Hizk Ri, the Matron of Pain. Your presence is unwelcome. You have distrubed a perfect order that has existed for eons. What right have you to enter these halls, cur?"⸩ ⸨Guardian tells you, "Do not answer. Your presence marks a return of the ancient ways. You shall be tested and if not found wanting, you shall find your way to the seat of the Matron's power and wake her from her slumber."⸩ ⸨Guardian tells you, "I pray that you fail, for power such as Hizk Ri's should never be loosed upon the world. We have suffered for millennia under her cruel wiles."⸩ ⸨Guardian tells you, "The pillars scattered about the room are devoted to the bodies that hang in the sky above. A riddle seals their secret and bars entrance to the halls beyond. I shall issue this riddle after this final warning: return to me for judgment only when the riddle is solved. If you fail to do so you will be struck dead where you stand. If you return to me with only half the puzzle solved you will be struck dead where you stand. You have been warned."⸩ ⸨Guardian tells you, "The riddle is as follows: Au, the light of this world, hangs in the east, opposed to star of portent. To the north, the moon run red with blood watches it's twin in the south. Prove your worth, or die trying."⸩ ⸨Guardian tells you, "You may advance through the halls of Hizk Ri, Matron of Pain. Be warned, you dwell amongst the hopeless and cruel."
L|1||Sealed Door to the Well of Tears⸩ ⸨Sealed Door tells you, "You are suited for the halls beyond, the restless dead herein will provide a fair challenge to you and those like you. Any beings weaker than you will not be permitted beyond the second guardian, though they may assist you through this corridor. Such assistance would prove you too weak to live."
L|1||Hizk Ri's Well of Tears Guardian⸩ ⸨Guardian tells you, "Within this well the wayward sister of Hizk Ri was cast beneath the world and bound by vile arts to suffer for all eternity. The restless souls, the make this place their home, have tormented the woman's soul since its imprisonment here."⸩ ⸨Guardian tells you, "If you wish to meet Hizk Ri you shall need to garner her sister's tears for me. You will need to collect them in an ancient philter, lost somewhere in this crypt. Collect them from the well and return them to me and I shall then let you pass. Go now and return to me only when you can hand me the phial of bloody tears."
L|1||Handing in A Phial of Bloody Tears⸩ ⸨You give Guardian A Phial of Bloody Tears.⸩ ⸨Guardian tells you, "You have pleased me. I will sup upon the tears of her soul this night and be sated for a time. Prepare for your reward."⸩

Quest.name: Thorsten_Cragstone's_Armor_&_Axe
Quest.notes: Repeat required for full qb
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|20 I|Rec. Level|40 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Glysander Cartoth» I|Starts At|25.7N, 48.5E in «Cragstone» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Thorsten Cragstone is dead, but his armor and axe are on display, and you can have your own replica if you dare to enter the Hidden Dungeon!
L|1|•|Note 1: When doing this quest with multiple people, make sure you take turns when interacting with NPCs, otherwise you may not receive items (such as the wax) and not be able to complete the quest! L|1|•|Note 2: While this quest is restricted to level 20+, it is possible for a character below 20 to obtain the first note, A Letter of Grief, by having a higher level get the key and unlock the chest for them. This lower level can then turn in the note for the full reward.
L|1||Quest Bonus Stamps: Two runs to collect all stamps. One for the Axe and one for the Armor.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Glysander will give you «A Bronze Key» and «A Certificate of Permission». They key has three uses and can be given. L|2|•|⟦GAVENOTETHORSTENARMOR1⟧ L|1|2.|Head to a cottage at 15.2N, 65.6E outside «Eastham» and use «A Bronze Key» on «Brontynn Marshad's Chest» and loot «A tightly scrawled Note» and «A Letter of Grief». L|1|3.|Next head to «Brontynn Marshad» at 10.3S, 57.6E in a locked tower (Shortcut: «Neu Gerz Villas¦Neu Gerz Villas Portal» at 2.1N, 50.4E just outside of «Lytelthorpe»). L|1|4.|Killing any of the «Tumerok Gladiator»s guarding the tower will drop the «Gate Key» needed to unlock the Gate. L|2|•|**Leaftide Note**: If your Jump is >5k you can just jump up to the top. L|1|5.|Giving «A Certificate of Permission» to «Brontynn Marshad» will cause him to give you «Elysa Strathelar's Letter to Lania Cartoth (First)¦Elysa Strathelar's Letter to Lania Cartoth» and «A Letter of Correspondence». L|2|•|⟦FREEDBRONTYNNTHORSTENARMOR⟧ L|1|6.|Who you go to next depends on which reward you want: L|2|•|For «Thorsten's Armor» go to «Lia Tze» at 49.4S, 62.4E in «Baishi» and talk to her, she will give you «A Letter of Correspondence (Lia Tze)» and «Wax». L|3|•|⟦TALKEDTOLIATZETHORSTENARMOR⟧ L|2|•|For «Cragstone's Axe» go to «Tai Wo» at 61.8S, 82.4E in «Mayoi» and talk to him, he will give you «A faithful copy of Elysa Strathelar's Letter to Lania Cartoth» and «Wax». L|3|•|⟦TALKEDTOTAIWOTHORSTENARMOR⟧ L|2|•|⟦RECEIVEDWAXTHORSTEN⟧ L|1|7.|Head back to Cragstone and take the portal to the «Isle of Tears» at 25.3N 49.9E. L|1|8.|Take the portal to the «Underground City» at 21.3N, 53.9E. L|2|•|**Leaftide Route**: Take Underground City portal in Subway. L|1|9.|Within the Underground City, follow the path down to the «Hidden Dungeon». L|1|10.|The «Hidden Dungeon» map above will provide the route down to «Thorsten Cragstone's Axe» and «Thorsten Cragstone's Armor». L|1|11.|Loot «Elysa Strathelar's Letter to Lania Cartoth (Second)¦Elysa Strathelar's Letter to Lania Cartoth» off «The skeleton of Lania Cartoth». L|1|12.|Use the wax on either the axe or the armor to receive a «Wax Mould» of the item. L|1|13.|Head back to who you received the «Wax» from and give them the «Wax Mould» for your reward: L|2|•|Return to «Lia Tze» at 49.4S, 62.4E in «Baishi» for «Thorsten's Armor». L|3|•|⟦RECEIVEDTHORSTENARMORARMOR⟧ L|2|•|Return to «Tai Wo» at 61.8S, 82.4E in «Mayoi» for «Cragstone's Axe». L|3|•|⟦RECEIVEDTHORSTENAXE⟧ L|1|14.|Take the notes to «Glysander Cartoth» at 25.7N, 48.5E in «Cragstone» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦GAVELETTERTHORSTENARMOR1⟧ L|2|•|⟦GAVELETTERTHORSTENARMOR2⟧ L|2|•|⟦GAVELETTERTHORSTENARMOR3⟧ L|2|•|⟦GAVELETTERTHORSTENARMOR4⟧ L|2|•|⟦GAVELETTERTHORSTENARMOR4COPY⟧ L|2|•|⟦GAVELETTERTHORSTENARMOR5⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Glysander Cartoth tells you, "Hello, I hope that you are here to help me! My name is Glysander Cartoth. I seek to recover a series of letters that Elysa Strathelar wrote to my older sister, Lania Cartoth. They were friends from childhood on Ispar and they corresponded for some time here in Dereth. One day my sister disappeared. I believe the letters may hold a clue to her disappearance. I will reward you with Experience Points for every letter you bring me. Furthermore, my sister once said something to me that leads me to believe the letters may direct you to items of great worth: Thorsten Cragstone's Armor or his axe! I know not whether these items are truly attainable but..."⸩ ⸨Glysander Cartoth tells you, "There is a man, Brontynn Marshad, who promised to try to track down the letters but I have not heard from him in some time. He was staying in a cottage south of Eastham, near the beach. There is a chest in the cottage inside which he said he would leave letters for me to pick up periodically. I give you the key to the chest, for I am unable to make this journey. Please see if there are letters in the chest and give Brontynn this note, should you find him. This not authorizes Brontynn to give you any letters he may have. Thank you, and best of luck!"⸩ ⸨Glysander Cartoth gives you A Certificate of Permission⸩ ⸨Glysander Cartoth gives you A Bronze Key.
L|1||Brontynn Marshad⸩ ⸨Brontynn Marshad tells you, "Those Tumeroks have me trapped here. I am glad their number has been dealt a severe blow!"
L|1||Handing in A Certificate of Permission⸩ ⸨You give Brontynn Marshad A Certificate of Permission.⸩ ⸨Brontynn Marshad tells you, "Thank you for liberating me! I hope you are not injured! I see Glysander has sent you. I know he is anxious to recover the letters but alas, I cannot continue this quest now."⸩ ⸨Brontynn Marshad tells you, "Here are two letters I have found. I can tell you where to find another letter, or its exact copy. Find Lia Tze in Baishi. She has a letter in her possession, and I was informed she might have a means for you to obtain a replica of Thorsten Cragstone's Armor. Or you may go to Tou-Tou and seek out a man named Tai Wo. He has a copy of the same letter Lia Tze has and may have knowledge of how to obtain a replica of Thorsten Cragstone's Axe. But beware- do not go to both of those people, for there is bad blood between them! Choose only one of them, for they will not deal with anyone who has had contact with the other. Now I will rest here for a bit and return home. Farewell!"⸩ ⸨Brontynn Marshad gives you Elysa Strathelar's Letter to Lania Cartoth.⸩ ⸨Brontynn Marshad gives you A Letter of Correspondence.
L|1||Tai Wo⸩ ⸨Tai Wo tells you, "Good, I see Brontynn Marshad sent you. Here is the letter I was going to give him. A learned colleague of mine who examined it believes this letter holds a clue to the location of Thorsten Cragstone's Axe."⸩ ⸨Tai Wo gives you A faithful copy of Elysa Strathelar's Letter to Lania Cartoth.⸩ ⸨Tai Wo gives you Wax.⸩ ⸨Tai Wo tells you, "Should you find it, you should leave it in its hiding place, however here is a quantity of wax with which you may make a mould of the axe. Having been an armorsmith in the past, the axe is of historical interest to me and I would very much like to make a replica of it. Bring me the mould with the impression of the armor and I will make a fine replica of the axe for you! I wish you luck in this, for the way sounds treacherous."
L|1||Speaking to Tai Wo Again⸩ ⸨Tai Wo tells you, "Are you having trouble finding where Thorsten Cragstone's Armor is? Read the letter I gave you!"
L|1||Speaking to Lia Tze, after Speaking to Tai Wo⸩ ⸨Lia Tze tells you, "A friend of mine in Tou-Tou observed you speaking with that vile excuse of a man, Tai Wo. I do not trust anyone who deals with him. Be gone!"
L|1||Handing in Wax Mould (Tai Wo)⸩ ⸨You give Tai Wo Wax Mould.⸩ ⸨Tai Wo examines the mould intensely.⸩ ⸨Tai Wo crafts a fine replica of Thorsten's Axe.⸩ ⸨Tai Wo tells you, "You took a fine mould! Here is an exacting replica of Thorsten Cragstone's Axe. Use it with care! I pray you do not come to the same end as he!"⸩ ⸨Tai Wo gives you Cragstone's Axe.
L|1||Lia Tze⸩ ⸨Lia Tze tells you, "Ah, yes, Brontynn Marshad sent you. Here is the letter I intended to give him. I came across it a long time ago, I remember not where. It seems to offer a clue to where Thorsten Cragstone's Armor was hidden."⸩ ⸨Lia Tze gives you A Letter of Correspondence.⸩ ⸨Lia Tze gives you Wax.⸩ ⸨Lia Tze tells you, "If you seek it and find it, I doubt you can remove the armor. Nor should you. However, I have also given you a quantity of wax with which you may make a mould of the armor. Having some armorsmithing skills myself, I have a historical interest in the armor. Bring me the mould with the impression of the armor and I will give you a fine replica of the armor which will serve as an exquisite decorative item. Go with care!"

H2|Dialog P|⸨=== Quest Clues === P|==== Asheron ====⸩ ⸨You tell Asheron, "Viridian Rise"⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "I did indeed spend time studying this place. In ages past it was called the Viridian Rise. It may seem that it has sprung forth overnight, but in reality the Deru trees are all hidden by extremely strong illusions and wards. Something has disrupted one of the great trees."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "Someone will have to enter this place and find out what happened."⸩ ⸨Asheron fixes his stare on you expectantly.⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "The ritual to enter the Viridian Rise is hidden in the guardian statues. I do not know the ritual order, but my studies did reveal the following:"⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "Each guardian must be invoked in order, and only once. The ritual begins with Oak and ends with Ash."⸩ ⸨You tell Ulgrim the Unpleasant, "Viridian Rise"⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "Why are you bothering ME about the Viridian Rise? Oh yeah, something attacked that Deru and the tree sent out unhealthy amounts of magic. Everything there is growing like crazy, and even the guardians are a bit... off because of it. Probably too tough for someone like you. I went up there looking for good ingredients for a new mead. Found the guardian statues, and figured out two things."⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "Spruce follows directly after Pine."⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "Maple follows directly after Willow."⸩ ⸨You tell Shade of Lady Adja, "Viridian Rise"⸩ ⸨Shade of Lady Adja tells you, "Yes, the Virdian Rise. I have wandered that place in my visions. The magics of the wounded Deru endanger us. It expends too much of the world's magic, and the guardians have become infused by it. They must be... culled before the forest spreads. It saddens me, but there is no other way that I know of to prevent the tree's growth from overwhelming all in its path."⸩ ⸨Shade of Lady Adja tells you, "Know that the Guardian of Yew must be invoked at some point after the Guardian of Pine."⸩ ⸨You tell Isin Dule, "Viridian Rise"⸩ ⸨Isin Dule tells you, "Yes, I sensed a darkness attack one of the elder trees. Something corrupt gnaws at the roots of the great tree. When I investigated the area I found the guardians. Although their ritual is hidden from my eyes, my research did reveal the following about the magics of those guardians."⸩ ⸨You find pages with indecipherable magical notes and symbols. You recognize two things among the magical glyphs, however. The first is the mark of Asheron. The second is a phrase or name written on the pages⸩ ⸨Viridian Rise⸩ ⸨The eyes of the statue briefly burn with blue flame.⸩ ⸨You feel as though you are cleansed of the magics of the Guardians and can begin the ritual from the beginning.⸩ ⸨As you finish the ritual of the Viridian Guardians blue fire emblazons a Mark of the Guardian on your hand! As the flame and mark fade you realize you have learned the magic necessary to enter the Viridian Rise.⸩ ⸨The mark of the Viridian Guardians briefly burns with blue flame.⸩ ⸨The statue seems to be recharging its energies.⸩

Quest.notes: Repeat required for full qb, up to 4 repeats
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|150+ I|Type|Locked Fellowship I|Starts With|«Emissary of Asheron (Aerbax's Citadel)¦Emissary of Asheron» I|Starts At|«South Gate» at 65.0S, 63.8W I|Route|«Mansion» to «Dangerous Portal Device» to «Center of the Obsidian Plains». I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Time|1 Hour I|Contracts|«Contract for Aerbax's Defeat» H2|Overview L|1|•|{TIP} - three runs to gather all reward stamps.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Collect 3 unique Harmonic Crystals by killing and looting them from the «Virindi Artificer» at each of the three gates surrounding the citadel. You only need one set of crystals per fellowship, and they are givable: L|2|1.|«North Gate Harmonic Crystal» - 63.3S 63.7W L|2|2.|«East Gate Harmonic Crystal» - 64.0S 62.9W L|2|3.|«West Gate Harmonic Crystal» - 64.1S 64.7W L|1|2.|When you have your crystals, your fellowship (max 9 people) will enter the «South Gate» portal (tieable & recallable) at 65.0S 63.8W and run to the very bottom. L|2|•|Note: Its a long run to the bottom, but its safe. Make sure you have everything you need for the quest before making the trip. L|1|3.|Once your fellow is buffed and ready, the quest leader needs to hand the 3 Harmonic Crystals to the «Emissary of Asheron (Aerbax's Citadel)¦Emmisary of Asheron», which will lock the fellowship. L|2|•|⟦gaveeastgateharmoniccrystal⟧ L|2|•|⟦gavenorthgateharmoniccrystal⟧ L|2|•|⟦gavewestgateharmoniccrystal⟧ L|2|•|{WARN} Once the fellowship is locked, you have **one hour to complete the quest**. L|1|4.|Everyone should now use the «Harmonic Transference Field» to be portaled on to «Aerbax's Citadel (POI)¦Aerbax's Citadel». L|2|•|⟦AerbaxPlatformAccess⟧ L|2|•|{TIP} If you die, disconnect, or are portaled off the platform (yes Aerbax can do that to you), simply portal recall to the «South Gate» and use one of the portals at the **TOP** of the dungeon to be sent back to the device room. Just like before, use the «Harmonic Transference Field» to be portaled back to the citadel platform and join your group. L|1|5.|While fighting «Aerbax's Shadow», he will portal several times to the platforms surrounding his citadel based on his HP %. Each time he portals he will start L|2|•|**Warning**: If Aerbax's health drops too much at a time, he may skip his portal trigger and become bugged. See below for more information. L|2|•|**IFL Changes**: The health ranges where Aerbax will portal have been altered on Infinite Leaftide in an attempt to make it less likely for him to become bugged. As of this writing, most of his portal triggers seem to be: (Update on 23JUN2025 - Each movement coincided with a 5-6 minute timer). So punch a few %, wait 20 seconds, and rinse and repeat! If in a Fellowship - Everyone must hit Aerbax Shadow, and kill adds near him. 1-2 punches at a time. L|3|•|**60-70%** HP - Portals to **East** platform. (5min at 77%) (15mins at 68%). But once he moved to East platform, times and % stuck. L|3|•|**40-60%** HP - Portals to **North** platform. (5min at 75%) L|3|•|**40-60%** HP - Portals to **West** platform. (5min at 63%) L|3|•|**40-60%** HP - Portals to **South** platform. (5min at 61%) L|3|•|**30-40%** HP - Portals to **Center** platform. (5min at 42%) L|2|•|It is recommended that you take care approaching the top end of these ranges and hit him for damage that will take him to exactly the top number (e.g., 70% for the first phase) rather than jumping below it (e.g., from 81% to 78%). Stay at the recommended % until 5min timer. If you get below the lower end of this range, he may be bugged. L|2|•|If you get below the threshold and he isn't teleporting, you can try killing him and waiting for him to respawn (or leave the area and come back). In at least some cases, he will respawn at the same platform position he was last at, not back at the start. Once he does this, you can try again and continue from where you are. If not, consider asking an Infinite Leaftide admin for help on Discord. L|2|•|Retail triggers: L|3|•|**90%** HP - Portals to **East** platform. L|3|•|**77%** HP - Portals to **North** platform. L|3|•|**72%** HP - Portals to **West** platform. L|3|•|**60%** HP - Portals to **South** platform. L|3|•|**33%** HP - Portals to **Center** platform. L|1|6.|Once «Aerbax's Shadow» is slain, loot an «Aerbax Mask Shard» off the ground. L|2|•|⟦aerbaxmaskshardpickuptimer⟧ L|1|7.|use the «Emissary's Return Portal» that appears to return to the «Emissary of Asheron (Aerbax's Citadel)¦Emmisary of Asheron» L|2|•|⟦aerbaxshadowdefeated⟧ L|1|8.|Speak with him for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦aerbaxshadowdefeatedrepeat⟧ L|2|•|⟦AerbaxCompletedWait⟧ L|2|•|⟦aerbaxcitadelrewards1⟧ **or** ⟦aerbaxcitadelrewards2⟧ **or** ⟦aerbaxcitadelrewards3⟧ L|1|9.|Turn the mask shard in to «Leopold» in «Ayan Baqur» for «Aerbax's Defeat» or save it for your «Paragon Weapons» quest.

L|1||Returning to Shan Zhen⸩ ⸨Shan Zhen tells you, "So now, the Portal Servitor seeks a goblet of the House of Realaidain? I think I have a note that would help this search..."⸩ ⸨Shan Zhen gives you Western Vault Notes.
L|1||Handing in Ancient Goblet to Portal Servitor⸩ ⸨You give Portal Servitor Ancient Goblet.⸩ ⸨You note that any other versions of the goblet that you have taken have vanished as well.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Ancient Goblets.⸩ ⸨Portal Servitor tells you, "This is the goblet that once belonged to House Realaidain. It was the vessel from which my master Lord Atlan and my mistress Lady Maila drank at their betrothal feast. Bring it to the apprentices of the sword sage."⸩ ⸨Portal Servitor gives you Asheron's Departure Journal.⸩ ⸨You've earned 6,891,063 experience.
L|1||Handing in Asheron's Departure Journal to Shan Zhen⸩ ⸨You give Shan Zhen Asheron's Departure Journal.⸩ ⸨Shan Zhen tells you, "At last! The item we seek!"⸩ ⸨Shan Zhen looks closely at the book.⸩ ⸨Shan Zhen tells you, "Yet I fear that it doesn't have any new information. Still, you've done as I asked, so I shall assist you."⸩ ⸨Shan Zhen touches your forehead and mutters a few words.⸩ ⸨Shan Zhen tells you, "Now it will be possible to pass through Prince Borelean's portal to Bur. Quest.name: Clutch_of_Kings_(Rehir)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Guard Lo Pan» I|Starts At|Cragstone 25.7N, 48.8E I|Route|«Mansion» to «Portal to Kivik Lir's Temple» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Clutch of Kings: Rehir» H2|Overview L|1|•|{WARN}: Talk to the Cragstone NPCs before running this a 2nd time, or you won't be able to pick up the hide at the end. L|1|•|This is the fifth of six quests in the «Clutch of Kings» quest series. L|1|•|Frost weapons are recommended.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Depth's of Kivik Lir's Temple L|1|1.|Speak to the «Watcher of the Dead» at 38.1S, 47.3W «Kivik Lir's Temple» to be portaled into the «Depth's of Kivik Lir's Temple». L|1|2.|Jump down and take the West ramp down, and continue heading west until you reach a ramp down on the east wall. Take the ramp down, then hug the wall left for the rest of the dungeon, with the only obstacle being a lever activated door in the first large room: L|1|3.|In the first large room you come to, open the Southeast door by entering the room on the East wall and pulling the lever inside. The entrance to the East room is activated by floor plates on either side of the door. L|1|4.|When you reach the end of the dungeon, use the Portal Gateway to be sent to the «Secrets of Kivik Lir's Temple».
H3|Part 2: Secrets of Kivik Lir's Temple L|1|1.|From the drop, pick up all 4 weapons lying on the ground. Also, take note of weapons' colored counterparts hanging on the wall: L|2|•|⟦MemoryGamePickedupMace⟧ L|2|•|⟦MemoryGamePickedupAxe⟧ L|2|•|⟦MemoryGamePickedupSpear⟧ L|2|•|⟦MemoryGamePickedupSword⟧ L|1|2.|Once you have collected all 4 weapons, talk to the statue in the middle to be portaled to the first room. L|2|•|⟦MemoryGameReceivedInstructions⟧ L|1|3.|Once inside, note the tint of the room. Drop the weapon whose colored counterpart matches the tint, then talk to the statue to be portaled to the next room. L|2|•|«Blue Sword» then drop «Sword (Rehir)¦Sword» L|3|•|⟦MemoryGameDroppedSword⟧ L|2|•|«Green Spear» then drop «Spear (Rehir)¦Spear» L|3|•|⟦MemoryGameDroppedSpear⟧ L|2|•|«Purple Axe» then drop «Axe (Rehir)¦Axe» L|3|•|⟦MemoryGameDroppedAxe⟧ L|2|•|«Red Mace» then drop «Mace (Rehir)¦Mace» L|3|•|⟦MemoryGameDroppedMace⟧ L|1|4.|Continue this process until you are portaled into a square room with an exit portal. Take the portal to complete the puzzle and enter «Kivik Lir's Temple».
H3|Part 3: Kivik Lir's Temple L|1|1.|From the drop, head East and hug the left wall all the way to the end, there are no levers are misdirections in here. L|1|2.|At the end, you'll find a hallway on the West wall, which leads to a «Portal Gateway». The device leads to «Rehir», the boss. L|1|3.|Before using the device, there are several things to know before going into the fight with Rehir, review these tactics: L|2|•|Do not debuff him, he counters most debuffs. L|2|•|Disband your fellowship before going into battle. Rehir casts Fellowship Debuffs, so you lessen the chance to be debuffed when not in a fellowship. L|2|•|If you are swallowed (portaled into Rehir's stomach), quickly switch to a «Critical Strike» weapon, and attack his «Stomach Wall» on full speed. You have only have a percent chance of escaping his stomach when you land a critical hit. L|3|•|Tip: If you're a mage, use wall spells for a greater chance to critical hit. L|1|4.|Once everyone is ready, use the Portal Gateway to be portaled into the «Center of Kivik Lir's Temple» (hot drop).
H3|Part 4: Center of Kivik Lir's Temple L|1|1.|When you portal in, you'll immediately be attacked by Burun, and «Rehir» is just to the North. L|1|2.|Kill Broodu using frost weapons/bows and «Tusker Fists» or Frost Wall. L|2|•|Note: Do not debuff Rehir, he will counter. See above for tactics. L|1|3.|Once you kill Broodu, loot «Rehir's Hide» from the floor. L|2|•|⟦RehirBeaten⟧ L|1|4.|Head to «Cragstone», and speak to «Guard Lo Pan» at 25.7N, 48.8E for your XP, «Mana Forge Key» (125+), and random reward. L|2|•|⟦RehirComplete⟧ L|2|•|⟦RehirKilled⟧ L|1|5.|{OPT} Hand Rehir's Hide to Guard Lo Pan for the title of Rehir Killer. L|2|•|Note: Hold on to the hide if you are trying to obtain the Kingslayer title. See the «Clutch of Kings» for more information.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Watcher of the Dead⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "My purpose is plain, I watch the dead that reside within the halls of this temple. I have stood this vigil since my sacrifice over thirty thousand years ago, when the world cooled and the darkness made war upon all. The weight of time has long crushed my bones to dust and left with me with this incorporeal form. Yet, I serve my purpose with the same vigor that I did in life."⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "I will not find rest until the threat from beyond is quashed. They will spread like a plague across this world if they are not shattered. Great waves of magic shall crash against their flesh and be pulled into their bodies. Their strength will grow until they can no longer be touched and then all shall be lost beneath the weight of their power."⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "A great failure for our sisterhood. They grew where our chosen fell. Now they come to shattered the coil of this world as we shattered the coil of theirs. You must defeat the behemoth within these halls else its power grow until it is unchecked by any force that remains on this world.""
L|1||Guard Lo Pan (Completing the Quest)⸩ ⸨Guard Lo Pan gives you Marksman's Robe.⸩ ⸨You've earned 56,184,660 experience.⸩ ⸨Guard Lo Pan tells you, "This is for your efforts against the Burun Kukuur, King Rehir. You will need to wait three weeks before returning to me for another reward. If you wish to change your title and you have a scrap of Rehir's hide I will accept the hide and name you Rehir Killer!"⸩

Quest.name: Monouga_Laboratory
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80|80, 120, 150 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|{OPT} «Corporal Liao Chen» I|Starts At|{OPT} 25.6N 49.3E in «Cragstone» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Aerbax's Prodigal Monouga» H2|Overview P|Quest to retrieve experiment logs from the Monouga Laboratory.
L|1|•|There are three versions of this quest, based upon which direction you take at the 4-way intersection near the dungeon entrance. Levels are suggested and not required for portals. This quest is commonly done with the «Monouga Feeding Pit Quest» which basically coincides with this one. L|1|•|It is easy to run solo to the end of the two higher level versions to pick up the log. The lowest level version, however, has dense spawns which makes it difficult to run without getting stuck. L|1|•|**Leaftide Quest Bonus**: Three runs total. One for each difficulty level. The start stamp is shared across all three.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|«Corporal Liao Chen» will give you «Monouga Laboratory Portal Attunement Gem». L|2|•|⟦ProdigalMonougaStarted0707⟧ L|1|2.|Run to the «Monouga Feeding Pits» at 9.8S 81.0W, southwest of «Fort Tethana» (bring your fire/slash weps). L|2|•|A 6.5 click run from «Gear Knight Invasion Area Camp Recall». L|2|•|If you don't have the «Gear Knight Invasion Area Camp Recall» Give «Merkitz ibn'Akadh» in «Xarabydun» one Trade Note (250,000). He will summon a portal directly to the «Direlands Gear Knight Resistance Camp». L|1|3.|Once inside, take the appropriate path for your level of difficulty. Levels are suggested. L|2|•|South| «Monouga Laboratory (80+)» - «Tusker Experiment Orb» L|2|•|East| «Monouga Laboratory (120+)» - «Olthoi Experiment Log» L|2|•|North| «Monouga Laboratory (150+)» - «Monouga Experiment Log» L|1|4.|{OPT} Pickup «Instructions (Monouga Feeding Pit)¦Instructions» from the ground. L|1|5.|{OPT} Ring the bell to summon an Imprisoned Monouga («Large Imprisoned Monouga¦Large», «Huge Imprisoned Monouga¦Huge» or «Giant Imprisoned Monouga¦Giant») from the Monouga Laboratory to the «Monouga Feeding Pits¦Feeding Pits». This portals him into the feeding pits for an hour, and means there will be one less creature to fight in the Laboratory. You can still hand a gem and use the bell after to summon portal after calling the Monouga. L|1|6.|Hand a «Monouga Laboratory Portal Attunement Gem» to the Bell. L|2|•|80+: ⟦LabPortalGem80⟧ L|2|•|120+: ⟦LabPortalGem120⟧ L|2|•|150+: ⟦LabPortalGem150⟧ L|1|7.|Ring the bell **again** to summon a portal. L|1|8.|Follow the hallways opposite of the bell until they reach a dead end. L|1|9.|{OPT} If you rang the bell twice, the imprisoned Monouga will be waiting for you. You can then kill it as part of the Monouga Feeding Pit Quest. L|1|10.|Take the portal at the dead end to travel to the level appropriate Monouga Laboratory. L|1|11.|Stick to the middle tunnel, watch out for lots of shadows and virindi. If alone is likely safer to run. The mid version (120+) seems to have a higher spawn rate (many creatures that spawn almost as fast as you can kill them). All the side passages lead to dead end rooms with lots of spawn. L|1|12.|Just before the end is an Imprisoned Monouga (if you didn't summon it to the feeding pits earlier). You are not required to kill it. L|1|13.|Just past the monouga room, pick up the experiment log on the ground. L|2|•|80+: ⟦TuskerExperimentLogPickupTimer⟧ L|2|•|120+: ⟦OlthoiExperimentLogPickupTimer⟧ L|2|•|150+: ⟦MonougaExperimentLogPickupTimer⟧ L|2|•|**Note** that there is no exit portal available. L|1|14.|Return to «Corporal Liao Chen» and hand him the experiment log for your rewards. L|2|•|80+: ⟦RepeatTuskerExperimentLog⟧ L|2|•|120+: ⟦RepeatOlthoiExperimentLog⟧ L|2|•|150+: ⟦RepeatMonougaExperimentLog⟧ L|2|•|⟦ProdigalMonougaCompleted0707⟧ L|2|•|⟦ProdigalMonougaRepeat0707⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen tells you, "Greetings, adventurer. I greet you in the name of Queen Elysa, whose command brings me here today."⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen gives you Monouga Laboratory Portal Attunement Gem.⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen tells you, "We seek intrepid adventurers like yourself, who might be willing to help us investigate a concerning development. It seems that some travelers have discovered a cavern in which drudges have been keeping monougas captive. What is unusual is that the drudges have very sophisticated portal sending enchantments which would seem to be beyond their means. We suspect Virindi involvement of some sort."⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen tells you, "Therefore, Prince Borelean led an expedition to investigate this drudge cavern. When he was finished, he had determined a way to reverse the portal sending - to open a portal from that location to the source of the monougas. These portal gems are the result of that determination."⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen tells you, "The Queen has commanded that whatever lay on the other side of that portal transit should be explored carefully, with the assumption that whatever is there is hostile. To do so, take the gem I have given you and charge it against the feeding bell. It will reverse the workings of the bell's portal sending magic, and, instead of summoning a drudge and a monouga, will open portals to the source of these monsters."⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen tells you, "You are welcome to explore the drudge cave, although many have explored it before now. Quest.name: Slave_Master_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Rec. Level|200 I|Type|Small Fellowship I|Starts With|«Nephthys» I|Starts At|«Encampment near Neftet» at 22.2S, 6.2E I|Route|East from «Yaraq» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|This quest is the original quest at the «Lost City of Neftet». It features the prominent temple up on the cliffs for the final dungeon. Due to having to repeat the flagging portion each time, this quest tends to not be very popular. *Scrying Rod expires after two-hours, finish parts one and two within timer or you will have to wait 20 hours for a new one* L|1|•|ILT Custom Changes: The doors in the Temple frequently didn't open due to a bug. Now there are no doors. Also the «Mu-miyah Device» has been moved to the lantern behind the Neftet Encampment tent, at 22.2S, 6.1E
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Sand Caves Flagging L|1|1.|Speak to «Nephthys» inside the tent to get the «Scrying Rod». L|1|2.|Use the «Scrying Rod» on top of the cliffs. This will cause a «Mu-miyah Device» to spawn, and when it does, use the device to flag for the next stage of the quest. You will get a message about it shocking you. The device moves around, and can be found at 1 of 4 locations (See map below). When you use the rod near one of the possible areas, a green message about "wind whipping through the chasms" will appear. P|(ILT change in August of 2026 has the location of the «Mu-miyah Device»s around a lantern behind the Neftet encampment tent, at 22.2S, 6.1E. Use the «Scrying Rod» while standing close to the lantern and, no matter what device is currently active, it will spawn.) L|2|1.|21.7S 8.0E L|2|2.|20.0S 7.1E L|2|3.|21.7S 7.4E L|2|4.|19.8S 8.0E L|2|•|If you have utility belt, click on your scrying rod and type /ub propertydump. 44126, 44125, 71395, and 44128 are device spots 1-4, in that order L|2|•|Note: A common pitfall on this quest is not being able to find the device up on the cliffs. Note that the message about the "wind whipping through the chasms" is given at each of the possible locations where the device can spawn. Many people get the message and believe they are in the correct location when they really are not. A good strategy is to go the exact coordinates shown above and use the Scrying Rod 2-3 times within those coordinates. If the device does not spawn, move on to the next coordinate location. L|2|•|⟦FindMumiyahDeviceStart⟧ L|1|3.|Return to the tent and talk to «Nephthys» to receive the first reward. L|2|•|⟦FindMumiyahDeviceWait⟧ L|2|•|⟦SandCaveFlagComplete⟧
H3|Part 2: Temple Flagging L|1|1.|Now you need to go into the «Sand Caves» dungeon. There are multiple portals found on top of the cliffs along the western edge that all drop at the same place (safe drop). L|2|•|There are multiple portals which drop at different locations within the dungeon. This appears somewhat random, but has been stated by the devs that it is not fully random. The exact mechanics of how the portals work is unconfirmed. L|1|2.|Run around the dungeon until you find a room with a «Mu-miyah Soothsayer» and «Mu-miyah Channeller». There are 5 possible rooms where they can spawn and the dungeon is a maze with rocks that randomly spawn to block passages. The dungeon is filled with Mu-miyah, Armoredillos, A'nekshay, and Golems. The dungeon portal is recallable if you die. L|1|3.|Loot «Red Destabilizing Crystal» and «Yellow Destabilizing Crystal» off the Soothsayer and Channeller. There are 6 of each crystal per spawn. L|1|4.|Leave the dungeon and find the «Mu-miyah Device» again using the «Scrying Rod». It may or may not be in the same location as previously. L|1|5.|Hand the crystals to the device and it will give you the second reward and flag you for Temple entrance. «Nephthys» will spawn next the device and direct you to enter the temple. Speaking to her is not required. L|2|•|⟦NeftetTempleFlagComplete⟧ L|2|•|⟦NeftetFreeHatsheput⟧ L|2|•|⟦NeftetDeviceCrystalTurnInWait⟧
H3|Part 3: Inside the Temple L|1|1.|Now go to the «Temple» dungeon portal (Portal is recallable) on top of one of the cliffs. L|1|2.|Kill every creature on the lower levels in order to open the doors to the wings at the top of the stairs above the huge statue. The only creatures in the dungeon are Mu-miyah and A'nekshay. L|2|•|Note: The doors will only stay open for 20 minutes. L|2|•|Go to NW door from drop, then immediately take the right down to a lower level and there is a Chorizite Chest ⟦chestchorizite48760⟧ L|2|•|Also, jump to the balcony from top level. ⟦chestchorizite48745⟧ L|1|3.|Once the creatures in the wings are all dead the doors to the next level will open. L|2|•|Note: It appears that only the «Mu-miyah Grand Vizier» (not «Mu-miyah Vizier», which is also present) and «Bak'tshay Lady» trigger the final set of doors. There is no need to clear the upper wings completely if these creatures can be killed. However, it is very difficult to kill them without killing everything else. L|1|4.|Go back to the top of the main stairway, enter the final set of doors, and kill the «Mu-miyah Slave Master». When you attack him a bunch of guards will spawn but focus on the Slave Master because the guards disappear when the Slave Master dies. The doors to the room close when you attack him, but will open again when he dies. L|1|5.|Use the bookcase in the room on the left to spawn the reward NPC in the room on the right. Note that the NPC does not appear on the radar. L|1|6.|Talk to him for the final reward. L|2|•|⟦NeftetFreeHatsheputWait⟧ L|1|7.|Quickly run (or Portal Recall, which is faster) to the beginning of the dungeon and take the right hallway (East from the entrance) on the first floor. Your first, immediate left is a remote activation door that was previously closed. Now that it's cleared, enter, run down the hall to pick up a «Large Tome» which is part of the «Strathelar Royal Cloak Quest». L|2|•|⟦LargeTome4PickupTimer⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|Once you reach the upstairs area, creatures start dropping the following keys to chests also located on the same floor. The keys also have a repeat timer. L|2|•|«Sandstone Mixed Key» used to unlock the «Mixed Equipment Chest (Sand Temple)¦Mixed Equipment Chest» L|3|•|On key pickup: ⟦SandstoneMixedKeyPickedUp⟧ L|2|•|«Sandstone Armor Key» used to unlock the «Armor Chest (Sand Temple)¦Armor Chest» L|3|•|On key pickup: ⟦SandstoneArmorKeyPickedUp⟧ L|2|•|«Sandstone Weapon Key» used to unlock the «Weapon Chest (Sand Temple)¦Weapon Chest» L|3|•|On key pickup: ⟦SandstoneWeaponKeyPickedUp⟧ L|2|•|«Sandstone Magic Key» used to unlock the «Magic Chest (Sand Temple)¦Magic Chest» L|3|•|On key pickup: ⟦SandstoneMagicKeyPickedUp⟧

H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Nephthys tells you, "The Sand Kings took control of our temple and began enslaving our people inside. Those of us who have managed to stay out of their grasp have not been able to gain access. Our hopes of freeing them have slowly turned to despair." L|1||Nephthys gives you Scrying Rod. L|1||Nephthys tells you, "My research has led me to believe that the Mumiyah have a hidden device somewhere in these cliffs that is blocking our entry." L|1||Nephthys tells you, "I have been working on a Scrying Rod which may allow us to discover the device in hopes of figuring out a way to disable it. Unfortunately, I have yet to be able to locate their device as I fear they move it regularly." L|1||Nephthys tells you, "Please, take this Scrying Rod and see if you can find that device and hopefully bring us one step closer to our freedom."
H3|Rewards Dialog L|1||Nephthys tells you, "The device has been discovered? Excellent. Now I must discover a way to disable it." L|1||Nephthys gives you Mana Forge Key. L|1||You've earned 5,000 Luminance. L|1||You've earned 80,000,000 experience.
L|1||Nephthys tells you, "We have discovered some caves at the western cliffs. I am hoping that there may be something useful in those caves that will allow us to better understand the device or even show us how to disable it." L|1||Nephthys tells you, "If you do discover something that may allow you to disable it do not waste time coming back here. Instead disable the device immediately."
L|1||You allow Mu-miyah Device to examine your Yellow Destabilizing Crystal. L|1||Using both pieces of the destabalizer you manage to interupt the energy field within the device. L|1||You hand over all of your Red Destabilizing Crystals. L|1||You hand over all of your Yellow Destabilizing Crystals. L|1||You hand over all of your Scrying Rods. L|1||You've earned 5,000 Luminance. L|1||You've earned 80,000,000 experience.
L|1||Nephthys tells you, "Excellent work on destabilizing the device. Now we must find a way into the temple." L|1||Nephthys tells you, "We have figured out a way into the temple at last." L|1||Nephthys tells you, "There is no telling what awaits in there. Proceed with extreme caution."
L|1||Hatshepsut tells you, "I am not sure where you came from but I certainly appreciate you freeing me from this place." L|1||Hatshepsut tells you, "Those Mumiyah simply came out of no where without any warning and enslaved so many of my people." L|1||Hatshepsut tells you, "I can't thank you enough." L|1||Hatshepsut gives you Mana Forge Key. L|1||You've earned 5,000 Luminance. L|1||You've earned 80,000,000 experience.
L|1||Hatshepsut tells you, "Thank you for freeing me from this prison. I am truly grateful."
L|1||Nephthys tells you, "Thank you for defeating the Slave Master. Maybe this will be the beginning of peace for our people."

Quest.name: The_Moars
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|73.1S, 81.3E near «Kryst» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to retrieve information for Sho translator «Fanzen San the Translator¦Fanzen San» on the Moarsmen and their ties with the ancient «Falatacot».
L|1|•|The information he needs consists of lore texts that can be obtained from sections of the «Sunken Mere». L|1|•|To reach the sections of the Mere, you must first collect items from all over the «Vesayen Isles» in various «Moarsmen» dungeons and combine them to create the portal gems needed. L|1|•|Alternatively, if you do not want the experience rewards, the items can be combined into other items rewards such as jewelry.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Retrieving the Items L|1|1.|Go to the «Mud Cave» at 73.1S, 81.3E near «Kryst» and retrieve the «Adjanite Gem» and the «Labyrinthine Necklace». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpGemPortalSunkenMereNewbie⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpNecklaceAdjanite⟧ L|1|2.|Go to the «Moarsman Muck» dungeon at 77.0S, 90.9E near «Kryst» and retrieve the «Emerald Clasp». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpEmeraldClasp⟧ L|1|3.|Go to the «Moarsmen Hideout» at 69.9S, 89.9E near «MacNiall's Freehold» and retrieve the «Amethyst Cradle». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpAmethystCradle⟧ L|1|4.|Go to the «Moars Laboratory» at 68.3S, 94.4E near «MacNiall's Freehold» and retrieve the «Aquamarine Prisms». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpAquamarinePrisms⟧ L|1|5.|Go to the «Moarsmen Spawning Grounds» at 69.5S, 96.5E near «MacNiall's Freehold» and retrieve the «Jade Dais». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpJadeDais⟧
H3|Part 2a: Creating the Portal Gems and Retrieving the Tomes H4|Sunken Mere (No Restriction) L|1|1.|The «Adjanite Gem» gives access to a non-restricted dungeon, the «Sunken Mere». L|1|2.|At the end of this dungeon, you will find the «Muddy Tome» L|2|•|⟦PickedUpBookMoarsNewbieUntranslated⟧ L|1|3.|Turn in the tome to «Fanzen San the Translator» for 500,000 xp and «Eating Habits of the Moars».
H4|Sunken Mere (Level 20+) L|1|1.|Combine the «Emerald Clasp» with the «Adjanite Gem» to create a «Decorated Adjanite Gem». L|1|2.|Use the gem to summon a portal to the 20+ section of the «Sunken Mere». L|1|3.|Retrieve the «Hunting Habits of the Moars¦Decaying Tome». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpBookMoarsLowUntranslated⟧ L|1|4.|Turn in the tome to «Fanzen San the Translator» for 1,000,000 xp and «Hunting Habits of the Moars».
H4|Sunken Mere (Level 40+) L|1|1.|Combine the «Amethyst Cradle» with the «Decorated Adjanite Gem» to create a «Entrancing Adjanite Gem». L|1|2.|Use the Gem to be summon a portal to the 40+ section of the «Sunken Mere» L|1|3.|Retrieve the «History of the Moars on Dereth, Part I¦Filthy Tome». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpBookMoarsMidUntranslated⟧ L|1|4.|Turn in the tome to «Fanzen San the Translator» for 4,000,000 xp and «History of the Moars on Dereth, Part I».
H4|Sunken Mere (Level 60+) L|1|1.|Combine the «Aquamarine Prisms» with the «Entrancing Adjanite Gem» to create a «Beholding Adjanite Gem». L|1|2.|Use the Gem to be summon a portal to the 60+ section of the «Sunken Mere» L|1|3.|Retrieve the «History of the Moars on Dereth, Part II¦Rotting Tome». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpBookMoarsHighUntranslated⟧ L|1|4.|Turn in the tome to «Fanzen San the Translator» for 8,000,000 xp and «History of the Moars on Dereth, Part II».
H4|Sunken Mere (Level 80+) L|1|1.|Combine the «Jade Dais» with the «Beholding Adjanite Gem» to create a «Eye of the Depths». L|1|2.|Use the Gem to be summon a portal to the 80+ section of the «Sunken Mere» L|1|3.|Retrieve the «Origin of the Moar¦Blackened Tome». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpBookMoarsExtremeUntranslated⟧ L|1|4.|Turn in the tome to «Fanzen San the Translator» for 15,000,000 xp and «Origin of the Moar».
H3|(Optional) Part 2b: Combining the Pieces into Alternate Rewards H4|«Imbued Adjanite Cameo» L|1|1.|In addition to the items from the dungeon, you will also need an «Excellent Oiled String» and «Mortar and Pestle». L|1|2.|Combine the «Excellent Oiled String» with the «Emerald Clasp» to create an «Adjanite Cameo» necklace. L|1|3.|Use a «Mortar and Pestle» on the Amethyst Cradle to create «Powdered Adjanite Amethyst». L|1|4.|Use the «Powdered Adjanite Amethyst» on the «Adjanite Cameo» necklace to create an «Imbued Adjanite Cameo» necklace.
H4|«Adjanite Crown» L|1|1.|Show «Hiro, Arcanum Artificer» the «Jade Dais», and you will receive an «Etheric Seal». L|1|2.|Combine the «Etheric Seal» with the «Jade Dais» to create an «Adjanite Crown».
H5|«Adjanite Mana Stone» L|1|1.|Show «Fanzen San the Translator» the «Aquamarine Prisms», and you will receive an «Onyx Cutting Tool». L|2|•|⟦ReceivedToolOnyxCutting⟧ L|1|2.|Use the Onyx Cutting Tool on the Aquamarine Prisms to receive 5 «Adjanite Mana Stone»s.
