H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Aun Shimauri tells you, "Wharu take the Hea! They have stolen our precious totems. If you come across any Hea, you may dispatch them with the Aun's blessings. And if you should find one of our totems on them, bring it to me and I shall confide some of our secrets to you.⸩ ⸨Aun Shimauri tells you, "We alone among the Tonk have been blessed by Palenqual. In her wrath against Wharu, she has given us the weapons that live to fight against him. Find one of our totems on the Hea, and I will reward you with the friendship of the Aun.
L|1||Handing in Totems⸩ ⸨You give Aun Shimauri Totem of Volkama⸩ ⸨Aun Shimauri tells you, "Thank you, traveler. You have proven your friendship to the Aun. Now...Curses on the Hea and their thieving ways! If they had not stolen our totems, I would be able to reward you myself. But...I shall have to do second best. Here is a history I have written that explains Palenqual's gift of living weapons to us.⸩ ⸨Aun Shimauri gives you Aun Shimauri's Instructions⸩ ⸨Aun Shimauri tells you, "Furthermore, I shall grant you permission to enter Palenqual's Caverns, where Kerehanua is waiting to help you create one of these weapons for yourself. Kerehanua's a chary old skinflint, so I wouldn't be surprised if he charged you a little bit for his weapons. Don't worry--his heart's in the right place. For now--seek out the visage of Tonkamu on the northern side of Wharu's Ridge, and you will find our hiding place."
L|1||Returning Dialog⸩ ⸨Aun Shimauri tells you, "Good to see you again! You and other adventurers have helped me regain a sufficient number of our totems. From now on, you may keep any more of our totems that you might find on the Hea."
L|1||Repeat totem turn-in⸩ ⸨You give Aun Shimauri Totem of Audetaunga.⸩ ⸨Aun Shimauri gives you Totem of Audetaunga.
L|1||Aun Kerehanua⸩ ⸨Aun Kerehanua tells you, "Sorry about making you come this far...but we can't be giving away our prized secrets to just ANYONE. Besides, if the Hea knew of my whereabouts, they'd kidnap me in a second.⸩ ⸨Aun Kerehanua tells you, "The weapons I sell will only gain their full magical potential once they are fused with one of our sacred triple totems. If you ever create one for yourself, you may wield it with our blessings. Remember always that the Aun have extended their friendship to you.⸩ ⸨Aun Kerehanua tells you, "These caverns have been overrun by vicious beasts and mercenaries since they were given to us. I'm surprised you made it this far.⸩ ⸨Aun Kerehanua tells you, "This is all wrong, friend! You're supposed to come here and buy something from ME! But nonetheless, I'm sure I'll find some use for this...gets awfully boring in here all by myself.⸩ ⸨Aun Kerehanua tells you, "Perfect. I hope you've chosen your totems well--fused with the proper triple totem, this weapon will be a powerful ally to you. And if you've forgotten how to finish its creation, may I suggest that you purchase Aun Shimauri's tome? He's giving them away for free..but I, for one, have my children to think about.⸩ ⸨Aun Kerehanua tells you, "The weapons I sell will only gain their full magical potential once they are fused with one of our sacred triple totems. If you ever create one for yourself, you may wield it with our blessings. Remember always that the Aun have extended their friendship to you.⸩

Quest.name: Putiputipuh's_Onga
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|20 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Hea Mutuona» I|Starts At|47.1N, 90.3W in «Ahurenga» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Help the Tumerok boy Tekapua retreive an onga for his pet grub, putiputi.
P|{TIP} Bring an «Apple» with you before starting to get all stamps in one run.
P|{TIP} The turn in order is important if you want all the stamps.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|{OPT} Speak with «Hea Mutuona», then give him some «Ale» from the local barkeep. He sends you to see «Tekapuapuh» located at 46.4N, 91.5W. L|1|2.|«Tekapuapuh» sends to you the «Secret Putiputi Place» located at 46.3N, 82.1W to get the "Onga" for «Putiputipuh» and gives you «Tekapuapuh's Note». L|2|•|⟦BoyGrubStartedQuest⟧ L|1|3.|{OPT} Give «Putiputipuh» an «Apple» before getting infested. L|2|•|⟦BoyGrubFedWrongApple⟧ - Giving apple may also stamp step 10. L|1|4.|Once inside you must first find the «Olthoi Cistern»s, one of these will contain a «Mysterious Tumerok Artifact» some will contain nothing, and others will trigger spawns. See the maps below to find out which one to use. L|2|•|Tip: The cisterns can be examined, and the ones containing the artifacts will have burden of 9050 and be labeled "Unlocked". L|2|•|⟦BoyGrubTookPah⟧ L|1|5.|When you have your artifact, find the room with the «Glowing Pustule»s, by killing one of these it will open a portal to the next area. Again, only one specific one will open the portal, see the map for clarification. L|1|6.|Do the same thing for the next two dungeons until you have the 2nd and final «Mysterious Tumerok Artifact (handgrip-shaped)¦Mysterious Tumerok Artifact». L|2|•|⟦BoyGrubTookAhna⟧ L|2|•|⟦BoyGrubTookNaq⟧ L|1|7.|Once you're in the fourth and final dungeon, use the cisterns, until you receive a message about an itch on your hand. This message means you're now flagged to feed Putiputipuh later on. These don't have burden for the correct one, and the correct one doesn't seem to be the one mentioned on other wiki's, so just try all of them in that central area. L|2|•|⟦BoyGrubInfested⟧ L|1|8.|From here you can go south to the room with the apples on the floor and pick one up. L|1|9.|Once you have the apple take the "Way Back to Tekapuapuh's" portal in the east room. L|1|10.|{OPT} Hand «Apple» to «Tekapuapuh» L|2|•|⟦BoyGrubFoundApple⟧ - This stamp may fire in Step 3. L|1|11.|Turn in the apple to Putiputipuh. L|2|•|⟦BoyGrubCompletedQuest⟧ L|1|12.|Then the three artifacts to Tekapuapuh for your reward. L|2|•|⟦BoyGrubGavePah⟧ L|2|•|⟦BoyGrubGaveAhna⟧ L|2|•|⟦BoyGrubGotBow⟧

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|130 I|Rec. Level|150 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Branwyn» I|Starts At|29.1N, 57.9E near «Arwic» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Everyone will need an «Amber Gem» for this quest. Amber can be purchased from vendors, such as «Thimrin Woodsetter» in «Candeth Keep». L|1|2.|Run to 73.3N 69.0E, on «Vissidal Island» and kill the Undead on the beach to search for «Offering to Xik Minru¦Offerings to Xik Minru» (you will need one of them to summon the boss). L|2|•|⟦offeringxikminru⟧ L|1|3.|Enter the portal to «Temple of Xik Minru» in the small building. L|1|4.|Hand the piece of amber to the «Causeway Sentinel» to be teleported to the next dungeon. L|1|5.|Jump up onto the ledge on the left. There are small platforms on the side to help. Pull the lever to open the door to the north. L|1|6.|This is a small dungeon with Moarsmen and Niffis. Another lever opens the door. Enter the portal to the next dungeon. L|1|7.|{OPT} Pick up «Geowulf's Journal (Logs 1-2)» on the floor of the room to the left. L|2|•|⟦GeowulfJournal1⟧ L|2|•|«Geowulf's Journal (Logs 3-4)» and «Geowulf's Journal (Logs 5-7)» are found elsewhere in the dungeon. L|3|•|⟦GeowulfJournal2⟧ L|3|•|⟦GeowulfJournal3⟧ L|1|8.|The other three small rooms have levers that open doors to the north. L|1|9.|Everyone pick up «Geowulf's Wedding Ring» in the SW room. L|2|•|⟦geowulfsring⟧ L|1|10.|Continue to the portal that takes you to the boss fight platform (any of the 4 will do). L|1|11.|Hand the «Offering to Xik Minru» to the Shrine of Xik Minru in the center part of the courtyard. to earn 50,000 xp and summon the «High Priestess Xik Minru» L|2|•|Phylactery - ⟦xikminrutrophy32024⟧ L|2|•|Seed - ⟦xikminrutrophy70094!⟧ L|2|•|Gold pile - ⟦xikminrutrophy70095!⟧ L|2|•|Crown coin - ⟦xikminrutrophy70096!⟧ L|2|•|Necklace - ⟦xikminrutrophy70097!⟧ L|2|•|{TIP} She appears to be immune to both fire and acid damage. L|1|12.|Loot the «Unreadable Falatacot Volume» and «Aurulent Key» from the boss. L|2|•|⟦templeofxikminru⟧ L|1|13.|Use the key on «Xik Minru's Reserve» found on the platform and loot some sets of dyes for «Ancient Armor». The reserve also contains some «Loot» items. L|2|•|Note: the 4 Upper Sanctum of Xik Minru portals take you back to the final part of the dungeon. L|1|14.|Go to «Branwyn», south of Arwic at 29.1N 57.9E. L|1|15.|{OPT} Give Branwyn the three parts of Geowulf's Journal for a small amount of experience. L|1|16.|Give Branwyn the ring to get a «Rose Quartz Wedding Ring». L|1|17.|Give the Rose Quartz Wedding Ring to «Roderick» in the «Mite Maze» to get an upgraded ring that is not attuned. L|1|18.|{OPT} Give the «Unreadable Falatacot Volume» to «Fanzen San the Translator» in «Hebian-To» to receive the translated «Book of Xik Minru». L|1|19.|{OPT} Give the Book of Xik Minru to «Sarkin Killcrane» in «Wai Jhou» for a small amount of experience and «Shadow Stalker Title Token».

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Branwyn tells you, "Please, bold one! Would you help me find my husband Geowulf the Stonehearted? It has been weeks since he left and I am worried something awful may have happened to him!"⸩ ⸨Branwyn tells you, "I am sorry. I should know to behave better in front of those who would help me."⸩ ⸨Branwyn tells you, "One morning, Geowulf and I had an argument, over some silly little thing now that I think upon it. He wanted to move closer to Glenden Wood to be near his ailing father. I love Geowulf's father dearly, but Arwic has been so profitable for my small floral business that I couldn't fathom leaving. I suppose I could commute, but at the time the thought didn't even enter my mind."⸩ ⸨Branwyn sniffles slightly and sounds as if she is on the verge of breaking into tears once again.⸩ ⸨Branwyn tells you, "We... we fought, and he grew angry and left. On his way he took his hiking pack and canteen and I have not seen him since."⸩ ⸨Branwyn tells you, "He would at times hike along the western reach he's of the Lost Wish range, and he always made certain to stop along the northern coast to take in the ocean view. I couldn't stand the hike, but I would often meet him at the Haliana settlement and we would walk the beach together."⸩ ⸨Branwyn fights back another surge of tears and continues with her story.⸩ ⸨Branwyn tells you, "I ... just I... oh Geowulf!"⸩ ⸨Branwyn tells you, "Please find my husband! Start your search along the northern coast near that settlement I told you of. Please find him, bring me good news of my beloved!"
L|1||Causeway Sentinel⸩ ⸨The ancient golem turns towards you and makes a menacing grinding noise. As you flinch back, the golem leans forward slightly. You can feel it working its way into your mind.⸩ ⸨Causeway Sentinel tells you, "... am entity who protect way to mistress."⸩ ⸨Causeway Sentinel tells you, "... seek you offering for mistress. Entity will grant way for proper giving."⸩ ⸨The golem wavers slightly, you can tell the magic used to forge it has weakened.⸩ ⸨Causeway Sentinel tells you, "... bring you the pitch of age-ed forest ... bring you the stone of night... bring you the gem of sacrifice..."⸩ ⸨Causeway Sentinel tells you, "... bring one or no grant flight."⸩ ⸨With that, the barnacled golem slumps back down upon the ground and returns to its slumber.⸩ ⸨Causeway Sentinel tells you, "... sleep..."
L|1||Handing in Amber to Causeway Sentinel⸩ ⸨You give Causeway Sentinel Amber.⸩ ⸨The ancient golem turns towards you and makes a menacing grinding noise. As you flinch back, the golem leans forward slightly. You can feel it working its way into your mind.⸩ ⸨Causeway Sentinel tells you, "... trespass not upon work of mistress...⸩ ⸨Causeway Sentinel tells you, "... or face most horrible wrath...⸩ ⸨The golem rumbles loudly at you once again and a surge of planar energy wells around you.⸩ ⸨Causeway Sentinel teleports you with Cataracts of Xik Minru.
L|1||Handing in Geowulf's Wedding Ring to Branwyn⸩ ⸨You give Branwyn Geowulf's Wedding Ring.⸩ ⸨Branwyn tells you, "Ah, my love, I am slain as well."⸩ ⸨Branwyn slips her husband's wedding band upon her finger and places her own gently in your palm.⸩ ⸨Branwyn gives you Rose Quartz Wedding Ring.⸩ ⸨Branwyn tells you, "Take it, I can wear it no longer."

L|2|•|⟦capplewine⟧ L|1|4.|Go to the Drudge Hovel and open the «Wine Cellar Door» with the key Lubziklan gave you, and work your way down to the end of the dungeon. L|1|5.|Loot the «Glorious Apple» and the «Cove Apple Wine» out of the «Wine Chest» near the exit portal. L|2|•|⟦coveapplewine⟧ L|1|6.|Return to Lubziklan and give him the Apple and the Wine. H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Ydnew will direct you to a «Burun Fortress» at 25.8S, 46.3E, to see if you can find explanation for the rise of Burun and Renegade activity. L|1|2.|Make your way to the «Burun Fortress» south of «Yanshi». L|2|•|Route: From Yanshi head to the «Swamp Temple Place» settlement portal at 10.3S 45.7E and then run to the fortress at 25.8S, 46.3E. L|1|3.|Pick up «Blueprints for a Burun Fortress» at 25.8S, 46.2E. L|2|•|In order to access the «Hidden Entrance» dungeon later on, you need to go to the fortress and pick up some «Blueprints for a Burun Fortress». Two «A Missive»s can be found in the same area as well. L|2|•|⟦BlueprintsBurunFort⟧ L|1|4.|Once you have the blueprints, go to the «Hidden Entrance» dungeon at 24.3S, 46.3E. You cannot use the portal, you have to run through the rock to go in. L|1|5.|At the end of the dungeon is the portal to another dungeon (and another at the end of that one, etc.). L|1|6.|Work your way through all of the dungeons, collecting all 11 Reports to Niarltah on the way - you need to be level 80 to get into the final dungeon. There are two notes in the initial entrance and underways dungeons, four in the tunnels and three in the final halls dungeon. Further, I am here to see that we keep close attention on the movements of the Burun and their new allies, the Renegades."⸩ ⸨Ydnew tells you, "The events of the past few months has brought a great deal of consternation into the High Queen's court. Since Rage Lao mistakenly opened the first portals from the world that these creatures came from, we have wondered what they were. We still know very little, but we are confident that we will learn more about them soon."⸩ ⸨Ydnew tells you, "In the past few weeks, we have seen a rise in Renegade and Burun activity near the old swamp temple near 25s and 46e."⸩ ⸨Ydnew tells you, "I have been given leave to reward adventurers who assist us in finding out as much information as they can about the new relationship that the Renegades have forged with these Burun. Please use caution when approaching the temple. We know that they have enclosed the structure and are busy working toward some other nefarious end as we speak."⸩ ⸨Ydnew tells you, "If you begin to become overwhelmed, please retreat. Quest.name: Clutch_of_Kings_(Reeshan)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Guard Ellyon» I|Starts At|Cragstone 25.7N, 48.8E I|Route|«Mansion» to «Portal to Izji Qo's Temple» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Clutch of Kings: Reeshan» H2|Overview L|1|•|{WARN}: Talk to the Cragstone NPCs before running this a 2nd time, or you won't be able to pick up the hide at the end. L|1|•|This is the first of six quests in the «Clutch of Kings» series. L|1|•|Frost weapons are recommended. L|1|•|Having melee/ranged weapons users against the final boss is strongly recommended. Boss is highly resistant to magic.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Depth's of Izji Qo's Temple L|1|1.|Speak to the «Watcher of the Dead» to be portaled into the «Depth's of Izji Qo's Temple». L|1|2.|From the drop, jump down and take the East exit. From here, hug the wall left for the rest of the dungeon, with the only obstacles being two lever activated doors: L|2|1.|In the first large room you come to, you'll need to open the Southwest door, which is activated by a floor plate, inside the Western most head of a statue in the Southwest part of the room. L|2|2.|In the second large room you come to, open the Southeast door by entering the room on the East wall and pulling the lever inside. The entrance to the East room is activated by floor plates on either side of the door. L|1|3.|When you reach the end of the dungeon, use the Portal Gateway to be sent to the «Secrets of Izji Qo's Temple».
H3|Part 2: Secrets of Izji Qo's Temple L|1|1.|From the portal drop, head north and use the «Instructions (Sign)», located on the East wall. You will obtain three sets of marbles: «Mixed Marbles», «White Marbles» and «Black Marbles». L|2|•|⟦BagPuzzleCanGetHintMarble⟧ L|2|•|⟦BagPuzzlePickBagVariant1⟧ or ⟦BagPuzzlePickBagVariant2⟧ L|1|2.|Once you have your marbles, go to the West wall and speak with the «Bag labeled "Mixed"», you'll get either a black or white marble (clue): L|2||Example: "You reach into the bag and pull out a black marble." L|1|3.|Now, depending on the marble you received in your clue, you'll need to hand the marbles in your pack to the appropriate bags: L|2|•|**Black** marbles: Hand your «Black Marbles» to the «Bag labeled "Mixed"», «Mixed Marbles» to the «Bag labeled "White"», and your «White Marbles» to the «Bag labeled "Black"». L|2|•|**White** marbles: Hand your «White Marbles» to the «Bag labeled "Mixed"», «Black Marbles» to the «Bag labeled "White"», and your «Mixed Marbles» to the «Bag labeled "Black"». L|2|•|⟦BagPuzzleMixedBagCorrect⟧ L|2|•|⟦BagPuzzleWhiteBagCorrect⟧ L|2|•|⟦BagPuzzleBlackBagCorrect⟧ L|2|•|⟦BagPuzzleSolved⟧ L|1|4.|If you've done the task correctly, you'll receive a success message: "You have successfully determined the contents of all three bags!" L|2|•|Note: If you fail, speak to the «Instructions (Sign)¦Instructions» sign, and attempt the puzzle again. L|2|•|⟦BagPuzzleFailed⟧ L|1|5.|Once complete, use the portal in the North wall to be portaled into «Izji Qo's Temple».
H3|Part 3: Izji Qo's Temple L|1|1.|From the drop, head East and hug the left wall all the way to the end, there are no levers are misdirections in here. L|1|2.|At the end, you'll find a hallway on the West wall, which leads to a «Portal Gateway». The device leads to «Reeshan», the boss. L|1|3.|Before using the device, there are several things to know before going into the fight with Reeshan, review these tactics: L|2|•|Do not debuff him, he counters most debuffs. L|2|•|Disband your fellowship before going into battle. Browerk casts Fellowship Debuffs, so you lessen the chance to be debuffed when not in a fellowship. L|2|•|If you are swallowed (portaled into Reeshan's stomach), quickly switch to a «Critical Strike» weapon, and attack his «Stomach Wall» on full speed. You have only have a percent chance of escaping his stomach when you land a critical hit. L|3|•|{TIP} If you're a mage, use wall spells for a greater chance to critical hit. L|1|4.|Once everyone is ready, use the Portal Gateway to be porataled into the «Center of Izji Qo's Temple» (hot drop).
H3|Part 4: Center of Izji Qo's Temple L|1|1.|When you portal in, you'll immediately be attacked by Burun, and «Reeshan» is just to the North. L|1|2.|Kill Reeshan using frost weapons/bows and «Tusker Fists» or Frost Wall. L|2|•|Note: Do not debuff Reeshan, he will counter. See above for tactics. L|1|3.|Once you kill Reeshan, loot «Reeshan's Hide» from the floor. L|2|•|⟦ReeshanBeaten⟧ L|1|4.|Head to «Cragstone», and speak to «Guard Ellyon» at 25.7N, 48.8E for your XP, «Mana Forge Key» (125+), and random reward. L|2|•|⟦ReeshanComplete⟧ L|2|•|⟦ReeshanKilled⟧ L|1|5.|{OPT} Hand Reeshan's Hide to Guard Ellyon for the title of Reeshan Killer. L|2|•|Note: Hold on to the hide if you are trying to obtain the Kingslayer title. See the «Clutch of Kings» for more information.
H2|Dungeons & Maps

H2|Rewards
R|Defeat Reeshan and speak to Guard Ellyon RK|Experience|56,184,660 (30% up to level 130) RK|Items| RI|One of the following random rewards: RI|Experience: 50,000,000 (15% chance) RI|«Black Spawn Den Portal Device» (17% chance) RI|«Gem of Perfect Health» (17% chance) RI|«Salvaged Fire Opal (Quest)¦Salvaged Fire Opal» (17% chance) RI|«Salvaged Imperial Topaz (Quest)¦Salvaged Imperial Topaz» (17% chance) RI|«Salvaged Steel (Quest)¦Salvaged Steel» (17% chance) Level 125+ reward RI|«Mana Forge Key» RE
R|Give Reeshan's Hide to Guard Ellyon RK|Title|Reeshan Killer RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Guard Ellyon, Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Guard Ellyon tells you, "You have not recently beaten King Reeshan, return to me when you have accomplished this feat."
L|1||Watcher of the Dead, Opening Dialog (below level req)⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "You are too frail to aid me in this creature. Return when your bones are equal to that of sixty."
L|1||Watcher of the Dead, Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "My purpose is plain, I watch the dead that reside within the halls of this temple. I have stood this vigil since my sacrifice over thirty thousand years ago, when the world cooled and the darkness made war upon all. The weight of time has long crushed my bones to dust and left with me with this incorporeal form. Yet, I serve my purpose with the same vigor that I did in life."⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "A threat, not of this world grows within the belly of this temple. They have come from across the stars, across the divide between our worlds with one thought in their ravenous minds; destruction."⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "Their pilgrimage is for naught, there are no sisters left upon this world who draw breath, there are none who recall the glory of Golden Shores and the valley wherein Ualannan once held vigil watching over all our sisters. All is dust, but this will not deter these beasts from another world."⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "They come and they shall spread their rot to the core of this world and there it shall grow unfettered until all is consumed and destroyed. You must destroy the beasts within the deepest halls of the Izji Qo's temple. They have found passage within and slaughtered or consumed all souls that have stood against their trespass."⸩ ⸨⸨Watcher of the Dead teleports you with Depth's of Izji Qo's Temple.⸩
L|1||Using the Portal Device inside the Depth's of Izji Qo's Temple⸩ ⸨A violent hum sounds in your head and you are drawn unceremoniously into portal space.⸩ ⸨⸨Portal Gateway teleports you with Secrets of Izji Qo's Temple.⸩
L|1||Using the Instructions sign inside the Secrets of Izji Qo's Temple⸩ ⸨The sign reads: Before you are three bags which contain white marbles, black marbles or a mixture of the two. You need to place the marbles that have been given to you in the bag with the same type of marbles inside. However, all of the bags are mislabeled. You may pick one marble out of one bag to help determine which marbles go in which bags. Use this sign again to start over.⸩ ⸨Instructions gives you Mixed Marbles.⸩ ⸨Instructions gives you White Marbles.⸩ ⸨Instructions gives you Black Marbles.
L|1||Using the Bag labeled "Mixed"⸩ ⸨You reach into the bag and pull out a black marble. L|1||or⸩ ⸨You reach into the bag and pull out a white marble.
L|1||Using the Bag labeled "Black" or Bag labeled "White"⸩ ⸨You cannot get your hand into the bag.
L|1||Completing the puzzle⸩ ⸨You have successfully determined the contents of all three bags!
L|1||Using the Instructions sign after completing the puzzle⸩ ⸨You have already solved this puzzle.
L|1||Using the Portal Device inside Izji Qo's Temple⸩ ⸨A violent hum sounds in your head and you are drawn unceremoniously into portal space.⸩ ⸨⸨Portal Gateway teleports you with Center of Izji Qo's Temple.⸩
L|1||Defeating Reeshan⸩ ⸨ has struck a deadly blow to Reeshan! As the behemoth falls to the ground lifeless, several bits of his flesh fall to the ground.
L|1||Guard Ellyon, Reward Dialog⸩ ⸨You've earned 56,184,660 experience.⸩ ⸨Guard Ellyon tells you, "This is for your efforts against the Burun Kukuur, King Reeshan. You will need to wait a day before returning to me for another reward. If you wish to change your title and you have a scrap of Reeshan's hide I will accept the hide and name you to Reeshan Killer!"⸩ ⸨Guard Ellyon gives you .⸩ ⸨Guard Ellyon tells you, "I am now authorized to reward more experienced adventurers with mana forge keys and you qualify. Best of luck to you."⸩ ⸨Guard Ellyon gives you Mana Forge Key.
L|1||Guard Ellyon, Post-Reward Dialog⸩ ⸨Guard Ellyon tells you, "I have given you a reward for your recent victory over the Burun Kukuur, King Reeshan. Please wait a day before returning to me for your reward. If you wish to change your title and you have a scrap of Reeshan's hide I will accept the hide and name you to Reeshan Killer!"
L|1||Guard Ellyon, Hide Dialog⸩ ⸨You give Guard Ellyon Reeshan's Hide.⸩ ⸨Let it be known that has faced and defeated Reeshan! Let it be known that from this day forth shall be known as Reeshan Killer! Huzzah! Huzzah! Huzzah!
L|1||Watcher of the Dead Dialog, After Defeat⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "My purpose is plain, I watch the dead that reside within the halls of this temple. I have stood this vigil since my sacrifice over thirty thousand years ago, when the world cooled and the darkness made war upon all. There is no threat to the inhabitants within. Your service is not needed."⸩

Quest.name: Crystalline_Markers
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|70 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Jyotsana» I|Starts At|«Crystalline Crag» at 14.6S, 62.0W I|Repeat|Non Repeatable I|Contracts|«Contract for Crystalline Markers» H2|Overview P|Explorer the Crystalline Crag and find the Crystal Markers.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Jyotsana». L|2|•|⟦CrystallineMarkerStart⟧ L|1|2.|Using First Crystal: L|2|•|⟦CrystallineMarkersFound⟧ L|2|•|⟦CrystallineMarkerCounter0109⟧
H3|Level 70+ Section L|1|1.|After speaking with «Jyotsana», go to the beginning of the floating platforms that extend from the side of the Plateau at 15.8S, 61.9W. L|1|2.|Jump from platform to platform until you reach the hilltop where the 1st «Crystal (Marker)» resides. Double click the crystal to record it. L|2|•|{WARN} Only the parts of platforms that fade in and out are solid. The parts that never fade are ethereal and you will fall through them. L|2|•|See the «Crystalline Bound Wisp» for jumping tips. L|1|3.|Keep going across the platforms and use the «Bound Wisp» for a free ride back to the Plateau, or jump down and use the «Resonant Portal» to get back to the Plateau. L|1|4.|From the drop run to the «Crystalline Portal» dungeon - it is at the opposite end of the Plateau at 17.0S, 61.2W. L|1|5.|The last 4 «Crystal (Marker)»s are in this dungeon. There are a ton of Wisps that will block your progress. High «Magic Defense» will help, as well as a «Magic Absorbing» item. L|1|6.|Run through the dungeon and keep going down. There are some pits you have to jump down on the way. You will find the Crystal markers throughout the dungeon. L|2|•|2: Center of top level L|2|•|3: Center of middle level L|2|•|4: Center of bottom level L|2|•|5: South side of 2nd level L|1|7.|Once you have used all 5 «Crystal (Marker)»s, you can return to «Jyotsana» for a reward. L|2|•|⟦CrystallineMarker5x⟧
H3|Level 90+ Section L|1|1.|At the bottom of the 70+ dungeon is a pit with the 5th Marker Crystal where there's another Crystalline Portal that is restricted to levels 90+. There are five more Marker Crystals in this dungeon (6th to 10th). L|1|2.|Run through the dungeon and use each of the 5 crystals (see map below for clarification): L|2|•|**6:** As you start running down the hallways, the first big room on your left has the first Marker on the ledge to your left on the top level. L|2|•|**7:** Keep heading down until you reach a second, smaller room with 4 exits. Take the south exit and follow the hallway to the east to a large room. At the end of the large 'U' shape is the Marker. L|2|•|**8:** Head back to the small room with 4 exits. Take the east one and take your first available left turn. In the large room you get to, jump down one level to the west, then one level to the south, then jump to the northwest to reach the platform with the Marker. L|2|•|**9:** Jump back to the platform to the southeast, then jump down to the east. The Marker is just northwest. L|2|•|**10:** Continue through the dungeon to the end. Next to the portal to the next dungeon will be the final Marker. L|1|3.|Once you have used all 5 «Crystal (Marker)»s, you can return to «Jyotsana» for a reward. L|2|•|⟦CrystallineMarker10x⟧
H3|Level 110+ Section L|1|1.|At the bottom of the 90+ dungeon is a pit with the 10th Marker Crystal where there's another Crystalline Portal that is restricted to levels 110+. There are five more Marker Crystals in this dungeon (11th to 15th). L|1|2.|You can find the markers easiest in the order of their numbers. The dungeon can be confusing so use the map to get a better idea of layout but these directions will get you through. L|2|•|**11:** Exit Northwest from the drop room. Stay right till you go up a ramp. Once at the top of the ramp stay left till you reach the marker. L|2|•|**12:**From 11 jump back into the drop room. Exit through the south passage in the Southwest corner of the room. Stick to your left and you will go up a ramp then down back into the lava. Take the first left and then stay to your right until you reach the marker. L|2|•|**13:** From 12 stick to your right. You will come to a point where you will go down into the lava tubes then very quickly back up. After that happens you will see a loop in the hallway. After you pass the loop you must start going left. Take the second passage you see on your left and follow it to the marker. L|2|•|**14:** From 13 take the first passage on your right. Then keep to your left until you reach a large open area. Once in the open area stick to your right until you come to the marker. L|2|•|**15:** From 14 stick to your right until you come to a large room that appears to be a dead end. There in a ramp in the middle of the floor concealed by the lava. You have to feel it out. Go down until you find the marker. L|1|3.|Once you have used all 5 «Crystal (Marker)»s, you can return to «Jyotsana» for a reward. L|2|•|⟦CrystallineMarker15x⟧
H3|Level 130+ Section L|1|1.|From the 110+ Section, there is a portal near the 15th Marker to the «Crystalline Adventurer¦Progenitors' Lair» L|2|•|**16** Can be found in the room with the «Shade of Ja'qu» L|2|•|**17** can be found in the room with the cold wisps (open with the lever in front of the whirling portal-like door) L|2|•|**18** is in a room with Ancient Golems in the Frost/Lightning Wisp section (opposite the ramp to the large room) L|2|•|**19** is in the large room with the Fire and Acid Wisps L|2|•|**20** Is in a small room on your way out to the crater (See «Crystalline Adventurer¦Progenitors' Lair» on how to access it) L|2|•|You can exit to the crater at 15.2S, 65.1W, which is outdoors and can't be accessed any other way. L|1|2.|Once you have used all 5 «Crystal (Marker)»s return to «Jyotsana» for a reward. L|2|•|⟦CrystallineMarker20x⟧
H3|Facility L|1|1.|From the 130+ section go outside into the Crater L|1|2.|Enter the «Facility» dungeon at 15.7S, 65.3W (no portal) L|2|•|**21** you can find from going down: first intersection left, second intersection left, close to the Eastern Facility Door. L|1|3.|There are four locked doors, with the Northern, the Eastern, the Western and the Southern Facility. The dungeon is 4-way symmetrical, and the route through the Eastern also describes the one through the other parts. L|1|4.|The «Eastern Gate Key» can be found near a corpse in front of the door to the Eastern Gate Facility. L|1|5.|Enter the Eastern Facility, use a lever to get into a room with «Ancient Golem»s and a ramp in the floor heading down. L|1|6.|Jump into the pit at the bottom of the ramp, and through the hallway to a door to a room with «Ancient Golem»s L|1|7.|Use the «Essence Lock» in the room with the «Ancient Golem»s to obtain the «Southern Gate Key». L|1|8.|Use the lever in the room with the Essence Lock to get to a jump down of several levels. L|1|9.|At the bottom, there is a portal back to the entrance of the Facility (50+, can be recalled but not summoned) L|1|10.|Open the door to the Southern Facility L|2|•|**22** is at the bottom of the first pit in the Southern Facility L|1|11.|Use the «Essence Lock» in the room with «Ancient Golem»s to obtain the «Western Gate Key». L|2|•|**23** is in the room with the «Essence Lock» in the Western Facility L|1|12.|Use the «Essence Lock» in the room with «Ancient Golem»s to obtain the «Northern Gate Key». L|2|•|**24** is in the first big room in the Northern Facility, near where the «Ancient Golem»s spawn L|1|13.|Use the «Essence Lock» in the room with «Ancient Golem»s to unlock the last Essence L|2|•|**25** is at the bottom of the dungeon, near the portal back to the «Facility» Entrance L|1|14.|{OPT} Kill the «Crystalline Essence Array» and loot a «Crystalline Array Fragment». (See «Crystalline Adventurer») L|1|15.|Once you have used all 5 «Crystal (Marker)»s, return to «Jyotsana» for a reward. L|2|•|⟦CrystallineMarker25x⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|The markers have specific numbers assigned to them. So if you happen to enter the dungeon and use the 5th Marker first it will say you've found the 5th marker even if its the first one you found. This makes it hard to remember how many you have left.

H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Jyotsana tells you, "I've found a variety of markers in this area and the ground under it. If you find these markers you can return to me and I will reward you for every five you discover."
H3|Speaking with Jyotsana after finding all 25 Markers L|1||Jyotsana tells you, "You've discovered enough crystals to earn a reward. Good work." L|1||Jyotsana gives you Reinforced Mana Forge Key. L|1||You've earned 200,000,000 experience. L|1||Jyotsana tells you, "You have not discovered enough new markers since we last talked. Please return to me when you have found more markers."

Quest.name: Guardians_of_Mhoire_Castle
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|125 I|Type|Small Fellowship I|Starts At|«Graveyard» at 66.5S, 44.7W I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest must be completed before you can access the «Castle of Lord Mhoire Quest».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Use the «Ancient Stones» in the «Burning Wood» at 66.5S, 44.7W to get a «Strange Jewel» and «Ancient Journal». L|2|•|⟦MhoireCastleFlagStarted⟧ L|2|•|Note: The journal can be translated by «Kuyiza» in «Zaikhal» for «Translated Tomb Writings». L|1|2.|The «Strange Jewel» must be used in 3 locations in the Graveyard to spawn bosses that must be killed to collect 3 candle items. L|2|•|Each boss spawns along with some accompanying minions. The minions respawn very quickly, so it is best to focus on attacking the boss. L|2|•|It is easier to do the flagging during the daytime so having to fight fewer monsters. L|2|•|Since there is no precise location mark, you will have to move step by step over the indicated sector using the gem repeatedly (3 seconds cooldown) until you find each exact spawn spot. L|1|3.|Use «Strange Jewel» to spawn «Lord Hendrel». Location is inside the rounded burnt soil sector at 66.6S 45.2W. L|2|•|Lord Hendrel is similar to a «Wight Blade Sorcerer» and spawns with several «Wight»s. L|1|4.|Defeat Lord Hendrel and loot «Lord Hendrel's Brand». L|2|•|⟦MhoireBrand1Pickup⟧ L|1|5.|Use «Strange Jewel» at 65.0S 44.2W (inside the southwest bunker of the five bunkers near the GY Colo building) to spawn «Lady Saliane» right there. L|2|•|«Lady Saliane» is similar to a «Spectral Dread». She spawns with several «Corrupted Grave Frost»s, which have low HP but are very dangerous when you are cold vuln'd. L|1|6.|Defeat Lady Saliane and loot «Lady Saliane's Brand». L|2|•|⟦MhoireBrand2Pickup⟧ L|1|7.|Use «Strange Jewel» on the far edge of the Graveyard, inside the rounded burnt soil sector at 65.1S 45.5W, to spawn «Lord Trimere». L|2|•|Lord Trimere is similar to a «Pyre Champion» and spawns with several «Pyre Minion»s. L|1|8.|Defeat Lord Trimere and loot «Lord Trimere's Brand». L|2|•|⟦MhoireBrand3Pickup⟧ L|1|9.|One by one, each person should hand all three items to the left (west) gargoyle statue at 64.6S 44.1W. L|2|•|First: ⟦MhoireCastleFlagCounter⟧ and ⟦MhoireBrand1⟧ L|2|•|Second: ⟦MhoireBrand2⟧ L|2|•|Third: ⟦MhoireCastleFlagWait⟧ and ⟦MhoireCastleGotAccess⟧ L|2|•|The gargoyle to the right (east) is the one used for the «Lord Mhoire Quest» and will not accept the items. L|1|10.|A blue portal will briefly open behind the statue. If you've handed all three items in, enter the portal to begin the «Castle of Lord Mhoire Quest». L|2|•|Note: This is a permanent flag, anytime in the future you can use the statue to reopen the portal.
P|Notes L|1|•|When repeating the candles, you must use the Ancient Stones again, if you haven't, you will get the following message when you try to hand a candle in (you can use after getting the candles if you forget): L|1|•|From the «Gaining Ground» event until «Retributions», the portal transported you to the Mhoire Castle courtyard which floated in the sky. However, as part of the «Retributions» event, the courtyard fell and was destroyed on the hills below.
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.
H2|Rewards
R| RK|Experience|100,000,000 (Fixed% up to level ) RK|Items| RI|«Ancient Mhoire Coin» RE
H2|Dialog H3|Using Ancient Stones L|1||Buried under these ancient stones is a stone box. Once sealed, recent tremors have cracked the seal. In the ruined box you find two items of interest. L|1||Ancient Stones gives you Ancient Journal. L|1||Ancient Stones gives you Strange Jewel.
H3|Giving Ancient Journal to Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator L|1||You give Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator Ancient Journal. L|1||Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "This journal is written in the runic script of old Dericost, a language not used in well over 5000 years. A moment - I shall transcribe a copy for you into Roulean." L|1||Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator gives you Translated Tomb Writings. L|1||Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "There you are. This sounds to me like more lore from that ancient graveyard. Did you find anything with this journal? Perhaps they are related."
H3|Handing the Brands and Using the Spawned Portal L|1||You allow Guardian Statue to examine your Lady Saliane's Brand. L|1||As the brand flares with blue flame, so do the eyes of the statue. The blue flame burns part of a mark onto your flesh. L|1||You hand over all of your Lady Saliane's Brands.
L|1||You allow Guardian Statue to examine your Lord Hendrel's Brand. L|1||As the brand flares with blue flame, so do the eyes of the statue. The blue flame burns a second part of a mark onto your flesh. L|1||You hand over all of your Lord Hendrel's Brands.
L|1||You allow Guardian Statue to examine your Lord Trimere's Brand. L|1||As the brand flares with blue flame, so do the eyes of the statue. The blue flame burns a third part of a mark onto your flesh, completing the Defender's Mark of House Mhoire. L|1||You hand over all of your Lord Trimere's Brands.
L|1||You've earned 100,000,000 experience. L|1||The gorgoyle drops a coin from its mouth!
L|1||The Defender's Mark of House Mhoire burns with blue flame and you are transported to Mhoire Castle.
L|1||The Defender's Mark of House Mhoire burns with blue flame and you are transported to the Northeast Tower of Mhoire Castle.
H3|Other Interactions H4|Level requirement L|1||Being less that level 125, you are chased off before you can dig around these ancient stones.
H4|Giving brands without first using the Ancient Stones L|1||You allow Guardian Statue to examine your Lady Saliane's Brand. L|1||You hold the brand expectantly up to the statue, but nothing happens. L|1||You suspect that the magic only works for those who start at the beginning.
H4|Giving the incorrect Brands L|1||You allow Guardian Statue to examine your Lord Trimere's Brand. L|1||The brand briefly flickers with blue flame, but nothing else happens. L|1||You allow Guardian Statue to examine your Lord Hendrel's Brand. L|1||The brand briefly flickers with blue flame, but nothing else happens.

Quest.name: Hieromancer's_Armor
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Zairente Ra-Yao» I|Starts At|«Linvak Mountains» (random spawn) I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|The armor from this quest may be further upgraded via the «Halls of Knorr» quest. L|1|•|This quest requires some lever pulling, but the doors stay open long enough for a single person to complete it.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Obtain Supplies L|1|1.|Locate the randomly appearing wilderness vendors, or obtain their items from other players. L|2|•|«Zairente Ra-Yao» - Sells «Peculiar Old Dagger», a required item. L|2|•|{OPT} «Hasina bint Rira» - Sells «Puzzle Box (Hieromancer's Armor)¦Puzzle Box». Used to obtain the «Decoded Untranslated Text». L|2|•|{OPT} «Spertat the Ursuin Hunter» - Sells «Unreadable Text». Used to obtain the Decoded Untranslated Text. L|1|2.|Obtain a «Vial of Organic Acid», a low drop rate trophy from various «Grievver»s, including «Virulent Grievver»s, «Venomous Grievver»s, «Bile Grievver»s, «Bane Grievver»s and «Harrower Grievver»s L|2|•|Note: The «Cave of the Escaped Thief» at 71.1N, 50.2W (landscape, no level requirement) from the «Sword of Bellenesse» quest is ideal for quickly hunting down a «Vial of Organic Acid», as it is populated by numerous high-level Grievvers on a quick spawn. L|2|•|⟦Feb01CLQuest5⟧ L|1|3.|Use the acid on the dagger to obtain the «Glittering Crystalline Key». L|1|4.|Locate a «Humming Crystal Portal», which spawns randomly in certain wilderness areas like the Direlands and Linvak Mountain Range. The portal is tiable, though not summonable, so if you chance across it before you have the acid or dagger you can save the tie. L|1|5.|At the «Humming Crystal», use the Glittering Crystalline Key on the «Strange Humming Crystal» to obtain the «Lyceum Recall Gem».
P|The following steps can be done in either order, and there are advantages to each. L|1||**Advantages of going to the Hieromancer Halls first:** L|2|•|If you are already at the Humming Crystal, the exit portals will bring you very close to the Halls. L|2|•|If you want the «Globe of Auberean», made from the «Blue Orb», you must obtain the blue orb in the Halls before heading to the Lyceum. L|1||**Advantage of going to the Lyceum first:** L|2|•|If you want to experiment with the color of your armor, or are unsure of your success rate, it is better to obtain the unkindled armor first and then go to the Halls, where you can pick up as many kindling stones as you need.
H3|Part 2: Hieromancer's Halls L|1|1.|While still at the «Humming Crystal», tie to or use the «Exit Portal (Humming Crystal)¦Exit Portal». It drops close to the «Hieromancers' Halls» L|1|2.|Enter the Halls. Follow the map to reach the «Silver Kindling Stone», «Sea Blue Kindling Stone» and «Sea Grey Kindling Stone». L|1|3.|Obtain the Kindling stones you need. It takes about 25 seconds for the stone to respawn. Color is purely for style and has no effect on the stats or spells on the finished armor. If you want Thaumaturgic Plate Armor - armor for trained War Magic - you need 1 stone per piece of armor. If you want Exarch Plate Armor - armor for specialized War Magic - you need 2 stones per piece of armor. L|1|4.|{OPT} After obtaining your kindling stones, head deeper in to obtain the «Blue Orb».
H3|Part 3: Ishilai Lyceum L|1|1.|Use the Lyceum Recall Gem to send yourself to the «Ishilai Lyceum». L|1|2.|Take the «Slip of Paper» and present it to «Eaushi the Trainer». It will teleport you into the «Lyceum Training Grounds». L|1|3.|Take the west hallway for the easiest difficulty test. Kill the «Tenuous Nephol Golem» and loot the «Small Pale Crystal». You may have to kill several golems before obtaining a crystal. Take the exit portal. L|1|4.|Re-enter the Training Grounds. Take the north hallway for the middle difficulty test. Kill the «Diaphanous Nephol Golem» and loot the «Pale Crystal». You may have to kill several golems before obtaining a crystal. Take the exit portal. L|1|5.|Re-enter the Training Grounds. Take the east hallway for the hardest difficulty test. Kill the «Turbid Nephol Golem» and loot the «Large Pale Crystal». You may have to kill several golems before obtaining a crystal. Take the exit portal. L|1|6.|Present the three crystals to Eaushi the Trainer to receive «Unkindled Thaumaturgic Plate Coat», «Unkindled Thaumaturgic Plate Girth» and «Unkindled Thaumaturgic Plate Leggings». L|2|•|Small Pale: ⟦Feb01CLQuest1⟧ L|2|•|Pale: ⟦Feb01CLQuest2⟧ L|2|•|Large Pale: ⟦Feb01CLQuest3⟧ L|1|7.|{OPT} While at the Lyceum, complete any of the following tasks. L|2|•|Kill a «Guardian Golem». Loot the «Trunk Key» from its corpse. Unlock the «Trunk» to obtain «Sasalia's Dress». L|3|•|⟦Feb01CLQuest11⟧ L|2|•|Head out of the castle and to the upper building and obtain the «Lightweight Tome», found in the basement library. L|3|•|⟦Feb01CLQuest6⟧ L|2|•|If you obtained a Blue Orb in the Hieromancer's Halls, give it to Eaushi the Trainer to obtain the «Globe of Auberean». L|3|•|⟦Feb01CLQuest8⟧ L|2|•|Enter the Lyceum Training Grounds. Kill the golems until one drops a «Sunstone Geode». Give it to Eaushi the Trainer to obtain the «Hieromancer's Orb». L|3|•|Sunstone Pick Up: ⟦Feb01CLQuest4⟧ L|2|•|Enter the Lyceum Training Grounds. With Lockpick, unlock the 350 resistance chest and loot «A Boot» and «Another Boot». Combine to create the «Boots of the Vault». L|3|•|⟦Feb01CLQuest7⟧ L|3|•|⟦Feb01CLQuest10⟧ L|2|•|While at the Lyceum, present Eaushi the Trainer with the various items from this quest. The golem often gives a response.
H3|Part 4: Kindling L|1|1.|Add one kindling stone to each piece of armor to create Thaumaturgic Plate Armor - armor for trained War Magic. L|1|2.|Add a second kindling stone to each piece of armor to create Exarch Plate Armor - armor for specialized War Magic. L|1|3.|Failing any step reverts the piece to the unkindled state. L|1|4.|Skill increases chances of applying the kindling stone, but there is no hard cap. It is recommended that you apply the kindling stones in the Heiromancer's Hall if you are lower level to have unlimited chances. L|1|5.|Adding a third stone to a piece of Exarch Plate Armor reverts it to the unkindled state, allowing for the color to be changed.
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Lyceum Training Grounds» From «Ishilai Lyceum» -- «map:0112¦0112» TR|«Hieromancer's Halls» 4.4S, 82.8W -- «map:02A9¦02A9» TE
H2|Rewards
R|Add one Kindling Stone to each Unkindled Thaumaturgic armor piece RK|Items| RI|Thaumaturgic Armor (Trained War Magic req.) RI|«Thaumaturgic Plate Coat» RI|«Thaumaturgic Plate Girth» RI|«Thaumaturgic Plate Leggings» RE
R|Add two Kindling Stones to each Unkindled Thaumaturgic armor piece RK|Items| RI|Exarch Armor (Specialised War Magic req.) RI|«Exarch Plate Coat» RI|«Exarch Plate Girth» RI|«Exarch Plate Leggings» RE
R|Side rewards RK|Items| RI|«Globe of Auberean» RI|«Lightweight Tome» RI|«Sasalia's Dress» RI|«Boots of the Vault» RI|«Hieromancer's Orb» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Eaushi the Trainer⸩ ⸨The golem stirs to life at your touch. "Kiya auranil..." it grumbles, then pauses⸩ ⸨In your mind, a mild voice says, "Good day. It has been many turns of the stars since this servant has greeted visitors. Welcome to the Ishelai Lyceum, serving in good faith His Most Serene Majesty Kellin II.⸩ ⸨"If you are a student, the written permission of the caloyer is required for me to send you to the trials.
L|1||Handing in Slip of Paper⸩ ⸨You give Eaushi the Trainer Slip of Paper⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "This note appears to be valid... although the date seems to be... a bit off. This golem shall now teleport you to one of the five trial grounds. May light fall upon your shoulders, young apprentice.⸩ ⸨⸨Eaushi the Trainer teleports you with Portal Sending.⸩
L|1||Opening the First Threshold, Lyceum Training Grounds⸩ ⸨The door swings wide, and a melodious voice in your mind says, "Beyond lays the first and easiest test. Once you jump into the abyss, you may not return this way. You must enter the test grounds again later."
L|1||Opening the Second Threshold, Lyceum Training Grounds⸩ ⸨The door swings wide, and a melodious voice in your mind says, "Beyond lays the second test, more difficult than the previous. Once you jump into the abyss, you may not return this way. You must enter the test grounds again later."
L|1||Opening the Third Threshold, Lyceum Training Grounds⸩ ⸨The door swings wide, and a melodious voice in your mind says, "Beyond lays the last and most grueling test. Once you jump into the abyss, you may not return this way. You must enter the test grounds again later."
L|1||Handing in Small Pale Crystal⸩ ⸨You give Eaushi the Trainer Small Pale Crystal⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "Well done, young master! You have defeated the first Nephol Golem. This is the first step on your path to becoming a Thaumaturge of the Order.⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer gives you Unkindled Thaumaturgic Plate Girth⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "You must still Enkindle this girth before it may be worn.
L|1||Handing in Pale Crystal⸩ ⸨You give Eaushi the Trainer Pale Crystal⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "Splendid, young master! You have defeated the second Nephol Golem. Only one remains before you may be eligible to become a Thaumaturge of the Order.⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer gives you Unkindled Thaumaturgic Plate Leggings⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "You must still Enkindle these leggings before they may be worn."
L|1||Handing in Large Pale Crystal⸩ ⸨You give Eaushi the Trainer Large Pale Crystal⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "Exceptional, young master! You have defeated the final Nephol Golem. You are now eligible to become a Thaumaturge of the Order.⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer gives you Unkindled Thaumaturgic Plate Coat⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "You must still Enkindle this coat before it may be worn, and the skill required to add the Kindling Stones to your personal battle armor is your final test before becoming a full Hieromancer.
L|1||Kindling armor, first attempt (success)⸩ ⸨With a burst of warmth and heat, the Kindling Stone fuses itself into the [coat/girth/leggings]. This piece of [color] colored Thaumaturgic Plate may now be worn!
L|1||Kindling armor, first attempt (failure)⸩ ⸨Your war magic skill is insufficient to kindle this piece of armor. Your Kindling Stone breaks!
L|1||Kindling armor, second attempt (success)⸩ ⸨With a burst of warmth and heat, the Kindling Stone fuses itself into your Thaumaturgic [Coat/Girth/Leggings]. You have created a piece of Exarch Plate!
L|1||Kindling armor, second attempt (failure)⸩ ⸨Your war magic skill is insufficient to apply a second Kindling Stone. The armor reverts to its unkindled state, and the Stone breaks.
L|1||Handing in Blue Orb⸩ ⸨You give Eaushi the Trainer Blue Orb⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "Ah. This bauble was created by the Imperial Talespinner Mistral Tersicor. For many years he wandered the world, recording the stories of all its' people.⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "He disappeared from the palace at Tentael one cold night, just after Caerlin II had taken the throne. He left a note, saying that the songs of other worlds needed to be written, and that he would return in 2300 years.⸩ ⸨Eaushi prods the orb gently. It blossoms, the blue surfaces spiraling open to reveal patches of green, brown, and white⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer gives you Globe of Auberean⸩ ⸨The ceaseless mountain winds whistle around Eaushi's facets
L|1||Globe of Auberean interaction⸩ ⸨You give Eaushi the Trainer Globe of Auberean.⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "Beautiful, is it not?"⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer gives you Globe of Auberean.
L|1||Handing in Sunstone Geode⸩ ⸨You give Eaushi the Trainer Sunstone Geode⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "It is rare to gain such a prize from the Nephol Golems, young master. This geode is said to indicate much favor. Perhaps you were born under Irihane ascendant?⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "No... This golem does not feel the influence of any lights it knows upon you. How odd."
L|1||Boots of the Vault interaction⸩ ⸨You give Eaushi the Trainer Boots of the Vault.⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "These bring back memories. These boots were the property of Marr Areleo, one of the Exarchs of the Order."⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "He and his brother were responsible for patrolling certain... storehouses, ensuring they remained safely under lock and key."⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer gives you Boots of the Vault.⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "This task was given to them by Caerlin I, at the behest of the mage Asheron."
L|1||Opening Trunk⸩ ⸨As the trunk is opened, a whisper of exotic scent rises from its rotting form. The ghosts of long-decayed spices leave you with an impression of warmth, hearth, and home.
L|1||Sasalia's Dress interaction⸩ ⸨You give Eaushi the Trainer Sasalia's Dress.⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "This was once worn by the mage Sasalia, who became one of our instructors. In addition to the combat arts, Sasalia was also a master of culinary magic."⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "An unusual combination for a Hieromancer. She often cooked for the students."⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer gives you Sasalia's Dress.⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "She had a rather peculiar pet, too. When she was a girl attending this school, it would sit on her head during classes."
L|1||Lightweight Tome interaction⸩ ⸨You give Eaushi the Trainer Lightweight Tome.⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "This book was crafted by Rurinah, a member of the last class of students here. She was quite skilled in the art of parchment-making."⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "The process had been passed through her family for generations. She was proud to note that her grandmother had made paper for the esteemed Maila of Knorr."⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer gives you Lightweight Tome.⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "This servant recalls her well - a terribly serious silver-haired girl, given to calling more lighthearted people 'fools.'"
L|1||Permission Slip interaction⸩ ⸨You give Eaushi the Trainer Permission Slip.⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer tells you, "This golem fears it does not recognize these letters, young master. It humbly apologizes. This golem was granted the capacity to impress its words upon the softly glowing mind, but not to read languages other than its own."⸩ ⸨Eaushi the Trainer gives you Permission Slip.⸩

Quest.name: Hoshino_Fortress_Infiltration
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|200 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Mareeno Donn» I|Starts At|«Royal Tent» at 80.7N, 43.0W I|Route|«Stonehold» to «Desolation Beach» portal at 69.6N, 20.2W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Hoshino Fortress» H2|Overview P|Multi stage quest to infiltrate Hoshino's fortress and tower.
L|1|•|The creatures in the fortress and dungeons hit very hard with melee damage, slashing war spells, and void DoTs. Creatures you'll encounter are primarily ghosts, undead, mu-miyah, and rats.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Main Gate Key L|1|1.|Talk to «Mareeno Donn» outside the «Royal Tent» at 80.7N, 43.0W. L|2|•|⟦UndeadDigBone1_0812⟧ L|2|•|Route: From «Stonehold», take the «Desolation Beach» portal at 69.6N, 20.2W and run to 80.7N, 43.0W. L|2|•|Talk to all the other NPCs at the tent to get flagged for kill tasks as well. You will likely complete them all during the quest. L|1|2.|Collect three broken key pieces from the three Gatekeepers that spawn inside one of the clusters of buildings at the base of the fortress: L|2|1.|«Broken Key (Lower)» - From the «Bushi Gatekeeper» L|2|2.|«Broken Key (Middle)» - From the «Samurai Gatekeeper» L|2|3.|«Broken Key (Upper)» - From the «Claw Master Gatekeeper» L|2|•|Note 1: The particular building in each cluster that the Gatekeepers spawn appears to be random. L|2|•|Note 2: Each piece of the key has a one hour timer before it disintegrates. Combining the pieces resets the timer. L|1|3.|Combine the 3 Broken Key pieces into a «Main Gate Key», which has a two hour timer before it disintegrates. L|1|4.|Go to the entrance to «Hoshino's Fortress» at 79.1N 41.5W and hand the Main Gate Key to the «Lock (Main Gate)¦Lock», located next to the gate. L|1|5.|Once inside the fortress run directly into the «Venerable Mausoleum» portal on the left in the courtyard. L|2|•|Note: Should anyone in your group die after entering the fortress and before using the Hoshino Tower poral in part 4, you will need to make another key to re-enter the fortress. It is often easiest for a single person/small group with very high melee defense or rares to collect the key from the nearby towns.
H3|Part 2: Venerable Mausoleum L|1|1.|From the drop, take the ramp down and work your way to a room with three pits (north, east, and west). L|1|2.|Jump down into each pit, and work your way to the end until you find the boss (see below). L|1|3.|Kill the bosses, and loot a bone from their corpses (drops 9). Everyone in the group needs one of each bone: L|2|•|North - «Ronin Hirachi» drops an «Ancient Skull» L|2|•|East - «Ronin Ginmura» drops a «Shaped Arm Bone» L|2|•|West - «Ronin Shimakawa» drops an «Ancient Arm Bone» L|2|•|Lockpick Bonus: There is a «Chorizite Chest» in the East section. L|1|4.|After looting each bone, use the surface portal nearby to head back to the top of the dungeon. Repeat these steps for each pit. L|1|5.|After you have both bones and a skull combine them into «Ancient Skull and Bones». L|1|6.|Hand the completed Ancient Skull and Bones to the «Ancient Altar», located in upper east level of the dungeon, near the «Samurai Titan» to obtain your rewards and the «Middle Gate Key». L|2|•|⟦HoshinoFortPart2⟧ L|2|•|Note: Do not get too close to the Titan or he will agro. L|1|7.|After the first person does their turn in, the «Crypt Eidolon» will spawn, smite the Samurai Titan, and subsequently disappear. L|2|•|Note 1: If you wish to see this animation again, wait for the Samurai Titan to respawn before handing in your skull and bones. L|1|8.|After everyone has turned in their Ancient Skull and Bones, take the nearby surface portal, which takes you back to the courtyard (extremely hot drop!). L|2|•|Note: The surface portal will expire within a few minutes of the last person's turn-in (it can be re-spawned via a turn in). L|2|•|Note: This point in the quest is a good time to use a melee defense rare or other rares in order to survive the coutryard battle. L|1|9.|Have one person give the Middle Gate Key to the «Lock (Middle Gate)¦lock» of the door to the north and proceed to the 2nd area of the courtyard. L|1|10.|Clear the entire spawn inside the 2nd courtyard. Once the last creature dies, the next door will open. L|1|11.|Run through the door and enter the «Falatacot Temple» portal, located inside a small building in the middle of 3rd courtyard. This is also a hot drop. L|2|•|Note 1: If anyone dies, someone will need to collect another key to the fortress in order to re-open the gate (see part 1). Someone who did not use their «Middle Gate Key» will then need to open the gate to the 2nd courtyard. L|2|•|Note 2: The door which opens to the 3rd courtyard after the spawn is cleared remains open for a longer amount of time (45 minutes?). This should allow time for anyone who died to re-join the group in the Falatacot Temple.
H3|Part 3: Falatacot Temple L|1|1.|Inside this dungeon, your group must kill enemies, and collect the upper, middle, and lower pieces of a lever from their corpses. The pieces drop randomly. Only 1 set is needed for the group. L|2|1.|«Broken Lever (Lower)» L|2|2.|«Broken Lever (Middle)» L|2|3.|«Broken Lever (Upper)» L|2|•|Note: The disintegration timer on these pieces all begin when you enter the dungeon, and not when you pick them up. L|1|2.|Once you have all three pieces, combine them to create a «Lever Handle». L|1|3.|Head to the north end of the dungeon and hand the «Lever Handle» to the «Lever Box» (located to the right of the door) to open it. L|1|4.|Proceed past the door, and you will be auto-portaled into the next part of this dungeon. L|2|•|Note: Once you portal in, don't move forward, or you will draw agro. L|1|5.|Kill everything in this dungeon to trigger the opening of the door (located in front of you at the drop). There are six hallways off of the main room that must be cleared. L|1|6.|Head up the stairs and down the hallway until you reach a room containing several enemies, including an «Exarch Nanjou Shou-jen». L|1|7.|Kill the Exarch Nanjou Shou-jen, and a «Freed Temple Exarch» NPC will spawn. L|1|8.|Speak with the Exarch NPC, to receive your second set of rewards and a «Final Gate Key». L|2|•|⟦FreedTempleExarch⟧
H3|Part 4: Hoshino Tower L|1|1.|When your group is ready, use the surface portal in this room to return to the 3rd courtyard (very hot drop). L|1|2.|Have one person use their «Final Gate Key» to open the final door to the north, which leads to an overlook, containing the spectral towers. L|1|3.|The final portal should be entered together as a group, so it is best to run to the spectral towers, then stop and clear any spawns that follow. L|1|4.|Admire the spectral towers floating on the side of the fortress then enter the «Hoshino Tower» portal (boss fight hot drop). L|2|•|⟦HoshinoTowerShortcut⟧ L|1|5.|Inside, kill the «First Lieutenant» and loot the «First Lieutenant's Insignia.» from his corpse (drops 9). Respawn is 10 minutes. L|2|•|Note: All fellow members should focus on the boss - the longer the fight, the more spawns will accumulate in the room. He goes down fast when both imp'd and vuln'd. L|2|•|Note: Flame waves will shoot out along the edges of the room - everyone should stay away from the walls. L|2|•|Note: If anyone should die during the boss fight, they can get back by using the shortcut portal located near the pagoda building across from the main gate to the fortress (need coords). L|2|•|⟦FirstLieutenantInsigniaPickup⟧ L|1|6.|After he dies, take the ramp up until you reach a room containing tables with «O-Yoroi Armor», «Reinforced Shou-jen Armor» and 2-use «Legendary Key»s on them. L|2|•|⟦HoshinoFortKeyPickup⟧ L|1|7.|You may loot one piece of armor from either set and one key. L|2|•|Note: If you are unsure what to choose, the O-Yoroi armor is more popular due to its unique look, while the Shou-jen armor looks similar to the «Nanjou Shou-jen Armor» which can be acquired while fighting in «Egg Orchard» and other similar dungeons. Both armor sets offer only epic cantrips as a set bonus, so for most players they are useful for tailoring only. We must learn as much as we can as quickly as we can, we have no time to waste."⸩ ⸨Mareeno Donn tells you, "Who knows what Hoshino Kei is planning, but whatever it is it can't be good! H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Jondor Torgren tells you, "Perhaps you could help a simple scholar... I've been told that strange landscape formations have appeared around the Empyrean graveyard, and that scouts from mysterious new secret societies have taken up positions at these sites. There are scouts at these formations to the north, east, and west of the graveyard."⸩ ⸨Jondor Torgren tells you, "I would be most indebted to you if you could somehow gain the trust of these scouts and bring me whatever written materials you can about the beliefs that their societies espouse. I would reward you with a bit of practical knowledge for any manifestoes that you could bring me. I have also heard that there are more senior representatives of each society in Ayan Baqur, but I doubt they'll talk to you until you've won the confidence of the scouts by the graveyard. Good luck! And be careful about straying into the graveyard itself!"
L|1||Kousu Temo (Eldrytch Web)⸩ ⸨Kousu Temo tells you, "Ah, so that curious Arcanum scholar sent you. I would be willing to give you the knowledge you seek on his behalf, if you would simply retrieve an artifact for me from this infected pit here before us..."⸩ ⸨Kousu Temo tells you, "In that crypt below, there is a chest that contains an ancient scepter. The scepter is an artifact that is of some interest to my superiors. Find the key among those creatures milling about in the pit, unlock the chest, and bring me the scepter. That will prove you worthy, and I will write you a letter of introduction to bring to my commander."
L|1||Completing Task⸩ ⸨You give Kousu Temo Scepter of Menilesh.⸩ ⸨Kousu Temo tells you, "Ah, the ancient scepter of Menilesh... Barely recognizable under the dust and decay of the millennia. Still, my masters will be pleased to see that I have recovered it. I will reward you with some practical knowledge. I will also give you a letter of introduction to bring to my commander, Qurakh al-Taal in Ayan Baqur. In time, you may prove yourself worthy of the Eldrytch Web..."⸩ ⸨You've earned 13,782,125 experience.⸩ ⸨Kousu Temo gives you Eldrytch Web Letter of Introduction.
L|1||Giving Eldrytch Web Letter of Introduction to Qurakh al-Taal⸩ ⸨You give Qurakh al-Taal Eldrytch Web Letter of Introduction.⸩ ⸨Qurakh al-Taal tells you, "Young Temo's note tells me that you helped him recover the scepter of Menilesh... We thank you for your devotion and your interest in the glories of ages long past. Perhaps, in time, you can join the Eldrytch Web and do your part to bring those glories back to Dereth, from the ruins and forgotten memories of the present day. We are not accepting new members now, but your assistance in this matter has been noted, and will not be forgotten. We will watch you with interest from this day forward. For now, perhaps you would wish to look through this book and learn some more about the Eldrytch Web."⸩ ⸨Qurakh al-Taal gives you Canon of the Eldrytch Web.
L|1||Candrus Steady-Hand (Celestial Hand)⸩ ⸨Candrus Steady-Hand tells you, "Old Jondor sent you looking for me, eh? I have little to hide, and perhaps you would some day be a worthy compatriot in our service, but first I think you must prove your mettle, for we all face dangerous times. Down in this strange pit is a nest of revenants, foul even by the standards of the undead. These Blight Spirits are a symptom of the disease that is spreading across our beloved Dereth! Slay eight of them for me and I will write you a letter of introduction to bring to my superior."
L|1||Completing Task⸩ ⸨Candrus Steady-Hand tells you, "Excellent work! You have served Dereth well today, slaying those tainted spirits and freeing their corrupted energies to the mana streams once more. Allow me to reward you with some practical knowledge. I should also give you a letter of introduction to bring to my commander, Joku Shunja in Ayan Baqur. Some time in the future, you may find yourself joining the Celestial Hand in defense of the realm..."⸩ ⸨You've earned 13,782,125 experience.⸩ ⸨Candrus Steady-Hand gives you Celestial Hand Letter of Introduction.
L|1||Giving Celestial Hand Letter of Introduction to Joku Shunja⸩ ⸨You give Joku Shunja Celestial Hand Letter of Introduction.⸩ ⸨Joku Shunja tells you, "So, Candrus tells me in this note that you helped him with that infestation of blight spirits. Well done! We welcome your service to the greater good of all Dereth. A spirit as noble as yours may one day find welcome in the ranks of the Celestial Hand, who act to defend all the inhabitants of Dereth from the ancient evils that besiege it. We are not accepting new members at the moment, but we have taken notice of you. For now, allow me to present you with a book on the principles that guide our actions as a group."⸩ ⸨Joku Shunja gives you Principles of the Celestial Hand.
L|1||Jawaq ibn Janath (Radiant Blood)⸩ ⸨Jawaq ibn Janath tells you, "Ah, that Arcanum scholar sent you to find out what you could from me, eh? Well, there may be a way for you to prove yourself worthwhile to me, and to my superiors. Down in this pit nearby is a foul, diseased creature known as a Blight Lictor. It is a symptom of the contamination that is creeping across this land. Bring its head to me and I will give you a letter of introduction that you can present to my field commander."
L|1||Completing Task⸩ ⸨You give Jawaq ibn Janath Blight Lictor's Head.⸩ ⸨Jawaq ibn Janath tells you, "I am well pleased. It brings a savage joy to my heart to see that foul creature's severed head. Allow me to reward you with some practical knowledge. I should also give you a letter of introduction to bring to my commander, Vierana du Canamorra in Ayan Baqur. You may be worthy to one day become a member of the Radiant Blood..."⸩ ⸨You've earned 13,782,125 experience.⸩ ⸨Jawaq ibn Janath gives you Radiant Blood Letter of Introduction.
L|1||Giving Radiant Blood Letter of Introduction to Vierana du Canamorra⸩ ⸨You give Vierana du Canamorra Radiant Blood Letter of Introduction.⸩ ⸨Vierana du Canamorra tells you, "I see you have been of use to one of my scouts. That Jawaq always was a little weak in the sword arm, if you know what I mean. Well, if you did what he could not, perhaps, in time, you may be useful to me. The Radiant Blood is not accepting more members yet, but we may in the not-too-distant future... Suffice it to say you have been noticed, and may be watched. For now, allow me to present you with a book on the tenets of our society to see if your heart belongs with us."⸩ ⸨Vierana du Canamorra gives you Tenets of the Radiant Blood.

Quest.name: Monster_Fights
Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|Gambling I|QB|10 stamps H3|Overview of Monster Fights P|Wager 5 MMD on the combatant of your choice in a free-for-all cage match just outside Sanamar for the chance at a Grand Casino Key.
H3|Placing your Bet P|Located north of «Sanamar» at 72.8N 60.7W, the «Monster Fight Bookie» will take 5 «MMD» and give you a «Monster Fight Ticket». P|There are 5 torches around the cages. About every 10 minutes, one more will light up, indicating how long it will be for the next fight begins. P|Once an hour, when all 5 torches are lit, eight combatants will spawn in the cage, give your ticket to the one you think will win. P|The fight takes about 10 minutes. Quest.name: The_Temple_of_Liazk_Itzi
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|40-59, 60-79, 80-99, 100 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Antechamber of Liazk Itzi» at 40.7S, 11.8E I|Route|From «Xarabydun» or use a «Fadsahil's Portal Gem» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|More commonly known as Blackmire 2, this quest has four level ranges: 40 - 59, 60 - 79, 80 - 99, and 100+
L|1|•|If you are soloing this quest you must be in a fellowship to claim the reward at the end. and claim the qb for each step
P|Prerequisites L|1|•|Before heading out, buy 1 «Dragonsblood» from your local archmage.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Use the «Odd Looking Vine» to be teleported into the «Antechamber of Liazk Itzi».
H3|Part 1: Antechamber of Liazk Itzi L|1|1.|Hand your Dragonsblood to the statue and go through the door it opens. L|1|2.|There are 4 statues. Use the one designated for your level range to be teleported into «Liazk Itzi Guardians»: L|2|•|Northwest - Levels 40 to 59 L|2|•|Southwest - Levels 60 to 79 L|2|•|Northeast - Levels 80 to 99 L|2|•|Southeast - Levels 100 and up
H3|Part 2: Liazk Itzi Guardians L|1|1.|At the entrance, take the first right. From then on there is only one path to the end. The dungeon is full of a single type of Falatacot undead: L|2|•|40 - 59: «Grave Spirit» L|2|•|60 - 79: «Crypt Spirit» L|2|•|80 - 99: «Restless Soul» L|2|•|100+: «Ancient Soul» L|1|2.|There are several doors opened by levers. The lever is always in the hallway very close to the door. Near the end you will come to a large room full of undead and two paths down. Both lead to the final room. Use the statue in this final room to be teleported to «Lair of Liazk Itzi».
H3|Part 3: Lair of Liazk Itzi L|1|1.|There are two options - jump down a hole and run past/fight a gauntlet of Slithis, or complete a jumping puzzle to avoid the monsters. Should you fall in the jumping puzzle, you will land in pit lined with flying dagger traps. There is a lever in the north end of the pit room will open a door to the south, and once out of the pit you'll have to fight slithis to reach the end of this section. L|2|•|40 - 59: «Ithik Stalk» L|2|•|60 - 79: «Irkith Stalk» L|2|•|80 - 99: «Irkith Stalk» ? L|2|•|100+: «Slithis Spthis» L|1|2.|After passing the jumping puzzle or creatures, use the statue at the intersection to be teleported to «Liazk Itzi's Offering Room».
H3|Part 4: Liazk Itzi's Offering Room L|1|1.|This next area is a test of speed. The dungeon is small and contains no creatures. One person must use all three Eye statues fast enough to activate the «Strange Device (Blackmire)¦Strange Device». L|2|•|{TIP} After using an eye, jump to break the animation and exit the room before the door closes. Being in combat or casting mode when using the eye will achieve this effect as well. L|1|2.|When the three eyes have been used fast enough, use the strange device and all members of the fellowship will be teleported to «Halls of Liazk Itzi».
H3|Part 5: Halls of Liazk Itzi L|1|1.|This section is full of Burun. There are 3 larger rooms, one to the northwest, one to the north, and one to the northeast. A Special burun boss randomly spawns in one of these rooms. L|2|•|40 - 59: «Burun Ruuk Adherent» & «Burun Ruuk Adherent Overseer» L|2|•|60 - 79: «Burun Ruuk Seer» & «Burun Ruuk Seer Watcher» L|2|•|80 - 99: «Burun Ruuk Soothsayer» & «Burun Ruuk Adherent Officer» L|2|•|100+: «Burun Ruuk Shaman» & «Burun Ruuk Shaman Keeper» L|2|•|⟦LiazkBeaten⟧ L|1|2.|Once the Burun boss is dead, use the statue in the the mid wing to be teleported to «Liazk Itzi's Crypt».
H3|Part 6: Liazk Itzi's Crypt L|1|1.|Claim your rewards in this section. Use the «Sarcophagus of High Matriarch, Liazk Itzi» to obtain the Bracers, and then use one of the other objects in the room to claim another reward. L|2|•|⟦ReceivedLiazkArmor⟧ L|2|•|⟦CompletedTempleLiazk⟧

The High Matriarch sleeps and you are not of the spirits that make this temple their home. Your business then must be to bring the sacrifices that will awaken the High Matriarch and allow her to reclaim this land once more."⸩ ⸨Guardian tells you, "Beyond the door that I guard are guardians of the tunnels that lead to her resting place. They stand vigil over the spirits who were tasked to defend her temple in her absence. Quest.name: Arcane_Pedestal_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|30 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} «Slithe Tradittor» I|Starts At|{OPT} 3.9N, 44.8E near «Lytelthorpe» I|Route|«Lytelthorpe» to «Osric Cottages» portal at 2.2N, 50.4E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Acquiring the Gelidite Dais L|1|1.|This quest's lore piece, «Rumor of an Artifact», can be purchased from the «Barkeeper» in «Glenden Wood», «Qalaba'r» or «Zaikhal». L|1|2.|In order to complete the production of the «Arcane Pedestal», you will need to acquire a «Gelidite Dais» from the «Gelidite Library Quest¦Gelidite Library», and also three «Bronze Statues Quest¦Bronze Statue» pieces. You can acquire these prior to retrieving the other parts to save a fair amount of running later. L|1|3.|To acquire the Gelidite Dais, head to the main quest dungeon at 69.2N, 17.2W. Once inside, continue through to the second dungeon. At the four-way intersection, go through the north door and take the immediate first east hallway. Through the two doors, you'll find the Gelidite Dais beside the «Oubliette Gatekeeper». Double-click the Dais to receive one in your inventory.
H3|Part 2: Bronze Gear, Coil and Spring L|1|1.|To acquire the Bronze pieces from three different creature Statues, you will have to head to three different foundries. It's important to note that the parts need to drop off of a specific creature. If you try to turn in a Bronze piece that was dropped off of a creature not listed, Slithe Tradittor will refuse it. L|2|•|**Note:** The Mammet Foundry is the most dangerous of the three, with numerous creature magic casters. It would be advisable to enlist the help of a friend to help keep the dungeon clear. Also note that the Bronze pieces are attuned, so they cannot be passed from one character to another.
TH| Bronze Part Foundry Dropped By Pick Up Stamp TR|«Bronze Gear from a Statue» Mannikin Foundry Portal in: «Holtburg», «Rithwic» or «Yaraq». «Bronze Statue of a Reedshark» ⟦GearReedshark⟧ TR|«Bronze Coil from a Statue» Effigy Foundry Portal in «Cragstone», «Glenden Wood» or «Zaikhal». «Bronze Statue of a Sclavus (Effigy)¦Bronze Statue of a Sclavus» ⟦CoilSclavus⟧ TR|«Bronze Spring from a Statue» Mammet Foundry Portal in «Arwic», «Mayoi» or «Stonehold». «Bronze Statue of a Skeleton (Mammet)¦Bronze Statue of a Skeleton» ⟦SpringSkeleton⟧ TE P||}
H3|Part 3: The Precarious Sojourn L|1|1.|Go to «Slithe Tradittor¦Slithe Tradittor's» cottage at 3.9N, 44.8E. L|2|•|Route: From the «Town Network», take the Aluvian (north) wing to «Lytelthorpe». From there, run to the «Osric Cottages» portal at 2.2N, 50.5E. L|1|2.|Talk to Slithe Tradittor to receive «Slithe Tradittor's Notes.¦Slithe Tradittor's Notes» and «Imaging Crystal». L|2|•|⟦SPOKEWITHSLITHE⟧ L|2|•|**Note:** The quickest route is to take the Midsong Cottages portal outside of «Al-Jalima» at 5.7N, 4.3E. L|2|•|**Note:** The Precarious Sojourn portal is found high atop a hill. You can climb up at 2.8N, 0.7W. L|1|3.|Go to the «Precarious Sojourn» portal at 2.3N, 0.8W outside of «Al-Jalima». At the drop, run north until the final platform, then turn east. Continue until the second-last platform and head north again. Turn east at the next platform and continue until the end. At this point, turn south and jump onto the floating tower. You may wish to clear the platform of creatures before attempting the jump to avoid bouncing off of them (which may drop you to the ground, requiring you to make the trip to Precarious Sojourn a second time). L|2|•|**Note:** The quickest route is to take the Bay of Sands Cottages portal outside of «Al-Jalima» at 5.7N, 4.3E. L|1|4.|Talk to «Alatar Locke» at the second-highest floor of the floating tower, and you will receive an «Unframed map of Dereth». L|2|•|⟦RECEIVEDDECORATIONDERETHMAPUNFRAMED⟧ L|1|5.|Use your Imaging Crystal on the «An Empyrean device» atop the tower to receive an «Imaging Crystal- Arcane Pedestal imprinted» in its place. L|1|6.|Return to Slithe Tradittor and hand him the Imaging Crystal. At this point, you can hand him the Gelidite Dais if you acquired one earlier, and follow with the Bronze pieces if you also have those. If you have neither, it's recommend you spend time to acquire both the Dais and three Bronze pieces before heading back, to save a somewhat lengthy run. The instructions to acquire these can be found at the top of this walkthrough. L|2|•|⟦TURNEDINIMAGINGCRYSTAL⟧ L|1|7.|Return to Slithe Tradittor and hand him the Gelidite Dais, and receive a «Parts List for Arcane Pedestal» in return. Listed inside are the required Bronze pieces to complete the construction of the Pedestal. Acquire these if you have not already. If you have, hand them over, one at a time. L|2|•|⟦TURNEDINDAIS⟧ L|1|8.|Return once more to Slithe Tradittor and hand him the three Bronze pieces the «Bronze Gear from a Statue», «Bronze Coil from a Statue» and the «Bronze Spring from a Statue». He'll award you with a fully-completed «Arcane Pedestal». L|2|•|⟦TURNEDINCOIL⟧ L|2|•|⟦TURNEDINGEAR⟧ L|2|•|⟦TURNEDINSPRING⟧ L|2|•|⟦RECEIVEDARCANEPEDESTAL⟧ L|1|9.|To complete the Dereth Map, pay a visit to the «Woodsman» who resides along the shoreline outside of «Holtburg», at 43.4N, 33.3E. Purchase a bundle of «Wood». L|1|10.|Head to the southwest side of «Zaikhal», to the «Agent of the Arcanum¦Agent of the Arcanum's» cottage at 13.2N, 0.3E. There you will find «Jordan Ibn'Ikia». First hand him the Unframed map of Dereth, then the Wood, and you will receive back a constructed «Dereth Map». L|2|•|⟦GAVEUNFRAMEDDERETHMAP⟧
