H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "Traveler. I have a tale to tell and a task I would put upon you. Were you to take this task on yourself, you will bear witness to things I have seen and a wondrous device I glimpsed but could not fathom or grasp."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "For you see, there is an artifact in a place unlike any that exists in Dereth."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "I am an explorer for the Explorer Society. In a desert region, I came upon a suspended walkway hung out from the edge of a cliff. The other end of the walkway was attached not to solid ground but was lost in the spinning light of a portal. I held my breath and stepped upon the walkway, half expecting it to collapse and throw me to the ground so far below. Yet, the walkway held my weight! I crept forward and stepped through the portal. I arrived on another walkway, or perhaps the same one somehow extended through the portal. There was a platform at its far end, then another walkway... Well, it is something you must see for yourself. Suffice it to say that I journeyed through this structure, all the while being assailed by vile creatures. Near the top of this construction I spied an artifact- a tall pedestal it was, with arcane shapes gyrating in the air above it. I know not its function but it was clear to me that this artifact, this device, is of some import. There are many things it could be and none, I believe, of small consequence! Before I was able to reach it, a wretched monster sent me back to my Lifestone! Later, I attempted to return, yet the portal would not permit me to pass. I know not why."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "I must study this device. I call it the "Arcane Pedestal." I even believe I have the means to create a version of it, but first I require an imprint of its morphology."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "I shall give you a copy of my notes and an Imaging Crystal. The notes show you the way to that place. The Imaging Crystal can be imprinted with the composition and design of this device. Return to me with the imprint embedded within the Crystal and I will study it and determine how to create it."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "The Arcane Pedestal! We shall have the Arcane Pedestal!"⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor gives you Imaging Crystal.⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor gives you Slithe Tradittor's Notes..
L|1||Alatar Locke⸩ ⸨Alatar Locke tells you, "Well, hello! My name is Alatar Locke. I am a cartographer for the Explorer Society. I was beginning to think no Isparians would ever make it to this place! I ended up here after spending quite a bit of time in the Floating City. I must say I do enjoy it here. From a good height, one can study the lay of the land and for one of my avocation that is quite a happy thing! In my spare time I have been making maps of Dereth. Perhaps you would like one?"⸩ ⸨Alatar Locke gives you Unframed map of Dereth.⸩ ⸨Alatar Locke tells you, "If you would like to have the map framed, I understand there is a Furniture Master in Zaikhal that may frame it for you. His name is Jordan Ibn'Ikia and he does quality work for little money."
L|1||Handing in Imaging Crystal⸩ ⸨You give Slithe Tradittor Imaging Crystal- Arcane Pedestal imprinted.⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "You were able to do it! Let me see what kind of image you captured of the Arcane Pedestal."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor examines the images within the crystal intently...⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "Ah, yes I can see what its components may be. They are similar to..."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor turns the crystal every which way, peering within it...⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "Thus far I can only say for certain that a Gelidite Dais is required for me to build this device. Once I have all the components, I should be able to build a scaled down version of the Arcane Pedestal. Go get one now and bring it to me. One may be found in the Gelidite Library."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "I still cannot discern the purpose of the Arcane Pedestal, but with a functioning version I may understand it. It must be a thing of great power! Go quickly. Tell no one of the Arcanum about this. This is no affair of theirs."
L|1||Handing in Gelidite Dais⸩ ⸨You give Slithe Tradittor Gelidite Dais.⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "Yes, this is the first component. I have been studying the imaging crystal and now know what the other components are."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "They are the same parts which are within the living bronze statues. Here is a list of the components. Bring them to me and I will construct this device. Remember, tell no one of this."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor gives you Parts List for Arcane Pedestal.
L|1||Handing in Bronze Statue Parts⸩ ⸨You give Slithe Tradittor Bronze Gear from a Statue.⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "You have the Gear."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "Where is the Coil?"⸩ ⸨You give Slithe Tradittor Bronze Coil from a Statue.⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "You have found the Coil."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "The Spring is still required."⸩ ⸨You give Slithe Tradittor Bronze Spring from a Statue.⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "You have obtained the Spring."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor quickly constructs an Arcane Pedestal!⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor tells you, "This device appears to do nothing. I suppose you want your version. Here it is. Do not speak of this to others. Be gone."⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor gives you Arcane Pedestal.⸩ ⸨Slithe Tradittor mutters to himself about now being to make many more for his master.
L|1||Handing in Unframed Map and Wood to Jordan Ibn'Ikia⸩ ⸨You give Jordan Ibn'Ikia Unframed map of Dereth.⸩ ⸨Jordan Ibn'Ikia examines the map.⸩ ⸨Jordan Ibn'Ikia tells you, "Such a fine map. This looks like the work of Alatar Locke, only he understands line weight so well! This would look magnificent hanging on your wall but it obviously requires a frame. I could frame this for you, however I have run out of wood. If you were to bring me some wood from a woodsman I could frame the map for you. I can hold the map for you until then. The woodsman in Holtburg carries very fine wood, even his firewood is of sufficient quality for this."⸩ ⸨You give Jordan Ibn'Ikia Wood.⸩ ⸨Jordan Ibn'Ikia tells you, "Thank you for obtaining this wood for me. I shall frame your map now."⸩ ⸨Jordan Ibn'Ikia skillfully makes a decorative frame for the map⸩ ⸨Jordan Ibn'Ikia gives you Dereth Map.⸩ ⸨Jordan Ibn'Ikia tells you, "Don't let people mark it all up with their corpse locations, now! Hee hee!"⸩
H2|Trivia L|1|•|An interview with the Arcane Pedestal quest designer, Les Nelken, can be found «Microsoft Zone Archive/News & Events/Interview with Turbine's Les Nelken¦here».

Quest.name: Crystal_Minds_and_Shattered_Souls
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|115 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Student» I|Starts At|29.9N, 27.1E in «Glenden Wood» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|This is a 3 part quest to gather 3 crystals for research. You will fight lots of level 160 chain casting Golems in this quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|To start, speak with the «Student» at 29.9N, 27.1E in «Glenden Wood». L|1|2.|Head to the «Dark Tree Crystal Mine» near «Danby's Outpost» (Town Network south) at 24.8N, 31.3W. L|1|3.|Inside the mine, run through to the southeast corner of the dungeon and find a «Mining Storage Chest» to loot the «Dark Tree Crystal» (there are 2 chests, and the item inside respawns quickly so this is group friendly) L|2|•|⟦PICKEDUPDARKTREECRYSTAL⟧ L|1|4.|Speak to the lugian «Lartorus» at 42.6N 62.4E to be teleported into a warehouse, then give the Dark Tree Crystal to «Aun Talamura». L|2|•|Route: Take the «Eotensfang» settlement portal from «Arwic» at 32.9N, 59.4E. L|2|•|⟦GOTDARKTREERWARD⟧ L|1|5.|You will then be flagged to enter the «Warehouse Annex Mine», enter it and find an «Obsidian Excavation Golem» near the end which drops the «Valara Crystal» (drop rate is about 1 in 4). L|2|•|{TIP} Hug the left wall and it will eventually get you to the bottom of the mine. L|2|•|⟦PICKEDUPVALARACRYSTAL⟧ L|1|6.|Return to the warehouse via a portal near where the golems are located. Talk to «Aun Talamura» then give the «Valara Crystal» to him. L|2|•|⟦SPOKEWITHFALLENMGR⟧ L|2|•|⟦TURNEDINVALARACRYSTAL⟧ L|1|7.|Take the surface portal. It will portal you to a «Misty Mine». Navigate your way to the bottom to find an «Ancient Chest (Misty Mine)¦Ancient Chest», which contains «An unknown crystal» (again, there are multiple chests and items inside respawn quickly). L|2|•|Note: Throughout this dungeon, there is what can only be described as an extremely bright psychedelic disco-ball effect. It is extremely bright and extremely annoying. If you suffer adversely from certain visual effects, you may want to exercise caution here. L|2|•|⟦PICKEDUPSOULSHATTERCRYSTAL⟧ L|1|8.|Take the «An unknown crystal¦unknown crystal» back to the "«Student»" in «Glenden Wood» to complete the quest and receive your rewards. L|2|•|⟦GOTSOULSHATTERREWARD⟧

P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Student tells you, "Hello. I am a student of Nuhmudira. Nuhmudira is still enlisting the services of Isparians in obtaining some rare compounds and crystals necessary for her research into Lifestones. Dark Tree Crystal and Valara crystal are critical to this research.⸩ ⸨Student tells you, "If you could aid us in this endeavour we would be most grateful. To obtain Dark Tree Crystal you should go to a mine northwest of Fort Danby. Then, bring the Dark Tree Crystal to an ancient Empyrean dungeon we are using as a storage warehouse. It is located northeast of the Eotensfang Cottages settlement- you may journey there via the settlement portals near Arwic. A fellow student at that location can portal you into the facility. Give the crystal to the person overseeing the warehouse. I wish you safe tidings.
L|1||Lartorus⸩ ⸨Lartorus tells you, "You have some crystals to deliver? Go."⸩ L|1||Lartorus teleports you with Storage Warehouse. P|⸨;Aun Talamura⸩ ⸨Aun Talamura tells you, "Welcome to our storage facility. We are using this Empyrean place as a warehouse for crystals and materials Nuhmudira needs for her research and instructing us.
L|1||Handing in Dark Tree Crystal to Aun Talamura⸩ ⸨You give Aun Talamura Dark Tree Crystal⸩ ⸨Aun Talamura tells you, "Good, one of the students sent you. Nuhmudira requires this. Thank you.⸩ ⸨Aun Talamura tells you, "Now if you would be willing to obtain some Valara crystal, you can find it nearby. This Empyrean facility is adjacent to another complex which is guarded by Golems. Some hold a crystal known as Valara crystal. Its properties are useful to Nuhmudira in her research. The portal to that complex is just down the corridor. Return directly here through the portal you find in the dungeon.⸩ ⸨You've earned 600,000 experience.
L|1||Handing in Valara Crystal to Aun Talamura⸩ ⸨Aun Talamura tells you, "I cannot get up yet. Did you bring Valara crystals? Nuhmudira will certainly need them now! Someone hit me from behind... The crystals have been taken, we have been robbed!⸩ ⸨You give Aun Talamura Valara Crystal⸩ ⸨Aun Talamura tells you, "Ow, my head! I was knocked down... the crystal supplies were stolen! I did not see who it was. All right, I'll take the Valara... you go through the surface portal and alert the guard. There was a student here a minute before you, I sent him there also.⸩ ⸨You've earned 800,000 experience
L|1||Timorous⸩ ⸨Timorous tells you, "What is happening? This is not the right place. I just came from the warehouse. We should not have arrived here. I sense danger! Are you going further? I'm staying here!"
L|1||Handing in An unknown crystal to Student⸩ ⸨Student tells you, "Someone just informed me there is a problem at the warehouse. Perhaps you could go check?"⸩ ⸨You give Student An unknown crystal⸩ ⸨Student tells you, "What is this? It is a crystal I do not recognize. I will make sure that it gets to Nuhmudira! Did you see what happened at the warehouse? We know not what occurred but many of the crystals that were collected for Nuhmudira are gone!⸩ ⸨You've earned 200,000,000 experience
L|1||Repeat Dialog (before timer is up)⸩ ⸨Student tells you, "We are still trying to determine what happened at the warehouse."⸩ ⸨Student tells you, "How are things with you?"⸩ ⸨Lartorus tells you, "Do you wish to go to the warehouse? We are not allowing anyone to enter there now until we investigate what happened. If you have crystals to deliver, bring it to the student who sent you here."⸩

Quest.name: Death's_Allure
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|175 I|Rec. Level|200+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Hermit» I|Starts At|94.2N, 43.0W in the «Shattered Outlands» I|Route|From «Eastwatch» to pass at 93.0N, 47.0W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Death's Allure» H2|Overview P|"The Hermit needs your help in hopes of finding a cure."
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to the «Hermit» inside the cave, she will give you a «Bag of Life Stone Chips», then enter the portal to «Thrungus Hole». L|2|•|Note: The Thrungus Hole portal is tiable, recallable, and summonable. L|1|2.|Scattered through the dungeon are six «Baby Thrungus» NPCs. Hand the Bag of Lifestone Chips to each baby. L|2|•|When you hand the bag of Lifestone Chips to a Baby Thrungus, a mob of higher level Thrungus will spawn. Be prepared to run or fight. L|2|•|{TIP} Baby Thrungus appear on the radar as yellow (NPC) dots. Refer to the «Thrungus Hole¦dungeon map» for locations. L|2|•|First give: ⟦ThrungusFeedings⟧ L|2|1.|⟦babythrungus1⟧ L|2|2.|⟦babythrungus2⟧ L|2|3.|⟦babythrungus3⟧ L|2|4.|⟦babythrungus4⟧ L|2|5.|⟦babythrungus5⟧ L|2|6.|⟦babythrungus6⟧ L|1|3.|After you have handed the lifestone chips to all six babies, you'll get a message that you have been coated with dust and to talk to the Hermit again. L|1|4.|Portal recall or use the surface portal at the bottom of the dungeon to return to the Hermit. Speak with her for your reward. L|2|•|{TIP} Save the baby in the portal room for last, in order to make an easy escape. L|2|•|⟦DeathsAllureQuestFinished⟧

H2|Videos TR| TE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Hermit tells you, "Stranger! Hear my words."⸩ ⸨Hermit tells you, "Long ago I stumbled upon an ancient Falatacot tomb. In my foolish quest for riches I defiled the tomb only to trigger an ancient curse that causes my flesh to melt. Behold!"⸩ ⸨Hermit tells you, "This melting of my body will continue until I die in twisted agony. My peace lasts but a moment as those accursed life stones will bring me back to life whereupon the cycle will begin anew."⸩ ⸨Hermit tells you, "My search for a cure has brought me here. Will you not help me find solace? The Thrungus within this cave possess a unique ability to process rocks by digesting them. Take these and feed them to the Thrungus. Bring me back a sample of the processed stones."⸩ ⸨Hermit tells you, "Seek me out if you should need more of these."⸩ ⸨Hermit gives you Bag of Life Stone Chips.
L|1||Hermit (Completing the Quest)⸩ ⸨Hermit tells you, "Yes! This is it!"⸩ ⸨Hermit carefully collects the Thrungus Dust from your clothes and then suddenly her smile turns to one of sadness.⸩ ⸨Hermit tells you, "You deserve to know the truth. It is my belief that this dust will sever my ties to the Life Stones so when next I die I will not be brought back. My heart aches for having to deceive you, but I feared you would not help me had I told you the truth."⸩ ⸨Hermit tells you, "But do not despair my friend. For while you were gone I started to have misgivings about my actions. Perhaps death is not the answer I should seek."⸩ ⸨You've earned 150,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 12,000 Luminance.⸩ ⸨Hermit gives you Strengthened Mana Forge Key.⸩ ⸨Hermit gives you 5 Trade Notes (250,000).⸩ ⸨Hermit tells you, "I bestow upon you the title of "Thrungus Reaper".⸩

She bids that willing souls investigate the origin of the dark magics that spread across Osteth and Palenqual. She has heard that new anima have spread from the place where the kah took place. Should you find anything of note, I would like to see it. I will be calling on the keh of the Nuuani for aid to understand the things you find. Ispar Elysatah wishes to reach a peaceful accord with this new Xuta."⸩ ⸨Translator Aun Laokhe tells you, "Should you find any odd writing that the other translators cannot decipher, perhaps the keh of the Nuuani will help decipher those as well."
L|1||While destroying the Door⸩ ⸨"Hold your posts! Lay another volley on them, brothers," a voice yells from beyond the wall.⸩ ⸨"Shore that door and dump more oil on them! Drive these maggots back!" A voice calls from the other side of the door.
L|1||Using the desk⸩ ⸨As you shuffle through the collection of papers a few documents catch your eye. Perhaps if you showed these to Aun Laokhe he could pass the information on to the High Queen.
L|1||Using the desk again⸩ ⸨There appears to be very little else of use here. No new orders appear to have come down to Commander Kamenua.

I will see that Ispar Elysatah is informed of this discovery."⸩ ⸨You've earned 15,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Translator Aun Laokhe tells you, "Farewell budhi."

I will inform Ispar Elysatah of these findings."⸩ ⸨You've earned 15,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Translator Aun Laokhe tells you, "Farewell budhi."

H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to «Londigul Ellic the Armorer» in «Glenden Wood» to be flagged for the quest. L|2|•|⟦glendeninvaderskills⟧ L|2|•|⟦glendeninvadersstarted⟧ L|1|2.|Kill 20 Invaders at the different road blocks (see below), Note, the «Blockade Guard»s do not count towards the killtask, the «Eater»s and «Viamontian Knight»s do. Quest.name: Lunnum's_Disappearance
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|100 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Fiun Gaya» I|Starts At|89.1N, 47.6W near «Eastwatch» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Lunnum's Disappearance» I|Quest Chain|Lunnum I|1|«Lunnum's Pyre» I|2|Lunnum's Disappearance I|3|«Lunnum's Return» H2|Overview L|1|•|You must have completed the «Lunnum's Pyre» Quest before you can start this one. Also, this quest will flag you to do the «Lunnum's Return» (Undead Slayer) quest. L|1|•|{WARN} You have to start this quest before the timer to completing the Pyre quest expires. If you don't you'll need to run the Pyre quest again.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Fiun Gaya» to flag. L|2|•|⟦LunnumsDisappearanceStarted0106⟧ L|1|2.|After learning of the theft of Lunnum, follow the foot tracks north to the «Thief's Encampment» at 90.4N 47.6W. Pick up a «Ruschk Totem», and optionally examine the «Empty Dye Pot» for an additional clue. L|2|•|⟦pickupruschktotem⟧ L|1|3.|Examine the totem for your next location: «Ruschk Camp». Give the Totem to the «Ruschk Camp Leader (NPC)» at 83.2N 54.6W, to receive a «Thief's List». L|1|4.|Going on the name and location in the thief's list, go to «Al-Jalima» and show the list to «Janda Sulifiya» the Mask Maker at 7.4N 4.6E. She'll give you a «Sketch of a Viamontian». L|1|5.|{OPT} Show the sketch to the «Grand Knight» of Sanamar and the «Grand Mother» of Silyun for additional clues. L|1|6.|Show the Sketch to «Fabian Strinjelli» in «Sanamar» at 72.0N 61.1W, who will mention someone called «Andrilos». L|2|•|⟦thrungaldenportal⟧ L|1|7.|{OPT} Go to the Cottage of Andrilos, at 78.6N, 72.2W. There is a note lying on the log next to the door saying "Gone hunting in the Thrungal Den". L|1|8.|Go to the «Thrungal Den» at 79.4N, 71.6W near «Westwatch». L|1|9.|Head south through the corridor and take the next two right hand turns. Next, take all lefts until you reach a large room that slopes downward and take the southwest exit. Finally, make all left hand turns until you reach «Andrilos». L|1|10.|You now a choice when dealing with «Andrilos»: L|2|1.|Talk to Andrilos L|3|•|⟦AndrilosLives⟧ L|2|2.|You can kill Andrilos and take his «Worn Token», which you can hand in for an experience reward - you will **not** receive a bonus reward in the final quest: «Lunnum's Return». L|3|•|{OPT} The Worn Token can also be shown to the Grand Knight and Grand Mother for additional information. L|2|3.|You can show Andrilos the sketch and you will receive information and your experience reward will be earned when you return to Fiun Gaya - you **will** also receive a bonus reward in the final quest: «Lunnum's Return». L|3|•|⟦AndrilosShownSketch⟧ L|3|•|⟦AndrilosAccused⟧ L|1|11.|Return to «Fiun Gaya» and give him the token or speak to him to earn your reward. L|2|•|⟦LunnumsDisappearanceCompleted0106⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "A dark deed must you uncover."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "In the night a thief crept to the Pyre while I slept. Awoke I did, the moment the Pyre was disturbed, but quick and sneaky was the thief. It stayed in darkness, but managed to snatch Lunnum from the light. I raged at the thief, but alas I was too weak to stop it. I remember red eyes and then the fog of dreams."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "My need is to be here and keep the light. Your need is to catch the thief and return Lunnum. Please, find the thief, she must be returned to the light!"
L|1||Ruschk Camp Leader⸩ ⸨As you look into the Leader's eyes you see an image in you mind. A small, funny looking Ruschk sneaks into the tent and takes a totem. Then the Ruschk attack the stranger, but it manages to summon a portal and escape.⸩ ⸨You give Ruschk Camp Leader Ruschk Totem.⸩ ⸨You look into the Ruschk Leader's eyes and he nods and gives you a piece of paper. You suddenly know that the thief dropped this when escaping the Ruschk Camp.⸩ ⸨Ruschk Camp Leader gives you Thief's List.
L|1||Handing in Thief's List to Janda Sulifiya⸩ ⸨You give Janda Sulifiya Thief's List.⸩ ⸨Janda Sulifiya tells you, "Hmmm, yes, I remember a Viamontian came into town looking for me to make a full Ruschk Guise for him. I've never made a full guise of a Ruschk and I must say it didn't turn out so well, but the man seemed pleased. He didn't say much, but I remember his face. Here, I'll make a sketch of him for you."⸩ ⸨Janda Sulifiya gives you Sketch of a Viamontian.⸩ ⸨Janda Sulifiya tells you, "I don't know if it's important, but I just remembered that he summoned a portal to Sanamar after he bought his guise. He made a big show of it too. Haha, As if I've never seen a portal summoning!"
L|1||Showing Sketch of a Viamontian to Fiun Gaya⸩ ⸨You allow Fiun Gaya to examine your Sketch of a Viamontian.⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "This is the thief? This would be the desecrator?"⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "He must pay! He must give us back the Light of the Fiun! He must die! You must take Lunnum back from this foul snatcher of hopes."
L|1||Showing Sketch of a Viamontian to Grand Knight⸩ ⸨You allow Grand Knight to examine your Sketch of a Viamontian.⸩ ⸨Grand Knight tells you, "Yes, I have had dealings with this man. You say he stole a corpse?"⸩ ⸨Grand Knight tells you, "Well, what people do in their spare time is none of my concern."
L|1||Showing Sketch of a Viamontian to Grand Mother⸩ ⸨You allow Grand Mother to examine your Sketch of a Viamontian.⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "Why would you show me this man's sketch?"⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "No matter, I've never seen this shabby man before."
L|1||Showing Sketch of a Viamontian to Fabian Strinjelli⸩ ⸨You allow Fabian Strinjelli to examine your Sketch of a Viamontian.⸩ ⸨Fabian Strinjelli tells you, "Yes, I have seen this man. He shops in town quite often. I believe his name is Andrilos. He lives somewhere in the Northern woods of Lotila Island."
L|1||Talking to Andrilos⸩ ⸨Andrilos tells you, "These fungal growths are facinating. Don't you agree? Collecting and categorizing the fungus in these caves is my hobby. It's important to have a hobby."⸩ ⸨Andrilos tells you, "Did you want to ask me something?"
L|1||Showing Sketch of a Viamontian to Andrilos⸩ ⸨You allow Andrilos to examine your Sketch of a Viamontian.⸩ ⸨Andrilos tells you, "Hmmm, I have to admit that this does look like me, but I was nowhere near Lunumm's Pyre when you say the theft took place. I... I was engaged in a private matter. I can't disclose all of the details or I might endanger other peoples lives, but I assure you that I am not your thief."
L|1||Talking to Andrilos after showing him the sketch the first time⸩ ⸨Andrilos tells you, "I remember you! I won't talk to you. All I will say is that I have been unjustly accused."
L|1||Showing Andrilos the sketch a second time⸩ ⸨You allow Andrilos to examine your Sketch of a Viamontian.⸩ ⸨Andrilos tells you, "I keep telling you, that is not me! Why would I want to take this Lunnum you speak of?"
L|1||Killing Andrilos⸩ ⸨You beat Andrilos to a lifeless pulp!⸩ ⸨Andrilos tells you, "I'm telling you, you have the wrong man. Why do you insist on attacking me."⸩ ⸨Your final blow silences Andrilos and he slumps limply to the cave floor.
L|1||Showing Worn Token to Grand Knight⸩ ⸨You allow Grand Knight to examine your Worn Token.⸩ ⸨Grand Knight tells you, "A hero? A hero wouldn't let a symbol of honor become so damaged. It almost looks like it was worn down on purpose... Who did you say you took this from?"⸩ ⸨Grand Knight tells you, "Hmmm, this bears further investigation. Thank you."
L|1||Showing Worn Token to Grand Mother⸩ ⸨You allow Grand Mother to examine your Worn Token.⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "No, I cannot say I know what this token means. I would think a hero wouldn't give an important token like this away..."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "Where did you find this?"⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "If you are responsible for taking this token from a hero I wouldn't dare show it to anyone else. There might be... repercussions."
L|1||Handing in Worn Token to Fiun Gaya (killed Andrilos)⸩ ⸨You give Fiun Gaya Worn Token.⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "The thief has been slain, but I gain no joy in this. She is still lost and I will die without her light."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "You have done well in finding the snatcher of hope and you deserve what rewards I can give you."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "I have word that Fiun Layeel at the Fiun Outpost whishes to speak with you. Please, leave me now. I must find a way to find her."⸩ ⸨You've earned 14,000,000 experience.
L|1||Speaking with Fiun Gaya (didn't kill Andrilos)⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "You found the thief, but you didn't slay him? I have great respect for life so I can see why you made such a decision. I however do not hold this Andrilos to be worthy of sympathy. He is beneath contempt."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "Be that as it may, you have done what you believe is right and I must respect that. You found the snatcher of hope, but her light is still lost to me."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "I have word that Fiun Layeel at the Fiun Outpost whishes to speak with you. Please, leave me now."⸩ ⸨You've earned 14,000,000 experience.⸩

Quest.name: Path_of_the_Jojii_Adherent
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|35 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Han Rin-Jo, Jojii Adherent» I|Starts At|52.4S, 82.0E in «Nanto» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|This quest gives you the «Font of Jojii» or individual items. Also, it flags you to use hooked fonts to get +2 to Focus, Coordination and Strength.
P|The quest involves collecting three items from three different dungeons, and then finding «Honshu Takeda»: L|1|•|«Path of the Jojii Adherent¦Part 1: Grace of the Unicorn» - Journey to the «Unicorn's Grace» and recover the «Crystals of Grace». Preferred attack: Electrical. L|1|•|«Path of the Jojii Adherent¦Part 2: Splendor of the Firebird» - Journey to the «Firebird's Splendor» and recover the «Rock of Splendor». Preferred attack: Bludgeoning. L|1|•|«Path of the Jojii Adherent¦Part 3: Power of the Dragon» - Journey to the «Dragon's Power» and recover the «Brazier of Power». Preferred attack: Fire. L|1|•|«Path of the Jojii Adherent¦Part 4: Journey's End» - Meet with «Honshu Takeda» and obtain the «Pure Water».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Grace of the Unicorn L|1|1.|Speak with «Han Rin-Jo, Jojii Adherent» in Nanto. L|2|•|⟦EmptySoul⟧ L|1|2.|Go outside from Han Rin-Jo's building, and find the «Nanto Jojii Shrine» at 53.1S, 81.1E. Double click on the «Scrawled Note (Jojii)¦Scrawled Note» next to it. L|1|3.|While in «Nanto» you can also talk to «Ikomi Ra, Jojii Adherent» at 49.1S, 81.7E, but it isn't necessary to proceed with the quest. L|1|4.|Go to «Sawato» and find the «Sawato Jojii Shrine» in town (28.7S, 59.2E). The shrine has an NPC blip (yellow dot on radar), so using the [ and ] keys for normal items does not work, use + and - to find it. Double click to get the «Unicorn's Grace (Text)¦Unicorn's Grace» text. L|2|•|⟦EmptySoulUnicorn⟧ L|1|5.|Take the «Ayn Tayan» portal from Sawato hub at 27.2S, 59.9E and run to «Unicorn's Grace» at 38.0S, 60.2E. L|1|6.|Head (S)W till you find a ramp down to the left, and a door. one ramp down, there's a room with the «Crystal Formation». L|1|7.|Double click it and you get the «Crystals of Grace». L|2|•|⟦EmptySoulCrystal⟧ L|2|•|The text, «Unicorn's Cavern (Text)¦Unicorn's Cavern», is also found here.
H3|Part 2: Splendor of the Firebird L|1|1.|Go to «Lin», find the «Lin Jojii Shrine» (54.3S, 73.1E), double click it to get the note, «Firebird's Splendor (Text)¦Firebird's Splendor». L|2|•|⟦EmptySoulFirebird⟧ L|1|2.|You can now enter «Firebird's Splendor» at 53.6S, 66.7E near «Lin». L|1|3.|When inside the dungeon go south, down a ramp and then left. L|1|4.|You come to a more or less circular area (maze). L|1|5.|Follow right hand rule till that rule drops you at a dead end (and 2 grated rooms). Turn 180 degrees and find a room with 2 grates and a non-grated exit to the S, and go S. L|1|6.|Follow right hand rule again, till you find a wooden door, behind it a room, another wooden door. L|1|7.|Go right (to your left is a portal), and down the stairs till you hit the lava-hallways, in the pit is the «Smooth Rocks». L|1|8.|Double click on it, you get the «Rock of Splendor». L|2|•|⟦EmptySoulOrb⟧ L|2|•|The text, «Stone of the Firebird (Text)¦Stone of the Firebird», is also found here.
H3|Part 3: Power of the Dragon L|1|1.|Go to «Kara», find «Miko Li, Jojii Adherent» in the tavern at 83.3S, 47.2E. L|2|•|⟦EmptySoulDragon⟧ L|1|2.|This flag you to enter «Dragon's Power» at 82.3S, 41.4E recallable, on the top of mountain again. L|1|3.|Hug the left wall till you find a ramp down to the E. Through a few rooms and up a ramp with an intersection. L|1|4.|Straight, left, head N, till you can go down 2 ramps again. Another room, at intersection go left. L|1|5.|Double click the «Smoldering Brazier» and you will get the «Brazier of Power». L|2|•|⟦EmptySoulShield⟧ L|2|•|The text, «Journey's End», is also found here.
H3|Part 4: Journey's End L|1|1.|Find «Honshu Takeda» at 77.7S, 59.2E. L|1|2.|Take the Xinh settlement portal at 60.8S, 80.3E from «Mayoi». You'll exit at 78.4S, 60.2E, and run a bit NW up a hill to Honshu. He will give you «Pure Water». L|2|•|⟦EmptySoulComplete⟧ L|2|•|⟦EmptySoulZen⟧ L|2|•|Note: By receiving the «Pure Water», you are now flagged to use any hooked «Font of Jojii». L|1|3.|You can use the «Pure Water» on either 3 of the objects, or on the combination of the three to create a «Font of Jojii» housing item. The Font of Jojii can be hooked on a yard or floor hook within a house.
H4|Creating the Font of Jojii L|1|•|Use the «Brazier of Power» on the «Crystals of Grace» to create «Grace and Power» L|1|•|Use the «Grace and Power» on the «Rock of Splendor» to create «Power, Grace and Splendor» L|1|•|Use the «Pure Water» on the «Power, Grace and Splendor» to create «Font of Jojii»
H4|Creating Sollerets, Orb or Shield L|1|•|Use the «Pure Water» on the following items: L|2|•|«Crystals of Grace» to create «Sollerets of Grace» L|2|•|«Rock of Splendor» to create «Orb of Splendor» L|2|•|«Brazier of Power» to create «Shield of Power»
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Unicorn's Grace» 38.0S, 60.2E -- «map:6449¦6449» TR|«Firebird's Splendor» 53.6S, 66.7E -- «map:6449¦6449» TR|«Dragon's Power» 82.3S, 41.4E -- «map:6449¦6449» TE
H2|Rewards L|1|•|Ability to use the «Font of Jojii» when hooked within a house.
H3|Items L|1|•|«Font of Jojii»
P|or one of the following items: L|1|•|«Sollerets of Grace» L|1|•|«Orb of Splendor» L|1|•|«Shield of Power»
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Han Rin-Jo's opening dialog⸩ ⸨Han Rin-Jo, Jojii Adherent tells you, "Sit, Please."⸩ ⸨Han Rin-Jo, Jojii Adherent tells you, "In my life, I have seen a great many wonders that have challenged my beliefs, and driven me near the edge of forsaking all that I had known. But in Jojii, I have found the virtuous path."⸩ ⸨Han Rin-Jo, Jojii Adherent tells you, "Not so long ago, another came to me. He was as accomplished as you, more so perhaps. What he had accomplished is not as important as what he had learned."⸩ ⸨Han Rin-Jo, Jojii Adherent tells you, "His name is Honshu Takeda, and he has begun to learn about himself and the way of Jojii. He had lost his way, and I have set him back upon his path. He will follow the shrines to Jojii. The first lies within this very town, just beyond these doors between the trees."⸩ ⸨Han Rin-Jo, Jojii Adherent tells you, "His journey will end in Kara. Much wisdom can be garnered by following the path and incorporating the lessons of the four stones in your actions."⸩ ⸨Han Rin-Jo, Jojii Adherent tells you, "Should you wish to follow in his steps, seek the shrine and pray as I am sure he has done."
L|1||Ikomi Ra's dialog after speaking to Han Rin-Jo⸩ ⸨Ikomi Ra, Jojii Adherent tells you, "I have met the man you seek, this Honshu Takeda. He is a good man. He will find his way back to the path of right living. I have sent him to seek grace at the shrine in Sawato. Perhaps if you pray, as he likely did, at the shrine you will see grace as well."
L|1||Using the shrine in Sawato⸩ ⸨As you sit and pray at the small shrine you see a small note resting on the top. You take the note.
L|1||Using the Crystal Formation⸩ ⸨You amass a small collection of crystals that link together, looking much like sollerets. The crystals come apart as easily as they can be put together.
L|1||Using Crystal Formation again⸩ ⸨The crystals that you collected within the past day have not reformed. Perhaps if you wait just a short while longer you will be able to find more.
L|1||Using the shrine in Lin⸩ ⸨As you sit and pray at the small shrine you see a small note resting on the top. You take the note.
L|1||Using the Smooth Rocks⸩ ⸨The rocks appear to be too large to carry. However, as you search through them you see one that has been formed into a perfectly smooth sphere, about the size of an orb.
L|1||Using the Smooth Rocks again⸩ ⸨The rocks are all too large. You found a smooth stone here within the past day. Perhaps if a little more time passes another such stone will be created by the shifting magma.
L|1||Miko Li's opening dialog:⸩ ⸨Miko Li, Jojii Adherent tells you, "You seek the power of the dragon, as did Honshu. Very well. I shall tell you were he was sent. In the valley, across the stretch of land, and water. Through the hills that bite, atop the crest where the sun sets, there is a portal into the place where the Dragon's flame smolders in a basin of metal. Honshu went there to find the Dragon's power."⸩ ⸨Miko Li, Jojii Adherent tells you, "Go there and find the strength that I hope he found."
L|1||Using the Smoldering Brazier⸩ ⸨The curvature of the metal basin is perfect for a shield. As you sift the coals and ashes aside you can tell that the heat from the burning embers has created this perfect object.
L|1||Using the Smoldering Brazier again⸩ ⸨The heat from the embers has not burned long enough. The metal is too cool and has not taken on the perfect curvature yet. Perhaps it will take a day for the embers to bend the metal.
L|1||Honshu Takeda's quest completion dialog⸩ ⸨Honshu Takeda tells you, "You have done well to find the power of the Dragon."⸩ ⸨Honshu Takeda tells you, "You have done well to find the power of the Firebird."⸩ ⸨Honshu Takeda tells you, "You have traveled the same path as I, and learned the lessons of the great spirits. Now you must know how they fit together."⸩ ⸨Honshu Takeda tells you, "The base is the Dragon's power. The grace of the Unicorn must be spread within. The splendor of the Firebird can be placed atop the combination of strength and grace but...only with pure water that represents the four stones and the path of Jojii can you bring the object to life."⸩ ⸨Honshu Takeda tells you, "Here, take this."⸩ ⸨Honshu Takeda gives you Pure Water.⸩ ⸨Honshu Takeda tells you, "The water can be used to waken the combined spirit of the three, or to awaken the strength of just one. I would advise against waking just one. There is little that can be finished that is not complete."
L|1||Honshu Takeda's repeated dialog after quest completion⸩ ⸨Honshu Takeda tells you, "You have completed your journey. Allow time for the teachings to be set within your being. If within one day you are still without direction, follow my path again, and I shall teach the steps anew."
L|1||Honshu Takeda's item examination dialog⸩ ⸨You allow Honshu Takeda to examine your Crystals of Grace.⸩ ⸨Honshu Takeda tells you, "These crystals must be laid into the Dragon's protective arms. Place them within the brazier. If you choose to use them alone, you can anoint them with the water I have given you, but you will not find completeness."⸩ ⸨You allow Honshu Takeda to examine your Rock of Splendor.⸩ ⸨Honshu Takeda tells you, "This should placed atop the crystals that have been laid into the brazier that represents the Dragon's power. Place it atop the crystals and brazier. You can choose to anoint this stone with the water I have given you, but you will not find completeness."⸩ ⸨You allow Honshu Takeda to examine your Brazier of Power.⸩ ⸨Honshu Takeda tells you, "The brazier represents the power of the Dragon a shield and defense for the Unicorn and Firebird. You can place the crystals within the Brazier. If you so choose, you may alter this with the water I have given you, but you will not find completeness."⸩ ⸨You allow Honshu Takeda to examine your Pure Water.⸩ ⸨Honshu Takeda tells you, "Anoint the combines pieces that represent the Dragon, Firebird and Unicorn to find a center for yourself. If you choose to anoint a single item you may release the magical properties within the item but you will still find yourself empty."
L|1||Creating the Sollerets of Grace⸩ ⸨As the water spreads over the crystals they take on the shape of sollerets.
L|1||Creating the Orb of Splendor P|As the stone drinks the water it takes on a splendorous appearance.
L|1||Creating the Shield of Power⸩ ⸨As the water pours over the brazier it hardens into a shield with a symbol of the dragon at its center.
L|1||Creating the Font of Jojii⸩ ⸨You sprinkle the crystals into the basin, preparing them for the perfect stone.⸩ ⸨You place the stone atop the crystals and are filled with a warm feeling. It is missing one final element.⸩ ⸨You pour the water over the crystals and a magical change takes place.
L|1||Using the Font of Jojii prior to completing the quest⸩ ⸨You fail to reach an enlightened state.
L|1||Using the Font of Jojii after completing the quest⸩ ⸨You have reached an enlightened state.⸩ L|1||Font of Jojii cast «Splendor of the Firebird» on you L|1||Font of Jojii cast «Grace of the Unicorn» on you L|1||Font of Jojii cast «Power of the Dragon» on you

Quest.name: Releasing_Jester
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|160 I|Type|Small Fellowship I|Starts At|«Graveyard» at 64.9S 44.1W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Quest Chain|The Jester I|1|«Lord Mhoire Quest» I|2|Releasing Jester I|3|«Jester Released» P|See also| «Jester»
H2|Overview L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|This quest coincides with, and requires completion of, the «Lord Mhoire Quest» (GY Colo) to obtain the key. L|1|•|{WARN} Due to the timer on «Jester Prison Key», you have 20 hours (real time) to complete Releasing Jester before the key crumbles to dust.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Return to «Jester's Prison» and give the key to the door to be portaled to the next section. Note that every person must have a key to get to the next section! L|2|•|{OPT} You can skip doing the dungeon portion of part 1 by giving the wall at the drop Laylana's Love Letter. However, the quest rewards are different and this does not flag you to do part 2 if you have never completed part 1. L|1|2.|Move through the dungeon and use switches to open doors, ignoring the lifeless guardians. Eventually, you'll come to a door with a switch in a side room that is stuck. Nearby is another wall on the radar that you can talk to. Give the wall «Laylana's Love Letter», this will activate the nearby switch and also cause the guardians in the dungeon to attack you. L|2|•|⟦GaveJesterLetter⟧ L|1|3.|Continue moving through the dungeon. You will encounter several rooms with switches you must pull in a progressive order. See the map for details. Each alcove room typically has 2 switches, one that opens the next alcove in the sequence, and one that reopens the door to that alcove. L|1|4.|Eventually you will reach the trap hallway with the arcane pyramids. These pyramids are usually a quick death if you get hit. They are the same pyramids as the ones on the «Empyrean Rescue Quest» and «Hoshino Must Die». Watch the pattern of pyramids as they come down the hall and zigzag to the safe side hallways as you move forward. L|2|•|⟦JesterReachedHallway⟧ L|1|5.|The door in the next room ("Jester's Cell") will portal you to the final room (safe drop). L|2|•|⟦JesterReachedCell⟧ L|2|•|Note that if you die, you can easily get back by using the «Jester's Prison» portal again in Graveyard. Answer 'Yes' when prompted to return. L|1|6.|Kill the pillar in the middle of the final room («Jester's Entombment Wall»). The pillar can be vuln'd before attacking. When it reaches 50% health, the Jester will summmon some guardians to attack you. Once the pillar dies, the Jester will be freed and will spawn nearby. L|2|•|{TIP} If you die in the last room, you can easily get back by using the «Jester's Prison» portal in Graveyard and answering 'Yes'. L|1|7.|Speak to the Jester **two times** to receive all possible rewards. L|2|•|⟦FreedJester⟧ L|1|8.|Return to «Laylana» and speak to her for the remaining rewards. L|2|•|⟦JesterCanDoPart2⟧ L|2|•|⟦JesterPart1Wait⟧

R|Release «Jester» and speak to «Laylana» RK|Experience|400,000,000 (20% up to level 200) RK|Luminance|10,000 RK|Title|Jester's Emanicpator RE
R|Give «Arcane Pyramid» to the «Jailer» (20 hour timer) RK|Items| RI|«Ancient Mhoire Coin» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Jailer tells you, "Begone! Only Lord Cynreft may visit the prisoner."⸩ ⸨Jailer tells you, "You have not heard of the prisoner? So powerful and so very mad. Once he entertained the court of Mhoire with his antics, but that was before the betrayal. Now he is imprisoned here for all time."⸩ ⸨Jailer tells you, "Go now. You have no business here."
L|1||Giving Laylana's Love Letter to Wall⸩ ⸨You give Wall Laylana's Love Letter.⸩ ⸨A very loud whisper can be heard coming from the hole in the wall. "Thanks for the letter! Things get kind of crazy in here sometimes, but I can hold on now that I know she still loves me."⸩ ⸨The Jester tells you, "Psst! You can go on just a bit further into the prison and help me out. It's not that dangerous really. Just a little deadly. Find my entombment wall and knock it down. That's all, just a little demolition and I'll be out of your hair. It's really not asking too much is it?"
L|1||The Jester⸩ ⸨The Jester says, "I would have gotten out on my own, but Cynreft wouldn't let me bring my hammer and chisel."⸩ ⸨The Jester says, "Hey, I'm trying to sleep! Keep it down!"⸩ ⸨The Jester says, "My music wasn't that loud!"⸩ ⸨The Jester says, "How many adventurers does it take to knock down a wall?"⸩ ⸨The Jester says, "Show that wall who the wall bully is!"⸩ ⸨The Jester says, "Go Team, Go! Knock away that stupid wall! You the best fighter or wizard or archer of them all!"⸩ ⸨You flatten Jester's Entombment Wall's body with the force of your assault!⸩ ⸨The wall crumbles and something flashes by you. Mad giggling fills the room.⸩ ⸨Jester says, "Wahoo! I'm free! I'm free!"⸩ ⸨Jester says, "Boy it feels good to stretch my legs!"
L|1||Speaking to Laylana after failing/choosing not to release Jester⸩ ⸨Laylana tells you, "Thank you for delivering my letter to my love."⸩ ⸨Laylana leans forward and gives you a ghostly kiss on the cheek.⸩ ⸨Laylana tells you, "I only ask you this because I know my love must have had a good reason for what he did. He was loyal to Lord Cynreft, I know it."⸩ ⸨Laylana bows her head in grief.⸩ ⸨Laylana tells you, "Yes, I respect your decision to abide by Lord Cynreft's wishes."⸩ ⸨Laylana tells you, "You should be rewarded for all you have done for me."⸩ ⸨You've earned 183,173,667 experience.
L|1||Speaking to Jester after releasing him⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Thanks friend! You really did me a favor. Hmmm, what could I do for you. Hey did you ever wonder what it would be like to have six arms? Tentacles? Feelers?"⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Eh, too much trouble. Here take this Pal."⸩ ⸨Jester gives you Arcane Pyramid.
L|1||Speaking to Jester a second time after releasing him⸩ ⸨The Jester waggles his finger in your face.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Naughty naughty! You tried to trick your old pal the Jester! I already gave you a present! You need to learn a lesson little one."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "This will hurt you more than it hurts me."⸩ ⸨The Jester halls back and punches you in the head. Leaving the Title, "Jester's Fool", stamped there.
L|1||Speaking to Laylana after freeing the Jester⸩ ⸨Laylana tells you, "My love is free! You have set my soul to rest my dear. May others know you as I do, the "Jester's Emancipator.""⸩ ⸨You've earned 198,157,237 experience.⸩ ⸨Laylana sighs in relief.⸩ ⸨Laylana tells you, "My love can prove his innocence now. We shall be together again someday. Thank you for your help dear."
L|1||Giving Arcane Pyramid to Jailer⸩ ⸨You give Jailer Arcane Pyramid.⸩ ⸨Jailer tells you, "Oh, it won't do to have these things in everyones hands."⸩ ⸨Jailer tells you, "Here take this instead."⸩ ⸨Jailer gives you Ancient Mhoire Coin.
L|1||Other Interactions⸩ ⸨You notice a marker on the door. "This door sealed by order of Lord Cynreft."⸩

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog L|1||Lady Dan'eel Trianna's Task⸩ ⸨Lady Dan'eel Trianna tells you, "Greetings, I am known as Lady Dan'eel Trianna. I am a researcher in the newly reforming Lyceum at Knorr. I have been sent here by Lord Asheron to enlist help in the gathering of several components needed in a ritual of exceptional importance."⸩ ⸨Lady Dan'eel Trianna tells you, "A group of noble, but foolhardy individuals attempted to aid Prince Borelean in an exceptionally dangerous ritual to bring his lost wife, Hoshino Kei, back from the dead. To do this, they used the Book of Eibhil to 'resurrect' her. Each participant sacrificed a portion of their spirit in order to fuel the ritual."⸩ ⸨Lady Dan'eel Trianna tells you, "This unfortunately led to them raising Hoshino Kei as a spectre and an Avatar of the Book itself, while also corrupting all of the participants in the ritual."⸩ ⸨Lady Dan'eel Trianna tells you, "Five of the participants withered soon after the ritual's completion, also raising back up as spirits of terrible power. The remainder are also beginning to wither in the same fashion."⸩ ⸨Lady Dan'eel Trianna tells you, "As their sacrifices were willing, there is a chance to undo the damage that was done. To that end, Lord Asheron tasked us with researching the lost rituals of the Light Falatacot. We have located a ritual that may heal these individuals, or at least keep the corruption at bay until we can find a more permanent solution."⸩ ⸨Lady Dan'eel Trianna tells you, "The ritual itself is tied to a legend about four sisters. Each sister governed over an aspect of the world. Together, the four could cleanse any corruption and heal the very spirit. Each sister had something that was considered sacred to them, and when the four materials are brought together, they can be used in rituals for healing the spirit."⸩ ⸨Lady Dan'eel Trianna tells you, "As we are trying to reconstruct these rituals from only scraps of information, we cannot guarantee their success, but it is somewhere to start."⸩ ⸨Lady Dan'eel Trianna tells you, "To aid us in this, I am prepared to reward Adventurers of sufficient experience for their efforts in collecting 10 pieces of Alb'arean Ore. Alb'arean Ore was sacred to the third sister, who was considered the Lady of Twilight and Rest. We've been able to locate a supply of this ore in the area held by the Gearknights along the Inner Sea."⸩ ⸨Lady Dan'eel Trianna tells you, "I have been authorized by the Lyceum to reward each adventurer who helps me only once per week. The ore can be unstable, and we're trying to take only enough to perform the necessary rituals at any given point."

Quest.name: Rynthid_Artifact_Collection
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Rec. Level|200+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«The Bringer of Light» I|Starts At|«Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|At the «Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains», «The Bringer of Light» requests that you complete 3 tasks related to the Rynthid and their artifacts. Collecting them requires that you visit each of the progressive dungeons on the platforms in the «Rynthid Infested Plains». 2 of the artifacts require completing a kill task, the other requires picking up items that spawn randomly on the ground.
P|The rewards for this quest are split evenly between the 3 individual tasks with a bonus for completing all 3. Partial rewards are available for only completing 1 or 2 of the tasks.
H2|Walkthrough L|1|1.|{OPT} Speak to «The Bringer of Light» at the «Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains». L|1|2.|Head up the platforms on the «Rynthid Infested Plains» and enter the «Path of Torment» portal. L|2|•|{WARN} Hot drop! L|2|•|Note: This is the same portal used for the «Rynthid Genesis» and «Defeating the Curator of Torment» quests.
H3|Artifact 1: Tormented Shadow Kill Task L|1|1.|In the dungeon, find the room with a small red crystal NPC and talk to it to be given a kill task to kill 20 «Tormented Shadow»s. L|2|•|⟦KillTaskTormentedShadowsStarted⟧ L|2|•|⟦KillTaskTormentedShadows⟧ L|2|•|⟦KillTaskTormentedShadows on first completion⟧ L|2|•|Route: Turn left after entering the dungeon and search the rooms on the left. The room the crystal is in has 2 paths leading into it. L|2|•|{WARN} Talking to the crystal a second time before completing the kill task will spawn nearby Rynthid enemies! L|2|•|Note: The kill task can be completed within any dungeon on the Rynthid Infested Plains. Kills outside do not count toward the kill task. L|1|2.|After killing 20 Tormented Shadows, talk to the crystal again to be given a crystal artifact. L|2|•|⟦KillTaskTormentedShadowsWait⟧
H3|Artifact 2: Enraged Shadow Kill Task L|1|1.|Work your way through the dungeon and find the portal for the «Platforms of Torment». L|1|2.|Back on the platforms, go straight down the ramp to the large platform, then turn left. L|1|3.|Take the ramp straight ahead, then turn left again up the ramp and into the «Path of Rage» portal. L|1|4.|Again you must locate a red crystal NPC in the dungeon. It is located in a dead end room. When you reach the first large room, take the paths on the right to reach it. L|1|5.|The crystal gives a kill task for 20 «Enraged Shadow»s. L|2|•|⟦KillTaskEnragedShadowsStarted⟧ L|2|•|⟦KillTaskEnragedShadows⟧ L|2|•|⟦KillTaskEnragedShadows on first completion⟧ L|2|•|{WARN} Talking to the crystal a second time before completing the kill task will spawn Rynthid, similar to the first crystal. L|1|6.|Complete the kill task, then talk to the crystal again to be given a 2nd crystal artifact. L|2|•|⟦KillTaskEnragedShadowsWait⟧
H3|Artifact 3: Wisp Collection L|1|1.|Continue through the dungeon until you reach the «Platforms of Rage» portal. L|2|•|{WARN} Very hot drop! Running recommended! L|1|2.|From the drop, run straight ahead to the ramp across the platform. L|1|3.|Take the ramp down, then turn right and follow another ramp down. L|1|4.|Do a half power jump to the platform nearby which has a floating crystal decoration in the middle of it. L|1|5.|Take the nearby portal for the «Path of Sorrow». L|1|6.|This dungeon is linear and randomly spawns «Wisp of Corrupted Emotion» on the ground. You need to collect 10 of them. L|2|•|Note: Typically there are between 2-5 wisps on the ground per run through the dungeon. So you will need to either visit multiple times or return to the dungeon drop and wait for more to spawn. The dungeon is log-able, so you can log out to wait for more to spawn if desired.
H3|Rewards L|1|1.|At any time after completing an artifact, return to the «Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains». L|1|2.|Give «The Bringer of Light» each crystal artifact and the 10 wisps for 25,000,000 experience, 5,000 luminance, and 1 «Durable Legendary Key» each. L|1|3.|Turning in all 3 artifacts gives an additional 3,000 luminance and the title "«Purifier»". L|2|•|⟦RynthidArtifacts1_0813⟧ L|2|•|⟦RynthidArtifacts2_0813⟧ L|2|•|⟦RynthidArtifacts3_0813⟧ L|2|•|⟦RynthidArtifactsWait_0813⟧
H2|Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Path of Torment» 62.1S, 65.8W -- -- TR|«Path of Rage» 62.1S, 65.8W -- -- TR|«Path of Sorrow» ?? -- -- TE
H2|Rewards
R| RK|Experience|75,000,000 RK|Luminance|18,000 RK|Title|Purifier RK|Items| RI|«Durable Legendary Key» (x3) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨The The Bringer of Light looks you up and down dismissively, and then nods to himself.⸩ ⸨The Bringer of Light tells you, "You'll do. I'm in need of additional bodies in my hunt of the corruption the Rynthid are spreading into this 'Dereth' place."⸩ ⸨The Bringer of Light tells you, "I have been sent by the Council to contain or eliminate the corruption spread by the Rynthid's presence in this... physical world of yours."⸩ ⸨The Bringer of Light tells you, "I care not for the Rynthid's activities on or above the surface. They are not my appointed task. Underground, however, the Rynthid hide their more questionable works."⸩ ⸨The Bringer of Light tells you, "I have three tasks your frame looks capable of accomplishing."⸩ ⸨The Bringer of Light tells you, "The first two tasks are similar. In both the Path of Torment and the Path of Rage, there are corrupted crystals. These crystals are gathering and harnessing the emotional energies harvested from entities you call Shadows, which have been corrupted by the Rynthid for this purpose."⸩ ⸨The Bringer of Light tells you, "Find them, do what you must to weaken them, and bring me a shard of each of them to study. For this, I will reward you."⸩ ⸨The Bringer of Light tells you, "The third task is simpler. In the Path of Sorrows, many have spotted Wisps of Corrupted Emotion.⸩ ⸨Bring me 10 of them, so they can be used to weaken the Rynthid's hold on your world."⸩ ⸨The Bringer of Light tells you, "Complete all three of these tasks, and I may have something extra for you."⸩

Quest.name: Shroud_of_Emotion
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Rinne Gorber» I|Starts At|«Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains» at 61.6S, 63.3W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Spirited Halls» H2|Overview P|Investigate the «Rynthid Infested Plains» for evidence of strange emotional energy.
L|1|•|The dungeon for this quest is on the third set of platforms at the Rynthid Infested Plains. Getting to the dungeon is the most dangerous part of this quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Ascending the Platforms L|1|1.|To begin this quest, speak with «Rinne Gorber» at 61.6S, 63.3W at the «Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains». L|2|•|Route: Use «Rynthid Recall» or take the «Dangerous Portal Device» from a mansion to Center of the «Obsidian Plains». L|2|•|⟦SpiritedStarted_0813⟧ L|1|2.|To gain entrance to the quest dungeon, you will need to make your way up the floating platforms and through a series of dungeons on the Rynthid Infested Plains. L|1|3.|To begin the climb, run to the access ramp located at 62.5S, 65.4W. At the third platform, perform a full power jump to the south. Then go west one platform, north two platforms, then west again to the «Path of Torment» portal at 62.1S, 65.8W. L|1|4.|Inside, you will need to make you way to the «Platforms of Torment» portal at the end of the dungeon. The dungeon is filled with Rynthid Virindi and their helpers. L|1|5.|Begin by going through the large room and heading west. Take the south tunnel, followed by going west at the next split. Head northeast through the next large room and exit this room through the east tunnel. From there, turn right and head south and follow the hall until you come to a room with the «Platforms of Torment» portal. L|1|6.|Back outside on the platforms, head down the ramp and then left. Head up the ramp ahead and turn left up another ramp to the «Path of Rage» portal. The drop is safe. L|1|7.|Inside the «Path of Rage» you will need to make your way to the end of the dungeon to the «Platforms of Rage» portal. L|1|8.|Proceed south through the 1st large room, exiting to the east. Continue east to another large room where you will take the 1st exit on the left (heading east). Stay east again at the split, and follow the halls to the «Platforms of Rage» portal ({WARN} unsafe drop point). L|1|9.|Outside, quickly head south and into the «Spirited Halls» portal straight ahead!
H3|Part 2: Collecting the Shrouds L|1|1.|Next is a series of dungeons each leading to a mini boss. There are 4 dungeons and bosses total. L|1|2.|The first dungeon is entirely linear. Make your way to the end where you will find a portal. L|1|3.|Go through the portal to begin the first boss fight with the «Apparition of Bloodlust». He is weak to cold and accompanied several «Deadly Spirit»s which die easily but cast a fire ring spell on death. Beware of being fire vulned when killing them! When the Apparition dies, loot a «Shroud of Bloodlust» (drops 9), then exit through the portal that spawns. L|2|•|⟦ShroudBloodlustPickup⟧ L|2|•|Note: The Deadly Spirits will respawn if the fight lasts for a long time. L|1|4.|The second dungeon is also linear. Whether you choose to go east or west at the path splits does not matter, just keep moving north through the dungeon until you come to another portal. L|1|5.|Through the portal is the second boss fight with the «Apparition of Apathy». He is weak to fire and has several «Pillar of Frost»s that spawn with him. Be sure to take out the pillars first as they can be dangerous. Kill him and loot a «Shroud of Apathy» then take the portal that spawns. L|2|•|⟦ShroudApathyPickup⟧ L|2|•|Note: If attempting the quest alone or with a small group, you can back up from the drop and move into one of the corners. From here, only 1 of the pillars can shoot spells at you. The boss will eventually come and attack you. Stay dispelled to avoid taking major cold damage from the spells. L|1|6.|The third dungeon is not linear like the previous 2. Head west from the drop, take the path south, take the 2nd hallway going west, then head east to the portal. L|1|7.|Beyond it is the third boss, the «Apparition of Envy», who is weak to lightning. He spawns with several «Acidic Tendril»s. Beware of missile attacks and void magic during the fight. Kill the Apparition for a «Shroud of Envy» then take the portal that spawns. L|2|•|⟦ShroudEnvyPickup⟧ L|1|8.|The fourth dungeon is entirely linear again. Towards the end of the dungeon, you reach 4 long rooms that shoot wall spells as you run through them. Each of these rooms corresponds to one of the four elements and has a Virindi («Flame Spirit», «Acidic Spirit») before it which casts the corresponding vuln spell. Be careful if you get vulned. L|1|9.|Eventually you will come to a portal, leading to the final boss, the «Apparition of Spite». He is weak to acid, but also counterbuffs when debuffed. He spawns with «Malicious Spirit»s, Rynthid Virindi similar to the ones in the first boss, except that they cast lightning ring spells on death instead of fire. Kill the last boss for a «Shroud of Spite», then take the portal that spawns. L|2|•|⟦ShroudSpitePickup⟧ L|1|10.|You will find yourself in a room with legendary chests, and 4 large crystal "Annex". Each crystal is colored to match the shroud that you need to hand to it. Make sure you hand the correct shroud to the correct annex! L|2|•|«Ruby Annex»: «Shroud of Bloodlust» L|2|•|⟦SpiritedBloodlust⟧ L|2|•|«Amethyst Annex»: «Shroud of Spite» L|2|•|⟦SpiritedSpite⟧ L|2|•|«Jade Annex»: «Shroud of Envy» L|2|•|⟦SpiritedEnvy⟧ L|2|•|«Sapphire Annex»: «Shroud of Apathy» L|2|•|⟦SpiritedApathy⟧ L|1|11.|Upon handing in the final Shroud, you will be rewarded with a 2 use «Legendary Key» and a «Spirit Crystal». L|2|•|Note: The surface portal in the middle of the room is not a safe drop! It will drop you on the third set of platforms again. L|1|12.|Return the «Spirit Crystal» to «Rinne Gorber» at 61.6S, 63.3W for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦SpiritedCompleted_0813⟧

H2|Rewards
R| RK|Experience|250,000,000 RK|Luminance|20,000 RK|Items| RI|One random necklace: RI|«Spirited Spite Guard» RI|«Spirited Envy Guard» RI|«Spirited Apathy Guard» RI|«Spirited Bloodlust Guard» RI|«Legendary Key» (2 uses) RI|«Trade Note (250,000)» (x9) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Rinne appears to be engrossed in thought. He smiles as he notices your presence.⸩ ⸨Rinne Gorber tells you, "Why hello there. With such a drastic change to the Obsidian Plains by our new visitors, it's of little surprise that a surge of strange and unnatural activity has permeated the area."⸩ ⸨Rinne Gorber tells you, "The energy I am detecting from the area is riddled with feelings of destruction, jealousy and malice. There are forces at work here that we can't yet hope to understand."⸩ ⸨Rinne Gorber tells you, "This is why I am here, to learn all I can from the spirits that now reside here. But I can't hope to do this alone, I am a scholar not a warrior and the Rynthid would tear me to pieces."⸩ ⸨Rinne Gorber tells you, "If you can find the source of these spirits, retrieve any artifacts or relics and bring them to me. I will reward you handsomely for your efforts."
L|1||Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨You allow Ruby Annex to examine your Shroud of Bloodlust.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Shroud of Bloodlusts.⸩ ⸨The Shroud of Bloodlust dissolves into the Ruby Annex.⸩ ⸨You allow Amethyst Annex to examine your Shroud of Spite.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Shroud of Spites.⸩ ⸨The Shroud of Spite dissolves into the Amethyst Annex.⸩ ⸨You allow Jade Annex to examine your Shroud of Envy.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Shroud of Envys.⸩ ⸨The Shroud of Envy dissolves into the Jade Annex.⸩ ⸨You allow Sapphire Annex to examine your Shroud of Apathy.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Shroud of Apathys.⸩ ⸨A tiny piece of the Annex and a small key fall to the floor. An irresistable urge compels you to pick them up.⸩ ⸨Sapphire Annex gives you Spirit Crystal.⸩ ⸨Sapphire Annex gives you Legendary Key.⸩ ⸨Rinne Gorber tells you, "I am bubbling with anticipation! What have you discovered about the increased unusual activity in the area?"⸩ ⸨You allow Rinne Gorber to examine your Spirit Crystal.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Spirit Crystals.⸩ ⸨Rinne Gorber tells you, "How magnificent! This crystal is teaming with incredible power!"⸩ ⸨Rinne takes the crystal and closes his eyes. He begins to whisper softly to himself as he clasps both hands tightly around the Spirit Crystal.⸩ ⸨Rinne Gorber tells you, "The horror! Such unspeakable evil! Only with the assistance of my guardian spirits was I able to take something so vile and create something so beautiful."⸩ ⸨Rinne Gorber tells you, "May this item guide and protect you from the wicked influences of this plagued land."⸩ ⸨Rinne Gorber gives you Spirited Bloodlust Guard.⸩ ⸨You've earned 264,999,985 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 21,199 Luminance.⸩ ⸨Rinne Gorber gives you 9 Trade Notes (250,000).
L|1||Other Interactions⸩ ⸨A portal appears in the center of the chamber as scraps of cloth from the Apparition flutter to the ground.⸩ ⸨The Apparition of Apathy appears unimpressed at your presence. With a wave of its hand the temperature in the chamber quickly drops.⸩ ⸨A portal appears in the center of the chamber as scraps of cloth from the Apparition flutter to the ground.⸩ ⸨A maniacal laugh comes from the Apparition of Envy as you enter the room.⸩ ⸨A portal appears in the center of the chamber as scraps of cloth from the Apparition flutter to the ground.⸩ ⸨The Apparition of Spite whispers, "Welcome friend, I have something just for you..."⸩ ⸨A portal appears in the center of the chamber as scraps of cloth from the Apparition flutter to the ground.⸩

Quest.name: Silifi_of_Crimson_Stars_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|10 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Leikotha» I|Starts At|«Leikotha's Crypt» at 10.1S, 31.3E I|Route|«Samsur» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Reclaim a lost relic of Ispar, the Silifi of Crimson Stars.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Crafting the Silifi L|1|1.|Visit «Leikotha's Crypt» at 10.1S 31.3E. Once inside, Speak to «Leikotha» to obtain a «Broken Haft». L|2|•|Route: From «Samsur», take the «Yinar» portal at 0.9S, 18.9E. From there, run west (and slightly south) to the crypt at 10.1S 31.3E. L|2|•|⟦CrimsonBrokenHaft@2⟧ L|1|2.|Next, visit «Kayna bint Iswas» in «Kayna bint Iswas' Home¦her home» at 1.7S, 36.6E. Hand your «Broken Haft» to Kayna to receive a «Repaired Haft» and the text, «Notes on the Silifi». L|2|•|Route: From «Lytelthorpe», take the «Devana» portal at 2.2N, 50.3E. From there, run east to the house at 1.7S, 36.6E L|2|•|⟦CrimsonBrokenHaft2⟧ L|2|•|{OPT} You can also give a «Skeleton's Skull» to Kayna to receive the text, «The Silifi of the Crimson Stars». L|1|3.|Find an appropriate «Silifi of Crimson Stars Quest¦Armoredillo Spine» and attach it to the «Repaired Haft» to create a «Silifi of Crimson Stars». (Heavy Weapon skill check). L|2|•|Note: If you fail to attach the spine, you will end up with a Broken Haft. Bring it back to «Kayna bint Iswas» to have her repair it again.

H3|Rubies L|1|1.|Choose three rubies and attach them to your «Silifi of Crimson Stars» to add spells to it. Any rubies you don't use can be handed to Leikotha for an experience reward. L|1|2.|**Weapon Upgrade:** Complete the «Silifi of Crimson Night Quest» to gain a 4th gem that gives your axe improved attack modifier, speed and the Crushing Blow and Resistance Cleaving properties. It also increases the weapons spells to level VII.
H4|The Ruby Al-Khur P|Spell: «Blood Drinker VI» L|1|1.|«Weathered Red Key» required. This is located in the «24.8S, 19.7E - Skeleton Bunker¦Skeleton Bunker» at 24.8S, 19.7E. L|2|•|{TIP} With a high enough lockpick you can skip the «Weathered Red Key» and go straight to Step 2. L|2|•|Route 1: From «Facility Hub», take the «Mosswart Maze» portal (25+). From there, run northeast to the bunker at 24.8S, 19.7E. L|2|•|Route 2: From «Uziz», take the «West Uziz Settlement» at 24.9S, 29.8E. From there, run west (and slightly north) to the bunker at 24.8S, 19.7E. L|1|2.|Once the key is obtained, head to the «Sylsfear Dungeon» at 11.0N, 14.7E. L|2|•|Route: From «Al-Jalima», take the «Unified Heart Villas» portal at 5.6N, 4.2E. From there, run south-southwest to the dungeon at 11.0N, 14.7E. L|1|3.|Once in the dungeon take the first passage to your left and hug the right wall. Ignore all the side passages sticking to the main path until you reach a split. There will be a «Dusty Sign» to your right and an incomplete lifestone in front of you. L|1|4.|Take the left passage and use the withered key on the door. L|1|5.|In the large room, step in front of the fountain on the east wall. This will open the door in the northwest corner. L|1|6.|Enter the northwest door and kill «Wari al Sha'im» for the ruby. L|2|•|⟦CrimsonRuby2⟧
H4|The Ruby Yujazik P|Spell: «Fire Protection Self VI» L|1|1.|The «The Ruby Yujazik¦Ruby Yujazik» is located in a «18.4S, 12.6E - Skeleton Tent¦Skeleton Tent» at 18.4S, 12.6E. L|2|•|Route: From «Al-Arqas», take the «Desert Mirage Cottages» portal at 33.4S, 13.1E. From there, run south-southwest to the tent at 18.4S, 12.6E. L|1|2.|The ruby is dropped by the «Skeleton Lord» here. L|2|•|⟦CrimsonRuby4⟧
H4|The Ruby Sulmada P|Spell: «Coordination Self VI» L|1|1.|The «The Ruby Sulmada¦Ruby Sulmada» is located in the «Amiantos Bethel». L|2|•|Route: From «Uziz», take the «Broken Sword Bethel Settlement» portal at 24.8S 29.8E. From there, run east (and slightly north) to the dungeon at 16.3S, 35.1E. L|1|2.|Once you portal in, turn to your left and notice the lever on the wall. This lever opens the timed door that gives access to the Skeleton Lord and the ruby. L|1|3.|When ready pull the lever and head east - jump down and take the southeast passage. Go left in this room and north down the ramp in the third room, you should now be in a room with bridges. L|1|4.|Jump down below the bridge to the south and hug the right wall up a ramp and hopefully through the wooden doors before they have shut. L|1|5.|Kill the «Skeleton Lord» and loot the «The Ruby Sulmada¦Ruby Sulmada» L|2|•|⟦CrimsonRuby5⟧
H4|The Ruby Mahwan P|Spell: «Defender VI» L|1|1.|The «The Ruby Mahwan» is located in the «Grievous Vault». L|2|•|Route: From Uziz, run southwest to the dungeon at 25.8S, 27.3E. L|1|2.|From the drop head past the portal and jump down into the side openings. Head north and then west through the wooden doors and take the ramp to your immediate right. L|1|3.|Follow the passage around and jump down into the east pit. Then take the third passage to the north and around before jumping into another pit. From here, go west through the doors and jump down, you will see a level to your right and the final pit. L|1|4.|Make sure that you pull the lever before jumping down. Quickly head northeast past the portal into the room with the «Greater Mu-miyah», kill it and loot the ruby. L|2|•|⟦CrimsonRuby3⟧
H4|The Ruby Al-Shajar P|Spell: «Lightning Protection Self VI» L|1|1.|The «The Ruby Al-Shajar¦Ruby Al-Shajar» is located in a «18.4S, 21.3E - Skeleton Tomb¦Skeleton tomb» at 18.4S, 21.3E. L|2|•|Route: From «Uziz», head to the «Djebel al-Nar Cottages» portal at 25.0S, 29.8E. From there, run south to the tomb at 18.4S, 21.3E. L|1|2.|Head down the stairs and go left down a level then up again, the ruby is found on the Skeleton Lord. L|2|•|⟦CrimsonRuby1⟧
