H2|Dialog P|⸨;Leikotha's Idle Chat⸩ ⸨In your mind, a soft voice sighs, "So many turns of the world have passed. When shall my torment end?"⸩ ⸨In your mind, a soft voice sighs, "Please leave me be... I wish thee no harm."⸩ ⸨In your mind, a soft voice sighs, "Disturb me not... Travel past this hole in the earth."
L|1||Leikotha's Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Ai, another comes, breaking mine wretched musings. Why have you come to this sandy tomb, filled with unnatural beasts? Is your heart filled with greed, seeking what treasures may lay within? Or is your heart of a more noble nature, perhaps seeking to release me from this torment? It matters not, for I have but one thing to offer you."⸩ ⸨Leikotha gives you Broken Haft.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Like so many things found on this unhappy world, it is broken. Once though it belonged to a friend. One like thee. One who hoped to release me. Ai, he failed... he failed."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Take the haft, I would see it used again in his name than have it stay with me and crumble to dust. If thou have no use for the Haft, I would still see it as it once was. Return the haft to me, repaired, and I will reward thee. Those that surround me speak of one of thy kind who may know how to set it to order once more. Look for her at 1.7 S, 36.6 E."
L|1||Giving the Broken Haft to Kayna bint Iswas⸩ ⸨You give Kayna bint Iswas Broken Haft.⸩ ⸨Kayna bint Iswas tells you, "Good heavens! Do you know what you have here? Do you see these markings? This is a piece of the legendary Silifi of the Crimson Stars!"⸩ ⸨Kayna bint Iswas tells you, "It looks like the blade, the rubies, and the top two jewel fittings have been broken off. I can repair the haft, but it will only be able to hold three of the five gems, should you manage to find them."⸩ ⸨Kayna bint Iswas gives you Repaired Haft.⸩ ⸨Kayna bint Iswas tells you, "You'll also have to replace the blade. Here, this pamphlet has some suggestions and tips for you."⸩ ⸨Kayna bint Iswas gives you Notes on the Silifi.⸩ ⸨Kayna bint Iswas tells you, "I'd choose carefully, were I you. As fragile as this is now, you wouldn't be able to remove the spine or the rubies try again."
L|1||Speaking with Leikotha after repairing the Haft.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Thy mind tells that the haft has been repaired. Give it to me, and I shall reward thee."
L|1||Giving the Repaired Haft to Leikotha⸩ ⸨You give Leikotha Repaired Haft.⸩ ⸨Leikotha inspects the haft.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "It is almost as I remember it when he carried it in his hand. Not quite though. Some harm cannot be undone."⸩ ⸨Leikotha sighs.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Ai, Wari. One like thee, a child of another sun. He carried this haft, a great blade resting within it, and sought to release me. He failed... and now has been cursed as I have."⸩ ⸨A single tear rolls down Leikotha's cheek. She raises a hand to her face and the dry wrappings absorb the tear instantly.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "As I have said, I shall reward you."⸩ ⸨You've earned 10,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "If thou returns with the gems that once graced this haft, I will reward thee again."
L|1||Giving the The Ruby Al-Shajart to Leikotha⸩ ⸨You give Leikotha The Ruby Al-Shajar.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Mine thanks. This gem was but the first one that graced the axe Wari once wielded. Thy people had begun to establish holdings here on Ireth Lassel when Wari came across this ancient tomb. This place of mourning that I have haunted for millennia."⸩ ⸨Leikotha looks to the ceiling above her, and then returns her attention to you.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "After defeating those that surround me, Wari approached me. The long days had gone by so slowly, and this diminutive creature, one so much like mine own people, intrigued me. For a moment, this curiosity lifted the burden of my torment off my soul."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "I hailed this creature, asked him his name and what he sought. A moment he stood silent, considering me. Then he told me his name, what had passed on the land above, and that he now looked for a cause to lend his blade to."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "A spark of hope entered my heart, if I could still be said to have one. So long had I sought to undo Nerash's binding, the curse that forever keeps me from passing. Perhaps this curious creature could finally undo it. Ai, I was wrong, so very wrong."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Ai, I see I have tarried thee long enough. I will reward thee for thy efforts."⸩ ⸨You've earned 25,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "If thou brings me another of the gems, perhaps I will tell thee more."
L|1||Giving The Ruby Yujazikt to Leikotha⸩ ⸨You give Leikotha The Ruby Yujazik.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "The second gem from Wari's axe. Allow me to reward thee."⸩ ⸨You've earned 25,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Since thou has shown an interest in Wari's tale, I will continue to tell it to thee."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "I had told Wari of Nerash's poison arrow and my fall at the Plateau of Gelid. Of how Nerash, a foul undead minion of Dericost, had sought to keep me at his side for all eternity. Of how I had been tortured and twisted by his dark rites and doomed to never know the peace of oblivion. Of my daughter, Alysse, who only knew her mother as a loathsome monster, who had been forced to flee the light."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Wari's noble heart was moved, he swore to find a means to undo Nerash's binding. I told him of the undead lords who roamed the sands of this land. The secrets of blood were known to them, perhaps they could aid him in releasing the binding."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Wari set off to find these lords. Never again did I see him."
L|1||Giving The Ruby Sulmadat to Leikotha⸩ ⸨You give Leikotha The Ruby Sulmada.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Ai, thou have found the third gem from Wari's axe. You shall be rewarded."⸩ ⸨You've earned 25,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Many days passed after Wari left this tomb. Days that had been very much the others before Wari had come, yet the spark of hope remained."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Then one of these creatures, these minor undead who derive a sick pleasure from seeing mine torment, told me that Wari had fallen. It cackled, the teeth in its fleshless skull rattling together with pleasure."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "The spark of hope died. Ai, if I could but join it."
L|1||Giving The Ruby Mahwant to Leikotha⸩ ⸨You give Leikotha The Ruby Mahwan.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Wari's fourth gem. Thank thee."⸩ ⸨You've earned 25,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "I had stood here, impassive, watching the days begin and end, ceaselessly. As the millennia had passed, I thought I had but one feeling left to me: sorrow. Yet Wari had shown I had another: hope. Now this fleshless fool, the one who told me of Wari's death, had brought out yet another: fury."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "I struck down the fool, although not before I found out where Wari had fallen. Wari had sought the answer to unbinding me in the dungeon Sylsfear."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "I left this tomb, something I had not done for untold ages, and sought out those who had done this."⸩ ⸨Leikotha sighs.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Ai, if only I had not. If only."
L|1||Giving The Ruby Al-Khurt to Leikotha⸩ ⸨You give Leikotha The Ruby Al-Khur.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "The fifth gem. I see thou have seen Wari. Fate has not been kind to a soul so noble. Some once said the same of me. However, thou does deserve a reward for giving Wari a moment of peace."⸩ ⸨You've earned 25,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Now you know what I found when I entered Sylsfear. Wari had sought out the undead lords, those who, in their life, had maintained the facility and studied the mana and structure of this world. These undead lords and their minions had overpowered Wari, had discovered why he sought them out, and thought of an appropriate punishment."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "His mighty blade was shattered and spread about the undead minions as trophies. He was left with but one piece; the gem thou have brought to me. The lords also cursed Wari in a manner similar to me. Yet Wari's curse had been imperfect and his mind was now as shattered his axe had been."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "I wept bitter tears when I returned to this tomb, seeing what had become of this noble child of distant sun. Ai, the tears were for me as well, for now I knew my torment would not end."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Thou does know the tale now, and I have but a few final words to offer thee: Do not fear the fate that awaits all creatures that draw breath, for fates much worse than that can be meted out."⸩ ⸨Leikotha tells you, "Now please leave me be."⸩

Quest.name: Society_Infiltration
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Society Rank|Master I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Operations Aid» I|Starts At|Society Chapterhouse I|Repeat|6 Days I|Time|40 minutes I|Contracts|«Contract for Aug Gem: Society» H2|Overview P|Feuding Societies are now going after each other by infiltrating each others basements. Your mission, if you choose to accept it, is to sneak in, do as much damage as you can and get out.
L|1|•|You have 40 minutes to complete the tasks. A strong mage can complete this quest in as little as 10 minutes. L|1|•|Only **one person** may attempt this quest at a time from each society. L|1|•|If you die, you must wait until the 40 minutes is up in order to try again.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|**Flagging.** Talk to the «Operations Aid» in your Society's Stronghold ( In the west wing of the Faction Stronghold near the society armor NPCs.). If the quest is available, the Aid will teleport you to a room with an «Operations Specialist» and an exit portal. Talk to the Specialist, and click "Yes" only once you are ready to begin. L|2|•|⟦SocietyAugNeedReward_0210⟧ L|2|•|⟦SocietyAugInProgress_0611⟧ L|1|2.|**Clear Two Rooms.** Run, don't fight, out of the south hallway into the main room and turn left into the west hallway taking either split past the first room and stop. Kill any spawn that followed. Then clear the side room on that split and go back to the other split in the west hall and clear it. Both small side rooms must be killed. (There is no need to kill spawns in main room you passed as you went from the south hall to the west hall.) As you approach each side room, you can lure two of the soldiers into the hallway staying out of the line of fire from archers and mages. Once both side rooms are clear, this will open a door further in towards the west. **You need to pass the entry-way to each room in order for the door to open.** L|1|3.|**Supply Room.** Kill the Soldier in the next room and loot the «Supply Room Key» on his corpse. Unlock the Supply Room door and use the «Lantern» which will set the supply crates ablaze. L|1|4.|**Main Keys**. Head east back to the main room and run across to the east hall and the next set of doors that have opened. Kill the two Master Sodiers in the hallway on both sides of the split for the two «Main Key»s No need to kill the remaining spawns in the side rooms - saving time. One key will unlock a door to a weapons room and the other to the locked north door in the main room. L|1|5.|**Loot Weapons**. Unlock weapons room and loot «Well Crafted Sword», «Well Crafted Wand» and «Well Crafted Bow» from the ground. L|1|6.|**Prison Key**. Head back to the main room and unlock the remaining door before the spawn in the main room has a chance to attack you. Once inside door, head back to the split hallway in order to stay out of line of fire from main room spawn. Bring one of the Master Soldiers out from the room into hallway and kill him looting the «Prison Key» he drops. L|1|7.|**Free Captives**. Continue to a closed door and a "T" in the hallway. Head right and unlock the two doors with the prison key. Note that the prison doors are not directly across from one another. Talk to the «Captive (Level 200)¦Captives» inside to free them. L|2|•|⟦AugRunCaptiveFreed⟧ L|1|8.|**Vat**. Head back up and across to the «Smelting Vat». **There is a bug in this quest though. The door into the room with the smelting pot should be unlocked after the prisoners have been freed. Sometimes however the door will remain locked. When the door is locked there is a small chance you can wait for the prisoners to reappear, free them, and finish the quest. This bug appears to have something to do with timers not resetting from the previous questor.** Place one weapon inside and it will take all three weapons, destroying them. L|1|9.|**Commander and Documents**. Once the weapons are destroyed, the final door at the "T" will open where you will face a «Commander». You must defeat him before you can use the «Documents», otherwise you will receive a message that you do not safe with the Commander nearby. In certain cases, you can avoid killing the Commander by trapping him on the spiral staircase and simply running past to use the documents. If he is not on the top level but trapped below you will be able to use the documents without killing him. A melee character pressed for time can save several minutes with this strategy. L|1|10.|Pick up the documents that can be found by pressing the '/' key after killing the Commander and you will be portaled back to the Operations Specialist. L|2|•|⟦SocAugDocumentsRead⟧ L|1|11.|Talk to him to receive your reward. L|2|•|⟦SocietyAugReward_0210⟧
L|1||Notes
P|General Strategies L|1|•|If you have a high base «Assess Creature», you can use the «Utterly Flawless Lense» or «Incomparable Lense» to Imperil enemies quickly. L|1|•|If you have a high base «Alchemy», you can use the «Alchemical Throwing Phials» to Imperil and Vuln your targets.
P|Strategies for Melees L|1|•|Use a magic absorbing shield. L|1|•|Do not stand toe-to-toe with the Mages in the first two rooms. Hit one, then leave room and heal. Come back and repeat until they are dead. L|1|•|Use a Spectral Rare from Lord M quest. The rare costs only 2 Lord Mhoire Coins and it raises your skill enough to kill quickly. L|1|•|Use Dispell Gems when taking on the mages. L|1|•|After the store room is set on fire, you do not need to worry about killing mages or archers any more. Lure the soldiers out of each room and kill them in the hallway. L|1|•|Do not try to heal inside the rooms with mages. Run to the hall and heal. The mages and archers will not follow you. L|1|•|Use Blighted/Weeping Weapon on the soldiers. L|1|•|Use Acid Rend Weapon on archers and Mages.
P|Master Soldiers L|1|•|The «Master Soldier»s have an extremely high melee defense and a shield. Debuffing the shield does not significantly improve damage - you must use a weapon that ignores shields. L|1|•|If you have a «Weeping Weapons¦Weeping weapon», you will find it difficult to hit them, even with 530+ buffed skill. You must either used a «Blighted Weapons¦Blighted weapon» (which has a higher attack modifier) or debuff their weapons melee defense modifier. Since hitting them is a challenge, using a «Royal Runed Weapons¦Royal Runed Weapon» is not feasible until their melee defense modifier is debuffed. If you do choose to use a «Weeping Weapons¦Weeping weapon», make sure you use an elemental one. L|1|•|Debuffing their weapons can be accomplished by using a «Royal Runed Slashing Baton» to land «Futility», and then casting «Wi's Folly». Note that the «Master Mages» will cast level 8 magic ineptitudes on you, except for «Item Enchantment». A 360 buffed skill with «Futility» gives a somewhat decent chance to affect them. L|1|•|If you are an archer, using a «Weeping Weapons¦Weeping weapon» and «Royal Runed Weapons¦Royal Runed Weapon» on the «Master Soldier»s is usually fine.
P|Master Archers L|1|•|These have an extremely high melee defense skill as well. See above strategies for countering it. L|1|•|If you are a Player Killer, you can use a «Black Page of Salt and Ash» to get an additional 10% attack skill modifier.
P|Master Mages L|1|•|These have a higher magic defense, but a lower melee defense than the rest. A good weapon with rending capability will help. L|1|•|They debuff magic skills with 8s, so a «Spectral Mastery Crystals¦Spectral Rare» or a «Society Gem of Dispelling» comes in handy if you are a mage.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog, Operations Aid⸩ ⸨Operations Aid tells you, "We have an important mission if you feel up to it, speak to the Operations Specialist to receive your orders." L|1||You are teleported to the Operations room.
L|1||Opening Dialog, quest ready, Operations Specialist⸩ ⸨Operations Specialist tells you, "We have an important mission if you feel up to it, we need you to infiltrate a society and find out what their plans are."⸩ ⸨Operations Specialist tells you, "Also while inside see what you can do to sabotage the society."⸩ ⸨Operations Specialist tells you, "We need you to do this alone to minimize the risk to our own society. Do you think you are up to it?" L|1||Dialog box appears: You will have 40 minutes to complete this quest, do you wish to begin? [ yes ] [ no ]
L|1||Accepting quest (clicking yes)⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Prison Keys.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Supply Room Keys.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Main Keys.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Well Crafted Bows.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Well Crafted Swords.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Well Crafted Wands.⸩ ⸨Operations Specialist tells you, "Very well, do not disappoint me."⸩ ⸨⸨Operations Specialist teleports you with [Society] Basement.⸩
L|1||Rejecting quest (clicking no)⸩ ⸨Operations Specialist tells you, "Please do not waste my time any further, I must find a soldier brave enough to embark on this mission."
L|1||Opening Dialog, quest in progress, Operations Specialist⸩ ⸨Operations Specialist tells you, "We currently have operatives in the field, if you check back shortly I may have a new mission for you."
L|1||Using the Lantern⸩ ⸨You use the lantern to ignite the crates in fire
L|1||Giving weapons to Smelting Vat⸩ ⸨You allow Smelting Vat to examine your Well Crafted [Bow/Sword/Wand].⸩ ⸨You hand of all of your Well Crafted Bows.⸩ ⸨You hand of all of your Well Crafted Swords.⸩ ⸨You hand of all of your Well Crafted Wands.⸩ ⸨You toss the weapons into the smelter and watch as they deform and melt.
L|1||Captives⸩ ⸨Captive tells you, "Thank you for getting me out of here, please help our fellow brother in the other cell."⸩ ⸨Captive tells you, "Thank you for releasing us both. Good luck on your mission, we will report back to the Stronghold that you are doing well."
L|1||Using the Documents⸩ ⸨You quickly look through the documents and make mental notes of all the important activities in these plans.⸩ ⸨Quickly you make your escape before reinforcements can stop you from reporting back.⸩ ⸨⸨Documents teleports you with [Society] Basement.⸩
L|1||Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨Operations Specialist gives you Blank Augmentation Gem.⸩ ⸨You explain the information you found in the book.⸩ ⸨Operations Specialist tells you, "Ahh that is most useful, you did well soldier."⸩ ⸨Operations Specialist tells you, "You have certainly earned this, we will certainly be able to use you again in the future."⸩

L|1||Defeating the Bound Falatacot⸩ ⸨The tormented Falatacot sighs gratefully as you discorporate the shell he had been bound into. "Thank you, man-thing..."
L|1||Returning Dialog⸩ ⸨Harkwull the Discreet tells you, "So you've picked up the fragment, have you? This is good news. Please, give it to me."
L|1||Handing in Untranslated Bound Falatacot Fragment⸩ ⸨You give Harkwull the Discreet Untranslated Bound Falatacot Fragment.⸩ ⸨You've earned 6,891,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Harkwull the Discreet tells you, "What a grisly memento the Falatacot left behind. Still, very curious, and it gives us an insight into Dardante's operations. A job well done. I feel confident in admitting you to the Whispering Blade. You can be trusted to see most of the translation... There are some parts that must still be reserved for our most senior members. On behalf of our Grand Master, I thank you."⸩ ⸨Harkwull the Discreet gives you Ring of the Whispering Blade.⸩ ⸨Harkwull the Discreet gives you Translated Bound Falatacot Fragment.
L|1||Handing in Ring of the Summoning Adepts⸩ ⸨You give Harkwull the Discreet Ring of the Summoning Adepts.⸩ ⸨Harkwull the Discreet tells you, "Right, well, this won't be much use to you any more. Thank you again for your assistance."⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,756,000 experience.
L|1||Returning⸩ ⸨Harkwull the Discreet tells you, "You've helped me recently, haven't you? I am grateful for the assistance, but I have no more to ask of you at the moment. If you still have the Summoning Adept's Ring, you can give it to me in exchange for practical knowledge..."⸩

Quest.name: Worcer's_Missing_Heirlooms
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|1-20 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Worcer» (Optional) I|Starts At|42.1N, 33.8E in «Holtburg» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Holtburg Redoubt» I|QB|9 H2|Overview P|«Worcer», who may be found in the Helm and Shield in «Holtburg», wishes to create an exhibit to honor citizens of Holtburg who were slaughtered by Tumeroks in Portal Year 6 (including his mother June and Hardunna's mother Hope). But he needs help recovering lost heirlooms from the «Holtburg Redoubt», located at 40.4N, 34.4E. Head there and recover the 8 items from «A List of Items (Worcer)¦Worcer's list». Then return them to Worcer.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Proceed to the «Holtburg Redoubt» at 40.4N, 34.4E. L|1|2.|Locate and collect the items on «A List of Items (Worcer)¦Worcer's list». L|2|1.|The «Bronze Candlestick» - found in the room north at the 1st junction. L|3|•|⟦HoltburgRedoubtCandlestick1204⟧ L|2|2.|The «Antique Bowl» - at the next 4 way intersection, turn right followed by a left at the next intersection. Go down the ramp and turn left at the bottom. Take the stairs leading down and at the bottom, take a right through the door and then into the room to your right. L|3|•|⟦HoltburgRedoubtBowl1204⟧ L|2|3.|The «Antique Platter» and «Bronze Lamp» - Go back to the hall at the bottom of the stairs and head west to the door on your left. L|3|•|⟦AntiquePlatterQuest⟧ L|3|•|⟦HoltburgRedoubtLamp1204⟧ L|2|4.|The «Bronze Handbell» - Follow the corridor out to the catwalk and head to the room directly west of it. L|3|•|⟦HoltburgRedoubtHandbell1204⟧ L|2|5.|The «Wedding Band» - Go to the south room and take the band from the «Hope Chest» near the beds. L|3|•|⟦HardunnaBandQuest⟧ L|2|6.|The «Antique Mug» - Go through the door next to the chest and follow the corridor until you see a door on your right to the next item room. L|3|•|⟦HoltburgRedoubtMug1204⟧ L|2|7.|The «Antique Goblet» - Exit and follow the path south and around to the north to the room where you will find the final item. L|3|•|⟦HoltburgRedoubtGoblet1204⟧ L|1|3.|Return each item to Worcer for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦HoltburgRedoubtCompleted_1111⟧ L|1|4.|You will receive the next starter quest rumor, «Directions to the Cave of Alabree», after turning in the 7th item in any order.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "I'd appreciate your help recovering some items from the old Redoubt."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "My parents were killed there when I was but a boy, when Holtburg was overrun with Tumeroks. I was saved, whisked away by the mage Celcynd at my parents' behest."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "The Redoubt is directly south of here. We put up an eternal flame at the site, in memory of all the townsfolk who died. Some of us are also trying to get together an exhibit to honor our parents. For instance, my mother had these heirloom dishes she was always polishing. She loved those dishes ..."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Anyway, if you could recover any of these items for our exhibit, I will reward you as well as I can."⸩ ⸨Worcer gives you A List of Items.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "If you need more help getting to the Redoubt, you can buy directions from Wilomine at the bar."
L|1||Handing in the Missing Heirlooms⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Antique Goblet.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Look, it's the old goblet I remember so well! Thank you for bringing it back to me!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Antique Mug.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "I never thought I'd see this again! You have my thanks!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Wedding Band.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "This wedding band belonged to the mother of my good friend Hardunna. She'll be thrilled to have this back!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Bronze Handbell.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Hardunna's mother would ring this bell to call us in to dinner. Thank you so much for bringing it back to us!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Antique Platter.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "My mother's antique platter! Thank you so much!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Antique Bowl.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "I always hated this bowl. But my mother loved it, bless her heart. It will make a great addition to our little memorial. Thank you."⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Bronze Candlestick.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Hardunna and I use to "borrow" this candlestick to go roaming about at night. Ah, those were innocent days."⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Bronze Lamp.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Hardunna's father, Roland, brought this with him from Ispar. He gave it to Hope, his wife, when they met. I am so glad to have this for our museum. You have my sincere thanks."⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.
L|1||Receiving "Directions to the Cave of Alabree"⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "You know, since you've been so helpful to me, perhaps you could also help Flinrala. She doesn't talk about it much, but she still grieves for her father, Brogord. He died defending the Redoubt."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "One of his axes is rumored to be in the Cave of Alabree, a bit west of here. Perhaps you could go and take a look? Bring anything you find back to Flinrala - I'm sure she'll be happy to have it."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Here, here are the directions. Wilomine also sells them, in case you lose those."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "If you bring me rat tails, wasp wings, or drudge charms, I'll reward you - I hate those cursed pests! I'd also appreciate help recovering one of my family's antique dishes from the old Redoubt."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Many years ago, Holtburg was overrun by Tumeroks. I was but a boy myself, and whisked away to Rithwic by the mage Celcynd, at my parents' behest."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "They died in the Redoubt east of the South Outpost, trying to hold the enemy at bay. There now burns an eternal flame at the site, in memory of those slain."⸩ ⸨Worcer gives you Worcer's Key.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Take this key, and see if you can recover one of my family's antique dishes!"
L|1||Giving Antique Platter to Worcer⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Antique Platter.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Bless you, friend! What a charitable deed you've done! If you have the time, I know Miss Ryndmad in Holtburg could also use your help."⸩ ⸨You've earned 3000 experience.⸩ ⸨Worcer gives you Scrap of parchment.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Give this to her."
L|1||Giving Scrap of parchment to Flinrala Ryndmad⸩ ⸨You give Flinrala Ryndmad Scrap of parchment.⸩ ⸨Flinrala Ryndmad tells you, "My father, Brogord, was a mighty man. He crafted his own great axe to fell timber. Alas, he was slain at the old Redoubt when I was just a babe in swaddling."⸩ ⸨Flinrala Ryndmad tells you, "This letter speaks highly of you. Take this key, which the mage Celcynd gave me. It unlocks the door to my father's room in the Redoubt."⸩ ⸨Flinrala Ryndmad gives you Flinrala's Key.⸩ ⸨Flinrala Ryndmad tells you, "If you can bring me back his axe, you will have whatever reward I can offer you."
L|1||Hardunna Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Hardunna tells you, "I use phyntos wasp wings, armoredillo spines, and drudge charms in my sculptures. If you bring me any, I'll reward you. Do you know someone willing to help me recover my mother's jewelry?"⸩ ⸨Hardunna tells you, "When I was a girl, Holtburg was overrun by Tumeroks."⸩ ⸨Hardunna tells you, "The children escaped to Rithwic, thanks to the mage Celcynd, but all the adults were slain in the Redoubt to the east of here - look for the eternal flame which burns in their memory."⸩ ⸨Hardunna gives you Hardunna's Key.⸩ ⸨Hardunna tells you, "Take this key. It will unlock my mother's old Hope Chest. Could you bring me back her wedding band?"

Quest.name: Bloodstone_Investigation
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|200 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Sir Donovan» I|Starts At|«Cabin by the Frozen Valley» at 83.8N, 4.3W I|Route|«Stonehold» to «Wisp Lake Cottages» portal at 69.6N, 20.2W. I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Bloodstone Factory» H2|Overview P|Investigate the Bloodstones origins for Sir Donovan.
L|1|•|The respawn timer for the final boss is very long (15 minutes). For this reason, players often limit this quest to one fellowship, even though there is no hard restriction. L|1|•|Several other quests and kill tasks coincide with this quest and can be completed at the same time as this quest if desired.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Frozen Tomb L|1|1.|Head to the «Gurog Ice Cave» 84.9N, 7.1W in the «Frozen Valley». L|2|•|Route/Shortcut: «Stonehold» to «Wisp Lake Cottages» portal at 69.7N, 20.2W. L|2|•|{OPT} After taking the shortcut, speak with «Gregoria, Gurog Destroyer» at 83.8N, 4.3W to first start the «Gurog Kill Task». L|1|2.|One of the three gurogs in the first room drops the «Entryway Key» used on the second door (700 difficulty). L|1|3.|The next section of the dungeon is part of «Nalicana's Test». If flagged, you can complete that quest, otherwise, the portal to the «Frozen Tomb» is straight ahead in the last room. L|1|4.|The Frozen Tomb begins with a linear path that has several doors. It is safest to have melee characters kill the Gurogs through the doors before opening them. L|1|5.|You will eventually reach a maze-like section. This is an area where many players die due to being overwhelmed by Gurogs. Hug the right wall and continue. L|1|6.|You will come to a longer hallway that opens into a larger room full of Gurogs and «Battle Lord Gregor». L|1|7.|«Battle Lord Gregor», the boss, is undead and is vulnerable to undead slayer and fire attacks. He respawns about twice as often as the eight Gurog Soldiers who surround him. L|1|8.|Pick up the «Carefully rolled scroll» next to Battle Lord Gregor at the end of the «Nalicana's Test» in the «Frozen Tomb». **Everyone must pick up a scroll.** L|2|•|If anyone needs luminance flagged, have them loot the mnemosyne from Battle Lord Gregor's corpse. There is only 1 per kill. L|1|9.|Head to «Zaikhal» and give the «Carefully rolled scroll» to «Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator» for the «Bloodstone Report». L|1|10.|Hand the «Bloodstone Report» to «Sir Donovan» at the «Cabin by the Frozen Valley» (83.8N 4.3W). L|2|•|⟦CanEnterLordKastellarsLab⟧
H3|Part 2: Lord Kastellar's Lab L|1|1.|Head back to the «Gurog Ice Cave» and all the way back to «Battle Lord Gregor».*ILT you must be a normal size character or entering the pillar will turn your screen black. L|1|2.|Use the «Pillar (Lord Kastellar's Lab)¦Pillar» on the wall in the back right corner of the room to be portaled to «Lord Kastellar's Lab». L|1|3.|Work your way through the linear dungeon until you reach «Lord Kastellar». You will be fighting Wights, Gurog, and Bloodstones. L|1|4.|Kill «Lord Kastellar» and loot a «Large Tome». He drops 9. L|2|•|⟦BloodstoneFactoryLargeTomePickup⟧ L|1|5.|Head back to «Zaikhal» and give the «Large Tome» to «Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator» for the translated «Research Notes (Lord Kastellar)¦Research Notes». L|1|6.|Head back to «Sir Donovan» and hand him the translated notes. This flags you to enter the next dungeon. L|2|•|⟦BloodstoneFactoryStarted_0211⟧
H3|Part 3: Bloodstone Factory L|1|1.|Proceed to the hole in the ground nearby at 84.5N 5.1W and use the «Pillar (Bloodstone Factory)¦Pillar» inside to get portaled to the «Bloodstone Factory» L|1|2.|Work your way through the dungeon. You will be fighting Wights, Gurog, and Bloodstones. L|1|3.|When you reach the large big room, head west and follow the passage down until it stops above a pit. L|1|4.|Inside the pit will be a «Bloodstone Crystal Stockpile» surrounded by a few «Gurog Guardian»s, Wights, and Bloodstones. The Gurog are on a very fast respawn. L|2|•|Note: The «Bloodstone Crystal Stockpile» cannot be debuffed. L|2|•|Note: It is a good idea to debuff all the enemies below before jumping so they can be killed quickly. It is much easier to keep the room clear after it has been initially cleared. Casting Blood loather on the gurogs guardians instead of killing them can make things easier. L|1|5.|Have archers machine gun the «Bloodstone Crystal Stockpile» with acid or bludge attacks while the rest of your group distracts the mob. L|1|6.|Once the «Bloodstone Crystal Stockpile» is dead, a «Master Bloodstone» will spawn. L|1|7.|Kill the «Master Bloodstone» using bludgeoning attacks. L|1|8.|Loot a «Shattered Master Bloodstone Shard» and a 3 use «Legendary Key». It drops 9 of each per kill, with a very long respawn timer (15 to 20 minutes). The legendary chests are located in an adjacent room. L|2|•|⟦ShatteredMasterBloodstoneShardPickedUp⟧ L|2|•|⟦BloodstoneFactoryKeyPickup⟧ L|1|9.|Hand the «Shattered Master Bloodstone Shard» to «Sir Donovan» at the «Cabin by the Frozen Valley» for rewards. L|2|•|Sir Donovan gives you Enlightenment Token. L|2|•|Sir Donovan gives you 11 Trade Notes (250,000). L|2|•|⟦BloodstoneFactoryCompleted_0211⟧ L|1|10.|The wand can be handed in for an alternate lower wield version and then again for an addition reward.
P|Notes L|1|•|As you must return to the «Cabin by the Frozen Valley» multiple times during the quest, it's best to have someone get a tie to «Wisp Lake Cottages» beforehand. L|1|•|The «Master Bloodstone» can be imp'ed and vuln'ed. «Crippling Blow» bludgeon weapons work very well. It has been verified a CB bow has done over 25k points of damage on the «Master Bloodstone» when imp'ed and vuln'ed.

R| RK|Experience|287,308,150 (20% up to level 220) RK|Luminance|40,000 RK|Title|Bloodstone Hunter RK|Items| RI|«Delicate Bloodstone Wand» RI|«Legendary Key» RI|«Trade Note (250,000)» (x11) RI|«Enlightenment Token» RE
R|Give «Delicate Bloodstone Wand» to «Sir Donovan» RK|Items| RI|«Sturdy Bloodstone Wand» RE
R|Give «Sturdy Bloodstone Wand» to «Sir Donovan» RK|Luminance|5,000 RE
H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "Greetings." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "My name is Sir Donovan. I have been dispatched here by Prince Borelean, in order to learn more about these mysterious Bloodstones that have been appearing in the area." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "If you find any information pertaining to the Bloodstones, perhaps we can get to the bottom of this mystery."
H3|Giving Bloodstone Report to Sir Donovan L|1||You give Sir Donovan Bloodstone Report. L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "What's this? Hmmm..." L|1||Sir Donovan carefully reads the scroll. L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "Well, this is disturbing. I've faced one of these Bloodstones before. They're not exactly pushovers in a fight. I'd hate to see what an army of them could do." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "See if you can find this pillar mentioned, and find this Lord Kastellar, or anything else that will help us get to the bottom of this mystery." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "I'd expect, given the wording, that this pillar is somewhere close to this Battle Lord Gregor. I'd start my search there." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "If nothing else, we at least need to shut down the creation of these Bloodstones." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "This ritual they mention worries me. Anything that involves the Archons and Geraine bodes very ill for the rest of us."
L|1||As you activate the runes in the order Sir Donovan gave you, you can feel the buildup of energy in the pillar. L|1||Pillar teleports you with Entering Lord Kastellar's Lab.
L|1||As Lord Kastellar collapses into dust, a maniacal voice echoes in your mind, "You're too late ! The Bloodstones are complete, and you will never stop them now!"
H3|Giving Research Notes to Sir Donovan L|1||You give Sir Donovan Research Notes. L|1||Sir Donovan reads the first couple of pages, but shuts the book once it moves into the technical creation of the Bloodstones. L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "Sometimes, Kuyiza amazes me." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "I'll send this book to the Prince. With any luck, either he or Asheron will be able to make heads or tails of the notes." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "As for this part Kuyiza noted. This I can do something about now." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "I can use this enchantment she noted to protect you from the wards on this facility. Since you've succeeded in finding everything so far, it's only proper I let you see this through." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "Find this Bloodstone Facility, do whatever you can to hamper their production. Better yet, see if you can find this 'Master Bloodstone' they mention. Bring me back proof of your success, and I'll make sure you are properly rewarded for it." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "Now, as for this enchantment..." L|1||Sir Donovan mumbles a few words, while tracing a finger through the transcribed array. Then he reaches out and touches your forehead. A jolt of power passes through your body, making your hands and feet go numb for a moment. L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "Well, that seemed to work. Let us hope Kuyiza transcribed it properly..." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "Good luck!"
H3|Rewards Dialog L|1||You allow Sir Donovan to examine your Shattered Master Bloodstone Shard. L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "Well, it looks like you were successful." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "You've done well. That crystal radiates a ton of geomantic power. The Master Bloodstone must've been very powerful." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "Here, let's see if we can put some of that power to work for you." L|1||You hand over 1 of your Shattered Master Bloodstone Shards. L|1||Sir Donovan pulls out some salvaged supplies, and converts a section of the shard into a rather delicate looking wand. L|1||Sir Donovan gives you Delicate Bloodstone Wand. L|1||Sir Donovan gives you Legendary Key. L|1||You've earned 287,308,150 experience. L|1||You've earned 40,000 Luminance. L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "And, to honor your success in the eyes of your peers." L|1||Sir Donovan awards you the title, "Bloodstone Hunter". L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "If you are not specialized in the use of Life Magics, I can reinforce the wand to make it a bit less delicate, but it'll weaken its effects slightly. Just hand it back to me and I'll do so." L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "Also, if you wish a reward other than the wand, hand me back the reinforced wand, and I'll release the Luminance trapped within the crystal and channel it into you."
L|1||You allow Sir Donovan to examine your Delicate Bloodstone Wand. L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "Very well. This will only take a moment." L|1||You hand over 1 of your Delicate Bloodstone Wands. L|1||Sir Donovan gives you Sturdy Bloodstone Wand.
L|1||You give Sir Donovan Sturdy Bloodstone Wand. L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "Very well. Let's see if I can remember how Nalicana taught me to release the luminance in an item..." L|1||Sir Donovan concentrates, and the wand in his hands disintegrates. Then he reaches out and touches your forehead. L|1||You've earned 5,000 Luminance. L|1||Sir Donovan tells you, "There. That worked pretty well."
H3|Other Interactions L|1||As you touch the pillar, you can feel the magics within it reacting to your enchantment. L|1||Pillar teleports you with Entering the Bloodstone Factory.
L|1||You bring Gurog Guardian to a fiery end! L|1||With a thunderous explosion, the stockpile is destroyed, leaving only scattered pieces of debris to mark its passage.

Quest.name: Captain_K'rank's_Errands
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Captain K'rank» I|Starts At|77.7S, 28.0E in «Linvak Tukal» I|Route|«Town Network» (annex wing) I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Help Captain K'rank with his many errands.
L|1|•|The errands are randomly given out by Captain K'rank. L|1|•|Talking to him the first time - ⟦KrankQuest⟧ L|1|•|{TIP} To get all the stamps you don't have to complete the tasks. The stamps are for the quest start. You can just come back every 20 hours for a new quest and stamp.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Treated Herbs Errand L|1|1.|If you receive a bag of «Treated Herbs» your destination is «MacNiall's Freehold» on the «Vesayen» Islands. To get to the Freehold, take the portal from the east (Sho) wing of the «Town Network». You need to give the Treated herb to «MacNiall the Unruled» who resides outside in the center of town. L|2|•|⟦KrankDeliveryMacNiall⟧ L|1|2.|Now return to the Linvak Tukal and give the «Sealed Missive (K'rank's Errands - Herbs)¦Sealed Missive» to Captain K'rank.
H3|Refined Ore Errand L|1|1.|If you recieve «Refined Ore» from Captain K'rank then your destination is the «Beachfort» located to the far northwest. To get there go to the town of «Mayoi» then to the «Lady Maila Estates» settlement portal at 60.8S, 80.3E. Next run west to the Beachfort at 76.0N 49.1W and give your Refined Ore to «Feruza ibn Salaq». L|2|•|⟦KrankDeliveryStonehold⟧ L|1|2.|Now return to the Linvak Tukal and give the «Sealed Missive (K'rank's Errands - Ore)¦Sealed Missive» to Captain K'rank.
H3|Well-Balanced Lugian Axe Errand L|1|1.|If you receive a «Well-Balanced Lugian Axe» your destination is the town of «Dryreach». To get to Dryreach, use the portal in the north (Aluvian) wing of the «Town Network». Find a Lugian NPC named «Gorak» accompanied by several other Lugians, and give him the axe and he will give you «Lugian Coins» in return. L|2|•|⟦KrankDeliveryDryreach⟧ L|1|2.|Now return to the Linvak Tukal and give the «Lugian Coins» to Captain K'rank.
H3|Wheel Cart Errand L|1|1.|If you receive a «Wheel Cart» your destination is the town of «Wai Jhou». Wai Jhou is a town located on the edge of the «Obsidian Plains» is fairly difficult to run to. The best option is to find a portal bot with a portal to the «Small Black Hill» which is very close to the town itself. Another option is to use the alternate portal to the Wai Jhou «Halls of Metos» found at «Imuth Maer Doquin». There is still quite a run involved through a landscape filled with Direlands creature spawn. When you reach Wai Jhou the NPC you are looking for is located in the tent with two other NPCs. These NPCs are part of the Candeth Keep salvage collection quest. Hand your Wheel Cart to Kreavon, the Lugian in the tent. L|2|•|⟦KrankDeliveryWaiJhou⟧ L|1|2.|Now return to the Linvak Tukal and give the «Full Wheel Cart» to Captain K'rank.
H3|Armoredillo Hide Collection Errand L|1|1.|If you receive a «Armoredillo Hide Collection Bag» you must collect five types of hide dropped by various Armoredillos. L|2|•|⟦KrankCollectionArmoredillo⟧ L|2|1.|«Small Armoredillo Hide» from «Brown Armoredillo¦Brown» and «Spiny Armoredillo»s L|2|2.|«Armoredillo Hide» from «Spikey Armoredillo¦Spikey» and «Stony Armoredillo»s L|2|3.|«Large Armoredillo Hide» from many types of «Armoredillo» L|2|4.|«Sturdy Armoredillo Hide» from a «Island Armoredillo» L|2|5.|«Plate Armoredillo Hide» from a «Plate Armoredillo» L|1|2.|When the bag is filled it will say so and you can return to the Linvak Tukal and give the sack to Captain K'rank.
H3|Golem Heart Crate Errand L|1|1.|If you receive a «Golem Heart Crate» you must hunt down six types of golems and get a heart from each. The hearts must be added to the crate in a specific order. The crate will tell you which heart it wants next and the list (in the correct order) is as follows. L|2|•|⟦KrankCollectionGolem⟧ L|2|1.|«Granite Heart» from a «Granite Golem» L|2|2.|«Iron Heart» from a «Iron Golem» L|2|3.|«Copper Heart» from a «Copper Golem» L|2|4.|«Obsidian Heart» from a «Obsidian Golem» L|2|5.|«Gold Golem Heart» from a «Gold Golem» L|2|6.|«Diamond Heart» from a «Diamond Golem» L|1|2.|When the crate is filled it will say so and you can return to the Linvak Tukal and give the Crate to Captain K'rank.
H3|Sclavus Cataloguing Crate Errand L|1|1.|If you receive a «Sclavus Cataloguing Crate» you must hunt down 4 different «sclavus» trophies. The different trophies must be added to the crate in a specific order. The crate will tell you which heart it wants next and the list (in the correct order) is as follows. L|2|•|⟦KrankCollectionSclavus⟧ L|2|1.|«Small Sclavus Hide» from a «Aste Sclavus» or «Se Sclavus» L|2|2.|«Sclavus Hide» from a «Essa Sclavus» or a «Sata Sclavus» L|2|3.|«Large Sclavus Hide» from a «Chomu Sclavus», «Faisi Sclavus», «Ulu Sclavus», the «Cold One»,or any Sclavus Lord L|2|4.|«Sclavus Tongue» from a «Aste Sclavus», «Sata Sclavus», «Essa Sclavus», «Chomu Sclavus», «Faisi Sclavus», «Ulu Sclavus», the «Cold One», or any Sclavus Lord L|1|2.|When the crate is filled it will say so and you can return to the Linvak Tukal and give the Crate to Captain K'rank.

I should not bother you with such concerns."⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "You have come to aid us, no? If you're so disposed to assisting me, bring these herbs to MacNiall and return to me with the missive that he supplies you."⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "Be swift, MacNiall's information is very important to our cause of unity. Yes, this was first proffered forth by other more notable scholars, but even the recent findings are still full of conjecture. Perhaps the Sclavus that live today are just an evolutionary product of that first race. Whatever the case we need samples to continue our studies."⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "Inside the crate you'll find several bags labeled for the different body parts that are commonly harvested from the Sclavus. Collect the small hide of the creature first, followed by the normal sized hide, the large hide and lastly add the tongue. Quest.name: Clutch_of_Kings_(Keerik)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Guard Sorchia» I|Starts At|25.7N, 48.9E I|Route|«Obsidian Rim» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Clutch of Kings: Keerik» H2|Overview L|1|•|{WARN}: Talk to the Cragstone NPCs before running this a 2nd time, or you won't be able to pick up the hide at the end. L|1|•|This is the fourth of six quests in the «Clutch of Kings», or «Clutch of Kings¦Burun Kings», series of quests. L|1|•|You will be facing Burun Ruuks and Burun Guruks in both dungeons and with the boss. All the monsters are commonly weak to frost and additionally a «Critical Strike» weapon will be needed for the boss fight. L|1|•|{WARN}: Keep failing the Shell Game to get all the stamps in 1 run.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Depth's of Hizk Ri's Temple L|1|1.|Speak to the Watcher of the Dead at 51.4S 67.9W to be portaled into the «Depth's of Hizk Ri's Temple». L|1|2.|Take the Northeast exit (there is a broken statue on the floor in front of the correct exit). L|1|3.|First intersection take a right -> run to end of hallway -> button on wall to open door L|1|4.|You will now be in a rather large room with many exits. The exits on the East and West walls both lead to rooms with levers inside, hit them to open doors back inside the big room, you can get into the rooms via plates on the floor that open the doors (there are plates inside the rooms that close the doors too, so be wary of them when you run back out). L|1|5.|Take either door (You only need one) on the South wall and then head up the ramp past the door to get to the portal.
H3|Part 2: Secrets of Hizk Ri's Temple L|1|1.|From the drop, walk to one of the 4 «Shell Table»s throughout the room. L|1|2.|Use the table, and then watch as the cups switch positions randomly, always keeping an eye on which cup is covering the shell. L|2|•|Tip: Move your camera into aerial mode in order to get a better view of the movements. L|2|•|⟦ShellGamePlaying⟧ L|2|•|⟦ShellGameShellAnswer1⟧ or ⟦ShellGameShellAnswer2⟧ or ⟦ShellGameShellAnswer3⟧ L|1|3.|Once the cups stop moving, pick up shell from the floor that most represents where it is on the table, then hand it back to the «Shell Table»: L|2|1.|«Left Shell» L|2|2.|«Center Shell» L|2|3.|«Right Shell» L|1|4.|If you receive a success message, take the portal on the north wall to move on to the next part. L|2|•|⟦ShellGameCompleted⟧ L|2|•|Note: If you fail, talk to the Shell Table in order to attempt to solve the puzzle again.
H3|Part 3: Hizk Ri's Temple L|1|1.|From the drop, head East and hug the left wall all the way to the end (make sure to head down in the grated area), there are no misdirections other than that, and no levers. L|1|2.|At the end, you'll find a hallway on the east wall, which leads to a Portal Gateway. The device leads to «Keerik», the boss.
H3|Part 4: Center of Hizk Ri's Temple L|1|1.|The drop is hot so check your buffs before entering. L|1|2.|«Keerik» can be seen across the room and will attack when he or his minions are attacked. L|1|3.|Once you kill Keerik, loot «Keerik's Hide» from the floor. L|2|•|⟦KeerikBeaten⟧ L|1|4.|Speak to «Guard Sorchia» at 25.7N, 48.9E in «Cragstone» for your XP and random reward. L|2|•|⟦KeerikKilled⟧ L|2|•|⟦KeerikComplete⟧ L|1|5.|{OPT} Hand Keerik's Hide to Guard Sorchia for the title of Keerik Killer. L|2|•|Note: Hold on to the hide if you are trying to obtain the Kingslayer title. See the «Clutch of Kings» for more information.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Watcher of the Dead⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "My purpose is plain, I watch the dead that reside within the halls of this temple. I have stood this vigil since my sacrifice over thirty thousand years ago, when the world cooled and the darkness made war upon all. The weight of time has long crushed my bones to dust and left with me with this incorporeal form. Yet, I serve my purpose with the same vigor that I did in life."⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "I will not find rest until the threat from beyond is quashed. They will spread like a plague across this world if they are not shattered. Great waves of magic shall crash against their flesh and be pulled into their bodies. Their strength will grow until they can no longer be touched and then all shall be lost beneath the weight of their power.⸩ ⸨"Watcher of the Dead tells you, "A great failure for our sisterhood. They grew where our chosen fell. Now they come to shattered the coil of this world as we shattered the coil of theirs. You must defeat the behemoth within these halls else its power grow until it is unchecked by any force that remains on this world."⸩

L|1|3.|Complete the riddles from the «Halls of Knorr»: L|2|•|A moth ate a word = Book L|2|•|... Empyrean steeped me in vats = Mead L|2|•|A lonely wanderer = Kite Shield L|1|4.|You will be teleported to the «Seat of Knorr». Now talk to «Arikas, Warden of Knorr» L|2|•|⟦ArikasSpoken⟧ L|1|5.|Go south and enter the «Collegium Occultus Anteroom». L|1|6.|Talk to «Bailor», he'll give you a «Broken Occultus Seal». L|2|•|⟦brokenoccultusseal⟧ L|1|7.|Give the seal to «Roderick» in the «Mite Maze». You will need «Lockpick» skill to get to him. L|2|•|⟦voidcrystalflag⟧ L|1|10.|Enter the «Collegium Occultus» portal, behing the Guardian. Head Mostly South and East until you reach «Master Malsivir». L|1|11.|Defeat him and loot the Void Crystal and «Malsivir's Journal». L|2|•|⟦VoidCrystalPickup⟧ L|1|12.|Use the exit portal back down the hall you came down to return to Bailor and give him the Void Crystal. He'll give you the XP reward and hand back the crystal. L|2|•|⟦voidcrystalfinished⟧ L|1|13.|Balior will tell you to hand the crystal to «Harlune», you will however have to bring it to Roderick who says he is acting on «Harlune»'s behalf. L|1|14.|Give the Void Crystal to Roderick. He will give you «Collegium Occultus Ring». L|2|•|⟦occultusringtimer⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Balior tells you, "A human entrant? Perhaps you are the one who can help. The sanctity of the Collegium Occultus has been violated, and my master has not responded. I discovered a broken seal that signals the presence of intruders."⸩ ⸨Balior tells you, "Please take this broken seal and bring it to a knowledgeable Empyrean. In the absence of my master, I believe the only other extant Empyrean in Ireth Lassel is one who has secluded himself in a cave, in the northern mountains of the island. Bring the Broken Occultus Seal to that one, human."⸩ ⸨Balior gives you Broken Occultus Seal.
L|1||Opening Dialog (if seal is lost)⸩ ⸨Balior gives you Broken Occultus Seal.⸩ ⸨Balior tells you, "I hope you can restore my faith in you human. Deliver this seal, this time with the care of not losing it first."
L|1||Speaking with Balior again⸩ ⸨Balior tells you, "Time is precious, human. Please bring the Broken Occultus Seal to a knowledgeable Empyrean. As I said, I believe the one I seek makes his home in a cave in the northern mountains of this Ireth Lassel."
L|1||Handing in Broken Occultus Seal⸩ ⸨You give Roderick Broken Occultus Seal.⸩ ⸨Roderick tells you, "Harlune told me that this might be a signal that there are intruders in Knorr. Ya gotta go to the golem Balior and help it out. Bring somethin' back to me and I'll see what I can do."
L|1||Returning to Balior⸩ ⸨Balior tells you, "I am grateful that you found the one that you call Harlune and alerted him to the danger. Now you must take up arms against the intruders in the Collegium Occultus."⸩ ⸨Balior tells you, "Go through this portal and seek out the one called Master Malsivir. He has looted a very dangerous artifact from the Collegium called the Void Crystal. There is no telling what kind of catastrophe could result if such foolish and short-sighted beings abused its powers."
L|1||Handing in Void Crystal to Balior⸩ ⸨Balior tells you, "You have retrieved the crystal from the human despoiler. Please, give it to me."⸩ ⸨You give Balior Void Crystal.⸩ ⸨Balior tells you, "This is the artifact that was sought. I am empowered to reward you for this effort. But I cannot serve as the crystal's guardian. Please bring the crystal to Harlune. It has become his responsibility to safeguard the artifact."⸩ ⸨You've earned 100,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Balior gives you Void Crystal.⸩ ⸨Balior tells you, "Please bring the Void Crystal to Harlune, the sole Empyrean currently extant on Ireth Lassel."
L|1||Handing in Void Crystal to Roderick⸩ ⸨You give Roderick Void Crystal.⸩ ⸨Roderick tells you, "Oh, yeah - Harlune told me what this is. I'll pass it along to him. He left word somethin' like this might appear. I'll pass it up, and Harlune'll keep it safe."⸩ ⸨Roderick tells you, "Here's a reward for ya. Harlune didn't tell me where he got it from, so don't ask me!"⸩ ⸨Roderick gives you Collegium Occultus Ring.
L|1||Retired dialog (from Ashes and Dust)⸩ ⸨You give Harlune the Misanthrope Broken Occultus Seal.⸩ ⸨Harlune the Misanthrope tells you, "Zounds! This broken seal can only mean that there are intruders in... Welll [sic], never mind. You must go back to the Golem Balior in Knorr and help it with whatever it asks you to do."⸩ ⸨Harlune the Misanthrope tells you, "No doubt it will be a secret and sensitive task. Be discreet. I won't mention this to you again, until you return with some sign from Balior that you have helped."⸩ ⸨You give Harlune the Misanthrope Void Crystal.⸩ ⸨Harlune the Misanthrope tells you, "Oh ho! So Balior is passing the hot potato to me! That fussy old Golem was always a little too eager to remind people of their duties. Well, it is technically correct. If the Collegium Occultus has been compromised, a Golem cannot be relied upon to protect this thing."⸩ ⸨Harlune the Misanthrope tells you, "I suppose I must hang on to it and keep it out of that blue-skinned devil's clutches until, uh... Well, for a while. Thanks, youngster."⸩ ⸨Harlune the Misanthrope gives you Collegium Occultus Ring.⸩ ⸨Harlune the Misanthrope tells you, "I know, I ought to reward you for all your hard work, and lugging this thing back to me... What's this I have in my pocket? There you go. Enjoy. Where did I get such a thing, you ask? Ask me no questions and I'll tell you no lies."⸩

Quest.name: Defeating_the_Curator_of_Torment
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Morgethais» (Optional) I|Starts At|«Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains» at 61.6S, 63.3W I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Assist «Morgethais» in defeating the «Curator of Torment (Rynthid Tentacle Weapons)¦Curator of Torment». This quest involves visiting most of the «Rynthid Infested Plains». A small group can do the first part of the quest and then the rest of the group can join.
L|1|•|This quest effectively ended the Curator of Torment storyline which ran from March - October 2013.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Destroying the 4 Crystals L|1|1.|«Morgethais» will ask you to assist him in destroying 4 «Sanctum Warding Crystal»s located throughout the «Rynthid Infested Plains». These crystals must be destroyed to spawn the portal to the «Catacombs of Torment» (62.31S, 65.52W). ⟦RTWStarted_1013⟧ L|2|•|When all 4 crystals have been destroyed within the same hour, a global will appear letting players know that the final dungeon is now open. L|2|•|**It does not matter in what order you kill the crystals.** Players can split up and destroy them separately to save time. L|2|•|Each crystal takes 1 hour to respawn. L|2|•|As soon as even 1 of the crystals respawns, the portal to the Catacombs of Opposition will close. L|2|•|Beware! If the landblock the crystals are in resets, the crystals will respawn! It is recommended to keep a character in the outside landblock while the quest is being run. L|1|2.|Of the 4 crystals, 2 can only be reached by going up the platforms, and the other 2 can be reached from the ground.
H4|Platform Crystal #1: Platforms of Torment L|1|1.|Make your way to the access ramp at 62.5S, 65.4W to begin climbing the platforms. L|1|2.|To get to the first dungeon, head up the ramp. Make a full power jump across to the southern platform, then take the west ramp. Head north to the T intersection, and turn west and head into the «Path of Torment» portal. L|2|•|{WARN} the dungeon drop is HOT! L|1|3.|Inside, head west and exit the room, then turn south. At the next split, head south. L|1|4.|Continue west (from/past the southern hallway leading to the crystal) until you come to a large room. In here, head northeast and take the far east exit, then bear south all the way to the «Platforms of Torment» portal. L|2|•|Note: The portal drops outside on the next higher series of platforms (Platforms of Torment). L|1|5.|The «Sanctum Warding Crystal» can be found not far from the drop at 62.0S 65.9W). It is on the very large platform directly ahead.
H4|Platform Crystal #2: Platforms of Rage L|1|1.|From the first platform crystal, head south and down the ramp. Take the next ramp heading east and up into the «Path of Rage» portal. L|1|2.|In the dungeon you will come to a large room. Take the first exit on the right bearing west. L|1|3.|After exiting the large room (or talking to the crystal) head east, then take the right bearing south. When you come to a 4 way split, head east until you come to a large room. In here, take the first left heading east. At the next split, head east and continue to the «Platforms of Rage» portal. L|2|•|{WARN} The drop is VERY hot!! L|1|4.|On the platforms, the crystal can be found by following the ramps down from the drop location (63.1S, 66.7W). L|2|•|If you are with a small group, it is easier to just run directly to the crystal instead of fighting the many mobs on the large platform. L|2|•|At the path split, it does not matter if you go left or right, both paths meet up at the crystal.
H4|Ground Crystal #1: Ground Level L|1|1.|This crystal is located at 62.77S, 65.98W on the ground. L|2|•|Note: The crystal is not far from the portals for the «Seed of Power» quest and the inner Obsidian Plains. If necessary, re-group there before moving in to attack the crystal.
H4|Ground Crystal #2: Platforms of Sorrow L|1|1.|This crystal is located on the «Platforms of Sorrow», but can be reached by jumping to the platforms from a cliff on the ground. L|1|2.|From the first ground crystal, head up the nearby cliff to 63.3S, 65.8W and do a full power jump to the two nearby platforms. L|2|•|Note: You will need to have high jump skill in order to make the jump. Mages will have difficulty without a jump cantrip. L|1|3.|You will land on two platforms which are connected by a single ramp. The platform with the crystal is just below. Jump down to it and destroy the crystal. P|When all 4 crystals have been destroyed, a green global message will appear letting players know that the wards have been dropped, and the portal to the Catacombs of Torment (62.31S, 65.52W) has appeared. The portal is located in the center of the Rynthid Infested Plains area on the ground.
H3|Part 2: The Catacombs of Torment L|1|1.|When you enter there will be a surface portal behind you, and a portal to the «Inner Sanctum» on your right. L|2|•|{WARN} Accidentally going through the surface portal may cause you to be locked out should one of the crystals respawn. L|2|•|The Inner Sanctum portal is a portal to return to the final fight should you die. This only applies if the crystals are all still dead and you can get back into the Catacombs. L|1|2.|Inside the catacombs you will enter in a large room. Make your way through it exiting west. L|1|3.|Take the first right turn (heading north) and at the next split turn right (north) and at the next split head north once more. L|1|4.|As you come to the next split take a right (west) and eventually you will come to a large room. L|1|5.|Proceed through the room heading south west, and exit to the west (taking the left of the 2 exits). L|1|6.|Head around and down the ramp and continue following the hall. Take the second hallway that you come to on your right (heading north). L|1|7.|At the next split, stay left (north east) until you come to another large room. L|1|8.|Head through the room heading south east, and eventually exiting to the east. L|1|9.|Follow the hall once again through a series of small looping corridors. Ignore the 2 hallways leading to the left, and instead turn right heading west. L|1|10.|Take the first turn on your left (heading south), followed by an immediate right (heading west), followed by an immediate left (heading south). L|1|11.|Down the hall you will find a room with a «Lothus Slayer», a «Lothus Archmage», and a portal to the «Inner Sanctum». ⟦TormentInnerSanctum⟧ L|2|•|Note: The drop of the Inner Sanctum is safe.
H3|Part 3: The Inner Sanctum L|1|1.|Upon entering, the players will see the «Curator of Torment (Rynthid Tentacle Weapons)¦Curator of Torment» NPC standing in the middle of the room. The room is completely safe for rebuffing until someone talks to him to trigger the final fight. L|1|2.|After talking to the Curator, there will be a series of waves of enemies, which culminates in a showdown with the Curator itself. **The first 2 waves of enemies are timed fights and last exactly 5 minutes total.** It is possible to use a wall strategy in the far hallway to minimize the difficulty of the battle for smaller groups.
L|1|1.|In the first spawn players will fight «Suppression Rift»s, «Containment Doll»s, «Lothus Servant»s, and «Marionette Knight of Torment»s. L|1|2.|In the second spawn, players will face «Rynthid Minion»s, «Rynthid Minion of Rage»s, «Rynthid Slayer»s, «Lothus Slayer»s, «Lothus Servant»s, «Marionette Knight of Torment»s, «Ravaging Rynthid Sorcerer»s, and «Lothus Archmage»s. L|1|3.|After 5 minutes, any remaining enemies will despawn and 4 «Lothus Guardian of Torment»s will appear. As each one is killed a small message will appear about the guardians dropping a «Sanctum Summoning Crystal». Destroy each crystal as it appears. Once all the «Lothus Guardian of Torment» are killed, the «Curator of Torment» will spawn. L|1|4.|Summoning Crystals spawn monsters until they are destroyed. Killing them will make the fight easier for the group. When the summoning crystals are all destroyed, the «Curator of Torment (Rynthid Tentacle Weapons)¦Curator of Torment» makes his appearance. L|1|5.|When the «Curator of Torment (Rynthid Tentacle Weapons)¦Curator of Torment» dies, a green global message appears, and he can be looted for a «Shard of the Curator of Torment's Mask» - he drops 20 of them. If needed, he will respawn in NPC-form just a few minutes after his death. L|1|6.|After collecting a shard, head north. The portal door that was blocking the path will now be open. Simply jump across the lava to the platform on the other side to collect your rewards. L|2|•|Should you miss the jump do not worry. The pit is not very dangerous and easy to escape using a shift jump. L|1|7.|On the ground players will find the Rynthid Tentacle weapons, along with a «Legendary Key» (5 uses). L|2|•|⟦TentacleWeaponPickup!⟧ L|2|•|⟦RTWKeyPickup_1013!⟧ L|1|8.|Once you have looted a weapon and used your kry, head back to «Morgethais» at the «Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦RTWCompleted_1013!⟧ L|2|•|Morgethais gives you 10 Enlightened Coins. L|2|•|Morgethais gives you 2 Enlightenment Tokens.
H2|Dungeons & Maps

H2|Rewards
R| RK|Experience|718,000,000 (50% up to level 220) RK|Luminance|90,000 RK|Items| RI|«Legendary Key» (5 uses) RI|«Trade Note (250,000)» (x35) RI|«Enlightened Coin» (x10) RI|«Enlightenment Token» (x2) RI|1 Rynthid Tentacle Weapon RI|«Rynthid Tentacle Bow» RI|«Rynthid Tentacle Dagger» RI|«Rynthid Tentacle Greatspear» RI|«Rynthid Tentacle Mace» RI|«Rynthid Tentacle Spear» RI|«Rynthid Tentacle Wand» RI|«Life-attuned Rynthid Tentacle Wand» RI|«Nether-attuned Rynthid Tentacle Wand» RE
H2|Videos
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Curator of Torment (NPC)⸩ ⸨A voice echos in your mind, "So, you've worked so hard to find me. You've interrupted my experiments and you've interfered with my plans. I cannot let you continue to exist, but I'm still not convinced you're worth my time. Guards! Remove this vermin from my sanctum. Their presence pollutes this place."
L|1||Lothus Guardian of Torment⸩ ⸨A voice echos in your mind, "Miserable failures! Can you not do something so simple as remove a few pathetic meat-bags?! Guardians! Succeed where the guards have failed, or face my wrath for your failure."⸩ ⸨ strikes down one of the Guardians! as the Guardian dies, it releases a Summoning Crystal into the room."
L|1||Curator of Torment⸩ ⸨A voice echos in your mind, "You've survived my guards and defeated my lieutenants... Very well. I will deal with you myself."⸩ ⸨Deep in the Catacombs of Torment, has struck down the Curator of Torment, forcing him again for a time into his prison in the abyss of Portalspace.⸩ ⸨The portal in the alcove splits in two, revealing a passage beyond.⸩

Quest.name: Defense_of_Zaikhal_(Platinum)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|100 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} «Jun Sawashima» I|Starts At|{OPT} 44.1N, 43.4W in «Plateau Village» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Defense of Zaikhal (Platinum)» H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Jun Sawashima» in «Plateau Village» L|2|•|⟦QuestZaikhalDefenseAcquired⟧ - shared with all versions L|1|2.|Enter the «Platinum Legion Keep» (100+) at 16.5N, 0.6E near Zaikhal L|1|3.|Move through the dungeon until you reach a locked door. Use the lever on the platform above (North Wall) to open the door and then continue down the hall. L|1|4.|Again, move until you reach a room with another locked door. Use the lever on the pillar before the door to open it and move up the ramp. L|1|5.|At the top of the ramp, use the Torch (lever) to open the 2nd locked door and enter the hallway. L|1|6.|{OPT} As you enter a room at the end of the hallway, there will be a cutback hallway to your right. Head down this hallway, kill the «Platinum Legion Quartermaster», and loot the «Platinum Legion Quartermaster's Key». At the end of this hall use the key on the «Platinum Legion Quartermaster's Chest» to get some decent treasure-generated loot. Backtrack to the the cutback entrance to continue the quest. L|2|•|⟦platinumlegionchestkey⟧ L|1|7.|Continue down the North West hallway until you reach the «Platinum Legion Doorkeeper», kill him loot the «Platinum Legion Door Key» and enter the nearby door. L|2|•|⟦platinumlegiondoorkey⟧ L|1|8.|At the end of the hall, kill «Captain Balanchi» and his «Platinum Legion Bodyguard»s, then loot a «Platinum Invader Lord Helm», «Corcima Castle Platinum Ward Portal Gem» and «Dispatch to Captain Balanchi» from «Captain Balanchi»'s corpse. L|2|•|⟦PlatinumInvaderLordHelm⟧ L|1|9.|When everyone is ready, Use the «Corcima Castle Platinum Ward Portal Gem» to summon a portal to «Corcima Castle». Enter the portal. L|2|•|Note: The portal is a hot drop. L|1|10.|Once everyone is inside the «Corcima Castle», kill the «Platinum Legion Castellan» nearby and loot «Platinum Knight Medallion» and «Royal Blood» (20 hour timer, keep in mind if you plan to do the quests -copper, silver, gold, platinum- in sequence) from his corpse. Everyone in the fellow needs a medallion and the blood, so you may need to kill him several times, the respawn is pretty fast. L|2|•|⟦platinumknightmedallion⟧ L|2|•|⟦defenseofzaikhalroyalblood⟧ - shared with all versions L|1|11.|Next, find «General Corcima» deeper in the courtyard and loot a «Shard of Corcima's Armor» from his corpse. He also drops 1 vial of «Royal Blood» (same 20 h timer) and a «Dispatch to General Corcima». L|2|•|⟦defenseofzaikhalplatinumshard⟧ L|1|12.|Return to «Jun Sawashima» at 44.1N, 43.4W in «Plateau Village» and hand him your «Shard of Corcima's Armor» to receive the «Coat of the Zaikhal Defender». L|1|13.|Also hand the medallion to Jun Sawashima for experience reward. L|2|•|⟦ZaikhalDefensePlatinumComplete_0511⟧ L|1|14.|Apply the Royal Blood to your Platinum Invader Lord Helm to create a «Blooded Platinum Invader Lord Helm».

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Jun Sawashima tells you, "The Viamontian assault on Zaikhal was successfully repelled. However, their fortresses remain. We must continue to assault their strongholds in order to keep them off our lands. My associate, Ardry the Dubious, has scouted out the Viamontians' defenses. Here are his notes."⸩ ⸨Jun Sawashima gives you Viamontian Reconnaissance.⸩ ⸨Jun Sawashima tells you, "Please go to Zaikhal and show those dogs the might of our Queen!"
L|1||Handing in Shard of Corcima's Armor⸩ ⸨You give Jun Sawashima Shard of Corcima's Armor.⸩ ⸨Jun Sawashima tells you, "A shard of the armor of Corcima himself! Truly, you are a hero. I can use this shard to make armor every bit as good as that which Corcima wore. Take this coat, with my gratitude."⸩ ⸨Jun Sawashima gives you Coat of the Zaikhal Defender.

I think a reward is in order for your work in slaying one of these monsters."⸩ ⸨You've earned 58,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Jun Sawashima gives you 4 Trade Notes (250,000).⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to collect the platinum insignia again.⸩
H2|Trivia P|When this quest was first introduced in the «Throne of Destiny (expansion)¦Throne of Destiny» expansion, the Viamontian legions and their leaders attacked «Zaikhal» proper where they were defeated by players.
P||[Player Name] has slain Captain Balanchi, one of the commanders of the Viamontian invasion! Without their leader, the Platinum Legion returns to its underground fortress and ceases to menace the land near Zaikhal.
P||[Player Name] has slain General Corcima, the commander of the Viamontian invasion! The last of the Viamontian invaders vanish from the roads near Zaikhal.

Quest.name: Disturbance_in_the_Ley_Lines
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Fellowship/Solo I|Starts With|«Lacarra Avanthi» (RB) or «Zho Heishan» (CH) I|Starts At|«Wai Jhou» at 61.8S, 51.3W or 61.9S, 51.4W I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Investigate possible ley line disruptions caused by «Lord Rytheran» at the behest of one of two societies for Major Life Magic and Major Magic Resist Headpiece. Very important lore developments for the observant.
L|1|•|There are two starting NPCs that are affiliated with the Celestial Hand and Radiant Blood socities. The NPC you start with has no long term impact on joining a «Society». The «Eldrytch Web» and their leader of sorts, Lord Rytheran, are actually part of the disturbance. L|1|•|**Leaftide Quest Bonus**: Two runs. One run per quest starter NPC. Second run with an alternate character on the same account.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Flag talking to either NPC. L|2|•|⟦askedlacarrafirst!⟧ OR ⟦askedzhofirst!⟧ L|2|•|⟦gardensofmenileshflag!⟧ L|1|2.|Travel to «Graveyard» and enter the «Gardens of Menilesh» at 64.7S, 43.8W. L|1|3.|You have a choice at this point, you can either assist Rytheran for the rewards, or you can kill Rytheran and take them. You will also receive additional loot.
H3|Fellowship: Defeating Lord Rytheran L|1|1.|Attack and defeat Lord Rytheran. L|2|•|{WARN} Do not try to vuln or imperil him as he will counter-buff. L|1|2.|Once you've defeated him, loot «Engraved Ashen Key». L|2|•|⟦engravedashenkeypickuptimer⟧ L|1|3.|Use the key on one of the «Lord of Menilesh's Engraved Chest»s and loot your item rewards.
H3|Solo: Assisting Lord Rytheran L|1|1.|Speak to «Lord Rytheran» at the start, he will instruct you to retrieve a ring. L|1|2.|Not far from the start is a «Strange Pillar». When used it summons many moarsmen and undead. L|2|•|Note: This pillar also has a role in another quest, «Jester Focuses». L|1|3.|From the drop, go down several levels, coming to a room with the «Strange Pillar» in the middle. Go west, up the ramp and south, stick left and you'll come to a large room with the «Ring of Remembrance» on the floor in the middle. L|2|•|{TIP} The dungeon forms a large circle, so you can go left or right and both lead to the large room with the ring. L|2|•|⟦ringofremembrancepickuptimer⟧ L|1|4.|Return to «Lord Rytheran» at the start and give him the ring for your item rewards. L|2|•|⟦ringofremembranceturnedin⟧
H3|Turn In L|1|1.|Go back to «Wai Jhou» and give the Mnemosyne to the NPC you originally talked to for the experience reward. L|2|•|⟦turnedinrytheransmnemosynezho⟧ OR ⟦turnedinrytheransmnemosynelacarra⟧ L|1|2.|{OPT} If you don't want the Visage, you can hand it in for additional XP.
P|Notes L|1|•|Lord Rytheran, when killed, takes about 8-10 minutes to respawn. L|1|•|If you choose to kill Lord Rytheran, «Lady Aerfalle (Disturbance in the Ley Lines NPC)¦Lady Aerfalle» briefly appears after he dies.
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Gardens of Menilesh» 64.7S, 43.8W «map:00E7.gif¦00E7.gif» -- TE
H2|Rewards
R|Defeat Lord Rytheran and loot «Lord of Menilesh's Engraved Chest¦Engraved Chest» RK|Items| RI|«Rytheran's Mnemosyne» RI|«Visage of Menilesh» RI|«Ornate Bone Key» RI|«Ancient Mhoire Coin» RI|Level 8 spell components (x4) RI|Tier 7 mutated loot (x2) RE
R|Give «Ring of Remembrance» to Lord Rytheran RK|Items| RI|«Rytheran's Mnemosyne» RI|«Visage of Menilesh» RE
