R|Give «Visage of Menilesh» to Lacarra Avanthi or Zho Heishan RK|Experience|49,539,309 (5% up to level 200) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Zho Heishan tells you, "Excellent, perhaps you can help me. My superiors seek some knowledge of the troubles affecting the ley lines of Dereth, and the problem seems to trace back to Rytheran, the ancient Dericostian noble. We have become aware that a path into Rytheran's current abode within the ruined Gardens of Menilesh has opened somewhere in the Empyrean Graveyard."⸩ ⸨Zho Heishan tells you, "Find a way to seek out Rytheran and see if you can retrieve his personal mnemosyne... We need access to his memories about the reading of the Book of Eibhil. It may not be necessary to destroy the undead lord, but merely to attain his cooperation."⸩ ⸨Lacarra Avanthi tells you, "You may be worth my time... My masters have determined that the dusty, deposed Lord Rytheran is the source of our current troubles with ley lines. If you would make yourself useful to us and to all the humans of Dereth, seek him out in his garden sanctuary."⸩ ⸨Lacarra Avanthi tells you, "There is a portal to these gardens located in the midst of the Empyrean Graveyard. We need a mnemosyne from Rytheran, bearing... vital information about a book he once held. Take it from him, by force or coercion, and bring it to me. You will be well rewarded."
L|1||Lord Rytheran⸩ ⸨Lord Rytheran tells you, "Ah, you seek my mnemosyne, do you not? My memories of that long-ago day when I read from the book... Your masters desire it so that they may meddle in this affair and save their fragile settlements from the depredation of the Blight. Well enough. I will give you the mnemosyne you seek if you do something for me..."⸩ ⸨Lord Rytheran tells you, "In the ancient garden below, my followers have gone mad, forgotten themselves and their allegiance to me. Regrettably, they had something that is dear to me in their possession when they lost their minds. A ring of some... sentimental value. Find that ring, and bring it to me. I will give you the mnemosyne you seek when you bring me the ring. You will have to kill me to get the mnemosyne otherwise, and I can already see you lack the power and the will to do that."
L|1||Defeating Lord Rytheran⸩ ⸨You bring Lord Rytheran to a fiery end!⸩ ⸨As Rytheran's battered bones collapse under the force of your assault, the undead lord's skeletal face seems to break into a bitter grin.⸩ ⸨Lord Rytheran says, "Fool! Are you truly willing to risk my eternal enmity, and the wrath of the formidable legions that serve me? Even if my memories fail me, the Web will remember..."⸩ ⸨A wind blows through the chamber, and the scattering of bones that was once Lord Rytheran of Menilesh vanishes. Another presence appears in the center of the room...⸩ ⸨Lady Aerfalle says, "My poor Rytheran, what have you done to yourself? What perils were unleashed by your dabbling with that accursed book? I am here now, and I will not let these mortal vermin sully your remains..."
L|1||Giving Ring of Remembrance to Lord Rytheran⸩ ⸨You give Lord Rytheran Ring of Remembrance.⸩ ⸨Lord Rytheran tells you, "Ah, a keepsake from my lady love... At last, a memory that will bring me some warmth in this eternal darkness. Take this mnemosyne, and my mask of office... And go. Leave me to my memories."⸩ ⸨Lord Rytheran gives you Rytheran's Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Lord Rytheran gives you Visage of Menilesh.
L|1||Giving Rytheran's Mnemosyne to Zho Heishan⸩ ⸨You give Zho Heishan Rytheran's Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨You've earned 297,235,856 experience.⸩ ⸨Zho Heishan tells you, "Amazing! You actually convinced Rytheran to part with his precious memory of the Book of Eibhil? I do not know what you had to do to accomplish it, and perhaps that is for the best. You have my thanks, and the thanks of the realm of Dereth for the good you have done here. These memories will be invaluable in helping us solve the mess that Rytheran and that book created."
L|1||Giving Visage of Menilesh to Zho Heishan⸩ ⸨You give Zho Heishan Visage of Menilesh.⸩ ⸨Zho Heishan tells you, "This mask is... breathtaking. It once belonged to Lord Rytheran himself? Truly a precious artifact. If you do not want it, I can grant you some practical experience for it."⸩ ⸨You've earned 49,539,309 experience.
L|1||Giving Rytheran's Mnemosyne to Lacarra Avanthi⸩ ⸨You give Lacarra Avanthi Rytheran's Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨You've earned 297,235,856 experience.⸩ ⸨Lacara Avanthi tells you, "Well done! I will not ask how you got this artifact from the hoary old tyrant. But this should contain the information we need to find out what Rytheran did wrong, and what we can do to stop what he has unleashed..."
L|1||Other Interactions
L|1||Using Strange Pillar⸩ ⸨The pillars surface feels cold and oily. A horrible taste blooms in your mouth and you hear a whispering voice. You realize the voice is coming from your own mouth, whispering words in a language you don't understand.
L|1||Showing Rytheran's Mnemosyne to Lord Rytheran=⸩ ⸨You allow Lord Rytheran to examine your Rytheran's Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Lord Rytheran tells you, "I do not want this any more. The memories are too foul and terrible. Better that I forget. Bring it to your masters, who would surely find it illuminating."⸩ ⸨Lord Rytheran tells you, "You have the mnemosyne your masters seek. Be off with you and bring it back to them. I find I take little pleasure in the stink of your sweat or the sound of your beating heart."
L|1||Speaking with a quest NPC after helping the other=⸩ ⸨Zho Heishan tells you, "You cannot fool me. You've already sought out Rytheran on Nuhmudira's behalf. Be careful of your associations. The blood witch is treacherous and would think nothing of sacrificing you for her own ends. I am afraid I can have no dealings with you."⸩ ⸨Lacarra Avanthi tells you, "I can already tell that you've helped that groveling fool Heishan with this matter of Rytheran. Beware of the time when you are forced to choose between your own kind and the Empyreans who would enslave us all."⸩
H2|Trivia L|1|•|When implemented there was a bug allowing unlimited xp so it was taken down Friday June 20, and was hotfixed Tuesday June 24.

Quest.name: Four_Corners_of_Dereth
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«El'Yst Maggann» (optional) I|Starts At|«Yanshi» at 12.0S, 42.5E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Travel to dungeons located at the four corners of Dereth to acquire four signet fragments. L|2|•|{WARN} The flagging is permanent. There is no need to repeat the 4 corners dungeons in subsequent completions.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «El'Yst Maggann». L|2|•|⟦FourCornersStarted_1113⟧
H3|Part 1: The Charged Niche L|1||This one involves a lever puzzle, unknown if it can be done solo. L|1|1.|The «Charged Niche» is located at 91.6N, 46.8E, on «Aerlinthe» island. L|2|•|Route: «Aerlinthe Recall» or giving a D Note to «Garaena the Emissary» outside «Candeth Keep». Run north and along the inner bay shore on Aerlinthe until you reach the crater to the north in the middle of the island. Take the path upward on the right side of the crater and follow it around to the back of the crater rim. L|1|2.|The drop has one enemy there, but is otherwise safe. The dungeon itself contains «Mu-miyah Lord»s, «Dust Golem»s, along with a few «Infectious Rat»s. L|1|3.|In this dungeon you will need to hit a series of levers in order to progress through the dungeon. L|1|4.|From the drop go until you come to a 4 way split with 3 wooden doors. The first lever you will need to hit, will open the door to the west. L|1|5.|To get to the lever, take the east door, then turn south, then east and follow the hall to the lever at the end. Pull it, then retrace your steps to the 4 way intersection. The west door will now be open. L|1|6.|Jump across from the west door. When you land there will be 3 paths. To find the lever in this section, begin by heading south. L|1|7.|Ignore the 1st turn on the left, and continue west and take the SECOND left (south). The lever will be at the end of the hall. L|1|8.|After pulling the lever backtrack and take the 1st turn (now on the right) heading south that you passed moments ago. L|1|9.|At the top of the ramp will be a jump. Take it. This will put you back at the start of the dungeon. The north door will now be open. Jump across. L|1|10.|To get to the next lever take the north path, followed by a left (west). The lever will be at the end of the hall. L|2|•|Note: After pulling this lever the final door will open. You will need to move fast to get back to it before it closes however (if by yourself). It seems to have a 3 minute timer so killing on your way back to it is not advised. L|1|11.|Pull it then backtrack to pit you jumped across. You will now need to take an alternate path to get back to the start of the dungeon. L|1|12.|The path back is littered with a series of short dead ends. Begin by going west and continue up a ramp. L|1|13.|At the top of the ramp head as far south as you can, then bear right (west). L|1|14.|Up another ramp then follow the hall south. In the small room head left (north) and then exit south from the next small room. L|1|15.|Continue to follow the hall east and you will head up another ramp. On the left will be the same jump you took earlier. Take it again now. L|1|16.|From the entrance head back to the intersection with the 3 doors, and take the east door and continue east at the split. The door will be open and you can now jump across. L|1|17.|Talk to the «Bak'tshay Keeper (Charged Niche)¦Bak'tshay Keeper» and a he becomes attackable, the door into the room will lock behind you and 3 «Infectious Rat»s will also spawn. L|2|•|Tip - Kill the «Infectious Rat»s 1st as they chain cast «Incantation of Fester Other». L|1|18.|Defeat the Bak'tshay Keeper. L|1|19.|Loot a «Signet Fragment (Charged Niche)¦Signet Fragment» (drops 9) and head to the next dungeon. L|2|•|⟦SignetFragmentCharged_Pickup⟧
H3|Part 2: The Fiery Alcove L|1|•|This dungeon involves a jumping puzzle. L|1|1.|The «Fiery Alcove» is located at 79.1s, 90.1e, a short run from «Kryst». L|2|•|Route: Take the portal to «Kryst» in the Sho (east) wing of the «Town Network». Then follow the island chain around to the dungeon. L|1|2.|The drop inside the dungeon is safe. Go straight, ahead is a room with Mumiyah Lords, kill them. L|1|3.|The dungeon is not long but has a floating platform room that requires you to navigate from one side all the way around to an elevated doorway the other side by jumping from platform to platform. L|2|•|If you happen to fall into the room that holds Infectious Rats, use either of the exit halls to run back up to the top, all paths leads directly back to same area at the top. L|2|•|Video of the solution to Jumping Puzzle L|1|4.|Once you have successfully jumped across the room and landed inside the doorway on the other side you will see the Bak'tshay Keeper in the nest room. L|1|5.|Talk to the «Bak'tshay Keeper (Fiery Alcove)¦Bak'tshay Keeper» and as he becomes attackable, the door into the room will lock behind you and 3 «Infectious Rat»s will also spawn. L|2|•|Tip - Kill the «Infectious Rat»s 1st as they chain cast «Incantation of Fester Other». L|1|6.|Defeat the Bak'tshay Keeper. L|1|7.|Loot a «Signet Fragment (Fiery Alcove)¦Signet Fragment» (drops 9) and head to the next dungeon. L|2|•|⟦SignetFragmentFiery_Pickup⟧
P|**Non-Jumping Strategy** L|1|1.|It is possible to complete this part of the quest for a group without having everyone complete the jumps. L|1|2.|Have 2 people complete the jumping portion to the far doorway. Have everyone else in your group clear the floor of the large room and wait underneath the far doorway above. L|1|3.|Have one of the two jumpers stand in the doorway to bug the door when the keeper is attacked. This person **must** not move. L|1|4.|When everyone is in position, have the second jumper talk to the keeper to begin the boss fight. Kill the rats first, then bait the keeper into attacking and drag him from the room. L|1|5.|Have the second jumper jump to the platform just outside the doorway, the keeper will follow and plummet to the floor below. L|1|6.|The rest of the group should now kill the keeper and loot the fragments. L|1|7.|If more fragments are needed, have the 2 jumpers stay in place until the keeper respawns. Then repeat the process.
H3|Part 3: The Frozen Recess L|1|1.|The «Frozen Recess» is located at 95.0n, 39.1w, a short run from «Eastwatch». L|2|•|Route: Take the «Eastwatch» portal in the Annex wing of the «Town Network». Then jump off the cliff and run. L|1|2.|The drop inside the dungeon is safe. In the entrance is a «Burning Sands Guardian» accompanied by two «Mu-miyah Lord»s, guarding three locked doors (left and right Resistance 850, straight ahead Resistance 999). Kill the golem and loot a «Chilled Key». Use the key to open the north door. L|1|3.|Follow the halls South until you head down a ramp. In the next room, take the exit heading west. Follow the hall until you come to another room with multiple exits. Take the North exit and you will come to a series of jumps. L|1|4.|Make two jumps across and there will be an open door into a room to the south. The danger here is in overshooting the jumps and falling into one of the pits. If this happens you must portal recall and run back. L|2|•|For a character with 500 buffed jump skill, the first jump is a 50% regular jump. For different jump skill levels, adjust accordingly. L|2|•|For a character with 500 buffed jump skill, the second jump is a 25% regular jump. For different jump skill levels, adjust accordingly. L|2|•|If anyone falls, others can run back to the start of the dungeon to open the locked door from the inside, if desired. L|1|5.|Talk to the «Bak'tshay Keeper (Frozen Recess)¦Bak'tshay Keeper» and as he becomes attackable, the door into the room will lock behind you and 3 «Infectious Rat»s will also spawn. L|2|•|Tip - Kill the «Infectious Rat»s 1st as they chain cast «Incantation of Fester Other». L|1|6.|Defeat the Bak'tshay Keeper. L|1|7.|Loot a «Signet Fragment (Frozen Recess)¦Signet Fragment» (drops 9) and head to the next dungeon. L|2|•|⟦SignetFragmentFrozen_Pickup⟧
H3|Part 4: The Stinging Corner L|1|1.|The «Stinging Corner» is located at 95.3s, 89.7w, on «Singularity Caul» island. L|2|•|Route: Use «Singularity Recall» and then run. L|1|2.|This dungeon is a true maze. From the start, head right (east). Ignore the little loop in the hall on your left, and take the next left bearing north until you arrive at a T intersection. L|1|3.|Take the left heading West to the corner of the hall, then follow the hall north to another T intersection. L|1|4.|Head left (west) followed by another immediate left heading south. L|1|5.|Ignore the left turn and proceed west down the hall and down the ramp. At the bottom of the ramp take the right turn heading east. L|1|6.|Ignore the little loop on your right and take the first actual hall on your right bearing east. L|1|7.|Take the first hallway on your right and head as far south as you can until the hallway turns. Follow it west and take the first hallway you come to on your left (heading south). L|1|8.|At the next T intersection head left (east). Ignore the halls on your left and right, and simply follow the hall as far west as you can until it turns north and takes you up a ramp. L|1|9.|At the top of the ramp take a right (heading east) followed by a left at the T intersection (heading west). L|1|10.|Ignore the turn on your left and instead proceed down the hall as it heads east and then turns south. L|1|11.|Follow the path as it turns east and then north. L|1|12.|Take the next hallway on your right (heading east) and follow the hallway south until it takes you down a ramp. L|1|13.|Talk to the «Bak'tshay Keeper (Stinging Corner)¦Bak'tshay Keeper» and as he becomes attackable, the door into the room will lock behind you and 3 «Infectious Rat»s will also spawn. L|2|•|{TIP} Kill the «Infectious Rat»s 1st as they chain cast «Incantation of Fester Other». L|1|14.|Defeat the Bak'tshay Keeper. L|1|15.|Loot a «Signet Fragment (Stinging Corner)¦Signet Fragment» (drops 9) and head to the next dungeon (if you have not completed them all yet). L|2|•|⟦SignetFragmentStinging_Pickup⟧ L|1|16.|Combine the the «Signet Fragment (Frozen Recess)» and «Signet Fragment (Fiery Alcove)» to create a «Combined Signet Fragment» (1st half) L|1|17.|Combine the «Signet Fragment (Stinging Corner)» and «Signet Fragment (Charged Niche)» to create a «Combined Signet Fragment» (2nd half) L|1|18.|Combine the two resulting halves to create the «Complete Signet» L|1|19.|Return the completed signet to «El'Yst Maggann» in «Yanshi» at 12.0S, 42.6E. This will flag you to enter the «Sanctuary of the Recluse» within the «Lost City of Neftet». L|2|•|{WARN} The flagging is permanent. There is no need to repeat the 4 corners dungeons. L|2|•|⟦FourCornersRecluseFlag_1113⟧
H3|Part 5: The Sanctuary of the Recluse L|1|1.|Head to the «Sanctuary of the Recluse» at 20.8S, 7.5E within the «Lost City of Neftet». It is located on top of one of the taller buildings. L|2|•|Route: Use «Neftet Recall» or run east from «Yaraq». L|1|2.|From the drop follow the hallway heading north. L|2|•|Note: Should you wish to loot the «Chorizite Chest» within the dungeon, take the path to the west. It is a series of rooms and T paths with dead ends one way, and the hall continuing the other. At the end is a room with four «Dust Golem»s and the chest. L|2|•|⟦chestchorizite87509⟧ L|1|3.|As you head north you will reach a room with four «Mu-miyah Lord»s and killable door. Take down the door and continue down the hall. L|1|4.|In the following section the dungeon you have the option of using lockpick to continue on (door has 850 resistance) or killing a «Dust Guardian» for an «Ancient Dusty Key» to open a second door L|1|5.|If you wish to use the lockpick option simply go North west and pick the first wooden door you come to, then jump across the gap. If you plan on killing the guardian, head north east to the room he is in and kill him, then head back to the North west bypassing the first wooden door and instead using the key to open the second wooden door (999 resistance). L|1|6.|Regardless of which method you picked, open the door, jump across the gap, and take the first turn you can heading south (the 2 paths meet back up at this intersection) until you come to a room with an altar in the middle of it. L|1|7.|Using the altar will spawn two «Bak'tshay Lackey»s and four «Dust Golem»s. As each Baktshay dies, it will spawn two Pillars in the corners of the room. Archers and Mages should quickly kill the Pillars as they are very dangerous! L|1|8.|As each set of Pillars is destroyed, one of the two doors leading to the next room will open. The two doors are on separate timers, so the Baktshay Lackeys need to both die within a short amount of time of each other. L|2|•|Note: If alone or with a small group, after the first Baktshay dies you can draw the second into the now open hallway and kill it there. Then if the first door closes, you are already inside and past it. L|1|9.|Once both are dead and the second door opens head into the small room beyond which contains an altar. Now is the last time to rebuff or prepare for the final fight ahead. When your group is ready use the altar.
H3|Part 6: Lair of the Magus L|1|1.|The drop into the Lair of the Magus is a very hot drop. When you come out of portal space you will be in a room with numerous «Mu-miyah Lord»s, «Dust Golem»s, a «Mu-miyah Magus», and a «Mu-miyah Recluse». All of these creatures can cast various forms of magical walls, waves, and rings (both War and Void). Be careful of getting multi-shot by bomb and ring spells. L|1|2.|A good strategy tends to be attacking the Dust Golems first, then the Lords, then the Magus and Recluse. This way you can minimize the number of spells flying around the room as quickly as possible. The Mu-miyah Magus uses «Void Magic». Beware of getting hit by a void drain spell in the chaos of the battle. L|1|3.|When the Recluse dies, a sarcophagus will spawn in the center of the room. Use it to get to the rewards room. There is a 3 minute timer on the sarcophogus so do not delay. L|2|•|Note: Because of the obstacles in the dungeon (destroyable door, locked door, mini boss room) and the timer on the sarcophogus, it is unlikely that anyone who dies will be able to get back. L|1|4.|Speak to the «Lingering Spirit of the Recluse» NPC for your «Legendary Key» and a non-useable «Idol of the Recluse». Use the key on the chests nearby. L|1|5.|Return to «El'Yst Maggann» and give her the idol for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦FourCornersCompleted_1113⟧

Quest.name: Guardian_of_the_Deru_Trees_of_Marae_Lassel

Wiki.page: Guardian of the Deru Trees of Marae Lassel

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Aun Kimintari» 44.2N 78.1W in «Timaru» I|Starts At|«Timaru» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Time|1 hour H2|Overview P|«Aun Kimintari» in «Timaru» gives a quest to help protect the Deru and weaken the Wharu (Olthoi).
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Royal Olthoi Jelly L|1|1.|Speak with «Aun Kimintari». 44.2N 78.1W in «Timaru» L|2|•|⟦GuardianoftheDeruTrees_Flag⟧ L|2|•|⟦GuardianoftheDeruTrees_StartJelly⟧ L|1|2.|After speaking with Aun Kimintari, head north to the «Roots of Skuld, Urd and Verdandi» at 51.9N, 73.0W, and use the portal inside the hole in the ground. From here, find the «Pool of Goo»: L|2|•|{OPT} You can land less than 1 click away from the destination by using «Ancient Empyrean Grotto» portal from inside the «Facility Hub». L|2|•|From the portal drop, hug the right wall (ignore first ramp down on right side. Dead end) until you reach a room with several exits. L|2|•|Take the exit in the far North East corner and continue and proceed to another room with a ramp down and several exits. L|2|•|Take the East (left) exit and then immediately take North hallway. Follow this hall and hug the left wall until you reach a winding bridge over a pool of acid. L|2|•|Follow the bridge to the North West until you reach the «Pool of Goo». L|1|3.|Use the «Pool of Goo» to collect «Royal Olthoi Jelly», L|2|•|⟦OlthoiJellyRoyalDeruPickedUp⟧ L|1|4.|Return it to «Aun Kimintari» in «Timaru». L|2|•|⟦CanPickupLargeCorruptedManaShard⟧ L|2|•|⟦GuardianoftheDeruTrees_StartShard⟧
H3|Part 2: Large Corrupted Mana Shard L|1|1.|Return to the «Roots of Skuld, Urd and Verdandi» @ 51.9N 73.0W and find the «Large Corrupted Mana Shard»: L|2|•|This time hug the left wall until you reach a split with East and West ramps. L|2|•|Take the East (right) ramp down, and follow the linear path until you reach a room with several pits and a ramp down. Note: Maze Ahead. L|2|•|At the bottom of the ramp, go left and follow the linear path South until you reach several cut-backs (diagonal halls). L|2|•|Take the first cut-back on the right, at the 3-way go West (middle), and then right at the split. L|2|•|Follow the corridor and again take a Right at the next split. Follow the path until you reach a room with a «Large Corrupted Mana Shard». L|1|2.|Use the «Large Corrupted Mana Shard» to pick it up, and return it to «Aun Kimintari» in «Timaru» to get a «Wharu Fetish». L|2|•|⟦GuardianoftheDeruTrees_StartFetish⟧
H3|Part 3: Wharu Fetish L|1|1.|Again, return to the «Roots of Skuld, Urd and Verdandi» @ 51.9N 73.0W and bring the «Wharu Fetish» to the «Altar of T'thuun»: L|2|•|From the portal drop, hug the wall left again, and this time take the West (left) ramp at the split. L|2|•|Kill the «Tendril of T'thuun»s on the way down, and eventually you'll reach a large room with the «Altar of T'thuun» in the center. L|1|2.|Hand your «Wharu Fetish» to the «Altar of T'thuun», which will spawn a mob of «Sclavus» and «Olthoi» that begin fighting each other (you can ignore them, they don't drop corpses or loot). L|2|•|{WARN} If you use the altar, you will be portaled to «The Pit of Heretics». L|2|•|⟦GuardianoftheDeruTrees_FetishHandedIn⟧ L|1|3.|Head back to «Timaru» and speak to «Aun Kimintari» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦GuardianoftheDeruTrees_Completed⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|The «Royal Olthoi Jelly», «Large Corrupted Mana Shard», and «Wharu Fetish» each **expire in 1 hour from pick up**, so complete this quest when you start it.

H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "I am called Aun Kimintari, and I am honored to meet you." L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "It is my chosen duty to guard the Keh of Tanae in Palenqual, what your Xuta call the Deru Trees of Marae Lassel, who are named Skuld, Urd and Verdandi in their own tongue." L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "These Deru, young by their count of years, have been weakened by Wharu, and are now attacked by a thing called T'thuun. This thing must be stopped." L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "I have a plan to weaken this 'T'thuun' and aid the Deru Trees, but I will need the assistance of your Xuta." L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "I believe that we can use Wharu against this new threat, but I will need some items our scouts have found under the roots of the Deru." L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "Find the passages of Wharu under the roots of the Deru Trees, east of Timaru. In those passages, find the Jelly left by their Tah. This can be used to attract Wharu, and will be important in our trap for this T'thuun."
H3|Giving Royal Olthoi Jelly to Aun Kimintari L|1||You give Aun Kimintari Royal Olthoi Jelly. L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "Ugh. Only something that smells this bad could attract Wharu. It will work, and I guess that is what matters most." L|1||Aun Kimintari stashes the jar into a heavy bag, which cuts off some of the smell. L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "Now, for the next part we need. Our scouts have found a place in the Roots where the minions of 'T'thuun' have collected the power of this world into a shard, and then corrupted it. I can use this power to anger Wharu against these creatures." L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "I can protect you from the shard's corruption using a trick taught to me by these 'Societies' your Xuta has created." L|1||Aun Kimintari chants softly while tapping on her drum with one hand. you feel a wash of power settle over you. L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "You'll find the shard under the roots of the Deru, guarded by this T'thuun's minions. Bring it to me, and we can set the trap in motion."
H3|Giving Corrupted Mana Shard to Aun Kimintari L|1||You give Aun Kimintari Corrupted Mana Shard. L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "The level of corruption and raw power in this thing is horrifying. Just taking this away from those things may help protect the Deru." L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "But, we will do one better. We will turn their corrrupted hopes into the very thing that destroys them." L|1||Aun Kimintari combines the Royal Olthoi Jelly and the Corrupted Mana Shard with a carved fetish that she pulls from a pouch. As she combines the items, she chants softly in a strange tongue and the Akiekie Fire flares up beside her. L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "There, this should do it. Take this fetish to the altar in the deepest part of the area hollowed out under the roots of the Deru. If you keep going down, you should find it eventually." L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "Place the fetish, a fetish to Wharu himself, upon the Altar. This should call Wharu to the place, who will then war with this T'thuun, weakening them both. This will help protect the Deru and weaken Wharu both, which will help the Tonk and those of your Xuta as well." L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "Be careful, the conflict between Wharu and this T'thuun will be vicious, if what has been seen by our scouts is true." L|1||Aun Kimintari gives you Wharu Fetish.
H3|Completing Quest L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "You honor the Tonk, the Aun and your Xuta by your actions and sacrifice. I thank you. I have been given a number of these keys by our Tah, who has gotten them from Elysatah of the Ispar Xuta. I am told your people prize them highly, and will take them as a proper reward for the risks you have taken." L|1||Aun Kimintari tells you, "Our trap will not end the threat, but will keep them from progressing for a time, and keep the Deru safe until a better answer can be found. Return to me in a month, and we should be able to trick them once again." L|1||Aun Kimintari gives you Braced Mana Forge Key.
H3|Other Interactions H4|Giving Wharu Fetish to Altar of T'thuun L|1||You give Altar of T'thuun Wharu Fetish. L|1||As you place the fetish upon the Altar of T'thuun, you can feel the pulse of power and hear both the commotion of guards coming to stop you and the rapid approach of the Olthoi, drawn to its call.

Quest.name: Halls_of_Knorr
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Olcris, Nuhmudira's Student» I|Starts At|68.7N, 21.6W in «Stonehold» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|The first quest which gave players access to the «Knorr Lyceum». L|1|•|Allows you to upgrade your «Hieromancer's Armor». L|1|•|Has other rewards including a Mace, UA weapon, and lots of lore texts. L|1|•|The stamp ⟦BookTurnedIn⟧ will only be awarded if complete the quest within 20 hours of the first time you ever talk to Olcris
H3|Prerequisites L|1|•|Lockpick is required to complete this quest. L|1|•|Bring at least one M (100,000) Trade Note. It will be required to begin. L|1|•|You must complete the «Hieromancer's Armor» quest and bring the Thaumaturgic or Exarch Plate Armor with you if you wish to upgrade it.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Getting to Knorr L|1|1.|Give «Olcris, Nuhmudira's Student» an M note to receive a «Knorr Portal Gem». You can only receive two gems before having to wait three days to acquire more. L|2|•|Talk: ⟦StartKnorr⟧ L|2|•|Talk: ⟦KnorrWait⟧ L|2|•|Give M Note: ⟦KnorrGem1⟧ L|2|•|**Note:** Once you speak to Olcris, you can receive two gems. If you take longer than the given time to buy all the gems, you will be able to speak to him again once you receive your second and be able to acquire another set. L|1|2.|Once you use the gem he gives you, you'll be in a room with a «Diamond Guardian¦Guardian» and an alcove full of items. Pick up the Book give it to the Guardian to be sent to the next room. L|2|•|You can speak to the Guardian to hear the slight riddle associated with the correct item, but this is entirely optional. L|1|3.|As before, pick up a Mead and give it to the Guardian. L|1|4.|Finally, give the Kite Shield to the Guardian to portal into the Seat of Knorr. L|1|5.|Feel free to speak to «Arikas, Warden of Knorr¦Arikas»; doing so allows you to bypass the timer on getting «Seat of Knorr Portal Gem»s from Olcris with the bonus of not having to go through the riddle rooms. There is one catch: The gems will cost an MMD note and you can only get one per visit. L|2|•|⟦ArikasSpoken⟧
H3|Part 2: Getting the Keys L|1|1.|Move North past Arikas. Open the door and stick left until, after opening a door, you come across a dining area littered with bones. L|1|2.|Head towards the East into a room with tables along the border (and noticeably less bones). Resume sticking left until you go up a ramp. L|1|3.|Head North throught 2 unlocked doors until you reach a locked one. Pick it open and continue North to another door you must pick to reach a study. L|1|4.|Pick up the «Key to the Defender Cache», «Key to the Elder Cache», and «Key to the Sentinel Cache» as well as at least one of the books in the room. Using the bookcase reveals another piece of lore. Olcris requires one book in order to get an M note back; any extra can be translated by Bretself in Cragstone. When done, head back to Arikas. L|2|•|⟦KeyKnorrDefenderPickedUp⟧ L|2|•|⟦KeyKnorrElderPickedUp⟧ L|2|•|⟦KeyKnorrSentinelPickedUp⟧
H3|Part 3: Obtaining the Weapons of Knorr L|1|1.|From Arikas, head East, through the door and into the Barracks Conveyance device at the end of the hall. L|1|2.|From the drop, head North then East. On the catwalk directly take the first right. Follow the hallway into a room with mushrooms and many doors. Pull the torch in the second room from the southern end. This opens a door to the west, one more room to the north. L|1|3.|Once through, stick left to a large room pick the lock of the door on the south wall and continue up to a room with two chests. Use your Elder key on the right chest and Sentinel key on the left chest. They contain the «Crescent Moons» and «Scepter of Thunderous Might» weapons used by Asheron's Order of Perfect Light. L|1|4.|Head back to the drop from the way you came (**do NOT portal recall**). The door may have closed by now, so look for a lever nearby to reopen it. You will know you've reached the drop when you find the Conveyances.
H3|Part 4: Obtaining the Helm of Knorr L|1|1.|From the drop, head North then West and follow the catwalk around ignoring the first and second hallways on the left but taking the third. L|1|2.|Continue along and you'll come to a large open room (after a down-ramp). The first door on the Left will need to be unlocked. Inside lies another book of lore as well as the «Chest of the Defender» housing the «Runic Helm of Knorr». This helm casts +25 health (does not stack with «Essence Glutton») and also has another use for mages which will be gone over later. Use your «Key to the Defender Cache» to obtain the helm. Head back to the drop (again, **do NOT recall**). L|1|3.|At the drop, head down the East hallway through two grate doors and take the Research Chambers Conveyance device if you have «Hieromancer's Armor» that you'd like to upgrade. L|2|•|At this point, if you do not have or wish to upgrade a set of Hieromancer's Armor, feel free to recall back to Stonehold and give Olcris a book to get an M note back.
H3|Part 5: Obtaining the Armor of Knorr P|Note: You must have Thaumaturgic or Exarch Plate Armor from the «Hieromancer's Armor¦Hieromancer's Armor Quest» on you to complete this part of the quest. You may still accompany and assist others, however, if you don't. L|1|1.|You must grab four Orbs of Infusion. There are three colours you may choose from; Royal Blue, Red or Mint Green. Each orb works for one piece of armor. The success rate of infusing the armor, is 100% so for a full set, you will only need 3 (Note, if you want the helm, you will need 4) L|2|•|«Orb of Infusion (Blue)¦Orb of Infusion» (Blue): simply head North through the door at the drop and stick left until you reach a large open room with a pedestal holding the blue orb under a beam of white light. Pick up as many as you need, then head back to the drop. L|2|•|«Orb of Infusion (Red)¦Orb of Infusion» (Red): simply head North through the door at the drop and stick right until you reach a large open room with a pedestal holding the red orb under a beam of pink light. Pick up as many as you need, then head back to the drop. L|2|•|«Orb of Infusion (Green)¦Orb of Infusion» (Green): you'll need to head to where the blue orb is (see above) and head through the passage on the East side. In the next large open room, on the South wall, is the green orb on a pedestal under a beam of mint light. Pick up as many as you need, then head back to the drop. L|1|2.|**Make sure now that you have as many orbs as you want.** You will have to come back for more if you do not have enough. L|1|3.|Take the Barracks Conveyance device then take the Forge Conveyance device (East hallway, first on the Left). L|1|4.|From the drop move South and stick Right to a large room with the «Forge of Knorr» in the middle. This forge will be used in upgrading the Heiromancer's Armor. L|1|5.|Affix an orb to each piece of the armor as well as to the «Runic Helm of Knorr» to create «Infused Plate Coat», «Infused Plate Girth», «Infused Plate Leggings» and «Infused Helm of Knorr». L|1|6.|When done, use the now-wearable armor pieces on the forge as you would normally unlock a door with a key. L|2|•|Thaumaturgic Plate will become Luminescent Plate and is one colour (the colour orb chosen). They will retain their +5 cantrips as well as gain some base AL. They will be unenchantable and have a Base War Requirement of 290 to wield. L|2|•|Exarch Plate will become Auroric Exarch Plate and is white with a trim of the colour orb chosen. They will retain their +10 cantrips as well as gain some base AL. They will be unenchantable and have a Base War Requirement of 315 to wield. L|2|•|The Runic Helm is slightly different in that it goes under a skill check. The helm will no longer be attuned/bonded, become unenchantable and will lose its +25 health spell. L|3|•|If you pass, the helm will become Auroric, matching the rest of the Auroric suit in color and AL as well gaining a +10 Life magic cantrip and a 315 Base Life wield requirement. L|3|•|If you fail, the helm will become Luminescent matching the rest of the Luminescent suit in color and AL as well gaining a +5 Life magic cantrip and a 290 Base Life wield requirement. L|1|7.|When done, simply recall to Stonehold and give Olcris a book for an M note back. Quest.name: Knights_of_Karlun_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|40 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Grand Mother» (WB) or «Grand Knight» (RM) I|Starts At|87.4N, 70.5W in «Silyun» (WB) or 70.0N, 62.4W in «Sanamar» (RM) I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Quest Chain|Joining the Rossu Morta I|1|«Eleonora's Heart Quest» (WB) or «Dericost Ruin Quest» (RM) I|2|Knights of Karlun Quest I|3|«Marauder's Lair Quest» (WB) or «Red Bull of Sanamar Quest» (RM) H2|Overview L|1|•|This is the second quest in the quest chain for the «Whispering Blade» (WB) and the «Ordina Rossu Morta» (RM) factions.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Eater Pit L|1|1.|Speak with the Grand Mother or Grand Knight for instructions on the quest. L|1|2.|From «Silyun», travel northeast to «Karlun's Fort» at 89.0N 67.6W and take the portal up. Speak to «Sir Ginazio». L|2|•|⟦Eaterpit⟧ L|1|3.|Use the exit portal and run due west to the «Eater Pit» at 88.8N 72.6W. At the end of the dungeon is an «Eater» named «Sword Swallower». Kill him and loot «Sir Ginazio's Sword». Each person in the party will need a sword, one per spawn. L|2|•|⟦sirginaziosword⟧ L|1|4.|Return to «Karlun's Fort» and give return Sir Ginazio's sword to him. L|2|•|⟦GinSword⟧ L|2|•|⟦heartofmadness⟧
H3|Part 2: Heart of Madness L|1|1.|Recall to «Silyun» and run southeast to the «Heart of Madness» at 84.8N 68.6W. L|1|2.|In a side passage room near the end of the dungeon you will find «Sir Coretto». Talk to him if you wish, then kill him and loot the «Testament of Sir Coretto». L|2|•|⟦corettoTestament⟧ L|1|3.|Return to «Karlun's Fort» and give the note to «Sir Ginazio». He will give you the «Breastplate of Karlun». L|2|•|⟦SirCoretto⟧
H3|Part 3: Hall of Karlun L|1|1.|Enter the «Hall of Karlun» at 88.9N 67.8W and at the end kill «Sir Belfelor» and loot the «Ring of Karlun». L|2|•|⟦ringofkarlun⟧ L|1|2.|Give the ring. L|2|1.|For Whispering Blade: return to «Silyun» and give the ring to the «Grand Mother», return the «Champion of Silyun Token» if you want the title. L|3|•|⟦KnightsOfKarlunCompleteSilyun⟧ L|2|2.|For Rossu Morta: return to «Sanamar» and give the ring to the «Grand Knight», return the «Champion of Sanamar Token» if you want the title. L|3|•|⟦KnightsOfKarlunComplete⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog (Grand Mother)⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "I wonder if you might help us, since you have helped us once before. There is a group of knights who has broken away from the murderous Viamontian loyalists. They call themselves the Knights of Karlun."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "Unfortunately for them, they possess something that would be useful to us, a ring that once belonged to Karlun, the Great Father of Viamont."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "I would have you take this ring from their leader, a knight named Sir Belfelor. Kill him if you must. But to even see this Belfelor, you must infiltrate the Knights of Karlun and gain their trust. They have a fortress located at 89.0N, 67.6W."
L|1||Opening Dialog (Grand Knight)⸩ ⸨Grand Knight tells you, "You have served us before, I see. There is another task for you, if you are strong enough for it. The King desires a bauble in the possession of a rogue group of Knights who have left our service. These so-called Knights of Karlun disdain the... physical gifts brought about by the transformation of our own Knights. But they distrust the rebels, too!"⸩ ⸨Grand Knight tells you, "The leader of the Knights of Karlun possesses a ring that once belonged to the great Karlun, founder of the nation of Viamont. Do whatever you must to gain their trust and take the ring from their Grand Master, a fallen knight named Sir Belfelor. You will probably have to kill Belfelor. Seek them out at 89.0N, 67.6W"
L|1||Guards⸩ ⸨Guard tells you, "Speak with Sir Ginazio. He deals with all outsiders."⸩ ⸨Guard says, "Knights of Viamont are men, not monsters. Varicci has gone too far..."
L|1||Sir Ginazio⸩ ⸨Sir Ginazio says, "Fighting alongside one of those foul Eater things would make me feel as debased as a Milantean..."⸩ ⸨Sir Ginazio says, "Karlun would not have approved of using fiendish beasts to do our fighting..."⸩ ⸨Sir Ginazio tells you, "Ah, have you come to join the Knights of Karlun? I do not trust you enough to send you on to speak with our Grand Master. Perhaps if you could prove yourself trustworthy..."⸩ ⸨Sir Ginazio tells you, "If you would enter our confidence, seek out the vile Eater-thing that swallowed my sword. It can be found at the heart of the Eater Pit, located at 88.8N, 72.6W . Bring me my sword, and we will speak further."
L|1||Handing in Sir Ginazio's Sword⸩ ⸨Sir Ginazio tells you, "Ah, you found my sword. Wonderful. Please give it to me, and I will tell you how else you might aid the Knights of Karlun."⸩ ⸨You give Sir Ginazio Sir Ginazio's Sword.⸩ ⸨Sir Ginazio tells you, "Well done. You have my thanks, but you have not proven yourself to the Knights of Karlun just yet. Now I must ask you to take on a more sensitive task. One of our leading warriors, a knight of great virtue named Sir Coretto, journeyed into the Heart of Madness to discover what afflicts the Fiun who have gone mad. It has been some time since we heard from him. Please follow him into the Heart of Madness at 84.8N, 68.6W and discover what has become of him."
L|1||Sir Coretto⸩ ⸨Sir Coretto tells you, "I would wager my friend Sir Ginazio sent you to find me. Noble of you, but futile. I am no use to anyone. I am... broken. I have discovered things too terrible to bear."⸩ ⸨Sir Coretto tells you, "Please, put me out of my misery. Strike me down so I may die like a true Knight. And when I am dead, take my last testament to Ginazio... So he will know. So they all will know."⸩ ⸨You bring Sir Coretto to a fiery end!⸩ ⸨Sir Coretto tells you, "Thank you..."
L|1||Handing in Testamentto Sir Ginazio⸩ ⸨Sir Ginazio tells you, "Well done. I see you have succeeded in making contact with Sir Coretto. Give me his last testament, and I will grant you permission to enter the Hall of Karlun and speak with our Grand Master, the honorable Sir Belfelor."⸩ ⸨You give Sir Ginazio Testament of Sir Coretto.⸩ ⸨Sir Ginazio tells you, "This is... heartbreaking. We all will mourn the great man that Sir Coretto was, and I thank you for putting him out of his misery. You have proven yourself to me. I will give you permission to enter the Hall of Karlun and speak with our Grand Master. You have also been judged worthy to receive a piece of armor of the Knights of Karlun. Wear it with honor."⸩ ⸨Sir Ginazio gives you Breastplate of Karlun.
L|1||Sir Belfelor⸩ ⸨Sir Belfelor tells you, "You may have fooled Sir Ginazio, outsider, but I know you are working for someone else, and that you seek the Ring of Karlun. I will not attack you, but you will get nothing from me. You may as well leave."⸩ ⸨Sir Belfelor says, "Treachery! Guards, attack!"⸩ ⸨You bring Sir Belfelor to a fiery end!⸩ ⸨Sir Belfelor tells you, "And so I die by treachery. Go running to your masters, corrupt puppet."
L|1||Handing in Ring of Karlun to Grand Mother (Whispering Blade)⸩ ⸨You give Grand Mother Ring of Karlun.⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "Beautiful. It is regrettable what had to be done to brave Sir Belfelor, but we are glad the Ring of Karlun is ours. You have our gratitude."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother gives you Champion of Silyun Token.
L|1||Handing in Champion of Silyun Token to Grand Mother⸩ ⸨You give Grand Mother Champion of Silyun Token.⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "May your kindness to the people of Silyun be known to all you meet."
L|1||Handing in Ring of Karlun to Grand Knight (Rossu Morta)⸩ ⸨You give Grand Knight Ring of Karlun.⸩ ⸨Grand Knight tells you, "Excellent work. One might grieve for the man Sir Belfelor was, but he was a fool and deserves his fate."⸩ ⸨Grand Knight gives you Champion of Sanamar Token.
L|1||Handing in Friend of Sanamar Token to Grand Knight⸩ ⸨You give Grand Knight Friend of Sanamar Token.⸩ ⸨Grand Knight tells you, "May your loyalty to the glory of Sanamar be apparent to all you meet."⸩

Quest.name: Lord_Mhoire_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|50 I|Rec. Level|200+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Graveyard» at 64.6S, 44.1W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Quest Chain|The Jester I|1|Lord Mhoire Quest I|2|«Releasing Jester» I|3|«Jester Released» H2|Overview P|This quest closely coincides with the quest: «Releasing Jester». If you intend to release Jester from his prison, you must complete part 1 **once**. After that, the ghost of Lord Mhoire will hand out the Jester Prison Key everytime you defeat his corrupted form.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|To begin this quest, you must obtain a «Ornate Bone Key» from «Pyre Champion»s, «Wight Blade Sorcerer»s, and «Wight Captain»s that spawn during the «time¦night» in the «Graveyard».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|(Optional) Part 1: Laylana and Jester's Prison L|1|1.|Speak with «Laylana» at 65.3S, 44.3W in the «Graveyard». L|2|•|⟦JesterPart1Started⟧ L|1|2.|Speak with the «Jailer» inside the tomb (middle in row of three) nearby at 64.9S, 44.1W. Turn right at the bottom of the first stairs in the bunker and keep going until you find the Jailer. L|1|3.|Go north from the Jailer past the hidden wall and use the portal to «Jester's Prison». You must click on the portal. L|1|4.|At the drop room, speak to the «Wall (Jester's Prison)¦Wall», the white dot visible on radar near the north wall. There is also a door in the room which you cannot use yet. L|2|•|⟦GotJesterLocation⟧ L|1|5.|Return to Laylana and speak to her again to get «Laylana's Love Letter» and the «Pleading Letter». Both are needed to complete the quest. L|1|6.|Take the Pleading Letter to Lord Cynreft (see below).
H3|Part 2: Lord Cynreft Mhoire L|1|1.|Bring the fellowship inside the building at 64.6S 44.1W (guarded by two «Guardian Statue»s). L|2|•|{TIP} Don't attack creatures while inside the building, it will get the attention of the entire graveyard and block the entrance for the key holder. L|1|2.|The quest leader («Ornate Bone Key» holder) should talk to the right «Guardian Statue»s outside the temple, and then **click Yes** to spawn a portal inside the building to «Lord Mhoire's Tomb» (handing the «Ornate Bone Key» at that moment). L|2|•|⟦GYColoOrnateBoneKeyTurnedIn⟧ L|2|•|Note: This portal only lasts about 30 seconds, so everyone must be close and ready to enter the portal immediately after it spawns. L|1|3.|Once inside, the person that used the key must speak with the «Shade of Parieth» NPC to begin the quest. L|2|•|Note: If you died outside AFTER using a key, you are still flagged to activate the quest inside. L|2|•|{TIP} Archers & Mages can perch on top of the «Sealed Vault» to avoid getting hit by melee attacks. L|1|4.|The fellowship must now defeat 5 waves of skeletons and undeads to beat the quest: L|2|1.|**Round 1:** «Pyre Minion»s L|2|2.|**Round 2:** «Wight»s, «Wight Captain»s, «Wight Blade Sorcerer»s L|3|•|{TIP} Kill Sorcerers first. L|2|3.|**Round 3:** «Pyre Minion»s L|2|4.|**Round 4:** «Pyre Minion»s, «Pyre Skeleton»s, «Pyre Champion»s L|3|•|{TIP} Kill Pyre Champions first. L|2|5.|**Round 5:** «Pyre Minion»s, «Pyre Skeleton»s, «Pyre Champion»s, «Lord Cynreft Mhoire», «Pillar of Fire¦Pillars of Fire» L|3|•|{TIP} Ignore «Lord Cynreft Mhoire» until everything else is dead. Also, kill the «Pillar of Fire¦Pillars of Fire» as soon as they spawn (1 or 2 hits when imperiled). L|1|5.|When «Lord Cynreft Mhoire» dies, the «Lord Cynreft Mhoire (NPC)» (ghost) spawns near the middle of the room. L|2|•|Note: «Lord Cynreft Mhoire»'s corpse typically contains «Mhoire Coin»s and sometimes a «Jester's Cards¦Jester Card». L|1|6.|Speak to the NPC to obtain «Lord Cynreft Mhoire's Key», which opens the «Sealed Vault» on the North wall. L|2|•|⟦GYColoWinRewardReceived⟧ L|1|7.|Give the «Pleading Letter» from Laylana to «Lord Cynreft Mhoire (NPC)», in return you will receive the «Jester Prison Key». L|2|•|⟦GavePleadingLetter⟧ L|2|•|{WARN} This key will remain in your inventory for 20 hours to give repeated access to the Jester's Prison. Note that this is a real world timer and will count down even when you are not logged in.
H4|Notes L|1|•|Limit your group to 1 fellowship (+/- 2 people). The quest only yields 10 «Lord Cynreft Mhoire's Key»s. L|1|•|Try to run this quest during «time¦the day» to make accessing the portal without casualties much easier. If forced to start at night, you can heal from the NW tower while the person uses the key and goes inside. L|1|•|{WARN} If the person with the key fails to make the portal that spawns, there is no way to activate the quest unless another key is used. L|1|•|Having more than one «Ornate Bone Key», the key holder can go outside and re-start the quest alone, while everyone else waits inside. L|1|•|Each key used activates the quest for 1 hour. You and anyone else who dies while inside the «Lord Mhoire's Tomb» must wait out the time remaining in order to make another portal appear.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Laylana tells you, "Hello, my name is Laylana. I would ask you a favor."⸩ ⸨Laylana tells you, "My love is missing. We are betrothed, but I have not seen him for so long. Please, you must help me find him. He was once the Jester to Lord Cynreft and the House of Mhoire. I fear that something horrible may have befallen him."
L|1||Jailer⸩ ⸨Jailer tells you, "Begone! Only Lord Cynreft may visit the prisoner."⸩ ⸨Jailer tells you, "You have not heard of the prisoner? So powerful and so very mad. Once he entertained the court of Mhoire with his antics, but that was before the betrayal. Now he is imprisoned here for all time."⸩ ⸨Jailer tells you, "Go now. You have no business here."
L|1||Using "Wall"⸩ ⸨The Jester tells you, "Please, you, yes you, the one talking to a wall."⸩ ⸨The Jester tells you, "You must free me. I was incarcerated without due process. I don't claim to be innocent, but who is? In this case though the punishment does not befit the crime."⸩ ⸨The Jester tells you, "Ok, I'm done. L|1||Returning to Laylana⸩ ⸨Laylana tells you, "You found him? He is imprisoned? Oh, my love, what could have happened."⸩ ⸨Laylana tells you, "Please deliver this note to Lord Cynreft and then deliver this note to my love in his prison."⸩ ⸨Laylana gives you Pleading Letter.⸩ ⸨Laylana gives you Laylana's Love Letter.
L|1||Giving Pleading Letter to Lord Cynreft⸩ ⸨You give Lord Cynreft Mhoire Pleading Letter.⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft carefully reads the letter.⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "I wish that things were different for this poor woman. But, there is no chance of the Jester's release."⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "Long ago my house fled the vile corruption of Geraine and his court. I sought to protect my family and my people from the unnatural magics spreading through the other noble houses."⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "We came to this small island, an ancient and little used retreat of my people. Here I hid my house from the un-death spreading through our empire. Here I hoped to plan a means of stopping Geraine and his dark reign."⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "Then we were betrayed!"⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft's ephemeral form suddenly coalesces and becomes almost solid. Grief and unspeakable anger rage within his eyes. Then he sags and fades almost from view.⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "My Court Jester, sharp of wit and nimble of foot, and lifelong friend, the last person I would expect to betray me, snuck away in the night. He met with Rytheran to bargain my house's secret location in exchange for power. I suppose he got his reward. I still don't know how that dark mage Rytheran did it, but he drove that treacherous fool mad with the power he instilled in him."⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "His mind broken, he returned to my court where he caused havoc and insanity. We finally trapped him, but the death he so richly deserved was now impossible. My most deadly spells had nearly no effect on him. He had grown so powerful he was no longer empyrean. He had become something horrible and everlasting."⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "I ordered him entombed for all eternity. And set guardians to watch over him."⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "I fear that I cannot grant the Maiden Laylana's request. It would be unthinkable to release him."⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "I do feel for her loss all the same. I myself lost those closest to me following the Jester's betrayal. I will let you deliver her Love Letter to the Jester, although it will surely mean nothing to his deranged mind."⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire gives you Jester Prison Key.⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "Take this key. It will grant you limited access to the Jester. Be sure that you do not listen to his rantings. He may be insane, but he remains as clever a trickster as ever he was. Above all do not try to free him. I took great measures to insure he will never be released and you would surely die in the attempt."⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "I thank you again for your bravery in destroying my corrupted form."
L|1||Using Ornate Bone Key on Guardian Statue⸩ ⸨You allow Guardian Statue to examine your Ornate Bone Key.⸩ ⸨Use the statue to insert the key into the key hole.⸩ ⸨As the bone key slides into the keyhole you hear a whispered voice.⸩ ⸨"This key will lead you to my tomb. I await you, if you believe your group has the strength to defeat me. Use this key and you will have only a short time to pass through into my final resting place."⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Ornate Bone Keys.⸩ ⸨The bone key turns with a loud click and crumbles to dust.
L|1||Shade of Parieth⸩ ⸨Shade of Parieth tells you, "Lord Cynreft has summoned me here to warn off those who would disturb him. I hope you are prepared!"⸩ ⸨Shade of Parieth says, "Prepare yourselves! The Royal Guard of Lord Cynreft come forth to protect him! You have one hour to defeat the guard and battle Lord Cynreft Mhoire!"⸩ ⸨Shade of Parieth tells you, "I await the one who used Lord Cynreft's key. If the one is not among you then begone."
L|1||Lord Cynreft⸩ ⸨His corrupted form destroyed, the spirit of Lord Cynreft appears.⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft says, "My time on this world is brief! Speak with me quickly heroes."⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire gives you Jester Prison Key.⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "You have my thanks. My spirit is free from the corruption of this place. I feel at peace. I can only hope that I am not drawn once again into the corruption."⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "I can only assume I have you to thank for this brief respite. Take this key. It will open a hidden cache of royal treasure hidden in the graveyard. Search for it."⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire gives you Lord Cynreft Mhoire's Key.⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire tells you, "Again I thank you for what you have obviously done."⸩ ⸨Lord Cynreft Mhoire bestows to you the title "Hero of House Mhoire."⸩

Quest.name: Portal_Space_Rifts
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|120 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Marcus Manfried» I|Starts At|«Mar'uun» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|In order to access the version of Mar'uun that is not destroyed, and thus this quest, you must complete the «Portal Space Time Travel» quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Marcus Manfried» and he will direct you to «Kaywin». Route: From Al-Arqas, take the Al-Nosaj portal at 33.5S, 13.1E. Then run to the Mar'uun at 10.6S, 17.1E. L|2|•|⟦PortalSpaceRiftsStarted⟧ L|1|2.|«Kaywin» will give you a «Rift Opening Device» and «Rift Closing Device». L|1|3.|Now start looking for a «Portalspace Rift», which appears on the floor as a little vent of colored gas. They are found all over Mar'uun, not just near the Test Portal area. They disappear after a short time (due to a decay timer) but always appear in the same places. Some known places of specific rifts: L|2|•|**Fire**: At the portal drop into town, one is in the hallway in front of you, and one is behind the bar on your right. L|2|•|**Frost**: One is behind the northern screen in the furnished room, and one is near Kaywin in the little nook across from the stabilizing machines. L|2|•|**Acid**: One is in the hallway near Kaywin, and one is under the stairs in the portal space research area. L|2|•|**Electricity**: One is next to the exit portal near the entrance, one is in Mar'uun's main circle hall, at a bend to the left of the entrance hallway, and one is in the furnished room behind the southern screen. L|1|4.|When you see one stand near it and use the Rift Opening Device and you will be portaled into the elemental plane of the elemental rift you used. L|1|5.|When you land in a room use your «Rift Closing Device» to initiate a spawn of elemental creatures. Kill all of them and a Elemental Zenith will spawn. Kill it and you will be portaled back to Mar'uun. L|2|•|If the Zenith does not spawn for you once you kill all the elemetals simply use the «Rift Closing Device» again and it should appear. L|2|•|Electric: ⟦ElectricZenithDead⟧ L|2|•|Acid: ⟦AcidZenithDead⟧ L|2|•|Fire: ⟦FireZenithDead⟧ L|2|•|Frost: ⟦FrostZenithDead⟧ L|1|6.|Repeat the steps above for 3 more elements until you have done all four then talk to Marcus for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦PortalSpaceRiftsDone⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Mar'uun» N/A -- -- TR|«Acid Elemental Plane» N/A -- -- TR|«Electric Elemental Plane» N/A -- -- TR|«Fire Elemental Plane» N/A -- -- TR|«Frost Elemental Plane» N/A -- -- TE
H2|Rewards
R| RK|Experience|100,000,000 (20% up to level 168) RK|Items| RI|«Mana Forge Key» RE
H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog H4|Wren L|1||Wren the Curious tells you, "I can't even start to tell you how much we appreciate all the help we've received from the great adventurers of Dereth." L|1||Wren the Curious tells you, "Marcus changed our experiments thanks to the information we received from the Arcanum though it wasn't all in time." L|1||Wren the Curious tells you, "We've been left with rifts coming through trying to merge the elemental planes with our own." L|1||Wren the Curious tells you, "Luckily we're only dealing with the base four elements and we can control this."
H4|Marcus Manfried L|1||Marcus Manfried tells you, "Our experiments opened rifts to the elemental planes." L|1||Marcus Manfried tells you, "We need to seal these rifts..." L|1||Marcus Manfried tells you, "I've commissioned the creation of several items to my specifications." L|1||Marcus Manfried tells you, "Go see Kaywin and she'll provide you with what you need."
H4|Kaywin L|1||Kaywin tells you, "Oh, I see you're here for Marcus's latest requests." L|1||Kaywin tells you, "Truely wonderful gadgets." L|1||Kaywin gives you Rift Opening Device. L|1||Kaywin tells you, "One is used to open rifts. It's a crazy sight to behold... you'll be ripped directly into the rift." L|1||Kaywin tells you, "The other is used to close rifts once you are inside. I can't truly say what that's like..." L|1||Kaywin gives you Rift Closing Device.
H3|Rewards Dialog L|1||Marcus Manfried tells you, "Excellent, you've closed all the rifts." L|1||Marcus Manfried tells you, "The Arcanum has given these to reward those who aid our call for help." L|1||Marcus Manfried gives you Mana Forge Key. L|1||You've earned 100,000,000 experience. L|1||Marcus Manfried tells you, "This won't be the end of the rifts. By my calculations you'll be able to assist us again in over six days time." L|1||You hand over 1 of your Rift Opening Devices. L|1||You hand over 1 of your Rift Closing Devices.
H3|Speaking to Marcus after completion L|1||Marcus Manfried tells you, "Any further exposure may cause catastrophic consequences." L|1||Marcus Manfried tells you, "My calculations say that you'll have to wait at least six days from your last exposure to the elemental planes." L|1||Marcus Manfried tells you, "Adventurers into the elemental planes act as an anchor, rooting it. Any one individual spending too much time in the elemental planes will cause it to become coterminous with our own plane." L|1||Marcus Manfried tells you, "Trust me, that's something we don't want but we must close these rifts..." L|1||Marcus Manfried tells you, "Luckily we stopped our experiments before we tapped into any planes beyond the four basic elemental planes."
H3|Other Interactions H4|Using the Rift Opening Device near a Portalspace Rift L|2||Portalspace Rift teleports you with Portalspace Rift.
H4|Using the Rift Closing Device inside the elemental plane L|1||The rift expands as elemental creatures flow out.
H4|Killing a Acid Elemental L|1||Acid dissipates into the surroundings. The sour taste of acid lingers in the atmosphere.
H4|Killing a Fire Elemental L|1||Fire dissipates into the surroundings. The atmosphere warms and your flesh blisters.
H4|Killing a Frost Elemental L|1||Frost dissipates into the surroundings. The atmosphere cools and a chill numbs you to the core.
H4|Killing a Electricity Elemental L|1||Electricity dissipates into the surroundings. A charge lingers in the atmosphere striking at exposed surfaces.
H4|Killing a Zenith L|1||As the elemental creature collapses you feel space fold in on itself. It feels like your gut turned inside out as you're ripped back through portal space.

Quest.name: Rossu_Morta_Chapterhouse_Access
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|100 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Melaverre» I|Starts At|70.0N, 62.4W near «Sanamar» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Quest Chain|Joining the Rossu Morta I|1|«Dericost Ruin Quest» I|2|«Knights of Karlun Quest» I|3|«Red Bull of Sanamar Quest» I|4|«Whispering Blade Infiltration» I|5|Rossu Morta Chapterhouse Access I|6|«Lost Messenger» (Optional) I|7|«Grael's Summoning Chamber» H2|Overview L|1|•|This is the fifth quest in the quest chain for the «Ordina Rossu Morta» faction.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak with «Melaverre» in the «Royal Hall» near «Sanamar». Melaverre will give you an «Elder Spirits Seal Fragment». L|2|•|⟦RossuMortaChapterhouseAccess_Start⟧ L|2|•|⟦BlackSpearTempleUpperLevel_Flag⟧ L|1|2.|Travel to «Black Spear Temple Upper Levels» at 68.5S, 66.1W on the «Obsidian Plains». L|2|1.|Easiest way is the «Black Spawn Den Portal Device» or the «Dangerous Portal Device» L|2|2.|Though the entrance portal is not recallable, the surface portal is L|1|3.|The dungeon is pretty straightforward. Run towards the end and hand your fragment to the «Broken Seal of the Elder Spirits». L|2|•|⟦ElderSpiritsSealStamp⟧ L|2|•|Note: if you die, run back to the dungeon and use the Seal again, you do not need a second fragment. L|1|4.|This will portal you to the lower level with «Shadow»s. L|1|5.|Again, there is only one way to go. Run until you come to a pit. L|1|6.|Jump down, kill «Shonossoar the Song-Keeper» and loot the «Shonossoar Fragment». L|2|•|⟦ShonossoarFragment_Pickup⟧ L|1|7.|Jump into the next pit, kill «Kaihoatai the Monitor» and loot the «Koihoatai Fragment». L|2|•|⟦KoihoataiFragment_Pickup⟧ L|1|8.|Jump into the next pit, kill «Parfarrail the Seer» and loot the «Parfarrail Fragment». L|2|•|⟦ParfarrailFragment_Pickup⟧ L|1|9.|Combine Shonossoar and Koihoatai fragments together to make «Partial Elder Spirits Tablet». L|1|10.|Combine the Parfarrail fragment with the partial tablet to create «Elder Spirits Tablet». L|1|11.|Return to «Melaverre», and hand her the tablet for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦RossuMortaChapterhouseAccess_Wait⟧ L|2|•|⟦AccessRossuMortaChapterhouse⟧ L|1|12.|Equip «Ring of the Rossu Morta» L|2|•|⟦RossuMortaChapterhouse_Flag⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps

H2|Rewards
R|Hand the Elder Spirits Tablet to Melaverre RK|Experience|9,647,000 (7% up to level 120) RK|Items| RI|«Ring of the Rossu Morta» RI|«Translated Elder Spirits Tablet» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Melaverre tells you, "Ah, I'm glad you came to me. I can see that you have done some dangerous and unorthodox things in the service of our King. I would ask you to do more. In the Obsidian Plains, at 68.4 S, 66.1 W, there is an ancient temple that the Order of the Raven Hand has been using as some site of worship. It is called the Black Spear Temple."⸩ ⸨Melaverre tells you, "Within the depths of the temple complex, there is a pedestal which bears the seal of the Elder Spirits that serve the "Living Darkness" the Raven Hand is so infatuated with. The seal is broken, but I have the missing fragment. I would like you to take it and explore the levels that the cultists have not yet been able to penetrate."⸩ ⸨Melaverre tells you, "I seek a tablet of ancient knowledge, which has been split into three pieces. The three pieces are guarded by ancient Shadows known as Shonossoar, Kaihoatai, and Parfarrail. Take the fragments from these creatures of Shadow, assemble the tablet, and bring it to me."⸩ ⸨Melaverre gives you Elder Spirits Seal Fragment.⸩ ⸨Melaverre tells you, "There is one thing for you to remember. I know that there are ways of concealing one's service to the King. Just know that this is a sensitive enough task that there will be no way that your involvement can be forgotten by any simple raid on the Royal Archives. However, if you do this for me, I will grant you full membership in the Ordina Rossu Morta."
L|1||Returning Dialog⸩ ⸨Melaverre tells you, "So you've picked up the Parfarrail Fragment, have you? Combine it with the other two fragments and give me the complete tablet, if you would be so kind."
L|1||Giving the Elder Spirits Seal Fragment to the Broken Seal of the Elder Spirits⸩ ⸨You give Broken Seal of the Elder Spirits Elder Spirits Seal Fragment.⸩ ⸨The Elder Spirits Seal seems to acknowledge your presence when you press the missing fragment into it. It teleports you to the lower levels of the Black Spear Temple...⸩ ⸨⸨Broken Seal of the Elder Spirits teleports you with Lower Black Spear Temple Portal Sending.⸩⸩ ⸨You get the sense that, in the future, simply touching the completed seal will be enough to activate the seal's magic and transport you back into the lower levels of the temple.
L|1||Handing in Elder Spirits Tablet to Melaverre⸩ ⸨You give Melaverre Elder Spirits Tablet.⸩ ⸨Melaverre tells you, "A fascinating record of the mysterious Grael. Count Dardante and our King are both very interested. I thank you for your service."⸩ ⸨You've earned 9,647,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Melaverre gives you Ring of the Rossu Morta.⸩ ⸨Melaverre gives you Translated Elder Spirits Tablet.
L|1||Returning Dialog⸩ ⸨Melaverre tells you, "You've done some work for me already, haven't you? Sorry, I don't have any more deep pits of eldritch magic to push you into at the moment."⸩

Quest.name: Search_for_Gareth_Dain
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 I|Type|Small Fellowship/Solo I|Starts At|«Sclavus Temple» at 82.5S, 75.0W I|Route|«Candeth Keep» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest requires «Lockpick» skill. L|1|•|{WARN} Need two runs to gather all stamps. Once for each reward option. L|2|•|{TIP} Gather both books and get the Tome translated on the first run, and turn in one of the books (keeping the other). Wait for the timer to expire, then talk to the ladies and turn in the other book. No need to rerun the whole thing.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to «Talira Dain» and «Dalius Kendmar» of «Candeth Keep» for initial details. L|2|•|To gather both stamps talk to «Talira Dain» then «Dalius Kendmar» and then «Talira Dain» again L|2|•|⟦TalkedToLadyDain⟧ L|2|•|⟦TalkedToDaliusKendmar⟧ L|1|2.|Head west to the «Sclavus Temple» at 82.5S, 75.0W. L|1|3.|Head down in the temple. You will reach a larger room with two stone heads and some altars. Pick the door on the western end of the room (resistance 525) L|1|4.|From here, you can head west, which will lead you to a room with the «Book of Memories». The book is found down the hall through the secret passage behind the sarcophagi, use the nearby torch to access the passage. L|2|•|The book of memories is required to obtain the «Polestar». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpJournalGarethDain⟧ L|1|5.|If you have no need for the book, head south to the boss chamber. L|1|6.|In the boss chamber, clear the sclavus. L|1|7.|Destroy the «Sarcophagus (Dareth Gain Quest)¦Sarcophagus» (20,000 estimated HP). L|1|8.|When the Sarcophagus is destroyed, «Sister Vitriaka» spawns, along with approximately thirty Sclavus Lords. Plan to position yourself wisely beforehand. L|1|9.|Kill Sister Vitriaka and the Sclavus. Loot the «Scrap of Paper (Gareth Dain)¦Scrap of Paper» from Sister Vitriaka. L|2|•|⟦PasswordVitriaka⟧ L|1|10.|Once the boss is dead, pull the torch labeled on the map for access to the hidden room off the boss chamber, where you will find the «Falatacot Tome (A Poorly Translated Journal)¦Falatacot Tome». L|2|1.|Note 1: Only the person that picked up the Scrap of Paper can use the torch to open the secret passage L|2|2.|Note 2: In the secret passage is another torch which can be used to open the door from there, so the person with the Scrap of Paper can run through. L|2|•|The tome is required to obtain the «Staff of Coercion». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpJournalVitriaka⟧ L|1|11.|Bring the «Falatacot Tome (A Poorly Translated Journal)¦Falatacot Tome» to «Fanzen San the Translator» in «Hebian-To» to receive «A Poorly Translated Journal».
H4|Option 1: «Polestar» L|1|1.|Give the «Book of Memories» to «Talira Dain» For the «Polestar» L|2|•|If you give them the incorrect book, they keep it and you cannot receive the reward. L|2|•|⟦DainAlive⟧
H4|Option 2: «Staff of Coercion» L|1|1.|Give «A Poorly Translated Journal» to «Dalius Kendmar» for the «Staff of Coercion». L|2|•|If you give them the incorrect book, they keep it and you cannot receive the reward. L|2|•|⟦DainDead⟧
