H2|Dialog P|⸨;Talira Dain's Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "Maybe you have heard of my husband, Gareth Dain?⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "He hunted these lands looking for treasure and glory, but three years ago he failed to return home. I could find nothing else to explain his disappearance, then one year ago a warrior told me that he had seen Gareth shortly before he went missing. The man said that Gareth had been fighting a group of Sclavus in the crater hills somewhere around here.⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "I moved to Candeth Keep with the hope that I could find clues to tell me what had happened to Gareth. Recently my husband's dear friend Dalius found a Temple in a crater west of here.⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "He says that the crater was filled with a howling sandstorm. He bravely fought his way to the eye of the storm to find a Temple protected by Sclavus. I am sure that this must be the same temple that my husband was last seen at.⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "Please, go and find out what happened to my husband. I just need to know what really happened."
L|1||Dalius Kendmar's Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "Hello friend, did Lady Dain ask you to speak with me?⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "I must ask a favor of you. I recently discovered something while searching for my long lost friend Gareth Dain.⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "I was exploring the wastelands west of here when a giant sandstorm blew in out of nowhere. It stung my face and made it almost impossible to breathe, but I forced my way onward. I eventually came to a calm at the center of the storm where I found an ancient temple. When I approached the structure a great number of Sclavus sprung from the sands and attacked, forcing me to retreat.⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "I have told Lady Dain what I discovered and we believe that this is the very Sclavus Temple that Gareth was last seen at. I do not however hold her belief that her husband still lives. She has obsessed over his disappearance for three years now and I dearly wish to see her mourning end.⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "Do her a noble deed and find proof of her husband's death. I am sure that my friend Gareth would have come back if humanly possible, so I know him to be dead. I ask of you to be sure that you bring only proof of his death, she has suffered enough and I could not bear to see her suffering continue. Do this for me and I will reward you."
L|1||Returing to Talira Dain⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "I've told you everything I know about my husbands disappearance. Ask Dalius if he knows more about the Sclavus Temple he found."
L|1||Returing to Dalius Kendmar⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "I have told you of the temple to the west. Search for a great sandstorm and find it's eye."⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "Lady Dain may be able to tell you something of use, but I warn you not to cause her undo stress."
L|1||Strange Sclavus dialog⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "I can no longer cry for what I have lost. My sorrow knows no release."⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus shakes it's head and stares through you.⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "I have to hide. I mustn't be ssseen.⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "Leave me alone!⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "Don't look at me. I am hideoussss!⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "We can't let you leave you know. She wouldn't be happy with ussss.⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "I found the doorway of the dead. The dead guard my secret. I mussstn't let her find it. My secret place.⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "She callsss to us! We mussst obey...⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "No! I am not hers! I belong to... who was she?"
L|1||Attacking Strange Sclavus:⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus yells, "Death to the intruders!"⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus falls. It hisses with its final breath, "Tell my wife I love her very much."
L|1||Upon destruction of the Sarcophagus:⸩ ⸨The sarcophagus cracks and it's stone crumbles to the floor. A figure rises from the debris.⸩ ⸨⸨Sister Vitriaka says, "Ek, taivti Tik Vaiktu Kiktij tiu ikni arkvikt."⸩
L|1||Showing texts to Strange Sclavus:⸩ ⸨You allow Strange Sclavus to examine your Book of Memories.⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "My memories, I had forgotten...⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "Why did I keep asking him. Daliusss my friend, you didn't want me to go, you told me of the danger, but that just made me want to explore the temple more. I was sso foolish!⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "I weedled the information from you and set off on my reckless adventure. If only I had listened to you my dear friend. I lost everything that day... I lost my love.⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "My Lady... I would not have you see me ssso. I would rather you believe me dead."
L|1||Showing Scrap of Paper to the Strange Sclavus⸩ ⸨You allow Strange Sclavus to examine your Scrap of Paper.⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "Open what?"⸩ ⸨You allow Strange Sclavus to examine your Falatacot Tome.⸩ ⸨Strange Sclavus tells you, "You must stop her! Others will come! Stop her!"
L|1||Showing Scrap of Paper to NPCs:⸩ ⸨You allow Talira Dain to examine your Scrap of Paper.⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "I ask you to find out what happened to my husband and you bring me back a scrap of paper with doodles on it!!!"⸩ ⸨⸨Talira Dain cast Fire Vulnerability Other VI on you.⸩⸩ ⸨⸨Talira Dain singes you for xx points with Flame Streak I.⸩⸩ ⸨⸨Talira Dain singes you for xx points with Flame Streak I.⸩⸩ ⸨⸨Talira Dain singes you for xx points with Flame Streak I.⸩⸩ ⸨You allow Dalius Kendmar to examine your Scrap of Paper.⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "I cannot read this. It looks like a clue though. Did you find anything else?"⸩ ⸨You give Fanzen San the Translator Scrap of Paper.⸩ ⸨Fanzen San the Translator tells you, "This is the Falatacot command for open. That is strange."
L|1||Showing NPCs untranslated Falatacot Tome:⸩ ⸨You allow Dalius Kendmar to examine your Falatacot Tome.⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "Why give this to me? I cannot read Falatacot... if that is what this strange language is."⸩ ⸨You allow Talira Dain to examine your Falatacot Tome.⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "I can't read this. Is it about my husband?"
L|1||Translating the tome⸩ ⸨You allow Fanzen San the Translator to examine your Falatacot Tome.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Falatacot Tomes.⸩ ⸨Fanzen San the Translator tells you, "This appears to be Falatacot in nature, but the language is older. I'm not familiar with the dialect, though some words appear to be very close with many of the writings that I have translated in the past."⸩ ⸨Fanzen San the Translator tells you, "Here, I translated as much as I could. I find it rather disturbing."⸩ ⸨You've earned 20,700,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Fanzen San the Translator gives you A Poorly Translated Journal.
L|1||Giving Dalius the wrong book (Book of Memories):⸩ ⸨You give Dalius Kendmar Book of Memories.⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "These are lies fabricated by some confused creature. My dear friend Gareth is dead and we must prove that to our Lady there. I will keep this so that she does not get confused."⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "Did you find nothing to prove what we already know?"
L|1||Giving Talira the wrong book (A Poorly Translated Journal):⸩ ⸨You give Talira Dain A Poorly Translated Journal.⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "Have you brought word of my husband?"⸩ ⸨Talira Dain takes the book and reads Fanzen's notes.⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "This Vitriaka performed some magical process on a..."⸩ ⸨Talira Dain looks up from the book in shock.⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "No. No, it can't be! It was someone else!! That undead Beast couldn't take my Gareth! Nooooo!!!"⸩ ⸨Talira Dain throws the book at you.⸩ ⸨She collapses to the floor in grief. Her body shaking with her sobs.⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "Gaaareth! My Gareth!!!"⸩ ⸨Dalius quietly motions you over to him and holds out a hand for the book.
L|1||Handing in Book of Memories to Talira Dain⸩ ⸨You give Talira Dain Book of Memories.⸩ ⸨Talira Dain takes the book and stares at the sclavus covering. She slowly opens it and starts to read.⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "Oh, my lord... Gareth... what did they do to you?!⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "No! My poor Gareth... She hurt you, she changed you."⸩ ⸨Talira Dain points a shaking finger at you.⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "You killed the Beast that did this to him? Tell me you killed her!!!⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "You did as I asked. I know the truth now, it's horrible, but I know.⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "Take this as a small reward and leave me."⸩ ⸨Talira Dain hands you a beautiful staff⸩ ⸨Talira Dain gives you Polestar.
L|1||Giving Dalius the journal after giving Talira the Book of Memories:⸩ ⸨You give Dalius Kendmar A Poorly Translated Journal.⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar glares at you in disgust."⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "You can't fix the damage you've done now."⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "Leave us! I'll dispose of this myself."
L|1||Speaking with Dalius after above scenario:⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar glares at you with distaste.⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "You had to tell her."⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "What good did you do her by telling her that her husband is now some hideous freak? I asked you to do a simple task and put my Lady's mind at peace, but you just had to go and ruin everything!"⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar's eyes suddenly loose their ferocity and he straightens up.⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "Well, what's done is done. Take your little magic staff and leave us. I have to comfort Talira. I'll make it all right."
L|1||Handing in "A Poorly Translated Journal" to Dalius Kendmar⸩ ⸨You give Dalius Kendmar A Poorly Translated Journal.⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "You have done my Lady and myself a great service. You are truly worthy of my friendship.⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "Take this staff as a small token of my appreciation."⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar gives you Staff of Coercion.
L|1||Speaking to Talira after completing the quest⸩ ⸨Talira Dain tells you, "My Gareth is gone!"
L|1||Speaking to Dalius after completing the quest⸩ ⸨Dalius Kendmar tells you, "I owe you a great debt my friend. You have helped my Lady put her late husband behind her. With my help she will learn to be happy once more."⸩

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "Greetings, I am Shadow Hunter Killcrane. Not a very uplifting title for a Knight of the Golden Flame, I know, but mine is a grim task."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "High Queen Strathelar has bid myself and others like me to follow the shadow wherever it goes. This is a daunting task to be certain."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "Of late, my journeys have led me to following the actions of the Order of the Raven Hand. Their activities have stirred again, particularly near the energies of the center of the Obsidian Plains."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "I tracked a heavily laden party of their agents to the Singularity Bore not but a handful of days ago."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "My Queen's orders were to find the source of the activity of the Raven Hand. My Lady did declare that I may seek the aid of others if need be."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "Travel to the Singularity Caul, seek out the Order of the Raven Hand, and find what it is that now draws those Shadow-worshipping miscreants to that island and return to me with your findings. Reports from adventurers tell of cultist campsites in the southern, eastern, and western portions of the island."
L|1||Showing pieces to Sarkin⸩ ⸨You allow Sarkin Killcrane to examine your Twilight Fragment.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "Hmm, I am not quite certain what this artifact is. I can say that this only appears to be a piece of the whole. Go back to the Singularity Caul and see if you can find the remaining fragments."⸩ ⸨As you turn to leave, Sarkin Killcrane mumbles under his breath, "I know I've seen something like this before, but where?"⸩ ⸨You allow Sarkin Killcrane to examine your Raven Fragment.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "Hmm, I am not quite certain what this artifact is. I can say that this only appears to be a piece of the whole. Go back to the Singularity Caul and see if you can find the remaining fragments."⸩ ⸨As you turn to leave, Sarkin Killcrane mumbles under his breath, "I know I've seen something like this before, but where?"⸩ ⸨You allow Sarkin Killcrane to examine your Iniquitous Fragment.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "Hmm, I am not quite certain what this artifact is. I can say that this only appears to be a piece of the whole. Go back to the Singularity Caul and see if you can find the remaining fragments."⸩ ⸨As you turn to leave, Sarkin Killcrane mumbles under his breath, "I know I've seen something like this before, but where?"⸩ ⸨You allow Sarkin Killcrane to examine your Combined Artifact Fragment.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "Hmm, I am not quite certain what this artifact is. I can say that this only appears to be a piece of the whole. Go back to the Singularity Caul and see if you can find the remaining fragments."⸩ ⸨As you turn to leave, Sarkin Killcrane mumbles under his breath, "I know I've seen something like this before, but where?"
L|1||Combining pieces⸩ ⸨The two artifacts link together effortlessly.⸩ ⸨The two artifacts link together effortlessly.
L|1||Handing in Vestibule Lock⸩ ⸨You give Sarkin Killcrane Vestibule Lock.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "So many adventurers have brought me pieces of this item, and it is only now that I see it completed that I remember where I've seen it before."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "You've been to the Soul Crystal Vaults, correct? You know - Fenmalain, Caulnalain, Shendolain, those three. Each house a gate that requires a key. Looking at this, it appears to be part of one such gate. Yet... this one is on the Singularity Caul."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "With this lock in our hands, we can assume that one such gate exists on the Singularity Caul, likely in an incomplete state."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "We know that these gates guarded some of the scattered pieces of the Crystal Array that were used to contain the essence of the Hopeslayer. It is not so far fetched to think that other similar arrays were created to contain other horrors."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "Wait... now this is odd... no offense to you, but it seems as though you put this together incorrectly. I've spent a good deal of time studying the gates; I should be of some help here."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "Here! Now go and seek out this new Shadow gate on the Singularity Caul. Infiltrate the dark places the gate will lead you to. I have heard tell of yet another concentration of Raven Hand forces in the northern reaches of that accursed place."⸩ ⸨You've earned 339,045,140 experience.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane gives you Vestibule Lock.
L|1||Nightmare Gate⸩ ⸨The air around the Nightmare Gate seems to momentarily warp, but nothing happens.⸩ ⸨You give Nightmare Gate Vestibule Lock.⸩ ⸨The Nightmare lock fits into the front of the gate.⸩ ⸨The air around the Nightmare Gate seems to warp momentarily as you are drawn into portal space.
L|1||Handing in Journal of High Archon Kraest⸩ ⸨You give Sarkin Killcrane Journal of High Archon Kraest.⸩ ⸨Shadow Hunter Killcrane cracks the seal of the journal and reads over its contents quickly.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "Ah, the infamous High Archon Kraest... hmm? You haven't heard of him before now? I suppose you wouldn't, few outside of the Raven Hand know of him, and those who do are likely ones such as myself."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "This journal contains Kraest's notes. His goal seems to be to unleash some trapped essence associated with the darkness. The text gives a better description of what exactly this being is... better than the Dericost texts I have managed to get my hands upon recently."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "Kraest calls this being "the Spear of Mukkir." I can't say as I heard of such a thing before. Though from what he has written, it is apparently a vicious and frightening creature."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "It is clear from this journal that Kraest accomplished what he sought to do on the Singularity Caul. He has shattered the first crystal he believes to be keeping this creature at bay."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane gives you Journal of High Archon Kraest.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane gives you 3 Trade Notes (250,000).⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane gives you Writ of Refuge.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane gives you Writ of Refuge.
L|1||Translating Unreadable Dericost Tome to Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator⸩ ⸨You give Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator Unreadable Dericost Tome.⸩ ⸨Kuyiza begins translating and transcribing the text for you, happily chatting along as she works.⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "It has been such a long while since I have had something new to work with. People usually bring me bits of parchment from Frore... not that I mind Frore..."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "Sometimes they bring me something about the undead scholar Rytheran... but I've seen most of what is said in those texts already..."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "Then there was that whole Elemental business... well... I wasn't able to leave my cottage because they were everywhere for a time..."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "And who would have thought that the Dericost would help us seal up the tunnels of the... oh my..."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza stops mid sentence, rapidly finishes her transcriptions and seals the tome with wax.⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "You are working for the Shadow Hunter Killcrane, yes? Quickly, take this directly to him. Don't dawdle. What is in this tome is of great import."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator gives you Translated Dericost Tome.
L|1||Handing in Translated Dericost Tome⸩ ⸨You give Sarkin Killcrane Translated Dericost Tome.⸩ ⸨Killcrane gently unlocks the sealed translation and quickly skims the bulk of Kuyiza bint Zayi's translation.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "A Dericost text... Kuyiza always manages to come through on these types of artifacts."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "Judging from her translation, this appears to be an account of some creature. Something powerful and driven by the darkness. The text doesn't do very well to describe it physically, merely stating that this creature could bring out the fear on those it fought."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "It was a beast of grand stature. Those it confronted were felled in the conflict or driven mad with fear."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "If the Raven Hand has managed to release something, or weaken the bonds that hold it, I fear we must act quickly."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane gives you Account of the Spear of Mukkir.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane gives you 3 Trade Notes (250,000).⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "For now, it appears my search is at a halt. Whatever the goal of the Raven Hand on the Singularity Caul, it seems as though they have achieved it."⸩ ⸨You've earned 339,045,140 experience.⸩

I|Level|115 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Astara Duskshield» I|Starts At|10.3N, 58.3E in «Rithwic» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|The search for Tamian Wilmot will uncover an ancient love story, and spear.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|«Astara Duskshield» will send you to speak to «Delton Hardor» at 10.7N, 59.4E. L|2|•|⟦SpokeWithAstara⟧ L|1|2.|Delton sends you to speak to «Ji Tenxien the Tailor» at 10.7N 59.2E. L|2|•|⟦SpokeWithDelton⟧ L|1|3.|From Ji, speak to «Wylreda the Scribe» at 10.6N 58.4E. L|1|4.|Now make your way back to «Astara Duskshield», she will then send you to «Lin». L|1|5.|Once in «Lin» you will find «Tian Li Quan» at 54.4S 73.1E. He will give you the «Journal of Tamian Wilmot». L|2|•|⟦GotTamianJournal⟧ L|1|6.|Now we are off to our first dungeon, «An Archive» located at 63.5S 36.8E. L|2|•|Route: A quick way to get here is to take the «Ro-Nan» portal outside «Qalaba'r» located at 74.8S 17.9E. L|1|7.|Optional: Go into the dungeon and you will find «A Note from Tamian Wilmot (First Note)¦A Note from Tamian Wilmot» on the wall next to a locked door. L|1|8.|The note will tell you to go outside the dungeon and find a group of «Iron Golem Guardian»s to the Northwest. L|1|9.|Kill the golems, one or more of them will drop a «Key to an Archive». Head back into the dungeon, go through the door and follow it to the end. L|1|10.|At the end of the dungeon you will find another «A Note from Tamian Wilmot (Second Note)¦Note from Tamian Wilmot» this one will direct you to the «Aia's Tower» outside «Uziz». L|2|•|⟦TowerDungeonAccess⟧ L|1|11.|Head to the «Tower Base Dungeon» outside of Uziz located at 34.7S 33.6E. Go in the dungeon, follow it all the way until you reach the «Upper Tower». L|2|•|Route: Take the South Uziz Villas portal at 24.9S 29.8E and run to the Tower Base Dungeon from there. L|1|12.|About halfway up the tower you will find a «Stone Plaque» and another «A Note from Tamian Wilmot (Third Note)¦Note from Tamian Wilmot» besides it. L|1|13.|Pick up the note, and head up one side of the tower, at the top will be a chest holding a «Glass Token Half», do the same to the other side of the tower to receive the other half. L|2|•|⟦GotSpearTokenHalf1⟧ L|2|•|⟦GotSpearTokenHalf2⟧ L|1|14.|Combine the halves into «A Glass Token», and bring them to the room at the bottom of the tower. Give the token to the «Spear of the Given Heart (Object)¦Spear of the Given Heart» to receive the «Spear of the Given Heart». L|2|•|⟦GotSpearGivenHeart⟧ L|1|15.|Bring back the third note and journal to «Astara Duskshield» to receive your experience reward. L|2|•|⟦GOTTAMIANJOURNALAWARD⟧ L|2|•|⟦GOTTAMIANNOTE4AWARD⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Astara Duskshield tells you, "Hello. Have you seen Tamian Wilmit around at all lately? I have not seen him in quite some time now. I am concerned about him, he had been acting a bit strange lately. He is a very dear friend. If you could find where he is I would very much appreciate it. He had a row with my friend Delton Hardor. Very out of character for Tamian.
L|1||Returning to Astara Duskshiel⸩ ⸨Astara Duskshield tells you, "Have you found anything out about Tamian yet?"
L|1||Delton Hardor⸩ ⸨Delton Hardor tells you, "Have I seen Tamian Wilmit? Strange fellow he is, not very able. Seems he can do nothing. I do not understand why Astara is still friends with him. Tis true, they knew each other on Ispar when younger but he is of no use here. Little in the way of useful skills, he has.⸩ ⸨Delton Hardor tells you, "Yes, you may go tell Astara I said so. He tried to fight me in sword practise. I swatted him finely for he is no good with a blade and he came at me like a rabid Carenzi. I had to give him a good thrashing, lucky he is we were using wood, not steel. Astara made me stop, also screamed at him, he slunk away like a drudge.⸩ ⸨Delton Hardor tells you, "I believe the last time I saw him was over by Ji Tenxien the Tailor. You could ask her.
L|1||Returning to Delton Hardor⸩ ⸨Delton Hardor tells you, "Do not bother me about Tamian any more, go talk to someone else about him."
L|1||Ji Tenxien the Tailor⸩ ⸨Ji Tenxien the Tailor tells you, "No, I have not seen Tamian Wilmit, not in a while. That boy is not good for much. Lazy, if you ask me. Always has his nose stuck in a piece of parchment. Perhaps Wylreda the Scribe has seen him. Tamian is always scrounging parchment off her.
L|1||Wylreda the Scribe⸩ ⸨Wylreda the Scribe tells you, "Tamian, has not been here lately, now that you mention it. Always in need of parchment, he is. He helps me out a bit in exchange for it. Cannot seem to do much around here but he is deft with ink and quill. Draws quite well, you know.⸩ ⸨Wylreda the Scribe tells you, "Hmmm. An acquaintance of mine, a Scribe named Tian Li Quan traveled through here recently and stayed with Tamian's family. Tamian was fascinated with some Empyrean relic the Scribe had evidence of. Perhaps his friend Astara knows of this, you should ask her.
L|1||Reporting back to Astara Duskshield⸩ ⸨Astara Duskshield tells you, "No word of Tamian? I suppose not, I spoke with most people here myself. I know Delton is still angry at him. Well, Tamian acted a bit wild that day when he and Delton fought, but perhaps he is just not used to swordplay and grew furious when Delton swatted him. Delton is quite good with a sword. Tamian knows nothing about them.⸩ ⸨Astara sighs⸩ ⸨Astara Duskshield tells you, "Of late, Tamian had been extremely interested in something a Scribe who was travelling[sic] through here had given him. It had to do with a tower. Tamian is always drawing towers and such. The Scribe was named Tian Li Quan and resides in Lin, I believe. Tamian is no great traveler and that is quite a way from here. Strange that he would go and say nothing, but perhaps...
L|1||Tian Li Quan⸩ ⸨Tian Li Quan tells you, "Why yes, I do know Tamian Wilmit. I met him when I was travelling through Rithwic. Then he came here not too long ago. He seemed unhappy, and driven. He did some research while he was here but did not speak much to me about it.⸩ ⸨Tian Li Quan tells you, "He left me a sealed copy of his journal in case someone came by looking for him. I think you are not the person he imagined may show up but I believe I should let you have it. He went to look for this structure. He went west.⸩ ⸨Tian Li Quan gives you Journal of Tamian Wilmot

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Guard Winterborn tells you, "Greetings Citizen. I wonder if I could request your aid with something."⸩ ⸨Guard Winterborn tells you, "Recently, there have been reports of a strange, large Banderling-like creature in the area. Several of the local shopkeeps are rather concerned."⸩ ⸨Guard Winterborn tells you, "There are a small group of amicable Banderlings I am acquainted with at 60.2S, 81.9W, who may know more of this situation. If you are willing, could you see if they know anything useful? Don't worry, he'll know I sent you."⸩ ⸨Guard Winterborn tells you, "Also, if you find anything unusual, please bring it to me, so I may add it to the body of information we have gathered on these sightings."
L|1||Chief Taraash⸩ ⸨Chief Taraash tells you, "Hmmm... Winterborn sent you. I smell him on you."⸩ ⸨Chief Taraash tells you, "Perhaps... Perhaps you can help. I trust you. L|1||Chief Taraash (When you're in a Locked Fellowship)⸩ ⸨Chief Taraash says, "Hmmm... Winterborn sent you. I smell him on you and your friends."⸩ ⸨Chief Taraash says, "Perhaps... Perhaps you can help. I trust you. I trust your friends."⸩ ⸨Chief Taraash says, "There is Banderling, named Haraag. He changed recently. He changed a lot. Bigger, stronger, different. He come and try to get Tribes to follow him. Some choose to follow, we chose to fight. We drove him off. Chased him to cave. Then, he ripped a hole in the world and fled through it. Those who chased him through hole, did not return."⸩ ⸨Chief Taraash says, "Now, those who choose Haraag come and steal artifacts of the Banderlings. Like those things you call portals, but worse. I have learned trick to protect you from hole while you travel to its end-place. Take your friends, who are group with you now, and go there. Inside, find Haraag. Retrieve what was stolen from us, and kill Haraag, if you can. Each bring back Artifacts, and I will reward each of you for them."⸩ ⸨Your fellowship is now locked. You may not recruit new members. If you leave the fellowship, you have 15 minutes to be recruited back into the fellowship.⸩ ⸨Chief Taraash raises his hands, and a soft glow infuses 's Fellowship.⸩ ⸨Chief Taraash says, "Now, go. And remember, if you leave group, you'll need new group and my blessing to enter hole again."
L|1||Handing in Sack of Banderling Artifacts to Chief Taraash⸩ ⸨You give Chief Taraash Sack of Banderling Artifacts.⸩ ⸨Chief Taraash tells you, "Thank you again. L|1||Showing in Shard of Harraag's Dagger to Chief Taraash⸩ ⸨You allow Chief Taraash to examine your Shard of Harraag's Dagger.⸩ ⸨Chief Taraash tells you, "Hmmm... Strange thing, this. L|1||Handing in Shard of Harraag's Dagger (Quest Item) to Guard Winterborn⸩ ⸨You give Guard Winterborn Shard of Harraag's Dagger.⸩ ⸨Guard Winterborn tells you, "Another Dagger Shard? Quest.name: Aerbax's_Prodigal_Drudge
Quest.notes: If you PKL the door, you will miss out on qb.
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|75+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Jarvis Hammerstone» (Optional) I|Starts At|25.6N, 49.4E in «Cragstone» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Aerbax's Prodigal Drudge» H2|Overview L|1|•|Investigate the Drudge Fort near Cragstone for Jarvis Hammerstone.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|Before heading to the Drudge Fort make sure you have multiple food items to feed «Sergeant Shanks» in step 3 and «Farmer Kao's Shovel» for step 4. Most groups choose to omit these steps and instead have someone PKL through the cave door. If your group is doing this, skip steps 3 and 4.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|«Jarvis Hammerstone» will inform you of a «Drudge Fort» west of Cragstone at 25.4N 45.9E. L|1|2.|Head to the fort, destroy the walls, and work your way to the inner ring of the fortress. You will find two NPCs: «Sergeant Shanks» the Drudge and «Hoogan» the Banderling. There is also a cave with a locked door. L|1|3.|Give Sergeant Shanks food items until he slips and tells you about the blueprints. L|2|•|⟦PickupDrudgeFortBluePrints⟧ L|1|4.|This flags you to pick up the «Drudge Fort Blueprints» dropped by the «Drudge Biter»s surrounding the cave entrance. You only need to get flagged once per character and then they can pick up blueprints forever. Not many of the Drudge Biters drop the blueprints, so you may need to do some searching to find them. L|1|5.|Bring the blueprints to Hoogan the Banderling, barricaded inside the small hut. Note that you cannot enter the hut, instead you must interact with Hoogan via the small window in the back of the hut. Give him the blueprints and he will tell you that he requires a shovel to escape. There is a «A Farmer's Plea for Help¦rumor» sitting in a pile of trash and stolen loot which will lead you to «Farmer Kao», the owner of the only shovel in Dereth. It saves time to get «Farmer Kao's Shovel» before the quest. Give the shovel to «Hoogan» in return for the «Cave Door Key». L|2|•|⟦GaveHooganBlueprints⟧ L|2|•|⟦GaveHooganShovel⟧ L|1|6.|Use the Cave Door Key to access the «Drudge Cave¦Cave» Dungeon. You will enter in a tunnel which connects to a large chamber. Opposite of you will be a portal to the next area. In order to enter it, you must first kill «Kernel Klank». This will release the restrictions on the portal which takes you to the main and final dungeon, «Under Drudge Fort». L|1|7.|Under Drudge Fort is a large maze, but experienced players will know the way through. If no one knows the way, study the map carefully. Eventually you will jump down to the lower level where Bonecrunch is. L|2|•|If you don't have the map: Once your portal to the lower dungeon, go straight until you hit a wall; go right 90 degrees until you hit a wall; go left and stay left until you go down a ramp; at the bottom of the ramp, stay right until you reach a balloon and a jump down. L|1|8.|When you reach the final room, there is one important thing to remember: **Do not kill «Captain Burnja»**. Killing Burnja puts out the «Wall of Fire» and lets «Bonecrunch» into the main room where he can and will lay waste to the entire group with his high hollow damage. The general strategy for the final room is this: L|2|•|Have one ore more players lead Burnja off to a side room and hold him there until Bonecrunch dies. L|2|•|Have an archer open the door behind the fire wall and lure Bonecrunch with an arrow. L|2|•|Have all archers and mages open fire on Bonecrunch. Slashing ammo with a rending bow is said to be best. L|2|•|Melees keep the spawns of drudges clear so the archers/mages can stay alive and concentrate on Bonecrunch. L|2|•|If anyone dies, they can portal recall and land at the top of the Under Drudge Fort L|1|9.|When Bonecrunch dies, it is then safe to kill Captain Burnja. Once Burnja is dead and the flame wall is down, have everyone in the fellowship loot «Bonecrunch's Chest Key» from his corpse. L|2|•|Captain Burnja carries 1 special board with nail that can also be turned in for a small amount of XP. He also drops «Burnja Token» that can be given in for a title reward. L|2|•|Board Turn In: ⟦BurnjasBoardTurnInRepeat⟧ L|1|10.|Once everyone has a key, exit the dungeon using the «Escape Portal» that appears behind Bonecrunch's throne. Using this portal is what flags you to get a reward from Jarvis. L|2|•|⟦DefeatedBonecrunch!⟧ L|1|11.|Close the chest, if open, and then unlock it using your key. L|2|•|{TIP} You can tell what item is in the chest by looking at the burden: L|3|•|Orb = 9140 BU L|3|•|Scroll = 9070 BU L|3|•|Hammer = 9840 BU L|1|12.|When finished, use the surface portal and run back to Cragstone and speak with Jarvis for experience and a random title reward. L|2|•|{OPT} Unwanted items can be traded or turned in for bonus experience. L|2|•|⟦DefeatedProdigalDrudgeWait!⟧ L|2|•|⟦DefeatedBonecrunchRepeat!⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|If you have more than 1 fellowship, you will need to kill Bonecrunch more than 1 time so everyone gets a key. To do this safely, **everyone should move back to one of the side rooms and wait for Bonecrunch and Burnja to respawn**. If you do not, there is a chance that Bonecrunch will get beyond the flame wall before it can respawn.

H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "We've driven those theiving Drudges back to their fort! but I'm worried they're still planning something..." L|1||Jarvis lowers his voice to a whisper. L|1||Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "Alot of help those Royal Guard were, just standing around and sending messages back and forth!" L|1||Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "The Healer, Avalenne, says she can see Drudges patrolling their fort west of town." L|1||Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "The Cragstone Elders have charged me with the task of getting rid of the drudges and I will reward you well if you can discover what they're doing in that fort of theirs."
H3|Sergeant Shanks L|1||Sergeant Shanks tells you, "I no talk to you. You are not Drudge and I told not to talk to not Drudge!"
H3|Handing in Drudge Fort Blueprints to Hoogan L|1||You give Hoogan Drudge Fort Blueprints. L|1||Hoogan looks the blueprints over. L|1||Hoogan tells you, "Alright, we know we need to dig to avoid these tunnels the Drudges dug here and here, but we don't have anything to dig with. If we had a shovel we could really get out of here." L|1||Hoogan tells you, "Can you find us a shovel? I don't know what the drudges used to dig their tunnels, but maybe you can find a clue around. If you bring me back a shovel I'll give you this key we slipped off of Shanks when he was sleeping today. I think it leads into their tunnels below." L|1||Hoogan tells you, "Remember, if you find a shovel be sure not to give it to anyone else. Bring it to me."
H3|Handing in Farmer Kao's Shovel to Hoogan L|1||You allow Hoogan to examine your Farmer Kao's Shovel. L|1||You hand over 1 of your Farmer Kao's Shovels. L|1||Hoogan bestows the title "Hoogan's Hero" on you. L|1||Hoogan tells you, "Perfect! With this we can finish the tunnel we've been clawing and scrapping out under the bed in here. You've saved my skin friend. Take this key and bring the fight to the Drudges in their tunnels and caves below." L|1||Hoogan gives you Cave Door Key. L|1||Hoogan tells you, "The tunneling is going much faster now that we have the shovel you brought us. You should use that key I gave you to get into the Drudges under ground caves. I'm pretty sure their leader is down there. At least that's what Shanks let slip :the other day. Thanks again human and good luck."
H3|Bonecrunch L|1||Bonecrunch says, "Stay away from my apples!" L|1||Bonecrunch says, "You! How did you get into my fortress? Never mind, now it's time for you to go crunch!" L|1||Bonecrunch says, "This is my throne room. I am BoneCrunch and that's my throne. There, tours over, now you die." L|1||Bonecrunch says, "Your time as masters of this land is at an end humans. You have no idea what is coming."
L|1||Bonecrunch says, "You have defeated my child. Your kind shows just as much promise as the Martine creature did. Soon you will embrace the simple truth. Clarity and purpose will be paid for with free will." L|1||Bonecrunch says, "Your not part of the Plan!" L|1||Bonecrunch says, "What? You call this loot? How come I never get your weapons?" L|1||Bonecrunch says, "Come! Protect your leader! Bite! Stab! Burn!"
H3|Captain Burnja L|1||Captain Burnja tells you, "Leave now humans or I burn you so bad you be dead!"
H3|Returning to Jarvis Hammerstone L|1||Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "Ah, I see you bested the Drudge leader, Bonecrunch, again. Well done! His sudden rise to power still worries me though." L|1||Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "The Royal Council is investigating the various creature uprisings in Dereth. It seems that the Mosswarts and Banderling have also been acting a bit odd lately. These are troubling times. I am glad that we have brave souls like you to protect our people." L|1||Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "For your continued bravery and service to Cragstone I grant you the wisdom of the Town Elders of Cragstone and the title "Cragstone Knight."" L|1||You've earned (20%) experience.
H3|Handing in Burnja Token L|1||You give Jarvis Hammerstone Burnja Token. L|1||Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "Ah, this is from that pyro-maniacal Drudge. I never did buy him as the leader of the raids." L|1||Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "Still, I'm glad you were able to defeat him. I'm so tired of trying to put out all the fires he keeps starting." L|1||Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "I hereby name you a "Cragstone Firefighter.""
H3|Handing in Protective Drudge Charms L|1||You allow Jarvis Hammerstone to examine your Protective Drudge Charm. L|1||You hand over 1 of your Protective Drudge Charms. L|1||Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "This is one of BoneCrunch's treasures? It looks like some of the other Drudge Charms I've seen, but it's obviously more powerful. I'll have Suya the Jeweler take a look at it. Thank you, here is a small reward for your help." L|1||You've earned 66,000,000 experience. (Level 200)
H3|Handing in Burnja's Board with Nails L|1||You give Jarvis Hammerstone Burnja's Board with Nails. L|1||Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "This is the weapon that Drudge you called Burnja was wielding? Not very sophisticated is it?" L|1||Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "I'm sure I can find someone who will buy this. Here have some of my writings on economics in a Post-Magical Revolutionary society." L|1||You've earned 1,839,776 experience.

Quest.name: Black_Death_Catacombs_Quiddity_Seed_Quest

Wiki.page: Black Death Catacombs Quiddity Seed Quest

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|130 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Emissary of Asheron (Asheron's Castle)¦Emissary of Asheron» (Optional) I|Starts At|«Asheron's Castle» I|Route|«Eastham» to «Asheron's Island» portal at 17.9N, 64.3E. I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Aerbax used strange Virindi magic to try to erase the memory of the defeat of the Olthoi Queen from the minds of the Isparians in an attempt to break their spirits and make them more easily controlled. This quest replays events from the past, starting several years before the defeat of the Dereth Olthoi Queen, Starting with the point when Elysa first escaped the olthoi nest she was held captive in and met Thorsten Cragstone for the first time. It follows them to the Underground City where the Aluvian Resistance was headquartered, to Asheron's Castle where Elysa first met Asheron, and into the Black Death Catacombs where Cragstone was killed by the Olthoi Queen and Elysa used her enchanted arrow to defeat the Queen.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Emissary of Asheron (Asheron's Castle)¦Emissary of Asheron». L|2|•|⟦quiddityseedquestflag⟧ L|1|•|The correct Emissary of Asheron is at Asherons Castle inside building with spiral stairs going up.
H4|Part 1: 1st Strange Device L|1|1.|Make your way to the 1st «Strange Device» at 21.9N, 19.0E L|2|•|Route: Facility Hub to 40 Bellig Tower Base, then run to the Strange Device at 21.9N 19.0E L|1|2.|Using the device spawns a "ghost" of Elysa Strathelar and Thorsten Cragstone, a reflection of their first encounter. Some olthoi will also spawn. L|1|3.|You must kill all the Olthoi. When you have killed them several gems, called «Elysa's Hope», will spawn around the device. more gems spawn if all are picked up. L|2|•|⟦elysashopepickuptimer⟧
H4|Part 2: 2nd Strange Device L|1|1.|Go to the 2nd Strange Device found in the «Underground City». L|2|•|The place where the words of the past were found refers to Elysa discovering Empyrean texts within the «Underground City». You can reach the Underground City by taking the portal in the «Abandoned Mine» or taking the Isle of Tears portal (25.2N, 49.9E) in Cragstone and running to the city at 21.3N, 53.9E. L|2|•|**Leaftide Route**: In sub. L|1|2.|The 2nd device is located in the area marked on the map as lvl -1. It is in the side room that does not contain the surface portal. If you are able to jump a whole level in dungeons, you can reach it quickly from the drop point by jumping on to the balcony just forward and to the left of the drop. Otherwise you will have to work your way through the dungeon. L|1|3.|When you use the device Elysa and Cragstone will appear again, and have a conversation about the texts Elysa has discovered. When they are done, «Elysa's Resolve» gems will appear on the floor. L|2|•|⟦elysasresolvepickuptimer⟧ L|1|4.|Combine the two gems to form «Elysa's Partial Reflection».
H4|Part 3: 3rd Strange Device L|1|1.|Go to 3rd Strange Device located at 21.2N, 69.2E L|1|2.|The home of Light refers to Asheron's castle. Take the portal in Eastham near the windmill to reach Asheron's Isle and then take the portal device at the drop to reach his castle. The device is just outside the door. Use it to watch Elysa and Thorsten discover Asheron's Castle and see Elsya teleport away into Asheron's Sanctum. After Elysa returns outside they will speak once more before giving you another clue. «Elysa's Courage» gems then appear on the floor. L|2|•|**Leaftide Route**: Asheron's Castle portal located in Subway (AC Storage) L|2|•|⟦elysascouragepickuptimer⟧ L|1|3.|Combine the two gems to form «Elysa's Incomplete Reflection».
H4|Part 4: 4th Strange Device L|1|1.|The 4th Strange Device is also found in the «Underground City». L|1|2.|The tomb of past warriors refers to Thorsten Cragstone's Tomb, found in the Underground City. Simply follow the directions on the map labeled "Shortest path to Hidden Dungeon" and stop in room with Thorsten's tomb. The Device is located on above this room, and you can reach it by jumping from one of the open windows. L|1|3.|Once the apparitions of Elysa and Thorsten disappear, «Elysa's Determination» gems will appear. L|2|•|⟦elysasdeterminationpickuptimer⟧ L|1|4.|One again combine the two gems to form «Elysa's Phantasmal Arrow».
H4|Part 5: Black Death Catacombs Quiddity Seed L|1|1.|You must now go to the «Black Death Catacombs Quiddity Seed» found in the «Black Death Catacombs». The Quiddity Seed is located behind the «Deeper Catacombs (Paradox)» portal to the Paradox-touched Olthoi Queen's lair. L|1|2.|You will be portaled into a completely black version of the old Black Death Catacomb (before it was split up by portals) with purple mist on the ground. The dungeon is full of virindi and more of the ghost Olthoi. Note that players can run through these olthoi, but the olthoi also can stack on top of eachother. L|1|3.|You will notice you are not dropped in the normal drop point or where the seed was located in the regular dungeon. If you are looking at the map of the Black Death Catacomb and the Lower Corridor, you are in the Lower Corridor, in the only room with a split level (a place where you can jump up or down a level). Note that the ACMaps map has drawn this room incorrectly so the ledge is not where it appears on the map. L|1|4.|Elysa is back up where the Quiddity Seed is in the regular dungeon. To reach her, take the passage south and simply hug the right wall from the drop - do not jump down to the lower level. Give Elysa the arrow to see the Thorsten's final moments replayed. L|1|5.|After the scene is done and the queen dies, «Head of the Apparition Olthoi Queen» will appear on the ground. H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Welcome, I'm glad you've come."⸩ ⸨Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Let's see if you have had any success with the Quiddity Seeds I told you of."⸩ ⸨Emissary of Asheron tells you, "The first Quiddity Seed lies in the Planar Collegium in the Lyceum at Knorr."⸩ ⸨Emissary of Asheron tells you, "The second alludes me. Speak with the Aun Tumeroks at Fort Tethana."⸩ ⸨Emissary of Asheron tells you, "The third is known to an apparition in the Northern Desert."⸩ L|1||Using the 1st Strange Device L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Must not catch me...must stay ahead of them..."
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "Wait a second, lassie - we're comin' ta get ya!"
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "Alright, boys! Let's be squashin' some bugs for the lady!"
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "No! Not back to the caverns! I'll die first!"
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Thank Pwyll! Give me a weapon and I'll help!" P|⸨A female whisper on the wind says, "Seek resolve in the place where the words of the past were found."⸩
L|1||Using the 2nd Strange Device
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "Lass...I brought ye some tea. It's not good, but it's the best we be gettin' from the surface."
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Lemongrass is fine, Thorsten. Thank you."
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "Ye be welcome, m'love."
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Thorsten, come here and look at this paper."
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "Well, lassie, truth be - I canna read."
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Oh...well, I'll teach you. But later. This writing is like nothing that I've ever seen before. It's not Roulean, not any of the scripts of far off lands - not even similar. I've figured out a way to translate it, though."
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "Oh? What's it say?"
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "This word seems like it would sound like...'Empyrean'...it's another culture, maybe a culture we can contact for help with the Olthoi!"
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "We've been over this before, lass - there's too many ta fight. We can stay here, safe..."
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "No, Thorsten...we will free our people...we must. There's directions to another one of those portals that leads to an island. If I read this right, there's a man named...'Asheron', I think. He's supposed to be the master of a school of powerful magic...surely his magic can help against the Olthoi!"
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "I dinna think so...the magics that our people know do nothing against 'em, and wouldn't this Asheron have fought the Olthoi off if he could've?"
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Perhaps he doesn't know how prolific they are, perhaps he doesn't even know we're here...either way, I intend to go there, with or without you."
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "Ye mean this, lass?"
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Yes. I cannot be content to live here under the earth when our people still live in thrall."
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "Alright, lass. I'll go with ye to visit this...Asheron. P|⸨A female whisper on the wind says, "Seek courage in the home of light."⸩
L|1||Using the 3rd Strange Device
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Where is the key..."
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "I think we be wastin' our time, m'dear. If whoever be inside be at all interested in talkin', they be doin' a good job o' hidin' it."
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Nonsense...I will not believe that this place is uninhabited."
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Whoever's in there - open up! I won't go away! You must listen to us, of the plight of our people! We were summoned here by strange portals, an unknown magic we have never seen be-"
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "Lass, ye've returned! I was worried for ye, but I dinna know how ta enter..."
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "It is alright, Thorsten...there was nothing you could've done. Thorsten, I have done it! I have met the sorcerer in his tower! It is a wondrous place. He is a man of few words though."
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "What did he say, lass?"
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Just one thing - "You must find the Queen and slay her.""
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "And how d'we do that?"
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "I think with this..."
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "What be that?"
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "I think it's a sort of poison, maybe. I think we should try it on our weapons when we fight the Olthoi."
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "I dinna think we're ready for an open confrontation quite yet...but if it be true, if it be the first step, maybe..." P|⸨A female whisper on the wind says, "Seek determination in the tomb of past warriors."⸩
L|1||Using the 4th Strange Device
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Pay heed me words, brave warriors of Aluvia! Today is the day we have dreamt of! We have our destiny in our hands!"
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "We have found the Queen of the Olthoi, the heart of the darkness we have fought for so long! We can reach her, and if we can reach her, we can slay her!"
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Do you remember your families, your friends, all held in slavery for so long? Today is the day we march forward to free them!"
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "There is no fury in the world like the Aluvians marching to war. Let us show the Olthoi the steel of Aluvian hearts! Let their death scream echo in their caverns, until finally we have met the Olthoi Queen in her dark majesty and ended her reign!"
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Let the horns of our ancestors sound triumphant! We march to war!" P|⸨A female whisper on the wind says, "And now, in the end...you must seek the end to my story, and the beginning to the story of humanity upon Dereth."⸩
L|1||Giving Elysa's Phantasmal Arrow to Elysa Strathelar
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Thorsten? Where are you? I cannot see what has happened in here..."
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "Thorsten! No...no..."
L|1||Thorsten Cragstone says, "Ye foul fiend!"
L|1||Elysa Strathelar says, "You! Die, now!" P|⸨A female whisper on the wind says, "...and that was the end of my story, hunter...while the swarm still exists, it never again held this land in thrall. And so, one queen gave way to another. Remember me...as an enemy, but as a worthy enemy..."⸩
L|1||Other Messages P|⸨You bring the two gems into close proximity, and they fuse into one.⸩ ⸨You bring the two gems into close proximity, and they fuse into one.⸩ ⸨You bring the two gems into proximity. They both give off a small pop and vanish in clouds of purple mist. The mist coalesces into a ghostly arrow tipped with a small dab of black goo.
L|1||Opening Dialog (Retired)⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "Welcome, I'm glad you've come."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "From my observations and from reports I've received from your Queen I believe that Aerbax is attempting something quite unheard of."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "It would seem our enemy has been tampering with the collective memories of three critical events in the past. He has built three dream structures using Quiddity Seeds to allow him to attack these memories and change our perspective in the present."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "The first Quiddity Seed is in Knorr where I first summoned the portals that sent my people into portal space."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "The second Quiddity Seed's location still alludes me. I believe that the Aun Tumeroks may have more experience in locating these dream structures. Visit Fort Tethana where an emissary of the Tumeroks has been sent to meet you."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "The third and final Quiddity Seed was not found by my divinations. I only have a vague idea of what memory may be at risk. Seek out an apparition in the Northern Desert who I have been told will help you."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "Do not take these tasks lightly. Our memories form the way we see the world around us. Change our memories and change reality. This is a very real threat."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "If Aerbax succeeds we may not even remember we were trying to stop him."
L|1||Rewards (Retired)⸩ ⸨You give Asheron Head of the Apparition Olthoi Queen .⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "What is this that you give me, Isparian?"⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "It is like the head of the old Olthoi Queen, but insubstantial. Tell me how you came about this?"⸩ ⸨You detail your pursuit of Elysa's remembrances.⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "It would seem that Aerbax's minion have been manipulating the memory of the defeat of the Olthoi Queen. Perhaps Aerbax thought that it would prove easier to turn the Isparians if they were still held in bondage to the Olthoi."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "There is a strange core to the Olthoi head...I have extracted it for your use."⸩ ⸨Asheron gives you Quiddity Ingot.⸩ ⸨Asheron gives you Empowered Bracers of the Perfect Light.⸩ ⸨You've earned 131,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "Elysa is safe. You have restored the past to what should be, and I believe Aerbax will not be able to gain a foothold against you through that means. Elysa is safe, but more importantly, all of your kind is safe by your actions."⸩ ⸨Asheron looks down at you with a warm friendliness.⸩ ⸨For valor and bravery in the face of the unknown I award [Player Name] the title "Warrior of the Past."⸩ ⸨You allow Asheron to examine your Empowered Bracers of the Perfect Light.⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "Perhaps you would rather have some experience in exchange for this?"⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "Very well."⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Empowered Bracers of the Perfect Lights.⸩ ⸨You've earned 16,241,571 experience.⸩

Quest.name: Clutch_of_Kings_(Browerk)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Guard Haigh» I|Starts At|25.7N, 48.9E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Clutch of Kings: Browerk» H2|Overview L|1|•|{WARN}: Talk to the Cragstone NPCs before running this a 2nd time, or you won't be able to pick up the hide at the end. L|1|•|This is the last of six part «Clutch of Kings» quest series. L|1|•|The quest consists mostly of «Burun», so frost weapons are recommended.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Xi Ru's Island L|1|•|Speak to the «Watcher of the Dead» 60.1S, 88.1W in «Ayan Baqur» to be portaled to «Xi Ru's Island». L|2|•|**Note:** If the Watcher of the Dead is not there, this means the quest is in progress by another group, and you must wait until the 3 hour timer is up. L|2|•|**Note 2:** If you cannot enter a font portal, the statue will not speak with you, or you cannot enter the portal that is summoned in the floating tower, you just need to speak to the «Watcher of the Dead» in Ayan again to refresh your flag. L|2|•|⟦OnBrowerkQuest⟧
L|1|•|To setup this quest, there are four «Sealed Valve»s that must be opened; each is located at the bottom of one of the four "Font Dungeons". This preparation can be completed ahead of time by 1 high level person with «Lockpick».
H4|Steamy Font (North) L|1|1.|Enter the «Steamy Font» at 91.1S, 89.6E L|1|2.|From the drop, go **North** and take your second **Right**, and head up the ramp. L|1|3.|Work your way up the ramps until you reach a locked gate. Unlock it, and flip the lever inside. L|1|4.|Backtrack the drop and jump down, through the now open gate in the floor. L|1|5.|From here, Take the North ramp down and follow the ramps down to the bottom floor. L|1|6.|Pick the locks to the **East** and **West** doors, and flip the levers inside each. L|1|7.|Backtrack to the drop, and now take the West ramp down and follow the ramps down to the bottom floor. L|1|8.|Use the «Sealed Valve» on the West side of the room, then take the exit portal to the East.
H4|Balmy Font (South) L|1|1.|Enter the «Balmy Font» at 91.5S, 89.7E. L|1|2.|From the drop, go **South** and take your second **Left**, and head up the ramp. L|1|3.|Work your way up the ramps until you reach a locked gate. Unlock it, and flip the lever inside. L|1|4.|Backtrack the drop and jump down, through the now open gate in the floor. L|1|5.|From here, Take the North ramp down and follow the ramps down to the bottom floor. L|1|6.|Pick the locks to the **North** and **South** doors, and flip the levers inside each. L|1|7.|Backtrack to the drop, and now take the West ramp down and follow the ramps down to the bottom floor. L|1|8.|Use the «Sealed Valve» on the West side of the room, then take the exit portal to the East.
H4|Humid Font (East) L|1|1.|Enter the «Humid Font» at 91.3S, 89.8E L|1|2.|From the drop, go **South** and take your second **Right**, and head up the ramp. L|1|3.|Work your way up the ramps until you reach a locked gate. Unlock it, and flip the lever inside. L|1|4.|Backtrack the drop and jump down, through the now open gate in the floor. L|1|5.|From here, Take the North ramp down and follow the ramps down to the bottom floor. L|1|6.|Pick the locks to the **North** and **East** doors, and flip the levers inside each. L|1|7.|Backtrack to the drop, and now take the West ramp down and follow the ramps down to the bottom floor. L|1|8.|Use the «Sealed Valve» on the West side of the room, then take the exit portal to the East.
H4|Muggy Font (West) L|1|1.|Enter the «Muggy Font» at 91.5S, 89.4E L|1|2.|From the drop, go **North** and take your second **Left**, and head up the ramp. L|1|3.|Work your way up the ramps until you reach a locked gate. Unlock it, and flip the lever inside. L|1|4.|Backtrack the drop and jump down, through the now open gate in the floor. L|1|5.|From here, Take the North ramp down and follow the ramps down to the bottom floor. L|1|6.|Pick the locks to the **North** and **East** doors, and flip the levers inside each. L|1|7.|Backtrack to the drop, and now take the West ramp down and follow the ramps down to the bottom floor. L|1|8.|Use the «Sealed Valve» on the West side of the room, then take the exit portal to the East.
H4|Font Guardian (Font Tower) L|1|•|At this point, all 4 «Sealed Valve»s should be open and the quest is now live. The rest of the group should join you at this point.
L|1|1.|When the group is ready, everyone should run to the top of the «Font Tower» at 91.3S, 89.5E, and jump to the adjacent floating platform to the south where the «Font Guardian» is located. L|1|2.|After everyone has made the jump, one person should talk to the «Font Guardian», and everyone should use the portal to «Qin Xikit's Hidden Crown», that spawns down the stairs. L|2|•|The portal remains open for 20 minutes.
H3|Part 2: Qin Xikit's Hidden Crown L|1|1.|From the drop, pull the lever on the south wall, and then head North into the room ahead. L|1|2.|**ONE** person should now use the «Ensorcelled Dais», which will give them «Qin Xikit's Crown» and spawn several «Ancient Sentinel»s and an «Ancient Defender» (Ghosts). L|1|3.|Kill the Ancient Defender, and then head through the door that opens to the North, and down the ramp (either direction). L|1|4.|Use the lever on the south wall, and then enter the room to the North. L|1|5.|The person who has Qin Xikit's Crown must hand it to the «Enchanted Dais» in this room, which will spawn a portal to Qin Xikit's Island. Take it.
H3|Part 3A: Qin Xikit's Island L|1|1.|From the drop, run Northwest until you reach a large temple. L|1|2.|Run to the top of the temple, go inside, and shift-jump down to the bottom. L|1|3.|To activate the Portal Device, all 4 eyes (north, south, east, west) must be used one time. Be careful, each time you use an eye, you will receive 5% vitae. L|2|•|{TIP} Have 4 separate people each use one eye in order to spread the vitae around. L|1|4.|Once all 4 eyes are used, head back to the middle and use the Portal Device to be portaled to «Qin Xikit's Antechamber».
H3|Part 3B: Qin Xikit's Antechamber L|1|1.|From the drop, take the hallway on the North wall. Hug the right wall, and work your way through the dungeon until you come to another Portal Device. L|2|•|Note: There are two spots in the dungeon where you'll have to flip levers/floor plates in order to open doors. See the map for more info. L|1|2.|Use the «Guardian» statue that is located just to the right of the Portal Device (**NOT** the Portal Device itself) to be portaled into the «Secrets of Qin Xikit's Temple».
H3|Part 4: Secrets of Qin Xikit's Temple L|1|1.|From the drop, jump down into the pit in front of you and move into the next room. L|1|2.|All must pick up an «Empty Water Skin» from the floor, and fill it with 6 pints of blood by using it on the «Pool of Blood» 6 times. L|1|3.|Once your Water Skin has 6 pints, hand it to the West «Sacrificial Statue» to pass the trial. L|2|•|Note: You can also fill the Water Skin with 9 or 10 pints of blood and hand it to the East or South Statues, respectively. L|2|•|⟦BloodPuzzleCompleted⟧ L|1|4.|Once you've passed the trial, go to the South room, jump down into the pit, and use the Exit Portal to go to «Qin Xikit's Temple».
H3|Part 5: Qin Xikit's Temple L|1|1.|From the portal drop, hug the left wall all the way to the end of the dungeon, where you'll find a «Guardian» statue. L|1|2.|Note: Once you pass through the octagonal type room, and go through a short narrow hallway, you'll need to descend a 2nd ramp. See the map for details. L|1|3.|Use the Guardian to be portaled into «Qin Xikit's Tomb». L|2|•|⟦QinXikitBeaten⟧
H3|Part 6: Qin Xikit's Tomb L|1|1.|From the drop, use the «Sarcophagus of High Matriarch Qin Xikit» on the North wall, which will give you the «Ancient Armored Helm», a piece of «Ancient Armor». L|2|•|⟦QinXikitComplete⟧ L|1|2.|Use the Portal Device on the West wall to be portaled into «Qin Xikit's Receiving Chamber», the last dungeon. L|2|•|Note: You will receive 5% vitae upon using the Portal Device.
H3|Part 7: Qin Xikit's Receiving Chamber L|1|1.|Work your way North through the dungeon to the end, where you'll find the end boss, «Browerk», sitting in his throne room. L|2|•|Note: If you choose, you can work off vitae in the first part of the dungeon before reaching the boss. L|1|2.|There are several things to know before going into the fight with Browerk, review these tactics: L|2|•|If you are swallowed (portaled into Browerk's stomach), quickly switch to a «Critical Strike» weapon, and attack his «Stomach Wall» on full speed. You have only have a percent chance of escaping his stomach when you land a critical hit. L|3|•|{TIP} If you're a mage, use wall spells for a greater chance to critical hit. L|1|3.|Once you kill Browerk, loot «Browerk's Hide» from the floor. L|2|•|⟦BrowerkBeaten⟧ L|1|4.|Speak to «Guard Haigh» at 25.7N, 48.9E in «Cragstone» for your XP and random reward. L|2|•|⟦BrowerkKilled⟧ L|2|•|⟦BrowerkComplete⟧ L|1|5.|{OPT} Hand Browerk's Hide to Guard Haigh for the title of Browerk Killer. L|2|•|Note: Hold on to the hide if you are trying to obtain the Kingslayer title. See the «Clutch of Kings» for more information.

R|Defeat Browerk and speak to Guard Haigh RK|Experience|56,184,660 (33% up to level 130) RK|Items| RI|«Mana Forge Key» (Level 125 and above reward) RI|«Ancient Armored Helm» One of the following random rewards: RI|«Dangerous Portal Device» RI|«Armsman's Robe» RI|«Gem of Damage Addition» RI|«Gem of Damage Modification» RI|«Gem of Mana Management» RI|«Gem of Inner Brilliance» RE
R|Give Browerk's Hide to Guard Haigh RK|Title|Browerk Killer RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Watcher of the Dead⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "Qin Xikit, Mistress of the Golden Shore, Keeper of the Kilika Vale in Ualannan's absence, lays beneath over thirty thousands years of weight. She has been silent these years imprisoned beneath her temple, bound by those who called her sister."⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "Once she walked amongst children of other suns and ushered them along a quickened path. Heresy! Cried our sisters and a great hunt began within our sect. A schism grew and swallowed our sisters in madness. They drew chains of mana about our immortal forms and locked our eternal bodies away."⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "Qin Xikit was the first to feel the sting of her sister's barbs, locked into a temple of her crafting, sealed away with the power of her crown."⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "Eternal silence is shattered and Qin Xikit stirs in her tomb. A gateway has opened and through it comes consumption. Sealed in her tomb the matron can do nothing and the spirits therein are all but gone. I am the last to hold vigil."⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "Seek her crown. Xi Ru consumed in madness, sealed Qin Xikit away. The crown must be found and the gateway to Qin Xikit's temple must be opened. At long last I can see Xi Ru's island, the magic that once locked it from sight has failed, a sister has succeeded at breaking the wards."⸩ ⸨Watcher of the Dead tells you, "Rejoice! Absolution is at hand."
L|1||Guard Haigh (Completing the Quest)⸩ ⸨Guard Haigh gives you Gem of Damage Addition.⸩ ⸨You've earned 56,184,660 experience.⸩ ⸨Guard Haigh tells you, "This is for your efforts against the Burun Kukuur, King Browerk. You will need to wait three weeks before returning to me for another reward. If you wish to change your title and you have a scrap of Browerk's hide I will accept the hide and name you Browerk Killer!"
L|1||Handing in Browerk's Hide⸩ ⸨You give Guard Haigh Browerk's Hide.⸩ ⸨Let it be known that has faced and defeated Browerk! Let it be known that from this day forth shall be known as Browerk Killer! Huzzah! Huzzah! Huzzah!⸩

H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Akahana tells you, "Hail! I have a mission that only a Lord may accomplish." L|1||Akahana tells you, "5 Coral Towers rise above Nyr'leha, the Moarsmen City, which lies to the South East of Candeth Keep on the Southern Shores of the Direlands. These Towers seem to draw Coral Golems to the outskirts of the city, effectively protecting it. We wish to make the city more vulnerable to attack in case we need to move against the Blighted Moarsmen." L|1||Akahana tells you, "Destroy the 5 Coral Towers and their protecting Coral Golems. Return to me when you have accomplished your task and I will reward you."

Quest.name: Decrepit_Tower_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|40 I|Rec. Level|50 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Ufet, Prophet of Blades» (optional) I|Starts At|13.9N, 0.7E in «Zaikhal» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for The Decrepit Tower» H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Loot a «Crest of the Shagar Zharala» from a «Shreth-Gnawed Corpse». Only one is needed for the quest. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpZharalimEmblem⟧ L|2|•|{TIP} «Shreth-Gnawed Corpse»s are typically located around the landscape near packs of «Malus Shreth»s. L|1|2.|Head to the «Decrepit Tower» at 23.8N, 12.2W and enter the portal. The portal is located at the bottom inside a tower near the bridge. You will have to jump over one section of missing stairs while climbing to the top of the tower. L|2|•|Note: **The only access to the mountain top where the dungeon is located is at 25.5N, 14.6W**. L|1|3.|Once inside, hand your «Crest of the Shagar Zharala» to «Yalik Ibn Ujsef», and he will give you a «Skeleton Key» in return. L|1|4.|Use the «Skeleton Key» on the locked «Sturdy Door» nearby to gain access to the rest of the dungeon. The key has three uses. L|1|5.|You must use the hidden button and lever in each room to open the six doors to gain access to the rest of the dungeon. One will open the door to the current room, the other will open the door to the next room in the sequence. The buttons are hidden and may be difficult to spot. Do them in the order NE SW E NW W SE. L|1|6.|{OPT} Find «Zharalim Master's Journal» (see level -3 on the map). If you are at the second set of lever activated doors, you have gone too far. This journal yields a random trophy reward and a stamp. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpZharalimMasterJournal⟧ L|1|7.|{OPT} Find «Zharalim Foreman's Journal» (see level -6 on the map). If you are at the third set of lever activated doors (the large room with four stone heads) it is on that level. This journal yields a random trophy reward and a stamp. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpZharalimForemanJournal⟧ L|1|8.|At the lowest level is one more lever puzzle. In the room with flames, walk into the northwest corner to open the lever activated door down the hallway. L|1|9.|Proceed all up the steps and continue on to the final lever puzzle. L|1|10.|In the final room, kill the three bosses for three tassels. «Rayssid Ibn Alhath» drops the «Woven Tassel of Far Sight» (x9), «Rheth Al'Thok» drops the «Woven Tassel of Sound Mind» (x9), and «Tiyol Ibn Yufaj» drops the «Woven Tassel of Discord» (x9). L|2|•|⟦PickedUpTasselMelee⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpTasselMagic⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpTasselMissile⟧ L|1|11.|The tassels can be can be attached to a «Shadow's Garb» mask to upgrade it, or can be given to «Ufet, Prophet of Blades» for XP and the reward items. L|1|12.|Give the Journals to «Ufet, Prophet of Blades» for MMDs, a random trophy and a final stamp. L|2|•|⟦DecrepitTowerComplete_0511⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Ufet's Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "You'll pardon me if my mind is on other matters today. Several of my comrades have left for a recently discovered library north west of this city, but they have not yet returned."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "I am not usually one to worry, but with all that has happened of late, assassinations, invasions and an increase in cult activity, I can't help but do so."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "I must remain at my station, but if you happen to come across them, please let me know where they are. Any information you find will put my mind at ease."
L|1||Yalik's Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Yalik Ibn Ujsef tells you, "Finally! People! People who aren't crazed!"⸩ ⸨Yalik Ibn Ujsef tells you, "Don't look at me like I'm the crazy one. It's all those down below who have gone raving mad! Can you help them?"⸩ ⸨Yalik Ibn Ujsef tells you, "Wait, you don't look like a Zharalim. Let me see your emblem! No emblem? Then I'm afraid I cannot let you pass. I am not about to let more people fall to the madness of this tower!"⸩ ⸨Yalik Ibn Ujsef tells you, "If you see any of my brethren in the wilds, be wary of them. Chances are they are maddened by whatever is in the depths of this place. I fear that in that maddened state, they may have fallen prey to some beast. Shreth are all too common in this region."
L|1||Handing in Crest of the Shagar Zharala to Yalik Ibn Ujsef⸩ ⸨Yalik Ibn Ujsef tells you, "Ah! I see you've brought your emblem with you. Give it here and I'll give you the key to the door over there."⸩ ⸨Yalik Ibn Ujsef tells you, "Already so many Zharalim have fallen into the grasp of madness, I would hate to see any more fall."⸩ ⸨You give Yalik Ibn Ujsef Crest of the Shagar Zharala.⸩ ⸨Yalik Ibn Ujsef tells you, "Thank you! As I promised, here is the key. Use it well."⸩ ⸨Yalik Ibn Ujsef gives you Skeleton Key.⸩ ⸨Yalik Ibn Ujsef tells you, "Beyond the door are a series of levers. Once you pass through the gate they bar, you may not be able to return here, so please prepare first."⸩ ⸨Yalik Ibn Ujsef tells you, "Also, if you happen to find my master in the depths, please let him know I am safe and continuing my duty up here."
L|1||Handing in the Excavation Directions to Ufet⸩ ⸨You give Ufet, Prophet of Blades Excavation Directions.⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "Ah! Yes! That was where they were headed. Thank you for finding this! Where did you find it?"⸩ ⸨As Ufet looks over the note, you relate to him how you found it.⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "I see. The shreth have always been known to be vicious."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "Thank you for this little bit of information, but I will need something more from you in order to reward you for your efforts."
L|1||Tassal Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨You give Ufet, Prophet of Blades Woven Tassel of Far Sight.⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,500,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "This came from the Shadow's Garb worn by Rayssid Ibn Alhath? Sadly I know little of the man save for his affinity for ranged weapons."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "It seems only fitting that the reward I give you should reflect that. Take this periapt. May it help guide your shots with accuracy and swiftness."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades gives you Periapt of Endless Sight.⸩ ⸨You give Ufet, Prophet of Blades Woven Tassel of Sound Mind.⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "You say Rheth Al' Thok wore this upon his Shadow's Garb? He was a bright man, poised to enter the ranks of the Zaikhal Arcanum. Well... that was before my compatriots offered him a place within our ranks. A shame that he was so easily enticed."⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,500,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "Since he joined the ranks of the Zharalim, he was striving to obtain the Shagraka- the casting focus used by many of the Zharalim's sorcerers."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "As he is no longer with us, the focus reserved for his use shall be passed on to you."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades gives you Shagraka.⸩ ⸨You give Ufet, Prophet of Blades Woven Tassel of Discord.⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,500,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "Ah, Tiyol's tassel, correct? I had no liking for that contemptuous man. In fact, it would not surprise me at all if he was the first to fall under the sway of the Raven Hand."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "You did the world a great justice by defeating him. And since he was such a vile man, I have no qualms about giving out his belongings."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "Before the group left for the library, many of them entrusted some of their belongings to my care. Primarily items that would be of no use to them in the grasslands and forests north of here."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "Tiyol left this Cowl. Here, take it. I am glad to be rid of his belongings. Surely you will put the Cowl to a more appropriate use."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades gives you Cowl of the Sand.
L|1||Journal Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨You allow Ufet, Prophet of Blades to examine your Zharalim Master's Journal.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Zharalim Master's Journals.⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "I thank you for this. It seems as though the Order of the Raven Hand have claws in several of my companions."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "I thank you for this information. With these bits of knowledge, we will seek to restore the honor of our fallen comrades."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "Here is something for your efforts."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades gives you Small Shard.⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades gives you 2 Trade Notes (250,000).⸩ ⸨You allow Ufet, Prophet of Blades to examine your Zharalim Foreman's Journal.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Zharalim Foreman's Journals.⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "The library seems to be caked in madness and filth. Remnants of a Shadow Bulwark perhaps? Soot-layered tombs and air that maddens."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "Now I see why the Raven Hand sought this place out. There may be artifacts of powerful shadows within."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "It seems, though, that Yalik has done well in guarding the place. This is a hugely important task for one as young as he. I wonder how well he will handle the task in the months to come."⸩ ⸨Ufet nearly forgets you in his musing, but quickly returns to the matter at hand.⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades tells you, "I thank you for this. We were right to suspect the Order of the Raven Hand were up to no good. Take this as a reward for your efforts."⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades gives you Platinum Golem Heart.⸩ ⸨Ufet, Prophet of Blades gives you 2 Trade Notes (250,000).⸩

Quest.name: Fetish_of_the_Dark_Idols_Quest

Wiki.page: Fetish of the Dark Idols Quest

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|45 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Aerlinthe¦Shimena Keep» I|Route|«Aerlinthe Isle» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to gain a «Fetish of the Dark Idols» that can be applied to any missile weapon («Bow», «Crossbow», or «Atlatl») to give it the «Magic Absorbing» property.
L|1|•|{WARN} Applying the «Fetish of the Dark Idols» will also reduce the «Melee Defense» modifier on your missile weapon by 10%. L|1|•|There are several ways to do this quest, however, the fastest way is to collect all 3 trophies before talking to any NPCs.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|{OPT} Use the «Floating Bottle» on the shoreline south west of Qalaba'r at at 74.7S, 9.9E to receive a «A Soggy Note». L|2|•|⟦UsedFloatingBottle⟧ L|1|2.|From «Aerlinthe Isle», run to «Aerlinthe¦Shimena Keep» at 91.6N, 49.6E and kill «Ancient Diamond Golem»s until you find a «Ancient Diamond Idol». L|2|•|⟦GotDiamondIdol⟧ L|1|3.|From «Redspire», head to the «Northern Ahurenga Plains Portal» at 40.9N, 83.5W and kill «Great Elariwood Golem»s until you find a «Great Elariwood Idol». L|2|•|⟦GotElariwoodIdol⟧ L|1|4.|Head to the «Ithaenc Island» and kill «Blood Fiend»s until you find a «Warding Ring». L|2|•|Tip: Blood Fiends are easily found to the west of the «Ithaenc Cathedral». L|2|•|⟦GotWardingRing⟧ L|1|5.|From «Aphus Lassel», run to «Kleeoh» at 2.5S 86.5E and hand her your «Warding Ring». She will return your ring and give you a «Vial of Black Blood». L|1|6.|Kill «Infected Assailer»s nearby until you find some «Infected Assailer Fur». L|2|•|Tip: Can be found around 0.9S 85.5E L|2|•|⟦GotTuskerFur⟧ L|1|7.|Return to «Kleeoh» at 2.5S 86.5E and give her the «Infected Assailer Fur» (she will return it to you). L|1|8.|Head to «Neydisa Castle» and give the «Infected Assailer Fur» to the «Loom» inside the castle to create some «Woven Tusker Fur». L|1|9.|Combine the «Vial of Black Blood» with the «Woven Tusker Fur» to create a «Blood-soaked Cord». L|1|10.|Combine the «Blood-soaked Cord» with the «Ancient Diamond Idol» to create an «Incomplete Fetish of the Dark Idols». L|1|11.|Combine the «Incomplete Fetish of the Dark Idols» with the «Great Elariwood Idol» to create an «Unfinished Fetish of the Dark Idols». L|1|12.|Head to the «Lighthouse Hermit» at 25.8S, 46.9W and talk to him. L|2|•|Route: Use the «Accursed Halls¦Outside Accursed Halls» portal from the «Drunken Madman» to land close to the Hermit. L|2|•|⟦TalkedToLighthouseHermit⟧ L|1|13.|Hand him your «Unfinished Fetish of the Dark Idols». He will hand you back a completed «Fetish of the Dark Idols». L|2|•|⟦DarkIdolsCompleted⟧ L|1|14.|Apply the «Fetish of the Dark Idols» to any missile weapon («Bow», «Crossbow», or «Atlatl») to give it the «Magic Absorbing» property.
