H2|Rewards H3|Items L|1|•|«Fetish of the Dark Idols»
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Lighthouse Hermit⸩ ⸨The hermit's eyes grow wide as he begins to speak.⸩ ⸨The old hermit shifts his position, and begins to talk with a slow and deliberate voice.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "Ah, I do remember now. I didn't think it would take this long, but no matter - you are here. If you will but listen to my story, I will reveal a great secret to you.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "I once was the greatest and most feared arbalister in all of Dereth. I once had everything a man could want from this life, and I have enjoyed all that I have experienced over the long years.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "But decades of adventure and excitement have caught up finally, I'm afraid. I find myself unable to see the bull's-eye any longer, thanks to the slow dimming of my sight. And more often than not I find the string to be too powerful for these feeble hands to draw or load.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "However, a ghost of the past still stirs in this old body. And before death's final arrow tears through the dark night in search of this weary target, I must see to it that my secret becomes known -- it is with you I entrust this knowledge.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "I have seen with my own eyes the devastating power of magic; how easily a burning fireball can send the most skilled archer to his demise!⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "It has long been said: "The only way to combat magic is with stronger magic." Before you sits an old man who has come to understand what this truly means.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "I obtained certain artifacts and studied about old, forgotten magic. I devised for myself a way to empower my crossbow with a powerful, arcane device - a fetish, one might call it.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "Any missile weapon may be empowered similarly. Be warned - the magic is strong, and thus irreversible by any process I know of. I will tell you all I can remember soon enough. But today I have talked long enough."⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "Travel now to Aerlinthe Island. Find the old ones, the ancient diamond behemoths roaming that enchanted, volcanic isle. Retrieve the ancient diamond relic, and return to me. I should more clearly see the past when I am again holding a piece of it.
L|1||Showing the Ancient Diamond Idol to Lighthouse Hermit⸩ ⸨You allow Lighthouse Hermit to examine your Ancient Diamond Idol.⸩ ⸨The hermit's eyes grow wide as he looks at the diamond relic.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "So you found the golems then? I trust they did not give you too much trouble -- I see a stout and strong dead-eye when I look into your eyes!"⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "Do not lose this priceless artifact. You will need to harness the magical, protective power found within it -- eventually."⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "Ah, but you have so much to do yet. Let us not delay any longer! You must venture to the Itheanc Cathedral, in the Veseyan Islands. The horrible fleshless dead, the blood fiends, have a most precious treasure in their possession -- a bright, silvery ring."⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "You must find this ring, for it contains a most vital magical element."
L|1||Showing the Warding Ring to Lighthouse Hermit⸩ ⸨You allow Lighthouse Hermit to examine your Warding Ring.⸩ ⸨The hermit rolls the ring back and forth in his hand slowly, thinking deeply about the past.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "A warding ring..."⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "Long ago I took a ring identical to this one from the charred and burning hand of a fiend. That time seems unreal to me now, beyond my grasp in memory."⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "I do remember some of the important details, though. This ring conceals a small glass vial containing blood. You will need this foul fluid."⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "There is no way for either of us to remove the vial from the ring, I'm afraid. But there is one who can -- one who knows of the darker magics."⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "You must locate the seer that calls the wild jungles of Aphus Lassel her home, and show this ring to her."⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "She will know what to do, and she will help you."
L|1||Showing Infected Assailer Fur to Kleeoh⸩ ⸨You allow Kleeoh to examine your Infected Assailer Fur.⸩ ⸨Kleeoh twists a small lock of fur out of the reeking, moist clump, and tucks it away. She hands the rest back to you.⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "You got a lot dere. I only take what I need, and no more."⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "I hope you and dat old hermit know what you doing! Evil maka like this needs a strong bond, and dis big wooly fur is a good start - but I do not know how you will create such a thing."
L|1||Showing Infected Assailer Fur to Lighthouse Hermit⸩ ⸨You allow Lighthouse Hermit to examine your Infected Assailer Fur.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "Oh, what an awful smell! I remember this stench more than ever! I hope the experience did not make you too ill."⸩ ⸨The old hermit thinks hard for a few moments.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "I remember...I took the fur somewhere, and it was fashioned into a sturdy piece of rope, or cord if you will."⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "I am sorry, but I cannot recall how this was accomplished. You will have to figure out a way to bind or weave this fur."
L|1||Handing in Unfinished Fetish of the Dark Idols to Lighthouse Hermit⸩ ⸨You give Lighthouse Hermit Unfinished Fetish of the Dark Idols.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "You are truly a hunter worthy of this powerful magic fetish. I have no doubt that you are excited to head out and t--"⸩ ⸨The hermit stutters, then begins to laugh loudly.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "Aha! It's a good thing you showed this to me. You did not properly secure the idols to the cord!"⸩ ⸨The hermit rebinds the cord to both idols, using a method of tying you have never seen before.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit gives you Fetish of the Dark Idols.⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "There you are. It took some effort, but I have fixed it for you."⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "You have done well. I am very content in the knowledge that the secret will not die with me now."⸩ ⸨Lighthouse Hermit tells you, "One final request: Tell no one of what you have learned from me!"⸩

Quest.name: Fiun_Healing_Machine_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|70 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Scorus» I|Starts At|87.5N, 70.3W in «Silyun» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Fiun Healing Machine» H2|Overview P|This quest takes you all over the «Halaetan Islands», with a little trip to «K'nath Lair». It involves retrieving different items from different dungeons, and keys to unlock doors in the next dungeon.
L|1|•|You will need the «Lockpick» skill or «Sturdy Iron Key»s to unlock chests during this quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to «Scorus» to receive the «Healing Machine Recipe» and «A Message from Scorus». L|2|•|⟦FiunHealingMachineStarted_0511⟧ L|1|2.|Travel to «Small Empyrean Vault» at 80.4N, 74.0W. L|2|1.|Route: Run from «Silyun». L|2|2.|Hang left and retrieve the «Small Empyrean Key» and portal recall. L|2|3.|Hang right, and use the Key on an Iron Door. L|2|4.|Go to the room North, and use either Lockpick or a «Sturdy Iron Key» to open the «Old Chest» to retrieve the «Lavus». L|1|3.|Travel to the «Remote Empyrean Vault» at 81.7N, 71.2W. L|2|1.|Route: Run from «Silyun». L|2|2.|Make your way to the «Old Chest». L|2|3.|Use lockpick or a «Sturdy Iron Key» to retrieve the «Tihn». L|3|•|⟦tihnhealingmachine⟧ L|1|4.|Travel to the «Hidden City» at 94.4N, 70.0W. L|2|1.|Route: Run from «Silyun». L|2|2.|Make your way to the «Old Chest». L|2|3.|Use lockpick or a «Sturdy Iron Key» to retrieve the «Healing Machine Pedestal» L|3|•|⟦pedestalhealingmachine⟧ L|1|5.|Travel to the «Frozen Library» at 90.7N, 56.4W. L|2|1.|Route: Travel southeast from «Fiun Outpost», head up the cliff at 93.6N, 54.5W. L|2|2.|Retrieve the «Ruschk Iceberg Key». L|1|6.|Travel to the «Ruschk Iceberg» at 96.3N, 60.0W. L|2|1.|Route: Run from Fiun Outpost. L|2|2.|Make your way through the dungeon to the door and unlock it with the «Ruschk Iceberg Key». L|2|3.|Jump down the pit, and travel further through the dungeon until you see another Old Chest. L|2|4.|Use lockpick or «Sturdy Iron Key» to unlock the Old Chest to retrieve the «Healing Machine Hook». L|3|•|⟦hookhealingmachine⟧ L|1|7.|Travel to the «K'nath Lair» at 49.7S, 56.3W. L|2|1.|Route: Take the «East Direlands Swamp» near «Dryreach» at 8.1S, 74.5E. L|2|2.|Make your way to the bottom and use the portal to the «Greater K'nath Lair». Quest.name: Harvesting_the_Bulb_of_Mornings
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Kaltus» I|Starts At|«Neftet Excavation Site» at 22.2S, 8.6E I|Route|«Yaraq» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for First Sister» I|Quest Chain|The Sisters of Light I|1|«Releasing the Light» I|2|Harvesting the Bulb of Mornings I|3|«Harvesting the Bulb of Harvests» I|4|«Harvesting the Bulb of Twilight» I|5|«Hoshino Must Die» H2|Overview L|1|•|You must have completed «Releasing the Light» at least once in order to flag for this quest. L|1|•|Harvest a seed from the «Bulb of Mornings» located near Neftet. However, you'll have to fight or run through many of Hoshino's spectral undead, «Mu-miyah», and «Reedsharks» to reach the Bulb. L|1|•|This quest is easily soloable by someone with a ranged attack, however, without a ranged attack killing the tentacles in the second part of the quest might be more difficult. L|1|•|Flags you for the «Harvesting the Bulb of Harvests» Quest
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to the «Neftet Excavation Site» on the outskirts of «Neftet» at 22.2S, 8.6E and speak with «Kaltus». L|2|•|⟦FirstSisterStarted_1012⟧ L|1|2.|Enter the hole in the ground near the «Neftet Excavation Site» and keep going down through the tunnels until you reach a portal to the «Temple of Mornings». L|1|3.|In the Temple keep going upwards until you reach «Sanctum Guardian Spirit» on a platform L|1|4.|Jump up and talk to the «Sanctum Guardian Spirit» to receive a kill task for 10 of the mu-miyah/spectral undead. L|2|•|⟦SanctumGuardianKillTask⟧ L|2|•|⟦SanctumGuardianKillTask on first completion⟧ L|1|5.|Finish the kill task and then return to the «Sanctum Guardian Spirit» again to be portalled into the next dungeon. L|2|•|⟦SanctumGuardianKillTask_Completed⟧ L|1|6.|There are usable «Large Desert Flower»s in the next dungeon. If you use them they will spawn around 10 «Sath'tik Tentacle»s «Sath'tik Tendril¦Tendril»s and «Sath'tik Eyestalk¦Eyestalk»s L|1|7.|Kill the tentacles and loot 15 «Delicate Desert Flower»s. L|2|•|Note: You should only need to kill 3 or 4 spawns to get 15. Everyone on the quest needs 15. L|1|8.|Go to the end of the dungeon and find the «Bulb of Mornings». Use it and it will take all your «Delicate Desert Flower»s and give you a «Seed of Essence». L|2|•|⟦BulbofMorningsSeedGiven⟧ L|1|9.|Return to «Kaltus» and hand him your «Seed of Essence» for your rewards. You will also be portaled to the «Neftet Treasury» to use your key. If you don't want your orb, you can hand it to «Calitoth» for some additional xp and luminance instead. L|2|•|⟦FirstSisterCompleted_1012⟧ L|2|•|⟦BulbofHarvests_Flag⟧ L|2|•|Note: The nearby surface portal will not actually take you back to the surface but rather to the bottom of the tunnels. It is better to run back from the Neftet recall unless you want to go through all the spectral undead and mu-miyah again.

L|1||Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨You allow Kaltus to examine your Seed of Essence.⸩ ⸨Kaltus tells you, "Beautiful!".⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Seed of Essences.⸩ ⸨Kaltus tells you, "This is... amazing!"⸩ ⸨Kaltus tells you, "Even being warned what we may find, it's still breathtaking to see. Now, to see if Popkin's spell works..."⸩ ⸨Kaltus chants over the seed, and a small wisp of light pours out of the seed and into his hand.⸩ ⸨Kaltus tells you, "Oh good, it worked. Spirit-magic is such a touchy thing."⸩ ⸨Kaltus tells you, "It's only a small fragment of her essence, but it's progress all the same. As for this seed, I think you may find it useful."⸩ ⸨You've earned 210,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 20,000 Luminance.⸩ ⸨Kaltus gives you Seed of Mornings.⸩ ⸨Kaltus tells you, "If you're interested, I'll likely need your assistance again in a couple weeks. The bulb should be ready to produce another seed by then."⸩ ⸨You give Calitoth Legendary Seed of Mornings.⸩ ⸨Calitoth tells you, "Thank you. I'll send this along to my mistress. Please, accept this gift in return."⸩ ⸨You've earned 46,709,251 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 1,000 Luminance.
L|1||Other Interactions⸩ ⸨A voice in your mind says, "Hmmm... You do not seem to have the taint that these other invaders do..."⸩ ⸨A voice in your mind says, "If you wish entry to this sacred place, then prove your worth. Slay ten of these Dark Falatacot-touched invaders: the children of the self-titled 'Sand Kings' and those spectres that serve the Avatar of the Book."⸩ ⸨A voice in your mind says, "Do this, then return to me. I will accept it as proof of your intents here."⸩ ⸨You have killed 10 Spectral Voidmages! Your task is complete!⸩ ⸨A voice in your mind says, "Very well, you've proven to at least be an enemy of those trying to invade this place. Tread carefully once inside."
L|1||Using the Bulb of Mornings without any Delicate Desert Flowers in your inventory⸩ ⸨Attempting to pluck one of the seeds directly yields nothing... You think you'll need some other means to gather a seed from the bulb.⸩ ⸨You look over the large plant. Unlike the rest of the temple and its denizens, the plant itself seems entirely pristine and unmarred. The plant itself seems to radiate a feeling of peaceful hope.⸩ ⸨As you go to pick the flower, Sath'tik tentacles erupt from the ground around you!
L|1||Using the Bulb of Mornings without the full 15 Delicate Desert Flowers in your inventory⸩ ⸨As you examine the large plant, the Delicate Desert Flowers in your pack start to glow faintly. Perhaps with more of them, you could achieve your goal.⸩ ⸨You offer up the Delicate Desert Flowers to the large plant. The flowers themselves glow momentarilly, and then are absorbed in the plant.⸩ ⸨A moment later, the plant releases a small glowing seed.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Delicate Desert Flowers.⸩

Wiki.page: Hea Bone and Hide Shirt Quest

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|35 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Hea Kassoka» I|Starts At|47.3N, 90.1W in «Ahurenga» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Stinky green Mosswarts have been stealing Hea Kassoka's supplies. Bring an end to this by either bringing him the head of the chief or negotiating with him peacefully.
P|{TIP} Two runs to get all stamps. Once for killing the final boss and once for talking to final boss.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Once you have spoken to Hea Kassoka, head north then east to «Hagra's Holdfast» at 48.2N, 88.5W. L|2|•|⟦HeaBoneFlag⟧ L|1|2.|The drop is safe and the dungeon is very easy to navigate without getting lost. L|1|3.|Make your way through various tunnels and rooms inhabited by «Mosswart Clinger»s and «Mosswart Mire-Witch»es until you reach their leader «Big Chief Hagra». L|1|4.|You now have two options when dealing with Big Chief Hagra: L|2|1.|You can talk to him and he will agree to be friends with Kassoka and hand you «Hagra's Treaty» to take back (no stamp) L|2|2.|You can kill him and loot «Head of Big Chief Hagra» L|3|•|⟦HagrasHead⟧ L|1|5.|Return the item to Hea Kassoka for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦HeaBoneHeadTurnin⟧ or ⟦HeaBoneTreatyTurnin⟧ L|2|•|⟦HeaBoneFlagTimer⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Hea Kassoka says, "This is the second time since moon-turn that those ugly little green thieves have stolen my supplies."⸩ ⸨Hea Kassoka tells you, "Much as it shames me, human, I would ask for your help. A group of filthy, smelly creatures known as Mosswarts have made a home on my island and are raiding my supplies. I am but one warrior and cannot attend to my duties and guard my supplies all the time."⸩ ⸨Hea Kassoka tells you, "I would like for you to go into Hagra's Holdfast at 48.2 N, 88.5 W and confront their chief. Whether you must negotiate with him or just kill him, put an end to their thievery."⸩ ⸨Hea Kassoka tells you, "We have discussed this, have we not? Go into Hagra's Holdfast at 48.2 N, 88.5 W and confront their chief. Put an end to their theft of my supplies, one way or the other."
L|1||Big Chief Hagra⸩ ⸨Big Chief Hagra tells you, "You! Human help Hagra! Big 'Rok with spear in 'Rok village, very angry with Hagra! Hagra have no choice, Hagra's people very hungry! We escape bad things on bigger land, need food to live and make more Mosswarts! You take this to Big 'Rok with spear, tell him we be friends!"⸩ ⸨Big Chief Hagra gives you Hagra's Treaty.⸩ ⸨Big Chief Hagra tells you, "I already give you note! You go talk to Big 'Rok with spear! Go now!"
L|1||Handing in Head of Big Chief Hagra⸩ ⸨You give Hea Kassoka Head of Big Chief Hagra.⸩ ⸨Hea Kassoka tells you, "Ah, the ugly little beast's head. This will do. It is fair and right that I reward you, human. This is an armored shirt of my own making."⸩ ⸨You've earned 1,500,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Hea Kassoka gives you Hea Bone and Hide Shirt.⸩ ⸨You give Hea Kassoka Hagra's Treaty.⸩ ⸨Hea Kassoka tells you, "You brought me the head, and that was fine. Well done. Now you give me this treaty? What good is the treaty if you have shown bad faith and slain their chieftain? I had a better opinion of you when you had given me his head, before you tried this craven trick. Be off with you."
L|1||Handing in Hagra's Treaty⸩ ⸨You give Hea Kassoka Hagra's Treaty.⸩ ⸨Hea Kassoka tells you, "So the little beggar would trade peacefully with me, eh? Still, it is an interesting proposal, and I think they may prove useful to me..."⸩ ⸨Hea Kassoka tells you, "Very well. I thank you for resolving this situation without undue bloodshed. It does not surprise me that⸩ ⸨you weakling humans always seek peaceful solutions. I will reward you with an armored shirt of my own making..."⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Hea Kassoka gives you Hea Bone and Hide Shirt.⸩ ⸨You give Hea Kassoka Head of Big Chief Hagra.⸩ ⸨Hea Kassoka tells you, "You brought me Hagra's treaty, and I was well pleased. The situation was resolved without bloodshed. Why, then, would you bring me his head? While I appreciate a good beheading as much as the next Hea, this seems... wasteful. You will get no additional reward from me. Begone."⸩

Quest.name: Heart_of_Innocence_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Heart of Innocence (Dungeon)¦Heart of Innocence» near 34.0N, 39.0E (portal moves) I|Route|«Fort Tethana» to «Hilltop Portal» at 1.7N, 71.5W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Quest Chain|The Heart of Innocence I|1|«Oswald's Dirk Quest» I|2|Heart of Innocence Quest I|3|«Elemental Caverns Quest» H2|Overview L|1|•|Quest to receive the «Heart of the Innocent», which can be used on a «Weeping Weapons¦weapon cast» sold by «Silencia the Archmage» to create a «Weeping Weapons¦Weeping Weapon» (has the «Bael'Zharon's Hate» property). L|1|•|To flag for this dungeon, you must have entered the «Fir Tree», which also requires a flag from part of the «Oswald's Dirk Quest¦Oswald's Dirk» quest. L|1|•|Someone with «Lockpick» must be on this quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to the «Heart of Innocence (Dungeon)¦Heart of Innocence» dungeon, which appears in a random location on the road between Cragstone and Holtburg around 34.0N, 38.6E, just south of the «Obsidian Span». L|1|2.|Once inside lockpick the door to the south (resistance: 402). Beyond this door, the dungeon is laden with magic traps that cast vulnerability spells and war magic attacks. L|1|3.|Beyond the first door, pick up «Key to Jaleh's Chest» and proceed south. Lockpick two more doors (resistance: 402) and continue south as far as you can. L|2|•|⟦KeyJalehTaken⟧ L|1|4.|In the southern most chamber, take the ramp inside the smaller room north. Loop back in either direction and head south once more. L|1|5.|Very shortly after you will encounter five bosses: «Adroth Salson», «Den-Ru Chang», «Itala the Knife», «Li Fanli», and «Torgrym the Magnificent». None of them drop anything special. L|1|6.|Once you have reached the boss chamber, there are no more magic traps. Pick up «Jaleh's Silk Shirt» and «Jaleh's Necklace» in the boss chamber then proceed east. L|2|•|⟦ShirtJalehTaken⟧ L|1|7.|Lockpick the next door (resistance: 402). In this room, pick up «Jaleh's Turban». Walk through the illusionary wall to the east to enter the final room. L|2|•|⟦TurbanJalehTaken⟧ L|1|8.|In the final room, use the «Body of Jaleh al-Thani» to obtain the «Heart of the Innocent». Pick up «Jaleh's Slippers» and «Jaleh's Wedding Ring». L|2|•|⟦RingJalehTaken⟧ L|2|•|⟦SlippersJalehTaken⟧ L|2|•|⟦HeartInnocentTaken⟧ L|1|9.|Head up the ramp to the upper level, and head east around the corner. Use the «Key to Jaleh's Chest» to open «Jaleh's Finery Chest», which contains «Jaleh's Chain Shirt» and «Jaleh's Leggings». L|1|10.|Return Jaleh's items to «Aaminah» in «Ayan Baqur» for experience. The items that give rewards are: Slippers, Silk Shirt, Turban, and Wedding Ring. L|2|•|**Note:** A very common bug with this quest causes «Aaminah» to skip your XP rewards for some of the items when turning them in. To minimize this chance, speak with her and then wait at least 30 seconds before handing in each item; repeat this for every item. L|1|11.|Aaminah will give you «Letter to Ro Bi-Jor». L|1|12.|Bring the letter to «Ro Bi-Jor, Apprentice Tailor» at 28.5S, 59.2E in «Sawato» to receive an additional small xp reward.
P|The following texts can also be found in the dungeon. L|1|•|«Aged Page» L|1|•|«Heart of Innocence (Text)» L|1|•|«Blood Stained Book» L|1|•|«Note Scrawled in Blood»

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "Now that I know what happened to my husband there is much that must be done. I want to thank all those that helped find him. I will not go to his final resting place, along the road from the Obsidian Span toward Glendon Wood, for there is nothing there for me.⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "If you find his things within that place I will still reward you for finding them."
L|1||Obtaining the heart⸩ ⸨Body of Jaleh al-Thani gives you Heart of the Innocent.⸩ ⸨The heart of Jaleh al-Thani floats from the wound in his chest and lands in your hands solidifying into a deep red gem.⸩ ⸨As soon as the heart turns crystalline in your hands another appears in the dead man's body beating once more.
L|1||Showing Jaleh's Leggings⸩ ⸨You allow Aaminah to examine your Jaleh's Leggings⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "I am sorry, thank you for your efforts. Take these, they will better serve you now, I have no need of them. They will only serve as painful memories of happy times that are now gone.⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "You should also be rewarded for your efforts.
L|1||Showing Jaleh's Chain Shirt⸩ ⸨You allow Aaminah to examine your Jaleh's Chain Shirt⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "His chain shirt crafted by the hands of the finest Aluvian metal smith on Dereth. This is all the proof I need to know that my husband is no longer among the living. For him to part ways with this finery ensures that his life is over.⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "How I wish that you had not found this item. But you have.⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "Take this as payment for services well done and please, I beg you leave me to grieve for my lost husband."
L|1||Showing Jaleh's Necklace⸩ ⸨You allow Aaminah to examine your Jaleh's Necklace⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "Jaleh's necklace.⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "It was a gift from his mother. He always wore it, he'd never taken it off around me. Even when he slept. It was the only thing that he had to remind himself of home. Here.⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "I have no need of it anymore. But you might find the same comfort that he did within its embrace.⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "I am grateful for your efforts."
L|1||Handing in Jaleh's Wedding Ring⸩ ⸨You give Aaminah Jaleh's Wedding Ring⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "If only you had known his kindness. Though he was gruff at times and often selfish there was a part of him that was truly and deeply generous and kind.⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "I knew that part of his life and now that has been taken. Where is the law in this land that will punish his murderer?⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "Would that there was someone that could bring this criminal to justice. Alas, I must be thankful that you have found this ring, the symbol of our love.⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "You have done more then ever I would have expected any to achieve. Thank you for setting my mind at ease. It is horrible what has happened but never knowing what had happened to Jaleh, my love, would have been far worse.⸩ ⸨You've earned 8,000,000 experience⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "I know that this is not much of a reward for what you have done but it is all I can manage."
L|1||Handing in Jaleh's Slippers⸩ ⸨You give Aaminah Jaleh's Slippers⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "Soft as the desert sand. Much like his touch. I shall miss it deeply. Why must such things happen?⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "Were they not supposed to have disappeared with the creation of the Lifestones. But now so many are learning ways to circumvent Asheron's potent magic.⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "Here it is meager I know but it is all I can muster.⸩ ⸨You've earned 8,000,000 experience⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "What defender allows this to happen to their people?⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "I want Jaleh back.⸩ ⸨Aaminah breaks down in a fit of tears.
L|1||Handing in Jaleh's Turban⸩ ⸨You give Aaminah Jaleh's Turban⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "Though he preferred the open air that a Qafiya afforded him he would often use his turban as a belt or sash. I thank you for returning this to me.⸩ ⸨You've earned 8,000,000 experience
L|1||Handing in Jaleh's Silk Shirt⸩ ⸨You give Aaminah Jaleh's Silk Shirt⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "This was his favorite shirt. He had it made by To-ping Ra. Though To-ping Ra allowed an apprentice to create it.⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "Jaleh was more than impressed, he was astounded but true to form he berated the apprentice and had the cost of the shirt lowered.I felt bad for the apprentice but there was little that I could do.⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "Do me one final favor, please.Take this note to the apprentice so that they might know the truth.⸩ ⸨Aaminah gives you Letter to Ro Bi-Jor⸩ ⸨Aaminah tells you, "I am very thankful for what you have done.⸩ ⸨You've earned 8,000,000 experience.
L|1||Handing in "Letter to Ro Bi-Jor" to Ro Bi-Jor, Apprentice Tailor⸩ ⸨You give Ro Bi-Jor, Apprentice Tailor Letter to Ro Bi-Jor⸩ ⸨Ro Bi-Jor, Apprentice Tailor tells you, "This clears a lot up. I had thought that the shirt was some of my best work. Now I know that it was.⸩ ⸨Ro Bi-Jor, Apprentice Tailor tells you, "I am truly sorry that Jaleh is dead. That is a tragedy.⸩ ⸨You've earned 250,000 experience⸩ ⸨Ro Bi-Jor, Apprentice Tailor tells you, "My thanks for delivering this to me.⸩

Quest.name: Loyalty_Reset_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Lydda» (RM) or «Giordonni» (WB) I|Starts At|59.8S, 88.0W in «Ayan Baqur» or 72.1N, 61.3W in «Sanamar» I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Overview P|Quest to reset your loyalties with either of the two factions so you can join its adversary instead.
L|1|•|You only need to complete this quest if you have completed more than 1 of the Ordina Rossu Morta or Whispering Blade «Faction Quests». If you have not, you can simply hand the relevant NPC a single «Trade Note (250,000)» (MMD note) to reset your faction loyalty.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Ruschk Burial Mound (Leaving Ordina Rossu Morta) L|1|1.|Speak with «Lydda» at 59.8S, 88.0W in «Ayan Baqur». L|2|•|⟦AccessRuschkBurialMound⟧ L|1|2.|Head to «Ruschk Burial Mound» at 91.5N, 69.0W. L|2|•|Route: Using the «Town Network», take the «Silyun» portal from the south hall and run to 91.5N, 69.0W. L|1|3.|Work your way to the bottom where you'll find the «Ruschk Crypt Guardian». L|1|4.|Kill the guardian and loot the «Inner Burial Chamber Portal Sending Gem» from its corpse. L|1|5.|Use the portal gem to be portaled to the «Inner Burial Chamber». L|1|6.|Head up the ramp to the North and kill the «Ruschk Grave Keeper». L|1|7.|Once dead, loot the «Ruschk Funerary Fetish» from its corpse. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpRuschkFuneraryFetish⟧ L|1|8.|Return the Ruschk Funerary Fetish to Lydda in Ayan Baqur to have your faction loyalty reset. L|2|•|⟦RossuMortaLoyaltyReset⟧
H3|Sclavus Umbral Forge (Leaving Whispering Blade) L|1|1.|Speak with «Giordonni» at 72.1N, 61.3W in «Sanamar» L|2|•|⟦AccessSclavusUmbralForge⟧ L|1|2.|Head to the «Sclavus Umbral Forge» near the «Plateau Village». L|2|•|Route: «Town Network» to «Eastham». Eastham to «Sliver-of-BlueCottages» 17.5N 61.6E, run to 34.1N, 50.6W. L|1|3.|From the drop run north along the mostly linear path to a room with a surface portal and acid pit. L|1|4.|There are two exits from this room and you need to take both to retrieve the two items that you need. L|1|5.|Start by taking the west exit and passing through 3 different areas until you reach a room with a «Aste Soul Renderer» and Lord. Kill the renderer and loot his key, use the key on the chest and take the «Umbral Crucible Top». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpUmbralCrucibleTop⟧ L|1|6.|Now head back to the acid room and head east, the layout is pretty much identical. L|1|7.|Kill the «Essa Soul Renderer» and take his key, loot the «Umbral Crucible Base» from the chest and combine it with the top to make «Umbral Crucible». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpUmbralCrucibleBase⟧ L|1|8.|Return the completed Umbral Crucible to Giordonni to reset your faction with the «Whispering Blade». L|2|•|⟦WhisperingBladeLoyaltyReset⟧

If you regret what you have done, and wish to serve King Varicci, I can help you."⸩ ⸨Giordonni tells you, "For the price of an MMD note, my associates and I can erase any evidence that you served the Grand Mother on that single occasion."⸩ ⸨Giordonni tells you, "Be warned, however, that neither I nor my associates will be able to do anything like this for you again."⸩ ⸨Giordonni tells you, "I see that you have done a couple of things for the Grand Mother of Silyun. If you regret what you have done, and wish to serve King Varicci, my associates and I can help you. With a word in the right ear, we can make your disloyal acts disappear from the royal archives."⸩ ⸨Giordonni tells you, "But first you must do something for me. I seek some arcane magical equipment, guarded by Sclavus in a fortified compound at 34.1 N, 50.6 W. Bring me the Sclavus' Umbral Crucible, and your record will be cleansed. I should tell you that the artifact may be incomplete, and need to be re-assembled."⸩ ⸨You give Giordonni Umbral Crucible.⸩ ⸨Lydda tells you, "I see that you have gone to some great lengths to serve King Varicci's interests. If you regret what you have done, and wish to take service under Queen Elysa, my associates and I can help you. We can arrange to have all evidence of your... transgressions disappear."⸩ ⸨Lydda tells you, "But first you must do something for me. Bring me the artifact, and your record will be wiped clean."⸩ ⸨You give Lydda Ruschk Funerary Fetish.⸩ ⸨Lydda tells you, "Excellent work. I will make sure that the royal archives no longer have any trace of your cooperation with King Varicci. However, this does not mean the Queen's agents or the Grand Mother will trust you. You will have to earn their trust."⸩

Quest.name: Mi_Krau-Li's_Jitte_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|25 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Catacombs of the Forgotten» at 17.3N, 32.8E I|Route|«Cragstone» or via portal in «Facility Hub» (east wing - speak to warden) I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Mi Krau-Li is too busy to be dead! Recover Mi Krau-Li's Jitte, and help him continue his work.
P|This quest optionally starts with the rumor «Mi Krau-Li Rumor».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Mi Krau-Li's Jitte L|1|1.|The dungeon is very linear and easy to navigate, head north through the large room and then just keep going south ignoring all the side passages, until you get to a room with a coffin. L|1|2.|The coffin is «Mi Krau-Li's Sarcophagus», and is empty, except for a «Note from Mi Krau-Li» himself. L|1|3.|After you have taken the note, head east through a winding passage, taking the first turn off to the south. L|1|4.|You will notice an altar with green mist at the end of the passage. «Mi Krau-Li's Jitte» is just in front of the altar. L|2|•|⟦JitteKrauLiLesser⟧ L|2|•|If you are doing the Hub Quests, show the jitte to «Warden (Catacombs of the Forgotten)» before proceeding or you will lose the bonus xp. L|2|•|If you are not a finesse weapon character you can stop here.
H3|Mi Krau-Li's Improved Jitte L|1|1.|Now you have the Jitte, follow the instructions in the note and head to «Krau Li's Labyrinth» at 35.1S, 23.8E in the «A'mun Desert». L|2|•|Route: From «Al-Arqas», take the «Al-Hatar Settlement» portal at 33.5S, 13.2E. L|1|2.|From the drop go forward to the door and then head west to the end of the corridor. Take a mental note of the door to the south and then continue down a ramp to the north. L|1|3.|You will now start to see green lights which can be used as an indicator that you're heading the right way. Follow the corridor and turn north into a room with a green flame and a torch tucked away in an alcove. Use the torch to activate the door you saw earlier. L|1|4.|Run back to the now opened door and use the lever. Head back through the doors and this time head east (the first right turn from the drop) and then north east. L|1|5.|Follow the green mist east to the next lever and then run back on yourself through the doors and then south to door 3. L|1|6.|For the final lever head south west, this opens the very first door you see when entering the dungeon. L|1|7.|Portal recall or use the nearby surface portal and make your way through the door - follow the lights east to «Mi Krau-Li». L|1|8.|Hand him «Mi Krau-Li's Jitte» for «Mi Krau-Li's Improved Jitte».
H3|Mi Krau-Li's Remastered Jitte L|1|1.|If you hand the Jitte back one more time he will ask you to retrieve some components for another upgrade: A «Pyreal Bar», «Dark Revenant Thighbone» and some «Cartilage of Old Scratchy¦cartilage» from «Old Scratchy» the Reedshark. L|2|•|⟦RemasteredJitteStarted⟧ L|1|2.|You must give him the components in the order he requests them. You may hand in both the bar and thighbone at the same time but you cannot pick up the cartilage until you have handed those first 2 parts in. L|1|3.|Turn in «Pyreal Bar» L|2|•|⟦RemasteredJittePyrealBar_TurnIn⟧ L|1|4.|Turn in «Dark Revenant Thighbone» L|2|•|⟦RemasteredJitteThighbone_TurnIn⟧ L|1|5.|Kill «Old Scratchy» and loot «Cartilage of Old Scratchy» L|2|•|⟦CartilageofOldScratchy_Pickup⟧ L|1|6.|Turn in «Cartilage of Old Scratchy¦cartilage» L|2|•|⟦RemasteredJitteCartilage_TurnIn⟧ L|1|7.|Once you have given him all 3 parts, hand him the Improved Jitte and he will then give you «Mi Krau-Li's Remastered Jitte». L|2|•|⟦RemasteredJitteCompleted⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Catacombs of the Forgotten» 17.3N, 32.8E -- «map:02E6¦02E6» TR|«Krau Li's Labyrinth» 35.1S, 23.8E -- «map:02E5¦02E5» TR|«Old Scratchy's Cave» 29.0S, 26.6E -- -- TE
H2|Rewards
R|Give Mi Krau-Li's Improved Jitte to Mi Krau-Li RK|Experience|15,000,000 RK|Items| RI|«Mi Krau-Li's Remastered Jitte» RE
R| RK|Experience|550,000 (Fixed% up to level Fixed) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Mi Krau-Li⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "Do I know you? I find it harder and harder to remember names and faces. To be frank, everyone who visits me these days smells unpleasantly of flesh and sweat. Upsetting the delicate dry atmosphere of my laboratory with all your moisture and heavy breathing. Anyway, if you've got my old jitte, I'd be happy to exchange it for a much improved one. I think I lost my old one in the Catacombs of the Forgotten at 17.3 N, 32.8 E. And if I've already given you my Improved Jitte, hand it over to me for inspection. I think I've developed a new forging technique that will improve upon even the improved design.⸩ ⸨You give Mi Krau-Li Mi Krau-Li's Jitte⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "My old jitte! Thank you! It seems rather inferior now, with the advances I have made in jitte technology. But it has great sentimental value. Take this new jitte I've been working on, see how it works out. If you want something better than that... Well, hand it back to me and we'll talk about truly extreme techniques in jitte crafting.⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li gives you Mi Krau-Li's Improved Jitte.
L|1||Handing in Mi Krau-Li's Improved Jitte⸩ ⸨You give Mi Krau-Li Mi Krau-Li's Improved Jitte⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li gives you Mi Krau-Li's Improved Jitte⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "Yes! You are a prime candidate to test out my new jitte design! All I need are a few ingredients... Ah, first, I'll hand you back the Improved Jitte. Hold on to it until you've gathered all the ingredients. You might need it to collect them, after all.⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "Well, let's start from the beginning. First, I need a bar of Pyreal. You know, a bar made of the Pyreal Motes that come from golems. So get to hunting golems, friend! Kill enough until you've got enough Pyreal motes to make into a bar. Bring me a Pyreal Bar, and we'll move on to the next ingredient.⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "Have you compiled a full Pyreal Bar yet? If not, why are you here? There's golems out there that need killing! Get me a Pyreal Bar, and we can start talking about further steps to get you a next generation jitte."
L|1||Handing in Pyreal Bar⸩ ⸨You give Mi Krau-Li Pyreal Bar⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "Well done! Didn't take you that long, did it? Actually, I can't really tell how long it takes people to do things. My sense of time passing doesn't really work. It's as if I'm frozen in some unchanging state... But maybe that's just because I am so focused on the crafting of my jitte...⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "Now what I need is the thighbone from one of the undead. Yes, a Dark Revenant Thighbone. I'm sure you know what they look like. Personally, those shambling skeletons give me the creeps. There but for the grace of Jojii go I, I always say. But, yes, bring me a Dark Revenant Thighbone, and we'll be one step closer to getting you the world's finest jitte!⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "Yes, good job bringing me the Pyreal Bar. No, I don't need to know how many golems you had to hunt down for it. Why, I could tell you some stories about my legendary fights against golems in the dawn of humanity's days here on Dereth that would curdle your blood! But that's neither here nor there. I still need a Dark Revenant Thighbone to continue working on the mixture for my next generation jitte!"
L|1||Handing in Dark Revenant Thighbone⸩ ⸨You give Mi Krau-Li Dark Revenant Thighbone⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "Hrm, yes, a nicely desiccated thighbone. Lighter than normal bone, but retains the famous tensile strength of Dereth's undead. You know, looking at this, I get a strange, creepy sensation... Like someone walking over my grave. Except I don't have a grave. But you know what I mean, right?⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "Now I only need one more ingredient. This might be a tougher to get hold of than the other items, however. I need the cartilage from the body of a particularly old and vicious Reedshark. His name is Old Scratchy. He lives in a cave at 29.1S, 26.6E. He was one of my greatest enemies when Ben Ten and I were competing over who could make the biggest pile of Reedshark corpses. Old Scratchy got the best of me a couple of times. I imagine, at his advanced age, his cartilage will be well cured, and exactly the right consistency to fashion a great jitte...⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "I have a Pyreal Bar and a Dark Revenant Thighbone from you. Well done so far. But as I've already told you, I need cartilage from the body of the ancient Reedshark known as Old Scratchy. That tough old fellow lives in a cave at 29.1S, 26.6E."
L|1||Handing in Cartilage of Old Scratchy⸩ ⸨You give Mi Krau-Li Cartilage of Old Scratchy⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "Aha! Yes, this cartilage will work nicely. It's almost a shame that Old Scratchy had to die so that my jitte may live, but if I were a Reedshark, I'd feel honored that a part of me live on in such a wonderful weapon... It'd be like immortality!⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "Now that the ingredients are all gathered, I just need you to hand me your old Improved Jitte, and I will return to you the Remastered Jitte of Mi Krau-Li!"
L|1||Handing in Krau-Li's Improved Jitte⸩ ⸨You give Mi Krau-Li Mi Krau-Li's Improved Jitte⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "Yes, yes, the components you gathered for me will work perfectly here... This will only take a moment, since I already prepared everything else... I've got a lot of free time down here, you see.⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li gives you Mi Krau-Li's Remastered Jitte⸩ ⸨You've earned 15,000,000 experience⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "Take my new Remastered Jitte and strike mightily against the fearsome beasts who continue to plague Dereth!"
L|1||Handing in the Remastered Jitte⸩ ⸨You allow Mi Krau-Li to examine your Mi Krau-Li's Remastered Jitte.⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "What, you don't like this one? It's the greatest jitte in existence! There's just no pleasing you people sometimes!"
L|1||Retired Dialog⸩ ⸨You allow Mi Krau-Li to examine your Mi Krau-Li's Improved Jitte.⸩ ⸨Mi Krau-Li tells you, "What, is my jitte not good enough for you? That is the best I can make right now. I am always experimenting. Come back some other time, maybe I will have something better."⸩

Quest.Wiki:

We need to keep their number down to keep their potential threat to a minimum." L|1||Shishalti bint Jaffa tells you, "Go to the Moarsmen City, South East of Candeth Keep, and search for their Spawning Pools. Kill any of the foul beasts you find in the pools. Quest.name: Mukkir_Aspect_of_Grael_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|151 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Varetha» I|Starts At|44.3S, 62.5W near «Obsidian Rim» I|Route|«Obsidian Rim Portal» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|1.|*** PARAGON ARMOR NOTE *** When repeating this quest for another Shard of the Black Spear, simply proceed to step 2.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Black Ferah's Vault L|1|1.|After speaking with «Varetha» at 44.4S 62.5W, run northeast to «Black Ferah's Vault» at 39.1S 60.1W. L|2|•|⟦blackferahsvault_start⟧ L|1|2.|Follow the linear dungeon, until you reach a large room with «Commander Jared Kurth», kill him and loot the «Shadow Vault Key» from his corpse. L|2|•|{TIP} Kurth hits very hard, stay outside the room and have mages/archers attack him. L|1|3.|Use the key to open the door on the far side of the room, and follow the hallway until you reach a pedestal containing an «Experimental Shadow Stone», take it. L|2|•|⟦experimentalshadowstonepickuptimer⟧ L|1|4.|Portal recall, run back to «Varetha» at 44.4S 62.5W, and hand it the «Experimental Shadow Stone» to be flagged for part 2. L|2|•|⟦mukkirinfestedblackspeartemple_start⟧
H3|Part 2: Mukkir Infested Black Spear Temple L|1|1.|Now head to the «Valley of Death» and find the «Mukkir Infested Black Spear Temple» at 37.2S 67.0W (access up the mountain is at 36.6S 66.9W). L|2|•|{TIP} Its fastest if you can find a VoD Hot Drop portal. L|1|2.|From the portal drop, hug the wall right until you get to an L-shaped room with falling rocks («Rock Fall»). L|1|3.|Watch the rock fall sequence, and run through the L-shaped just as the closest rock falls, hugging the left wall as you run. L|1|4.|From here, hug the left wall all the way down until you pass a group of three shadows L|2|•|Note: Always take the first hallway on the left, even in big rooms (see map). L|2|•|Note 2: Be sure to hug the wall, there are traps throughout the dungeon that will spawn Mukkir over and over, should you hit them. L|1|5.|Once you pass the three shadows, you'll descend a long and steep ramp. From here, go left, ignore the next left, and then take the next left again, which leads down a ramp and to the black pit. L|1|6.|When you get to the large black pit, jump to the north platform (strong, straight normal jump), and then back to the lower south platform (same jump). L|1|7.|Finally, you'll come to «Grael's Chamber», home of the «Mukkir Aspect of Grael (creature)¦Mukkir Aspect of Grael». L|2|•|⟦graelschamberportalflag⟧
H3|Part 3: Grael's Chamber L|1|•|Note: Once you have passed through the Grael's Chamber portal at the bottom of the dungeon you can use the portal at the start of the dungeon to quickly return if you should die. L|2|•|{TIP} Healers and debuffers can safely remain at the jump if, they wish. L|1|1.|Fully debuff the «Mukkir Aspect of Grael», then jump down in the pit and kill him. L|1|2.|Once he's dead, loot a «Shadow Chest Key» and a «Shard of the Black Spear» from his corpse, and enter the Trophy Room portal. L|2|•|⟦shardoftheblackspearpickuptimer⟧ L|2|•|⟦shadowchestkeypickuptimer⟧ L|1|3.|Use the «Shadow Chest Key» on an «Ancient Reliquary», which will always include a random «Rare»s. L|1|4.|Return the «Shard of the Black Spear» to «Varetha» at 44.4S 62.5W for XP, a «Mukkir Aspect Slayer Title Token», and a hookable «Black Spear of Mukkir Strength». L|2|•|⟦mukkiraspectofgraelquest_wait⟧ L|2|•|Note: You can also return the hookable black spear to «Varetha» for up to 20 Million XP. L|1|5.|Return the «Mukkir Aspect Slayer Title Token» to «Hoshar ibn Jalaq» at 59.6S, 88.0W in «Ayan Baqur» to obtain the «Greater Mukkir Slayer Stone». L|1|6.|Apply the «Greater Mukkir Slayer Stone» to a loot generated weapon to give it the «Mukkir Slayer» property. L|2|•|{WARN} Once you apply the stone, it cannot be undone. Be sure you use it on the intended weapon.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Varetha touches your forehead, sending a dark chill throughout your body.⸩ ⸨Varetha tells you, "My Lord, Isin Dule, has sent me to aid you in the containing of the Mukkir Aspect of Grael. Though it will be a difficult thing to accomplish, this can be done. I have managed to locate the stone, but so have Grael's followers. Gather this stone for me, and I should be able to modify it to hold Grael's Mukkir Aspect for a time. I will attune you to the defenses of the location..."⸩ ⸨Varetha tells you, "You will find the stone at 39.1 S, 60.1 W. Go there and retrieve the stone. While you are gone, I will prepare what I need to modify it."

L|1||Handing in Shard of the Black Spear⸩ ⸨You give Varetha Shard of the Black Spear.⸩ ⸨Varetha tells you, "Now, this will make a trophy to be remembered."⸩ ⸨Shadow Power fills the shattered remnants of the Black Spear, which reforms completely.⸩ ⸨Varetha tells you, "It is no longer a weapon of destruction, as it once was. L|1||Handing in Black Spear of Mukkir Strength⸩ ⸨You give Varetha Black Spear of Mukkir Strength.⸩ ⸨Varetha tells you, "You do not wish such a trophy? Please journey to the Viamontian Esper Mine at 72.2 N, 3.0 E and see if you can get the gem that the mine's commander carries. I should be able to use that to forge a portal gem into the heart of Varicci's research operation."

The Commmander [sic] of that mine should have a gem, similar to this one, that will allow me to forge a portal gem."
L|1||Handing in Direlands Mine Commander's Gem⸩ ⸨You give Royal Guard Qumasha Direlands Mine Commander's Gem.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard Qumasha tells you, "Yes, the Direlands Mine Commander's gem. I have heard that Dardante keeps his notes in a locked chest in his office. If you cannot pick the lock, you will have to ransack his desk to find his key."
L|1||Handing in Count Dardante's Notes⸩ ⸨You give Royal Guard Qumasha Count Dardante's Notes.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard Qumasha gives you Necklace of the Elemental Adepts.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard Qumasha tells you, "This is valuable information. I thank you."⸩ ⸨You've earned 78,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard Qumasha tells you, "This necklace may be useful to you, should you have to encounter any more of those Viamontian Elemental Adepts. L|1||Handing in Necklace of the Elemental Adepts⸩ ⸨You give Royal Guard Qumasha Necklace of the Elemental Adepts.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard Qumasha tells you, "Ah, so you do not find the necklace useful. L|1||Handing in Shard of the Black Totem⸩ ⸨You give Soju Bo-Ki Shard of the Black Totem.⸩ ⸨Soju Bo-Ki tells you, "Excellent! This means that Grael's power has been dealt a serious blow! You have done the realm of Dereth a great service, friend."⸩ ⸨You've earned 17,429,613 experience.⸩ ⸨Soju Bo-Ki gives you Helm of the Black Totem.⸩

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina tells you, "You've already aided me once, for which I thank you. I would ask you to aid me a second time."⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina writes out a note, and then places the Enlightened Master's Medallion into the letter and seals it.⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina tells you, "Take this missive to Ookami Kiri, in Yanshi. She may have additional work for you, once she reads this."⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina gives you Folded Missive.
L|1||Returning to Sayuji⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina tells you, "Have you any word from Ookami Kiri?"
L|1||Ookami Kiri⸩ ⸨Ookami Kiri tells you, "You are one of the ones aiding my friend Sayuji Jina-san. Does your task progress well?"
L|1||Handing in Folded Missive to Ookami Kiri⸩ ⸨You give Ookami Kiri Folded Missive.⸩ ⸨Ookami Kiri takes the note with a polite bow, and then reads over it quickly.⸩ ⸨Ookami Kiri tells you, "It seems, looking at this medallion, that Sayuji Jina-san's fears have born fruit. My Mistress feared that this may have been the case, and has left me with a course of action, which I will now pass on to you."⸩ ⸨Ookami Kiri tells you, "There is an Enlightened Master of the Tanada Clan, one who came to Dereth in the beginnings of the Portals appearing in Sho lands. My Mistress has left me with a message to send to him, to seek his aid should Jina-san's fears prove true. If this corruption upon the Tanada Clan of the Nanjou Shou-Jen be a recent one, which it does seem to be, then he may be free of it still."⸩ ⸨Ookami Kiri tells you, "Take this letter to the Tanada training school, hidden at 66.3N, 7.6E, and deliver it to Master Seijuro. Be warned, however, that the students of this school will not take kindly to your arrival, and you will need to prove your worth to meet Master Seijuro, much as you did in gaining this medallion for Jina-san."⸩ ⸨Ookami Kiri gives you A Formal Request.
L|1||Returning to Ookami⸩ ⸨Ookami Kiri tells you, "You are one of the ones aiding my friend Sayuji Jina-san. Does your task progress well?"
L|1||Shrine of Earth⸩ ⸨The Tanada Shrine of Earth is made of polished stone and scented wood. It seems to have a slot built into it, as if to accept some small, disc-shaped object...⸩ ⸨You give Tanada Shrine of Earth Medallion of Earth.⸩ ⸨Though the Shrine of Earth does not move or change in any appreciable way, you can almost feel its approval as you present it with the medallion that once belonged to the Master of Earth.
L|1||Shrine of Stone⸩ ⸨The Tanada Shrine of Stone is made of polished stone and scented wood. It seems to have a slot built into it, as if to accept some small, disc-shaped object...⸩ ⸨You give Tanada Shrine of Stone Medallion of Stone.⸩ ⸨Though the Shrine of Stone does not move or change in any appreciable way, you can almost feel its approval as you present it with the medallion that once belonged to the Master of Stone.
L|1||Shrine of Metal⸩ ⸨The Tanada Shrine of Metal is made of polished stone and scented wood. It seems to have a slot built into it, as if to accept some small, disc-shaped object...⸩ ⸨You give Tanada Shrine of Metal Medallion of Metal.⸩ ⸨Though the Shrine of Metal does not move or change in any appreciable way, you can almost feel its approval as you present it with the medallion that once belonged to the Master of Metal.
L|1||Master Seijuro⸩ ⸨Master Seijuro tells you, "You have fought well to come here. Why have you come?"
L|1||Handing in A Formal Request to Master Seijuro⸩ ⸨You give Master Seijuro A Formal Request.⸩ ⸨As Master Seijuro reads the letter, a look of mild surprise passes over his face.⸩ ⸨Master Seijuro tells you, "Well, I honestly never thought I'd see a letter in this handwriting ever again..."⸩ ⸨Master Seijuro tells you, "It's been years since the battle at Yanshi, and she's been gone ever since. Now, she resurfaces, with such dire words, requesting my help..."⸩ ⸨Master Seijuro tells you, "Were these words to have come from any but the one who sent you, I'd have killed you on the spot for such an accusation. But, I owe her my life, and I trust her judgment."⸩ ⸨Master Seijuro tells you, "Here, take this token to the one who sent you. She will know what it means, and will know how to respond to it. Consider it my final test of you, to ensure that this letter is real. If this letter is a fake, and your Mistress is not whom I think it is, then you will know the wrath of the Tanada Clan. Now, go."⸩ ⸨Master Seijuro gives you Medallion of the Sword.
L|1||Retuning to Seijuro⸩ ⸨Master Seijuro tells you, "I see you have not yet delivered my reply to the one who sent you. You should do so with haste."⸩ ⸨You allow Master Seijuro to examine your Medallion of the Sword.⸩ ⸨Master Seijuro tells you, "This is your test. There is no turning back now. I suggest you hurry, lest I take your dawdling as failure and deceit."
L|1||Handing in Medallion of the Sword to Ookami Kiri⸩ ⸨You give Ookami Kiri Medallion of the Sword.⸩ ⸨Ookami Kiri examines the medallion intently, while you tell her of your encounter with Master Seijuro.⸩ ⸨Ookami Kiri tells you, "This is the response Master Seijuro has sent? Very well, I will get it to my Mistress with all haste. Thank you for your assistance in this. It is greatly appreciated."⸩ ⸨Ookami Kiri tells you, "Here, take this letter to Sayuji Jina, in Shoushi. I believe she has a reward for you, for all that you have done to aid us."⸩ ⸨Ookami Kiri gives you Sealed Missive.
L|1||Handing in Sealed Missive to Sayuji Jina⸩ ⸨You allow Sayuji Jina to examine your Sealed Missive.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Sealed Missives.⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina reads the letter from Ookami Kiri, a barely noticeable smile forming on her face as she does so.⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina tells you, "Ookami Kiri speaks well of your aid to both her and my Mistress. For this I thank you, and would like to reward you once again. My Mistress has entrusted me to give this gift to those who have aided her in this matter directly. I think you've earned it."⸩ ⸨You've earned 25,500,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina gives you Tachi of Grace.⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina tells you, "If such a blade is not useful to you, you may return it to me for more practical knowledge."⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to complete this quest again.
L|1||Handing in Tachi of Grace to Sayuji Jina⸩ ⸨You give Sayuji Jina Tachi of Grace.⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina tells you, "Very well. It is a pity that you do not wish to keep it, but not all have use for blades, so I understand. I hope this practical knowledge is more useful to you."⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,064,801 experience.
L|1||Returning to Sayuji⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina tells you, "Ah yes, I remember your excellent work in the past on this ongoing Tanada investigation. I would ask you to tangle again with those renegade Nanjou Shou-Jen... My colleague Meshenq in Zaikhal had a run-in with some Tanada while he was exploring the southern land bridge. Please go to Zaikhal and see if there is some way you can help him."⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to complete this quest again.
L|1||Returning to Ookami⸩ ⸨Ookami Kiri tells you, "Thank you again for your assistance in this matter. I have nothing more for you at this time. Perhaps later on, I will have work for you again."⸩

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Te Ven» I|Starts At|«South Yanshi Outpost» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|A quest to retrieve the remaining three of the four «The Collected Writings of Jhong Mi¦Writings of Jhong Mi». The missing part (part 3) is found by completing the previous Yanshi Starter Quest: «Lou Ei's Stolen Bracelet».
P|This quest rewards a stamp that is used in the «Exploration Society Letters» quest to gain useful equipment.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1 of the Writings of Jhong Mi (40+) L|1|1.|Once you have obtained «Te Ven's Key» from «Te Ven» (15.7S, 46.4E) run to the nearby «Deserted Ruin» at 16.0S, 47.2E. L|1|2.|Inside the dungeon take a right at the split and then keep left until you reach a locked door use the key and loot the first of Jhong Mi's «Writings (Deserted Ruin)¦Writings» from the chest. «Yanshi Town Stamp» is also in the chest. L|2|•|⟦NewbieQuestStampYanshi⟧ L|2|•|⟦WritingJhongMiAQuest⟧ L|1|3.|Return the writings to «Dai Ya the Scholar» in Yanshi (12.0S, 42.6E) for your rewards.
H3|Parts 2 and 4 of the Writings of Jhong Mi (Starter Quest - Optional) P|These two quest turn-ins are for very little XP, and are not required to complete the high xp/exploration society quest, The Deserted Ruin L|1|1.|Head to Old «Yanshi» and go to the «Yanshi Tunnels» just a few clicks away at 12.1S, 45.6E. L|1|2.|Take all lefts until you reach an open room with furniture and food on the floor, in the corner near the beds is a chest which contains the second of Jhong Mi's «Writings (Yanshi Tunnels)¦Writings». L|2|•|⟦WritingJhongMiBQuest⟧ L|1|3.|Go back to the start and use the surface portal, when outside head east to the «ReedShark Lair» at 12.2S, 48.3E. L|1|4.|Make your way through the hall ignoring the first few side rooms, you will be in an open room with a bridge above you. L|1|5.|From here head west past the bridge and up the ramp to the third of Jhong Mi's «Writings (ReedShark Lair)¦Writings» stored in a chest. L|2|•|⟦WritingJhongMiCQuest⟧ L|1|6.|Return both of the writings to «Dai Ya the Scholar» in Yanshi (12.0S, 42.6E) for your rewards.

H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Retrieving the Elemental Talisman L|1|1.|Everyone needs the «Elemental Talisman» key to access the Prodigal Harbinger's lair. L|1|2.|The Talisman is found in the «Artifex Collegium» dungeon located on the north part of the «Singularity Caul» at 91.9S, 93.7W. You will only need to do this once, as you can use the same talisman for future quests. L|1|3.|Once inside the collegium, head north and take the east passage from the first large room you enter. From there, it's a linear path to the room with the «Artifex of the Elements» and the talisman (found on the floor). The Artifex drops the text «Message to the Elemental Artifex».
H3|Part 2: Tunnels to the Harbinger L|1|1.|Just like the other «Harbinger Quest»s, start by entering the «Tunnels to the Harbinger», located next to «Issk» at 12.9S, 46.5E or «Vincadi» at 12.6S 46.7E. L|2|•|Note: If you enter the Issk side, you are restricted from entering the Vincadi side and vice versa. Make sure everyone in your fellowship hands their item to the same NPC. L|1|2.|Once inside, the dungeon is linear to the bottom (keep heading down). The only obstacles are a series of 5 jumps that must be made. L|2|•|**Jump 1: Acid Pit** - Full jump ahead (land on invisible platform) L|2|•|**Jump 2: Lava Pit** - Jump into the pit and take the hallway to the North L|2|•|**Jump 3: Ice Shelf ** - Shift-jump down onto the platform above the ice shelf, clear the spawn, and wait for your group. L|2|•|**Jump 4: Ice/Acid Pit Combo** - Dispel, then shift Jump down onto the ice shelf and **quickly** run to the edge and full jump across the acid pit (land on invisible platform). The ice hurts, so be quick. L|2|•|**Jump 5: Staging Area** - Shift jump down and quickly move to the south (near the portals). L|1|3.|This is a good place to rebuff if needed; if not use the «Essence Chambers». L|1|4.|After using the portal it is imperative that you look behind you and find a «Hollow» on the wall. L|2|•|{TIP} It cannot be selected by using Next/Closest Item keys; it can only be seen by hovering over it with your mouse, using a program that enables Dungeon Light will make this easier. L|1|5.|After everyone has found the «Hollow», and can easily recognize and find it again, everyone needs to take their «Elemental Talisman» and give it to four «Hollow»s. Each of these four are located behind each of the four Essences. If you give it to the hollow successfully there will be a message in green verifying as much. L|2|•|⟦HollowsUsed⟧ L|1|6.|If also running the «Essence Recovery» quest, kill each of the 4 Essences and pickup the crystallized essence that is left behind: L|2|1.|«Essence of Strife» for the «Crystallized Essence of Strife» L|3|•|⟦essenceofstrifepickup⟧ L|2|2.|«Essence of Enchantment» for the «Crystallized Essence of Enchantment» L|3|•|⟦essenceofenchantmentpickup⟧ L|2|3.|«Essence of Artifice» for the «Crystallized Essence of Artifice» L|3|•|⟦essenceofartificepickup⟧ L|2|4.|«Essence of Verdancy» for the «Crystallized Essence of Verdancy» L|3|•|⟦essenceofverdancypickup⟧ L|1|7.|Ignore the portals which appear after all 4 essences have been killed. These portals are for the Essenceless Harbinger, not Prodigal! L|1|8.|Return to the north wing. To the south on the inner wall, there is the final hollow. Give the last talisman to the hollow on the south wall. You will be portaled into «Prodigal Harbinger's Antechamber». L|2|•|⟦HarbingerProdigal⟧
H3|Part 3: Prodigal Harbinger's Antechamber L|1|1.|You will be teleported to one of four alcoves, overlooking «Harbinger» and several of his Elemental minions. L|2|•|Note: Be careful, it is possible to take damage from the frozen cold when standing here. L|1|2.|From here, its best to debuff everything in the room before jumping down. L|2|•|Note: Once Harbinger is attacked, anyone who enters «Prodigal Harbinger's Antechamber» will be portaled directly into the pit with Harbinger. L|1|3.|Once you kill «Harbinger», loot a «Corrupted Harbinger Blood» from the floor. L|2|•|⟦CorruptedHarbingerBlood_Pickup⟧ L|2|•|If Killing shot: ⟦ProdigalHarbyKillShot⟧ L|1|4.|Use the surface portal that spawns nearby (DON'T DELAY, the portal doesn't stay long). You MUST use the surface portal to flag for the «#Rewards¦rewards». L|2|•|⟦ProdigalHarby_Completed⟧ L|1|5.|Turn into «Vincadi», «Issk», or «Emissary of Asheron»

L|1||Issk's yellow eyes contract. L|1||Issk tells you, "Very well, perhaps another time."
H3|Interactions L|1||You allow Hollow to examine your Elemental Talisman. L|1||You place the Elemental Talisman in the hollow and its blue gem shines with cold blue light. L|1||You allow Hollow to examine your Elemental Talisman. L|1||You place the Elemental Talisman in the hollow and its red gem burns with fiery light. L|1||You allow Hollow to examine your Elemental Talisman. L|1||You place the Elemental Talisman in the hollow and its purple gem flickers with arcs of electric light. L|1||You allow Hollow to examine your Elemental Talisman. L|1||You place the Elemental Talisman in the hollow and its green gem glows with caustic green light.
L|1||As you place the Elemental Talisman into the hollow you hear a distant unearthly cry. The wall quakes gelatinously and you are suddenly pulled through its horrible fleshy surface.

Quest.name: Aerbax's_Prodigal_Mosswart
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 I|Rec. Level|100+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Sergeant Brigitta» I|Starts At|74.3S, 84.6E in «Kryst» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Travel to Kryst and talk to Sergeant Brigitta. L|2|•|Route: Town Network, East Side(Sho), back left wall L|2|•|⟦AerbaxsProdigalMosswartStarted⟧
H3|Part 1: Mosswart Holding L|1|1.|Head to the «Mosswart Holding» at 78.2S, 86.7E. P|On the ground outside of the cave. Pick up Mosswart Thanking Stone⟦PickedUpMosswartStoneThanks⟧ L|1|2.|From the drop, go north and take the ramp down. At each intersection, go South, East, South, North, East, and East respectively, then take the ramp to the lower level intersection. L|1|3.|At this intersection, go West, then South, East, and South respectively, where you'll need to speak with any of the «Visiting Shaman». L|2|•|⟦VisitingShaman_Flag⟧ L|1|4.|Backtrack to the lower level intersection, and go North. From here, pass through each intersection, going East, South, South, and North respectively. L|1|5.|In the small side room nearby, use the «Pile of Stained Papers» to make a copy of them and receive «Piece of Paper». L|2|•|⟦ReceivedPieceofPaper⟧ L|1|6.|{OPT} Continue South until you reach «Bragara, the Chosen One», Aerbax's Prodigal Mosswart. The rooms are full of powerful Mosswarts and it is recommended that you approach slowly as a solo. There is no additional reward for killing Bragara. L|1|7.|Head to «MacNiall's Freehold» and give the «Piece of Paper» to «Researcher Tharin», located in the bar at 74.0S, 92.3E. L|2|•|⟦PieceofPaperTurnin⟧ L|1|8.|Head back to Kryst and speak to Sergeant Brigitta for your experience and title rewards. L|2|•|⟦AerbaxsProdigalMosswartRepeat⟧ L|2|•|⟦AerbaxsProdigalMosswartCompleted⟧
H3|Part 2: Mosswart Worship Cavern L|1|•|Note: No QB for this part, can stop after part I if you don't want the spear. L|1|1.|Head to the «Mosswart Worship Cavern» at 41.1S 48.8W in the «East Direlands Swamp». L|1|2.|Hug the right wall until you find an NPC, «Ahumba», at the end of the dungeon. L|1|3.|Speak to him to obtain the «Blessed Spear of the Mosswart Gods». L|2|•|{OPT} If you don't want the spear, you can return it to «Sergeant Brigitta» for additional xp.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Sergeant Brigitta tells you, "Friend, welcome to our lines. I am Sergeant Brigitta, second in command of the defense here. We're managing to keep Kryst safe, but there are things you could do to help us against the Mosswarts."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Brigitta tells you, "The Mosswarts are led by a being named Bragara. However, we are not concerned for him so much as we are concerned about the movements of his forces."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Brigitta tells you, "Go to the caverns under the Mosswart Holding and bring us the plans for his attack, and we will be better able to stop their advance."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Brigitta tells you, "Also, there are shamans who did not agree with Bragara's claim of godhood among the Mosswarts. We have it on good authority that some shamans have been imprisoned in the very same caverns that the plans are located in. While you are in there, please free a shaman. It will help the Mosswarts be able to muster a resistance against Bragara, which will in turn make our jobs easier."
L|1||Visiting Shaman⸩ ⸨You rapidly explain your reason for being here to the Mosswart shaman, who after a moment nods.⸩ ⸨Visiting Shaman tells you, "Me trust you. Me seek out others of my kind who maybe resist Bragara. Wish luck."
L|1||Using Pile of Stained Papers⸩ ⸨You make a copy of the writing on some spares pieces of paper that are handy.⸩ ⸨You shuffle through the notes, and manage to figure out that they're a plan of some sort. However, while the words seem vaguely familiar and close to words you realize, they are just different enough that you can't tell exactly what the author meant. You'll need to get them properly interpreted by someone else, perhaps someone who has some experience with this particular band of Mosswarts.⸩ ⸨Pile of Stained Papers gives you Piece of Paper.
L|1||Researcher Tharin⸩ ⸨You introduce yourself to the researcher, and briefly summarize the contents of the plans you read in the Mosswart Holding⸩ ⸨Researcher Tharin tells you, "Yes, these Mosswart do seem to utilize a strange cipher - unusual even for Mosswarts. Luckily for you, I've figured out what they mean by some of these keywords..."⸩ ⸨Researcher Tharin spends a moment explaining the most recent scheme of the Mosswarts - enough for you to report back to Sergeant Brigitta.
L|1||Showing Piece of Paper to Sergeant Brigitta⸩ ⸨You present the transcribed papers you gathered to the sergeant.⸩ ⸨Sergeant Brigitta tells you, "Can you read these? I can't. Without being able to make out what they say, they're not much use to me."⸩ ⸨The sergeant pauses for a moment to ponder, then speaks again.⸩ ⸨Sergeant Brigitta tells you, "I've heard that there might be someone in MacNiall's ragtag village who is doing research on the Mosswarts. Maybe you should bring this note there and see what he thinks of it?"
L|1||Handing in Piece of Paper to Researcher Tharin⸩ ⸨You give Researcher Tharin Piece of Paper.⸩ ⸨Researcher Tharin gives you Piece of Paper.⸩ ⸨Researcher Tharin tells you, "Here's a more in-depth translation of what you took, for your own records. I doubt that your Sergeant Brigitta will need any of this information - this is for your own purposes."⸩ ⸨From the translation job that Tharin did, however, you do feel like you understand the Mosswart plans better, and are now prepared to report them to Sergeant Brigitta.
L|1||Returning to Sergeant Brigitta⸩ ⸨You explain in detail how Researcher Tharin interpreted the Mosswart plans, and then mention the Mosswart shaman you freed and his intentions.⸩ ⸨Sergeant Brigitta tells you, "Well done, adventurer! We appreciate what you've done to help protect Kryst from the Mosswart threat."⸩ ⸨You've earned 30,000,000 experience.
L|1||Receiving Blessed Spear of the Mosswart Gods from Ahumba⸩ ⸨Ahumba tells you, "Humie help Mosswart shamans flee Bragara. Humie receive great spear from Mosswart gods as reward. Mosswart debt to humie end here."⸩ ⸨Ahumba gives you Blessed Spear of the Mosswart Gods.⸩ ⸨Ahumba tells you, "This place holy to Mosswart gods and heroes. Ahumba care for place, not fight in it. But you not belong here. You go. Nothing for you here."
L|1||Handing in Blessed Spear of the Mosswart Gods to Sergeant Brigitta⸩ ⸨You give Sergeant Brigitta Blessed Spear of the Mosswart Gods.⸩ ⸨Sergeant Brigitta tells you, "I think we can find a soldier to equip this with. Thank you for the contribution."⸩ ⸨You've earned 3,441,334 experience.
L|1||Quest Repeats⸩ ⸨Sergeant Brigitta tells you, "Welcome back. We believe that the Mosswarts have devised a new plan, and if you could retrieve the information for us it, and free another shaman along the way as well, that would be very appreciated."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Brigitta tells you, "Do you need a reminder of what we need? Alright."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Brigitta tells you, "The Mosswarts presumably have plans to take Kryst at some point. We need to interrupt their plans somehow, and the best way to do this would to know what exactly their plans are."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Brigitta tells you, "While you're at it, we've also heard that not all Mosswarts are working along with Bragara. It would help our cause if someone freed some of those Mosswarts to encourage unrest among the enemy."⸩

H2|Trivia P|When first introduced, this quest was much more intricate. To complete the quest, one would first have to go to the Linvak Tukal Entryway and kill the Lugian Commander. This would spawn the lugians at the first raider camp. In order to spawn the second camp, the first one would need to be killed, and same for the third camp. The Commander would not respawn unless the camps were all defeated. This caused issues as people would sometimes only spawn up to the camp they needed to get their desired item, leaving the quest in an unfinished state. P|⸨"The Lugians seem to lose their courage after the death of their commander. Some of them fall back to regroup with their second in command, the Master of the Hunt."⸩ ⸨"The Lugians become disheartened at the fall of their leader! Many of them run for the hills to their next encampment..."⸩ ⸨"The Lugians seem to lose their courage after the death of their commander. Frantic, they fall back to their last staging ground."⸩ ⸨"Infighting erupts among the Lugians as they see their leader's body collapse to the ground. Linvak Tukal is safe from the depredations of the Gotrok until another leader arises to unite them once again."⸩ P|In addition to the spawning order, creation of the Sleeves of Inexhaustability, Staff of Clarity, Spear of Purity did not require Axe, Mana Conversion, and Spear skill respectively as they do now. Instead, the sleeves required Mana Conversion skill, the staff required Spear skill, and the spear required axe skill. Since the trophies were attuned/bonded, this required people to drag someone else along to get their reward, or temporarily training a skill to complete their item.
P|When the quest was redesigned, the spawning pattern and restrictive skill requirements were removed. In addition, all the items were updated.
