L|1|2.|Everyone in the group will have to click 3 mnemosynes located in 3 separate dungeons. L|1|3.|In each of the 3 towns surrounding Hoshino Fort, look for a mysterious hatch. Click it to access each of the dungeons (NOTE: since you are now going to visit the 3 towns, you can take the opportunity to collect the 3 parts of the «Main Gate Key» as detailed below, in point 1 of Part 2) L|2|•|**Town 1:** 79.8N, 41.0W - the hatch is in the Sho-style armorer building and can be accessed from outside through the wall (no need to enter the building). L|2|•|**Town 2:**78.6N, 40.6W - from town 1, run W then S for a safe route. The hatch is in the mage tower,under the stairs on the first floor. You must enter the building to access it. L|2|•|**Town 3:** 78.2N, 42.3W - the hatch is on the first floor of the tavern and you must enter the building to access it. L|2|•|Note: The coordinates given are for safe areas on the edge of each town with the correct building just ahead. L|1|4.|Make your way to the end of each dungeon. There will be lever doors throughout. Sometimes the lever or button will be located next to the door, and sometimes you will have to backtrack to find it. L|1|5.|At the end, you must kill a Daimyo boss (25k HP), which will open a portal to the mnemosyne you need to click. You must kill the boss in the large room he is in or there will not be enough room for the portal to open. L|1|6.|(Optional) Once you have clicked on all 3 mnemosynes, return to «Lord Brem» and talk to him. L|2|•|⟦HoshinoMnemosyne1⟧ L|2|•|⟦HoshinoMnemosyne2⟧ L|2|•|⟦HoshinoMnemosyne3⟧ L|2|•|⟦HoshinoMnemosynesDone⟧
H3|Part 2: Gauntlet L|1|1.|You must now collect the pieces to get the key to «Hoshino Fortress». See the «Hoshino Fortress Infiltration» page for more details. L|1|2.|Enter Hoshino Fort and in the first courtyard, look for a mysterious hatch inside the gazebo to the right of the main gate. Click it to access the final dungeon. L|1|3.|At the entrance you will see a Private Quarters portal, which will take you back to the final room once you have entered this portal at the end of the first section of the dungeon. However, keep in mind you will need a new key to enter Hoshino Fort every time in order to get back and access this portal. Thus, it is most useful only if the entire group dies. L|1|4.|The first section of the dungeon will be a gauntlet of several large rooms with a fast respawn rate. You must kill your way through, keeping in mind that if you take too long, respawn from the previous large room can catch you from the back. L|2|•|{WARN} After you clear the first room there is an especially fast respawn that is guaranteed to catch you before you finish the second room. This maybe by design or perhaps there is a floor trap in the exiting hallway that triggers it. Whatever the case be very careful after clearing the first room. L|1|5.|You will then come to a large metal door located at a 3-way. You will have to enter each fork to the left (2) and right (2), pushing switches to open it. There are 4 levers, and the order is SE, NW, NE, SW. L|1|6.|The next section is a loop with another metal door opened by a nearby lever. Once you get past this door, you will jump down. L|1|7.|The jump is safe as long as you don't move forward. Ahead, you will notice 2 metal gates and tunnels to the east and west. L|1|8.|You have some options here. You can send two people to simultaneously pull levers located in the large rooms down these tunnels (healers can remain just inside each tunnel and still reach the pusher). Alternatively, one person or a small group can do the pulling while others are left behind to block the two gates, which close quickly. If blocking, pull the lever in the WEST tunnel first (as this opens the first gate). Note the respawn at the gates is fast so it is advised the bulk of the group remain to defend there. (NOTE: We have found that a single person can pull both levers and run through the doors JUST IN TIME. But to do this it is not possible to stop the run even for a moment, for which it is advisable to eliminate the monsters from the corridors beforehand).
H3|Part 3: Trap Corridor L|1|1.|Once past the gates do not rush ahead - there is a pyramid trap. You will also find a lever on the wall right before the entrance to the tunnel with the trap. L|2|•|Note: Pyramid traps do roughly 400 damage with an aegis active. A pierce protection rare negates all damage. L|1|2.|In the trap tunnel, there is a wooden door (no lever, it's just a normal door). Midway through the tunnel there is a 4-way (with colored mist) where you will notice a frost ring spell trap that fires every couple of seconds. Once the trap fires, pyramids will shoot out of the same location going in all 4 directions. Note that the pyramids may in rare cases fire simultaneously but more often will fire one at a time following a pattern. First, a pyramid will head toward you (backwards). Then a pyramid will head toward the wooden door (forward). Likewise, pyramids will also shoot off into the other 2 tunnels (to the left, N and right, S). There will be cubicles in the tunnel wall that you can use to make your way forward. L|1|3.|Solving this part requires coordinated lever work. Past the wooden door, you will find a lever-activated metal gate (your goal). To open this gate, you must first press the lever at the entrance to the trap tunnel. L|1|4.|This will then open a gate to a room with a lever in the tunnel to the left (N) from the 4-way. One person should make their way there to pull this lever when the door opens. L|1|5.|Doing so opens a door to a lever room in the right (S) tunnel from the 4-way and likewise you should position a person there. The person pushing the lever in the N tunnel will not be able to make it to the S tunnel on time without hitting a pyramid - remember pyramids will also fly down these tunnels. L|1|6.|Once you pull this lever, the metal gate past the wooden door will open. There is a lever right after it, which you can use to re-open it. Thus, there is no need to block it as long as one person makes it past.
H3|Part 4: Jumping Puzzle L|1|1.|You will next reach the jumping puzzle room, which you will enter from the S end. This room has an acid pit, and many creatures (most of whom will jump down in the acid). **Only 1 person out of the whole group must complete the jumps.** The goal to jump your way up, and into a tunnel (very high up) on the N side of the room. There is also a lever there, which will spawn a portal down below used to bypass the acid pit jumps for the rest of your group. L|2|•|If you fall, you can get back up by shift jumping onto a small platform out of the acid pit. From there, you must do a full jump to a set of platforms arranged in a row. Keep in mind you should stand as far back on the small platform as you can before full jumping to make it. Once on the row of platforms, shift jump back out to the entrance stage. L|2|•|**Lockpick Bonus:** In the acid pit, you will find a tunnel leading to a «Chorizite Chest», which appears to follow a modified tier 8 rule. The difficulty is 600, and the chest resists spells so you cannot cast weaken lock on it. Only one person must have lockpick to open the chest for everyone else. L|3|•|⟦chestchorizite72526⟧ L|1|2.|The first jump is to a set of platforms just to the left of the entrance to the room. This is a full shift jump (take a step back from the edge to do it). L|1|3.|Next, jump in a diagonal (about SW) to a set of platforms located along the S wall. This is a 3/8 power normal jump (for 563 jump skill, which I will assume for all other jumps). You can use the wall to stop you depending on how you aim. L|1|4.|Next, full jump to the SW corner of the room. L|1|5.|The next jump is to a square platform in the center of the room. This is a difficult jump that requires about, but no more than, 1/2 power. L|1|6.|Next, jump to the platform above, on the W wall (use the wall to stop) L|1|7.|From here you will make a jump up and to the N onto a set of platforms arranged in a right angle. This is a full power jump but you will barely make it. Keep in mind a higher jump skill can overshoot if using full power. L|1|8.|The last jump is to the opening on the N wall (marked by two torches), and also full power. L|1|9.|Once there, you can pull the lever to open the shortcut portal for the rest of your group below.
H3|Part 5: Private Quarters L|1|1.|Ahead, you will fight a few more spawns and at last reach the Private Quarters portal. The drop is safe. L|2|•|⟦PrivateChambersShortcut⟧ L|1|2.|You will now be in a large room with the «Spirit of Bist'elle» and a mnemosyne. DO NOT click on the mnemosyne unless ready to begin combat. Everyone in the group can talk to her (unknown if this is required). L|1|3.|This fight requires teamwork. By clicking the mnemosyne, the room will be filled with creatures on a fast respawn. An NPC form of Hoshino Kei will also spawn next to the mnemosyne. DO NOT at any time speak to her - she will portal you to «Fort Tethana». The goal is to kill three large ward crystals (Blight, Decay, and Darkness) that will also spawn in separate locations in this room. Archers can machine gun the crystals but they are immune to life magic. Once each crystal dies, it will be replaced by an NPC that you must protect. If the NPC dies, the crystal will respawn and you will have to kill it again. Note that you cannot heal the NPC and must instead kill the spawns that attack it. L|1|4.|The suggested strategy is to remain near the middle of the room and bring each crystal down to very low HP before killing them all simultaneously. This will save you from having to defend each NPC while some of the crystals are still alive. L|1|5.|Once all crystals are dead, and all NPCs remain alive for 5min, Hoshino Kei will become vulnerable and the NPCs you were defending will despawn, but the monster respawns will continue. L|1|6.|You can imperil and vul the «Materialized Hoshino Kei», but she will dispell constantly (it is a level 8 dispell). You may choose to assign a dedicated vuler. Keep in mind she has very high magic defense and 500k HP (HP is unconfirmed). She can also dispel your buffs (including rares!). Hoshino sticks to the center of the room mostly, however, if she targets a player on the edge of the room with a ring spell she will move to them. L|1|7.|Once dead, pick up a «Mirror Shard» from her body. She drops 9. These shards are turned in to the «Spirit of Bist'elle» who will give you a key to a reward chest, as well as the XP and luminance rewards, then portal you to the chest room. L|2|•|Spirit of Bist'elle gives you 20 Enlightened Coins. L|2|•|Spirit of Bist'elle gives you 2 Enlightenment Tokens. L|2|•|⟦MirrorShardPickup⟧ L|2|•|⟦DefeatHoshinoKeiCompleted_0113⟧ L|1|8.|Loot the «Legendary Empowered Robe of Utter Darkness» from the altar in the NE corner, then use the key to loot the chest of your choice. L|2|•|⟦UtterDarknessRobePickup⟧

Perhaps there's hope for you yet."⸩ ⸨An amused voice in your mind says, "When you are dead and raised into my service, (player), I'll teach you real magic."⸩ ⸨An amused voice in your mind says, "You may yet make a fine servant, (player), with some additional training."⸩ ⸨A wave of cold radiating from northern Osteth rips through the air like a shockwave as (the killer) strikes down the spectral form of Hoshino Kei!⸩ ⸨A ragged voice in your mind says, "You may have defeated me, for now, but this little trap of yours will not hold me forever."⸩

Quest.name: Essence_Recovery
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|100 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|{OPT} «Talar the Apprentice» I|Starts At|{OPT} 41.8S, 15.8E in «Xarabydun» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to the gain the «Prismatic Glyph» used to upgrade «Shadow Armor».
L|1|•|Everyone in the fellowship will need a «Harbinger Quest¦Harbinger Item» to enter the dungeon.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Step 1: Decanter of Essence L|1|1.|«Talar the Apprentice» will give you «Instructions for Essence Recovery». L|1|2.|First step in the instructions is to gather four «Enchanted Decanter»s from the «Arcanum Research Facility» near «Al-Jalima» at 5.9N, 6.3E. L|1|3.|From the drop point, take the north west door to the decanter rooms. They are found scattered on the floor here. L|1|4.|Fill with Mana by using on the «Essence Font» in the «Fathomless Chasm Abyss» at 36.9S 63.4E, west of «Shoushi».
H3|Step 2: The Essences of Magic L|1|1.|From «Yanshi», run to either «Issk» at 12.9S, 46.5E or «Vincadi» at 12.6S, 46.7E. L|2|•|Note: Each NPC offers the same quest, however the lore is different for each. Flagging with one will prevent you from accessing the other, so be sure your whole group flags with the same NPC. L|2|•|{TIP} Soft tie to the surface portal @ 13.0S, 47.3E for convenience. If you die, you'll want an easy way to get back quickly. L|1|2.|When your group is ready, everyone should hand their «Harbinger Item» to the NPC (either «Issk» or «Vincadi») and then use the nearby «Tunnels to the Harbinger (Issk)¦Tunnels to the Harbinger» portal to begin. L|1|3.|Once inside, the dungeon is linear to the bottom (keep heading down). The only obstacles are a series of 4 jumps that must be made. L|2|•|**Jump 1: Acid Pit** - Full jump ahead (land on invisible platform) L|2|•|**Jump 2: Lava Pit** - Jump into the pit and take the hallway to the North L|2|•|**Jump 3: Ice Shelf ** - Shift-jump down onto the platform above the ice shelf, clear the spawn, and wait for your group. L|2|•|**Jump 4: Ice/Acid Pit Combo** - Dispell, then shift Jump down onto the ice shelf and **quicky** run to the edge and full jump across the acid pit (land on invisible platform). The ice hurts, so be quick. L|2|•|**Jump 5: Staging Area** - Shift jump down and quickly move to the south (near the portals). L|1|4.|Take the «Essence Chamber» Portal L|1|5.|Kill each of the 4 Essences and pickup the crystallised essence that is left behind: L|2|1.|«Essence of Strife» for the «Crystallized Essence of Strife» L|3|•|⟦essenceofstrifepickup⟧ L|2|2.|«Essence of Enchantment» for the «Crystallized Essence of Enchantment» L|3|•|⟦essenceofenchantmentpickup⟧ L|2|3.|«Essence of Artifice» for the «Crystallized Essence of Artifice» L|3|•|⟦essenceofartificepickup⟧ L|2|4.|«Essence of Verdancy» for the «Crystallized Essence of Verdancy» L|3|•|⟦essenceofverdancypickup⟧ L|2|•|{WARN} After you kill all four essences, a portal will open to the «Essenceless Harbinger Quest¦Essenceless Harbinger» - do not use it! as fighting the Harbinger is not necessary for this quest. L|1|6.|Use each «Decanter of Essence» on each of the four essences to create decanters of essence: L|2|1.|«Decanter of Essence of Artifice» L|2|2.|«Decanter of Essence of Enchantment» L|2|3.|«Decanter of Essence of Strife» L|2|4.|«Decanter of Essence of Verdancy» L|1|7.|Give all four decanters of essence to «Talar the Apprentice» to receive «Prismatic Oil» and the text «An Ancient Masonry on Aerlinthe». L|2|•|⟦DecanterOfEssencesGiven⟧ L|1|8.|The oil is used to complete the glyph recovered from the Ancient Masonry. If you're not interested in completing the 2nd step and upgrading «Shadow Armor», you can hand the oil back to Talar for experience.
H3|Step 3: Ancient Masonry on Aerlinthe L|1|1.|Head to Aerlinthe by either using the «Aerlinthe Recall¦recall spell» or by using the methods outlined «Aerlinthe¦here». L|1|2.|From the drop head north and around the shoreline to the «Ancient Masonry» portal at 88.1N, 47.6E. Progressing through the dungeon is done via levers. L|1|3.|**Room 1:** Pull the lever directly ahead to open the center room. Pull the lever inside this room and then run to the east middle room and pull the floor lever. Now run to the west center room and pull that floor lever which will open the north door to lever room 2. L|1|4.|**Room 2:** Use the first two levers in the center as before. Run west to the middle room and pull the floor lever to open the north room. Now run to the north middle room and pull the floor lever to open the east doors to lever room 3. L|1|5.|**Room 3:** Use the first two center levers. Run to the north middle room and pull the lever on the floor. Now run to the east middle room and pull the floor lever which will open the south doors to the 4th lever room. L|1|6.|**Room 4:** Use the first two center levers. Run to the east middle room and pull the lever on the floor. Now run to the south middle room and pull the floor lever which will open the door to the west. L|1|7.|The final west section has a locked door to the south (Dif. 500), if someone has high enough lockpick it is possible pick the door and skip the final part, otherwise you need to head north for the key. L|1|8.|Use the levers in the west and east rooms to open the double doors to the north. Inside is the «Ancient Steward», defeat it and loot the «Steward's Key». L|1|9.|Head back to the locked door to the south and unlock it with the key, inside are «Glyph of Alteration¦Glyphs of Alteration» on the floor. L|2|•|⟦glyphofalterationpickup⟧ L|1|10.|To activate the Glyph you now need a «Pyreal Mote», if you don't have one simply head to the «Mysterious Cave» or «Halls of Metos» and kill the Golems there until one drops. L|1|11.|Once you have a Mote, use the «Glyph of Alteration» on it to make a «Pyreal Glyph». Use the «Prismatic Oil» upon the Pyreal Glyph to make a «Prismatic Glyph». L|1|12.|Use the prismatic glyph on Enhanced «Shadow Armor» to make a piece of the Shimmering Shadows set. You need only one glyph to complete a suit.

R| RK|Items| RI|«Prismatic Glyph» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "The four Essences have sunken into the ground below Old Yanshi. The Menhir rings that once focused and held them have been overpowered by the Harbinger's magic and he now feeds from their power."⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "Yes, you look skilled enough to help me. I require a sample from each of the four Essences below Old Yanshi."⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "All of the Arcanum's attempts at collecting these samples ourselves have failed. Fifteen of our best agents were defeated in a recent attempt on the Essence of Verdancy. Find yourself a group of adventurers at least as powerful as you before you go anywhere near these new Essences."⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "First, you need to retrieve four Enchanted Decanters from the Arcanum Research Facility outside of Al-Jalima. You will use these decanters to collect each Essence's essence. The details are in these instructions."⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice gives you Instructions for Essence Recovery.⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "Good luck and don't underestimate the power of the Essences. They are raw magic after all."
L|1||Handing in Decanter of Essence of Artifice⸩ ⸨You give Talar the Apprentice Decanter of Essence of Artifice.⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "Ah, Essence of Artifice! I can't wait to start testing this. These Essences react differently to various alchemical tests than the pure essence we collect from the Fathomless Chasm."⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "You still need to retrieve a sample of the Essence of Enchantment for me."⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "You still need to retrieve a sample of the Essence of Verdancy for me."⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "You still need to retrieve a sample of the Essence of Strife for me."
L|1||Handing in Decanter of Essence of Enchantment⸩ ⸨You give Talar the Apprentice Decanter of Essence of Enchantment.⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "Ah, Essence of Enchantment! You didn't get any on you I hope. I theorize that this essence could have dangerous effects if it comes in contact with a creature. I'll have to be very careful while I'm testing this."⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "You still need to retrieve a sample of the Essence of Verdancy for me."⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "You still need to retrieve a sample of the Essence of Strife for me."
L|1||Handing in Decanter of Essence of Strife⸩ ⸨You give Talar the Apprentice Decanter of Essence of Strife.⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "Ah, Essence of Strife! War in a bottle eh? I don't know where to begin testing this. I'll have to confer with some of the Arcanum's War Magic specialists."⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "You still need to retrieve a sample of the Essence of Verdancy for me."
L|1||Handing in Decanter of Essence of Verdancy⸩ ⸨You give Talar the Apprentice Decanter of Essence of Verdancy.⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice gives you Prismatic Oil.⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice gives you An Ancient Masonry on Aerlinthe.⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "Ah, Essence of Verdancy! It's a good thing this decanter is enchanted or the essence would have eaten right through it and through the floor stones and through the ground beneath. In fact I don't think it would stop until it reached its source."⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "Let's see, where did I put those enchanted gloves."⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "Excellent, more essence samples. These will prove invaluable in my continuing research. Let me mix your reward."⸩ ⸨Talar combines a small amount of each essence into a small vial of viscous red oil. He holds the bottle up to the light and watches as the oil clears and prismatic colors can be seen spinning in vial.⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "Here you go. This oil works on the same principle of elemental energies that the Prismatic Plume uses. Apply this oil to a piece of Greater Amuli Shadow Armor and you should be able to instill it with an impressive amount of elemental protection. If you would prefer a different reward then give me back the Prismatic Oil and I'll see what I can do."⸩ ⸨Talar the Apprentice tells you, "If you wish to apply the Prismatic Oil to one of the other Greater Shadow Armor pieces you should read this report we received from an Arcanum Researcher on Aerlinthe Island. He found a buried structure there which may hold the required intermediary you need to instill the other armor sets with the Prismatic Oil."⸩

Quest.name: Frest_Greelving's_Haunted_Mansion
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Frest Greelving» I|Starts At|6.0N, 43.7E I|Route|«Facility Hub» (30+ section) I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|One of the quests accessed through the «Facility Hub», this quest is creepy and there are a lot of weird things to see. Not for the squeamish!
P|Talking with the Aun Warden of the 30+ section gives you access to the portal in «Facility Hub».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes
H3|Part 1: Frest Greelving's Haunted Mansion L|1|1.|Speak with «Frest Greelving» at 6.0N, 43.7E to receive «Journal of Frest Greelving». L|2|•|⟦TALKEDTOOWNER⟧ L|1|2.|Run up the hill to 6.5N, 43.9E and enter «Frest Greelving's Mansion». L|1|3.|Locate three of «Frest Greelving's Chest»s to obtain the three items he requests: L|2|1.|**Main Floor:** «Frest Greelving's Emerald» L|2|2.|**Bedroom:** «Frest Greelving's Puffy Shirt» L|2|3.|**Tower:** «Antique Platter» L|3|•|While you're in the tower, kill the level 50 (44 retail) «Zombie» and loot «An Old Chronicle» from his corpse. L|1|4.|Return the Emerald, Shirt and Platter to Frest Greelving for the rewards. L|2|•|⟦TURNEDINJEWELEMERALDHAUNTEDMANSION⟧ L|2|•|⟦TURNEDINSHIRTPUFFYHAUNTEDMANSION⟧ L|2|•|⟦TURNEDINANTIQUEPLATTERHAUNTEDMANSION⟧ L|2|•|If you are only interested in completing the Hub quest, you may return to the Hub at this point and show the NPC one of the reward items. L|3|•|⟦fachubhauntedmansion⟧ L|1|5.|If you want to continue the quest, bring «An Old Chronicle» to «Bretself the Translator» at 26.0N 47.0E in «Cragstone» for translation and to obtain a «Chronicle of Archeological Site Celadon». L|1|6.|Return to «Frest Greelving» at 6.0N, 43.7E and hand him the «Chronicle of Archeological Site Celadon». He will give you a «Portal Chamber Key» in return. L|2|•|⟦HAUNTEDMANSIONDUNGEONPERMISSION⟧ L|1|7.|Head back to «Frest Greelving's Mansion» at 6.5N, 43.9E and work your way into the basement, where you'll find a locked door (500 Diff). L|1|8.|Use the «Portal Chamber Key» on the locked door and then use the Mansion Dungeon Portal to enter «Frest Greelving's Dungeon».
H3|Part 2: Frest Greelving's Dungeon L|1|1.|From the drop, head to the Northwest corner of the dungeon, and look for the broken wall opening. L|1|2.|Head North through the opening and work your way through the dungeon until you get to the icy part of the dungeon. L|1|3.|From here, hug the left wall, moving through several big rooms until you get to a wishbone type split. L|1|4.|Take the left hallway and follow it until you get to a large room with a swirling vortex. L|1|5.|Kill the «Zombie» underneath the vortex and loot the «Staff of Nullification» from its corpse. L|1|6.|Backtrack to the wishbone split, and now take the other (right) hallway. L|1|7.|Follow the hallway until you come to another large room with a «Dark Sarcophagus» in it. L|1|8.|Wield the «Staff of Nullification» and use it to kill the «Dark Sarcophagus». L|2|•|⟦NULLIFIEDSARCOPHAGUS⟧ L|1|9.|Return to «Frest Greelving» at 6.0N, 43.7E and talk to him to receive your rewards. L|2|•|⟦GAVEEVILCOUCH⟧

Quest.name: Grael's_Summoning_Chamber
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|140 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Jathaq al-Nishadina» I|Starts At|«Rossu Morta Chapterhouse» (drop point) at 69.7N, 62.3W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Quest Chain|Joining the Rossu Morta I|1|«Dericost Ruin Quest» I|2|«Knights of Karlun Quest» I|3|«Red Bull of Sanamar Quest» I|4|«Whispering Blade Infiltration» I|5|«Rossu Morta Chapterhouse Access» I|6|«Lost Messenger» (Optional) I|7|Grael's Summoning Chamber H2|Overview L|1|•|You must have completed the first five «Ordina Rossu Morta» quests in order to begin this quest. L|1|•|You also need to have access to «Vissidal Island». L|1|•|Since many of the creatures inside look like humans and Viamontians, but are «Shadow»s, a Shadowslayer weapon helps.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Jathaq al-Nishadina». L|2|•|⟦GraelsSummoningChamber_Start⟧ L|1|2.|Enter «Black Spear Summoning Chamber» at 75.8N, 70.5E on the northeast end of «Vissidal». L|1|3.|The dungeon is pretty straightforward. From drop head N, next west. L|2|•|There will be 3 «Umbral Soldier»s on the way. L|1|4.|Kill the «Keeper of the First Door» and loot the «First Keeper's Key» from his corpse. L|1|5.|Unlock the door and go east, south and then west, until you reach the «Keeper of the Second Door». L|1|6.|Kill the keeper and loot the «Second Keeper's Key». L|1|7.|Unlock the door and continue on until you find «Archmage Aigonne». L|2|•|He is with a «Tainted Knight» and a «Tainted Vivimancer». L|1|8.|Kill him, loot «Aigonne's Key», «Heart of Archmage Aigonne» and «Archmage Aigonne's Notes» (optional). L|2|•|⟦HeartofArchmageAigonne_Pickup⟧ L|1|9.|Use the key to unlock the door and jump down into the pit. L|1|10.|Kill «Pontifex Maegris». L|2|•|He's accompanied by 2 «Panumbral Soldier»s. L|1|11.|Loot the «Head of Pontifex Maegris» and the «Journal of Maegris» (optional). L|2|•|⟦HeadofPontifexMaegris_Pickup⟧ L|1|12.|Hand the heart first, and then the head to «Jathaq al-Nishadina» for the «Rossu Morta Chapterhouse Recall Orb» and experience. L|2|•|⟦HeartofArchmageAigonne_TurnIn⟧ L|2|•|⟦GraelsSummoningChamber_Wait⟧ L|2|•|⟦CanPickupSilveranToken⟧ L|1|13.|Give «Meerana du Renari» a «Silveran Token» of choice to receive your «Rossu Morta Token». L|2|•|⟦PlayerReceivedRossuMortaToken!⟧ L|1|14.|The token can be used to purchase a Red Rune Silveran weapon from the «Rossu Morta Quartermaster». L|2|•|⟦PlayerReceivedSilveranToken⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|Once you have completed this quest you cannot re-enter the «Black Spear Summoning Chamber». L|1|•|If you're not happy with your choice of weapon, you can exchange the weapon by handing it to «Meerana du Renari» for another «Rossu Morta Token».

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Jathaq al-Nishadina tells you, "You may be strong enough to help me, friend. We recently learned of a shameful and idiotic betrayal by Pontifex Maegris of the Raven Hand. It was stupid to trust him, but that is another matter. What most concerns us is that a team of Count Dardante's most capable assistants, under Archmage Aigonne, located Maegris' summoning chamber, from where he apparently tried to wake Grael. We know something happened, but we cannot be sure, and Dardante's assistants have not returned. You must investigate the summoning chamber and bring back what evidence you can of Maegris and Aigonne. The summoning chamber can be reached through the Black Spear shrine on Vissidal Island, at 75.8 N, 70.5 E."
L|1||Handing in Heart of Archmage Aigonne⸩ ⸨You give Jathaq al-Nishadina Heart of Archmage Aigonne.⸩ ⸨Jathaq al-Nishadina tells you, "Thank you for bringing back Aigonne's heart. Just a cursory inspection of this grisly trophy indicates that something very strange happened to Aigonne down there. You also have Maegris' head, do you not? Please hand it over. With the head and the heart, we should be able to use some of our more, ahem, unorthodox tracking techniques to locate Grael."
L|1||Handing in Head of Pontifex Maegris⸩ ⸨You give Jathaq al-Nishadina Head of Pontifex Maegris.⸩ ⸨Jathaq al-Nishadina tells you, "The head of the faithless Pontifex Maegris should help us conduct a full investigation of what happened in his summoning chamber. You have also brought in Archmage Aigonne's head, so I thank you and pronounce myself satisfied with your efforts. You may find this orb useful... It will allow you to recall directly to this Chapterhouse."⸩ ⸨You've earned 98,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Jathaq al-Nishadina gives you Rossu Morta Chapterhouse Recall Orb.⸩ ⸨Jathaq al-Nishadina tells you, "Go speak with the Chapterhouse Chamberlain about an additional reward."
L|1||Exchanging Red Rune weapon for a token⸩ ⸨You give Meerana du Renari Red Rune Silveran Crossbow.⸩ ⸨Meerana du Renari tells you, "Well done, friend. You have earned a most powerful reward for your loyal and courageous service to King Varicci. Due to new procedures you must purchase your Silveran weapon with this token from the quartermaster."⸩ ⸨Meerana du Renari gives you Rossu Morta Token.⸩

Quest.name: Invoker_Quest
Quest.notes: do Baudren First
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|70 I|Type|Fellowship/Solo I|Starts With|«Aun Aulakhe» I|Starts At|«Aun Settlement» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|You must first complete the «Buadren Quest» before you can begin upgrading it to an «Invoker». L|1|•|This quest features a complicated series of levers to pull to advance through the dungeons. These can be done solo, but it may be easier to have a group to assist. You do not need a Buadren in order to enter the dungeon, so you can enlist the help of anyone who is willing to help.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes P|**Note:** The walk through below is written for someone who is doing the quest solo. Aegis/health rations/potions are *strongly* recommended. It is also recommended that you study the map and familiarize yourself with the hidden portal locations («Lilitha (NPC)¦Lilitha»/Empyrean rooms). Unless you are a mage or using a magic defense rare, you will likely not be able to resist all of the spells cast by the rifts/dolls.
P|If you happen to be doing this quest with a group, it is faster to study the map and decide who will hit which levers to speed the process. If soloing, you will not want to fight anything, as you must move quickly to get to each door before it closes again. It is also recommended to read the entire walk through before starting as many steps must be done quickly after one another.
L|1|1.|Speak to «Aun Aulakhe» in the «Aun Settlement» at 82.7N 21.2E. L|2|•|⟦PortalSpacePermissionGiven⟧ L|1|2.|Pick up an «Akiekie Ember» on the ground near Aun Aulakhe. L|2|•|⟦EmberInvokingPickup⟧ L|1|3.|Enter the Portal Space dungeon portal nearby. L|1|4.|**Segment 1** L|2|1.|Pull the gem lever near the yellow door (SW) to open the blue door (SE). You will be entering the **blue** section on the first dungeon map. L|2|2.|Go through the blue door and all the way to the bottom where another blue door is closed. Be careful to avoid the passageway with a hidden portal to the Lilitha section on the way down. L|2|3.|Pull the gem lever (lever 7) in the room with the closed blue door. L|2|4.|Run back up and use the passageway with the hidden portal to the Lilitha section. See the map to know where it is. L|2|5.|From the drop in the Lilitha section, quickly heal if you need to, then click on the door to open it. L|2|6.|Find and use the **orange** portal. This will take you to the orange section of the first dungeon. L|2|7.|Run down the very similar passage in the orange section to the bottom. Again be careful to avoid the Lilitha hidden portal passageway. Note that it is in a different location in each color section of the dungeon. L|2|8.|Run through the open door (door 7) at the bottom and into the **orange** portal to the second dungeon. L|2|9.|Heal and take a breather before starting segment 2. L|1|5.|**Segment 2** L|2|1.|Head straight and go down the long staircase which is made of steps that look like portals. L|2|2.|At the bottom, run into the large room and quickly hit the gem lever (lever 4). L|2|3.|Run back up the portal staircase. Note that sometimes you may have to do a shift jump to get to the next step. The staircase is a bit glitchy going up. Go as fast as you can. L|2|4.|At the top, run into the orange portal straight ahead. This will take you back to the bottom of the orange section of the first dungeon. L|2|5.|Pull the lever right next to you at the drop point (lever 8)! Then run upward and find the passageway to Lilitha's section. L|2|6.|From the Lilitha section drop, quickly heal if needed, then find the **yellow** portal and take it. L|2|7.|Run down from the yellow section drop, avoiding the passageway to Lilitha's. Go through the open door (door 8) at the bottom and take the **yellow** portal to the second dungeon. L|2|8.|From the drop, take the first passageway to the right and follow it down and to the left until you get to a large room at the bottom. L|2|9.|Run through the open door (door 4). L|2|10.|Stop, heal, and take a breather after going through the door. Avoid turning left beyond the door or you will take a hidden portal before you want to. L|1|6.|**Segment 3** L|2|1.|Head south into a large room with flashing lighting. L|2|2.|Go east to the closed door and hit the gem lever (lever 5). Note you will take damage from the lightning. Be quick! L|2|3.|Head back north to the yellow door you came through, and run into the passage just right of the door. There is a hidden portal the Empyrean section (see map). L|2|4.|From the drop in the Empyrean section, turn around and open the door and take the **green** portal. This will take you to the green section of the second dungeon. L|2|5.|Run north through the lightning field and hit the gem lever (lever 6) through the open door (door 5). L|2|6.|Continue north into a large room, run around the building in the center and hit the gem lever (lever 10). L|2|7.|Run back the way you came and as far south as you can go. The passageway to the far south contains the hidden portal to the Empyrean section. L|2|8.|From the Empyrean drop, head southeast across the room. Beware of lightning damage! Open the door and take the **blue** portal. This will take you to the blue section of the second dungeon. L|2|9.|Run south through the lightning field (beware!) and through the open door (door 6). L|2|10.|Continue south into a larger room and run around the building and into the door (door 10). L|2|11.|Take the portal inside into the final dungeon. L|1|7.|The final dungeon has no levers. Head west and then north up the stairs. Follow the linear path. L|1|8.|When you reach a larger room, head either east or west. It doesn't matter which way. L|1|9.|When you reach another large room, jump up the portal staircase to reach «Aun Tanua». L|1|10.|Give Aun Tanua the Akiekie Ember. He will give you back a «Burning Akiekie Ember». L|2|•|⟦EmberBrightGivenNew⟧ L|1|11.|You cannot portal recall back, so head back downstairs to a room that has an exit portal in the center. Do not take any of the "colored" portals in the side rooms. L|1|12.|Hand the Burning Akiekie Ember to Aun Aulakhe. He will then ask for your Buadren. L|2|•|⟦EmberBrightReceivedNew⟧ L|1|13.|Give him the «Buadren» and he will upgrade it to an «Invoker». L|2|•|⟦InvokingAunTanuaComplete⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Aun Aulakhe tells you, "Several moons ago, my father Shimauri summoned us to his accustomed story hour, to tell of a story never heard by my generation.⸩ ⸨Aun Aulakhe tells you, "Long ago, in the combined pasts of the Hea and Aun, Aun Tanua was a nigh-legendary warrior who was beloved by our xuta. He left our gates to challenge the Puh in his mudflats of Ahurenga, never to return. We thought perhaps he had been captured or slain by the Hea, but now we have discovered the truth⸩ ⸨when they were unable to conquer him, the Hea called upon the Atua ngamaru. Answering them, the floating demons bore down and plunged him down into the depths of the Lightning-Sea, never to be heard of again.⸩ ⸨Aun Aulakhe tells you, "My task is to find warriors brave enough to enter the Lightning-Sea, who can search for him and bring him back to us. My buhdi Tikakhe tells me that you might be the person we are looking for.⸩ ⸨Aun Aulakhe tells you, "When you find Tanua, warm him with the ember of the akiekie fire that you see on the ground, for there is no telling how Aun Tanua's mind might have fared in his captivity.⸩ ⸨Aun Aulakhe tells you, "My training, both in my homeland and with the Aualuan of your xuta, has taught me to create the Burning Pools that shimmer upon the Lightning-Sea. I have opened such a portal on the surface of the akiekie pond, and if you dare swim its depths, enter it and find Aun Tanua!⸩ ⸨Aun Aulakhe tells you, "A word of advice⸩ ⸨All must depend upon the coordination of their fellows to navigate the Shimmering Sea. Farewell, and Tanae speed you in your hunt."
L|1||Lilitha⸩ ⸨Lilitha inclines her head toward you and waits, looking numbly expectant⸩ ⸨Lilitha reaches toward you, and absently gropes her own face. She seems confused⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "That one is... The box hasn't seen flesh poison in... in a long time.⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "Person. The box meant person."⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "They brought a man here once. They split him open and scooped out his insides. They made a pile, like sticky fruit. Then they put other things inside him that glowed red and purple.⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "One of the Masters said they learned how to do it by studying the box. It said the man's name was Martine."⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "They put a thing in the box's head. A crystal thing. When the box becomes agitated it screams. The Masters told the box it is a keeper."⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "Attentive."⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "The box attends the master."⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "They took the box outside in a cloud. It's nothing but purple. You could fall forever, and everything was bent this way and that. But in some places there were blue ribbons that crackled and danced."⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "There were things around the ribbons. They looked like glowing water and trailed strings of jelly. They turned as the box went by and poked each other with the jelly-strings. They were the size of houses. Maybe. Size doesn't work right outside."⸩ ⸨Lilitha blinks at you uncomprehendingly⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "Why is that one on the other side of the wall?"⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "The box used to count the days with marks on the walls. It used its fingernails. It counted four years. Then they changed the walls so they wouldn't mark. That was a long time ago."⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "Does that one see the hand? It is not the box's hand. They took that. They put it in a glass bubble and it turned into fog. They attached the box to this one later. Sometimes the hand talks to the box."⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "The box doesn't know what they are. They didn't talk at first. They just kept stabbing glass pins into the box. The first thing they said was the box's own voice, like an echo. Then they started putting the box's words together in different ways."⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "Temenua. That one caught the box as it slept. It brought the box to a child, and the child gave it to these things.⸩ ⸨An angry blush colors Lilitha's cheeks, and an unexpected gleam rises in her eyes..⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "It BOUND me. No one EVER --⸩ ⸨... but a faint, glissando shriek comes from her head. She flinches, and the gleam dies as quickly as it came.⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "They took the box apart twice. First they looked for what was inside the box, but they said it was empty. Then they wanted to know what made the box go.⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "They did it with blue lights. They drew lines on the box and it fell to pieces.⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "They wouldn't let the box move. The box watched it happen, until the light reached its eyes.⸩ ⸨Lilitha tells you, "It... hurt me...⸩ ⸨Lilitha abruptly falls to her knees and begins to retch, hugging herself tightly.
L|1||Handing in Akiekie Ember⸩ ⸨You give Aun Tanua Akiekie Ember⸩ ⸨Aun Tanua gently cups the ember in his clawed hands, and as its glow warms his skin, his past gradually seeps into memory. For the first instant in an endless monotony of time, he remembers. Ezheret. Palenqual. Timaru. Home⸩ ⸨As determination and strength return to the old warrior's stance, he turns to you once more⸩ ⸨Aun Tanua tells you, "I have no knowledge of how long I have been imprisoned here. Endless half moments on moments, my memory failing, my own keh draining away...All I know is that I cannot leave, for the Atua ngamaru have me captured inside these walls of light.⸩ ⸨Aun Tanua tells you, "My own Timaru is far from me, but you have brought me an ember of her heart, and once again my people are with me. You must have been sent with this gift by one of my brethren, and for that I thank you.⸩ ⸨Aun Tanua tells you, "There is but one way to let my brothers envision my fate, and I must ask one more favor of you.⸩ ⸨Aun Tanua lifts the akiekie ember to his face and softly blows across its faintly glowing surface. As his keh suffuses the ember, it suddenly fans into a flame. He holds it a moment longer, then relinquishes it to your care⸩ ⸨Aun Tanua gives you Burning Akiekie Ember⸩ ⸨Aun Tanua tells you, "Give this to the one that sent you here to me. He will understand its intent and what should be done. Go now, and if you ever tread upon the shores of Palenqual, let her know I am with her."
L|1||Handing in Burning Akiekie Ember⸩ ⸨You give Aun Aulakhe Burning Akiekie Ember⸩ ⸨Aun Aulakhe carefully lifts the glowing ember from your hands and gazes into it with awe⸩ ⸨Aun Aulakhe tells you, "Aun Tanua was unable to return with you again, but look! He has infused this ember with his own keh. I wonder...⸩ ⸨Aulakhe kneels down and carefully adds the glowing ember to the encampment's fire.v⸩ ⸨Aun Aulakhe tells you, "This is a triumph, for even though he remains in captivity, Aun Tanua's spirit can now dance with our ancestors in the akiekie fire. There are wards that block the use of the portals to the Catacombs. I've located a tablet that will allow me to enchant you to bypass the Eastern Temple Catacomb's wards. Go into the Temple. There is a portal to the Temple opened at 70.4N 50.5E. Find the entrance to the Eastern Catacombs, bring back the Tablet you will find there, and I can give you further access to the Temple."
L|1||Handing in Eastern Temple Tablet⸩ ⸨You give Kiriel Shadowborn Eastern Temple Tablet.⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "Ahh, the Eastern Catacombs Tablet..."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Nightborn examines the tablet, muttering over the runes while tracing them with a finger. A cold darkness slowly covers the runes.⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "There is a second tablet in the Western Catacombs. It contains the rest of the enchantment I need to gain you access to the crystal. With this Tablet, I can give you access to the Western Catacombs. Enter the Western Catacombs, find the tablet hidden there."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "There, now you can enter the Western Catacombs. Good luck."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn intones softly and a cold chill passes over you for a moment..
L|1||Handing in Western Temple Tablet⸩ ⸨You give Kiriel Shadowborn Western Temple Tablet.⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "The Western Catacombs Tablet..."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Nightborn examines the tablet, muttering over the runes while tracing them with a finger. As with the first tablet, a cold darkness slowly covers the runes.⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "Now, I'll be able to complete the enchantment gaining you access to the Northern Catacombs. At the bottom of the Northern Catacombs, you should find the gate to the crystal we seek. Find it. Destroy it. Bring me proof of its demise, and I will reward you."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn once again intones softly and a cold chill passes over you for a moment..⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "There, now you can enter the Northern Catacombs. Good luck, and take care. The path only gets more difficult from here."
L|1||Handing in Crystal Shard⸩ ⸨You give Kiriel Shadowborn Crystal Shard.⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "A shard of the partially reformed Soul Crystal..."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "It is good that this crystal not be allowed to fully reform. There is a chance, if the Falatacot and the crystal were left alone for long enough, that they could re-sink the Dark Isle, cutting us off from the opportunity we sought in its raising."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "Tell [sic] Please, accept this humble reward for your continued efforts to keep the Dark Isle above the waves."⸩ ⸨You've earned 46,949,665 experience.⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn gives you Helm of Isin Dule.
L|1||Global broadcast⸩ ⸨A chill wind blows across Dereth, carrying with it an equally chill voice. The following words echo in the wind, "People of Dereth, I know that we have not always been allies, but now is not a time for us to be enemies. I have sent my Emissary to the place you call 'Bandit Castle'. There, those who are strong enough may find a path to aid in the battle against the Black Spear, the one called Grael. Seek my Emissary and begin the path of retaliation against one who would destroy all of us."
L|1||Kiriel Shadowborn, Opening Dialog (retired)⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "Thank you for coming. I feared many would not be willing to hear me out."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "Grael has awakened. My lord tried to stop this, but it has come to pass. I fear the Black Spear's rage will consume this world, if he is not stopped. To that end, my Lord has sent me to aid you and all those who go with you."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "First, a little lesson in history..."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "Long ago, Grael, the Black Spear of the Kemeroi, chose to sleep. The place he chose to sleep was an isle north of here, north of Vissidal Isle. His presence covered the island in Shadow, and the isle soon came to be called the Dark Isle."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "Those Falatacot who followed the Old One, N'cthail took a chance and used ancient seals to sink the isle below the waves. It was their hope that none would ever wake Grael and that this world would be free of him forever. Now, however, that wish has been undone by another."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "I have been shown the path to this temple. There is a second tablet in the Western Catacombs. It contains the rest of the enchantment I need to gain you access to the crystal. Enter the Western Catacombs, find the tablet hidden there."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn intones softly and a cold chill passes over you for a moment.⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "There, now you can enter the Western Catacombs. Good luck."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "The second tablet. Now we're getting somewhere"⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "Now, I'll be able to complete the enchantment gaining you access to the Northern Catacombs. At the bottom of the Northern Catacombs, you should find the gate to the crystal we seek. Find it. Destroy it. Bring me proof of its demise, and I will reward you."⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "There, now you can enter the Northern Catacombs. Good luck, and take care. The path only gets more difficult from here."
L|1||Global, crystal defeat⸩ ⸨A deep rumble shakes Dereth as the Dark Isle begins its slow rise from the bottom of the sea.⸩ ⸨In the depths below the Temple of N'cthail, [Player]'s party has shattered the Soul Crystal of the Dark Isle! The ancient Falatacot seals fall away as the flows of magic north of Vissidal slowly right themselves.
L|1||Crystal death message⸩ ⸨The Soul Crystal of the Dark Isle shatters, scattering pieces all around the chamber!⸩ ⸨Kiriel Shadowborn tells you, "Have you done it? I can feel the power flowing around you. If you have proof of the crystal's demise, please, hand it to me so that I may reward you."⸩
H2|Trivia L|1|•|When this quest was introduced, the first person from each server to complete it received a special «Empowered Helm of Isin Dule».

Quest.name: Ritual_of_the_Blight
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|15, 35, 55, 75, 95, 125 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Captain Warner» I|Starts At|«Mayoi» at 61.4S, 82.5E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|«Captain Warner» in «Mayoi» shows you how to enter the tunnels below the six Moarsmen Forts and asks you to retrieve evidence of how they are being blighted.
L|1|•|This quest can be completed in conjunction with «Moarsmen on the Shores» for additional XP.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|There are six moarsmen temples, increasing in difficulty and reward from Rank to Verdant. L|1|2.|Head to the forts listed below and enter the portal to the dungeon at the base of the temple. L|1|3.|All of the dungeons are identical and involve some minor jumping. From the drop go right, left, right, straight, straight, right, ignore the slanting side passages, right, then jump across the pits (tap jumps work well). L|2|•|{TIP} It is possible to jump from the bottom of the pit to the last platform if you have a few augs. Shift jump onto the rocks then shift jump onto the platform. L|2|•|It's best to kill the moarsmen before jumping if possible. If you fall down, the water area leads back to an inviso staircase leading back up to the start of the jumps. L|1|4.|After making several jumps across pits you'll come to a large room, circle around (no need to jump) and kill the human, who will drop a tattered note and a book of lore, «The Creation of Blighted Moarsmen». Each dungeon has a unique human that drops a unique note, the book however is the same for all six. L|2|1.|«Siabot the Deranged» for «Tattered Rank Moarsman Ritual» L|3|•|⟦TatteredGrimyMoarsmanRitual_Pickup⟧ L|2|2.|«Inkitan the Crazed» for «Tattered Disgusting Moarsman Ritual» L|3|•|⟦TatteredDisgustingMoarsmanRitual_Pickup⟧ L|2|3.|«Despe the Insane» for «Tattered Putrid Moarsman Ritual» L|3|•|⟦TatteredDesolationMoarsmanRitual_Pickup⟧ L|2|4.|«Ves the Mad» for «Tattered Desolation Moarsman Ritual» L|3|•|⟦TatteredRankMoarsmanRitual_Pickup⟧ L|2|5.|«Cloywer the Unstable» for «Tattered Grimy Moarsman Ritual» L|3|•|⟦TatteredPutridMoarsmanRitual_Pickup⟧ L|2|6.|«Lorfne the Unhinged» for «Tattered Verdant Moarsman Ritual» L|3|•|⟦TatteredVerdantMoarsmanRitual_Pickup⟧ L|1|5.|Return to «Mayoi» and give the tattered notes to «Captain Warner» for your rewards.

Quest.name: Shadow_Aspect_of_Grael_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|101-150 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Abbess Zik'Lir» I|Starts At|83.5S, 97.2E on «Ithaenc Island» I|Route|«Recall the Sanctuary» or purchase «Invitation Ithaenc Cathedral» from a «Wedding Planner» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|Recommended items and pre-quests: Sanctuary Recall (or Invitation Ithaenc Cathedral from a Wedding Planner), Shadowfire Isparian Wand, Gems of Stillness. None of these are required, but will make your life MUCH easier.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Abbess Zik'Lir» to flag for the quest. L|2|•|⟦FalatacotVault_Flag⟧ L|1|2.|Run down the shore to the «Falatacot Vault» at 74.7S, 98.2E. The drop is safe, if you need to buff. The dungeon is quite simple. There is only one route through the dungeon, just make your way down however you need to. The easiest method is to run right by all the creatures (a run rare and high melee defense will help you here). Use dispell potions or Gems of Stillness as necessary if you brought some (recommended). Once at the end, you will be faced by «Count Dardante (Creature)¦Count Dardante» and multiple «Twisted Shadow»s. If you have your Shadowfire, you can vuln the Count and kill him in a short amount of time. If you don't, you are in for a much longer and harder battle. L|1|3.|Once «Count Dardante (Creature)¦Count Dardante» is killed, loot the «Falatacot Vault Key» from his corpse, and use that to unlock the «Falatacot Vault». Make your way down to the end and pick up the «Falatacot Soul Trap» from the ground. L|2|•|⟦FalatacotSoulTrap_Pickup⟧ L|1|4.|Head back to «Abbess Zik'Lir» and hand the Soul Trap to him. L|2|•|⟦SIBlackSpearTemple_Flag⟧ L|1|5.|Head to the «Shadow-Infested Black Spear Temple» at 76.83S, 93.79E. Unlike the Ruschk Aspect dungeon, the «Shadow-Infested Black Spear Temple» is identical to the «Mukkir Infested Black Spear Temple». The drop is safe, so rebuff as necessary. You can avoid 90% of the traps in this dungeon by hugging the walls, and jumping over intersections. L|1|6.|Hold to the right wall until you reach a room of Falling Rocks. You can avoid these rocks by hugging the left wall. If you have under 300 HP, you will most likely be one shot if hit. After the rock room, follow the left wall to a large room with a ramp and multiple exits. Take the west exit. Make your way down to a second room, and take first south exit. Take the left hall, and follow the left wall. At the next split, take the left again. Keep to the left wall until a 3-way. Take the middle hallway. Take four lefts through three 3-ways, and one 2-way split. Take the middle passage through the following two 2-way splits, then the next left. Take two rights, a left turn, and a right until you reach a ledge. Simply take a full running jump straight (with a triple axle, if you like), across to the next ledge. Turn around 180 degrees, and repeat. If you fall, it is a straight shot back to the ledge, but it is well-guarded, so avoid doing so. After the second jump, simply waltz right down the tunnel and enter Grael's Chamber. L|2|•|⟦GraelsChamberShadow_Flag⟧ L|1|7.|Once inside «Grael's Chamber», you will run to a ledge. The «Shadow Aspect of Grael» is down inside the pit, out of radar reach. There are multiple ways to defeat him easily| L|2|1.|Go all out and hope no one dies. L|2|2.|Stay on the ledge, and have melees cast Imperil 1 on him, while mages and archers rain missiles down on him. L|2|3.|Jump down, stand on opposite sides, and use wall spells (Tusker Fists works with a Shadowfire and Bludge Vuln, it is very effective). He will run in between the two sides, and this limits his offensive ability. L|2|4.|Push him in to a corner to avoid melee attacks. L|2|5.|Pray he glitches. L|3|•|Note: Grael can be solo'd by a combination of methods #2 and #5, or #1 and #4. L|3|•|{WARN} When the aspect dies he casts «Dark Vortex», a ring spell which quickly drains your health. Watch your health and back off to a safe distance as soon as you can. L|1|8.|From his corpse, retrieve a «Shard of the Black Spear», and a «Falatacot Chest Key». L|2|•|⟦ShadowShardoftheBlackSpear_Pickup⟧ L|2|•|⟦FalatacotChestKey_Pickup⟧ L|1|9.|Enter the trophy room, and use your key on the Falatacot Chest. It will spawn a random «Rare» item, and high quality loot. The Rare item is generally tier 2 or higher, but it is possible to get lower tiers as well. L|1|10.|Once everyone has pulled their items, head back to «Abbess Zik'Lir», and give her the «Shard of the Black Spear». L|2|•|⟦ShadowAspectofGrael_Wait⟧ L|1|11.|Now that you have your nifty new spear, bring the «Shadow Aspect Slayer Title Token» you received to «Soju Bo-Ki» in «Ayan Baqur». L|1|12.|The «Mukkir Slayer Stone» can be used on a loot-generated weapon to give it the "Mukkir Slayer" effect, alternatively it can be given to «Soju Bo-Ki» for xp.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Abbess Zik'Lir tells you, "Yes, you may aid in this. Strong enough to, most likely, survive, but not so strong that the Black Spear's wards will hold you out. I can aid your people in removing the Black Spear from this world, as is the will of my Lord, Nc'thail. To do this, you must gather a thing lost for me."⸩ ⸨Abbess Zik'Lir tells you, "There is a thing called a Soul Trap. My people have not used such in ages, but it may find use here. I have managed to locate one, but those who serve the Black Spear have reached the location first. I can enchant you to bypass the magicks on the portal there, so you can gain the Soul Trap."⸩ ⸨Abbess Zik'Lir tells you, "Go to the portal you will find at 74.7 S, 98.2 E. Somewhere in that ancient vault, you will find the Soul Trap. Beware those who will try to stop them, and have a care while carrying the device, lest you accidentally activate it..."⸩ ⸨Abbess Zik'Lir tells you, "Go, bring the Soul Trap back to me. Remember my warnings."
L|1||Handing in Falatacot Soul Trap⸩ ⸨You give Abbess Zik'Lir Falatacot Soul Trap.⸩ ⸨Abbess Zik'Lir tells you, "Ahh, the Soul Trap. It is good to see you carrying it, as opposed to the other way around. I see you heeded my warnings. Now, I will prepare this to contain the Shadow of the Black Spear. It will not hold him forever, but it will serve for a time."⸩ ⸨Abbess Zik'Lir tells you, "Go to the following location, 76.9 S, 93.8 E. There, you will find the portal to where Grael's Shadow lurks. My Lord tells me this, so you may know it to be true. Find the Shadow, kill it. I will deal with the rest."
L|1||Handing in Shard of the Black Spear⸩ ⸨You give Abbess Zik'Lir Shard of the Black Spear.⸩ ⸨Abbess Zik'Lir tells you, "Well, this is indeed a fitting Token. Perhaps it will also make a suitable reward..."⸩ ⸨The Abbess chants over the shattered remains, which reform into a spear.⸩ ⸨Abbess Zik'Lir tells you, "It will not survive use as a weapon, but the magicks within the pieces are strong, and tappable, if you place the spear in a secure location. Also, take this token, so you may prove to your people that you are worthy of whatever reward they have in store for you."⸩ ⸨You've earned 80,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Abbess Zik'Lir gives you Shadow Aspect Slayer Title Token.⸩ ⸨Abbess Zik'Lir gives you Black Spear of Shadow Renewal.
L|1||Handing in Black Spear of Shadow Renewal⸩ ⸨You give Abbess Zik'Lir Black Spear of Shadow Renewal.⸩ ⸨Abbess Zik'Lir tells you, "The Spear does not suit your desires? Very well, I think you'll find this gift more... inspiring."⸩ ⸨You've earned 6,496,628 experience.
L|1||Handing in Shadow Aspect Slayer Title Token to Soju Bo-Ki⸩ ⸨You give Soju Bo-Ki Shadow Aspect Slayer Title Token.⸩ ⸨Soju Bo-Ki tells you, "I salute you as a true hero, friend. I thank you on behalf of Dereth and on behalf of the Whispering Blade for the great thing you have done."⸩ ⸨You've earned 80,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Soju Bo-Ki grants you the title Hero of the Golden Flame.⸩ ⸨Soju Bo-Ki gives you Mukkir Slayer Stone.
L|1||Handing in Mukkir Slayer Stone to Soju Bo-Ki⸩ ⸨You give Soju Bo-Ki Mukkir Slayer Stone.⸩ ⸨Soju Bo-Ki tells you, "Very well, if you do not desire this gem, I will take it in exchange for a bit of advancement..."⸩ ⸨You've earned 6,496,628 experience.⸩

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Lamorda Loschi tells you, "You may be able to help me... I would ask you to seek out a Ruschk chieftain named Garaktar. His blood has some unique properties, and may be of great use to us in our efforts to combat the demon known as Grael. If you are strong enough to fight the mightiest of Ruschk, venture to 87.3 N, 48.8 W in the Halaetan Isles, and bring me the blood of Garaktar."
L|1||Handing in Garaktar's Blood⸩ ⸨You give Lamorda Loschi Garaktar's Blood.⸩ ⸨Lamorda Loschi tells you, "Well done. The blood of Garaktar is indeed helpful. It allows me to make this token, which will gain you entrance to the chambers of Grael's White Totem. Simply give this Gateway Token to the White Totem Gateway on the Halaetan Islands, and a portal should open up for you. Once you have gained access to the White Totem Temple, destroy the White Totem, and that will help split Grael's power..."
L|1||Handing in Shard of the White Totem⸩ ⸨You give Lamorda Loschi Shard of the White Totem.⸩ ⸨Lamorda Loschi tells you, "Excellent! This means that Grael's power has been dealt a serious blow! The shattering of the White Totem temporarily split his avatar. I will get this to our mages, who might be able to work the proper rituals of sympathetic magic to keep Grael's spirit sundered. You have done the realm of Dereth a great service, friend."⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,637,784 experience.(level 99)⸩ ⸨Lamorda Loschi gives you Helm of the White Totem.⸩

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Tanada Sajo tells you, "Greetings! I can see you have aided my clan in the sensitive matter of the Temple of Black Waters. I am Tanada Sajo. You have aided us once before, so I must ask for your help again. Though your actions at the Temple of Black Waters helped free the majority of our clan from the thrall of Aerbax, another important task remains."⸩ ⸨Tanada Sajo tells you, "Because Aerbax succeeded in corrupting the Masters of Air, Earth, and Water, he was able to steal the scroll of each House. Only my uncle's House of Fire remained uncorrupted. Aerbax has locked the scrolls inside infernal devices of his own creation and continues to try to influence the acolytes of the orders through them. We cannot appoint new Masters of the schools until the scrolls are recovered. Please, journey to the Chamber of the Scrolls in the southern mountains at 52.2S, 63.2E and destroy the devices imprisoning the scrolls. Free the scrolls and bring them to me, and I will see that you are richly rewarded."
L|1||Returning to Sajo⸩ ⸨Tanada Sajo tells you, "I see you are still missing the Scroll of Water... Please, return when you have all the scrolls."
L|1||Resonators⸩ ⸨As the Air Stasis Resonator collapses under the fury of your assault, the chamber containing the House of Air's scroll cracks open, and you can feel the approval of generations of Tanada spirits.⸩ ⸨As the Earth Stasis Resonator collapses under the fury of your assault, the chamber containing the House of Earth's scroll cracks open, and you can feel the approval of generations of Tanada spirits.⸩ ⸨As the Water Stasis Resonator collapses under the fury of your assault, the chamber containing the House of Water's scroll cracks open, and you can feel the approval of generations of Tanada spirits.
L|1||Giving scrolls to Tanada Sajo⸩ ⸨Tanada Sajo tells you, "Well done! All three scrolls recovered. I would reward you myself, but my uncle, the Master of the House of Fire, wishes to see you. With no further delay, I shall take the scrolls from you and send you to see my uncle, Tanada Han-Tu."⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Scroll of Airs.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Scroll of Earths.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Scroll of Waters.
L|1||Tanada Masters⸩ ⸨Tanada Ganza tells you, "I thank you for retrieving the Scroll of Air so that we Tanada may reclaim our good name."⸩ ⸨Tanada Hido tells you, "I thank you for retrieving the Scroll of Earth so that we Tanada may reclaim our good name."⸩ ⸨Tanada Shouka tells you, "I thank you for retrieving the Scroll of Water so that we Tanada may reclaim our good name."
L|1||Tanada Han-Tu⸩ ⸨Tanada Han-Tu tells you, "So you are the promising young warrior who has helped our clan so greatly. You have the eternal gratitude of all Tanada, past present and future, for recovering our scrolls and helping defeat our corruption. Though no material reward can match what you have done for us, please accept these meager gifts as a token of the esteem of the Clan Tanada."⸩ ⸨Tanada Han-Tu gives you Fist of Enlightenment.⸩ ⸨You've earned 97,449,430 experience.⸩ ⸨Tanada Han-Tu tells you, "I hope you will forgive the abruptness of your departure, but we have pressing clan business to conduct..."
L|1||Giving Fist of Enlightenment to Tanada Sajo⸩ ⸨You give Tanada Sajo Fist of Enlightenment.⸩ ⸨Tanada Sajo tells you, "Truly? You wish to surrender this magnificent and elegant weapon?"⸩ ⸨Tanada Sajo tells you, "Very well, as you like it..."⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Fist of Enlightenments.⸩ ⸨You've earned 16,241,572 experience.
L|1||Returning to Tanada Sajo⸩ ⸨Tanada Sajo tells you, "You have already purified the scrolls for me! I can ask you for no more. You have brought peace to my family, and for that you have my eternal gratitude."⸩

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina tells you, "You may be able to help me... I seek knowledge of the Tanada clan of the Nanjou Shou-Jen. Their appearance in this land could bode great ill, even for the Sho people whom they are supposedly pledged to protect. I would have you seek out their training school in the southern mountains of Osteth."⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina tells you, "If this school is like the schools they maintained on Ispar, you will have to defeat the Master of each school - Storms, Wind, and Breath - and prove your worthiness to three shrines, before being allowed to see the Enlightened Master of the school. The Enlightened Master should be carrying a jade medallion which I would very much like to see. You will have to take it from him by force. If you are up to this dangerous task, the entrance to the Tanada school, which they call the House of Air, is located at 68 S, 45 E."
L|1||Returning to Sayuji⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina tells you, "I've asked you to journey into the southern mountains and seek out the Tanada training school at 68 S, 45 E. As far as I can tell, you have not proven yourself to any of the shrines, let alone confronted the Enlightened Master, so I have to ask why you are here. Please, go to the Tanada House of Air and take the Enlightened Master's jade medallion. I need to inspect that medallion. It will shed some light on the mysterious arrival of the Nanjou Shou-Jen."
L|1||Shrine of Storm⸩ ⸨The Tanada Shrine of Storms is made of polished stone and scented wood. L|1||Shrine of Breath⸩ ⸨The Tanada Shrine of Breath is made of polished stone and scented wood. It weems to have a slot built into it, as if to accept some small, disc-shaped object...⸩ ⸨You give Tanada Shrine of Breath Medallion of Breath.⸩ ⸨Though the Shrine of Breath does not move or change in any appreciable way, you can almost feel its approval as you present it with the medallion that once belonged to the Master of Breath.

This confirms some of my fears. I cannot tell you very much now, as I feel that most of what I know will be lost on you."⸩ ⸨Sayuji Jina tells you, "But here, I should reward you... I will give you some gems that I think you will find useful... Quest.Wiki:

Level|100+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Pau Yajin» I|Starts At|28.8S 59.4E in «Sawato» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Quest Chain|Tanada Clan I|1|«Tanada House of Storms Quest» I|2|«Tanada House of Earth Quest» I|3|«Tanada House of Water Quest» I|4|Tanada Temple of Black Water Quest I|5|«Tanada House of Fire Quest» H2|Overview P|To begin this quest you must have completed the «Tanada House of Storms Quest», «Tanada House of Earth Quest», and then the «Tanada House of Water Quest» quest at least once before.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Pau Yajin» at 28.8S 59.4E in «Sawato» L|2|•|⟦TanadaTempleofBlackWaterStarted⟧ L|1|2.|Run to the «Black Water Temple» at 24.2S, 57.1E. L|1|3.|Enter the tunnel dug in the ground, proceed into cave. L|1|4.|Kill «Black Water Gatekeeper». Loot «Black Water Key», used to open nearby «Black Water Threshold» (resistance 9999). L|1|5.|Enter «Black Water Temple» just behind the threshold (no level restrictions, cannot be tied, recalled, or summoned). L|1|6.|Proceed through dungeon. Kill «Master of the Depths» located at the end. Loot «Jade Medallion of the Depths». L|3|•|⟦JadeMedallionDepths_Pickup⟧ L|1|7.|Portal recall to return to Sawato. If you do not have item magic, hit the surface portal nearby and run back to Sawato. Give Pau Yajin the medallion. L|3|•|⟦ShrineofBlackWater_Flag⟧ L|1|8.|Run back to the temple. Use the «Shrine of Black Water» in the Mage Tower to enter the final dungeon. L|1|9.|Proceed through the dungeon. L|2|•|{WARN} «Fist of the Depths¦Fists of the Depths», worn by the enemy, can do massive damage - their critical hits are typeless damage. L|1|10.|Kill «Watcher of the Black Water». Loot «Mask of the Watcher of Black Water» and «Black Water Watcher's Shard». L|3|•|⟦MaskofBlackWater_Pickup⟧ L|1|11.|Return to Sawato. Give Pau Yajin the mask for your reward. L|3|•|⟦TanadaTempleofBlackWaterCompleted⟧ L|3|•|⟦TanadaHouseofFireQuest_Flag⟧ L|1|12.|{OPT} Hand in an unwanted mask to Pau Yajin for a bonus experience reward. L|1|13.|{OPT} Bring «Black Water Watcher's Shard» to «Diyas al-Yat» for the «Translated Black Water Watcher's Shard».

R| RK|Experience|35,000,000 (Fixed% up to level ) RK|Items| RI|«Mask of the Depths» RE

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Pau Yajin tells you, "So you've already helped us investigate the three other Tanada temples! You are both brave and dedicated. I must ask your assistance as well, as my colleagues Sayuji Jina and Meshenq have already done."⸩ ⸨Pau Yajin tells you, "I ask you to journey to the Tanada Temple of Black Water, in the swamp at 24.2 S, 57.1 E. There you must find the Tanada assassin known as the Master of the Depths. Slay him and bring me his jade medallion. I will need his medallion to be able to get to the bottom of the corruption of that clan of Tanada."
L|1||Returning to Pau⸩ ⸨Pau Yajin tells you, "Haven't I already asked you to go to the Tanada Temple of Black Water at 24.2 S, 57.1 E and bring me back the jade medallion of the Master of the Depths? Please hurry."
L|1||Using shrine (unflagged)⸩ ⸨You feel a vague sense of unease as you touch this shrine, nothing more. Perhaps a dowser in Sawato might know more about it.
L|1||Returning to Pau⸩ ⸨Pau Yajin tells you, "You've got the jade medallion of the Master of the Depths? Good work. Please give it to me and I can figure out what our next actions against the Temple of Black Water must be."
L|1||Handing in Medallion of the Depths⸩ ⸨You give Pau Yajin Jade Medallion of the Depths.⸩ ⸨Pau Yajin tells you, "You have done well to retrieve this medallion from the corrupted Master of Depths. You can see the corruption in the jade itself! What a terrible thing has happened to a once-noble House of Nanjou Shou-Jen. Our sources tell us that the key to the corruption of the Tanada can be found back at the Temple of Black Water. There is a Virindi Watcher there whose lair may be accessed through the Shrine of Black Water. Go back to the temple and use the shrine, and you should be able to find your way to the lair of the Watcher of Black Water..."
L|1||Using Shrine (flagged)⸩ ⸨You feel a hot warmth wash over your entire body as the Shrine of Black Water seems to recognize you and pull you in...
L|1||Returning to Pau⸩ ⸨Pau Yajin tells you, "You've got the mask of the Watcher of the Depths. Please hand it over to me and I shall reward you."
L|1||Handing in Mask of the Watcher of Black Water⸩ ⸨You give Pau Yajin Mask of the Watcher of Black Water.⸩ ⸨Pau Yajin tells you, "So it is done. The foul Virindi presence that has corrupted the Tanada has been rooted out. This will not save the souls of the Tanada who have already been corrupted, but at least we know what we are dealing with and can take appropriate steps. I am grateful for all the help you have given us."⸩ ⸨Pau Yajin tells you, "If you don't need that mask, I'll take it back in exchange for practical training."⸩ ⸨You've earned 35,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Pau Yajin gives you Mask of the Depths.
L|1||Handing in the mask⸩ ⸨You give Pau Yajin Mask of the Depths.⸩ ⸨Pau Yajin tells you, "Really? You're not interested in this lovely mask? Pity, I find it quite stylish. Still, if you don't want it..."⸩ ⸨You've earned 6,891,063 experience.
L|1||Handing in the shard⸩ ⸨You allow Pau Yajin to examine your Black Water Watcher's Shard.⸩ ⸨Pau Yajin tells you, "Ah, unfortunately, I cannot translate this... You may wish to bring it to Diyas al-Yat of Zaikhal for translation."
L|1||Handing in Black Water Watcher's Shard to Diyas al-Yat⸩ ⸨You give Diyas al-Yat Black Water Watcher's Shard.⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat tells you, "Well, this is disturbing..."⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat tells you, "These Tanada from the House of Water seem to have become the pawns of forces greater than themselves. Here, have a look for yourself."⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat gives you Translated Black Water Watcher's Shard.
L|1||Handing in translation⸩ ⸨You allow Pau Yajin to examine your Translated Black Water Watcher's Shard.⸩ ⸨Pau Yajin tells you, "Very interesting. I thank you for sharing this with me. You can keep the translation, however. It is not very useful to me. I am satisfied that the Watcher of the Black Water has been defeated."
L|1||Returning to Pau⸩ ⸨Pau Yajin tells you, "You've already resolved the situation at the Temple of Black Water for me. I can ask no more of you."⸩

Quest.notes: the run there takes the longest

Wiki.page: The Legend of the Tusker Paw

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Kleeoh» (do not need to speak to for repeats) I|Starts At|2.5S, 86.5E I|Route|«Oolutanga's Refuge» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for The Legend of the Tusker Paw» H2|Overview P|**Leaftide:** «Throne of the Tusker King» portal location in AC Storage Facility.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Behind the Waterfall L|1|1.|Talk with «Kleeoh» L|2|•|⟦KingOolutangaEnter⟧ L|1|2.|Beginning with «Behind the Waterfall» at 8.7S 85.7E, there are a series of 4 dungeons. L|2|•|Route: from your mansion, use the «Dangerous Portal Device» until you drop at the western end of Aphus Lassel, and then run to 8.7S 85.7E. L|1|3.|Follow the linear path heading east whenever possible, you will pass down a number of ramps before reaching the area with a statue of Bael'Zharon and the Tusker Warrior's Lair portal behind it.
H3|Part 2: Tusker Warrior's Lair L|1|•|From the drop head north to the end of the room and go left at the split. At the bottom of the ramp hug the right wall untill you head down another ramp, from the small room take the west exit. From here the path is very linear: head south and you will get vulned with Tusker Gift before reaching a very long room filled with Tuskers. Simply head east from here until you reach the Tusker Food Storage portal.
H3|Part 3: Tusker Food Storage L|1|•|From the drop, go right at the split and head down the ramp. Take the immediate right and then the third passage from the next corridor, head down the ramp to the Tusker area and hug the right wall until you reach the last area with the Legend of the Tusker King portal.
H3|Part 4: Legend of the Tusker King L|1|•|From the drop, just follow the linear path through some small rooms containing crude Tusker paintings until you come to a split. Take either direction and head south to a large ramped room, take the ramp down and go west at the junction to the Throne of the Tusker King portal.
H3|Part 5: Throne of the Tusker King L|1|•|Speak to «Oolutanga, the Tusker King» who will portal you to a ready room with a portal to the «Arena of the Tusker Hero» and «Mowen Udaun». Dispel any vulns before going in. L|2|•|⟦SpokenBobo⟧
H3|Part 6: Arena of the Tusker Hero L|1|1.|Kill «Mowen Udaun» then quickly go into the portal that appears on the north side of the room, this flags you for the reward. If you miss the portal you will need to run all the way back and kill Mowen again. L|2|•|⟦MowenWinner⟧ L|2|•|⟦MowenFighter!⟧ L|1|2.|Speak to «Oolutanga, the Tusker King» again, don't move until you are given the «Fabled Tusker Paw». It will have one use if you were in the group and used the portal that spawns when Mowen dies. If you did the most damage you will be given a three use paw. L|2|•|⟦MowenWait⟧ L|2|•|Additional Stamps depending on current number of contracts completed: L|3|•|⟦ContractQuestcounter_0511⟧ L|3|•|⟦50to11BrokerContractsA⟧ L|1|3.|To the south of Bobo are two portals, do not use the exit portal. Go inside «Idol of Wishes» in the SW corner. L|1|4.|Inside this dungeon are a series of tusker statues, each one corresponds to a skill and most give experience into that skill (random) or alternatively give a special reward about 3% of the time. L|2|•|The main exception is the «Statue of Artificer's Wish» which always gives the spell «Recall Aphus Lassel». L|3|•|⟦RecallTuskerIsland⟧ L|2|•|See the table below for a complete list of possible rewards. L|2|•|You can also hand in various Nanner foods to Oolutanga to receive xp into your cooking skill. L|1|5.|The quest can be repeated every 3 days, during this period you cannot renenter the arena where Mowen spawns.
