H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "Hello child, I sense dat you be looking for high adventure here where da tusker is king, no? Well let Kleeoh give you da help den. Why ya wonder I hid from ya when first ya came to da island?⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "Well that be simple, Oolutanga don't be liking those of us dat can think for ourselves. Who's Oolutanga?⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "You come to da island of da king Oolutanga. A refugee from da halls of a cruel virindi name by Aerbax.⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "Oolutanga is a special tusker you see. Yes. He be powerful strong and powerful big and powerful smart. He be a tusker dat hates da virindi. He frees his people when he can.⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "He has a magic about him. A magic dat comes from da hand dat he lost while fighting da former owner of dis island.⸩ ⸨Kleeoh chortles⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "Dey say dat if a person get hold of da hand taken from Oolutanga dey can have three wishes granted. But only in da temple of da king.⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "You be wanting to go dere den eh?⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "Well head to da waterfall on de interior of dis island and search for da entrance. Dere you find your way... Dere you find your way.⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "Read da signs. Dey tell secrets dey do.
L|1||Oolutanga, the Tusker King⸩ ⸨Oolutanga, the Tusker King tells you, "I am Oolutanga the Tusker King. You are not worthy of speaking to me. You must fight and beat our hero Mowen Udaun before you can have my magic Tusker Paw.⸩ ⸨Oolutanga, the Tusker King tells you, "Take your group and prepare for battle in the room where I will send you. Take your time and be ready to fight our champion who is very strong. Then go through the portal there and come to the isle of testing.⸩ ⸨Oolutanga, the Tusker King tells you, "I will bring the other tuskers to watch you in your fight.⸩ ⸨Oolutanga, the Tusker King tells you, "Win and I will reward you with my fabled Tusker paw, I will even make sure it has its magical powers courtesy of the other who speaks like you, Ketnan.⸩ ⸨Oolutanga, the Tusker King tells you, "Lose and your body will rot in the arena. Sorry that is the way of things around here. Make sure you armor yourself well, because your magic will help very little against Mowen.
L|1||Oolutanga, the Tusker King (Defeating Mowen Udaun)⸩ ⸨Oolutanga, the Tusker King tells you, "Congratulations, you have been part of a group that bested Mowen, the tusker hero. So I, Oolutanga, give you now a reward so that you know that Oolutanga, who is me, honors his word.⸩ ⸨Oolutanga, the Tusker King gives you Fabled Tusker Paw⸩ ⸨Oolutanga, the Tusker King tells you, "Don't Worry I have more. They are a novelty item now, I had them made by that guy in the funny green suit.⸩ ⸨Oolutanga, the Tusker King tells you, "Go through the portal to the temple of wishing. But do it before three days pass or you will lose your right to enter there.
L|1||Oolutanga, the Tusker King (Defeating Mowen Udaun and Inflicting Most Damage)⸩ ⸨Oolutanga, the Tusker King tells you, "Congratulations, you have bested the hero of the tusker people. But do it before three days pass or you will lose your right to enter there.

Quest.name: The_Shadows_of_Bitter_Winter
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Shade of Farelaith» I|Starts At|74.3N, 58.6E northeast of «Bandit Castle» I|Route|«Cragstone» to «Haliana» at 26.2N, 46.3E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for The Shadows of Bitter Winter» H2|Overview P|Farelaith's younger brothers have been corrupted into Shadows and must be destroyed.
L|1|•|Since most of the creatures, and the bosses, are «Shadow»s, one of the «Shadowfire Weapons» comes in handy.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Shade of Farelaith» L|2|•|⟦ShadowsWinterStarted_0511⟧ L|1|2.|Enter the «Temple of Stirring Shadows». L|1|3.|First enter the South Wing. L|1|4.|From drop, head roughly South. Easiest way is to take the SE hallway, and hang left. L|1|5.|Attack Baranaith, he is not named, but he is the «Shadow Phantom» weilding a spear. L|1|6.|Loot the «Spear of Baranaith» from his corpse. L|2|•|⟦SpearOfBaranaith⟧ L|1|7.|Take the surface portal, return to «Shade of Farelaith», and hand him the spear for the «Spear of Winter Flame». You are now flagged for the next part. L|2|•|⟦TempleNorthWing⟧ L|1|8.|Re-enter the «Temple of Stirring Shadows» L|1|9.|Now enter the North Wing. L|1|10.|From drop, head roughly North. L|1|11.|Take the right (east) passage and go immediately left down a ramp. From here, keep right until you reach Korogaith. L|1|12.|Attack Korogaith, he is not named, but he is the «Shadow Phantom» weilding an axe. L|1|13.|Loot the «Axe of Korogaith» from his corpse. L|2|•|⟦AxeOfKorogaith⟧ L|1|14.|Take the surface portal, return to «Shade of Farelaith» at 74.3N 58.6E, and hand him the axe for the «Axe of Winter Flame». You are now flagged for the next part. L|2|•|⟦TempleEastWing⟧ L|1|15.|Re-enter the nearby «Temple of Stirring Shadows» L|1|16.|Now enter the East Wing. L|1|17.|From drop, head East, and East, and east. L|1|18.|Attack Hiranaith, he is not named, but he is the «Shadow Phantom» weilding a mace. L|1|19.|Loot the «Mace of Hiranaith» from his corpse. L|2|•|⟦MaceOfHiranaith⟧ L|1|20.|Take the surface portal, return to «Shade of Farelaith» at 74.3N 58.6E, and hand him the mace for experience and the «Mace of Winter Flame» and «Farelaith's Untranslated Journal». L|2|•|⟦ShadowsWinterComplete1205⟧ L|1|21.|Hand the jounal to «Edobar the Esoteric» in «Cragstone» at 26.0N 47.0E, or «Gallatria du Ressetta» in «Sanamar» at 70.0N 62.4W to receive an additional xp reward and the translated text, «Our Bitter Winter».

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "You... Yes, you could help me, mortal. I need you to slay my younger brothers, who were corrupted into beings of Shadow by our former master, Grael. Please, you must enter this Temple of the Stirring Shadow. The temple has three wings, and one of my brothers serves in each wing. They have lost their names and faces to the Shadow corruption, but they still bear their own weapons... I was a mage in my past life, mortal. Help me, and I shall reward you."⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "Enter the South Wing first, and seek out my poor youngest brother, Baranaith. He wielded a spear in life, as he does now in the shadow. Bring me his spear so that I may know his torment is no more."
L|1||Defeating the Shadow Phantoms⸩ ⸨You hear the plaintive voice of the shadow that once was Baranaith cry out⸩ ⸨"Farelaith! My brother! Where is my older brother, who said he would guide and protect me?"⸩ ⸨You hear the husky voice of the shadow that once was Korogaith cry out⸩ ⸨"Farelaith! My brother! Where is my older brother, who abandoned us to the abomination of Grael?"⸩ ⸨You hear the booming voice of the shadow that once was Hiranaith cry out⸩ ⸨"Farelaith! My brother! Where is my older brother, whom I once defended against all others?"
L|1||Handing in Spear of Baranaith⸩ ⸨You give Shade of Farelaith Spear of Baranaith.⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "Oh, my brother's spear! Baranaith was my youngest brother. He was barely more than a child when we were taken to the slave pits of Haebrous. I failed him, most of all..."⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "Take this spear, mortal, as an instrument of vengeance. I have infused it with some portion of my power."⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "Now go into the North Wing and seek out my brother Korogaith. You will know him by his axe."⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith gives you Spear of Winter Flame.
L|1||Handing in Axe of Korogaith⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "You have my brother Korogaith's axe? Please, give it to me, so that I know that he has been granted oblivion."⸩ ⸨You give Shade of Farelaith Axe of Korogaith.⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "This is indeed the axe of my brother Korogaith. He was just a few years older than Baranaith. He was a hunter and a woodsman without peer. He was the one who tracked down Grael in the wilderness... Oh, would that we had never found that accursed soul again, but perished together in the snow..."⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "Take this axe. I have infused it with some portion of my power, to serve as an instrument of vengeance against the dark powers that corrupted my brothers."⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith gives you Axe of Winter Flame.⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "Now go into the East Wing, the last of the wings, and seek out my brother Hiranaith. You will know him by his mace."
L|1||Handing in Mace of Hiranaith⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "You have my brother Hiranaith's mace? Please, give it to me, so that I know that he has been granted oblivion."⸩ ⸨You give Shade of Farelaith Mace of Hiranaith.⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "Oh, my brother Hiranaith. This is his mace, with which he served in the town guard, before our father was forced to sell us to the imperial slavers. Hiranaith was a year younger than me, but twice as strong. He was my protector in the slave pits. Alas, I could not help him in his time of need..."⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "I have infused the mace with some portion of my power. Take it and use it against the shadowy things which corrutped us. I give you also my journal, that you may know something of Grael, who was once our master and twice betrayed his followers."⸩ ⸨You've earned 10,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith gives you Mace of Winter Flame.⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith gives you Farelaith's Untranslated Journal.
L|1||Handing in Farelaith's Untranslated Journal to Edobar the Esoteric⸩ ⸨You give Edobar the Esoteric Farelaith's Untranslated Journal.⸩ ⸨You've earned 10,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Edobar the Esoteric tells you, "What a fascinating account. I am immensely grateful you brought this to my attention. It sheds such a great deal of light on the mystery of Grael!"⸩ ⸨Edobar the Esoteric gives you Our Bitter Winter.⸩

Quest.name: Tracking_Grael
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|140 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Varlanna» I|Starts At|«Whispering Blade Chapterhouse» (drop point) at 59.9S, 87.2W I|Route|From «Eastwatch» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Quest Chain|Joining the Whispering Blade I|1|«Eleonora's Heart Quest» I|2|«Knights of Karlun Quest» I|3|«Marauder's Lair Quest» I|4|«Shade Iron» I|5|«Whispering Blade Chapterhouse Access» I|6|«Pheraion's Sanctum Quest» (Optional) I|7|Tracking Grael H2|Overview L|1|•|You must have completed the first five «Whispering Blade» (quest 6 is optional) quests in order to begin this quest. L|1|•|You will also need to have access to «Vissidal Island».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Varlanna» in the «Whispering Blade Chapterhouse». L|2|•|⟦TrackingGraelWhiteSpear_Start⟧ L|1|2.|Go to Eastwatch and run North East. L|1|3.|Run to the «White Spear's Cave» at 93.8N 40.1W. L|2|•|The cave is guarded by 2 «Uber Penguin»s and there are 2 also inside with «Harrak the White Spear». L|1|4.|Kill Harrack and loot «Head of the White Spear». L|1|5.|Return to the «Whispering Blade Chapterhouse» and give «Varlanna» the head. L|2|•|⟦AltarNest_Flag⟧ L|2|•|⟦TrackingGraelVargol_Start⟧ L|1|6.|Travel to the far east end of «Vissidal» island to the «Altar Nest» at 75.9N 69.4E. L|1|7.|Kill «Vargol the Scion» and loot «Head of the Mukkir Scion». L|2|•|He is protected by several Mukkir «Broodling»s. L|2|•|⟦HeadoftheMukkirScion_Pickup⟧ L|1|8.|Return to the «Whispering Blade Chapterhouse» and give «Varlanna» the head for the «Whispering Blade Chapterhouse Recall Orb» and a «Whispering Blade Token». L|2|•|⟦CanPickupSilveranToken⟧ L|2|•|⟦TrackingGrael_Wait⟧ L|1|9.|The token can be used to purchase a Red Rune Silveran weapon from the «Whispering Blade Quartermaster». First, select your weapon token, then give it to Eddred the Wolf. He gives you Whispering Blade Token in return that you use to buy the weapon from the Chapterhouse Quartermaster. L|2|•|Pick up Siveran Token from table. L|3|•|⟦PlayerReceivedSilveranToken⟧ L|2|•|Hand token to «Eddred the Wolf». L|3|•|⟦PlayerReceivedWhisperingBladeToken⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|Once you have completed this quest you cannot re-enter the «Altar Nest». L|1|•|If you're not happy with your choice of weapon, you can exchange the weapon by handing it to «Eddred the Wolf» for another «Whispering Blade Token».

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Varlanna⸩ ⸨Varlanna tells you, "You may be a doughty enough warrior... I'll tell you my needs plainly. I need help to track down Grael. Yes, a tall order, but not as tough as one might think. There are creatures we have had reports of, who might be, ah, enough like Grael to help us track him down. It's a peculiar kind of tracking magic, not well known outside of the Whispering Blade."⸩ ⸨Varlanna tells you, "If I had the heads of a Ruschk elder of particularly rarified blood and of a Mukkir Scion, that may be enough for me to start on his trail. Please, first go to the east coast of the Isle of Ruin in the Halaetans and bring me the head of the Ruschk elder called Harrak the White Spear. He is a tough and crafty old fiend, and of surpassingly pure blood, so beware. The White Spear's cave can be found at 93.8 N, 40.1 W. Beware, he keeps a brood of vicious penguins to guard him."
L|1||Handing in Head of the White Spear⸩ ⸨You give Varlanna Head of the White Spear.⸩ ⸨Varlanna tells you, "What a magnificent brute. Almost a pity that he had to die. He was the last of his proud bloodline, you know. Yes, this will help with my tracking methods. Now, if you would be so kind, please journey to Vissidal Island and seek the altar of Grael. Near the altar, at 75.9 N, 69.4 E, is the nest of a powerful Mukkir, who I think would help me with the second part of my tracking technique. Bring me the head of the Vargol the Scion from the Altar Nest, and I shall reward you."
L|1||Handing in Head of the Mukkir Scion⸩ ⸨You give Varlanna Head of the Mukkir Scion.⸩ ⸨Varlanna gives you Whispering Blade Chapterhouse Recall Orb.⸩ ⸨Varlanna tells you, "Truly, a fearsome head. This will serve, yes. I commend you for your excellent work and for your courage. Now, the rewards I promised... Practical training, as well as an orb that you may use to recall to this Chaperhouse..."⸩ ⸨Varlanna tells you, "You have also earned the right to a Silveran weapon from our most closely guarded stores. Please pick a token representing your weapon of choice from the table behind me."⸩ ⸨You've earned 98,000,000 experience.⸩

I|Level|180 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Valerian McGreggor» I|Starts At|«Freebooter Keep Black Market» (West hallway) I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Kill Task|Yes H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Valerian McGreggor». L|2|•|⟦KillTaskMcGreggorTentacle_0908⟧ L|1|2.|Head out to «Freebooter Isle» and run to the «Deru Tree of Degar'Alesh» just north of the island drop at 62.0S, 96.0E. L|1|3.|Kill 50 Slithis tentacles. L|2|•|First Kill: ⟦KillTaskMcGreggorTentacle_0908 on first completion⟧ L|1|4.|Return to «Valerian McGreggor» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦WeedingoftheDeruTree_Repeat⟧ L|2|•|⟦KillTaskMcGreggorTentacleWait_0908⟧
L|1||Notes L|1|•|This kill task is located on «Freebooter Isle», which means you must have made Rank 3 in your society to start it. L|1|•|Slithis tentacles include «Eyestalk of T'thuun», «Tendril of T'thuun» and «Tentacle of T'thuun».
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No related dungeons.
H2|Rewards
R| RK|Experience|198,157,237 (20% up to level 200) RK|Items| RI|«Aged Legendary Key» (x2) RE
H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Valerian McGreggor tells you, "Greetins to ye." L|1||Valerian McGreggor tells you, "Me name's Valerian, Velerian McGreggor. I've been studying the dead-lookin Deru Tree to the north of the Ruins of Degar'Alesh on Freebooter Isle, but me researches have been interrupted as of late." L|1||Valerian McGreggor tells you, "Ya see, these nasty tentacles, like the Slithis you see on occasion, but bigger, erupted out all over the roots of the tree. Worse! Since they've appeared, the Mana flows around the ruins have been all choked up! That there's bad for me and bad for business." L|1||Valerian McGreggor tells you, "I'll tell ye what. If ye go out there and kill 50 of those tentacles for me, just the ones on Freebooter, mind ye, I'll make it worth ye while." L|1||Valerian McGreggor tells you, "The Marae Lassel Deru Trees can rot for all I care. Damn Tumies won't let me within a mile of them for some reason."
H3|Completing Kill Task L|1||Valerian McGreggor tells you, "That should do it! The Mana flows around the Ruins of Degar'Alesh are moving much better now, thank ye. Here's a little something for yer efforts." L|1||Valerian McGreggor gives you Aged Legendary Key. L|1||Valerian McGreggor gives you Aged Legendary Key. L|1||You've earned 99,078,619 experience.

Quest.name: Aerbax's_Prodigal_Olthoi
Quest.notes: need to get queen head if trying in one run
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|120 I|Rec. Level|150+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|{OPT} «Ethan Wintermaine» I|Starts At|43.8N, 54.9E near «Paradox-touched Valley» I|Route|«Arwic» to «Far Claw Villas» portal at 32.9N, 59.4E, or use «Paradox-touched Olthoi Infested Area Recall» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|Everyone who participates in this quest must have a «Coruscating Olthoi Scent Gland». Glands are only found on level 160+ «Paradox Olthoi». The best place to hunt for glands is in «Olthoi North». L|1|•|There are several convenience ties that you can get ahead of time to speed things up| L|2|•|Part 1: Surface portal of the «Olthoi Tunnels» at 48.0N, 53.0E. L|2|•|Part 2: «Black Death Catacombs» at 60.0N, 71.1E.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Ethan Wintermaine». L|2|•|⟦ParadoxQueenStarted⟧
H3|Part 1: Paradox-touched Olthoi Ward Guardian L|1|1.|From «Paradox-touched Valley», enter the «Ward Guardian Cave», the western most burrow at the back of the valley. L|1|2.|Stick right until you come to a 4-way intersection, go SE. L|1|3.|When you come to a large room, stick right until you leave the large room then go straight NE. L|1|4.|Pass by the first intersection and the dungeon becomes linear from here until you reach a large room containing the «Paradox-touched Olthoi Ward Guardian». L|1|5.|Kill the «Paradox-touched Olthoi Ward Guardian» to open access to Aerbax's Prodigal Olthoi quest. L|2|•|{WARN} Once the Ward Guardian is dead, you have a 6 hour window to run the quest.
H3|Part 2: Deeper Catacombs L|1|1.|From the drop of the «Black Death Catacombs», head down the ramp, and head to the south side of the room, where you'll find an opening in the wall that leads to the «Deeper Catacombs (Paradox)» portal. L|2|•|{OPT} Loot «Directives» from one of the Tanada corpses scattered near the portal as part of the «Tanada House of Water's Directives» quest. L|1|2.|Work your way through the dungeon until you reach the Egg Room. Loot an «Paradox-touched Olthoi Egg», from the ground. L|2|•|⟦ParadoxEggPickup⟧ L|1|3.|Hand your «Coruscating Olthoi Scent Gland» to the «Sealed Olthoi Passage (Door)¦olthoi-style door» and you'll be portaled to the «Sealed Olthoi Passage». L|2|•|{WARN} From here you have 2 hours of access to the Sealed Olthoi Passage. Should you die before reaching the Queen, olthoi-style door and you'll be portaled inside again.
H3|Part 3: Sealed Olthoi Passage L|1|1.|From the drop, go left at the first intersection then stick right until you come to a square room, take the NE passage. L|1|2.|You'll eventually come to a large room. Go east then south in the room, and take the passage down. L|1|3.|Stick to the right wall and you'll come to a jagged bridge over a pool of acid. Follow the bridge to the other side of the room. L|2|•|**Note:** If anyone falls into the acid, there is a tunnel back up on the west side. L|1|4.|At the wishbone intersection go right, and then follow the hallway straight, ignoring all other cut-backs. L|1|5.|When you come to a dead-end pit, turn around, hold shift and jump down backwards into the pit to be portaled into the Paradox-touched Olthoi Queen's lair. If you jump into the middle of the pit you will drop into the acid and not on the ledge. This will bring the queen before your party gets setup and if she gets up on the ledge she will kill everyone. L|2|•|{WARN} When you portal in, **do not** move forward. This is a good place to rebuff and/or give final instructions.
H3|Part 4: Paradox-touched Olthoi Queen L|1|1.|You'll portal in on a ledge, overlooking the queen. There are a couple of strategies to killing the queen, however if you have a small/moderate size group, the best way is to setup on the mushroom on the far wall. L|1|2.|One person with high melee should lead the way for everyone to jump up onto the mushroom that is against the center of the far back wall L|1|3.|From here, you're safe from melee attacks as long as you stay against the wall. L|1|4.|Fully debuff the queen (including her UA & Strength), then attack. L|1|5.|Once the queen dies, loot a «Carapace Shard» from her corpse. L|2|•|⟦ParadoxCarapacePickup⟧ L|2|•|She also drops one «Paradox-touched Olthoi Queen's Head», which can be turned in for a title. L|3|•|⟦ParadoxQueenHeadPickup⟧
H3|In Case of Death L|1|1.|If anyone should die while fighting the queen, you can quickly get back by heading to the burrow east of «Olthoi North» at 44.5N 57.3E. L|1|2.|Someone inside the Queen's Lair must use open the door to the burrow by using the «Olthoi Cistern» Lever, located in the corner of the Queen's Lair. L|1|3.|Once the door opens, use the portal just inside to be portaled back to the Queens Lair. L|2|•|Note: Access via this entrance is restricted to players who have entered the Queen's Lair within the past 2 hours.
H3|Part 5: Rewards L|1|1.|Return to the valley Tent at 43.8N 54.9E and hand the «Carapace Shard» to «Ethan Wintermaine» to receive a «Paradox-touched Olthoi Weapon Token» and a «Braced Mana Forge Key». L|2|•|⟦ParadoxQueenWait⟧ L|2|•|Note: If you don't want a weapon, wand or shield, the token can be returned to Ethan Wintermaine for XP. L|1|2.|If you looted a «Paradox-touched Olthoi Egg», it can be given to «Adrien Swiftblade» in the tent for experience. L|2|•|⟦ParadoxEggCount⟧ L|2|•|⟦ParadoxEggWait⟧
L|1|1.|If you have the Queen's Head, hand it to «Ethan Wintermaine» for the title of Paradox-touched Queenslayer. L|1|2.|To obtain your weapon or shield, bring the token to one of the NPCs located in the northermost burrow inside the valley («Paradox Olthoi Refuge», 43.5N 55.2E). L|2|•|Note: Each NPC is holding the reward they give in exchange for the «Paradox-touched Olthoi Weapon Token». L|3|•|«Crusher» - Axe (Light Weapon) L|3|•|«Deena» - Katar (Light Weapon) L|3|•|«Miko» - Spear (Finesse Weapon) L|3|•|«Thrasher» - Mace (Finesse Weapon) L|3|•|«Sasha» - Sword (Heavy Weapon) L|3|•|«Lash» - Dagger (Heavy Weapon) L|3|•|«Mac» - Staff (Heavy Weapon) L|3|•|«Slasha» - Great Sword (Two Handed) L|3|•|«Tikka» - Shield L|3|•|«Long-Shot» - Bow L|3|•|«Dead-Eye» - Crossbow L|3|•|«Swift-Eye» - Atlatl L|3|•|«Peda» - Wand (War) L|3|•|«Peda's Assistant» - Wand (Life)
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Ward Guardian Cave» 43.1N, 55.1E -- «map:C4B4¦C4B4» TR|«Deeper Catacombs (Paradox)» 59.9N, 71.2E -- «map:0088¦0088» TR|«Sealed Olthoi Passage» 59.9N, 71.2E -- «map:C7B7¦C7B7» TR|«Paradox-touched Olthoi Queen 's Lair» 59.9N, 71.2E -- -- TR|«Empty Paradox Olthoi Cave» 43.4N, 55.4E -- -- TE
H2|Rewards
R|Hand the queen's head to «Ethan Wintermaine» (One per group) RK|Title|Paradox-touched Queenslayer RE
R|Give carapace to «Ethan Wintermaine» RK|Experience|69,355,033 (7% up to level 200) RK|Items| RI|«Paradox-touched Olthoi Weapon Token» RI|«Braced Mana Forge Key» RI|«Trade Note (250,000)» (x8) RE
R|Give unwanted weapon token to «Ethan Wintermaine» RK|Experience|49,539,309 (5% up to level 200) RE
R|Give «Paradox-touched Olthoi Egg» to «Adrien Swiftblade». RK|Experience|27,530,674 (40% up to level 100) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine tells you, "Greetings citizen."⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine tells you, "If you're of a mind to help quell this invasion, I have a mission for you. We've found that, with the increase in the infestation of this area, that the stronger Paradox-touched Olthoi have some capacity to pass beyond the Sealed Olthoi Passage that those aiding the Guard Swiftblade have found."⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine tells you, "Those who have hunted them have been able to use these stronger Olthoi to gain passage beyond the door themselves."⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine tells you, "Beyond that passage lies my mission for you. It's a simple one, in concept anyways."⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine smiles.⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine tells you, "Before we get to that, you'll need to bypass the Wards on the Deeper Catacombs Portal. Guard Swiftblade, in the tent behind me, has more information in bypassing the Wards. Speak to him if you need more information on that process."⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine tells you, "Go beyond the passage, find the Paradox-touched Olthoi Queen, and kill her. Bring me back proof of her death, and I'll reward you for your part in it. Be warned, however. She's not a creature to be taken lightly, or hunted alone."
L|1||Adrien Swiftblade⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Greetings. If you're of a mind to help in this odd situation, I could certainly use your help."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Along with the rise of these strange new Olthoi, there is a Portal, warded by powerful magics, which formed in the Black Death Catacombs. You may've seen it already, or you may not have."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Anyways, I've found a way to get the wards to drop for a time. There is a Ward Guardian in a cave located in a heavily infested area nearby, around 43.6N, 55.5E. When that thing dies, the wards falter for a time."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Be warned, however, the Ward Guardian has grown dramatically in strength since it first appeared. It is now as strong or stronger than those twisted bugs that wander the inner areas of the infestation, and should not be taken lightly."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Once the Ward Guardian is dead, so you should be able to enter the Deeper Catacombs of the Paradox-touched Olthoi. Once in there, look for anything that may be of use to use in our research and bring it back to me."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "If, for some reason, the Portal is closed again when you get there, you should find the Ward Guardian in his cave and kill him again."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "I would hurry though, every time the Ward Guardian dies, it's either reborn, recreated, or whatever roughly six hours after its death, and the Wards return with it."
L|1||Defeating the Paradox-touched Olthoi Queen⸩ ⸨As (Player) strikes the final blow against the Paradox-touched Olthoi Queen, a piercing howl fills your mind. Amidst the horrifying noise in your skull, you hear the following words, "You may have stopped me for a time, but you will never be rid of me. I am no simple insect that can be driven off or so simply destroyed. My Master will rid the world of you pathetic meatbags, and we will usher a new age into this reality."
L|1||Handing in Carapace Shard to Ethan Wintermaine⸩ ⸨You give Ethan Wintermaine Carapace Shard.⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine tells you, "Ahh, you've killed her again. Very good."⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine tells you, "Please, allow me to reward you for your victory."⸩ ⸨You've earned 69,355,033 experience.⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine gives you Paradox-touched Olthoi Weapon Token.⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine tells you, "Bring the token to one of the Olthoi Weaponcrafters in the valley below, and they'll exchange it for a weapon you may find very useful."⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine tells you, "If you're not interested in the weapon, I can take the token back and reward you with something else appropriate."⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine gives you Braced Mana Forge Key.
L|1||Handing in Paradox-touched Olthoi Weapon Token to Ethan Wintermaine⸩ ⸨You give Ethan Wintermaine Paradox-touched Olthoi Weapon Token.⸩ ⸨Ethan Wintermaine tells you, "No need for a weapon, I see. Very well, accept this instead."⸩ ⸨You've earned 49,539,309 experience.
L|1||Handing in Paradox-touched Olthoi Egg to Adrien Swiftblade⸩ ⸨You give Adrien Swiftblade Paradox-touched Olthoi Egg.⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "What's this?"⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade looks over the Paradox-touched Olthoi Egg.⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Where did you find this?"⸩ ⸨You explain to Adrien Swiftblade where you came across the egg, and how you came to bring it to him.⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Wonderful! I see word is indeed spreading, if kind-hearted people such as yourself are aiding in this without me having to ask them to do so myself. Dereth is indeed full of wonders. Please, allow me to reward you for your generous act."⸩ ⸨You've earned 27,530,674 experience.⸩

Quest.name: Aerbax's_Prodigal_Tumerok
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Nomea ibn Makar» I|Starts At|74.3S, 19.1E in «Qalaba'r» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak with «Nomea ibn Makar» in «Qalaba'r». L|2|•|⟦aerbaxsprodigaltumerokstart⟧ L|1|2.|After speaking with Nomea, head to «Ayan Baqur» and run north to the «Lonely Fortress» at 56.7S, 88.5W. L|2|•|{WARN} The portal to the lonely fortress is surrounded by Virindi Executors, Virindi Profatrix and Paroxysm Shadows. Get in the bunker fast or you risk being pinned down by all the creatures. L|1|3.|Once inside, you face some narrow tunnels full of the same monsters and a few hollows as well, stay right until you reach an acid pit you must jump across. L|1|4.|The next part of the dungeon is full of small iron golems called «Rheaga's Companion»s. Continue up to the top where you will find «Hea Rheaga», speak to him and choose either to kill him or spare him. L|2|•|If you choose to spare him, pick up the «Letter to Nomea». This will get you the Friend of Rheaga title. L|2|•|⟦lettertonomeapickuptimer⟧ L|2|•|If you choose to kill him, loot the «Head of Rheaga» off his corpse. This will get you the Slayer of Rheaga title. L|2|•|⟦headofrheagapickuptimer⟧ L|1|5.|{OPT} Before you leave you may also read «Rheaga's Journal» on the floor in a little room near Rheaga. It is only lore and must be read in the dungeon because it can't be picked up. L|1|6.|Once you're finished, head back to «Qalaba'r» and give the Letter or Head to Nomea. L|2|•|Note: Once you get one of the titles you cannot get the other title on a future run. L|2|•|⟦aerbaxsprodigaltumerokrepeat⟧ L|2|•|⟦aerbaxsprodigaltumerokwait⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Lonely Fortress» 56.7S, 88.5W -- -- TE
H2|Rewards
R|Give «Letter to Nomea» to «Nomea ibn Makar» RK|Experience|30,000,000 RK|Title|Friend of Rheaga RE
R|Give «Head of Rheaga» to «Nomea ibn Makar» RK|Experience|20,000,000 RK|Title|Slayer of Rheaga RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Nomea ibn Makar tells you, "Ah, you may be suitable for the task I have at hand. We've received reports that the Virindi renegade Aerbax has endowed a Hea Tumerok with increased intelligence and magical power. You can only imagine what danger this creature would pose if it came to unite the Tumeroks, the way Aerbax's other experiments have tried, yes?"⸩ ⸨Nomea ibn Makar tells you, "Please venture to the Lonely Fortress on the western edge of Dereth, north of Ayan Baqur, and see to it that this Tumerok poses us no threat."
L|1||Hea Rheaga⸩ ⸨Hea Rheaga tells you, "Greetings, human. Have you come to slay me? I have divined, through my vast intelligence and penetrating senses, that a human named Nomea in your shantytown of Qalaba'r wishes me dead. Simply because I am a failed experiment of the meddler Aerbax. I can assure you that I pose no threat."⸩ ⸨Hea Rheaga tells you, "I have no desire to meet, let alone unite or enslave, my brethren. Nor do I care to wage any kind of war, by arms, sorcery, or guile, against humankind. I have studied enough to know that no good can come of treating with your people."⸩ ⸨Hea Rheaga tells you, "If you would slay me, be done with it now. I can assure you, death neither fascinates nor terrifies me. I am not particularly attached to the life I have been given."⸩ ⸨Hea Rheaga tells you, "If you would spare me, merely pick up the note you see before me, and deliver it to Nomea. I am convinced it will convince Nomea of my benign intent."⸩ ⸨Hea Rheaga tells you, "Be warned, I will fight back if attacked. I am not completely apathetic, after all. I do possess some survival instinct."⸩ ⸨⸨Hea Rheaga says, "Is there anyone at all like me? Anyone as unfortunate as me?"⸩
L|1||Killing Hea Rheaga⸩ ⸨Hea Rheaga says, "Oh dear... It looks like death is just as boring as the rest of this uninspiring existence..."
L|1||Giving "Letter to Nomea" to Nomea ibn Makar⸩ ⸨You give Nomea ibn Makar Letter to Nomea.⸩ ⸨Nomea ibn Makar tells you, "A very interesting note you've given me here. I suppose this is enough to confirm that this Rheaga has no interest in uniting his kin for a war against us. I thank you for your service."⸩ ⸨You've earned 30,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Nomea ibn Makar has granted you the title "Friend of Rheaga"
L|1||Giving Head of Rheaga to Nomea ibn Makar⸩ ⸨You give Nomea ibn Makar Head of Rheaga.⸩ ⸨Nomea ibn Makar tells you, "Funny, the beast doesn't look any smarter than any of the other Tumeroks. Good job, bringing that dangerous creature down. Oh, he may have protested his innocence, but all of these things that Aerbax twisted... Well, they can't help eventually turning to his will, can they?"⸩ ⸨You've earned 20,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Nomea ibn Makar has granted you the title "Slayer of Rheaga"⸩

Quest.name: Aetherium_Raid_(Low)
Quest.startTown: Inner Sea Gear Knight Resistance Camp
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|40 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Sir Oakley» I|Starts At|«Inner Sea Gear Knight Resistance Camp» at 33.4S, 6.3E I|Route|«Yaraq» to «Ijaniya» at 22.4S, 0.2E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|One of the many quests from the «Inner Sea Gear Knight Invasion Area» aimed at lower level characters.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|After everyone has spoken with «Sir Oakley», head to the «Gear Knight Excavation» at 36.0S, 7.2E. L|2|•|⟦AetheriumRaidsLowStarted⟧ L|1|2.|Work your way to the bottom. There are a few dead ends but the dungeon is fairly small and easy to navigate. Just hug the right wall and you'll get there quickly. L|1|3.|At the end you will find a «Dull Aetherium Ore Stockpile» guarded by several «Stockpile Guardian (Level 60)¦Stockpile Guardian»s. Destroy the stockpile. Note: The guardians respawn very quicky, and do not leave a corpse or drop any loot so there is no use killing them. L|1|4.|When the stockpile is destroyed, several «Dull Aetherium Ore Fragment»s appear on the ground after about 10 seconds. Pick one up. L|2|•|⟦DullAetheriumCoreFragment⟧ L|1|5.|Return to Sir Oakley and give him the fragment for your reward. L|2|•|⟦AetheriumRaidsLowCompleted⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Gear Knight Excavation» 36.0S, 7.2E -- -- TE
H2|Rewards
R| RK|Experience|5,000,000 RE
H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Sir Oakley tells you, "Greetings. I have been stationed here by the Queen in order to assist in the slowing of the Gear Knight forces invading Dereth." L|1||Sir Oakley tells you, "To that end, my scouts have identified a stockpile of Aetherium Ore at the bottom of one of the Gear Knights excavations. If you are willing, I am authorized to send adventurers to destroy the stockpile, and reward you if you bring me proof of its destruction." L|1||Sir Oakley tells you, "You will find the tunnels they have dug at 36.1 S, 7.2 E. They've been reinforcing the location since they created it, so expect defenses in place." L|1||Sir Oakley tells you, "My reports indicate that the resistance in the site is quite high, so you may want to recruit a few of your compatriots to assist in this mission. Just make sure they all come to me first, so I can properly reward them upon your successful completion."
L|1||Sir Oakley tells you, "You'll find the excavation they're using to store their Aetherium Stockpile at 36.1 S, 7.2 E. Get in there, destroy it, and bring me back some of the remaining debris as proof."
H3|Rewards Dialog L|1||You allow Sir Oakley to examine your Dull Aetherium Ore Fragment. L|1||Sir Oakley tells you, "A job well done. I'll take the remaining debris off your hands, and reward you." L|1||You hand over 1 of your Dull Aetherium Ore Fragments. L|1||You've earned 5,000,000 experience. L|1||Sir Oakley tells you, "It'll take them a while to build up another stockpile. Come back in a week, and I'll have another mission for you."
H3|Other Interactions L|1||With a thunderous explosion, the stockpile is destroyed, leaving only scattered pieces of debris to mark its passage.

L|1|3.|Follow the instructions and collect pyreal and crystal creature trophies in return for rewards from «Asheron's Servant» (see table below). Quest.name: Burun_Liberator
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Scout Leader Tmauruk» I|Starts At|«Kor-Gursha» on «Bur» I|Route|«Portal to Bur» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|The Falatacot are abducting shamans of the Ruuk tribe in «Kor-Gursha». Scout Leader Tmauruk will instruct you on the path to where they are being held captive and requests you bring back a broken lik of the chain binding them after you have freed them.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Scout Leader Tmauruk» in «Kor-Gursha». L|2|•|⟦BurunLiberator_Start⟧ L|1|2.|Take the «Southern Catacombs» portal in the tunnel east of Tmauruk. Stick right until you come to another portal, use the «Rock South Catacombs¦Rock» next to the portal to enter the «Upper Catacombs». L|1|3.|See the map for the location of the statue that takes you to the «Lower Catacomb». It is in the NE corner, the first door on the inner wall. Drop is safe. L|1|4.|The first large room has several tunnels branching off from it, each tunnel passes by a «Falatacot Prison Warden» that drops a single use «Lower Catacomb Prison Key». Following the warden are a series of prison cells with the final cell that is either empty or holds the NPC «Burun Shaman of Kor-Gursha». L|1|5.|If the NPC is there, use the key to open the «Lower Catacomb Prison Door», the door can also be picked as it's 650 resistance (debuff first). L|1|6.|If the cell is empty, return to the large room and try another tunnel. The shaman spawns randomly. L|1|7.|Speak to the shaman to shatter his chain and free him. Several rings of the broken chain that held him will appear on the floor. Everyone take a «Link of a Falatacot Chain». L|2|•|⟦LinkofaFalatacotChainPickupTimer⟧ L|1|8.|Return to «Kor-Gursha» and give the link to «Scout Leader Tmauruk» for the xp and title rewards. L|2|•|⟦BurunLiberator_Wait⟧ L|2|•|⟦BurunLiberator_Repeat⟧

H2|Rewards
R|Hand in «Link of a Falatacot Chain» to Tmauruk RK|Experience|197,347,085 (30% up to level 180) RK|Title|Burun Liberator RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Scout Leader Tmauruk tells you, "Jurukka. I am Tmauruk, leader of the scouts of this tribe. While I would rather be away from the town scouting, Gruuklar has asked me to remain here and brief those of you who wish to help."⸩ ⸨Scout Leader Tmauruk tells you, "Torgluuk has been rescued, but the bloodletters continue to abduct the other shamans of the tribe. Torgluuk wants me to continue instructing you Derethians how to find the upper catacomb so that they can be rescued."⸩ ⸨Scout Leader Tmauruk tells you, "There is a rock in the southern catacombs, somewhat near the north of the top level cavern. If you push the rock aside, you'll find a very small corridor, impossible to see without knowing exactly what you are looking for."⸩ ⸨Scout Leader Tmauruk tells you, "Bring the chains that bound the shaman to me as evidence of their freedom."
L|1||Burun Shaman of Kor-Gursha⸩ ⸨Burun Shaman of Kor-Gursha says, "Thank you for freeing me. I have been a captive here for too long, but now I can return to guiding the Burun. Good luck in the future, friend. Scout Leader Tmauruk will want to speak with you when you return to Kor-Gursha."
L|1||Handing in Link of a Falatacot Chain to Scout Leader Tmauruk⸩ ⸨You give Scout Leader Tmauruk Link of a Falatacot Chain.⸩ ⸨You've earned 197,347,085 experience.⸩ ⸨You have been given the title 'Burun Liberator'!⸩ ⸨Scout Leader Tmauruk tells you, "Well done, finder! To have freed our people is a noble thing. We shall remember your deeds. If any more shamans are lost to the bloodletters, I will tell you."
L|1||Handing in Link of a Falatacot Chain to Scout Leader Tmauruk (Quest Repeats)⸩ ⸨You give Scout Leader Tmauruk Link of a Falatacot Chain.⸩ ⸨You've earned 98,673,543 experience.⸩ ⸨Scout Leader Tmauruk tells you, "Again you aid us, finder! Our shamans owe you a debt of gratitude. But the bloodletters will⸩ ⸨surely try to kidnap our shamans again in the future, and we may need your help again."⸩
H2|Trivia L|1|•|When this quest was first introduced, you get the title Torgluuk's Liberator for liberating «Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha» from the prison.

Quest.name: Chasing_Oswald
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|90 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Huntsman of Silyun» I|Starts At|86.9N, 70.0W in «Silyun» I|Repeat|Non Repeatable I|Contracts|«Contract for Chasing Oswald» H2|Overview P|Help the Huntsman of Silyun find «Oswald», the infamous assassin, and gain an additional «Skill Credit».
L|1|•|The «Huntsman of Silyun» will ask you to bring him a «Abhorrent Eater Jaw», «Ravenous Eater Jaw» or «Insatiable Eater Jaw» before he will let you help him. L|1|•|The recommended jaw is the «Abhorrent Eater Jaw» since it's the easiest to retrieve, from the Abhorrent Vault at 88.5N, 50.3W.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Lugian Ice Tunnels L|1|1.|Hand the jaw to the huntsman, he will send you to the «Lugian Ice Tunnels» at 93.3N, 50.1W. L|2|•|⟦ChasingOswaldDungeonFlag⟧ L|2|•|Route: «Silyun» to «Plains of Ruin» portal at 87.7N 69.7W. L|1|2.|From the drop in «Lugian Ice Tunnels», stick right until you come to a squarish room with tunnels leading off to the north and to the south. L|1|3.|Go south and you'll come to a large room that has a corpse in an alcove on the south wall. Loot the «Note to Alvirre» off the «Corpse (Lugian Ice Tunnels)¦Corpse» and return it to the «Huntsman of Silyun» (If you took the Plains of Ruin portal use portal recall and take the «Silyun» portal at 90,6N 51.0W - right infront of you). L|2|•|⟦ChasingOswaldRuschkIceHold⟧
H3|Part 2: Ruschk Icehold L|1|1.|Again, take the Plains of Ruin portal at 87.7N 69.7W in «Silyun» and run south to «Ruschk Icehold» at 87.3N 51.8W. (You can also take the surface portal in 90 Eaters if you know someone with that tie.) L|1|2.|Stick left from the drop and in the last large room there is another corpse in an alcove on the south wall. Loot «Varette's Orders» from the corpse and return it to the «Huntsman of Silyun» (If you took the Plains of Ruin portal use portal recall and take the «Silyun» portal at 90,6N 51.0W - right infront of you). L|2|•|⟦ChasingOswaldViamontPrison⟧
H3|Part 3: Viamontian Royal Prison L|1|1.|Go to «Eastwatch» through Town Network, (Annex, last portal on the left side) then run north to the «Viamontian Royal Prison» at 92.0N 41.6W. L|1|2.|From the drop stick to the middle until you come to a room with an acid pit in the middle, go north to a small room where you'll go east, continue east until you come to a large L shaped room, there's a small hallway leading up in the middle of the room where you'll find a lever that opens a door on the far east side of the room. Use the lever and go through the door and continue east until you come to a T intersection, go north to a green room, there's two hidden walls here. Use the hidden wall on the east wall near the NE corner of the room. L|1|3.|Past several doors is the «Royal Prison Warden» who drops the «Prison Warden's Orders» and «Prison Warden's Key». Use the key to open the «Prison Warden's Chest» that contains the «Seven Habits of Effective Adventurers» and «Oswald's Prison Journal». L|1|4.|{OPT} Near the chest is a lever that opens the door to the prison cell to the north across the large acid pit. Use the lever then from the top level jump across to the platform before the cell door. On the «Prison Guard's Corpse» in the cell is a «Note to a generous host». L|1|5.|Return to «Silyun» and give «Huntsman of Silyun» first «Oswald's Prison Journal», then give him the «Seven Habits of Effective Adventurers», he will then award your bonus «Skill Credit». (Note there's no explicit message regarding the credit, your credits just go up by one when you hand the 2nd book). L|2|•|⟦OswaldJournal⟧ L|2|•|⟦OswaldManualCompleted⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Lugian Ice Tunnels» 93.3N, 50.1W -- «map:001C¦001C» TR|«Ruschk Icehold» 87.3N, 51.8W -- «map:001D¦001D» TR|«Viamontian Royal Prison» 92.0N, 41.6W -- «map:001E¦001E» TE
H2|Rewards L|1|•|One additional «Skill Credit».
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Huntsman of Silyun tells you, "You are new to Silyun, are you? If you are a skilled hunter, you may be of some use for me, in helping me track the most dangerous quarry of all: the assassin, Oswald! Of course, first you must prove your skill. Bring me the jaw of an Abhorrent, Ravenous, or Insatiable Eater, and we will talk of how you may help me."
L|1||Handing in Abhorrent Eater Jaw⸩ ⸨You give Huntsman of Silyun Abhorrent Eater Jaw.⸩ ⸨Huntsman of Silyun tells you, "So, you are indeed a mighty hunter of beasts. How are you as a hunter of men? I have been tracking the infamous assassin, Oswald, for some time. By last report, he traveled into a series of tunnels belonging to those grey giants, the Lugians. Please journey into the Lugian Ice Tunnels, located at 93.3N, 50.1W , and bring back any evidence of Oswald's whereabouts."
L|1||Handing in Note to Alvirre⸩ ⸨You give Huntsman of Silyun Note to Alvirre.⸩ ⸨Huntsman of Silyun tells you, "This is what you found in the Lugian Ice Tunnels? Most curious. It seems that Oswald has taken an interest in the Ruschk, for some reason. I believe the location to which he refers is the Ruschk Icehold. You can find it at 87.3N, 51.8W. Please go there and continue the investigation."
L|1||Handing in Varette's Orders⸩ ⸨You give Huntsman of Silyun Varette's Orders.⸩ ⸨Huntsman of Silyun tells you, "And this is the evidence of Oswald that you found in the Ruschk Icehold? Interesting, indeed. So Varicci seeks the assassin for his own purposes. If the King's soldiers have captured Oswald, then they would have taken him to the Royal Prison. That grim dungeon is located at 92.0N, 41.6W. Please go there and see if Oswald is, indeed, in captivity."
L|1||Handing in Oswald's Prison Journal⸩ ⸨You give Huntsman of Silyun Oswald's Prison Journal.⸩ ⸨Huntsman of Silyun tells you, "Ah, a very interesting look into the mind of this most troublesome killer. This gives me much to think about. Consider your service ended. I thank you for your assistance..."⸩ ⸨Huntsman of Silyun tells you, "Oswald's journal makes note of a skill manual he wrote, in Tracker's Script. That is a secret language known only by the most accomplished hunters and trackers of Ispar. If you find that skill manual, I could translate it for you and train you to be more skillful."
L|1||Handing in Seven Habits of Effective Adventurers⸩ ⸨You give Huntsman of Silyun Seven Habits of Effective Adventurers.⸩ ⸨Huntsman of Silyun tells you, "This is the skill manual that Oswald wrote about in his journal. It is written in a most curious cipher. This is in Tracker's Script, which was a coded language used among the most accomplished hunters of Ispar. That is a very interesting clue to Oswald's background. Let me decipher it for you..."
L|1||Speaking to the Huntsman of Silyun after completing the quest⸩ ⸨Huntsman of Silyun tells you, "Excuse me? I believe we have already done our business. You have chased Oswald as far as he could be chased, and I have trained you in skill to reward your efforts. Please ask no more of me."⸩

Quest.name: Dericost_Ritual_Investigation
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|30 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Sir Learth» I|Starts At|«Cabin by the Frozen Valley» at 83.8N, 4.3W I|Route|«Stonehold» to «Wisp Lake Cottages» portal at 69.6N, 20.2W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Ritual Investigation» H2|Overview L|1|•|Completing this quest allows you to access the «Halt Dericost Ritual Quest».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Sir Learth». L|2|•|⟦RitualHuntStarted_0311⟧ L|1|2.|«Sir Learth» will ask you to track down 10 «Enchanted Mnemosyne»s. L|2|1.|83.7N, 6.7W - «Frozen Valley» - In the Valley. Due west of where the quest starts. L|2|2.|65.7S, 44.1W - «Graveyard» - Inside a bunker ahead and slightly to the right as you come out of the Mhoire Forge Recall Bunker. L|2|3.|2.5S, 16.4E - «Large Mnemosyne Collection Site» - Just outside of «Samsur». Large Mnemonsyne (last portal in the place), to your left as you materialize. L|2|4.|32.8N, 66.7E - in a Tower at the «32.5N, 66.1E - Skeleton Fort¦Skeleton Fort» («Jacob's Axe Quest») - Skeleton Fort portal in the «Facility Hub» 35+ Section East side, ahead and to the right, run from the base up. L|2|5.|87.6S, 65.5W - «Anadil's Tomb» - East of «Candeth Keep». If running from Candeth Keep, the first tomb, down inside and to the right. If coming via Sylsfear portal, last tomb. L|2|6.|17.0S, 57.3W - «Chalicmere Castle» - Give Sake to the «Drunken Madman» at 53.0S 61.0E in the «Ridge Tower» south of «Baishi» then take the Outside Accursed Halls portal, alternatively you can use a Portal to Izji Qo's Temple if you have one hooked at your Allegiance Mansion. Use the door at the middle inside of the castle, and run around to the right inside the walls to the end where the Mnemosyne is. L|2|7.|64.1N, 13.2E - «Mountain Cavern» - Right before the locked door, to the left in the corner. This is the Shortcut portal to Frore in Crater at 64.1N, 13.2E...up and to the left. L|3||**Note**: If you are below level 200, you will need to complete the Standing Stones section of the «Frore» quest in order to get this and the next Mnemosyne. L|2|8.|Inside - «Frore» - Past the Mountain Cavern, in the first room on top of the ledge on the right. 500 jump to get up there. L|2|9.|17.3N, 32.8E - «Catacombs of the Forgotten» - Portal in «Facility Hub» 25+Section located in the east side room. Just stick to a wall and go down when you can.The mnemosyne is in an alcove in the East room before where the Note from Mi Krau-Li is found. L|2|10.|10.3N, 54.9E - «Trothyr's Rest» - near Altar of Asheron (Rithwic Portal {Aluvian Wing} town network). You'll need to pick at least one door. L|2|•|First: ⟦EnchantedMnemosynesFound⟧ L|1|3.|Talk to «Sir Learth» again for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦RitualHuntCompleted_0311⟧ L|2|•|⟦RitualHuntRepeat_0311⟧ L|2|•|⟦HaltDericostRitualQuestFlag⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "Greetings, Citizen."⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "Lord Asheron, using several clues and occurrences, has determined that the Dericost Emperor, Geraine, is using a powerful ritual which is destabilizing both the mana and temporal flows of this world."⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "Due to the clue Sir Donovan found in the report on the Bloodstones, the Prince believes that the ritual mentioned is likely the one causing the disturbances my Lord Asheron has detected. This is why I am organizing the hunt for this site from here."⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "I am seeking adventurers who will help me put an end to this treacherous and dangerous ritual Geraine is performing. To that end, we must first locate this ritual, and pierce whatever defenses are guarding it."⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "My Lord Asheron tells me that to conduct a ritual of this magnitude in secret, they would need to have created a series of anchors, or points, with which to feed power to the ritual as well as shield it from outside magics."⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "These anchor points will most likely be made using something dear to the Dericost, though we have not confirmed what that may be yet. These points are also most likely in places of power where the undead are in control."⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "My Lord Asheron believes that there should be ten of these points, scattered throughout Dereth. Any less, and the mana flow would not be strong enough to empower a temporal ritual. Any more, and the energy flows of the wards themselves would be detectable."⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "As we do not yet know specifically what and where to seek, I am gathering any and all willing to help me in my goal. I will place an enchantment upon you, that should let you interact with these points, and draw information out of them which will allow Lord Asheron and the Prince to both pinpoint and breach the defensive magics of the ritual site."⸩ ⸨Sir Learth chants softly for a moment, and a warm sensation flows over you.⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "That should do it. Hunt well, and good luck."
L|1||Mnemosyne interaction⸩ ⸨You use the enchantment Sir Learth bestowed upon you to extract the information from the enchanted mnemosyne.
L|1||Mnemosyne interaction, repeat⸩ ⸨The enchantment Sir Learth bestowed upon you begins to interact with the enchanted mnemosyne, but then the power recedes, as you have already gained all you can from this mnemosyne.
L|1||Rewards Dialog (first time)⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "I can sense the changes in the enchantment I placed upon you. I take it you found the points I asked you to?"⸩ ⸨Sir Learth chants for a moment, and there is a flare of energy that jumps from your hand to his.⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "Ahh, yes. You have found all of the points. I'm not skilled enough in Geomancy to read these findings, but Lord Asheron and the Prince should be able to decipher them."⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "I'll pass this info along to them. Thank you again for your assistance. Once we pinpoint the ritual and breach the wards, we'll have more work for you."⸩ ⸨You've earned 48,061,586 experience.
L|1||Rewards Dialog (repeats)⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "You have another batch of information for me, wonderful."⸩ ⸨Sir Learth chants for a moment, and there is a flare of energy that jumps from your hand to his.⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "Thank you again for your assistance. The more information we gain from the points, the better our chances of breaching their defenses."⸩ ⸨You've earned 210,046,659 experience.
L|1||Speaking with Learth, before timer expires⸩ ⸨Sir Learth tells you, "Thank you. The information you have provided me should allow Lord Asheron and the Prince to track down the exact location of the ritual Geraine is using to alter the timestream, as well as pierce its wards."⸩

Quest.name: Empyrean_Rescue_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Emissary of Asheron (Cragstone)¦Emissary of Asheron» I|Starts At|«Cragstone» at 24.4N, 48.3E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Empyrean Rescue» H2|Overview P|Come to Asheron's aid in rescuing a pocket of trapped Empyreans.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You must be a «Knight» in a society faction in order to have access to «Freebooter Isle» where they are being held. This quest requires making two trips to Freebooter, so it is best if everyone is a «Master» and can use the statue in the society stronghold. L|1|•|There are several spots where it is easy to die and very difficult to recover a corpse, so beware of bringing items you might lose if you die. L|1|•|Bringing a royal runed bow or xbow for use on destroyable doors can be helpful.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Glowing Apostate Shard L|1|1.|Talk with «Emissary of Asheron (Cragstone)¦Emissary of Asheron». L|2|•|⟦EmpyreanRescueStarted_0910⟧ L|1|2.|After speaking with the Emmisary of Asheron, travel to «Freebooter Isle» and run north to 54.0S, 97.6E where you will find an open magma tube style entrance (just north of a similar entrance used for «Defeating Bandit Mana Hunter Boss»). L|1|3.|Stay left and you will find a portal not too far inside the cave. L|1|4.|Inside the first dungeon, continue staying left for a long time and you will eventually find an «Apostate Nexus Master». Kill him and everyone loot a «Dark Apostate Shard» (drops 9). L|2|•|⟦DarkApostateShardPickupTimer⟧ L|1|5.|Return the shard to the Emissary in Cragstone who will give you a «Glowing Apostate Shard» with a 60 minute timer. L|2|•|⟦SparklingPortalFlag_0910⟧
H3|Part 2: Sparkling Portal L|1|1.|Return to the same dungeon on Freebooter and look for a blotchy/hazy looking portal. These are closed portals that spawn in fixed locations in a couple of places in the dungeon (sticking left you will pass two or three). L|2|•|Note: The closed portals won't show up on radar, you have to look for them visually (See notes below). L|1|2.|Find and open Sparkling Portal by using the Glowing Apostate Shard on the swirling portals and take it to enter the second dungeon. L|1|3.|The second dungeon has several maze sections of interconnected rooms that you will have to navigate. It is possible to run through the dungeon without fighting, but it is easy to get stuck at certain spots due to the narrow hallways and the size of the Gear Knight enemies. At the end of the dungeon, you'll find an «Apostate Nexus Guardian» in a room with two surface portals (don't take either). Kill the guardian in the main room to avoid portal spawning issues. When the guardian dies, a white Gateway portal will open to the third dungeon. Take the portal. L|2|•|The mini map plugin helps to make navigating the maze sections easier.
H3|Part 3: Pyramid Traps and Boss L|1|1.|In the third and final dungeon, you will quickly come to a killable door. Take it out and proceed forward. L|1|2.|Go slowly as you'll soon come to a hallway with pyramid traps similar to «The Jester» and «Hoshino Must Die». The pyramids are typically instant death if you get hit by one. Using a pierce protection rare will negate all damage. There are five sets of alcoves on the sides of the hallway and you'll need to run from side to side (no more than one intersection at a time) until you make it past the pyramids. It is safest to wait until there are two pyramids close together that go past, then run to the next alcove. Then wait and repeat. The timing is fairly lenient so as long as you don't fumble your turns or the start of your running you should make it through ok. L|1|3.|At this point the dungeon changes textures and the mobs start to get very dangerous. The undead and skeletons hit extremely hard and the hallways are so narrow that it is easy to become stuck if running. Remember that the dungeon is loggable though, it can help if you get really stuck. L|1|4.|Continue until you get to a room with «Wailing Statue»s and a door blocking the exit. Have ranged characters destroy the door, or if there aren't any, there is a safe spot just in front of it where the statues don't hit you. L|1|5.|Continue down passing three cooled lava doors that are destroyable. After this is the jump down to the boss room. Be sure to re-buff before jumping down as the boss room is a hot landing. L|1|6.|The boss room has a mostly invisible floor which is suspended over the lava. Several Undead Commanders are in the boss room by default. The first portion of the fight can be very dangerous, as the Undead Commanders hit very hard. L|2|•|{WARN} «Sparkling Portal»s may appear in the lava room - be careful not to enter one. L|1|7.|After all the Undead Commanders and other spawns have been killed two named Undead («Filinuvekta Exarch» and «Filinuvekta Hieromancer») will spawn. They each drop the robe they are wearing when they die (decorative purposes only). L|1|8.|Once those 2 are killed an «Engorged Bloodstone» will spawn (some have reported that using the glowing shard causes it to spawn). The bloodstone will not attack unless it is attacked first. This is a good time for anyone who died to get back to the boss room if possible. Note that some of the minor spawns in the boss room will respawn after a few minutes. L|1|9.|Once everyone is ready, destroy the bloodstone. Everyone should then loot an «Engorged Bloodstone Shard». It drops more than 9 (amount?) per kill. The entire boss fight sequence has to be repeated to get more shards if necessary. L|2|•|⟦EngorgedBloodstoneShardPickupTimer⟧ L|1|10.|Once everyone has looted, move to the far side of the room where you'll find the wall has opened. Do a medium tap jump over the gap to the legendary rewards room. L|1|11.|Loot a 3 use «Legendary Key» from the ground in the middle and use it on the chests. L|2|•|⟦ERQLegKeyPickupTimer⟧ L|1|12.|Return the shard to the Emissary of Asheron in Cragstone for your robe, xp, and luminance rewards. An animation of the Empyreans who were rescued is displayed after each person turns in their shard. L|2|•|⟦EmpyreanRescueCompleted_1010⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|The dynamic for the portals is that they activate every 12-15 minutes and turn red for 60 seconds and are named Sparkling Portal. During this phase you can enter the portal if you have the glowing shard in your inventory (you do not need to use the shard). While red, the portal also shows up on radar. So if you happen to get lucky and get there while it is red, just go right in. After the minute is up the portal will "disintegrate" and appear purple and hazy again. Some players have had the portal disappear entirely, if this happens continue on until you find another. The portals are a somewhat random spawn. If no portals are found, kill creatures within the dungeon and a portal will have a chance to spawn. After repeated testing it appears that despite the shard's description, using it has no effect on portals. It's just a matter of waiting for the portal to open on its own.

H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Greetings!" L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "I have been sent here to ask adventurers, such as yourself, to aid in a rather delicate situation my Lord Asheron has found himself in." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "We have found another pocket of temporal and portalspace disturbances similar to the ones located in the Iron Blade foothold in the Direlands." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "This newer disturbance is located along a mana flow underneath the volcano on the north end of the place locally referred to as 'Freebooter Isle'." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Be warned, however, that this disturbance seems more powerful than the ones in the Direlands, and as it sits on a known Ley Line, the potential threat is far greater." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Gather strong friends, bring them all to me, so I may offer them what protections I can, and then begin your hunt." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Now, as to those mentioned protections..." L|1||The Emissary of Asheron utters a single, harsh sounding word, and a tingle washes over you. L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Find the force or entity responsible, end it. Return to me with proof, or better; a way to save my lord's people, and I'll reward you for it." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Any questions?"
L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Hello again! Have you located the source of the disturbance that is blocking my Lord Asheron's ritual from rescuing the pocket of Empyreans he has located?" L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "The main source of the disruption seems to be coming from an area under the Freebooter Isle Volcano, likely inside one of the steam vents that riddle the area." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Be warned, though, the portalspace disruptions in the area are massive, and my lord Asheron also believes there is a large scale temporal disturbance being shielded by the portalspace disruptions." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Take friends, be careful."
H3|Giving Dark Apostate Shard to Emissary of Asheron L|1||You allow Emissary of Asheron to examine your Dark Apostate Shard. L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Interesting. Quest.name: Halt_Dericost_Ritual_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|200 I|Type|Multi-Fellowship I|Starts With|«Lady Daenerah» I|Starts At|«Cabin by the Frozen Valley» at 83.8N, 4.3W I|Route|«Stonehold» to «Wisp Lake Cottages» portal at 69.6N, 20.2W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Ritual Disruption» H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest requires first-timers to complete the «Dericost Ritual Investigation» to flag for entry to the dungeon.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|After completing the Dericost Ritual Investigation, talk to «Lady Daenerah» at the «Cabin by the Frozen Valley». L|2|•|⟦RitualTimeStarted_0411⟧ L|1|2.|Travel to the Menhir Ring at 21.7S, 9.4E L|2|•|Route: «Al-Arqas» to «Djinaya Wind Cottages» portal at 33.5S, 13.1E. L|1|3.|Use the west «Menhir» (21.7S, 9.4E) to portal into the first dungeon. L|1|4.|This dungeon has 4 «Enchanted Mnemosyne»s that must be used to flag for entry to the second part of the dungeon. High level Undead, Bloodstones and Skeletons abound in both dungeons, including highly dangerous «Undead Commander»s. L|2|•|First: ⟦CavernEnchantedMnemosynesFound⟧ L|1|5.|After using all four Mnemosynes, take the surface portal and use the eastern Menhir to portal into the second dungeon. L|1|6.|The dungeon is linear, jump down two jumps and run to a third. This is a good spot to rebuff and/or park a healer. Only 1-2 creatures spawn at the top of the third jump. L|2|•|{OPT} In a side room off the main hall in this dungeon, pick up the «Large Tome», which is used in the «Strathelar Royal Cloak Quest». L|3|•|⟦LargeTome3PickupTimer⟧ L|1|7.|When ready, jump down and clear the large ritual room. Loot the dead «Corpse of Royal Knight¦Aluvian Soldiers» for a «Broken Shield» (lore item). L|1|8.|After clearing, use the «Bloody Breastplate» on the ground to begin a cutscene involving «Apparition of Borelean Strathelar¦Borelean», «Apparition of Hoshino Kei¦Hoshino Kei», and «Apparition of Emperor Geraine¦Geraine». L|1|9.|After the cutscene, more Bloodstones, Undead, and Skeletons will spawn, followed by «Lord Winstead» and his accompanying «Filinuvekta Hieromancer»s. The Hieromancers cast level 8 vulns and wars, and are quite dangerous. L|2|•|{OPT} Shield yourself from incoming war magic spells by hiding behind the pillars. L|1|10.|After killing Lord Winstead, loot the «Sealed Tome» from his corpse (he drops 30). L|2|•|⟦SealedTomePickupTimer⟧ L|1|11.|Enter the «Hidden Treasury» portal which spawns in the alcove after Lord Winstead is killed. L|2|•|Note: Sometimes the portal has failed to spawn. It may be safest to kill Lord Winstead on the north side of the room as that side seems to always spawn the portal. L|1|12.|Loot a 4 use «Legendary Key» from the altars in the middle of the room and use on the nearby chests. L|2|•|⟦DericostLegKeyPickupTimer⟧ L|1|13.|Return to «Lady Daenerah» and give her the Sealed Tome for luminance and experience points. L|2|•|⟦RitualTimeCompleted_0411⟧
