H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "Greetings, Citizen." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "Prince Borelean has stationed me here to aid adventurers, such as yourself, in the attacks against Emperor Geraine's ritual which has been altering the timeline." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "As you have recently aided Sir Learth, I can pull the information from his enchantment and the mnemosynes you found in order to allow you to bypass the wards that protect the location." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "Once inside, it'll be up to you to locate and disrupt the ritual itself. Bring me back whatever you find." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "Even better, if you can bring back something vital to their ritual as proof of your success, you will be handsomely rewarded." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "From what Lord Asheron was able to divine from Sir Learth's research, the ritual site is a nexus, previously hidden, in the desert east of Yaraq. Find the point where that nexus touches the surface of the desert, and you should be able to find a way in." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "Now, let's see about those protections." L|1||Lady Daenerah touches your head, and a series of slight vibrations passes through your body as her spells draw forth the needed information, and then turn it into a protective enchantment. L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "There, that should be all you need to gain access to the site. From that point on, you are on your own." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "I expect it will be very dangerous in there, so you should go with similarly attuned friends." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "Just be sure that they come to me first! I'd hate for them to get there and then have the outer wards fry them to death."
L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "Were you able to locate the ritual yet? According to Lord Asheron's scrying, it should be located somewhere east of Yaraq, in the desert."
H3|Cut Scene Dialog L|1||The apparitions that haunt this artifact begin to stir. L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "Ah, there you are my child. I have been expecting thee." L|1||With a wave of his hand, the Apparition of Emperor Geraine magically pins Hoshino Kei to the ground. L|1||Apparition of Hoshino Kei says, "Arggh!" L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "Oh no, whelp. You will not be interfering today. There is much here for you to learn, and I'd hate to have to kill you before then." L|1||With a wave of his hand, the Apparition of Emperor Geraine magically pins Borelean to the ground. L|1||Apparition of Borelean says, "Arggh!" L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "That's better. Stay there for a while, and lern something for once." L|1||Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "You... You're the one ... who warned me about my mother's assassination... Why?" L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "That was a pivotal moment in your timeline, boy." L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "That assassination would've driven forth a timeline that was... less than optimal to my plans." L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "Your actions saved me a great deal of effort in this ritual, I should thank you." L|1||The Apparition of Emperor Geraine smiles. L|1||Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "Leave... Her... Alone!" L|1||Apparition of Emperor Gerain says, "And, I should thank you for bringing your darling wife here. I've been waiting for her to come back to me." L|1||The Apparition of Borelean Strathelar struggles against the magical bonds that hold him. L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "Oh, I'm afraid I cannot do that, boy.." L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "You see, she has been a key to my success for some time." L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "Why did you think I had my undead kidnap her all those months ago?" L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "I set in her the preparations needed to sacrifice her to the Book, so as to complete this ritual in its entirety." L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "You came here to stop me, but all you accomplished was guaranteeing my success." L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "For that, I thank you." L|1||Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "NO!!!!" L|1||The Apparition of Borelean Strathelar struggles against the magical bonds that hold him, almost escaping before the magic redoubles and pins him to the ground. L|1||The Apparition of Emperor Geraine points at Borelean in mocking laughter. L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "It will take more than that to break my hold on thee, boy. ow sit quiet and watch. You're about to see history remade..." L|1||With a screm that tears through your heart and soul, Hoshino Kei dies. L|1||The Apparition of Emperor Geraine laughs maniacally. L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "Ahh, boy, you have made all of these long plans so worthwhile." L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "For that gift, and the soul of your wife, I'll send her corpse to you after you leave this place." L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "I'm afraid that's all of her that you will be getting back, however." L|1||The Apparition of Emperor Geraine smiles. L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "The Book is a rather voracious eater when it comes to certain sacrifices." L|1||The Apparition of Emperor Geraine sighs. L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "Now, I tire of this." L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "Die." L|1||The Apparition of Borelean Strathelar lets out a strangled grunt as the life is crushed out of him and he is whisked back to the Lifestone. L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "No one can stop me now. Not you, whelp, not your precious mother and not even your upstart of a tutor, Asheron." L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "With this sacrifice, this retual will be anchored in eternity!" L|1||The Apparition of Emperor Geraine pulls a struggling ball of light from Hoshino Kei's chest. L|1||Apparition of Emperor Geraine says, "Begin the final stage of the Ritual! Our victory is now at hand!" L|1||A hot, dry wind blows through the chamber as the vision fades. Shortly thereafter, a ripple seems to pass through everything, and the world shifts. L|1||The air shimmers and hums with power as time itself shifts, revealing the Time Ritual's defenders.
H3|Lord Winstead L|1||As Lord Winstead collapses into dust, a maniacal voice echoes in your mind, "You are too late, ! The world is irrevocably changed!" L|1||With the lead ritualist's death, the temporal distortions caused by the ritual fade.
L|1||The air shimmers all around you and you have a vision of a city in the desert. Far in the distance, behind the city and lit by the setting sun, you can see Yaraq on the coast. as quickly as the vision comes to you, it fades. L|1||As Lord Winstead collapses into dust, a maniacal voice echoes in your mind, "You are a fool, ! Disrupting me only delays the inevitable!" L|1||With the lead ritualist's death, the temporal distortions caused by the ritual fade.
H3|Giving Broken Shield to Daenerah L|1||You give Lady Daenerah Broken Shield. L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "Where did you get this?" L|1||You explain how you found the shield on a corpse in the ritual room. L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "Ahh, yes. I heard about that..." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "It was a very sad day for the kingdom. When we first identified the location of the ritual, the Prince and Princess took a squad of knights and attacked the ritual." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "They were underprepared for what they would face. Geraine massacred them all, and sacrificed the Princess to his ritual..." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "About an hour after they all returned to their lifestones, the Princess's body appeared in her rooms." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "No amount of magic tried thus far has done anything to bring her back..." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "Poor Borelean. He's devastated, and is refusing to see anyone at present." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "It was after that attack that I was sent here to organize further attacks. You adventurers have the most uncanny success rate, historically speaking."
H3|Rewards Dialog L|1||You allow Lady Daenerah to examine your Sealed Tome. L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "What is this?" L|1||You hand over 1 of your Sealed Tomes. L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "Is this the Book of Eibhil!?!" L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "No, it can't be, could it?" L|1||Lady Daenerah casts a quick spell and a tiny portal opens. She quickly passes the sealed tome into the portal. A moment later, her expression goes blank, like her focus is wholly elsewhere... L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "I see..." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "It would seem that the sealed tome you brought me both is and is not the Book of Eibhil. Geraine has somehow either made empowered copies of the book, or somehow broken the Book into aspects. Lord Asheron is not yet sure which." L|1||Lady Daenerah tells you, "Either way, you have helped remove a dangerous artifact from the hands of the Dericost. Please, accept this as a reward, with our thanks." L|1||Lady Daenerah gives you Empowered Robe of the Perfect Light. L|1||Lady Daenerah gives you Legendary Key L|1||You've earned 502,789,262 experience. L|1||You've earned 40,000 Luminance.
H3|Other Interactions L|1||As you activate the runes in the order Lady Daenerah gave you, you can feel the buildup of energy in the menhir stone.
L|1||You use the enchantments placed upon you to attune your aura to the enchanted mnemosyne.
L|1||As you touch the menhir stone, the enchantments from the ritual markers allow you to bypass the ward and activate the planar magics held within.
H4|Showing the broken shield to NPCs L|1||You allow Asheron to examine your Broken Shield. L|1||Asheron looks sad for a moment. L|1||Asheron tells you, "This is the remnant of a very sad day. I was not there, and as such I will not speak of it. Take that shield to Lady Daenerah. She can explain the events to you if she wishes."
L|1||You allow Lord Dargeth to examine your Broken Shield. L|1||Lord Dargeth tells you, "Where did you get this?" L|1||You explain how you found the shield on a corpse in the ritual room hidden under the desert, where Emperor Geraine was performing his rituals to alter time. L|1||Lord Dargeth tells you, "Ahh, so you've seen. I won't speak more of it. If you wish to hear the tale, try Lady Daenerah. She sent you to that abominable place, she can explain what happened."

Quest.name: Lunnum's_Return
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|120 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Fiun Layeel» I|Starts At|95.9N, 56.8W at the «Fiun Outpost» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Lunnum's Return» I|Quest Chain|Lunnum I|1|«Lunnum's Pyre» I|2|«Lunnum's Disappearance» I|3|«Lunnum's Return» H2|Overview L|1|•|When repeating the quest, you do not need to do part 1.
H2|Walkthrough H3|Part 1: Blue Face Paint Recipe L|1|1.|After speaking with «Fiun Layeel» at the «Fiun Outpost» head to «Nuhmudira's Mansion» at 4.0S, 36.0E. L|2|•|Route: From «Lytelthorpe», take the «Devana» portal at 2.2N, 50.4E. L|1|2.|Run down to the basement and use «Nuhmudira's Dungeon» portal. L|1|3.|From the drop, head Northwest and use the «Bookcase (Dungeon)¦Bookcase» portal (middle bookcase in a series of 3 bookcases), to be portaled into the Bookcase Dungeon. L|1|4.|Head down the ramp and begin destroying «Storage Crate (Nuhmudira's Dungeon)¦Storage Crates» until you find a «Blue Face Paint Recipe», which will appear on the floor. L|1|5.|Once you have your recipe, return to Fiun Outpost and hand the recipe to Fiun Layeel to be flagged for the «Temple Entrance». L|2|•|⟦templeentranceflagged⟧ L|2|•|⟦LunnumsReturnStarted1006⟧
H3|Part 2: Temple Entrance L|1|1.|Use the «Temple Entrance» portal at 84.3N 24.7E. L|2|•|Route: «Celdiseth's Portal Gem», or from «Arwic», take the «Dagger Vale» portal at 32.9N 59.4E. L|1|2.|From the drop, hug the left wall all the way down until you reach a room with an undead «Patrician Phaerix». L|1|3.|Kill the «Patrician Phaerix» and loot the «East Temple Key» from its body. L|1|4.|Using the key, open the wooden door to the south, and use the lever at the bottom of the ramp, which opens the gate to the small west room. L|1|5.|Move through the gate to another large room containing another undead, «Patrician Kilkitris». L|2|•|Note: Keep 1 person in the middle chamber while you kill the 2nd undead, so if the gate closes, they can re-open it with the wall lever. L|1|6.|Kill «Patrician Kilkitris», loot the «West Temple Key», and repeat the process of using the key to unlock the wooden door and use the lever, which opens the gate that leads down to «Lunnum». L|2|•|{TIP} Using the lever past the West Temple Doors activates both the door leading to the middle room AND the door leading to Lunnum. It is a good idea to hit the lever past the second locked door after waiting a few minutes for the door to the middle room to close. Hitting the lever then will open both doors and give you passage to Lunnum without worrying about leaving someone in the middle room (if you are soloing, for instance). L|1|7.|When you reach Lunnum, debuff and kill her. L|2|•|{TIP} Its a good idea to perch on the east or west alcoves and kill her from a distance. This way she cannot reach you. You can also fight her in the room behind where she spawns. She only has around 3k stamina. With stamina bolts and innervation, an archer can quickly machine gun her down. L|1|8.|Once dead, loot a «Ritual Chest Key» from her corpse (she drops 30), and head south up the ramp to the chest room. L|2|•|{TIP} If your character is 275 or doesn't need the rewards, there is no pickup timer on the chest items, only on the key. This means you can unlock the chest and let someone else loot so they can pickup the items and turn them in for xp. L|2|•|⟦ritualchestkeypickuptimer⟧ L|1|9.|Loot «Lunnum's Chest» and loot your rewards L|1|10.|Return to «Fiun Outpost» and give «Lunnum's Token» to «Fiun Layeel» to receive XP. L|2|•|⟦LunnumsReturnComplete1006⟧ L|2|•|If you let Andrilos live in "Lunnum's Disappearance": ⟦AndrilosLivesExtraXP⟧ and ⟦AndrilosLivesExtraXPWait⟧ L|1|11.|{OPT} If you don't want your «Fiun Crown», hand it to «Fiun Layeel» for an additional experience reward. L|1|12.|{OPT} If you don't want your «Black Skull of Xikma», hand it to «Fiun Layeel» for additional XP.

L|1||Handing in Lunnum's Token⸩ ⸨You give Fiun Layeel Lunnum's Token.⸩ ⸨Fiun Layeel tells you, "It is a shame what became of Lunnum. Quest.name: Nalicana's_Test
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|200 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Nalicana» I|Starts At|«Asheron's Castle» I|Route|«Eastham» to «Asheron's Island» portal at 17.9N, 64.3E I|Repeat|Non Repeatable I|Contracts|«Contract for Nalicana's Test» H2|Overview P|This quest allows you to begin earning «luminance» points from various higher level creatures and quests. «Luminance» is a critical game mechanic in advancing a character in Asheron's Call. This quest is therefore essential for character progression beyond level 200.
L|1|•|The quests «Gurog Creation», «Bloodstone Investigation», and the «Gurog Kill Task» all overlap with this quest and can be completed at the same time, if desired. It is not uncommon for higher level players who are already luminance flagged to accompany those who are just over level 200 to complete this quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|«Nalicana» will give you the quest contract, «Contract for Nalicana's Test». L|2|•|⟦OracleLuminanceRewardsQuestStart_1110⟧ L|2|•|⟦OraclePortalEntry⟧ L|1|2.|Travel to the «Frozen Valley», and enter the «Gurog Ice Cave» at 84.9N, 7.1W. L|2|•|Route/Shortcut: «Stonehold» to «Wisp Lake Cottages» portal at 69.7N, 20.2W. L|2|•|Alternate Route: Cragstone to Far Horizon Cottages Portal at 26.1N, 46.3E takes you to the area of the Temple of Forgetfulness. Gurog Ice Caves are a short run from there. L|2|•|{OPT} After taking the shortcut, speak with «Gregoria, Gurog Destroyer» at 83.8N, 4.3W to first start the «Gurog Kill Task». L|1|3.|One of the three Gurogs in the first room drops the «Entryway Key» used on the second door (700 difficulty). L|1|4.|Go straight ahead and take the portal to the «Frozen Tomb». L|2|•|{OPT} Complete «Gurog Creation» in the current dungeon 1st before proceeding to the «Frozen Tomb». L|1|5.|Continue forward through linear hallways, killing the Gurogs as you go. L|1|6.|Once you reach the maze-like section, hug the right hand wall and follow the path until you see the hallway ahead open into a larger room. L|1|7.|Defeat «Battle Lord Gregor». L|1|8.|Loot «Battle Lord Gregor's Mnemosyne». L|2|•|{OPT} If you are also completing «Bloodstone Investigation», proceed into the room ahead and loot the scroll. L|1|9.|Return the mnemosyne to «Nalicana» in «Asheron's Castle» to receive your rewards. L|2|•|⟦OracleLuminanceRewardsAccess_1110⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|If you are quick, you can run directly to the last room with the Frozen Tomb portal without fighting. L|1|•|It you're a melee fighter, it's safest to kill the Gurogs through the doors before opening them. L|1|•|When fighting Gregor, staying in the back of the hallway prevents the nearby Gurogs from reaching you. L|1|•|When everyone is ready, have mages and missile characters lure him out of the room and down the hallway. He is undead and is vulnerable to undead slayer and fire attacks. L|1|•|Battle Lord Gregor respawns about twice as often as the eight «Gurog Soldier»s who surround him.
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Gurog Ice Cave» 84.9N, 7.1W -- -- TR|«Frozen Tomb» 84.9N, 7.1W -- -- TE
H2|Rewards L|1|•|Ability to earn «Luminance»
R| RK|Luminance|15,000 RK|Items| RI|«Luminance, and the Paths of the Empyrean» RI|«Empyrean Robe (Blue)» RE
H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Nalicana tells you, "Greetings, I am Nalicana, the Seer of the Yalain." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "Due to several factors, including both the return of the... altered... Empyreans, as well as Geraine's manipulations of time via the Book of Eibhil, the Light has empowered several Seers, including myself." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "We may, in turn, empower those who prove their worth to walk the ancient Empyrean Paths, and gain power from the Light itself, known as Luminance." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "The different eras of Empyrean history have each empowered a Path, from our beginnings in the Paths of the Falatacot, through the more recent Dericost and Haebrean Paths, up to the Path of the Yalain." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "To prove your worth, and be empowered to gain Luminance, my task for you is fairly straightforward. There is an Undead, known as Battle Lord Gregor. He is one of Geraine's top nobles, and is the overseer of the forces which now include the beings called Gurog." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "Hidden deep in the area held by these Gurog, he organizes the forces Geraine has chosen to put forth. Find him, defeat him, and bring me his Mnemosyne. Contained therein, we hope to find much knowledge on what Geraine is up to." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "The Gurog have emerged in an area of the mountains of Northern Osteth. You'll find the Battle Lord deep in the caves there."
H3|Lord Gregor L|1||Battle Lord Gregor is reduced to cinders! L|1||Battle Lord Gregor tells you, "Fool. Killing me will not change anything back to what it was. It's too late for that now."
H3|Rewards Dialog L|1||You allow Nalicana to examine your Battle Lord Gregor's Mnemosyne. L|1||You hand over all of your Battle Lord Gregor's Mnemosynes. L|1||Nalicana tells you, "Thank you for this. Lord Asheron should be able to learn much from it, to help counter Geraine's mad schemes." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "You have completed the task I have set before you. Now, it is time for you to gain access to the Paths." L|1||Nalicana touches your brow, and you feel a great upwelling of light and heat fill your entire form. Just when it feels like you may burst from the pressure inside you, the feeling fades down to a comfortable warmth. L|1||You've earned 15,000 Luminance. L|1||Nalicana tells you, "Welcome into the Light. You now may gain inner Luminance from your adventures, if they be truly challenging to your strength." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "This Luminance, in turn, may be used to empower both auras and items for your benefit." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "You may always come to me, for the Path of the Yalain is open to all who have proven themselves to the Light." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "In addition, you may also seek out one of the more... specialized... paths from the history of the Empyrean." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "You must choose only one specialty path, for when you choose to walk one Path, you lose access to the others." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "This book will explain the details." L|1||Nalicana gives you Luminance, and the Paths of the Empyrean.
L|1||Nalicana tells you, "I see that you have not yet chosen to walk one of the more specialized paths yet." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "There are special benefits that can be gained by choosing to follow one of the Seers of the past cultures of the Empyrean." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "The Seer of the Light Falatacot, the Shade of Lady Adja, can be found in the Cathedral of Ithaenc. Her specialties focus on furthering your resistance to damage, and your skill at the skills you have specialized in." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "The Seer of the Dark Falatacot, Ka'hiri, can be found near the town of Sawato. Her specialties focus on furthering your ability to damage others, and your skill at the skills you have specialized in." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "The Seer of the Dericost, Liam of Gelid, can be found in the entrance of Frore. His specialties focus on furthering your ability to damage others, and your ability to critically damage others." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "The Seer of the Haebrean, Lord Tyragar, can be found in Silyun. His specialties focus on furthering your resistance to damage, and your resistance to critical damage." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "As for myself, I will empower any and all who have proven themselves and absorbed the Luminance necessary to empower themselves or items to help them. I recommend also following one of the other, more specialized paths." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "If you wish to leave one specialty path for another, speak with the Seer you wish to follow, and they will tell you what they require in order to induct you onto their Path." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "Be warned: To change one's Path, once chosen, will disrupt your existing attunements to the Light. All of your specialty path auras will fade."
H3|Other Interactions H4|Level Restriction L|1||Nalicana looks you over carefully. L|1||Nalicana tells you, "Greetings, young one. While I am pleased to meet you, you are not yet strong enough for what the Light can offer. Gain in experience, and return to me later." L|1||Nalicana tells you, "May the Light go with you."
H4|Quest Repeat L|1||You hand over all of your Battle Lord Gregor's Mnemosynes. L|1||You allow Nalicana to examine your Battle Lord Gregor's Mnemosyne. L|1||Nalicana tells you, "You have already gained access to the Paths of the Empyrean, and may earn Luminance. I have no other reward to offer you for this."

Quest.name: Nexus_Crawl

I|Level|150 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Ned the Clever» I|Starts At|«Zaikhal» at 13.4N, 0.9E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Nexus Crawl» H2|Overview L|1|•|Help «Ned the Clever» investigate the Apostate Virindi by placing a listening device deep in the Apostate Nexus. Earn an Epic Magic Resist, Epic Life Magic Virindi Mask.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|«Ned the Clever» will give you an «Aetheric Resonator». L|2|•|⟦NexusCrawlStarted0509⟧ L|2|•|⟦ApostateNexusFlag⟧ L|1|2.|Go to the old «Nexus» dungeon at 40.1S, 79.2W in the West Direlands. H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog;⸩ ⸨Ned the Clever tells you, "Excellent! You can help me! We in the Arcanum think the Virindi Apostates are up to no good, but we're not sure what they're doing. It all seems to be involved with this rare Aetherium metal that's been recently discovered. We think they are stockpiling great quantities of the ore, but we do not know what they intend to do with it. We need a doughty adventurer like yourself to seek out a deposit under their control, and plant a tracking device in their stores..."⸩ ⸨Ned the Clever tells you, "We have traced some suspicious energy patterns to the old Nexus discovered during the days of Bael'Zharon's rise. This facility may hold some clue to the location of a Virindi Apostate storehouse. L|1||Talking to Ned the Clever after completing the quest⸩ ⸨Ned the Clever tells you, "Congratulations! If I were you I'd prefer to hold on to such a remarkable souvenir of my exploits, but I suppose you get a lot more excitement than I do."⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Nexus Crawler's Masks.⸩ ⸨You've earned 49,539,309 experience

Quest.name: Noble_Weapons_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 I|Type|Fellowship/Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} «Royal Guard Gabrielle» I|Starts At|{OPT} 10.5N, 58.2E in «Rithwic» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest is the first step in obtaining one of the «Regal Weapons» («Burun Slayer» weapons). L|1|•|Use a «Burun Soaked Soul Stone» to give the «Noble Weapons» «Burun Slayer» attributes and turn them into «Burun Slaying Weapons». For how to obtain the «Burun Soaked Soul Stone», see «Soul Stone Quest» L|1|•|They can be turned into «Regal Weapons» by completing the «Clutch of Kings (Browerk)» quest. The random rewarded Gems can be added to a «Burun Slaying Weapons». L|2|•|«Gem of Damage Addition» - Melee L|2|•|«Gem of Damage Modification» - Missile L|2|•|«Gem of Mana Management» - Caster
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Proceed to the «Renegade Fortress (60+)¦Renegade Fortress» at 29.5S, 65.5W and locate the Lugian spy «Toberik» to obtain «Toberik's Report». L|2|•|He is not inside the dungeon itself, but instead can be found down a ramp near the dungeon entrance portal. L|2|•|Go down the ramp and to the right, and locate a room with a number of crates that form a sort of stairway. Jump up these crates and then up through a hole in the ceiling to get to Toberik. L|3|•|⟦SpokeToLugianSpy⟧ L|2|•|You can talk to Toberik multiple times and receive multiple reports. The reports are givable, so you can do this step ahead of time and grab a report for each person in your group. L|1|2.|Proceed to «Linvak Tukal» and have each person in your group present a copy of Toberik's Report to «Captain K'rank». Handing the report to Captain K'rank is the official flag for the quest, so if you already have a report for each member of your group you can start at this step. L|2|•|⟦EnterBurunCatacombs⟧ L|1|3.|Proceed to the «Burun Fortress» at 25.8S, 46.3E outside of «Yanshi». L|2|•|To get there, take the «Swamp Temple Place» settlement portal at 10.3S 45.6E. You will need to recall to this portal at least twice, so take note of the route to the castle. L|1|4.|{OPT} Pick up the «Blueprints for a Burun Fortress¦blueprints» (hookable) off a table just outside the fortress' SW corner. L|1|5.|Destroy the «Fortress Barrier» to the south to gain entry. L|2|•|Physical attack required: Magic doesn't do enough damage, although the gate has no melee defense so anyone can equip a weapon and attack. You will have to destroy this gate at least three times (see below). L|1|6.|Inside the fortress there are four mini-boss dungeons, tunnels to which are located to the SE, NE, NW and SW. At the end of each tunnel is a rock which serves as a portal (level 60+ restricted). L|1|7.|{OPT} Enter each dungeon in turn and take out each mini-boss to weaken «Morgluuk» (by reducing the number of minions in the final room). Three of the mini-boss' has 'Watcher' in the name and a message is broadcast when killed. One of the mini-bosses is an egg. L|2|•|Note: Two of the dungeons do not have an exit portal, so you will need to recall back to the Swamp Temple Place housing portal, and run to the fortress and destroy the South Gate again. Also the air in these dungeons is poisonous - if you stand in one place too long you take damage. The ramps are the only clear spaces to rest. L|1|8.|The entrance to Morgluuk's dungeon («Burun Fortress Central Mound», see map below) entrance is above ground level, you can access it by using the ramp just inside the South Gate. Walk through the rock as if it is a portal (does not show up as a portal on radar). L|1|9.|Also the air in this dungeon does 15-30 points damage. Safe are the ramps and the larger rooms. Proceed through the dungeon (down is good...), and kill «Morgluuk». Best place to kill him is at the last ramp before the large room. He spawns with multiple minions, and also the air down at the ramp does damage. It is possible to kill him without weakening him with a full fellow. L|1|10.|Once «Morgluuk» is killed, he drops «Morgluuk's Head» and «Morgluuk's Flesh» (x9). L|2|•|⟦HeadMorgluuk⟧ L|2|•|⟦SkinMorgluuk⟧ L|1|11.|Return to «Linvak Tukal» and talk to «Captain K'rank». L|2|•|⟦KrankMorgluuk⟧ L|1|12.|Then hand the «Morgluuk's Flesh» to receive experience, «Portal Gem (Hidden Chamber)¦Hidden Chamber Portal Gem» and «Reward Key». L|1|13.|If you looted the head, hand that in to Krank also to receive «Morgluuk's Trophy Head» and an additional portal gem and key. L|1|14.|Use the recall gem to be portalled into a «Hidden Chamber» within High Queen Elysa's castle. Use your key on one of the Noble Weapon chests in the chamber, the wall behind the chest indicates what weapon it holds. If you don't need a weapon there is a «Noble Treasure Chest».

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Royal Guard Gabrielle tells you, "...For the past several days Captain K'rank, the lugian in charge of this operation and several other investigations for High Queen Elysa and our allies, has been waiting for a report. He fears the worst and needs our help in trying to contact the lugian spy, Toberik."⸩ ⸨Royal Guard Gabrielle tells you, "...If you can make your way to the Renegade fortress in the direlands and find this lugian I am certain that your efforts would be rewarded."
L|1||Toberik⸩ ⸨Toberik tells you, "Ahh, an Isparian. We must be quick. If I am seen talking to you then I will surely be killed and all that I have worked for will be lost."⸩ ⸨Toberik tells you, "My efforts to uncover the details of the treaty between the Burun and the Renegades has turned up very little as of yet. Though I have managed to garner enough information to provide Captain K'rank with enough to formulate a strike against the Renegades and Burun."⸩ ⸨Toberik gives you Toberik's Report.⸩ ⸨Toberik tells you, "Take this to K'rank. He will give you the greater details of what I have discovered. Be wary however, the details within explain what I have learned about the Burun brothers, more specifically, Morgluuk. Tell him that if he can find someone to assist in raiding the Burun fortress that I will handle the other brother, keeping him away long enough for a group to defeat Morgluuk, smashing the morale of the Burun."⸩ ⸨Toberik tells you, "Go quickly, do not let the renegades see you leave."
L|1||Captain K'rank⸩ ⸨You give Captain K'rank Toberik's Report.⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "Toberik, you crazy hoktor! Well Isparian, it appears as though you brought this report to me in good time. Toberik means to detain Morgluuk's brother, Torgluuk, so that we can face just the one brother. The plan is not without trouble though. We have managed to learn much from the blueprints that we obtained from the Burun fortress in the Blackmire Swamp."⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "Currently, we believe that the best course of action is to approach the fortress from there north. The walls are weaker there, it appears as though the Renegade builders have been spending more time trying to discern the goals of the Burun and not enough on shoring up their work."⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "This will not be a simple fight. We will need you to be quick and efficient in your assault. We Lugians will assist the Tumeroks of Marae Lassel in laying an assault against one of the Renegade fortresses to provide you a small amount of assistance."⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "Once you break the walls down, you will need to enter the catacombs that the Burun have built beneath the fortress. Find your way through and defeat Morgluuk. He is very strong, there may be ways to weaken him without facing him... I would advise trying to find a way to weaken him before assaulting him directly."⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank says "Good luck to you, !"
L|1||Handing in Morgluuk's Head⸩ ⸨You give Captain K'rank Morgluuk's Head.⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "A brave warrior who has continued our efforts to crush the morale of the Burun and the renegades. You have done well. Here take this and display it proudly."⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank gives you Morgluuk's Trophy Head.⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank gives you Portal Gem.⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "The High Queen also wishes you to take a small reward from her coffers. Take these."⸩ ⸨[Player Name] has defeated Morgluuk and received a glorious reward for their efforts.⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank gives you Reward Key.⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "The key will open whichever chest you choose within the treasure room to which the gem brings you."⸩ ⸨You've earned 5,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "That is all that I have to give."⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank says, "Thank you again for your efforts, [Player Name]."
L|1||Handing in Morgluuk's Flesh⸩ ⸨You give Captain K'rank Morgluuk's Flesh.⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "Filthy creatures these Burun. As promised you are to be rewarded for your efforts."⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank gives you Portal Gem.⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank gives you Reward Key.⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "The key will open whichever chest you choose in that room. Each chest should clearly display what it holds."⸩ ⸨You've earned 20,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank tells you, "That is all that I have to give."⸩ ⸨Captain K'rank says, "Thank you again for your efforts, [Player Name]."⸩

L|1||Handing in Grazer Bug⸩ ⸨You give Jedeth Eckhart Grazer Bug.⸩ ⸨Startled, Jedeth Eckhart drops the Grazer Bug to the ground.⸩ ⸨Once freed of its confines, the Grazer Bug quickly makes its way over to Dar Rell.⸩ ⸨Jedeth Eckhart tells you, "That's a Grazer Bug! My old man told me about them. They have the uncanny ability to track down their mate no matter how far they are separated."⸩ ⸨Jedeth Eckhart's eyes suddenly widen as understanding finally dawns upon him.⸩ ⸨Jedeth Eckhart yells, "Dar Rell! Quest.name: Olthoi_Chasm_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|20 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Xavier, Royal Guard» I|Starts At|0.7N, 44.7E near «Lytelthorpe» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|The Olthoi Chasm quest is a series of increasingly difficult dungeons each with a note at the end. The goal of the quest is to retrieve a series of notes at the end of each dungeon and turn them in to «Xavier, Royal Guard» located on the surface by the entrance portal to the first dungeon.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|The progressive dungeons are all different but have similar set ups. First you encounter Undead and Skeletons, and then in the later portion of the dungeons you encounter Olthoi. You can just run through the dungeons to the end and grab the notes if you wish. L|1|2.|The entrance to the second dungeon is at the end of the first dungeon, and so on - be sure and pick up the note before you enter each portal. L|1|3.|There is no surface portal in this dungeon. Once you have all 5 «Untranslated Note»s, you have to recall and run all the way back to hand in the notes to the Royal Guard for the rewards. L|1|4.|Each dungeon is progressively harder. A level 20 character may be able to make it through the first dungeon, but may not survive the second. The final dungeon is extremely hard and you should be Level 200+ or have a large group of 150+. L|1|5.|There is an «Exploration Marker» just outside the dungeon portal, if you are so inclined.
H3|Part 1: Olthoi Chasm (Level 20+) L|1|1.|From the portal drop go down either the west or east ramp down and continue going down until a reach a large sloping room where there are several ramps on the floor. Take the ramp to the west or east (depending on which ramp you used from the drop) going down. L|1|2.|Off the passage you are in now will be a large pit that you have to jump down into. Exit the large room continue going down. L|1|3.|You'll come to another large sloping room with more ramps in the floor. Go down to the ramp to the Northwest and you should come to a green olthoi door at the end of the hall. Go through the door and continue straight down till you see the portal to the next area. Pick up the Untranslated Note at the bottom on front of the portal. L|2|•|⟦DeepPlaces1⟧
H3|Part 2: Shallow Olthoi Chasm (Level 40+) L|1|1.|This is a pretty simple dungeon. The general rule is to always stay left the whole way through the dungeon and always go up, never down. There are some short dead ends off the main passage but you can navigate though pretty easily. Again the note is right in front of the portal to the next area. L|2|•|⟦DeepPlaces2⟧
H3|Part 3: Deep Olthoi Chasm (Level 60+) L|1|1.|Take the first left then the first right. You will come to the a hall with several ramps down. Take the ramp down to the left and take a left at the bottom. Then go straight and up to another hallway with ramps. L|1|2.|In the hallway to the end with the metal door and go right. This passage will take you down then up again at the top you'll be in yet another hallway with ramps. From the passage you just exited take the ramp down to the left and across from you (not the one right in front of you). L|1|3.|Stay left through a large room then stay right and down a long ramp and at the bottom stay left until you reach the portal and the note. L|2|•|⟦DeepPlaces3⟧
H3|Part 4: Cavernous Olthoi Chasm (Level 80+) L|1|1.|From the drop stay right until you go down a ramp then left at the bottom. Go immediately right then straight to a green olthoi door and go through it. You'll go through a large room that slopes down then up again. L|1|2.|At the first T go left go take the first right and go straight down a ramp into a large room. Go left down a slope in the room to another ramp going down. L|1|3.|Take the first right then straight into a room filled with olthoi. Go down a ramp in the floor of the that room. L|1|4.|Take the first left and then go straight until you see the portal and note. L|2|•|⟦DeepPlaces4⟧
H3|Part 5: Abyssal Olthoi Chasm (Level 100+) P|At the drop in this section you will find an undead NPC, «Jaenyn, Stone Shaper». He has no use except for lore purposes. His interactions are listed on his wiki page.
L|1|1.|The first part of this dungeon mirrors the first Chasm section almost exactly. L|1|2.|From the drop go down one of the ramps in the floor to the east or west and continue down until a reach a large sloping room where there are several ramps on the floor. Take the ramp to the west or east (depending on which ramp you used from the drop) going down. L|1|3.|Off the passage you are in now will be a large pit that you have to jump down into. Exit the large room continue going down. L|1|4.|You'll come to a large room with a ramp down in the center. Go down and go through a metal door to find the final note in a stone hallway with an alloy machine at the end (which cannot be picked up). L|2|•|⟦DeepPlaces5⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|Bring each «Untranslated Note» to «Kuyiza bint Zayi» at 14.0N 0.1E near «Zaikhal» to receive the following translated texts: L|2|•|«Missive to the World Shaper» L|2|•|«Second Missive to the World Shaper» L|2|•|«Third Missive to the World Shaper» L|2|•|«Fourth Missive to the World Shaper» L|2|•|«Fifth Missive to the World Shaper»

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Aun Kielerea⸩ ⸨Aun Kielerea tells you, "Greetings. I am Aun Kielerea, a hunter for the Aun Xuta. My brothers and I have ventured away from the land of Palenqual to seek out mightier prey than what can be found near our home."⸩ ⸨Aun Kielerea tells you, "This does not mean we have forsaken Aun Hareltah, rather that we are looking for glorious battle against truly worthy opponents. And we believe we have found it!"⸩ ⸨Aun Kielerea tells you, "My brothers have stationed themselves across this land, hunting the strongest of the creatures you call golems. Quest.name: Renegade_Mace_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|40 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Renegade Camp» at 17.1N, 4.8W I|Route|«Zaikhal» to «Sharvale» at 12.7N, 1.8W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Reign of Terror» H2|Overview L|1|•|Bring a «M Note» or someone who has completed the quest and is wearing the «Renegade Pendant»
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Double click the «Renegade's Pack» to obtain «Letter to General Garsh» and «Travel Log». L|2|•|⟦LetterGarsh⟧ L|1|2.|This flags you to enter the «Renegade Garrison» (take «Mountain Shortcut» portal E from «Arwic Mines» (cross mountains at 42.9N 53.1E) L|1|3.|Enter «Renegade Garrison» at 44.1N 51.8E. L|2|•|{OPT} If contract active then talk to «Sergeant Maloth» L|3|•|⟦ReignofTerrorStarted_0511⟧ L|1|4.|Inside, hand the Travel log, the Letter and a «M Note» to «Sergeant Maloth» to open the door. L|1|5.|The dungeon is pretty straightforward. Go straight (S) at first intersection, through a room, straight (S) again at next intersection, another larger room, again straight (E) at next intersection, and two more rooms. L|1|6.|On the way, you will be facing lots of Renegade «Lugian»s and «Tumerok»s until you run into a Reinforced Door. L|1|7.|Best is to let melees kill the huge spawn of Olthoi behind the door before killing the door itself. L|2|•|{TIP} Archers can shoot the Olthoi through the door. L|1|8.|The next part is all kinds of olthoi. The dungeon is straightforward again, keep going E, until you run into the «Royal Olthoi Guardian». L|1|9.|Kill it, loot the «Smelly Olthoi Gland», and use this to open the next door. L|1|10.|Left hand rule until you come to a jump. Jump down, a bit more going E, and another jump to the «Young Olthoi Queen». L|1|11.|Kill it and a door to the N will open, also loot a «Olthoi Chitin» from her corpse (she drops 15). L|2|•|⟦ChitinROT1⟧ L|1|12.|Behind the door is a «Pool of Goo» with the corpse of the Dead Olthoi Queen in it. Use it to obtain «Royal Olthoi Jelly». L|2|•|⟦OlthoiJellyRoyalPickedUp⟧ L|1|13.|Portal recall to «Sergeant Maloth», and hand him the «Olthoi Chitin» to receive your main rewards. L|2|•|{OPT} If contract active - ⟦ReignofTerrorComplete_0511⟧ L|1|14.|Equip Renegade Pendant L|2|•|⟦PendantRenegade⟧ L|1|15.|The «Royal Olthoi Jelly» was used in the Ancient Olthoi Queen story arc by «Nuhmudira», but now you can turn it in for a «Writ of Refuge» at an «Agent of the Arcanum»

H2|Rewards
R|Give Olthoi Chitin to Sergeant Maloth RK|Experience|39,000,000 (175% up to level 75) RK|Items| RI|«Renegade Pendant» RI|«Renegade Mace» RI|«Trade Note (250,000)» (x2) RE
R|Give Royal Olthoi Jelly to an Agent of the Arcanum RK|Items| RI|«Writ of Refuge» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Maloth's Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨You shake Sergeant Maloth's shoulder. He seemed to be sleeping with his eyes open.⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "Wha! Humans! Leave now and you may yet live!"⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth looks you over. His eyes focus on your weapons and jewelry. He glances about the room for a moment.⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "Perhaps I was too hasty my friend."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "Many days ago, our engineers broke into an olthoi tunnel while excavating the lower sections of this garrison. We fought them, and lost all but the top level beyond this door, which I was ordered to guard until reinforcements arrive."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "Unfortunately, I have fallen on hard times and could not possibly consider jeopardizing my career by ignoring my ranking officer's orders. If only I could somehow be assured of your intentions..."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "I suppose you could bring me proof of your defeat of the olthoi below... if I had proof of their defeat, I could assure a promotion... But no, I cannot make a deal so risky without a little something to fall back on in case it were to fail."
L|1||Showing the Travel Log to Maloth⸩ ⸨You allow Sergeant Maloth to examine your Travel Log.⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "Hah, the fool, writing down directions to our secret garrison. I'm glad he's gone, less competition for me, hahaha."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth's eyes glaze over and a soft snoring sound reverberates around the room.
L|1||Showing the Letter to General Garsh to Maloth⸩ ⸨You allow Sergeant Maloth to examine your Letter to General Garsh.⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "Ah, so they didn't survive the journey... Put it away."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "Remember, I never saw that letter."
L|1||Handing in Trade Note (100,000)⸩ ⸨You give Sergeant Maloth Trade Note (100,000).⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth swiftly reaches out and the tradenote disappears. P|⸨Sergeant Maloth says, "Ah, I see that you intend to help us and that I, a loyal Gotrok, would be lax in my duties did I not allow creatures of such obvious honor to assist us in our hour of need."⸩⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "You must not forget that I am taking a risk in allowing you entrance. Bring me back proof that you removed the olthoi menace from our garrison and I may have a small reward for you."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "Also, my fellows within may not recognize you for the heroes that you are so be prepare to defend yourselves. If you can't handle them then you surely cannot handle the olthoi deeper down. If caught, remember to say that you got into the dungeon through portal magic."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "Oh, If I see you again I am sure I will not recognize you. You humans all look alike to me with your pointy noses and huge ears, haha! Thus, if you require entrance you will have to pay m... I mean donate towards our rebuilding efforts again."
L|1||Handing in Olthoi Chitin⸩ ⸨You give Sergeant Maloth Olthoi Chitin.⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth mashes his fists in celebration.⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "Well done! With this as proof of my defeating the Olthoi below I will garner much respect in our army. You should be rewarded for your assistance."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth gives you Renegade Pendant.⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth gives you Renegade Mace.⸩ ⸨You've earned 39,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "There, and since I'm feeling so magnanimous I will also grant you access to the garrison whenever I see you wearing your pendant. It's the only way I will recognize you."⸩ ⸨Sergeant Maloth tells you, "Olthoi have a way of coming right back unless you kill them all so you may want to return to insure they have been exterminated."
L|1||Handing in Royal Olthoi Jelly to an Agent of the Arcanum⸩ ⸨You give Agent of the Arcanum Royal Olthoi Jelly.⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum tells you, "We thought this jelly was useless for a time. But we've recently discovered it has certain properties which are of much interest to us. Please, take this Writ as a reward."⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum gives you Writ of Refuge.⸩

L|1|2.|In this room is the «Ward of the Retreat» who drops the «Grave Robber Title Token». I|Level|80 | Recommended Level = 150+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Kor-Gursha» on «Bur» I|Route|«Rithwic» to «Glystaene Cottages» portal at 8.9N, 60.9E to «Portal to Bur» at 67.4N, 30.5E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Saving Asheron» H2|Overview L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|At least one person must complete the «Enhancing Mucor» quest to take the «Mana Barrier» down in order to start the quest. The Mana Barrier remains down for 24 hours.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to the «Collector Golem» to begin the Saving Asheron portion of the quest. To the East and down some ramps eventually to the right. L|2|•|⟦SaveAsheronStarted0207⟧ L|1|2.|Take the East hallway and then speak with «Scout Leader Tmauruk». L|1|3.|Take the «Southern Catacombs» portal. Northern most East Tunnel From here. L|1|4.|Stick right past Guruk and use ROCK next to «Temple of the Three, Ritual Chambers» portal to enter «Upper Catacombs». L|1|5.|Go up until you come to a hallway filled with side doors. This hallway forms a large square, you start in the middle on the west side. Follow the hallway around to the middle of the east side (don't open any doors). There will be some open doorways going west into a large room from the hallway there. Go up the ramps then up to the west as far as you can go until you come to another large room with a portal to the «Temple of the Three». L|1|6.|This dungeon has a series of locked doors that can be unlocked using keys dropped by the «Gate Guardian»s: L|2|1.|«1st Locked Gate Key» L|2|2.|«2nd Locked Gate Key» L|2|3.|«3rd Locked Gate Key» L|2|4.|«4th Locked Gate Key» L|2|5.|«5th Locked Gate Key» L|1|7.|You'll come to two «Mana Barrier»s that need to be destroyed to access the «Crystal Array». Archers can destroy both barriers from the hallway before the dispel traps. The Mana Barriers have no missile defense, so even untrained missile skills can hit them. If you don't have a trained missile skill, use «Greater Armor Piercing Arrow»s and a «Red Rune Silveran Bow». Casters can destroy the barriers prior to the dispel trap as well, which will hit you right as you enter the room with the crystal, missile is unnecessary. L|1|8.|Use the crystal and a portal will open to the «Temple of the Three, Ritual Chambers». L|2|•|⟦RitualChambersFlag!⟧ L|2|•|The portal drop is a good place to rebuff safely. One way down to a large room with a statue at the bottom of three ramps. Kill the statue and a large spawn of sclavus and falatacots will appear. L|1|9.|After killing «General Tain'Kivix» and all of the «Sclavus Ritualist»s three named Falatacots will appear. L|1|10.|Prioritize killing the «High Acolyte of the Sacrifice» first, as he can smite you. Then, the «High Acolyte of the Blood» and finally the «High Acolyte of the Spirit». L|1|11.|With all of the falatacots dead, destroy the «Empyrean Blooded Ritual Statue» again. L|1|12.|Pick up a «Glowing Statue Shard» and exit using the «Kor-Gursha» portal to the north. L|2|•|⟦GlowingStatueShardPickupTimer!⟧ L|1|13.|The shards remain on the ground for quite a while, anyone that died or disconnected (the dungeon sends to Lifestone when relogging) can run back (last portal recall to go to the Glystaene Cottages, run to 67.4N 30.5E to go back to «Bur», «Kor-Gursha», then «Southern Catacombs». When you come to the Rock, instead use the portal next to it, it will send you right back to the «Temple of the Three, Ritual Chambers». Run down and pick up a shard. L|1|14.|Once you are back in «Kor-Gursha», give the shard to the «Collector Golem» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦SaveAsheronRepeat0207!⟧ L|2|•|⟦SaveAsheronCompleted0207!⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|You are now flagged to do the «Bur Recall Quest» which starts in «Cragstone».

L|1||Tmauruk dialog⸩ ⸨Scout Leader Tmauruk tells you, "Jurukka. I am Tmauruk, leader of the scouts of this tribe. H2|Trivia L|1|•|When the quest was first introduced, Asheron actually needed to be saved from the ritual on Bur. Those who successfully completed the quest the first time received XP, a white «Empowered Empyrean Robe (White)¦Empowered Empyrean Robe» and the title Asheron's Savior.

Quest.name: Shadowfire_Stone_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|125 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist» I|Starts At|41.8S, 15.8E in «Xarabydun» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Quest Chain|Creating a Shadowfire Stone I|1|«Repaired Shadow Stone Quest» I|2|Shadowfire Stone Quest H2|Overview P|Quest to gain a stone to add the Shadow Slayer property to an «Isparian Weapon». Unlike other stones, the change is permanent and the stone cannot be removed.
L|1|•|You must have a «Repaired Shadow Stone» from the «Repaired Shadow Stone Quest» in order to start this quest. L|1|•|You will also need two «Decanter of Essence» to complete your Shadowfire Weapon. L|1|•|To get the title "Honorary Shadow Hunter" you have to give a completed stone to «Sarkin Killcrane», which means if you want both the title and the stone you will need to repeat the quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Empyrean Workshop L|1|1.|Show the «Repaired Shadow Stone» to «Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist» in «Xarabydun» to get flagged for the first dungeon portal. L|2|•|⟦AccessEmpyreanWorkshop⟧ L|1|2.|Go to the «Empyrean Workshop» at 66.9N, 15.9E near «Neydisa Castle». L|1|3.|From the drop continue east until you come to stairs leading down into a large room. Do not jump down into any of the pits. From there go east and down, once down go west until you come to a room with the «Inner Chamber Guardian» who you can either kill now, or on your return trip, he drops the «Inner Chamber Key». Do not use key yet. L|1|4.|Everyone must pick up the «Empyrean Notebook» from the ground and then portal out. L|2|•|⟦EmpyreanNotebookPickup⟧ L|1|5.|Take the book to «Bretself the Translator» in «Cragstone» at 26.0N 47.0E to get «Atlan's Coded Notebook». L|1|6.|Take the translated book to «Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist» in «Xarabydun» to be flagged for the second dungeon. L|2|•|⟦AccessAtlansLaboratory⟧ L|1|7.|Return to the «Empyrean Workshop» and take the same path down, this time use the «Inner Chamber Key» to open the door just past the golem and go in the portal to «Atlan's Laboratory».
H3|Part 2: Atlan's Laboratory L|1|1.|From the drop continue to the large ocatagon room with a pit in the middle. Jump down then run south. At the first intersection go west. You'll come to a large room that loops around (shaped like the letter "C"). Follow the room until you come to the northeast corner where tunnel leads off to the east. Go east past the first intersection just past the room (T intersection west south east) then stick right the rest of the way. L|1|2.|You will cross several bridges then come to a platform in lava, «Atlan's Crafting Golem» spawns here and he drops five or six «Damaged Stone Infuser»s. He is on a 5 minute respawn timer. L|2|•|⟦pickupdamagedstoneinfuser⟧ L|1|3.|Return to «Xarabydun» and give the «Damaged Stone Infuser» to «Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist» for 161 million xp, «Ciandra's Stone Infuser Instructions» and «Repaired Stone Infuser». L|1|4.|Go to «Shade of Farelaith» at 74.3N, 58.6E and give him the «Repaired Shadow Stone» and «Decanter of Essence» for a «Dormant Shadowfire Stone». L|2|•|Route: «Cragstone» to «Haliana» portal at 26.2N 46.3E (West along the beach then up into the mountain). L|2|•|⟦RepairedStoneGiven⟧ L|1|5.|Apply a «Decanter of Essence» to the «Repaired Stone Infuser» to obtain a «Charged Stone Infuser». L|1|6.|Use the «Charged Stone Infuser» on the «Dormant Shadowfire Stone» to obtain the «Shadowfire Stone».
L|1|1.|{OPT} Unwanted stones can be given to «Sarkin Killcrane» in «Wai Jhou» for experience and a title reward.
H3|(Optional) Part 3: Coverting the Stone into a Shadownether or Life-attuned Shadowfire Stone P|This step makes the stone useful for mages trained in «Void Magic» (Nether) and offensive «Life Magic» L|1|1.|If you are looking to obtain the «Shadownether Stone» or «Life-attuned Shadowfire Stone» return the Shadowfire Stone to the Shade of Farelaith. Dialog boxes will pop up, just answer accordingly: L|2|1.|Dialogue box pops up asking "Do you wish this stone attuned to the power of Nether?" L|2|2.|If no, another box pops up asking "Do you wish this stone attuned to be able to craft a Life-attuned Shadowfire Isparian Wand?" L|1|2.|The stone is now ready to either be inserted into an «Isparian Weapon».

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨You give Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator Unreadable Dericost Tome.⸩ ⸨Kuyiza begins translating and transcribing the text for you, happily chatting along as she works.⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "It has been such a long while since I have had something new to work with. People usually bring me bits of parchment from Frore... not that I mind Frore..."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "Sometimes they bring me something about the undead scholar Rytheran... but I've seen most of what is said in those texts already..."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "Then there was that whole Elemental business... well... I wasn't able to leave my cottage because they were everywhere for a time..."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "And who would have thought that the Dericost would help us seal up the tunnels of the... oh my..."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza stops mid sentence, rapidly finishes her transcriptions and seals the tome with wax.⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "You are working for the Shadow Hunter Killcrane, yes? Quickly, take this directly to him. Don't dawdle. What is in this tome is of great import."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator gives you Translated Dericost Tome.
L|1||Showing Repaired Shadow Stone to Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist⸩ ⸨You allow Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist to examine your Repaired Shadow Stone.⸩ ⸨Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist tells you, "I've found a way to alter these stones to work with an Isparian Weapon, but I need you to get something for me first. I've managed, in my research, to locate a possible location for one of Atlan's Workshops, where he made the first weapons we based the Isparian Weapons on."⸩ ⸨Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist tells you, "The portal should be at 66.9N 15.9E, along the outside of the Mt. Esper Caldera. Go there, and gather for me whatever information you can."
L|1||Handing Empyrean Notebook to Bretself the Translator⸩ ⸨You give Bretself the Translator Empyrean Notebook.⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "Hmmm... This seems to be written in some sort of Empyrean Code."⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "I can translate it into recognizable characters, but I can't make heads or tails of it. Seems Atlan didn't want other people reading his notes."⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator gives you Atlan's Coded Notebook.
L|1||Handing in Atlan's Coded Notebook to Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist⸩ ⸨You give Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist Atlan's Coded Notebook.⸩ ⸨Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist tells you, "Ahh, the translated tome! Wonderful!"⸩ ⸨Ciandra examines the book intently.⸩ ⸨Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist tells you, "This is going to take a bit of work, but this first part here is a magical "key" to enter Atlan's Laboratory. I'll attune you to the wards, so you can gain entrance. Go in there and see what you can find."⸩ ⸨Ciandra chants quietly, and a soft glow infuses your skin for a moment.⸩ ⸨Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist tells you, "Be careful in there. If these wards are any indication, Atlan was more than capable of setting up his lab to be well defended."
L|1||Handing in Damaged Stone Infuser to Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist⸩ ⸨You give Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist Damaged Stone Infuser.⸩ ⸨Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist tells you, "Perfect! This is just the tool mentioned in these notes."⸩ ⸨Ciandra examines the Damaged Stone Infuser.⸩ ⸨Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist gives you Repaired Stone Infuser.⸩ ⸨Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist gives you Ciandra's Stone Infuser Instructions.⸩ ⸨Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist tells you, "It's been damaged... This will complicate things slightly. Ahh, this is bent too far over here... This part will need to be reset... there."⸩ ⸨You've earned 161,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist tells you, "There you go, it should work now, but those repairs have made it rather fragile. It'll work as it needs to, but I don't think it'll survive more than one use."⸩ ⸨Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist tells you, "The book will tell you how to use it. You'll need two Decanters of Essence to make the process work. The first, you will need to bring, along with a Repaired Shadow Stone, to the Shade of Farelaith, in Northern Osteth. He can be found at 74.3N, 58.6E. The second you will need for charging the Stone Infuser. The information is all in the book."⸩ ⸨Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist tells you, "If you don't have two Decanters of Essence, my Apprentice can direct you in how to get some."
L|1||Handing in Repaired Shadow Stone to Shade of Farelaith⸩ ⸨You give Shade of Farelaith Repaired Shadow Stone.⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "You must be from the mortal, Ciandra. She sent her apprentice to ask my aid in altering these stones. I can aid you, but I will need a source of Pure Mana to do so. The act of setting these stones against their creators is draining on my spirit, and would soon end my existence without the aid of the Mana."⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "I'll hold onto this, and make the preparations to this stone. Get for me a Decanter of Essence. They hold enough power for me to complete the process."⸩ ⸨You give Shade of Farelaith Decanter of Essence.⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "Ahh, yes mortal, this will do."⸩ ⸨Farelaith drains the decanter. Glowing slightly, he focuses his anger against the Shadows into the Repaired Shadow Stone. The last, minor flaws in the crystal disappear, and the stone now radiates a gentle warmth, where before it was cold.⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "There, this should meet your needs, and be an instrument of my vengeance as well. Here"⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith gives you Dormant Shadowfire Stone.
L|1||Handing in Shadowfire Stone to Shade of Farelaith (Shadownether stone)⸩ ⸨You give Shade of Farelaith Shadowfire Stone.⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "You must want this infused with Nether energies."⸩ ⸨Purple and Black energy flows from Farelaith's hands into the stone.⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "I hope this serves you well, even though I feel the art of Void Magic is a dangerous area for Isparians to meddle in."⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith gives you Shadownether Stone.
L|1||Handing in Shadowfire Stone to Shade of Farelaith (Life-attuned stone)⸩ ⸨You give Shade of Farelaith Shadowfire Stone.⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "You must want this altered to attune it to life magics."⸩ ⸨A warm glow flows from Farelaith's hands into the stone.⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith tells you, "I hope this serves you well."⸩ ⸨Shade of Farelaith gives you Life-attuned Shadowfire Stone.
L|1||Handing in Shadowfire Stone to Sarkin Killcrane⸩ ⸨You give Sarkin Killcrane Shadowfire Stone.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane examines the Shadowfire Stone.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "This will be a great aid to the Knights of the Golden Flame. I thank you for this. Allow me to give you something in return."⸩ ⸨You've earned 161,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "For your generosity, I hereby grant you the title of Honorary Shadow Hunter."⸩

Quest.name: Splitting_Grael_(High)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Hoshar ibn Jalaq» I|Starts At|59.6S, 88.0W in «Ayan Baqur» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Splitting Grael (High)» H2|Overview L|1|•|If you have already done this quest, you can skip steps 1-4 and simply use the «Abyssal Totem Gateway» in step 5.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Hoshar ibn Jalaq» at 59.6S, 88.0W in «Ayan Baqur». L|2|•|⟦SplitGraelHighIchorTurnin0806⟧ L|1|2.|Kill the «Mukkir Progenitor» on «Dark Isle». Found around (86.5N, 57.3E). L|1|3.|Loot a «Progenitor's Ichor». (Each person will need to get an Ichor for turn in). L|2|•|⟦progenitorsichorpickuptimer⟧ L|1|4.|Give the ichor to Hoshar to get an «Abyssal Gateway Token». L|1|5.|Hand the token to the «Abyssal Totem Gateway» on «Dark Isle» (86.5N, 57.3E) to be portaled into the «Abyssal Totem Temple». L|2|•|⟦AbyssalTotemGatewayFlag⟧ L|1|6.|Attack the «Abyssal Totem» at the end of the dungeon. If you die in the dungeon just use the totem gateway to be instantly portalled back into the temple. L|1|7.|Loot a «Shard of the Abyssal Totem». L|2|•|⟦shardoftheabyssaltotempickuptimer⟧ L|1|8.|Give the shard to Hoshar to receive your rewards. L|2|•|⟦SplitGraelHighComplete0806⟧
P|This quest is solo-able for a ranged toon. When nearing the final room, there is a small spot within the columns. In this confined space, Mukkir will not attack you. You can attack the «Abyssal Totem». Although it will initially cause Mukkirs to attack you, you can let them attack you. Just wait and heal until they find their way back to spawn point. Then you can simply attack the «Abyssal Totem», although patience is required since it has 50k health. As the seasoned warrior knows, Mukkirs are not to be handled lightly, especially alone. I completed this alone with a level 217 mage.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Hoshar ibn Jalaq tells you, "You may be able to help me... I would ask you to seek out a powerful Mukkir known only as the Progenitor. Its ichor has some unique properties, and may be of great use to us in our efforts to combat the demon known as Grael. If you are strong enough to fight mighty Mukkir, venture to 86.4 N, 57.4 E on the Dark Isle, and bring me the ichor of the Progenitor."
L|1||Handing in Progenitor's Ichor⸩ ⸨You give Hoshar ibn Jalaq Progenitor's Ichor.⸩ ⸨Hoshar ibn Jalaq tells you, "Well done. The Ichor of Hastar the Misbegotten is indeed helpful. It allows me to make this token, which will gain you entrance to the chambers of Grael's Abyssal Totem. Simply give this Gateway Token to the Abyssal Totem Gateway on the Dark Isle, and a portal should open up for you. Once you have gained access to the Abyssal Totem Temple, destroy the Abyssal Totem, and that will help split Grael's power..."⸩ ⸨Hoshar ibn Jalaq gives you Abyssal Gateway Token.
L|1||Handing in Shard of the Abyssal Totem⸩ ⸨You give Hoshar ibn Jalaq Shard of the Abyssal Totem.⸩ ⸨Hoshar ibn Jalaq tells you, "Excellent! This means that Grael's power has been dealt a serious blow! The shattering of the Abyssal Totem temporarily split his avatar. I will get this to our mages, who might be able to work the proper rituals of sympathetic magic to keep Grael's spirit sundered. You have done the realm of Dereth a great service, friend."⸩ ⸨You've earned 224,034,451 experience. (Level 270)⸩ ⸨Hoshar ibn Jalaq gives you Helm of the Abyssal Totem.⸩

Quest.name: Strathelar_Royal_Cloak_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|200 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} «Sir Daeglan» I|Starts At|{OPT} «Encampment near Neftet» at 22.2S, 6.2E I|Route|From «Yaraq» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|«Sir Daeglan» is looking to learn all he can about «Geraine». H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Tome 1 («Book 1: The Apostates») is found during the «Apostate Finale» L|2|•|⟦LargeTome1PickupTimer⟧ L|2|•|It is in the third dungeon of that quest («Apostate Nexus (Shimmering)»). L|2|•|Please see quest walk through for «Apostate Finale» L|1|2.|Tome 2 («Book 2: The Gurogs and the beginnings of the Plan») is found during the «Wardley and the Wights» quest. L|2|•|⟦LargeTome2PickupTimer⟧ L|2|•|It is located in the «Frozen Wight Lair» in the room with the «Frozen Wight High Acolyte». L|2|•|Please see the quest walk through for «Wardley and the Wights». L|1|3.|Tome 3 («Book 3: The Time Ritual and the Sand Kings») is found during the «Halt Dericost Ritual Quest». L|2|•|⟦LargeTome3PickupTimer⟧ L|2|•|It is located in a side room off the main hall in the final dungeon of this quest. («Warded Dungeon Passage») L|2|•|Please see the quest walk through for «Halt Dericost Ritual Quest» L|1|4.|Tome 4 («Book 4: Further Manipulations of Time») is found during the «Slave Master Quest» L|2|•|⟦LargeTome4PickupTimer⟧ L|2|•|It is located in the «Temple», behind a bunch of boxes on the right side of the first floor. Quest.name: Tanada_House_of_Water_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Meshenq» I|Starts At|13.8N, 0.6E in «Zaikhal» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Quest Chain|Tanada Clan I|1|«Tanada House of Storms Quest» I|2|«Tanada House of Earth Quest» I|3|Tanada House of Water Quest I|4|«Tanada Temple of Black Water Quest» I|5|«Tanada House of Fire Quest» H2|Overview L|1|•|To begin this quest you must have completed the «Tanada House of Storms Quest» and the «Tanada House of Earth Quest» at least once before.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|«Meshenq» 13.8N 0.6E, in Zaikhal, will give you a «Tanada Gate Medallion». L|2|•|⟦TanadaHouseofWaterStarted⟧ L|1|2.|Put on the «Tanada Gate Medallion» (necklace) and enter the «Tanada House of Water» dungeon at 85.3S, 5.8W. L|2|•|Equip: ⟦TanadaHouseofWaterPortal_Flag⟧ L|2|•|Route 1: «Lesser Direlands Device» Portal to the «Southern Landbridge». L|2|•|Route 2: From «Qalaba'r», take the «Land Bridge Villas» portal at 74.9S, 17.9E. L|1|3.|Work your way through the linear dungeon until you reach the «Consul to the Tanada». L|1|4.|Kill him and loot the «Tanada Consul's Message Shard» from his corpse. L|2|•|⟦TanadaConsulsMessageShard_Pickup⟧ L|1|5.|Give the message shard to «Diyas al-Yat» at 13.8N, 0.1E in «Zaikhal». He will return «Tanada House of Water Orders». L|1|6.|Give your «Tanada Gate Medallion» to «Diyas al-Yat» and he will return a «Channeled Tanada Medallion». L|2|•|{OPT} If you don't want the medallion, hand it back to «Diyas al-Yat» for additional XP. L|1|7.|Now head back to «Meshenq» and hand him the «Tanada House of Water Orders» to receive experience and a «Copy of Tanada House of Water Orders». L|2|•|⟦TanadaHouseofWaterCompleted⟧ L|2|•|⟦TanadaTempleofBlackWaterQuest_Flag⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Meshenq tells you, "Ah! Sayuji Jina told me of you! You helped her investigate the Tanada houses of Earth and Air, did you not? Excellent! I need your help now."⸩ ⸨Meshenq gives you Tanada Gate Medallion.⸩ ⸨Meshenq tells you, "I was exploring the southern land bridge when I was attacked by a pair of Tanada! But these were strange Tanada, not like the descriptions I've heard from Jina. They killed me and sent me back to my lifestone here in Zaikhal, but before I died I was able to tear this medallion off one of them..."⸩ ⸨Meshenq tells you, "My camp was at 85.2 S, 4.4 W, and I think they came from the west. I would advise you to search the area and see if you can locate some trace of the Tanada presence... Please bring me back any evidence you might turn up of what has brought the Tanada to that area."
L|1||Returning to Meshenq⸩ ⸨Meshenq tells you, "We have spoken already, have we not? I asked you to journey to my camp at 85.2 S, 4.4 W on the southern land bridge and see if you can track the Tanada who came from the west to attack me. Please, go there and bring me back whatever evidence you find of the Tanada's activities. The trail grows colder as we speak..."
L|1||Consul to the Tanada⸩ ⸨Consul to the Tanada tells you, "This world no longer belongs to your kind!"⸩ ⸨My master will take his revenge, weakling flesh puppet!
L|1||Meshenq⸩ ⸨Meshenq tells you, "Ah, so you found some kind of black crystal shard on a Virindi that was hiding among the Tanada? Fascinating. I hadn't counted on Virindi involvement, and they are quite beyond my realm of expertise. I think you should give it to Diyas al-Yat here in Zaikhal. He's able to translate those strange artifacts... Please bring me the translation that he gives you."
L|1||Showing Tanada Consul's Message Shard to Meshenq⸩ ⸨You allow Meshenq to examine your Tanada Consul's Message Shard.⸩ ⸨Meshenq tells you, "I can't make much sense of this. Please give it to Diyas al-Yat here in Zaikhal. He should be able to translate it. Please just give me his translation."
L|1||Giving Tanada Consul's Message Shard to Diyas al-Ya⸩ ⸨You give Diyas al-Yat Tanada Consul's Message Shard.⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat tells you, "Ah, a message shard from a Virindi Consul found in the southern land bridge? Most intriguing... Let me see if I can translate it for you..."⸩ ⸨A strange, cold light emanates from the eyes of Diyas al-Yat as he concentrates on the message shard.⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat gives you Tanada House of Water Orders.⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat tells you, "I have translated the shard for you. You should bring that translation to Meshenq. He will know what to do with such dire news. Imagine, Nanjou Shou-Jen corrupted by the chaos Virindi! Such an abomination!"⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat tells you, "Also, Meshenq has told me he gave you a medallion he took from the Tanada who attacked him. The medallion is attuned to the corrupted spirits of the House of Water Tanada. If you give it to me, I can channel its magic to make it useful to you, but I am afraid it will lose the property that grants you access to the House of Water. Not that you need to go to that foul place any more..."
L|1||Handing in Tanada House of Water Orders to Meshenq⸩ ⸨You give Meshenq Tanada House of Water Orders.⸩ ⸨Meshenq tells you, "A house of the Tanada has been corrupted by the chaos Virindi? Terrible news! I have much to report to my colleagues who share this task of investigating the Tanada... In the meanwhile, I thank you for your excellent service."⸩ ⸨You've earned 27,564,250 experience.⸩ ⸨Meshenq tells you, "I'll also give you a copy of this translation, for your own edification..."⸩ ⸨Meshenq gives you Copy of Tanada House of Water Orders.
L|1||Handing in Gate Medallion to Diyas al-Ya⸩ ⸨You give Diyas al-Yat Tanada Gate Medallion.⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat gives you Channeled Tanada Medallion.⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat tells you, "Yes, as I may have mentioned, this medallion is attuned to the corrupted life-force of the Nanjou⸩ ⸨Shou-Jen who have given themselves to the dominion of the chaotic Virindi... Truly tragic. I can channel the magic in this medallion to be useful to you, but it will no longer grant you access to the House of Water. I can't imagine why you'd want to go back in there, though."⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat tells you, "If you don't find this channeled medallion useful, you can just give it to me and I'll compensate you with general training."
L|1||Showing channeled medallion to Meshenq⸩ ⸨You allow Meshenq to examine your Channeled Tanada Medallion.⸩ ⸨Meshenq tells you, "It was very thoughtful of Diyas to enchant that for you, but I don't think you should be giving it to me... I don't have much use for it. If you don't want it, perhaps you should give it back to him."
L|1||Handing in Channeled Tanada Medallion to Diyas al-Ya⸩ ⸨You give Diyas al-Yat Channeled Tanada Medallion.⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat tells you, "Ah, you don't find this useful? A pity. The patterns are so mesmerizing..."⸩ ⸨You've earned 6,891,063 experience.
L|1||Returning to Meshenq⸩ ⸨Meshenq tells you, "Ah, you've already helped me with my incident in the wilds, have you not? I am confident that you brought justice to those Tanada and whoever is directing them. I thank you again, but there is nothing more I would ask of you now."⸩

Quest.name: The_Caliginous_Bethel
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|35 I|Rec. Level|80+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Aurten Rhell» I|Starts At|39.5N, 75.5W in «Bluespire» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for The Caliginous Bethel» H2|Overview P|Help Aurten Rhell investigate the strange incidents on the Marescent Plateau.
L|1|•|{WARN} If you're doing this quest as part of the «50-100 Contracts Quest», then you must give the Repugnant Bracelet to «Aurten Rhell» in Bluespire for the contract to display as complete. You **cannot** do this once it has been cleaned. L|1|•|{TIP} If you are only after the stamps then don't cleanse the bracelet, but still get the water if you haven't stamped the bucket pickup.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Cultist Altar L|1|1.|Head to the «Marescent Plateau» and search for a randomly spawning «Cultist Altar». Wait for your group to join you at the altar, then use it. L|1|2.|Kill the creatures that spawn from the altar until you finally kill a «Dark Vapor», which will spawn a portal to the «Caliginous Bethel». Enter the portal. L|2|•|Note: If «The Black Breath» is one of the creatures you have to kill, you will need a mage of considerable ability to bring it down. Solo low/mid-level melee/archer players will find themselves unable to make a dent in «The Black Breath»'s health unless they use the «Curse of Raven Fury» spell to attack it.
H3|Part 2: Caliginous Bethel L|1|1.|{OPT} From the drop, turn around and pick up the «Note (Order of the Raven Hand)¦Note» on the floor (lore only). L|1|2.|Work your way North until you find a large room with a caged NPC named «Twitch» inside. Take the West hallway and go straight up the ramp. L|1|3.|At the top of the ramp, take a left, and follow the hallway to a ramp down. At the bottom of the ramp, in the adjacent room, the room is blocked by a «Reinforced Door» on either side, destroy the door and pick up «Jaeget's Journal» from the floor. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpNoteBethelCultist⟧ L|1|4.|Backtrack to the hallway just before the entrance to the large room with Twitch in it. Take the south passage down the ramp, take your first left, then run straight until you dead end into a wall (which is actually the lever activated door D5, see map). L|2|•|Note: to activate that lever (L5) you will need to go through D1 to D4 by pulling the corresponding levers in that order. The doors remain open for long enough to make this run easily soloable. L|1|5.|Once through the wall/door, work your way until you reach a room with a deep pit. Jump down and pick up «Bewren's Journal» from the ground. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpNoteBethelBrother⟧ L|1|6.|Use the floor-activated lever to open a hidden door inside the pit and continue down another pit and hallways until you reach a room with many shadows and an NPC named «Proselytic Shadow». L|2|•|{WARN} Be carefull not to enter the «Calignious Bethel Portal» located in the same room as the «Proselytic Shadow» or you will end up back at the start of the dungeon. L|1|7.|Each person must loot a «Repugnant Bracelet» from the corpse of a «Lesser Shadow Wretch», of which there are several in this area. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpBraceletRepugnant⟧ L|1|8.|{OPT} If you don't want your bracelet, hand it to Aurten Rhell for a «Writ of Refuge». You must choose this reward if you're completing the quest as part of the 50-100 contract. L|2|•|If contract active: ⟦CaliginousBethelComplete_0511⟧ L|1|9.|Once everyone has a Repugnant Bracelet, go to the «Ithaenc Cathedral» and pick up the «Well Bucket» at 82.6S, 93.6E. L|2|•|⟦bucketadja⟧ L|1|10.|Use the Well Bucket on «Adja's Well» to obtain «Water of Ithaenc». L|1|11.|Use the Repugnant Bracelet on the Water of Ithaenc on to obtain the «Refulgent Bracelet». L|2|•|{WARN} Do not attempt to use the Water of Ithaenc on the Repugnant Bracelet, you will drink it. L|1|12.|Return the «Aurten Rhell» in «Bluespire» and hand him both Bewren's Journal and Jaeget's Journal for random, casino style rewards.
