H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "Hello there! Can I trust you?"⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "I think so, I think I can. I had to quickly stow my guard uniform when Varicci's men swept into the city! But I am continuing my investigation."⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "If you can find any information on the strange incidents occurring on the plateau, I will reward you."⸩ ⸨Aurten kneels down and opens a nearby pack. He tilts the pack so that you can see what is inside and then quickly pulls back the pack from your sight and closes it.⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "Varicci's invasion cannot prevent us from doing our necessary work, don't you agree? Move out!"
L|1||Twitch⸩ ⸨Twitch tells you, "Where am I? I finally found some nice people who help me escape from those lunatics on that backwards island, and they toss me into this cage threatening me with sacrifice and torture!"⸩ ⸨Twitch tells you, "You don't think they mean to throw me into their sacrificial pit, do you?"⸩ ⸨Twitch tells you, "Haha, no, they wouldn't do that... I mean, why would they?"
L|1||Proselytic Shadow⸩ ⸨Proselytic Shadow tells you, "He who was... brother... betrayed..."⸩ ⸨Proselytic Shadow tells you, "Where has the light gone? I cannot see. I was.. betrayed?"⸩ ⸨Proselytic Shadow tells you, "The darkness, so cold... so painful..."⸩ ⸨Proselytic Shadow tells you, "Free... free... help... the light is lost."⸩ ⸨Proselytic Shadow tells you, "The dark one whispers to me now. He beckons me to avoid the light."
L|1||Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨You give Aurten Rhell Bewren's Journal.⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "Fiction! Pure fiction! I could have written a more compelling tragedy. I do have to admit, even though this is surely a fake, you did put a fair amount of effort into it. If anything you entertained me with this garbage. Here, take this."⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "I know... I know... you at least tried to help me out. You really shouldn't be getting anything from me, but since I'm such a nice guy I'll make an exception for you."⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "Cultists... Summoning and worshipping shadows... how ludicrous!"⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell gives you [Random Trophy].⸩ ⸨You give Aurten Rhell Jaeget's Journal.⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "Some papers? While an interesting read I am sure, how am I to know if this is genuine and not some fiction you yourself devised? Very well, I suppose you deserve some reward even if these papers are fabricated."⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "You have a lot of nerve to deliver this garbage to me. But I am a man of my word. Here. This is for you, even though you don't deserve it."⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell gives you [Random Trophy].⸩ ⸨You give Aurten Rhell Repugnant Bracelet.⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "So many people have brought me pieces of parchment with melodrama scrawled upon it. One person even brought me a strange stick, whatever that is for, but this... finally! Solid evidence of wrong doing on the plateau!"⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "Wait... what was I getting so excited over? This is just some amulet caked in carenzi refuse. Hardly proof of anything. You know what? I am so tired of people bringing me dead ends and fallacies! Here! Just take this!"⸩ ⸨Aurten hastily pulls a writ from his backpack and throws it at you.⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell gives you Writ of Refuge.⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "Just because you haven't been helpful doesn't mean I won't reward you for the effort. Maybe next time you'll bring me something worthwhile!"
L|1||Opening Dialog, Retired⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "Ah hello! Perhaps you could help me. I am new to this island and am not particularly familiar with the landscape. Could I convince you to help me? I need information on the strange incidents occuring on the plateau."⸩ ⸨Aurten kneels down and opens a nearby pack. He tilts the pack so that you can see what is inside and then quickly pulls back the pack from your sight and closes it.⸩ ⸨Aurten Rhell tells you, "What are you waiting for? I promised my superiors I would have a report for them!"⸩

Quest.name: Town_Founder
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|62.3S, 51.4W in «Wai Jhou» I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest flags you for access to the «Tree Portal» in «Candeth Keep».
P|**Leaftide:** This quest is for the stamps as the tree top vendors are all in the Marketplace.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak with the three NPCs, «Aun Teverea» (cloth), «Caelis Renning» (metal & wood), and «Kreavon» (gem). L|2|•|⟦TalkedToBuilder⟧ L|1|2.|To complete the quest, you must give the three of them a combined total of 100 **partial bags** of salvage. Each NPC only accepts a certain type of «Salvage». L|2|•|Note: A partial bag of «Salvage» is defined as a bag that has at least **1 Unit** of salvaged material in it. Thus you loot and «Salvage» everything since one of them will accept it. L|2|•|Example: You could give 50 bags to one, 25 to another and 25 to the last one. L|2|•|First Turn in to any of the three: ⟦StrongholdBuilder⟧ L|2|•|«Caelis Renning»: ⟦StrongholdHumanBuilder⟧ L|2|•|«Aun Teverea»: ⟦StrongholdTumerokBuilder⟧ L|2|•|«Kreavon»: ⟦StrongholdLugianBuilder⟧ L|1|3.|Continue collecting and handing bags until you receive a «Candeth Keep Stamp», which indicates you're now flagged for the «Tree Portal» in «Candeth Keep». L|2|•|⟦StrongholdBuilderComplete⟧ L|1|4.|If you're interested in hats and titles, continue to hand bags of «Salvage» to the appropriate NPCs until you give **each** of them 100 partial bags of «Salvage» to the relevant NPC for a hat and title.
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.
H2|Rewards
R|Give a combined total of 100 salvage bags RK|Items| RI|«Candeth Keep Stamp» RE
R|Give 100 bags of salvage to Aun Teverea RK|Title|Trapper RK|Items| RI|«Trapper's Hat» RE
R|Give 100 bags of salvage to Caelis Renning RK|Title|Timberman RK|Items| RI|«Timberman's Hat» RE
R|Give 100 bags of salvage to Kreavon RK|Title|Miner RK|Items| RI|«Miner's Hat» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Caelis Renning⸩ ⸨Caelis Renning tells you, "Hail friend, my name is Caelis. The Aluvian, Sho, and Gharun'dim peoples united under Queen Elyssa have joined together to form the Isparian third of the new alliance.⸩ ⸨Caelis Renning tells you, "We are assigned to this outpost near Wai Jhou, to collect building materials for the continued upkeep of Candeth Keep. I will accept all types of salvaged metal and wood that you can afford to donate to the cause. Large or small, poor or priceless, your donations will be treated equally."
L|1||Handing in Salvage (1-99 bags)⸩ ⸨Caelis Renning tells you, "Thank you friend. Keep up the good work. In my journies, I have found that banderlings hoard many types of weapons suitable for salvaging."⸩ ⸨Caelis Renning tells you, "You are off to a very good start. Yet, building materials are in short supply, please continue to bring me what you can. Keeping the town in good condition requires a constant supply of wood planks and metal hardware."⸩ ⸨Caelis Renning tells you, "Ah, more materials for the stronghold. Do you find all of this overland, or are you one of those heroes that takes up residence in some dark dungeon?"⸩ ⸨Caelis Renning tells you, "You have given me one-half the wood and metal materials that I would ask of you. The residents of the stronghold shall know you by your name and your deeds."⸩ ⸨Caelis Renning tells you, "Many good people like yourself are bringing cartloads of raw metals and wood. Candeth Keep can be well maintained with these materials. Your efforts will be rewarded."⸩ ⸨Caelis Renning tells you, "You have given much to help the alliance. More materials are still needed, but rest assured you have donated the bulk of the quota set forth by the alliance council."⸩ ⸨Caelis Renning tells you, "The storehouses are beginning to fill with the materials you and the others have generously given to the cause. We now have enough materials to make another delivery to Candeth Keep, but we will surely need more to maintain our stronghold."
L|1||Handing in Salvage (100 bags)⸩ ⸨Caelis Renning tells you, "Friend, your hard work has paid off. You have given the most that can be donated by any one member.⸩ ⸨Caelis Renning tells you, "You will be welcomed in Candeth Keep as a co-founder. Quest.name: Ulgrim's_Drinking_Contest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Wah Chon the Barkeep» I|Starts At|52.4S, 82.0E in «Nanto» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Challenge and beat «Ulgrim the Unpleasant» at his drinking contest to win titles and even the ultimate reward of a «Mystical Mug».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to «Ulgrim's Island». L|2|•|**Leaftide**: Portal in AC Storage L|2|•|Retail Route: L|3|•|Purchase «Wah Chon's Winter Lager» from «Wah Chon the Barkeep». L|3|•|Head to «Baishi» and travel south from the town up a mountain to the «Drunken Madman» who resides outside a small tower at 53.0S 61.0E. Hand him the Winter Lager and he will open a portal to «Ulgrim's Island». L|1|2.|On the small island adjacent from the one with the cottage that you port in on are many small golems. All the golems can drop an «Ulgrim's Contest Mug» trophy. Kill the golems until you have the desired number of mugs you need to reach your goal. If you want all three titles and the Mystical Mug then you'll need at *minimum* 11 of the mugs (10 to win and one to lose). L|1|3.|Once you have your mugs head to «Ayan Baqur» then Ulgrim resides just outside the bar in the center of town. Hand a Contest Mug to Ulgrim to begin the contest. L|2|•|⟦UlgrimsDrinkingContestFlag⟧ L|2|•|⟦UlgrimsDrinkingContestDrinking⟧ L|1|4.|Five mugs will fall to the ground. The goal is to use each of the mugs before Ulgrim does. You can see the set up below. L|2|•|{TIP} The best way to do it is to first put your camera in overhead view (see «#Images¦images» below). L|2|•|First Drink: ⟦UlgrimsDrinkingContestDrinks⟧ L|1|5.|After you give the mug to Ulgrim take a step backwards and turn slightly to the left or right. By starting out turned towards the mug you are going to use first you avoid having to spend time turning once the contest starts. L|1|6.|Target the mug with your mouse then press R (or what key you have set to "Use Item") as quickly as you can. As you are drinking the first mug target the next mug and keep pressing R. There is no room for any delays. L|1|7.|Continue in that manner until all 5 mugs have been used. L|2|•|First win: ⟦UlgrimsDrinkingContestWins⟧ L|2|•|Tenth Win: ⟦MysticalMugFlag⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.
H2|Rewards
R|Lose at a round RK|Title|Master of the Porcelain Altar RE
R|Win a round RK|Title|Ulgrim's Drinking Buddy RE
R|Win 10 rounds RK|Title|Master of the Mystical Mug RK|Items| RI|«Mystical Mug» RE
L|1|•|Once you have the Mystical Mug you are flagged to use any Mystical Mug hooked in a house or mansion. When you use the Mystical Mug it casts a spell "«Cast Iron Stomach»" which increases your Stamina by 50 points and stacks with most buffs.
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Handing Ulgrim's Contest Mug to Ulgrim the Unpleasant⸩ ⸨You give Ulgrim the Unpleasant Ulgrim's Contest Mug.⸩ ⸨Ulgrim clears his throat and announces "Attention my avid fans! I have been challenged to a Drinking Contest by ! We shall begin in a few seconds."⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "Make this look good kid, I have a reputation to keep here."⸩ ⸨Ulgrim opens a backpack and starts arranging a number of Mug in the Sand. He sits five before you and five before himself and carefully fills them each with a small keg labled "Ulgrim's Best". The keg has a image of Ulgrim giving a thumbs up painted on it.⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "There we go. Now, I must prepare." P|⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant says, "We will begin in five seconds!"⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant says, "4"⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant says, "3"⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant says, "Begin"⸩
L|1||Contest in Progress⸩ ⸨You drink the stout. P|⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant says, "One"⸩⸩ ⸨You drink the stout. P|⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant says, "Two"⸩⸩ ⸨You drink the stout. P|⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant says, "Three"⸩⸩ ⸨You drink the stout. P|⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant says, "Four"⸩⸩ ⸨Ulgrim stops to pose for onlookers with his stout mug held high.⸩ ⸨You drink the stout.
L|1||Winning the Contest P|⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant says, "You beat me! I can't believe I lost."⸩⸩ ⸨Ulgrim really looks at you for the first time and smiles in admiration.⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "It's a pleasure to drink with you my friend!"⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "For besting me at my own game I'm making you one of my Drinking Buddies. Come back and drink with me anytime!"
L|1||Losing the Contest P|⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant says, "Five! Haha! I win again!"⸩⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "For coming in second place I award you a title befitting of your drinking prowess."
L|1||Winning the Contest 10 Times P|⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant says, "You have truly bested me. I bow to you in my humble defeat."⸩⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "My my, you really have been practicing! I believe this is the 10th time you've beaten me. I think... no."⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "Yes, I think you are ready. You have achieved the coveted rank of "Master of the Mystical Mug".⸩ ⸨You are entrusted with the safekeeping of the Mystical Mug. Keep it well protected, for there are many dark forces that would love to get their claws on it."⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant gives you Mystical Mug.⸩

Quest.name: Adept_Test
Quest.notes: You do not get qb credit from talking to your faction NPC, must kill them and loot it.
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Society Rank|Initiate I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Aldrion of the Celestial Hand» («Celestial Hand¦CH») «Khadira of the Eldrytch Web» («Eldrytch Web¦EW») «Shien Genda of the Radiant Blood» («Radiant Blood¦RB») I|Starts At|«Faction Stronghold» (east wing) I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Overview L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You must first hand in a total of 95 «Commendation Ribbon»s to the «Commendations Officer» in your society stronghold, before you can start the quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with your «Inspector of the Adepts». L|2|•|⟦OnAdeptTest⟧ L|1|2.|Take the «Neydisa Castle» portal in «Town Network» (South Wing) and run north to 74.8N, 18.4E. Go inside the «Mage Academy» and then exit the surface portal, this will allow you to easily portal recall. Enter the «Rogue Delvings» right next to the «Mage Academy». L|1|3.|There are three keys you need to obtain, the «Celestial Hand» encampment is on the west side from the drop, the «Eldrytch Web» to the north, and the «Radiant Blood» to the east. L|1|4.|At the end of each wing is a named Captain surrounded by Scouts that will give you a key (if same faction) or will drop the key on his corpse (if opposing faction). L|2|1.|«Donnarion's Key» : can be found in the west wing L|3|•|⟦PickedUpDonnarionKey⟧ L|2|2.|«Haroush's Key» : can be found in the north wing L|3|•|⟦PickedUpHaroushKey⟧ L|2|3.|«Joroshi's Key» : can be found in the east wing L|3|•|⟦PickedUpJoroshiKey⟧ L|2|•|{WARN} No stamp for the key if you talk to your Society key holder. Only stamps for killing and looting. L|2|•|Note: It is easier to recall after each key and start from the drop instead of running back through the undead (if you used the surface portal in «Mage Academy» as suggested). L|1|5.|Once you have all three keys, use them to open three successive doors (color coded) to the south of the drop. Silver first, Gold second, and Green third. The doors close quickly (30 seconds). L|1|6.|At the end of the south wing you will find «Benedino». Kill him and loot the «Lens of Filinuvekta» and «Benedino's Letter» (optional). L|2|•|Remember this if you pass through all three doors and die: the keys are on an hour timer, meaning you cannot finish this till an hour later if you die because you will need keys again to pass through the doors. L|1|7.|Return to your faction stronghold and give the lens to your «Inspector of the Adepts». The item will disintegrate 1 hour (or less) after it's picked up so you must turn it in quickly.

H2|Dialog P|⸨=== Celestial Hand === L|1||Aldrion's Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Aldrion of the Celestial Hand tells you, "You have proven yourself to be somewhat useful to this society, but how trustworthy are you? There is a rogue agent, we suspect working for the assassin Oswald, who infiltrated our ranks and stole an important artifact: a fragment of an ancient lens that belonged to the Filinuvekta, a faction of the Undead of Dericost. We would like you to hunt down the rogue Benedino and recover the lens from him."⸩ ⸨Aldrion of the Celestial Hand tells you, "Our scouts have run him to ground in an offshoot of the Mage Academy that Lord Rytheran of Menilesh established. Unfortunately, forces from the Eldrytch Web and Radiant Blood have chased him there as well, and Benedino exploits a stalemate among the three Societies. You must be the one to break the stalemate. Our own forces occupy the western branch of the dungeon. Seek out Captain Donnarion, and he will have further instructions for you."
L|1||Aldrion's Returning Dialog L|1||Dialog needed.
L|1||Captain Donnarion⸩ ⸨Captain Donnarion tells you, "Aldrion sent you down here to hunt down Benedino, eh? More power to you. Perhaps you can bust through where the other Societies have held us. Benedino is holed up in the southern wing of the Rogue Delvings. You'll need three keys to get through all the gates to Benedino's hideout. I have one key, but the captains from the Eldrytch Web and Radiant Blood have taken the other two. You'll need to confront them in their own camps to get the keys you'll need. Rest here if you need to, but you should get going as soon as you can."
L|1||Aldrion's Returning Dialog L|1||Dialog needed.

There is a way in which you might prove yourself worthy to become an Adept of the Society... We were recently infiltrated by some servant of the rogue Oswald... a rat of a man named Benedino. He stole an artifact from us, a fragment of the Lens of the Filinuvekta that is... most prized by our scholars."⸩ ⸨Khadira of the Eldrytch Web tells you, "Our scouts have tracked Benedino to a facility called the Rogue Delvings, an offshoot of the Mage Academy that Lord Rytheran of Menilesh established. Quest.name: Aerbax's_Prodigal_Shadow
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|140 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«The Orphanage» I|Route|Located the randomly spawning portal on Singularity Caul. «The Orphanage (Portal Gem)¦Portal gems» can also be obtained as a reward from the «Dens of Iniquity» high stakes. I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|To run this quest, everyone must have a «Pulsating Bony Lump», which is found on the floor at the bottom of the North wing of the «Artifex Collegium» at 91.9S 93.7W on «Singularity Caul». L|2|•|{TIP} There is no pick-up timer on the lumps and they are givable, so its easiest if one person gets them for everyone before the quest starts. L|1|•|Before starting, it's easiest if you have a «Pandemic Key» to open the locked door in the «Orphanage». L|2|•|{TIP} There is no pick-up timer on Pandemic Keys and they are givable, so someone should get one before the quest starts (pick up a couple in case you have to run people back down that die on the flagging portion). L|1|•|The final part of this quest typically causes a lot of deaths, so its a good idea to have several vitae items in your pack so you can return to the fight as quickly as possible.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes
H4|Part 1: The Orphanage L|1|1.|To begin, locate a randomly spawning «The Orphanage» portal on «Singularity Caul», or alternatively use an «The Orphanage (Portal Gem)¦Orphanage Portal Gem» if you have one. L|2|•|{TIP} Once you locate «The Orphanage» portal, someone should stand outside to hold the land block while everyone gets there. L|1|2.|Once everyone is inside The Orphanage, head down the ramp in the North East corner (North, then East). Follow the ramp down and take a Right at the bottom of the ramp. You'll see a locked door on your left. L|2|•|{TIP} Use the map of The Orphanage (see above) if you need help navigating the dungeon. L|1|3.|Use your «Pandemic Key» to open the door, and **jump down three times** to the bottom of the pit. L|1|4.|From here, take the North exit and follow the hallway to a large room, where you'll take either the East or West ramps up (both lead to the same place). L|1|5.|At the top of the ramp, you'll see a room with a surface portal and a «Statue of Bael'Zharon». L|1|6.|Everyone must **hand** their «Translation of the Pulsating Bony Lump¦Pulsating Bony Lump» to the «Statue of Bael'Zharon» to be portaled to the «Orphanage Wing». L|2|•|⟦ProdigalShadowFlag⟧ L|2|•|{WARN} Do not use the «Statue of Bael'Zharon», it will give you 5% vitae each time you use it.
H4|Part 2: The Orphanage Wing L|1|1.|From the drop, head North and hug the left wall, down the ramp, until you've passed through two larger rooms. L|1|2.|At the next intersection, take a Right, and follow the long linear path (ignoring all cut-backs) until you reach two-way split. L|1|3.|From here, take a Left and then take your First Right and follow the linear path to the final dungeon, the «Prodigal Shadow Child's Lair», which is an **intense hot drop**. L|2|•|{TIP} The «Prodigal Shadow Child's Lair» will require a download for most people, so the best strategy is to have everyone immediately run across the dungeon and hit the surface portal in the North East corner of the dungeon (there is an easy way back). This way everyone will portal in together on the next attempt.
H4|Part 3: Prodigal Shadow Child's Lair P|{TIP} If you die inside the «Prodigal Shadow Child's Lair», you can easily get back by using the «Statue of Bael'Zharon, the Hopeslayer», just North of the «Caul Recall» drop.
L|1|1.|Everyone should rebuff at the «Caul Recall» drop, and when ready, use the «Statue of Bael'Zharon, the Hopeslayer» to re-enter the «Prodigal Shadow Child's Lair». L|1|2.|You must survive three waves of «Shadow»s and «Penumbral Terror»s to eventually reach the bosses («A Shadow of Ler Rhan» and «A Shadow of Black Ferah»). L|2|•|Note: There are several strategies that people use, but typically its a good idea to have several healers in your group. L|2|•|{TIP} Try to kill the «Shadow Eddy»s first, they trigger the spawn of the mobs. L|1|3.|Once everything is dead, you'll need to kill the final boss, «Kirienne Palacost», who for most of the fight appears as a protected NPC in the North West corner of the dungeon. L|2|•|{WARN} Do not attempt to use or talk to «Kirienne Palacost» while he is surrounded by his protective bubble. You will be smited. L|1|4.|Once defeated, everyone must loot a «Scrap of Shadow Essence» from «Kirienne Palacost»'s corpse (he drops 20 scraps). L|2|•|⟦ScrapofShadowEssence_Pickup⟧ L|1|5.|Take the «Scrap of Shadow Essence» to «Riordin Nightbane» in «Wai Jhou» at 61.9S 51.4W for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦ProdigalShadowRepeat⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|There is an active «Shadow» library in part of the «Orphanage Wing» where «Uninscribed Fleshy Lump»s are being bred and where several old and new lore items can be found: L|2|•|«Shriveled Lump» L|2|•|«Sticky Lump» L|2|•|«Fleshy Lump (Shadow Note Translation)» L|2|•|«Fleshy Lump (Isin Dule's Orders)» L|2|•|«Throbbing Lump» L|2|•|«Oozing Lump» L|2|•|«Pulsing Lump» L|2|•|«Amorphous Lump» L|2|•|«Misty Message Shard» L|2|•|«Aerbax's Message Shard» L|2|•|«Obsidian Shard (The Mirror)»

H2|Dialog P|⸨You give Statue of Bael'Zharon, the Hopeslayer Pulsating Bony Lump.⸩ ⸨As you fit the lump into the keyhole, you feel a bone-numbing chill pass through your very soul. A pulling sensation forms in the core of your being, but before it becomes unbearable, you see the "key" shrivel and die. Almost immediately thereafter, the chill fades and then you feel a familiar pulling sensation.
L|1||Defeating Ler Rhan⸩ ⸨As Ler Rhan falls, you hear a soft, contemptuous voice declare, "You may've shattered his echo of my true self, but you have not defeated me, nor my children. We will return."
L|1||Defeating Black Ferah⸩ ⸨As Black Ferah falls, you hear a cold, contemptuous voice declare, "Pathetic wretch, you have but slain a small sending of my true self!"
L|1||Defeating Kirienne Palacost⸩ ⸨Kirienne Palacost stirs, as if lost in the throws of a fitful sleep.⸩ ⸨As strikes the final blow against Kirienne Palacost, the Shadow Child screams out in agony! A voice echoes throughout the land, carrying along with it a searing pain in your mind, "I hate you !!! I'm telling my uncle and he's going to get you!!"
L|1||Handing in Scrap of Shadow Essence to Riordin Nightbane⸩ ⸨You give Riordin Nightbane Scrap of Shadow Essence.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "What is this?"⸩ ⸨You explain where and how you came to have the Essence to Riordin Nightbane.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "This creature must've been truly powerful to have its essence survive its death..."⸩ ⸨You've earned 297,235,855 experience.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "You have done us all a great service, in aiding in the death of a Shadow such as this one. Please, it would honor me if you would accept these humble rewards for your noble and courageous act."⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane gives you Aegis of the Golden Flame.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane gives you Braced Mana Forge Key.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane grants you the title, "Prodigal Shadow Slayer".⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "Know that the Aegis I have given you is a rare symbol amongst our Order, and that to carry and display one is considered a great honor."
L|1||Handing in Aegis of the Golden Flame to Riordin Nightbane⸩ ⸨You give Riordin Nightbane Aegis of the Golden Flame.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "You do not wish this as a reward? Very well, but remember that its ownership and display infers a certain level of respect in our Order. But the decision is yours. Please, accept this in exchange for the aegis."⸩ ⸨You've earned 49,539,309 experience.
L|1||Handing in Scrap of Shadow Essence to Riordin Nightbane (Quest Repeat)⸩ ⸨You give Riordin Nightbane Scrap of Shadow Essence.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "Once again, you have stepped up where few others would and protected Dereth from the rise of a creature who could spell the end of all of us. Please, accept these rewards."⸩ ⸨You've earned 99,078,619 experience.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane gives you Aegis of the Golden Flame.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "Remember, the Aegis I have given you is a rare symbol amongst our Order, and that to carry and display one is considered a great honor."⸩

Quest.name: Brewmaster_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|40 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Rand» I|Starts At|71.8N, 60.8W in «Sanamar» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to gain the «Brew Kettle» used in creating attribute buffing «Beer»s.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Brewmaster's Spine L|1|1.|Head to the «Waterfall Cave», located at 84.0N, 75.4W. L|2|•|Route: «Sanamar» to «Cataracts of Sabella» portal at 75.9N, 61.3W. L|1|2.|From the drop, hug the right wall all the way to the bottom, where you'll reach a pit. L|1|3.|Jump into the pit and follow the hallway until you reach a large room, where you'll pick up a «Brewmaster's Spine» and a «Sdolin Buk!» on the ground. L|2|•|⟦brewmasterspine⟧ L|1|4.|Now take the surface portal and run to the «Remote Empyrean Vault» at 81.6N, 71.2W.
H3|Part 2: Brewmaster's Front Cover L|1|1.|From the «Remote Empyrean Vault» portal drop, continue to take the ramps down, doing a U-turn at each ramp until you reach a split with a corpse of a «Famished Eater» in it. L|1|2.|Take the right split and head down the ramp into a larger room. Pick up the «Brewmaster's Front Cover», located on the floor to the South side of the room. L|2|•|⟦brewmastercover⟧
H3|Part 3: Brewmaster's Back Cover L|1|1.|From «Westwatch», run to the «Viamontian Garrison» at 75.3N, 73.8W. L|2|•|Route: From «Town Network», take the «Westwatch» portal at 71.2N, 61.3W. L|1|2.|From the portal drop, take the door to your immediate left (West), and hug the left wall until you reach a long hallway with a series of doors on either side. L|1|3.|Open the 2nd door on your right, and pick up the «Brewmaster's Back Cover» from the ground. L|2|•|⟦brewmasterback⟧
H3|Part 4: Brewmaster's Pages L|1|1.|From «Silyun», run to «Lola's Den» at 91.9N, 69.6W. L|1|2.|From the portal drop, hug the left wall all the way down until you find the «Brewmaster's Pages» resting on a pedestal near the Surface Portal. Take them. L|2|•|⟦brewmasterpages⟧ L|2|•|{TIP} You may have to jump onto the pedestal to pick up the pages.
H3|Part 5: Brewmaster's Bible L|1|1.|Combine the Brewmaster's Spine with the Brewmaster's Front Cover to create an «Incomplete Brewmaster's Bible». L|1|2.|Now combine the Incomplete Brewmaster's Bible with the Brewmaster's Back Cover to create an «Nearly Complete Brewmaster's Bible». L|1|3.|Finally, combine the Nearly Complete Brewmaster's Bible with the Brewmaster's Pages to create «Rand's Brewmaster's Bible». L|1|4.|Give Rand's Brewmaster's Bible to «Rand» to receive your rewards. L|2|•|⟦BrewmasterBibleReturned⟧

Quest.name: Bur_Recall_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Oswent the Pale» I|Starts At|25.7N 49.2E in «Cragstone» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|To access this quest, you must have completed the «Saving Asheron» quest. L|1|•|This quest is a prerequisite for «Aerbax's Prodigal Lugian». Once that quest has been started with the «Royal Summons», the dungeon for this quest becomes permanently inaccessible.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Oswent the Pale» in «Cragstone». L|2|•|⟦BurRecall_Start!⟧ L|1|2.|Head to «Linvak Tukal» and use «Kresovus' Lockbox» located up in Kresovus' chambers at 77.6S, 28.0E. You will be sent to the «Secret Chamber of Kresovus». L|1|3.|Destroy the «Watcher's Wall», an attackable door, while keeping the «Watcher's Guard»s killed (if in a group). The door is high health and the lugians respawn quickly. Tusker Fists and Curse of Raven Fury work well. L|2|•|{TIP} If you are attempting this solo, Imp VII, Slash Vuln VII, and an AR weapon works very well on the door. L|1|4.|When the door is destroyed, kill the virindi «Watcher in the Warren» and loot the «Watcher's Message Shard». Repeat as needed (1 shard per spawn, 5 minute respawn). L|2|•|⟦WatchersMessageShardPickupTimer!⟧ L|1|5.|Return the shard to «Oswent the Pale» who will give you the «Scroll of Bur Recall» and an experience reward. L|2|•|⟦BurRecall_Repeat!⟧ L|2|•|⟦BurRecall_Wait!⟧

R| RK|Experience|275,000,000 (Fixed% up to level 150) RK|Items| RI|«Scroll of Bur Recall» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale tells you, "You fought valiantly against the Falatacot that imprisoned Asheron on Bur, didn't you? I have seen council reports on your bravery. I commend you for your past service, and I would ask for your assistance once more in a very sensitive matter of utmost importance to the realm. Some of us have reason to believe that Lord Kresovus, the leader of our Lugian allies, is... not what he seems."⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale tells you, "Please venture to the Lugian stronghold of Linvak Tukal and discreetly investigate Lord Kresovus' quarters. It could be that there is some evidence there of what has happened to him."
L|1||Defeating the Warren Watcher⸩ ⸨As you deal a fatal blow to the Warren Watcher and dissipate its essence, it shrieks in your mind, "You have slain this iteration, meat puppet, but you will not interfere with the Master's immortality!"
L|1||Handing in Watcher's Message Shard to Oswent the Pale⸩ ⸨You give Oswent the Pale Watcher's Message Shard.⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale tells you, "This is exactly the sort of thing I was looking for. I think the presence of the Virindi confirms our suspicions that the Lord Kresovus who resides now in Linvak Tukal is an impostor! But please, keep this discreet. I cannot even share with you what we translate from this shard. Some secrets are too sensitive. But I thank you for your loyal and courageous service."⸩ ⸨You've earned 275,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale tells you, "You might also find this useful, since you've been to Bur... A scroll to help you recall to that mysterious and intriguing world."⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale gives you Scroll of Bur Recall.⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale tells you, "I may have another mission for you, should you choose to accept it."
L|1||Handing in Watcher's Message Shard to Oswent the Pale (Quest Repeat)⸩ ⸨You give Oswent the Pale Watcher's Message Shard.⸩ ⸨Oswent the Pale tells you, "Thank you for bringing this to me... Quest.name: Clutch_of_Kings_(Broodu)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Guard Hamdyn» I|Starts At|25.7N, 48.8E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Clutch of Kings: Broodu» H2|Overview L|1|•|{WARN}: Talk to the Cragstone NPCs before running this a 2nd time, or you won't be able to pick up the hide at the end. L|1|•|This is the third of six quests in the «Clutch of Kings», or «Clutch of Kings¦Burun Kings», series of quests. L|1|•|It is broken up into four parts; a dungeon, a puzzle, another dungeon, and finally the boss, «Broodu». L|1|•|The trophy is acquired from the ground after killing the boss. L|1|•|It is then taken to «Cragstone», and given to «Guard Hamdyn» for your reward(s); or can be saved for the «Clutch of Kings» series. L|1|•|You will be facing Burun Ruuks and Burun Guruks in both dungeons and with the boss. All the monsters are commonly weak to frost and additionally a «Critical Strike» weapon will be needed for the boss fight.
H2|Walkthrough H3|Part 1: Depth's of Liazk Itzi's Temple L|1|1.|From «Xarabydun», run to the temple at 40.8S, 11.9E and speak to the «Watcher of the Dead» to be portaled into the «Depth's of Liazk Itzi's Temple». L|1|2.|From the drop, jump down and take the North exit. From here, hug the wall left for the rest of the dungeon, with the only obstacle being a lever activated door in the first large room: L|2|•|In the first large room you come to, open the Southeast door by entering the room on the East wall and pulling the lever inside. The entrance to the East room is activated by floor plates on either side of the door. L|1|3.|When you reach the end of the dungeon, use the Portal Gateway to be sent to the «Secrets of Liazk Itzi's Temple».
H3|Part 2: Secrets of Liazk Itzi's Temple L|1|1.|From the drop, pull one of the 3 levers in front of you, which will determine the following sequence of levers you will pull: L|2|1.|Pull lever «0 1 1 2 3 5», then pull 8, 13, 21, 34 and 55. L|2|2.|Pull lever «3 1 4 1», then pull 5, 9, 2, 6 and 5. L|2|3.|Pull lever «2 3 5 7 11», then pull 13, 17, 19, 23 and 29. L|1|2.|If you succeed, you'll be portaled in front of an exit portal which leads to «Liazk Itzi's Temple», take it. L|2|•|⟦NumberPuzzleCompleted⟧ L|2|•|Note: If you fail, you'll be portaled to the beginning, where you'll have to start over again.
H3|Part 3: Liazk Itzi's Temple L|1|1.|From the drop, head East and hug the left wall all the way to the end, there are no levers are misdirections in here. L|1|2.|At the end, you'll find a hallway on the West wall, which leads to a «Portal Gateway». The device leads to «Broodu», the boss. L|1|3.|Before using the device, there are several things to know before going into the fight with Broodu, review these tactics: L|2|•|Do not debuff him, he counters most debuffs. L|2|•|Disband your fellowship before going into battle. Broodu casts Fellowship Debuffs, so you lessen the chance to be debuffed when not in a fellowship. L|2|•|If you are swallowed (portaled into Broodu's stomach), quickly switch to a «Critical Strike» weapon, and attack his «Stomach Wall» on full speed. You have only have a percent chance of escaping his stomach when you land a critical hit. L|3|•|{TIP} If you're a mage, use wall spells for a greater chance to critical hit. L|1|4.|Once everyone is ready, use the Portal Gateway to be porataled into the «Center of Liazk Itzi's Temple» (hot drop).
H3|Part 4: Center of Liazk Itzi's Temple L|1|1.|When you portal in, you'll immediately be attacked by Burun, and «Broodu» is just to the North. L|1|2.|Kill Broodu using frost weapons/bows and «Tusker Fists» or Frost Wall. L|2|•|Note: Do not debuff Broodu, he will counter. See above for tactics. L|1|3.|Once you kill Broodu, loot «Broodu's Hide» from the floor. L|2|•|⟦BrooduBeaten⟧ L|1|4.|Head to «Cragstone», and speak to «Guard Hamdyn» at 25.7N, 48.8E for your XP, «Mana Forge Key» (125+), and random reward. L|2|•|⟦BrooduKilled⟧ L|2|•|⟦BrooduComplete⟧ L|1|5.|{OPT} Hand Broodu's Hide to Guard Hamdyn for the title of Broodu Killer. L|2|•|Note: Hold on to the hide if you are trying to obtain the Kingslayer title. See the «Clutch of Kings» for more information.

I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|100+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Dark Monolith Caverns» I|Route|«Dark Monolith Caverns Portal Gem» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|"A request to all Virindi sympathetic to Aerbax's cause. We would aquire a source of power from beneath the black plains the humans call the Direlands. This power source would be a significant benefit to our affairs." -«Dark Monolith Caverns Portal Gem»
L|1|•|This quest requires the «Dark Monolith Caverns Portal Gem» to begin. This item can be found on both high level «Virindi» and «Human¦Raven Hand» humans.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Use the portal gem to open a portal to the «Dark Monolith Caverns». L|1|2.|Split into two groups. The group going south will encounter large groups of Shadows and Virindi. The group going east will encounter large groups of Raven Hand cultists. L|1|3.|Have both groups progress to through the dungeon. Each group will come to a room with several large hostile crystals and a lever. The lever opens the door on the other wing of the dungeon. Pull both levels. L|1|4.|The groups will be re-united at this point. Destroy a group of Slithis. You will come to another large room full of more hostile crystals. Destroy these then one of the destructible doors. L|1|5.|Progress to the final chamber. Destroy the «Guardian of the Monolith». L|1|6.|Loot the «Title Token: Guardian of the Dark». L|2|•|⟦GuardianOfTheDarkTitleToken⟧ L|1|7.|Use the Dark Monolith located on the platform in the center of the room to obtain the hookable version of the «Dark Monolith». L|2|•|⟦DarkMonolithReceived⟧ L|1|8.|{OPT} Runed Chest next to the «Dark Monolith». L|2|•|⟦ChestQuestDarkMonolith⟧ L|1|9.|Bring the title token to «Ulgrim the Unpleasant» to be rewarded with the title reward. L|1|10.|{OPT} If you don't want the Dark Monolith, you can give it to Ulgrim for experience.

Quest.name: Deewain's_Dark_Cavern
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Rec. Level|200 I|Type|Group I|Starts At|«Dark Cavern» I|Repeat|20 hours I|Time|20 Hours I|Kill Task|False I|Contracts|«Contract for Deewain's Dark Cavern» H2|Quest Overview
P|"Fayza is interested in the Energy Infused Rocks from Deewain's Dark Cavern."
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Run to the «Dark Cavern» at 87.9N, 9.3W. L|2|•|Route: Take the «Snowy Valley» settlement portal in «Tou-Tou» (27.1S, 96.0E) L|1|2.|You are dropped at a random starting location when you enter.
H3|Maze L|1|•|Preliminary Directions: (See map for possible drop points, use /loc to find where you have been dropped) L|1|1.|This is a maze, stretching east and west. Go up and as far north where you can. There are identical big rooms with pits on the north and south sides. **You need the north big room**. L|2|•|{WARN} The south side pit does NOT have a ledge, and will result in you falling all the way to the bottom, with no means of getting out other than recalling. L|1|2.|When you reach the north big room with a pit, you can zoom out, and see an opening one level down. L|1|3.|The pit has an invisible floor, do a shift jump down to it. It was about a 3/4 jump. The invisible floor is out a bit from the edge, so don't try to just jump as close to the edge as you can. L|1|4.|Proceed into the tunnel from the invisible floor, there is a "Surface" Portal. (It does NOT take you to the surface where you started!!) L|1|5.|This portals you to another big room with stones to jump (optional, read on ..).
H3|Jumping Puzzle L|1|•|If you do not want to jump, you can kill the Defender golems up the ramp on the right hand side of the room. The path leads to the same portal puzzle as the jumping puzzle.
H4|Concerning the Path with the Golems L|1|1.|There is a series of 3 rooms to pass through, each with 3 Follower of Deewain golems (lvl 220, 3250 hp), and a different element of "Defender" golem (25,000 hp) («Fiery Defender», «Chilled Defender», «Charged Defender»). L|1|2.|The Followers are on a very fast respawn timer, but do minimal damage both melee and magic wise L|1|3.|Slay the "Defender" of a room to open the two doors into the room beyond. Once the "Defender" is killed, the Followers in it's room will disappear. L|1|4.|At the end of the 3 rooms is a room with 3 portals (see "portal puzzle" part below for further explanation) L|1|•|Note: watch out when a double spawn occurs: killing a defender the second time closes the door again.
H4|The Jumping Puzzle Option P|The locations of the platforms change, so there will be different routes. Route 1: L|1|1.|Shift Jump to the rock in the middle, just below the platform L|1|2.|Looong jump N, towards another rock in the middle, you won't land on top of it, but bump off it on another one L|1|3.|Shift jump to the NW L|1|4.|Long jump E, slightly N, to a rock against the wall L|1|5.|Shift jump to the next one L|1|6.|Backwards shift jump L|1|7.|Step backwards, shift jump L|1|8.|Long jump straight N L|1|9.|Shift jump W L|1|10.|Backwards shift jump on the platform
H3|Portal Puzzle L|1|•|Next, there will be three portals, each bringing you to a next section with more portals L|1|•|Worked: (confirmed) L|1|1.|Left (Updated) L|1|2.|Left L|1|3.|Mid L|1|4.|Right L|1|5.|Mid
L|1|•|If you take a wrong portal, you're back at the start of the jumping puzzle...
H3|Fallen Spikes & Rocks L|1|•|If you do it right, you will end up in another big room with LOTS of Falling Spikes. L|2|•|Go left wall, watch sequence, when last one nearby falls, run like hell L|1|•|Next, there are «Missile Defender» Golems who hurl rocks at you. L|1|•|Step back into the hallway and kill the 4 «Fallen Rock»s that lie on the ramp. L|1|•|On the other side, there is another large room with «Follower of Deewain¦Followers of Deewain», 1 «Fiery Defender», 1 «Charged Defender» and a «Chilled Defender». L|1|•|Kill the «Chilled Defender», «Fiery Defender», «Charged Defender» and a 5 minute portal to «Deewain»'s Chambers will spawn. L|2|•|Use portal: ⟦DeewainBossRoomFlag⟧
H3|Deewain's Chamber L|1|1.|«Deewain (Creature)¦Deewain» «Iron Golem (350)» is surrounded by a few Rocks and Followers of «Deewain». He is weak to bludgeoning and acid. Deewain has 200,250 health and nasty debuffs. If you defeat him, the rocks blocking the passage out of the room disappear. L|1|2.|Follow the passage and pick up a rock on the ground (1 day timer) L|2|•|⟦DeewainRockTrophy0211⟧ L|1|3.|Pick up «Legendary Key» L|2|•|⟦DeewainLegKeyPickupTimer⟧ L|1|4.|Hand to «Fayza» in «Xarabydun» for your reward. L|2|•|⟦DeewainCompleted0211⟧
L|1||Note: If you die at this point, run back to the «Dark Cavern» and you will be warped back to «Deewain»'s Chamber. There are originally only a few rocks, but they respawn after being picked up, no need to kill «Deewain» again.

Quest.name: Elari_Wood_Bow
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|50 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Marescent Plateau» I|Route|«Timaru» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|A band of Hea Tumeroks hunts on the «Marescent Plateau». Among this party is «Hea Temenua», who carries the bow formerly used by the infamous archer, «Lilitha». Kill Temenua and obtain the two parts of the bow, which can be recombined.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Find «Hea Temenua» on the «Marescent Plateau». He is a rare spawn and is found with a number of other Hea Tumeroks including «Hea Karenua» and «Hea Kanokeh». L|2|•|⟦ChampionKillQuest2⟧ L|1|2.|Kill Temenua and loot the two components of the bow on his corpse: the «Greenwood Haft» and the «Gromnie Sinew Bowstring». L|2|•|⟦ChampionQuest06⟧ L|2|•|⟦ChampionQuest07⟧ L|1|3.|Hea Karenua also drops the «Awakener» and 4 «Karenua's Key»s. L|2|•|⟦ChampionQuest01⟧ L|1|4.|Combine the «Greenwood Haft» and the «Gromnie Sinew Bowstring» to produce the «Sublime Elari Wood Bow» (Bow Skill Check). L|2|•|Bow skill of 320 gives a 50/50 chance of success. If it breaks you have to wait three weeks to try again with new parts.
P|Notes L|1|•|«Karenua's Key» can be used on the «Hea Raiders' Cache» found on the plateau at 43.3N, 82.5W.

Quest.name: Empyrean_Acid_Propylaeum_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|50 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|31.6S, 74.2W I|Route|«Baishi» go to the «Drunken Madman» at 53.0S, 61.0E. Give him «Sake» to summon the «Walled Portals». I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Start by heading to «Baishi». Nab a Sake from the local bar, then head to the Drunken Madman (53S, 61W) and give him the Sake and take the portal that he summons. Then just run to the Propylaeum at 31.6S, 74.2W. A good idea to avoid making everyone run and get confused is to have someone head out ahead of time or use the Mount Lethe Recall spell and head to the Sclavus Cathedral at 33.5S, 80.1W and tie to the exit portal inside. L|1|2.|Take the tunnel ahead of you and take the right turn. Jump on down the hole you come to, and make sure you get out of the acid pool before you get hurt. Take the WEST passage, and form a line at the «Chest (Empyrean Acid Propylaeum)¦Chest». Everyone needs a «Hammer of Acid» from this chest. Once everyone has their Hammer, take the SOUTH passage from the room with the Acid pool. Head along the halls until you reach a large room with two portals. Split into 2 groups here. L|2|•|⟦KeyHammerEmpyreanAcidPickup⟧ L|1|3.|If there is more than 1 fellowship, a good idea would be to assign group leaders both from the same fellowship. After the groups are split up and leaders assigned if needed, one group goes into the Upper portion, the other group goes into the Lower portion. L|1|4.|Both groups should stay in communication the whole time on when they are at doors/levers and if doors are opened. All of the following is considering both groups stay in constant communication of progress to make sure nobody gets stuck anywhere. L|1|5.|Steps for the group in the Lower section: L|2|1.|Head forward and at the intersection head SOUTH into the room with an acid pool, hit the button on the wall inside (Partially hard to see from the hall). L|2|2.|Head back to the intersection and head WEST to a door. (Ignore the path that turns off to the EAST) L|2|3.|Once the door opens, hit the lever inside and head back to the intersection at the beginning, then head NORTH and take the first left. L|2|4.|When the other group is ready, hit this lever and continue on NORTH, turning left at the fork. In the next room head through the NORTH exit and follow the path to the next door. (Ignore the path that heads off to the EAST) L|2|5.|After you get through the next door, continue on SOUTH to the pit. Angle your camera to see the door directly below you. (Example of camera angle) L|2|6.|Once the door opens, jump down and run through the door, then take a left at the fork. L|2|7.|In the first room you come to is a set of blight and dispel traps, jump to one side of the room and then through the next hallway. Rebuff if needed. (The first jump into the room.) (The second jump out of the room.) L|2|8.|In the next large room, take the NORTH exit once the door opens. Work your way around to the doorway, and jump through to avoid the trap there. (The jump through the doorway.) Use your hammer on the «Prism of Acid» like a chest and key. L|2|9.|Once everyone in the group has a «Fragment of the Acid Prism», head on through the door you came through on the SOUTH side of the room and take the EAST exit and the portal at the end. L|3|•|⟦PrismFragmentAcidPickup⟧ L|1|6.|Steps for the group in the Upper section: L|2|1.|Run ahead of you and through the small passage to the first door. When it opens, run in and take the EAST exit, turning left at the fork. L|2|2.|Hit the lever in the room and head back WEST into the larger room, then take the SOUTH exit. Don't stand too close to the door, as the acid pool will hurt you through it. L|2|3.|Once the door opens, run through the pool and head NORTH at the intersection. L|2|4.|When you get past the door, take the NORTH exit from the room. Hit the lever inside and head back. Take the WEST exit from the room. L|2|5.|Head up the stairs and into the next room. L|2|7.|From where you are, jump SOUTHEAST into the corner of the grates sticking upward. After that, jump over to the lever and wait there. L|2|8.|Once the other group reaches their final door, after the room with the traps, hit this lever and wait here. L|2|9.|As the other group gathers their prisms, this group may gather their bracelets from the room EAST of the lever (jump across to it). Do not exit the portal yet. L|2|2.|Someone in the Lower section runs out of the prism room (hit the lever on top of the grates if the door is closed) and on through the SOUTH exit of the room. L|2|3.|The person in the lower section hits the lever at the end of this passage and then runs back to the prism room (or through the portal). L|2|4.|The person(s) who fell run through the exit of the room under the grates and through the passage to an open door, from here the rest should be familiar. L|1|8.|When you exit you will need to run back to the Propylaeum. You will be dropped at the location where the Essence used to be when you take the exit portal. L|1|9.|Repeat the entire dungeon with a reversed group setup in order to get everyone a Ebuillant Bracelet and Prism. L|1|10.|Go to any Agent of the Arcanum and turn in the Prism for your reward. Quest.name: Empyrean_Cloister_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|21 I|Type|Small Fellowship I|Starts At|«Empyrean Cloister» at 23.4S, 5.8E I|Route|From «Yaraq» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|This dungeon contains the first part of the «Sword of Lost Hope Quest» - the «Skull of Avoren Palacost».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Split your group into two teams. About half way into the dungeon one team will need to enter the «Empyrean Cloister Upper» and one the «Empyrean Cloister Lower». L|2|•|Upper team members will receive the «Skull of Avoren Palacost». L|3|•|⟦HopeslayerSkull⟧ L|2|•|Lower team members will receive a «Barbed Fletching Tool», «Obsidian Dagger», and an «Empyrean Scalemail Shirt». L|3|•|⟦BarbedFletchingTool⟧ L|3|•|⟦HopeslayerObsidianDagger⟧ L|3|•|⟦EmpyreanScalemailShirt⟧ L|1|2.|Each team, as they proceed through the Upper and Lower dungeons, needs to throw levers for the other team. So as levers are located by one team, they need to wait at the lever until the other team indicates that they are at their closed door. L|1|3.|As Acid Pits are encountered they must be jumped - make sure you have a high jump skill and that you are buffed! Also a good tip is to have an «Aphus Lassel Portal Gem» ready for use in case you do fall in. L|1|4.|In the final room in Lower is a torch that acts as the final lever for the Upper team. L|1|5.|The «Skull of Avoren Palacost» spawns on the floor in Upper, the «Barbed Fletching Tool» and «Obsidian Dagger» in Lower are on the «Mausoleum Guardian».
P|TIP: This quest can easily be done "solo", provided you have 2 characters on your account that can survive the run. The lever-activated doors stay open for a minute or more; you can easily switch characters at each lever door, activate the lever using your other character and run it the next lever/door, then switch characters and proceed in the other dungeon in the same fashion.
P|Notes L|1|•|If you visit the optional quest starter, «Chosen of Asheron», he will hand you the texts: «Asheron's Second Missive» and «Instructions (Sepulcher of the Hopeslayer)¦Instructions».

If you are one of the champions who took part in the defeat of Bael'Zharon, I can take your Soul Crystal Gem and give you a spellcasting staff to commemorate your achievement. L|1||Chosen of Asheron gives you Asheron's Second Missive L|1||Chosen of Asheron tells you, "Also, I have instructions here that will lead you to the site of the Hopeslayer's defeat, should you wish to visit it. L|1||Chosen of Asheron gives you Instructions.

Quest.name: Empyrean_Fire_Propylaeum_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|25 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|73.5N, 2.7W I|Route|«Crater» to «Anadil» at 66.3N, 14.3E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Take the tunnel ahead of you and take the right turn. Jump on down the hole you come to, and make sure you get out of the acid pool before you get hurt. Take the WEST passage, and form a line at the «Chest (Empyrean Fire Propylaeum)¦Chest». Everyone needs a «Hammer of Fire» from this chest. Once everyone has their Hammer, take the SOUTH passage from the room with the Acid pool. Head along the halls until you reach a large room with two portals. Split into 2 groups here. L|2|•|⟦KeyHammerEmpyreanFirePickup⟧ L|1|2.|If there is more than 1 fellowship, a good idea would be to assign group leaders both from the same fellowship. After the groups are split up and leaders assigned if needed, one group goes into the Upper portion, the other group goes into the Lower portion. L|1|3.|Both groups should stay in communication the whole time on when they are at doors/levers and if doors are opened. All of the following is considering both groups stay in constant communication of progress to make sure nobody gets stuck anywhere. L|1|4.|Steps for the group in the Lower section: L|2|1.|Head forward and take the first right. Once the other group is at their first door hit the lever. L|2|2.|Run NORTH from the lever and when you reach the second intersection, head SOUTH. L|2|3.|After the door is open, run in and hit the lever once the other group is at their next door, then run NORTH through the hall taking the first left after the intersection. L|2|4.|Hit the lever here once the other group gets to their next door, then go back to the hall and run NORTH, taking a left at the fork. L|2|5.|Once the door opens, run through the NORTH exit of the room and through the passage (Ignore the door on your left as you go) and make your way through the next large room and SOUTH again to the pit room. L|2|6.|Angle your camera to see when the door opens. (Example of camera angle) When it is open, hop down and run through the door, taking a left at the fork. L|2|7.|In the first room you come to is a set of blight and dispel traps, jump to one side of the room and then through the next hallway. Rebuff if needed. (The first jump into the room.) (The second jump out of the room.) L|2|8.|In the next large room, take the NORTH exit once the door opens. Work your way around to the doorway, and jump through to avoid the trap there. (The jump through the doorway.) Use your hammer on the «Prism of Fire» like a chest and key. L|2|9.|Once everyone in the group has a «Fragment of the Fire Prism», head on through the door you came through on the SOUTH side of the room and take the EAST exit and the portal at the end. L|3|•|⟦PrismFragmentFirePickup⟧ L|1|5.|Steps for the group in the Upper section: L|2|1.|Run forward and on through the door once it opens, then take the EAST exit to the room and a right at the fork. Hit the lever once the other group is at their first door. L|2|2.|Run back WEST and take the SOUTH exit from the room and through the door once it opens up. L|2|3.|At the intersection head NORTH, down the ramp and through the door when it is open. L|2|4.|Head through the NORTH exit of the room and hit the lever inside, then head back SOUTH into the larger room and take the WEST exit. L|2|5.|Head up the stairs and into the next room, the next lever you need to hit is in this room, wait til the other group is at the pit, then hit the lever. L|2|6.|Head on through the SOUTH exit of this room and through the passage on to the grate room. Jump on over SOUTHEAST and then on to the lever. L|2|7.|Once the other group reaches their final door after the room with the traps, hit this lever and wait here. L|2|8.|As the other group gathers their prisms, this group may gather their bracelets from the room EAST of the lever (jump across to it). Do not exit the portal yet. L|2|9.|Once all prisms are collected in the other group, if the door is closed for them hit the lever, then head on through the portal in the room with the bracelet. L|3|•|⟦BraceletIncalescentPickup⟧ L|1|6.|If anyone falls in the grate room, the following must occur: L|2|1.|The person(s) who fell hits the lever under the grates (Nobody should jump down for this unless help is needed to kill). L|2|2.|Someone in the Lower section runs out of the prism room (hit the lever on top of the grates if the door is closed) and on through the SOUTH exit of the room. L|2|3.|The person in the lower section hits the lever at the end of this passage and then runs back to the prism room (or through the portal). L|2|4.|The person(s) who fell run through the exit of the room under the grates and through the passage to an open door, from here the rest should be familiar. L|1|7.|When you exit you will need to run back to the Propylaeum. You will be dropped at the location where the Essence used to be when you take the exit portal. L|1|8.|Repeat the entire dungeon with a reversed group setup in order to get everyone a Incalescent Bracelet and Prism. L|1|9.|Go to any Agent of the Arcanum and turn in the Prism for your reward. The Writs are only awarded for the first Prism that you hand in of each type, after that you only get the Craftable Prism and the XP. L|2|•|⟦PrismFragmentFireGiven⟧

Quest.name: End_of_Days
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|200 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Aun Ol'tra» I|Starts At|«Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains» at 61.6S, 63.3W I|Route|«Rynthid Recall» or «Mansion» to «Dangerous Portal Device» to Center of the «Obsidian Plains» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for End of Days» H2|Overview P|As originally discovered in the «Purging the Corruption» quest, the «Curator of Torment» has been experimenting on Tumeroks as well as Gearknights, Lugians, and Olthoi. Assist Aun Ol'tra in destroying the corrupted Tumerok Bah'Ktar.
H2|Walk Through L|1|1.|Speak to «Aun Ol'tra» in the «Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains» at 61.6S, 63.3W L|2|•|Route: «Rynthid Recall» or «Mansion» to «Dangerous Portal Device» to Center of the «Obsidian Plains» L|2|•|⟦EODStarted_1013⟧ L|1|2.|Head to «Bah'Ktar's Tower» at 62.7S 66.6W. L|2|•|The safest route is to jump down into the canyon and head north from the encampment. Near where the ground turns from black to brown, you can find a path up to the west. Continue heading west and then south to reach the dungeon. L|1|3.|The dungeon consists of a series of rooms filled with Tumeroks and Rynthid enemies and is largely linear. There are 4 large room connected by hallways in between. Each of the 4 large rooms has several large portal energy traps that goes off every 15-20 seconds. After these traps go off, random blue portals appear in the room which drop you back at the start if you happen to run into them. The cycle then repeats with the traps going off again. L|2|•|When fighting, it is best to stay in the hallways than to fight in the large rooms and risk being portaled to the start. L|2|•|It makes sense where appropriate to pause at the entrance to each large room and wait for the portals to spawn again before entering. Otherwise new portals may spawn on top of you while running through the room. L|1|4.|Just before the entrance to the 5th and final room, there is a path leading down to the left. It leads to a maze section containing a «Chorizite Chest» and many Rynthid enemies. L|2|•|⟦chestchorizite72060⟧ L|1|5.|In the 5th room, there are no portal traps, only corrupted Tumeroks, Rynthid, and a «Tormented Watcher» Hollow Minion. L|1|6.|When the Tormented Watcher dies, a portal to the boss room will spawn. L|2|•|Warning: The boss room is a hot drop! L|1|7.|In the boss room are a several lightning elementals and the boss, «Bah'Ktar» (Tumerok). L|1|8.|Each person needs to loot a «Crimson Scarab» off of «Bah'Ktar» (drops 9). L|2|•|⟦CrimsonScarabPickup⟧ L|1|9.|«Legendary Key»s will spawn on the ground. Loot one and use it on the chests which have spawned in the room. L|2|•|⟦EODKeyPickup_1013⟧ L|2|•|Note that there is a countdown timer on the chests. So loot quickly! L|1|10.|Return to «Aun Ol'tra» and give him the «Crimson Scarab» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦EODCompleted_1013⟧

H2|Trivia
P|When first introduced, this was a server quest. When large numbers of parts were turned in, the Gold Gear Primus slowly took form next to Takahume. First the feet (1k), then the legs (10k), then the abdomen (20k), then the torso (30k), then the arms (40k), and finally «Atamarr», the Gold Primus, was activated at 50k.
P|Once activated, Atamarr accepted the items and gave a quest to retrieve a «Storage Box».

Quest.name: Harlune's_Diplomacy
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Roderick» I|Starts At|«Mite Maze» at 41.1N, 57.3E I|Route|«Facility Hub» to Mite Maze portal in the west wing I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Harlune's Diplomacy» H2|Overview P|«Harlune the Misanthrope» has disappeared from the «Mite Maze» and the mysterious «Roderick» claims to be working on his behalf. He asks you to deliver a diplomatic message on his behalf to the Falatacot on Bur.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You must be «Asheron's Departure¦Bur Flagged» in order to complete this quest. L|1|•|Someone with «Lockpick» must open the doors in «Mite Maze» to access «Roderick». L|1|•|You must maintain the «Diplomatic Message from Harlune» in your inventory throughout the quest.
L|1|•|**Leaftide Quest Bonus**: Two runs for all stamps.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Taking the Diplomatic Message to Bur L|1|1.|If this is your first time talking to «Roderick», you will receive a stamp: L|2|•|⟦FirstTalkWithRoderick⟧ L|1|2.|«Roderick» will give you «Diplomatic Message from Harlune». L|2|•|Note: If you haven't done the «Water of Mount Lethe» quest recently, the first time you speak to Roderick he will give you «A Crabbed Note». Speak to him again for the «Diplomatic Message from Harlune». L|2|•|⟦CHDSStarted0608⟧ L|1|3.|Go to «Kor-Gursha» on «Bur» and speak to «Scout Leader Tmauruk». L|2|•|Route: «Rithwic» to «Glystaene Cottages» portal at 8.8N, 60.9E. From there head to the «Portal to Bur» (must be flagged) at 67.4N, 30.5E. Alternatively, use the «Bur Recall» spell. L|1|4.|Continue east to the «Southern Catacombs» portal. L|1|5.|Stick right past Guruk and use the Rock next to Temple of the Three, Ritual Chambers portal to enter the «Upper Catacombs». L|1|6.|Use the statue inside the 4th room from the south in the back hallway (runs North to South, see map) to enter the «Falatacot Visitor's Alcove».
H3|Part 2: Falatacot Visitor's Alcove L|1|1.|From the drop, head South, and take your first right. Use the second door you find, and move through the linear dungeon until you reach a large room. L|2|•|Note: If you reach a pit, you have taken the wrong door. Do not jump into any pits, you will not be able to get out. L|1|2.|Run straight ahead. Near to the center of the room is a floor plate (that not works properly, so you have to do a little jump over it), which triggers the spawn of a statue and about 10 undeads. L|1|3.|Survive in the room until you receive a green message that the eyes light up and the statue can be used. L|2|•|{TIP} Once you spawn the mob, retreat into the hallway and close the door until the statue charges. L|1|4.|Use the statue to portal to the next stage. L|1|5.|From the drop, take your first right. Ignore the door and follow the linear path until, once again, you reach a large room. L|1|6.|Run straight ahead. Again, near to the center of the room is a floor plate (that not works properly and requires to do a little jump over it), which triggers the spawn of a statue and seven «Blood Priestess»es and an «Elite Zharalim Agent». L|1|7.|Survive in the room until you receive another green message and the statue can be used again. L|2|•|{TIP} Once you spawn the mob, retreat into the hallway and close the door until the statue charges. L|1|8.|Use the statue to be teleported into the next stage.
H3|Part 3: The Falatacot Herald L|1|1.|Take the door to the east and speak with the «Falatacot Herald». He will take your Diplomatic Message from Harlune and spawn a mob of creatures «#footnote1¦*». L|2|•|{TIP} Immeditely after speaking to the Falatacot Herald, run up to the platform behind him. Mages and archers can perch from here. L|2|•|Note: Be careful the Laisu Sclavus casts Poison Health (20% lower health for 5 minutes) and there is no shortcut back. L|1|2.|Kill the three «Falatacot Blood Prophetess»es, one of which will have a «Falatacot Blood Prophetess Trinket» on their corpse (drops 3). L|2|•|⟦CHDSFalatacotCharm0608⟧ L|2|•|{TIP} They are vulnerable to cold physcial attacks, and fire elemental attacks (undead slayer). L|1|3.|Once you have a trinket, return to «Mite Maze» and give it to «Roderick» for your reward. L|2|•|⟦CHDSCompletedOnce0608⟧ L|2|•|Second Run: ⟦CHDSRepeat0608⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Roderick tells you, "Hmm...Ya think ya might be interested in doin' a favor for Harlune? Ya look tough enough to survive what he has in mind."⸩ ⸨Roderick gives you Diplomatic Message from Harlune.⸩ ⸨Roderick tells you, "The Falatacot Matriarchs sent him a message, ya see, askin' if he'd like to ally. Well, of course he don't - the Falatacot can't be trusted one bit. So he wants to send a message back...but ya know how Harlune can be."⸩ ⸨Roderick tells you, "Anyways, he asked me to find some volunteers to deliver the mission. He didn't tell me to mention it, but I'll be nice and mention it anyways - the Falatacot ain't gonna be happy when they read the message."⸩ ⸨Roderick tells you, "Here, take this and bring it to Bur. One of the statues up there should lead to a new place where ya can go and deliver the message, and then ya better be ready for a fight. If ya win, bring something back to prove to me that ya won."
L|1||Giving Diplomatic Message from Harlunes to Falatacot Herald⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Diplomatic Message from Harlunes.⸩ ⸨The Falatacot Herald reads the message from Harlune. At first, his aged face is impassive, but as he continues reading a visage of sheer fury appears.⸩ ⸨⸨Falatacot Herald says, "You would dare mock our offer so?! You would dare present me with such insults?! Do you see that corpse in the corner? That is from the last messenger we had to deal with, dispatched from that Dericost worm Rytheran!"⸩⸩ ⸨⸨Falatacot Herald says, "It is fortunate for you the Matriarchs themselves are indisposed - your deaths shall be quick, instead! Come, servants of the Blood, destroy these interlopers and drain their blood for our ends!"⸩⸩ ⸨⸨Falatacot Blood Prophetess says, "You would dare such insolence? Fear our wrath!"⸩
L|1||Giving Blood Prophetess Trinket to Roderick⸩ ⸨You give Roderick Falatacot Blood Prophetess Trinket.⸩ ⸨Roderick tells you, "So...ya survived, huh? Congratulations. Quest.name: Harvesting_the_Bulb_of_Harvests
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Adrenkus» I|Starts At|«Valley of Death» at 37.6S, 62.2W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Second Sister» I|Quest Chain|The Sisters of Light I|1|«Releasing the Light» I|2|«Harvesting the Bulb of Mornings» I|3|Harvesting the Bulb of Harvests I|4|«Harvesting the Bulb of Twilight» I|5|«Hoshino Must Die» H2|Overview L|1|•|{TIP} It is recommended that if you have less than 600 buffed jump skill, that you bring a jump rare to make the second set of jumps much easier
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You must have completed the previous quests: «Releasing the Light», and «Harvesting the Bulb of Mornings» in order to start this quest. L|1|•|This quest flags you for the next one, «Harvesting the Bulb of Twilight»
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Adrenkus» in the Valley of Death at 37.6S 62.2W to start the quest. He is in the «Temple of Harvests», which is a cave-like hole in the ground, in the first room on the left (south) L|2|•|**Leaftide Route**: «Temple of Harvests» portal in Subway. L|2|•|⟦SecondSisterStarted_1112⟧ L|2|•|Note: In this chain of the Bulb quests, you will be fighting Emergent Gromnies, as well as Verdant Moars/Moarsmen. L|1|2.|Follow the tunnels and take the third passage on the right to reach the «Sanctum Guardian Spirit». Talk to him to be portaled to the next section. L|1|3.|Take the right passage from the start, and make your way down until you are able to take a turn SOUTH. L|1|4.|You will come to a room with 2 platforms with a floor of spikes beneath it. Jump across and continue on. L|2|•|First jump is a half-power jump to the platform halfway the E way L|2|•|Full power jump to the W L|2|•|Just-over-half power jump to the exit L|2|•|Note: If you fall move SLOWLY to the north hall. The spikes do damage based on movement so be patient. L|2|•|Note: From the north hallway, head west and then take the first hallway going south to get back to the jumps L|1|5.|Eventually you will come to a room with platforms/jumps. Make your way to the top and loot the «Enchanted Seedling», then continue on through the hallway up top. If you fall into the pit with the vines don't run around because they do damage when you move around in them. Instead you have to jump over them to get to where you can get to a platform to get out of the pit. L|2|•|**Recommended Path for the jumps (assumes 600+ jump skill)** L|2|•|Stand in the NW corner of the main platform, and face the west wall. Hold spacebar (full) > hold shift > hold C > release spacebar > land on 1st platform L|2|•|On the first platform, again stand in the north west corner, and face the west wall. Hold spacebar (full) > hold C > release spacebar > land on 2nd platform L|2|•|On the second platform, stand halfway between the north and south end of the platform, and face north. Hold spacebar (full) > hold up arrow > release spacebar > land on 3rd platform L|2|•|On the 3rd platform look diagonally towards the east wall at the long platform (2nd from the left). Aim for the left side of the platform which you are looking at. Hold spacebar (full) > hold up arrow > release spacebar > land on 4th platform L|2|•|From the 4th platform look straight across to the west platform with the Enchanted Seedling on it. Hold Spacebar (full) > hold up arrow > release spacebar > land on 5th platform L|2|•|From the 5th platform face back to the west and make another full power back to the platform you just came from. Hold spacebar (full) > hold up arrow > release space > Land back on the 4th (now 6th) platform L|2|•|On the 4th/6th platform, stand in the south east corner and face the east wall. Hold spacebar (full) > hold C key > release spacebar > land on 7th platform L|2|•|On the 7th platform face diagonally to the south towards the door/hallway. This is a very quick tap-jump forward. Not much power is needed at all. It is recommended to aim for the left side of the hallway, as if you bounce it will give you room to spare. L|2|•|**Alternative Path for the jumps (assumes 560 jump skill, can be done with 525 and a lot of jumping skills)** L|2|•|From the base platform, stand on the far left side, just a bit from the ledge, and do a full shift-jump forward L|2|•|From this 2nd platform, face SE and do a full jump towards the platform in the corner L|2|•|stand near the wall on the edge, and a full shift jump to the W, towards a platform halfway the S wall L|2|•|from here, stand on the corner and a half power NNW towards a platform halfway the room on the W wall L|2|•|stand in the middle of the platform, and do a full power jump N towards the platform in the NW corner L|2|•|6th jump: full jump from the corner towards the platform halfway the E wall L|2|•|7th jump: just-a-bit-more-than-a-tap jump to the platform in the middle of the room L|2|•|Full jump towards the hallway L|1|6.|You will come to an area with «Bloodroot Vine»s. Collect 15 of the red «Bloodroot Vine (Red)¦Bloodroot Vines». The yellow «Bloodroot Vine (Yellow)¦Bloodroot Vines» will simply disappear in a ring spell, acid vuln, or void DOT spell. The red colored ones are able to be picked up. Running or walking through the vines does frequent damage (between 40 and 70 per hit), avoid the vines except when you need to pick them up and definitely don't fight the creatures in the middle of a patch of vines. L|1|7.|When you have 15, continue east until you reach the «Bulb of Harvests» and use it for a «Seed of Essence (Harvest)¦Seed of Essence». L|2|•|⟦BulbofHarvestsSeedGiven⟧ L|1|8.|Head back to «Adrenkus» to hand in the Seed and claim your reward. L|2|•|Note: There is no surface portal but you can run back through the dungeon to the jumping puzzle room and use the surface portal in the pit (you can jump down straight into it). Otherwise you have to run back through the whole VoD so backtracking through the dungeon is faster. L|2|•|⟦SecondSisterCompleted_1112⟧ L|2|•|⟦BulbofTwilight_Flag⟧ L|2|•|Note: Upon handing, you will be portaled to the «Neftet Treasury» with chests you can use your Legendary Key on. L|1|9.|{OPT} If you don't want your orb, you can hand it to Calitoth for some xp and luminance instead.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "Greetings!"⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "Welcome to my little subterranean paradise!"⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "Well, we were originally set up on the surface, but the local fauna kept trying to eat the miners, so we relocated here."⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "So far, we've been able to hide this location from Hoshino Kei's forces, but I'm not sure how long that'll last."⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "This should be the location of the spirit of the Lady of Harvest and Justice. According to the Lady of Mysteries, as well as recorded legends that have been recovered, her spirit should rest in some sort of bulb or plant."⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "We need to recover her essence as quickly as possible, preferably before the spectral skeletons figure out where this site is."⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "If you'd be willing to brave the temple, you'll find the Guardian deeper in these tunnels. Just watch out for the local fauna."
L|1||Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨You allow Adrenkus to examine your Seed of Essence.⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "Utterly fascinating..."⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Seed of Essences.⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "The magics of the Deru and the Light Falatacot never cease to amaze me."⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "Now, to see if the essence is intact..."⸩ ⸨Adrenkus chants over the seed, and a small wisp of light pours out of the seed and into his hand.⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "Beautiful, what is contained here is both intact and free of corruption. Well done, well done indeed."⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "It's only a small fragment of her essence, but it's progress all the same. As for this seed, I think you may find it useful."⸩ ⸨You've earned 198,157,237 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 20,000 Luminance.⸩ ⸨Adrenkus gives you Seed of Harvests.⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "If you're interested, I'll likely need your assistance again in a couple weeks. The bulb should be ready to produce another seed by then."⸩ ⸨Adrenkus tells you, "Also, my friend Norus has a dig site near the Inner Sea Gearknight area, but none of us have heard from him recently. If you could go see if he needs any help, it'd be greatly appreciated."⸩ ⸨You give Calitoth Legendary Seed of Harvests.⸩ ⸨Calitoth tells you, "Thank you. I'll send this along to my mistress. Please, accept this gift in return."⸩ ⸨You've earned 49,511,803 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 1,000 Luminance.
L|1||Other Interactions⸩ ⸨You allow Bulb of Harvests to examine your Bloodroot Vine.⸩ ⸨You offer up the freshly picked Bloodroot Vines to the large plant. The vines themselves pulse with energy and begin to reach out toward the bulb, and then are absorbed in the plant.⸩ ⸨A moment later, the plant releases a small glowing seed.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Bloodroot Vines.⸩

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|N/A I|Repeat|None I|Kill Task|False I|Quest Chain|Mask Maker I|1|«Virindi Masks» I|2|Heritage Regalia Masks H2|Overview
P|Bring repaired «Virindi Masks» to the «Mask Maker»s for a piece of regalia.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Obtain a repaired Virindi Mask. For more information, see the «Virindi Masks» quest. L|2|•|«Virindi Mask»s are crafted into the first tier heritage regalia masks. L|2|•|«Virindi Inquisitor's Mask»s are crafted into the second tier heritage regalia masks. L|2|•|«Virindi Profatrix Mask»s are crafted into the third tier heritage regalia masks. L|2|•|«Virindi Consul Mask»s are crafted into the fourth tier heritage regalia masks. L|2|•|«Virindi Desecrator Mask»s are crafted into the fifth tier heritage regalia masks. L|1|2.|Bring the Virindi Mask to one of the four mask makers to have it crafted into a piece of regalia: L|2|•|«Alexander the Deft» in «Eastham» crafts Aluvian regalia masks. L|2|•|«Janda Sulifiya» in «Al-Jalima» crafts Gharu'ndim regalia masks. L|2|•|«Tsua Kagemata» in «Sawato» crafts Sho regalia masks. L|2|•|«Trilaine di Ricard» in «Sanamar» crafts Viamontian regalia masks.

L|1||Tsua Kagemata:⸩ ⸨You give Tsua Kagemata Virindi Consul Mask.⸩ ⸨Tsua Kagemata tells you, "A beautiful specimen! L|1||Trilaine di Ricard:⸩ ⸨You give Trilaine di Ricard Virindi Consul Mask.⸩ ⸨Trilaine di Ricard tells you, "Ahhh. This material is exquisite. Enjoy!"⸩ ⸨Trilaine di Ricard gives you The Royal Bull of Sanamar.
L|1||Virindi Desecrator Mask L|1||Alexander the Deft:⸩ ⸨You give Alexander the Deft Virindi Desecrator Mask.⸩ ⸨Alexander the Deft tells you, "Amazing! L|1||Janda Sulifiya:⸩ ⸨You give Janda Sulifiya Virindi Desecrator Mask.⸩ ⸨Janda Sulifiya tells you, "The material of this mask is the most exquisite that I've seen yet. L|1||Tsua Kagemata:⸩ ⸨You give Tsua Kagemata Virindi Desecrator Mask.⸩ ⸨Tsua Kagemata tells you, "This mask radiates great power. L|1||Trilaine di Ricard:⸩ ⸨You give Trilaine di Ricard Virindi Desecrator Mask.⸩ ⸨Trilaine di Ricard tells you, "I am honored to even hold a mask of such power and grace as this one.
