Quest.name: Hidden_Presents
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|Varies I|Repeat|Yearly H2|Overview L|1|•|This is a «Seasonal Quests¦Seasonal Quest» that is only active once per year during the month of December (Activated 16 December 2013). L|1|•|The main item reward for this quest is a «Pet Items¦Pet Summoning Item». L|1|•|Additional random item and experience «#Rewards¦rewards» vary by level.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Travel to 12 locations scattered throughout Dereth to find 12 hidden «Gift Box»es. L|1|2.|Use each gift box for a special reward (experience or one of 9 trophy rewards listed below) and the title «Gifted». L|2|•|⟦GiftBoxesFound⟧ L|2|•|⟦GiftBoxesFoundCounter⟧ L|1|3.|Once you've used all 12 gift boxes you will be rewarded with an «Enchanted Olthoi Egg» that summons a «Pet Olthoi Soldier» and the second title «Seasonal Seeker». L|2|•|⟦GiftBoxesWait⟧
H3|December 2013 Gift Box Locations TH|# Location Coordinates Difficulty Route/Notes TR|1 «Lytelthorpe» 1.0N, 54.2E 1 Take the «Lytelthorpe» portal in the «Aluvian» section of «Town Network» then run to the «Gift Box». TR|2 «Caulcano» 94.4S, 94.6W 12 Inside the «Caulcano» crater on the «Singularity Caul». Run from the island drop point (via the portal in «Singularity Bore», or «Singularity Recall» spell) and the «Gift Box» is located at the top of the tower in the center of «Caulcano». TR|3 «Freehold» 74.4S, 92.1E 3 Take the «Freehold» portal in the «Sho» section of Town Network. The «Gift Box» is in the basement of the «Agent of the Arcanum» building. TR|4 «Kara» 74.9S, 40.6E 2 Take the «Kara» portal in the Sho section of Town Network. Then use the «Lake Thrasyl Cottages» portal (72.0S, 42.4E). Then run to the «Gift Box». TR|5 «Aerlinthe» 91.6N, 46.0E 10 From the Aerlinthe drop (Hand «Garaena the Emissary» (87.6S, 65.6W) a «D Note» or use the «Aerlinthe Recall» spell), run to the crater in the north central area of the island. Run up and around the edge of either side of the crater to the «Gift Box». **Note: from here, run to the next location** TR|6 «Aerlinthe» 90.3N, 43.4E 11 From the «Aerlinthe» drop (Hand «Garaena the Emissary» (87.6S, 65.6W) a «D Note» or use the «Aerlinthe Recall» spell), run to the crater in the north central area of the island. Run up and around to the backside of the crater to the «Gift Box» hiding inside the «90.3N, 43.5E - Pyre Skeleton Cave¦Pyre Skeleton Cave» on the far end of the Island. Note: «Gift Box» is guarded by several dangerous «Pyre Skeleton»s. TR|7 «Linvak Tukal» 84.4S, 33.6E 7 Take the «Qalaba'r» portal in the «Gharu'ndim» section of Town Network, then take the «Linvak Tukal Foothills Settlement» portal at (74.9S, 17.8E) then run to the «Gift Box». TR|8 «Tumerok Fortress» 23.1S, 71.8W 8 Visit the «Drunken Madman» at 53.0S, 61.0E for a portal to the «Walled Portals», then run to the «Gift Box». TR|9 «Tumerok Treehouse» 43.9N, 10.8E 4 Take the Town Network to «Glendon Wood», then take the «Firedew» Settlement portal at 27.9N, 29.5E and then head to the «Gift Box». TR|10 «24.0N, 72.0W - Aun Tahuirea's Camp¦Aun Tahuirea's Camp» 20.2N, 71.2W 5 From your allegiance «Mansion», use a «Black Spawn Den Portal Device» until you reach the dungeon in the «North Direlands», then run to the «Gift Box». TR|11 «Halaetan Node Pyramid» 94.3N, 66.4W 9 Take the «Silyun» portal in the Annex section of Town Network, then run north to the «Gift Box». TR|12 «Tou-Tou» 25.3S, 96.0E 6 Take the «Tou-Tou» portal in the «Sho» section of Town Network, Run from the town network drop to west side shore and follow it north to tip at 25.3S, 96.0E TE

Quest.name: His_Master's_Voice
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 I|Rec. Level|100+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Ssavashka the Devoted» I|Starts At|42.7S, 46.6W I|Route|«Mansion» to «Portal to Kivik Lir's Temple» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for His Master's Voice» H2|Overview P|Quest to gain the «Tome of Blood and Bone» housing item which gives you an additional 10 Focus for 2 hours.
L|1|•|Only one person needs to do steps 1-3 to obtain the portal gem. The rest of the group can then enter the summoned portal.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|After you have spoken with «Ssavashka the Devoted» enter the «Font of the Eternal Harvester». L|2|•|⟦MastersVoiceStarted_0511⟧ L|1|2.|Head south through the dungeon ignoring all side passages. L|1|3.|Defeat the «Eternal Harvester» and loot «Crypt of Adhorix Portal Gem». L|1|4.|Use the gem to summon a portal to the «Crypt of Adhorix». L|1|5.|Destroy the «Tomb of Adhorix» and loot «Tomb Rubble». L|2|•|⟦MastersVoiceRubbleAcquired⟧ L|1|6.|Use the surface portal and hand the rubble to Ssavashka the Devoted for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦MastersVoiceComplete0710⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|A «Pillar of the Eternal Harvester» is found in each corner of the «Crypt of Adhorix». The pillars spawn a «Demilich» and «Elite Revenant» beside it at a very fast rate. You can control the spawns by destroying the pillars but they will also respawn eventually.
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Font of the Eternal Harvester» 42.7S, 46.6W -- «map:0038¦0038» TR|«Crypt of Adhorix» 42.7S, 46.6W -- «map:0038¦0038» TE
H2|Rewards
R|Hand in «Tomb Rubble» RK|Experience|30,000,000 RK|Items| RI|«Tome of Blood and Bone» RI|«Trade Note (250,000)» (x3) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Ssavashka the Devoted tells you, "Help me, man-thing. Help me. My master's tomb lies defiled within that portal, profaned by the Dericostian sorcerer-dog known as the Eternal Harvester. Day and night, sleep and wake, I hear the voice of Master Adhorix. He is in pain because of the Dericostian's desecration."⸩ ⸨Ssavashka the Devoted tells you, "End my torment. Go into this portal, defeat the Harvester, and destroy the tomb of Adhorix. It is the only way we will have peace. Bring me rubble from the tomb once you have done this, and we will reward you."
L|1||Handing in Tomb Rubble⸩ ⸨You give Ssavashka the Devoted Tomb Rubble.⸩ ⸨Ssavashka the Devoted tells you, "At last, my master can rest in peace. At last, his voice no longer wails in my mind. I thank you, man-thing. Perhaps there is a way I can give you to speak with my Master yourself, that he may show you his gratitude..."⸩ ⸨You've earned 30,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Ssavashka the Devoted gives you Tome of Blood and Bone.⸩

Quest.name: Impious_Staff_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|20 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Dizah ibn Nadqab» I|Starts At|«Four Towers» near «Zaikhal» at 12.4N, 2.3E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Kill Task|False H2|Overview L|1|•|Purchasing a Smelting Pot from a «Master Mage» (or other storekeeper who sells Alchemical Supplies) will allow you to skip the first visit to the Mite Maze (part 2).
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|An «L Note» is needed to enter the 1st dungeon. L|1|•|Lockpick is required in the «Mite Maze» and will also help get you through the doors in the «Colier Mine» faster.
L|1||Quest Bonus Stamps L|1|•|There is an extra, fail stamp when turning in «Slag» before the Broken Staff. L|1|•|If you want to follow the lore and gather the stamps then you'll need two runs: L|1|1.|Follow the main guide for the **first run**. L|1|2.|Follow secondary guide for **second run**. L|1|•|But for an optimal stamp run follow the steps in the order below: L|2|•|Buy «Smelting Pot» from «Master Mage» L|2|•|Do part 1 to get «Broken Staff» L|2|•|Do part 3 to get «Iron Ore» L|2|•|Visit «Roderick» in «Mite Maze» L|2|•|Hand in «Slag» first to get fail stamp. He'll give it back to you. L|2|•|Hand in «Broken Staff» L|2|•|Hand in «Slag» again.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|First Run H3|Part 1: Impious Temple L|1|1.|Hand Dizah an «L Note» to get access to the tower with the portal. L|1|2.|Go in the «Impious Temple» L|1|3.|{OPT} Grab «Dizah ibn Nadqab's Journal» from the bottom of the first part of the dungeon (from drop, go right and down one level), lore reasons only L|1|4.|Collect 4 Keys (the doors are impossible to pick, resistance 999): L|2|1.|The «Inferus Key» can be found on the body of the «Impious Inferus Guardian» in the SE part. Portal Recall. L|2|2.|The «Mortuus Key» can be found on the body of the «Impious Mortuus Guardian» in the NW part. Portal Recall. L|2|3.|The «Occasus Key» can be found on the body of the «Impious Occasus Guardian» in the SW part. Portal Recall. L|2|4.|The «Superna Key» can be found on the body of the «Impious Superna Guardian» in the NE part. Portal Recall. L|1|5.|Head NW, left, and up and N to the lever part (it's the only route with openings in the grates). L|1|6.|In the big room, go into the corridor to the SE, and pull the 2 levers in the smaller room (See map) L|1|7.|Go back to the big room, head NW through the now open door L|1|8.|Pull the levers in the 2 rooms to the left and go back into the corridor and to the N, then E. L|1|9.|Use «Superna Key» for the first room to the left, pull lever L|1|10.|Use «Inferus Key» for the second room to the left, pull lever L|1|11.|Back to the corridor and continue through the 2 now open doors L|1|12.|Use «Mortuus Key» to open the next door, and «Occasus Key» for the one behind that L|1|13.|Kill the «Impious Lichen High Priest» and loot the «Broken Staff» off his corpse (drops one, fast respawn).
H3|Part 2: The Mite Maze L|1|1.|Head to «Mite Maze» (lockpick required). L|2|•|Route: There is a portal to the Mite Maze in the «Facility Hub». (Level 30 hall) L|1|2.|Hand the «Broken Staff» to «Roderick», who replaces «Harlune the Misanthrope» L|2|•|⟦ImpiousStaffBrokenGiven⟧ L|1|3.|He will give you a «Smelting Pot» L|2|•|Note: If you try to give him a second staff before the timer is up, he won't give you a Smelting Pot, but will keep the staff.
H3|Part 3: Colier Mines L|1|1.|Head to the «Colier Village». L|2|•|Route: There is a portal to Colier the «Facility Hub» (level 15 hall). Otherwise, take the «Colier View Hill» Settlement portal at 26.2N, 46.3E in «Cragstone» L|1|2.|Before entering the dungeon, find 2 keys: L|2|•|The «Small Rusted Key» from a «Banderling Raider» in a house at 56.7N, 38.6E. L|2|•|The «Cell Key» from a «Drudge Prowler» in a house at 56.5N, 38.0E. L|1|3.|Enter the «Colier Mines» (entrance in the basement of the house at 56.7N 38.5E). L|1|4.|Use the «Small Rusted Key» to open the door directly at drop (resistance 400). L|1|5.|Head N (See map) till you find the second locked door (resistance 700), open with «Cell Key». L|1|6.|Go left, open another door (resistance 700) with the «Cell Key» and get the «The Baron's Key» (See Map) from one of the «Undead Miner»s. You can also grab the «Scratched Key» for the «Baron's Amulet of Life Giving» (See «Baron's Amulet of Life Giving Quest»). L|1|7.|Back to the door, go right now, and straight at first intersection. L|1|8.|Through a series of rooms, in the fourth room, to the S, is a locked door (resistance 1000). Open with «The Baron's Key». L|1|9.|Straight and N until you see a «Wheelbarrow» in a small room. L|1|10.|Use (open) the «Wheelbarrow» to obtain «Iron Ore» (Note: you can pick up another one to simplify the second run, but it has a 60 minutes timer). L|2|•|⟦ImpiousQuestIronOre⟧ L|1|•|Tip: keep the keys if you plan to abandon the dungeon and to do a second run for the fail stamp.
H3|Part 4: Getting the Staff L|1|1.|Hand the «Smelting Pot» and the «Iron Ore» to someone trained in Alchemy (no skill check) to craft «Slag». L|1|2.|Return to «Mite Maze» and hand the «Slag» to «Roderick» to receive the «Impious Staff». L|2|•|⟦ImpiousStaffQuest⟧
H3|Second Run P|Note: you will need to wait 20 hours between the first and second run, otherwise «Roderick» will give you another repaired Staff instead of the fail stamp. To avoid waiting the 20 hours you can have another character on the same account deliver the second «Slag» to the NPC. L|1|1.|Buy «Smelting Pot» from «Master Mage» L|1|2.|Run part 3 to get the «Iron Ore». L|1|3.|Run part 4. L|1|4.|Handing the «Slag» to «Roderick» should produce the fail stamp. L|2|•|⟦ImpiousQuestSlag⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Impious Temple» 12.2N, 2.4E -- «map:015E¦015E» TR|«Mite Maze» 41.1N, 57.3E -- «map:01F8¦01F8» TR|«Colier Mine» 56.8N, 38.3E -- «map:01AE¦01AE» TE
H2|Rewards
R|Give Slag to Roderick RK|Experience|10,300,000 (100% up to level 61) RK|Items| RI|«Impious Staff» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Dizah ibn Nadqab tells you, "While excavating this site, I inadvertently awakened the undead that rest here. I was able to escape the dungeon with my life, but before doing so I found a large audience chamber with treasure."⸩ ⸨Dizah ibn Nadqab tells you, "Offer me any trade note worth 5000 pyreals and I'll give you access to the dungeon. In return, you can keep anything you find in there. I can use the trade note to further my investigation in this site."⸩ ⸨Dizah ibn Nadqab tells you, "From what I was able to uncover so far, I believe this area was once a place used by powerful Gharu'ndim War Mages. Any relics you find may be difficult for you to use. Yet, perhaps you will be able to understand what I could not. You can't go down there if you're not level 20, in fact I wouldn't go down there if I were you. Just forget the whole thing, you're better off that way."
L|1||Handing in Trade Note (5,000)⸩ ⸨You give Dizah ibn Nadqab Trade Note (5,000).⸩ ⸨Dizah ibn Nadqab tells you, "I take this with gratitude. I'll open the door for you, but be warned, this is a risky venture. If you should fail, you will return to this place outside of the sealed tower...And I give no refunds."⸩ ⸨⸨Dizah ibn Nadqab says, "Oh, if you find something of interest I might be able to identify it for you."⸩⸩ ⸨⸨Dizah ibn Nadqab says, "You should hurry. I'll close the door for you in a minute."⸩
L|1||Impious Lichen Priest dialog⸩ ⸨⸨Impious Lichen Priest says, "Another fool has come in search of fate, my brothers."⸩⸩ ⸨⸨Impious Lichen Priest says, "Your kind has disturbed us for the last time!"⸩⸩ ⸨Impious Lichen High Priest tells you, "Insignificant mortal! Soon you shall know your own demise!"
L|1||Handing in Broken Staff⸩ ⸨You give Dizah ibn Nadqab Broken Staff.⸩ ⸨Dizah ibn Nadqab tells you, "This is clearly broken. There is one person I know who might have the knowledge and skill to repair this. He lives in the Mite Maze dungeon north of Arwic, located at 41.1N x 57.2E. Sorry I can't be more help."⸩ ⸨Dizah ibn Nadqab gives you Broken Staff.
L|1||Give Slag to Roderick before the Staff⸩ ⸨You allow Roderick to examine your Slag.⸩ ⸨Roderick tells you, "That is nice and all, but I need a staff to fix before that slag is of any use."
L|1||Handing in Broken Staff to Roderick⸩ ⸨You give Roderick Broken Staff.⸩ ⸨Roderick tells you, "Alright...Umm...Harlune told me how to do this..."`⸩ ⸨Roderick tells you, "Alright. Take this and go to Colier Mines."⸩ ⸨Roderick gives you Smelting Pot.⸩ ⸨Roderick tells you, "If ya find some ore in a wheelbarrow and ya bring it to me, I think it'll be enough to fix the staff, alright?"
L|1||Giving Iron Ore to Roderick⸩ ⸨You allow Roderick to examine your Iron Ore.⸩ ⸨Roderick tells you, "I gave ya the smelting pot for a reason, ya know."
L|1||Smelting Ore⸩ ⸨You smelt the ore into an ugly, shapeless piece of slag. Quest.name: Ithaenc_Quiddity_Seed_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|130 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Emissary of Asheron (Asheron's Castle)¦Emissary of Asheron» I|Starts At|«Asheron's Castle» I|Route|«Eastham» to «Asheron's Island» portal at 17.9N, 64.3E. I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|To begin this quest, you must first have spoken with Asheron located in his sanctum. Since the introduction of this quest, Asheron has been replaced by an Emissary of Asheron located in the base of Asheron's Tower." L|2|•|⟦quiddityseedquestflag⟧ L|1|2.|Go to Ft. Tethana. After you speak with the emissary, head to «Aun Aemaua» located at 1.6N,71.7W in «Fort Teth». He will tell you to go to the Ithaenc Seed at Ithaenc Cathedral. L|1|3.|The «Ithaenc Quiddity Seed» is located at rear of Ithaenc Cathedral. Use the Recall to Sanctuary, and head up the stairs to the read balcony. L|1|4.|The drop is safe. Head down and speak with «Shade of Dule». L|1|5.|The dungeon is small, but full of deadly «Virindi» called «Dream Marauder»s. At the end you will find the «Thief of Dreams», a virindi boss that drops «Avoren's Skull». Only one skull is needed per fellowship. Grab the skull and return it to Shade of Dule. L|2|•|⟦shadeofduleportal⟧ L|1|6.|Dule will summon a portal to the next dungeon. He will summon more portals if spoken too again, should anyone die or get lost. L|1|7.|Inside the dungeon are powerful shadows and grievvers on a very fast respawn. It is best not to try to fight your way through. From the drop, head east down a ramp and continue east until you get to a locked olthoi style door. Wait there until the door is opened, and then go through and kill until it closes again. To open the door, one person should run east from the drop down the ramp, take a left (heading north), and press the button on the wall of the second room, then continue on to meet up with the rest of the group at the locked door. The door stays open for a minute or two. Once everyone is through the door, mages can begin to vuln creatures in the pit below. This pit is the final room and location of the «Shade of Bael'Zharon». L|1|8.|When the group is ready, jump down in the pit. Melees are best to clear the grievvers while mages take out the Black breaths. The Shade of Bael'Zharon is a large creature, and wall and volley/blast spells are highly effective. Note that it's creature type is "Hopeslayer" so shadow slayer weapons and wands will not increase damage. L|1|9.|When the Shade of Bael'Zharon is dead, everyone should loot the «Claw of the Hopeslayer». He drops 10 claws, so you may have to kill again if your group is larger. He respawns in approx 5 - 10 minutes. L|2|•|⟦clawofthehopeslayerpickuptimer⟧ L|1|10.|Return the claw to «Aun Aemaua» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦clawofthehopeslayerfirstrun⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Welcome, I'm glad you've come."⸩ ⸨Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Let's see if you have had any success with the Quiddity Seeds I told you of."⸩ ⸨Emissary of Asheron tells you, "The first Quiddity Seed lies in the Planar Collegium in the Lyceum at Knorr."⸩ ⸨Emissary of Asheron tells you, "The second alludes me. Speak with the Aun Tumeroks at Fort Tethana."⸩ ⸨Emissary of Asheron tells you, "The third is known to an apparition in the Northern Desert."
L|1||Aun Aemaua⸩ ⸨Aun Aemaua tells you, "Aha! Another worthy adventurer. You have spoken with Lord Asheron about the threats to the realm, have you? Excellent. I would have you seek out the Quiddity Seed that materialized in Ithaenc Cathedral down in the Vesayen Isles. It is a gateway to a strange realm, both of this world and not... A realm in which memories and dreams acquire tangible form... Aerbax wishes to destroy the realm's memories of the defeat of Bael'Zharon! Such a thing is not to be borne! You must take a group and journey into the Quiddity Seed, the device by which Aerbax manipulates our collective memories, and defeat his designs!"⸩ ⸨The Quiddity Seed thrums in response to your touch, and a surge of portal energy washes over you, ushering you into a strange, half-real dream realm...
L|1||Shade of Dule⸩ ⸨Shade of Dule tells you, "Human! You can help end my bizarre imprisonment here by that unjumped bag of air Aerbax. Some half-formed shade of the Hopeslayer himself awaits in the chambers below! An agent of Aerbax, a creature known as the Thief of Dreams, has taken the skull of Avoren Palacost, and seeks to destroy humanity's accomplishment in defeating Bael'Zharon! You must act quickly, and stop the Thief of Dreams from coming through here with the skull! Take the skull from him and bring it to me, and I shall open the way for you and your comrades to assault the shade of the Hopeslayer..."
L|1||Giving Avoren's Skull to Shade of Dule⸩ ⸨Shade of Dule tells you, "Yes... you have the skull of little Avoren Palacost. Such a sweet-natured boy he was, the light of his father's life. What lengths we go to, for the sake of our offspring. But I suppose I would not know. Hand me the skull and I can help you find the Hopeslayer's lair, and hopefully you will be able to interrupt the schemes of this Aerbax upstart and free me from this ungracious prison."⸩ ⸨You give Shade of Dule Avoren's Skull.⸩ ⸨Shade of Dule says, "Well done! The skull of poor young Avoren. Ilservian's rage was so great... But this sentimentality serves no one, does it? I am now one step closer to freedom from this prison realm that Aerbax constructed. The Hopeslayer of this dream realm will never recover this skull, and will thus remain vulnerable... But you all have more work to do. You must defeat this shade of my former master. I believe your agent of Asheron waiting in the "real" world seeks some trophy of the encounter... A claw will do, and there ought to be enough claws on that beast to supply all of you..."
L|1||Giving Claw of the Hopeslayer to Aun Aemaua⸩ ⸨You give Aun Aemaua Claw of the Hopeslayer.⸩ ⸨You've earned 129,932,574 experience.⸩ ⸨Aun Aemaua tells you, "Well done! What an exceedingly strange artifact! A claw of Bael'Zharon retrieved from the dream realm of the Quiddity Seed... You have done a great thing, by helping foil Aerbax's plans to destroy our memories of the triumph against Bael'Zharon. You certainly deserve your reward..."⸩ ⸨Aun Aemaua has granted you the title "Hope of the Past".⸩ ⸨Aun Aemaua gives you Empowered Pauldrons of the Perfect Light.⸩ ⸨Aun Aemaua tells you, "And there is this curious artifact, some kind of mysterious ingot that seems to be a remnant of the Hopeslayer's energy from that strange dream realm... Perhaps you should hold on to it. It may be useful later."⸩ ⸨Aun Aemaua gives you Quiddity Ingot.⸩ ⸨Aun Aemaua tells you, "If you had a group of friends who helped you defeat the shade of Bael'Zharon, they will have to give me the claws they collected individually."
L|1||Giving Empowered Pauldrons of the Perfect Light to Emissary of Asheron⸩ ⸨You allow Emissary of Asheron to examine your Empowered Pauldrons of the Perfect Light.⸩ ⸨Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Perhaps you would rather have some experience in exchange for this?"⸩ ⸨Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Very well."⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Empowered Pauldrons of the Perfect Lights.⸩ ⸨You've earned 16,241,571 experience.⸩

Quest.name: Metos_Motes
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|15 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Halls of Metos» (Ayan Baqur or Wai Jhou) I|Route|See walkthrough I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|This quest is part of the «Asheron's Departure Lower» series, allowing characters level 1-79 to be flagged to use the «Portal to Bur». For full details, see the «Asheron's Departure Lower» guide. For information on flagging for characters level 80 and above, see «Asheron's Departure».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to either the Halls of Metos near Ayan Baqur and the one near Wai Jhou. The order is unimportant, but you will need to visit both. Shortcut portals have been created so lower level characters can reach these dungeons located in the dangerous Direlands. L|1|2.|The Halls of Metos near Wai Jhou is located at 61.4S, 46.6W. L|2|•|Route 1: «Lytelthorpe» to «Neu Gerz Villas» at 2.2N, 50.3E. South from Neu Gerz to «Imuth Maer Doquin» at 11.6S, 57.9E. In one of the ruins at Imuth, behind a fake wall, is the «Gateway to the Halls of Metos» portal. L|2|•|Route 2: Run from «Wai Jhou», «Small Black Hill», the «Graveyard», or other nearby location. L|1|3.|The Halls of Metos near Ayan Baqur is located at 56.0S, 89.2W. L|2|•|Route 1: «Zaikhal» to «Sharvale» at 12.7N, 1.8W. Southwest from Sharvale to a «Halls of Metos» portal at 12.8N, 12.2W. L|2|•|Route 2: Run from «Ayan Baqur» or other nearby location. L|1|4.|Proceed to the end of the dungeon (Obsidian Golems Room, lvl -6) and collect the special «Metos Pyreal Mote». Repeat for the other Halls of Metos. L|2|•|⟦pyrealmotewai⟧ L|2|•|⟦pyrealmoteayan⟧ L|1|5.|Once you have the motes from Ayan and Wai Jhou, proceed to the Halls of Metos near «Tufa» located at 4.4S 0.6W. L|2|•|Route 1: «Al-Jalima» to «Midsong Cottages» at 5.7N, 4.3E. L|2|•|Route 2: «Yaraq» to «Aqalah» at 22.5S, 0.2E. L|1|6.|Proceed to the end of the dungeon, to the same room where you found the motes in the previous two halls. L|1|7.|Give your two special motes to the «Golem Warden of Metos» to receive your rewards. L|2|•|Ayan Given First: ⟦pyrealmoteayangiven⟧ L|2|•|Wei given first: ⟦pyrealmotewaigiven⟧ L|2|•|You will NOT get a stamp when turning in the second mote. L|2|•|Two runs to get all the stamps: L|3|•|The first run you need to gather and turn in both Motes. L|3|•|Second run just gather and turn in the mote you turned in second on the first run.

L|1||Handing in Metos Pyreal Mote 2 (Level 1-79)⸩ ⸨You give Golem Warden of Metos Pyreal Mote.⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,899,563 experience.⸩ ⸨The golem speaks in a normal voice - perhaps Empyrean by its accent.⸩ ⸨Golem Warden of Metos tells you, "For you who have come this far, I leave a message. Your diligence is appreciated, even applauded, but you should not attempt to reconstruct the portal to Bur. I have learned only too well the risks associated with opening portals to other worlds, and alloing them to remain open. It is better if my portal remains closed. I should be able to repoen it when it is time for me to return. At this point, I shall hopefully have with me a solution to the Burun problem."⸩ ⸨Golem Warden of Metos tells you, "Also, I imagine that Metos would have appreciated if I mention that there are no inactive golems available for you. Unfortunately, I required the last one for the portal ritual."⸩ ⸨A piece of paper is ejected from the golem slowly, which you take.⸩ ⸨Golem Warden of Metos gives you Ruminations and Warnings on Portal Creation.⸩ ⸨The golem's voice changes yet again - this time to a scholarly female voice.⸩ ⸨Golem Warden of Metos tells you, "This is like the golems in the Temple of Enlightenment, but different. But I feel compelled to amend Lord Asheron's message, as it is now inaccurate. He had taken the last one, but since then the golem manufacturing process has resumed on its own - no doubt due to adventurers who came and installed motes in this golem. So, there are golems now - the Golem Constructor should be able to help, I think."

Quest.name: Mhoire_Infiltration
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Rec. Level|200 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Mhoire Soldier (Mhoire Infiltration)¦Mhoire Soldier» I|Starts At|«Graveyard» at at 65.4S, 44.0W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Geraine's Study» H2|Overview P|House Mhoire needs help to investigating the whereabouts of «Geraine», and the missing book.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Mhoire Soldier (Mhoire Infiltration)¦Mhoire Soldier» (65.4S 44.0W) in «Graveyard». L|2|•|⟦GerainesLibraryBook0312⟧ L|1|2.|Head to «Geraine's Study», at 82.9N, 6.4W. L|2|•|Route/Shortcut: «Tou-Tou» to «Snowy Valley» portal at 30.5S, 94.6E *ILT- Take Subway to Frozen Tomb and take the surface portal at the drop , This drops you right outside Geraine's Study. L|1|3.|Once inside, take each corridor (East, West, and South), killing creatures and looting the Stone Tablets from their corpses. L|2|1.|«Stone Tablet (Circular)» L|2|2.|«Stone Tablet (Crescent)» L|2|3.|«Stone Tablet (Crossed)» L|2|4.|«Stone Tablet (Star)» L|2|5.|«Stone Tablet (Triangular)» L|2|6.|«Stone Tablet (Wavy)» L|2|•|**Tip 1:** It's a good idea to collect as many Stone Tablets as you can, because the quest requires different ones depending on what parchments you find. L|2|•|**Tip 2:** If you find multiple sets of the correct tablets, you can solve the puzzle and go directly to Geraine on immediate subsequent runs. L|1|4.|At the end of each wing, you will need find a key in order to obtain a Torn Parchment, which will help unlock the puzzle: L|2|1.|«Door Key (Geraine's Study East)¦East door key» - The key is found on a «Cultist High Priest», and the parchment is found by using the book on the table beyond the locked door. L|2|2.|«Door Key (Geraine's Study West)¦West door key» - The key is found on a «Cultist High Priest», and the parchment is located on a «Wight Captain» in the dead-end room beyond the locked door. L|2|3.|«Door Key (Geraine's Study South)¦South door key» - The key is found on a «Wight Captain» in a dead end room, and the parchment is found on a corpse in a cell which requires the key to open. L|2|•|**Lockpick Bonus:** There is a «Chorizite Chest» behind the desk in the Wight Captain room. L|3|•|⟦chestchorizite72326⟧ L|1|5.|Once you have all three torn parchments, return to the main room (with the altars and bookshelves), and use the number on the icon along with the tear location (in the description) to determine which book contains the proper sequence: L|2|•|The parchment which is torn down the right side indicates how many bookshelves to count (from left to right). L|2|•|The parchment torn down both sides or down the middle indicates what row on the bookshelf (from top to bottom). L|2|•|The parchment torn down the left side indicates what book to use (from left to right). L|3|•|Note: Only books with stone tablet icons count. Skip over empty spine books as you count. L|1|6.|Once you have identified the right book, use the three icons on its spine to break the code: L|2|•|The tablet matching the **Top** icon goes to the **West** altar. L|2|•|The tablet matching the **Middle** icon goes to the **Middle** altar. L|2|•|The tablet matching the **Bottom** icon goes to the **East** altar. L|1|7.|Have one person in your party hand the proper stone tablet to each altar. If you are correct, the doors to the north will open. L|1|8.|Work your way north a short ways until you reach «Renselm (Creature)¦Renselm» (an undead). Kill it, and more doors will open to the north, revealing a large room with Geraine and several cell doors inside. L|1|9.|Once through the doors, you will find «Geraine (Creature)¦Geraine» standing at the far side of the room. L|2|•|{WARN} Do not attack Geraine until all participants are in the room. Attacking him will cause the entry doors to close and they will not re-open upon his death. L|1|10.|Once you kill Geraine, the cell doors around the room will open, allowing you to loot a «Book (Geraine's Study)¦Book» from the tables inside. L|2|•|Note: The books will not respawn, so it may be necessary to kill Geraine again with a larger group. L|3|•|⟦GeraineStudyBookPickup!⟧ L|2|•|Geraine also drops 9 «Legendary Key»s on a 27 day timer. L|3|•|⟦GeraineStudyKeyPickup!⟧ L|1|11.|Take the book to the «Mhoire Soldier (Mhoire Infiltration)¦Mhoire Soldier» (65.4S 44.0W) in «Graveyard» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦GerainesLibraryCompleted0312!⟧ L|2|•|⟦CanEnterGeraineRefuge!⟧
L|1|•|Weeping or AR fire seem to work best on Geraine (he is a «Human») L|1|•|There are no special death messages after killing Renselm or Geraine. Geraine is also classified as a Human, not Empyrean/Dericost/Undead. Since there are many Cultists («Raven Hand»?) in the dungeon, one could speculate if the being killed in this dungeon is the real Geraine, or perhaps one of the Raven Hand posing as Geraine.

Quest.name: Monouga_Feeding_Pit_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Corporal Liao Chen» (optional) I|Starts At|25.6N 49.3E in «Cragstone» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|You have one hour to kill an imprisoned Monouga before it gets portaled back to the Laboratory. There are three versions of this quest, based upon which direction you take at the 4-way intersection near the dungeon entrance. L|1|•|A closely related quest, «Monouga Laboratory», was added the patch after this quest was added. They are commonly done together. L|1|•|If you are doing both this quest and «Monouga Laboratory», it is best to follow the steps for that quest as there are more. The steps for this quest are listed as optional on the other quest article.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|«Corporal Liao Chen» will give you «Monouga Laboratory Portal Attunement Gem» used in the related quest, «Monouga Laboratory». L|2|•|⟦ProdigalMonougaStarted0707⟧ L|1|2.|Run to the Monouga Feeding Pits southwest of «Fort Tethana» at 9.8S, 81.0W. L|2|•|A 6.5 click run from Gear Knight Invasion Area Camp Recall. L|2|•|{TIP} If you don't have the Gear Knight Invasion Area Camp Recall Give Merkitz ibn'Akadh in Xarabydun one MMD Trade Note (250,000). He will summon a portal (level 150+) directly to the Direlands Gear Knight Resistance Camp. L|1|3.|Enter the section of the dungeon appropriate to the level of the quest that you want to do: L|2|•|80+: South L|2|•|120+: East L|2|•|150+: North L|1|4.|{OPT} Pickup «Instructions (Monouga Feeding Pit)¦Instructions» from the ground. L|1|5.|Ring the bell to summon an imprisoned Monouga from the Laboratory to the feeding pits. This portals him into the feeding pits for an hour. L|2|•|80+: «Large Imprisoned Monouga» L|2|•|120+: «Huge Imprisoned Monouga» L|2|•|150+: «Giant Imprisoned Monouga» L|1|6.|Once you ring the bell go to the door opposite the bell room. On the far side is a door that leads down to the imprisoned Monouga, There are no side exits on the way down so you cannot get lost. L|1|7.|{OPT} If you see a «Drudge Caretaker», you can kill it to get a «Large Bag of Food» (drops 10). The loot gives you a stamp, and the bag can be turned in to «Jarvis Hammerstone» for XP. L|2|•|⟦LargeBagofFood_Pickup⟧ L|1|8.|Kill the imprisioned Monouga and loot a rib. The monouga has a huge amount of health and a high regeneration rate. You probably cannot complete the quest in the time given without debuffing it. There are 10 ribs on the corpse. L|2|•|80+: «Large Monouga Rib» L|3|•|⟦LargeMonougaRib_Pickup⟧ L|2|•|120+: «Huge Monouga Rib» L|3|•|⟦HugeMonougaRib_Pickup⟧ L|2|•|150+: «Giant Monouga Rib» L|3|•|⟦GiantMonougaRib_Pickup⟧ L|1|9.|Give the rib to an «Ivory Crafter» to get a Thrown Weapon with the «Monouga Slayer» property.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen tells you, "Greetings, adventurer. I greet you in the name of Queen Elysa, whose command brings me here today."⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen gives you Monouga Laboratory Portal Attunement Gem.⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen tells you, "We seek intrepid adventurers like yourself, who might be willing to help us investigate a concerning development. It seems that some travelers have discovered a cavern in which drudges have been keeping monougas captive. What is unusual is that the drudges have very sophisticated portal sending enchantments which would seem to be beyond their means. We suspect Virindi involvement of some sort."⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen tells you, "Therefore, Prince Borelean led an expedition to investigate this drudge cavern. When he was finished, he had determined a way to reverse the portal sending - to open a portal from that location to the source of the monougas. These portal gems are the result of that determination."⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen tells you, "The Queen has commanded that whatever lay on the other side of that portal transit should be explored carefully, with the assumption that whatever is there is hostile. To do so, take the gem I have given you and charge it against the feeding bell. It will reverse the workings of the bell's portal sending magic, and, instead of summoning a drudge and a monouga, will open portals to the source of these monsters."⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen tells you, "You are welcome to explore the drudge cave, although many have explored it before now. The Queen seeks adventurers to enter the portal from which the monougas come, and hopefully more fully identify exactly what all of this humanoid activity means to the Isparian inhabitants of Dereth."
L|1||Returning to Liao⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen says, "Greetings to you again, Natalia Brynmad. We could use your assistance again. It seems that some of the researchers want additional information from inside the research laboratory you investigated for me before. Here, take another of the portal gems the researchers created and get yourself back to the lab."⸩ ⸨Corporal Liao Chen gives you Monouga Laboratory Portal Attunement Gem.
L|1||Using bell⸩ ⸨You ring the bell.⸩ ⸨In the distance, shrieks and growls echo through the halls. A purple light glows brightly for a few moments.
L|1||Drudge local area broadcast⸩ ⸨The Drudge Caretaker spreads his collected food out in the Monouga's feeding area.
L|1||Turning in food⸩ ⸨You give Jarvis Hammerstone Large Bag of Food.⸩ ⸨Jarvis Hammerstone tells you, "Why, yes - this does look like some of the food lately stolen from Cragstone. L|1||Turning in ribs⸩ ⸨You give Ivory Crafter Large Monouga Rib.⸩ ⸨Ivory Crafter tells you, "See the curve on this rib? Here, try this out."⸩ ⸨Ivory Crafter gives you Eyeslasyer (Large).⸩ ⸨You give Ivory Crafter Huge Monouga Rib.⸩ ⸨Ivory Crafter tells you, "See the curve on this rib? Here, try this out."⸩ ⸨Ivory Crafter gives you Eyeslasyer (Huge).⸩ ⸨You give Ivory Crafter Giant Monouga Rib.⸩ ⸨Ivory Crafter tells you, "See the curve on this rib? It will allow superior launching of projectiles, and the nature of the bone itself will naturally attune itself to slaying the mighty monouga. Here, try this out."⸩ ⸨Ivory Crafter gives you Eyeslayer (Giant).⸩

Quest.name: Nanjou_Stockade
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|200 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Shorikan» I|Starts At|«Hoshino Town 2¦Hoshino Town #2» at 78.0N, 41.6W I|Route|«Stonehold» to «Desolation Beach» portal at 69.7N, 20.2W. I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Nanjou Stockade» I|Quest Chain|Nanjou Shou-jen Academy I|1|«Ninja Academy» I|2|«Tanada Intercept» I|3|«Tanada Slaughter» I|4|Nanjou Stockade H2|Overview P|After helping the Nanjou in their fight against the Tanada in «Tanada Intercept and Slaughter», they determine that you are too dangerous to be kept alive and send you to a Nanjou prison.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to «Shorikan» located on the 2nd floor of a house near the edge of «Hoshino Town 2¦Hoshino Town #2» at 78.1N, 41.7W. He will portal you but beware he will speak for a while before doing so. Creatures spawn on both floors of the house, and those below can also hit you through the floor. L|2|•|⟦NanjouStockadeStarted_1012⟧ L|2|•|Route: «Stonehold» to «Desolation Beach» portal at 69.7N, 20.2W. L|1|2.|Shift jump your way out of the pit by using the stones along the walls. Make sure you do not land in one of the other pits on your final jump, otherwise you must recall and run back to Shorikan again. L|1|3.|The dungeon is filled with «Spectral Nanjou Mihari» and purple and green «Spectral Minion»s and «Spectral Archer¦Archer»s. For the most part, the dungeon is entirely linear. L|1|4.|Make your way through the dungeon until you reach «Spectral Nanjou Kaibinn». You should never jump down into any of the pits you come across. Kill the boss for a «Lower Chamber Key» and use it to unlock the door behind him. L|1|5.|Continue onward, eventually you will reach a spot where you can choose to go straight or turn right. Turning right leads to the second boss, a «Spectral Nanjou Keibi» which drops the «Upper Chamber Key» to the next door. L|2|•|Note: The boss is located behind a wall in the middle of the room. Melees can attack through the wall to kill him safely. L|1|6.|Continue onward and you will come to a large room with ledges and perched archers. Clear as much as you can from below, including the snipers along the walls. It's unlikely you will be able to clear them all before jumping. L|1|7.|Jump your way up the large room by using the ledges along the walls. Most of these are full normal jumps from one ledge to the next. Use shift jumps for the small stones, and full jump from them onto ledges. Your goal is a tunnel at the very top with 2 skeletons pinned on the wall surrounding the tunnel entrance. L|2|•|The jumps can be tricky because you often will bounce off arrows in the air or be blocked by the «Spectral Nanjou Mihari» that are on the ledges. L|1|8.|Past the jump room is the final chamber. It contains the final boss, a «Spectral Nanjou Zaikan», the «Legendary Chest»s and an exit portal. The doors to the room will close when you start attacking. L|1|9.|The boss is flanked by two Spectral Nanjou Mihari. When the fight starts, Spectral Archers will also spawn in the corners of the room. L|2|•|Note: Using the layout of the room, you can move to where the legendary chests are and control how many enemies attack you at one time. It is possible to drag the boss away so that you don't have to deal with the respawning minions. L|1|10.|Loot a «Spectral Nanjou Zaikan's Sword» and a «Legendary Key» from the boss (he drops 9 of each). The key can be used on the chests nearby. L|2|•|⟦NanjouStockadeSwordPickup⟧ L|2|•|⟦NanjouStockadeKeyPickup⟧ L|1|11.|Take the surface portal to be dropped at a safe location outside of the Hoshino Towns. L|1|12.|Run back to Shorikan and give him the sword for experience and luminance rewards. L|2|•|⟦NanjouStockadeFinished_1012⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Shorikan tells you, "You have proven to be instrumental in our battle with the Tanada. The tide surely swings in our favor due to your actions."⸩ ⸨Shorikan tells you, "We are grateful, but the situation is...delicate. None can know of what has transpired. The Tanada would surely wage an all out war and many of our own may view our actions as dishonorable and cowardly."⸩ ⸨Shorikan tells you, "Nothing is beyond reproach, not to ensure our victory."⸩ ⸨Shorikan pauses for a moment.⸩ ⸨Shorikan tells you, "I must be sure the news of what we have accomplished dies with you. Our success is far more important than your life."⸩ ⸨Shorikan tells you, "It truly pains me, but I have little choice. Your actions and our involvement end on this day."⸩ ⸨Shorikan reaches towards you and places a single finger on your shoulder.⸩ ⸨Shorikan looks your way. You cannot see his face but you can feel the tension in the air.⸩ ⸨Shorikan tells you, "Impossible! This cannot be! We will not fail again."⸩ ⸨Shorikan reaches towards you and places a single finger on your shoulder.
L|1||Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨You allow Shorikan to examine your Spectral Nanjou Zaikan's Sword.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Spectral Nanjou Zaikan's Swords.⸩ ⸨You've earned 300,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 15,000 Luminance.⸩ ⸨You throw the sword at the feet of Shorikan. Shorikan picks up the sword and wipes the dirt from the blade.⸩ ⸨Shorikan tells you, "You still live? Your skill in the art of battle is impressive."⸩ ⸨Shorikan tells you, "No good can come from further bloodshed over our misunderstanding. I underestimated you and you have proven me wrong."⸩ ⸨Shorikan tells you, "Take these rewards, but keep the tale of our interactions silent. Even someone as hardy as yourself would be crushed by the reprisal of both the Tanada and our forces. Let us not forget that the Tanada would show you no mercy for your slaughter of their recruits."⸩ ⸨Shorikan tells you, "The logical course of actions would be for all to forget we ever spoke. Revenge would only place you in the middle of a war that even you could not win."⸩ ⸨Shorikan tells you, "I trust that we have an agreement."⸩

Quest.name: New_Singular_Repositories
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|55 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Ecorto the Lost Director» I|Starts At|«Zaikhal» at 13.7N, 0.1E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak with «Ecorto the Lost Director» to receive «Ecorto's Chisel». The chisel has a chance of breaking when used so talk to Ecorto three times to get a chisel for all three of the pillars. L|1|2.|You now need to head to each of the repositories to get a sliver from each of the pillars located there. First head to the Singular Pyreal Repository at 4.2S, 8.9E. L|2|•|Route: using the «Town Network», take the west hall to «Samsur» and then take the «Return of Mumiyah Cottages» portal at 1.1S, 18.9E to 6.4S, 4.2E. From there, it's a short run to the Repository at 4.2S, 8.9E. L|1|3.|Once inside the dungeon just stick to the main path heading north, at the T section take a right and then north again until you reach a large open room with a number of «Singular Pyreal Pillar»s. Use the chisel on the pillar for a «Sliver of Singular Pyreal». L|1|4.|{OPT} Kill «Singular Doll» and loot «Doll Leader's Charm» L|2|•|⟦CharmDollOct01!⟧ L|1|5.|Now head to the second Chorizite Repository at 77.3S, 51.6E. L|2|•|Route: Head to «Kara» via the east hall of the «Town Network» and then take the North Adjamaer Cottages settlement portal at 83.0S, 48.0E. From there, it's a very short run to 77.3S, 51.6E. L|1|6.|From the drop just head north until you reach the last room with the «Singular Chorizite Pillar»s. Use the chisel on a pillar to get a «Sliver of Singular Chorizite». L|1|7.|{OPT} Kill «Singular Lugian Warlord» and loot «Lugian Warlord's Scepter» L|2|•|⟦ScepterLugianOct01⟧ L|1|8.|Go to the Obsidian Repository at 55.9S, 64.8W. L|2|•|Route: Use a «Dangerous Portal Device» at your mansion to get to the «Obsidian Plains» (Rythnid recall is closer) and then run to the dungeon from there. L|1|9.|At the drop, take the west passage and then stick to the main path ignoring all side passages like in the previous repositories. Eventually, you should end up in a room with four «Singular Obsidian Pillar»s above you in each corner of the room, to get up there head north and take either of the side passages. Use the chisel one final time to get a «Sliver of Singular Obsidian». L|1|10.|{OPT} Kill the «Singular Virindi Director» and loot the «Obsidian Director's Mask» in the room just before the Pillar. L|2|•|⟦MaskDirectorOct01⟧ L|1|11.|Now you have all 3 slivers, combine the chorizite sliver with the pyreal sliver to make a «Singularity Calyx». Then combine the calyx with the obsidian sliver to create a «Fragment of the New Singularity». L|1|12.|Hand the fragment to Ecorto in Zaikhal and he will summon a portal to the final dungeon where the «New Singularity Director» awaits. This dungeon is just as linear as the others, simply head north through a number of rooms and you will come to the Director's lair. Kill the director and take the «Virindi Shroud». L|2|•|⟦ShroudVirindiOct01⟧

L|1||Opening Dialog, Ecorto the Lost Director⸩ ⸨Ecorto the Lost Director tells you, "Greetings, human. Call me Ecorto. Find the repositories of the New Singularity in the desert, the southern mountains and the Obsidian Plains, human.⸩ ⸨Ecorto the Lost Director gives you Ecorto's Chisel⸩ ⸨Ecorto the Lost Director tells you, "Take this chisel, scrape slivers from the pillars they assemble, and bring the joined elements back to me... Quest.name: Releasing_the_Light
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Shah-hi» I|Starts At|«Excavation Site» at 77.7S, 97.0E I|Route|«Sanctuary Recall» or use an «Invitation Ithanc Cathedral» portal gem from a «Wedding Planner» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Sisters of Light» I|Quest Chain|The Sisters of Light I|1|Releasing the Light I|2|«Harvesting the Bulb of Mornings» I|3|«Harvesting the Bulb of Harvests» I|4|«Harvesting the Bulb of Twilight» I|5|«Hoshino Must Die» H2|Overview P|Explore an excavation site and learn the history of the Sisters of Light.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to the «Excavation Site» at 77.7S, 97.0E and speak with «Shah-hi». L|2|•|⟦BlessedCaveStarted_0912⟧ L|2|•|Route: Run from the «Sanctuary Recall» drop or use an «Invitation Ithanc Cathedral» portal gem from a «Wedding Planner». L|1|2.|Enter the hole in the ground (northwest of the NPCs at 77.6S 96.8E) and enter the portal to the «Blessed Cave» at 77.6S 96.7E in the cave . L|1|3.|Keep making your way down whenever possible (you will encounter numerous Adolescent Gromnies, as well as the new "Emergent" gromnus, complete with wings!). L|1|4.|Eventually you will come to a large room with a bridge made of the blocks that fade in and out, with numerous gromnies below. L|1|5.|{OPT} You may also in this room, jump up to collect the «Damaged Yalaini Tome» above. It may be turned in later for an additional 5,000 luminance XP and a «Legendary Key». L|2|•|⟦DamagedYalainiTomePickup⟧ L|1|6.|Cross the room, and continue making your way down whenever possible, until you reach a ledge with numerous tentacles and more gromnus below. L|2|•|Route to pit: South East at split > Exit the large room South East > Down the ramp ahead to the North East > South West across the intersection > North West down the ramp > North East (right turn) > Arrive at pit/jump. L|1|7.|Work your way through the tentacles being mindful of the numerous drain spells, until you reach large room full of pillars and tentacles with a «Ritual Statue of Entrapment» in the middle. L|1|8.|Kill the «Ritual Statue of Entrapment» statue to free the «Spirit of Bist'elle». L|1|9.|Talk to the «Spirit of Bist'elle» who will tell you of her imprisonment, and instruct you to return with news to your employer. L|2|•|⟦BlessedCaveReachedEnd⟧ L|1|10.|Return to «Shah-hi» for your initial rewards. You will also be portaled to the Neftet Chest Room to use your keys. L|2|•|⟦BlessedCaveCompleted_0912⟧ L|2|•|⟦BulbofMornings_Flag⟧ L|2|•|Note: the nearby surface portal just down one of the halls NE (up a ramp from the statue) will take you right back to the excavation. L|1|11.|Take the «Damaged Yalaini Tome» to «Bretself the Translator» in «Cragstone» and in return he will give you «The Sisters of Light» tome. L|1|12.|Return the «The Sisters of Light» tome to «Popkin of the Gate» for your final rewards. You will also be portaled to the Neftet Chest Room to use your keys.

L|1||Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨You explain to Shah-hi what you found in the depths of the temple.⸩ ⸨Shah-hi tells you, "Wow! That's more than we could've hoped for."⸩ ⸨Shah-hi tells you, "You actually found and helped one of the four Sisters mentioned in the lore we've been researching? That's unbelievable."⸩ ⸨Shah-hi tells you, "I have to relay this info to Popkin immediately. We'll have to begin looking for sites in the areas where the sacred materials were found."⸩ ⸨Shah-hi tells you, "Thank you very much for your assistance. Here, let me reward you for your part in this."⸩ ⸨You've earned 210,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 20,000 Luminance.⸩ ⸨Shah-hi gives you Legendary Key.⸩ ⸨Shah-hi tells you, "If you're interested, my brother Kaltus has run into some problems with his dig site, just outside of the Canyons of Neftet, in the desert. I'm sure he'd love the assistance."⸩ ⸨Shah-hi tells you, "For now, however, I'll send you to a place prepared for you to use that key. You may also find that where your going makes it easier to get to Kaltus."⸩ ⸨You allow Popkin of the Gate to examine your The Sisters of Light.⸩ ⸨Popkin of the Gate tells you, "Is that what I think it is?"⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your The Sisters of Lights.⸩ ⸨Popkin of the Gate tells you, "This is exactly what I was looking for!"⸩ ⸨Popkin of the Gate tells you, "It's a much later period transcription of the lore we've been researching, so I'll need to crosscheck it against the older pieces in case the story evolved over time, but this still invaluable to our research here.⸩ ⸨Popkin of the Gate tells you, "I hope this'll do for compensation for your skills and time. You've given us a great leap forward here."⸩ ⸨You've earned 45,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 5,000 Luminance.⸩ ⸨Popkin of the Gate gives you Legendary Key.
L|1||Other Interactions⸩ ⸨Lugian Miner tells you, "Greetings."⸩ ⸨Lugian Miner tells you, "Did you see those things? I'm not going back in there."⸩ ⸨Lugian Miner tells you, ""I've run into a lot of things in all my years, but a horde of elemental lizards trying to chew my face off is a bit much, even for me."
L|1||Giving Damaged Yalaini Tome to Bretself the Translator⸩ ⸨You give Bretself the Translator Damaged Yalaini Tome.⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "Well, what have we here? Where did you find this?"⸩ ⸨You explain where you found the ancient tome.⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "Fascinating. You know, this book isn't as old as its location may lead you to believe. This appears to be penned by one of the Adjanites, which were an order of Empyreans from Asheron's time, only a few thousand years ago. The story itself seems far older, though. She refers to it as coming from a Falatacot tribe. Very strange..."⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "But I digress. You can see for yourself, and I won't keep you here any longer."⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator gives you The Sisters of Light.
L|1||Showing The Sisters of Light to Shah-hi⸩ ⸨You allow Shah-hi to examine your The Sisters of Light.⸩ ⸨Shah-hi tells you, "The whole legend... this is an amazing find. You should take this to Popkin of the Gate, near Cragstone. She's the one collating all of the lore. She'll reward you well for this, I'm sure."⸩ ⸨Shah-hi tells you, "I'm stuck here dealing with angry Gromnies and even angrier miners..."⸩

Quest.name: Search_for_Abmim_ibn_Ibsar_&_Mad_Star_Investigation

Wiki.page: Search for Abmim ibn Ibsar & Mad Star Investigation

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Ma'yad ibn Ibsar» I|Starts At|21.7S, 1.6W in «Yaraq» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Under Cove Crypt» H2|Overview P|Ma'yad ibn Ibsar is looking for her missing brother, Abmim ibn Ibsar. Help her locate him and investigate the mystery of the Mad Star!
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|«Ma'yad ibn Ibsar» will direct you to «Akyafi ibn Sumwar», who in turn directs you to the other side of the Yaraq Cove. L|1|2.|Head west and follow the shore along the southern edge of the cove until you reach the Pillars of the Inner Sea. L|1|3.|Locate the «Corpse of Abmim ibn Ibsar» at 22.3S, 4.7W and loot «Abmim's Jambiya» from it. L|2|•|⟦JambiyaAbmimPickup⟧ L|1|4.|Head to 21.5S, 4.1W where there is a bunker to the «Under Cove Crypt», but the door will not open! Pick up «A Note to Ma'yad» located just outside the bunker door. L|2|•|⟦YaraqNoteCoveCrypt1204⟧ L|1|5.|Go to the nearby Drudge Tower and work your way to the top. One of the Drudges drops a «Scrawled Note (Translation)¦Scrawled Note» that you will need. L|2|•|⟦NoteDrudgeScrawledPickup⟧ L|1|6.|On the top of the tower is a button that opens the bunker door. Press the button and run down the stairs and into the bunker before the door closes! L|1|7.|Enter the «Under Cove Crypt» by jumping into the portal located in the bunker. L|1|8.|Work your way into the Crypt where you will find a «Mad Star Marionette» casting at you. Kill it through the window and loot the «Mad Star Marionette's Head». L|2|•|⟦YaraqHeadMarionetteMadStar1204⟧ L|1|9.|{OPT} There is a Runed Chest behind a lock door. Grab the Tumerock Key (see map) or pick the lock and chest. L|2|•|⟦ChestQuestLockedNewbiePOIE⟧ L|1|10.|Return to Ma'yad ibn Ibsar and give her A Note to Ma'yad and Abmim's Jambiya for experience rewards. L|1|11.|Go upstairs to Akyafi ibn Sumwar and give him the Scrawled Note and the Mad Star Marionette's Head for further experience.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Ma'yad ibn Ibsar's Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Ma'yad ibn Ibsar tells you, "Hail, traveler. Have you encountered a man named Abmim ibn Ibsar? He is my brother, who foolishly listened to those who whisper of an unsafe freedom to be gained in the Direlands."⸩ ⸨Ma'yad ibn Ibsar tells you, "We have not heard from him in several months, and begin to worry. If you bring me news of him, I would reward you as well as I may."⸩ ⸨Ma'yad ibn Ibsar tells you, "The last we heard, he had finally accepted some honest work from Akyafi the Translator. Perhaps Akyafi, who resides upstairs, can tell you more."
L|1||Akyafi ibn Sumwar's Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar tells you, "I am a humble scholar from Zaikhal. Of late, we have heard of the unusually large number of Drudges in the hills around the Yaraq Cove."⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar tells you, "They seem to gather near the ruin of the Empyrean port on the far side of the cove, where the Mad Star flickers. Perhaps you could investigate, and bring me back something which would explain their presence?"⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar tells you, "I recently sent young Abmim to investigate, but he has not yet returned."⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar tells you, "If you are having difficulty locating the Mad Star, you may buy directions from the barkeeper, Jubal. He's afraid of the Mad Star; ask him instead how to reach the Pillars of the Inner Sea.
L|1||Giving Akyafi ibn Sumwar Abmim's Jambiya⸩ ⸨You allow Akyafi ibn Sumwar to examine your Abmim's Jambiya.⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar tells you, "Hmmm? No, this isn't mine. Why don't you try asking Ma'yad about it?"
L|1||Giving Ma'yad ibn Ibsar Abmim's Jambiya⸩ ⸨You give Ma'yad ibn Ibsar Abmim's Jambiya.⸩ ⸨Ma'yad ibn Ibsar tells you, "Ah, Abmim, I knew you would one day run afoul of something. He that chooses a thief's life has it stolen from him early. My brother became a brigand and murderer, friend traveler."⸩ ⸨Ma'yad ibn Ibsar tells you, "Be not as foolish as he - do not lightly discard the protection this mage Asheron provides. But, as I promised, you have earned a reward."⸩ ⸨You've earned 11,250 experience.
L|1||Giving Akyafi ibn Sumwar A Note to Ma'yad⸩ ⸨You allow Akyafi ibn Sumwar to examine your A Note to Ma'yad.⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar tells you, "Hmmm? No, this isn't mine. Why don't you try asking Ma'yad about it?"
L|1||Giving Ma'yad ibn Ibsar A Note to Ma'yad⸩ ⸨You give Ma'yad ibn Ibsar A Note to Ma'yad.⸩ ⸨Ma'yad ibn Ibsar tells you, "Abmim, my brother! Ah, to learn that at the last you had renounced your evil ways! This gives me great joy and great pain - joy that you came to your sense, and pain that it came too late!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 11,250 experience.⸩ ⸨Ma'yad ibn Ibsar tells you, "Traveler, you have eased my troubled heart. Thank you."
L|1||Giving Ma'yad ibn Ibsar Scrawled Note⸩ ⸨You allow Ma'yad ibn Ibsar to examine your Scrawled Note.⸩ ⸨Ma'yad ibn Ibsar tells you, "I believe that Akyafi the Translator was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to him?"
L|1||Giving Akyafi ibn Sumwar Scrawled Note⸩ ⸨You give Akyafi ibn Sumwar Scrawled Note.⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar tells you, "I have never before heard of a Drudge carrying paper! It is well known that they are far too feebleminded to understand the written word. Allow me to reward you for this fascinating discovery."⸩ ⸨You've earned 7,500 experience.⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar tells you, "I wonder what this means? Give me a moment; I believe I may be able to translate it."⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar gives you Translation.⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar tells you, "There you are. This is ... intriguing. I wish to study this more closely. In the meantime, I would like you to investigate the Mad Star more carefully. Search the nearby Crypt, if you would, and bring me anything you find."
L|1||Giving Ma'yad ibn Ibsar Mad Star Marionette's Head⸩ ⸨You allow Ma'yad ibn Ibsar to examine your Mad Star Marionette's Head.⸩ ⸨Ma'yad ibn Ibsar tells you, "I believe that Akyafi the Translator was looking for this! Why don't you try taking it to him?"
L|1||Giving Akyafi ibn Sumwar Mad Star Marionette's Head⸩ ⸨You give Akyafi ibn Sumwar Mad Star Marionette's Head.⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar tells you, "What is this? Can this be the creature the drudges' note referred to?"⸩ ⸨Akyafi fishes a note from his pocket and reads it carefully.⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar tells you, "No ... no ... I do not ... No, I do not know. I must study!"⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar tells you, "But thank you, friend."⸩ ⸨You've earned 37,500 experience.⸩ ⸨Akyafi ibn Sumwar tells you, "If you are looking for more adventure, you might want to peruse the rumors that Jubal has at the bar. Or perhaps you should journey to Shoushi. I hear that there are many good people there who may need some help!"⸩

Quest.name: Seed_of_Power
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Virindi Delegate (Seed of Power)¦Virindi Delegate» I|Starts At|«Obsidian Plains» at 61.6S, 63.3W I|Route|«Mansion» to «Dangerous Portal Device» to «Center of the Obsidian Plains» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Visitors» H2|Overview P|Help the «Virindi Delegate (Seed of Power)¦Virindi Delegate» investigate strange power surges emanating from the «Obsidian Plains».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head west to the «Rynthid Crystal Access Device» at 63.1S, 65.5W. It is surrounded by 3 dungeons.
H3|Part 1: Splinter (Seed) Dungeons H4|Seed of Anger L|1|1.|You will proceed through 4 number of rooms with portal doors. To open them, simply hit the lever in the alcove nearby. L|1|2.|After the 4th lever room, you will come to the final room containing «Virindi Confer», high level hollow minions, and the «Disciple of Anger». Kill the disciple and loot a «Splinter of Anger» from the floor (9 spawn). Once you have a splinter, take the exit portal back to the surface L|2|•|⟦AngerSplinterPickup⟧
H4|Seed of Misery L|1|1.|This dungeon has a number of large rooms with virindi and lightning pillars in them. Do not fight in the rooms, simply run through the large rooms, and follow the hall. The hall appears to split after each room, but in fact one route dead ends shortly. L|2|•|Exit 1st big room to the north, go west L|2|•|Exit 2nd big room to the east, go north L|2|•|Exit 3rd big room to the south, go west L|2|•|Exit 4th big room to the south, go east L|1|2.|After the 4th large room is a smaller one with «Chorizite Pillar»s, more «Virindi Confer» and a «Hollow Servitor». Kill the servitor to open the door to the east leading to the final room L|1|3.|Again in the final room kill the «Disciple of Misery» and loot a «Splinter of Misery» from the floor. When you have one, take the exit portal to the surface L|2|•|⟦MiserySplinterPickup⟧
H4|Seed of Hatred L|1|1.|This dungeon splits early on either to the east or to the west. Which way you go does not matter, as the dungeon is linear and the 2 paths meet up later on. L|1|2.|From the drop, head east (or west) through 2 large rooms with more Lightning Pillars and virindi, until you come to the smaller 3rd room, which has a killable door. Killing the door opens the hall to reveal a jump. L|2|•|{WARN} Do NOT use a full power jump! You will hit the ceiling above and fall down into the pit. For those with a high jump skill 1/3 should suffice. For those with a lower skill 1/2 will do it. There is no way out of the pit below, and if you are vulned the floor will deal SERIOUS lightning damage! L|1|3.|After making the jump, follow the hall north to a large room. This room has a number of giant pits you must now jump across L|2|•|Note: If you fall, follow the hall back to the start of the dungeon. it is possible to overshoot the jumps!! For high jump skill players (600+) it is recommended not to aim straight across. Instead jump slightly north or south, to give yourself extra landing space. L|1|4.|Make the 2 jumps, then continue south down the hall to the final room with the «Disciple of Hatred» and his minions. Kill the Disciple and loot a «Splinter of Hatred» then take the exit portal. L|2|•|⟦HatredSplinterPickup⟧
H3|Part 2: Rynthid Access Dungeon L|1|1.|Once you have all 3 Splinters, head to the «Virindi Delegate (Seed of Power)¦Virindi Delegate» located up on the rim of the Obsidian Crater (61.6S, 63.3W) to hand them in for the first 3 rewards. L|2|•|Hatred: ⟦Seed2_0713⟧ L|2|•|Misery: ⟦Seed3_0713⟧ L|2|•|Anger: ⟦Seed1_0713⟧ L|1|2.|In addition to your rewards, the Virindi Delegate will also give you «Focused Splinter of Anger», «Focused Splinter of Misery» and «Focused Splinter of Hatred». Take the focused splinters back to the «Rynthid Crystal Access Device» at 63.1S, 65.5W and give one (it will take all 3 Focused Splinters) to the device to be portalled into the next dungeon. L|2|•|⟦VisitorsGotAccess_0713⟧ L|1|3.|In here you will be completing a series of puzzles. L|2|•|Note: If you die run back and use the Crystal Access Device again at 63.1S, 65.5W to be portalled back to the 1st puzzle room. L|1|4.|Head north through the 2 rooms with lightning pillars (be sure to dispel before running!). In the 3rd room, there will be lightning storms all over the ceiling shooting streaks at you. Run across this room as well but beware!! Throughout the rooms are traps to take all your stamina, and give you 300% burden by casting «Weight of Eternity» on you! After exiting the room with the lightning storm, head through the hallways with the lightning traps but STOP before entering the 4th large room! L|1|5.|This 4th large room (with red lightning coursing over the ground) is the final trial. L|2|•|Note: If you fail this puzzle, you will be portalled to a small room leading to the start of the dungeon and need to run back. L|1|6.|In this room, you must walk ONLY where the lightning goes (it does not hurt). You can even move if ther is no lightning visible, as long as you don't stray off of the lightnings path. Take your time and go SLOW. There is NO direct path to the south east exit. You will traverse the entire room on your way there. I went east, then south, then all the way west, then south, then east on my way to the door. L|2|•|Note: There is also a «Chorizite Chest» in this room in the opposite corner to the exit hallway. L|3|•|⟦chestchorizite51643⟧ L|2|•|Note: Do not try and jump. There is an invisible ceiling and you will simply be portalled back to the start of the dungeon. L|1|7.|After crossing the room, sprint over and talk to the «Mysterious Portal (Seed of Power)¦Mysterious Portal» (be careful of the 2 pillars in the room as well). It will reward you with a «Lightning Cloud» before portalling you out of the room and dropped at (81.7S, 62.9W) near «Candeth Keep». L|2|•|⟦LightningCloud_0713⟧ L|1|8.|Return once more to the «Virindi Delegate (Seed of Power)¦Virindi Delegate» located up on the rim of the Obsidian Crater your final rewards. L|2|•|⟦Visitors4Completed_0713⟧

Quest.name: Serpent_Burial_Grounds_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Rec. Level|180 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Kraytuss Nallah» I|Starts At|«Stonehold» at 68.8N, 21.7W I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Infiltrate the Serpent Burial Grounds.
L|1|•|Although it's not required, «Lockpick» skill is recommended for this quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Kraytuss Nallah» in «Stonehold» at 68.8N, 21.7W to flag for this quest. L|2|•|⟦SerpentBurialGroundsStarted⟧ L|1|2.|Head to the «Serpent Burial Grounds» at 67.6N, 25.3W (safe drop). L|1|3.|From the drop, continue north, into a large room with a locked door (800 diff). L|1|4.|Pick the door («Lockpick» skill, diff 800 before debuff), and jump across the acid pit. L|2|•|Note: If you do not have lockpick, you can take the side hallway for a longer, more difficult route that ends up at the «Warding Crystal». L|1|5.|Continue forward and work your way down to a room containing a «Warding Crystal». L|1|6.|Kill the «Warding Crystal» and take the door that opens to the east. L|1|7.|Continue through the linear dungeon until you come to a ledge with an acid pool below. L|1|8.|When your group is ready, jump down into the acid and quickly run forward into the room. L|2|•|Tip: If you stay somewhat close to the acid pit after jumping, you can avoid drawing aggro from all of the enemies at once. L|1|9.|Clear the spawn, and kill «Shikken Moriyaki». L|2|•|Tip: Have a mage debuff Shikken Moriyaki's weapon. He can hit very hard otherwise. L|1|10.|Once dead, loot a «Bone Fragment from Shikken Moriyaki» from the corpse. L|2|•|⟦SerpentBurialGroundsBonePickup⟧ L|1|11.|Also loot a 2 use «Legendary Key» from the Sclavus enemies. Each Sclavus drops one. Shikken Moriyaki also drops 2 keys. L|2|•|⟦SerpentBurialGroundsKeyPickup⟧ L|1|12.|Use the keys on the nearby chests, then portal recall back to Stonehold. L|1|13.|Give Kraytuss Nallah the Bone Fragment from Shikken Moriyaki to receive your rewards. L|2|•|⟦SerpentBurialGroundsDone⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Maqudh al Nishadina tells you, "Do you wield the Silifi of Crimson Stars? Would you like to wield a Silifi like mine? If so, I can help you improve the weapon, to add the Critical Strike ability and Lightning Cleaving properties to it... Yes, I have a way of repairing one of the damaged jewel settings. But my method demands a very particular ruby... Never mind that for now. If you wish to start on the path to improving your Silifi, you must first bring me a Plate Armoredillo Spine. Do not trouble me with the specifics. Just bring me a spine.
L|1||Handing in Plate Armoredillo Spine⸩ ⸨You give Maqudh al Nishadina Plate Armoredillo Spine.⸩ ⸨Maqudh al Nishadina tells you, "Yes, this will do. I need this to reinforce the blade, which will break under the power of the enchantments I plan to - but that is not important right now. The next step is for you to bring me a Shadow Fragment. Yes, you must slay Shadows, those blots of corruption. Collect enough of their shards until you have combined them into a Shadow Fragment. We can go no further until you bring me that." steps to improving your Silifi."
L|1||Handing in Shadow Fragment⸩ ⸨You give Maqudh al Nishadina Shadow Fragment.⸩ ⸨Maqudh al Nishadina tells you, "Excellent. This Shadow Fragment will help me repair the setting on the axe... But in the meantime, you need to seek out the final ingredient... There is a crypt not too far from here, ruled by a terrible undead lord named Darayavaush. In life he was a great king, but in undeath he is a terrible tyrant. Go and destroy Darayavaush, and bring me the ruby he carries. It is his ruby that will provide the enchantment for your improved Silifi. Darayavaush resides in a crypt among his minions located at 12.3 N, 8.2 E."
L|1||Handing in Ruby of Crimson Night⸩ ⸨You give Maqudh al Nishadina Ruby of Crimson Night.⸩ ⸨Maqudh al Nishadina tells you, "Excellent. This is the final ingredient I require. I can now construct for you a new gem setting to add to your Silifi of the Crimson Stars. As I said, it will imbue your Silifi, with whatever combination of jewels you currently have, with the power of Critical Strike and Lightning Cleaving. However, this new gem setting can only be applied to a Silifi that already has three gems attached to it. You will not be able to use this on an incomplete Silifi. Take this, and go forth with your new Silifi of Crimson Night."⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,817,868 experience.⸩ ⸨Maqudh al Nishadina gives you Crimson Night Gem Setting.⸩ ⸨Maqudh al Nishadina tells you, "If your are not an axe wielder and do not want this item, while I have to wonder why you bothered to speak with me, then I will take back the gem setting in exchange for some practical knowledge."
L|1||Handing in Crimson Night Gem Setting⸩ ⸨You give Maqudh al Nishadina Crimson Night Gem Setting.⸩ ⸨Maqudh al Nishadina tells you, "A pity you have no use for this... Then again, we can't all be strong enough to wield such a mighty axe. Perhaps some practical knowledge will serve you better."⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,064,801 experience.⸩

Quest.name: Wedding_Trials
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Small Fellowship I|Starts At|«Wedding Trials Dungeon» at 32.8N, 55.2E I|Route|«Arwic» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: The Wedding Trials L|1|1.|It's a straightforward quest dungeon. However, because it is for marriage, you do need to have two people (but yes with a good run skill you can solo). L|1|2.|Once you enter the dungeon one person takes a right hall, and one person takes the left hall. Follow the hall down past the "Cold Feet" portal, to a door that you can't open. L|1|3.|At this point on the wall in the room with the door you will find a button. Each room will have one. The person who took the right hall will open the left halls door with his button, and vise versa. L|1|4.|This will lead to hall where both of you will once more come together. Down the hall about half way there is another hall that leads to a room with a K'nath named "Jealousy". L|1|5.|Both of you will need to get a kill on Jealousy. He drops an item called, «Symbol of Friendship». Don't worry though, he spawns about every 30 seconds. From this room there are two doors. Each person takes a door, and follows the hall to the next room. L|2|•|⟦MarriageSymbolFriendship⟧ L|1|6.|In this room you will find a "pressure plate" that like the buttons will open the opposite door, and allow the other person to advance. Once you're past the door that is opened by the pressure plate follow the hall yet again to another room that holds the K'nath named Anger. Slay him and loot the «Symbol of Love». L|2|•|⟦MarriageSymbolLove⟧ L|1|7.|Combine your Symbol of Friendship and your Symbol of Love to get the «Symbol of Commitment». Once you both have this, take the door that you didn't use to enter this room to leave it. L|1|8.|This will lead to hall and to the last K'nath. This one is named Greed, on it you will find the «Symbol of Honor». Combine the Symbol of Honor and the Symbol of Commitment to get «Symbol of Marriage». L|2|•|⟦MarriageSymbolHonor⟧
H3|Part 2: The Wedding Ceremony L|1|1.|{OPT} Read the «Wedding Handbook» that can be purchased from one of the «Wedding Planner»s. L|1|2.|You now have the "hard" part of the quest done, now off to find a Grand Sentinel to do the ceremony. L|2|•|They are easily found by going to one of the «Wedding Planner»s and getting a portal gem. There are 3 portal gems that you can buy for around 35k a piece. The Wedding Planners also sell many other items such as wedding cake, gowns, raiments and so on. L|1|3.|Each takes you to a different spot: L|2|•|«Grand Sentinel Ehcac» at «Ithaenc Wedding Site» - 82.0S, 94.8E L|2|•|«Grand Sentinel Muroba» at the «Wedding Hall» - use a recall scroll L|2|•|«Grand Sentinel Tretia» at the «Plateau Wedding Site» - 45.7N, 43.3W L|1|4.|Once you and your friends have arrived give your «Symbol of Marriage» to the Grand Sentinel. He will then commence the ceremony. # During the ceremony you will receive a «Wedding Ring», «Emblem of Marriage», and «Promise Gem» - which, when used, makes the fireworks for hitting 126/maxing out a skill occur from your character. L|2|•|⟦MarriageCompleted⟧ L|1|5.|Congratulations, on your new life in Dereth as husband and wife!

H2|Dialog H3|Grand Sentinels L|1||Grand Sentinel Muroba tells you, "It gives me great joy knowing those I join in union go forth to make this land a happier and healthier place to be."
L|1||Grand Sentinel Tretia tells you, "To begin the marriage ceremony, you must first hand me the Symbol of Marriage. If you are in search of the Symbol, a series of tests await you near Arwic."
L|1||Grand Sentinel Ehcac tells you, "To begin the marriage ceremony, you must first hand me the Symbol of Marriage. If you are in search of the Symbol, a series of tests await you near Arwic."
H3|Handing in Symbol of Marriage L|1||Grand Sentinel Ehcac says, "Welcome, friends and family! Let us begin the ceremony of Marriage!"
L|1||You give Grand Sentinel Ehcac Symbol of Marriage.
L|1||Grand Sentinel Ehcac says, "You have come here today to demonstrate your commitment to one another. You come bearing the Symbol of Marriage as proof of that commitment. I accept this Symbol as a your vow that you agree to love, cherish and honor your spouse for all your time here in Dereth."
L|1||Grand Sentinel Ehcac gives you Emblem of Marriage.
L|1||Grand Sentinel Ehcac says, "You have made your vows under the Symbol of that which you hold important. Before the witnesses of your friends and family, I now pronounce this union to be made. There is one last step you must take to make this union complete."
L|1||Grand Sentinel Ehcac gives you Wedding Ring.
L|1||Grand Sentinel Ehcac says, "May your marriage bring you great happiness. You should take the time to inscribe the Emblem of Marriage with words that show your commitment to your spouse, then present them."
L|1||Grand Sentinel Ehcac says, "You who stand here as witnesses are the friends and family of those seeking our blessings today. You are charged with the task of helping them in their new role of marriage, to support them in their times of need, and to do all that you can to make their marriage a blessed and happy union."
L|1||Grand Sentinel Ehcac gives you Promise Gem.
L|1||Grand Sentinel Ehcac says, "Use this Promise Gem as a final demonstration of your love. When used, the of Marriage becomes complete."
H2|Trivia P|Weddings were originally held on request by in-game volunteers known as Sentinels. The Sentinel and «Advocates» program was discontinued as of the «Lonely In The World» event. You can read the relevant letter to the players «Announcements - 2001/02 - Lonely In The World¦here» P|See also: L|1|•|«Microsoft Zone Archive/News & Events/For the Love of Dereth¦For the Love of Dereth» L|1|•|«Microsoft Zone Archive/News & Events/Spring Brings New Expressions of Love¦Spring Brings New Expressions of Love» L|1|•|«Microsoft Zone Archive/News & Events/Mass Weddings, March 10¦Mass Weddings, March 10» L|1|•|«Emblem of Marriage (Retired)» L|1|•|«The Wedding Guide»

Quest.name: Aerbax's_Prodigal_Human
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Rec. Level|170+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Hidden Laboratory» at 67.2N, 27.1W I|Route|«Stonehold» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Aerbax's Prodigal Human» H2|Overview P|Dojiro Sangi went missing some time ago, along with a drudge near holtburg, Harraag the Banderling, the Aun Town Crier from Timaru, and Claude the Virindi mage of Ayan. Now we have learned the fate of Dojiro. Thankfully he was not fully turned by Aerbax, and with our help, he has ended his new tortured life and rendered Aerbax's Prodigal Isparian experiment useless. P|See «Missing Persons Investigation» for more information.
L|1|•|This quest opened up with a «Prodigal Human Investigation¦live event» during the «Children of the Prodigal Lord» patch. It currently has no starting rumor or NPC to speak to. L|1|•|«Lockpick» is not required, but can be used instead of the key. However, the key is found in the same room as the door, so picking the lock is not much of a time saver.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Proceed carefully through dungeon. There are high level «Simulacrum¦Simulacra», «Tuskers», «Virindi», and «Hollow Minion»s, including the «Blight Hollow Minion» (new to this dungeon). L|1|2.|When you reach a large room with a door made of glowing energy, you must either kill the «Lab Guardian» Virindi to acquire the «Lab Guardian's Key», or pick the door with lockpick (800 resistance can be reduced to 600 with weaken lock 7). The key has 3 uses to open three doors so it can be worth your time to get it. L|1|3.|Continue through dungeon. There is a doorway leading to a large pit full of energy. There is an invisible floor here. Cross to the other side and open the energy door with the same key from before or pick it again. L|1|4.|Continue to the final room. It is best to destroy the minions before taking on the Virindi boss «Demerax the Sculptor». He is not easy to solo unless you have a very high magic resist, due to all the other mobs debuffing every spell in the book. He also regens health very quickly, so debuff him if possible. L|1|5.|Kill Demerax and loot the «Paradox-infused Potion» and «Virindi Message Shard (Demerax the Sculptor)¦Virindi Message Shard». L|2|•|⟦ParadoxinfusedPotion_Pickup⟧ L|1|6.|Give the potion to Dojiro Sangi, located in the center of the room. L|2|•|⟦ProdigalHumanPotionAcquired_1107⟧ L|1|7.|Go to «Candeth Keep» and give «Dojiro Sangi's Ring» to «Ryukai Hiro» at 87.8S, 67.3W, next to the grocer's shop. L|2|•|⟦ProdigalHumanCompleted_1107⟧ L|1|8.|{OPT} Bring the message shard to «Diyas al-Yat» to receive the text «Observations and Instructions: Dojiro Sangi».
