R|Hand in «Dojiro Sangi's Ring» to «Ryukai Hiro» RK|Experience|240,000,000 RK|Title|Dojiro Sangi's Savior RK|Items| RI|«Mana Forge Key» RE
H2|Video TR| TE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Dojiro Sangi⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi tells you, "Help... me..."⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi tells you, "They're turning me into some kind of monster! I hear... voices... inside my head... telling me to... Enighten? everyone? I don't... understand..."⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi tells you, "You need, to stop this... for me... I can't... become... this thing."⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi's eyes come into focus on you, and a look of wild desperation fills his ruined face, beneath the mask.⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi tells you, "The potion they use on me! It's supposed to be dangerous, if not given slowly! Give it to me! Give me the Bottle! Help me ruin what they are doing to me!!"⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi's voice changes, taking on a calm, almost metallic quality.⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi tells you, "You will not harm my Prodigal Child. He is your salvation, your race's chance at Enlightenment. He is one of my beloved vessels, our Future! Leave him be, it is only the pains of rebirth that he feels. He will unify us all!"⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi casts Synaptic Misfire on you.⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi casts Self Loathing on you.
L|1||Demerax⸩ ⸨Demerax the Sculptor's voice echoes through the area, "You cannot escape 'Asheron's Protection', little Sangi. Even death will not stop you from becoming my Master's beloved Child."⸩ ⸨Demerax the Sculptor's laughter echoes along the walls.
L|1||Defeating Demerax⸩ ⸨Demerax the Sculptor is incinerated by your assault!⸩ ⸨Demerax the Sculptor screams in rage as he dies!⸩ ⸨A searing pain fills your mind, carrying the following words along with it, "You won't stop the Master's plans! It's too late to stop him now!"
L|1||Handing in Paradox-infused Potion to Dojiro Sangi⸩ ⸨You give Dojiro Sangi Paradox-infused Potion.⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi tells you, "Yes!!"⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi guzzles down the Paradox-infused Potion.⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi screams, his voice echoing with the sound of multiple voices, crying out in unison!⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi tells you, "Thank you... Please... Take this... home..."⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi gives you Dojiro Sangi's Ring.⸩ ⸨Dojiro Sangi's eyes flash with violet light, and a cold humming fills the room.⸩ ⸨A voice fills your mind, "Pray for death, little meat-bag. Your attempts will not foil me forever..."⸩ ⸨With a final shudder, Dojiro Sangi's form disintegrates.
L|1||Handing in Dojiro Sangi's Ring to Ryukai Hiro⸩ ⸨You give Ryukai Hiro Dojiro Sangi's Ring.⸩ ⸨Ryukai Hiro tells you, "You have something for me?"⸩ ⸨Ryukai Hiro tells you, "I recognize this... Where did you get this?"⸩ ⸨You tell Ryukai Hiro about your encounter with Dojiro Sangi in Aerbax's Lab.⸩ ⸨Ryukai Hiro tells you, "I see. It is a great sadness that things needed to turn out this way, but you did the right thing, and saved Sangi from a terrible fate. Please, allow me to reward you."⸩ ⸨Ryukai Hiro grants to you the title, "Dojiro Sangi's Savior".⸩ ⸨You've earned 164,455,904 experience.⸩ ⸨Ryukai Hiro gives you Mana Forge Key.
L|1||Handing in Dojiro Sangi's Ring to Ryukai Hiro (Quest Repeat)⸩ ⸨You give Ryukai Hiro Dojiro Sangi's Ring.⸩ ⸨Ryukai Hiro tells you, "If you have this, it must mean that Aerbax brought Sangi back and continued his mad plans..."⸩ ⸨Ryukai Hiro tells you, "Thank you for once again freeing Dojiro Sangi. Please, accept this reward."⸩ ⸨You've earned 69,729,299 experience.⸩ ⸨Ryukai Hiro gives you Mana Forge Key.⸩

L|1||Speaking to Aun Bernawa⸩ ⸨Aun Bernawa tells you, "I am waiting here for Hea Toneawa. I don't suppose he gave anything to you for my sister, Mariona?"
L|1||Giving Aun Bernawa the Note from Hea Toneawa to Aun Mariona⸩ ⸨You give Aun Bernawa Note from Hea Toneawa to Aun Mariona.⸩ ⸨Aun Bernawa tells you, "Hm...let me see...that bakha Toneawa! If he dares to think that he can meet my little sister here in secret he's got another thing coming. She will never be corrupted by that melodramatic sissy! If I ever catch him lurking about in our arbor again, I'll cut off his OWN tail for him! He'll wish he'd never left Timaru for Ahurenga! And if he thinks I'll let Mariona run away with him across the water...Why, why I'll...Here, take this to him. I must prepare to journey back to Timaru. My family must hear of this ridiculous affair."⸩ ⸨Aun Bernawa gives you Note from Aun Bernawa to Hea Toneawa.
L|1||Giving Aun Bernawa the Note from Aun Bernawa to Hea Toneawa⸩ ⸨You allow Aun Bernawa to examine your Note from Aun Bernawa to Hea Toneawa.⸩ ⸨Aun Bernawa tells you, "I thought I told you to take this to that bukha Toneawa!"

L|1||Speaking to Hea Toneawa after completing the quest⸩ ⸨Hea Toneawa tells you, "Many thanks, my friend, but I couldn't trouble you again with the affairs of my heart so soon. Perhaps tomorrow I will find the courage to contact my beloved again."
L|1||Speaking to Aun Bernawa after completing the quest⸩ ⸨Aun Bernawa tells you, "YOU! Back again? Be off with you--and tell Hea Toneawa once and for all that the Aun will have nothing to do with him."

Quest.name: Apostate_Finale
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Rec. Level|200 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Emissary of Asheron (Gear Knight Camp)¦Emissary of Asheron» I|Starts At|«Direlands Gear Knight Resistance Camp» I|Route|Use «Gear Knight Recall» or give an MMD to «Merkitz ibn'Akadh» in Xarabydun to summon a portal to the camp. I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Time|1 Hour I|Contracts|«Contract for Apostate Finale» H2|Overview P|The Emissary of Asheron has you investigate the appearance of new portals inside Gear Knight dungeons which brings leads you to fight the Apostate Grand Director. You are rewarded with a triple Epic virindi mask. It helps greatly to have the «Gear Knight Recall» spell, or a handful of MMDs so you can use the portal summoned by «Merkitz ibn'Akadh» in «Xarabydun».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak with «Emissary of Asheron (Gear Knight Camp)¦Emissary of Asheron». L|2|•|⟦ApostateFinaleStarted_0910⟧ L|1|2.|After speaking with the «Emissary of Asheron (Gear Knight Camp)¦Emissary of Asheron», head due north to a burrow entrance to the «Gear Hunter Dungeon» at 7.2S, 75.0W. L|2|1.|From entrance stick left until you come to a room with hallways leading down to the north and south. L|2|2.|Go north and down, at the next intersection go east (left). Soon after you'll come to a 4 way intersection, go north (left). L|2|3.|Stick left until you come to a six-sided room with «General Tarkaris» and with a 150+ req «Mysterious Portal» and go inside. L|2|•|⟦EmptySkinPickedUp!⟧ L|1|3.|In this dungeon is the first of three shards you need. See map for the location of the «Apostate Nexus Master (Level 220)¦Apostate Nexus Master» that drops nine «Sparkling Apostate Shard»s. Or follow the directions below for each intersection after the drop. L|2|1.|Straight (West) L|2|2.|Left (West) L|2|3.|Straight (North) L|2|4.|Straight (East) L|1|4.|Once each person has a «Sparkling Apostate Shard» exit the dungeon. L|2|•|{OPT} If you return to the Emissary and show him your shard. He will direct you to proceed you to the next section. To speed along simply go to the next step. The shard lasts 60 minutes so if you lose your shard for some reason you will need to get another one to continue. L|1|5.|Run to the «Direlands Gear Knight Dungeon» at 10.4S 75.2W (southmost of the three burrows around the Resonator device). Hug the left wall until you see a purple glow and a Virindi Mask. Use the Sparkling Apostate Shard and enter the portal. L|1|6.|Once inside the «Apostate Nexus (Scintillating)», either stick left or stick right and you'll soon come to a large room with mana fountains at the bottom/end. Next to it will be another «Apostate Nexus Master (Level 220)¦Apostate Nexus Master» that drops 9 «Scintillating Apostate Shard»s. L|1|7.|When everyone has a shard exit the dungeon. Return to the «Direlands Gear Knight Dungeon» at 10.4S 75.2W and stick left until you come to the room with the «Iron Blade Warmaster». Use the most recent shard in this room to open a portal to the «Apostate Nexus (Shimmering)». L|2|•|In this dungeon you will also find the Large Tome in the first large room to your right - «Book 1: The Apostates» for the «Strathelar Royal Cloak Quest» L|3|•|⟦LargeTome1PickupTimer⟧ L|1|8.|When everyone has a shard exit the dungeon. Return to the «Direlands Gear Knight Dungeon» at 10.4S 75.2W and stick left until you come to the Virindi Mask on the wall next to the tunnel that leads down to the room with the «Iron Blade Warmaster». Use the third shard AT THE MASK on map listed as SHIMMERING to open a portal to the «Heart of the Apostate Nexi». L|1|9.|Once inside, stick left until you come to a large room, continue sticking left and take the hallway leading east out of the large room and continue sticking left until you come to a jump. At the bottom of the jump is the final boss, the «Apostate Grand Director». L|1|10.|When you have defeated him, loot one of the 9 «Shard of the Apostate Grand Director's Broken Mask». Kill again if more shards are needed. L|2|•|⟦ApostateFinaleMaskShardPickup⟧ L|1|11.|Once everyone has a shard, head back to the camp and give the shard to the Emissary to receive your rewards. L|2|•|⟦ApostateFinaleCompleted_0910⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|The boss frequently doesn't drop a corpse on death. He respawns in five minutes, it seems to work best if you surround his spawn spot (the pillar of energy in the middle of the room) and don't let him move from his spawn spot. He also sometimes disappears before he dies (again wait for respawn). L|1|•|Once you complete the quest (turn in the mask shard) you lose your flag to enter the «Mysterious Portal» so you won't be able to help anyone with the quest. L|1|•|The «Book 1: The Apostates» for the «Strathelar Royal Cloak Quest» is found in the only dungeon that has checkerboard tile floors. When you enter there is a ramp in front of you going down. At the bottom of the ramp are two rooms, one to the left, and one to the right. The Large Tome is in the room on the right in the far left corner on the floor. L|2|•|⟦LargeTome1PickupTimer⟧

H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Greetings!" L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "I have been sent here to ask adventurers, such as yourself, to aid in a rather delicate situation my Lord Asheron has found himself in." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "He has learned that the disruptions endangering a small pocket of located Empyreans are tied to a set of growing Temporal anomalies, as well as direct interference by these 'Apostate' Virindi." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "To that end, he has located a confluence of overlapping temporal and portalspace disturbances in the Iron Blade fortifications to the north of here, as well as a defended portal in the caves of the Apostate Simulacra." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "I have been given the means to allow you passage through the defended portal, but from there, it will be up to you to locate and end the disturbances, so my Lord Asheron may stabilize the area around the located Empyreans, and extract them from their present circumstances." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "There are several ... points, of greater disturbance within the Iron Blade's tunnels. we originally thought them to be due to the high levels of Aetherium, combined with the methods the Iron Blade Primus is using to control the portal pathway to his or her homeworld, but there are temporal anomalies mixed into the disturbances that lead my Lord to believe that they are related to the Portalspace that have prevented him from simply removing the group of Empyreans he has located..." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "My apologies, I do ramble on sometimes." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "The short form. There's a portal in the simulacra cave we believe to be key to ending the disturbance. I can protect you from the barriers and wards upon it." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "In there, hopefully, you'll find the source of the problem, or something that will lead you through the points of greatest disturbance in the Iron Blade Tunnels." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Find the force or entity responsible, end it. Return to me with proof, and I'll reward you." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Any questions?"
L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Hello again! Have you located the source of the disturbances that are blocking my Lord Asheron from rescuing the pocket of Empyreans he has located?" L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "We managed to detect several temporal and portalspace disturbances within the Iron Blade's area of influence, and believe that masked portals may be hidden within their tunnels." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "We also managed to locate a new portal in the deep cave the Simulacra have delved near to the Iron Blade fortifications, and believe that may be a good place to seek out what is needed to find the masked portals within the Iron Blade tunnels."
H3|Giving Sparkling Apostate Shard to Emissary of Asheron L|1||You allow Emissary of Asheron to examine your Sparkling Apostate Shard. L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "A fascinating piece of congealed energy. It does not look very stable though. I fear it would not long survive contact with the energies that animate this form." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Perhaps it can be used to open a passageway into portalspace, if brought to the correct area in the Iron Blade tunnels? It does resonate similarly to one of the detected anomalies within the tunnels." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "I wish I could tell you more, but the Aetherium levels in the tunnels and in the Gear Knights make it difficult to pin down an exact location... Which would indeed be a great reason to hide something there..." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Good luck!"

Which would indeed be a great reason to hide something there..." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Good luck!"
H3|Giving Shimmering Apostate Shard to Emissary of Asheron L|1||You allow Emissary of Asheron to examine your Shimmering Apostate Shard. L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "A fascinating piece of congealed energy. It does not look very stable though. I fear it would not long survive contact with the energies that animate this form." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Perhaps it can be used to open a passageway into portalspace, if brought to the correct area in the Iron Blade tunnels? L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "I wish I could tell you more, but the Aetherium levels in the tunnels and in the Gear Knights make it difficult to pin down an exact location... Which would indeed be a great reason to hide something there..." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "Good luck!"
H3|The Grand Director L|1||A throbbing pain forms in your mind and you hear, "You will pay for the mistake of interrupting our work here, fleshling. You'll beg for death before I finish with you."
L|1||As 's final blow rends the Grand Director's cloak asunder, the creatures' mask shatters into multiple shards.
H3|Rewards Dialog L|1||You allow Emissary of Asheron to examine your Shard of the Apostate Grand Director's Broken Mask. L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "This is amazing! I have never seen so much power packed into a small shard of Virindi mask like this before!" L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "The energy signature on this also matches the brunt force of the disturbances that have striven against my Lord Asheron!" L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "I believe, I owe you both great thanks, and reward for the aid you have given me in my task. Ah, I have an idea!" L|1||The Emissary absorbs the shard, glowing brighter for a moment, and then pulls from his center a smaller mask, identical to the one the Grand Director wore. L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "This being was indeed at the heart of the Portalspace disturbances, but strangely not the temporal ones..." L|1||Emissary of Asheron tells you, "I will relay your success and these findings to my Lord Asheron. Hopefully, the temporal disturbances alone are not enough to further delay his rescue efforts." L|1||You hand over 1 of your Shard of the Apostate Grand Director's Broken Masks. L|1||Emissary of Asheron gives you Apostate Grand Director's Mask. L|1||Emissary of Asheron gives you Strengthened Mana Forge Key. L|1||You've earned 430,962,225 experience.

Quest.name: Arcanum_Furniture
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|20 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Hollow Lair near Lytelthorpe» at 2.2S, 50.7E I|Route|«Lytelthorpe» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|General P|Vanquish the «Minion Leader» at the end of the «Hollow Lair near Lytelthorpe¦Hollow Lair» for access to the Arcanum Furniture Shop.
P|Be sure to bring some «MMD» notes with you on this quest if you plan to buy furniture. This vendor isn't cheap!
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to the «Hollow Lair near Lytelthorpe» at 2.2S, 50.7E, and once inside, talk to the «Arcanum Envoy». L|1|2.|Take the south hallway and then your second left. Follow the hallway until you reach a room with a «Minion Leader». L|1|3.|Kill the «Minion Leader» and then pick up «A Near Illegible Note» on the ground nearby. L|2|•|⟦KilledMenacet⟧ L|2|•|⟦MenacetsNote⟧ L|1|4.|Give «A Near Illegible Note» to the «Arcanum Envoy» and he will give you «Nuhmudira's Token» in exchange. L|1|5.|You can either give him the token back for access to the «Arcanum Furniture Shop», or you can hand it to an «Agent of the Arcanum» in exchange for a «Writ of Refuge» (Non Repeatable). L|2|•|Hand to «Arcanum Envoy»: ⟦ArcanumFurniturePermission⟧ L|2|•|Hand to «Agent of the Arcanum»: ⟦NuhmudiraTokenQuestComplete⟧ L|2|•|Both of these stamps are available. But there is a 20 hour pickup timer on the note. Come back later to do the other. L|1|6.|If you decide to get «Arcanum Furniture Shop» access, speak with «Jasin of the Arcanum» inside to purchase everything you need.

We have never seen such a tenacious hollow minion commanding troops before. I hope this is the worst of the surprises we face in the near future.⸩ ⸨Arcanum Envoy tells you, "Nuhmudira preserve us. L|1||Handing in A Near Illegible Note⸩ ⸨You give Arcanum Envoy A Near Illegible Note⸩ ⸨Arcanum Envoy tells you, "Ahh, here is the token of Nuhmudira's esteem.⸩ ⸨Arcanum Envoy gives you Nuhmudira's Token⸩ ⸨Arcanum Envoy tells you, "You may use this token in one of two ways. L|1||Handing in Nuhmudira's Token⸩ ⸨You give Arcanum Envoy Nuhmudira's Token⸩ ⸨Arcanum Envoy tells you, "Thank you. You may now enter the portal. I hope you enjoy the selection of goods.

We have a lovely fountain, an interesting lawn ornament, a handy inscribable plaque, a useful chalk board and a melodious doorbell you can use in your home. I hope you enjoy.⸩

Quest.name: Assault_on_Frost_Haven
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|100+ I|Type|Small Fellowship I|Starts At|«Frost Haven» I|Route|«Qalaba'r» to 74.8S, 17.8E «Qalabar Oasis Settlement» to 68.4S, 25.4E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|A seasonal quest in «Frost Haven» which rewards players with many holiday-themed «Housing Items» and «Pet Items».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes
L|1|1.|Defeat the «Abominable Snowman» that is currently attacking the town and loot a «Frozen Present» from its corpse. L|2|•|⟦frozenpresentpickuptimer⟧ L|1|2.|Shortly after defeating the Abominable Snowman, «Scold» will appear. L|1|3.|Attack and defeat «Scold». He will break into «Scold Chunk»s and then «Scold Lump»s as you work to beat him. L|1|4.|Loot a «Hot Coal» from the «Scold Lump»'s body. L|2|•|⟦hotcoalpickuptimer⟧ L|1|5.|Use the «Hot Coal» on the «Frozen Present» to reveal a «Present». L|2|•|Note: If you don't receive a «Frozen Present», hand your «Hot Coal» to «The Mayor» of «Frost Haven» and he'll give you one.
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.
H2|Rewards H3|Items P|1 random reward from «Present»:
P|Abominable Pack Snowman Mr. P. Holiday Pack Doll Pack Scold Magic Hat Doll House Holiday Feast Holiday Hearth Holiday Lights (Strand) Big Wreath Orb of Eternal Frost Snowmaker Festivus Rug Jubilee Rug Grand Bed Pile of Presents Pitiful Pine Tree Snow Drift Wood Stove Banner Walking Cane
H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||The Mayor tells you, "Hello there, hello there!" L|1||The Mayor tells you, "I'm Mayor of Frost Haven. Welcome to our humble little town." L|1||The Mayor tells you, "Normally it isn't this quiet, but we've been having a bit of a problem." L|1||The Mayor tells you, "Have you seen that mountain peak to the North? That's Mount Ingot, a homicidal Magma Golem named Scold lives up there. Every few weeks he emerges from his cave and marches down the mountain to stomp all over our town. Oh the snomanity, oh, it's awful!" L|1||The Mayor tells you, "On top of all that, there's an Abominable Snowman tromping around the mountains and he doesn't like us non-abominable types." L|1||The Mayor tells you, "Oh! You have to help us. He must be stopped. If you don't help us I'm afraid we may be doomed. Doomed! Doomed!" L|1||The Mayor tells you, "Umm, I'm sure I could dip into the slush fund for a reward if you stop him."
H3|Sam L|1||Sam screams, Defend the town!!! L|1||Sam tells you, "Why does everyone keep attacking us? We are a peaceful race. All we want is to live in pea..." L|1||Sam tells you, "Don't worry about me! I'll be fine. Go on without me... defend the town... I..I'm counting on you!"

L|2|•|⟦AugmentationProvingGroundAccess⟧ L|1|3.|Navigate the realm dungeons until you reach the main level (see «#Dungeons & Maps¦maps»). L|2|•|**Leaftide**: Portal located in South room of Sub. L|2|•|{TIP} There is a portal near the end that many people choose to portal tie to for convenience and may be able to summon it provided they have handed in a jaw first.
H3|Part 2: Defeating Sir Bellas L|1|1.|At the end of the final dungeon is the Augmented Knight - «Sir Bellas». L|1|2.|Sir Bellas is a Knight, and equally vulnerable to all elements. His weapon is also hollow and so ignores Item Magic. He buffs himself randomly against magic if vulned/imperiled (counterbuffing). Use your best weapon against him. If you can Imperil and Vuln him, a Knight Slaying Sword (the «Replica Sword of Bellenesse») will kill him quickly, but most any AR or CS weapon will do. You can also use Lightning. Without good melee defense he can be difficult to tank. L|1|3.|Loot a «Blank Augmentation Gem» from Sir Bellas' corpse (**Leaftide: 1d 20h timer**) that you can then give to any Augmentation Trainer to get a gem that when used collects the xp and gives you the augmentation. L|2|•|⟦AugmentationBlankGemAcquired⟧ L|2|•|Note: If you make a mistake before using the gem, you can give it to any other Trainer for an exchange. See «Augmentation Gems» for a list of available augmentations, what they do, and where the NPCs are located. L|1|4.|Killing Sir Bellas (or the other viamontians) also sometimes earns you one of the notes that can start the «Assassin's Roost» Quest. He no longer has an uber loot profile, but he does drop boss-level quantities of loot.

Quest.name: Aun_Tanua's_War_Taiaha_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Bachus Flufens» I|Starts At|«Redspire» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Tumerok Spear L|1|1.|Speak to «Bachus Flufens» above the Redspire Bar, she will tell you about rumors of a Tumerok artifact and direct you to the «Tumerok Cavern» at 40.2N 84.7W. She will also give you «Bachus Flufen's Journal». L|1|2.|Run west along the coast to the cavern. You will be portalled in to a room with 3 exits, one of which is the surface portal, take the west exit and head down the stairs. L|1|3.|At the split go left down some more stairs leading to another split. L|1|4.|From here take either the left or right passage and head north until you reach some more stairs down. L|1|5.|At the split go either left or right to some metal doors. L|1|6.|You will come in to a large open section with a «Hea Warrior» at the end near a wooden Tumerok Vault. L|1|7.|Dispatch the Warrior and take his «Vault Key (Tumerok Cavern)¦Vault Key». L|2|•|⟦TanuaCompleted01⟧ L|1|8.|Unlock the «Tumerok Vault (Tumerok Cavern)¦Tumerok Vault» with the key and loot the «Tumerok Spear». L|1|9.|Recall to Redspire and hand Bachus the spear. L|1|10.|She will examine it and suggest you retrieve the 2nd part of the spear from a nearby «Tumerok Cave» at 41.7N, 82.5W.
H3|Part 2: Wooden Tumerok Figurine L|1|1.|Run over and enter the cave, you will portal into a room with 3 doors, take the south door. L|1|2.|Hug the right wall until you reach a room shaped like an L. From this room take the north door. L|1|3.|Take the stairs down and head right at the split. L|1|4.|Hug the left wall through a door and into a small room. L|1|5.|Take the east door out of this room and follow the the passage keeping to the left - ignore the next door. L|1|6.|Go through the door to your east into a small room and leave through the door to the north. L|1|7.|You should be near an exit portal, take the door opposite it to the east. L|1|8.|Follow the passage down the stairs into a similiar area to that of the last dungeon. L|1|9.|At the end of this area is a «Hea Shaman (30)¦Hea Shaman» defeat him and take his «Vault Key (Tumerok Cave)¦Vault Key». L|2|•|⟦TanuaCompleted02⟧ L|1|10.|Use the key on the «Tumerok Vault (Tumerok Cave)¦Tumerok Vault» and take the «Wooden Tumerok Figurine». L|1|11.|Combine the Wooden Figurine with the Tumerok Spear to form «Aun Tanua's War Taiaha». L|1|12.|Recall to «Redspire». If you do not want your newly formed weapon you can return it to «Bachus Flufens» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦TanuaCompleted⟧

R| RK|Experience|411,000 (175% up to level 20) RK|Items| RI|«Aun Tanua's War Taiaha» RI|«Peerless Healing Kit» RI|«Copper Pea» (x2) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Bachus Flufens tells you, "Woe is me! As if it were not bad enough that I was driven out of my farm to the west by the Hea, now Varicci has taken over my town! Fortunately Micon and I are safe, but I must say that it has made it very difficult to continue my work."⸩ ⸨Bachus Flufens tells you, "Have you heard of my work? I am researching rumors of a Tumerok artifact, of which the few hints I have discovered are quite unbelievable. They must hold that relic in high esteem indeed. A most fanciful folk, I must say! I heard that it is a legendary spear that they dismantled and enshrined in two separate caverns on the island. It once belonged to a warrior from an opposite faction, I believe. He tried to persuade them back to traditional ways, but they would have none of it. Somehow they dispatched him but retained his spear...which is supposed to have some sort of magical, "living" properties to it. I'm not quite sure what to believe."⸩ ⸨Bachus Flufens tells you, "Perhaps the answer could be found in the caverns to the northwest along the shore. Try the area around 40.2N 84.7W --at least that's where I saw the Tumeroks heading last. Beware, friend--it's quite likely to be well guarded. I'd go myself, but I must catch up on my journal today. If you would like to read it, here are a few pages that I wrote the other day."⸩ ⸨Bachus Flufens gives you Bachus Flufen's Journal.
L|1||Handing in Tumerok Spear⸩ ⸨You give Bachus Flufens Tumerok Spear.⸩ ⸨Bachus Flufens examines the spear intensely.⸩ ⸨Bachus Flufens tells you, "Ah, so there was something to their story after all...what an interesting find! But look here...don't these slots along this side suggest that it is missing a part? I wonder if it lies over in the caves directly to the northeast? For the past season I've been able to watch many Tumerok comings and goings here from my front porch. If you were to bring me back the object in its entirety, I'm sure I could reward you."⸩ ⸨Bachus Flufens gives you Tumerok Spear.
L|1||Handing in Wooden Tumerok Figurine⸩ ⸨You give Bachus Flufens Wooden Tumerok Figurine.⸩ ⸨Bachus squints carefully at the figurine.⸩ ⸨Bachus Flufens tells you, "I have never seen an artifact such as this before...some sort of Tumerok figurine? Ah...but it seems as if it is not in its entirety? Perhaps it should be married to another piece? If you bring me back the completed artifact, I will surely reward you!"⸩ ⸨Bachus Flufens gives you Wooden Tumerok Figurine.
L|1||Handing in Aun Tanua's War Taiaha⸩ ⸨You give Bachus Flufens Aun Tanua's War Taiaha.⸩ ⸨Bachus gingerly lifts the weapon from your grasp and weighs it in her hands.⸩ ⸨Bachus Flufens tells you, "A Tumerok War Taiaha! One of the first examples of Tumerok war craft I have ever seen. I must send this on to Aliester--he will be delighted to further his research on Tumerok culture. I thank you!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 411,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Bachus Flufens gives you Peerless Healing Kit.⸩ ⸨Bachus Flufens gives you 2 Copper Peas.⸩

L|2|•|⟦AncientBone_Pickup⟧ L|1|3.|Use the «Ancient Caves» map (see above) to locate the «Deeper Caves» portal. L|1|6.|Once inside the «Deepest Caves», locate and pickup a «Fossilized Bone» from the ground. L|2|•|**Note:** This bone creates the highest wield bone handle. L|2|•|⟦FossilizedBone_Pickup⟧ L|1|7.|Once you have your bone(s), return to «Ayan Baqur».
H4|Step 2: Carving the Bone into a Handle L|1|1.|Hand each bone handle to either «Yuan Hanzu» (for Bow or Crossbow) or «Havala bint Mylos» (for Atlatl) at 60.1S 87.9W and have them carve the bones into Bone Handles. L|2|•|**Note:** If you dont want any or all of the Bone Handles you have carved, simply hand them back to either «Yuan Hanzu» (for Bow or Crossbow) or «Havala bint Mylos» (for Atlatl) and they'll give you XP instead.

Quest.name: Count_Phainor's_Amulet
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Grularr Wa'ydo» I|Starts At|«Kara» at 83.4S, 47.2E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Graverobber» H2|Overview
H2|Walk Through L|1|1.|Talk to «Grularr Wa'ydo» in «Kara» at 83.4S, 47.2E (upstairs). L|2|•|⟦GraverobberStarted_0213⟧ L|1|2.|Enter «Count Phainor's Tomb», located in «Graveyard» at 65.0S 44.1W. L|1|3.|From the drop, speak to «Grularr Wa'ydo», and then hug the left wall all the way down until you reach «Grularr Wa'ydo» again. L|2|•|{OPT} Along the way you'll pass a hidden «Chorizite Chest» on a ledge you can shift jump to, it can be picked then opened by anyone (diff 600). The exact location changes each time the «landblock» reloads. You can find it easily by hitting the find next item key as you run. L|3|•|⟦chestchorizite48773⟧ L|1|4.|From here, head down the ramp and find the «Spirit of Protection» in the next room. Kill it and loot «Phainor's Chamber Key». L|1|5.|Once you have the key, take the right passage and follow it until you reach «Grularr Wa'ydo» again. L|1|6.|Speak to «Grularr Wa'ydo», use «Phainor's Chamber Key» on the door behind him, and jump across the pit into the final room. L|1|7.|Find the boss, «Count Phainor», in the room beyond and kill him. L|2|•|Note: Once he notices you, Phainor will summon «Guardian Wisp»s that use fire vulns and arcs. L|2|•|{OPT} Kill the wisps first, as they are dangerous but die quickly and do not respawn after being killed. L|1|8.|Kill «Count Phainor» and enter the door that opens in his room. L|1|9.|Talk to «Grularr Wa'ydo» one last time to collect your rewards of a «Legendary Key», 214,584,377 «Xp» and 10k «Luminance». L|2|•|⟦GraverobberCompleted_0213⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|Once completed you cannot reenter the main dungeon unless someone not on the timer talks to the NPCs to open doors for you.

The craftmanship and the stories behind the pieces are simply unmatched in today's age."⸩ ⸨Grularr Wa'ydo tells you, "There is an exquisite amulet that lies within a tomb hidden deep in the Graveyard of the southern Direlands. As you can see though, I am hardly a warrior. Quest.notes: easy newb quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Dwennon» I|Starts At|42.6N, 33.6E in «Holtburg» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Time|25 Minutes H2|Overview L|1|•|This is a very quick way to go solo from level 8 after completing the «Training Academy Quest» (and starter contracts) to level 16 without any risk. L|1|•|If you are using Decal, the Khao Tipper plugin can automate this task. See the «Plugins» page.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to «Dwennon» to start the quest. L|2|•|⟦OnCowTipQuest⟧ L|2|•|⟦CowTipCounter⟧ L|1|2.|Tip 300 «Cow (Creature)¦Cow»s by using or double-clicking them. Any cow will work. L|2|•|⟦CowTipCounter on first completion⟧ L|1|3.|Return to «Dwennon» when you're finished to receive your rewards. L|2|•|⟦CowTipWait⟧
TH|Total Cow Tips Chat Message TR|1 You think to yourself "One tip down, I wonder how many more this guy could possibly expect..." TR|50 The cows lips do not move but you would almost swear you just heard "Moooo, Mooo Mooooooo!" TR|100 A thought pops into your head "Cow Logic" and you think... "What's that?" Maybe you can ask Dwennon about it some day. TR|150 You think to yourself "I must be at least half done, and if not then Dwennon can just finish tipping this cow himself." TR|200 Your arms are getting tired, you think to yourself "I must have tipped at least 200 times by now." TR|250 Unless you lost track someplace along the way, which you think is very possible at this point, you believe that's your 250th tip. What, no fireworks? Maybe you have a few more tips to go still. TR|300 It seems to you like you have done enough tipping for now, maybe Dwennon in Holtburg has an update for you... TE
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.
H2|Rewards
R|Tip a Cow 300 times... RK|Title|"Obviously Bored" RK|Items| RI|«Tipped Pack Cow» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Dwennon tells you, "You've seen them lingering around town, haven't you? They've been here all along, you know that, don't you? They have spies all over the place. They see and hear everything. They must be stopped, and stopped the only way we know how. Simply killing them isn't good enough, we need to tip them and tip them often. Go, go tip the cows, they must be stopped!"
L|1||Completing Quest⸩ ⸨Dwennon tells you, "Good, those cows will be set for a while, you can take a break. I expect you to report back here tomorrow to continue though, we can't let down our guard. Even better, search out cows around the world and tip them. They must all be stopped."⸩ ⸨You've earned 500,000 experience."⸩ ⸨You are Obviously Bored, maybe you should check your titles.⸩ ⸨Dwennon gives you Tipped Pack Cow.⸩ ⸨Dwennon tells you, "Don't tell them I gave that to you, you don't want to see them when they get very mad."⸩

Quest.name: Crafting_Forges_(High)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|100 I|Type|Small Fellowship/Solo I|Starts At|«Fort Tethana» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Crafting Forges (High)» H2|Overview P|Retrieve essences from the three Virindi dungeons to power the crafting forges for upgraded forge spells and experience rewards. They can also be given to the Arcanum for writs of refuge.
H2|Walkthrough L|1|1.|Go to each of the three Power Forge dungeons. Each dungeon has the same layout, the only difference is that the higher level restricted dungeons have more formidable creatures. L|1|2.|Kill the Virindi Overseer located in the final area of each dungeon. The Overseer drops enough items for 3 people. L|2|•|«Western Overseer» drops the «Western Forge Essence» and «Band of Shielding» L|3|•|⟦RingShieldingWestAcquired1204⟧ L|3|•|⟦ForgeEssenceWestAcquired1204⟧ L|2|•|Each overseer also drops the «Inner Sea Directive» L|1|3.|Take each of the Essences to an «Agent of the Arcanum» for a Writ + experience reward **or** hand them to an «Alchemy Forge» to receive an experience reward and to upgrade all forges from a Master [Craft Name]'s Boon (3 minutes) to a Master [Craft Name]'s Greater Boon (6 minutes). L|2|•|Handing to Forge: ⟦CraftingForgeCompleted0710⟧ and ⟦ForgeEssenceGiven1204⟧

Quest.name: Crystalline_Killer
Quest.Wiki:

L|2|•|⟦KillTaskCrystallineWisps10109⟧ L|1|2.|Kill 100 of any variation of «Crystalline Wisp» on the plateau and in the «Crystalline Portal» (70+) dungeons. P|Notes L|1|•|All Wisps in the dungeons and on the plateau, and all Pillars in the dungeons count toward the task. Quest.name: Dark_Towers
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|80+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|The Dark Towers I|Route|«Dark Towers (Portal Gem)¦Dark Towers Portal Gem» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|"Take heed! With the loss of our Lord, many shadows seek leadership other than the old generals. A new dark power is rising near the crater where our Lord was first imprisoned. Come and bask in the dark glory! We shall rise anew and consume this land with darkness!"
L|1|•|To access this quest, you must first obtain a «Dark Towers (Portal Gem)¦Dark Towers Portal Gem». They can be found as trophies from «Shadow Spectre»s, as rare trophies in «Black Marrow Reliquary¦Black Marrow Reliquaries», and also be purchased from the Colosseum Coin Collector for 8 Colosseum Coins. You can find many spawns of «Shadow Spectre» in the «Temple of Stirring Shadows»
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Gather your group and then use the gem to summon a portal to the first of 3 Dark Towers suspended in the air above the «Obsidian Plains». L|2|•|Note: This is a hot drop full of «Shadow Spectre»s, «Abyssal Shadow»s, and «Destroyer Grievver»s. L|1|2.|Kill the «Shadow Phantom Leader» to spawn a portal to the next tower. L|1|3.|After portaling in to the 2nd tower, kill the «Shadow Nightmare Leader» to spawn a portal to the 3rd tower. L|2|•|Note: This is a hot drop full of «Shadow Wraith»s, «Shadow Phantom»s, and «Bane Grievver»s. L|1|4.|The final tower has a bunker, which is home to a «Consumed Wraith». Kill the wraith and loot a «Shadow Stone Necklace» from its corpse (drops 5 necklaces). L|2|•|Note: This is a hot drop full of «Shadow Nightmare»s, «Shadow Wraith»s and «Shadow Phantom»s. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpNecklaceShadowStone⟧ L|2|•|There is also an unlocked «Runed Chest» inside the bunker you can use if you choose. L|3|•|⟦ChestQuestDarkTowers⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.
H2|Rewards H3|Items L|1|•|«Shadow Stone Necklace»
H2|Dialog P|No quest dialog.

L|1||[Society NPC] tells you, "There is, upon the Dark Isle, an undead Ruschk named Vaeshok. He has thrown off the mantle of his former master, and now seeks to serve a new master - the dark power behind the Blight." L|1||[Society NPC] tells you, "Go and defeat him, then return to me. L|1||[Society NPC] gives you 4 [Society] Trade Tokens.

Quest.name: Diemos_Flagging
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|120 I|Rec. Level|150+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Arwic Mines» at 33.8N, 56.8E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Aug Gem: Diemos» H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest involved two parts: beating Colosseum ten times (completing all 18 rooms and earning a key), and fashioning an «Empyrean Golem Stone» and giving it to the «Gladiator Diemos (Statue)¦Gladiator Diemos Statue».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Stone of Alb'arel L|1|1.|Go to «Arwic» and enter the «Arwic Mines» just outside the North city wall at 33.8N 56.8E. The dungeon is large and complicated, see the map for the route down. The «Stone of Alb'arel» is on the ground at the very bottom on Level -6. Unlike the other two dungeons, only a single stone spawns and takes a minute or two to respawn. L|2|•|⟦StoneofAlbarel_Pickup⟧ - shared with «Crafter Golems» quest.
H3|Stone of Rez'arel L|1|1.|Go to «Cragstone» and take the «Colier View Hill» portal west of town at 26.3N 46.3E. Run a short ways southwest to «Colier» at 56.8N 38.4E. Look for a two story building with a «Banderling Raider Guardian» inside at 56.7N 38.6E. He drops the «Small Rusted Key». In another single story building you will find a «Heavy Drudge Prowler» at 56.5N 38.0E, which drops the «Cell Key». Enter the «Colier Mines» portal in the building basement in the middle of the town (56.7N 38.5E). L|1|2.|This dungeon is also quite complicated and several doors are 1000 lockpick resistance so you need special keys, see the «#Dungeons & Maps¦map» for layout details. From the drop use the «Small Rusted Key» to open the north door, take a right, then left, then right, then left and you'll come to a locked door on the north wall of a small room. Use the «Cell Key» to open it, go left and up, then due west, use the «Cell Key» again and the hall will bend to the south, kill the «Undead Curator» to get the «Scratched Key». L|1|3.|Last portal recall to the start of the dungeon and go northeast through several intersections until you come to a large room, stick left and you'll come to a lever, pull the lever and quickly run south and jump down past the door that just opened (it closes fast). After the jump go north past a room, right at the T intersection and follow the bend to the north, north through the 4 way intersection and you'll come to a small room with a locked chest, use the «Scratched Key» to open the chest which holds the «Treasure Chest Key» and «The Baron's Key». L|1|4.|Last portal recall and backtrack to where you first used the «Cell Key». From that Y intersection go east and down, you'll come to a 4 way intersection, go east then stick left until you come to another locked door. Use «The Baron's Key» to open it. L|1|5.|Past the door stick left, you'll go down twice then come to a large room with a hole in the middle of the floor, go down it. From this point stick right, you'll have to open another locked door with «The Baron's Key». L|1|6.|At the end is a large room where the Baron is at, pick up a «Stone of Rez'arel» off the ground. If you happen to want the «Baron's Amulet of Life Giving» (+15 Health), you can use the «Scratched Key» on the chest in this room. L|2|•|⟦StoneofRezarel_Pickup⟧ - shared with «Crafter Golems» quest.
H3|Empyrean Sun Stone L|1|1.|The «Empyrean Sun Stone» is on the ground at the end of the «Mines of Despair», in the same room as the «Lich Overseer». See «Focusing Stone Quest» for details, there is also a «Dungeons & Maps¦map» showing the lever locations. L|2|•|⟦EmpyreanSunStone_Pickup⟧ - shared with «Crafter Golems» quest.
H3|Empyrean Golem Stone and Gladiator Diemos L|1|1.|Combine Empyrean Sun Stone with Stone of Alb'arel to create «Empyrean Sun and Moon Stone». L|1|2.|Combine Empyrean Sun and Moon Stone with Stone of Rez'arel to create an «Empyrean Golem Stone». L|1|3.|Hand the Empyrean Golem Stone to the statue of Gladiator Diemos in the east hall of «Colosseum». L|2|•|⟦GolemStoneDiemosGiven⟧ L|1|4.|With the stone handed in and 10 wins, the statue will portal you to «Gladiator Diemos» anytime you use the statue. L|1|5.|Diemos is very high health and can take about an hour to kill for a group. He drops the «Gladiator Diemos Token» that you give to the «Master Arbitrator» in return for the «Gladiator Diemos Statue», the title "Immortal Champion," and a new token, «Arbitrator's Augmentation Token», that can either be given back to the «Master Arbitrator» for a full level worth of experience or if you give the new token to «Fiun Rehlyun» in «Fiun Outpost» for a «Blank Augmentation Gem». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpMarkerBoss10x⟧ L|1|6.|When repeating the quest, you do not need to redo the stones, you can simply use the statue in «Colosseum» and proceed directly to «Gladiator Diemos».

Well done indeed. I hereby grant you the title, Immortal Champion."⸩ ⸨Master Arbitrator tells you, "In addition to your new title and this useful hook caster, I'll also give you a token that you can trade back to me for a great deal of practical knowledge, or you can trade it in to Fiun Rehlyun at the Fiun settlement in the Halaetan Isles for a blank Augmentation gem. A difficult decision, I know."⸩ ⸨Master Arbitrator gives you Gladiator Diemos Statue.⸩

Quest.name: Drudge_Aviator
Quest.notes: Needed for Abandoned Shops Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Aludi al-Jaladh» I|Starts At|60.7S, 88.0W in «Ayan Baqur» I|Repeat|20 Hours P|This entry is for the quest "Drudge Aviator". For the creature, see «Drudge Aviator (Creature)»
H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Aludi al-Jaladh» in «Ayan Baqur». This flags you for the «War Room». L|2|•|⟦QuestReconnaissanceAcquired0105⟧ L|1|2.|Make your way to the Drudge balloon fort at 12.1S, 92.7W. L|2|•|Go inside the statue portal in the middle of «Ayan» and take the «Fort Tethana» portal on the left. L|2|•|If you have a large group it is worth the time to tie to the entrance portal of the «War Room», it will save everyone else a run of 8-10 minutes. L|2|•|You can also take the «Northwest Direlands Portal» from «Aerlinthe» for a shortcut. L|1|3.|Kill drudges in the fort until you've found the «Drudge Key (Red)¦Red», «Drudge Key (Silver)¦Silver», «Drudge Key (Black)¦Black», and «Drudge Key (Green)¦Green» Drudge keys. L|2|•|If you have lockpick you can skip this part. L|1|4.|Go inside the portal to the «War Room». The portal is in the middle of the courtyard of the fort. L|2|•|From the drop, pick the door or use the black Drudge Key and head east. L|2|•|Stick right until you come to the next locked door, use the silver Drudge key. L|2|•|Stick left to the next locked door and use the red Drudge Key. L|2|•|Continue sticking left to the last locked door and use the green Drudge key. L|1|5.|The «Drudge Aviator (Creature)¦Drudge Aviator» spawns above you on a platform near a table. L|2|•|Run through the chamber to the west wall and follow the ramp up (it circles over the chambers). L|2|•|When you reach the ledge, shift-jump over to the «Drudge Aviator (Creature)¦Drudge Aviator» near the table on the platform. L|2|•|Be aware of the "Escape Route" exit portal directly under the ledge. He's guarded by a group of Drudge Toilers on a fast respawn rate. L|2|•|Kill the Drudge Aviator and retrieve the «Flying Machine Plans» and «Flying Machine Instructions» from its corpse. There is only one set per corpse (5 min respawn). L|3|•|⟦FlyingMachinePlansAcquired0105⟧ L|1|6.|Once you have both take the "Escape Route" exit portal, climb the tower and give the «Flying Machine Instructions» to the «Drudge Flying Machine». The flying machine balloon will portal you back to the hill south overlooking «Ayan Baqur» and «Aludi al-Jaladh» will be behind you. L|1|7.|Give the plans to «Aludi al-Jaladh» for your rewards. Aludi also accepts any leftover keys for a trivial amount of xp and pyreals. L|2|•|⟦QuestReconnaissanceCompleted0105⟧

Quest.name: Enhancing_Mucor
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 I|Rec. Level|120+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha» I|Starts At|«Kor-Gursha» on «Bur» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|In order to do this quest you must have access to Bur and have completed the «Burun Liberator» quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|In «Kor-Gursha», the Burun town on Bur, find «Torgluuk» the High Shaman of Kor-Gursha and speak to him. He will hand you some «Inert Mucor». L|2|•|⟦EnhancingMucor_Start!⟧ L|2|•|{WARN} Do not accidentally consume it because it has a 99% lowering effect on attributes. If you do consume it, speak to Torgluuk for more. L|1|2.|After you have the «Inert Mucor» go to the «Southern Catacombs» down on the passages near Torgluuk. L|1|3.|Go right from the portal drop through one big room then through after hallway. In the next big room is a Rock and red portal right beside each other. L|1|4.|Use the Rock and you will be portaled to the the «Upper Catacombs». L|1|5.|Go up till you reach a T intersection and go right then make a left up another hallway with doors on each side. Run all the way up that hallway and before you turn again stop and on the right side of the hallway go in the third room from the end and use the statue. L|1|6.|You should be portaled into the dungeon with the Ley Line, the «Ley Line Cavern». It contains the same monsters as the «Upper Catacombs». L|2|•|At the first 4 four way intersection go straight L|2|•|At the first T intersection go right L|2|•|At the second T intersection go left L|2|•|It is now a straight shot to the «Ley Line (Object)¦Ley Line» room. No branches. You have to jump across a magma pit using several small platforms hovering over it though. L|1|7.|In the last room you will find a «Infused Empyrean Blood Golem», several «Ley Line (Object)¦Ley Lines», and a bunch of NPC corpses of humanoid diamond golems («Corpse of a Servitor of Asheron»). Click the Ley Line, it will ask you if you want to hand it your Inert Mucor. L|2|•|⟦EnhancingMucor_Repeat!⟧ L|2|•|⟦EnhancingMucor_Wait!⟧ L|2|•|{WARN} Do Not Stand in the Ley Line, it does massive amounts of damage to you. L|2|•|Note: If no other player had turned in Inert Mucor in the last 24 hours a global message would have resulted and the mana barrier in Asheron's Defender quest would have fallen for 24 hours. L|2|•|Also note that the first time that you do the quest the xp reward is higher and the NPC interactions are slightly different. L|1|8.|Once you have the Enhanced Mucor you have several choices of what to do with it. You can| L|2|•|Turn it into Torgluuk for 5% of your XP to level (32,891,181 max, level 179+) L|2|•|Save it for a quest like the «Colosseum» then eat it for its beneficial spell. L|2|•|Use it to craft one of the «Mucor Enhanced Weapons».
H3|Crafting a Mucor Enhanced Weapon L|1|1.|Purchase the weapon you'd like to enhance from «Dobblar» in «Kor-Gursha». L|1|2.|Using «Alchemy», use an «Alembic» on the «Enhanced Mucor» to create «Alembic Mucor». L|2|•|{WARN} 450 «Alchemy» skill gives only a 50% success rate, so you may want to use an «Alchemist's Crystal» (rare). L|1|3.|Use the «Alembic Mucor» on the type of salvage of your choice (No skill check)| L|2|1.|**Melee Weapons:** Use «Alembic Mucor» on «Salvaged Granite» to create «Mucor-altered Granite». L|2|2.|**Missile Weapons:** Use «Alembic Mucor» on «Salvaged Mahogany» to create «Mucor-altered Mahogany». L|2|3.|**Magic Caster:** Use «Alembic Mucor» on «Salvaged Opal» to create «Mucor-altered Opal». L|1|4.|Using either «Weapon Tinkering» (melee, missile weapons), or «Magic Item Tinkering» (wand), apply the bag of altered salvage to the weapon you purchased from «Dobblar» to create a «Channeling Weapons¦Channeling Weapon». L|2|•|{WARN} 681 buffed skill yields a 98% chance. Make sure your tinkerer is buffed.
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Southern Catacombs» N/A «map:00D4.jpg¦00D4.jpg» -- TR|«Upper Catacombs» N/A -- -- TR|«Ley Line Cavern» N/A -- -- TE
H2|Rewards
R|Enhance the Mucor in the Ley Line RK|Experience|140,000,000 RK|Items| RI|«Enhanced Mucor» RE
R|Give «Enhanced Mucor» to «Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha¦Torgluuk» RK|Experience|32,891,181 (5% up to level 180) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha tells you, "I see that you are aware of the upper catacomb. Doubtless, you are also aware of the mana barrier within and what lays beyond? I have mused on how to remove the barrier, and I think I have a way. Listen closely."⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha tells you, "The mana barrier must be powered, and most likely that power comes from what you term "ley lines". Asheron has told me of these things, and the Ruuk have in fact encountered them on occasion. The Falatacot have manipulated the ley lines of this world in the past for their own purposes, often eventually causing upheaval. I believe this is what has caused earthquakes and other disasters in the past."⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha tells you, "You may have heard of mucor - the fungus that the shamans of the Burun consume for its power and recollection to the past? It does not begin as safe for consumption - it must be prepared. I think that if you were to siphon a small part of the power of the ley line into some inert mucor, it may disrupt the mana barrier for a short period of time - perhaps a day. By doing this, you would also be helping to stabilize our world by minimizing the ley line's potential energy. Finally, you would then have some enhanced mucor of your own."⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha tells you, "The ley line exists in a chamber off of the upper catacomb. There will be a Falatacot statue along the southern edge of the catacomb. If you focus upon it and put into your mind the image of a cavern with a great glowing line, you will reach your destination."⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha tells you, "Be warned that one can only enhance mucor safely every so often. I would recommend that you wait fourteen days after you enhance your mucor."⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha tells you, "I would take the enhanced mucor if you were to bring it to me. I cannot demand it of you, though. I also cannot tell you what effect enhanced mucor may have on your - you would have to try it for yourself. Finally, I'm told our weaponcrafter, Kuurak, has some ideas on how enhanced mucor might be used in weaponcrafting. Speak to him for more information on that."⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha gives you Inert Mucor.⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha tells you, "Take this. But heed my warning. Do not consume it before you have prepared it within the ley line. It has a generally fatal effect on our people and, which you are different, I suspect it would harm you as well."
L|1||Opening Dialog (Quest Repeats)⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha tells you, "The smell of preparing mucor has faded from you - I can still tell you have ever done it, but it should be safe for you to go again. The cavern of the ley line is reached through one of the statues alogn the southern edge of the upper catacomb."⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha gives you Inert Mucor.⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha tells you, "Here is some more inert mucor. Once again, do not consume it until it is prepared - it is dangerous otherwise."
L|1||Receiving more Inert Mucor⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha tells you, "Greetings to you who would help us. I can give you no more information except what I have already told you. If you have lost your inert mucor, however, I can give you more."⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha tells you, "Here, take this."⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha gives you Inert Mucor.⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha tells you, "Remember, mucor can be dangerous, even to Burun - do not consume it while it has not been properly prepared, and do not try to prepare more than one piece of mucor within a two week period or grave consequences may result. You should be safe to prepare mucor currently."
L|1||Giving Inert Mucor to a Ley Line⸩ ⸨You observe the glowing line from afar, then consider the inert mucor you have in your backpack.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Inert Mucor.⸩ ⸨You insert the mucor very cautiously into the ley line, being careful not to put your hand in.⸩ ⸨Because the mana barrier is down, you determine that enhancing your mucor will have no effect upon it.⸩ ⸨You begin the familiar process of preparing your mucor. In a few moments, it is ready and you remove it from the ley line.⸩ ⸨Ley Line gives you Enhanced Mucor.⸩ ⸨You've earned 65,782,362 experience.
L|1||Handing in Enhanced Mucor to Torgluuk⸩ ⸨You give Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha Enhanced Mucor.⸩ ⸨Torgluuk, High Shaman of Kor-Gursha tells you, "Thank you. I shall put this to good use - save it for a time of need, rather than consuming it incessantly as the Kukuur do."⸩ ⸨You've earned 32,891,181 experience.⸩

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Neelic appears preoccupied.⸩ ⸨Neelic tells you, "My apologies, but it appears we have been the victim of theft. How could this happen here? Our guards are second to none!"⸩ ⸨Neelic tells you, "Allow me to explain. Our caches of raw materials used to craft the finest of Lugian weapons have been pillaged. Large quantities of ore and lumber have gone missing, but our guards reported nothing out of the ordinary."⸩ ⸨Neelic tells you, "More disturbing than the theft of our resources are the disappearances of many of our finest young crafters. They simply disappeared."⸩ ⸨Neelic tells you, "I sense foul play. No Lugian would ever abandon their duties or conspire to steal from their own kind. These are desperate times, and I humbly ask for your assistance in getting to the bottom of this so that we can hold those responsible accountable for their misdeeds."⸩ ⸨Neelic tells you, "If you can track down these bandits and bring them to justice, we would be in your debt. Please make haste, our forges are all but shut down due to the loss of so much raw material and crafter alike."
L|1||Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨You allow Neelic to examine your Translated Orders for Zrikux.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Translated Orders for Zrikuxs.⸩ ⸨Neelic takes the parchment. You can see the rage grow in his eyes as he reads.⸩ ⸨Neelic tells you, "Simple-minded?!? They thought us easy fodder did they? We will not be such easy prey again. Our guards will be doubled and the young smithies will be better protected so this will not occur again."⸩ ⸨Neelic tells you, "The city of Linvak Tukal is grateful for your assistance. Justice has been served to those responsible."⸩ ⸨Neelic tells you, "Please accept these gifts as our thanks. May they serve you well."⸩ ⸨You've earned 500,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 15,000 Luminance.⸩ ⸨Neelic gives you Granite Salvage.⸩ ⸨Neelic gives you Translated Orders for Zrikux.⸩ ⸨Neelic gives you Forging Gloves.
L|1||Other Interactions P|⸨Forge Guardian says, "Intruder!"⸩ ⸨Zrikux says, "I've been expecting you, Your painful demise awaits."⸩⸩

I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|25+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Nelvaine the Brewer» I|Starts At|«Neydisa Castle» I|Route|«Town Network» (Annex) I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Purchase two mugs of «Nelvaine's Olde Ispar Stout» from «Nelvaine the Brewer». L|1|2.|Inside the castle, give the first mug to «Gormling the Sneaky Seneschal» to get «Gormling's Note». L|2|•|⟦GormlingStoutQuest⟧ L|1|3.|Speak to «Lady Tallial» on the second floor of the castle. L|1|4.|Travel to «Bandit Castle». Take «Mountain Shortcut» at 34.9N 56.0E in «Arwic». Run east to 42.4N 60.5E and take the «Bandit Castle Portal». Go north to 66.3N 50.0E and give Gormling's Note to «Jourgensson». He will reward you with 20 «Oswald's Throwing Dagger»s. L|1|5.|Give the second mug of «Nelvaine's Olde Ispar Stout» to «Jourgensson». He gives you «Jourgensson's Letter» to give to «MacDugal» in the middle of the castle. L|1|6.|«MacDugal» will then give you «MacDugal's Key» and instruct you to retrieve a bag from «Bandit Castle Prison». L|1|7.|Go down into the basement and enter the dungeon. From the drop go west and stick right until you come to a large room with a pit in the middle. Take the hall south in the SW corner. Go straight until you come to a T intersection and go east. Stick right until you come to a room with an exit portal. L|1|8.|Use «MacDugal's Key» to open the door and pick up «Gwillim's Alchemy Bag» and «Gwillim's Alchemy Notes» off the ground. L|2|•|⟦GwillimAlchemyNote⟧ L|2|•|⟦GwillimAlchemyBag⟧ L|1|9.|Use the exit portal and give the bag to «Gwillim, the Apprentice» to receive 250 «Deadly Frost Arrow». L|1|10.|Return to Neydisa Castle and give the notes to «Lady Tallial» for the «Neydisa Hauberk».

L|1||Gormling Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Gormling the Sneaky Seneschal tells you, "Welcome to our humble castle. I am Gormling, Lady Tallial's seneschal. Take care not to cause too much trouble around here, hm?"

L|1||Lady Tallial Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Lady Tallial tells you, "Welcome to Neydisa Castle. We are a peaceful settlement, but MacDugal's band of raiders has recently re-occupied the castle to the east. L|1||Giving additional Nelvaine's Olde Ispar Stouts to Gormling⸩ ⸨You give Gormling the Sneaky Seneschal Nelvaine's Olde Ispar Stout.⸩ ⸨Gormling the Sneaky Seneschal tells you, "Oh, I've had quite enough, thanks...You go ahead and drink, though."⸩ ⸨Gormling the Sneaky Seneschal gives you Nelvaine's Olde Ispar Stout.
L|1||Giving Gormling's Note to Gormling⸩ ⸨You give Gormling the Sneaky Seneschal Gormling's Note.⸩ ⸨Gormling the Sneaky Seneschal tells you, "Yes, fool, I gave this to you. Now deliver it to Jourgensson, please! And tell no one of this!"⸩ ⸨Gormling the Sneaky Seneschal gives you Gormling's Note.
L|1||Giving Gormling's Note to Lady Tallial⸩ ⸨You give Lady Tallial Gormling's Note.⸩ ⸨Lady Tallial tells you, "What's this? This note must belong to my seneschal, Gormling. Please return it to him."⸩ ⸨Lady Tallial gives you Gormling's Note.
L|1||Giving Gormling's Note to Jourgensson⸩ ⸨You give Jourgensson Gormling's Note.⸩ ⸨Jourgensson tells you, "Wotcha, mush. Keep this on the hush-hush, will yer? Here's somefin' fer yer troubles. Got 'em off some passing rogue in green armor. Shifty-eyed manker."⸩ ⸨Jourgensson gives you 20 Oswald's Throwing Daggers.⸩ ⸨Jourgensson tells you, "Wot? Not enough? Well don' ye have the big britches! Here, then."⸩ ⸨You've earned 150,000 experience.
L|1||Giving Nelvaine's Olde Ispar Stout to Jourgensson⸩ ⸨You give Jourgensson Nelvaine's Olde Ispar Stout.⸩ ⸨Jourgensson tells you, "Right, thanks. Ye're a toff. Take this note to MacDugal and he'll treat yer right. Now sod off and let me drink in peace!"⸩ ⸨Jourgensson gives you Jourgensson's Letter.
L|1||Giving Jourgensson's Letter to MacDugal⸩ ⸨You give MacDugal Jourgensson's Letter.⸩ ⸨MacDugal tells you, "Well, Jourgensson says you're all right. Maybe you can help. Down underneath the castle, there's a prison full of beasties. That idiot Gwillim dropped some notes and his bag in there."⸩ ⸨MacDugal tells you, "Now he says he can't mix potions! Bring the bag back to him, and he'll reward you. You'll need this to get in there."⸩ ⸨MacDugal gives you MacDugal's Key.
L|1||Gviing Gwillim's Alchemy Bag to Gwillim⸩ ⸨You give Gwillim, the Apprentice Gwillim's Alchemy Bag.⸩ ⸨Gwillim, the Apprentice tells you, "You've found it! Oh, thank you, thank you, you've saved my life! Here, take these... And go ahead and keep those notes."⸩ ⸨Gwillim, the Apprentice tells you, "That's not much for someone of your stature. But this is all I can give you."⸩ ⸨Gwillim, the Apprentice gives you 250 Deadly Frost Arrows.⸩ ⸨You've earned 75,000 experience.
L|1||Giving Gwillim's Alchemy Notes to Gwillim⸩ ⸨You give Gwillim, the Apprentice Gwillim's Alchemy Notes.⸩ ⸨Gwillim, the Apprentice tells you, "Oh, I don't really need that back. Did you happen to find my bag down there? I dropped them both in the same room, dratted insects!"⸩ ⸨Gwillim, the Apprentice gives you Gwillim's Alchemy Notes.
L|1||Giving Gwillim's Alchemy Notes to Lady Tallial⸩ ⸨You give Lady Tallial Gwillim's Alchemy Notes.⸩ ⸨Lady Tallial tells you, "Just as I suspected. Thank you for your bravery. People have complained about the reward I granted for service in the past. Perhaps this antique hauberk will be more appreciated."⸩ ⸨Lady Tallial gives you Neydisa Hauberk.⸩ ⸨Lady Tallial tells you, "And someone of your obvious experience deserves a bit more."⸩ ⸨You've earned 150,000 experience.⸩

Long have I awaited your arrival."⸩ ⸨Shibak stares at you silently then continues.⸩ ⸨Senior Sage Shibak tells you, "We of the Fiun have long labored to rectify that which we are the cause."⸩ ⸨Senior Sage Shibak tells you, "To that end we have dedicated our lives so our fate does not become yours."⸩ ⸨Senior Sage Shibak tells you, "That is why it is with great concern that those that would save this world have fallen silent."⸩ ⸨Senior Sage Shibak tells you, "Perhaps one such as yourself would help me?"⸩ ⸨Senior Sage Shibak tells you, "Speak to Fiun Abayar and return with that which is spoken."⸩ ⸨Senior Sage Shibak tells you, "The place of which you must seek lies at 92.1N 46.3W and is barred from those not invited."⸩ ⸨Shibak touches your forehead with one finger and whispers faintly.⸩ ⸨Senior Sage Shibak tells you, "I have opened the way for you."⸩ ⸨Senior Sage Shibak tells you, "Hurry. Quest.name: Frore
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|20 I|Rec. Level|60+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|66.1N, 51.4E near «Bandit Castle» I|Route|From «Facility Hub», take the «Mite Maze» portal in the west corridor, then run east to 42.4N, 60.5E and use the «Bandit Castle Portal». I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|For each person that wants to loot the rewards chest, you will need to obtain a «Gelidite Standing Stone Translation». Note that the translation is givable, so it is possible for the quest leader to acquire multiple copies using multiple characters ahead of time. L|1|•|Note 1: (Level 200+ characters) - Step 1 and 2 can be skipped if you're level 200 or greater. A level 200+ portal to the «Mountain Cavern» is located near «Crater Village» at 64.1N, 13.2E. You will also need a lockpicker to deal with the 999 difficulty chest. L|1|•|Note 2: (Level 20+ characters) - Lockpicking skill (162+) is required for a door in part 3.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You will require a «Seal» from an undead such as «Lich Lord»s and «Revenant»s. You will need one seal for each person going on the quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Rune Transcription L|1|1.|Go to «Bandit Castle» and head to the nearby «Bandit Castle Standing Stone» at 66.1N, 51.4E. To reach the stone, you must run to the top of the mountain and down a slope to a ledge only reachable from the top. L|1|2.|Use the Seal or a lockpick to unlock the standing stone and pick up the «Bandit Rune Transcription». The nearby «Hasty Note (Bandit Castle)» will lead you to Neydisa. L|2|•|⟦BanditTranscription⟧ L|1|3.|Go to «Neydisa Castle» and head to the nearby «Neydisa Castle Standing Stone» at 69.2N, 15.3E. L|2|•|Route: A portal to Neydisa can be found in the southern wing of the «Town Network». L|1|4.|Open the standing stone and pick up the «Neydisa Rune Transcription». The nearby «Brief Note» will lead you to Stonehold. L|2|•|⟦NeydisaTranscription⟧ L|1|5.|Go to «Stonehold» and head to the nearby «Stonehold Standing Stone» at 72.0N, 22.0W. L|2|•|Route: A portal to Stonehold can be found in the northern wing of the «Town Network». L|1|6.|Open the standing stone and pick up the «Stonehold Rune Transcription». The nearby «Quick Note» will hint at combining the transcriptions. L|2|•|⟦StoneholdTranscription⟧ L|1|7.|Use the Bandit Transcription on the Neydisa Rune Transcription to create the «Partial Rune Transcription». L|1|8.|Use the Stonehold Transcription on the Partial Rune Transcription to create the «Complete Rune Transcription». L|1|9.|Bring the Complete Transcription to «Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator» in «Zaikhal» to obtain the «Gelidite Standing Stone Translation». You are now ready to venture in to Frore. L|2|•|Note that the Gelidite Standing Stone Translation is attuned and bonded. So if you are getting multiple for a group, keep the Complete Rune Transcription and give it to each person to turn in. There is a 6 day timer on being able to get the rune transcriptions.
H3|Part 2: Traveling to the Lost City L|1|1.|With «Gelidite Standing Stone Translation»s in hand, go to «Plateau Village». L|1|2.|Present your translation to «Mairisa bint Fuda» at 44.4N 43.4W. She will give you the «Gelidite Treasure Key» and summon a portal to the top of the peak outside the Mountain Cavern. L|2|•|{WARN} Everyone that wants to loot the reward chest must give Mairisa a translation. Do not take the portal if you have not turned yours in yet. Please allow Mairisa enough time to complete her interactions with each player before handing in translations. When everyone has their key, take the summoned portal.
H3|Part 3: The Lost City of Frore L|1|1.|Following the map, proceed to the Lost City of Frore portal. Note that the first area is a repetitive maze and can be easy to get lost in. L|1|2.|Take all lefts from the jump down, and you will be brought directly to the end of the dungeon. L|1|3.|You will need lockpick to advance passed the resistance 162 door after the pressure plates. It is in the same room as the Mnemosyne. L|1|4.|To open the lever doors, one must step on the three pressure plates that are found at the center of the three standing stone rings found in three larger cave chambers, located after the maze and before the city. L|2|•|{WARN} If soloing, the magical portals beyond the doors take you to each of the three pressure plates. It is possible to use each portal and run back to the doors before they close. After you pass the first of the three pressure doors, you can close and reopen them using the buttons on the walls to reset the timers and give you some more time. The timers are more generous then they used to be, and as long as you hurry, you should have no problem getting them in one run. Note: When soloing take note: You can double back and reset the timers on the doors by opening all previous doors JUST before running through the next portal. Also, the 3rd portal drops you in a different location than the first two. From the third portal drop, run east first and then down. L|1|5.|When everyone is through, enter the «Lost City of Frore». L|1|6.|Open the locked door in the entrance with lockpick. Proceed up, jump down into the pit, and enter the hallway below. You will come to an intersection. If you have high enough jumping skill to jump up one dungeon level, take the left. If you do not, take the right. The right path is slightly longer and requires the use of one lever. L|1|7.|Following the map, proceed to the end. The rewards chest is under a beam of light in the room just prior to the old crystal chamber. Clear the room and loot the «Chest (Lost City of Frore)¦chest» for the item rewards. If you are with a group make sure to completely empty it. L|2|•|**Note:** «Glowing Box» is the only item to have stamp. L|2|•|⟦GlowingBoxPickup⟧ L|1|8.|Return the «Glowing Box» to «Mairisa bint Fuda» in «Plateau Village» for an experience reward.
P|Hasty Note (Bandit Castle) Brief Note Quick Note The Tremblant Party (Aluvian) The Tremblant Party (Gharu'ndim) The Tremblant Party (Sho) Legend of Frore Our Great Work The Book of Minesh Yarick's Journal Memorial Return to Frore

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Combining rune transcriptions⸩ ⸨The two transcriptions seem to fit together perfectly, forming a partial message in an ancient language. It appears that some of the message is still missing.⸩ ⸨The three transcriptions seem to fit together perfectly, forming a complete message in an ancient language.
L|1||Handing in Complete Rune Transcription to Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator⸩ ⸨You give Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator Complete Rune Transcription.⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "Hm. This appears to be a portalspace coordinate. Such things are not within my knowledge. You might want to seek out my colleague Marisa bint Fuya."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "She would be able to cast a portal to this location. Unfortunately, she's on sabbatical, and has gone to the town of Plateau."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator gives you Gelidite Standing Stone Translation.⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "Be warned, though - you will need a substantial party to reach the Lost City, and should you die..."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "You will be unable to reenter the caves to recover your equipment. Be certain you are prepared before you ask Mairisa to cast the portal!"
L|1||Mairisa bint Fuda⸩ ⸨Mairisa bint Fuda tells you, "I came here to be free of the madding pace of the Arcanum at Zaikhal. Unless you have urgent business, I'd prefer to be left to my meditation."⸩ ⸨Mairisa bint Fuda tells you, "If you are another seeking the lost City of Frore, be warned - you will need a substantial party to survive. Should you die, you will be unable to reenter the caves to recover your equipment. Be certain you are prepared."
L|1||Handing in Gelidite Standing Stone Translation⸩ ⸨You give Mairisa bint Fuda Gelidite Standing Stone Translation.⸩ ⸨Mairisa bint Fuda tells you, "Yes, I can provide transit to the location written here. I believe you will have need of this. A passing adventurer threw it at my head some time ago, when my portal spell fizzled."⸩ ⸨Mairisa bint Fuda gives you Gelidite Treasure Key.
L|1||Handing in Glowing Box⸩ ⸨You give Mairisa bint Fuda Glowing Box.⸩ ⸨Mairisa bint Fuda tells you, "It can't be I thought this had been lost long ago...."⸩ ⸨You've earned 18,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Mairisa slowly opens the box, the golden glow washes across her face. Her facial expression seems to become more calm.⸩ ⸨Mairisa bint Fuda tells you, "Thank you kind adventurer, it was a kind gesture of yours to return this to it's rightful owner."⸩ ⸨You must wait 26d 23h 43m 37s to retrieve the box again.⸩
H2|Trivia P|See also: «The Great Work Crystal» event page
P|When this quest was introduced, the Aluvian lord «Sir Joffre Tremblant» had only just been killed and then resurrected by the Gelidite. Each of the servers had a single chance to defeat him in his new form and loot his unique «Tremblant's Ivory Staff¦Ivory Staff».

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|200 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Sir Donovan» (optional) I|Starts At|«Frozen Valley» at 83.8N, 4.3W I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|You must find and use an item dropped by enemies at the «Frozen Valley» in order to be flagged to enter the dungeon.

Kill a few enemies to reach the NPC and talk to it to be flagged for killing 20 guardians within the dungeon. Quest.name: Frozen_Fury
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Mage Syltyn Rillon» I|Starts At|«Glenden Wood» at 27.8N, 24.7E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Frozen Fury» H2|Overview P|Prove yourself worthy to Mage Syltyn Rillon by bringing her a Virindi Signet, you may then remove the Sword of Frozen Fury from its dais in Glenden Wood.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: The Virindi Complex L|1|1.|Speak to «Mage Syltyn Rillon» at 27.8N, 24.7E (near «Glenden Wood»), who will give you the text, «A Tale of Paths», to help with navigating the Virindi Complex. L|2|•|⟦SpokeWithSyltyn⟧ L|1|2.|Make your way to the «Virindi Complex» at 73.8N, 25.1E. L|2|•|Route 1: From «Crater Lake Village», take the «Patron's Honor Cottages» portal at 66.2N, 14.2E. From the settlement, run west-southwest to the dungeon at 73.8N, 25.1E. L|2|•|Route 2: From «Neydisa Castle» run east-northeast to the dungeon at 73.8N, 25.1E. L|1|3.|From the drop, jump down each step and through the passage to more drops with a bridge overhead (used to exit the dungeon). After reaching the bottom head south until you reach two portals with another copy of A Tale of Paths. L|1|4.|Pick up the book if you didn't keep the original and want to find your own way through the complex.
H3|Part 2: Navigating the Portal Maze L|1|1.|The west portal follows Atlas' route and the east portal is Syretta's route from the story. L|1|2.|We will follow Atlas' route, so head west into the portal and you will appear in a room with four portals, from here take the west portal again to end up in a room with 8 portals. L|1|3.|Now take the east portal (the middle one) to a room with 4 portals lined up in a row. L|1|4.|Take the last portal to the east of the row. Then, in the next room, take either of the middle portals. L|1|5.|You should now be in a room with a red moving light and two portals. Take the west portal and then, in the next room with 4 portals, take the east one. L|1|6.|If you succesfully traversed the portal rooms you will fall through some mysterious lights into the next section. Go into the portal in the middle of the room. L|1|7.|Head around the caged lighting area and down the passage to the left. L|1|8.|Ignore all side passages and stick to the main path and you should come to a ledge with a flame in the center leading up into the ceiling. Jump down off the ledge to the left and head north - the next part is fairly linear and leads up and around platforms suspended in the air with crystals. L|1|9.|As you head up go east past the area that contains what looks like cells for experiments. You should now be in a room with a single platform in the middle with a Virindi Executor on top of it. The Virindi Interrogators here drop «A Virindi Signet». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpVirindiSignet⟧ L|1|10.|The exit portal leads to the bridges mentioned earlier which cross over into a room with the surface portal. L|1|11.|Bring the signet back to «Mage Syltyn Rillon» to be flagged to remove the «Sword of Frozen Fury» from the «Sword of Frozen Fury (Dais)¦dais» at 29.6N, 27.4E. L|2|•|⟦MayGetSword⟧ L|2|•|⟦GotFrozenFuryAward⟧ L|2|•|{OPT} The sword can be given to «Weaponsmith Omaro Nagate» near Glenden Wood (30.0N, 25.8E) for the «Dagger of Frozen Fury».
P|Notes L|1|•|The untranslated texts, «Virindi Obsidian Shard» and «Obsidian Shard from Aerbax», can be found in the early and later sections of the complex.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Mage Syltyn Rillon tells you, "Hello. I am Mage Syltyn Rillon, a member of the Explorer Society. Perhaps you are wondering about the sword on the dais in town. I had been a friend of Martine's back on Ispar. I encountered Martine here, during one of his mad rampages. He knew not who I was, nor did he seem to care and the encounter ended badly for me. Upon arriving at the Lifestone I was angry, yet understood that the Virindi were principally at fault for causing Martine's actions. I became determined to help fellow Isparians combat the Virindi and other perils of this harsh land. With the help of Omaro Nagate the weaponsmith, I crafted a frost sword that should be of good utility to adventurers who are skilled in the ways of the blade."⸩ ⸨Mage Syltyn Rillon tells you, "To obtain this weapon you must first prove your worthiness. There is a Virindi complex north of Bandit Road. I left a note on a tree along Bandit Road, east of Neydisa Castle, marking the location where you should turn north. Go to the complex, navigate through it and bring to me a Virindi Signet. I shall then allow you to take the sword."⸩ ⸨Mage Syltyn Rillon tells you, "Oh, take this. It will aid you in your journey through part of the complex. Read it carefully."⸩ ⸨Mage Syltyn Rillon gives you A Tale of Paths.
L|1||Speaking to Syltyn Rillon again⸩ ⸨Mage Syltyn Rillon tells you, "If you are having difficulty finding the complex, go along Bandit Road and find the note I left."
L|1||Returning to Syltyn Rillon⸩ ⸨Mage Syltyn Rillon tells you, "Ah, so you have returned. Not all do. Did you get a signet from one of the Virindi? If so, please give it to me."
L|1||Giving Virindi Signet to Mage Syltyn Rillon⸩ ⸨You allow Mage Syltyn Rillon to examine your A Virindi Signet.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your A Virindi Signets.⸩ ⸨Mage Syltyn Rillon tells you, "Thank you. I see you succeeded. You were clever in navigating the dungeon and sufficiently brave to face its denizens. I deem you worthy of receiving the Sword of Frozen Fury. I wish you safe travels and swiftness of blade when they are otherwise."⸩ ⸨You've earned 25,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Mage Syltyn Rillon gives you Trade Note (250,000).⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to complete this quest again.
