Quest.name: Gearknight_Lesser_Lords
Quest.startTown: Inner Sea Gear Knight Resistance Camp
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|30 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Dame Alistra» I|Starts At|«Inner Sea Gear Knight Resistance Camp» at 33.4S, 6.3E I|Route|«Yaraq» to «Ijaniya» portal at 22.4S, 0.2E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|One of the many quests from the «Inner Sea Gear Knight Invasion Area» aimed at lower level characters. The «Gear Knight»s have established a beach head on the eastern shore of the Inner Sea. «Dame Alistra» has you assault the «Gear Knight» leaders. P|This can be run concurrently with the «Monthly Explorer Society Quests» by talking to «Ansar El-Kerdany» in «Kara» before talking to «Dame Alistra». After completing «Dame Alistra»'s quest return to «Kara» and talk to «Ansar El-Kerdany» for ⟦MonthlyQuestMonthlyOne0710⟧
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Dame Alistra». L|2|•|⟦GearknightLesserLordKillCount⟧ L|1|2.|Travel to the nearby Gearknight Invasion Area at 36.7S, 7.3E. L|1|3.|In the center are six Empyrean head statues, each containing a Gear Knight guardian. After the guardians are defeated a portal will spawn between the statues. You may recall to any of the portals during the quest (but not summon them). L|1|4.|The portal will teleport you atop one of the six nearby towers, upon each you will defeat a Gear Knight lesser lord. A few seconds after each is defeated a portal will spawn that leads to the next tower. L|2|•|⟦GearknightLesserLordKillCount⟧ L|2|•|Note: Be sure to step away from the tower's center if you do not wish to be instantly teleported when the portal spawns. L|1|5.|The final two lords you will face are «Gold Gear Lesser Lord»s. L|2|•|«Large Gold Aetherium Core Fragment» Pickup: ⟦LargeGoldAetheriumCoreFragmentPickup⟧ L|1|6.|Return to «Dame Alistra» for your reward and title. L|2|•|⟦GearknightLesserLordKillTask⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|Core fragments can be given to «Jin Ato» as part of the «Inner Sea Aetherium Collection» quest. L|1|•|Rarely, Gear Knights will drop Large Aetherium Power Core, that when turned in to Atamarr, gives experience points instead of Mana Forge Key and Ornate Gear Marker.
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.
H2|Rewards
R| RK|Experience|2,000,000 (20% up to level 60) RK|Title|All for One RE
H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Dame Alistra tells you, "I am Dame Alistra, one of Queen Elysa's Knights. It is my chare to disrupt the Gearknight's command structure." L|1||Dame Alistra tells you, "Atop the six towers sit six Gearknight Lesser Lords. Destroy six Lesser Lords atop their towers and return to me once you have." L|1||Dame Alistra tells you, "To reach the six Lesser Lords you must first make sure their gauntlet of six guardians is destroyed, only then will a portal open to the tower of the first lord."
H3|Rewards Dialog L|1||Dame Alistra tells you, "I see that you've destroyed six Lesser Lords. I shall reward you for your assistance to the Crown." L|1||You've earned 2,000,000 experience. L|1||You have been granted the title, "All for One". L|1||Dame Alistra tells you, "It'll take their leaders time to regroup. Return tomorrow and I should have another task for you."

Quest.name: Glenden_Wood_Invasion_(High)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|130 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} «Captain Anrayl» I|Starts At|{OPT} «Glenden Wood» at 29.9N, 27.3E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Glenden Wood Invasion (High)» H2|Overview P|Help fight off the Viamontian invasion of Glenden Wood and rescue some captured citizens.
P|This is the high version of the quest. For the 80+ and 100+ versions see: L|1|•|«Glenden Wood Invasion (Low)» L|1|•|«Glenden Wood Invasion (Mid)»
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|{OPT} Speak to «Captain Anrayl» in «Glenden Wood» at 29.9N, 27.3E. L|2|•|⟦Captive130GWI1205⟧ L|1|2.|Go south of town to 27.2N 27.9E and kill the 3 «Portal Pillar»s. Once all are dead the portal will turn from white to red and can be entered. L|1|3.|There are multiple levers to pull, reference the map for the path down. L|1|4.|Half way down you'll come to a locked door with an «Unchained Knight» in the same room that drops a «Viamont Staging Area Key» to open both this door, and a door at the very end (2 use key). Both doors are 9999 resistance. L|1|5.|You'll come to a «Royal Vivimancer» protected by a «Mana Barrier». Melees, archers, and war mages will need to destroy the mana barrier before being able to kill the vivimancer. Life and void mages may harm the vivimancer with indirect damage spells. L|1|6.|When the vivimancer is killed, the passage opens to the end of the dungeon. L|1|7.|Use the key again on the final door and speak to one of the «Captive»s. L|2|•|⟦CaptiveTalk180⟧ L|1|8.|Use the exit portal (or recall) and speak to «Captain Anrayl» again in «Glenden Wood» for xp, title, and the «True Strike Bow». L|2|•|⟦Completed_GWI130_1205⟧ L|1|9.|If you don't want the bow, you can turn it in to «Tomo Genza» for the «Fleet Strike Gauntlets». If you don't want those either you can hand him the gaunts for 20,000,000 XP.
H3|Tips L|1|•|Once you reach the section with 3 of the Reinforced (destroyable) doors on a narrow pathway suspended across a room, wait in the hallway prior to the first door for 20-30 seconds; 4 of the 6 Viamontian casters perched along the sides of the room will jump down and run at you after a few moments, getting stuck down below the bridge. Once they do, if you have ~320 jump or higher, simply jump over each of the barriers rather than fighting through them. If you're sharp, you can even cross all 3 barriers in 2 jumps, by landing on top of the second door with your first jump. L|2|•|This makes the trip across MUCH safer, as they would otherwise be spamming level 7 war streaks at you. You'll be able to see them on your radar once they jump down.
L|1|•|When you reach the area with the Unchained Knight, keep at least 2-3 of the less-powerful Viamontian Knights between you and it to minimize your damage taken (assuming you're not melee, of course). Debuff their weapons (if you can) as well as the Unchained Knight's, and go to town with ranged damage for an easy kill.
L|1|•|When you reach the section near the end with the Mana Barrier, mages CAN drain/harm the Vivimancer to death without needing to take down the mana barrier. This is probably the best way to do this quest solo, as: L|2|1.|the mana barriers are extremely resistant to all damage types and take a ridiculously long time to kill, L|2|2.|the mana barriers share a room with a ~30 second spawn of up to 5 Viamontian Knights (similar to the ones in the last small room on the way to it), L|2|3.|the Vivimancer casts a wide range of level 7 vulns and will chain-cast wars once he is initially attacked.
L|1|•|The Vivimancers have extremely high Magic Defense, so you may want to bring a Princely/Royal Runed Slashing Baton to cast Futility if your Creature is not higher than 400/450 (respectively). As a reference, the Vivimancer in the 80+ dungeon had an overall resist rate of 79% with a casting skill of 380 over the course of 200 casts.
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Viamont Staging Portal (High)» 27.2N 27.9E -- «map:005A¦005A» TE
H2|Rewards
R| RK|Experience|130,000,000 (Fixed% up to level ) RK|Title|Invader's Bane RK|Items| RI|«True Strike Bow» RI|«Trade Note (250,000)» (x4) RE
R|Give unwanted bow to to «Tomo Genza» RK|Items| RI|«Fleet Strike Gauntlets» RE
R|Give unwanted gauntlets to «Tomo Genza» RK|Experience|20,000,000 (??% up to level ??) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Captain Anrayl tells you, "We know of three Viamont Portal Platforms in the woods outside of town. I want you to investigate the South Portal Platform and if possible put it out of commission. Do whatever it takes to prevent the Viamonts from reinforcing their foothold in Glenden Woods."⸩ ⸨Captain Anrayl tells you, "I wouldn't advise going on this mission alone though. Find others skilled soldiers to accompany you. Have them talk to me before you leave so I know who is in the field. When your done report back to me."⸩ ⸨Captain Anrayl tells you, "You can find the Portal Platform at 27.2N 27.9E"
L|1||Captives Dialog⸩ ⸨Captive tells you, "Thank goodness your here. We were taken from our houses and locked down here. Every so often one of us is lifted through that grating up there so the mages can... do something to them. All we know is that they scream as if they are dying."⸩ ⸨Captive tells you, "You should go now, we have some... business to take care of with those mages."
L|1||Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨Captain Anrayl tells you, "It still chills my blood to think of our own people being used against us. Those horrible Knights are barely human anymore."⸩ ⸨Captain Anrayl tells you, "Take this bow crafted by Tomo Genza. Thanks to her tireless efforts Glenden Woods still stands. If you wish a different reward then return the bow back to⸩ ⸨her at the Blacksmith's."⸩ ⸨Captain Anrayl gives you True Strike Bow.⸩ ⸨You've earned 130,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Captain Anrayl tells you, "May those who invade our lands cringe when they hear your name and may they flee when they hear your Title, Invader's Bane."⸩

L|1||You hand over 1 of your Supplies for Massilors. L|1||Massilor the Withered tells you, "Be on your way now and report back to your masters. Which ever of them you might serve. Heh, heh. Quest.name: Hamud's_Demise
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|100 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Ivory Crafter» I|Starts At|«Ivory Crafter¦Locations for Ivory Crafter» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Hamud's Demise» H2|Overview P|Devana ibn Rafik is looking for information on her father, Hamud ibn Rafik. Hamud and his daughter were followers of the Shagar Zharala on Ispar. The «Shagar Zharala, the Zharalim¦Shagar Zharala» had become corrupt so Hamud was made an outcast left Ispar through the portals to Dereth where he began a new organization based on the tenants of the Shagar Zharala, the «Tenebrous Edge». Unfortunately Hamud allied himself with the Shadows thinking that they were the "incarnations of the very ideals that we in the Zharalim tried to emulate". Hamud was corrupted by the shadows and became a shadow himself.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Kill «Brass Gromnie»s until one drops a «Brass Gromnie Tooth». L|1|2.|Give the Tooth to an «Ivory Crafter» in exchange for «Brass Knuckles». L|1|3.|Give the «Brass Knuckles» to the Ivory Crafter and they will give you a note, the «Introduction to Devana». You will also receive the «Contract for Hamud's Demise» with the note. L|2|•|⟦HamudsDemiseStarted_0511⟧ L|2|•|Note: They will not keep the Brass Knuckles. The Ivory Crafter only examines it. If you plan on repeating the quest, hold on to the knuckles. L|1|4.|Take the Introduction note to «Devana bint Hamudi» just outside «Zaikhal» at 12.9N, 0.4E. She will give you a «Key to Hamud's Chambers» and «Devana's Note». L|1|5.|Go to the «Mountain Fortress» at 82.4S, 19.9E near «Qalaba'r» L|1|6.|The dungeon is full of Zefirs on the upper levels and Shadows on the lower levels. Make your way through the dungeon until you find a locked door. Use the «Key to Hamud's Chambers» to unlock the door. L|2|•|{WARN} Don't discard your key now. The key has two uses and you need to return to Hamud later. L|1|7.|Just beyond the locked door you will find «Hamud ibn Rafik». Give him Devana's Note. He will give you the «Foundry Key» and instruct you to bring him a Pyreal Dagger from the «Empyrean Foundry». L|2|•|{OPT} There are three pieces of lore on the ground. You can't pick them up so you have to read them there: the «A letter to Devana», the «Precepts of the Tenebrous Edge», and «The Fallen Master of Shagar Zharala». L|1|8.|Go to the «Empyrean Foundry» dungeon found in the «Blackmire Swamp» near «Sawato» at 25.2S, 54.2E. L|1|9.|The dungeon is full of Mosswarts on the upper levels and Sclavi on the lower levels. Make your way through the dungeon until you find an «Ancient Pyreal Dagger». L|2|•|{WARN} The Mosswarts use combination vuln/war lightning and fire damage. The Sclavi also use war attacks. Lower level characters are advised to advance slowly through the dungeon to avoid being swarmed. L|2|•|⟦OldManMountainQuest⟧ L|1|10.|Return to the Mountain Fortress and give Hamud the Ancient Pyreal Dagger and he will give you «Hamud's Pyreal Katar» and «Hamud's Last Testament». L|1|11.|Give the Last Testament to Devana back in Zaikhal and she will give you «Oswald's Dagger», 2 «Trade Note (250,000)¦Trade Notes (250,000)», and an experience reward. L|2|•|⟦HamudsDemiseCompleted_0511⟧

I am trusting you in my house; I trust that you will repay me with your good behavior."

I study the ways and means of Dereth's natural flora and fauna - and her unnatural fauna as well."⸩ ⸨Tanami Kei tells you, "I've been making a name for myself lately, with my astute and erudite writings about the mysteries of cross-world speciation. But success breeds jealousy! And a certain man - I will not call him a colleague, nor even a rival, for in truth he is not worthy to be listed among the ranks of Natural Philosophers! - a certain man has stolen from me the notes I was compiling for my next book!"⸩ ⸨Tanami Kei tells you, "If you can retrieve any of my notes for me, in any condition, I will reward you with a handsome crossbow I have made!"⸩ ⸨Tanami Kei tells you, "Berkholt, in the bar, sells directions to this miscreant's dwelling. Please, friend, help me restore my reputation!"
L|1||Handing in Ishaq's Lost Key⸩ ⸨You give Ishaq the Philosopher Ishaq's Lost Key.⸩ ⸨Ishaq the Philosopher tells you, "There it is! The key to my storage chest! THank you so much! Now I can continue my great work!"⸩ ⸨Ishaq the Philosopher tells you, "Here, as I promised, is your reward. Are you sure you wouldn't like to hear some of my manuscript? I could just run and get my notes... ? No? Well, no worries."⸩ ⸨Ishaq the Philosopher gives you Ishaq's Mace.⸩ ⸨You've earned 25,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Ishaq the Philosopher tells you, "Thank you again. Be sure to drop by again sometime! You may need to remind me of our meeting, however - my memory isn't so good these days, I'm afraid."
L|1||Handing in Ruined Notes (Tanami Kei)⸩ ⸨You give Tanami Kei Ruined Notes.⸩ ⸨Tanami Kei tells you, "Excellent! Excellent! You took - I mean, you found some of my notes!"⸩ ⸨Tanami Kei tries to read the sad mass of paper, to little effect.⸩ ⸨Tanami Kei tells you, "Oh my. These are in some condition. Well, at least I have them now. And I believe I promised you a reward for your help."⸩ ⸨Tanami Kei gives you Tanami's Crossbow.⸩ ⸨You've earned 25,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Tanami Kei tells you, "Thank you! Perhaps you can help me again in the future. Now, I must begin deciphering these immediately ..."
L|1||Handing in Ruined Notes (Ishaq the Philosopher)⸩ ⸨You allow Ishaq the Philosopher to examine your Ruined Notes.⸩ ⸨Ishaq the Philosopher tells you, "My notes! My notes! What have you done to my notes?"⸩ ⸨Ishaq the Philosopher tells you, "Not only have you betrayed my trust, but you ruined my work! My great manuscript! Ahhh!"⸩ ⸨Ishaq the Philosopher tells you, "Begone! Get out of my sight! And never return! I will remember your infamy until the end of my days!"⸩

Quest.name: Jester_Focuses
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|160 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Jester (NPC)¦Jester» I|Starts At|«Graveyard» at 64.6S 43.8W (Use «Summoning Stone») I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Jester Focuses» H2|Overview P|Help the Jester clear out the voices of the lalalas from his head for bit.
L|1|•|You must have completed the «Jester's Lost Marbles» quest once before in order to complete this quest. L|1|•|This quest overlaps greatly with two other quests| «Lord Rytheran's Journal» and «Disturbance in the Ley Lines». It might be best to do all three at the same time.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Go to «Graveyard» at 62.8S 45.1W where you can climb up onto the cliff ledge. L|1|2.|Follow the ledge back towards Graveyard and at 63.1S 44.3W is the entrance to the «Knathtead Excavation». Some archers and mages have had success solo by perching on ledges near the end. L|2|•|Note: With a large group the best way to make your way down is for the mages to imperil all the little k'naths then let the archers and melees kill them. L|2|•|Note: Solo tip| When you reach the section of the valley that houses the K'nath Mother and leyline, run in circles around the K'naths to force them into melee mode. They rarely cast war spells again once in this mode. L|1|3.|The «Knathtead» spawns become more dense as you continue into the valley cut. At the end of the valley is the «K'nath Mother». She drops 9x «Piece of K'nath Core» and respawns after 5 minutes. Each person in your group will need one. L|2|•|⟦pieceofknathcorepickuptimer⟧ L|1|4.|Return to «Graveyard» and summon the «Jester» again, give the «Piece of K'nath Core» to the Jester. He will give you a «K'nath Core». L|2|•|⟦jesterfocusesstarted⟧ L|1|5.|Get a «Rytheran's Master Seal» while you are in Graveyard. It is in the «Ancient Chest (Graveyard)¦Ancient Chest» in a bunker at 65.6S, 43.9W at the south end of the Graveyard (near south summoning stone). L|1|6.|Go to «Lord Rytheran's Private Sanctum» accessed by handing the Master Seal to the «Master's Sentinel» statue located at 74.7N, 18.4E north of «Neydisa Castle». L|2|•|⟦mastersealturnedin⟧ L|2|•|Note: Once you have handed the Master Seal to the statue once then you are flagged to enter forever. From then on just use the statue to be teleoprted into the dungeon. L|1|7.|Once inside «Lord Rytheran's Private Sanctum», the drop is safe so make sure you are buffed and have a fire weapon buffed as you will encounter numerous undead in this dungeon. When ready, proceed north and then east through the dungeon and you will come upon «Imperial Guard»s and «Imperial Archivist»s, kill them and continue on until you come upon a room with a 3-way split, to the north and south you will find locked cloister doors and to the east you will find a locked Lord's Sanctum door. L|1|8.|First, head to the north, upon clearing your way through you will find a spot with a monster named «Majordomo of the North Cloister», kill it and retrieve the «North Cloister Key» (no timer), use this on the nearby locked northern cloister door. L|1|9.|Continue on and you will encounter many «Blood Priestess»es, they will spam level 7 acid attacks and drain your health and mana quite a bit, kill them and move on. Eventually you will come to an open room with 3 priestesses and some pillars and bookshelves, once you clear the room, on the eastern side on the floor near one of the pillars you will find the «North Cloister Key Half» (no timer), pick it up and head back to the 3-way split room again. L|1|10.|Proceed to the south clearing the «Imperial Guard»s and «Imperial Archivist»s along the way until you locate the «Majordomo of the South Cloister», kill it and retrieve the «South Cloister Key» (no timer), use this on the nearby locked southern cloister door. L|1|11.|Continue on through the door and you will encounter many «Celestial Illuminator»s, kill them and proceed through again until you come to another open room with pillars and bookshelves, kill the 3 illuminators in here and on the southern side of the room, near one of the bookshelves you will find the «South Cloister Key Half» (no timer), pick it up. L|1|12.|Combine the «North Cloister Key Half» with the «South Cloister Key Half» to create «Key to the Lord's Sanctum». L|1|13.|Head back to the 3-way split and this time go to the east, now use «Key to the Lord's Sanctum» to unlock the Lord's Sanctum door. You will see a pit immediately with a «Imperial Guard» on the other side, jump over the pit and proceed straight east, killing all the guards and archivists along the way, eventually you will turn north and proceed past more guards. Continue on until you reach a room with 2 «Imperial Guard»s and 2 «Imperial Archivist»s standing around the «Master's Lectern» in the center of the room. L|1|14.|Give the «K'nath Core» to the «Master's Lectern» at the end of the dungeon. After a few seconds the lectern will give you back the «K'nath Core (Malignant)». L|2|•|{WARN} When you hand in the core the Lectern will cast «Black Madness» (reduces all skills by 30%) on you and several undead with spawn. L|2|•|{OPT} While you are there you can pick up «Rytheran's Untranslated Journal» that lies on the ground in the same room as the Lectern. The book is worth a good amount of xp when given to «Danira the Dusty» in the Zaikhal Library. The book is on a 5 minute respawn timer. L|3|•|⟦rytheransuntranslatedjournalpickuptimer⟧ L|1|15.|Return to Graveyard and give the «K'nath Core (Malignant)» to the «Jester» who will give you «K'nath Core (Peaceful)». L|1|16.|Enter the «Gardens of Menilesh» at 64.7S 43.8W. L|2|•|{WARN} You must have talked to either «Zho Heishan» or «Lacarra Avanthi» in «Wai Jhou» in order to be flagged to enter the dungeon. See «Disturbance in the Ley Lines». L|2|•|{OPT} While you are there you can do the «Disturbance in the Ley Lines» Quest. L|1|17.|Not far from the start is a «Strange Pillar», several moarsman and undead spawn when you interact with it, but be sure not to move until you have the item back. Give the «K'nath Core (Peaceful)» to the «Strange Pillar» to get the «Empowered K'nath Core». L|1|18.|Give the «Empowered K'nath Core» to the «Jester» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦jesterfocusescompleted⟧

H2|Videos TR| TR| TE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "I can't think with all these lalalas in my head. I had an idea that might shut them out, for awhile at least. I believe that one of the mana suckers feeding on the exposed ley line may have the first thing I need."⸩ ⸨The ley line is North of here. It's quite dangerous having it exposed like that, be careful."
L|1||Giving Piece of K'nath Core to Jester⸩ ⸨You allow Jester to examine your Piece of K'nath Core.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Piece of K'nath Cores.⸩ ⸨Jester gives you K'nath Core.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Hey! This is what I need! How did you know? Oh wait, I sent you to get this didn't I?"⸩ ⸨The Jester holds the core in front of himself and begins to move his hands in alternating circles. The core slowly spins between his palms and you see lines of power pulse over it like a burning spider web.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Here, I need you to take this to a place I heard your people just broke into. Rythy's Private Library may have something he kept the Book of Eibhil in. I need you to get the sphere as close to whatever he kept it in."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "AHahahahahaha! You should see the look on your face! You remind me of a pet Grobbit I had when I was little. Yes you do! Roll over! You can't have a treat if you don't roll over lalala!"⸩ ⸨The Jester stares into the distance with his head cocked to one side listening to something. Then he shakes his head and looks at you again.⸩ ⸨Jester says, "Ooo, what's over there?"⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "The core should be able to absorb a small amount of the radiant energy the book gave off during it's stay in Rythy's Book Hole. Return to me if you are successful."⸩ ⸨The Jester smiles and holds his arms out charitably.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "I'll understand if you're captured and tortured, being still kept alive in a state of anguish for the rest of your brief life, and you're unable to bring back my K'nath Core."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "I'm told you may need a seal to access his Library. I remember seeing something like a seal in a tomb's chest south of here."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Good Luck. Oh, and maybe if your really helpful I'll give you some cake."
L|1||Speaking to Jester after giving him Piece of K'nath Core⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Couldn't you find Rythy's Library? I need you to place the K'nath Core in whatever Rythy was using to store the Book of Eibhil in."⸩ ⸨The Jester holds out an open hand and closes a finger for every statement.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Southern Graveyard. Ancient Chest. Seal."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Sentinel Statue next to Mage Academy Portal."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Find where the book was kept. This is important! Repeat these words, "Klatoo Veranda Nec#%@!"⸩ ⸨The rmaining word is difficult to hear as the Jester covers his mouth with his other hand."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Place core where book was."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Return core to grateful Jester who will give you some cake."⸩ ⸨The Jester holds his now closed fist to his chest in a salute.
L|1||Giving Rytheran's Master Seal to Master's Sentinel Statue⸩ ⸨The statue remains inert, unmoving, and vaguely menacing.⸩ ⸨You give Master's Sentinel Rytheran's Master Seal⸩ ⸨The statue seems to glimmer for a moment, and a disembodied voice intones, "Welcome back, Master. Even in our ageless vigil, you have been long absent."
L|1||Using Master's Sentinel Statue (Repeat)⸩ ⸨The statue seems to glimmer for a moment, and a disembodied voice intones, "Welcome back, Master."
L|1||Using the Master's Lectern⸩ ⸨The lectern pulses with a malign intelligence as you touch it, and it almost feels like it is examining you... Suddenly, a discordant shriek echoes in your mind, and the pedestal makes its displeasure known.⸩ ⸨Master's Lectern tells you, "Thief! Impostor! Master has already removed the Book of Eibhil!"⸩ ⸨⸨Master's Lectern cast Enervation of the Heart on you, but it is surpassed by Avalenne's Blessing⸩
L|1||Giving K'nath Core to Master's Lectern⸩ ⸨You give Master's Lectern K'nath Core.⸩ ⸨As you touch the Knath Core to the lectern it pulses malignantly. Suddenly, a discordant shriek echoes in you mind.⸩ ⸨Master' Lectern tells you, "Thief! Impostor! Master has already removed the Book of Eibhil! Guards! Protect the master's library!"⸩ ⸨⸨Master's Lectern cast Black Madness on you⸩⸩ ⸨Master's Lectern gives you K'nath Core.⸩ ⸨The Knath Core begins to pulse with the same malignant glow of the lectern.
L|1||Giving K'nath Core (Malignant) to Jester⸩ ⸨You give Jester K'nath Core.⸩ ⸨The Jester takes the core from you and begins to juggle it with a bunch of colorful balls. His dexterity is nothing short of amazing.⸩ ⸨Suddenly he grasps the K'nath Core and stares at it as colorful balls fall to the floor around him.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "The core. You found where the book was kept."⸩ ⸨He closes his eyes breaks out into a fit of giggles before getting himself under control and holding the K'nath Core before him.⸩ ⸨Slowly a peaceful green light spreads through the core, overtaking its malignant red glow. The core's light now reminds you of sunlight seen through a canopy of rustling green leaves.⸩ ⸨For the first time since you met him the Jester looks exhausted.⸩ ⸨Jester gives you K'nath Core.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "I must ask one more favor of you. Take the core to the ancient gardens beneath Rytheran's Tower and gather the final energy emanating from the deep places there. Humans from... Y-chew have been investigating the garden entrance lately, they may be of some help.⸩ ⸨The Jester begins stumbling about and mumbling to himself. He casts a glance over his shoulder at you and spins, somehow seeming to vanish behind himself.
L|1||Giving K'nath Core (Peaceful) to Strange Pillar⸩ ⸨You give Strange Pillar K'nath Core.⸩ ⸨As you bring the core closer to the pillar the symbols appear to draw back from it, but that could just be the light. The core seems drawn to the pillar like a magnet. It clinks against the pillar, sticking firmly. A vibration runs up the pillar and through your arm shaking loose a drift of dust. Then the core detaches suddenly and you are able to pull it away.
L|1||Giving Empowered K'nath Core to Jester⸩ ⸨You give Jester Empowered K'nath Core.⸩ ⸨You've earned 710,250,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 15,000 Luminance.⸩ ⸨The Jester opens his mouth impossibly wide and swallows the core. The shifting green light begins to radiate from his eyes then from behind the teeth of his smile. As he begins to laugh insanely it spreads along his arms to his hands, bursting in green beams of light from his fingertips.⸩ ⸨With a bright flash of light the Jester's laughter subsides and he raises his head. Calmly, almost lovingly, he looks at you with a weary smile on his face.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, Thank you friend. I have forgotten how peaceful it was without the voice of T'thuun in my mind.⸩ ⸨A sparkling green tear falls from the Jester's right eye.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "I must hurry. I'm not sure how long I have before the voices return."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "First I will reward you for the gift you have given me."⸩ ⸨The Jester chuckles kindly and awards you the Title "Jester's Little Helper."⸩ ⸨The green light fades from the Jester's eyes and he begins to laugh hysterically.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Now I will tell you as much as I know before it floods my thoughts with its will."⸩ ⸨The Jester produces a book and places a hand over its closed cover. You hear a furious scratching come from the book and you see thin lines of color appear on it's pages ends.⸩ ⸨Jester gives you Braced Mana Forge Key.⸩ ⸨Jester gives you The Jester's Revelations.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Take this book. I hope it will answer some of your questions and help prepare your people for what is coming. Take this bookmark as well."⸩ ⸨Jester gives you Two of Hands.
L|1||Other Interactions⸩ ⸨With a high resonating note the Knath Mother flips over and begins to quickly melt away leaving a crystalline core behind.⸩

Quest.name: Kidnapped_Handmaiden
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|125 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Sir Draithon» I|Starts At|«Yanshi» at 12.9S, 41.7E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Kidnapped Handmaiden» H2|Overview P|Rescue Ayaname Chiyoko.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You must have completed «Castle of Lord Mhoire Quest» to access Mhoire Castle and the Throne Room.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Sir Draithon» at 12.9S 41.7E west of «Yanshi» for a «Attuned Essence Gem». L|2|•|⟦KidnapPrincessStarted_0410⟧ L|1|2.|On the ground at 64.3S, 45.5W (Graveyard), you can find Ayaname Chiyoko way above you. You can use the «Attuned Essence Gem» to get some dialog. L|1|3.|Head to «Mhoire Castle». L|1|4.|Use the Northeast portal to enter the castle. L|1|5.|Use the Great Hall Portal inside the room you portal into. L|1|6.|Make your way to the Throne room. L|1|7.|Behind the throne, use the «Attuned Essence Gem» right in front of the gargoyle style statue to the right in the corner. A portal will appear, enter the portal which takes you to a floating portal at 64.3S 45.5W (be warned it is not a safe drop). L|1|8.|Kill the «Pyre Champion» and make your way down the stairs to another «Pyre Champion». L|1|9.|At the bottom you will find «Ayaname Chiyoko» and a «Wight Kidnapper». L|1|10.|Kill the «Wight Kidnapper» and loot the «Vile Potion». There is only one of these potions per kill, so if you have a group, you need to kill mulitiple times. L|1|11.|Hand the «Vile Potion» to «Ayaname Chiyoko». L|2|•|⟦SpokeAyanameChiyoko⟧ L|1|12.|Return to «Sir Draithon» in «Yanshi» for your reward. L|2|•|⟦KidnapPrincessComplete_0410⟧

Borelean is likely searching for me as well, and the Queen will know how to get a hold of him before he falls into some trap looking for me."⸩ ⸨Hoshino Kei touches your hand, and the tingle of a small enchantment passes over you.⸩ ⸨Hoshino Kei tells you, "Return to the Guard that sent you and let him know what has transpired. Quest.name: Killing_Bosh_Bosh
Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Kuuru» I|Starts At|«Kor-Gursha» I|Route|See «Bur» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Kuuru» in «Kor-Gursha». L|2|•|⟦KillBoshBosh_Start⟧ L|1|2.|Take the «Southern Catacombs» portal and work your way down to the «Deep Guruk Caverns». L|1|3.|«Bosh Bosh» can spawn in 3 different small square rooms in these catacombs. See the map for the location of each room. L|1|4.|Bosh Bosh is a semi-rare spawn. If he is not there in one of the rooms, kill the Guruk there and wait for the respawn. By repeating this, Bosh Bosh will eventually spawn in place of one of the other Guruk in the room. The respawn timer for each room is fairly low (less than 5 min). It can take anywhere in the range of 5 to 50 times to get Bosh Bosh to spawn. L|1|5.|If you kill the spawn that appear along with Bosh Bosh, they will not respawn until after he is dead. L|1|6.|Bosh Bosh is a boss similar to the other «Burun Kings¦Clutch of Kings». He casts similar debuffs and counters any debuffs you might cast on him. However, he does not have the ability to swallow characters (portal into stomach) like the other kings. Use cold weapons. L|1|7.|When Bosh Bosh dies, there are 2 kinds of tokens found on his corpse. The larger tokens can only be looted by those who scored a critical hit while fighting. These tokens give a title and xp. The smaller tokens can be looted by anyone else who is present. These tokens give less xp and no title. L|2|•|⟦BoshBoshSlayerTokenPickupTimer⟧ L|1|8.|Both types of tokens should be handed into Kuuru in «Kor-Gursha». L|2|•|⟦KillBoshBosh_Wait⟧
L|1||Notes L|1|•|Bosh Bosh can be solo'd by a higher level player (level 200+). L|1|•|Beware of spells cast by Bosh Bosh that lower all attributes (Grip of Death, Greater Muccor Blight).

Quest.name: Liberation_of_Uziz
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Virindi Edifice» I|Starts At|19.4S, 18.2E I|Route|«Al-Arqas» to «Ahr-Zona» portal at 33.5S, 13.1E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Uziz Abductions» H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Travel to the «Virindi Edifice» in the desert at 19.4S 18.2E. L|2|•|Route: «Al-Arqas» to «Ahr-Zona» portal at 33.5S, 13.1E L|2|•|{OPT} Pick up «Dream Beacon» text on the floor outside the portal. L|1|2.|You will enter into a room with 3 hallways branching off to the left, right, and middle L|2|•|Note: The dungeon is full of levers. Be careful as most of these are fake and drain your health when used. L|1|3.|Head left at the first split and make your way past the hollow minions and simulacra to a lever on the wall with blood spots below it. L|2|•|Route:. After you make the initial turn left, take a right (north) at the first split and then another right (north) into a small room. L|2|•|From here proceed west until you come to another T intersection. Head left (east) into the small room and up the ramp L|2|•|Up the ramp in the first small room is a lever with puddles of blood under it. L|1|4.|Hit the bloodied lever, then continue up and jump down. From here, return to the main entrance with the 3 splits L|1|5.|From the main entrance again, take the right hallway followed by another right, then proceed straight through the now-open lever door and jump over the pit. L|1|6.|Continue through 3 rooms until you come to the 4 room (a small square room). In here you will find a jumping puzzle above you (if you come to a door opening to a pit, you have gone too far). L|1|7.|Make your way up the jumping puzzle. The platforms are grates, and may be difficult to see (try using overhead view). At the top of the jumping puzzle is a lever, hit it. L|1|8.|After hitting the lever, jump down and continue onward to the door opening to a pit. Jump down, and head west back to the main entrance. L|1|9.|From the main entrance take the middle path. Continue north until you come to an open door and a pit. Jump across, and continue until you find a lever with a blue flame above it. Pull it. L|1|10.|After pulling the lever, continue on opening doors as you go. When you come to a pit, jump down and head south back to the main entrance L|1|11.|From the main entrance, head right again, followed by a left. Follow the hall to the now-open door and jump down. L|1|12.|At the bottom you will find the «Curator of Torment». When you enter the room he will summon and kill Uziz's Town Crier. (Stand back or he will kill you too!). He will then summon a «Simulacrum Shifter». If you let him do that, The boss casts life protection over himself (like anek'shays) and summons lightning elementals that will hit hard, war and vuln. For a short fight, a life mage should do the imperil+vulns (debuffing his weapon next) while the others attack him immediately with AR/Soulbound weapons. (use Slash/Bludgeon/Pierce damage) L|2|•|**WARNING!!:** If you fight the boss outside of the room and kill him, there is a triggering floor plate at the entrance of the room that will re trigger the event if you walk on it : Face the entrance and do a small power forward jump over it. L|1|13.|Kill the boss and loot the «Door Key (Virindi Edifice)». Use the key on the locked door ahead, jump over the pit, and continue until you find the «Vision of Horror (Virindi Edifice)¦Vision of Horror», along with the «Uziz» townsfolk. L|1|14.|Talk to the «Vision of Horror (Virindi Edifice)¦Virindi Delegate» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦AbductedCompleted_0313⟧ L|1|15.|{OPT} «Chorizite Chest» behind D5 (see map) L|2|•|⟦chestchorizite72137⟧

L|1||Curator of Torment⸩ ⸨Curator of Torment says, "The meatbags again attempt to interfere with my vision!"⸩ ⸨The room begins to crackle with energy.⸩ ⸨Curator of Torment says, "This insolence must be met with punishment. Know that your intrusion has lead to the death of one of your kind."⸩ ⸨The Curator casts its gaze toward the Town Crier.⸩ ⸨Curator of Torment says, "You my child. An example must be made. You have been chosen."⸩ ⸨Curator of Torment says, "This blood is on your hands."⸩ ⸨Curator of Torment says, "Your feeble attempts to stop me again fall unsuccessful. These humans are mine."⸩ ⸨Curator of Torment says, "Come forth my archetype! Obey me! Kill our unwelcomed guests! Their suffering is your reward."
L|1||Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨Virindi Delegate tells you, "A disturbance has been sensed. I was sent to investigate what could cause such a tidal wave of emotions to rage outwards."⸩ ⸨Virindi Delegate tells you, "The settlement you call Uziz was the center of this rift."⸩ ⸨Virindi Delegate tells you, "To discover one of the enlightened is torturing and experimenting on the humans of this land is as unsettling as it is dangerous."⸩ ⸨Virindi Delegate tells you, "The Reaver of Dreams will be informed of this immediately."⸩ ⸨Virindi Delegate tells you, "First things first, these humans must be released."⸩ ⸨A low pitched humming sound resonates through the chamber.⸩ ⸨Virindi Delegate tells you, "Worry not for their fate. The wards trapping them have now begun to fall and soon they will fully recover from their stasis. I will return them to their town once their minds and bodies have been released and healed."⸩ ⸨Virindi Delegate tells you, "Your kind should be grateful for your bravery."⸩ ⸨You've earned 275,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 20,000 Luminance.⸩ ⸨Virindi Delegate gives you Legendary Key.⸩ ⸨You have been awarded the title of "Liberator of Uziz"⸩

Quest.name: Lord_Rytheran's_Journal
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|150+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Danira the Dusty» I|Starts At|«Zaikhal» at 13.9N, 0.1E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Danira the Dusty». L|2|•|⟦rythjournalstart⟧ L|1|2.|Head to the «Graveyard», once there, clear your way to the bunker located at 65.6S, 43.9W, once inside you should see an ancient chest, open it and take the «Rytheran's Master Seal». L|1|3.|From here, you must take the Master Seal to the statue located outside the mage academy, the fastest route here would be to take the «Neydisa Castle» portal in the south wing of the «Town Network» and run to the «Master's Sentinel» statue located at 74.7N, 18.4E. Once there, hand the Master's Sentinel statue your «Rytheran's Master Seal» and it will teleport you to the dungeon (the drop is safe). L|2|•|Note: Once you have handed the Master's Sentinel your «Rytheran's Master Seal», you are flagged to re-enter the dungeon (if repeating you do not need to get another seal, you're still flagged for entry). If you use the surface portal or tie to it, you can recall should you die (use the statue instead of handing seal to get back in). L|2|•|⟦mastersealturnedin⟧ L|1|4.|Once inside «Lord Rytheran's Private Sanctum», the drop is safe so make sure you are buffed and have a fire weapon buffed as you will encounter numerous undead in this dungeon. When ready, proceed north and then east through the dungeon and you will come upon «Imperial Guard»s and «Imperial Archivist»s, kill them and continue on until you come upon a room with a 3-way split, to the north and south you will find locked cloister doors and to the east you will find a locked Lord's Sanctum door. L|1|5.|First, head to the north, upon clearing your way through you will find a spot with a monster named «Majordomo of the North Cloister», kill it and retrieve the «North Cloister Key», use this on the nearby locked northern cloister door. L|1|6.|Continue on and you will encounter many «Blood Priestess»es, they will spam level 7 acid attacks and drain your health and mana quite a bit, kill them and move on. Eventually you will come to an open room with 3 priestesses and some pillars and bookshelves, once you clear the room, on the eastern side on the floor near one of the pillars you will find the «North Cloister Key Half», pick it up and head back to the 3-way split room again. L|1|7.|Proceed to the south clearing the «Imperial Guard»s and «Imperial Archivist»s along the way until you locate the «Majordomo of the South Cloister», kill it and retrieve the «South Cloister Key», use this on the nearby locked southern cloister door. L|1|8.|Continue on through the door and you will encounter many «Celestial Illuminator»s, kill them and proceed through again until you come to another open room with pillars and bookshelves, kill the 3 illuminators in here and on the southern side of the room, near one of the bookshelves you will find the «South Cloister Key Half», pick it up. L|1|9.|Use «North Cloister Key Half» with the «South Cloister Key Half» to create «Key to the Lord's Sanctum». L|1|10.|Head back to the 3-way split and this time go to the east, now use «Key to the Lord's Sanctum» to unlock the Lord's Sanctum door. You will see a pit immediately with a «Imperial Guard» on the other side, jump over the pit and proceed straight east, killing all the guards and archivists along the way, eventually you will turn north and proceed past more guards. Continue on until you reach a room with 2 «Imperial Guard»s and 2 «Imperial Archivist»s standing on a square block of obsidian in the middle of a room, clear the room and on the northern wall you will find a desk with «Rytheran's Untranslated Journal» to the left of it. Pick up the untranslated journal and take the surface portal to the west. (Book respawn is a 4 min timer) L|2|•|⟦rytheransuntranslatedjournalpickuptimer⟧ L|1|11.|Portal back to «Zaikhal» and hand the «Rytheran's Untranslated Journal» to «Danira the Dusty» to receive your rewards. L|2|•|⟦rythjournalrepeat⟧

H2|Videos H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Danira the Dusty tells you, "Ah, you may be able to help me. I seek an artifact of the dread undead lord Rytheran. I think the ley line disturbances across the realm have opened up a gate into his personal library. There is some kind of gate that appeared within the old Mage Academy... But I believe, to enter it, you must have a seal of Rytheran's... A seal that my scouts have traced to a crypt in the Empyrean Graveyard in the Direlands. The graveyard can be found at 65 S, 44 W, but I do not know which crypt within its expansive grounds would contain the seal you need."⸩ ⸨Danira the Dusty tells you, "Go search the crypts in that graveyard, and try to find Rytheran's lordly seal that will allow you into his Library. Enter the library through the gate near the Mage Academy and search for books. It may be too much to ask that the Book of Eibhil is still in there, but perhaps some journal of Rytheran's would help illuminate the trail to that terrifying artifact. In any case, please bring me whatever books you may find in there."
L|1||Returning to Danira⸩ ⸨Danira the Dusty tells you, "I've asked you to fetch Lord Rytheran's journal, have I not? Have you found the book yet?"
L|1||Showing Rytheran's Master Seal to Danira the Dusty⸩ ⸨You allow Danira the Dusty to examine your Rytheran's Master Seal.⸩ ⸨Danira the Dusty tells you, "Yes, this is the seal of Rytheran's that I asked you to find, but the seal itself does me no good. As I told you, the gate to Rytheran's Library can be found near the old Mage Academy. The entrance portal to that dungeon can be found at 74.7 N, 18.5 E. Search for some new formation or artifact near that portal."
L|1||Statue interactions⸩ ⸨The statue remains inert, unmoving, and vaguely menacing.⸩ ⸨You give Master's Sentinel Rytheran's Master Seal⸩ ⸨The statue seems to glimmer for a moment, and a disembodied voice intones, "Welcome back, Master. Even in our ageless vigil, you have been long absent."
L|1||Key creation⸩ ⸨You have successfully combined the two halves of the Lord's Sanctum Key.
L|1||Using Master's Lectern⸩ ⸨The lectern pulses with a malign intelligence as you touch it, and it almost feels like it is examining you... Suddenly, a discordant shriek echoes in your mind, and the pedestal makes its displeasure known.⸩ ⸨Master's Lectern tells you, "Thief! Impostor! Master has already removed the Book of Eibhil!"⸩ ⸨⸨Master's Lectern cast Enervation of the Heart on you⸩
L|1||Giving Rytheran's Untranslated Journal to Danira the Dusty⸩ ⸨You give Danira the Dusty Rytheran's Untranslated Journal⸩ ⸨Danira the Dusty tells you, "You recovered Rytheran's Journal? Excellent!"⸩ ⸨Danira briefly skims the pages of Dericostian runes.⸩ ⸨Danira the Dusty tells you, "Unfortunate... The journal provides little information about where he has hidden the Book of Eibhil. I suppose it was too much to hope for. Still, this book has done much to illuminate the undead lord's thinking, and it shows us he is intimately involved with the ley line disturbances and the rise of the graveyard... Oh, what has Rytheran unleashed?"⸩ ⸨Danira the Dusty tells you, "I thank you for this. I'll provide you with a translation of the text, for your own edification, and some practical knowledge "⸩ ⸨Danira gives you Rytheran's Journal⸩ ⸨You've earned 247,696,546 experience.

I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Lugian Assault» H2|Overview P|Deliver the Scroll to Commander Presk.
L|1|•|The greatest danger on this quest are the exploding rock traps in many of the rooms of the dungeon. The rocks randomly fall from the ceiling and then split into pieces that fly outward in multiple directions. These rocks do massive damage if you are bludgeon vulned. It is recommended to dispel any vulnerabilities in the hallways between rooms.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Raksaa» in the «Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains» at 61.6S, 63.2W, and he will give you a «Sealed Scroll for Commander Presk». L|2|•|⟦LugianAssaultStarted_0913!⟧ L|2|•|Use «Rynthid Recall» or «Mansion» to «Dangerous Portal Device» to Center of the «Obsidian Plains». L|1|2.|Head to the «Presk's Bunker» at 63.6S, 66.3W. It is located on opposite side of the plains from the encampment NPCs. The drop is safe. L|1|3.|The dungeon consists of a series of large rooms full of exploding rock traps. Each large room has several «lever»s and a «door» which is opened by only 1 of the levers. One person should pull the correct lever while everyone else waits in the hallway until each door is open. After each room, everyone should dispel any bludgeon vulns. (The levers used to activate each door may alternate but this is unconfirmed) L|1|4.|The 1st room has 4 levers. Pull the NW lever to open the door. L|1|5.|Proceed through the door and you will come to a T intersection. L|2|•|Note: Following the left path leads to more exploding rock rooms and eventually a «Chorizite Chest». The path then drops you back at the start of the dungeon. L|3|•|⟦chestchorizite72153⟧ L|1|6.|The 2nd room has 4 levers. Pull the SW lever to open the door. L|1|7.|The 3rd room has 6 levers. Pull the middle lever on the north wall to open the door. L|1|8.|The 4th room has 6 levers. Pull the SW lever on the south wall to open the door. L|1|9.|The 5th room has 4 levers. Pull the NW lever on the north wall to open the Door. L|1|10.|The 6th room has 4 levers. Pull the NE lever on the east wall to open the door. L|1|11.|Through the 6th door is a portal to «Presk's Treasury» ({WARN} hot drop). L|1|12.|Inside the treasury is a room with 3 «Lugian Guardian»s, «Captain Keeson», and 4 perched Lugian throwers. The room also has exploding rock traps. L|1|13.|Run to the southwest corner and start attacking «Captain Keeson» and the «Lugian Guardian»s. L|2|•|Note 1: It is still possible to be hit by the rock traps and thrown rocks in the corners, but the amount of hits is greatly reduced. L|2|•|Note 2: The Lugians use «Dirty Fighting», so beware of health drains. Captain Keeson's weapon randomly casts bludgeon vulnerability also. L|2|•|Note 3: The drop inside «Presk's Treasury» is Hot, 3 x «Lugian Guardian»s, «Captain Keeson» and a «Door» on the opposite side of the room. L|1|14.|Once «Captain Keeson» is dead, loot the «Treasury Key» off of his corpse to unlock the nearby door. Jump across the pit (1/4 power) and hand your «Sealed Scroll for Commander Presk» to «Commander Presk» for a «Legendary Key» and a «Sealed Scroll for Raksaa». The legendary chests are nearby. L|2|•|⟦LugianAssaultCompleted_0913!⟧ L|1|15.|Head back to the «Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains» and hand your «Sealed Scroll for Raksaa» to «Raksaa» for your rewards.

We must take advantage of this!"⸩ ⸨Raksaa tells you, "If he is willing to accept aid from Linvak, we may be able to swing the war against these Rynthid in our favor."⸩ ⸨Raksaa tells you, "Be wary of his minions. They will not recognize you as friend or ally and will attack you on sight, but if you can reach Commander Presk within his bunker, he may be willing to consider our offer."⸩ ⸨Raksaa tells you, "Deliver this sealed scroll that contains our proposal to the Commander inside his bunker to the Southwest and return to me right away with his response...that is, if you survive Presk's forces and he doesn't crush you into jelly."⸩ ⸨Raksaa gives you Sealed Scroll for Commander Presk.
L|1||Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨You allow Commander Presk to examine your Sealed Scroll for Commander Presk.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Sealed Scroll for Commander Presks.⸩ ⸨You hand the Sealed Scroll to Commander Presk.⸩ ⸨Commander Presk tells you, "This is quite an interesting offer. Bring this document to your Raksaa."⸩ ⸨Commander Presk tells you, "And a small token for your assistance, little messenger. Quickly use your key and then begone."⸩ ⸨Commander Presk gives you Legendary Key.⸩ ⸨Commander Presk gives you Sealed Scroll for Raksaa.⸩ ⸨You allow Raksaa to examine your Sealed Scroll for Raksaa.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Sealed Scroll for Raksaas.⸩ ⸨Raksaa takes the sealed scroll and begins to read the contents.⸩ ⸨Raksaa tells you, "Good, good. This is a far better response than I expected."⸩ ⸨Raksaa tells you, "It is a small step, but it is a step forward in ridding the Plains of these vile creatures. Quest.name: Menhir_Research
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|50 I|Rec. Level|180 (to research all 20 fields) I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Cara the Apprentice» I|Starts At|«Xarabydun» at 41.7S, 15.8E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Menhir Research» H2|Overview P|Cara needs your help in collecting Menhir Mana Field signatures.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|Although this quest is level 50 and above, you must be level 180 and in a society to reach all 20 of the mana fields. A level 50 may reach up to 16 of the 20 fields for a reduced reward.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes P|See also: «Menhir Research/Menhir by Efficiency» for completing the quest on multiple characters.
L|1|1.|«Cara the Apprentice» will hand you an «Enchanted Mana Stone», which you must **use** whilst standing at at a menhir mana field to see if the mana fields have changed. You will obtain this message: (x) of 20 rings have been lit. L|2|•|Talk with Cara: ⟦MenhirResearchNPCCounter⟧ L|2|•|Menhir mana fields are found inside dungeons and on the landscape all over Dereth. See the map for confirmed locations. L|2|•|Menhir mana fields are typically found at «Menhir Ring»s, but not all menhir rings have mana fields, and not all mana fields are found at menhir rings. L|2|•|First Field: ⟦MenhirResearchNPCCounter⟧ on first completion L|1|2.|You can take the stone back to Cara when you have found 5 or more fields, or you can continue on for up to 20 mana fields. L|1|3.|Turning in the stone at any point completes the quest and resets the repeat timer. If you turn in the stone before you have found 20 fields, a pop-up box will ask you if you want to complete the quest now. L|2|•|⟦MehirResearchComplete0310⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|The menhir mana fields are numbered, but it does not matter in which order you complete them. L|1|•|The «Enchanted Mana Stone» may be used while running, and using it will not stop you. You must be within the borders of the mana ring to receive credit, however; be as close to the center as possible. L|1|•|Giving the stone to Cara is a good way to check how many menhir mana fields you've found. Just be sure to click "No" to prevent completing the quest if you wish to continue searching.

Quest.name: Messenger's_Collar_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|90 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Strange Swamp Temple» at 41.7S, 49.2W I|Route|«Mansion» to «Portal to Kivik Lir's Temple» or «Dryreach» to «East Direlands Swamp» portal at 8.1S, 74.5E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|For quest repeats, you can go straight to part 2 and use your old collar to enter the dungeon. The collars are givable, so you can take any character directly to the 2nd part as long as they have a collar on. L|1|•|While the quest can first be completed at level 90, the experience does not cap until level 125. It is possible to run the quest repeatedly and stockpile all your tomes until 125, and turn them all in then. If you have the pack space available to do this it is highly advisable. As an example I («User:An Adventurer¦An Adventurer») recently saved 13 tomes. Upon reaching 125, I turned them all in and advanced to 129.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Strange Swamp Temple L|1|1.|{OPT} Loot «Explorer's Journal» from the «Corpse of Ainea Besu» near the drop point. L|1|2.|Go to the bottom of this dungeon. Step near the strange portal device to spawn the «Burun Messenger». L|1|3.|Kill the Burun Messenger and loot the «Messenger's Collar». He has 100,000 health and drops five collars each time. Note: Unless you can imp/vuln as a melee/ranged AND have a crushing blow-type weapon (preferably frost), expect it to take a while to kill him. L|2|•|⟦MessengersCollar_Pickup⟧
H3|Part 2: Ikzisik Tika Ri Zikma L|1|1.|Go to «Ikzisik Tika Ri Zikma» east of Stonehold at 70.6N, 14.5W. L|1|2.|Although it is not necessary to enter the dungeon, equip the «Messenger's Collar» to get the QB stamp: L|2|•|⟦IkzisikTikaRiZikmaFlag⟧ L|1|3.|From the entrance, stay to the left. Go down a ramp and stay to the left. You'll pass 2 dead ends shaped like a cross, guarded by a Sclavus. At the third, stay to the left and run past a Burun. Go up a ramp, then enter a large room (dangerous, don't linger); run through it across a bridge. Stay to the right and run through a hall that shoots fire spells on both sides. At the end of the hall, go left. Stop and kill the Falatacot Patrician and Falatacot Matrician, or run past to grab the «Falatacot Tome (Messenger's Collar)¦Falatacot Tome». L|2|•|⟦FalatacotTome_Pickup⟧ L|1|4.|Bring the tome to «Fanzen San the Translator» in «Hebian-To» for your rewards and the translated text, «Words of the High Matriarch». L|2|•|⟦MessengersCollar_Repeat⟧

Quest.name: Nen_Ai's_Pet_Drudge
Quest.notes: easy newb quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|1-20 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Nen Ai» I|Starts At|34.8S, 71.2E near «Shoushi» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Nen Ai's Pet Drudge» H2|Overview P|«Nen Ai» has been raising a pet drudge in her home at 34.8S, 71.2E. Quest.name: Overlord's_Sword_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|20 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|Tumerok Priest I|Starts At|8.1S, 74.5E in «Dryreach» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Help the people of «Dryreach» by working your way up the ranks of the Tumerok army all the way to the Overlord himself.
L|1|•|There is a «Tumerok Fortress Rumor¦rumor» for this quest.
L|1|•|The most time consuming part of this quest is aquiring all of the various keys. This can be skipped entirely, and the players can advance to the final dungeon, if there is a skilled Lockpick in the group (700 resistance is the final door), if you have 2+ fellowship members and you can PKL through the door, or you can tie to the portal from outside of the fortress. This will save you atleast an hour. You can also have someone with buffed jump skill of 430+ jump over the fortress wall and open the door from the inside.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Priest's Key L|1|1.|As you come to the portal at 8.1S, 74.5E in «Dryreach», you will meet a group of Tumeroks - kill the «Tumerok Priest» and loot the «Tumerok Priest's Key».
H3|Gladiator's Key L|1|1.|Enter the swamps portal and run to fort at «40.0S, 54.9W - Tumerok Stronghold¦40.0S, 54.9W» as inscribed on the key. L|1|2.|Enter the fort without the towers using the Priest's key and loot the «Tumerok Gladiator's Key» from the «Tumerok Gladiator».
H3|Major's Key L|1|1.|The key is inscribed with the nearby coordinates of «42.0S, 56.2W - Tumerok Fort¦42.0S, 56.2W» - run there for the next key. L|1|2.|Use the Tumerok Gladiator's key to unlock the door to the fort. L|1|3.|Defeat Tumerok Majors until you find the «Tumerok Major's Key».
H3|Taskmaster's Key L|1|1.|For the next key, head to «Fort Tethana». L|2|•|Route| From the «Town Network», take the Aluvian wing (north) to Fort Teth. L|1|2.|Run to the «Tumerok Mine» at 7.9N, 61.3W. L|1|3.|From the drop, turn right and make your first left into a large open room. L|1|4.|Head west and head down the ramp. Hug the right wall along the hallway. L|1|5.|You'll come to a locked door (resistance 425), use the Tumerok Major's Key to open it. L|1|6.|Kill Taskmasters in the room until you find the «Tumerok Taskmaster's Key».
H3|Augmented Tumerok's Key L|1|1.|For the next key you will need to return to «Dryreach» and take the East Dires portal once more. L|1|2.|From there, run to the next fort located at «34.2S, 49.8W - Tumerok Fort¦34.2S, 49.8W». L|1|3.|Enter the fort using the Tumerok Taskmaster's Key and kill the «Augmented Tumerok»s until you find the «Augmented Tumerok's Key».
H3|Heavy Tumerok Key L|1|1.|From «Ayan Baqur», or using «Mount Lethe Recall», run to the «Cave (Ayan Baqur)¦cave» dungeon portal at 47.8S, 83.7W. L|1|2.|From the entrance hug the left wall ignoring the side rooms until you reach a ramp up. L|1|3.|Keep to the left until you go through a room and then take the ramp up. Take the first left, then up once again. L|1|4.|Follow the corridor until you reach a T junction. Make a right to the locked door (resistance 550). L|1|5.|Use the Augmented Tumerok's Key to open it. In the room you will find two chests. L|1|6.|The «Heavy Tumerok Key» is inside one of the chests.
H3|High Priest's Key L|1|1.|The final fort is a short way from the Cave at «51.1S, 82.0W - Tumerok Fort¦51.1S, 82.0W». L|1|2.|Use the Heavy Tumerok Key to open the door (resistance 600). L|1|3.|The «High Priest's Key» is found on a High Priest at the top of the north east towers.
H3|Gilded Tumerok Key L|1|1.|Return to «Fort Teth» and run to the «Tumerok Fortress» at 12.3N, 73.7W. L|1|2.|Use the High Priest's Key to open the door (resistance 650). L|1|3.|Make your way to the northeast tower. The entrance (Tumerok Fortress Portal) is up top (restricted to levels 20+). L|1|4.|From the entrance, take the passage around to the southeast until you reach some stairs. L|1|5.|Take the stairs down to the lower level and you'll see two passages on the west wall. L|1|6.|Take the one on your right, then hug the right wall until you reach a large open room. L|1|7.|Exit the room on the the west side and go through the doors. Continue straight ahead through two more doors and take the ramp up. # You should now be at a locked door. A pressure plate on the floor to the north opens it. L|1|8.|Inside is an altar guarded by Tumeroks. From this room take the passage to the north and go through two doors. L|1|9.|At the T junction take the right passage heading south and down a ramp. At the bottom of the ramp make a left into a small room. L|1|10.|You'll find 6 chests guarded by «Wasteland Rat»s. One of the chests holds the «Gilded Tumerok Key».
H3|Defeating the Tumerok Overlord L|1|1.|Head back to the altar room and look for the blue crystal on the south wall, behind the crystal is a secret passage. L|1|2.|Follow the ramps down and around to the final locked door (resistance 700). Use the Gilded Tumerok Key to open it. L|1|3.|Follow the corridor to a room with «Virindi Preceptor»s and blue crystals. L|1|4.|Take the corridor to the north and enter the Overlord's lair L|1|5.|Kill the «Tumerok Overlord» and take his «Overlord's Sword» and «Overlord's Key». The key opens «The Overlord's Chest» in the middle of the room. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpOverlordSword⟧ L|2|•|⟦KeyOverlord⟧ L|1|6.|The chest contains various low tier loot and the «Mark of the Overlord», which can be handed to «Lieutenant Rothe» in Dryreach for experience. L|2|•|⟦MarkoftheOverlord_PickUp⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Dinsmal the Beggar tells you, "It's said that tumeroks are crawling all over the Direlands. There's even supposed to be a big, hidden, underground fortress somewhere, where the biggest and most powerful tumeroks live."⸩ ⸨Dinsmal the Beggar tells you, "Tumeroks have some basic building skills and have also taken over many Empyrean ruins in the Direlands, so you'll see numerous walled forts over there."⸩ ⸨Dinsmal the Beggar tells you, "It's said that some of them are locked, so you might need to find the right key, or know someone who can pick the locks!"⸩ ⸨Orcud the Beggar tells you, "Near the main tumerok camp, outside of town, is a portal into the Direlands. Supposedly there's a portal that comes back from the Direlands, too, but it's guarded by tumeroks on the other side."
L|1||Handing in Mark of the Overlord⸩ ⸨You give Lieutenant Rothe Mark of the Overlord.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Rothe tells you, "Ahh the mark of the Overlord, you are a brave adventurer indeed. Let me reward your efforts."⸩ ⸨You've earned 18,000,000 experience.⸩

Quest.name: Paradox-touched_Olthoi_Egg_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Adrien Swiftblade» I|Starts At|43.8N, 54.9E in «Paradox-touched Valley» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|When first introduced, the «Paradox-touched Olthoi Ward Guardian» was only a nymph. The guardian and the minions in its dungeon have since been upgraded, and it is no longer possible for a character of the intended level range for this quest to kill the guardian. You will instead have to wait until the guardian has been killed in preparation for the «Aerbax's Prodigal Olthoi¦Prodigal Olthoi» quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|«Adrien Swiftblade» will inform you on the status of the ward guardian. L|2|•|⟦ParadoxEggStarted⟧ L|1|2.|If it is still alive, kill the «Paradox-touched Olthoi Ward Guardian», or alternatively wait for it to be killed, thus dropping the ward on the «Deeper Catacombs (Paradox)¦Deeper Catacombs» portal found inside the «Black Death Catacombs». L|1|3.|Go to the Black Death Catacombs and enter the «Deeper Catacombs (Paradox)¦Deeper Catacombs». L|1|4.|Work your way down to the bottom where you will find a room full of «Paradox-touched Olthoi Egg»s. Grab an egg. L|1|5.|Return to Adrien Swiftblade for your reward. L|2|•|⟦ParadoxEggCount⟧ L|2|•|⟦ParadoxEggWait⟧

TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Ward Guardian Cave» 43.1N, 55.1E -- «map:C4B4¦C4B4» TR|«Black Death Catacombs» 59.9N, 71.2E -- «map:5E45¦5E45» TR|«Deeper Catacombs (Paradox)» N/A -- «map:0088¦0088» TE

R|Give Paradox-touched Olthoi Egg to Adrien Swiftblade RK|Experience|27,530,674 (40% up to level 100) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Adrien Swiftblade (Ward Guardian status: dead)⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Greetings. If you're of a mind to help in this odd situation, I could certainly use your help."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Along with the rise of these strange new Olthoi, there is a Portal, warded by powerful magics, which formed in the Black Death Catacombs. You may've seen it already, or you may not have."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Anyways, I've found a way to get the wards to drop for a time. There is a Ward Guardian in a cave located in a heavily infested area nearby, around 43.6N, 55.5E. When that thing dies, the wards falter for a time."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "The Ward Guardian is presently dead, so you should be able to enter the Deeper Catacombs of the Paradox-touched Olthoi. Once in there, look for anything that may be of use to use in our research and bring it back to me."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "If the Portal is closed again when you get there, you should find the Ward Guardian in his cave and kill him."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Be warned, however, the Ward Guardian has grown dramatically in strength since it first appeared. It is now as strong or stronger than those twisted bugs that wander the inner areas of the infestation, and should not be taken lightly."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "I would hurry though, every time the Ward Guardian dies, it's either reborn, recreated, or whatever roughly six hours after its death, and the Wards return with it."
L|1||Handing in Paradox-touched Olthoi Egg⸩ ⸨You give Adrien Swiftblade Paradox-touched Olthoi Egg.⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "An Olthoi egg?"⸩ ⸨You explain to Adrien Swiftblade the circumstances of the catacombs and of the egg room.⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Damn. So, it seems this new threat is one that won't go away lightly. Nothing is ever simple in this world."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "I'll send this along to our researchers. Perhaps, with time and effort, we can find out where these new Olthoi came from, and find a way to put a stop to them before the threat they pose grows worse."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "You've done this world a great service today. Please, allow me to reward you for your efforts."⸩ ⸨You've earned 18,397,757 experience.
L|1||Handing in Paradox-touched Olthoi Egg (Quest Repeats)⸩ ⸨You give Adrien Swiftblade Paradox-touched Olthoi Egg.⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Another egg."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade sighs⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "I'm glad you've brought me this, as the researchers needed another, but I had vainly hoped these would run out eventually. Ah well, such is life in Dereth, I guess."⸩ ⸨Adrien Swiftblade tells you, "Please, allow me to reward you for your noble and necessary efforts."⸩ ⸨You've earned 6,132,586 experience.⸩

L|1|5.|«Elijah» will give you «Portable Igloo» which of course you give back to «Mr. P» who will draw a map in the sand telling you to head to «80.8N, 57.4W - Penguin Rookery¦Penguin Rookery» at 80.8N, 57.4W. H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Mr. P reaches into his "P-pocket" and pulls out a small piece of candy. His eyes light up at the sight of it and he quickly tosses it into his mouth.⸩ ⸨Mr. P leans back and continues to enjoy his sweet treat when he realizes he is being watched.⸩ ⸨Feeling a little embarrassed Mr. P puffs up his belly and squints at you. You feel as if this strange little penguin is judging you. After a few awkward moments he picks up an old candy wrapper from the ground, smoothes it out a bit and hands it to you.⸩ ⸨Mr. P gives you Marked Candy Wrapper.⸩ ⸨Mr. P sits back again and hums to himself while rubbing his tummy.
L|1||Handing in Marked Candy Wrapper to Larinne Kerendova⸩ ⸨You give Larinne Kerendova Marked Candy Wrapper.⸩ ⸨Larinne Kerendova tells you, "What's this? Ahh, Mr. P is looking for more penguin treats. Very well, here you go."⸩ ⸨Larinne Kerendova gives you Small Sack of Penguin Treats.⸩ ⸨Larinne Kerendova tells you, "What? How do I know that? It says so right here, see?"⸩ ⸨Larinne Kerendova points at the paw-print, and then at the placement of the toes.
L|1||Handing in Small Sack of Penguin Treats to Mr. P⸩ ⸨You give Mr. P Small Sack of Penguin Treats.⸩ ⸨Mr. P is sitting outside nibbling on cookies when you hand him the Small Sack of Penguin Treats.⸩ ⸨Mr. P sniffs at the sack and can smell the pengy food. Mr. P sticks his tongue out at it but knows that a proper diet is best for young pengys. Mr. P nods at you for a job well done.⸩ ⸨Mr. P continues to nibble on his cookie a bit then hands it to you.⸩ ⸨Mr. P gives you Partially-eaten Cookie.⸩ ⸨Odd, it's shaped like an igloo... Maybe you should look for a mechanic who knows a thing or two about igloos.
L|1||Handing in Partially-eaten Cookie to Elijah⸩ ⸨You give Elijah Partially-eaten Cookie.⸩ ⸨Elijah tells you, "No thanks, I'm not hungr... Oh, wait! This is not so much food as a request from that odd little penguin for a Portable Igloo!"⸩ ⸨Elijah tells you, "Did he come to his senses and finally decide it's too hot in the south, with the sand and the sun and the Oy this place is so very hot?"⸩ ⸨Elijah gives you Portable Igloo.⸩ ⸨Elijah tells you, "You better get this to him quickly, before he melts."⸩ ⸨Elijah tells you, "Hmmm... Do penguins melt?"
L|1||Handing in Portable Igloo to Mr. P⸩ ⸨You give Mr. P Portable Igloo.⸩ ⸨Mr. P inspects your Portable Igloo and nods. Mr. P has never been fond of igloos but understands that not all pengys like the warm weather like he does.⸩ ⸨Mr. P has one final important task for you. He has received news that a pengy rookery has been overrun by mean old Eaters. Mr. P wants you to help save the pengy population and rescue an egg.⸩ ⸨Mr. P draws a small but highly detailed map of the Halatean Isles in the sand, pointing out a location that seems to be at 80.8N, 57.4W.
L|1||Handing in Penguin Egg to Mr. P⸩ ⸨You give Mr. P Penguin Egg.⸩ ⸨Mr. P is so happy to see that you have saved an egg he jumps up and down and does a little belly slide. Mr. P waddles into his house for a moment and returns with a gift for you, your very own pet pengy.⸩ ⸨Mr. P gives you Pet Penguin Igloo.⸩ ⸨You've earned 6,000,000 experience.⸩

Quest.name: Plateau_Village_Transit
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|30 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} «Lieutenant Allandal» I|Starts At|{OPT} 42.9N, 42.3W in «Plateau Village» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|In response to the events of the «Fort Tethana Tug of War» quest, Queen Elysa had given orders to send soldiers from Plateau Village to Fort Tethana as reinforcements. But before they could achieve this the Viamontians had built a castle and overrun a nearby Renegade Tumerok fort to block this move.
P|Lord Tyrell Marsan, the leader of the soldiers, required you to clear a path through the Viamontians and return to him with the enemy's colors (pennants). The mission was successful and the army of New Aluvia marched on towards Teth. To learn the fate of Lord Marsan see «The Dark Spiral Quest».
P|Since then, the soldiers are now gone and only «Lieutenant Allandal» remains. She still rewards adventurers for raiding the Viamontian fortifications.
P|{WARN} the respawns are extreme. If you are running with a group be prepared to wait.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to «Bluespire». From Bluespire enter the Viamontian Laboratory in the center of town (39.4N, 75.3W). L|1|2.|When inside the dungeon head north through the doors and ignore the next side rooms. At the T-intersection take either a left or right, you will come to a ramp down, instead turn around and go south into the room with two doors. L|1|3.|Inside the west room is the «Viamontian Portal Mage», kill him and take his «Bracelet of Passage». L|1|4.|Equip the «Bracelet of Passage». L|2|•|⟦BraceletOfPassage⟧ L|1|5.|Now go take the ramp north and whilst wielding the bracelet enter the portal to «Castle Pietrus». L|1|6.|You will portal into the basement of a villa type building at Castle Pietrus. Head up the stairs to the top floor and defeat «Captain Vietre Lasallia», take his «Viamontian Pennant (Pietrus Castle)¦Viamontian Pennant». L|1|7.|{OPT} The «Castle Pietrus Log Book» is downstairs in a side room full of books and can be handed in for additional xp. L|2|•|⟦pickupcastlepietruslogbook⟧ L|1|8.|Now you have the first of two Pennants head south east to the «16.5N, 50.5W - Tumerok Fortification¦Tumerok Fortification» at 16.5N, 50.5W. L|2|•|Note: to access there climb at 18.8N, 49.6W L|1|9.|Defeat «Captain Iacollia Dimari» here and loot the «Viamontian Pennant (Bloodstone Company)¦Viamontian Pennant». L|1|10.|{OPT} The «Tumerok Record Book» found in the south east tower can also be given in for some experience (stairs are barricaded so use the outside wall). L|2|•|⟦pickuptumerokrecordbook⟧ L|1|11.|Return the books and pennants to «Lieutenant Allandal» to be awarded the XP.

R|Give Viamontian Pennant (Bloodstone Company) to Lieutenant Allandal RK|Experience|1,300,000 (25% up to level 50) RK|Items| RI|«Shield of Strathelar» RE
