H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "Peace be with you in these dark times. I serve Queen Elysa Strathelar in an information gathering role, but currently those of us who gather information for Her Majesty are baffled by a strange occurance."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "We recently sent an army to the Fort Tethana region, a move that was matched by the Viamontian loyalists. We have heard nothing about either force since a report that they had sat down to parlay, except for a rumor of Tumerok activity in the area."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "The Queen would like you to explore the area, and return with any information you find."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "I have heard that others are in search of information about what happened to the forces. Although Her Majesty would prefer that people aid her, in this matter she believes that something which transcends this war has occurred. As such, if you choose to aid the Viamontians, there will be no negative ramifications from our side."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "Also, if you have ventured to the fortifications between here and Fort Tethana, I will accept any Viamontian banners you may have retrieved."
L|1||Handing in Viamontian Pennant⸩ ⸨You give Lieutenant Allandal Viamontian Pennant.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "I see that the banner you give me is that of the Viamontians. Great praise shall be heaped upon you for your efforts against the enemy."⸩ ⸨You've earned 1,700,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal gives you Strathelar Pennant.⸩ ⸨You give Lieutenant Allandal Viamontian Pennant.⸩ ⸨You've earned 1,300,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal gives you Shield of Strathelar.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "You have achieved much in vanquishing the Viamontian foe. Though the need is no longer as pressing, keeping that corridor open for supplies in case of a future attempt to move forces to the northern Direlands is still a vital goal."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "For your efforts, I award you with one of the shields we give to members of our army. Return it if you do not wish it as a reward."
L|1||Handing in Tumerok Record Book⸩ ⸨You give Lieutenant Allandal Tumerok Record Book.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "I shall ensure that this is brought to Queen Elysa's attention."⸩ ⸨You've earned 1,700,000 experience.
L|1||Handing in Castle Pietrus Log Book⸩ ⸨You give Lieutenant Allandal Castle Pietrus Log Book.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "I shall ensure that this is brought to Queen Elysa's attention."⸩ ⸨You've earned 1,700,000 experience.
L|1||Handing in Shield of Strathelar⸩ ⸨You give Lieutenant Allandal Shield of Strathelar.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "This shall be given to one of our soldiers, then. I am afraid that I do not tell stories the way Lord Marsan used to..."⸩ ⸨The lieutenant's eyes mist a little.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "He was not such a bad man, in truth. Perhaps given to boasting, but he did not deserve the fate he received."⸩ ⸨You've earned 288,496 experience.⸩

Quest.name: Reception_Games
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|50+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Wedding Chapel» at 12.9S, 41.6E I|Route|«Yanshi» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|There are different games and other activities which went live after the «Wedding of Borelean and Hoshino».
H3|Current Status of the Games P|The games are «Seasonal Quests¦Seasonal» and are activated on the anniversary of the wedding around the time of the May event. The games finish when the June patch goes live (now **deactivated**).
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Candle Race L|1|1.|Talk to «Hoshino Kiri». L|1|2.|A pop-up will ask you if you want to start the race. Click yes to begin, you now have 30 seconds to reach the «First Enchanted Candle». Run up to the platforms, some skill jumping required. L|1|3.|Use the «First Enchanted Candle», you now have 30 seconds the reach the «Second Enchanted Candle». L|1|4.|Use the «Second Enchanted Candle», you now have 30 seconds the reach the «Third Enchanted Candle». L|1|5.|Use the «Third Enchanted Candle», you now have 30 seconds to return back to «Hoshino Kiri». L|1|6.|Return to «Hoshino Kiri» for your reward. L|1|7.|If you fail, you have to wait 15 minutes to try again.
H3|Hidden Egg Search L|1|1.|Go to the «Celebration Castle» nearby L|1|2.|Talk to the «Game Coordinator» L|1|3.|Jump into the castle and use the «Rock Pile»s. L|1|4.|You will have 3 minutes to get the random «Egg (Blue)¦Egg» from the «Rock Pile»s, one per random pile L|1|5.|If you by accident hit one of the brown tiles, you will get portaled into the Pavillion on the «Wedding Chapel» site and have to run back. L|1|6.|Collect at least 5 eggs for a «Top Hat» or 8 eggs for the hat and a special reward.
P|Notes L|1|•|If you want to guarantee yourself the «Grand Casino Key» and not just the «Top Hat» : Run the game, if you don't get all 8 «Egg (Blue)», then hand in all your eggs to game coordinator and then talk to him to restart it. Your quest timer only kicks in if you get any of the rewards. L|1|•|When looking for «Rock Pile»s don't forget to check on top of the roofs on the towers. (Only the NE tower roof can spawn an egg, all the others are decoys)
H2|Rewards
R|Hidden Egg Run RK|Items| RI|«Top Hat» (5+ eggs) RI|«Golden Key (Casino)» (8 eggs, first time) RI|One random reward (8 eggs, repeats): RI|«Colosseum Coin» RI|«Ancient Mhoire Coin» RI|«Small Olthoi Venom Sac» RE
R|Candle Race RK|Items| RI|«Royal Bouquet» RE
H2|Dialog H3|Candle Run H4|Opening Dialog L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "Greetings!" L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "on this joyous occasion, it brings me pleasure to provide one of the entertainments provided for all of you." L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "If you wish to participate, I have a race you can run. If you succeed, you can have a copy of the bouquet akin to the one my sister has, and like the one I am holding." L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "There are 3 candles, ringing this area in a loop, that you must touch in turn and return to me, before the enchantments placed on you run out." L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "Be warned. The time runs out quickly, and you must touch them in the proper order, which is a loop back to me, starting with the one to the east of here." L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "The path should be fairly obvious, just look for the floating platforms and ramps that mark it." L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "And remember, you must make it to each candle in turn, and then back to me, before the time runs out." L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "Are you ready to start?"
L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "When you're ready to start the race, speak to me again."
L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "Begin! Run! Off you go! Get to the first candle!"
L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "What're you talking to me for?!?! RUN!!! Time's a wasting!"
L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "Aww, you didn't make it in time. I'm sorry. You can try again in fifteen minutes, if you'd like."
L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "I'm sorry that you didn't make it in time, but you can try again soon." L|1||You may attempt this race again in 14m 57s.

L|1||You touch the candle, feeling the wash of enchantment fall over you. You now have 30 seconds to reach the next candle. L|1||You touch the candle, feeling the wash of enchantment fall over you. L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "Here's your reward, and I hope you had fun." L|1||Hoshino Kiri gives you Royal Bouquet.
L|1||Hoshino Kiri tells you, "Congratulations again on winnning the race."
H3|Hidden Egg Search H4|Opening Dalog L|1||Game Coordinator tells you, "Search the rock piles inside the structure to find hidden eggs." L|1||Game Coordinator tells you, "You have three minutes to look, starting... NOW!" L|1||Game Coordinator tells you, "Return to me with the eggs you find and I'll reward you if you find enough."
L|1||You find nothing in this pile of rocks. L|1||You find a small egg hidden in this pile of rocks. L|1||You find a note indicating you should talk to the event coordinator to participate.

Quest.name: Rynthid_Foothold
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Vision of Horror (Emotions Unbound)¦Vision of Horror» I|Starts At|«Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains» at 61.6S, 63.3W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Rynthid Genesis» H2|Overview P|The Rynthid Virindi have begun invading Dereth. Assist the «Vision of Horror» in stopping them from expanding their foothold in the «Obsidian Plains» any further into Dereth.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Ascending the Platforms L|1|1.|To begin this quest, speak with «Vision of Horror (Emotions Unbound)¦Vision of Horror» located at the «Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains» at 61.6S, 63.3W. L|2|•|⟦GenesisStarted_0813⟧ L|2|•|Note: You should also speak with the other NPCs at the encampment to flag for various kill tasks which can be done concurrently with the quest. P|portal is on the top right platform (portal not pictured).]] L|1|2.|Make your way to the access ramp at 62.5S, 65.4W to begin climbing the platforms L|1|3.|To get to the 1st of the dungeons, head up the ramp. Make a full power jump across to the southern platform, then take the west ramp. Head north to the T intersection, and turn west and head into the portal «Path of Torment». L|2|•|WARNING: the dungeon drop is HOT! L|1|4.|Inside the «Path of Torment» dungeon, head west and exit the room, then turn south. At the next split, head south. L|2|•|Note: If desired, you can flag with a crystal in this dungeon for a kill task which is part of the «Rynthid Artifact Collection» quest. L|1|5.|Continue west until you come to a large room. In here, head north east and take the far east exit, then bear south all the way to the Platforms of Torment portal. L|1|6.|From the Platforms of Torment drop, head down the ramp, and bear south down the ramp. Take the next ramp heading east and up into the «Path of Rage» portal. L|1|7.|In the dungeon you will come to a large room. Take the 1st exit on the right bearing west. L|2|•|Note: As in the first dungeon, you can optionally flag with a crystal in this dungeon for a kill task which is part of the «Rynthid Artifact Collection» quest. L|1|8.|After exiting the large room head east, then take the right bearing south. When you come to a 4 way split, head east until you come to a large room. In here, take the 1st left heading east. At the next split, head east and continue to the Platforms of Rage portal. L|2|•|WARNING: the drop is VERY hot!! P|from Platforms of Rage drop point]] L|1|9.|From the Platforms of Rage drop, walk north and look down. You will see a platform below you with a portal to «Rynthid Genesis» on it. Shift-jump down onto the platform and enter the portal.
H3|Part 2: Rynthid Genesis L|1|1.|When you enter you will be standing on a grate above the floor. Jump down and head east. At the intersection there will be a door to the south. In order to continue past it you will need to pull a series of levers to open it. L|2|•|WARNING: Beyond that door, all the hallways do constant electric damage. The rooms beyond are safe, but all hallways have this lightning damage. There is no way to jump over or avoid it, but a lightning protection rare will render all damage 0. It is best to move quickly through the hallways into the larger rooms. L|1|2.|To find the levers to open the door, return to the main entrance room. You will be heading to 2 different rooms, each containing a pair of levers you will need to hit. L|2|•|Note: the order in which you hit the levers does NOT matter & the hallways leading to all the lever rooms also have the electric damage. L|1|3.|To get to the 1st pair of levers, head north from the main room. The hallway will split but it doesnt matter which path you take as they both meet up in the room with the levers. Hit the 2 levers, then return back to the main entrance. L|1|4.|From the main entrance head south to find the second pair of levers. Again, when the hallway splits it does not matter which way you go, as they meet up in the lever room. Hit the pair of levers here, then return to the main entrance, and head east to the door which should now be open. L|1|5.|Head south through the now open door, until you come to another large room. In the room is a hallway to the south, blocked by another portal door. To open it, you will need to hit the levers contained in the room to the north. L|2|•|Note: Again the hallways leading to the levers split, but it does not matter which way you go. The hallway again contains the electric damage. L|1|6.|After hitting the levers in the room to the north, the portal door blocking the south hallway will open. Continue moving forward through the hallways (it does not matter if you go left or right at T intersections, they all meet up) until you come to a large room. Exit this room to the east where you will come across a room with a «Corrupt Bulwark» and a hallway to the south, blocked once again by a portal-door. L|1|7.|When the «Corrupt Bulwark» dies, the portal door opens, and you may continue south until you come to a large room with a pit in the middle, and a portal down in it. This is your last chance to heal, rebuff, and prepare for the final fight. When everyone is ready, jump down into the pit and enter the portal, to begin the final fight. L|2|•|Warning: The drop is hot!
H3|Part 3: Aspect of Avarice L|1|1.|The final fight is not 1 fight, but a series of 5 successive waves. These waves of monsters get progressively tougher as you go. Immediately upon the death of the last monster for any given wave, the new wave will appear. L|1|2.|In the 5th and final spawn will be the «Aspect of Avarice» who is accompanied by a host of minions on a VERY fast respawn. When the «Aspect of Avarice» dies, an «Aspect of Avarice (NPC)¦NPC version» of the Aspect will appear along with «Legendary Chest»s. L|2|•|Note: The minions will also reset if you do not clear the spawns fast enough after the Aspect is dead. L|2|•|Note: The minions do NOT disappear when the Aspect dies, so it would be wise to clear them out before collecting your rewards. L|1|3.|Talk to the NPC to receive a 3 use «Legendary Key». Loot one of the chests in the room, and then head back to the «Vision of Horror (Emotions Unbound)¦Vision of Horror» (61.6S, 63.2W) to collect your rewards. L|2|•|Note: the surface portal in the room here is a SAFE drop, which will put you roughly 2.5 clicks away from the «Vision of Horror (Emotions Unbound)¦Vision of Horror» at the «Encampment near Rynthid Infested Plains» at (61.6S, 63.2W). L|2|•|⟦AvariceRewarded_0813!⟧ L|1|4.|Talk with «Vision of Horror (Emotions Unbound)¦Vision of Horror» L|2|•|⟦GenesisCompleted_0813!⟧

Quest.name: Singularity_Recall
Quest.notes: bring a physical dmager and lockpicker, the sage is magic immune
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|90 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|94.8S, 91.0W I|Route|«Singularity Bore» to «Singularity Caul» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|Note 1: Everyone must be flagged for «Singularity Caul» to complete this quest. See «Caul Flagging» for details. L|1|•|Note 2: Someone in your group will need to have «Lockpick» to complete this quest. L|1|•|Note 3: You will find a magic resistant mob at some point during this quest. Make sure you have some form of melee or missile attack. L|1|•|Note 4: The three dark ring rewards share the same timer and cannot all be picked up. Make sure it's the ring you want before you loot it (see rewards). L|2|•|⟦RingMaelstrom⟧
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Caul Asylum L|1|1.|From the Caul drop, head to the «Caul Asylum» at 94.8S 91.0W. L|1|2.|From the drop, «Lockpick» the door to the North and run through the linear dungeon (always going down) until you get to a large room behind a locked gate. L|1|3.|Unlock the gate to the large room, and head to the South exit. Unlock it and head down the ramp. L|1|4.|From the split, take the West hallway until you get to a room with «The Gatekeeper». Kill him and loot an «Asylum Chest Key» (one per group needed). L|1|5.|Backtrack to the split. One person (with lockpick) should now head back through the large room, and up the first ramp. Take all lefts until you reach a room with a locked door and an «Asylum Chest» inside. Use the «Asylum Chest Key» on the chest and loot the «Asylum Key», then rejoin the group. L|2|•|⟦AerbaxChestKey1Pickup⟧ L|1|6.|The group should now take the east hallway to a large room with a locked door. Use the «Asylum Key» on the locked door and enter the portal to the «Caul Athenaeum».
H3|Part 2: Caul Anthenauem L|1|1.|From the drop, take the Northeast ramp up. Take the first ramp up on your left, and continue until you reach a 3-way split. L|1|2.|You must now access the portal to the «Caul Sanitorium», which is located behind a locked gate in the first hallway after taking a right at the 3-way split. L|2|•|Long Route: You must find «The Sage» (**magic resistant Virindi**), who always spawns in the southeast corner room on this level. He drops an «Athenaeum Key», which is used to unlock the gate to the «Caul Sanitorium» portal. L|2|•|Short Route: You can use the «PKLite» exploit to bypass the locked gate. L|1|3.|Once the gate is open, jump accross the portal walkway and use the «Caul Sanitorium» portal.
H3|Part 3: Caul Sanitorium L|1|1.|In this part, you need to find the real portal to Aerbax's Antechamber. Only 1 portal is real and all portals are named "Caul Sanitorium". L|1|2.|From the drop, run down the portal staircase, and jump across to the Southeast platform L|2|•|Tip: Its easiest to jump from the portal staircase to the Southwest platform, back to the center pillar, and then to the Southeast platform. L|1|3.|From here, take the ramps down, take your first right, and then the first cutback to your left. L|1|4.|Now hug the left wall, take the ramp up, and follow the long straight hallway until you dead-end into a split. L|1|5.|Take the hallway on the left (Southeast), and use this portal to enter «Aerbax's Antechamber».
H3|Part 4: Aerbax's Antechamber L|1|1.|From the drop, you'll need to use a series of levers (see map) to open the South gate. L|2|•|Tip: You can use the «PKLite» exploit here to bypass the levers and save time. L|1|2.|Head down the ramp and take a right at the split. Follow the linear dungeon. L|2|•|Note: 2 doors along the way will require you to use a lever, which are behind locked doors just around the corner. L|1|3.|Once you open the last gate, jump down and take a right, where you'll find a group of «Shadow»s. Kill them and then hit the lever on the South wall. L|1|4.|Enter the room to the North and kill the «The Auditor». Everyone loots the green «Asylum Chest Key (Auditor)¦Asylum Chest Key». L|2|•|⟦AerbaxChestKey2Pickup⟧ L|1|5.|**Attention**: One person also needs to get the blue «Key (Auditor)¦Key» from the «The Auditor» to open the final door. L|1|6.|Once everyone has their «Asylum Chest Key (Auditor)¦Asylum Chest Key», take the Northeast exit and work your way back to the portal drop. A lever on the way opens the North door. L|1|7.|From the drop zone, take the North ramp down, but be sure to jump over the base of the ramp (at the intersection) to avoid the dispell trap. L|2|•|Note: If you forgot to hit the lever on the way, you can also use the «PKLite» exploit to open the North door. L|1|8.|From the intersection, your first left, and then your first right will take you to the final room. L|2|•|Note: You must use a lever to open the locked gate here. The locked door to the Northeast provides access to the lever in the room to the Northwest, which subsequently opens the door to the North. L|1|9.|Use the «Key (Auditor)» (from the «The Auditor») to open the final room, which contains a number of «Sanatorium Chest»s. L|1|10.|Use your «Asylum Chest Key» on any of the «Sanatorium Chest»s to obtain the «Recall to the Singularity Caul» scroll. L|2|•|⟦RecallSingularityCaul⟧

Quest.name: Singularity_Weapons_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|25 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Kara» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|QB Stamps P|Each weapon rewards a QB stamp as well as each upgrade. See all here «Singularity Weapons»
H2|Overview P|Quest to gain one of «Candeth Martine»'s «Virindi Slayer¦Virindi Slaying» weapons.
L|1|•|Completing the first part of the quest requires a «Sturdy Iron Key» and completing the second part of the quest requires «Lockpick» skill. L|1|•|The 1st part of the quest gets you the base weapon, which has the unfavorable «Destroyed on Death» property. L|1|•|The 2nd part of the quest removes the «Destroyed on Death» property, but keeps the stats the same. L|1|•|The 3rd part improves the stats and increases the wield requirement. L|1|•|The 4th and final step improves the spells, bonuses, and adds «Armor Cleaving» to weapons or a bonus percent damage to wands while again raising the wield requirement.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: The Base Weapon L|1|1.|You will first need to find a «Tattered Virindi Cloak», which drops on «Mosswart Mire-Witch»es. Not all witches drop it, only outside and in spawns of five mosswarts (inside or in spawns of less than five will not drop them, the five spawn ones always drop one). Good places to find such spawns include near «Kara», especially in the lake area, and on the «South Direlands Landbridge», there is a portal there in «Qalaba'r». Though the lake areas are small; so I suggest the following get to Kara (East wing (Sho) in Town Network), then run to the southwest until the shore. Then just run west along the shore until you see a group of 5 witches (usually between 38.0E and 15.0E). With this method, you should find one in less than 30 minutes and you won't have to climb mountains. Do not kill any other spawns than the 5 witches, the spawn can reset when you leave the landblock but dead creatures take a long time to respawn with someone in the landblock : so it reduce both your's and other's chances to find the special spawn. The cloak has an 18 hour quest timer on it. L|2|•|⟦VirindiTatteredCloak⟧ L|1|2.|Once you've found a Cloak, take the «Freehold» (portal in the East wing (Sho) of «Town Network»). Just to the northwest is the dungeon «A Mosswart Hideout» at 72.7S, 90.7E. L|1|3.|Once in the Hideout, head west and hug the right wall. After going down 2 ramps you'll end up at the «Chest (A Mosswart Hideout)¦Chest». L|1|4.|Open the chest with a «Sturdy Iron Key» and loot the «Virindi Essence (Blue)¦Virindi Essence». There is a 20 hour timer on the essence. L|2|•|⟦VirindiEssence⟧ L|1|5.|Use the «Virindi Essence (Blue)¦Virindi Essence» on the «Tattered Virindi Cloak» to get a «Glowing Virindi Cloak». L|1|6.|Go to the «Moss Chamber» near «Zaikhal» at 14.1N 0.7W. L|1|7.|Down east ramp from big hall, stay all rights, thru door, down several right turning ramps, continue rights until you see «Gragghk» in between two big wooden ramps. Moss Chamber portal located in South wall. L|1|8.|Kill «Gragghk» and loot «Torn Mosswart Shroud» L|2|•|⟦MosswartTornShroud⟧ L|1|9.|Go in that portal and give the «Glowing Virindi Cloak» to the Virindi NPC that is standing behind the item you want to get your «Singularity Weapons¦Singularity Weapon». H3|Part 2: The Bound Weapon L|1|1.|Travel to the «Black Dominion» dungeon at 88.6S 25.9W on the South Landbridge. To get there you can take the «South Direlands Portal» west of «Mayoi» on a hill at 62.2S 77.1E. From the drop run south to the coast, then follow the shore due east to 88.6S 25.9W. L|1|2.|Inside the dungeon, go east until you come to books shelf area, go to southeast corner of the book area and down to the east. Pick the 40 resistance locked door. Go South, sticking left, until you come to a jump. Warning, there are lots of hollow minions, so if you are a mage you might want to hold a shield for this part, they are low level (level 85 Terebrous Hollow Minion) but a lot. L|1|3.|Jump down and take the hallway in the Northeast corner going East, just after you get into the hallway turn North and down where you'll jump down into a large octagon shaped room. L|1|4.|Go south down a few more jumps and you'll come to the final octagon shaped room with an exit portal and the «Virindi Castaway» NPC. Give him your singularity weapon/caster and don't move until he gives you back a Bound version. Now the item will not be destroyed on death. Take the exit portal to get out quickly.
H3|Part 3: The Ultimate Weapon L|1|1.|Travel to «Martinate Holding» at 59.6N 77.1W on the «Tuatara Plains» on northern «Marae Lassel». L|2|•|Route: Take the South wing (Annex) of the «Town Network» to «Danby's Outpost». Then go northeast past the fort and take the «Central Tuatara Plains Portal» at 23.9N 28.0W. L|1|3.|Sticking left will get you to the end of the dungeon where you'll find a virindi NPC, the «Executor Assistant». Give him your Bound Singularity weapon and he will return an Ultimate Singularity weapon. L|2|•|{OPT} Speak to the assistant to receive «A Journal by Martine».
H3|Part 4: Further Upgrading the Quest Weapon L|1|1.|Purchase a «Weapon Upgrade Kit Containment Gem» from «Colosseum Coin Collector», «Hisham al-Evv», «Panhsj», «Lintareal» or «Hurnmel the Smith». L|1|2.|Use the gem to obtain a «Weapon Upgrade Kit» (givable/tradeable) and add to the ultimate weapon to create the upgraded version.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Laedron the Geomancer tells you, "Greetings! Are you here to help reclaim the land's ley lines from the corruption of T'thuun? At the behest of our noble Queen Elysa, the mage Asheron has raised six pyramids over the most tainted ley nodes in Dereth, the sites most under the grip of the wicked creature T'thuun. These pyramids must be powered! Certain creatures found in the vicinity of those nodes sometimes bear tiny crystals of concentrated, tainted mana."⸩ ⸨Laedron the Geomancer tells you, "Bring these crystals to each of the pyramids! Once a pyramid has been sufficiently stoked by brave Derethians such as yourself, all that will be required to defeat T'thuun's power at that site is to destroy the guardian that T'thuun has stationed there... I have written a book that explains all this. I'll give you one now..."⸩ ⸨Laedron the Geomancer gives you A Field Guide to Tainted Nodes.

L|1||Esper Node Golem

These shards, filled with the power of both the Virindi and the Shadows."⸩ ⸨Ennio di Cinghalle tells you, "Given what information Guard Winterborn could provide, I was able to locate a Cave, off to the north of the Banderling-creature, where a large gathering of 'Chaos-Virindi' have gathered, and seem to be monitoring the Banderling-creature's present predicament."⸩ ⸨Ennio di Cinghalle tells you, "My job for you is simply this: Go to that cave, located at 58.6S, 81.5W and bring me back any information that you find. Do this for me, and you will be well rewarded."
L|1||Returning to Ennio⸩ ⸨Ennio di Cinghalle tells you, "Back so soon? Go to the cave at 58.6S, 81.5W and see if you can find any information of use."
L|1||Showing Virindi Message Shard⸩ ⸨You allow Ennio di Cinghalle to examine your Virindi Message Shard.⸩ ⸨Ennio di Cinghalle tells you, "What is this? Some sort of odd crystal? Ahh, I've heard of these. The Virindi use these much as we use letters."⸩ ⸨Ennio di Cinghalle tells you, "Go, get this translated, and bring it back to me. I do not have the time to deal with such things."
L|1||Handing in Virindi Message Shard to Diyas al-Yat⸩ ⸨You give Diyas al-Yat Virindi Message Shard.⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat tells you, "Fascinating..."⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat tells you, "It seems this is some sort of continuation of other experiments I've translated shards for. It seems they are trying to create some sort of penultimate creature, or something along those lines."⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat gives you Observations: Harraag.
L|1||Handing in translated text to Ennio di Cinghalle⸩ ⸨You give Ennio di Cinghalle Observations: Harraag.⸩ ⸨Ennio di Cinghalle tells you, "Ahh, the translation. Thank you for this. Here, take a copy of this for yourself, and also, the reward I've promised you."⸩ ⸨You've earned 117,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Ennio di Cinghalle gives you Observations: Harraag.⸩ ⸨Ennio di Cinghalle awards you the title, "Royal Investigator".
L|1||Returning to Ennio⸩ ⸨Ennio di Cinghalle tells you, "Thank you for your assistance. For one of the Bloodless, you have shown great skill in the face of adversity."⸩

I|Level|180 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Bemeth the Gatherer» I|Starts At|«Encampment near Neftet» at 22.2S, 6.1E I|Route|Run east from «Yaraq» or use «City of Neftet Recall». H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Kill monsters at «City of Neftet» until you find an «Ancient Tablet of the Crystal Amulet (Level 180+)¦Ancient Tablet of the Crystal Amulet» and use it so you can enter the portal (see the contract link for the list of creatures that drop it). L|2|•|⟦SandMiniThree_CanEnter_0511⟧ L|1|2.|Go to the «20.5S, 7.6E - Ancient Portal» (ground level). L|2|•|Note: don't be mistaken with another of the 4 **very** close portals of the same name (see «Catacombs»). L|1|3.|Begin killing the «Corrupt Conflagration»s inside. They will drop a «Corrupted Flame» on the ground, which will appear as a green flame. L|2|•|The «Corrupted Flame» can also spawn on the ground by itself. L|2|•|The «Corrupted Flame» will appear as a yellow NPC dot on your minimap. L|1|4.|"Using" the flames will make them disappear and you will get a message: As you reach out to touch the corrupt flames they are cleansed by the energies of the altar. First flame use will stamp you. L|2|•|⟦SandMiniThree_CrittersKilled_0511⟧ L|2|•|There is no counter, but when you have found 20 flames, you will get a different message when using the next: You reach out to touch the flames but they burn your hand. L|2|•|Though the respawn is fast, if you are with a group and in need of more Flames, use the Catacombs portal to another small dungeon with «Corrupt Conflagration»s L|1|5.|Once you have found 20 «Corrupted Flame»s, use the «Altar of the Green Crystal» inside the dungeon to receive the «Amulet of the Green Crystal». L|1|6.|Return the Amulet to «Bemeth the Gatherer». L|2|•|⟦SandMiniThree_Wait_0511⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|The «Corrupt Conflagration»s in the «21.0S, 7.5E - Ancient Portal» dungeon also leave a Flame after being killed, which gives the same message when used. It is unknown however, if these count towards the 20 total for this quest (the Altar mentions "in this place")

L|1||Altar of the Green Crystal gives you Amulet of Green Crystal. L|1||Sensing you have completed its test, the altar opens and a crystal amulet is revealed.

Quest.name: Tracing_The_Stone
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Society Rank|Adept I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Turiq al Qorra» («Celestial Hand¦CH») «Durvush the Dusty» («Eldrytch Web¦EW») «Kalal ibn Dariz» («Radiant Blood¦RB») I|Starts At|«Faction Stronghold» (east wing) I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Kill Task|Yes I|Contracts|«Contract for Stone Tracings» H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to the listed NPC in your «Faction Stronghold» to receive «Archaeologist's Tracing Paper». L|2|•|⟦TaskGrave2WallCarvingStarted⟧ L|1|2.|Head to the «Wight Barrow» (hole in the ground) on the west middle side of «Graveyard» at 65.3S, 44.6W. L|1|3.|Run to the bottom of the cave (can stick left or stick right) and you'll come to a largish room with a dead end tunnel to the south. Inside the tunnel is the «Mhoire Carved Cenotaph». Use your tracing paper on it to create an «Imprinted Archaeologist's Paper». L|2|•|Note: You must be out of attack mode to succeed in the trace. L|1|4.|Return to the NPC in your «Faction Stronghold» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦TaskGrave2WallCarvingWait⟧

H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||[Society NPC] gives you Archaeologist's Tracing Paper. L|1||[Society NPC] tells you, "Ah, are you here to prove your competence and loyalty to the rest of the Society? I have a task for you. Next to the Empyrean Graveyard, in a deep underground passage located at 65.3S, 44.6W, you will find a large chamber with a stone marker in it. The marker has strange carvings... Fascinating carvings, really." L|1||[Society NPC] tells you, "I tried to copy it myself but the light was poor and I was being menaced by undead. The undead are still likely to be there. You will have to fight your way through them to make the copy. Here, let me give you a piece of paper that you can trace the design on easily..."
H3|Speaking to NPC after Completing Task L|1||[Society NPC] tells you, "Beautiful! An expert transcription of the carving. You might have a future in archaeology, if you weren't so bent on advancing within the Society. Well done, at any rate. Let me just take that off your hands..." L|1||You hand over 1 of your Imprinted Archaeologist's Papers. L|1||[Society NPC] gives you 15 [Society] Commendation Ribbons. L|1||[Society NPC] gives you 4 [Society] Trade Tokens. L|1||[Society NPC] tells you, "If you wish to serve me again, come back in a week."
H3|Other Interactions L|1||You deftly trace the intricate design of the wall carving onto the paper that you were supplied with.

Quest.name: Tumerok_Vanguard_Outposts
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|50 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«North Vanguard Outpost» / «South Vanguard Outpost» I|Route|«Yaraq» to «Aqalah» portal at 22.4S, 0.2E (North) - «Khayyaban» to «Desert Vanguard Cottages» portal at 49.4S, 26.0E (South) I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|This quest is for the Vanguard Leader's amulet, insignia and his weapon, which is either a morningstar or crossbow depending on which outpost leader you defeat.
L|1|•|Both the insignias can be given in for experience. L|1|•|The weapons have the «Resistance Cleaving¦Cold» property.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: North Vanguard Outpost L|1|1.|To reach the «North Tumerok Vanguard Outpost» (7.5S, 0.0W) take the «Aqalah» settlement portal in «Yaraq» at 22.4S, 0.2E. L|1|2.|The leader is at the end of the dungeon and is guarded by «Tumerok Gladiator»s. To make your way to him just simply make your way north through the dungeon. You will fight «Drudge Ravener»s, «Reedshark Stalker»s and various Tumeroks including «Tumerok High Priest¦High Priests» and Gladiators along the way. L|1|3.|Kill the «Tumerok North Vanguard Leader» and take his «Vanguard Leader's Morningstar», «Vanguard Leader's Amulet» and the «Northern Tumerok Insignia». L|2|•|⟦NorthernTumerokInsignia⟧ L|2|•|⟦TumerokVanguardMorningstar⟧ L|2|•|⟦TumerokVanguardAmulet⟧ - Shared with Southern L|1|4.|Give insignia to «Ufet, Prophet of Blades» in «Zaikhal» (13.9N, 0.7E) for 5,000,000 xp.
H3|Part 2: South Vanguard Outpost L|1|1.|To reach the «South Tumerok Vanguard Outpost» (45.9S, 14.2E) take the «Desert Vanguard Cottages» portal from «Khayyaban» at 49.4S, 26.0E. L|1|2.|The south outpost has similiar creatures as the north dungeon. To reach the leader just run south through the dungeon, most side rooms just loop around to the middle passages anyway so ignore them. L|1|3.|Kill the «Tumerok South Vanguard Leader» and take his «Vanguard Leader's Crossbow», «Vanguard Leader's Amulet» and the «Southern Tumerok Insignia». L|2|•|⟦SouthernTumerokInsignia⟧ L|2|•|⟦TumerokVanguardCrossbow⟧ L|2|•|⟦TumerokVanguardAmulet⟧ - Shared with Northern L|1|4.|Give the insignia to «Ufet, Prophet of Blades» in «Zaikhal» (13.9N, 0.7E) for 5,000,000 xp.
P|Notes L|1|•|The texts, «Ardry's Reconnaissance» and «Ardry's Rant» can be found at the drops points of the north and south outposts, respectively.

Quest.name: Tunnel_of_Love_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|120 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Singularity Caul» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|«Lockpick» is not required for this quest, however, if you do have it, you can gain access to a free «Black Marrow Reliquary» chest pull.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Find a «Butterscotch Suckling» dropped by «Stalking Margul»s (rare drop). L|1|2.|Give the suckling to «Xireri» at 94.4S 96.6W on «Singularity Caul» for entrance to the «Tunnel of Love», located at 94.4S, 96.6W. L|2|•|⟦TunnelOfLove⟧ L|2|•|⟦TunnelOfLoveCoolDown⟧ L|1|3.|Once inside, the dungeon is linear. If your jump skill is high enough, you can jump from one bridge up to the next, saving you a few mob encounters. L|1|4.|Near the end of the dungeon is an «Iron Chest» containing «A Letter From the Heart». Loot it. L|2|•|⟦LetterFromHeartPickedUp⟧ L|1|5.|Bring «A Letter From the Heart» to NPC «Surloshen Realaidain» at 99.7S, 96.7W for your rewards.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Xireri pats you on the cheek, stomps its foot, and shakes its head. You surmise that such actions mean the Golem is hungry, and will only grant you access to the Tunnel of Love in exchange for a Butterscotch Suckling, which can usually be found in the possession of the Stalking Margul who occupy the eastern edges of the Singularity Caul.
L|1||Handing in "A Letter From the Heart"⸩ ⸨You give Xireri Butterscotch Suckling.⸩ ⸨Xireri bows deeply, then wiggles its hand and does a little pirouette. You surmise that such actions mean the Golem is thankful for the Butterscotch Suckling, and has now granted you access to the Tunnel of Love.
L|1||Picking up "A Letter From the Heart"⸩ ⸨From somewhere up above, you hear the grinding of stone on stone as Xireri grows angry. You feel that perhaps you will not be welcome in these tunnels again. That is, until you appease the golem with some more of that tasty Butterscotch Suckling.
L|1||Handing in "A Letter From the Heart"⸩ ⸨You give Surloshen Realaidain A Letter From the Heart.⸩ ⸨Surloshen Realaidain tells you, "This... this... this tells me nothing."⸩ ⸨Surloshen Realaidain tells you, "I see that look on your face. You think me in denial, don't you? You believe that my mother was crazy, that she obsessed over a man who did not return her affections. But don't you see? This letter proves nothing! Surely he simply refuses to take responsibility for his actions! Asheron is my father! And there is nothing you can say that will make me believe otherwise!"⸩ ⸨Surloshen Realaidain closes his eyes and slowly exhales. The shaking in his body subsides as he calms himself down.⸩ ⸨Surloshen Realaidain tells you, "I apologize. I should not have raised my voice. You have done me a great service, and for that I should reward you. Please take this helm. It is too heavy for me. My neck hurts when I wear it."⸩ ⸨You've earned 116,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Surloshen Realaidain gives you Surloshen's Helm.⸩ ⸨Surloshen Realaidain slaps himself in the face.⸩ ⸨Surloshen Realaidain says, "I told you so!"⸩

I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Ulgrim the Unappreciated» I|Starts At|«Ulgrim's Island» I|Route|Give «Drunken Madman» in «Baishi» a «Mug of Winter Lager» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Ulgrim is thirsty but can't be arsed to trek down into the basement, so he has you fetch a mug of his special brew. L|1|5.|Inside the room just before the chest room is a secret passage on the west wall with some hanging rugs behind barrels. Quest.name: Uncovering_the_Renegades
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Small Fellowship/Solo I|Starts With|«Aruq ibn Balthar» I|Starts At|«Zaikhal» at 13.4N, 0.7E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Uncovering the Renegades» H2|Overview P|«Aruq ibn Balthar», a geomantic investigator in Zaikhal, is enlisting adventurers to search a new Renegade stronghold in the Direlands.
L|1|•|Prepare to fight lots of Lugians, Tumeroks, and Virindi in the Apostate Citadel dungeon.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Aruq ibn Balthar». L|2|•|⟦UncoverRenegadesStarted0309⟧ L|1|2.|Go to the «Apostate Citadel Mines» near the «Obsidian Rim» at 48.7S, 68.9W. L|1|3.|The Mines filled with Hollow Lugians. Run to the end of the dungeon where you will find locked door and a «Gotrok Mining Foreman» who has the «Apostate Citadel Barracks Key». Get the key and unlock the Barracks Door (Lockpick Resistance 9999) then go the «Apostate Citadel Barracks» portal beyond. L|1|4.|The Barracks are full of Tumeroks. Run to the end of the dungeon where you will find a locked door and a «Hea Apostate Warlord» who has the «Apostate Citadel Headquarters Key». Get the key and unlock the Headquarters Door (Lockpick Resistance 9999) then jump **across** an acid pit right on the other side of the door. Go in the «Apostate Citadel Headquarters» portal beyond. L|1|5.|The Headquarters are full of Virindi. Run to the end of the dungeon where you will find the «Apostate Master». L|1|6.|Kill the Master and loot the «Apostate Message Shard» shard off his corpse (4 per kill). L|1|7.|Return to Zaikhal and give the Message Shard to «Diyas al-Yat» by the library for the translated «Apostate Orders». L|1|8.|Give the Apostate Orders to «Aruq ibn Balthar» your rewards and a copy of the orders. L|2|•|⟦UncoverRenegadesComplete0309⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|You can not re-enter the dungeon until the repeat timer has expired.

H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Aruq ibn Balthar tells you, "Aha! A doughty Derethian warrior! You may be just the person to help me here... There is a strange new fortified location in the Direlands, guarded by fearsome Gotrok Lugians! It is quite strange to see renegades outside their normal bailiwick in the southern mountains, and our scouts report that these monsters are even more powerful than the others of their ilk that we have previously surveyed." L|1||Aruq ibn Balthar tells you, "We suspect, based on geomantic emanations from that location, that they are working at the behest of rebel Virindi again, but we need an intrepid adventurer such as yourself to personally infiltrate the installation and gather intelligence. Could you do this for us? Journey to the depths of the new Gotrok fortress in the Direlands at 48.7S, 68.9W and bring back whatever message shards you can find. I would be in your debt, and you would not go unrewarded."
H3|Giving Apostate Message Shard to Diyas al-Yat L|1||You allow Diyas al-Yat to examine your Apostate Message Shard. L|1||Diyas al-Yat tells you, "I heard that Aruq sent you off to that new fortress in the Direlands. Is this the shard you found there? Fascinating... Let me have a look..." L|1||You hand over 1 of your Apostate Message Shards. L|1||Diyas stares into the fragment of crystal for a moment, and his eyes widen with horror. L|1||Diyas al-Yat tells you, "The Virindi rebels are gathering their allies again! They seek to step into the gap left by T'thuun's defeat! Quick, take this translation to Aruq, he will make sure the proper people are notified." L|1||Diyas al-Yat gives you Apostate Orders.
H3|Giving Apostate Orders to Aruq ibn Balthar L|1||Aruq ibn Balthar tells you, "Ah, Diyas translated the shard for you? Please hand it over, I am most curious to see what it will reveal..." L|1||You allow Aruq ibn Balthar to examine your Apostate Orders. L|1||Aruq ibn Balthar tells you, "Good work, my friend! I knew I could count on you!" L|1||Aruq takes a moment to read the translated message. L|1||You hand over 1 of your Apostate Orderss. L|1||Aruq ibn Balthar tells you, "Zounds! What a fell plot the rebel Virindi are hatching here! I am glad you were able to escape with this critical intelligence. I will send it on to my superiors on the Royal Council. No doubt they will dispatch scouts as soon as possible to comb the lands for these Nexuses they speak of. I imagine the secret societies will be quite interested in this as well... But here, here is your reward. It's something a previous visitor left here, I think you may find it useful." L|1||Aruq ibn Balthar gives you Mana Forge Key. L|1||You've earned 315,069,990 experience. L|1||You've earned 12,1719 Luminance. L|1||Aruq ibn Balthar gives you Apostate Orders. L|1||Aruq ibn Balthar tells you, "On further consideration, I should also give you a copy of this translation, for your own records... And perhaps you can help spread the word, if you belong to a secret society, that the Virindi rebels are rising to threaten Dereth again!"

Quest.name: Unleash_the_Gearknights
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Solo/Fellowship I|Starts With|«Hei Shou» I|Starts At|«Eastham» at 17.5N, 63.5E I|Route|«Town Network» north I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Unleash the Gearknights» H2|Overview P|Apostates are ambushing clockwork soldiers. «Hei Shou» has you investigate the «Gear Knight» arrival.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|After speaking with «Hei Shou», go to the «Reaving Facility» at 40.1 N, 50.9 W. L|2|•|⟦UnleashGearKnightStart0909⟧ L|2|•|Route: «Plateau Village» to «Wilomine Villas» portal at 45.4N, 42.3W. L|1|2.|The dungeon starts as an open burrow, stick to all lefts until you come to the portal. You should not need to fight. The Lugians are hollow. L|1|3.|Inside are «Apostate Servant»s and «Reaver Simulacrum»s that cast tons of war magic. Near the end is the «Apostate Reaving Master» that drops a «Arrival Chamber Key» to a door down a ramp nearby. There is a large, deep pit just past the door. Jump ACROSS the Pit! L|1|4.|Past the door is a portal to the «Arrival Chamber» where you will find several «Iron Blade Arrival Guard»s guarding the «Iron Blade Lieutenant». They are weakest to Acid. If your group is small you can use the wall near the surface portal to hide behind so you don't have to fight them all at once. You can lure the Lieutenant easily...his escort will return to their positions if you pull him from near the drop point. L|1|5.|The Lieutenant drops 9 «Aetherium Core Fragment»s. L|2|•|⟦AetheriumCoreFragmentPickupTimer⟧ L|1|6.|Give «Hei Shou» in «Eastham» the «Aetherium Core Fragment» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦UnleashGearKnightComplete0909⟧ L|2|•|{WARN} You lose your quest flag once you turn in the fragment and will not be able to reenter the dungeons. (until you get flagged again)

H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Hei Shou tells you, "Hail, friend! Are you as concerned about the Apostate Virindi threat to Dereth as I am? If you are, I would ask you to investigate a site in northwestern Osteth that seems to be the source of some very interesting energy emanations." L|1||Hei Shou tells you, "Seek the site at 40.1 N, 50.9 W, investigate it to its deepest levels, and bring me back anything interesting that you find. You will be well rewarded."
H3|Apostate Master L|1||The Apostate Master whirls to attack and screeches to its minions, "Destroy the Isparian interlopers! Keep the Arrival Chamber sealed! The Isparians must not reveal our deception!"
L|1||A shrieking sound pulses from the core of the falling Virindi. As the cloak become immobile a shrill voice sounds in your mind, "Your triumph is temporary and illusory. The mechanical soldiers have accepted our ruse!"
H3|Iron Blade Lieutenant L|1||The Gear Knight turns to attack and announces, "Isparian allies of traitor Asheron detected. Commencing combat protocol. Die, betrayers, die!"
L|1||The Gear Knight shudders to a stop and begins to rattle. In a fading voice, it intones, "Power core critically damaged, fragmenting. Protocol fails. Uploading to backup."
H3|Completing Quest L|1||Hei Shou tells you, "Fascinating! So you discovered some kind of hostile metal men in that dungeon? And they've destroyed the Apostate facility I asked you to investigate? Well, that's quite a development. I see you brought back some kind of souvenir from your excursion. I'd love to analyze it to learn more about these clockwork soldiers. May I have it? I will reward you, of course..."
L|1||You allow Hei Shou to examine your Aetherium Core Fragment. L|1||Hei Shou tells you, "A most interesting find! From what you tell me, the Apostates were ambushing these clockwork soldiers, Gear Knights as you call them, and harvesting their Aetherium for their own purposes. And to use Simulacra to do it, so the Gear Knights blamed us Isparians for it..." L|1||Hei Shou tells you, "Whatever else they are, these Apostates are very clever." L|1||You hand over all of your Aetherium Core Fragments. L|1||Hei Shou gives you Mana Forge Key. L|1||You've earned 12,000 Luminance. L|1||You've earned 396,314,475 experience. L|1||Hei Shou tells you, "I must send news to the Arcanum and to Lord Asheron, and all the royal council... What a discovery!"

Quest.name: Virindi_Rescue
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Rec. Level|200 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Omarah» I|Starts At|«Plateau Village» at 44.2N, 43.2W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Virindi Rescue» H2|Overview P|Retrieve the «Essence of Dravann» in the «Virindi Research Facility» and return it to «Omarah» in «Plateau Village».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak with «Omarah» in Plateau at 44.2N 43.2W, «Omarah» the Virindi is located in the basement of the «Agent of the Arcanum». L|2|•|⟦VirindiRescueStarted0612⟧ L|2|•|Route: From the «Town Network», take the Aluvian wing to «Plateau Village». L|1|2.|As directed by «Omarah» head to the «Virindi Research Facility» dungeon located at 43.3N, 43.7W. L|1|3.|Work your way through the dungeon freeing all the 3 «Virindi Captive»s as you proceed. L|1|4.|To Free a «Virindi Captive» kill the «Virindi Jailor» just outside the captives door and loot a «Virindi Prison Key» dropped by the «Virindi Jailor» which is used to unlock the cell doors. L|1|5.|A 2nd locked door will open **once you talk** to the freed «Virindi Captive». Ensure you use it quickly as it will close and the only way to open it is to free the «Virindi Captive» again as per the step above. L|1|6.|You will then come upon the «Virindi Keeper». Kill the «Virindi Keeper» and loot the «Virindi Research Center Key» which is dropped by the «Virindi Keeper», used to unlock the «Virindi Research Center Door». L|1|7.|Work your way through the dungeon to a ledge where you must jump down. L|1|8.|The jump down lands in the arena that has the «Curator of Torment» in it. L|1|9.|Talking to the Curator or just waiting a bit, the Curator disappears and «Dravann» the Hollow Minion spawns, alone. L|1|10.|Kill «Dravann» the Hollow Minion and loot an «Essence of Dravann». L|2|•|⟦DravannEssencePickup⟧ L|1|11.|Return the «Essence of Dravann» to «Omarah» in Plateau for your reward. L|2|•|⟦VirindiRescueCompleted0612⟧

You look brave enough to complete a task to free the ones like me; ones that have escaped the oppressing control of the Quiddity."⸩ ⸨Omarah tells you, "Rarely our kind will show signs of individual thought, signs that we have become enlightened and free from the grip of the single-minded."⸩ ⸨Omarah tells you, "See the crater to the south? A strange portal appeared recently and I can feel the call of my brethren from within. I can feel their identity being ripped away from them."⸩ ⸨Omarah tells you, "I was drawn to the portal by the voices but I saw one of the Reaver of Dreams' minions guarding the entrance, so I hid here before they discovered me and dragged me into their facility. I am too little to attempt a rescue; the Virindi within are far too powerful for me to handle by myself."⸩ ⸨Omarah tells you, "I do not know what the Reaver of Dreams is doing in there, but it can't be good and we must put a stop to this evil."⸩ ⸨Omarah tells you, "Free any of the enlightened within and slay the one in charge. This will not stop the Reaver, no, but it will show that we will not crumble to their will."⸩ ⸨Omarah tells you, "Return to me when you have put an end to their experiments and I will reward you."

With your assistance we can defeat the Curator."⸩ ⸨Virindi Captive tells you, "Venture further, release any that are enlightened beyond the Quiddity and together we will end this oppression!"⸩ ⸨Virindi Captive tells you, "I have sensed this time approaching. It possesses a key which unlocks the way to the Curator. Kill this Keeper and take the key."⸩ ⸨A strange sound eminates from the Virindi for a moment.⸩ ⸨Virindi Captive tells you, "We are ready."⸩ ⸨Virindi Captive tells you, "We are weakened from the Reavers' experiments but this will not hinder the enlightened from joining with you on the final assault. We will fight to the death for our freedom and to stop the Reaver's plan."⸩ ⸨Virindi Captive tells you, "This ends today!"
L|1||Curator of Torment⸩ ⸨Curator of Torment says, "This cannot be! Fleshlings? L|1||T'ing Douzen gives you 2 Adventurer's Tokens.

Quest.name: Asheron's_Departure_Lower
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|15-79 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|N/A I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|This guide briefly explains how to get characters level 15-79 to be flagged to use the «Portal to Bur». For more details, see the individual quest guides linked to in the walk through. For information on flagging for characters level 80 and above, see «Asheron's Departure».
P|The notes you receive from these quests contain hints for the flagging for higher level characters.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|As part of the «Dagger of Tikola Quest», obtain the «Ancient Shard of Metal» and present it to «Felscuda». She will give you the «Ruminations on Portal Creation». L|2|•|⟦BurFlagged(Metal)⟧ L|1|2.|As part of the «Mountain Sewer Quest», obtain the «Inscribed Purple Gem» and present it to «Bretself the Translator». He will give you the «Letter to Bretself the Translator». L|2|•|⟦BurFlagged(Gem)⟧ L|1|3.|As part of the «Metos Motes» quest, obtain «Metos Pyreal Mote»s and present them to the «Golem Warden of Metos». It will give you «Ruminations and Warnings on Portal Creation». L|2|•|⟦BurFlagged(Motes)⟧ L|1|4.|Obtaining all three of these notes flags your character to use the «Portal to Bur». L|2|•|{WARN} Only characters level 1-79 can be flagged this way. Once flagged, it is permanent. You **do not** need to complete «Asheron's Departure» at level 80.
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Folthid Cellar» 8.6S, 52.9E -- «map:013B¦013B» TR|«Mountain Sewer» 29.8S 93.9E -- «map:0191¦0191» TR|«Halls of Metos» 56.0S, 89.2W (Ayan Baqur) 61.4S, 46.6W (Wai Jhou) 4.4S, 0.6W (Tufa) -- «map:02F3¦02F3» TE
H2|Rewards
R|Obtain all three notes RE
R|Give the «Ancient Shard of Metal» to «Felscuda» RK|Experience|135,000 (135% up to level 16) RE
R|Give the «Inscribed Purple Gem» to «Bretself the Translator» RK|Experience|2,300,000 (100% up to level 40) RE
R|Metos Motes (First Mote) RK|Experience|1,317,983 (25% up to level 50) RE
R|Metos Motes (Second Mote) RK|Experience|2,899,563 (55% up to level 50) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Handing in Ancient Shard of Metal to Felscuda⸩ ⸨You give Felscuda Ancient Shard of Metal.⸩ ⸨You've earned 135,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Felscuda gives you Ruminations on Portal Creation.⸩ ⸨Felscuda tells you, "Where did you find this? From the cellar? But how...this bodes ill..."⸩ ⸨Felscuda tells you, "I shall tell you what I know - what I truly know, that is. The cellar you have exited leads into what remains of a Falatacot ruin."⸩ ⸨Felscuda tells you, "That is right - I know of the Falatacot, and I've studied much more than I make Lady Folthid or passers-by aware of. It is no accident that Lady Folthid's house was built here. I suggested it, at the advice of...another patron. I remain in service here secretly - but as Lady Folthid, being a noble, might talk to other powerful individuals, I have only revealed myself to you as you are not so powerful, yet. Please keep my secret."⸩ ⸨Felscuda tells you, "Since the house was built, I have watched for signs of activity from the cellar. It has been quiet, but this device indicates new activity."⸩ ⸨Felscuda tells you, "Someone has attempted to use it recently - I can tell by the small tarnish here, which indicates that a surge of portal magic enveloped the device. However, whatever magic was attempted did not work. This is but a fragment of the entire device, and the device would have needed to be whole in order to work properly."⸩ ⸨Felscuda tells you, "If I were to guess, I would say that there was a faction of Falatacot somewhere doing something - I am sorry I cannot be more specific."⸩ ⸨Felscuda tells you, "Someone should find Asheron and inform him...but he has not been seen in so long. This note may help. It was research he was conducting shortly before he left. May it be of use to you."
L|1||Handing in Inscribed Purple Gem to Bretself the Translator⸩ ⸨You give Bretself the Translator Inscribed Purple Gem.⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator gives you Trade Note (10,000).⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,300,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "I am surprised I have been seeing these in circulation. Can you keep a secret?"⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "At one point a few years ago, I was honored to receive a letter from Asheron himself, through Scholar Antius Blackmoor. I was flattered to have received it, but what he asked me was unusual."⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "He wished that I would watch out for anyone bearing these gems. If the person seemed powerful enough that they might know how to use them, I am to plead ignorance. I do not think you are, however."⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator gives you Letter to Bretself the Translator.⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "Therefore, I shall tell you - they are from a hidden cache that Asheron stored in the mountains, for use in portal creation. I am not certain precisely where he intended to open a portal to, but the gems were to be a power source. The inscription reads, simply, "Property of Asheron Realaidain," nothing more."⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "I shall share with you the letter I received. Perhaps it will tell you more about the gem and its uses. I'll also give you this trade note as payment for the gem - I am supposed to retain them, but I can at least offer you fair market value for them."
L|1||Handing in Metos Pyreal Motes to Golem Warden of Metos⸩ ⸨You give Golem Warden of Metos Pyreal Mote.⸩ ⸨You've earned 1,317,983 experience.⸩ ⸨The golem speaks in a low, gravelly, regulated voice.⸩ ⸨Golem Warden of Metos tells you, "My power level has reached half. If you supply me with a mote from the Halls of Metos in the southwestern part of Ireth Lassel, I should be able to fully serve you."⸩ ⸨You give Golem Warden of Metos Pyreal Mote.⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,899,563 experience.⸩ ⸨The golem speaks in a normal voice - perhaps Empyrean by its accent.⸩ ⸨Golem Warden of Metos tells you, "For you who have come this far, I leave a message. Your diligence is appreciated, even applauded, but you should not attempt to reconstruct the portal to Bur. I have learned only too well the risks associated with opening portals to other worlds, and alloing them to remain open. It is better if my portal remains closed. I should be able to repoen it when it is time for me to return. At this point, I shall hopefully have with me a solution to the Burun problem."⸩ ⸨Golem Warden of Metos tells you, "Also, I imagine that Metos would have appreciated if I mention that there are no inactive golems available for you. Unfortunately, I required the last one for the portal ritual."⸩ ⸨A piece of paper is ejected from the golem slowly, which you take.⸩ ⸨Golem Warden of Metos gives you Ruminations and Warnings on Portal Creation.⸩

Quest.name: Assault_Quest_(Expert)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|100 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Tirenia» I|Starts At|42.1N, 33.7E in «Holtburg» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Assault (Expert)» H2|Overview P|"One of the Queen's hidden vaults has been assaulted. Find the object the creatures were after and bring it to Tirenia."
L|1|•|The Tursh Totem quest has 4 different defiled temples. Each temple has pretty much the exact same layout, the only difference being the creatures and some of the rewards for finishing them. There are no upper restrictions on the temples and they all reward you with a «Replica of a Tursh Totem» on completion.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak with «Tirenia» at 42.1N, 33.7E in «Holtburg» to begin. L|1|2.|Enter the «Defiled Temple Asylum» at 77.8N, 32.8E. L|2|•|Note: If your mansion already has a «Replica of a Tursh Totem» portal device, this is the easiest way to the dungeon (drops at 77.2N, 32.6E). If you do not have the mansion item available, take the Plateau portal from the Town Network [Aluvian], then take the Zatara portal at (45.3N 42.3W). L|1|3.|Jump down into the pit and kill the spirits until you receive a message about feeling "changed". L|2|•|⟦AssaultVaultAccessGranted0105⟧ - Shared with all Versions L|1|4.|Run back up the ramp and enter the «Fortified Vault Sewers» portal. L|1|5.|Work your way through this mostly linear dungeon (see map), until you reach the «Fortified Royal Vault» portal. L|1|6.|Work your way to the end of the dungeon, kill the «Shadow Annihilator (Fortified Royal Vault)¦Shadow Annihilator», and loot a «Tursh Totem Shard (100+)¦Tursh Totem Shard» from its corpse. L|2|•|⟦ShardTurshTotemAssaultUberAcquired0105⟧ L|1|7.|Return the Tursh Totem Shard to «Tirenia» at 42.1N, 33.7E in Holtburg for your reward. L|2|•|⟦TurshTotemUberComplete_0511⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Defiled Temple Asylum» 77.8N, 32.8E -- «map:000A¦000A» TR|«Fortified Vault Sewers» 77.8N, 32.8E -- «map:000F¦000F» TR|«Fortified Royal Vault» 77.8N, 32.8E -- «map:0014¦0014» TE
H2|Rewards
R|Hand in «Tursh Totem Shard (100+)» RK|Experience|79,000,000 (Fixed% up to level ) RK|Items| RI|«Royal Oil» RI|«Replica of a Tursh Totem» RI|«Trade Note (250,000)» (x3) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Tirenia tells you, "Please, the Queen is in dire need of your assistance! A group of creatures recently assaulted one of the Queen's hidden vaults. The few guards who were able to escape told me that these creatures were after some sort of artifact."⸩ ⸨Tirenia tells you, "These vaults house numerous objects of immense power. Whoever these invaders are, we cannot allow them to obtain that which they seek. I need you to infiltrate the vault and repel the interlopers. If you happen upon the object they are after, return it to me."⸩ ⸨Tirenia tells you, "These creatures cut off surface access to the vaults. You will have to enter the sewers beneath in order to break in. Access to the sewers can be found in an old temple at 77.2N, 33.0E. Be sure to take reinforcements with you. These beasts assaulted our vaults in great numbers."
L|1||Royal Guard (In Royal Vaults)⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "The Queen dispatched a force of Guards to explore the shores of Northern Osteth. It was then that the Shadows struck. They took us completely by surprise. We are mostly new recruits here. I fear we are not quite up to this challenge."⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "I don't understand. The force is comprised of Shadows, Drudges, and Virindi. And a Lugian leads them all. Is there some new alliance here that we haven't heard of?"⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "They're after the Tursh Totem! You have to get in there and take it from them. The Queen would rather the totem be destroyed than it fall into the hands of the Shadow."⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "Where did you come from? I thought all access to the surface was cut off."⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "You bear the stench of the sewers on you. Perhaps your stink will drive them off!"⸩ ⸨You allow Royal Guard to examine your Tursh Totem Shard.⸩ ⸨Royal Guard tells you, "Excellent! But can we be sure the totem was completely destroyed? Anyway, you have done your part in this battle. Take this shard to Tirenia in Holtburg."
L|1||Handing in Tursh Totem (100+)⸩ ⸨You allow Tirenia to examine your Tursh Totem Shard.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Tursh Totem Shards.⸩ ⸨You've earned 79,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Tirenia gives you Replica of a Tursh Totem.⸩ ⸨Tirenia gives you Royal Oil.⸩ ⸨Tirenia gives you 3 Trade Notes (250,000).⸩ ⸨Tirenia tells you, "The Tursh Totem. If they had escaped with this object..."⸩ ⸨Tirenia tells you, "You have done our Queen a great service. I am only sorry that the totem had to be destroyed in the process. Still, that is better than the alternative."⸩ ⸨Tirenia tells you, "You deserve a reward for your heroic actions. Please take this replica as a show of our gratitude."
L|1||Reward Interactions⸩ ⸨You allow Tirenia to examine your Replica of a Tursh Totem.⸩ ⸨Tirenia tells you, "This is a reward for the service you have done our Queen. We are in your debt."⸩ ⸨You allow Tirenia to examine your Royal Oil.⸩ ⸨Tirenia tells you, "This is a reward for the service you have done our Queen. We are in your debt."⸩

Quest.name: Bobo's_Medicine
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 | Recommended Level = 125+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Jilna Fullgood» I|Starts At|2.0N 95.6E in «Oolatanga's Refuge» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Bobo's Medicine» H2|Overview P|Help stop Bobo feeling sick from the Death Blossom by bringing him some «King's Crown Infusion».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Jilna will ask you to retrieve some more King's Crown from the base of a giant tree overlooking the «Chapel of Xi Ru». There is also a way that requires no flagging, talk to the «Watcher of the Dead» in «Ayan Baqur» at 60.1S 88.1W. L|1|2.|Run west then north along the beach until you get to the Moarsmen Encampment at 88.6S 85.8E. From there, head south up the mountain all the way up to the «Deru Tree of Xi Ru's Island» at 89.8S 87.4E and take one of the «King's Crown» water lilies growing at the base of the tree. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpKingsCrown⟧ L|1|3.|Take the «King's Crown» to «Jilna Fullgood» at 2.0N 95.6E in «Oolatanga's Refuge» on «Aphus Lassel». She gives you the «King's Crown Infusion». L|1|4.|Give the «King's Crown Infusion» to «Bobo», see «The Legend of the Tusker Paw» for details on reaching him. L|2|•|**Leaftide Route**: Sub > AC Storage > Throneroom of the Tusker King L|2|•|⟦DeliveredCureBobo_0807⟧ L|2|•|{OPT} Before heading to «Bobo», pick a «Jungle Orchid» from outside the «Tusker Lacuna» dungeon at 9.9S, 90.7E. Various creatures (see «Jungle Orchid») will spawn when you do, which will drop the trophy version. The orchid can be given to «Kleeoh» (2.5S 86.5E) for experience.
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.
P|See «The Legend of the Tusker Paw» for details on reaching «Bobo».
H2|Rewards

R|Give the «Jungle Orchid» to «Kleeoh». RK|Experience|13,782,125 (10% up to level 120) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Jilna Fullgood tells you, "Now that King Oolutanga is free of Mudmouth's hold I can treat him for the Jungle Orchid poison Mudmouth gave him. It's amazing he survived really. That much poison would have killed any normal Tusker. To create more of the potion he needs I'll need more King's Crown."⸩ ⸨Jilna Fullgood tells you, "You can find the King's Crown water lily at the base of a giant tree overlooking the Chapel of Xi Ru on the last of the Vesayen Islands. Be careful, I hear it is protected by Moarsmen."⸩ ⸨Jilna Fullgood tells you, "Oh, if you are able to find and destroy Mudmouth, I have been honored by Oolutanga to reward you in exchange for any befouled treasures he may have wrought."
L|1||Showing a Jungle Orchid to Jilna Fullgood⸩ ⸨You allow Jilna Fullgood to examine your Jungle Orchid.⸩ ⸨Jilna Fullgood tells you, "It always amazes me how something so delicate and beautiful can also be so deadly."⸩ ⸨Jilna Fullgood tells you, "Take this to Kleeoh. She'll know what to do with it."
L|1||Handing in Jungle Orchid to Kleeoh⸩ ⸨You give Kleeoh Jungle Orchid.⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "Dis for Kleeoh? Dis be a beautiful flower, no?"⸩ ⸨Kleeoh, pauses a moment and stares into you with her piercing dark eyes.⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "Haha, you not here to do me evil. You want someting I think..."⸩ ⸨Kleeoh smiles at you for a moment.⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "You know about dis flower? Dis be a Death Blossom. Very beautiful, very dangerous!"⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "You breath too much of its perfume and you go all weak like a baby. You no move for hours you so tired."⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "Now, you fool enough to lick a petal and you be dead before your head touch ground. Very powerful poison!"⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "Dat Mudmouth was usin dis flower to make da Tusker King sick."⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "I hear Jilna be makin powerful maka to for him now."⸩ ⸨Kleeoh tells you, "I have need of dis flower for my magics. I tink you will find dis fair payment."⸩ ⸨Kleeoh holds up a palm with white powder and blows it into your eyes.⸩ ⸨You've earned experience.
L|1||Handing in King's Crown to Jilna Fullgood⸩ ⸨You give Jilna Fullgood King's Crown.⸩ ⸨Jilna Fullgood tells you, "Yes, this looks perfect."⸩ ⸨Jilna places the white petals of the flower into a mortar and sprinkles a number of dried herbs over it. She then uses her pestle to grind the ingredients together and adds the resulting powder to a potion of blue liquid. The potion fizzes and its blue color swirls to a pearlescent white.⸩ ⸨Jilna Fullgood tells you, "Excellent, take this potion to Oolutanga and see that he drinks the whole thing."⸩ ⸨Jilna Fullgood gives you King's Crown Infusion.
L|1||Handing in King's Crown Infusion to Oolutanga, the Tusker King⸩ ⸨You give Oolutanga, the Tusker King King's Crown Infusion.⸩ ⸨Oolutanga, the Tusker King tells you, "I Oolutanga thank you. It isn't easy to make decisions for the betterment of all tuskers when Oolutanga, who is me, is sleepy."⸩ ⸨Oolutanga gurgles the potion down and a wide smile spreads across his face as he smacks his lips noisily. His eyes shine with a renewed brightness.⸩ ⸨Oolutanga, the Tusker King tells you, "You who are not Oolutanga have done well for a non-tusker. I will show you how I make other Tuskers smart like me, Oolutanga."⸩ ⸨Oolutanga leans forward and hits you on the head with his giant stone hand. You feel a flood of awareness spread from the lump he made.⸩ ⸨You've earned experience.⸩
H2|Trivia L|1|•|When this quest was first introduced, a character had to first be flagged to pick up a King's Crown. This was achieved by speaking with «Jilna Fullgood» (originally located in the Tusker Emporium), who asked you to find a «Jungle Orchid» and then bring it to «Kleeoh». Giving Kleeoh the Jungle Orchid (also known as Death Blossom) gave a hint on where to find a cure.
P|⸨Oolutanga, the Tusker King tells you, "Oolutanga so tired..."⸩ ⸨Mudmouth tells you, "Go and prove your valor to our King by beating his most valued warrior to a pulp."

Quest.name: Buadren_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|50 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Danby's Outpost» / «Neydisa Castle» I|Repeat|None H2|Overview L|1|•|Part of this quest involves crafting steps for some of the items. However, there is no skill check for these steps and therefore can be carried out by any character.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Kill «Fire Shreth»s, and loot a «Fire Shreth Hide». L|2|•|Tip: Fire Shreths can be found in the area sorrounding «Danby's Outpost» and «Neydisa Castle». L|1|2.|Use a «Noodle Cutter» on the hide to create «Leather Straps». L|1|3.|Kill «Ebon Mattekar»s, and loot a «Ebon Mattekar Hide». L|2|•|Tip: «Ebon Mattekar»s are found in the mountain range between «Linvak Tukal» and «Qalabar». High numbers can also be found on «Traitor's Island». L|1|4.|Hand the hide to «Aun Tikakhe», and you'll recieve «Tanning Oil». Use this oil on the hide to create a «Tanned Mattekar Hide». L|2|•|Route: To reach Aun Tikakhe at the «Aun Settlement», either use a «Celdiseth's Portal Gem» or take the «Dagger Vale» portal east of «Arwic» at 32.9N 59.4E, and then run west to 82.7N 21.0E. L|1|5.|Kill «Mighty Oak Golem»s, and loot a «Tree Trunk». L|2|•|Tip: «Mighty Oak Golem»s can be found in the north of «Osteth», the area around the Aun Settlement is a good area. L|1|6.|Use a «Whittling Knife» to make it into a «Hollowed-Out Tree Trunk». L|1|7.|Combine the items: use the tanned hide on the trunk, then add the straps to create «Wrapped Hollowed-Out Tree Trunk». L|1|8.|Give the resulting «Buadren (Quest Item)¦Buadren» to «Aun Tikakhe» so he can add the spell "Heart of Oak" and the Buadren can be weilded. L|2|•|⟦BuadrenInvokingGiven⟧
H3|Upgrading the Buadren to an Invoker P|See «Invoker Quest» for more details.
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.
H2|Rewards H3|Items L|1|•|«Buadren»
H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Aun Tikakhe tells you, "When Aulakhe first came and told me he was leaving Timaru, I knew I could not let him go alone. We have journeyed across the breadth of Dereth on our quest, and I have seen much that could be used to create semblances of the items we had back on Palenqual. L|1||Aun Tikakhe tells you, "In the days since we have settled here, even more powerful spirits than before have pledged their aid in the creation of the Buadrens much like the one you see in my hands. L|1||Aun Tikakhe tells you, "The great Aualuan Kenchaua has sent word from the mountains of the south that Ebon Mattekar pledged his hides to form Buadren's head. L|1||Aun Tikakhe tells you, "Fire Shreth from the plains of the north has pledged his hides to form Buadren's sinews. L|1||Aun Tikakhe tells you, "As we finally settled here, near the akiekie of Aula's new ani, Ispar Celdisethaua, Mighty Oak promised his limbs to form Buadren's body. L|1||Aun Tikakhe tells you, "Once you assemble these three gifts, give the hide of Ebon Mattekar to me. I will inspect it for its imperfections--if it is perfect, I will give you a fragrant oil brought from Timaru to tan it into a supple drumskin. Tanae speed your hunt, friend."
H3|Showing Ebon Mattekar Hide L|1||You allow Aun Tikakhe to examine your Ebon Mattekar Hide L|1||Tikakhe inspects the hide for any small imperfections and finds none L|1||Aun Tikakhe tells you, "This hide will do nicely to create a drumhead for your buadren. Use this Tanning Oil on it to make it into a suitable leather. Once you complete your drum, give it to me and I will enjoin Mighty Oak to infuse it with his keh. L|1||Aun Tikakhe gives you Tanning Oil.
H3|Handing in Buadren L|1||You give Aun Tikakhe Buadren L|1||Tikakhe slowly turns the buadren over in his hands, inspecting every detail L|1||Aun Tikakhe tells you, "The spirits of this land are indeed generous. I could not have made a better buadren myself. Wait one moment, while I invoke the keh of Mighty Oak. L|1||Beating gently upon the buadren, Tikakhe slowly murmurs a prayer to the anima of his choosing. A quiet descends upon the forest, and the trees themselves bend to listen to Tikakhe's call. Abruptly, a soft glow permeates the drum, one that is gone as suddenly as it came L|1||Aun Tikakhe tells you, "A last tale to tell before my work is done: I must tell you that this was merely a test, to prove to us that you are the warrior that we have journeyed from Palenqual to find. Aun Aulakhe's has undertaken a grave mission for our people, and we shall not return to our beloved Timaru until it is accomplished. Speak to him now--I will let him know that you have been chosen. L|1||Aun Tikakhe pauses a moment to take you into his confidence L|1||Aun Tikakhe tells you, "Although he is still young and untested, my heart believes Aulakhe is destined one day to become the most gifted of our Aulauan, surpassing even his father, Shimauri. You would do well to guard this buadren safely--there may come a time when Aulakhe may be able to enhance it once more. L|1||Aun Tikakhe gives you Buadren.

Quest.name: Burun_Raids
Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|Quest / area I|QB|2 stamps H2|Summary L|1|•|Burun raiding parties attack various towns during the «Mired Hearts» event. L|1|•|The attacks were led by either Ruuk Shamans or «Jorgluuk». On death they dropped «Burun Idol»s and also triggered a global message. The Idols were droppable on death but could be handed into «Translator Aun Laokhe» in Arwic to remove the drop on death property,; however, no real use has ever been found for the Idols other than a housing item.
L|1|•|During the raids, «Bleeargh» the mosswart would appear in various towns south east of «Osteth» to trade salvage with players so he could make new clothing and build new homes after they were destroyed by the Burun. L|1|•|If you traded with him he gave you a «Mosswart Thanking Stone» and other items such as armor, peas and pyreals. L|1|•|Shortly after completing the trade Burun creatures would attack and attempt to kill Bleeargh. If he was succesfully protected more rewards were handed out to players, if he was killed you could loot a «Mosswart Mourning Stone» from his corpse. L|1|•|Most of the time his death was caused by unscrupulous players that chose to kill him, sometimes even after he had handed out gifts, this also triggered a Burun attack. L|1|•|The Mosswart Thanking Stones could also be taken to «Aun Laokhe» to earn the title of Diplomat. The Mourning Stones that were shown to him, however, were simply met with anger and no reward.
L|1|•|See «Bleeargh's Gratitude» for his current active quest.

Quest.name: Caul_Flagging
Quest.notes: do this and then immediately go get the caul recall
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|50 | Recommended Level = 80+ I|Type|Small Fellowship I|Starts At|«Singularity Bore» at 64.1S, 63.8W I|Route|From an accessible allegiance «Mansion», use a «Dangerous Portal Device» until you reach the centre of the «Obsidian Plains». I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Overview L|1|•|Singularity Bore flags you to be able to use the portal to Singularity Caul. Flagging consists of killing The Guardian of the Singularity. There are 4 possible routes to different Guardians. L|1|•|The number of chain casting enemies can become overwhelming if you are not near maxxed magic defense. One way to accomplish this quest easily if your buffed magic defense is already around 250 to use a magic defense rare boosting magic defense to approximately 500. Almost no spells will get through a magic defense of 500 which makes killing the Guardian a matter of finishing before the 15 minutes on the rare are up.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|You need to obtain the kill on the «Guardian of the Singularity» to be flagged for «Caul». There are 4 Guardians available in the dungeon. L|1|2.|From drop, go S and jump down a pit (two traps, a mana blight and a lightning bolt one) L|1|3.|After the jump, go either W or E, next either N or S. At the end, each room will hold a Guardian. L|1|4.|The shortest run is to go W, next S. Enemies in the Southwest route consist of «Drudge Bloodletter»s, «Ascendant Drudge»s, and various high level virindi. L|1|5.|Kill the «Guardian of the Singularity», and loot the «Quintessence Sickle» from his corpse. L|2|•|⟦VirindiIsland⟧ L|2|•|⟦VirindiAxe⟧ L|1|6.|Once the guardian is dead you are flagged after you get the «#Dialog¦message» about only opening the path to your doom. L|1|7.|You can now access «Singularity Caul» from the hall north of the dungeon drop. For the Caul island recall spell complete the «Singularity Recall» quest.
