Quest.name: Celestial_Hand_Initiation
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Kirina of the Celestial Hand» I|Starts At|«Hebian-To» at 39.7S, 83.6E I|Repeat|Non Repeatable I|Quest Chain|Joining a Society I|1|«Investigating the Societies» I|2|Celestial Hand Initiation H2|Overview
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|In order to start this quest, you must have completed the «Investigate the Factions» quest, which allows you to preview each faction. Once you have decided to join the «Celestial Hand», this quest will make you a member.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Kirina of the Celestial Hand» in «Hebian-to». L|1|2.|Get «Corrupted Mana Shard» L|2|•|Leaftide Experience L|3|1.|Go to Sub > AC Storage and use the pedestal. L|2|•|Retail Experience L|3|1.|Head to the «Corrupted Catacombs» at 23.9S, 54.1E near «Sawato». If you will be taking a group, you can tie to «Empyrean Foundry» at 25.1S 54.1E to make a much shorter run. L|3|2.|The place is somewhat of a maze so you might have to backtrack. Run through the dungeon (look for down ramps) until you find a «Slimy Key» on the ground in a room with pillars. The route from the drop is straight at first intersection, right on next, then left. Keep right hand rule until a ramp down into a room with pillars, and go left (South) here and more ramps down. Next intersection go right, and on the floor is the key. L|3|3.|From here head back up in the dungeon and look for a locked door (660 diff). The door isn't far past a surface portal in the area with Sclavus. If you have run through the «Swamp Ruin» portal, it might be easier to recall and re-enter the dungeon. The route from the drop is straight at first intersection, right on next, then left. Keep right hand rule until a ramp down into a room with pillars, and go straight (West) here into the sclavus part. From there, go right at next intersection and down, once you find the portal in a pillar room, go straight (West) and there is the door. L|3|4.|Once through the door, grab the «Corrupted Mana Shard» from the pedestal. L|1|3.|Return the shard to «Kirina of the Celestial Hand» to be initiated into the «Celestial Hand» faction. L|1|4.|Use the «Initiate's Treasure Key» to loot one of the four chests inside the «Celestial Hand Stronghold» («Armor Quartermaster's Chest», «Equipment Quartermaster's Chest», «Weapon Quartermaster's Chest», «Researcher's Chest»).
P|Notes L|1|•|The «Corrupted Mana Shard» will only last 1 hour before turning to dust so you must hand it in to «Kirina of the Celestial Hand» within 1 hour of picking it up. L|1|•|Once initiated, you can now use the portal to the «Celestial Hand Stronghold» located next to Kirina.

H4|Superb Imprinting Mote (Level 100+) L|1|1.|Go to the «Ancient Masonry» dungeon on «Aerlinthe Island», and get a «Superb Imprinting Mote» near the end of that dungeon. Quest.name: Crystalline_Bound_Wisp
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|50 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Crystalline Crag» at 15.8S, 61.9W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Crystalline Bound Wisp» H2|Overview P|Display your jumping prowess by travelling from platform to platform in search of the elusive «Bound Wisp».
L|1|•|You will need a resonably high jump skill to complete this quest. 325-330 minimum, but 400+ suggested.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|From the «Crystalline Crag» portal drop, run to 15.8S, 61.9W where the floating platforms start. L|1|2.|Use a full power jump to reach the first platform. L|1|3.|Tap jump from two large platforms in close proximity to each other. L|1|4.|Use a full power jump to reach the large platform below. L|1|5.|Shift-jump to small platforms that fade in out, but do not jump onto the parts which do not fade as they are ethereal and you fall straight through them. Shift jumps may be at 2/3rds power depending on your jump skill. L|1|6.|Use a full power jump to reach the hilltop with the «Crystal (Marker)¦Crystal Marker» (see «Crystalline Markers» quest) on it. L|1|7.|The jump from the Marker Crystal hilltop to the next large platform can be made directly. When facing the target platform, stand against the left edge of the hilltop about 1/3rd of the way down from the top (behind you). Full power long-jump should get you on to the platform (depending on your jump skill). L|1|8.|Finally, use a full power jump to reach the «Bound Wisp». L|1|9.|Use the Bound Wisp to receive the reward and a portal back to the Resonant Portal drop on the Crag. L|2|•|⟦crystallineboundwisp⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.

Quest.name: Dark_Isle_Flagging
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Lanaith» I|Starts At|70.4N, 50.5E near «Bandit Castle» I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Overview P|**Dark Isle Quest - 150 Flagging**
P|This is a simple quest that gives access to «Dark Isle» for the first time and flags you to use the Dark Isle portal on the east end of «Vissidal».
L|1|•|You must have completed the «Gateway to the Deep» before attempting this quest. L|1|•|If you are planning to do this solo, using a weapon with a high melee bonus comes in handy when running through. The «Mukkir» all ignore shields but do use «War Magic», so wielding a magic absorbing shield such as the «Sanguinary Aegis» will help.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to «Lanaith» at 70.4N, 50.5E. This will flag you to enter the «Deep Mukkir Nest» on «Vissidal». L|2|•|Route 1: From «Arwic», take the «Norvale» Settlement Portal at 33.0N, 59.4E. From Norvale, run southwest. L|2|•|Route 2: Run north from «Bandit Castle».
L|2|•|⟦StartDarkIsleFlag⟧ L|1|1.|Make your way to «Vissidal». L|2|•|Route 1: From «Cragstone», take the «Haliana» Settlement Portal. From Haliana, run southeast to the Vissidal portal at 70.2N, 65.6E. L|2|•|Route 2: Recall to Vissidal (if tied there), or use a «Vissidal Island Portal Gem». L|1|2.|Run north from the Vissidal portal drop point and Enter the «Deep Mukkir Nest» at 81.0N 59.3E. The dungeon is practically linear, and symmetrical for most of its path (see map). L|1|3.|Kill the «Fanatical Mukkir Ward Guardian» and loot the «Locked Gate Key» to unlock the door and continue to the end. L|2|•|Note that the door closes quickly. L|1|4.|Destroy the «Dark Crystal Spire», and enter the portal that appears. This drops you on «Dark Isle», and flags you to use the «Vissidal Portal to Dark Isle¦Dark Isle portal on Vissidal Island». L|2|•|The portal spawned by the Spire needs to be double clicked to be used. L|2|•|⟦DarkIsleFlagged⟧

L|1||Lanaith tells you, "My Master has located a nest of Mukkir on Vissidal Isle, near that village of strange Merwarts. He believes they are the ones holding the Wards in place. Quest.name: Eleonora's_Heart_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} «Grand Mother» I|Starts At|{OPT} 87.4N, 70.5W in «Silyun» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Quest Chain|Joining the Whispering Blade I|1|Eleonora's Heart Quest I|2|«Knights of Karlun Quest» I|3|«Marauder's Lair Quest» I|4|«Shade Iron» I|5|«Whispering Blade Chapterhouse Access» I|6|«Pheraion's Sanctum Quest» (optional) I|7|«Tracking Grael» H2|Overview P|This is the first quest in the «Whispering Blade» quests line.

She led our people to many great victories in the war against Varicci. But her skill was not enough to hide her from the King's vengeance forever."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "Before the Fiun barrier was dropped - before we even knew of the existence of lifestones - Eleonora fell in battle against Varicci himself."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "He took her to his torture chamber and murdered the poor girl. H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|•|Make sure everyone from your fellow has a «Harbinger Quest¦Harbinger Item» before starting.
H3|Step 1: The Tunnels L|1|1.|From «Yanshi», run to either «Issk» at 12.9S, 46.5E or «Vincadi» at 12.6S 46.7E. L|2|•|Note: Each NPC offers the same quest, however the lore is different for each. Flagging with one will prevent you from accessing the other, so be sure your whole group flags with the same NPC. L|2|•|{TIP} Soft tie to the surface portal at 13.0S, 47.3E for convenience. If you die, you'll want an easy way to get back quickly. L|1|2.|When your group is ready, everyone should hand their «Harbinger Items» to the NPC (either «Issk» or «Vincadi») and then use the nearby «Tunnels to the Harbinger (Issk)¦Tunnels to the Harbinger» portal to begin. L|2|•|**Shared with all versions:** ⟦EnterHarbingerIssk⟧ or ⟦EnterHarbingerVincadi⟧ L|2|•|Note: If you are already flagged to enter the dungeon you do not need to turn in an item before doing the quest. You can do the quest then find the item for the skill you want afterward. Also even if you have never done the quest before and you are not flagged to enter you may hand in any Harbinger item (a common one like a «Wood Heart») then after the quest is done find the item for the skill you really want and hand that in then talk to the NPC. You will be rewarded based on the last item you turn in to the NPC before talking to them. L|1|3.|Once inside, the dungeon is linear to the bottom (keep heading down). The only obstacles are a series of 4 jumps that must be made. L|1|4.|Choosing Vincadi means you fight through Sclavi and tentacles on the way down. Choosing Issk means you fight Virindi and Tentacles. L|2|•|**Jump 1: Acid Pit** - Full jump ahead (land on invisible platform). Hit the far wall. L|2|•|**Jump 2: Lava Pit** - Jump into the pit and take the hallway out. L|2|•|**Jump 3: Ice Shelf ** - Shift-jump down onto the platform above the ice shelf, clear the spawn, and wait for your group. L|2|•|**Jump 4: Ice/Acid Pit Combo** - Dispell, then shift Jump down onto the ice shelf and **quicky** run to the edge and full jump across the acid pit (land on invisible platform). Hit the far wall, preferrably above the door. The ice hurts, so be quick. L|2|•|**Jump 5: Staging Area** - Shift jump down and quickly move to the south (near the portals). L|1|5.|At this point, everyone should check buffs, and when ready, use the «Harbinger's Lair» portal to begin the fight. L|2|•|⟦HarbingerEmpowered⟧
H3|Step 2: Harbinger L|1|1.|When you get inside, someone should debuff Harbinger fully. Start with UA/Strength and then Imperil, Slash/Blud/Pierce Vuln, Fester, etc... He is basically immune to Elemental damage, but takes equal damage from all Physicals...thus, Pierce or Slash is the best way to go. L|1|2.|Rapid kills of the Harbinger are accomplished by holding him in place with a circle of archers, healers, and/or non-attacking melees...and then Tusker Fisting the crap out of him. Pure attacking him is slow, as he has 500k+ hit points and is resistant to weapon damage. L|2|•|**Special Note**: The Harbingers are Elementals. A Prismatic Atlan Wand thus deals double damage on them. A Tusker Fisting mage with such a wand is basically equal to two of himself. Having someone with life magic on hand to keep their mana full basically means he can nonstop Fist. L|2|•|{TIP} If you have low level players in your group, it is a good idea to designate them as fellowship healers. L|1|3.|Throughout the fight, Hands will spawn. Stop attacking Harbinger and team up on each Hand one at a time. The Hands are an Imperil Vulnerable creature...don't use Armor Renders or Vulns, they counter buff. Imperil them and use standard physical weapons for best all around results. They also take little damage from magic, so melee and archers are the best to kill them with. L|2|1.|Green - «Hand of Verdancy» L|2|2.|Blue - «Hand of Enchantment» L|2|3.|Purple - «Hand of Artifice» L|2|4.|Red- «Hand of Strife» L|1|4.|Once Harbinger's health gets below 50%, Essences will spawn around the Harbinger (Note: If he's backed up against a wall, only two or three might spawn!) Stop attacking Harbinger and team up on each Essence one at a time. Essences no longer smite. The fastest way to kill them is Armor Rend Elemental weapons of the opposed elements, although Physicals work roughly half as well. For instance, The Purple Essence is best Acid Vulned, Imperiled, and then attacked with AR ACid. L|2|1.|Purple - «Essence of Artifice». Highest rate of fire, this essence kills a lot of people, because it never uses Item magic, basically war war war. L|2|2.|Blue - «Essence of Enchantment». Debuffs, and uses Cold magic. L|2|3.|Red - «Essence of Strife». Fire magic and vulns. L|2|4.|Green - «Essence of Verdancy». Uses a lot of life magic, and no longer Smites (the Harbinger does that). L|1|5.|When the Harbinger dies, loot a «Harbinger Arm Token» from the ground and then take the surface portal that spawns. Taking the Portal is ONE OF THE FLAGS...you cannot teleport out! If you do, you can't get the skill point xp! L|2|•|⟦HarbingerEmpoweredTokenPickup⟧ L|2|•|**Shared with all versions:** ⟦HarbingerWarriorWait⟧ L|2|•|**Shared with all versions:** ⟦HarbingerCompletedNuhmudira⟧ L|1|6.|Talk to «Issk» or «Vincadi» for 1 point in the skill related to Harbinger item turned in. L|2|•|**Shared with all versions:** ⟦HarbingerCompletedWaitIssk⟧ or ⟦HarbingerCompletedWaitVincadi⟧
P|**Note:** If you die, portal recall and run back to the «Tunnels to the Harbinger (Issk)¦Tunnels to the Harbinger», near «Issk» or «Vincadi». When you click to enter the portal it will ask you if you want to return to Harbinger's Lair. Click **YES**.

L|1|2.|When your group is ready, everyone should hand their «Harbinger Item» to the NPC (either «Issk» or «Vincadi») and then use the nearby «Tunnels to the Harbinger (Issk)¦Tunnels to the Harbinger» portal to begin. L|1|3.|Once inside, the dungeon is linear to the bottom (keep heading down). The only obstacles are a series of 4 jumps that must be made. L|2|•|**Jump 1: Acid Pit** - Full jump ahead (land on invisible platform) L|2|•|**Jump 2: Lava Pit** - Jump into the pit and take the hallway to the North L|2|•|**Jump 3: Ice Shelf ** - Shift-jump down onto the platform above the ice shelf, clear the spawn, and wait for your group. L|2|•|**Jump 4: Ice/Acid Pit Combo** - Dispell, then shift Jump down onto the ice shelf and **quicky** run to the edge and full jump across the acid pit (land on invisible platform). The ice hurts, so be quick. L|2|•|**Jump 5: Staging Area** - Shift jump down and quickly move to the south (near the portals). L|1|4.|Take the «Essence Chamber» Portal L|1|5.|Kill each of the 4 Essences, the «Essence of Strife», «Essence of Enchantment», «Essence of Artifice» and the «Essence of Verdancy» L|1|6.|Each will drop multiple crystallized essences used in the «Essence Recovery» quest. L|1|7.|After all 4 are killed, a portal will spawn to the «Harbinger». L|2|•|Enter: ⟦HarbingerEssenceless⟧ L|1|8.|Kill the «Harbinger», loot a «Harbinger Arm Token», and take portal which spawns after he dies. Quest.name: Focusing_Stone_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|14 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Le-Ai Rea» I|Starts At|«Mayoi» to «Xinh» portal at 60.8S, 80.4E. I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|1.|You must obtain a «Skull of High Acolyte» from the «Skull of High Acolyte Quest» before you can obtain the keys to the mines. L|1|2.|This quest requires someone with «Lockpick» to pull two levers. L|1|3.|One person with «Lockpick» can accomplish Part 2. The rest of the fellowship can continue on to Part 3 while keeping the doors open for the lever puller.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Obtaining Keys to the Mines L|1|1.|Find «Le-Ai Rea» at 75.9S 57.3E and hand him the «Skull of High Acolyte». He will return a «Golden Key (Mines of Despair)¦Golden Key» and «Le-Ai Rea's Key». L|1|2.|Enter the «Mines of Despair» at 75.4S, 57.2E.
H3|Part 2: Mines of Despair (Levers) L|1|1.|From the drop, head north and unlock the wooden door with the «Golden Key (Mines of Despair)¦Golden Key». L|1|2.|If you have a group, have someone hold this door for you, as you'll need to come back through it. L|1|3.|Go left at the split and jump down into the pit. L|1|4.|Hug the left wall until you reach a locked door at the bottom of a wide ramp. Unlock it. L|1|5.|Take a right at the next split, and then your first left. L|1|6.|At the next split, take a right, and then hug the wall left until you reach an intersection that has a pit to your left and a small square room to your right. L|1|7.|Open the door to the small square room and use the wall lever to open the first door. L|1|8.|Back out of the room,.jump down into the pit, and hug the wall left until you reach another small square room with a wall lever. Pull this lever to open the second door. L|1|9.|Now portal recall to bring you back to the «Mines of Despair» drop. L|1|10.|Head North and take a right at the split. Jump down into the pit, run down the ramp and hug the right wall to join your group. L|2|•|Note: If the first door has closed already, use your «Golden Key (Mines of Despair)¦Golden Key» to open it again.
H3|Part 3: Mines of Despair (Inactive Focusing Stone) L|1|1.|Head north through the first door, then take a right at the split. L|1|2.|Jump down into the pit, run down the ramp to the north, then hug the wall right until you reach a lever-activated door. L|1|3.|One the door opens (from the lever runner), one person should hold it while the rest continue. L|1|4.|Once through the door, take your first right. L|1|5.|Hug the left wall until you reach another lever-activated door, in a larger room with «Undead Miner»s. L|1|6.|Again, wait here for the lever to be pulled, and when it opens, hold the door. L|1|7.|Once your party is all together, move down the linear dungeon until you reach the «Lich Overseer». Kill him and loot an «Focusing Stone (Inactive)¦Inactive Focusing Stone» from his corpse (drops 3). L|2|•|⟦FocusingStone⟧ L|1|8.|{OPT} While in this room, you can also loot a «Empyrean Sun Stone», which is used in «Diemos Flagging» and in making «Crafting Golems». L|2|•|⟦EmpyreanSunStone_Pickup⟧ L|1|9.|Now, use «Le-Ai Rea's Key» on the door to the west, follow the hall into a larger room, and enter the portal to «Beyond the Mines of Despair».
H3|Part 3: Beyond the Mines of Despair L|1|1.|From the drop, follow the linear dungeon until you reach a suspended bridge. L|1|2.|Move to the center of the bridge and jump off to the West side. L|1|3.|Run around to the North West, then use the ramp down on the East side. L|1|4.|From here, its linear all the way to the final room, where you'll find a «Vortex». L|1|5.|Use the «Focusing Stone (Inactive)¦Inactive Focusing Stone» on the Vortex to activate your «Focusing Stone».
P|Notes L|1|•|A «Scrawled Note (Mines of Despair)¦Scrawled Note» can be found at the Mines of Despair drop point. It can be given to «Le-Ai Rea» for the «Bound Book».

Quest.name: Fort_Tethana_Tug_of_War
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|50 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} «Jin Ghao» I|Starts At|{OPT} «Danby's Outpost» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Go to Fort Tethana, and head northeast to the Viamontian camp at 5.9N, 69.0W. There you will find a «Viamontian Man-at-Arms»; kill him and take his note «Tethana's Response» and if you wish, a «Fort Tethana Portal Gem». This gem will make the return trip to Teth slightly faster. L|2|•|{OPT} Loot the «Knight's Stash» for some randomly generated loot. L|3|•|⟦KnightsStash⟧ L|1|2.|Return to Danby's Outpost and give Tethana's Response to Jin Ghao. He will give you «The Queen's Missive». L|1|3.|Return to Teth. L|2|•|{OPT} Speak with the «Soldier (NPC)¦Soldier» in front of the Purple Tumerok Tavern. He will send you to the nearby «Renegade Incursion». L|1|4.|Go to the Renegade Incursion located at 0.5N, 73.3W and locate «Arwyth Margyle», who is at the end of the dungeon with two soldiers. Present her with The Queen's Missive and she will give you «Tethana's Price». L|1|5.|Bring this note to Jin Ghao or the Grand Knight, depending on what rewards you want and which side you wish to help. Note that there are no loyalty quest flags associated with this quest, and your choice on which side to help is purely a roleplaying decision. L|2|•|Bring Tethana's Price to «Jin Ghao» in «Danby's Outpost» for 7,500,000 xp and the «Blade of the Realm». L|3|•|⟦TugOfWar⟧ L|2|•|Bring Tethana's Price to the «Grand Knight» in «Sanamar» for 7,500,000 xp and «Renlen's Grace». L|3|•|No Stamp

When attacked, they quickly fled into the hills. We have sent emissaries to Teth in the hopes that they might shed some light on this situation, but our emissaries have not exactly been met with the warmest of receptions."⸩ ⸨Jin Ghao tells you, "I do not like this situation. You can find the entrance to the pit just southwest of here. It's still on the plateau, though."
L|1||Arwyth Margyle⸩ ⸨Arwyth Margyle tells you, "I have assumed command with the absence of Commander Kurth. Speak quickly if you have business - we have a war of our own to fight around here."
L|1||Soldier (Renegade Incursion)⸩ ⸨Soldier tells you, "We hear the talk of blue-skins out of the north. We understand the fear they instill in many who follow the Queen, but we have our own problems to deal with here. If the blue-skins would aid us in this conflict, who are we to hold to ancient grudges?"⸩ ⸨Soldier tells you, "The Renegades have been at our door for years. And in all that time, what reinforcement has the Queen shown us?"⸩ ⸨Soldier tells you, "I thought that when Commander Kurth went missing, we'd have morale problems in the fort. But the truth of it is that we have no time to worry about that while we're constantly under siege by the Renegades."⸩ ⸨Soldier tells you, "I've seen those Knights in action, and I must say, I am impressed. If Fort Tethana were to gain control of soldiers such as those, Fort Tethana would surely be a force to be reckoned with."
L|1||Handing in Tethana's Response⸩ ⸨You give Jin Ghao Tethana's Response.⸩ ⸨Jin Ghao tells you, "So, the King of Sanamar courts Fort Tethana. No further dealings with Varicci are to be tolerated!"⸩ ⸨Jin Ghao tells you, "Go!"⸩ ⸨Jin Ghao gives you The Queen's Missive.

Quest.name: Gelidite_Library_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Kai Mallan, Sho Enchanter» I|Starts At|69.2N, 17.2W I|Route|«Stonehold» I|Repeat|Non Repeatable I|Quest Chain|Nuhmudira's Fate I|1|Gelidite Library Quest I|2|«Nuhmudira's Boon Quest» or «The Callous Heart Quest» H2|Overview P|This Quest is a lore-heavy quest from the Gaerlan/Martine Story Arc. «Nuhmudira» was kidnapped, and held prisoner in this dungeon. P|The way you complete this quest, and if you choose to save or damn «Nuhmudira», has its influences on other quests L|1|•|If you choose to **damn** her, you will be flagged for «The Callous Heart Quest», but will have to do all 3 parts in the «Soul Stone Quest» L|1|•|If you choose to **save** her, you will be flagged for the «Nuhmudira's Boon Quest», and will have to do only the first part in the «Soul Stone Quest» P|(Note that these are not the only influencing choices upon the Soul Stone quest, and your required steps may differ regardless of your choice.)
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Gelidite Library L|1|1.|Talk to «Kai Mallan, Sho Enchanter» near the entrance to the dungeon. L|1|2.|Enter the «Gelidite Library». There are lower level elementals in this dungeon. L|1|3.|Go down, and down a ramp to a T intersection. To the left (S), there is a room with the lore book «Linaural Urilaentai». To the right (N), there is a room with the lore book «Miadun hu Okardunai». L|1|4.|If you are not interested in picking up the books, go right (N) through the room. On the N side, there is a hidden entrance to a corridor with a ramp down. L|1|5.|Follow this corridor through a smaller room, another corridor, a larger room, and exit this large room to the SE. You will find the portal to the next dungeon, the Gelidite Library Labyrinth. L|1|6.|At the drop, you will find the «Empty Binding». Pick it up. Goal is to collect 8 pages. L|1|7.|The dungeon holds no creatures. Look at the map for the location of the pages, or see below for directions.
H3|Part 2: Gelidite Library Labyrinth L|1|1.|After you portal in into the Library, grab the «Empty Binding» on the floor next to a golem corpse. L|1|2.|The Binding mentions it needs 8 pages, starting with a scrawling note. The following directions are not in the sequence you should add them, but the fastest way. L|2|1.|From the drop, go take the west passage. Go left at first intersection, and follow the hallway all the way to a fork. To the left, on the floor, is the first note, «A Hastily Scrawled Note». L|2|2.|Backtrack to the first intersection, and go right (west) to find the third note. L|2|3.|Back to the 4way intersection with the golem corpse. L|2|4.|From there, take the South hallway. Go left (S) at the first fork, through 2 doors and up and down a ramp. The second note lies to the right in a little alcove. L|2|5.|Backtrack to the dead golem L|2|6.|The East hallway holds the next 4 notes. L|2|7.|Keep right hand rule (a relatively long way) until you come into a little room which is a dead end. The seventh Note is on the floor. L|2|8.|Backtrack, at first intersection go left (S), hug right wall till you come to a 4way intersection. Go SW, hug right wall till you come into a small room with a door on the other side. On the floor will be the fifth note. L|2|9.|Exit on the other side, and hang right for a short while. The sixth note is in an alcove behind a door. L|2|10.|Go back to the little room where the fifth note was, and from there, back up N to the 4way intersection. Go straight (NE) and keep hugging the right wall, up a few ramps to a little room which is a dead end. The fourth note is in this room. L|2|11.|Backtrack, first intersection go right, next one left, and you're back at the dead golem L|2|12.|The eighth and final note can be found by going into the N hallway. At the first intersection, go right (S), up a ramp, left, and right (N) up another. Left to a little room with the eighth note. L|2|13.|Backtrack to the first intersection, and this time, go right and east, this is where the «Gelidite Dais». the «Oubliette Gatekeeper» and the portal to the next section are. L|1|3.|Assemble the Book, ID the notes for the right sequence: L|2|1.|First Note: Use an empty book binding on this item. «A Hastily Scrawled Note (Page 1)» L|2|2.|Second Note: Use a book binding with one page on this item. «A Hastily Scrawled Note (Page 2)» L|2|3.|Third Note: Use a book binding with two pages on this item. «A Hastily Scrawled Note (Page 3)» L|2|4.|Fourth Note: Use a book binding with three pages on this item. «A Hastily Scrawled Note (Page 4)» L|2|5.|Fifth Note: Use a half full book binding on this item. «A Hastily Scrawled Note (Page 5)» L|2|6.|Sixth Note: Use a book binding that is missing three pages on this note. «A Hastily Scrawled Note (Page 6)» L|2|7.|Seventh Note: Use a book that is missing two pages on this page. «A Hastily Scrawled Note (Page 7)» L|2|8.|Eighth Note: Use a nearly full book binding on this note to complete the book «A Hastily Scrawled Note (Page 8)» L|1|4.|Adding the 8th Note changes the «Book Binding» into an «Unreadable Tome». L|1|5.|Give the «Unreadable Tome» to the «Oubliette Gatekeeper» to receive «Nuhmudira's Charm» and be flagged to enter the Oubliette portal. L|2|•|⟦PortalOublietteBypass⟧
H3|Part 3: Gelidite Library Oubliette L|1|1.|Again, no creatures in this dungeon. If you swap the camera up high, you can see where «Nuhmudira» used to be imprisoned, lying on top of the column in the middle. On the floor you will find different pieces of lore: «A Hastily Scrawled Note (Text 1)», «A Hastily Scrawled Note (Text 2)», «A Hastily Scrawled Note (Text 3)», «Bloody Scrawled Note», «Scrawled Bloody Note» and «A Painfully Scrawled Note». L|1|2.|There are TWO levers here. This is where you make your choice: L|2|•|The «Skull Lever», to the West, will give your lifeforce to Nuhmudira. You will die and have 5% vitae, but without leaving a corpse. This means you **saved** her. You will appear at a lifestone just outside of «Zaikhal» at 15.8N, 2.1E. L|3|•|⟦SacrificedNuhmudira⟧ L|2|•|The «Plain Lever», to the East, will make «Nuhmudira» suffer more, and you will be portaled back to «Kai Mallan, Sho Enchanter». This means you **condemned** «Nuhmudira», and you can talk to Kai Mallan for further instructions (see «The Callous Heart Quest». L|3|•|⟦AbandonedNuhmudira⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Gelidite Library» 69.2N, 17.2W -- «map:5464¦5464» TR|«Labyrinth» From the «Gelidite Library» -- «map:5463¦5463» TR|«Oubliette (Labyrinth)» From the «Labyrinth» -- «map:5462¦5462» TE
H2|Rewards
R| RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening dialog, Balthazar, Royal Guardian⸩ ⸨Balthazar, Royal Guardian snaps to attention and salutes you.⸩ ⸨Balthazar, Royal Guardian tells you, "Hail, fellow Isparian. I have been sent here to ensure that none venture into this hold. It is overrun by a horde of Sclavus -- they have stolen some of the items that were collected here by Nuhmudira, the Arcanum and their Agents. These Sclavus are of a potent and singular mind, it seems, and all attempts to root them from their positions have met with great casualties."⸩ ⸨Balthazar, Royal Guardian tells you, "Our High Queen has organized a unit of her elite forces and established a foothold within the first rooms of this storehouse. If you are brave enough, you may assist us in restoring the stolen items. However ..."⸩ ⸨Balthazar, Royal Guardian sighs.⸩ ⸨Balthazar, Royal Guardian tells you, "I do not know you, Isparian. And I fear that trust is in short supply these days. I must ask you to prove yourself before I can accept your assistance. If you journey to Stonehold and there choose to support Nuhmudira with the sacrifice of your own life essence, then I will know that you are truly on our side."
L|1||Opening dialog, Kai Mallan, Sho Enchanter⸩ ⸨Kai Mallan, Sho Enchanter tells you, "How did you come to me? You have overstayed your welcome here. Return to your precious cities! My master cares not for those that will let her evil go unpunished."
L|1||Oubliette Gatekeeper⸩ ⸨Oubliette Gatekeeper tells you, "It is forbidden to pass these walls unless you have been given the permission of he who watches the gate. To be given that passage, hand me your key so that I may verify the inscriptions and grant you access. But be forewarned, your entry to this place will place you in direct contact with the accused. Make your decision wisely, for you may cast your vote only once.⸩ ⸨Oubliette Gatekeeper tells you, "The key, had you forgotten, is a writing infused with the magic of my masters. I will infuse the writing with the power of the dias, and then return it to you.
L|1||Adding pages to the Book Binding⸩ ⸨The page reattaches itself to the book, for a brief instant the sigil on the page looks as though it bleeds. A womans voice echoes in your mind speaking in a tongue you do not understand.
L|1||Handing in Unreadable Tome to Oubliette Gatekeeper⸩ ⸨You give Oubliette Gatekeeper Unreadable Tome⸩ ⸨The Golem lifts a metallic hand toward the dais holding the book. A soft thrum echoes through the room, as a warm glow surrounds the book. Pages twist upon one another, and a feeling of warmth cascades over you⸩ ⸨Oubliette Gatekeeper gives you Nuhmudira's Charm⸩ ⸨Oubliette Gatekeeper tells you, "Read well the words within, this is a living being that has been imprisoned. There is too much passion in the writing for it to be otherwise. Choose wisely for the work within has never been used upon living flesh before and the results are as of yet untested and unknown. This prisoner must be guilty of heinous crimes against my masters.⸩ ⸨Oubliette Gatekeeper tells you, "You may now pass. Remember your judgement is final.
L|1||Pulling Plain Lever⸩ ⸨The feeling that you have abandoned a friend washes over you.
L|1||Pulling Skull Lever⸩ ⸨Your strength deserts you as your soul is stripped of essence. In your mind, a woman's voice says, "Thank You."
L|1||Handing in another Unreadable Tome to Oubliette Gatekeeper⸩ ⸨You give Oubliette Gatekeeper Unreadable Tome.⸩ ⸨Oubliette Gatekeeper tells you, "You may cast your vote only once. I will, however, infuse your writing."⸩ ⸨The Golem lifts a metallic hand toward the dais holding the book. A soft thrum echoes through the room, as a warm glow surrounds the book. Pages twist upon one another, and a feeling of warmth cascades over you.⸩ ⸨Oubliette Gatekeeper gives you Nuhmudira's Charm.
L|1||Speaking to Agent of the Arcanum after saving Nuhmudira⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum claps his hands together.⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum tells you, "I am so happy that you were kind enough to give of yourself so that she may survive. She has certainly done this for all of us. Please take this."⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum gives you Letter to Balthazar.⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum tells you, "Seek out Balthazar, outside of Lin. He will instruct you further on how you may aid us."⸩ ⸨Tears well in the agents eyes and they sniff.⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum tells you, "I am sorry...but knowing that she is trapped in an inescapable place, and that her life force is being drained away...I wish that there was more we could do for her."⸩
H2|Trivia P|For the story on how and why «Nuhmudira» was kidnapped, and «Kai Mallan, Sho Enchanter» 's role it in it, see the Teaser of «Betrayal».

Quest.name: Green_Mire_Grave_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} «Hiro Ishigame» I|Starts At|{OPT} 33.7S, 72.8E in «Shoushi» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
P|Recover the Green Mire Warrior's Yoroi Cuirass and Yari from his resting place.
P|"In the swamps outside Shoushi you'll find the resting place of the once great Green Mire Warrior. You will need to discover a number of keys and use them to traverse his final resting place."
P|**Lockpick skill can also be used on doors instead finding and using the required keys**
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|•|{OPT} Purchase the rumor, «Green Mire Camp Directions», from «Jaikite Sanzen the Barkeeper» in Shoushi (33.7S, 72.5E). L|1|•|{OPT} Talk to «Hiro Ishigame» in «Shoushi» at 33.7S, 72.8E.
L|1|1.|Head to the «Green Mire Grave» at 27.8S, 71.6E. L|2|•|Route 1: From the east wing of the «Town Network», go to «Shoushi» and then directly to the Green Mire Grave. L|2|•|Route 2: Go through the left portal in the level 15 room of the facility hub. You will spawn facing away from the portal to the Green Mire Grave.
H3|Part 1: Worn Key L|1|1.|Go south from the portal room and hug the right wall. L|2|•|Note: You should come to a big room filled with Drudges and a corpse in the corner with a «Personal note». L|1|2.|Kill the «Drudge Slave Keyholder» and loot the «Worn Key» from its corpse L|1|3.|Portal recall if you have the spell, otherwise run back to the portal room by hugging the left wall.
H3|Part 2: Short Key L|1|1.|Go north from the portal room past the «Piece of parchment (North Passage)». L|1|2.|Follow a series of larger rooms roughly, until you hit a big room with a «Braggart Mosswart». L|1|3.|Kill and loot the «Braggart Mosswart». The «Key (Short Key)¦short key» will be on its corpse. L|1|4.|Portal recall or run back to the portal room.
H3|Part 3: Large Key and Yari L|1|1.|Go east from the portal room, following a corridor. L|1|2.|Keep going east through a big room, opening 2 doors. L|1|3.|Go through straight through two more rooms, turn right, go through two more rooms, go left, and left again. L|1|4.|Follow the corridor until you reach a split. L|1|5.|Follow either corridor from the split until you reach a ramp. L|1|6.|Go up the ramp, and unlock the door with the Short Key. L|1|7.|Go west, up another ramp, and where you can look down to a larger room. L|1|8.|Go south through a small room. L|1|9.|Follow the corridor up a few ramps to a large room, where the third «Key (Large Key)¦Large Key» can be found on a «Ravenous Mosswart». L|1|10.|Also in this room is the chest holding the «Green Mire Yari (Quest Item)», which can be unlocked with the green «Worn Key». L|2|•|⟦GreenMireYariQuest⟧ L|1|11.|Portal recall or run back to the portal room.
H3|Part 4: Simple Key L|1|1.|Go west from the portal room. L|1|2.|At the first split, go left, and then right down a ramp. L|1|3.|Go left at the next intersection. L|1|4.|Follow the corridor until you see 4 prison cells (2 by 2). Use the red and silver Large Key to open the prison door with a chest behind it, and the green Worn Key to open the chest - loot the «Key (Simple Key)¦Simple Key».
P|Note: do not portal recall yet!
H3|Part 5: Silver Key and Cuirass L|1|1.|Turn around and follow the corridor back to the 4-way intersection. L|1|2.|Go west, and follow the corridor until you reach another locked door. L|1|3.|Use your newly acquired Simple Key to unlock the door. L|1|4.|Keep going down all the ramps, until you hit a larger room. L|1|5.|Kill the «Mosswart Overchief» for the final key, the «Silver Key». L|1|6.|With this key, you can open the chest on the north side of the room, where the «Green Mire Yoroi Cuirass (Quest Item)» is stashed. L|2|•|⟦GreenMireCuirassQuest⟧ L|1|7.|Bring the cuirass and the yari to «Hiro Ishigame» (33.7S 72.8E) in Shoushi to be repaired and receive an xp reward. This step must be done before you can hand the Cuirass to the Warden if doing FacHub stamp. If you do not want any of the items, simply hand them to Hiro for some additional xp. L|2|•|⟦fachubgreenmiregrave⟧

Quest.name: Gurog_Creation
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|200 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Fayza» (optional) I|Starts At|«Xarabydun» at 41.9S, 15.9E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Gurog Creation» H2|Overview P|Investigate the origins of the «Gurog» race in the «Frozen Valley».
L|1|•|This quest coincides with both «Nalicana's Test» and «Bloodstone Investigation». The «Gurog Kill Task» can also be completed at the same time.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Travel to the «Frozen Valley», and enter the «Gurog Ice Cave» at 84.9N, 7.1W. L|2|•|Route/Shortcut: «Stonehold» to «Wisp Lake Cottages» portal at 69.7N, 20.2W. L|2|•|{OPT} After taking the shortcut, speak with «Gregoria, Gurog Destroyer» at 83.8N, 4.3W to first start the «Gurog Kill Task». L|1|2.|One of the three gurogs in the first room drops the «Entryway Key» used on the second door (700 difficulty). L|1|3.|Proceed straight ahead and go up the wooden ramp, then take the first left. Loot the «Journal of a Soldier» on the table surrounded by a few «Gurog». L|2|•|⟦JournalofaSoldierPickup⟧ L|1|4.|Return to the main hallway, then proceed straight across to find the «Cellar Key». It spawns on a corpse with a few «Gurog» around it. L|1|5.|Return to the main hallway, go back down the wooden ramp, then take either the left or right down to a cellar door (700 difficulty). L|1|6.|Loot the «Torn Note» on the corpse of a Gurog in the room with 3 caged mattekars down below, one drop per kill on a 10-minute respawn. L|1|7.|Before giving either of the notes to the «Mortified Soldier», talk to him for a stamp. L|2|•|⟦GurogCreationStarted_1110⟧ L|1|8.|After getting the note, give either the Torn Note or the Journal of a Soldier to the «Mortified Soldier» who is hiding behind the boxes in the same room. He will give you a legendary key and not take either of the items from you. L|2|•|⟦JournalNoteTurnInWait⟧ L|1|9.|Proceed back up to the main route, back up the wooden ramp to the north, then straight ahead to the last room where the legendary chests are located. L|2|•|{OPT} The portal to the «Frozen Tomb» can then be used if you are completing «Nalicana's Test» or «Bloodstone Investigation». L|1|10.|Give both the note and the journal to «Fayza» in «Xarabydun» for rewards (you must first have given them to the Mortified Soldier, otherwise Fayza will not accept the items). L|2|•|⟦GurogCreationCompleted_1110⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|**You must have both the note and the journal for the turn in** L|1|•|Gurog Soldiers use Two-Handed Weapons with a cleaving property, meaning they will hit more than one person at once. Position characters intelligently to prevent this, as a few Gurogs cleaving players at once can quickly kill them. L|1|•|Gurog Minions are shield hollow, but Gurog Soldiers and Gurog Henchmen are not.

Quest.name: Harvesting_the_Bulb_of_Twilight
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Norus» I|Starts At|«Temple of Twilight» at 34.5S, 8.4E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Third Sister» I|Quest Chain|The Sisters of Light I|1|«Releasing the Light» I|2|«Harvesting the Bulb of Mornings» I|3|«Harvesting the Bulb of Harvests» I|4|Harvesting the Bulb of Twilight I|5|«Hoshino Must Die» H2|Overview P|Harvest the Seed of Twilight.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You must have completed «Harvesting the Bulb of Harvests» at least once to do this quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Run to the underground tunnel, located next to the burning tent at 34.5S 8.4E. L|2|•|Route 1: From «Yaraq», take the «Ijaniya» settlement portal at 22.4S, 0.2E. L|2|•|Route 2: From «Al-Arqas» to «Al-Kasan» at 33.6S, 13.1E L|1|2.|Head down and talk to «Norus» on the left. L|2|•|⟦ThirdSisterStarted_1212⟧ L|1|3.|Speak to Norus, and then begin to work your way down the tunnel, killing spectral creatures as you go. L|1|4.|Everyone will need a «Pulsating Spirit-trap Gem», which are looted from the corpses of the spectral creatures. L|1|5.|When you reach a magma pit, jump across (South) to a entrance below. L|2|•|There is a Chorozite Chest located above and to the West. ⟦chestchorizite87566⟧ L|1|6.|From here, hug the left wall and work your way down to the «Sanctum Guardian Spirit». L|1|7.|Hand the spirit your gem to enter the next section of the «Temple of Twilight» L|2|•|Note: You cannot stockpile gems, as he will take all of them out of your inventory. L|1|8.|Make your way down. You will reach a pit with the «Bulb of Twilight» below. Jump down twice then enter a tunnel to the S. L|1|9.|You will reach a distinct section with ore on the ground. Everyone needs a stack of 15 «Alb'arean Ore (Twilight)¦Alb'arean Ores». L|2|•|In this part of the dungeon, you will encounter Emergent Gromnies, «Empowered Savage Carenzi¦Empowered Carenzis» and «Nature Guardian»s L|1|10.|Once you have the ore, go back up to the «Bulb of Twilight» and talk to it to receive the «Seed of Essence (Twilight)¦Seed of Essence». L|2|•|⟦BulbofTwilightSeedGiven⟧ L|1|11.|Portal recall and hand the seed to Norus for the rewards. If you don't want your orb, you can hand it to «Calitoth» in the «Neftet Treasury» for some xp and luminance instead. L|2|•|⟦ThirdSisterCompleted_1212⟧ L|2|•|⟦HoshinoMustDie_Flag⟧ L|2|•|Note: Upon handing, you will be portaled to a room with chests you can use the Legendary Key on.

H2|Rewards
R| RK|Experience|210,000,000 RK|Luminance|20,000 RK|Items| RI|«Legendary Seed of Twilight» RI|«Legendary Key» RI|«Trade Note (250,000)» (x7) RE
R|Give «Legendary Seed of Twilight» to «Calitoth» RK|Experience|49,511,803 RK|Luminance|1,000 RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Norus tells you, "Thank the Deru someone came!"⸩ ⸨Norus tells you, "We were originally set up on the surface, but Hoshino Kei's spectral skeletons destroyed everything and slew all of the miners."⸩ ⸨Norus tells you, "I barely made it out of there alive."⸩ ⸨Norus tells you, "This should be the location of the spirit of the Lady of Twilight and Rest. According to the Lady of Mysteries, her spirit should rest in some sort of bulb or plant."⸩ ⸨Norus tells you, "We need to recover her essence as quickly as possible, preferably before the spectral skeletons figure out a way past the Guardian or the creatures inside the temple."⸩ ⸨Norus tells you, "If you'd be willing to brave the temple, you'll find the Guardian deeper in these tunnels. Just be very careful, the tunnels are still packed full of invaders."
L|1||Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨You allow Norus to examine your Seed of Essence.⸩ ⸨Norus tells you, "Well done..."⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Seed of Essences.⸩ ⸨Norus tells you, "You made it past that pile of invaders, as well as the temple itself. Well done indeed."⸩ ⸨Norus tells you, "Now, to see if the essence is intact..."⸩ ⸨Norus chants over the seed, and a small wisp of light pours out of the seed and into his hand.⸩ ⸨Norus tells you, "Beautiful, what is contained here is both intact and free of corruption. Well done, well done indeed."⸩ ⸨Norus tells you, "It's only a small fragment of her essence, but it's progress all the same. As for this seed, I think you may find it useful."⸩ ⸨You've earned 210,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 20,000 Luminance.⸩ ⸨Norus gives you Seed of Twilight.⸩ ⸨Norus tells you, "If you're interested, I'll likely need your assistance again in a couple weeks. The bulb should be ready to produce another seed by then."⸩ ⸨Norus tells you, "Also, as you have aided all of the Lost Sisters, you may wish to seek out Lord Brem, in the encampment that watches over Hoshino Kei's Fortress. He is seeking those adventurers who've been brave enough to assist us in collecting all of the essences of the Sisters."⸩ ⸨You give Calitoth Legendary Seed of Twilight.⸩ ⸨Calitoth tells you, "Thank you. I'll send this along to my mistress. Please, accept this gift in return."⸩ ⸨You've earned 49,511,803 experience.⸩ ⸨Calitoth gives you Legendary Key
L|1||Other Interactions⸩ ⸨As you hand the spirit-trap gem to the Guardian, all of the gems in your possession shatter in a pulse of light and the released energy is absorbed into the spirit.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Pulsating Spirit-trap Gems.⸩ ⸨A voice in your mind says, "Thank you for this, but I will not allow you entry."⸩ ⸨A voice in your mind says, "You are here unannounced and unexpected, but as you have aided me with this fragment of my essence, I will not send you away."⸩ ⸨A voice in your mind says, "Seek the one in these caverns who can give you understanding and purpose, if you wish to enter this place, and then return to me."⸩ ⸨You allow Bulb of Twilight to examine your Alb'arean Ore.⸩ ⸨You offer up the Alb'arean Ore to the large plant. The stack of ore turns into a golden mist which is then absorbed in the plant.⸩ ⸨A moment later, the plant releases a small glowing seed.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Alb'arean Ores.⸩

Quest.name: Hive_Eviscerator_Pincer_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|200 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Behdo Yii» (optional) I|Starts At|«Redspire» at 40.8N, 83.3W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Olthoi Hive Eviscerator Pincer» H2|Overview P|One of the «Olthoi Pincers» quests continuing the chain of pincer quests on «Marae Lassel» with «Behdo Yii» in «Redspire». This pincer continues the reward theme of experience, «Titles», trade notes, enchanted jewelry, healing kits, and some dispel gems.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to the «Hive Eviscerator Burrow» on «Marae Lassel» at [48.6N, 73.7W] (safe drop) L|1|2.|The dungeon is symmetrically for many parts: generally: down is good. This is one of the many possible routes L|1|3.|From the drop, head straight, next right down a ramp, going east, take another right to the south, and a left to the south where you'll find a room with 3 Olthoi. Cross it, going into a corridor to the S. L|1|4.|At the next split, go right and follow the corridor into a huge room with Olthoi and Virindi one level higher. The Virindi debuff with Imperil and Lightning Vuln 8s. Run around to the other side, and go E & down a ramp. L|1|5.|Follow the corridor until it faces N with niches left and right. Good place to stop & kill, and get rid of debuffs. L|1|6.|At the next crossing, go either left or right down a ramp, and cross the room to another corridor. Virindi in this room will try to debuff you. Follow the corridor, dive into a niche outside of range of the Virindi, dispell & kill the aggro. L|1|7.|Follow the corridor until you see an exit portal. To the S is a corridor with a big room with Virindi and Olthoi. Don't go in there. Kill the Olthoi in the niches on both sides of the corridor to prevent back-stabbing. L|1|8.|Kill the «Olthoi Hive Eviscerator» from the big room (you can lure them out one or two at a time) until one drops a pincer. If you use the niches to the N, you are (mostly) out of range for the debuffs of the Virindi. L|1|9.|Loot the «Hive Eviscerator Pincer» and hand it to «Behdo Yii» in «Redspire» for your rewards L|2|•|⟦HiveEvisPincer_0513⟧ L|2|•|There is aslo a «Chorizite Chest» at the bottom of the dungeon. L|3|•|⟦chestchorizite72698⟧

Quest.name: Hive_Queen_Assault
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Virindi Delegate» I|Starts At|«Greenspire» at 43.3N, 66.7W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Olthoi Hive Queen» H2|Overview P|Investigating the disturbance on Marae Lassel.
L|1|•|This quest is a parallel to the original olthoi queen but with touger Olthoi that spray lightning instead of acid, high level virindi, as well as void-casting olthoi grubs.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|One person with «Lockpick» is required to complete part 1 of the quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Crafting the Tuning Forks L|1|1.|Speak to the «Virindi Delegate» in «Greenspire» at 43.3N, 66.7W. L|2|•|⟦IDOQStarted_0413⟧ L|1|2.|Head to the «Chiming Portal» at 45.0N, 73.5W L|2|•|Route: «Town Network» south to «Timaru» L|1|3.|Inside the dungeon you will need to collect the parts to assemble 5 «Tuning Fork»s. The dungeon is full of level 240 virindi, and olthoi that use lightning rather than acid. L|1|4.|The dungeon is a giant loop with an inner and outer loop. On the outer loop there are 2 rooms, one on the East side of the dungeon, and the other on the West side. These 2 rooms contain the 2 parts needed to make the forks, L|2|•|Note: Individual parts are attuned and bonded, so 1 person needs to gather both. Completed keys can be given though. L|1|5.|In each of the 2 rooms is a «Galvanic Chest». These chests are 500 lockpick to open, and can be weakened. In the west chest you will find a «Bar of Curved Metal» and in the east chest you will find the «Metal Pipe». Gather 5 of each (simply loot the chest multiple times) and combine them to make the «Tuning Fork»s. The chests refill every 30 seconds. L|2|•|{WARN} When these chests are opened they do MASSIVE lightning bomb damage (1 shot KOs are very likely). A «Astyrrian's Jewel» (Lightning Protection) rare will however negate all damage.
H3|Part 2: Breaking the Rings L|1|1.|5 people must each have 1 «Tuning Fork», and wait at their assigned «Menhir Ring». L|1|2.|Hand forks to drummers in the following order to break the Menhir rings: L|2|1.|53.0N, 73.3W - «Aun Kahmaula» L|2|2.|49.2N, 74.6W - «Aun Gehaua» L|2|3.|46.5N, 75.8W - «Aun Tanaua» L|2|4.|44.7N, 80.9W - «Aun Laiaua» L|2|5.|50.1N, 80.4W - «Aun Aanaua» L|1|3.|It will take a few minutes after dropping using a Fork before the next drummer spawns L|2|•|⟦GaveTuningFork⟧ L|2|•|Note: It is not known if there is a timer on handing in forks, of if they prevent players from entering Timaru as was the case with the Bells for the original queen.
H3|Part 3: West Fork Dam Hive (Getting Sprayed) L|1|1.|Head to the «West Fork Dam Hive» at 49.1N, 80.0W. L|2|•|Note: The olthoi in here have recklessness and sneak attack. Watch your back. L|1|2.|Inside the dungeon, work your way down (follow left wall... 5 Left's and then on the 6th intersection turn right.) until you find the «Western Royal Hive» Portal. L|1|3.|Clear out the room until everyone has received the message about the olthoi exploding, and you being covered in goo. Once you have gotten this message, you are flagged to enter the «Western Royal Hive». L|2|•|⟦WesternRoyalHiveOK⟧
H3|Part 4: Western Royal Hive L|1|1.|Complete the 3 tests to access the «Queen's Quarters». The tests do not have to completed per player.
H4|Origins Test L|1|1.|Head East and then NORTH until you come to a larger room with 2 Hive Guardians (one is a virindi, the other is an «Olthoi Hive Guardian»). Kill the «Olthoi Hive Guardian»s and loot the «Guardian Warrior's Key». Use it to open the door and jump across to the «Origins Portal». L|1|2.|Destroy the «Hive Olthoi Egg» and you will receive green text about the queen screaming in anger. Take the exit portal and it will return you to the initial drop point for the «Western Royal Hive».
H4|Grub Test L|1|1.|Head west until you come to another large room with a virindi and «Olthoi Hive Guardian». L|1|2.|Kill the «Olthoi Hive Guardian» and loot the «Guardian Soldier's Key». Open the door and jump across to the «Grubs Portal» L|1|3.|The grubs test finds you in a room with a multitude of high level void-casting «Olthoi Hive Crawler»s. Kill the «Olthoi Hive Crawler»s, and then kill the «Hive Maggot Giant» that spawns and you will get a green message about them exploding in a burst of acid and guts. Take the exit portal to return to the «Western Royal Hive» drop point.
H4|Virindi Test L|1|1.|Head west again, but instead of going all the way west, head north when possible until you come to another large room. Again kill the 2 «Olthoi Hive Guardian»s, and loot the «Guardian Soldier's Key». Open the door, and jump across to the portal. L|2|•|The Virindi test consists of a large open room filled with «Virindi Clandestine» and a «Virindi Sentinel». Kill the Sentinel to trigger another green text message. Take the «Western Royal Hive» portal back to the initial drop point. L|1|2.|When all 3 trials have been completed, you may now enter the «Queen's Quarters». Head east again, but this time turn SOUTH, until you come to the 4th and final room, again with 2 «Olthoi Hive Guardian»s. Kill them, loot the «Guardian Soldier's Key», and jump across to the portal.
H3|Part 5: The Queen's Quarters L|1|•|{WARN} There is no quick way back should you die! You have a 2 hour flagging to enter the Western Royal Hive once you have been "sprayed" but you will still need to kill the guardian in the South East again to gain access to the «Queen's Quarters» portal. L|1|1.|The queens lair is a series of T intersections, some of which lead further into the dungeon, but the majority of which lead simply to dead end rooms. These rooms are host to more virindi and olthoi. Make your way going down whenever possible. You will know you are close when you find a hallway closed by metal gates (they open as easy as any other door. No levers or lockpick required). L|2|•|Route to the gates: **West > North > West > West > North and down the ramp > East > South to the end of the hall > West and down ramp > North > East > North then take the 1st right (East) down the ramp** > The gates will be ahead L|1|2.|Beyond these gates is a room with a portal to the room with the queen. This is the LAST safe spot so any pre-fight prep can be done here L|2|•|Note: The drop is hot. Once you go in, there is no way to get back short of running through the entire dungeon. L|1|3.|Upon entering you will be swarmed by «Olthoi Hive Warrior». Kill them at the drop point, then take down the fake queen to the west. L|1|4.|When she dies a green message will appear, and the REAL «Olthoi Hive Queen» will spawn. L|2|•|The quest has been changed. It will be her with no minions. The void grubs and olthoi she had when the quest was released have been removed L|1|5.|Kill the queen and use her body to recieve a head (if you are the killer) or a carapace if you helped. L|2|•|⟦HiveQueenKill⟧ awarded to the player who killed the queen L|2|•|{WARN} The head/carapace will appear in your pack directly so make sure you have a free space! The head is no give, so if you want it, you MUST be the one to kill her! L|2|•|⟦IDOQCompleted_0413⟧ L|2|•|Note: There is no confirmation as of yet to the number of «Olthoi Hive Queen Carapace» given out via the new reward mechanic. L|1|6.|When everyone has either the head or carapace, take the portal and give the item to the «Virindi Delegate» to receive your rewards.

Quest.name: Isparian_Weapons_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|20-39, 40-49, 50-59, 60-79, 80 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Alaine the Apprentice» I|Starts At|«Xarabydun» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Kill Task|False H2|Quest Overview L|1|•|{WARN} No Quest Bonus stamps awarded L|1|•|Quest to gain a weapon forged from pyreal using pure mana. These weapons were designed during the «Elements of Revenge» story arc for use against «Elementals», but they can also be adapted for fighting «Shadows». See «Atlan Stones» for more information.
H2|Walk Through H4|Step 1: Creating the Perfect Diamond Infused Pyreal Ingot L|1|1.|[Optional] Speak with «Alaine the Apprentice» in «Xarabydun». L|1|2.|Proceed to the «Arcanum Research Facility» outside of «Al-Jalima» and pick up «Enchanted Decanter»s. There is no limit to how many you can take, but bear in mind their burden. L|1|3.|Proceed to the «Fathomless Chasm» near «Shoushi». L|1|4.|Locate the level-appropriate sub-dungeon within the Fathomless Chasm and enter with your group. L|1|5.|Fill your Decanters in the pool at the end of the dungeon to get «Decanter of Essence» (no longer «Attuned» and «Bonded», and now stackable to 10) L|1|6.|To create an «Isparian Weapon», you will need to get an Alchemist to craft you a Quality Diamond Infused Pyreal Ingot, Superb Diamond Infused Pyreal Ingot, or a «Perfect Diamond Infused Pyreal Ingot»: L|2|•|Combine a «Decanter of Essence» with «Diamond Powder» to create «Thick Diamond Oil» («Alchemy» Skill Check): L|3|•|Decanter of Essence Diamond Powder Thick Diamond Oil L|2|•|Combine «Thick Diamond Oil» with a «Quality Pyreal Ingot» to create a «Perfect Diamond Infused Pyreal Ingot» («Alchemy» Skill Check): L|3|•|Thick Diamond Oil Quality Pyreal Ingot Perfect Diamond Infused Pyreal Ingot
H4|Step 2: Forging the Isparian Weapon at Crater Lake Village L|1|1.|Once you have your Ingot, buff up and proceed to «Crater Lake Village». L|1|2.|Go up the tower and shop with «Silencia the Archmage». Purchase a ** Glyph** (see below). L|1|3.|Combine your ** Glyph** with your «Perfect Diamond Infused Pyreal Ingot» to create a **Perfect Isparian Ingot** (weapon skill check) L|1|4.|Hand your **Perfect Isparian Ingot** to «Silencia's Magma Golem» next to «Silencia the Archmage» to obtain an «Isparian Weapon».
H4|Step 3: Adding Stones to your Weapon L|1|1.|There are a range of stones available for the Isparian Weapons that can add elemental damage and special properties such as «Category:Slayer¦Slayers». See «Atlan Stones» for more information.
H5|Step 3b: Creating the Isparian Weapons Modifying Tool L|1|1.|To obtain an «Isparian Weapons Modifying Tool» used to remove «Atlan Stones» from a weapon, you will need the assistance of an Alchemist again: L|2|•|Combine a «Decanter of Essence» with «Ground Chorizite» to get «Nullification Oil» («Alchemy» Skill Check): L|3|•|Decanter of Essence Ground Chorizite Nullification Oil L|2|•|Combine the «Nullification Oil» with a «Diamond Heart» to get a «Treated Diamond Heart» («Alchemy» Skill Check): L|3|•|Nullification Oil Diamond Heart Treated Diamond Heart L|2|•|Use an «Intricate Carving Tool» on the «Treated Diamond Heart» to get an «Isparian Weapons Modifying Tool». (Lockpick Skill Check) L|3|•|Intricate Carving Tool Treated Diamond Heart Isparian Weapons Modifying Tool

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Nekshla» I|Starts At|«Encampment near Neftet» at 22.2S, 6.2E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Escape» H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to «Nekshla» at «Encampment near Neftet» (22.2S, 6.2E). L|2|•|⟦EscapeStarted_0213⟧ L|1|2.|Enter the «Desert Dwelling» portal at 21.0S 7.6E. L|2|•|Tips: The drop is not safe, be healed and ready before entering the portal. The dungeon is filled with traps. In the bigger rooms are statues that rotate and cast high-damage void volleys. The hallways have alcoves which cast blade trap spells. The safe locations are against the walls in the hallways, away from the alcoves. There are «Ensorcelled Weapon»s throughout the dungeon, but only 1 at a time. L|1|3.|The dungeon is linear, follow the path. When you reach «Janthef», talk to him, and he will summon a group of «Ensorcelled Weapon»s. Kill them and loot the key and use it to open the locked door ahead. L|1|4.|Follow the path once more. When you find «Janthef» again, he will summon more weapons. When one of the weapons is killed (you won't know which one), a «Whirlwind Golem» will spawn (weak to cold, similar to «Dust Golem», watch for wave spells). The golem drops the next key. L|1|5.|When you reach a split in the dungeon, the left path has more traps and leads to a «Chorizite Chest¦chorizite chest», the right path leads to the end of the dungeon. L|2|•|⟦chestchorizite48824⟧ L|1|6.|On the left path, there are bludgeon vuln traps just before and after multiple bludgeon spell traps which cross the hallway. Move carefully down the hallway to avoid the spells. L|1|7.|At the end of the right path is «Janthef (Creature)» along with 3 «Whirlwind Golem»s. You can drag them into the side room one at a time for safety. L|1|8.|Kill Janthef and the «Spirit of Janthef» will spawn right next to where he died. Talk to the spirit for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦EscapeCompleted_0213⟧ L|1|9.|The exit portal is a hot drop into Neftet and is not recommended.

Quest.name: Knorr_Quiddity_Seed_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|130 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} «Emissary of Asheron (Asheron's Castle)¦Emissary of Asheron» I|Starts At|{OPT} «Asheron's Castle» I|Route|«Eastham» to «Asheron's Island» portal at 17.9N, 64.3E. I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|In this quest you have stop Aerbax from erasing the memory of Asheron saving the Empyrean from the Olthoi.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You'll need to bring a «Trade Note (100,000)» or «Trade Note (250,000)» with you in order to gain access to the «Knorr Lyceum» where Quiddity Seed is. Bring both if you're not sure.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to «Stonehold». There, speak with «Olcris, Nuhmudira's Student» in the barn. L|2|•|If you have never been to Knorr before he will ask you for an M note in exchange for a «Knorr Portal Gem». L|2|•|Note: You can only get 2 Knorr Portals Gems every 3 days from Olcris. L|2|•|If you have previously been to Knorr and talked to «Arikas, Warden of Knorr» you can hand Olcris an M Note in exchange for a «Seat of Knorr Portal Gem». If you do this you can skip the riddles of the next step and go straight to Step 4. L|1|2.|Use the gem to be teleported to the Gates of Knorr. To reach the Seat of Knorr you must complete three riddles given by the Diamond Guardians. You must pick up the correct item on the ground that answers the riddle and hand it to the golem to be teleported in the next part. L|2|•|First Riddle: Book L|2|•|Second Riddle: Mead L|2|•|Third Riddle: Kite Shield L|1|3.|Once in the Seat of Knorr first talk to «Arikas, Warden of Knorr». This will flag you to get another Seat of Knorr Portal Gem from Olcris for an MMD Note when you need another. L|1|4.|Take the south hall and enter the «Collegium Planar Abstraction» Conveyance (level restriction 130+). Its the second conveyance in the right side of the hall. The dungeon is populated by Olthoi and Virindi. L|1|5.|The first thing you come to are a series of levers you must pull to open a few bookcases. First pull the torch lever in the hallway then watch which bookcase opens leading into a small room. Pull the lever in the room and go back into the hall and see which bookcase is open now. Keep pulling levers until you find a bookcase that leads to a long hall rather than another room. L|1|6.|Keep going up until you find a Planar Academy Lecture Hall portal. Go in the portal. L|1|7.|Run straight across the Lecture Hall and up a hallway and go in the Planar Academy Headmaster's Rooms portal. L|1|8.|Find the Quiddity Seed and use it to be portaled. You will enter a dreamworld of the room you were just in, only hundreds of years ago. If this room looks familiar, it is because its the room featured in the original opening movie sequence. Asheron appears at one end of the room, casting «The Sundering», the spell which sent all the Yalaini into Portal Space when the Olthoi overtook them. His health slowly drains, so you only have a certain amount of time to defeat the virindi forces. L|1|9.|Kill the Virindi Portals that appear in this room, along with Olthoi and Virindi minions. The portal is attackable, and once you destroy it the Olthoi and Virindi will vanish. Acid attacks worked well on the portal, others have reported that any damage type will work. Once the first portal is destroyed another will open, and you will repeat the process for 4 portals total. With each portal, the Olthoi and Virindi get stronger. L|1|10.|A final portal will appear near the stairs, but this one is not attackable. Instead, a Virindi called the «Cleaner» spawns with a few Virindi minions. The Cleaner was not difficult with imperil+vuln+Singularity weapon. L|1|11.|Once the Cleaner has been defeated talk to «Asheron» and he will give you an «Empyrean Spherule (Quest Item)¦Empyrean Spherule». You will automatically be booted from the dungeon after a couple minutes back to the Quiddity Seed. L|2|•|⟦knorrquiddityseedwait⟧ L|1|12.|Give the Spherule to Asheron's Emissary at Asheron's Castle for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦knorrquiddityseedquestrepeat⟧ L|2|•|Note: The «Quiddity Ingot (Knorr)» you are given as a reward is used in the «Knorr Quiddity Ingot Purification» Quest.

Quest.name: Mace_of_the_Explorer_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} «Olivier Rognath» I|Starts At|{OPT} 17.5N, 63.3E in «Eastham» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest that covers the plight of «Candeth Martine», a member of the «The Exploration Society¦Exploration Society» who was captured during a battle between the Mosswarts and Banderlings.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Banderling Mace Shaft L|1|1.|Make your way to the «Banderling Conquest Dungeon» west of «Sawato» at 29.0S, 50.5E. L|2|•|Route: Use the portal in the east wing of the «Facility Hub». L|1|2.|From the drop, head south at the T junction into a room with two exits, take the south exit if you want the lore item, «A Battered Leather Journal», otherwise head west until you reach a large room with a ramp down. L|1|3.|Ignore this room and head west again and down a ramp, now head south until you reach an area with rocks and the «Banderling Mace Shaft» on the floor. Take the shaft and head down the ramp to the surface portal. L|2|•|⟦BanderlingMaceShaft⟧
H3|Part 2: Banderling Mace Head L|1|1.|Now go to «Al-Arqas» and run to the «Mosswart Maze» at 25.2S, 19.4E or use the portal in the East wing of the «Facility Hub». L|1|2.|From the drop point take the first right and head north along the corridor hugging the left wall if necessary. L|2|•|If you want the second lore piece, «A Dry Withered Leather Bound Journal», make another right turn before heading north. L|1|3.|Keep heading north east past the surface portal and you will come to an area with two «Goldenback Tusker»s and a «Banderling Mace Head» on the floor. Take the mace head and run back to the surface portal. L|2|•|⟦BanderlingMaceHead⟧ L|1|4.|Combine the mace head with the shaft to make a «Banderling Ceremonial Weapon», return it to «Olivier Rognath» for the «Mace of the Explorer». You can also let him examine your journals for additional lore.

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Olivier Rognath tells you, "Hello! If you journey to the Banderling Conquest dungeon far west from Sawato, and bring me back the mace shaft, I may be able to give you some more information."
L|1||Handing in Banderling Mace Shaft⸩ ⸨You give Olivier Rognath Banderling Mace Shaft⸩ ⸨Olivier Rognath tells you, "What a find! This is the shaft of a unique Banderling Ceremonial Weapon. They use it in many of their tribal rituals, although for unknown purposes. If you can find the head of this weapon, and then find a way to reattach the weapon, I would be most interested! Please come see me! The last I heard the head was in some sort of Maze a ways off east from Uziz.⸩ ⸨Olivier Rognath gives you Banderling Mace Shaft.
L|1||Handing in Banderling Mace Head⸩ ⸨You give Olivier Rognath Banderling Mace Head⸩ ⸨Olivier Rognath tells you, "Ahhh....fascinating. I believe this is a part of a rare Ceremonial Weapon, highly prized by Banderling tribes. For what reason, no one knows; it's the cutting edge of Banderling Studies. If only you had the shaft as well. The last I heard it was in a banderling dungeon far west from Sawato."⸩ ⸨Olivier Rognath gives you Banderling Mace Head
L|1||Handing in Banderling Ceremonial Weapon⸩ ⸨You give Olivier Rognath Banderling Ceremonial Weapon⸩ ⸨Olivier Rognath tells you, "My word, I am speechless! Well, not speechless, but certainly amazed! This is the first Banderling Ceremonial Weapon we have found intact. I must send this on to the Society at once. There may even be an Explorership in it for me. In return for this artifact, let me present to you this quality weapon. It will serve you in good stead for much of your adventuring career."⸩ ⸨Olivier Rognath gives you Mace of the Explorer
L|1||Handing in A Battered Leather Journal⸩ ⸨You give Olivier Rognath A Battered Leather Journal⸩ ⸨Olivier Rognath tells you, "Oh my. This is certainly distressing. But tremendously exciting. I almost envy him! To be able to observe them this closely...I, too, have never heard of Banderlings and Mosswarts coming to blows. I shall have to further ponder what this means. And I will have to forward this news on to the Society. If you come across any further word of the whereabouts of Sir Martine, I would be most desperate to learn of it. The last I heard he was spotted somewhere near Uziz."⸩ ⸨Olivier Rognath gives you A Battered Leather Journal
L|1||Handing in A Dry Withered Leather Bound Journal⸩ ⸨You give Olivier Rognath A Dry Withered Leather Bound Journal⸩ ⸨Olivier Rognath tells you, "Well, this explains everything! Well, not everything. But it is a start! I can only surmise that Sir Martine's thoughts on the matter are correct. A Banderling Ceremonial Weapon! I am most amazed. If I could get my hand on such a weapon, it would be an invaluable find! I wonder what is behind all these machinations. Is it possible the Mosswarts are acting on their own? Strange are the wonders of Dereth. And whatever happened to Sir Martine? Maybe there are clues on the new Jungle Island? I have heard rumors sighting him there."⸩ ⸨Olivier Rognath gives you A Dry Withered Leather Bound Journal
L|1||Facility Hub Warden⸩ ⸨Warden tells you, "This task has multiple parts, you will want to return here after finishing a dungeon to take the next portal.⸩ ⸨Warden tells you, "Venture into the Banderling Conquest Dungeon and the Mosswart Maze. From each you'll recover part of a mace.⸩ ⸨Warden tells you, "Once you have found both parts of the mace combine them and take the Banderling Ceremonial Weapon to Olivier Rognath in the middle of Eastham.⸩ ⸨Warden tells you, "Return to me with the Mace of the Explorer that he gives you and I'll see to it that you are rewarded.
L|1||Showing Mace of the Explorer to the Warden (Bonus Reward)⸩ ⸨You allow Warden to examine your Mace of the Explorer⸩ ⸨Warden tells you, "You've done well to complete this task. In your adventures of Dereth you'll often need to travel great distances to complete a single goal.⸩ ⸨Warden tells you, "A reward is in line.⸩ ⸨You've earned 550,000 experience⸩

Quest.name: Major_Prismatic_Stone_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
