H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Josef tells you, "I knew if I whispered long enough one of you outsiders would make your way over to me. The names Josef, and before you ask no there's no surname. Just Josef. Don't ask cause I ain't tellin'. L|1||Josef tells you, "Now listen up, and listen up well cause i don't like taking to much time in repeating myself. It makes me waste precious air and that's not fun. L|1||Josef clears his throat and then drops his voice into a deep whisper L|1||Josef tells you, "A while back the boss, Martine, was planning on opening the way to Marae Lassel. A new home for people. Thing is there were people there already, like us but they grew up different. No big deal right? Well the thing is when he did his spell or whatever something else happened. L|1||Josef tells you, "He finished his little trick and suddenly a portal storm hit the center of the living area here. Portal energy was whipping off the walls and down the corridors. Next thing we know there's a guy sitting in the middle of the room, naked as the day he was born and about eight, maybe nine feet tall. L|1||Josef tells you, "He was real confused. Had no clue where he had come from or where he was, just his name. Gaerlan. And he said over and over again...is Asheron among you. L|1||Josef tells you, "Now here's the rub. I know a lot more than that, but I need some help. So you help me...I help you. Take this. L|1||Josef gives you Josef's Wish List L|1||Josef tells you, "Get me the things on that list and I'll talk. It's simple really."
H3|Handing in Josef's Wish List" Items L|1||You give Josef Virindi Mask L|1||Josef says, "Not bad. Not bad at all. You got connections kid. This will get me in real good. L|1||Josef snickers and looks you over L|1||Josef tells you, "I guess that means I've got some singing to do. No problem. Grab a chair maybe. L|1||Josef pauses a long moment L|1||Josef tells you, "Gaerlan, yeah that was the guys name. Where he came from nobody knows but Martine came right close to turning him into slag after he got back from opening the portals to Marae Lassel. The only thing that allowed the guy to stay was that he groveled better than anyone I had ever seen grovel. Even better than Ketnan. L|1||Josef tells you, "Anyway, this guy said that he had the ability to help Martine, so long as he kept him alive. Martine was wary at first. When I say wary I mean really wary. You see Martine was really trying to get himself back on the straight and narrow. King of like what he did for us and all. But he listened to the guy anyway. It went well. I guess. Martine allowed him to stay. Heck he even gave him his own room within this underground city. L|1||Josef tells you, "Where is it? Keep the goodies coming."
L|1||You give Josef Yellow Jewel L|1||Josef tells you, "Hmm, nice trinket. L|1||Josef tells you, "Okay so this Gaerlan guy, he starts "assisting" Martine with some of his endeavors, going with him out to blow up the arrival points around Dereth. See it went like this. L|1||Josef tells you, "Martine told this guy about the fact that he had it in for Asheron. Mistake one, this guy was into that and used that to his advantage. See, this guy never looked at us as anything more than vermin. Really it's true. Once or twice I overheard him talking about how we had bred as quickly as the vermin that had come from our world. L|1||Josef tells you, "I guess they brought them back after they visited us. Now this was something that was a little odd to hear, but I guess that a long time ago they used to go to different worlds and watch. Then the portals started opening to other places...I never pieced that together. But I know that this guy Gaerlan put the poison thoughts into Martine's head. L|1||Josef tells you, "Martine has been getting better. He was less whimsical from time to time. More stable really. Then the poison started and the high-pitched voice came back. Then he set out to destroy the arrival point from Ispar. L|1||Josef tells you, "Martine had no idea what was happening with that, but I know that this guy did. He even wrote about it I'd guess. L|1||Josef tells you, "In his little diary. He carried it with him a lot. Sorry pal, no more until there is more payment."
L|1||You give Josef Quiddity Ingot L|1||Josef tells you, "Pulling out all the stops now aren't you. L|1||Josef tells you, "Okay then. Martine went to those places where the portals dropped people from Dereth and together with Gaerlan they sealed them closed. No more people that went through the portals that lead there could get through. L|1||Josef tells you, "Kind of makes you wonder, huh? At any rate the deed was done. Martine was happy, no content, you can never really say that he has been happy. I mean the guy did lose his wife and child ant then his humanity. That has to be rought right? L|1||Josef tells you, "So this Gaerlan guy starts riling him up and getting him to listen to his hatred, or the Virindi in him, whatever that is. Then Martine builds a son. I wouldn't say it if it wasn't true. He thought about it and it happened. Of course Gaerlan was there the entire time, assisting him in the creation of this thing. A Hollow Minion. I tell you, he called it son and embraced it. And sent it out onto the world. L|1||Josef tells you, "He did that three times in all. Each time, they got a little tougher. But still Martine wasn't done. He set about a plan to kill the Queen. But then that was twisted. Gaerlan made sure of that. "The boy he said. The boy. You have a son now, Martine. You won't need two." Martine listened and lo, he set about to kill Borelean. L|1||Josef shakes his head L|1||Josef tells you, "That was just not like Martine. Just not like him. I'm sorry I can't talk about this anymore."
L|1||You give Josef Shackles of Obedience L|1||Josef tells you, "These won't help me much, but... L|1||You've earned 100,000 experience L|1||Josef tells you, "That should help you a little. See, I want these for a specific reason. They'd remind Martine of what the Virindi did to him. We don't want that happening to him ever again. By we I mean the majority of us here. All of us had problems. Some greater than others, but we did all have problems and Martine gave us something that none of us had, Hope. L|1||Josef tells you, "In a sense he was our savior. He took us out of the darkest times that any of us had ever faced, brought us back from that brink and got us motivated to live again. L|1||Josef tells you, "Not easy to do with a bunch of ne'er do wells. But he did it. We started working with him to build places that we could call our own. Do things that we could have pride in. We struggled it's true but in the end we were feeling better and things were looking up. Until Gaerlan came back. And then the voice returned. L|1||Josef lowers his eyes L|1||Josef tells you, "It was like watching your best friend disappear. He had beaten that thing back. It was gone, forever. But now it was back. L|1||Josef tells you, "Nothing more I can say about that."
L|1||You give Josef Directive Key L|1||Josef tells you, "Nice one. L|1||Josef tells you, "Settle in. So Martine set his sights on the kid. Vile. Out of Character. Why did we stay you wonder? We're loyal to Martine. Loyal cause he saved us from something worse than any death could be. He saved us from despair. L|1||Josef tells you, "What else could we do? We stayed with him. But this guy Gaerlan preyed on him more. He helped him with the Olthoi. He demonstrated some intense understanding about their bodies. Strong points, weak points. The best place to strike them to incapacitate them but not kill them. Things that no one of us would have known. Where he got that knowledge I don't know. L|1||Josef tells you, "He helped Martine where the Virindi failed. He made a hollow version of the Olthoi. Weaker. But damn they hit hard and there was no way to defend against them. Funny thing is Gaerlan would never go near them. L|1||Josef tells you, "But he convinced Martine to invade the mainland of Dereth. That Elysa and Asheron were joined now, making war on his son. Trying to bring about Martine's destruction now. L|1||Josef tells you, "And also about this time, Gaerlan started to gain more freedom, and he used it. We'd inform Martine but he didn't care. He was busy off on his own. Not until recently did we start to realize that he was visiting Elysa. L|1||Josef tells you, "There's more, but we made a deal."
L|1||You give Josef Master Key L|1||Josef tells you, "Hmm more trinkets. Good job. L|1||Josef tells you, "Martine started getting a little more lucid around this time. Not a lot mind you, but with Gaerlan taking some time away from constant contact with Martine he started to act more normal. Though something had really changed within him and every night he would leave here to go visit Elysa. L|1||Josef tells you, "He watched her from afar at first, then got closer and closer until recently and became very solemn. No silent. L|1||Josef tells you, "He hasn't spoken in the longest time. Not since Gaerlan shunted him like a child. Not since he killed Asheron. L|1||Josef lowers his eyes and shakes his head L|1||Josef tells you, "Now, things are breaking down. We need him you see. Some of us still think that we can pull him around. Others think that we'd be best to foster his hate and tell him to finish the job. Still others...like me think he did the job. There is no hop e left. Asheron is dead. And Martine has finally realized the truth. L|1||Josef looks you dead in the eye and speaks solemnly L|1||Josef tells you, "Asheron never meant harm to anyone. This world, the Olthoi, the pain. It was never him. It was never him...and now Martine has killed the brightest list that this world had."
L|1||You give Josef Singularity Key L|1||Josef tells you, "This is the best possible thing you could give me friend. L|1||Josef tells you, "Martine likes these the most because it means that you not only killed one of their most powerful members, but you have also found a way to steal some of their treasures. L|1||Josef manages a weak smile L|1||Josef tells you, "Take this. L|1||Josef gives you Gaerlan's Key L|1||Josef tells you, "See I've made a life of finding information. I listened to everything and learned as much as I could. In his room Gaerlan kept a chest. In that chest must be something special. It was bright, like the rainbow and vibrant. Get what you can, he left it. Oh and getting there just takes a little leap of faith. L|1||Josef tells you, "Good luck, friend."

L|1||Giri bint Ashud tells you, "This batch should last me about a week, return to me then, and I can send you out to get me another batch, for the same reward, of course."

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "You, who have done so much for the people of Silyun, I now request a boon from you."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "Not for the people. Not for the cause. But for ME!"⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "I seek...no demand vengeance. It is my right and I have been denied it for far too long."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "For you see, not long after we arrived on this wretched land, my favorite grandson was taken from me."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "One of those vile creatures we now call Eaters attacked our camp and brutally killed and ate him as we we all watched in stunned horror."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "The short of the tale is that thing escaped and all attempts to kill it have met with failure."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "You shall be my blade. My truth. My justice. My revenge!"⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "Seek this creature out and kill it."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "Bring me the jaws of this Eater so that they can cause no more sorrow to others."
L|1||Handing in Marauder's Jaw⸩ ⸨You give Grand Mother Marauder's Jaw.⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "This is from the beast that killed my grandson?"⸩ ⸨The fire in Grand Mother's eyes slowly fades replaced by tears of sorrow.⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "For so long I have waited for this moment."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "All the old pain and memories flood back into my soul when I look upon this jaw."⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "Bless you soldier of light. He will trust you if I vouch for you."
L|1||Handing in Hero of Silyun Token⸩ ⸨You give Grand Mother Hero of Silyun Token.⸩ ⸨Grand Mother tells you, "For your deeds and service to Silyun I shall bestow the title Hero of Silyun upon you. Kneel before me."⸩ ⸨Let it be known that has won the approval and support of the people and shall henceforth be called, Hero of Silyun!⸩

Quest.name: Mausoleum_of_Anger_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|40-69 I|Rec. Level|40 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Gatekeeper of Anger» I|Starts At|«Dryreach», «Kara» I|Repeat|5 minutes I|Kill Task|False H2|Overview P|This quest was colloquially known as xp levers, and was only available on «Darktide». It was announced in January 2005, introduced in February 2005, and then removed in June 2005.
P|There are four versions of this quest. See: L|1|•|«Mausoleum of Bitterness Quest» (20-49) L|1|•|«Mausoleum of Anger Quest» (50-59) (Infinite Leaftide: 250-499) L|2|•|⟦TouchedPvPHatePillar400205⟧ L|2|•|⟦TouchedPvPHateEffigy400205⟧ L|1|•|«Mausoleum of Cruelty Quest» (60-89) L|1|•|«Mausoleum of Slaughter Quest» (80-109)
P|In addition to the level requirements, this quest requires that you have the «Player Killer» status.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Run to the «Gatekeeper of Anger». Known locations for this gatekeeper are: L|2|•|79.7S, 44.3E, west of Kara. L|2|•|10.1S, 74.0E, South of Dryreach. L|1|2.|Speak to the Gatekeeper to be teleported into the «Mausoleum of Anger». L|1|3.|Make your way to the «Pillar of Anger» and interact with it. This will flag you to use the Effigy for 30 minutes. L|1|4.|Make your way to the «Effigy of Anger» and interact with it. As long as you are flagged, you may use the Effigy every 5 minutes for a reward. L|1|5.|If you exceed the level restrictions of the dungeon while inside and attempt to use the Pillar or Effigy again, it will dispel your protections, cast «Tusker's Gift» on you, and debuff your jump skill. Then it will teleport you to high in the air at 65.3N, 5.4E, near the «Mountain Cavern», where you will fall to your death.

L|1||If PK, too high or too low level:⸩ ⸨Gatekeeper of Anger tells you, "The Gate does not open for those who seek powers above or below their station."

L|1||If flagged:⸩ ⸨Effigy of Anger tells you, "We recognize the darkness in your soul and we will grant you strength."

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80-109 I|Rec. Level|80 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Accursed Gatekeeper of Slaughter», «Unholy Gatekeeper of Slaughter» I|Starts At|«Ayan Baqur», «Candeth Keep», «Wai Jhou» I|Repeat|5 minutes I|Kill Task|False H2|Overview P|This quest was colloquially known as xp levers, and was only available on «Darktide». It was announced in January 2005, introduced in February 2005, and then removed in June 2005.
P|There are four versions of this quest. See: L|1|•|«Mausoleum of Bitterness Quest» (20-49) L|1|•|«Mausoleum of Anger Quest» (40-69) L|1|•|«Mausoleum of Cruelty Quest» (60-89) L|1|•|«Mausoleum of Slaughter Quest» (80-109) L|2|•|⟦TouchedPvPHatePillar800205⟧ L|2|•|⟦TouchedPvPHateEffigy800205!⟧
P|In addition to the level requirements, this quest requires that you have the «Player Killer» status.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Run to the «Accursed Gatekeeper of Slaughter» or the «Unholy Gatekeeper of Slaughter». Known locations for these gatekeeper are: L|2|•|60.1S, 66.5W, Obsidian Plains - Accursed Gatekeeper. L|2|•|82.9S, 81.0W, Southwest Direlands - Unholy Gatekeeper. L|2|•|63.7S, 51.5W, south of Wai Jhou - Unholy Gatekeeper. L|1|2.|Speak to the Gatekeeper to be teleported into the «Accursed Mausoleum of Slaughter» or «Unholy Mausoleum of Slaughter», depending on which Gatekeeper you used. L|1|3.|Make your way to the «Pillar of Slaughter» and interact with it. This will flag you to use the Effigy for 30 minutes. L|1|4.|Make your way to the «Effigy of Slaughter» and interact with it. As long as you are flagged, you may use the Effigy every 5 minutes for a reward. L|1|5.|If you exceed the level restrictions of the dungeon while inside and attempt to use the Pillar or Effigy again, it will dispel your protections, cast «Tusker's Gift» on you, and debuff your jump skill. Then it will teleport you to high in the air at 62.4S, 71.1W, at the Shadow Spire crater on the «Obsidian Plains», where you will fall to your death.

Quest.name: Niffis_Fighting_Pits
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Niffis Fighting Pits (Dungeon)¦Niffis Fighting Pits» I|Route|«Niffis Fighting Pits (Portal Gem)¦Niffis Fighting Pits Portal Gem» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Banderling brother! Come one, come all to the most excitable, tentaclicacal, fighttastical, Niffcacal, underground fight of the year! Bring your well-trained Niffis fighter to the Niffis Fighting Pits! It's Niffis versus Niffis in the brutalist bloodsport of the Dires! Owned and operated by Grikflap the Uf-bringer!
L|1|•|To access this quest, you first need to obtain a «Niffis Fighting Pits (Portal Gem)¦Niffis Fighting Pits Portal Gem» from a Banderling «Banderling Aggressor¦Aggressor», «Banderling Predator¦Predator» or «Banderling Scalper¦Scalper» and summon on a flat surface. The gem can also be purchased from the «Colosseum Coin Collector».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Inside the «Niffis Fighting Pits (Dungeon)¦Niffis Fighting Pits» dungeon, pick up the note «Heartfelt Plea» on the ground near the drop. L|2|•|⟦QuestLittlestNiffisNoteAcquired1204⟧ L|1|2.|{OPT} Runed Chest in last big room. L|2|•|⟦ChestQuestLittlestNiffis1204⟧ L|1|3.|The dungeon is linear, so just keep heading forward. L|1|4.|At the end of the dungeon, give the Heartfelt Plea to «Reijiri». Each person in the group needs to hand a note to get the reward.
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Niffis Fighting Pits (Dungeon)|Niffis Fighting Pits» N/A -- -- TE
H2|Rewards
R|Give Heartfelt Plea to Reijiri RK|Experience|20,000,000 (Fixed% up to level Fixed) RK|Items| RI|«Wallbound Niffis» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Reijiri⸩ ⸨Reijiri sighs deeply. You get the feeling that beneath her prize-fighting, rough and tumble exterior lies an ocean of despair and longing. You wonder just what could cause such a deep feeling of sadness in one who has accomplished so much.⸩ ⸨Yet before you can question her, she wipes away a purple tear with one shaking tentacle, cocks her head, and resumes her previous stance of fighter, champion, warrior.⸩ ⸨Reijiri beats the air rapidly with her wings.⸩ ⸨Reijiri flexes her tentacles.⸩ ⸨Reijiri's tentacles quiver, as if itching to lash out. You get the feeling this is a well-trained and well-disciplined fighter and you know, deep in your heart, that she will not hurt you now. No, she will not. She's saving it for the ring.
L|1||Handing in Heartfelt Plea⸩ ⸨You give Reijiri Heartfelt Plea.⸩ ⸨Reijiri ponders the note for a long moment. She looks you in the eye and your heart breaks at the sadness you glimpse beneath those dark, melancholy orbs. This is a fighter who has abandoned those that love her. And for what? Glory? Acceptance? Approval from those who would use her for naught but entertainment? Or worse, for profit?⸩ ⸨Reijiri regards you for a time, then nods her head. You don't quite understand what passes between you, but you think it feels a little something like gratitude. Perhaps you have helped this poor, small Niffis. Perhaps you have pointed out the path - the path which all of us seek - towards contentment.⸩ ⸨You've earned 20,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Reijiri gives you Wallbound Niffis.⸩

Level|100 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Darhy, Assistant to Nuhmudira» I|Starts At|13.2N, 0.8E in «Zaikhal» I|Repeat|None H2|Overview P|This was the culmination of the «A Time of Chaos» Story Arc, evolving around the «Ancient Olthoi Queen». L|1|3.|Keep going down, and follow right hand rule. At the bottom, you will find «A Bar Tab» and «Hiyp the Toad's pickaxe». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpHiypPickaxe⟧ L|1|4.|Return the pickaxe to «Hiyp the Toad» in the Arwic tavern. L|2|•|⟦DoneWithHiypTheToad⟧ L|1|5.|«Hiyp the Toad» sends you to «Djusufa bint Huqis the Jeweler» in «Zaikhal». L|2|•|⟦TalkedToZaikhalJeweler⟧ L|1|6.|«Djusufa bint Huqis the Jeweler» will in return send you to «Cydna Wren» at 4.9N, 23.8E near «Samsur». L|2|•|⟦TalkedToExStudentROT2⟧ L|1|7.|Get «Cydna Wren's Portal Gem» from under «A small pile of rocks» near an Armoredillo Cave at 11.0N 21.1E. L|2|•|Route: «Al-Jalima» to «Dillo Butte Settlement» at 5.7N, 4.3E. L|1|8.|Use the Portal Gem to get portaled into «Nuhmudira's Dungeon». There are no creatures in this part of the dungeon. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpROT2Crystal⟧ L|1|9.|Hand this crystal in to «Darhy, Assistant to Nuhmudira» to receive a «Crystal Ring of Quickness», «Crystal Ring of Protection», «Whispering Venom Crystal Ring» or a «Scintillating Crystal Ring». L|1|10.|Wear the ring to get access to the «Lair of the Ancient Queen». L|2|•|⟦CanAccessQueenLairROT2⟧

L|1|2.|You have the choice to take three different routes (with different level «Olthoi», that leads towards an «Olthoi Sentinel». Take the north passage for the route with the easiest Olthoi. L|1|3.|Kill the 100,000 hp «Olthoi Sentinel» at the end of the lair and loot an «Olthoi Abdomen Fragment» (1-3 fragments per kill). L|1|4.|Turn this in at the «Olthoi Hunter» and receive an Olthoi Shield. Which shield you receive depends on your level.

Nuhmudira had determined there is an unknown force that seems to "drown out" mana and suppresses higher forms of magic. This force is particularly powerful in the proximity of this lair and prevents anyone from being portalled successfully there.⸩ ⸨Darhy, Assistant to Nuhmudira tells you, "A very rare crystal, Whispering Venom crystal is required to nullify this effect- the wearing of a ring made from this crystal allows a successful journey through portal space to this lair. Alas, Nuhmudira did possess a supply of these crystals however they were stolen once from her warehouse, together with numerous other crystals. While the other crystal types are being replaced through the good efforts of Isparians, a supply of Whispering Venom crystal is lacking."⸩ ⸨Darhy, Assistant to Nuhmudira tells you, "There is a mine at desert's edge, west of Khayyaban, which used to be a source of these crystals. It may be somewhat depleted but it is our only hope. Please try to find some and return as soon as you are able!"
L|1||Hiyp The Toad Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Hiyp the Toad tells you, "Yeah, I like the beer here, so what? I'll do some alchemy later. I could mine some crystals if I had my pickaxe..."
L|1||Handing in Toad's Pickaxe to Hiyp the Toad⸩ ⸨You give Hiyp the Toad Hiyp the Toad's pickaxe⸩ ⸨Hiyp The Toad looks at you with a sodden expression⸩ ⸨Hiyp the Toad tells you, "Hey, that's my best pickaxe! I must have left it down in the, ummm, where was that... oh yeah there was that mine, I was tryin' to get some of those crystals them's in Zaikhal wanted. Maybe it'll help with the bugs, maybe not. Well, there's nothing in that mine, I'll tell ya. So I said to myself, forget it, go have a drink. You trying to get some too? Hmmm, I just may know someone who can get some. There's a jeweler, name of Djusufa bint Huqis, she's in Zaikhal. I know her a while, she told me something interesting. One night a woman came to her and handed her a strange crystal, wondered if she knew what it was good for. The jeweler, she didn't know, never seen one like that before. She said she'd have to ask around, maybe check with one of Nuhmudira's people. Well, this woman gets all nervous and just leaves. Anyway, that's all I know. Go see Djusufa bint Huqis."
L|1||Djusufa bint Huqis the Jeweler⸩ ⸨Djusufa bint Huqis the Jeweler tells you, "So, Hiyp told you to talk to me about Whispering Venom crystal. Yes, that is correct, it was a dark and stormy night when this woman came banging on my shop door even though I had just closed. She seemed to be rather nervous but needed to know about a crystal, which she handed to me. She wanted to understand what it may be used for. I examined it carefully for I had never seen one like it before. It's purpose or potential eluded me and I said to her that I would have to inquire with one of the scholars working with Nuhmudira about it. She became very agitated then and ran out the door. I tried to go after her to return the crystal but she was gone.⸩ ⸨Djusufa bint Huqis the Jeweler tells you, "I remembered later that I had seen her about town and that she was in fact one of Nuhmudira's students. Not wanting to cause trouble for her I inquired discreetly and found out she was originally from somewhere northeast of Samsur. Eventually I brought the crystal to one of Nuhmudira's other students and he said he believed it was Whispering Venom crystal. I allowed him to keep it and that was that. So, I do not have the crystal now. Had I known so many would be seeking such crystal these days I might have made a tidy sum selling it!"
L|1||Cydna Wren⸩ ⸨Cydna Wren tells you, "What do you want from me? Oh ... the crystal. That jeweler must have led you to me. Ah well, there is no hiding ... nor does it matter who I put my trust in. Experience has taught me that lesson. If you keep my location here a secret, I will tell you where some of those crystals may be found. Take this small journal. I wrote it in case ... something happened to me."⸩ ⸨Cydna Wren gives you Cydna Wren's Journal.
L|1||Speaking to Cydna Wren again⸩ ⸨Cydna Wren tells you, "What do you want from me? Go away, I do not trust you."
L|1||Using the small pile of rocks⸩ ⸨You pick up a gem from underneath the rock.
L|1||Handing in Whispering Venom crystal to Darhy, Assistant to Nuhmudira⸩ ⸨You give Darhy, Assistant to Nuhmudira Whispering Venom crystal.⸩ ⸨Darhy, Assistant to Nuhmudira tells you, "I am delighted you were able to get some Whispering Venom crystals from that mine!"⸩ ⸨Nuhmudira's assistant casts several spells upon the crystal and fashions a portion of it into a ring.⸩ ⸨Darhy, Assistant to Nuhmudira tells you, "Wearing this ring will allow passage through the portal. Go and get the better of the Olthoi that dwell in that foul lair!"⸩ ⸨Darhy, Assistant to Nuhmudira gives you Crystal Ring of Protection.
L|1||Handing in Olthoi Abdomen Fragment to Olthoi Hunter⸩ ⸨You give Olthoi Hunter Olthoi Abdomen Fragment.⸩ ⸨Olthoi Hunter tells you, "The Olthoi Sentinel is truly a fearsome creature. I shall make you a shield worthy of a prince with this fragment."⸩ ⸨Olthoi Hunter gives you Greater Olthoi Shield.⸩ ⸨Olthoi Hunter tells you, "Take care."⸩

Quest.name: Preparation_for_the_Ritus
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|40 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Gerent's Compound» at 87.2S, 17.5W I|Route|«Qalaba'r» to «Land Bridge Villas» at 74.8S 17.8E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Originally, this quest was designed for the «A Time of Chaos¦Ancient Olthoi Queen» Story Arc. «Nuhmudira» asked players to gather 3 items, each obtained from level restricted dungeons. After the Story Arc, the items remained ingame. The lore texts, however, are not available anymore.
L|1|•|«Lockpick» skill is required for the «Ancient Temple» (Max. difficulty 600).
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Gerent's Compound and the Energy Crystal L|1|1.|Travel to «Gerent's Compound» at 87.2S, 17.5W. L|2|•|Route: Take the «Land Bridge Villas» portal in «Qalaba'r» (74.8S 17.8E) and go west to 87.2S, 17.5W. L|1|2.|Make your way to the end of the dungeon (see map). L|1|3.|Talk to the «Representative of the Singularity» to receive the «Energy Crystal». L|2|•|⟦OrbEnergyCrystal⟧
H3|Aerbax's Holding and the Bracelet of Dark Essence L|1|1.|Travel to «Aerbax's Holding» at 62.4S, 71.1W on the «Obsidian Plains». L|2|•|Route: The dungeon is a short run west of «Singularity Bore», you can use the «Dangerous Portal Device» at your mansion to quickly go to the Bore. L|1|2.|Keep hugging the right wall. The dungeon is relatively short. L|1|3.|Warning, when trying to run through, after the ramp up to the room, and the subsequent hallway, it's easy to get stuck between creatures. L|1|4.|Use the «Magically Sealed Dais» to receive the «Bracelet of Dark Essence». L|2|•|⟦EssenceBraceletReceived⟧
H3|Ancient Temple and the Living Tome L|1|1.|Travel to the «Ancient Temple» at 33.0S, 88.0W north of «Ayan Baqur». L|2|•|Route: Use «Mount Lethe Recall» and go west to 33.0S, 88.0W. L|1|2.|Make your way to the end of the (rather long) dungeon (see map). L|1|3.|In the final room, with a «Falatacot Abbess», use the tome to receive your «Living Tome». L|2|•|⟦BookFalatacotWay⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|The «Living Tome» can also be given to «Fanzen San the Translator» at 39.2S, 81.6E near «Hebian-To» for the «Unknown Script» lore text.

In his jealousy, the anima Carenzi has infested the beautiful shrine I built for Raeta with his own creatures. I tried to route them myself, but the horrid beasts nearly ripped me to pieces and ate the key to my chest! Until my shrine is cleansed of his defiling presence, Raeta will not return!"⸩ ⸨Aun Papileona tells you, "I locked my amulet inside my chest--if you bring it to me as proof that you have driven Carenzi away, I will reward you with the title of Carenzi Slayer. Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Uber P» I|Starts At|«Isle of Ruin» at 94.6N, 53.2W I|Route|«Fiun Outpost» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|{OPT} Talk to «Uber P» near «Fiun Outpost» at 94.6N, 53.2W to receive the «Letter from Uber P». L|1|2.|Travel to the «Frigid Grotto» near «Fiun Outpost» at 97.1N, 51.8W. L|1|3.|{OPT} Head south at the start of the dungeon and go left. Navigate through to find an «Algid Warrior», an elemental who drops keys to chests in the same room. Quest.name: Shadow_Captain's_Heaume_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|26, 31 I|Type|Multi-Fellowship I|Starts With|{OPT} «Chosen of Asheron» I|Starts At|«Cragstone» / «Hebian-To» / «Zaikhal» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest requires at least 2 players/teams to complete. There are two separate dungeons, each of which have levers that open doors in the other dungeon.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|•|For this walk through, instructions for **Team 1** refer to those players that enter the «Upper Shade Stronghold» (26+), and instructions for **Team 2** refer to those players that enter the «Shade Stronghold» (31+). L|2|•|Note: The rewards on this quest are split. **Team 1** will receive the «Shadow Captain's Heaume», and **Team 2** will receive the «Heart of Shadow».
H3|Part 1: Upper & Lower Shade Stronghold L|1|1.|From «Crater Lake Village», take the «Stone Triad Dell» portal at 66.2N, 14.3E, and run to 73.5N, 0.2W. L|1|2.|**Team 1:** Enter the «Upper Shade Stronghold» at 73.5N, 0.2W. L|1|3.|**Team 2:** Enter the «Shade Stronghold» at 73.5N, 0.2W. L|1|4.|**Team 1:** From the drop, head North and flip the lever on the North wall, which opens the first door for Team 2. Continue down the linear hall until you reach the next lever activated door. L|1|5.|**Team 2:** From the drop, head north through the first open door (Team 1 opened it), and flip the lever on then North wall, which opens the first door for Team 1. Continue down the linear hall until you reach the next lever. L|1|6.|Both dungeons are relatively straight and linear. Repeat the lever, door relationship back and forth until both parties reach rooms with a portals to the «Upper Heart of Darkness» and «Heart of Darkness» respectively. Take the portals. L|2|•|**Note:** When you get to the lava pits, jump over them, don't jump in them.
H3|Part 2: Upper & Lower Heart of Darkness L|1|1.|**Team 1:** From the drop, head South and use the second (middle) lever on your left, which opens the first door for Team 2. L|1|2.|**Team 2:** From the drop, head North and use the first lever on your left, which opens the first door for Team 1. L|1|3.|**Team 1:** Continue to move through the hallway until you get to a small 4-room offshoot, each of which contains a lever. Use the southwest most lever to open the final door for Team 2. L|1|4.|**Team 2:** Once through the door, take your first left at the bottom of the ramp and use the lever to open the next gate for Team 1. L|1|5.|**Team 1:** Once through the gate, continue until you reach the final room, where you'll the final lever on the North wall (under the statue). Flip the lever for Team 2, then kill the «Upper Shadow Heart Leader» and loot the «Shadow Captain's Heaume» from his corpse (drops 1 per kill). L|2|•|⟦ShadowCaptainsHeaume⟧ L|1|6.|**Team 2:** Head through the last door, run down the ramp, and kill the «Lower Shadow Heart Leader». Loot the «Heart of Shadow» from the ground nearby. L|2|•|⟦HopeslayerHeart⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|If you visit the optional quest starter, «Chosen of Asheron», he will hand you the texts: «Asheron's Second Missive» and «Instructions (Sepulcher of the Hopeslayer)¦Instructions».

Quest.name: Shadow_Statues
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|100+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} «Riordin Nightbane» I|Starts At|{OPT} 61.9S, 51.5W in «Wai Jhou» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Riordin Nightbane in «Wai Jhou» is a member of the shadow hunting group, the «Knights of the Golden Flame». They are opposed to the «Order of the Raven Hand» and he wants you to find statues that the Raven Cultists have built in the «Valley of Death».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Go to the «Valley of Death» and search for a «Shadowy Statue of the Hopeslayer». L|1|2.|Use the Statue and 2 «Void Knight»s (shadows) and 2 «Raven Augur (Level 160)¦Raven Augur»s (humans) will spawn. L|1|3.|Kill the Shadows and Augurs and check their corpses for a «Small Shadow Statue of the Hopeslayer». L|2|•|Note: The drop rate is very high. Maybe 20% or more. L|1|4.|Continue finding statues and killing until you collect 3 statues total. L|1|5.|Bring the three statues to «Wai Jhou» and give them to «Riordin Nightbane» who resides on the 2nd floor of the tower. L|2|•|⟦SmallShadowStatueTurnIns⟧ L|2|•|⟦SmallShadowStatueTurnIns_wait⟧ L|2|•|Note: If you turn in anymore statues before the week timer is up then you will get an M trade note rather than xp.
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.
H2|Rewards
R|Give 3 Shadowy Statues of the Hopeslayer to Riordin Nightbane RK|Experience|37,456,440 (20% up to level 130) RE
R|Give additional statues to Riordin before the repeat timer expires RK|Items| RI|«Trade Note (100,000)» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "I have been brought here to assist Sarkin Killcrane in the collection of the Frozen Black Crystals he has been receiving from adventurers as of late. If you wish to try to retrieve one of these crystals for us, I have heard that they can be found on a Mukkir named Targor. Targor seems to be a part of an ongoing conflict between the Raven Hand and a group of Shadows up around 68.4N, 66.6E."⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "Also, there have been reports of Shadows and Raven Hand Cultists erecting statues to the Hopeslayer in what people refer to as the 'Valley of Death'."⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "If you find any small idols or some such in their possession, my colleagues in the Knighthood would be interested in studying them. I'd say, three of them, total, would be enough to allow them to magically study them for information."
L|1||Using Shadowy Statue of the Hopeslayer⸩ ⸨The fragile statue, crafted of pure shadow, begins to fade as you touch it.
L|1||Handing in first two Small Shadow Statues of the Hopeslayer⸩ ⸨You give Riordin Nightbane Small Shadow Statue of the Hopeslayer.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane looks over the statue, with a dark look on his face.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "Disgusting little things, aren't they?"Riordin Nightbane tells you, "Not quite a set of three yet. Hand me another statue, if you have one on you, or go get more. I'll need a set of three to send off."⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "Sorry, not my decision, it's what they requested of me. On the third statue, I'll reward you for your efforts."
L|1||Handing in the third Small Shadow Statue of the Hopeslayer⸩ ⸨You give Riordin Nightbane Small Shadow Statue of the Hopeslayer.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "The final statue requested, wonderful. With these three statues, my colleagues should be able to figure out what those shadows and their Raven Hand helpers are up to in the Valley. These three should hold them for a while, about a week if I had to guess. If you find any more of these statues before then, however, I'll pay you in good, old fashioned Trade Notes for them."⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "Now, for the reward both promised to you, and rightly earned."⸩ ⸨You've earned 37,456,440 experience.
L|1||Handing in Small Shadow Statue of the Hopeslayer (before Repeat Timer expires)⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "Also, if you have any more of those small shadow statues, my colleagues do not need them at the moment, but I'd be interested in buying them off you for, say... 100,000 pyreals a piece?"⸩ ⸨You give Riordin Nightbane Small Shadow Statue of the Hopeslayer.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "Another Shadow Statue, wonderful. I don't know if I should be pleased that we have more subjects for research, or horrified that you find these so readily available. Here, allow me to pay you for this one."⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane gives you Trade Note (100,000).⸩

Quest.name: Shivering_Stone_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|Major stone: «Serac Vault» at 59.9S, 55.0E I|Route|«Linvak Tukal» to «Outside Linvak Tukal» portal to Serac Vault at 59.9S, 55.0E. I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to obtain one of «Lady Maila»'s elemental stones (also known as «Atlan Stones»). The stones can be used to upgrade various weapons and armor:
L|1|•|Minor and major stones can be used to upgrade «Atlan Weapons» and «Isparian Weapons». L|1|•|Major stones can be used to upgrade «Shadow Armor». L|1|•|Both the stones can also be given to an «Agent of the Arcanum» for a «Writ of Refuge» (you need 1 major stone or 2 minor stones for the writ). L|1|•|The minor stone is weaker than the major stone and therefore much easier to obtain.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|The Major Shivering Stone L|1|1.|From the vault entrance room, go straight ahead into the east passage and hug the right wall. At the end you should come to a ledge looking into a large room with rock formations, jump down and head east into the passage behind the rock. L|1|2.|At the end of the passage you will come out onto a catwalk back in the first area. Follow the path around to a ledge and jump across to the north catwalk. L|1|3.|Now follow it west ignoring the bridge to the north and at the end shift jump across west to the catwalk. From here, follow the path north to the final area. L|1|4.|You should now see a lever on the wall to your right. Pause for a moment and use your bracket keys to search for more levers. You should pick up two more levers to your left across the gap, the passage with the levers is blocked by metal grating. One of these levers opens the wooden door to the north and to the room with the stone. L|1|5.|The wall lever to your right opens the door to the area behind the grating. Once you pull it, you need to run back along the path you just came from and it will lead to that area. L|1|6.|Once you have pulled the lever on the left wall behind the grating (other lever closes the metal door here), run back one last time and jump across into the room for the «Major Shivering Stone». L|3|•|⟦shiveringstonemajor!⟧ L|1|7.|{OPT} You can take «Textbook (Atlan's Treatise)¦Textbook» and «Elaborate Scroll», that is found with the stone, to Bretself the Translator in «Cragstone» for translation at 26.0N, 47.0E.
H3|The Minor Shivering Stone L|1|1.|To get to the «42.7N, 49.8E - Igloo¦igloo» quickly, start in «Holtburg» and take the «Holtburg Wilderness Settlement» portal from Holtburg at 40.2N, 35.1E, this will drop you only a short run from the igloo at 42.7N, 49.8E. L|1|2.|Once there you will see it is surrounded by «Frost (Elemental)¦Frost» elementals, you can run right past them into the cave where you will find the «Minor Shivering Stone». L|3|•|⟦shiveringstoneminor!⟧ L|1|3.|{OPT} You can take the «Textbook (Atlan's Treatise)¦Textbook», that is found with the stone, to Bretself the Translator in «Cragstone» for translation at 26.0N, 47.0E.

We hope to tap those energies for other uses. Here, take this as a reward."⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum gives you Writ of Refuge.⸩

Quest.name: Skull_of_High_Acolyte_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Small Fellowship I|Starts At|«Acolyte Towers» at 88.4S, 10.6W I|Route|«Qalaba'r» to «Land Bridge Villas» portal at 74.8S, 17.8E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Old quest that was good fun to do with a fellowship and offered some good loot at the end. Now the quest is only really worth doing for the «Skull of High Acolyte» which is required to gain access to the «Mines of Despair» for the «Focusing Stone Quest».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Portal to the Acolyte Towers L|1|1.|To start this quest head to «Qalaba'r» and use the «Land Bridge Villas» portal at 74.8S 17.8E. L|1|2.|From there run to 88.4S, 10.6W. (Note: unless you have more than 200 health and a reasonably high jump, it would be a good idea NOT to jump down behind the Villas. Even at 165, my mage took more than 140 points of impact damage and she was fully buffed.) L|1|3.|Kill the lich outside of the middle (East) tower. Its death opens the door. Run to the top and pull the lever. This will open the door to the highest (North) tower. Enter the highest tower which spawns a group of liches and undead, kill the lich that is taller than the other undead to open the door to the lowest (South) tower. L|1|4.|Run down and go inside to trigger a Lesser Acolyte to spawn outside. Kill the Acolyte to spawn the portal. Enter the Soul Fearing Vestry Portal.
H3|Part 2: The Acolyte Towers L|1|1.|From the drop turn right, follow the passage, look for a button in an alcove to your right. It opens a door to the right further down the passage. Straight across from the open door is another locked door. To open it, go up the ramp and run around the wall to a room full of zombies. Pull the lever in the back of the room. Run back down through both doors. L|1|2.|Head north down the ramp. At the "T" turn left, then right, heading north. Ignore all side passages til the next "T". Turn left, then right, heading north into the final room and the first Lesser Acolyte. Kill him to spawn a portal to the next dungeon. L|1|3.|From the drop, go west 'til you get to a locked door on the right. To open it, there is a corridor (just around the corner) on the south wall. Hug the right or west wall, the button is located across the bridge at the end of a short corridor to the right. In order to make the run back easier, you may want to kill everything on your way to the button. L|1|4.|Back to the door, and down the ramp. At the "T" turn right then north up the ramp to a ledge. You must jump across to the room with the lever. After pulling the lever, jump down and go to the west around a wall to a ramp. Go down the ramp and through two doors. The second Lesser Acolyte awaits. Kill him to spawn a portal to the next dungeon.
H3|Part 3: The High Acolyte L|1|1.|From the drop use the west corridor, then up the ramp and north 'til you hit a dead end. Go through the door to the right, then north up a ramp. Follow the corridor around 'til you're once again heading north down a ramp. Turn left, then left again, there is a button in an alcove to your right. It unlocks a door on the south wall behind you. L|1|2.|Follow the corridor to the High Acolyte. Kill him to spawn a portal. L|1|3.|But, wait! There's more! Make sure that everyone loots a «Yucky Key» and a «Skull of High Acolyte». Since the High Acolyte only drops one Yucky Key and Skull per death, you'll have to wait for respawn. The respawn is about 5 minutes. After everyone has their skull and key, use the portal. L|2|•|⟦SoulFearingVestrySkull⟧ L|2|•|⟦SoulFearingVestryKey⟧ L|2|•|The Yucky Key has 4 uses. The «Small Chest»s are located across the hall from the surface portal. L|1|4.|Take the Skull of High Acolyte to «Le-Ai Rea» located at 75.9S 57.3E. He gives a «Golden Key» and «Le-Ai Rea's Key» for each Skull of High Acolyte. These keys are needed for the «Focusing Stone Quest».

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|Major stone: «Jahannan Vault» at 66.9N, 15.0E I|Route|«Khayyaban» to «Al-Mar Oasis» at 49.2S 26.0E, to Jahannan Vault (duplicate portal) at 49.8S, 15.0E. I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to obtain one of «Lady Maila»'s elemental stones (also known as «Atlan Stones»). The stones can be used to upgrade various weapons and armor:
L|1|•|Minor and major stones can be used to upgrade «Atlan Weapons» and «Isparian Weapons». L|1|•|Major stones can be used to upgrade «Shadow Armor». L|1|•|Both the stones can also be given to an «Agent of the Arcanum» for a «Writ of Refuge» (you need 1 major stone or 2 minor stones for the writ). L|1|•|The minor stone is weaker than the major stone and therefore much easier to obtain.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|The Major Smoldering Stone L|1|1.|Once inside the dungeon, head through the doors and take the west passage. Don't bother jumping across the platforms, the room beyond is a dead end (unless you have very high jump skill) - instead jump down to the lower section. L|1|2.|Go south down the stairs, killing the chain casting Zefir as you go. Head down the corridor and at the split go south up the ramp and follow it along to a room with a catwalk opposite. L|1|3.|Jump across to the platform (), no need to shift jump as the wall beyond the chains will stop you falling. L|1|4.|Go to the end of the catwalk, jump into the north room and head up the ramp to the next set of platforms. L|1|5.|Jump across to the brown platforms aiming for the wall like before. From here simply tap jump into the corridor to the south and move on to the next set of platforms. L|1|6.|At the next jump (), carefully shift jump across making sure to land on the dark brown wood and not the lighter colored beam near the wall, if you land on this part you will fall straight through into the area below. Once on the platform, jump across to the east platform and then tap jump into the corridor. L|1|7.|Go up the ramp into the next area with an «Inferno» and two spiral staircases. Head up the stairs and jump across to the platform and then into the corridor. L|1|8.|You will come to an open room with a bridge in the middle (), you will need to get across to the bridge and then to the mesh wall before going up the final passage to the west. If you do not have enough jump skill to reach it, you can simply jump down and take the long route around to the bridge that way. L|1|9.|At the end of the west passage you will come to a long drop, at the bottom is the adjoining room with the «Major Smoldering Stone». L|2|•|⟦smolderingstonemajor⟧ L|1|10.|{OPT} You can take the «Textbook (Atlan's Treatise)¦Textbook» found with the stone, and the «Carefully Printed Note» found on the way to the stone to Bretself the Translator in «Cragstone» for translation at 26.0N, 47.0E.
H3|The Minor Smoldering Stone L|1|1.|To get to the «15.0S, 31.2E - Fiery Cave¦cave» quickly, start in «Samsur» and then proceed to the «Yinar» settlement portal at 0.8S, 18.9E, from here it is a short run to the cave at 15.0S, 31.2E. L|1|2.|Once there you will see «Ember»s, run right past them down into the cave and pick up the «Minor Smoldering Stone». L|2|•|⟦smolderingstoneminor⟧ L|1|3.|{OPT} You can take «Textbook (Atlan's Treatise)¦Textbook», that is found with the stone, to Bretself the Translator in «Cragstone» for translation at 26.0N, 47.0E.

Quest.name: Snow_Lilies
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|130+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Lila Fiori» (optional) I|Starts At|86.8N, 70.3W in «Silyun» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|«Lila Fiori» needs fresh Snow Lilies for the Grand Mother's order but has run out. Help her by gathering 3 Lilies from the «Isle of Ruin» near «Eastwatch».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|«Snow Lily¦Snow Lilies» spawn on the landscape and when you used them they generate a spawn of four creatures| an «Insolent Penguin», 2 «Bloated Eater»s, and a «Mudwort Thrungus». L|1|2.|Each of these creatures has a chance of dropping a «Snow Lily». L|1|3.|When you have three Lilies, return them to Lila to receive your rewards. L|2|•|⟦SnowLillies⟧ L|1|4.|{OPT} You may also bring single Snow Lilies to «Fiun Gaya» at 89.1N, 47.6W for a lesser xp reward (no repeat timer). L|2|•|⟦GayaLily⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.
H2|Rewards
R|Hand 3 «Snow Lily¦Snow Lillies» to «Lila Fiori» RK|Experience|107,000,000 (33% up to level 150) RK|Items| RI|«Snow Flake Charm» RE
R|Hand 1 «Snow Lily» to «Fiun Gaya» RK|Experience|1,000,000 (1.5% up to level 100) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Lila Fiori⸩ ⸨Lila Fiori tells you, "What am I to do? The Grand Mother has placed an order for fresh Snow Lilies, but I am all out. Can you help me?"⸩ ⸨Lila Fiori tells you, "Go to the Isle of Ruin and bring me back three fresh Snow Lilies. They are very rare so you will have to search for them."⸩ ⸨Lila Fiori tells you, "Be careful when picking them as they tend to attract hungry creatures."⸩ ⸨Lila Fiori tells you, "But I'm sure you'll have no problem dealing with the nasty monsters."
L|1||Handing in Snow Lilies (Lila Fiori)⸩ ⸨You allow Lila Fiori to examine your Snow Lily.⸩ ⸨You hand over 3 of your Snow Lilys.⸩ ⸨Lila Fiori tells you, "I shall make a gorgeous flower arrangement for the Grand Mother with the Snow Lilies you found!"⸩ ⸨Lila Fiori tells you, "Here. This is for you."⸩ ⸨You've earned 107,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Lila Fiori gives you Snow Flake Charm.⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to turn in more Lillies for xp.
L|1||Speaking to Lila before timer is up⸩ ⸨Lila Fiori tells you, "Thank you for bringing the Snow Lilies. The Grand Mother will be so pleased."⸩ ⸨Lila Fiori tells you, "If you should find some more Snow Lilies, I will gladly buy them from you."⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to turn in more Lillies for xp.
L|1||Giving Lila a Snow Lily before timer is up⸩ ⸨You allow Lila Fiori to examine your Snow Lily.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Snow Lilys.⸩ ⸨Lila Fiori tells you, "Snow Lilies! I can use as many of these as you can find."⸩ ⸨Lila Fiori tells you, "I'll buy this one from you."⸩ ⸨Lila Fiori gives you Trade Note (100,000).
L|1||Fiun Gaya⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "It is for me to welcome you to this place of sadness. I am Fiun Gaya, Keeper of the Light."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "With Lunnum missing my heart is an empty black, still my duty must be fulfilled. My duty, my purpose, is to be sure that the light of Lunnum's Pyre remains bright and pure."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "To my sorrow, the ravages of time have consumed this old one."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "No longer can I make the journey to re-stoke the fire eternal. Respectfully, I ask for your help."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "A Fiun Hatchet, you will need. Retrieve one from this chest."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya gives you Story of Lunnum's Pyre.⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "If you would hear of a dark deed then ask me you must."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "Another favor I might ask. Should a Snow Lily be found, perhaps you may bring it to me?"⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "Good journey, friend."
L|1||Handing in Snow Lilies (Fiun Gaya)⸩ ⸨You give Fiun Gaya Snow Lily.⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya starts to weep uncontrollably.⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "These were Fiun Lunnum's favorite flower. Delicate and pale as her skin."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "It is with sorrow that I did have to end her existence."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "Before judgment is passed, an explanation is needed. Please listen."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "Long ago on our world, we Fiun were a proud race."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "Great achievements were ours and our society did flourish, but arrogant did we become."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya's eyes turn to stone.⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "Gods we thought ourselves to be and so we tried to create life that was equal in beauty to us."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "And that is how the abomination called the Eater was born."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "Nearly destroy us they did and our home they now have, as the last of the Fiun fled here to Dereth."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "And so followed the Eater."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "Not only did we doom our world, we have now also set this world on the same path of destruction."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "So it was with great amazement, that for all the evil that we had done, there was still talk among the Fiun of rebuilding our society. Deserve to live we did not."⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "So I killed she who had done no wrong...my beloved Lunnum. I stand here today in penance for my deeds."⸩ ⸨You've earned 1,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Fiun Gaya Snow Lily.⸩ ⸨Fiun Gaya tells you, "Place this on Lunnum's Pyre I shall. Thank you."⸩ ⸨You've earned 1,000,000 experience.⸩

I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to obtain one of «Lady Maila»'s elemental stones (also known as «Atlan Stones»). The stones can be used to upgrade various weapons and armor:
L|1|•|Minor and major stones can be used to upgrade «Atlan Weapons» and «Isparian Weapons». L|1|•|Major stones can be used to upgrade «Shadow Armor». L|1|•|Both the stones can also be given to an «Agent of the Arcanum» for a «Writ of Refuge» (you need 1 major stone or 2 minor stones for the writ).
P|The minor stone is weaker than the major stone and therefore much easier to obtain.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|The Major Sparking Stone L|1|1.|The dungeon has «Amethyst Gromnie»s and lightning elementals. L|1|2.|From the drop take the first right, continue across the bridge, and then jump down. L|1|3.|Then follow either hall to large room. Cross the room and take the West(right) hall and follow it to another big room. L|1|4.|Take an immediate left without crossing this room and follow that path. In the next big room cross to the other side and take the north hall(right). L|1|5.|At the intersection go strait and down to another big room. Take the hall immediately on the right and down across a bridge. At the intersection go East(right) to the end of the hall and head north. L|1|6.|Go right at the intersection and right again. You should be in a square room with a path up to the West. Follow that path to a ledge and jump down to the bottom with the «Major Sparking Stone» and some other gems. Collect it and recall. L|1|2.|Pick up the «Minor Sparking Stone» from inside the cave. L|2|•|⟦sparkingstoneminor⟧ L|1|3.|{OPT} You can take the «Textbook (Atlan's Treatise)¦Textbook» and the «Hastily Scrawled Note» found with the stone to Bretself the Translator in «Cragstone» for translation at 26.0N, 47.0E.

Quest.name: Suzuhara_Baijin's_Delivery
Quest.Wiki:

L|2|•|⟦SuzuharaPackageAcquired1204⟧ L|1|4.|Go back to the large room with the bridges and jump down and use the «Portal to the Beach Fort¦portal» to the «Beach Fort». L|2|•|{OPT} Use the Exploration Marker at the bottom of the pit before you leave. L|1|5.|Give the package to «Suzuhara Sheshumi». He'll give you a «Note to Baijin». L|2|•|⟦SuzuharaComplete_0511⟧ L|1|6.|Return it to Baijin in «Stonehold».

Quest.name: Sword_of_Lost_Light_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|30+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Holtburg Dungeon» at 43.6N, 33.0E I|Route|«Holtburg» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|After collecting seven keys inside different dungeons scattered across Dereth you can enter the Halls of Lost Light where the «Guardian of the Lost Light» wields the sword. The sword can be significantly upgraded via additional quests.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes P|Only a single set of keys is required and can be collected beforehand.
H3|Key #1: Worn Small Key (Holtburg) L|1|1.|From «Holtburg», enter the «Holtburg Dungeon» at 43.6N, 33.0E L|1|2.|From the drop, hug the left wall until you reach a down ramp. L|1|3.|At the bottom of the ramp, enter the first room on your right and kill the «Swamp Rat»s inside. L|1|4.|Loot a «Worn Small Key» from the corpse of one of the rats.
H3|Key #2: Worn Strange Key (Yaraq) L|1|1.|From «Yaraq», enter the «Yaraq Tunnels» at 24.6S, 1.4W. L|1|2.|From the drop, go straight through the first two doors, leading to a large curving room. L|1|3.|Take the south exit and hug the wall left until you reach a down ramp. L|1|4.|At the bottom of the ramp, take your first right, and then your first left, which leads to another down ramp. L|1|5.|At the bottom of the ramp, hug the wall right until you reach a 5-way intersection. Take the 2nd hall on the left. L|1|6.|From here, head straight until you reach a dead end, where you'll find a few «Drudge Slave»s. L|1|7.|Kill the slaves and loot the «Worn Strange Key» from one of their corpses.
H3|Key #3: Worn Plain Key (Yanshi) L|1|1.|From «Yanshi», enter the «Yanshi Tunnels» at 12.2S, 45.5E, L|1|2.|From the drop, hug the left wall until you reach a diamond shaped room, with a locked gate to the North, and several «Drudge Slave»s. L|1|3.|Kill the «Drudge Slave»s and loot the «Worn Plain Key» from one of their corpses.
H3|Key #4: Worn Old Key (Shoushi) P|{WARN} «Shoushi Grotto» has been updated on Leaftide and the «Worn Old Key» has been removed. You must pick the locks associated with the key.
L|1|1.|From «Shoushi», enter the «Shoushi Grotto» at 34.5S, 72.8E. L|1|2.|From the drop, head straight, and take the ramp down into a larger rectangular room. L|1|3.|Take the West exit, and then take the hallway on the right. Follow it until you descend a ramp. L|1|4.|Hug the left wall until you reach a large room with some empty life stone foundations. L|1|5.|From here, exit the room to the right, and continue straight ahead until you reach a Throne Room. L|1|6.|Kill «Drudge Slave»s in this room until you find a «Worn Old Key» on one of their corpses.
H3|Key #5: Worn Rusty Key (Samsur) L|1|1.|From «Samsur», enter the «Dungeon Manor» at 1.9S, 19.8E. L|1|2.|From the drop, take the first right, and then left at the split. Continue down the ramp, into an open area. L|1|3.|From here, hug the wall left, until you descend down a ramp into a larger room that contains a small chamber that houses a pedistle and floating gem. L|1|4.|Kill «Drudge Slave»s until you find the «Worn Rusty Key» on one of their corpses.
H3|Key #6: Worn Odd Key (Rithwic) L|1|1.|From «Rithwic», enter the «Rithwic Crypt» at 14.0N, 59.1E. L|1|2.|From the drop, take your first right, enter the third door on the left, and go down the ramp. L|1|3.|At the bottom, take a left and enter the room with three «Desert Rat»s. L|1|4.|Kill the rats and loot the «Worn Odd Key» from one of their corpses.
H3|Key #7: A silvery, mysterious key (Al-Jalima) L|1|1.|From «Al-Jalima», enter the «Carved Cave» at 7.4N, 0.6E. L|1|2.|From the drop, take the east hallway and then head straight into a large room. L|1|3.|Loot the «Carved Key» from a chest in one of the smaller rooms to the left. L|1|4.|Return to the drop, and this time take the west hallway until you reach a locked door. L|1|5.|Use the Carved Key to unlock the door, head north on to the platform, and then jump across the to the north. L|2|•|Note: Do not jump into the pit directly front of you, jump across it on to the ledge. L|1|6.|Loot the «Small Carved Key» from a chest in a small room to the east. L|1|7.|Take the west ramp up, and hug the right wall until you reach a locked door. L|1|8.|Use the Small Carved Key to open the door and head move to the ledge that extends from the east side. L|1|9.|Jump diagonally to the adjacent ledge to the Southeast (tap jump). L|1|10.|Note: If you fall, just take the ramp up to the West, and try again. L|1|11.|Once across the jump, take the South ramp down, and follow the hallway until you reach a room with several stone pillars and a few «Shadow»s. L|1|12.|Loot «A silvery, mysterious key» from the «Oak Chest» on the south wall of this room. L|1|13.|Use the «Halls of the Lost Light» portal to enter the final dungeon.
H3|Part 8: Halls of the Lost Light L|1|1.|If you didn't take the portal from «Carved Cave», enter the «Halls of the Lost Light» at 76.5s, 74.9W near «Candeth Keep». L|1|2.|From the drop, take the left door on the south wall and hug the wall left, using the keys you obtained to open the appropriate doors as you go (If you take the right door, hug the right wall). L|2|•|Note: Order of key use is as follows: «Worn Strange Key», «Worn Small Key», «Worn Old Key», «Worn Plain Key», «Worn Rusty Key», «Worn Odd Key», «A silvery, mysterious key». L|1|3.|After using the «Worn Odd Key», jump down, and as you head north, you'll reach a wooden door on the North wall with an old cloth banner hanging above it. L|1|4.|Use «A silvery, mysterious key» to open the door and enter the final room and the end of the hallway. L|1|5.|Kill the «Guardian of the Lost Light», and loot the «Sword of Lost Light» and «Superior Shield» from its corpse! L|2|•|Note: The guardian drops 1 set per spawn. Respawn is 5 minutes. L|2|•|⟦ShieldSuperior⟧ L|2|•|⟦SwordLostLight⟧
P|A note from Iquba A Note from Tibri A torn note An odd note An old note (Lich Archmage) An old note (Monougas) Crumpled Note Rumor (Dungeons) Rumor (Keys)
H3|Part 9: Upgrading the Sword P|See also: «Sword of Lost Light Infusions»
L|1|•|The sword can be upgraded using volcanic infusions («Blue Fire Infusion», «Red Fire Infusion», and «White Fire Infusion») obtained from the «Lady Aerfalle Quest». L|1|•|The upgraded sword can be converted to a «Sword of Lost Hope» by adding «Blood of the Hopeslayer», see «Sword of Lost Hope Quest» for details. L|1|•|The upgraded sword can be empowered by adding an «Radiant Mana Infusion», see «Radiant Mana Infusion Quest» for details. L|1|•|An empowered sword can be further improved by adding one of three slayer infusions («Empowered Skeletonbane Infusion», «Empowered Shadowfire Infusion», or «Empowered Olthoibane Infusion»), see «Radiant Mana Infusion Quest» for details.
P|Blue Fire Infusion Red Fire Infusion White Fire Infusion Blood of the Hopeslayer Radiant Mana Infusion Inert Skeletonbane Infusion Empowered Skeletonbane Infusion Inert Shadowfire Infusion Empowered Shadowfire Infusion Inert Olthoibane Infusion Empowered Olthoibane Infusion

Or maybe directions to a mysterious sword?"⸩ ⸨Town Crier tells you, "...and a warrior came forth bearing the mark of Light upon him. He carried, in his hand, the rays of the sun crafted into steel. A blade with a purpose in the hands of a virtuous heart brings hope where there is none. The Light has been found again."⸩ ⸨Town Crier tells you, "I heard from Alatar Locke recently... he was upset that he had to redo some of his oldest notes... something about some carved caves?"⸩ ⸨Town Crier tells you, "In the Halls of Lost Light the Guardian has stirred and the sword glows brighter now than ever. Perhaps this is an omen of things to come. Perhaps it is a sign that even in this growing darkness there is still hope."⸩

Quest.name: Tanada_Hunting_Parties
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|60+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Sayuji Jina» I|Starts At|33.3S, 72.8E in «Shoushi» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|The Tanada Masters which drop the medallion spawn according to the same mechanism as the «Dire Champions».
P|You will only receive the title reward after completing either the first or the first and second Tanada series of quests. At this point it is uncertain if just the first quest or both are needed, but it can be assumed that no further quests in the series are needed, as they were introduced after the hunting parties.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Travel to Southern or Northern «Osteth» and find a spawn of 1 «Acolyte of Breath», 1 «Acolyte of Wind» and 1 «Acolyte of Storms» L|1|2.|Good places for finding these spawns are around «Kara» in the South and around the portal to Bur in the North («Glystaene Cottages» from «Rithwic». H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Run north of «Fort Tethana» to the «Tumerok Post» at 12.2N 68.1W and go in, tie to the surface portal (or just go through it) so you can easily return if you die. H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialong, Lieutenant Durgan⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Durgan tells you, "Greetings, friend. Though we do not claim independence...yet...we still must look after our own concerns, since Elysa Strathelar won't. At times, we look to outsiders for aid. Are you willing to be that aid we seek?"⸩ ⸨The lieutenant shrugs his shoulders.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Durgan tells you, "I am Commander Margyle's intelligence chief, and I have a very vexing problem. It seems that Elysa sent her army in our direction, no doubt to put us directly under her heel again. A Viamontian force also made passage from Marae Lassel, and all projections indicated that they would fight each other north of here, near the coast."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Durgan tells you, "No matter who won, we would have gained an advantage. But what I find odd is this..."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Durgan tells you, "There was also word of a Renegade Tumerok band mobilizing to engage the other two forces. The three armies apparently encamped and parlayed, but there is no word from any of the forces after that. No army can keep themselves so hidden, especially not on our territory."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Durgan tells you, "I want to know what happened to those three armies, and I will reward you to tell me. If you are truly helpful, I may discuss what the future holds for beloved Tethana."
L|1||Opening Dialong, Lieutenant Allandal⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "Peace be with you in these dark times. I serve Queen Elysa Strathelar in an information gathering role, but currently those of us who gather information for Her Majesty are baffled by a strange occurance."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "We recently sent an army to the Fort Tethana region, a move that was matched by the Viamontian loyalists. We have heard nothing about either force since a report that they had sat down to parlay, except for a rumor of Tumerok activity in the area."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "The Queen would like you to explore the area, and return with any information you find."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "I have heard that others are in search of information about what happened to the forces. Although Her Majesty would prefer that people aid her, in this matter she believes that something which transcends this war has occurred. As such, if you choose to aid the Viamontians, there will be no negative ramifications from our side."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "Also, if you have ventured to the fortifications between here and Fort Tethana, I will accept any Viamontian banners you may have retrieved."
L|1||Opening Dialong, Lieutenant Dialossa⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Dialossa tells you, "Let me be honest. Your allegiance, whether for or against His Majesty, doesn't matter for the particular matter I am dealing with. Frankly, it seems like a threat against all Isparians."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Dialossa tells you, "The two warring sides were on the brink of battle, at long last, near the northern coast of the Direlands. But Count Di Orza has not sent a report back to King Varicci. Neither have the Bloodless sent a report back to their leader. There was a detachment of Tumeroks in the area as well, and they also have not been heard from since."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Dialossa tells you, "Something awful has happened, I fear. Please gather what information you can and return, and I will do what I can to help you."
L|1||Returning Dialong, Lieutenant Durgan⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Durgan tells you, "Greetings, friend. I know that you are familiar with the area we now call the Shadow March. I like to ensure that I have as much intelligence as possible of the area. If you have fetched items from that area, I will take them from you and reward you."
L|1||Returning Dialong, Lieutenant Allandal⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "Her Majesty seeks all information that can be gleaned about the Shadow March. If you have any written records that you have discovered there, she has authorized me to accept them and reward you. I am also authorized to accept Viamontian banners taken from the fortifications between here and Fort Tethana."
L|1||Returning Dialong, Lieutenant Dialossa⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Durgan tells you, "Greetings, friend. I know that you are familiar with the area we now call the Shadow March. I like to ensure that I have as much intelligence as possible of the area. If you have fetched items from that area, I will take them from you and reward you."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Dialossa tells you, "Your deed precede you. I've heard you are one of the few to dare tread in the Shadow March. If you have found information there, I'll gladly see it. Do not feel like you are betraying any trusts...based on what I've seen, this threat affects all of us."
L|1||Damaging mist in the dark spiral⸩ ⸨The black mist boils 6 points of flesh from your bones!
L|1||Handing in Lord Marsan's Log Book to Lieutenant Durgan⸩ ⸨You give Lieutenant Durgan Lord Marsan's Log Book.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Durgan tells you, "There is a hint of conspiracy here. You say you found this in Lord Marsan's camp? He is a fool. Was a fool, I suppose. Still, normally he would aggrandize himself, not reveal his true cowardly nature in his writings. Unfortunately, his ramblings do nothing to help us assess the true nature of this foe - simply inspire a certain level of skepticism and make me wonder if this is a ploy by Elysa or the Viamontians. Nothing could be so great as he describes."⸩ ⸨You've earned 13,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to complete this quest again.
L|1||Handing in Lord Marsan's Log Book to Lieutenant Allandal⸩ ⸨You give Lieutenant Allandal Lord Marsan's Log Book.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "It seems the esteemed Lord Marsan may have met a poor end, as have perhaps the other armies arrayed on that field as well. Astonishing, that something can slay so many with so little apparent effort. I shall report to Her Majesty about this. But what is that great force that he writes about?"⸩ ⸨You've earned 13,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to complete this quest again.
L|1||Handing in Lord Marsan's Log Book to Lieutenant Dialossa⸩ ⸨You give Lieutenant Dialossa Lord Marsan's Log Book.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Dialossa tells you, "The log of the Bloodless who led the enemy forces? And it seems that a great force swooped in and destroyed them all."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Dialossa tells you, "I am skeptical of this report, and yet there is no other obvious explanation. I shall accept it as written, then."⸩ ⸨You've earned 13,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to complete this quest again.
L|1||Handing in Lore of the Dark Spiral to Lieutenant Durgan⸩ ⸨You allow Lieutenant Durgan to examine your Lore of the Dark Spiral.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Lore of the Dark Spirals.⸩ ⸨After reading the tattered pages, Lieutenant Durgan looks pale and shaken. He rapidly regains his composure.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Durgan tells you, "I see that you have succeeded. Never in my wildest dreams would I have imagined that such things were afoot so near to us. I will recommend to Commander Margyle that we begin to prepare to repel whatever dark dreams these shadows and their allies have in store."⸩ ⸨You've earned 124,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Durgan tells you, "And you have served Tethana well. May I interest you in this document? It concisely details what we, the citizens and soldiers of Tethana, would have of any who would claim sovereignity over us. Perhaps reading it will bolster your will as well, and you will be inspired to stand against tyranny? If it does not inspire you, return it to me for a further reward."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Durgan gives you Tethana Manifesto.⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to complete this quest again.
L|1||Handing in Lore of the Dark Spiral to Lieutenant Allandal⸩ ⸨You allow Lieutenant Allandal to examine your Lore of the Dark Spiral.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Lore of the Dark Spirals.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "A...a...a thing greater than evil than the Hopeslayer? Can such a thing be? But what?"⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "It...it must just be rhetoric. But I shall make Queen Elysa aware of this...just in case."⸩ ⸨You've earned 124,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "I can only imagine the horrors you have seen. Take this, with the knowledge you have earned it."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal gives you Shield of the Strathelar Elite.⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to complete this quest again.
L|1||Handing in Lore of the Dark Spiral to Lieutenant Dialossa⸩ ⸨You allow Lieutenant Dialossa to examine your Lore of the Dark Spiral.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Lore of the Dark Spirals.⸩ ⸨The Viamontian spy wipes his forehead nervously.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Dialossa tells you, "I've heard stories of the Hopeslayer. Will the world be shattered under the weight of a greater power? I must warn the king."⸩ ⸨You've earned 124,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Dialossa tells you, "Here is your reward. Fly it proudly."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Dialossa gives you Viamontian Pennant of Loyalty.⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to complete this quest again.
L|1||Handing in Tethana Manifesto⸩ ⸨You give Lieutenant Durgan Tethana Manifesto.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Durgan tells you, "Although I am disappointed that you do not wish to keep that manifesto, I understand. We must all make our way in the world. Take care that you do not allow yourself to be blind to the follies of your leaders, however."⸩ ⸨You've earned 12,204,511 experience.
L|1||Handing in Shield of the Strathelar Elite⸩ ⸨You give Lieutenant Allandal Shield of the Strathelar Elite.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Allandal tells you, "You wish not to bear the elite shield? As you wish."⸩ ⸨You've earned 12,204,511 experience.
L|1||Handing in Viamontian Pennant of Loyalty⸩ ⸨You give Lieutenant Dialossa Viamontian Pennant of Loyalty.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Dialossa tells you, "You do not wish to display loyalty to King Varicci? I suppose it was too much to ask, especially in these tense times."⸩ ⸨You've earned 12,204,511 experience.⸩

Quest.name: The_Mage_Academy
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Tazal al-Ashfai» I|Starts At|6.1N, 3.5E near «Al-Jalima» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Mage Academy» H2|Overview P|"Search the Mage Academy for Lady «Jaera»'s Tomb."
L|1|•|This quest involves quite a bit of lever pulling; however, there is currently a «#Short Version¦shortcut» to skip them. L|1|•|«Lockpick» skill is needed for some of the keyless locked doors inside the academy. If your skill is high enough, you could also skip part 2a where get the Stone/Old keys to unlock the 500 and 750 difficulty doors.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: The Burial Temple L|1|1.|He will ask you to go to the «Burial Temple» nearby at 8.5N, 6.0E and retrieve a black gem for him from the creature known as Kelannik. L|1|2.|When inside the temple, take the east passage and jump down. Now head to the end of the corridor and through a false wall. At the intersection head straight on through a room with Skeletons and at the T junction take a right. L|1|3.|In the next room go left and around to a lever, use it and then take the north passage continuing on through two rooms - take the first left down the ramp and open the door. You will come to another door that is now open, inside this room is «Lord Kelannik» and his two guards. L|2|•|NOTE: Respawn in this room is ~5-10 minutes if doing this in a group (seems like a randomized time). L|1|4.|Defeat Kelannik and loot the «Black Gem» and «Cursed Key». Take the exit portal just outside the room and run back to Tazal al-Ashfai. L|2|•|⟦GotGemPortalMageAcademy⟧ L|1|5.|Hand Tazal the Black Gem for experience and he will attempt to summon the portal Kelannik uses...
H3|Part 2: The Mage Academy H4|Part 2a: Levers 1 - 4 (Stone Key/Old Key) L|1|1.|From the drop room make a mental note of the lever to your right for later and head down the ramp hugging the left wall. You need to take the third turn off to the east on level 6 (see map). L|1|2.|You should come to a room with an «Empyrean Statue» and Masonry Golem behind a lever activated door. L|1|3.|Leave this area and turn right heading southwest and then turn left at the T into a room with Zefirs. Kill the «Xekrit Zefir Guardian» for the «Stone Key». L|1|4.|Now head west down the hall to the room opposite with 3 levers. Hit the wall levers only (center lever #3 releases the Masonry Golem) and run back (left wall hug) to the ramp and up to the portal drop room to pull that lever you saw earlier. L|1|5.|Now head down again, but this time take the second turn off to the west (level 4) and through the floor plate activated door. Take a right and then left into the corridor and joining room. L|1|6.|Kill the «Banderling Smasher»s here and loot the corpses until you find the «Old Key». Only 1 of the 3 drops the key.
H4|Part 2b: Lever 5 and the Sewers L|1|1.|Now you have the old key, run back to the ramp and head down and and unlock the wooden door for lever 4 (lvl 8 on the map). L|2|•|Note| There are locked metal doors on either end of the corridor opposite this lever. The next lever (5) opens the large metal sewer doors in the room beyond. L|1|2.|Pull the lever and run back up the ramp to the third turn off with the Banderling Smasher. Turn right and then left and unlock the door (750 diff.) using the old key. L|1|3.|Inside the next room is a gate that requires lockpicking and the door you just opened beyond that with the lever to door 5. L|1|4.|Pull the lever and run back down the ramp to the metal doors on the bottom floor. Unlock one of the them and head into the sewer area. L|1|5.|Head east at the junction around to a locked metal door on your left. Use the «Cursed Key» to open it. L|1|6.|Go up the ramp and stick to the path ignoring all the smaller side rooms. You will cross bridges that pass through a number of areas, hop from the final ledge into the east passage and then jump down into a room with a surface portal and «Zombie Mage». L|1|7.|Here you find the library where «Rytheran's Apprentice» awaits. Defeat him and take «Rytheran's Key» and «Sheets of Paper» for translation. Now you have Rytheran's Key you need to make your way to Lady Jaera's Tomb. L|2|•|⟦mageacademykey⟧ L|1|8.|Use the surface portal and reenter the academy, go back to the room with the statue and the golem behind a lever door (third room down). Go south east and hug the left wall until you reach a room with pillars and a «Black Coral Golem» guarding a door. L|1|9.|Kill the Golem and use the «Stone Key» on the door. There are lightning traps in this room, dispatch the two Golems here. L|1|10.|Use «Rytheran's Key» on «Lady Jaera's Tomb» and loot «Lady Jaera's Wand». L|2|•|Note: The tomb will cast «Gossamer Flesh» on you when opened. L|2|•|⟦TrophyMageAcademy_1110⟧ L|1|11.|Bring the wand to «Tazal al-Ashfai» for the rest of the rewards.
H3|Short Version L|1|1.|Skip part 1 with the «Burial Temple» for the 99 million xp and make your way straight to the «Mage Academy». L|2|•|Route: From the «Town Network» head to «Neydisa Castle» (south hall) and then run to 74.7N, 18.5E. L|1|2.|Jump up where it says "You may jump on monsters then on bridge from here" on the map to bypass the lever pulling and the majority of the quest. L|1|3.|Jump across south and then down past the portal, kill «Rytheran's Apprentice» and loot Rytheran's key. L|2|•|⟦mageacademykey⟧ L|1|4.|Kill the «Xekrit Zefir Guardian» for the «Stone Key» if you don't have lockpick (door is diff. 500), and unlock the door to the tomb room. L|1|5.|Use «Rytheran's Key» on «Lady Jaera's Tomb» and loot «Lady Jaera's Wand». L|2|•|Contract Complete: ⟦TrophyMageAcademy_1110⟧ L|1|6.|Bring the wand to «Tazal al-Ashfai» for your rewards.
