R|Hand in «Lady Jaera's Wand» RK|Experience|172,500,000 (26?% up to level 182?) RK|Items| RI|«Braced Mana Forge Key» RI|«Trade Note (250,000)» (x10) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Tazal al-Ashfai tells you, "Hail, traveler. It is pleasant to meet anyone here in the wastes. Tell me, have you discovered a crypt in these regions called the Burial Temple?"⸩ ⸨Tazal al-Ashfai tells you, "I have heard that the dead walk there, and one in particular always carries a certain black gem I seek for my research."⸩ ⸨Tazal al-Ashfai tells you, "Through my studies, I have found that the dreadful creature is named Kelannik."⸩ ⸨Tazal al-Ashfai tells you, "Please retrieve this gem and return it to me. Your courage will not go unrewarded."
L|1||Handing in Black Gem⸩ ⸨You give Tazal al-Ashfai Black Gem.⸩ ⸨Tazal al-Ashfai tells you, "Wonderful! Can you see the portal energy pulsing within it?"⸩ ⸨You've earned 99,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Tazal al-Ashfai tells you, "No doubt you have seen and experienced much on this adventure!"⸩ ⸨Tazal al-Ashfai tells you, "I have heard stories that the ancient dead of Dereth talk to each other as we do, and form a society underneath our own..."⸩ ⸨Tazal al-Ashfai says, "Let us see where this Kelannik fellow liked to travel."⸩ ⸨Tazal al-Ashfai tells you, "Why, I do believe that this portal leads to the Mage Academy! Beware young traveler, this place is not for the faint of heart..."
L|1||Handing in Lady Jaera's Wand⸩ ⸨You give Tazal al-Ashfai Lady Jaera's Wand.⸩ ⸨Tazal al-Ashfai tells you, "What a magnificent artifact to behold. I thought this item was destroyed ages ago."⸩ ⸨Tazal al-Ashfai tells you, "I must reward you greatly for this surprise gift!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 172,500,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Tazal al-Ashfai gives you Braced Mana Forge Key.⸩ ⸨Tazal al-Ashfai gives you 10 Trade Notes (250,000).
L|1||Handing in "Sheets of Paper" to Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator⸩ ⸨You give Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator Sheets of Paper.⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "Indeed, this is the runic script of old Dericost, a language not used in well over 5000 years... Save for this letter, which looks newly written..."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi looks slightly troubled.⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "This was found on Rytheran's Apprentice? It seems Rytheran is up to something involving that ancient graveyard and some book that was powerful enough to scare even the ancient Dericost into not using it."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi shudders⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator tells you, "Here, see for yourself."⸩ ⸨Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator gives you Rytheran's Letter.⸩

P|This quest rewards a stamp that is used in the «Exploration Society Letters» quest to gain useful equipment.
P|If you have Lockpicking and can pick a chest with 220 difficulty, you can skip much of this quest.

L|1|3.|Hug the right wall to the second chest that contains «Brentsella's Key». L|1|4.|Head back to the split at the beginning and go south, unlock the chest with the key and take «Letter to Celcynd (Brentsella)¦Letter to Celcynd» and the «Rithwic Town Stamp» L|2|•|Note: There is no timer on picking up the letter. L|2|•|⟦NewbieQuestStampRithwic⟧ L|2|•|⟦LetterToCelcyndQuest⟧ L|1|5.|Return the letter to «Celcynd the Dour» in «Rithwic» at 10.7N, 58.1E for «Celcynd's Ring». L|1|6.|Take the ring to «Brentsella» at the «South Rithwic Outpost» or «Mindorla» at the «East Rithwic Outpost» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦RithwicCelcyndRing⟧

Quest.name: The_Temple_of_Izji_Qo
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60-79, 80-99, 100 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Izji Qo's Temple Entrance» at 12.8S, 58.9W I|Route|«Mansion» to «Portal to Izji Qo's Temple» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Easiest of the five Blackmire quests. This one provides you with useful fellowship spells for mana, stamina and health regeneration at levels IV to VII.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|From your mansion use the «Portal to Izji Qo's Temple» device. Run to the nearby temple at 12.8S, 58.9W, jump into the pit and use the Guardian Statue. L|1|2.|From the drop take the north east passage, all other directions lead to dead ends with Burun and Guruk creatures. L|1|3.|You will come to three guardian statues, each one portals you into a different version of the «Izji Qo's Trials¦Trials» dungeon depending on your level. The left statue is 100+, the middle is 80-99 and the right statue is 60-79. L|1|4.|The trials are not very difficult to navigate, after going right at the first T section it's very linear and impossible to get lost, at the end of the trials is another guardian statue use it to portal to the next section. L|1|5.|This dungeon is longer than the previous dungeon and contains the same creatures, however, if you're doing the 100+ it also contains «Guruk Titan»s. Like before there is only one route you can take through the dungeon. L|1|6.|Eventually, you should end up on a ledge overlooking a room with stone heads. Mages can debuff creatures from here and jump over to the statues whilst others clear the room. L|1|8.|Once it is safe, run north and use the final guardian statue to be portalled in to the room with the scrolls and Izji Qo's defiled crypt. L|1|3.|Near the exit portal is an «Armoredillo Key» on the floor. L|2|•|⟦ArmoredilloKeyPickedUp⟧ L|1|4.|There are five chests (one in each of the large rooms), but only the one in the western, octagonal room contains the Spinning Staff of Death. Quest.name: Baron's_Amulet_of_Life_Giving_Quest

Wiki.page: Baron's Amulet of Life Giving Quest

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|15+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Colier» I|Route|East wing of «Facility Hub» (speak to warden) I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Retrieve the Baron's coveted Amulet of «Life Giver» to increase your maximum health by 15 points.
P|NOTE: There is a "Wheelbarrow" shown on the map. The ore inside the wheelbarrow gives a stamp. L|1|•|⟦ImpiousQuestIronOre⟧
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Look for a two story building with a «Banderling Raider Guardian» inside at 56.7N, 38.6E. He drops the «Small Rusted Key». L|1|2.|In another single story building isolated on the SW side of the town at 56.5N, 38.0E, is a «Heavy Drudge Prowler» that drops the «Cell Key». L|1|3.|Once you have your two keys, you're ready to enter the «Colier Mines» portal in the building basement in the middle of the town. L|1|4.|From the drop use the Small Rusted Key to open the north door, and head north east and then west at the second split. L|1|5.|You should now be in a room with a locked metal gate. Use the Cell Key to open it. L|1|6.|Now go left and up and then due west, use the Cell Key again and the hall will bend to the south, kill the «Undead Curator» and loot the «Scratched Key» off his corpse. L|1|7.|Go back to the room where you first used the Cell Key. Head east along the passage through the room and turn left into the room with a Drudges and a lever. Pull the lever and run south through the door and jump down into the pit. L|1|8.|From here head north east and then north at the cross section. You should end up in a room with a locked chest. Use the Scratched Key to unlock it and loot the «Treasure Chest Key» and «The Baron's Key». L|2|•|⟦ColierMineTreasureKey⟧ L|1|9.|Now go south at the cross and up the ramp. Head through the room with the Banderlings and jump down into the pit. You're now back in the prison cell area where you got the two keys earlier. L|1|10.|From the pit, head south at the T and then west taking the second passage heading north down to first Cell Key door. L|1|11.|From that Y intersection go east and down, you'll come to a 4 way intersection, go east then stick left until you come to another locked door (diff. 1000). Use The Baron's Key to open it. L|1|12.|Past the door stick left, you'll go down twice then come to a large room with a hole in the middle of the floor, go down it. From this point stick right, you'll have to open another locked door with The Baron's Key. L|1|13.|At the end is a large room where the Baron is at. The «Baron's Amulet of Life Giving» (+15 Health) is inside the «Treasure Chest» in this room, use the Treasure Chest Key to open it. L|1|14.|{OPT} In this room on the floor are also «Stone of Rez'arel¦Stones of Rez'arel». These are part of the «Diemos Flagging» or «Crafting Golem» quests and you can pick one up while you're here if you wish. L|2|•|⟦StoneofRezarel_Pickup!⟧

Quest.name: Bur_Portal_Summoning_(High)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|120 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Portal to Bur» at 67.4N, 30.5E I|Route|«Rithwic» to «Glystaene Cottages» at 8.8N, 60.9E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest was originally part of the effort to open to the portals to the world of Bur. There were originally orbs in the three pedestal dungeons which were used to activate the portal. Those that turned in the orbs got the title "Portal Ritualist". Now there are only shards of the pedestals in the dungeons can can be turned in to the pedestals for experience rewards. The dungeons can be run without killing a single monster in about 2 or 3 minutes if you know the way well and can jump well.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|To open the portal to the pedestal dungeon there is an item magic skill check. Be sure to buff your skill if it doesn't work unbuffed. If you pass the skill check a gateway will appear. L|1|2.|The «Western Pedestal» requires about 360 or greater item magic skill to the open the portal. L|2|•|**Sucess:** You examine the pedestal carefully, and divine how to open a portal using this pedestal. L|1|3.|{WARN} From the room where the portal drops you there is a ramp down but there is a dispel trap at the top of the ramp. You must position yourself in front of the passage and do a tap jump through the doorway in order to avoid it. L|1|4.|At the bottom of the ramp turn right then take the first left and from there run straight through a hallway populated by ghosts (you'll go up then down and end up at a door). L|1|5.|{WARN} From the door you will go down a ramp and at the bottom there is a dispel trap in the narrow hallway leading to a wider hallway. To avoid it stand at the bottom of the ramp and take a step forward (don't go too far forward though) then do a tap jump forward. Whether you miss the trap or not head straight down the hall and down a ramp. The hallway turns sharply so you can lose whatever is chasing you and can rebuff if you were dispelled. L|1|6.|A the bottom of the ramp turn right and go in the third room on your left. There is a passageway in the back of the room. Go down and then dispel yourself if you can to remove any frost vulns (and you probably will). L|1|7.|Now comes the lever room. The room does cold damage if you stand still too long so its best to keep moving. If you are not cold vulned you take about 32 damage a hit but if you are vulned then the damage increases to about 90 damage a hit and not many can survive that hence dispelling is imperative. L|2|•|A rough map of the lever room is to the right L|2|•|Note: If you fall into the pit with the ghosts there is a way back up by which you return to the ledge through a door to the west. L|2|•|First run to the ledge in front of you to the north. Tap jump forward (not shift jump) at about 1/4 power. This will land you on a platform that spans the entire center of the room. L|2|•|From the center platform you can see two platforms with levers across another gap like the one you just crossed. Aim for one of the levers (doesn't matter which is pulled first) and do another 1/4 power tap jump forward onto the lever platform. L|2|•|Pull the lever then do another 1/4 power tap jump forward across to the other lever and pull it. L|2|•|Now do another 1/4 power tap jump back to the center platform and then another jump back to the ledge where you came into the room. The doors that were opened by the levers are to the east. L|1|8.|Run up and you will enter a room filled with many monsters and a several Pedestal Shards on the ground. If you are solo its best to dispel yourself then sprint in and grab a «Shard of the Western Pedestal» then portal recall fast. L|2|•|⟦WesternPedestalShard_Pickup⟧ L|1|9.|Return to the Pedestals by the Portal to Bur and hand the western pedestal the shard for an xp reward.
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Western Pedestal Dungeon» 67.4N, 30.5E -- -- TE
H2|Rewards
R|Western Pedestal (120+) RK|Experience|99,078,618 (10% up to level 200) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Giving Western Pedestal Shard to Western Pedestal⸩ ⸨You give Western Pedestal Shard of the Western Pedestal.⸩ ⸨You examine the stone and find a gash which matches the shape of your shard. You press the shard against the gash, and the two pieces of stone seal together magically. You have now done all that you can do to repair this pillar for now.⸩ ⸨You've earned 99,078,618 experience.⸩

Quest.name: Bur_Portal_Summoning_(Mid)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80-119 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Portal to Bur» at 67.4N, 30.5E I|Route|«Rithwic» to «Glystaene Cottages» at 8.8N, 60.9E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest was originally part of the effort to open to the portals to the world of Bur. There were originally orbs in the three pedestal dungeons which were used to activate the portal. Those that turned in the orbs got the title "Portal Ritualist". Now there are only shards of the pedestals in the dungeons can can be turned in to the pedestals for experience rewards. The dungeons can be run without killing a single monster in about 2 or 3 minutes if you know the way well and can jump well.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|To open the portal to the pedestal dungeon there is an item magic skill check. Be sure to buff your skill if it doesn't work unbuffed. If you pass the skill check a gateway will appear. L|1|2.|The «Eastern Pedestal» requires about 310 or greater item magic skill to the open the portal. L|2|•|**Sucess:** You examine the pedestal carefully, and divine how to open a portal using this pedestal. L|1|3.|{WARN} From the room where the portal drops you there is a ramp down but there is a dispel trap at the top of the ramp. You must position yourself in front of the passage and do a tap jump through the doorway in order to avoid it. L|1|4.|At the bottom of the ramp turn right then take the first left and from there run straight through a hallway populated by ghosts (you'll go up then down and end up at a door). L|1|5.|{WARN} From the door you will go down a ramp and at the bottom there is a dispel trap in the narrow hallway leading to a wider hallway. To avoid it stand at the bottom of the ramp and take a step forward (don't go too far forward though) then do a tap jump forward. Whether you miss the trap or not head straight down the hall and down a ramp. The hallway turns sharply so you can lose whatever is chasing you and can rebuff if you were dispelled. L|1|6.|A the bottom of the ramp turn right and go in the third room on your left. There is a passageway in the back of the room. Go down and then dispel yourself if you can to remove any frost vulns (and you probably will). L|1|7.|Now comes the lever room. The room does cold damage if you stand still too long so its best to keep moving. If you are not cold vulned you take about 32 damage a hit but if you are vulned then the damage increases to about 90 damage a hit and not many can survive that hence dispelling is imperative. L|2|•|A rough map of the lever room is to the right L|2|•|Note: If you fall into the pit with the ghosts there is a way back up by which you return to the ledge through a door to the west. L|2|•|First run to the ledge in front of you to the north. Tap jump forward (not shift jump) at about 1/4 power. This will land you on a platform that spans the entire center of the room. L|2|•|From the center platform you can see two platforms with levers across another gap like the one you just crossed. Aim for one of the levers (doesn't matter which is pulled first) and do another 1/4 power tap jump forward onto the lever platform. L|2|•|Pull the lever then do another 1/4 power tap jump forward across to the other lever and pull it. L|2|•|Now do another 1/4 power tap jump back to the center platform and then another jump back to the ledge where you came into the room. The doors that were opened by the levers are to the east. L|1|8.|Run up and you will enter a room filled with many monsters and a several Pedestal Shards on the ground. If you are solo its best to dispel yourself then sprint in and grab the «Shard of the Eastern Pedestal» then portal out fast. L|2|•|⟦EasternPedestalShard_Pickup⟧ L|1|9.|Return to the Pedestals by the Portal to Bur and hand the eastern pedestal the shard for an xp reward.

Save them if you wish to earn the title of Kingslayer (see Walk Through).

L|1|3.|If you've saved the hides from all 6 of the kings, combine them in the following order to create the complete «Combined Kukuur Hides»: «Kiree's Hide» + «Reeshan's Hide» + «Kiree's Hide» + «Broodu's Hide» + «Keerik's Hide» + «Rehir's Hide» + «Browerk's Hide». L|1|4.|Hand the «Combined Kukuur Hides» to Guard Devon to receive a «Burun Kukuur Floatee», «Mana Forge Key» (125+), and the title of Kingslayer!

The rewards that I grant are meant for those that have fought through all six of the Burun Kings. When you have done so return to me. If you choose, combine the scraps of flesh that you collect from the Kings and combine them one after the other. When all six are together hand it to me for a fair reward."
L|1||Guard Devon (Defeating all 6 Kings)⸩ ⸨Guard Devon tells you, "You have fought through a great many foes to prove your heroism. There is no question that you a person of great honor and skill. This is your reward."⸩ ⸨You've earned 187,282,200 experience.⸩ ⸨Guard Devon gives you Noble .⸩ ⸨Guard Devon says, "You are a hero to us all, . Your efforts shall not soon be forgotten. I am prepared to grant you a reward every three weeks. Return to me when you have defeated the beasts again and I shall grant you another boon. I will offer you a title and a reward for your home."⸩ ⸨Guard Devon tells you, "I am now authorized to reward more experienced adventurers with mana forge keys and you qualify. H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Getting the key to Folthid Cellar L|1|1.|Speak with «Raxanza Folthid» at 8.8S, 53.7E and she will ask you to retrieve some «Old Nectar» for her and give you a «Key (Dagger of Tikola Key 1)¦Key» to the cellar where it can be found.
H3|Part 2: Folthid Cellar L|1|1.|Go to the «Folthid Cellar» at 8.6S, 52.9E. Go inside. Use the «Key (Dagger of Tikola Key 1)¦Key» to open the cellar door. L|1|2.|Take a right after opening the door, working your way down into the dungeon. L|1|3.|Notice the lever to the west in the room below, to reach it jump down to the south side of the bridge and head around through the corridor to the lever. L|2|•|⟦oldnectarpickup⟧ L|1|5.|Loot the nectar and jump down into the deeper catacombs of the dungeon. In this lower chamber, take the hallway on the north wall. Quest.name: Eldrytch_Web_Initiation
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Arturus of the Eldrytch Web» I|Starts At|«Cragstone» at 26.3N, 49.6E I|Repeat|Non Repeatable I|Quest Chain|Joining a Society I|1|«Investigating the Societies» I|2|Eldrytch Web Initiation H2|Overview
L|1||Prerequisites P|In order to start this quest, you must have completed the «Investigate the Factions» quest, which allows you to preview each faction.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to «Arturus of the Eldrytch Web» at 26.3N 49.6E in «Cragstone». L|1|2.|Get «Corrupted Mana Shard» L|2|•|Leaftide Experience L|3|1.|Go to Sub > AC Storage and use the pedestal. L|2|•|Retail Experience L|3|1.|Head to the «Corrupted Catacombs» at 23.9S, 54.1E near «Sawato». If you will be taking a group, you can tie to «Empyrean Foundry» at 25.1S 54.1E to make a much shorter run. L|3|2.|The place is somewhat of a maze so you might have to backtrack. Run through the dungeon (look for down ramps) until you find a «Slimy Key» on the ground in a room with pillars. The route from the drop is straight at first intersection, right on next, then left. Keep right hand rule until a ramp down into a room with pillars, and go left (South) here and more ramps down. Next intersection go right, and on the floor is the key. L|3|3.|From here head back up in the dungeon and look for a locked door (660 diff). The door isn't far past a surface portal in the area with Sclavus. If you have run through the «Swamp Ruin» portal, it might be easier to recall and re-enter the dungeon. The route from the drop is straight at first intersection, right on next, then left. Keep right hand rule until a ramp down into a room with pillars, and go straight (West) here into the sclavus part. From there, go right at next intersection and down, once you find the portal in a pillar room, go straight (West) and there is the door. L|3|4.|Once through the door, grab the «Corrupted Mana Shard» from the pedestal. L|1|3.|Return the shard to «Arturus of the Eldrytch Web» to be initiated into the «Eldrytch Web» faction. L|1|4.|Use the «Initiate's Treasure Key» to loot one of the four chests inside the «Eldrytch Web Stronghold» («Armor Quartermaster's Chest», «Equipment Quartermaster's Chest», «Weapon Quartermaster's Chest», «Researcher's Chest»).
P|Notes L|1|•|The «Corrupted Mana Shard» will only last 1 hour before turning to dust so you must hand it in to «Arturus of the Eldrytch Web» within 1 hour of picking it up. L|1|•|Once initiated, you can now use the portal to the «Eldrytch Web Stronghold» located next to Arturus.

In the swamps of middle Osteth there is a cave. In that cave is the entrance to the Corrupted Catacombs. If you search around 23.9S, 54.1E, you should find the entrance."⸩ ⸨Arturus of the Eldrytch Web tells you, "In those catacombs, you'll find a Corrupted Mana Shard. Retrieve the Shard and bring it to me, and your test will be complete."⸩ ⸨Arturus of the Eldrytch Web tells you, "Be warned, once you have the Shard, it'll be rather unstable, and will last only an hour before it turns to dust. I'll cast a spell on you that will protect you from the corruption of the Shard. I wouldn't recommend touching it without the protections."⸩ ⸨Arturus of the Eldrytch Web chants briefly, and then touches your brow.⸩ ⸨Arturus of the Eldrytch Web tells you, "There, you should now be able to carry the Corrupted Mana Shard safely."
L|1||Giving Corrupted Mana Shard to Arturus of the Eldrytch Web⸩ ⸨You give Arturus of the Eldrytch Web Corrupted Mana Shard.⸩ ⸨Arturus of the Eldrytch Web tells you, "Well done. You have done all I asked of you, and done so quickly enough for the Mana Shard to still be in one piece. Well done indeed."⸩ ⸨Arturus of the Eldrytch Web tells you, "Welcome to the Society of the Eldrytch Web! Nearby, you will find a portal into our Stronghold, where you will find several important people to your future within our Society."⸩ ⸨Arturus of the Eldrytch Web gives you Eldrytch Web Initiate Armor Writ.⸩ ⸨You've earned 198,157,237 experience.⸩ ⸨Arturus of the Eldrytch Web gives you Initiate's Treasure Key.⸩ ⸨Arturus of the Eldrytch Web gives you Eldrytch Web Initiate's Handbook.⸩ ⸨Arturus of the Eldrytch Web tells you, "Make sure to read your Initiate Handbook. Inside, you will find important information covering your interactions within our Society, including how to improve your reputation and rank within the Society."⸩

Quest.Wiki:

H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to the «Lair of the Eviscerators» at 53.7N, 76.6W. L|1|2.|The «Eviscerator Pincer» is dropped by an «Olthoi Eviscerator» at the end of the dungeon (see map). L|2|•|⟦OlthoiHunting5⟧ L|1|3.|When you have the pincer, bring it back to Behdo Yii to receive your rewards.

H2|Rewards
R|Hand in «Eviscerator Pincer» RK|Experience|5,000,000 (Fixed% up to level ) RK|Title|Bug Butcher RK|Items| RI|«Sublime Necklace of Acid and Piercing Protection» RI|«Trade Note (100,000)» RI|«Treated Healing Kit» (x2) RI|«Gem of Stillness» (x2) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Behdo Yii⸩ ⸨Behdo Yii tells you, "Hello there stranger! I am wondering if you can help me in a bit of a predicament I find myself in. I was busy exploring a wonderfully well-preserved abandoned Tumerok outpost, when I was beset upon by a number of Olthoi!"⸩ ⸨Behdo Yii tells you, "I had never seen these fearsome creatures that close before, and the fact that I escaped with my life leads me to believe that these Olthoi aren't quite so tough as their mainland counterparts. But now that Redspire has been taken over by Varicci's men, I couldn't return to the place even if I thought I could kill the Olthoi! If you could journey to this tumerok outpost and rid it of these troublesome beasts I would be most grateful."⸩ ⸨Behdo Yii tells you, "If you could bring me back some proof that you have conquered them, such as a pincer, I would reward you well. I believe the portal to the Abandoned Tumerok Site now lies a bit to the northeast of here -- I have heard rumors that strange eddies in the currents of portal space have shifted it away from its original location."
L|1||Handing in the Eviscerator Pincer⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Eviscerator Pincers.⸩ ⸨Behdo Yii tells you, "You really are a savior! Here is your reward."⸩ ⸨You've earned 1,600,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 3,400,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Behdo Yii gives you Sublime Necklace of Acid and Piercing Protection.⸩ ⸨Behdo Yii gives you Trade Note (100,000).⸩ ⸨Behdo Yii gives you Treated Healing Kit.⸩ ⸨Behdo Yii gives you Treated Healing Kit.⸩ ⸨Behdo Yii gives you Gem of Stillness.⸩ ⸨Behdo Yii gives you Gem of Stillness.⸩ ⸨Behdo Yii tells you, "Here is your new title of Bug Butcher!"⸩ ⸨Behdo Yii tells you, "Oh, my friend, the onslaughts never end! The moment I feel that we...I mean, you have brought these infestations to their final end, I hear that yet another swarm of even more dangerous Olthoi has made their presence known! Please, my friend, save my reputation once more. The Olthoi Warrior's Nest lies upon the northern part of the Marescent Plateau. Bring me the proof of a single Warrior's pincer, and I will reward you handsomely."⸩

Quest.name: Eye_of_T'thuun_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Tamara du Cinghalle» I|Starts At|43.2N, 67.1W in «Greenspire» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Kill Task|Yes H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Tamara du Cinghalle». L|2|•|⟦KillTaskTentacleofTthuun_0908⟧ L|1|2.|Run just east of the «Tall Tree»s on the northeastern edge of the «Marae Lassel Plateau» at 51.8N, 72.7W. L|2|•|Route: Take the portal at 42.0N, 77.6W near «Redspire» and «Bluespire» to get up onto the plateau. L|2|•|Alt Route: Take Facility Hub Portal and use Ancient Empyrean Grotto Portal. L|1|3.|Kill 50 tentacles. L|2|•|First Kill: ⟦KillTaskTentacleofTthuun_0908 on first completion⟧ L|1|4.|Double click on the «Eye-covered Tentacles of T'thuun» to retrieve a «Plucked Eye of T'thuun». After you pluck the eye, high level sclavus will spawn. You can simply leave at this point since the reward has been given. L|1|5.|Return to «Tamara du Cinghalle» for your rewards. L|2|•|⟦KillTaskTentacleofTthuunWait_0908⟧ L|2|•|⟦PluckerofEyes_Repeat⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No related dungeons.
H2|Rewards
R| RK|Experience|263,129,446 (40% up to level 180) RK|Title|Plucker of Eyes RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨**Opening Dialog**⸩ ⸨Tamara du Cinghalle tells you, "Greetings."⸩ ⸨Tamara du Cinghalle tells you, "I have a task for you, if you are willing to aid us against the beast, T'thuun, who has been harrying the Deru Trees on Marae Lassel. The Tumeroks up on the Plateau have been in an uproar about this T'thuun since the first tentacles appeared."⸩ ⸨Tamara du Cinghalle tells you, "Our researchers believe, if we can get one of the eyes from the largest tentacle by the Trees, that we can use it to find a long-term solution to this problem."⸩ ⸨Tamara du Cinghalle tells you, "The challenge is, that unless the tentacles are weakened and the large tentacle is distracted, it's impossible to get an eye off of it."⸩ ⸨Tamara du Cinghalle tells you, "Killing the smaller tentacles seems to distract the larger one. Killing 50 should be enough to get an eye off of the larger, eye covered one."⸩ ⸨Tamara du Cinghalle tells you, "Bring me back an eye, and I'll reward you on behalf of my superiors and the Tumeroks on the Plateau."
P|**Completing Kill Task**⸩ ⸨You have killed 50 Tentacle of T'thuuns! Your task is complete!⸩ ⸨Tentacle of T'thuun is torn to ribbons by your assault!⸩ ⸨You quickly pluck an eye from the confused and distracted tentacle, which begins to radiate menace as the remaining eyes focus in on you.⸩ ⸨Eye-covered Tentacles of T'thuun gives you Plucked Eye of T'thuun.⸩ ⸨Tamara du Cinghalle tells you, "You look like you've been busy. Have you completed the task I set before you?"
P|**Handing in Plucked Eye of T'thuun**⸩ ⸨You give Tamara du Cinghalle Plucked Eye of T'thuun.⸩ ⸨You've earned 263,129,446 experience.⸩ ⸨Tamara du Cinghalle tells you, "Ahh, success. The researchers will be very pleased. With this, we can hopefully find some way to end this infestation of the Deru Trees. The researchers told me that it'll take roughly 2 weeks to complete the tests on this eye. Return to me after that, and I may have more work for you."⸩ ⸨Tamara du Cinghalle tells you, "And, here is your reward, on behalf of my superiors and the Tumeroks up on the plateau."⸩ ⸨Tamara du Cinghalle awards you the title, "Plucker of Eyes".⸩

Quest.name: Faces_of_the_Mukkir_(High)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80-99 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Qath al-Haddash» I|Starts At|74.2S, 19.2E in «Qalaba'r» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Faces of the Mukkir (High)» H2|Overview P|Help the rogue scholar Qath al-Haddash investigate Viamontian dig sites. This quest is one of the few contract quests which has upper level restrictions on the portals. As a result, you can only do the quest level corresponding to your current player level.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Qath al-Haddash» in «Qalaba'r». L|2|•|⟦FacesMukkirNotes1005⟧ - shared with all versions L|1|2.|Go to «Mistress Gabille's Dig» at 8.5N 88.9W. L|2|•|Route: «Aerlinthe» drop to Northwest Direlands. L|1|3.|Run to the end and kill «Mistress Gabille». Loot «Gabille's Encoded Notes» from her. L|2|•|⟦detailmukkirorbnotespickup⟧ L|1|4.|Return the notes to Qath to receive your rewards. L|2|•|⟦FacesMukkirComplete1005⟧ - shared with all versions
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Mistress Gabille's Dig» 8.5N, 88.9W -- «map:0042¦0042» TE
H2|Rewards
R|Give «Gabille's Encoded Notes» to «Qath al-Haddash» RK|Experience|?? (100% up to level > 98) RK|Items| RI|«Detailed Mukkir Orb» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog (Level 80-99)⸩ ⸨Qath al-Haddash tells you, "Yes, you should be suitable... I have been tracking Viamontian interest in a certain obscure race of creatures, thought long-vanished... I would have you journey to the dig site overseen by Mistress Gabille, a Viamontian scholar. Bring me Gabille's notes on their findings. The notes are likely to be written in some strange cipher, unreadable by the untrained eye. The dig site can be found at 8.5N 88.9W."
L|1||Handing in Gabille's Encoded Notes⸩ ⸨You allow Qath al-Haddash to examine your Gabille's Encoded Notes.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Gabille's Encoded Notes.⸩ ⸨Qath al-Haddash tells you, "Useful information, this. Confirms some of my suspicions, and discredits some theories. I thank you. You may find this entertaining... it is a spellcasting orb crafted in the shape of what we believe these "Mukkir" to look like, with some useful enchantments on it. You may also be curious to see a translation of the notes..."⸩ ⸨You've earned ?? experience.⸩ ⸨Qath al-Haddash gives you Detailed Mukkir Orb.⸩ ⸨Qath al-Haddash gives you Mistress Gabille's Notes.⸩ ⸨You must wait 20h to complete this quest again.⸩

Quest.name: Falatacot_Medallion_(High)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|81-120 I|Type|Small Fellowship I|Starts With|«Gruuk'lar» I|Starts At|«Kor-Gursha» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Make you way to «Steamy Guruk Caverns» found in the «Eastern Catacombs» - see for directions. L|1|2.|One you portal in, go east while hugging the right wall. L|1|3.|You will come to a corridor with two paths leading down southwards. Take the left path, following it to the end. L|1|4.|You will come out into a large room. L|1|5.|Head north to the very end of the chamber and take the right hand exit leading east and then take a right hand turn at the intersection. L|1|6.|You will again exit into a large room, take the northeast exit and follow the corridor until you reach an intersection. Go left from here heading east. L|1|7.|You will now go down a longer than usual path leading into the final room. L|1|8.|The Falatacot boss can be found just around the corner to the north of the large room. The boss varies on what dungeon you entered and will be flanked by other creatures. L|1|9.|Defeat «Matriarch Vik'Liri Di» and loot the «Engraved Falatacot Medallion». L|2|•|⟦EngravedFalatacotMedallionPickupTimer⟧
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Steamy Guruk Caverns» N/A -- -- TE
H2|Rewards
R|Give «Engraved Falatacot Medallion» to Gruuk'lar RK|Experience|48,300,000 RK|Title|Ruuk Ally RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Gruuk'lar tells you, "Greetings, traveler from Dereth."⸩ ⸨Gruuk'lar tells you, "Don't look too surprised that I know your language. We've had one of your people here for some time, teaching us of your ways. Teaching us of this metal you call 'Pyreal' and of how to engage in 'Commerce'."⸩ ⸨Gruuk'lar tells you, "But I digress. I'm no gatherer or 'merchant' to trade in such things. I'm a guardian of this small Tribe, and my Clutch helps protect and hide this place from the others."⸩ ⸨Gruuk'lar tells you, "There are four caverns which have become connected to this cavern via magic, "Portals" I have heard them called. They appeared the same time Torgluuk and Asheron disappeared, and occasionally Guruk come through them to attack us. I have sent hunters from my Clutch, but none have returned, and I can't afford to send more, as we must be ready to defend the village."⸩ ⸨Gruuk'lar tells you, "These Guruk who attack us seem to be being controlled by those your people call Falatacot. The False Gods of our hated Fiazhat enemies. Travel into these 'Portals', destroy these False Gods, and bring proof of their demise to me, and I will reward you."⸩ ⸨Gruuk'lar looks you over.⸩ ⸨Gruuk'lar tells you, "There is a portal to the Southern Catacombs, down the tunnel to the Northeast of here. In the depths of those catacombs, you will find the portal to the Deep Guruk Caverns."
L|1||Handing in Engraved Falatacot Medallion⸩ ⸨You give Gruuk'lar Engraved Falatacot Medallion.⸩ ⸨Gruuk'lar looks the medallion over, sniffing at it.⸩ ⸨Gruuk'lar tells you, "There is strange magic on this. I will send it to our Shaman, and see what they can learn from it. Thank you. It is a clue, and with it, we may be able to track down more information."⸩ ⸨Gruuk'lar tells you, "Take this."⸩ ⸨You've earned 48,300,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Gruuk'lar declares you an ally of the Ruuk.⸩

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«The Floating City» I|Route|Random portals (see walkthrough) I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Retrieve a bottle of perfectly aged distillery dew from the Floating City and return it to Jilsaya bint Dah or Lord Aleval.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes P|The city is full of both stable and unstable portals (shown on the maps), it's best to use the stable portals otherwise you may end up in the Lost Chamber and have to start over as there is no way back.
L|1|1.|Find the randomly appearing portal to «The Floating City» or the «Golem Sanctum», which has a stable portal just inside the drop. **Note:** These are the only portals you can tie to, the portals inside the city cannot be tied or recalled to. L|2|•|Floating City portal sightings| L|3|•|West of Al-Jalima L|2|•|Golem Sanctum portal sightings| L|3|•|South of Sawato (near the Battlefield of Ayn Tayan). L|1|2.|If you are using the stable portal in the «Golem Sanctum» you will end up in the tunnels and will have to use an unstable portal (like the landscape floating portal) to reach a section of the city with stable portals. L|1|3.|Hopefully you will end up in the city's bar area where the dew is found, if you don't you need to make your way to the Banderling area for the stable portal to the bar or you can use an unstable portal for a chance at appearing in the bar. L|1|4.|The Banderling part of the city can be reached through portals in the Construction Area and Museum (see the maps below). L|1|5.|When you finally reach the bar area, head east around the room and then go south at the stamina pool beneath the bridges. L|1|6.|At the end of the corridor, go right into the west room where you will find 3 Zombie Mages and the chest containing the «Distillery Dew». You will want to dispatch the chain-casting mages one at a time using the corridor, as they could kill you very quickly when together. L|2|•|⟦DistilleryDewQuest⟧ L|1|7.|Take the dew to «Lord Aleval» in the «Lytelthorpe» or «Jilsaya bint Dah» in «Al-Arqas» for your rewards.

Quest.name: Gear_Crossbow_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|150+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Frozen Cave» at 93.5N, 60.5W I|Route|«Fiun Outpost» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Find the Frozen Gearknight in the «Frozen Cave» dungeon and free him by slaying the «Frozen Glacial Golem» for xp and a «Gear Crossbow». The dungeons has no level req but is very dangerous for all but the highest level characters, including high damage cold winds and frozen slurry floors. Mages should use their «Chilling Ebony Staff» if they have one to make it impossible to be cold vulned.
L|1|•|This is a fairly simple dungeon consisting of a series of tunnels between levels, and several frozen ledges/bridges that criss-cross back and forth over a large chasm with a high damage floor at the very bottom. Fortunately, with a little bit of jumping expertise, traversing the entire dungeon is quick and easy. Before attempting jumps, however, please note that jumping in this dungeon is risky due to high damage winds that can easily kill you if you are cold vulned (a near constant condition due to the frost elementals that spam wars and vulns). If you do not have a «Chilling Ebony Staff» equipped, be sure to dispel any cold vulns before each jump.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head west from the «Fiun Outpost» to the «Frozen Cave» at 93.5N, 60.5W. L|2|•|{TIP} Because it is easy to die in this dungeon, you may want to tie to the surface portal just inside the «Ruschk Iceberg» dungeon to the north at 96.3N 60.0W.
H3|Part 1: Navigating the Cave H4|Method 1: Jumps (Skip killing walls) L|1|1.|From the entrance, proceed to jump down the first small chasm to the first level below. Head South out of the room, then cross the bridge over the chasm into a small chamber with 4 golems and a Wall of Ice - ignore all of them. (The golems should not attack you; if they do, you may simply cross back over the bridge and they will quickly return to their slumber). L|1|2.|Once all of the elementals from the first room have left you alone, walk back onto the bridge and angle your camera view to see the level directly beneath it. There are 2 small shelves directly below the bridge you are standing on, each protruding just beyond the width of your bridge. L|1|3.|Use a very small jump to drop down to either one of the shelves below, then cross over to the East. From there, head North following the East wall a short way down to the next level. L|1|4.|Remain in the middle of this hallway (before the bend leading to the next room) while you dispell, heal up, and clear out any elementals that may be blocking your path or which have followed you from the previous level. L|1|5.|Once you are safe, exit the hallway and proceed to the ledge directly West of you. Jump down a short way to the larger shelf directly below you, and immediately hug the East wall (underneath the ledge you just jumped down from) to avoid elementals dropping down on you from above. Dispell, heal, kill anything that may have stuck to you. L|1|6.|Once safe again, head to the West wall on your shelf to get a better view. Look South-east; you will see the next level below you and a medium distance across the chasm from where you are. This is your target. Read on to see what to do if you miss, then jump across to the next level. L|2|1.|IF YOU MISS your jump and fall to the bottom, quickly head back toward the direction of the shelf, and approach the SOUTH side. AVOID the area directly underneath the shelf you jumped from, as you will take heavy cold damage. From here, you can shift jump back up to the rock pillars/outcropping above you - be sure to aim between any two pillars to make sure you "stick." L|2|2.|Once off the chasm floor, you can then do a full jump directly to your target (doable with 500 buffed jump, but probably not much below that). L|2|3.|Note that, for some jumpers, this three-step process may actually be an easier way to make the final jump across - but beware possible cold damage! L|1|7.|Done with the jumps! From here, head North to another room, then to a winding hallway leading to the final area. It is recommended that you remain in this hallway until you know what to do in the last area. See below.
H4|Method 2: Killing Walls (Skip jumps) L|1|1.|Other than the big jump at the very start, you can avoid the other jumps by killing Walls of Ice (normal damage). The Frozen Stone Walls are no longer killable and spawn randomly in place of some of the ice walls (previously you were able to kill them with life bolt ring spells). What this means is that of the several ways down, only one will be usable because the others will have at least one stone wall in the way (though one route does allow you to make a short jump to avoid a possible stone wall). Note that golems near each Wall will become aggressive once you begin attacking, so be careful. Because it is random, each time the dungeon spawns the stone wall placements can change. Below are the different possible routes you can take: L|2|•|**Route A:** The quickest (fewest Walls to kill) way is to proceed North from the entrance and bear Right at the split, then proceed through as normal, bearing East and South after the first Wall of Ice. L|2|•|**Route B:** L|2|•|**Route C:** L|1|2.|It is recommended that you remain in the final windy hallway before the last large room until you know what to do in the last area. See below.
H3|Part 2: Frozen Glacial Golem & Gear Knights L|1|1.|Near the very end of the dungeon you'll come to a large down-sloping room with a large ice overhang that is on both sides and the ceiling at the bottom of the slope. Under the overhang (where the path narrows just before the «Frozen Glacial Golem») is a floor trap that spawns approximately half a dozen Gear Knights. There are two general ways to complete the quest from this point, but be sure to read the next section before attempting either: L|2|1.|Walk on the trap to trigger the Gear Knight spawn, kill them all and the «Frozen Glacial Golem» will die automatically, causing the «Frozen Gearknight» to change from ethereal to a killable creature. L|2|2.|Jump over the trap and kill the «Frozen Glacial Golem» yourself (pull him to the side for the best chance at avoiding issues). Once dead, the «Frozen Gearknight» changes from ethereal to a killable creature. L|1|2.|Important tip for mages and archers: after spawning the Gear Knights, it is possible to jump behind the «Frozen Glacial Golem» for protection; you will be safe from melee attacks on the far wall behind it (but NOT spells!), and can pick off the Gear Knights one by one with relative impunity. Stand to either side of the golem and jump over his shoulder toward the wall behind him. L|1|3.|In either case, once the «Frozen Glacial Golem» is dead and the «Frozen Gearknight» becomes attackable, do regular damage to break the ice around the it and the NPC «Ordas Myr» will immediately appear in the same spot. Speak to him for xp and the crossbow. Ordas will disappear after a few minutes, so if you have party members who need to make their way back after dying, it is best to wait to break the ice around the «Frozen Gearknight» until they have returned safely. L|2|•|⟦gearxbowwait⟧ L|1|4.|This quest can sometimes bug: if the ice around the frozen Gear Knight doesn't become attackable after the golem dies, have everybody in the fellow(s) log out for 5 min. Then all come back to repeat the process (kill gear knights or golem) until it works.
P|Notes L|1|•|The color of the xbow is random, colors found so far include black, gold and orange. L|1|•|When released the transition from ethereal and encased in ice to killable creature for the «Frozen Gearknight» is unreliable. It is supposed to occur when the «Frozen Glacial Golem» is either killed directly, or dies indirectly as a result of killing all the Gear Knights that spawn from the nearby floor trap. As a consequence you may need to kill the golem more than once (the transition is brief so check right away).

H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to «Xarabydun» go down into the underground section at 41.9S, 16.1E. Take all right turns until you reach a locked door in the sewer area. Kill the «Mite Squire» here and loot the «Guard Post Key». L|1|4.|Kill the «Mite Warrior Princess» and loot the 40 «Discus»es - notice the lever activated door here. L|1|5.|Run back to the area with the «Wood Golem» and «Shadow Sprite» and use the key on the door here. L|1|6.|Pull the lever (which can be reached without opening the door), to open the door in the Mite Warrior Princess' room. L|2|•|Optional step - Pick the locked door (resistance: 82) and loot the «Forgotten Text» from the «Armory Chest». L|1|7.|Run back to the Mite area and through the doors before they shut, jump over the stone wall and enter the «Lightless Tunnels» portal. L|1|8.|Go east from the drop and hug the left wall, head down the ramp in the K'nath room to a room filled with «Crystal Nodule»s - take as many as you want, they can be stored on a mule until the repeat timer expires. If I could leave Redspire, I'd teach those bugs what's what, but I'm sure you could do it! If you could go there and teach them a lesson or two, I would be very appreciative."⸩

Quest.name: Hea_Totem_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|35 I|Rec. Level|70 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Timaru» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Slay the brutal Temepuh: Hea Temenua, and then retrieve rubble from the broken Menhir Rings, and you will be rewarded with one of the powerful weapons of Palenqual.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Find «Hea Temenua» and loot a «Hea Totem» from his corpse. He is a random rare spawn on the «Marescent Plateau» and is found with a number of other Hea Tumeroks including «Hea Karenua» and «Hea Kanokeh». L|2|•|⟦ChampionKillQuest2⟧ L|2|•|Note: While the «Hea Totem» can be given to other players, they will not be flagged to hand in the Totem until they have killed Hea Temenua. L|2|•|{OPT} Loot the «Greenwood Haft» and «Gromnie Sinew Bowstring», they can be used to create the «Sublime Elari Wood Bow». L|3|•|⟦ChampionQuest06⟧ L|3|•|⟦ChampionQuest07⟧ L|2|•|{OPT} «Hea Karenua» also drops the «Awakener» and 4 «Karenua's Key»s. L|3|•|⟦ChampionQuest01⟧ L|1|2.|Hand the totem in to one of the 3 Aun NPCs in the big tent in the center of «Timaru» for the weapon of your choice. L|2|•|«Aun Rukuona» gives the Caster «Stave of Palenqual (Base)» and the text «The Stave of Palenqual» L|2|•|«Aun Turiona» gives the Crossbow «Kalindan of Palenqual (Base)» and the text «The Kalindan of Palenqual» L|2|•|«Aun Kiriona» gives the Melee Staff «Hoeroa of Palenqual (Base)» and the text «The Hoeroa of Palenqual» L|2|•|Note: You can still hand the Totem to «Aun Hareltah», however, you must talk with him before you hand the totem. Hareltah can give any of the three weapons but you have to talk with him before you hand the totem and he will tell you which weapon he will give you. This was the way the quest «#Trivia¦used to work» before the other NPCs were added. It is preferable to use the NPCs in the back of the tent to choose your weapon so you won't mistakenly get the wrong one. L|3|•|⟦HareltahKill1⟧ or ⟦HareltahKill1@GiveTotem⟧ only for «Aun Hareltah» turn in. L|1|3.|Decide which three totems you want to add to the weapon. Different totems add different extra properties or spells to your weapon (see below). L|1|4.|Make your way to the bottom of each hive, and loot the «Rubble» from the corpse of a special (these are givable despite the dungeons being level restricted) blue colored Olthoi Noble. This Olthoi is not always there, you might have to kill a few spawns for it to appear. L|2|•|Tiny: ⟦MenhirRubbleAPickUp⟧ Rubble description: northwest L|2|•|Small: ⟦MenhirRubbleBPickUp⟧ Rubble description: southwest L|2|•|Simple: ⟦MenhirRubbleCPickUp⟧ Rubble description: southeast L|2|•|Shallow: ⟦MenhirRubbleDPickUp⟧ Rubble description: northeast L|2|•|New: ⟦MenhirRubbleEPickUp⟧ Rubble description: north L|1|5.|Turn the Rubble in to the «Aun Ngationa» in the tent of «Aun Hareltah» in «Timaru» to receive a totem that you can add to the weapon: «Carenzi Totem», «Siraluun Totem», «Storm Totem», «Tonk Totem» and «Timaru Totem». L|2|•|⟦RingQuest02⟧ L|2|•|⟦RingQuest03⟧ L|2|•|⟦RingQuest04⟧ L|2|•|⟦RingQuest05⟧ L|2|•|⟦RingQuest06⟧ L|2|•|Alternatively the five different totems you get from turning the Rubble can be given to «Aun Hareltah» for some experience (500,000 max). L|1|6.|Attach the three totems of your choice to your weapon.
H3|Totem Spells TH|Totem Magic Melee Missile TR|Tonk «War Magic Mastery Self VI» (+35 Skill) «Staff Mastery Self VI» (+35 Staff Skill) «Missile Weapon Mastery Self VI» (+35 Missile Weapons Skill) TR|Storm «Avalanche» (War Spell - it will rain hail stones) «Crushing Blow» (Base damage reduced, 4x Critital Strike Damage) «Eye of the Hunter» (175% instead of 145%) TR|Siraluun «Minor Focus» (+5 Focus, stacks with Focus VI) «Lesser Strength of Earth» (+8 Strength, stacks with Strength VI) «Lesser Hunter's Acumen» (+8 Coordination, stacks with Coordination VI) TR|Carenzi «Focus Self VI» (+35 Focus) «Strength Self VI» (+35 Strength) «Coordination Self VI» (+35 Coordination) TR|Timaru «Timaru's Shelter» (+10 Magic Defense) «Timaru's Shelter» (+30 Natural Armor) «Timaru's Shelter» (+10 Quickness) TE

H2|Trivia L|1|•|This quest was once closely tied with the «Olthoi Queen Quest» in a way that was intended to bring out roleplaying in the game, but ultimately made the Menhir rebuilding part of the quest very difficult and unpopular. The mechanic was steamlined during the «Discoveries» event so players no longer had to coordinate their efforts with players running the Queen Quest. You can read more about this «Announcements - 2003/05 - Discoveries¦here». L|2|•|Players who chose to side with the Hea Tumeroks would break the Menhir Rings using the Pyreal Bells. L|2|•|Players who chose to side with the Aun Tumeroks would help repair the rings by handing in rubble to the appropriate Tumerok drummer found at each of the rings. L|2|•|Handing in rubble at a Menhir Ring made that NPC disappear, so if you had broken 5 rings, the quest would be reset back to 4 rings and players running the Queen quest would now need to find an additional bell dropper. L|1|•|Aun Hareltah was originally the only NPC that handed out weapons for the Hea Totem. The weapon he gave out varied on his position in the Timaru building, which changed everytime a stage of the Queen quest was completed: L|2|•|When the quest is dormant, Hareltah will kneel in front of the building and reward the «Hoeroa of Palenqual». L|2|•|When the first Menhir Ring is broken, he will pace back and forth in the front of the building and reward the «Kalindan of Palenqual». L|2|•|When the fifth and final ring is broken, he will pace back and forth in the back of the building and reward the «Stave of Palenqual».

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|100+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Jester» (Optional) I|Starts At|«Graveyard» at 65.8S, 43.8W (Use «Summoning Stone») I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Obtain a complete deck of Jester's missing cards to obtain a reusable spell gem that will cast +15 Focus (Deck of Eyes) or +15 Coordination (Deck of Hands) for 10 minutes. The two decks have a shared 60 minute cooldown timer.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Obtain the cards listed below from undead creatures in the «Graveyard» (random trophies) and the Jester quests «Jester Released» and «Jester's Lost Marbles». L|1|2.|Combine two cards from the same deck in order from Ace to King until you have a complete deck of 13 cards. There is also a a rare card, «The Jester (Card)¦The Jester», which is wild and can be used in place of any other card. L|2|1.|«Ace of Eyes» or «Ace of Hands» L|2|2.|«Two of Eyes» or «Two of Hands» L|2|3.|«Three of Eyes» or «Three of Hands» L|2|4.|«Four of Eyes» or «Four of Hands» L|2|5.|«Five of Eyes» or «Five of Hands» L|2|6.|«Six of Eyes» or «Six of Hands» L|2|7.|«Seven of Eyes» or «Seven of Hands» L|2|8.|«Eight of Eyes» or «Eight of Hands» L|2|9.|«Nine of Eyes» or «Nine of Hands» L|2|10.|«Ten of Eyes» or «Ten of Hands» L|2|11.|«Jack of Eyes» or «Jack of Hands» L|2|12.|«Queen of Eyes» or «Queen of Hands» L|2|13.|«King of Eyes» or «King of Hands» L|2|14.|«Deck of Eyes» or «Deck of Hands» L|1|3.|Once you have combined a complete suit of cards into a deck, give the deck to Jester at 65.8S, 43.8W who will return an activated deck. L|2|•|{TIP} It's best to hand during the day even though Jester can be summoned during the night. And make sure you're in no immediate danger, it's worth your time to clear any dangerous creatures that come over to you first, then use the «Summoning Stone». He takes a good 15-20 seconds from when you hand the completed deck until he returns the new item.
P|Notes L|1|•|The same creatures/quests that give cards can also give a «Jester's Token». The token lets you gamble for a new card by giving the token to a «Casino» boss. The boss then permits you to give the card you want to gamble to a «High-Stakes Gamesmaster». The Gamesmaster will return a new, random card. The token is attuned and bonded, cards are not. The token is only good for a single exchange of cards. L|2|•|Token turn in: ⟦tradejestercard⟧ L|1|•|The combined deck is tradable, but once you hand to jester and it's activated and is «Attuned» (not ivoryable) and can only be used by the character that turned it in.
H2|Rewards
R|Give the complete «Deck of Eyes» to Jester RK|Items| RI|«Deck of Eyes Completed» RE
R|Give the complete «Deck of Hands» to Jester RK|Items| RI|«Deck of Hands Completed» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Hey there little person. Have you seen my cards around? I had two decks, but I can't seem to find them. I probably put them down somewhere when I was talking to the lalas."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "It's too bad, I think much more clearly when I can focus on something like my cards or puzzles and games and..."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Hey there little person! Gosh you people are everywhere. I was just talking to one of you."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "If you find a whole deck of cards can you bring it back for me? I promise I won't turn you into a frathock if you do. I might turn you into something else funny though. I can't swear I won't, but definitely not a frathock, which is a big deal since they are my favorite."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Okay bye now."
L|1||Showing a card to Jester⸩ ⸨You allow Jester to examine your Seven of Hands.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Oh goody, you found one. Come back when you have the whole deck."
L|1||Showing Jester's Token to Jester⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Hehe, a token for gambling your cards. What fun! Go see the Gambling Bosses about using this. I made them a deal they couldn't refuse. They're still alive so I guess they agreed. Let me"
L|1||Giving Jester's Token to a Den of Iniquity boss⸩ ⸨You give Monty the Munificent Jester's Token.⸩ ⸨Monty the Munificent tells you, "Very well. You may gamble one card with the High-Stakes Gamesmaster over there."⸩ ⸨Monty the Munificent tells you, "I don't know why I agreed to gamble these cards. That funny fellow was just so persuasive! I agreed before I even asked myself the most important question in gambling. What's my take?"⸩ ⸨You give Aluvian High-Stakes Gamesmaster Seven of Hands.⸩ ⸨The Gamesmaster takes your card and shuffles it into a large deck in front of her. She then fans the deck out in front of you.⸩ ⸨Aluvian High-Stakes Gamesmaster tells you, "Pick a card. Pick any card you like. All selections are final."⸩ ⸨You carefully slip one card out and turn it over to find...⸩ ⸨Aluvian High-Stakes Gamesmaster gives you Two of Hands.⸩ ⸨You give Aluvian High-Stakes Gamesmaster Two of Hands.⸩ ⸨Aluvian High-Stakes Gamesmaster gives you Two of Hands.⸩ ⸨Aluvian High-Stakes Gamesmaster tells you, "The Boss has to get a Jester Token before I will gamble any cards with you."
L|1||Giving a completed deck to Jester⸩ ⸨You give Jester Deck of Eyes.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "A whole deck? You found all thirteen cards?"⸩ ⸨The Jester holds the cards to his ear and flips through them.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Yep, it's all there. Wowwie, You sure do have a lot of time on your hands!"⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "I've already made myself a new deck. Since you went to the trouble of finding it you can have this one. First, let me charge it up."⸩ ⸨The Jester puts the cards between his hands and begins to giggle. Sparks coruscate across his teeth and his eyes roll back into his head.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Now where did I put that spell? Ah, here it is!"⸩ ⸨The deck begins to glow and then brighten in stages.⸩ ⸨The Jester's Eyes reappear and he hands you the glowing deck back.⸩ ⸨Jester gives you Deck of Eyes.⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "There you go all, charged up and ready for fun and games!"⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "You need to give it some time to recharge after you use it. An hour should do it."⸩ ⸨Jester tells you, "Ok, get out of here kid. I have lots and lots of things to do."⸩

Quest.name: Knight_Test
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 | Recommended Level = I|Society Rank|Adept I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Francesca du Orza» («Celestial Hand¦CH») «Luciana du Maki» («Eldrytch Web¦EW») «Viviana Fortiore» («Radiant Blood¦RB») I|Starts At|«Faction Stronghold» (east wing) I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Overview L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You must first hand in a total of 295 «Commendation Ribbon»s to the «Commendations Officer» in your society stronghold, before you can start the quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to Inspector of Knights in your Society's stronghold! L|2|•|⟦OnKnightTest⟧ L|1|2.|Travel to the «Ancient Cloister» dungeon at 82.5S 96.1E on «Ithaenc Island», near the Sanctuary in a keyhole depression. L|1|3.|Going up (never down) you will eventually come to a large room with a surface portal and a «Leatherbound Journal» on the ground. Take the journal. L|1|4.|Return the journal to the Inspector of Knights in your «Faction Stronghold» and then speak to the «Promotions Officer» in the south wing for your rewards. L|2|•|{WARN} The dungeon cannot be reentered after you speak to the NPC for Eldrytch Web and Celestial Hand, so be sure to recover any bodies before speaking (or get a Radiant Blood friend to recover for you).
P|Notes L|1|•|The dungeon has a large number of lore items scattered around the dungeon that can be translated in «Hebian-To» by «Fanzen San the Translator». These are optional and give lore texts: L|2|•|«Aged Falatacot Scroll» L|2|•|«Stained Falatacot Scroll» L|2|•|«Tattered Falatacot Scroll» L|2|•|«Worn Falatacot Scroll» L|2|•|«Wrinkled Falatacot Scroll»

H2|Dialog P|⸨Celestial Hand L|1||Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Francesca du Orza tells you, "So... you are here for your third trial, adept. Welcome, and heed well what I say."⸩ ⸨Francesca du Orza tells you, "By now you should be aware of the existence of the Falatacot, and the two branches from which they spring. One calling themselves Dark, another Light. One dealing in the power of undeath and corruption in service to their Old Ones, and one working to protect what they considered to be worshipful spirits - the Deru Trees. The followers of Adja looked to the Light Falatacot for inspiration."⸩ ⸨Francesca du Orza tells you, "There was a hidden place where some of these Light Falatacot congregated once, long ago. They were known as the Hidden Sisterhood, for they hid from the vengeful attacks of their Dark cousins. In their cloister they recorded much of what it was to live in that ancient world. Eventually, they passed on - but their cloister still remains."⸩ ⸨Francesca du Orza tells you, "Go there now - bring the secrets of the past to me. I have heard it said that there may be, in specific, a leatherbound journal which reveals many secrets of the past."⸩ ⸨Francesca du Orza tells you, "Bring that to me. I can read Falatacot, and can tell you what it says if you show it to me."
L|1||Giving Leatherbound Journal to Francesca du Orza⸩ ⸨You give Francesca du Orza Leatherbound Journal.⸩ ⸨Francesca du Orza tells you, "You have succeeded. Well done, adept... though soon you shall bear a different title, I think."⸩ ⸨Francesca du Orza tells you, "I can tell you what it says, for I have already read it. We return the journal to its location every time an adept brings it to us, as a test of their persistence and skill."⸩ ⸨Francesca du Orza tells you, "It details the existence of a place called Degar'Alesh - a powerful place to the Light Falatacot, for it was a secret place untouched by the darkness. Here it was that their most powerful temple had been built, atop a powerful ley line which sustained them and their servants."⸩ ⸨Francesca du Orza tells you, "I tell you of this place because, now that it has come to light, many would seek to use it for their own ends. The Blighted One has made its appearance there, and slain the Deru Tree that once protected the island. Now we are able to make our way to that place, but beware - so can our rivals from the other factions."⸩ ⸨Francesca du Orza tells you, "Now you know the secret of Degar'Alesh. Now, to continue your service to us, you must go there and fight in the War of the Ancient Powers."⸩ ⸨Francesca du Orza tells you, "There is a place called Freebooter Keep. Go there now, fight for our cause... and win. But first, be sure to go to the Promotions Officer. You have proven yourself worthy of the next rank in our order, and you should ensure that you are given your just reward."
L|1||Promotions Officer⸩ ⸨Promotions Officer tells you, "Congratulations, you have completed the tests of the Knight within our Society. You have proven yourself to our Society many times over."⸩ ⸨Promotions Officer tells you, "Now, it is time to honor you as you deserve. Kneel."⸩ ⸨Promotions Officer tells you, "For honor, bravery, and service to our great Society, I do declare you a Knight of our Society. May your service be long and full of Honor."⸩ ⸨Promotions Officer gives you 10 Celestial Hand Trade Tokens.⸩ ⸨You've earned 680,803,762 experience.⸩ ⸨The Promotions Officer declares in a loud, clear voice, "Let all within the Stronghold know that has achieved the Rank of Knight within our great Society."⸩ ⸨Promotions Officer tells you, "And, as you have not previously achieved this Rank in any Society, I have something extra for you as well."⸩ ⸨Promotions Officer gives you Knight's Treasure Key.

Quest.name: Lady_Mhoire_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|150+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Graveyard» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|«Lady Tairla Mhoire» is a rare spawn boss creature in the «Graveyard» that only appears in the «Time¦nighttime» hours (Gloaming to Dawnsong).
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Keep a look out for the Lady. She spawns in the area of the Graveyard with the rows of bunkers near the temple where you start the «Lord Mhoire Quest». Remember that she only spawns during the «Time¦night» and disappears at Dawnsong. L|1|2.|If you are lucky enough to be around when she spawns immediately summon reinforcements. She is not easy to fight alone and has a great deal of health. L|1|3.|The absolute best way to kill her is for archers to perch on the nearby bunkers and kill with using either a Critical Strike Lightning Bow, or a «Spectral Bow»s with Lightning Arrows (the Ghost SLayer neutralizes the Armor Render at negative AL) («Raider Lightning Arrow»s preferably). Vuln her to Lightning, and Imperil her...she goes to a negative AL. Mages should use their «Spectral Staff» or just heal the archers. Melees should just heal because it is normally too dangerous to jump down into the fray. L|2|•|The Lady's most dangerous attacks are frost attacks including Frost Wave and Glacial Strike. When frost vulned (and you will be vulned thanks all the ghosts around) these spells do tremendous damage. L|1|4.|When the Lady dies an NPC version of the Lady spawns that hands out «Lady Tairla Mhoire's Key». She only has **10** keys to give. After she hands 10 keys the NPC disappears. You do not need to participate in the fight to get a key. After «Lady Tairla Mhoire» is killed, and while her NPC ghost is present, a pile of «Noble Remains» appears in the area and it remains until Dawnsong. L|2|•|Talk to NPC Version: ⟦LadyMhoireRewardWait⟧ L|1|5.|Don't forget to loot her corpse, it generally contains «Ancient Mhoire Coin»s, and sometimes a «House Mhoire Cloak». L|2|•|Cloak Pickup: ⟦MhoireCloakPickUp⟧ L|1|6.|Once you have a key enter the bunker where the «Sealed Vault» is located (64.9S, 44.1W). It is the 2nd bunker on the right when you are facing north. Unlock the Vault and loot the «Ancient Mhoire Coin»s (3 to 5 coins) and the «Lady Tairla's Ancient Emblem of Mhoire» inside. L|1|7.|Take the emblem to a «Arcanum Mana-smith» at one of the «Mana Forge»s for a single use «Mana Forge Key» in return.
H2|Rewards
R|Defeat Lady Tairla Mhoire RK|Items| RI|«Ancient Mhoire Coin»s RI|«House Mhoire Cloak» (rare) RE
R|Speak to the NPC ghost of Lady Tairla Mhoire RK|Title|Lady Tairla's Champion RK|Items| RI|«Lady Tairla Mhoire's Key» RE
R|Loot the Sealed Vault RK|Items| RI|«Ancient Mhoire Coin»s RI|«Lady Tairla's Ancient Emblem of Mhoire» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Lady Tairla Mhoire (Creature)⸩ ⸨Why do you leave the floor so soon? I will not leave the dance!⸩ ⸨Lady Tairla Mhoire cries out, "Awake and attend me, my handmaidens, and join our dance!"
L|1||Lady Tairla Mhoire (NPC)⸩ ⸨Her corrupted form destroyed, the spirit of Lady Tairla appears.⸩ ⸨Lady Tairla says, "I can linger in this place for only a short time. Come speak gentlefolk."⸩ ⸨Lady Tairla Mhoire tells you, "The endless dance of madness caused by this... corruption had ended, at least for a time."⸩ ⸨Lady Tairla Mhoire tells you, "I can not thank those who have given me this peace enough, however brief. Take my key and seek my hidden vault. The treasures there are yours."⸩ ⸨Lady Tairla Mhoire gives you Lady Tairla Mhoire's Key.⸩ ⸨Lady Tairla Mhoire tells you, "I thank you for your grace and bravery."⸩ ⸨Lady Tairla Mhoire bestows to you the title "Lady Tairla's Champion."⸩ ⸨Lady Tairla Mhoire tells you, "I am sorry hero, but I have no more keys to give."⸩

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Behdo Yii⸩ ⸨Behdo Yii tells you, "Hello there stranger! I am wondering if you can help me in a bit of a predicament I find myself in. Quest.name: Lilitha's_Lost_Bow
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Eldrista the Adventurer» I|Starts At|35.7N, 33.4E near «Holtburg» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Eldrista doesn't like mucking about dungeons, so asks you to do the dirty work for her.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|She will ask you to retrieve Lilitha's Bow from the «Hunter's Leap» found nearby at 35.7N, 32.6E. L|1|2.|At the drop, go southeast and jump onto the raised platform. Follow the platform around and jump into the east corridor. L|1|3.|You should come to another raised platform with multiple paths, take the left path heading east. L|1|4.|At the next intersection go straight on through the south passage to a ledge overlooking a ramp below. L|1|5.|Jump off and at the top of the ramp make a left and you'll see another very steep ramp, this time heading down. L|1|6.|At the bottom are some rooms behind the ramp. «Lilitha's Broken Bow» spawns next to a Revitalizing Fountain in the southeast room. L|1|7.|Return it to «Eldrista the Adventurer», who will mend the bow and give you an xp reward. If you do not want the bow you can give it to her for some small additional xp. L|2|•|⟦LilithasBowGiven⟧

Well, just west of here is a dungeon called Hunter's Leap. You'll find it around 35.7N, 32.6E. Legend has it that the great hunter Lilitha lived there when she was younger, while she practiced her skills."⸩ ⸨Eldrista the Adventurer tells you, "I never met her myself, but I have a lot of respect for someone with that kind of spirit. But it's still better than what most of these so-called archers can make today."⸩ ⸨Eldrista the Adventurer tells you, "I made my living for a long time by collecting the arrows she left behind and selling them. If not, you must obtain one of three keys depending on your faction (see below): L|2|•|«Celestial Hand» - Find the «Skith'Kirit's Key» on the floor in the **East Wing** (first room you pass), head back to the start and head **North** until you reach «Skith'Kirit». Kill him and loot «Skith'Kirit's Severed Head» from his corpse. L|2|•|«Eldrytch Web» - Find the «Armory Key» on the floor in the **West Wing** (first room you pass), head back to the start and head **East** until you reach «Tikchti». Kill him and loot the «Titanic Dericost Mnemosyne» from his corpse. L|2|•|«Radiant Blood» - Find the «Vault Key» on the floor in the **North Wing** (first room you pass), head back to the start and head **West** until you reach «Kathirik». Kill him, he respawns every four minutes, and loot the «Ancient Falatacot Tome of Light» from his corpse. L|1|4.|Return to your «Faction Stronghold» and hand the trophy item to your «Inspector of Masters» to complete the test.

Wiki.page: Necklace of the Golden Flame Quest

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|150+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Targor's Cave» at 68.4N, 66.6E I|Route|«Rithwic» to «Isparian Flame Estates» portal at 8.7N, 60.9E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|From the entrance, head down the ramp, go straight through the 4-way intersection and then take a right at the wishbone split. L|1|2.|Work your way through the dungeon until you reach a large room with «Archon Merille» in it. L|1|3.|{OPT} Kill «Archon Merille» and loot the «High Archon Kraest's Instructions» from her corpse. L|1|4.|Continue past the room and take a right at the next split. L|2|•|**Note:** From here the dungeon becomes rather symmetrical, continue heading North. L|1|5.|Work your way until you reach a locked Outer Locked Gate (600 Diff), where you'll find a shadow named «Dealith». Kill him and loot the «Outer Locked Gate Key». L|2|•|{OPT} «Dealith» also drops the untranslated text, «Sticky Lump». L|1|6.|Use the key to open the gate, and continue until you reach another locked gate. This time you must kill «Faurset» and loot the «Middle Locked Gate Key» from his corpse. L|1|7.|Again, use the key to open the gate and continue until you reach another locked gate. This time you must kill «Liantor» and loot the «Inner Locked Gate Key» from his corpse. L|1|8.|Now, work your way through a series of Mukkir until you reach a dead end room. Clear it out and wait just a moment for «Targor», the boss, to spawn. L|1|9.|Kill «Targor» and loot a «Frozen Black Crystal» from its corpse. L|2|•|⟦FrozenBlackCrystal_Pickup⟧ L|1|10.|Return the «Frozen Black Crystal» to «Riordin Nightbane» in «Wai Jhou» for XP and the «Necklace of the Golden Flame».

If you wish to try to retrieve one of these crystals for us, I have heard that they can be found on a Mukkir named Targor. Targor seems to be a part of an ongoing conflict between the Raven Hand and a group of Shadows up around 68.4N, 66.6E."
L|1||Handing in Frozen Black Crystal⸩ ⸨You give Riordin Nightbane Frozen Black Crystal.⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "Ahh, a frozen crystal shard. The mages in the Order have had some luck with figuring out what this was. It seems that this is a fragment of some sort of Totem, similar to the Ice Totems built by the Ruschk."⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "We haven't been able to reconstruct the totem yet, as the pieces are small and badly damaged, but we are hoping to collect enough pieces to reconstruct at least one complete totem."⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "It is our hope to use this totem to learn more about the Mukkir, and possibly make a weapon against them."⸩ ⸨Riordin Nightbane tells you, "It was a great risk and noble act that you undertook in acquiring this crystal and bringing it here. Quest.name: Oubliette_of_Mhoire_Castle_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|125 I|Rec. Level|200 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Shade of Terelev» I|Starts At|«Mhoire Castle» I|Route|«Graveyard» at 64.6S, 44.1W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Mhoire Oubliette» H2|Overview L|1|•|A key element to this quest is not aggrevating the «Blinded Apparition»s to attack. They respawn very quickly and hit for high cold damage. Using a good shield, a melee defense rare, or a frost protection rare are all good strategies if an apparition comes after you. L|1|•|It is possible to solo this quest without rares if you can avoid aggrevating the apparitions. L|1|•|The Oubliette is a gauntlet of dungeons, with each one connecting to the next. Some of these require characters to collect items to proceed. It may be restricting to bring a large group as you will have to wait for respawns to get enough items.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You must have completed the «Guardians of Mhoire Castle» and «Castle of Lord Mhoire Quest»s.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Enter the the northeast tower of «Mhoire Castle» and speak to the «Shade of Terelev». L|2|•|⟦StartedOublietteBoss_0112⟧ L|1|2.|Enter the «Mhoire Castle Great Hall» portal, run down past the Ancient Throne and through the southeast door. L|1|3.|Find your way to the portal to the «Oubliette of Mhoire Castle». It is located on the path which leads to the «Legendary Chest¦legendary armor chests», which is the northern middle room on the map. L|2|•|Note: The Oubliette dungeons are not loggable. You will end up at the lifestone if you logout. L|1|4.|Collect 10 «Mhoire Oubliette Portal Glyph»s by killing any monsters inside the dungeon. Some enemies drop more than 1 per kill. L|2|•|Note: You will need more of these glyphs later in the quest, but the portal will take all of them in your inventory when portaling, so you cannot stock up. L|2|•|{OPT} While collecting glyphs, you can also collect 20 «Red Veined Grub»s for the «Red Veined Grub Collection Task» (side quest). L|1|5.|Once you have 10 glyphs, work your way through the dungeon until you find the Deeper into the Oubliette portal. L|2|•|Note: If you do not have 10 glyphs in your possession, you will not be able to use the portal. L|1|6.|The next dungeon has no enemies, only lightning traps. Run through the dungeon, evading the random Incantation of Lightning Bolts shooting toward you from the walls, until you find the Deeper into the Oubliette portal. L|2|•|{OPT} Wear a weapon or shield with an aegis affect to absorb the damage if you get hit. L|2|•|Note: Getting hit is not an instant death as long as you are not lightning vulned. Be sure to dispel vulns before attempting. L|1|7.|In the next stage, you will once again need to collect 10 «Mhoire Oubliette Portal Glyph»s by killing any monsters inside the dungeon. L|1|8.|Once you have all 10, continue once again, to the Deeper into the Oubliette portal. L|1|9.|In the next section there more enemies, but you do not have to collect glyphs to move to the next section. Make your way to the next portal and take it. L|2|•|Note: Beware of the «Blinded Apparition»s, they are hollow and can kill you easily. If you don't run into them, they will not attack. The apparitions first appear in this section. L|1|10.|In next dungeon, you must again collect 10 «Mhoire Oubliette Portal Glyph»s by killing any monsters inside the dungeon and use the portal to get to the next stage. L|1|11.|In the next stage, you will find a maze of hallways, including a series of jumps going both up and down. It's mostly linear, so follow it through until you reach another portal. L|2|•|**Lockpick Bonus:** There is a «Chorizite Chest» along the way in this section. L|3|•|⟦chestchorizite48767⟧ L|2|•|Note: When jumping up, use a full shift jump. L|1|12.|In the final stage, work your way through a mostly linear dungeon, with jumps going both up and down until you reach a large room where the boss, «Hovoros the Shadowed» resides. He is there along with several «Wight Blade Sorcerer»s and «Blinded Apparition»s who walk around the room. L|1|13.|Kill Hovoros and loot a «Corrupted Spectral Page» from his corpse (drops 8). He respawns fairly quickly, so don't waste any time. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpTokenOublietteBoss_0112⟧ L|2|•|Note: Hovoros will occasionally drop a «Blackened House Mhoire Cloak» (rare drop). L|1|14.|Return to the Northeast tower of «Mhoire Castle» and speak to the «Shade of Terelev» for your reward. L|2|•|Note: There is currently no exit portal from the Oubliette, so you must recall back to Graveyard and then return to Mhoire Castle from there for rewards. L|1|15.|Head back into the Mhoire Castle Great Hall and proceed beyond the throne room again to the treasure rooms with «Legendary Chest»s. Note that the chests are divided by type into 3 separate rooms.
P|Tips L|1|•|The «Blinded Apparition»s only aggro when provoked in this dungeon. So the key element during the boss fight is to avoid them. L|1|•|It is advised not to use weapons or items that proc with ring spells (i.e. «Replica BloodScorch» and/or «Great BloodScorch»), as they will agro the apparitions. L|1|•|If you accidentally make the apparitions go agro and you are alone you can run back to the last jump, leap up one level and wait on the ledge until they ignore you and then you can try again. L|1|•|Killing apparitions is redundant as they respawn rather quickly. If you do decide to kill apparitions, a good shield prevents a lot of damage. L|1|•|The Wight Blade Sorcerers respawn fairly quickly during the fight. It is worth clearing them, but they do not stay gone for too long. L|1|•|Horvoros uses «Void Magic», so be ready for bleed damage and void blasts. L|1|•|If you have a high «Summoning» skill, you can send high level summons into the final room to fight for you. This can help to avoid aggrevating the apparitions.

L|1|•|Sometimes you will find a corpse of the «Pumpkin Follower» near Pumpkin Lords and Kin on the landscape of Osteth. L|1|6.|From the pit, head west through the hall into a large room. Use the book shelf again to enter the hall to the south. The book case on the right has another shard. L|1|7.|Continue through the 1st large room to the a large rectangular room with lightning shooting through it. Quest.Wiki:
