H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|First you must talk to «Ayesha of the Radiant Blood» in «Zaikhal», before you go. L|2|•|⟦CanPickupCorruptedManaShard⟧ - shared with all Initiation Quests L|1|2.|Get «Corrupted Mana Shard» L|2|•|Leaftide Experience L|3|1.|Go to Sub > AC Storage and use the pedestal. L|2|•|Retail Experience L|3|1.|Head to the «Corrupted Catacombs» at 23.9S, 54.1E near «Sawato». If you will be taking a group, you can tie to «Empyrean Foundry» at 25.1S 54.1E to make a much shorter run. L|3|2.|The place is somewhat of a maze so you might have to backtrack. Run through the dungeon (look for down ramps) until you find a «Slimy Key» on the ground in a room with pillars. The route from the drop is straight at first intersection, right on next, then left. Keep right hand rule until a ramp down into a room with pillars, and go left (South) here and more ramps down. Next intersection go right, and on the floor is the key. Keep right hand rule until a ramp down into a room with pillars, and go straight (West) here into the sclavus part. From there, go right at next intersection and down, once you find the portal in a pillar room, go straight (West) and there is the door. Quest.name: Ranger_Lord_Mhoire
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|150+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|The «Burning Wood» in the «Graveyard» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|The «Corrupted Pyre Oak» is a rare spawn boss creature found in the «Burning Wood» section of the Graveyard that only appears in the nighttime hours (Gloaming to Dawnsong).
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Keep a look out for the «Corrupted Pyre Oak». It spawns in the «Burning Wood» area of the Graveyard, the valley to the southwest. It is found right near the edge of the Graveyard around 66.5S, 44.8W. Remember that it only spawns during the night and disappears at Dawnsong. L|1|2.|If you are lucky enough to be around when he spawns immediately summon reinforcements. It is not easy to fight alone and has a great deal of health. L|2|•|The golem spawns with a number of «Corrupted Pyre Spark»s that cast level 8 Fire Vulns so it is best to avoid them completely. It also has many of the normal spawns of Pyre Skeletons near it. L|1|3.|The absolute best way to kill it is for archers kill it from afar with using Spectral Bows with Lightning Arrows (Raider Lightning Arrows preferably). Archers should be able to find a spot outside the agro range of the creatures (Sparks and Skeletons) where they can fire on the golem. The Sparks will not defend the golem. Mages should just support the archers and debuff the golem. Melees should also just heal because it is normally too dangerous to jump down into the fray. L|2|•|The Pyre Oak's most dangerous attacks are fire attacks including Flame Wave and Fire Bomb. When fire vulned these spells do tremendous damage and can even one shot you. L|1|4.|When the Pyre Oak dies an NPC, «Ranger Lord Grymar Mhoire», spawns that hands out «Lord Grymar Mhoire's Key». L|2|•|⟦LordGrymarRewardWait⟧ L|1|5.|Once you have a key go to the «Burnt and Twisted Stump» located just behind the bunker near where the Golem and NPC were at 66.3S, 44.8W. L|1|6.|Unlock the Stump and loot your rewards.
P|Notes L|1|•|When the Corrupted Pyre Oak has spawned, a «Corrupted Frost Grave» will appear in the main section of the Graveyard notifying you that the golem is up. L|1|•|Ranger Lord Mhoire only gives out a maximum of 10 keys, after which he disappears. L|1|•|You do not need to participate in the fight to get a key. L|1|•|After the NPC disppears a pile of «Noble Remains» appears where he was and it remains until Dawnsong. L|1|•|The Pyre Oak drops a treasure pile when it dies that has a good chance of having a «Jester Card» or «Ancient Mhoire Coin» on it.
H2|Rewards
R|Speak to «Ranger Lord Grymar Mhoire» and loot «Burnt and Twisted Stump» RK|Title|Warden of the Burning Wood RK|Items| RI|«Lord Grymar's Ancient Emblem of Mhoire» (Give to «Arcanum Mana-smith» for a MFK. RI|«Ancient Mhoire Coin»s (x3-5) RE
H2|Dialog H3|Ranger Lord Grymar Mhoire L|1||His corrupted forest form destroyed, the spirit of Lord Grymar appears. L|1||Lord Grymar says, "I can linger in this wood for only a short time. Come speak gentlefolk."
L|1||Ranger Lord Grymar Mhoire tells you, "The corruption of my spirit binds me to these trees. I can feel the burning of the wood as if it was my own flesh." L|1||Ranger Lord Grymar Mhoire tells you, "You have my thanks for becoming watchers of this wood, however burnt. Take my key and seek my hidden vault. The treasures there are yours." L|1||Ranger Lord Grymar Mhoire gives you Lord Grymar Mhoire's Key L|1||Ranger Lord Grymar Mhoire tells you, "I thank you for your skill and bravery." L|1||Ranger Lord Grymar Mhoire bestows to you the title "Warden of the Burning Wood."
H3|Giving Lord Grymar's Ancient Emblem of Mhoire to Arcanum Mana-smith L|1||You allow Arcanum Mana-smith to examine your Lord Grymar's Ancient Emblem of Mhoire. L|1||You hand over 1 of your Lord Grymar's Ancient Emblem of Mhoires. L|1||Arcanum Mana-smith tells you, "Here's an interesting bit of information for you. Mhoire had his family's emblems infused with a small bit of mana - enough that I can use it in the forges successfully. I'll give you a key - one of the special keys, not my normal keys - in thanks." L|1||Arcanum Mana-smith gives you Mana Forge Key.

Quest.name: Renegade_Living_Weapons
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|120 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Renegade Fortress (120+)¦Renegade Fortress» at 29.5S 65.6W I|Route|«Mansion» to «Lesser Direlands Device» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to upgrade one of «Palenqual's Living Weapons».
L|1|•|If you plan to solo this, and run through, a tinked up cov shield might come in handy because of all the rocks flying.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Enter the «Renegade Fortress (120+)» at 29.5S 65.6W. The portal is in the basement of the Lugian style building to the right. L|1|2.|Run through the dungeon until you see a «Renegade Elite Trooper», a very tall tumerok with 4,800 hp. Kill him and loot the «Vault Key (Renegade Fortress)¦Vault Key». L|2|1.|From drop, go up the stairs, in the first large room, take E exit. L|2|2.|Follow the corridor, in the next larger room, cross over to the opposite side into a hallway. L|2|3.|Go up a ramp, over a bridge, next a ridge over the larger room. Follow that ridge until you can go East into the next hallway. L|2|4.|Up another ramp, and in the next larger room, the «Renegade Elite Trooper» can be found. L|3|•|⟦RenegadeVaultKey_Pickup⟧ L|1|3.|Portal recall and find the «Tumerok Vault» which is in a room in a dead end hallway. L|2|1.|From drop, go up the stairs, in the first large room, take the S exit. L|2|2.|Follow the corridor into a dead end hallway with enforced doors on both sides. L|2|3.|The second room on the left holds the Vault. L|1|4.|Unlock the Tumerok Vault with the Vault Key and loot the «Ritual Spear». L|1|5.|Run back up through the dungeon past where you found the Elite Trooper till you come to a big open room with a surface portal. In that room behind a door is the «Living Vault». L|2|1.|After the Elite Trooper, you will have to go through a series of large rooms and up large ramps. Some ramps it is safe to hide behind until the spawn quiets down. L|2|2.|Through another corridor and a few doors. L|2|3.|Next there will be another corridor with side rooms and enforced doors. L|2|4.|The last doors on left and right will lead to the large room. L|2|5.|On top of a plateau is the exit portal. Under the plateau is the «Living Vault». L|2|6.|The Vault is behind a door, access the room from the left side, otherwise you are looking at the back of the Vault. You might want to close the door behind you to be able to open the vault without being hammered on. L|1|6.|Open it with the Ritual Spear and loot the «Nutrient Oil Soaked Totem». L|1|7.|Apply the Oil Soaked Totem to any of the Living Weapons to upgrade them to Renegade Weapons.

Quest.name: Rusted_Knife_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|1-20 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Nurbaha bint Dah» I|Starts At|31.3S, 10.8E in «West Al-Arqas Outpost» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Nurbaha bint Dah is looking for her mother's knives. Travel to the Unfinished Temple to retrieve one.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to «Nurbaha bint Dah» at 31.3S, 10.8E in «West Al-Arqas Outpost». L|1|2.|She will send you to the «Unfinished Temple» at 30.1S 9.1E to retrieve the «Rusted Knife». L|1|3.|From the drop go West until you pass through your first door, from here go South. L|1|4.|When you get to a fork with ramps going down, take the West ramp. You will go through another door and into a room with a chest in it. L|1|5.|Loot the «Rusted Knife» from the chest, and bring it back to «Nurbaha bint Dah» for your reward. L|2|•|⟦KnifeDahQuest⟧ L|1|6.|You will receive a «Hasty Note (Al-Arqas)¦Hasty Note». Previously, this note could be brought to «Jilsaya bint Dah» in Al-Arqas to begin the «Abandoned Shops Quest». Now, Jilsaya bint Dah does not accept this item.
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Unfinished Temple» 30.1S 9.1E -- «map:015B¦015B» TE
H2|Rewards
R|Give Rusted Knife to Nurbaha bint Dah RK|Experience|4,500 (Fixed% up to level Fixed) RK|Items| RI|«Hasty Note (Al-Arqas)» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Nurbaha bint Dah tells you, "Long ago, on the way to Al-Arqas, my mother and I came upon a ruin and camped there. At night, monsters came upon us, and after holding them off for a while, we fled."⸩ ⸨Nurbaha bint Dah tells you, "We left behind my mother's collection of knives, among the first she ever forged. They are not worth very much, but I will help you if you get one for me."⸩ ⸨Nurbaha bint Dah tells you, "The Unfinished Temple is to the northwest of here. We fled pretty far into the ruins before we realized we had to leave. I think we were at least two levels down when we lost the knives. Last I was there, I found only one knife."
L|1||Handing in the Rusted Knife⸩ ⸨You give Nurbaha bint Dah Rusted Knife.⸩ ⸨Nurbaha bint Dah tells you, "That is definitely one of my mother's knives! Thank you."⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨Nurbaha bint Dah gives you Hasty Note.⸩ ⸨Nurbaha bint Dah tells you, "Here is a letter to take to my sister Jilsaya in Al-Arqas. She has a task for you."⸩

Quest.name: Sanguinary_Aegis_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|77.0S, 64.4E I|Route|«Mayoi» to «Lugian Meadows Settlement» at 60.8S, 80.3E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview H2|Walkthrough & Notes
H3|Part 1: Lugian Excavation L|1|1.|{OPT} From «Rithwic», enter «Martine's Retreat» at 10.6N 58.3E, then run down the ramp and speak with «Leandra» to begin the quest. L|1|2.|Enter the «Lugian Excavations», located at 77.0S, 64.4E. L|1|3.|From the drop, hug the wall left until you reach a «Deposit of High-Grade Chorizite Ore» (rock pile). L|1|4.|Kill the nearby «Extas Raider»s, and loot their corpses until you find a «Lugian Pick Axe». L|2|•|Note: Be careful, these lugians are hollow! L|1|5.|Use the «Lugian Pick Axe» on the «Deposit of High-Grade Chorizite Ore» to obtain a «Chunk of High-Grade Chorizite». L|1|6.|Once you've mined the ore, hand it to «Feruza ibn Salaq» in the «Beach Fort» at 76.0N, 49.1W. He'll return some «Refined High-Grade Chorizite». L|2|•|Route: From «Mayoi», take the «Lady Maila Estates» portal at 60.9S, 80.3E. L|2|•|⟦ChoriziteC⟧ L|1|7.|Return to «Leandra» at «Martine's Retreat» and hand her the «Refined High-Grade Chorizite». You'll receive a «Chorizite Formula» and «Notes of Chorizite Distillation».
H3|Part 2: Abandoned Armory L|1|1.|Enter the «Abandoned Armory», located at 83.6S, 14.7W. L|2|•|Route: Take a Mansion «Lesser Direlands Device» portal and run to the «Abandoned Armory», located at 83.6S, 14.7W L|2|•|Route: From «Qalaba'r», take the «Land Bridge Villas» portal at 74.8S, 17.8E. L|1|2.|From the drop, head North, then take the West (left) ramp down. L|2|•|Note: This dungeon is symmetrical and either direction works, but for this walk through we assume starting from the left. L|1|3.|When you enter the next large room, run into the little room in the center and hit the floor plate, which opens the doors to the North and South. L|1|4.|Take the door to the North and go left at the split. In the next large room, repeat the same floor plate procedure, but this time exit the door to the West. L|1|5.|Again, continue until you reach another large room. Repeat the floor plate procedure and then take the door to the South. L|1|6.|Now take your first right (South), and head down the ramp until you reach a large room, where at the back of the room, you'll see several «Deteriorated Aegis» sitting on pedestals. L|1|7.|Pick up any color of «Deteriorated Aegis» you like (they are all the same), and use your «Chorizite Formula» on it to create a «Sanguinary Aegis». L|2|•|⟦DeterioratedAegisPickup⟧

H2|Rewards H3|Items L|1|•|«Sanguinary Aegis»
H2|Dialog H3|Leandra L|1||Leandra tells you, "Ah, a visitor! It is so nice to see a new face around here, especially now that my spirits have been lifted. I must tell you of my newest findings." L|1||Leandra tells you, "I have been working on a distillation process that transforms chorizite ore into a viscous formula capable of absorbing magical damage." L|1||Leandra tells you, "If you have the inclination, bring me a small amount of the highest quality refined chorizite available, and I will reward you with one application of the formula, and my notes."
H3|Handing in Chunk of High-Grade Chorizite to Feruza ibn Salaq L|1||You give Feruza ibn Salaq Chunk of High-Grade Chorizite. L|1||Feruza ibn Salaq tells you, "This is the very purest grade of chorizite. You must be formidable to have survived in the mines of the Lugians. I don't know of any smiths with a forge hot enough to shape it, though." L|1||Feruza ibn Salaq gives you Refined High-Grade Chorizite.
H3|Handing in Refined High-Grade Chorizite to Leandra L|1||You give Leandra Refined High-Grade Chorizite. L|1||Leandra tells you, "One moment please. The success of choritize distillation relies on steady hands and a clear mind." L|1||Leandra gives you Chorizite Formula. L|1||Leandra gives you Notes on Chorizite Distillation. L|1||Leandra tells you, "All done, here is one flask of chorizite formula, as promised, and a copy of my notes." L|1||Leandra tells you, "Be sure to read the notes I gave you - and remember, the formula is new and largely untested. More research will be needed to fully understand its properties."

Quest.name: Shendolain_Vestibule_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|60 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Shendolain Vestibule» at 53.8S, 59.6W I|Route|53.8S 59.6W I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to destroy a replica of the powerful «Shendolain Soul Crystal¦Soul Crystal» that was once found in the Shendolain Chamber.
P|**Leaftide Shortcut:** There is a portal directly to the final dungeon in AC Storage.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes P|**Notes**: L|1|•|It is strongly recommended to have at least one other player to operate the levers at the top of the dungeon, which open doors throughout the way down to the bottom. The doors only stay open for 60 seconds. L|1|•|Lockpick is required inside the «Shendolain Chamber». L|1|•|Each player that wants a reward must have a «Shendolain Key». These keys are not attuned/bonded so anyone can obtain them ahead of time and distribute them to the group. L|1|•|There are two entrances to the Shendolain Vestibule. One is on the Obsidian Plains, and the other is on the southwestern shores of the Inner Sea. The Obsidian Plains entrance will be more difficult to reach but a quick route, while the Inner Sea entrance will be less difficult to reach but take longer.
H3|Part 1: Preparation & Reaching the Dungeon L|1|1.|Obtain enough «Shendolain Key»s for everyone that wants to complete the quest. L|2|•|Dropped by: «Bane Grievver»s, «Blighted Bane Grievver»s, «Destroyer Grievver»s, «Harrower Grievver»s, «Rufous Grievver»s, and «Venomous Grievver»s. L|2|•|Good farming location: «Cave of the Escaped Thief». L|1|2.|Head to the «Shendolain Vestibule». There are two entrances to the dungeon. The original entrance is at 53.8S, 59.6W on the «Obsidian Plains». The secondary entrance is at 61.3S, 39.5W on the southwestern shores of the «Inner Sea». L|2|•|**Route to original location**: «Danby's Outpost» to «Desert March» at 22.6N, 28.8W. Take the «Black Hill» portal inside. From the destination, run to the vestibule. L|2|•|**Route to duplicate location**: «Facility Hub» to «Folthid Estate», run east-southeast to «Imuth Maer Doquin» at 11.6S, 57.9E. From there, take the shortcut portal to «Halls of Metos (Wai Jhou)». Take the surface portal then head northwest, staying on the current plateau level. Turn north, then northeast. When you reach the point of the plateau (approx. 58.4S, 43.8W) you can either keep hugging the wall of the upper level, or you can jump down to the shoreline. If you want to avoid jumping down, there is a hill where you can descend at 61.0S, 43.5W. Either way, once you are on the shore, hug the coast and head generally southeast until you reach the dungeon entrance. L|2|•|**Tip**: If leading for a larger group, one character can tie to the surface portal of the «Shendolain Vestibule», then summon it for the group.
H3|Part 2: Shendolain Vestibule L|1|1.|Once inside, make your way to the lever room. From the drop, head forward (south), then turn right (west). Follow this hall down a ramp, accross a bridge, around a bend, and down another ramp. When you reach a split, continue forward (south). The dungeon is symmetrical, so you will head up a ramp, around a bend, across a bridge, and up another ramp. When you reach the top of the ramp, turn right (south) to reach the lever room. L|1|2.|Split the party into two groups: One group to make their way to the «Shendolain Gate», the other group to operate the levers. The lever room and adjoining hallway have undead/skeleton spawns, so the person/people left behind to use the levers must be capable in combat. L|1|3.|Proceed down into the dungeon. Refer to the map for one possible route down. L|2|•|**Note**: At each set of doors, one of the doors will not have a corresponding lever in the lever room. On the map, these doors are: D4, D5, D10, and D- (D15). L|1|4.|When you reach the bottom, use the «Shendolain Key» on the «Shendolain Gate» to receive a «Shendolain Portal Gem». This is a teleporting gem, not a portal summoning gem, so each player will need one.
P|If the lever operator(s) want a reward as well, you will need to swap positions and repeat this part for them.
H3|Part 3: Shendolain Chamber L|1|1.|Use your «Shendolain Portal Gem» to be teleported into the «Shendolain Chamber». This dungeon is also fairly symmetrical, with multiple paths leading to the end. L|1|2.|From the drop, jump into the pit. L|1|3.|Enter the hallway to the north, then take a left (west), an immediate right (north), and once down the ramp head forward (east). A short ways down the hall you will reach a locked door (resistance: 322). Pick the door and pull both levers. L|1|4.|Exit the lever room at to the north, where you entered. Make your way back up the hall. At the split you previously ignored, turn left (south). L|1|5.|{OPT} You will run into «Elleina of Berkesh». You can choose to kill her and loot the «Petulantly Written Note» (1 drops). There is no reward for this untranslated lore text. L|1|6.|At the intersection with Elleina, immediately turn right (west) at the next split, go forward (west) then immediately turn right (north). Follow this down and around and you will reach the one of the doors activated by the levers you pulled. L|1|7.|Proceed through the door. At the split, go forward (south). There is a Mana Blight trap at the bend before the ramp. Jump over to avoid or be prepared to recover your mana. Head down the ramp and you will reach the chamber of the «Shendolain Crystal». L|1|8.|Kill the Shendolain Crystal and loot the «Shendolain Gem». It drops 5 crystals in total. L|2|•|⟦ShendolainCrystal⟧
H3|Part 4: Rewards L|1|1.|Head to «Al-Arqas». The reward NPCs are found on the upper balcony of the jeweler's shop «House of Treasure». L|1|2.|Hand the crystal to the NPC that corresponds to the reward you want: L|2|•|Give the crystal to «Gerloc the Defender» to receive the «Shendolain Crystal Shield». L|2|•|Give the crystal to «Gervena the Oblique» to receive the «Shendolain Crystal Orb». L|2|•|Give the crystal to «Gersan the Sureshot» to receive the «Shendolain Crystal Bow». L|1|3.|If you want a crossbow instead, obtain a «Crossbow Stock» from «Barnar the Tinker» and attach it to the bow to create the «Shendolain Crystal Crossbow». L|1|4.|If you want an atlatl instead, give the bow back to «Gersan the Sureshot» «Shendolain Crystal Atlatl».

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog, Gerloc⸩ ⸨Gerloc the Defender tells you, "Greetings. My siblings and I traveled here seeking gems of great power. I hear that there are some master armorers who craft suits of armor from fused gems. Those are beneath my notice. Bring me something even more powerful than a scintillating gem, and I will craft a great and unique shield for you. If you have one of my old shields, I will improve it for you."
L|1||Opening Dialog, Gersan⸩ ⸨Gersan the Sureshot tells you, "If you can find a gem more powerful than a mere scintillating gem, I would be interested in it. Give me such a gem and I will use it to craft a magical bow for you. The bow will be so powerful, in fact, that normal ammunition will not work on it. You will have to come to me for arrowheads as well. If you have one my old missile weapons, I will improve it for you."⸩ ⸨Gersan the Sureshot tells you, "I am not a crossbow maker, however, so if you need a crossbow you will have to attach a stock to the bow yourself."
L|1||Opening Dialog, Gervena⸩ ⸨Gervena the Oblique tells you, "I have heard of powerful gems, more powerful than the mediocre gems you bring to those so-called master smiths. If I had such a gem, I could make a powerful spell-casting orb with unique properties."⸩ ⸨Gervena the Oblique tells you, "Of course, if you are not a masterful mage, you should speak with one of my younger brothers. If you have one of my old orbs, I will improve it for you."
L|1||Using the Shendolain Key on the Shendolain Gate⸩ ⸨You now have a gem that will send you to the Shendolain Chamber.
L|1||Handing in Shendolain Gem⸩ ⸨You give Gerloc the Defender Shendolain Gem⸩ ⸨Gerloc the Defender tells you, "Most impressive. This gem allows me to craft a shield of exceptional power. Wear it proudly in battle. But all worthy things are rare... So take care not to lose this shield!⸩ ⸨Gerloc the Defender gives you Shendolain Crystal Shield⸩ ⸨You've earned 10,000,000 experience⸩ ⸨Gerloc the Defender tells you, "I've also taken the liberty of granting you some practical knowledge...⸩ ⸨You give Gersan the Sureshot Shendolain Gem⸩ ⸨Gersan the Sureshot tells you, "A wondrous gem, a miracle of rare device! Here is a bow, equally rare and precious and irreplaceable. The bow will only fire crystal-tipped ammunition, so bring me crystal shards and I will make arrowheads for you.⸩ ⸨Gersan the Sureshot tells you, "If you need a crossbow, you must find a way to fit a stock yourself. If you need an atlatl, give me back the bow and I'll see what I can do.⸩ ⸨Gersan the Sureshot gives you Shendolain Crystal Bow⸩ ⸨Gersan the Sureshot tells you, "I've also taken the liberty of granting you some practical knowledge...⸩ ⸨You've earned 10,000,000 experience⸩ ⸨You give Gervena the Oblique Shendolain Gem.⸩ ⸨Gervena the Oblique tells you, "As powerful an orb as I have ever seen, with one exception... Here is an orb of equal power and rarity. Remember, if you lose this orb, I will not be able to replace it for you!"⸩ ⸨Gervena the Oblique gives you Shendolain Crystal Orb.⸩ ⸨You've earned 10,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Gervena the Oblique tells you, "I've also taken the liberty of granting you some practical knowledge..."⸩

I have tried to explain to them that you are the one doing all the killing, but they don't seem to understand that. Now they expect me to go kill off a nest of Olthoi supersoldiers! We call them Olthoi Legionaries, and they are quite terrifying, from what I am given to understand. Well, not so terrifying to one such as you, eh? They have taken over an ancient Empyrean grotto, kill them, return a pincer as proof to me, and I shall shower you with riches."⸩

Quest.name: Stone_Tool_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Artifex Vault» at 26.5N, 45.8W I|Route|«Samsur» to «Dovetail Valley Villas» portal at 0.8S, 18.9E to Artifex Vault (duplicate portal) at 24.5N, 8.1E I|Repeat|1 Hour H2|Overview P|Quest to retrieve the «Stone Tool» from the Artifex Vault. The tool is used to remove «Atlan Stone»s from «Atlan Weapons» and «Shadow Armor».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|From the drop, run down to the bottom of the slope to some Tumeroks and paths down. L|1|2.|Take either of the paths and then take the corridor west. L|1|3.|Follow the corridor around and then take the ramp down. Ignore the lever activated doors to your left instead run west through the hall of crystals. L|1|4.|At the end is a room with another level activated door and a lever which opens the doors doors back to the east. L|1|5.|Pull the level and run back through the hall and pull the lever that is now accessible - run back to the previous doors. L|1|6.|Continue on, ignore the first crossway instead going to the section ahead with the barrels. Notice the lever activated door a little to the west. L|1|7.|From the barrels take a right going east. L|1|8.|Take the first right into another room with blue crystals. Run to the doors at the end of the room and pull the lever. L|2|•|{OPT} Alternatively, if you have the lockpick skill, go east at the first crossway and unlock the door (resistance: 402) to access the next lever. L|1|9.|Now run back to where the barrels are and go through the now open doors into another room of crystals. L|1|10.|Run to end and jump down into the pit. Follow the corridor along to an large open chamber with huge barrel like platforms. L|1|11.|Jump across the barrels to the east, taking extra care on the last platform (If you fall into the pit below a surface portal is the only exit). L|1|12.|Go east and you will come to a long mist filled pit with platforms on all sides. If you don't have the health or skill for the fall, carefully jump to each platform until you reach the bottom. L|1|13.|At the bottom use the button on the west wall to open the metal doors to the final hallway. L|1|14.|This next section has many side rooms each filled with blue crystals and «Tumerok Trooper»s. Run to the end ignoring the side rooms. L|1|15.|At the end of the hallway go south through two sets of metal doors until you come to a lever room. The pressure points on the floor here open doors releasing more Tumeroks from above. L|1|16.|Pull the lever in the northeast corner and run back to the hallway taking the middle south corridor - pull the final lever. L|1|17.|Run back to the lever room and through the doors with the portal. Just infront of the portal lies the «Stone Tool» and two texts: «Textbook (Atlan's Treatise)» and «Textbook (A Journal)». L|2|•|⟦stonetool⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Ambrosia Roe tells you, "Things have begun to quiet down thankfully. But there are stirrings from the deeper areas of the Retreat. Hibdin knows more about it than I do. I'm content simply watching for now. I'm just glad that I am free of Gaerlan's mind control."
L|1||Hibdin Velos⸩ ⸨Hibdin Velos tells you, "Hello friend. We've fallen on some hard times here in Martine's Retreat. With Martine being gone for so long, we can only surmise that he is indeed dead. But that is the least of our problems."⸩ ⸨Hibdin Velos tells you, "About two weeks ago Remmick, our head farmer, came up from the subterranean farm and said that it was madness down there. It seems that a farm hand named Harker had become... touched."⸩ ⸨Hibdin Velos tells you, "If you wouldn't mind helping us out with getting some of the food and maybe killing Harker, we'd be in your debt. I'd pay you handsomely."⸩ ⸨Hibdin Velos tells you, "Before you go, you might want to speak to Remmick. He might have some pointers for you."
L|1||Remmick⸩ ⸨Remmick tells you, "Everything is falling apart. I can't get crops anymore, and without those crops then everyone here will starve, or be forced to move back to the surface. But most don't want that. They'd rather live out their lives here.⸩ ⸨Remmick tells you, "If only we could get rid of Harker! The farm has never been truly safe. Rats, wasps, even Olthoi have been known to peek their heads in from time to time."⸩ ⸨Remmick tells you, "The worst were the grubs, though. Hundreds of them at times. They're small enough to smash outright, sure... but they're more a threat to the harvest."⸩ ⸨Remmick tells you, "If you're going down there, be prepared... One more thing: Harker has a bundle of hooligans who traffic with him now. You watch your back down there, you hear?"⸩ ⸨Remmick tells you, "Go talk to Hibdin, he's the one organizing the expeditions down there."
L|1||Approaching Harker⸩ ⸨Harker tells you, "Welcome to my farm. Have you come to join with the other compost?"
L|1||Killing Harker⸩ ⸨Harker tells you, "A shell is nothing more than a device that allows us to traffic amongst your ilk. This body will return with me as its host. Our lives are eternal thanks to Aerbax."
L|1||Handing in Harker's Head (below level 60)⸩ ⸨You give Hibdin Velos Harker's Head.⸩ ⸨Hibdin Velos tells you, "Well, it looks like you've done pretty well down there. I've got a reward for your efforts--it's only fair that we give you something. You have, after all, returned the productivity to the farm for the time being."⸩ ⸨Hibdin Velos gives you Opal Gauntlets.⸩ ⸨Hibdin Velos tells you, "While these aren't as potent as the other gauntlets, they have the distinction of three cantrips."
L|1||Handing in Harker's Head (level 60+)⸩ ⸨You give Hibdin Velos Harker's Head.⸩ ⸨Hibdin Velos tells you, "Well, it looks like you've done pretty well down there. I've got a reward for your efforts--it's only fair that we give you something. You have, after all, returned the productivity to the farm for the time being."⸩ ⸨Hibdin Velos gives you Sunstone Gauntlets.⸩ ⸨Hibdin Velos tells you, "If you show these to Leandra she might be able to explain the special properties of these gauntlets."

Quest.name: Sword_of_Bellenesse
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|100 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} I|Starts At|{OPT} I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|The Sword of Bellenesse has been stolen from the vaults of Sanamar. Agents of both Sanamar and Silyun seek help recovering the blade, along with a Gharu'ndim master weaponsmith. Who will you help?
P|This quest is **not** part of the Rossu Morta or Whispering Blade line of quests, and your loyalties will not affect who you wish to work with.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Enter the «Cave of the Escaped Thief» at 71.1N, 50.2W. L|2|•|Route 1: «Mayoi» to «Lady Maila Estates» portal at 60.9S, 80.3E. L|2|•|Route 2: «Stonehold» to «The Pit», jump to the bottom and take the «Portal to the Beach Fort». L|1|2.|Hug the left wall to the bottom of the dungeon until you reach an «Escaped Thief» surrounded by 4 «Abhorrent Eater»s. L|1|3.|Kill the thief and loot «The Sword of Bellenesse» (drops one per kill, 4 minute respawn timer). L|2|•|⟦swordofbellenese⟧ L|1|4.|Return the sword to the NPC of your choice for a reward: L|2|•|«Bhravarn ibn Salizim» for the «Replica Sword of Bellenesse» L|2|•|«Lucari di Bellenesse» for the «Shield of Silyun» L|2|•|«Turien di Furza» for the «Shield of Sanamar» L|1|5.|{OPT} If you don't want your item reward it can be handed back for experience.

L|1||Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Bhravarn ibn Salizim tells you, "Salutations, friend."⸩ ⸨Bhravarn ibn Salizim tells you, "I wonder if you could aid me in a piece of research, for which you will be well rewarded. Recently, a sword was stolen from the Vaults of Sanamar, the Sword of Bellenesse. It is reported to be one of the most exquisite pieces of Viamontian Weaponsmithing of its time."⸩ ⸨Bhravarn ibn Salizim tells you, "Rumor has it that the thief is hiding in a cave around 71.1 N, 50.2 W. Quest.name: Sword_of_Lost_Hope_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|36 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Sepulcher of the Hopeslayer» I|Route|«Sepulcher of the Hopeslayer Portal Gem» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to attain a vial of the Hopeslayer's «Blood of the Hopeslayer¦blood», which can be used to upgrade the «Sword of Lost Light» into the «Sword of Lost Hope».
L|1|•|This quest is the final part of a chain that must be completed before hand (by at least 1 person in the fellowship) to create the portal gem that leads to the quest dungeon. The quests can be completed in any order. L|1|•|«Lockpick» skill (max diff. 402) is required for a door in part 2.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|If you haven't already, hand the «Dark Crucible» to one of the «Chosen of Asheron» to receive the «Sepulcher of the Hopeslayer Portal Gem». L|1|2.|Summon the portal to the dungeon while on flat ground. Buffing can be done before or after summoning as the drop zone of the Sepulcher is safe. However, be careful while in the drop area not to enter the surface portal as there is no way back without a second portal gem. L|1|3.|Have the lockpicker unlock the middle door - the other two passages are rigged with mana and stamina blight traps. L|1|4.|After clearing the section of Grievver and Shadows, you will see a lever in the center of the room, have a group or person stay behind at the lever ready for use when you reach the door - everyone else will continue on west. L|1|5.|At the split, take the middle passage across a grated floor and down a ramp. Defeat the Grievvers and Shadows in this room and head around to the north passage. L|1|6.|The next section is made of Shadow-twisted organic material which constantly eats away at your health for 9 points or more. The alcoves in the central corridor are safe zones from the damage, so stand in them whenever you can. L|1|7.|Stand at the door and have the group that stayed behind pull the lever, when the door opens move into the alcoves beyond the door and wait. L|1|8.|The lever group now needs to get to the door and take the left corridor north through some rooms to the last lever, pull it, and then run back and join up with the others (the first door can be reopened from inside the corridor). When the final door is open, everyone should move into the end of the passage before the pit and buff up if necessary. L|1|9.|Down below is the final room where «A Shadow of Black Ferah» is found along with the «Remnants of Ilservian» laid out on an altar. L|1|10.|Kill the spawns and loot a vial of «Blood of the Hopeslayer» (10 vials are found on the Ilservian's remains). L|2|•|⟦LostHopeInfusion⟧ L|1|11.|After you have infused the «Sword of Lost Light» with the volcanic infusions («Blue Fire Infusion¦blue», «White Fire Infusion¦white», and «Red Fire Infusion¦red») for improved stats, you can use the «Blood of the Hopeslayer» on it to create the «Sword of Lost Hope». You cannot add infusions other than the «Radiant Mana Infusion» to the sword once you have used the blood on it, so make sure you do it in that order if you want the best possible sword.

Take this."⸩ ⸨Chosen of Asheron gives you Asheron's Missive.⸩ ⸨Chosen of Asheron tells you, "Assemble the artifacts and bring them to me, so that with my lord's help you may challenge and strike down the Hopeslayer."⸩

Quest.name: Sylsfear_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|10 | Recommended Level = 50+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Zaikhal»/«Glenden Wood» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|A very old quest (possibly introduced in Beta or Release) involving exploring the «Mount Alphus Range» and surrounding dungeons. The only rewards are a pull from the «Laboratory Supply Chest» which contains a low amount of low tier loot generated items.
L|1|•|While lockpicking is not required, a lockpicker can skip most of this quest. L|1|•|{TIP} - One of the «Silifi of Crimson Stars Quest» enhancement rubies is located in the dungeon. With lockpick you can pick it up while you are here.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|{OPT} Purchase the «Alphus Range Directions» and «Legend of the Undead Defender» avialable from various barkeeps. While not specifically related to this quest, they provide clues to several locations you will visit. L|1|2.|Head to the «Mount Alphus Range». See that page for route information. L|2|•|If you have no lockpicking skill, proceed to step 3. L|2|•|If you can pick a resistance: 364 door, proceed to step 6. L|2|•|If you can pick a resistance: 583 door, proceed to step 8. L|1|3.|Head to 21.7N 19.4E and enter the «Zabool Tower». Work your way to the top and take the exit portal to reach the summit of Mount Zabool. Head to the southern end of the plateau and take the portal to Mount Alphus. L|1|4.|Head to 19.3N, 17.6E and approach «Zalphoos the Shopkeeper». Purchase the «Zalphoos' Key» and optionally the «Zalphoos Guidebook» for more information on the area. L|1|5.|Head to 19.5N, 17.5E and take the portal to the Base of Mt. Alphus. Enter the nearby portal to Mt. Alphus Valley. L|1|6.|Head to 20.5N, 13.2E and enter the «Alfreth Dungeon». It is a medium sized cave. Either path you take will lead you to a locked door (resistance: 364). Open this door with the Zalphoos' Key or pick the lock. L|1|7.|Jump into the pit beyond the locked doors and work your way to the end of the banderling area. Kill the Banderling Captain and take its «Worn Key». L|1|8.|Proceed to the «Sylsfear Dungeon» located at 11N, 14.7E. There are two routes: L|2|•|Head to 17.8N 16.0E and enter the «Bellig Tower». Work your way to the top, optionally stopping to kill the «Revenant (Bellig Tower)¦Belling Tower Revenant» and taking its «Hammer of Lightning». At the top take the exit portal to the summit of Mount Bellig. Head to the south end of the plateau and take the portal to Mount Gemm, from Gemm head to Mount Dalt, and from Dalt head to Mount Syliph. Enter the «Syliph Tower» located at 12.3N, 11.5E. Work your way down, stopping at «Gemm the Smith» if you wish, and exiting at the bottom to the base of Mt. Syliph. Near that drop point is another portal, leading just down the steep hills to Mt. Syliph Plain. Just east of this drop point, you will find the Slysfear Dungeon. L|2|•|Simply run outdoors to 11N, 14.7E. The Mount Alphus range provides an obstacle, so one must first run to the southern end of the valley and then to Sylsfear. L|1|9.|Inside Sylsfear you will find two hallways near the drop. Proceed down the left (south) hallway first. At the first turn, go right (west). You will come to a long hallway with many side hallways. Ignore all these and proceed straight (east). You will come to an intersection with a malformed lifestone in front of you and a «Dusty Sign» warning you not to take the right (east) path. Take this path anyway. L|1|10.|You will come to a locked door (resistance: 249). However, it is locked from the inside, and you can simply open it. Proceed with caution as this next area is filled with shadows and several magical traps. You will reach a final room. Kill the «Trusted Tusker» and loot its «Worn Key». Kill the «Revenant Antiquary» and loot its «Laboratory Key». L|2|•|⟦sylsfeartreasurekey⟧ L|1|11.|Return to the start of the dungeon. If you choose to retrace your steps and you find that the door leading to the shadow area has locked behind you, the Worn Key from the tusker will open it. Alternatively, you may portal recall if you have the ability. L|1|12.|From the entrance, take the right (west) hallway. Just beyond the two golems you will come to a locked door (resistance: 583). Open this door with the Worn Key taken from the Banderling Captain in the Alfreth Dungeon or pick the lock. This leads to the Laboratory area. Proceed with caution: The final area of the laboratory contains fire and lightning elementals, including an «Astyrrian» and «Inferno». L|1|13.|Open the «Laboratory Supply Chest» (resistance: 2000) with the «Laboratory Key» The loot generated contents are your reward for this quest. L|2|•|{WARN} when opened, the chest casts Lightning Vulnerability VI on you at 500 spellcraft. If the Astyrrian is still alive, this can lead to the quick demise of an unprepared adventurer.
L|1||Notes L|1|•|Four versions of the text, «A Scribbled Note», can also be found in the «Alfreth Dungeon» and «Sylsfear Dungeon»s.

H2|Trivia L|1|•|According to old entries on AC Explorer, the Sylsfear dungeon existed during beta (in October 1999) and the Male Tusker dropped its key back then. L|1|•|According to the CoD AC Database entry on Sylsfear, originally "Undead controlled this facility," and "when the Hopeslayer's forces were loosed upon the land," the Undead inside Sylsfear collaborated with the Shadows, and now "the deepest reaches of it are full of Shadows and Undead." This likely means that originally, the Shadow/Undead area was only populated with Undead, and during some event in the Fourth Sending of Darkness the Shadows were added.

Quest.name: The_Forbidden_Catacombs
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|50 | Recommended Level = 100+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Guardian of the Forbidden» I|Starts At|«Greater Battle Dungeon» I|Route|«Xarabydun» to «Small Creepy Statue» at 41.8S, 15.9E I|Repeat|None H2|Overview P|Fight your way to the bottom of the catacombs and claim the great treasure of the Forbidden.
L|1|•|You must be a «Player Killer» to access this quest. L|1|•|First you must get a «Shadow Fragment» or «Pyreal Bar» to be given access to the «Forbidden Catacombs». L|1|•|Should you die in the catacombs you will need another «Shadow Fragment» or «Pyreal Bar» to enter. L|1|•|You only need to enter the dungeon to acquire all available Quest Stamps
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Double click the statue to enter the Greater Battle Dungeon and make your way down to the red area with the «Bael'Zharon (NPC)¦Bael'Zharon» wannabe and «Guardian of the Forbidden». The wannabe sells the «Forbidden Note» quest rumor and other items including exceptionally cheap spell components. L|2|•|⟦EnterBattleDungeon⟧ L|1|2.|Go up the ramp to the Guardian and hand your item to it. You will be portaled in to a room with «The Black Breath» and 8 destroyable «Door»s. L|1|3.|Each of the doors lead to rooms with various creatures (see «Forbidden Catacombs» for a list). The «Forbidden Key» to the chest is randomly dropped by creatures on this level and also the next level down. L|1|4.|To reach the second level of the catacombs, destroy one of the doors in the northwest corner and then head north going left at the split. Destroy the door and jump down through the hole. L|1|5.|You will now be a room similiar to before, but this time with four doors. L|1|6.|Beyond these doors you will find more corridors leading to rooms filled with creatures; however, this time there are also creatures found in the main corridors. L|1|7.|Once you have found a key head east via the south corridor until you reach a door guarded by two «Platinum Golem»s. Destroy the door and jump down into the pit leading to the third floor. L|1|8.|From this level take the north corridor and jump into the pit. L|2|•|Note: There is a button on the south wall near the 2nd pit down. This opens a secret door on the north wall that leads back to the Tumerok room on the 1st floor (there is a locked door on the other end). L|1|9.|Jump down the hole and destroy the door leading into an area with a stone statue of Bael'Zharon. Head up the slope and around to a door and ledge overlooking the room with the «Forbidden Chest»s. L|1|10.|There are no creatures on this level, however, once you jump down Drudges and «Platinum Golem»s can fall from the room above. L|1|11.|Use the key on one of the chests for your rewards.
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Greater Battle Dungeon» «Small Creepy Statue» -- -- TR|«Forbidden Catacombs» N/A «map:604B.png¦604B.png» -- TE
H2|Rewards H3|Items L|1|•|Tier 5-6 «Loot».
H2|Dialog H3|Guardian of the Forbidden L|1||Guardian of the Forbidden tells you, "Heed my warning -- Turn back now! This place is not for you." L|1||Guardian of the Forbidden tells you, "You shall not enter." L|1||Guardian of the Forbidden tells you, "Begone! Only death dwells within."
H3|Handing in Shadow Fragment L|1||You give Guardian of the Forbidden Shadow Fragment. L|1||Guardian of the Forbidden tells you, "A symbol of the Shadow -- you may enter."
H3|Handing in Pyreal Bar L|1||You give Guardian of the Forbidden Pyreal Bar. L|1||Guardian of the Forbidden tells you, "A symbol of Greed -- you may enter."

Quest.name: Virindi_Servant's_Amulet_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|36|36, 41 I|Type|Small Fellowship I|Starts With|{OPT} «Chosen of Asheron» I|Starts At|{OPT} «Cragstone» / «Hebian-To» / «Zaikhal» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Half way through this quest the dungeon splits and each path has doors opened with levers in the other dungeon so at least two people are needed to open doors for each other. Each path has one of the two rewards so if both are wanted the groups must reverse and do both paths once.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|From the «Obsidian Rim», run to the «Chakron Gate» dungeon at 52.9S, 62.7W. L|2|•|Route: Access up the mountain is at 54.5S, 63.8W L|1|2.|The dungeon is symmetrical so you can either stick left or stick right and you will eventually come to a room with two portals. L|1|3.|At this point the group must divide. The Upper part contains the shard and the Lower part contains the amulet. To get both parts you will need to reverse after doing once. L|1|4.|See the «#Maps¦map» for details on door and lever placement. L|2|•|Note: At Upper Chakron, one of the door opening triggers (L5) is activated by running between 2 large crystals. L|1|5.|At the end of the Upper part the «Fragment of the Singularity» is on the ground and respawns every couple of minutes. L|2|•|⟦HopeslayerSingularity⟧ L|1|6.|At the end of the Lower part is the «Chakron Flux Servant» that drops the «Virindi Servant's Amulet» and respawns every couple of minutes. L|2|•|⟦VirindiMasterAmulet⟧ L|1|7.|After everyone has looted the amulet do not take the exit portal, last recall instead to return you to the top where a portal will take you to the two portal room so you can switch dungeons (there's both an exit and dungeon portal so be sure to take the right one).

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|20 | Recommended Level = 50+ I|Type|Fellowship/Solo I|Starts With|«Roderick» I|Starts At|41.1N, 57.3E in «Mite Maze» I|Route|Mite Maze portal in the «Facility Hub» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|«Lockpick» skill is required for this quest. L|1|•|The «Water of Lethe» is givable. If you already have a character with the recall, you might send this one in to grab the water, and give it to the character needing the recall. This saves you a run from «Ayan Baqur».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to Roderik over and over until you get a «A Crabbed Note». L|2|•|Frist Time Talking to Roderik: ⟦FirstTalkWithRoderick⟧ L|1|2.|Once you have the «A Crabbed Note» head to 33.8S, 85.3W - «Mount Lethe Magma Tubes». L|1|3.|Head down and you will find critters until you get to a lever guarded by a magna golem. L|1|4.|Pull the lever, go right into the open door and pull the other lever go back near the surface portal and head down. L|1|5.|At the end when you find the «Pool of Lethe», open it like a chest and loot «Water of Lethe» (2 minute respawn). L|2|•|⟦TakeWaterLethe⟧ L|1|6.|Take the water to «Celcynd the Dour» in Rithwic in the tavern at 10.7N, 58.1E and he will hand you «The Reign of Alfrega». L|1|7.|Take this back to «Roderick» and he will give you the «Scroll of Mount Lethe Recall». L|1|8.|Use the scroll to learn the recall spell. When you recall you will be high up in the air and then fall to the ground. A very cool recall spell!
P|Notes L|1|•|Rumors for his quest include: «The Reclusive Mage», «Mount Lethe Rumor», «Mount Lethe Directions» and «Of Lord Cambarth». L|1|•|If you talk to Roderick multiple times, you can get the «Diplomatic Message from Harlune» - used for the «Harlune's Diplomacy» Quest. L|1|•|Step 2: Route: You can run from Ayan or get a ride through the «Sclavus Cathedral». L|1|•|Step 4: Where you pulled the levers are the mini-bosses, «Lord Cambarth» and «Foreman Brelax», that can be defeated for some lore. L|1|•|Step 5: There is a bigger boss virindi («Virindi Overseer» here, but you don't have to kill it for the water. If you do kill it you can get the «Torn Journal» lore text, but it's hard for a non-mage (barely possible for two level 170 melees).

H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Buy a «Decanter of Nullified Essence» from «Beldin the Gem Dealer» in Old Yanshi. He is in a burned out building. He also sells the «Guide to Fighting the Harbinger». L|1|2.|Give Decanter to the nearby «Stone of Yanshi». Everyone must turn in a Decanter to be flagged to get rewards. L|1|3.|3 waves of enemies will spawn nearby, first a wave of «Elemental»s, next «Child of Acid», «Child of Fire», «Child of Frost» and «Child of Lightning», then «Caustic Knight», «Galvanic Knight»s, «Incendiary Knight»s and «Glacial Knight»s. L|1|4.|After the enemies are all dead, the «Reflection of the Harbinger» will spawn. Kill him. L|1|5.|Once the Reflection of the Harbinger is dead, loot a «Reflective Shard» from the ground. The shard is used for reward turn in only. Killing the Reflection activates the Tunnels to the Harbinger portals to be the "easy" version. They will remain like this until the Harbinger is either defeated or the quest resets. L|2|•|⟦WeakenedHarbingerReflectiveShard⟧ L|1|6.|When your group is ready, everyone should hand their Harbinger Item to the NPC (either Issk or Vincadi) and then use the nearby Tunnels to the Harbinger portal to begin. L|2|•|**Shared with all versions:** ⟦EnterHarbingerIssk⟧ or ⟦EnterHarbingerVincadi⟧ L|1|7.|Once inside, the dungeon is linear to the bottom (keep heading down). The only obstacles are a series of 4 jumps that must be made. L|2|•|**Jump 1: Acid Pit** - Full jump ahead (land on invisible platform) L|2|•|**Jump 2: Lava Pit** - Jump into the pit and take the hallway to the North L|2|•|**Jump 3: Ice Shelf ** - Shift-jump down onto the platform above the ice shelf, clear the spawn, and wait for your group. L|2|•|**Jump 4: Ice/Acid Pit Combo** - Dispel, then shift Jump down onto the ice shelf and **quicky** run to the edge and full jump across the acid pit (land on invisible platform). The ice hurts, so be quick. L|2|•|**Jump 5: Staging Area** - Shift jump down and quickly move off of the lava/ice floor. L|1|8.|Unlike the other Harbinger quests, there are no portals after the 5th jump. Instead, you must continue to jump down a few times until you reach the Harbinger. L|1|9.|Note that because there is no portal to the Harbinger, there is no easy way to get back if you die. L|1|10.|The «Harbinger (Easy)¦Harbinger» has a few elementals with him at the bottom. Clear them out first before attacking the Harbinger. L|1|11.|The Harbinger can be debuffed and is an elemental type, so «Atlan Weapons» and «Isparian Weapons» with «Major Prismatic Stone»s in them work well. L|1|12.|Kill the «Harbinger», loot a «Harbinger Arm Token», and take the portal which spawns after he dies. You must take the portal to be flagged for rewards! L|2|•|**Shared with all versions:** ⟦HarbingerWarriorWait⟧ L|2|•|**Shared with all versions:** ⟦HarbingerCompletedNuhmudira⟧ L|1|13.|Talk to «Issk» or «Vincadi» for 1 point in the skill related to Harbinger item turned in. L|2|•|**Shared with all versions:** ⟦HarbingerCompletedWaitIssk⟧ or ⟦HarbingerCompletedWaitVincadi⟧ L|1|14.|Hand the «Harbinger Arm Token» to the nearby «Emissary of Asheron (Yanshi)¦Emissary of Asheron» for the title "Champion of Dereth" and the «Royal Coat of Arms Stamp». L|1|15.|Hand the «Reflective Shard» to «Ciandra» in «Xarabydun» for an experience reward.

She bids you understand. She bids you complete the task and return to me. She needs the proof of your resolve. She needs to see that you will not fail.
L|1||Vincadi⸩ ⸨Vincadi tells you, "Greetings Isparian, I welcome you to my current location. I wish to convey certain fragments of information to you. The information contained within these fragments offers our assistance in the removal of a grave danger to your ilk.⸩ ⸨Vincadi tells you, "We wish to aid you so that you are spared a most horrific death at the hands of a thing that, "should not be".⸩ ⸨Vincadi tells you, "Accept this small treatise and read the words of Aerbax to comprehend the stipulation of our proposal.⸩ ⸨Vincadi gives you Experimentation.
L|1||Completing the Quest⸩ ⸨Vincadi tells you, "You have done well to earn your reward.⸩ ⸨Vincadi tells you, "Aerbax is pleased with your progress. You have served his research, and mine, very well. I have become aware of an unstable anomaly within the construct of your physical form, and I am afraid that any further tampering with your make-up before this heals could be disastrous."
L|1||Handing in Harbinger Arm Token⸩ ⸨You give Emissary of Asheron Harbinger Arm Token⸩ ⸨Emissary of Asheron tells you, "I award you the title Champion of Dereth. L|1||Handing in Reflective Shard⸩ ⸨You give Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist Reflective Shard⸩ ⸨Ciandra takes the shard and examines its reflective surface with a satisfied look⸩ ⸨Ciandra, Arcanum Alchemist tells you, "I take it the Nullification Barrier held. Quest.name: Altar_of_Bael'Zharon_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Lytelthorpe» or «Baishi» I|Repeat|None H2|Overview P|The original two quests for turning Player Killer.
P|Follow in the footsteps of «Y'leric Loredane», an Isparian who was one of the first to leave Asheron's protections by swearing allegiance to Bael'Zharon. He found one of the Hopeslayer's altars inside a dungeon in the Direlands.
P|The «Warning Letter» written by Y'leric is found at both quest NPCs.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Method 1: Grilhud the Hermit L|1|1.|{OPT} Purchase the «Bloodshed Rumor» from «special:whatlinkshere/Bloodshed Rumor¦scribes». L|1|2.|Find the «Broken Sigil» in «Dungeon Nye». L|2|•|Route: Take the «Enchanter's Meadow» portal near «Lytelthorpe» at 2.2N, 50.4E and then run to 6.2N, 34.4E. L|1|3.|From the drop, take the south passage up the ramp and hug the left wall until you come to a door leading into a small room. L|1|4.|Head north out of the room and at the T section turn right and head up the ramp. L|1|5.|Go through the metal door and head north to the next T section and go left heading down. L|1|6.|Follow the corridor across the bridge into a room where you will find the Sigil on the floor. L|1|7.|Now you have the sigil, you must bring it to «Grilhud the Hermit» who is found in a bunker not far from the dungeon at 11.8N, 33.7E. L|2|•|Route: Run from Dungeon Nye or take the «Hermit Hill Cottages» Settlement portal outside «Eastham» and then run southeast to the Hermit. L|1|8.|Give the sigil to Grilhud and she will summon a portal that drops you just outside the «Old Talisman» dungeon. L|1|9.|Once inside the Old Talisman, head west and follow the left hand rule. L|2|•|Note: Two of the upper levels of the dungeon have spots where you can drop out into the main chamber with the altar, but it's quite a long way down. L|1|10.|Eventually you should come out just above the «Altar of Bael'Zharon», jump down and use it to turn into a «Player Killer».
H3|Method 2: Drunken Madman L|1|1.|{OPT} Purchase the «Path of Strife Rumor» from «special:whatlinkshere/Path of Strife Rumor¦shopkeepers». L|1|2.|Head to the the tower mentioned in the rumor, it is found outside of «Baishi» at 53.0S 61.0E. L|2|•|Route: Take the portal to Baishi from the east hall of the «Town Network». L|1|3.|When in Baishi first purchase some «Sake» from «Kiun Baicho the Barkeeper» in the bar at 49.5S, 62.7E. L|1|4.|Give the Sake to the «Drunken Madman» and he will summon a portal to the «Walled Portals». L|1|5.|Now take the «Outside Accursed Halls» portal and enter the «Accursed Halls¦halls». L|1|6.|From the drop, go west through the doors and hug the left wall until you have climbed two lots of stairs. L|1|7.|At the third lot of stairs head north and then north again at the split leading into the open room. L|1|8.|Now head up the ramp to the north into the room with the «Altar of Bael'Zharon». L|1|9.|Use the altar to turn into a «Player Killer».

This is my service to those who wish to be free of Asheron's bonds."⸩ ⸨Grilhud the Hermit tells you, "Bring me the Broken Sigil from the dungeon to the south, and I will give you the shortcut you desire!"
L|1||Handing in Broken Sigil⸩ ⸨You give Grilhud the Hermit Broken Sigil.⸩ L|1||Grilhud the Hermit says, "Ah, yes, that's it, that's it!"

P|⸨You give Drunken Madman Broken Sigil.⸩ ⸨Drunken Madman tells you, "What is this? Doesn't look like sake...."⸩ ⸨Drunken Madman tells you, "And it's broken! Now leave me alone!"
L|1||Drunken Madman⸩ ⸨Drunken Madman tells you, "Have you read the note on the pedestal?"⸩ ⸨Drunken Madman tells you, "If that is what you desire, then fetch me a good drink of sake, and I shall grant your wish. Otherwise, leave this place. Hee, hee!"
L|1||Handing in Sake⸩ ⸨You give Drunken Madman Sake.⸩ L|1||Drunken Madman says, "Ah, a drink! Hee, hee!"

You have become one of his Chosen, a Player Killer.⸩

Quest.name: Assassin's_Roost_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Rec. Level|80 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Contact Instructions» I|Starts At|-- I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|«Selaina the Subtle¦Selaina» was a master assassin on Ispar and now she has come to Dereth and is creating a new order of assassins here. L|1|•|During this quest you will track down Selaina to her headquarters called the «Assassin's Roost», a tower in the South Direlands. L|1|•|Getting to the top of the tower requires you to follow a series of clues found all over Dereth then traveling though a dungeon set with several puzzles you can complete, however, there are other ways though. L|1|•|This quest has many different divergence points and gives you choices about how you want to complete it. L|1|•|{WARN} You must bring MMDs with you if you want to buy any of the item rewards. Be sure to bring enough MMDs to buy everything you want to buy. «Assassin's Roost Quest¦See prices for different items here».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Contact Instructions L|1|1.|Kill Human Bandits and Viamontians until one of them drops «Contact Instructions (Bottle Clue)», «Contact Instructions (Knowledge Clue)», or «Contact Instructions (Sign Clue)». L|2|•|Read the text of the instructions right away because it will "self destruct" in 8 minutes after you've looted it. L|2|•|The text will point you towards the first clue you must find. You must find the first clue referenced in the instructions within one week of looting it or else you'll need to find another text. L|2|•|Places to hunt: L|3|•|«Hunter's Leap» dungeon. L|3|•|All around Marae Lassel for Mercenaries, Poachers, Assassins and others. L|3|•|Viamontians in the Augmentation dungeon. L|3|•|Viamontians at the Staging Areas around Glendon Wood. L|3|•|Viamontians on the Isle of Ruin (near Eastwatch).
H3|Following the Clues L|1|1.|Read the «Contact Instructions». L|1|2.|There are 3 separate ways the quest diverges at this point. Read your Instructions to see which of the three clue trails you must follow.
H4|Contact Instructions 1 L|1||"A wish to find the one for which you seek starts with knowledge.
L|1||Knowledge is power, even if it is not power you seek.
L|1||Discipline over ones temptations is needed to control power."
L|1|1.|Go to the Hebian Library (39.2S, 81.6E) and use the «Open Book» on the top floor. L|1|2.|Now go to «Bandit Castle» and use the «Tree» at 65.8N 49.6E. L|1|3.|Find a «Mud Golem Heart» and give it to the «Stone Collector» in «Zaikhal» to receive a «Mysterious Untranslated Scroll». L|1|4.|Take the scroll to «Kuyiza bint Zayi» in the Zaikhal Library at 14.0N, 0.1E. L|1|5.|Buy «Danby's Ale» at «Danby's Outpost» from «Barkeep Aliece Landlig». L|1|6.|Hand «Ulgrim» the Ale and he will give you a «Skipping Stone». L|1|7.|Give the Skipping Stone to any «Fishing Hole» to be portaled to the dungeon.
H4|Contact Instructions 2 L|1||"It is ours to search for signs in life.
L|1||Be it around town.
L|1||No matter how swamped you may be."
L|1|1.|Go to the «Sawato» and use the «Sign (Assassin's Roost)¦Sign» at 28.4S 59.7E. L|1|2.|Then go to «Sanamar» and use the «Skeleton (Assassin's Roost)¦Skeleton» on the 2nd floor of the Viamontian Great Hall at 69.8N, 62.3W. L|1|3.|Find a «Green Phyntos Wasp Wing» and give it to a Sho «Wing Collector» (There is one in «Mayoi») to receive a «Mysterious Untranslated Scroll». L|1|4.|Take the «Mysterious Untranslated Scroll» to «Fanzen San the Translator» in the «Hebian-To Library» at 39.2S 81.6E. L|1|5.|Buy «Danby's Ale» at «Danby's Outpost» from «Barkeep Aliece Landlig». L|1|6.|Hand «Ulgrim» the Ale and he will give you a . L|1|7.|Give the Skipping Stone to any «Fishing Hole» to be portaled to the dungeon.
H4|Contact Instructions 3 (Bottle) L|1||"We often search for answers at the bottom of a bottle.
L|1||This time, you may find the answer is right."
L|1|1.|Go to the Holtburg tavern and use the «Bottle». L|1|2.|Now go to «Wai Jhou» and use the «Encrusted Scroll Case». It is in the top floor of the tower in front of the Joji Shrine. L|1|3.|Then give a «Drudge Charm» to an Aluvian «Collector» (one in Holtburg) to receive a «Aged Mysterious Untranslated Scroll». L|1|4.|Take the «Aged Mysterious Untranslated Scroll» to «Bretself the Translator» at the Cragstone Library at 26.0N 47.0E. L|1|5.|Buy «Danby's Ale» at «Danby's Outpost» from «Barkeep Aliece Landlig». L|1|6.|Hand «Ulgrim» the Ale and he will give you a «Skipping Stone». L|1|7.|Give the Skipping Stone to any «Fishing Hole» to be portaled to the dungeon.
H3|The Roost Dungeon P|Note: Once you are in the dungeon, if you leave or die you will have to go through the entire series of clues again to obtain another «Skipping Stone» to return. You do not need another «Contact Instructions» but you do need to redo the clues starting at the bottle, sign, or book.
P|You can also use the above to your advantage. Since each item turn-in («Drudge Charm», «Green Phyntos Wasp Wing» or «Mud Golem Heart») nets you 1 million experience points, you can redo the clues repeatedly for numerous Skipping Stones and experience rewards (unknown expiration timer).
H4|Door Key L|1|1.|From the drop you will find a room full of Bottles, Barrels, and Kegs that can be killed like creatures, but you must manually select them. Destroy them until one drops a 3-use «Door Key». (Barrels appear to have the best drop rate) L|2|•|{WARN} Mages may have difficulty destroying the items to find a key - they are highly magic resistant. L|1|2.|Use the key on the locked door. L|1|3.|From this point there are two trials to complete, with an optional kill task that can be used to bypass each trial. L|2|•|{WARN} By opting out of a trial, you will receive no xp or title.
H4|Trial 1: Floor Puzzle L|1|•|If you step on an incorrect tile, it will portal you back to the start (similar to the puzzle on the «Gaerlan's Citadel» quest). L|1|1.|Navigate a floor of tiles based on the pattern provided below. L|1|2.|Talk to «Lander», the NPC at the end, to receive 10 million experience and the title Sure Step.
L|1|•|In order to bypass the trial: L|1|1.|You will find a hallway that will branch off from the hallway leading to the the trial. L|1|2.|Go down until you find «Ardenson», an NPC that gives a kill task for 50 «Black Rat»s which are found around him. L|1|3.|Kill 50 Rats and return to the NPC and he will teleport you past the trial.
P|**Step by step directions for the Floor Puzzle:**
L|1|•|First will be the direction then the color of the tile you should be on having moved that direction. You will leave the board 4 times. 3 During the crossing and the 4th at the end.
L|1|1.|Start on the north path. L|1|2.|You get back on at a green space it is 2 spaces west. H4|Trial 2: Bridge Jumping L|1|•|{WARN} If you fall during this trial there are many Wailing Statues below which continually cast Sacrificial Edges (flying knives). Movement when getting hit by knives is reduced significantly. Lower level characters could easily die so you may want to have an «Aphus Lassel Portal Gem» handy. If you survive a fall there is a door which allows access back to the jump quest start point, but it is a very difficult task.
L|1|1.|Jump across several bridges and platforms, using the levers in each room to open doors as needed. L|1|2.|Talk to «Maniel» at the end to receive 10 million experience and the title Bridge Jumper. L|1|3.|To proceed to the portal, you must shift+jump down to a platform which is below the space between the last bridge and the landing where the NPC stands.
L|1|•|In order to bypass the trial: L|1|1.|You will find a hallway that will branch off from the hallway leading to the trial. L|1|2.|Go down until you find «Maximas» who gives a kill task for 50 «Weak Mangy Carenzi»s which are found around him. L|1|3.|Kill 50 Carenzis and return to the NPC and he will teleport you past the trial. L|1|4.|:Maximas teleports you with Jump Puzzle Bypass.
P|**Suggested Jump Strategy** L|1|•|Doors stay open for about 5 minutes. If you have any doubts after a retry that they will stay open long enough, close and reopen them. L|1|1.|From the door, move toward the bridge ahead. Stand near the edge on the right side, turn left and aim at the opening on the left end of the bridge. Long jump. L|1|2.|Enter the room on the left and use the lever to open the gate on the other side of the bridge. L|1|3.|Go across to the room on the other side and use the lever. Turn left and walk to the edge of the doorway opening in the wall. L|1|4.|If you look down, left and across the bridge below you should see the far gate open. If it's not open, pull the lever behind you again. L|1|5.|Aim straight at the open gate below and do a full-power long jump. L|1|6.|Pull the lever in this room, and then run across the bridge and pull the next lever. L|1|7.|Go back onto the bridge and shift-jump onto the railing. The center is good for this - jump at a slight angle. Walk on the railing to the left until you are nearly to the corner of the left room. L|1|8.|Shift-jump to the first fading platform and turn left. L|1|9.|Check your jump height by jumping straight up and make sure you can jump high enough for the next fading platform - you may need to raise your jump skill. L|1|10.|Full power shift-jump up to the next fading platform, it is two-spaces wide. L|1|11.|Turn right and line-up with the opening in the wall across from you and slightly above. Take a quick look down and note the floor below... L|1|12.|This jump is the hardest jump. It is not a tap jump, nor a full power jump, but somewhere in between (depending on your jump skill). I always use an «Aphus Lassel Portal Gem» if I miss this jump, but use your best judgement. L|1|13.|After you make the jump, use the lever in the room to open the gate on the right. L|1|14.|Go across the bridge and use the next lever to open the door on the balcony below (provides access to the shopkeeper NPCs, not needed to complete the jump puzzle). L|1|15.|Turn left and walk to the edge of the doorway opening in the wall. Long jump out of the doorway to «Maniel» on the far platform. L|1|16.|Talk to «Maniel» for your reward. If you do not wish to access the tower NPCs then you are done. L|1|17.|To access the tower NPCs, go to the edge and note the balcony and door below. L|1|18.|Turn around, (optionally take one walking step forward) and do a tiny backward shift-jump to the balcony below.
H4|Exit to the Tower L|1|1.|Once you are past the trials you must run up many flights of spiral stairs until you reach a yellow portal. L|1|2.|The portal deposits you at the bottom of the Tower in the South Direlands where «Selaina the Subtle» and «Creed» reside. L|1|3.|Once done it is possible to jump down and run to the «Wai Jhou» lifestone.
H3|The Tower L|1|•|**If you attempted to kill Selaina in the past and have died or killed her and try to give her any of the writs before giving her a writ of forgiveness she will eat them up and give you nothing.** L|1|•|At the top of the tower is «Creed» and «Selaina the Subtle». Creed is a vendor that sells several different items in exchange for MMDs. Selaina looks like an NPC but can be attacked like a regular creature although she only attacks players once provoked. L|1|•|Creed sells several writs that can be given to Selaina in exchange for an Society Armor Writ, a Mana Forge Key, or a couple special titles (Assassin and Death Dealer). Also he has a portal gem that goes straight to the tower. L|1|•|Creed sells a «Assassin's Cowl¦Cowl» and a «Assassin's Edge¦Dagger» that can also be obtained by killing Selaina. The Cowl always drops while the Dagger may not. The stats of the cowl and dagger sold by Creed and looted from Selaina have identical stats but slightly different descriptions. L|1|•|If you kill Selaina you must purchase a «Writ of Forgiveness» from Creed and hand it to Seliana if you ever want to get anything from her in the future. According to her the more you kill her the more expensive it becomes to obtain forgiveness.
H3|Fighting Selaina L|1|1.|Debuff Selaina's Dagger before starting the fight. The debuffs on her dagger will not cause her to attack you yet. L|1|2.|* When your first blow lands she will teleport you to the top of the tower so there is no point to trying to hide on the lower levels. L|1|3.|Selaina uses a multi-strike dagger and can hit for a lot of damage if your melee defense is not very high. However, for characters over level 180 it is unlikely she poses a significant threat. If you are with more than one person, consider having a healer on standby. L|1|4.|When she dies she drops the «Assassin's Cowl» (100% of the time) and can drop the «Assassin's Edge» (not 100% drop rate) as well as some generic armor. L|1|5.|* Note: The value of items dropped would be 520 MMDs if you were going to buy them from «Creed». So if you want the Cowl and Dagger then killing Selaina may be the best option economically speaking presuming she drops the Dagger for you. 520 MMDs > 50 MMDs for the Writ of Forgiveness.
P|Alternatively, a «Duelist's Jewel», the slashing protection rare, will reduce all slashing melee damage significantly. When used in combination with a shield with 1000 buffed protection from slashing, all of Selaina's slashing hits were reduced to 0 damage, even with imperil 7. Piercing hits were rare and very weak, hitting for around 25 damage.
P|**Update:** As of 2013, due to the introduction of higher level loot (tiers 7 and 8), a higher level character (level 250+) that is reasonably well equipped has little to fear from Selaina. Having melee defense of 500 or higher will result in virtually no attacks hitting you. Needing a slashing rare or healer is probably only necessary for lower level characters.
P|Notes L|1|•|The quest is not split up by race. As long as you find each respective letter, you can get the clues that correspond.

Quest.name: Atlan_Weapons_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|20+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|see dungeons & maps I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to forge «Atlan Weapons».
P|{WARN} No Quest Bonus stamps awarded
H2|Walkthrough & Notes P|See also: «Pragmatic Guide to Atlan Weapons».
H3|Step 1: Creating the Pyreal Ingot L|1|1.|Atlan weapons are forged from «Pyreal Mote»s, which are dropped by «Golem»s. You will need the equivalent of 16 motes to create a weapon. See «#Dungeons & Maps¦below» for some good places to hunt Golems. L|1|2.|Combine two Pyreal Motes to create a «Pyreal Sliver». L|1|3.|Combine two Pyreal Slivers to create a «Pyreal Nugget». L|1|4.|Combine two Pyreal Nuggets to create a «Pyreal Bar». L|1|5.|Finally, combine two Pyreal Bars to create a «Quality Pyreal Ingot» (Alchemy skill check).
H3|Step 2: Forging the Atlan Weapon at Crater Lake Village L|1|1.|Head to «Crater Lake Village» and purchase the appropriate glyph from «Silencia the Archmage» at 64.8N 13.4E. L|2|•|Route: «Glenden Wood» to «Highland Manors» portal at 28.0N, 29.5E. Run southwest to the «Crater Pathway» dungeon at 60.6N, 15.7E and when inside take all ramps up to the surface portal that exits at Crater Lake Village. L|1|2.|Apply the glyph to your «Quality Pyreal Ingot» (Weapon skill check) to create a «Superb Infused Ingot». L|1|3.|Hand the Superb Infused Ingot to «Silencia's Magma Golem» and it will give you an «Atlan Weapon» of the same type as the stamp you used.
TH|Glyph Resulting Weapon TR|«Magic Glyph» «Atlan Wand» TR|«Missile Weapons Glyph» «Atlan Bow» TR|«Two Handed Weapons Glyph» «Atlan Two Handed Sword» TR|«Heavy Weapons Glyph» «Atlan Sword» TR|«Light Weapons Glyph» «Atlan Mace» TR|«Finesse Weapons Glyph» «Atlan Axe» TE
H3|Step 3: Upgrading your Weapon P|For the full stats of all possible upgrades, see «Atlan Weapons».
P|The base weapons have no wield requirements.
P|Minor Atlan stones can be applied to create wands that require 290 base War Magic to wield, bows that require 290 Missile Weapons to wield, and melee weapons that require 325 of a given weapon skill to wield. Atlan weapons with minor stones cannot be upgraded further, but the stones can be removed to revert the weapon to a base weapon.
P|Major Atlan stones can be applied to create wands that require 310 base War Magic to wield, bows that require 315 Missile Weapons to wield, and melee weapons that require 350 of a given weapon skill to wield.
P|The Black Fire Atlan Stone can be applied to Major stone weapons create wands that require 330 base War Magic to wield, bows that require 335 Missile Weapons to wield, and melee weapons that require 370 of a given weapon skill to wield.
P|The Enhanced Black Fire Atlan Stone can be applied to Major+Black Fire stone weapons create wands that require 355 base War Magic to wield, bows that require 360 Missile Weapons to wield, and melee weapons that require 400 of a given weapon skill to wield.
P|There are no upgrade paths for Life Magic or Void Magic wands.

Quest.name: Bandit_Hilt_Quest
Quest.notes: 2 possible
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|{OPT} «MacNiall the Unruled» I|Starts At|{OPT} 74.1S, 92.3E in «MacNiall's Freehold» I|Repeat|7 Days H2|Overview L|1|1.|The original Bandit Hilt quest was retired, but it was brought back and updated on 3/31/2025 for ILT. L|1|2.|When applied to a melee weapon, the new «Bandit Hilt»s require that specific weapon skill to be **Specialized** and each weapon skill has a unique buff. This will not take up a tinker slot, but will attune the weapon to you. L|2|•|«Finesse Weapons» get +critical strike chance and +critical strike damage L|2|•|«Light Weapons» get +1 strike L|2|•|«Heavy Weapons» get +1 cleave L|2|•|«Two Handed Combat» gets +5 melee modifier. L|2|•|UA «Light Weapons» get +1 cleave since UA can not multi-strike. This adds HW spec requirement. L|1|3.|At some point a bow version of Bandit Hilt was added, Bandit Bowstring. Steps for this were lazily added to this page below.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes - Bandit Hilt L|1|1.|Aquire an «Idol Gem» from one of the «Idol» creatures. The «Umbral Hall» dungeon is a good place to find these. L|1|2.|Return to «MacNiall the Unruled» and give him the Idol Gem. L|2|•|⟦BanditBlades⟧ L|1|3.|In return he will give you «Bandit Cousin's Letter» which you must take to MacNiall's cousin «MacDugal» at the «Bandit Castle». Quest.name: Bandit_Shield_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|40+ (shield wield req.) I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Bandit Castle» at 66.5N, 50.0E I|Route|From «Arwic», take the «Mountain Shortcut» portal at 35.0N, 56.0E. Run east and take the Bandit Castle portal at 42.4N 60.5E. I|Repeat|None H2|Overview P|{WARN} No Quest Bonus stamps awarded
P|This quest can be completed with lockpick but for those without the skill they will need to retrieve a number of keys from the dungeon to gain access to the shield.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Once at Bandit Castle, enter the «Bandit Castle Prison» by taking a ramp into the center room. There's a ramp downward to the portal room. L|1|2.|From the drop point go straight ahead and right at the split. You will come to a large open room with creatures locked in cells and a pit in the center. L|1|3.|Jump down the pit and exit to the North East (East door, go left.) L|1|4.|In front of the portal are three «Giant White Rat»s kill one of them and take the «Key (Bridge Access)¦Bridge Access Key». L|1|5.|Go back to the split and head right into the room with a locked gate, take the north room and use the key on the chest. L|1|6.|Take the «Key (Cell Key)¦Cell Key». Now on the way back go to the side room with the «Revenant» and a locked door. Use the «Key (Bridge Access)¦Bridge Access Key» to open it. L|1|7.|Use the «Key (Cell Key)¦Cell Key» on the locked chest inside this room and take the «Key (Prison Access)¦Prison Access Key». L|1|8.|Go left into the main room and take the stairs in the south east corner. Use the «Key (Bridge Access)¦Bridge Access Key» on the next door to access the bridge leading to a room with 3 «Revenant»s and a chest. L|1|9.|Use the «Key (Prison Access)¦Prison Access Key» on the chest. L|1|10.|Take the «Silver Key» and make your way back to the area with the three rats and the surface portal. L|1|11.|Use the Silver Key on the chest in the alcove for the «Bandit Shield».

Wiki.page: Black Death Catacombs Quiddity Ingot Purification

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|60+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|44.2N, 62.8E I|Route|«Arwic» to «Eotensfang Cottages» portal at 32.8N, 59.5E. I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|{WARN} No Quest Bonus stamps awarded
L|1|•|The Purified Quiddity Ingot obtained from this quest was originally used in the «Aerbax's Citadel» quest when it first went live. These days the Purified Ingot has no known use.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You must have done the «Black Death Catacombs Quiddity Seed Quest» Quest before doing this quest in order to have the «Quiddity Ingot (BDC)» you need for this quest. The Black Death Catacombs Ingot is the one that says it "glows with a bluish light" in its description. You must use that ingot and not the ingots from the other two Quiddity Seed quests.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Run down through the dungeon until you find a «Vat of Olthoi Jelly». L|1|2.|Give your Quiddity Ingot to the Vat to receive your rewards.
