H2|Dialog P|⸨;Giving Black Death Catacombs Quiddity Ingot to Vat of Olthoi Jelly⸩ ⸨You give Vat of Olthoi Jelly Quiddity Ingot.⸩ ⸨You immerse the ingot in the green ichor. The ingot's glow changes from blue to green.⸩ ⸨Vat of Olthoi Jelly gives you Purified Quiddity Ingot.⸩ ⸨You've earned 6,136,130 experience.
L|1||Using Vat of Olthoi Jelly⸩ ⸨You choke down some of the ichor in the vat. While it tastes putrid, you can feel that your body is better able to heal itself for now.⸩ ⸨Vat of Olthoi Jelly cast Hydra's Head on you.
L|1||Giving the Purified Quiddity Ingot to the Gate Stones under Aerbax's Citadel⸩ ⸨You give North Gate Stone Purified Quiddity Ingot.⸩ ⸨You touch the stone with the Quiddity Ingot and it makes a simple clinking noise. The stone appears to be inactive.
L|1||Opening Dialog (retired)⸩ ⸨You allow Hoshino Kei to examine your Quiddity Ingot.⸩ ⸨Hoshino Kei tells you, "This ingot is attuned to the power of Isparian potential. The being it is most similar to is Queen Elysa. I have heard the story of how a female voice was involved in the quest, though my theory is that it was the voice of the long-dead Olthoi Queen which helped to break the spell."⸩ ⸨Hoshino Kei tells you, "It seems that Queen Elysa's fate shall forever be intertwined with the Olthoi. As such, the Olthoi may prove to be a means to purify this ingot. Scouts in the Olthoi North have reported a newly-discovered cavern of Olthoi - there may be a sufficient means of purification there."⸩ ⸨Hoshino Kei tells you, "This cavern is not located in a dangerous place. I would advise seeking a vassal, perhaps, who might be willing to perform this task for you."
L|1||Showing Purified Black Death Catacombs Quiddity Ingot to Hoshino Kei (retired)⸩ ⸨You allow Hoshino Kei to examine your Purified Quiddity Ingot.⸩ ⸨Hoshino Kei tells you, "This ingot is attuned to the power of Isparian potential, but it has been purified already. You need not do anything else with this ingot, except wait for an opportunity for it to be used."⸩

P|Notes L|1|•|In terms of spawn density the best one to hunt is the Hoary Armoredillo north of Silyun. You can get 20 fairly quickly there by covering a fairly small area near the Node. L|1|•|There are several Blight Guardian Sclavi along with the Blight Lord. Beware of getting overwhelmed by war magic until you have taken out some of the Sclavi. Quest.name: Caulnalain_Vestibule_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|40 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Caulnalain Vestibule» I|Route|Run from «Neydisa Castle» or take «Windrune Cottages» portal from «Crater Lake» at 66.4N, 14.3E. I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to destroy a replica of the powerful «Caulnalain Soul Crystal¦Soul Crystal» that was once found in the Caulnalain Chamber.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|Retrieve a «Caulnalain Key» as a trophy from «Shadow Lieutenant»s, «Sinister Shadow»s and «Lesser Void Knight»s. You can find Lieutenants in the Caulnalain dungeon itself.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Once you portal in, jump down into the area below using either the east or west room, it doesn't matter which. L|1|2.|At the bottom go into the south west room and head down the passage, once you reach the T section head left and then take the second left turn heading south. L|1|3.|You will come to a room with green lighting in two corners, take the east passage from this room and just follow the path all the way to the room with the «Caulnalain Gate». You will find that the gate is just metres away from the pit you dropped into at the start. L|1|4.|Use a «Caulnalain Key» on the gate to receive a «Caulnalain Portal Gem». L|1|5.|The last part is very easy to navigate as the only way to progress is by jumping down a pit at the end of each section. After the second jump head east into the area with the «Caulnalain Crystal». L|2|•|Note: The Caulnalain Crystal has high regeneration and a decent amount of hit points for a quest of this level. It also heals itself and drains your health. L|1|6.|Once you have defeated the crystal loot a gem (it drops 5 in total) and take it to one of the brothers in «Al-Arqas» (31.3S, 13.5E) for your reward. L|2|•|⟦CaulnalainCrystal⟧
L|1||Notes L|1|•|The untranslated text, «Throbbing Lump», is dropped by the «Caulnalain Shadow Leader» in the «Caulnalain Chamber». L|1|•|If you continue on into the sections behind the «Caulnalain Crystal» you will find lots of areas that spawn «Crystal Spur»s. The Spurs drop «Tiny Shard»s, which can be given to «Gersan the Sureshot» for 30 «Bundle of Crystal Arrowheads¦Crystal Arrowheads». The arrowheads can be used to fletch ammunition for crystal missile weapons.

I hear that there are some master armorers who craft suits of armor from fused gems. Those are beneath my notice. Bring me something even more powerful than a scintillating gem, and I will craft a great and unique shield for you. If you have one of my old shields, I will improve it for you."
L|1||Opening Dialog, Gersan⸩ ⸨Gersan the Sureshot tells you, "If you can find a gem more powerful than a mere scintillating gem, I would be interested in it. Give me such a gem and I will use it to craft a magical bow for you. The bow will be so powerful, in fact, that normal ammunition will not work on it. You will have to come to me for arrowheads as well. If you have one my old missile weapons, I will improve it for you."⸩ ⸨Gersan the Sureshot tells you, "I am not a crossbow maker, however, so if you need a crossbow you will have to attach a stock to the bow yourself."
L|1||Opening Dialog, Gervena⸩ ⸨Gervena the Oblique tells you, "I have heard of powerful gems, more powerful than the mediocre gems you bring to those so-called master smiths. If you have one of my old orbs, I will improve it for you." L|1||Using the Caulnalain Key on the Caulnalain Gate⸩ ⸨You now have a gem that will send you to the Caulnalain Chamber.
L|1||Handing in Caulnalain Gem⸩ ⸨You give Gerloc the Defender Caulnalain Gem.⸩ ⸨Gerloc the Defender tells you, "A worthy gem. It allows me to craft a powerful shield. May this shield protect you well in the days ahead. But take care with it! It will not be easily replaced!"⸩ ⸨Gerloc the Defender gives you Caulnalain Crystal Shield.⸩ ⸨You've earned 5,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Gerloc the Defender tells you, "I've also taken the liberty of granting you some practical knowledge..."⸩ ⸨You give Gersan the Sureshot Caulnalain Gem⸩ ⸨Gersan the Sureshot tells you, "A rare and powerful gem. Quest.name: Composite_Weapons_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|0+ I|Rec. Level|20+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Yuan Hanzu» (bow and xbow) «Havala bint Mylos» (atlatl) I|Starts At|«Ayan Baqur» I|Repeat|N/A I|Quest Chain|Composite Weapons I|1|Composite Weapons Quest I|2|«Composite Weapons Upgrade» H2|Overview P|{WARN} No Quest Bonus stamps awarded
P|This quest covers creating the basic Composite Bow, Composite Crossbow, and Composite Atlatl. Once you create your weapon, you may proceed to the «Composite Weapons Upgrade» quest to enhance it.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes P|There are 18 variations of the «Composite Bow», 18 variations of the «Composite Crossbow», 54 variations of the «Composite Bow with Handle», and 54 variations of the «Composite Crossbow with Handle». For all possible weapons, see «Composite Weapons Quest/Full Rewards».
P|The best possible Composite Bows and Crossbows are made from «Great Mattekar Horn»s, «Ravener Guts», «Large Lugian Sinew»s, and a «Dark Revenant Thighbone». For these weapons, see the rewards section.
P|The Atlatl, which was a later addition, only has 4 variations. For these weapons, see the rewards section.
P|The table below outlines all components and what property they grant to bows and crossbows.
TH|Item Crafted From Effect TR|«Shaped Fire Auroch Horn» «Fire Auroch Horn» +2% Melee Defense TR|«Shaped Great Mattekar Horn» «Great Mattekar Horn» +6% Melee Defense TR|«Cured Small Lugian Sinew» «Small Lugian Sinew» (failure) Bow: Speed 45 Xbox: Speed 120 TR|«Cured Lugian Sinew» «Small Lugian Sinew» (success) «Large Lugian Sinew» (failure) Bow: Speed 40 Xbow: Speed 105 TR|«Cured Large Lugian Sinew» «Large Lugian Sinew» (success) Bow: Speed 35 Xbow: Speed 90 TR|«Oiled String» «Sclavus Tongue»s (failure) Bow: +40% Damage Xbox: +60% Damage TR|«Fine Oiled String» «Sclavus Tongue»s (success) «Ravener Guts» (failure) Bow: +90% Damage Xbow: +120% Damage TR|«Excellent Oiled String» «Ravener Guts» (success) Bow: +110% Damage Xbow: +140% Damage TR|«Bone Handle (Low)» «Undead Thighbone» (failure) +2% to Attack Bonus Aura of Blood Drinker III Missile Weapon Mastery III TR|«Bone Handle (Medium)» «Undead Thighbone» (success) «Dark Revenant Thighbone» (failure) +4% to Attack Bonus Aura of Blood Drinker IV Missile Weapon Mastery IV TR|«Bone Handle (High)» «Dark Revenant Thighbone» (success) +6% to Melee Bonus +25% to Damage Bonus Armor Cleaving Brittlemail VI Defender VI Boon of Refinement Swift Killer VI Strathelar's Boon Infected Caress TE
H3|Gathering Trophies P|For the «Great Mattekar Horn», hunt «Great Mattekar»s. The best location to do this is the «Mattekar Cave» near «Neydisa Castle», but they can also be found as landscape spawns in locations such as the «Lost Wish Mountain Range».
P|For the «Fire Auroch Horn», hunt «Auroch Fire Bull»s or the «Master of the Herd». Fire auroch herds can be found at the following points of interest: L|1|•|«11.5N, 37.9E - Auroch Herd» L|1|•|«29.6N, 39.1W - Fire Auroch Heard and Reedshark Pack» L|1|•|«26.9N, 39.0W - Fire Auroch Heard» L|1|•|«80.7S, 34.5W - Auroch Herd»
P|For the «Large Lugian Sinew», hunt mid to high level lugians, such as «Gotrok Gigas», «Gotrok Montok», «Gotrok Extas», «Gotrok Tiatus», «Gigas Raider», «Extas Raider», and «Tiatus Raider». These creatures may be found in the following dungeons: «Hills Citadel», «Wilderness Citadel», «Ridge Citadel», «Old Mine», «Linvak Tukal Entryway», and «Lugian Excavations»
P|For the «Small Lugian Sinew», hunt low to mid level lugians, such as «Gotrok Amploth», «Gotrok Obeloth», «Gotrok Lithos», «Amploth Raider», «Obeloth Raider», and «Lithos Raider». These creatures may be found in the following dungeons: «Hills Citadel», «Forking Trail», «Trialos», «Lugian Post», «Lugian Outpost», and «Lugian Quarry».
H3|Crafting Components P|More to come
H3|The Composite Bow and Crossbow H4|Step 1: Crafting the Stave L|1|1.|Hunt «Great Mattekar»s until you find **two** «Great Mattekar Horn»s. (VERY low drop rate) L|1|2.|Head to «Ayan Baqur» and hand your two «Great Mattekar Horn»s to «Yuan Hanzu». You'll receive two «Shaped Great Mattekar Horn»s. L|1|3.|Hunt Lugians until you find **two** «Large Lugian Sinew»s. L|2|•|Cooking Pot Large Lugian Sinew Cured Large Lugian Sinew L|2||You expertly cure the lugian sinew. L|2|•|Shaped Great Mattekar Horn Cured Large Lugian Sinew Composite Arm L|2||You combine the horn and sinew into a bow arm. L|1|4.|Repeat this step to get 2 arms for the stave. L|2|•|Composite Arm Composite Arm Composite Stave L|2||You combine the two arms into a stave.
H4|Step 1b: Crafting the Stock for the Crossbow L|1|1.|Hunt Golems made of wood such as «Wood Golem»s, «Small Wood Golem»s and «Forest Lord»s until you find a «Wood Heart». L|1|2.|Hand your «Wood Heart» to «Barnar the Tinker» in «Cragstone» at 25.3N 49.1E to receive a «Crossbow Stock». L|2|•|Composite Stave Crossbow Stock Composite Stock with Stave
H4|Step 2: Crafting the String L|1|1.|Hunt «Drudge Ravener»s until you find **three** «Ravener Guts». L|2|•|Ravener Guts Ravener Guts Twisted Drudge Ravener Guts L|2|•|Ravener Guts Twisted Drudge Ravener Guts Braided Drudge Ravener Guts L|2|•|Bloodseeker Oil Braided Drudge Ravener Guts Excellent Oiled String L|2||You apply the oil liberally to the string. L|1|2.|Attach the string to the bow stave or crossbow stock with stave (weapon skill check). L|2|•|Excellent Oiled String Composite Stave Composite Bow L|2||You deftly attach the string to the stave. L|2|•|Excellent Oiled String Composite Stock with Stave Composite Crossbow L|2||You deftly attach the string to the stave.
H4|Step 3: Adding a Handle L|1|1.|**Notes:** L|2|•|If you want to add the highest tier handle, skip this step and go directly to the «Composite Weapons Upgrade» quest. L|2|•|You can upgrade the handle to your weapon at any time by simply adding another «Bone Handle» to your weapon. L|1|2.|Hunt «Dark Revenant»s (some other «special:whatlinkshere/Dark Revenant Thighbone¦Undead Creatures» also drop the thighbone) until you find a «Dark Revenant Thighbone». L|2|•|Whittling Knife Dark Revenant Thighbone Bone Handle (High) You intricately carve the bone into a handle. L|1|3.|Attach the «Bone Handle» to your «Composite Bow» or «Composite Crossbow» to increase its stats. L|2|•|Bone Handle (Low) Composite Bow Composite Bow with Handle (Low) You deftly attach the handle to the bow. L|2|•|Bone Handle (Medium) Composite Bow Composite Bow with Handle (Medium) L|2|•|Bone Handle (High) Composite Bow Composite Bow with Handle (High) L|2|•|Bone Handle (Low) Composite Crossbow Composite Crossbow with Handle (Low) L|2|•|Bone Handle (Medium) Composite Crossbow Composite Crossbow with Handle (Medium) L|2|•|Bone Handle (High) Composite Crossbow Composite Crossbow with Handle (High)
H3|The Composite Atlatl H4|Step 1: Crafting the Stave L|1|1.|Hunt «Great Mattekar»s until you find **two** «Great Mattekar Horn»s. L|1|2.|Head to «Ayan Baqur» and hand your two «Great Mattekar Horn»s to «Havala bint Mylos». You'll receive two «Carved Great Mattekar Horn»s. L|1|3.|Hunt Lugians until you find **two** «Large Lugian Sinew»s. Quest.name: Enlightenment
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|275 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Viridian Rise» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|{WARN} No Quest Bonus stamps awarded
P|Reset your character to level 1, losing all experience and luminance but gaining a title, two points in vitality and one point in all of your skills. In order to be eligible for enlightenment, you must be level 275, Master rank in a «Societies of Dereth¦Society», and have all luminance auras with the exception of the skill credit auras.
P|As stated in the Spring 2014 patch notes, Enlightenment is a process for the most devoted players of Asheron's Call to continue enhancing characters which have been "maxed out" in terms of experience and abilities. It was not intended to be a quest that every player would undertake or be interested in.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Take the «Temple of the Font» portal located at the base of the Deru Tree on the «Viridian Rise». L|2|•|**Note:** This is a one way trip, there is no portal to get back to the tree. L|1|2.|If you meet the requirements you can click on the «Font of Enlightenment and Rebirth» to enlighten your character. L|2|•|**Requirements**: L|3|•|Level 275 L|3|•|Have all luminance auras (crafting aura included) except the 2 skill credit auras. (20 million total luminance) L|3|•|Have master rank in a society L|3|•|Have 25 unused pack spaces L|3|•|Have become enlightened less than 5 times. L|1|3.|If you choose to become enlightened| L|2|•|**You lose**: L|3|•|All experience, reverting to level 1. L|3|•|All luminance and luminance auras with the exception of the skill credit auras. L|3|•|The ability to use «aetheria» (until you attain sufficient level and re-open aetheria slots). L|3|•|The ability to gain luminance (until you attain level 200 and re-complete «Nalicana's Test»). L|3|•|The ability to equip and use items which have skill and level requirements beyond those of a level 1 character. Any equipped items are moved into your pack automatically. L|2|•|**You keep**: L|3|•|All augmentations obtained through «Augmentation Gems». L|3|•|Skill credits from luminance auras, «Aun Ralirea», and «Chasing Oswald» quests. L|3|•|All quest flags with the exception of aetheria and luminance L|2|•|**You gain**: L|3|•|A new title each time you enlighten L|3|•|+2 to vitality L|3|•|+1 to all of your skills L|3|•|An attribute reset certificate L|1|4.|**Known Bugs**: In the initial release and first hotfix to the Spring 2014 patch, there are bugs in the enlightenment process. L|2|•|Sometimes the character fails to receive the attribute reset certificate for some reason. This does not seem to be related to being overburdened, but can be caused by being at 300% burden after reverting to level 1.

H3|Notes P|The Amateur set has the following characteristics: L|1|•|The armor is level 40+ to wield. L|1|•|The melee weapons require 325 base skill to wield. L|1|•|The missile and magic weapons require base 290 skill to wield. L|1|•|The jewelry and clothing do not have any wield requirements. L|1|•|None of the equipment is attuned, and only the jewelry is bonded.
P|The Seasoned set has the following characteristics: L|1|•|The armor is level 40+ to wield. L|1|•|The melee weapons require 325 base skill to wield. L|1|•|The missile and magic weapons require 290 base skill to wield. L|1|•|The jewelry and clothing do not have any wield requirements. L|1|•|All of the equipement is attuned, bonded, and ivoryable.
P|What this means is: L|1|•|The entire amateur set may be given to and used by another character, but the seasoned set may not. L|1|•|The amateur jewelry and clothing may be given to and equipped by a very low level character. Since the arcane lore requirement is 85 buffed skill, a character in the 10-15 range could likely use these items. L|1|•|Due to the melee weapons' requirements of 325 base skill, it is very unlikely you will be able to use them at level 40. A more reasonable level to obtain 325 base melee skill is around 55 to 65.

Quest.name: Fate_of_Bael'Zharon
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|200 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Isin Dule (Arwic)¦Isin Dule» I|Starts At|«Arwic» at 33.4N, 56.9E I|Repeat|Non Repeatable I|Quest Chain|Shadow Invasion I|1|«Shadow Communication» I|2|«Strange Crystal Quest» I|3|Fate of Bael'Zharon I|4|«Dark Recordings» I|5|«Shadow Assault» I|6|«Tou-Tou Blockade» I|7|«Stop the Rebuilding» H2|Overview L|1|•|Quest three in the Shadow Invasion chain. L|1|•|After completing this quest, you must wait 20 hours? before you may begin the 4th quest: «Dark Recordings». Did not require a wait period to begin the next quest 3/28/26. L|1|•|Choosing a side offers unique title rewards.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|«Isin Dule (Arwic)¦Isin Dule» will ask you to find «Ler Rhan (NPC)¦Ler Rhan», who is located in the buried shadow spire «The Shadows» near Tou Tou at 29.5S, 94.2E. L|1|2.|Travel to Ler Rhan, and he will give you a «Message from Ler Rhan to Ter Shen.». L|2|•|⟦SummoningCaveRhan⟧ L|1|3.|At this point, you must make the decision concerning which side you will take. L|2|•|Note: The Ler Rhan side is considerably easier than the Isin Dule side.
H3|Siding with Ler Rhan L|1|1.|Head directly to the «Summoning Cave» located at 29.2S 95.8E. Do not speak to «Isin Dule (Arwic)¦Isin Dule», if you have already spoken to him see the next section. L|1|2.|You will be ported into a version of the dungeon with NPC shadows. L|1|3.|Find «Ter Shen» and give him the message. L|2|•|⟦SpokeTerShen⟧ L|1|4.|He will instruct you to speak with «Quaron», who is around the corner, who should give you a «Door Key (Summoning Cave)» to use on the two locked doors further down. L|1|5.|Unlock both doors, speak to both «Gatekeeper»s, and they will open the further doors for you. L|1|6.|From here, jump down and find two strange crystals, use them to get a «Strange Purple Crystal from The Shadows». L|2|•|⟦SummoningCaveCrystal1⟧ ⟦SummoningCaveCrystal2⟧ L|1|7.|Once you have two of these, there is a large room in this part of the dungeon which should have spawned two «Bael'Zharon Summoner»s. L|1|8.|Give each summoner a crystal, and defend them until the «Void of Bael'Zharon (NPC)¦Void of Bael'Zharon» spawns, continue to defend until he disappears and drops some «Energy Scintilla»s. L|2|•|Note: If you (or the summoners) die before BZ disappears you will have to start over. You must wait 30 minutes before picking up new crystals. L|1|9.|Bring the «Energy Scintilla» to «Ler Rhan (NPC)¦Ler Rhan» for your reward.
H3|Siding with Isin Dule L|1|1.|After receiving the «Message from Ler Rhan to Ter Shen.», you **must** speak with «Isin Dule (Arwic)¦Isin Dule» again. L|2|•|⟦SummoningCaveDule⟧ L|2|•|Note: If you do not speak with Isin Dule before entering the «Summoning Cave», you will have to complete the quest from the Ler Rhan side (see previous section). L|1|2.|Enter the «Summoning Cave», located at 29.2S 95.8E. L|1|3.|In this version of the dungeon, the shadows are all normal creatures (instead of shadow NPCs). L|1|4.|As you progress through the dungeon, one of the side rooms has a shadow which drops the «Door Key (Summoning Cave)¦Door Key» L|1|5.|Further in you will come to a 3 way split with 2 locked doors (720 resistance), each containing a button that must be pressed. L|1|6.|Unlock each door and press the button in each room, which will open the doors that lead to the summoning room. L|1|7.|Jump down, and take a left. Working your way through the dungeon until you find a room with the «Void of Bael'Zharon (NPC)». L|2|•|Note: There will be human soldiers in this dungeon that are supposed to be fighting with you. However, there may be a bug, because the soldiers will also attack you! L|1|8.|Defeat the «Bael'Zharon Summoner»s and the «Void of Bael'Zharon (NPC)» will disappear, leaving behind «Energy Scintilla»'s on the ground. L|2|•|Note: The summoners in the final room do not show up on radar, select them using bracket keys ( [ ] ), or by directly clicking upon them. L|1|9.|Bring the «Energy Scintilla» back to «Isin Dule (Arwic)¦Isin Dule» for your reward.
P|Notes L|1|•|Crystals have a 30 minute timer on use, if you fail to protect the «Void of Bael'Zharon (NPC)» you must wait to start again. L|1|•|The Dungeons allow logging. So you may run your chars near the end, defeat it once, and then loot on multiple chars.

Quest.name: Forgotten_Tunnels_of_Nyr'leha
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Society Rank|Lord I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Jin Kyong» («Celestial Hand¦CH») «Chun Hei» («Eldrytch Web¦EW») «Myung Hee» («Radiant Blood¦RB») I|Starts At|«Celestial Hand Nyr'leha Beach Fort» at 92.1S, 50.3W «Eldrytch Web Nyr'leha Beach Fort» at 91.4S 53.8W «Radiant Blood Nyr'leha Beach Fort» at 93.6S 51.8W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Forgotten Tunnels of Nyr'leha» H2|Overview
P|{WARN} **This doesn't seem to be implemented on ILT**.
P|Explore a buried temple on west «Moarsman City» island to find four crystals that disrupt energy field generators long enough for you to retrieve two artifacts. Your society rewards you with a society shield.
L|1|•|You must be at least a «Lord» in one of the three «Societies of Dereth» to do this quest (and a «Master» to wield the shield).
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to your society's beach fort on Moarsman City and speak to the appropriate listed NPC. L|1|2.|Head to the «Forgotten Tunnels». There are three different locations, they all go to the same dungeon, just drop you in a different corner of a triangular layout. It makes no difference which portal you use (see below for more details): L|2|•|92.9S, 56.4W L|2|•|93.1S, 56.9W L|2|•|93.6S, 56.6W L|1|3.|You will need four gems for your group (2 purple and 2 orange), designate one person to pick up gems and have only that person pick them up (all gems need to be on the same person). L|1|4.|From the drop either stick left or stick right (you follow a circular path around the triangular shaped dungeon). You will pass 4 rooms with a spawn of sclavus or moarsman. In each room a guardian drops a key («Key (Guardian Moarsman)» and «Key (Guardian Sclavus)») that opens a small side room with one of the four crystals. You will also pass two rooms with golems, for the moment just save the two keys that drop on the golem guardians. L|2|•|NOTE: While all the keys are named "Key" and have 2 uses, each room's key is unique and will only open that room's door, so you will need to kill all six Guardians. L|1|5.|Once you have all four gems (2 «Orange Energy Crystal»s and 2 «Purple Energy Crystal»s) and the two «Key (Guardian Golem)¦Key»s from the golem rooms, head back a golem room (one is on the east side of dungeon and one is on the west side). L|1|6.|Use the key to open the door and use the lever, have the person that picked up all the gems go up the ramp and jump (normal jump straight across the room). The rest of the group should continue circling until they come back to the other golem room, use that room's key to get to lever, now everyone go up ramp and and jump across to join the gems holder. L|2|1.|Directions for person holding all 4 gems: The jump leads into a large room with walkways above a pit full of Slithis. The east and west walkways lead to the two guardian golem rooms. The north and south walkways lead to rooms with the Energy Field Generators. The two levers (one in each golem room) open the north and south doors respectively). Check which one opened first and jump across to the field generator. Each side takes 2 of the gems (North two orange and South two purple). Hand one gem and it will take both of that color). Then use a low power tap jump to return to the slithis area (if you use too much power you will hit your head and fall into the pit with no way back up). L|1|7.|Once the main group has used the other golem lever, the last door will be open (north or south). The gem holder jumps across and hands the remaining two gems then tap jumps back to the slithis area. Everyone should now jump down and use the Energy Ring in the middle of the slithis. This will give everyone an «Energy Ring» (handing in the four gems drops the fields and makes the ring usable, if the fields are still up you won't get a ring in your pack). L|1|8.|You now need to return to the drop area (each drop from each of the three portals has two lever doors by the drop). All three drops (all six doors) lead up to the same location. Handing in the four gems and using the energy ring starts a 5 minute timer. When this timer is up all the lever doors at the bottom of the three dungeon portal drops will open and stay open for 3-5 minutes. If you use a faction statue/portal you have enough time to run back to the dungeon and still make the door. If you jumped back across the pits, just wait at one of the six doors for it to open. L|1|9.|Go up (using a gem style lever to open a door midway) until you come to a large room with a ramp, go up the ramp and jump down (an invisible floor keeps you from falling onto the spikes). L|1|10.|Continue and kill the «Guardian of The Secret Keeper» who opens the two doors by him, they both go to the same place. L|1|11.|Kill «The Secret Keeper». Loot a «Glimmering Shard» (he drops 9). L|1|12.|Return to your faction's fort on Moarsman City island outside (there are no surface portals, you will need to return normally) and give the ring or shard to the NPC (he takes both and gives you xp and the shield for your faction). L|1|13.|The shields are givable, but if you don't want it at all, you can turn it in to the fort NPC for a small amount of xp (3.5 mill).
P|Notes L|1|•|It is unclear why there are two field generators on the south side, perhaps it is an erroneous duplicate.

R|Give unwanted shield to society NPC RK|Experience|3,500,000 (Fixed% up to level ) RE
H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Jin Kyong tells you, "Over on the west side of the island we have discovered a long forgotten system of tunnels under the island. At first look it appears these may be part of an ancient temple. We ask you to investigate this place and bring back to me any items of interest you may find there. But be warned, it is a dangerous place."
H3|Rewards Dialog L|1||You allow Jin Kyong to examine your Energy Ring. L|1||You hand over 1 of your Glimmering Shards. L|1||You hand over 1 of your Energy Rings. L|1||Jin Kyong gives you Shield of the Celestial Hand. L|1||Jin Kyong gives you Braced Mana Forge Key. L|1||You've earned 300,000,000 experience. L|1||You've earned 15,000 Luminance. L|1||Jin Kyong tells you, "I will send these items to our researchers immediately. You say he also mentioned something about the mist and finding white mist in the final room? This is a mystery indeed. Thank you for your efforts soldier, hopefully this all leads to a great discovery."
L|1||You give Jin Kyong Shield of the Celestial Hand. L|1||Jin Kyong tells you, "You don't want this finely crafted shield? Well I shall compensate you for it instead." L|1||You've earned 3,500,00 experience.
H3|Other Interactions H4|Showing Crystals L|1||You allow Jin Kyong to examine your Purple Energy Crystal. L|1||Jin Kyong tells you, "This is an interesting item indeed but I suspect it will lead you to even greater finds."
L|1||You allow Jin Kyong to examine your Orange Energy Crystal. L|1||Jin Kyong tells you, "This is an interesting item indeed but I suspect it will lead you to even greater finds."
H4|Using Field Generator Without Both Crystals
L|1||You feel the energy flowing from this device as your hand nears it. You decide it is best not to touch it.
L|1||You allow Energy Field Generator to examine your Orange Energy Crystal. L|1||You think it would be wise to insert both crystals at the same time.
H4|Using North Field Generator With Both Orange Crystals L|1||You allow Energy Field Generator to examine your Orange Energy Crystal. L|1||You hand over all of your Orange Energy Crystals. L|1||You hand over all of your Orange Energy Crystals. L|1||You drop all of the orange crystals you have into the device.
H4|Using South Field Generator With Both Purple Crystals L|1||You allow Energy Field Generator to examine your Purple Energy Crystal. L|1||You hand over all of your Purple Energy Crystals. L|1||You hand over all of your Purple Energy Crystals. L|1||You drop all of the orange crystals you have into the device.

H4|Using the Energy Ring After Dropping the Energy Field L|1||As you try to grab the ring a new one appears in your hand. L|1||Energy Ring gives you Energy Ring.

Quest.name: Gaerlan's_Citadel_(Extreme)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|80-149 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Arwic» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|**Note:** See «Gaerlan's Citadel (Uber)» for Quest Bonus Stamps
H2|Walkthrough & Notes P|There is a pair of bunkers in «Eastham» (17.1N, 63.0E) that contain many portals related to this quest. Portals exist for the Ziggurats, Proving Grounds and the Citadel Library. If you die or lose connection, you can use the portals for fast re-entry.
H3|Part 1: Lightning Guardian Lair L|1|1.|Enter the «Lightning Guardian Lair» at 86.7S, 10.4E. L|2|•|Route: Take the «Artifice Cottages» portal at 32.9N, 59.4E from «Arwic». L|1|2.|Work your way to the bottom of the dungeon, where you'll find a boss golem for your level range. L|1|3.|Kill the boss golem and take the portal that spawns at the top of the ramp to be portaled to «Citadel Valley».
H3|Part 2: Frost Ziggurat L|1|1.|Jump down off the cliff and run Southeast to 57.8N, 48.4E, where you'll find «Asheron's Platinum Golem». L|1|2.|Speak with «Asheron's Platinum Golem» and you'll receive an «Imbued Pyreal Nugget». L|1|3.|From here, run Southwest and enter the Frost Ziggurat portal at about 57.1N, 47.8E that matches your level range. L|2|•|Note: From this point onward, and until you finish the quest, you may use the Frost Ziggurat portal in the bunkers south of Eastham. L|1|4.|Work your way through this dungeon, always going up, until you reach a «Platinum Golem¦Platinum Golem (NPC)» L|1|5.|Hand the «Platinum Golem¦Platinum Golem (NPC)» your «Imbued Pyreal Nugget», and then enter the Proving Grounds portal located next to him. L|2|•|Note: From this point onward, and until you finish the quest, you may use the Proving Grounds Extreme portal in the bunkers in Eastham.
H3|Part 3: Proving Grounds Extreme P|Inside the proving grounds, you must tackle a series of trials:
H4|Trial 1: The Riddle L|1|1.|Speak with the «Tribunal» located in the center of the room, and you'll be given a riddle. L|1|2.|To answer the riddle, use the statue that corresponds with the right answer. If correct, you'll receive a blue «Seal Fragment (Blue)¦Seal Fragment» and be portaled to the «Rolling Ball of Death¦Rolling Balls of Death».
TH|Question Answer TR|I've legs, and a foot, and also a head. But I cannot think nor move on my own. What am I? **Bed** TR|I am void, and absence, I am not a color. What am I? ** Black** TR|The maker want it not, the buyer does not use it, and the user never sees it. What am I? ** Coffin** TR|No sound, no voice, no breath,no sleep, no thought, no sight, no more. What is it? ** Death** TR|It begins eternity, ends time and space, it rests at the start of every end and the end of every place. What is it? ** E** TR|I never grow, but can become very wide, and everything falls into darkness when I hide. What am I? ** Eyes** TR|I can be an old love, but mostly a lost passion. My life grows as you feed me, but when I drink water I die. ** Flame** TR|What is it that has one voice but becomes four-footed, two-footed, and three-footed? ** Man** TR|I am a room without walls, windows or doors. What am I? ** Mushroom** TR|A poor man has too much of me, a wealthy man needs me not, and if you feast upon me you will die. What am I ? ** Nothing** TR|What has no beginning or end, yet binds two together? ** Ring** TR|You will break me if you name me. What am I? ** Silence** TR|At night they come without being called, but at dawn they are lost without being stolen. What are they? ** Stars** TR|I pass through the water and never get wet. What am I? ** Sunshine** TR|It waits for none and gauges all, it is eaten by leisure and work the same, it is abundant but there never seems to be enough. What is it? ** Time** TR|It never was, is always to be, none have seen it, but many dream of it, it is the hope of all that live that it shall always come. What is it? ** Tomorrow** TR|It cannot be slain so long as there is a ray, it is inspires the heart to wish for the best, yet exercise caution to not lose this gift for then you shall just be forlorn. What is it? ** Hope** TR|I whip, and I whistle all the day long, sometimes my voice can sound as a song. I never grow tired but sometimes grow weak, and I change without warning and cause door to creak. What am I? ** Wind** TE
H4|Trial 2: Rolling Balls of Death L|1|1.|Take a moment to identify the pattern, and when ready, move through the dungeon, only stopping at the safe spots (alcove corners) until you reach the last alcove. L|2|•|Note: The only safe spots to stand inside this dungeon are on the 45 degree angles that are the corners of the alcoves. L|1|2.|Once you get to the last safe spot before the long hallway, you'll see a door. Use missile weapons to destroy the door and then run into the room on the far side. L|1|3.|After the door has been destroyed, carefully make your way to the end of the room and loot an orange «Seal Fragment (Orange)¦Seal Fragment» from the Chest on the South wall, and then use the Proving Grounds portal on the North wall.
H4|Trial 3: Floor Puzzle P|The floor puzzle contains a series of tiles that contain a hidden path to the other side. If you step on a wrong tile you'll fall through and be forced to start over.
L|1|1.|Navigate your way through the Floor Puzzle: L|2|1.|From the left side of the room, walk on to the Fire tile to start. L|2|2.|Move North 3 spaces to the 3rd Frost tile. L|2|3.|Move East 4 spaces to Fire tile. L|2|4.|Move North 1 space to the Frost tile. L|2|5.|Move East 2 spaces to the Acid tile. L|2|6.|Move North 2 spaces to the Frost tile. L|2|7.|Move West 1 space to the Acid tile. L|2|8.|Move North and exit the puzzle. L|1|2.|Enter the room to the North and loot a green «Seal Fragment (Green)¦Seal Fragment» from the Chest on the East wall, and then use the Proving Grounds Extreme portal on the Northwest corner.
H4|Trial 4: Reverence of the Ceremony P|The key to this riddle is to **NOT TALK** in open chat. If you do, you'll have to start over and fight your way through a series of golems. This includes spellcasting and anything that your character says openly. Fellow chat and global channels are still fine. L|3||Reverence must be shown during a ceremony. (Note that sometimes this is bugged; nothing happens some trips when you speak out loud.) L|1|1.|Without speaking, run through the linear dungeon and loot a purple «Seal Fragment (Purple)¦Seal Fragment» from the chest at the end of the hall, then use the «Citadel Valley» portal to complete the Trials.
H3|Part 4: Citadel Library L|1|1.|Combine the the blue and orange «Seal Fragment»s to create a «Combined Seal Fragment (Blue-Orange)¦Combined Seal Fragment». L|1|2.|Combine the green and purple «Seal Fragment»s to create another «Combined Seal Fragment (Green-Purple)¦Combined Seal Fragment». L|1|3.|Combine the 2 «Combined Seal Fragment»s to create an «Ornate Seal». L|1|4.|Return to «Asheron's Platinum Golem» at 57.8N, 48.4E and hand him your «Ornate Seal» to receive an «Imbued Ornate Seal» and a «Citadel Portal Gem». L|1|5.|Use the «Citadel Portal Gem» to be portaled to the Citadel Surface. L|1|6.|Hand your «Imbued Ornate Seal» to any «Ornate Pillar» on the structure to be portaled to the «Citadel Library». L|2|•|Note: From this point onward, and until you finish the quest, you may use the Citadel Library portal in the bunkers in Eastham. L|1|7.|From the drop, use the East facing staircase just to your front left and take it all the way to the platform at the top of the dungeon. L|1|8.|At the top, take the Electric Destruction portal at the very top to be portaled to final part of the quest.
H3|Part 5: Electric Destruction: Gaerlan Electric Aspect L|1|1.|From the drop, follow the linear dungeon until you reach a catwalk, from which you can see «Gaerlan» himself in the room below. L|1|2.|Fully debuff and fester «Gaerlan», and then kill him with Pierce or Slash weapons. L|2|•|{TIP} A common strategy is have melee players form a melee wall on the catwalk, and then drag him up to the catwalk. This way mages and archers can attack from a safe distance. L|1|3.|Once Gaerlan is dead and vanishes, quickly take the portal to «Gaerlan's Inner Sanctum» that spawns in the room under the catwalk. L|1|4.|From the drop head up the ramp to the South, take your first 2 lefts, and then your first right. L|1|5.|At the T intersection, take either direction and run until you reach a pit of acid or fire. Jump down into the room with «Gaerlan's Phylacteric Prison». L|1|6.|Use the prison to receive your rewards. L|1|7.|{OPT} Take the «Citadel Apex» portal on the south wall and loot «Martine's Mask» and «Martine's Robe».
H3|Notes P|There are various bookshelves in the Citadel Library that can be used for lore dialog, an to obtain lore texts: L|1|•|«Bookshelf (Citadel Library - Falatacot)» - use for additional lore dialog. L|1|•|«Bookshelf (Citadel Library - Dericost)» - use once to obtain the tomes listed below, use repeatedly for additional lore dialog. L|2|•|«Decrepit Tome (Untranslated)¦Decrepit Tome» L|2|•|«Fiery Tome» L|2|•|«Icy Tome» L|2|•|«Ebuillant Tome» L|2|•|«Charged Tome» L|1|•|«Bookshelf (Citadel Library - Yalain)» - use once to obtain the «Leather Bound Tome», use repeatedly for additional lore dialog. L|1|•|The texts can be translated into the following: L|2|•|«Decrepit Tome (Untranslated)¦Decrepit Tome» - translates into «Decrepit Tome (Translated)¦Decrepit Tome» L|2|•|«Charged Tome» - translates into «Disciples of Tempest» L|2|•|«Ebuillant Tome» - translates into «Disciples of Corrosion» L|2|•|«Fiery Tome» - translates into «Disciples of Strife» L|2|•|«Icy Tome» - translates into «Disciples of Stasis» L|2|•|«Leather Bound Tome» - translates into «Gaerlan's Research Notes»

H2|Rewards L|1|•|The additional item rewards are distributed based on what skills you have trained or above. The item you get will go in order from the most skill credits to train the skill down to the least, then restart. (For War, and its 4 staves, this means you must do 3 full
R|Use «Gaerlan's Phylacteric Prison» RK|Experience|41,246,375 (30% up to level 120) RK|Items| RI|«Elemental Master Robe» RI|«Iasparailaun» RI|One additional item: Bracelet of Knowledge Circlet of Supremacy Ring of Intellect Daulan Faur Dauloirae Saelgauloi Dauloi Falauloi Gauraloi Habraeloi Lautaloi Palauloi Raudaloi Sacraloi Saulandoi Shauraloi Taulandoi Tauraloi RE
R|Give «Iasparailaun» to an Agent of the Arcanum RK|Experience|22,000,000 (Fixed% up to level ) RK|Title|Gaerlan Slayer RK|Items| RI|«Gaerlan Token» RI|«Trade Note (100,000)» (x2) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Asheron's Platinum Golem⸩ ⸨Asheron's Platinum Golem tells you, "Though lord Asheron does not condone the horror wrought upon him, I have been placed here to assist those that would strike down the undead form of Gaerlan.⸩ ⸨Asheron's Platinum Golem tells you, "Where once he meant to control the world and destroy my lord Asheron, now he suffers for eternity, now he has been given over unwillingly to the carrion call of the undead by Nuhmudira.⸩ ⸨Asheron's Platinum Golem tells you, "Enter and activate the Platinum golems so they may hold the citadel open for you as you progress. You will need this to awaken my brethren within. When they are awake you shall be asked to past the tests that all must face to pass deeper into the citadel.⸩ ⸨Asheron's Platinum Golem gives you Imbued Pyreal Nugget⸩ ⸨Asheron's Platinum Golem tells you, "The portals into the citadel's inverted ziggurat lay nearby. Complete this task and the magic within the pyreal will allow Asheron's voice to enter you. I will speak to you more once this is accomplished.
L|1||Giving Imbued Pyreal Nugget to Platinum Golem⸩ ⸨You give Platinum Golem Imbued Pyreal Nugget⸩ ⸨Platinum Golem says, "I hear and obey Lord Asheron Realadain.⸩ ⸨Asheron's voice fills your mind, "You have done well. Now you must pass a set of trials that the citadel itself will place before you. In a sense it lives, as this was the design of the Empyrean from before my years. You must not fail. Failure can lead to death. I will ensure that portals are created to assist you should you meet with misadventure.
L|1||Giving Ornate Seal to Asheron's Platinum Golem⸩ ⸨You give Asheron's Platinum Golem Ornate Seal⸩ ⸨Asheron's Platinum Golem tells you, "This was constructed by the most ancient of the Empyrean people.⸩ ⸨Asheron's Platinum Golem tells you, "I have been given gems that will portal you onto the citadel. There you should find entrance into the library. They will appear as pillars of a bygone era. Give this seal to the pillars. Once done, you should be transported into the lowest level of the sanctum, located in the tower.⸩ ⸨Asheron's Platinum Golem tells you, "Lord Asheron wishes you well on your endeavor.⸩ ⸨Asheron's Platinum Golem gives you Imbued Ornate Seal⸩ ⸨Asheron's Platinum Golem gives you Citadel Portal Gem
L|1||Defeating Gaerlan's Electric Aspect⸩ ⸨ has defeated Gaerlan's electric aspect. As the illusion crumbles away a deep voice thunders over the world, "A doomed eternity to relive this life. Stasis within the walls of a crystalline prison. How could I have fallen to you vermin. Nuhmudira, my revenge upon you shall be as painful as yours upon me."⸩

Quest.name: Gaerlan's_Citadel_(Low)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|20-39 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Arwic» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|**Note:** See «Gaerlan's Citadel (Uber)» for Quest Bonus Stamps
H2|Walkthrough & Notes P|There is a pair of bunkers in «Eastham» (17.1N, 63.0E) that contain many portals related to this quest. Portals exist for the Ziggurats, Proving Grounds and the Citadel Library. If you die or lose connection, you can use the portals for fast re-entry.
H3|Part 1: Frost Guardian Lair L|1|1.|Enter to the «Frost Guardian Lair» at 52.8N, 62.4E. L|2|•|Route: Take the «Sennon Valley Retreat» portal at 32.9N, 59.4E from «Arwic». L|1|2.|Work your way to the bottom of the dungeon, where you'll find a boss golem for your level range. L|1|3.|Kill the boss golem and take the portal that spawns at the top of the ramp to be portaled to «Citadel Valley».
H3|Part 2: Lightning Ziggurat L|1|1.|Jump down off the cliff and run Southeast to 57.8N, 48.4E, where you'll find «Asheron's Platinum Golem». L|1|2.|Speak with «Asheron's Platinum Golem» and you'll receive an «Imbued Pyreal Nugget». L|1|3.|From here, run Southwest and enter the «Lightning Ziggurat»at about 57.1N, 47.8E. L|2|•|Note: From this point onward, and until you finish the quest, you may use the Ziggurat portal in the bunkers south of Eastham. L|1|4.|Work your way through this dungeon, always going up, until you reach a «Platinum Golem¦Platinum Golem (NPC)» L|1|5.|Hand the «Platinum Golem¦Platinum Golem (NPC)» your «Imbued Pyreal Nugget», and then enter the Proving Grounds portal located next to him. L|2|•|Note: From this point onward, and until you finish the quest, you may use the Proving Grounds portal appropriate for your level range in the bunkers in Eastham.
H3|Part 3: Proving Grounds Low P|Inside the proving grounds, you must tackle a series of trials:
H4|Trial 1: The Riddle L|1|1.|Speak with the «Tribunal» located in the center of the room, and you'll be given a riddle. L|1|2.|To answer the riddle, use the statue that corresponds with the right answer. If correct, you'll receive a blue «Seal Fragment (Blue)¦Seal Fragment» and be portaled to the «Rolling Ball of Death¦Rolling Balls of Death».
TH|Question Answer TR|I've legs, and a foot, and also a head. But I cannot think nor move on my own. What am I? **Bed** TR|I am void, and absence, I am not a color. What am I? ** Black** TR|The maker want it not, the buyer does not use it, and the user never sees it. What am I? ** Coffin** TR|No sound, no voice, no breath,no sleep, no thought, no sight, no more. What is it? ** Death** TR|It begins eternity, ends time and space, it rests at the start of every end and the end of every place. What is it? ** E** TR|I never grow, but can become very wide, and everything falls into darkness when I hide. What am I? ** Eyes** TR|I can be an old love, but mostly a lost passion. My life grows as you feed me, but when I drink water I die. ** Flame** TR|What is it that has one voice but becomes four-footed, two-footed, and three-footed? ** Man** TR|I am a room without walls, windows or doors. What am I? ** Mushroom** TR|A poor man has too much of me, a wealthy man needs me not, and if you feast upon me you will die. What am I ? ** Nothing** TR|What has no beginning or end, yet binds two together? ** Ring** TR|You will break me if you name me. What am I? ** Silence** TR|At night they come without being called, but at dawn they are lost without being stolen. What are they? ** Stars** TR|I pass through the water and never get wet. What am I? ** Sunshine** TR|It waits for none and gauges all, it is eaten by leisure and work the same, it is abundant but there never seems to be enough. What is it? ** Time** TR|It never was, is always to be, none have seen it, but many dream of it, it is the hope of all that live that it shall always come. What is it? ** Tomorrow** TR|It cannot be slain so long as there is a ray, it is inspires the heart to wish for the best, yet exercise caution to not lose this gift for then you shall just be forlorn. What is it? ** Hope** TR|I whip, and I whistle all the day long, sometimes my voice can sound as a song. I never grow tired but sometimes grow weak, and I change without warning and cause door to creak. What am I? ** Wind** TE
H4|Trial 2: Rolling Balls of Death L|1|1.|Take a moment to identify the pattern, and when ready, move through the dungeon, only stopping at the safe spots (alcove corners) until you reach the last alcove. L|2|•|Note: The only safe spots to stand inside this dungeon are on the 45 degree angles that are the corners of the alcoves. L|1|2.|Once you get to the last safe spot before the long hallway, you'll see a door. Use missile weapons to destroy the door and then run into the room on the far side. L|1|3.|After the door has been destroyed, carefully make your way to the end of the room and loot an orange «Seal Fragment (Orange)¦Seal Fragment» from the Chest on the South wall, and then use the Proving Grounds portal on the North wall.
H4|Trial 3: Floor Puzzle P|The floor puzzle contains a series of tiles that contain a hidden path to the other side. If you step on a wrong tile you'll fall through and be forced to start over.
L|1|1.|Navigate your way through the Floor Puzzle: L|2|1.|From the left side of the room, walk on to the Fire tile to start. L|2|2.|Move North 3 spaces to the 3rd Frost tile. L|2|3.|Move East 4 spaces to Fire tile. L|2|4.|Move North 1 space to the Frost tile. L|2|5.|Move East 2 spaces to the Acid tile. L|2|6.|Move North 2 spaces to the Frost tile. L|2|7.|Move West 1 space to the Acid tile. L|2|8.|Move North and exit the puzzle. L|1|2.|Enter the room to the North and loot a green «Seal Fragment (Green)¦Seal Fragment» from the Chest on the East wall, and then use the Proving Grounds Extreme portal on the Northwest corner.
H4|Trial 4: Reverence of the Ceremony P|The key to this riddle is to **NOT TALK** in open chat. If you do, you'll have to start over and fight your way through a series of golems. This includes spellcasting and anything that your character says openly. Fellow chat and global channels are still fine. L|3||Reverence must be shown during a ceremony. (Note that sometimes this is bugged; nothing happens some trips when you speak out loud.) L|1|1.|Without speaking, run through the linear dungeon and loot a purple «Seal Fragment (Purple)¦Seal Fragment» from the chest at the end of the hall, then use the «Citadel Valley» portal to complete the Trials.
H3|Part 4: Citadel Library L|1|1.|Combine the the blue and orange «Seal Fragment»s to create a «Combined Seal Fragment (Blue-Orange)¦Combined Seal Fragment». L|1|2.|Combine the green and purple «Seal Fragment»s to create another «Combined Seal Fragment (Green-Purple)¦Combined Seal Fragment». L|1|3.|Combine the 2 «Combined Seal Fragment»s to create an «Ornate Seal». L|1|4.|Return to «Asheron's Platinum Golem» at 57.8N, 48.4E and hand him your «Ornate Seal» to receive an «Imbued Ornate Seal» and a «Citadel Portal Gem». L|1|5.|Use the «Citadel Portal Gem» to be portaled to the Citadel Surface. L|1|6.|Hand your «Imbued Ornate Seal» to any «Ornate Pillar» on the structure to be portaled to the «Citadel Library». L|2|•|Note: From this point onward, and until you finish the quest, you may use the Citadel Library portal in the bunkers in Eastham. L|1|7.|From the drop, use the East facing staircase just to your front left and take it all the way to the platform at the top of the dungeon. L|1|8.|At the top, take the Icy Demise portal at the very top to be portaled to final part of the quest.
H3|Part 5: Icy Demise: Gaerlan's Frost Aspect L|1|1.|From the drop, follow the linear dungeon until you reach a catwalk, from which you can see «Gaerlan» himself in the room below. L|1|2.|Fully debuff and fester «Gaerlan», and then kill him with Pierce or Slash weapons. L|2|•|{TIP} A common strategy is have melee players form a melee wall on the catwalk, and then drag him up to the catwalk. This way mages and archers can attack from a safe distance. L|1|3.|Once Gaerlan is dead and vanishes, quickly take the portal to «Gaerlan's Inner Sanctum» that spawns in the room under the catwalk. L|1|4.|From the drop head up the ramp to the South, take your first 2 lefts, and then your first right. L|1|5.|At the T intersection, take either direction and run until you reach a pit of acid or fire. Jump down into the room with «Gaerlan's Phylacteric Prison». L|1|6.|Use the prison to receive your rewards. L|1|7.|{OPT} Take the «Citadel Apex» portal on the south wall and loot «Martine's Mask» and «Martine's Robe».

L|1|7.|From the drop, use the East facing staircase just to your front left and take it all the way to the platform at the top of the dungeon. L|1|8.|At the top, take the Fiery Consumption portal at the very top to be portaled to final part of the quest.
H3|Part 5: Fiery Consumption: Gaerlan's Fire Aspect L|1|1.|From the drop, follow the linear dungeon until you reach a catwalk, from which you can see «Gaerlan» himself in the room below. L|1|2.|Fully debuff and fester «Gaerlan», and then kill him with Pierce or Slash weapons. L|2|•|{TIP} A common strategy is have melee players form a melee wall on the catwalk, and then drag him up to the catwalk. This way mages and archers can attack from a safe distance. L|1|3.|Once Gaerlan is dead and vanishes, quickly take the portal to «Gaerlan's Inner Sanctum» that spawns in the room under the catwalk. L|1|4.|From the drop head up the ramp to the South, take your first 2 lefts, and then your first right. L|1|5.|At the T intersection, take either direction and run until you reach a pit of acid or fire. Jump down into the room with «Gaerlan's Phylacteric Prison». L|1|6.|Use the prison to receive your rewards. L|1|7.|{OPT} Take the «Citadel Apex» portal on the south wall and loot «Martine's Mask» and «Martine's Robe».
H3|Notes P|There are various bookshelves in the Citadel Library that can be used for lore dialog, an to obtain lore texts: L|1|•|«Bookshelf (Citadel Library - Falatacot)» - use for additional lore dialog. L|1|•|«Bookshelf (Citadel Library - Dericost)» - use once to obtain the tomes listed below, use repeatedly for additional lore dialog. Quest.name: Gaerlan's_Citadel_(Uber)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Fort Tethana» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes P|There is a pair of bunkers in «Eastham» (17.1N, 63.0E) that contain many portals related to this quest. Portals exist for the Ziggurats, Proving Grounds and the Citadel Library. If you die or lose connection, you can use the portals for fast re-entry.
H3|Part 1: Prismatic Guardian Lair L|1|1.|Enter the «Prismatic Guardian Lair» at 10.9N, 81.2W. L|2|•|Route: Either from NW Direlands Aerlinthe portal or from Fort Tethana. L|1|2.|Work your way to the bottom of the dungeon, where you'll find a boss golem for your level range. L|1|3.|Kill the boss golem and take the portal that spawns at the top of the ramp to be portaled to «Citadel Valley». L|2|•|⟦GaerlanQuest⟧
H3|Part 2: Prismatic Ziggurat L|1|1.|Jump down off the cliff and run Southeast to 57.8N, 48.4E. L|1|2.|Speak with «Asheron's Platinum Golem» and you'll receive an «Imbued Pyreal Nugget». L|2|•|⟦ZigguratEntrance⟧ L|1|3.|From here, run Southwest and enter the Prismatic Ziggurat portal at about 57.1N, 47.8E. L|2|•|Note: From this point onward, and until you finish the quest, you may use the Prismatic Ziggurat in the bunkers south of Eastham. L|1|4.|Work your way through this dungeon, always going up, until you reach a «Platinum Golem» NPC. L|1|5.|Hand the Golem your Imbued Pyreal Nugget, and then enter the Proving Grounds portal located next to him. L|2|•|⟦ProvingGrounds⟧ L|2|•|Note: From this point onward, and until you finish the quest, you may use the Proving Grounds Uber portal in the bunkers in Eastham at 17.2N 63.0E
H3|Part 3: Proving Grounds Uber P|Inside the proving grounds, you must tackle a series of trials:
H4|Trial 1: The Riddle L|1|•|Infinite Leaftide Note: There are two quest stamps to be obtained by failing the riddles twice: L|2|1.|⟦RiddleFail⟧ L|2|2.|⟦RiddleFail2⟧ L|1|1.|Speak with the «Tribunal» located in the center of the room, and you'll be given a riddle. L|2|•|First Time: ⟦HasSphinxRiddle⟧ L|1|2.|To answer the riddle, use the statue that corresponds with the right answer. If correct, you'll receive a blue «Seal Fragment (Blue)¦Seal Fragment» and be portaled to the «Rolling Ball of Death¦Rolling Balls of Death».
TH|Question Answer Stamp TR|I've legs, and a foot, and also a head. But I cannot think nor move on my own. What am I? **Bed** ⟦RiddleBed⟧ TR|I am void, and absence, I am not a color. What am I? ** Black** ⟦RiddleBlack⟧ TR|The maker want it not, the buyer does not use it, and the user never sees it. What am I? ** Coffin** ⟦RiddleCoffin⟧ TR| ** Darkness** ⟦RiddleDarkness⟧ TR|No sound, no voice, no breath,no sleep, no thought, no sight, no more. What is it? ** Death** ⟦RiddleDeath⟧ TR|It begins eternity, ends time and space, it rests at the start of every end and the end of every place. What is it? ** E** ⟦RiddleE⟧ TR|I never grow, but can become very wide, and everything falls into darkness when I hide. What am I? ** Eyes** ⟦RiddleEyes⟧ TR|I can be an old love, but mostly a lost passion. My life grows as you feed me, but when I drink water I die. ** Flame** ⟦RiddleFlame⟧ TR|What is it that has one voice but becomes four-footed, two-footed, and three-footed? ** Man** ⟦RiddleMan⟧ TR|I am a room without walls, windows or doors. What am I? ** Mushroom** ⟦RiddleMushroom⟧ TR|A poor man has too much of me, a wealthy man needs me not, and if you feast upon me you will die. What am I ? ** Nothing** ⟦RiddleNothing⟧ TR|What has no beginning or end, yet binds two together? ** Ring** ⟦RiddleRing⟧ TR|You will break me if you name me. What am I? ** Silence** ⟦RiddleSilence⟧ TR|At night they come without being called, but at dawn they are lost without being stolen. What are they? ** Stars** ⟦RiddleStars⟧ TR|I pass through the water and never get wet. What am I? ** Sunshine** ⟦RiddleSunlight⟧ TR|It waits for none and gauges all, it is eaten by leisure and work the same, it is abundant but there never seems to be enough. What is it? ** Time** ⟦RiddleTime⟧ TR|It never was, is always to be, none have seen it, but many dream of it, it is the hope of all that live that it shall always come. What is it? ** Tomorrow** ⟦RiddleTomorrow⟧ TR|It cannot be slain so long as there is a ray, it is inspires the heart to wish for the best, yet exercise caution to not lose this gift for then you shall just be forlorn. What is it? ** Hope** ⟦RiddleHope⟧ TR|I whip, and I whistle all the day long, sometimes my voice can sound as a song. I never grow tired but sometimes grow weak, and I change without warning and cause door to creak. What am I? ** Wind** ⟦RiddleWind⟧ TE
H4|Trial 2: Rolling Balls of Death L|1|1.|Take a moment to identify the pattern, and when ready, move through the dungeon, only stopping at the safe spots (alcove corners) until you reach the last alcove. L|2|•|Note: The only safe spots to stand inside this dungeon are on the 45 degree angles that are the corners of the alcoves. L|1|2.|Once you get to the last safe spot before the long hallway, you'll see a door. Use missile weapons to destroy the door and then run into the room on the far side. L|1|3.|After the door has been destroyed, carefully make your way to the end of the room and loot an orange «Seal Fragment (Orange)¦Seal Fragment» from the Chest on the South wall, and then use the Proving Grounds portal on the North wall. L|2|•|⟦ProvingGroundsRollingDeath⟧
H4|Trial 3: Floor Puzzle P|The floor puzzle contains a series of tiles that contain a hidden path to the other side. If you step on a wrong tile you'll fall through and be forced to start over.
L|1|1.|Navigate your way through the Floor Puzzle: L|2|1.|From the left side of the room, walk on to the Fire tile to start. L|2|2.|Move North 3 spaces to the 3rd Frost tile. L|2|3.|Move East 4 spaces to Fire tile. L|2|4.|Move North 1 space to the Frost tile. L|2|5.|Move East 2 spaces to the Acid tile. L|2|6.|Move North 2 spaces to the Frost tile. L|2|7.|Move West 1 space to the Acid tile. L|2|8.|Move North and exit the puzzle. L|1|2.|Enter the room to the North and loot a green «Seal Fragment (Green)¦Seal Fragment» from the Chest on the East wall, and then use the Proving Grounds Extreme portal on the Northwest corner. L|2|•|⟦ProvingGroundsFloorWalk⟧
H4|Trial 4: Reverence of the Ceremony P|The key to this riddle is to **NOT TALK** in open chat. If you do, you'll have to start over and fight your way through a series of golems. L|2|•|⟦ProvingGroundsComplete⟧ L|1|2.|Use the «Citadel Valley» portal to complete the Trials.

Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Gauntlet» I|Kill Task|False H2|Overview P|Defeat the three «Gauntlet» bosses.

Quest.name: Ghost_Hunter_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|100 I|Rec. Level|150 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Sharia Blackmist» I|Starts At|«Graveyard» at 65.3S, 43.3W I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|«Sharia Blackmist» investigates the paranormal for the Arcanum. Help her do some ghost busting by banishing 3 ghosts beneath the newly unearthed «Mhoire Castle» in Graveyard.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk with «Sharia Blackmist». L|2|•|⟦SpokeWithSharia⟧ L|1|2.|Sharia will give you a «Crystal of Spectral Blood» and a «Skull of One Thousand Torments». L|1|3.|Just outside the Graveyard to the northwest is a large rubble strewn pit at 64.4S 45.1W where the «Mhoire Castle» once erupted from the ground. L|1|4.|Walk around the pit using the Crystal every 10 feet or so. If there is no ghost nearby there will be no message. If a ghost is somewhat close but not near the message will be will be: The jewel swirls with a blood red color. If there is a ghost very close by the message will also include: You hear a faint whisper saying "A spirit is close now. I can taste it." L|1|5.|Once you find a location with a ghost, an area with a radius of about 15 feet will have a ghost somewhere within it (continue using the crystal to make sure you haven't left the area). Wander around within the area where a ghost is using the Skull until you get close enough to kill it (there will be no indication how close you are until you kill it) and you get the message: :A resonant voice cries out in anguish. L|1|6.|On the ground will be a «Spectral Heart». Repeat two more times until you have 3 hearts then return to Sharia and give them to her. L|2|•|⟦GhostHunterWait⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|The ghosts can be found during the night and during the day.
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.
H2|Rewards
R| RK|Experience|35,000,000 (Fixed% up to level ) RK|Items| RI|«Adventurer's Token» (x2) RE
H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Sharia Blackmist tells you, "Greetings. The Blackmist family has accepted the position of investigators of the paranormal for the Arcanum." L|1||Sharia Blackmist gives you Crystal of Spectral Blood. L|1||Sharia Blackmist tells you, "The recent unearthing of Mhoire Castle has left unusual paranormal disturbances in the rubble left behind. These unseen spirits corrupt the magic in this area. I need you to find and destroy the spirits there. Unfortunately the spirits are invisible and incorporeal." L|1||Sharia Blackmist tells you, "I have developed two pieces of arcane equipment to locate and banish these spirits." L|1||Sharia Blackmist gives you Skull of One Thousand Torments. L|1||Sharia Blackmist tells you, "The Crystal of Spectral blood will glow red when it detects a spirit. If the spirit is close it will whisper to you." L|1||Sharia Blackmist tells you, "The Skull of One Thousand Torments can destroy these spirits. The problem is you must be very close to a spirit for it to work. It alos takes a few seconds to recharge." L|1||Sharia Blackmist tells you, "You must figure out the location of these spirits using the crystal and destroy three of them. Nothing will be left except for their corrupted, spectral hearts." L|1||Sharia Blackmist tells you, "When you have obtained three hearts as proof that you have destroyed them hand one to me and I will reward you for your efforts."
H3|Completing Quest L|1||Sharia Blackmist tells you, "Greetings. The Blackmist family has accepted the position of investigators of the paranormal for the Arcanum." L|1||Sharia Blackmist tells you, "Have you destroyed three of these invisible spirits and retrieved their hearts? L|1||You allow Sharia Blackmist to examine your Spectral Heart. L|1||Sharia Blackmist tells you, "Excellent! I can now finish my studies! Take these tokens as a reward. L|1||You hand over all of your Crystal of Spectral Bloods. L|1||You hand over all of your Skull of One Thousand Tormentss. L|1||You've earned 35,000,000 experience. Quest.name: Glenden_Wood_Dungeon_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|30.0N, 26.4E in «Glenden Wood Dungeon» I|Route|«Glenden Wood» I|Repeat|None H2|Overview P|This quest involves collecting a series of keys which will unlock the way to the «Oversized Banderling Ogre» and his «Platemail Hauberk of the Ogre¦Platemail Hauberk».
L|1|•|If you have the lockpick skill you do not need any of the keys - highest lock is 162 resistance.
P|{WARN} No Quest Bonus stamps awarded - Only stamp is from «Undead Mechanic Quest»
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Step 1: Plain-Looking Key L|1|1.|From the drop go northwest and head through the large room, you should see two passages, take the passage on your right heading north. L|1|2.|From the dining area, take the west exit at the opposite end of the room. L|1|3.|Continue west through a room with benches and a desk into a smaller room with a wooden door to your right. L|1|4.|Behind the door should be three Drudges, one of which is a «Drudge Hoarder», kill it for the «Key (Plain-Looking)¦Plain-Looking Key».
H3|Step 2: Rusty Key L|1|1.|Head back into the room with the benches and unlock the door (res.100) to the north with your key. L|1|2.|Go up the stairs to a small room overlooking an area with two «Lich»s and a «Banderling Bloodblade» locked inside a room directly beneath you. L|1|3.|Jump down whilst taking care as the Lichs cast spells that could kill a lower level character. L|1|4.|Dispatch the Lichs and unlock the door (res.100) to the Bloodblade, kill it and loot the «Key (Rusty Key)¦Rusty Key».
H3|Step 3: Antique Key L|1|1.|Exit this area through the south door and go left heading east into the prison cells section of the dungeon. L|1|2.|Continue on and turn right just before the lone «Banderling Ogre» that is guarding a chest. L|1|3.|The second cell to your right has a strangely «Large Silver Rat». Unlock the doors (res.82) with the rusty key and kill it for the «Key (Antique Key)¦Antique Key».
H3|Step 4: The Oversized Banderling Ogre L|1|1.|Return to the Banderling that you saw before: L|2|•|If you have the lockpick skill, head north up the corridor and go through the second to last cell. This leads directly to a room with a chest, then go down ramp 6 on the map. L|2|•|If you do not have the lockpick skill, head south down the corridor to the last room and open it with one of your keys. Then go down ramp 1 on the map (gather the «Alloy Tool» if you wish) and back up ramp 3 - then you can proceed down ramp 6. L|3|•|⟦UndeadMechanismPickup4⟧ L|1|2.|You'll find yourself in a very long corridor. Once you meet some rooms at the end, go north and then west into the room with the «Oversized Banderling Ogre». L|1|3.|Kill the Ogre and loot the «Platemail Hauberk of the Ogre», and (optionally) 250 «Fire Arrows» and an «Key (Oddly-Shaped)¦Oddly-Shaped Key». L|2|•|Return to the «Facility Hub» and show the hauberk to the correct Warden for your reward. L|1|4.|If you wish to use the key the Banderling dropped, return to the room at the top of ramp 6 on the map - the key is for the chest in this room.

This dungeon is overrun by creatures that were once contained in its cells."⸩ ⸨Warden tells you, "This will be the greatest dungeoneering challange you've faced yet. You'll need to find creatures that hold the keys or lockpick the doors yourself."⸩ ⸨Warden tells you, "Fight your way through the dungeon and find the Oversized Banderling Ogre. Kill it and recover its Platemail Hauberk."⸩ ⸨Warden tells you, "The portal behind me will take you to Glendon Wood outside the dungeon. Find the Hauberk in the dungeon and return to me with it."

I as I thought you were very capable and I'm sure you completed this task with ease. This is a very nice piece of armor, keep it if you can make use of it."⸩ ⸨Warden tells you, "If you have no use for it I'm sure a shopkeep would be willing to offer you a small stack of pyreals in exchange for it."⸩

Quest.name: Gold_Hill_Ruins_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Gold Hill Ruins» I|Route|«Gold Hill Ruins (Portal Gem)¦Gold Hill Ruins Portal Gem» I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Overview P|"There's gold on that hill. While huntin' along the inland sea I got me a gem like this one off a Sclavus. It summoned a portal to a hill where the Sclavus were protectin' some sorta ruin. They forced me offin' that hill, but not before I caught me a glimpse of somethin' gold shinin' in the ruins. I finally found another one of these gems and I'm goin' back for the gold just as soon as I kill me another Sclavus. - Harker Shan-ue of the Exploration Society."
L|1|•|To access this quest, you must first obtain a «Gold Hill Ruins (Portal Gem)¦Gold Hill Ruins Portal Gem» dropped by some Sclavus creatures such as «Chomu Sclavus» and «Faisi Sclavus».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Use the gem in an open space to summon a portal to the «Gold Hill Ruins», a location outside on a hill at 21.2N, 12.6W. L|1|2.|It is a safe drop. On the hill, in between the ruins, lots of «Sclavus» spawn| «Chomu Sclavus», «Faisi Sclavus», «Aste Sclavus Lord», «Essa Sclavus Lord» L|1|3.|On the ground, at 21.0N 12.7W, you find a «Large Golden Coin». L|2|•|⟦CoinAttachmentPickup⟧ L|1|4.|Runed Chest at 21.3N, 12.4W L|2|•|⟦ChestQuestCoinAttachment⟧ L|1|5.|Give the Coin to a Beggar, such as «Binthura the Beggar» in «Dryreach». L|1|6.|She will give you a «Serpent Ring», and a «Philanthropist Title Token» which can be turned in at the «Bestowers' Guild of Dereth» in «Eastham», «Lin», or «Qalaba'r» for the title reward.
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.

R| RK|Title|Philanthropist RK|Items| RI|«Serpent Ring» RI|«Philanthropist Title Token» RE

I can get a good meal and a hot bath with this!"⸩ ⸨The snake sighs and uncoils from the coin.⸩ ⸨"You have lifted the curse. Finally, I may rest." The small snake coils in on itself biting its tail.⸩ ⸨Binthura the Beggar gives you Serpent Ring.⸩ ⸨Binthura the Beggar tells you, "Here, a small token of my gratitude."⸩ ⸨Binthura the Beggar gives you Philanthropist Title Token.

L|1|•|This is a randomly occurring quest/event that is only active during the festival season. See also: «Seasonal Quests and Events».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|A global precedes the beginning of the raid with an announcement of the location. L|2|•|The town chosen is random. The following locations have been verified: «Tufa», «Al-Jalima», «Samsur», «Khayyaban», «Xarabydun» L|1|2.|In the town, a huge «Holiday Present (Gurog Present Raids)¦Holiday Present» appears, which is attackable. Do not use summons nearby or they will attack the present! L|1|3.|After a few minutes, waves of «Gurog Grump»s will spawn and will try to attack and destroy the «Holiday_Present_(Gurog_Present_Raids)¦Holiday Present». After several waves a «Gurog Mastermind» and the rat «Max» will appear. L|2|•|«Max» drops one random trophy item. L|1|4.|If all the enemies are killed and the present is still intact, it will become usable. Use the present to receive your rewards. Quest.name: Hammer_of_Lightning_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Bellig Tower Base» at 17.8N, 16.0E I|Route|Direct from «Zaikhal», or via portal in the «Facility Hub» I|Repeat|None H2|Overview P|This is one of the original quests of AC. Thankfully the «Hammer of Lightning» was updated since then so a low level axe character may find it useful.
P|{WARN} No Quest Bonus stamps awarded
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|From the drop, take either of the two north passages and go up the ramp. L|1|2.|Follow the corridor around to the south exit. L|1|3.|At the split, take either of the passages up to another split. Head right here and then left up the long ramp. L|1|4.|You should now be on bridge that you can cross to the north exit. L|1|5.|Head north and you will start climbing a series of ramps with a room of Golems at each level. L|1|6.|Ignoring the Golems keep taking ramps up until you come to a corridor with a side room full of bookshelves. L|1|7.|Kill the «Revenant» in this room and loot the «Hammer of Lightning».
P|Notes L|1|•|In the Revenant's lair there is a «History Shelf» from which you can take «General History of Dereth Vol. I» through «General History of Dereth Vol. XI¦Vol. XI».

Quest.name: Hollow_Weapons_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Lugian Mines» at 73.9S, 39.0E I|Route|«Qalaba'r» to «Southern Park» settlement portal at 74.8S, 17.8E. I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to create hollow weapons that are impervious to magical protections (ignores modified armor and protection values).
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Once inside keep heading south. After heading down a ramp you'll reach a large open room. You can reach deposits at the ends of either route exiting this room. L|1|2.|You will need a «Lugian Pick Axe» to mine the ore. They can be found on any of the «Laigus Lugian» in the mine. L|1|3.|Use the pick axe on the deposit to receive your «Chunk of Low-Grade Chorizite». You are able to mine more than one chunk of ore but you only need one for the quest. L|1|4.|Head to Feruza's «Beach Fort» and give the Ore to «Feruza ibn Salaq» to have it made into «Refined Low-Grade Chorizite». L|2|•|⟦ChoriziteA⟧ L|2|•|Route: From «Mayoi», take the «Lady Maila Estates» Settlement Portal at 60.8S, 80.3E L|1|5.|With the Refined Ore in hand head to «Silencia's Magma Golem» located in «Crater Lake Village». L|2|•|Route: From «Glenden Wood», take the «Highland Manors» settlement portal nearby at 27.9N, 29.5E. Run southwest to the «Crater Pathway» at 60.6N, 15.7E and take all ramps up the surface portal. L|1|6.|Buy the appropriate glyph from «Silencia the Archmage» and combine with the refined ore. L|2|1.|«Infused Low-Grade Chorizite Ore (Atlatl)» L|2|2.|«Infused Low-Grade Chorizite Ore (Axe)» L|2|3.|«Infused Low-Grade Chorizite Ore (Bow)» L|2|4.|«Infused Low-Grade Chorizite Ore (Claw)» L|2|5.|«Infused Low-Grade Chorizite Ore (Crossbow)» L|2|6.|«Infused Low-Grade Chorizite Ore (Dagger)» L|2|7.|«Infused Low-Grade Chorizite Ore (Mace)» L|2|8.|«Infused Low-Grade Chorizite Ore (Spear)» L|2|9.|«Infused Low-Grade Chorizite Ore (Staff)» L|2|10.|«Infused Low-Grade Chorizite Ore (Sword)» L|2|11.|«Infused Low-Grade Chorizite Ore (Two Handed Spear)» L|1|7.|Hand the Infused Ore to Silencia's Magma Golem to receive your Hollow Weapon. L|1|8.|Apply «Bloodhunter Oil» to the «Hollow Weapons¦Hollow Weapon» to upgrade it to a «Deadly Hollow Weapons¦Deadly Hollow Weapon». L|2|•|Note: You cannot upgrade missile weapons, but you can craft deadly chorizite arrows using the «Chorizite Fletching Tool» (see «Chorizite Ammunition» for a guide).

Quest.name: Hunting_Aun_Ralirea
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|50 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Marescent Plateau» I|Route|«Timaru» I|Repeat|Non Repeatable I|Contracts|«Contract for Hunting Aun Ralirea» H2|Overview P|Quest to gain an additional «Skill Credit» to purchase «Skills» with.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Hunt «Aun Ralirea» on the «Marescent Plateau», he is a rare random spawn and can appear anywhere on the plateau, though he is more commonly found in the northern half. L|2|•|Note: Because the spawn is rare, hours can be spent trying to find him unsuccessfully. One strategy to greatly increase the odds is to drop all five bells for the «Olthoi Queen Quest». This causes the plateau to be overrun with olthoi spawns. Because there are far more spawn points, Ralirea has a much higher chance of spawning. If you also choose to kill the olthoi for «Tesserae», it isn't uncommon to see «Aun Ralirea» three or more times. L|2|•|Note: From Severlin on 03/05/10| "Your best bet is to actually kill spawns. Since he is a random spawn off generators in the area the more generator activity the more likely you are to find him. If you just run around looking for him and don't clear any spawns it is possible he just hasn't spawned at all." L|1|2.|«Aun Ralirea» speaks in open chat when you are near him. Be sure the person that needs the skill credit kills him. L|2|•|On Kill: ⟦ChampionKillQuest1⟧ L|1|3.|He drops a «Clay Figurine» that you take back to «Hea Arantah» in «Ahurenga» for the skill credit and if the person handing did not kill him (ID corpse if uncertain), no credit will be given. L|2|•|⟦ArantahKill1⟧ and ⟦ArantahKill1@GiveFigurine⟧ are the same stamp, but the @GiveFigurine is only visible at https://infiniteleaftide.online L|2|•|Note: You must hand the figurine to Arantah within 20 hours of looting it to gain the skill credit.
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.

Quest.Wiki:

L|2|•|Complete the «Climbing the Viridian Deru Tree» quest at the Deru Tree. This appears to be a once per character quest. L|1|3.|Once you have 100, go to the Viridian Deru Tree and give them to «Kervim'telek» for a random reward. Quest.name: Ithaenc_Quiddity_Ingot_Purification
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Dark Isle» at 85.4N, 57.2E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|{WARN} No Quest Bonus stamps awarded
L|1|•|The Purified Quiddity Ingot obtained from this quest was originally used in the «Aerbax's Citadel» quest when it first went live. These days the Purified Ingot has no known use.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You must have done the «Ithaenc Quiddity Seed Quest» Quest before doing this quest in order to have the «Quiddity Ingot (Ithaenc)» you need for this quest. The Ithaenc Ingot is the one that says it "glows with a deep red light" in its description. You must use that ingot and not the ingots from the other two Quiddity Seed quests. L|1|•|You must have access to the «Dark Isle» to enter the dungeon.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Proceed through the dungeon filled with Sclavus (that cast «Poison Health»), Ghosts, and some Remoran. Through the dungeon you will encounter three major obstacles besides the normal dungeon creatures. L|1|2.|First obstacle is a lava pit with some small platforms hovering over it. You must jump from platform to platform to reach of the exit on the other side of the pit. Mostly long jumps are required, not shift jumps. If you fall it is easy to get back up and try again but note that the lava does about 40 damage per hit. L|1|3.|Second obstacle is a large room overflowing with Sishalti tentacles. You have to clear the way through the room and hallway to get past them. A mage with Tusker Fists helps a lot here. L|1|4.|Third, and last, obstacle is a room with a hidden, winding path over a another lava pit. It may appear you have to jump but you don't. Just feel your way across the invisible bridge to the exit in the opposite corner of the room. L|1|5.|You'll arrive in the last area and see a bridge over a lava pit with a locked door on the other side. You don't need lockpick here. Simply jump from ledge you're on to ledge on the other side of the bridge on either side of the locked door. L|2|•|{WARN} In the next step **do not** use the «Well of Blood» or it will just kill you. Only hand your ingot to the Well. L|1|6.|Enter the room on the side of the bridge (its filled with tentacles) and give your Quiddity Ingot to the «Well of Blood» at the back of the room to receive experience and a «Purified Quiddity Ingot (Ithaenc)». You are now done, portal recall or use the nearby surface portal that takes you back to the «The Deep»
