Quest.name: Jester_Released
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|160 I|Type|Small Fellowship I|Starts With|«Jailer» I|Starts At|«Graveyard» at 64.9S, 44.1W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Jester Released» I|Quest Chain|The Jester I|1|«Lord Mhoire Quest» I|2|«Releasing Jester» I|3|Jester Released P|See also| «Jester»
H2|Overview P|After «Releasing Jester», you must now try and return him to his cell.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|Complete «Releasing Jester» once.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|The Jailer will hand you 200 «Ball of Fire» and a «Jester Prison Key» with which to access the dungeon where Jester is now loose. L|2|•|⟦JesterRepeatRun0308⟧ L|1|2.|Give key to Portal. L|2|•|⟦OnJesterPart2⟧ L|2|•|{WARN} You have 20 hours (real time) to complete the quest before the «Jester Prison Key» crumbles to dust. L|1|3.|Travel through the dungeon just the same as before until you get to the Cell portal at the end. L|1|4.|The cell portal will now teleport you to a new area. Light the «Brazier» (use fire attacks) to make the «Jester» and several guardians spawn. L|1|5.|Kill the guardians first so that you can focus on the Jester. L|1|6.|Battle the Jester using the Balls of Fire given to you by the Jailer. The Balls of Fire have "Touched" slayer on them, so they are generally effective on him. The Jester can be vulned. His melee defense is very high, so hitting him with melee weapons is typically not an effective strategy. The Jester will spawn on the platforms that ring around the room and he will constantly teleport from one to another. Throw the Balls of Fire at him to kill him. He casts a lot of interesting spells including| the Arcane Pyramid spell, a spell that shoots a Cow-shaped projectile, a spell that shoots a table projectile, Blood Bolt, and several volley spells with special names. The Jester will also randomly cast Adja's Gift on you during the battle. L|1|7.|Once defeated, speak to the «Jester (NPC)» **twice** to receive all your rewards. L|2|•|⟦JesterFree0308⟧

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Watcher of the Dead» I|Starts At|«Xi Ru's Island» at 90.3S, 87.3E I|Route|«Ayan Baqur» to «Watcher of the Dead» at 60.1S, 88.1W or «Ithaenc Cathedral» to Portalling Device (requires special flag) at 83.4S 89.8E. L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|You must have done the «Knorr Quiddity Seed Quest» Quest before doing this quest in order to have the «Quiddity Ingot (Knorr)» you need for this quest. The Knorr Ingot is the one that says it "glows with a soft white light" in its description. You must use that ingot and not the ingots from the other two Quiddity Seed quests. L|1|•|The Purified Quiddity Ingot obtained from this quest was originally used in the «Aerbax's Citadel» quest when it first went live. These days the Purified Ingot has no known use.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|From «Xi Ru's Island», run to the «Roots of the Deru Tree» dungeon at 90.3S, 87.3E beneath the waterfall behind «Xi Ru's Chapel». L|1|2.|The dungeon is a hallway wrapped around one large main room. The Drop point puts you in the hallway which wraps around the room first going up then down, until you reach the large room. There are many windows in the hallway which allow you to see into the main room but they are blocked by roots. At the end of the dungeon you will find the «Pool of Water». L|1|3.|Give the Knorr Quiddity Ingot to the Pool to receive your rewards.

Quest.name: Mnemosyne_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Repeat|None I|Kill Task|False H2|Overview P|Collect mnemosynes from Dericost undead, and bring them to the Zharalim Undead hunters in Tufa or the apprentices of the Archons of the Way outside of Samsur.
P|The text «Mnemosynes and the Art of Lockpicking» describes some of the details and lore behind this quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Mnemosyne Collection L|1|1.|Collect mnemosynes: L|2|•|«A Tiny Mnemosyne» - Dropped by lower level skeletons and greater Mu-miyah. Some good locations to hunt for tiny mnemosynes include: «Amiantos Bethel»n «Bone Lair», «Dungeon Binar», and «Grievous Vault». L|2|•|«A Small Mnemosyne» - Dropped by lower level undead, skeletons, and mu-miyah. Some good locations to hunt for small mnemosynes include: «Mountain Keep» and «Trothyr's Rest». L|2|•|«A Large Mnemosyne» - Dropped by mid to high level undead and skeletons. The «Serac Vault» is a good location to hunt for large mnemosynes, but many other locations exist.
P|Locked mnenosynes may be turned in for rewards, but the rewards are greater if they are unlocked.
H3|Intricate Keys L|1|1.|Collect «Wood Heart»s, «Copper Heart»s, and «Obsidian Heart»s. These may be obtained as trophies from their respective golems, or as rewards from the «Elysa's Favor Quest». L|1|2.|Purchase an «Intricate Carving Tool», available from numerous shopkeepers (see item for details). L|1|3.|With lockpicking skill, use the carving tool on the hearts to craft «Intricate Wooden Key»s, «Intricate Copper Key»s, and «Intricate Obsidian Key»s. Each heart yields three keys. The keys may be given after being crafted. L|1|4.|Use a wooden key on a tiny mnemosyne to produce «An Unlocked Tiny Mnemosyne». L|1|5.|Use a copper key on a small mnemosyne to produce «An Unlocked Small Mnemosyne». L|1|6.|Use an obsidian key on a large mnemosyne to produce «An Unlocked Large Mnemosyne».
H3|Undead Hunter Rewards L|1|1.|Go to the Undead Hunter's tent at 13.3S, 5.1E in «Tufa» L|1|2.|Bring locked or unlocked mnemosynes to «Ya-Bint-Al-Hawa», «Anid Al-Fadee», or «Gabal Feteh». L|2|•|Ya-Bint-Al-Hawa exchanges mnemosynes for healing kits. L|2|•|Anid Al-Fadee exchanges mnemosynes for dispel gems. L|2|•|Gabal Feteh exchanges mnemosynes for crystal arrowheads.
H3|Undead Rewards L|1|1.|Go to the «Mnemosyne Collection Site» at 2.5S, 16.4E near «Samsur». L|1|2.|Give locked or unlocked tiny mnemosynes to «Saelar's Apprentice» for an experience reward. L|1|3.|Proceed to the «Small Mnemosyne Collection Site», level 15+ L|1|4.|Give locked or unlocked small mnemosynes to «Hahnain's Apprentice» for an experience reward. L|1|5.|Proceed to the «Large Mnemosyne Collection Site», level 30+ L|1|6.|Give locked or unlocked small mnemosynes to «Renselm's Apprentice» for an experience reward.

L|1||Opening Dialog, Saelar's Apprentice⸩ ⸨Saelar's Apprentice tells you, "Greetings, outlander. I am the apprentice of Saelar of Menilesh. His master, the great Tennar Portheran perished during the Fourth Sending, along with so many of our people. But before he died, he set in motion a way for our people to preserve our heritage and our memories in the face of the recent catastrophes that have befallen the Dericost. He invented a number of Mnemosynes, devices that allow us to record our stories and lives in these little pyramids."⸩ ⸨Saelar's Apprentice tells you, "Tennar commissioned a locksmith from among your kind, whose name I do not know, to make these Mnemosynes lockable and to make keys to the Mnemosynes which only Tennar would possess. Unfortunately, I have no idea what happened to the lockpicker or his keys. The Mnemosynes have been coming in, and I have no way of opening them."⸩ ⸨Saelar's Apprentice tells you, "But still, if you come across a Mnemosyne please bring them to me and I will reward you well. The collection for the larger Mnemosynes I have tasked to the other assistants whom can be found through the portal."
L|1||Rewards, Saelar's Apprentice⸩ ⸨You give Saelar's Apprentice A Tiny Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Saelar's Apprentice tells you, "Thank you. Here is your reward."⸩ ⸨You've earned 5,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Saelar's Apprentice An Unlocked Tiny Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Saelar's Apprentice tells you, "In His Name, who Walks Eternal! I never thought I would see these unlocked. I urge you to bring me more of these unlocked treasures, so that the Dericost society may live forever."⸩ ⸨You've earned 25,000 experience.
L|1||Other Interactions, Saelar's Apprentice⸩ ⸨You allow Saelar's Apprentice to examine your A Small Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Saelar's Apprentice tells you, "Thank you for bringing this to us. If you step through the portal and bring it to the other assistants, they will be able to reward you."⸩ ⸨You allow Saelar's Apprentice to examine your An Unlocked Large Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Saelar's Apprentice tells you, "Thank you for bringing this to us. I am gratified to see that you found a way to unlock it. If you step through the portal and bring it to the other assistants, they will be able to reward you."
L|1||Opening Dialog, Hahnain's Apprentice⸩ ⸨Hahnain's Apprentice tells you, "Yes? Hahnain told me to expect you. Why we need to deal with you...I will accept the Mnemosynes, but Renslem's Apprentice has been tasked with collecting and sorting the largest of the Mnemosynes. He can be found through that portal."
L|1||Rewards, Hahnain's Apprentice⸩ ⸨You give Hahnain's Apprentice A Small Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Hahnain's Apprentice tells you, "Yes, here is the reward you were promised."⸩ ⸨You've earned 15,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Hahnain's Apprentice An Unlocked Small Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Hahnain's Apprentice tells you, "I cannot believe that you fledglings know how to unlock Tennar's great Mnemosynes, and Saelar refuses to do anything about it. If Tennar were still alive...But Saelar is a more cautious sort. Here is your reward."⸩ ⸨You've earned 80,000 experience.
L|1||Other Interactions, Hahnain's Apprentice⸩ ⸨You allow Hahnain's Apprentice to examine your A Tiny Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Hahnain's Apprentice tells you, "You should have handed this to Saelar's Apprentice, it is his job."⸩ ⸨You allow Hahnain's Apprentice to examine your An Unlocked Tiny Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Hahnain's Apprentice tells you, "I do not understand why the Archons do not just torture these secrets out of you! I am not the collector for these. Go see Saelar's Apprentice."⸩ ⸨You allow Hahnain's Apprentice to examine your A Large Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Hahnain's Apprentice tells you, "This is for Renselm's Apprentice. Step through that portal there."⸩ ⸨You allow Hahnain's Apprentice to examine your An Unlocked Large Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Hahnain's Apprentice tells you, "So much of our glorious history is to be found in that Mnemosyne. Be careful with it outrider, be very careful. Go see Renslem through that portal."
L|1||Opening Dialog, Renselm's Apprentice⸩ ⸨Renselm's Apprentice tells you, "Hand me the Mnemosyne. You will get your just reward."
L|1||Rewards, Renselm's Apprentice⸩ ⸨You give Renselm's Apprentice A Large Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Renselm's Apprentice tells you, "Yes, this is for me."⸩ ⸨You've earned 40,000 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Renselm's Apprentice An Unlocked Large Mnemosyne.⸩ ⸨Renselm's Apprentice tells you, "Yes."⸩ ⸨You've earned 300,000 experience.

Quest.name: Mountain_Sewer_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|15 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Mountain Sewer» at 60.9S, 82.0E I|Route|«Mayoi» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest is part of the «Asheron's Departure Lower» series, allowing characters level 1-79 to be flagged to use the «Portal to Bur». For full details, see the Asheron's Departure Lower guide. For information on flagging for characters level 80 and above, see «Asheron's Departure». L|1|•|{TIP} The mountain sewer is also a good location to complete the «Kilif Zefir Kill Task».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Make your way through the dungeon. After a section with rats and zefirs, you will head down a ramp with a gate at the bottom. Once through the gate, take the hall to the right. This will lead to the area containing the «Inscribed Purple Gem» and «Ancient Arbalest». L|2|•|⟦inscribedpurplegem⟧ L|1|2.|Bring the Gem to «Bretself the Translator» located at 26.0N 47.0E in the «Cragstone Library» west of «Cragstone» to receive your rewards. If you're level 1-79, you will also receive «Letter to Bretself the Translator».

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Handing in Inscribed Purple Gem (Level 1-79)⸩ ⸨You give Bretself the Translator Inscribed Purple Gem.⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator gives you Trade Note (10,000).⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,300,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "I am surprised I have been seeing these in circulation. Can you keep a secret?"⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "At one point a few years ago, I was honored to receive a letter from Asheron himself, through Scholar Antius Blackmoor. I was flattered to have received it, but what he asked me was unusual."⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "He wished that I would watch out for anyone bearing these gems. If the person seemed powerful enough that they might know how to use them, I am to plead ignorance. I do not think you are, however."⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator gives you Letter to Bretself the Translator.⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "Therefore, I shall tell you - they are from a hidden cache that Asheron stored in the mountains, for use in portal creation. I am not certain precisely where he intended to open a portal to, but the gems were to be a power source. The inscription reads, simply, "Property of Asheron Realaidain," nothing more."⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "I shall share with you the letter I received. Perhaps it will tell you more about the gem and its uses. I'll also give you this trade note as payment for the gem - I am supposed to retain them, but I can at least offer you fair market value for them."
L|1||Handing in Inscribed Purple Gem (Level 80+)⸩ ⸨You give Bretself the Translator Inscribed Purple Gem.⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,750,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "This is a very pretty Empyrean bauble. The writing is largely inconsequential. I'll take care of diposing it for you, and give you what a collector might pay for it."⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator gives you Trade Note (10,000).⸩

Quest.name: Nuhmudira's_Boon_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|15 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Balthazar, Royal Guardian» I|Starts At|54.8S, 74.4E near «Lin» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Quest Chain|Nuhmudira's Fate I|1|«Gelidite Library Quest» I|2|Nuhmudira's Boon Quest H2|Overview P|QB Stamps awarded for Ruined Amulet Turn in
P|You must of chosen to save «Nuhmudira» in the «Gelidite Library Quest» to be flagged to complete the Nuhmudira's Boon quest. If you pulled the «Plain Lever» and not the «Skull Lever» in the «Oubliette (Labyrinth)¦Oubliette» dungeon, then you're flagged for the «The Callous Heart Quest» instead. P|This quest allows you to improve gorgets created by Nuhmudira before she was imprisoned within the Gelidite Library. The gorgets are kept inside the Arcanum Storehouses which have since been overrun by Sclavus, when the Sclavus made their home there they also unintentionally brought other creatures that stole some of the ruined amulets that were kept in the storehouses.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|After you have flagged by saving Nuhmudira, speak to an «Agent of the Arcanum» who will thank you for your deed and direct you to «Lin» to speak with «Balthazar, Royal Guardian». L|1|2.|Speak with Balthazar to receive «A List of Raiding Creatures». Each creature on the list drops a specific «Ruined Amulet», the ruined amulets can be handed to Balthazar for elixirs that imbue the gorget with different spells depending on which amulet you hand in. (see table below) L|1|3.|You can either go and find the amulets now or enter the Arcanum Storehouses for the gorgets first. Inside you see that there are three different storehouses that have different levels of difficulty. The north portal is the most difficult but the red gorgets found inside can be imbued with higher level V spells. The west portal takes you to middle level with the blue gorgets, these can be imbued with level IV spells. And finally the east portal takes the to the upper section which is the easiest but you will only find green gorgets here that provide lower level III spells. L|1|4.|{OPT} Once you have the gorgets let Balthazar examine one and he will tell you to take them to «Hiro, Arcanum Artificer» in Xarabydun at 41.8S, 15.8E. L|1|5.|{OPT} Hand the gorget you wish to imbue to Hiro and he will give you more information. L|1|6.|The gorget must be imbued with an elixir of the left hand (creature spell) first to activate it, and then (optional) an elixir of the heart (life spell). Note, the ruined amulets are bound, but the elixirs are not. There is a 27 day timer for changing the spells on the gorget.

Quest.name: Palm_Fort
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180 I|Society Rank|Lord I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Fort Commander» I|Starts At|«Moarsman City» at: 92.1S, 50.3W (CH) 91.4S, 53.8W (EW) 93.6S, 51.8W (RB) I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Palm Fort» H2|Overview P|Defend Society forts on Moarsman Isle by talking to the fort commander. It will spawn a continuous wave of Moarsmen/Sclavus. The fort guards help you. L|1|•|You need to have previously gained access to «Moarsman City». L|1|•|After completing this quest you will be able to do the «Supply Saboteur» quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to the «Fort Commander» of your respective faction to start. L|2|•|«Eldrytch Web Nyr'leha Beach Fort» - 91.4S 53.8W L|2|•|«Radiant Blood Nyr'leha Beach Fort» - 93.6S 51.8W L|2|•|«Celestial Hand Nyr'leha Beach Fort» - 92.1S 50.3W L|1|2.|Several «Reinforcement Soldier»s will spawn in front of the fort and a steady stream of «Moarsman Attacker»s and «Sclavus Attacker»s will spawn and attack the fort. Along with the reinforcements, the existing «Master Archer»s, «Master Mage»s and «Master Soldier»s will aid in the defense. L|2|•|{WARN} It is easy to accidentally target your fellow faction members, if you attack them they will begin attacking you as well. L|1|3.|The attack lasts about 5 minutes, if all your «Reinforcement Soldier»s die before the attack ends, you lose. All spawned creatures disappear and you can immediately restart if you wish by talking to the commander again. L|1|4.|Speak to the «Fort Commander» after the attack has been won for 50 million xp, «Luminance», 4 «Trade Token»s, and 25 «Commendation Ribbon»s. (Speak quickly, the commander will disappear after three minutes.) If you wait and he goes, you will have to repeat the quest when he returns after a few minutes. L|2|•|⟦PalmFortDefended1209⟧
P|Notes L|1|•|If you arrive and the NPC is gone, he should appear after a few minutes (may need landblock to reset, uncertain). L|1|•|Stay inside fort during the attack. Trying to defend outside of the fort won't work as the spawns will just continue.

Quest.name: Phantom_Weapons_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Lugian Excavations» at 77.0S, 64.3E I|Route|«Mayoi» to «Lugian Meadows Settlement» portal at 60.8S, 80.3E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to create Phantasmal weapons that ignore the physical protections armor and shields give, as if you were naked. Phantasmal items are crafted from pure chorizite and are unenchantable.
P|{WARN} No Quest Bonus stamps awarded
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Once inside keep heading east. After heading down two ramps you'll reach a large open room. You can reach a deposit of ore at the end of the second path heading west. L|1|2.|You will need a «Lugian Pick Axe» to mine the ore. They can be found on any of the Lugians near the ore deposits. L|1|3.|Use the pick axe on the deposit to recieve your «Chunk of High-Grade Chorizite». You are able to mine more than one chunk of ore but you only need one for the quest. L|1|4.|Head to Feruza's «Beach Fort» at 76N, 49.1W and give the Ore to «Feruza ibn Salaq» to have it made into «Refined High-Grade Chorizite». L|2|•|⟦ChoriziteC⟧ L|1|5.|With the Refined Ore in hand head to «Silencia's Magma Golem» located in «Crater Lake Village». L|1|6.|Buy the appropriate glyph from «Silencia the Archmage» and combine with the refined ore. L|2|1.|«Infused High-Grade Chorizite Ore (Atlatl)» L|2|2.|«Infused High-Grade Chorizite Ore (Axe)» L|2|3.|«Infused High-Grade Chorizite Ore (Bow)» L|2|4.|«Infused High-Grade Chorizite Ore (Claw)» L|2|5.|«Infused High-Grade Chorizite Ore (Crossbow)» L|2|6.|«Infused High-Grade Chorizite Ore (Dagger)» L|2|7.|«Infused High-Grade Chorizite Ore (Mace)» L|2|8.|«Infused High-Grade Chorizite Ore (Spear)» L|2|9.|«Infused High-Grade Chorizite Ore (Staff)» L|2|10.|«Infused High-Grade Chorizite Ore (Sword)» L|2|11.|«Infused High-Grade Chorizite Ore (Two Handed Spear)» L|1|7.|Hand the Infused Ore to Silencia's Magma Golem to receive your Ravenous Weapon. L|1|8.|Apply «Bloodhunter Oil» to the «Ravenous Weapons¦Ravenous Weapon» to turn it into a «Phantom Weapons¦Phantom Weapon».
L|1||Notes L|1|•|Step 4: Route - From «Mayoi», take the «Lady Maila Estates» Settlement Portal at 60.8S, 80.3E. L|1|•|Step 5: Route - From «Glenden Wood», take the «Highland Manors» settlement portal nearby at 27.9N, 29.5E. Run southwest to the «Crater Pathway» at 60.6N, 15.7E and take all ramps up the surface portal. L|1|•|Step 8: Phantom missile weapons are created straight from high grade ore, there is no ravenous missile weapon or upgrade step. You can craft deadly chorizite arrows using the «Chorizite Fletching Tool» (see «Chorizite Ammunition» for a guide).

Quest.name: Premonitions_of_the_Fourth_Sending_of_Darkness

Wiki.page: Premonitions of the Fourth Sending of Darkness

Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|20 I|Rec. Level|50+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Ancient Lighthouse» at 3.9N, 72.5W I|Route|From «Fort Tethana» I|Repeat|None H2|Overview
P|An old quest added during the first event, the Sudden Season. Its rewards are only knowledge of the events of the past and those which were to come, the Fourth Sending of Darkness.
P|The Lightless Catacombs and Small Icecave were repopulated with stronger creatures in later events, and are thus more difficult. The Ancient Lighthouse and Disaster Maze may have the original creatures, but several monster rebalances may have made some more difficult. In addition, all dungeons are in areas that are not survivable for lower levels - the Dires and the Lost Wish Range. It is recommended you run this quest with a higher level character than it was initially designed for.
L|1|•|Portions of this quest require Lockpicking and keys.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Ancient Lighthouse (18+) L|1|1.|Go to «Fort Tethana». L|1|2.|Head North to 3.9N, 72.5W and take the portal to lighthouse to be transported atop the nearby mountain. Enter the «Ancient Lighthouse». L|1|3.|Following the map, proceed to the lowest level of the dungeon. L|1|4.|Pick up the «Dusty Volume», found in a small cell by a skeleton. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpDustyVolume⟧ L|1|5.|Bring the book to «Bretself the Translator¦Bretself» in «Cragstone» for translation.
H3|Disaster Maze (20+) L|1|1.|Go to «Wai Jhou». L|1|2.|Head northeast to the «Disaster Maze» at 61.3S, 50.9W. L|1|3.|Following the map, first collect the «Silvery Key» (lockpicking required), then proceed to the end, using the key to open a 1400 resistance door. L|1|4.|Pick up the «Slimy Note» in the Virindi Director's chambers. L|2|•|⟦PickedUpSlimyNote⟧ L|1|5.|Bring the note to «Kuyiza bint Zayi the Translator¦Kuyiza bint Zayi» in «Zaikhal» for translation.
H3|Lightless Catacombs (14+) L|1|1.|Use a «South Direlands Portal». An easy one to reach is located within the «Wedding Hall», which you may reach by using the «Invitation Wedding Hall» sold at all «Wedding Planner»s. L|1|2.|Head to the «Lightless Catacombs» at 82.3S, 35.2W. L|1|3.|Following the map, proceed to end of the dungeon (lockpicking required) L|1|4.|Pick up the «Dark Note». L|2|•|⟦PickedUpDarkNote⟧ L|1|5.|Bring the note to «Fanzen San the Translator¦Fanzen San» in «Hebian-To» for translation.
H3|Small Icecave (1+) L|1|1.|Obtain a bowl of «Carol's Carrot Soup». L|1|2.|Go to «Bandit Castle», give «Karwin, the Lunatic» the soup to obtain «Karwin's Key». Quest.name: Protecting_Picketed_Pets
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Colton Reeyan» I|Starts At|«Danby's Outpost» at 23.5N, 28.8W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Protecting Picketed Pets» H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Colton Reeyan» at «Danby's Outpost» to receive «Sealed Letter» and «3 Drugged Meats» (attention to its 3 hours lifespan). L|2|•|⟦SaveAPetStarted_1212⟧ L|1|2.|Run to «Colton Reeyan's Sanctuary» at 22.9N 37.0W. L|1|3.|Hand the «Sealed Letter» to the «Mosswart Messenger» at the entrance. If he isn't there, it means someone else just handed. Wait for him to respawn. L|2|•|Note: if you die, you need to get another «Sealed Letter» to get back in. The killtask does not reset by handing a new letter. L|1|4.|As you make your way through the dungeon 'killing' the «Mosswart Worker»s and «Mosswart Grunt»s. When they die, they respawn in NPC form. Talk to them when they do. You will need to talk to 10 of them (does not matter if «Mosswart Worker» or «Mosswart Grunt»). L|2|•|Talk to first spawned NPC: ⟦WorkersMotivated⟧ L|1|5.|The dungeon has 3 sections. Straight ahead, left and right. You need to make your way through each section and find the loose pets. Two of the sections require you to jump up a series of platforms. L|1|6.|Down the left passage (West), take a right (North) at the fork and you will end in a room with platforms going up the wall (you may need to change the camera to see them). L|2|•|The following is one of many routes to take to the top: From the lowest platform in the South East Corner, make a half power regular jump to the platform to the west - From there, full power to the middle platform on the east wall - from there full power across to the west - from there, make a full power sidestep jump up to the south west - stand in the middle of the platform and make a second full power sidestep jump to the south. If all went well (and your jump skill is sufficiently high) you should have 1 final jump over to the elevated hallway (which a jump just below 1/2 power should cover). L|1|7.|At the top, continue into a room with a «Mosswart Director» and 2 «Mosswart Grunt»s and kill them all. Killing the Director will open a door on the opposite side of the room (for getting back to the entrance) L|2|•|Note: Should someone die in the room with the «Mosswart Director», the door will re-open after a few minutes L|1|8.|Hand one of the «3 Drugged Meats¦Drugged Meat» to «Shady» the Armoredillo to poison him. L|2|•|⟦Petsave⟧ L|1|9.|Pick up the «Sleeping Armoredillo» by using the drugged «Shady» and place him in Shady's Cage in the other corner of the room (you have to give the «Sleeping Armoredillo» to «Shady's Cage Door»). L|1|10.|Proceed to the end of the passage over the 2 lava jumps and onto the next section. L|1|11.|Down the middle (north) passage you will come to a room with 2 «Mosswart Worker»s you need to kill and «Bubba» the pet snow tusker. L|1|12.|Hand the «3 Drugged Meats¦Drugged Meat» to «Bubba» the Snow Tusker to poison him. L|1|13.|Pick up the «Sleeping Tusker» and place him in «Bubba's Cage Door¦Bubba's Cage» in the other corner of the room. L|1|14.|Return to the starting room and proceed to the next (E) section. You need to take a right at the fork again, and will find yourself in another end room with platforms. L|2|•|The following is one of many routes to take to the top: Shift-jump upon the first platform on the opposite side of the entrance. From the middle of this platform, another shift-jump towards a platform on the same wall. One step from the ledge of this platform, full power jump to the platform in the corner. From this platform, halfpower-jump to the platform in the middle of still the same wall. Full power jump to the opposite side. Stand on the corner of this platform, and fullpower jump to either of the corners on the opposite sides of the room. Two shift-jumps to get to the exit on top. L|1|15.|At the top, continue into a room with a «Mosswart Director» and 2 «Mosswart Worker»s and kill them all. L|1|16.|Hand the «3 Drugged Meats¦Drugged Meat» to «Spot» the Ursuin to poison him. L|1|17.|Pick up the «Sleeping Ursuin» and place him in «Spot's Cage Door¦Spot's Cage» in the other corner of the room. L|1|18.|Proceed to the end of the passage over a lava jump and back to the start. L|1|19.|Return to «Colton Reeyan» to collect your rewards. L|2|•|⟦SaveAPetFinished_1212⟧

Quest.name: Quiddity_Weapons_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|40 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Small Fellowship I|Starts At|23.3S, 46.0W I|Route|«Mansion» to «Portal to Izji Qo's Temple» or give «Sake» to the «Drunken Madman» near «Baishi» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|The quest involves gathering the parts to a key and then using it to unlock a singularity trove containing a «Quiddity Ingot». The ingot can then be used to obtain one of the «Quiddity Weapons».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Creating the Martinate Trove Key H4|Ring of a Singularity Key L|1|1.|First make your way to the The «Malignant Tabernacle» located at 23.3S, 46.0W. L|2|•|Note: There is an «Exploration Marker» just outside the dungeon. L|1|2.|This dungeon is fairly linear (keep going down) and contains Elementals and Dual Elementals. Make your way to a large open room - the Elementals in this room drop the «Ring of a Singularity Key». L|2|•|⟦BrokenKeyRingMartine⟧
H4|Teeth of a Singularity Key L|1|1.|For the second part of the key you need to go to «Venemous Nidus» at 13.1S, 91.8W. L|2|•|Route: Take the «Northwest Direlands Portal» from «Aerlinthe Island».. L|1|2.|From the drop, head east and then take your first right. Head straight south and down a ramp. Hug the right wall and continue down a series of ramps until you reach a pit. Jump down and make your way south into a large room. This room contain Simulacra - once you have cleared the room find the way out on the west wall. L|1|3.|In this next area Hollow Olthoi await - kill them to find «Teeth of a Singularity Key». L|1|4.|Once you have the Teeth you can combine it with the Ring to make a «Martinate Trove Key». L|2|•|⟦BrokenKeyTeethMartine⟧
H3|Part 2: Unlocking a Martinate Singularity Trove L|1|1.|Make your way to the «Convergent Median» dungeon found south of the Direlands at at 87.1S, 40.3W. L|2|•|Route: A shorcut can be made by taking a «South Direlands Portal». L|1|2.|This dungeon is the most dangerous of the three containing Dual Elementals, Hollow Olthoi, Martinate Simulacra, and Virindi. L|1|3.|Once you arrive in the dungeon, head west to a dead end. Turn to face north and go down a ramp and then go east and down another ramp. L|1|4.|You should end in a large room with a large ring in the middle. Take the north or south exit and head down the ramp. Make your way east killing both Duals and Virindi. L|1|5.|Both corridors lead to a large open room, filled with more Duals, Virindi, and some Hollow Olthoi. Dispatch these and then make your way toward the door in the middle of the east side wall. Make your way through it and you will reach the final room. There is section in the middle of the room containing «Martinate Singularity Trove». Use your key and grab the «Quiddity Ingot». L|2|•|⟦PickedupQuiddityIngot⟧
H3|Part 3: Obtaining the Quiddity Weapon L|1|1.|The inscription on the Ingot gives you the coordinates 32.0N, 43.2W. Go here to receive your weapon by giving the Ingot to the appropriate «Virindi Crafters¦Virindi Crafter». L|2|•|Route: Head to «Qalaba'r» and take the «Axefall Glen» settlement portal at 74.9S, 17.6E. L|2|•|«Crafter of Arbelests» - «Balister of the Quiddity» - Crossbow L|3|•|⟦BalisterofQuiddity⟧ L|2|•|«Crafter of Atlatls» - «Atlatl of the Quiddity» - Thrown Weapons L|3|•|⟦AtlatlofQuiddity⟧ L|2|•|«Crafter of Axes» - «Axe of the Quiddity» - Axe L|3|•|⟦AxeofQuiddity⟧ L|2|•|«Crafter of Blades» - «Blade of the Quiddity» - Sword L|3|•|⟦BladeofQuiddity⟧ L|2|•|«Crafter of Bows» - «Bow of the Quiddity» - Bow L|3|•|⟦BowofQuiddity⟧ L|2|•|«Crafter of Fists» - «Fist of the Quiddity» - Unarmed Combat L|3|•|⟦FistofQuiddity⟧ L|2|•|«Crafter of Greatblades» - «Greatblade of the Quiddity» - Two-Handed L|3|•|⟦GreatbladeofQuiddity⟧ L|2|•|«Crafter of Knives» - «Dagger of the Quiddity» - Dagger L|3|•|⟦DaggerofQuiddity⟧ L|2|•|«Crafter of Maces» - «Mace of the Quiddity» - Mace L|3|•|⟦MaceofQuiddity⟧ L|2|•|«Crafter of Orbs» - «Eye of the Quiddity» - War Magic L|3|•|⟦EyeofQuiddity⟧ L|2|•|«Crafter of Spears» - «Lance of the Quiddity» - Spear L|3|•|⟦LanceofQuiddity⟧ L|2|•|«Crafter of Staves» - «Stave of the Quiddity» - Staff L|3|•|⟦StaveofQuiddity⟧
H3|Part 4: Enhancing the Quiddity Weapon L|1|1.|Purchase a «Weapon Upgrade Kit Containment Gem» from «Colosseum Coin Collector», «Hisham al-Evv», «Hurnmel the Smith», «Lintareal» or «Panhsj» L|1|2.|Use the gem to obtain a «Weapon Upgrade Kit» (givable/tradeable) and add to the weapon to create the enhanced version.

Quest.name: Radiant_Mana_Infusion_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|150 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Dark Isle» at 92.3N, 55.5E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|Quest to gain the Radiant Mana Infusion used to empower the «Sword of Lost Light» or «Sword of Lost Hope».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|From «Dark Isle», enter the «Sclavus Tunnels» at 92.3N 55.5E. L|1|2.|Hug the left wall until you reach a dead end, where you'll find a «Charred Falatacot Journal» on the ground. L|1|3.|Kill the nearby «Sclavus Acolyte of T'thuun» and loot the «Reinforced Door Key» from its corpse. L|1|4.|Turn around and hug the left wall until you reach a large room. L|1|5.|Continue through this room exiting down a hallway to the northeast. L|1|6.|Take your first right, then first left, and inmediately hug the right wall at the ramp, to a locked door. L|1|7.|When you reach the locked door (resistance: 700), use the Reinforced Door Key and continue to follow the right wall until you reach a ramp down to a small room. Loot the «Radiant Mana Infusion» from the altar. L|2|•|⟦RadiantManaInfusionPickup_0209⟧ L|1|8.|{WARN} there is an exposed Ley Line in the right hand corner of room with the altar that does massive typeless damage if you stand in it. Beware!
L|1||Notes L|1|•|Apply the Radiant Mana Infusion to the «Sword of Lost Hope» to upgrade to an «Empowered Sword of Lost Hope» or to the «Sword of Lost Light» to upgrade it to an «Empowered Sword of Lost Light» (The «Red Fire Infusion¦Red Fire», «White Fire Infusion¦White Fire», and «Blue Fire Infusion»s must be added **before** you add the radiant infusion). L|1|•|You can also use a «Radiant Mana Infusion» with «Inert Shadowfire Infusion», «Inert Skeletonbane Infusion» or «Inert Olthoibane Infusion»s to create an empowered slayer infusion. The empowered infusion can only be added to an empowered sword (2 Radiant Infusions in total required).

Quest.name: Ries_Woron's_Story
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|? I|Rec. Level|125 I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Ries Woron» I|Starts At|«Baishi» at 49.5S, 62.7E I|Route|«Town Network» east I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest requires someone with «Lockpick» skill. L|1|•|You cannot log out in the «Thug Hideout» - you will appear back at the lifestone. L|1|•|If you intend to pick up the «Pile of random parts» as part of the «Gear Knight Parts» quest, make sure you have spoken to «Nurino» before starting this quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Beginning Ries Woron's Story L|1|1.|When your group is assembled, speak to «Ries Woron» to get portaled to the «Thug Hideout». L|2|•|{WARN} This quest has a 90 minute timer. You must kill all the Thugs and complete the quest before the timer expires, otherwise the various checkpoints will shut, preventing you from completing the quest. L|2|•|The first person who talks to Ries Woron should receive the «Story of Ries Woron» book, which tells you the amount of time you have remaining to complete the quest. If this item is not received, someone has already started the quest and the timer is already running. The book timer counts down from 90 minutes. L|2|•|If another group has already started the quest, you will receive a message asking you if you want to enter anyway. This only appears after a few minutes, allowing for everyone in your group to get inside first. L|2|•|If you die or fall into a pit, portal recall and talk to Ries again for a ride back to the dungeon. L|2|•|The respawn in the dungeon is 5-10 minutes for Thugs (so you must kill them all quickly and move forward without wasting time). Any brown or white mice that spawn are on a regular respawn. L|1|2.|When you first enter the dungeon, it will likely be empty except for possibly a mouse. The Thugs will soon spawn. L|1|3.|The first section of the dungeon contains «Thug»s and «Thug Boss»es. Make sure you kill them all. L|1|4.|Inmediately beyond the first room there is a lever on the left wall which opens the next 2 doors. L|1|5.|In the next rooms, one of the «Thug Boss»es holds the «First Gate Key». Use the key to open the first gate. Note that the gate is a normal door and will shut and lock again after a minute or so. **Note: the door is lockpickable**. L|1|6.|The second section contains more Thugs. Eventually you will reach another gate with 2 side rooms full of locked chests (500 difficulty). L|2|•|The «Second Gate Key» is located in one of the locked chests. This key is 2 use and is used to open the next 2 gates. **Note: both gates are lockpickable, so you don't need the keys from the chests** L|2|•|If you wait for it, the second key will respawn again in the chest. You can then loot additional keys for future runs if desired. The key is giveable. L|1|7.|Past the second gates is a room with 2 bridges. The bridges are triggered by a floor plate at the front of the room. Do not jump while the bridge is going up or you may fall into the pit. The bridges are on a normal timer and will go back down after a minute or so. L|1|8.|Keep heading north until you get to a long room with a throne. This is the first checkpoint. **The wall behind the throne will only open if all the Thugs prior to this point have been killed**. L|2|•|Note that the fireplace mantle is not the checkpoint. The checkpoint is the brick wall beyond and to the left. L|1|9.|Beyond the throne room, there is a fork in the path. The right path leads back to the start of the dungeon and the backdoor (see below). Take the left path to continue northward. L|1|10.|You will come to the first jump pit. If you fall, you must recall and talk to Ries again to re-enter the dungeon. You need a jump skill of approximately 200 to make the jump. L|1|11.|You will come to a long room full of Thugs on three different levels. Do not enter this room from the bottom or you will be swarmed and die. Go up the left or right passages to the top level and start fighting from there. All of the Thugs respawn once, so be ready. This is where many people die or too much time is spent killing if you do not have a capable group. L|1|12.|{OPT} In this room you will see cages, some with a «Trapped Townsperson». Kill all the Thugs and you can open a cage and free the Townsperson. Talk to her for the title "No Cage Can Hold Me" (this part can be buggy and may not work). L|2|•|⟦SaveTownspersonWait⟧ L|1|13.|Once all of the Thugs are dead (one respawn inclusive), the doors to the south will open. This is the second checkpoint. L|2|•|Note: There are several sets of doors in this room on each level. All of them lead to a pit you must jump over and then to the same location. Most people use the doors on the bottom level. L|1|14.|Next you will come to the second jump pit. Again use a full power jump to get across. L|1|15.|Eventually you get to a room where Fiona is trapped in a cage. There are several Thugs to kill here.
H3|Part 2: Rescuing Fiona Woron L|1|1.|On the right side of the room there are some tables containing Mixing Bowls and 4 bottles labeled A through D. There is also a Cooking Vat beside a table. On the left side of the room you will see a Recipe. **Ignore the recipe!** It will just get you killed. There is only one correct potion that will cure Fiona. Other combinations of potions will have various effects including: nothing happening, killing you, casting Poison Health on you, summoning a portal to the top of Palace at Sanamar, killing Fiona, or turning Fiona into a Wight Blade Sorcerer. Only one person in your group needs to mix a potion: L|2|1.|Pick up «Bottle A», «Bottle C», and «Bottle D». L|2|2.|Hand «Bottle A» to the «Mixing Basin» followed by «Bottle C». This should get you a «Green Potion». L|2|3.|Hand «Bottle C» to the «Mixing Basin» followed by «Bottle D». This should get you a «Purple Potion». L|2|4.|Hand both bottles to one of the «Cooking Vat»s. This should get you a «Black Potion». L|1|2.|Unlock the cage that holds Fiona (350 Difficulty) to let her out. Then hand her the Black Potion (**only Black!**). You only need one person from the group to hand her a potion. L|1|3.|Have everyone talk to Fiona for a «Braced Mana Forge Key». Only talk to her once the potion has been handed in! L|2|•|⟦SaveFionaWait⟧
H3|Part 3: The Unknown Warrior L|1|1.|There are 2 brick walls that open within the room where Fiona is. Each is activated by a bookcase within the room. L|2|•|{OPT} If you want to obtain a «Gear Shield» as part of the «Gear Knight Parts» quest (Level 130), then use the SW bookcase to open the South brick wall and pick up «Pile of random parts» from the altar. The parts weigh 1,000 burden. L|3|•|⟦PileOfRandomPartsPickup⟧ L|1|2.|Use the NW bookcase to open the North brick wall. When you get to the doorway wait for the bridge then all cross the bridge to the center platform where «The Unknown Warrior» waits. **Do not talk to The Unknown Warrior until you are ready to fight.** His sword and shield can be debuffed before you start the fight. When he is about to die he portals out and several «Thug Boss»es will spawn. Kill them. L|1|3.|Once the Thug Bosses are killed, there is a 5 minute delay for the exit bridge to rise and the far gate opens. Do not try to jump onto the bridge or you will have to recall and run back. L|2|•|{WARN} The bridge only stays up for approximately 5 minutes. This means anyone who might be running back must get there before the 5 minutes is up. Once the bridge goes down, the quest is over, regardless of how much of the 90 minutes has passed. L|1|4.|Across the bridge to the north is a room with the five pieces of the «Armor of Darkness». You can choose the item of your choice. The pieces are givable and there is a 20-hour timer to pick up another one. L|2|•|⟦ArmorOfDarknessPickup⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpCoatofDarkness⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpLeggingsofDarkness⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpGauntletsofDarkness⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpHelmofDarkness⟧ L|2|•|⟦PickedUpSolleretsofDarkness⟧ L|1||Notes
P|Back Door L|1|•|If someone dies or misses a jump, the back door can be used to rejoin the group after recalling and talking to Ries again. The switch for the back door is on the inside, so someone who didn't fall/die must run and open it ahead of time. It is a good idea to appoint someone to go and open the back door in case it is needed. You cannot run back the normal way due to the various gates which require keys. L|1|1.|After the throne room, take the right path at the fork and run down the very long hallway. L|1|2.|Pull the switch on the wall to open the back door. The door looks like a brick wall. L|2|•|Note that the back door is accessed by taking the southeast path in the first room of the dungeon (turn right from portal drop). A short jump is needed to hop over into the long passageway. L|2|•|The backdoor is on its own timer and stays open for a very long time (possibly an hour or more). It does not shut automatically when the quest timer expires.
P|Obtaining multiple pieces of armor L|1|•|Since the quest is not fellowship locked, it is possible to obtain multiple pieces of armor on a single account by having an alternate character enter the dungeon and run to the end. If you are planning on attempting this, it is a good idea to move your second character to Baishi ahead of time. There are several conditions that must be met for this to work. L|1|•|The back door must be opened. L|1|•|The character must have a jump of at least 200 to get over the 2 pits. L|1|•|The quest must be completed (Unknown Warrior killed) with a sufficient amount of time left that another character can run to the end. It takes approximately 5 minutes to run from the start of the dungeon to the armor room.
P|Timer expiration L|1|•|The exact mechanics of the quest timer expiring are not fully known. Below is a list of known/unknown things which occur when the timer is up. L|1|•|The first and second checkpoints close (wall behind throne, all double doors in multi-level room) L|1|•|The bridge to the Unknown Warrior goes down (unconfirmed). L|1|•|Fiona respawns within her cage (unconfirmed). L|1|•|Any existing spawn within the dungeon (excluding mice) vanishes. L|1|•|Note that the final bridge is on a separate timer which starts when the Unknown Warrior vanishes (5 minutes until it raises, then 5 minutes until it lowers again).

L|1||You open the lock with ease. L|1||Trapped Townsperson tells you, "Thank you for getting me out of that cell. I need to get out of here before they grab me again." L|1||You have been awarded the title "No Cage Can Hold Me"

Quest.name: Sclavus_Santa's_House_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|200+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Qalaba'r» I|Repeat|Yearly? H2|Overview P|Seasonal festive quest to free the Sclavus Santa who has been imprisoned for years by an imposter.
L|1|•|Note: If you die during this quest, you will have to start all over again at the presents puzzle.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to «Sclavus Santa's House» at 69.8S, 25.6E. L|2|•|Route 1: Use the «Citadels Portal Device» at your Mansion to the «Ridge Citadel» then run 1.5 click to the house portal at 69.8S, 25.6E. L|2|•|Route 2: From «Qalaba'r», take the «Qalabar Oasis Settlement» at 74.8S, 17.8E (5 click run, some mountaineering). L|1|2.|Once inside the dungeon run straight ahead and talk to the «Moarself» NPC. L|2|•|⟦SclavusPresentStart⟧ L|1|3.|You will now have 5 minutes to solve a puzzle by opening «Present (Sclavus Santa's House)¦Present»s, and find the matching item to open the door. This puzzle is on a 5 minute timer. You need to find all matching items, and can only make 3 mistakes. If you fail, you have to start all over again, and the puzzle resets. L|2|•|"You have found a snowman. Find its match." L|2|•|First Present: ⟦SclavusPresentsOpened⟧ and ⟦SclavusPresentFirstGuess⟧ L|2|•|Wrong Guess: ⟦SclavusPresentWrongGuess⟧ L|2|•|There seem to be at least 5 patterns starting from the far left (see below for a «#Puzzle Guide¦puzzle guide»). L|2|•|If you're with a group, only one person needs to solve the puzzle, the rest can follow when the door opens. L|1|4.|After solving the puzzle, go straight (in a side room is another Moarself cooking) and talk to «Santa Sclavus (NPC)» who tells you to use the nearby door to get a present. L|2|•|⟦SclavusPresentPortalDoor⟧ L|1|5.|This door portals you into a maze area with «Gumdrop»s, a variant of «Knathtead». **Hot Drop!** You will immediately be debuffed and though not directly in the line of fire, the Gumdrops will quickly find you and start chaincasting L|1|6.|Go E, up a ramp and left, through a bigger long room full of «Gumdrop»s. On both sides you will see imprisoned Moarselves L|2|•|{OPT} Lockpicking the doors and talking to these NPCs (they will disappear after this) will give you additional experience and luminance when talking to the «Santa Sclavus (NPC)¦Santa Sclavus» NPC at the end of the dungeon. L|3|•|⟦SclavusPresentMoarselfFreed⟧ L|1|7.|There will be another ramp up with 2 Gumdrops and 4 in the smaller room below. You can imp and bludge vuln the Gumdrops from the corridor. L|2|•|One of the will drop a «Door Key (Sclavus Santa's House)¦Door Key», use it to open the door (resistance 1000). L|1|8.|Next is the Rolling Snowballs of Death part. L|2|1.|Look at the pattern, some will run from left to right, others from right to left. L|2|2.|You can follow directly behind one ball, to jump to the next row. Also, there is space between each row where no Snowball can hit you. L|2|3.|The exit is in the corner the farthest away from you (NE) L|1|9.|The next area is an area with «Uber Penguin (240)¦Uber Penguin»s (level 240) and reinforced doors (diff 600). L|1|10.|There are 3 penguins in each section and one of the penguins drops another 2 use «Door Key (Sclavus Santa's House)». All keys look the same, but are only usable for the next 2 doors, to enter a safe area, and to exit it. L|1|11.|Above you are lots of «Snowman Sentry¦Snowman Sentries», who keep cold vulning you and can war you from above in the Penguin rooms (and if you're unlucky and the door is open, in the safe areas too). L|1|12.|After 3 or 4 of such penguin-door-safe-door-penguin sections, you will arrive in a safe room without creatures. Run up the ramp and use the lever to open the door. You will now be in an area much alike the area after the puzzle, including a cooking NPC «Moarself (NPC)» L|1|13.|In the next area, you will be fighting the imposter «Santa Sclavus (Creature)¦Santa Sclavus» who is guarded by two evil «Moarself (Creature)¦Moarselves» and four «Gumdrop»s. L|1|14.|The door behind Santa Sclavus him will open upon his death (no need to loot as he doesn't carry items). There, you will find the real «Santa Sclavus (NPC)¦Santa Sclavus» who will reward you with xp, luminance and a pet Gumdrop summoning item. L|2|•|⟦SclavusPresentWait⟧ L|2|•|Note: The door will stay open for about 5 minutes. The NPC disappears after about 5 minutes after killing the Creature Santa, and will respawn when the creature respawns. However, only after the creature is killed, you can talk to him for your reward. L|2|•|Note 2: if you have first killed the Imposter and talked to Santa, and then free the moarselves and talk again, you will not get the rewards for freeing the moarselves.

H2|Dialog H3|Moarself L|1||Moarself tells you, "Only one person may attempt the puzzle at a time. L|1||Moarself tells you, "If you can solve the puzzle you can gain access to Santa's House." L|1||Moarself tells you, "Be careful. If you make a 3 mistakes you will have to start over." L|1||Moarself tells you, "You have 5 minutes. Good luck."
H3|Santa Sclavus (Imposter) L|1||Santa Sclavus tells you, "Welcome to my humble home." L|1||Santa Sclavus tells you, "Tisss the season to be generous and you've traveled so far to find me." L|1||Santa Sclavus tells you, "Head down that hallway over there and take one of anything you'd like."
H3|Santa Sclavus (Real) L|1||Santa Sclavus tells you, "Pleassssse you must help me." L|1||Santa Sclavus tells you, "That imposter has imprisoned me for years."
H3|Santa Sclavus (After defeating imposter Santa Sclavus) L|1||Santa Sclavus tells you, "Thank you for disposing of that imposter." L|1||Santa Sclavus tells you, "His jealousy has left me imprisoned in this small room for years, unable to spread joy to Dereth." L|1||Santa Sclavus tells you, "Take this as a small token of my appreciation." L|1||Santa Sclavus gives you Bag of Gumdrops. L|1||You've earned 9,009 Luminance. L|1||You've earned 132,499,992 experience.
H3|Santa Sclavus (After freeing the Moarselves) L|1||Santa Sclavus tells you, "You rescued my Moarselves. I can't thank you enough." L|1||You've earned 1,589 Luminance L|1||You've earned 52,999,997 experience.

Quest.name: Sealing_Away_the_Book_of_Eibhil

Wiki.page: Sealing Away the Book of Eibhil

Quest.Wiki:
I|Rec. Level|200 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Asheron (NPC)¦Asheron» I|Starts At|«Asheron's Castle» I|Route|«Eastham» to «Asheron's Island» portal at 17.9N, 64.3E. I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|«Asheron (NPC)¦Asheron» is asking adventurers to bear the burden of sealing away the «Book of Eibhil» one page at a time.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to «Asheron (NPC)¦Asheron» in «Asheron's Castle» to receive «A Page of the Book of Eibhil». L|2|•|⟦SealBookStarted_0611⟧ L|1|2.|Head to the «Deep Caves», located in the «City of Neftet» at 20.7S, 8.3E. L|2|•|Route: From the «Town Network», take the Gharu'ndim wing to «Yaraq» and then head northeast to the «City of Neftet». L|1|3.|Hug the right wall until you reach the «Guardian Spirit», and speak with him to be able to enter the «Temple Trial». L|2|•|⟦SealBookGuardianTalk⟧ L|1|4.|Head through the trial until you reach the «Apparition of Borelean Strathelar (Eibhil)» and the «Apparition of Lady Daenerah», after their interaction, the door beside them will open. Jump down and find your next set of NPC's. L|1|5.|Repeat 4 more times until you reach the «Avatar of the Deru». L|1|6.|Give him your page, and he will return the «Deru Avatar's Gem». L|2|•|⟦SealBookGotGem⟧ L|1|7.|Bring the «Deru Avatar's Gem» to «Asheron (NPC)¦Asheron» for your reward. L|2|•|⟦SealBookCompleted_0611⟧

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "Ahh, good. I can feel your inner Luminance. If you will help me, I have a mission of the utmost importance for you."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "I have managed to capture the elusive and dangerous Book of Eibhil, and have divined a way to seal its power from affecting this world."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "To that end, I am asking you to aid me in the delicate task of bearing a small portion of the cursed tome to one who can lock it away forever."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "There is a power stirring under the desert of Neftet, awoken by the A'nekshay who have escaped the slavery of the Sand Kings."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "It is a power strong enough to bind the Book from harming others forever."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "Find that power, a true Avatar of the Deru, and ask it to help you seal away that single page. When you have succeeded, return to me."⸩ ⸨Asheron gives you A Page of the Book of Eibhil.
L|1||The Guardian Spirit⸩ ⸨The Guardian Spirit looks you over carefully for a moment, and then you hear a voice echo in your mind, "I see you, . I see why you have come."⸩ ⸨A voice in your mind says, "You have brought great evil here, . I would turn you away, but I can also see the need that brought you here."⸩ ⸨A voice in your mind says, "But, to bear such as you carry in front of the Avatar, you must be tested, and you must gain wisdom. Enter the portal here, and proceed on your trial. Those here will try to stop you. Have no fear, you can cause them no permanent harm."⸩ ⸨A voice in your mind says, "You will also see five visions, so you will gain greater understanding of the peril that brought you here this day. Good luck, and may the Blessings of the Deru go with you."
L|1||Apparitions of Lady Daenerah and Borelean Strathelar⸩ ⸨Apparition of Lady Daenerah says, "You summoned me, Your Highness?"⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "I did, Lady Daenerah"⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "It has become increasingly dangerous to store these copies of the Book here."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "We have decided it is best if they are hidden far from the castle at this point."⸩ ⸨Borelean hands Lady Daenerah a rolled parchment.⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "We have decided it is best if they are hidden far from the castle at this point."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "Have all the books moved to that location, and make sure all further tomes are sent there as well."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "And, Lady Daenerah, speak of this to no one."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "The less opportunities the enemy has to hear of the Book's true location, the less likely they are to try to retrieve all of these copies."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Lady Daenerah says, "As you wish, Your Highness. It will be done."⸩ ⸨Borelean pours through copies of the Book, looking for something.⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "It has to be here somewhere, it just has to be..."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "There just has to be a way in these copies to bring my wife back..."⸩ ⸨A whisper of a female voice echoes through the room, "Seek the path, my love. You will find the way to me."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "I will not lose you, my love. No death in Dereth is permanent. There has to be a way..."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "Why can't I find it?"⸩ ⸨Borelean pours through book after book, lines of desperation etched deeply into his face.⸩ ⸨A whisper of a female voice echoes through the room, "You will find the path, my love. You will find your way to me." echoes through the room, "Seek the path, my love. You will find the way to me. Do not lose hope."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "With all of the powers in this world, there has to be a way to make this work..."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "Bah! These copies are useless. I must find the Book itself. I *need* the Book of Eibhil itself!"⸩ ⸨A seductive female voice echoes in your mind, "You have called to me, by despair and blood, and I have come. If you will pay my price and learn my secrets, that which you seek can be returned to you. But, with all your soul, you must desire this above all else, and you must be willing to do all that must be done. The road is long, but all things are achievable."⸩ ⸨Borelean looks around the room, fear and hope both showing on his worn features.⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "I could get her back? Bring her back to life?"⸩ ⸨A seductive female voice echoes in your mind, "That and more, my love. That and much more."⸩ ⸨Borelean stares intently at the Book of Eibhil, seeming deep in thought.⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "There has to be some way to perform this ritual without sacrificing another's life. There has to be."⸩ ⸨A seductive female voice echoes in your mind, "Without the spark of a fading spirit, her own spirit will be weakened, likely to the point where she cannot be revived. Would you let such a simple fear hold you back? What is the cost of one spirit compared to the return of your beloved wife?"⸩ ⸨Borelean thinks for a moment, seeming conflicted.⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "No. There must be another way. What if several each gave of themselves willingly? From what you've said, the life energy needed for this ritual need not come from a single spirit."⸩ ⸨A seductive female voice echoes in your mind, "You would offer willing sacrifice? From several, as opposed to the totality of one? Very well, but each must swear by blood and spirit to me, and to me alone. Only then will there be enough power to attempt this."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "It shall be done. I'll spread the word to my closest Knights and her Handmaidens. All will be sworn to secrecy, and those who volunteer willingly will join in the ritual."⸩ ⸨You hear a whisper in your mind that Borelean does not seem to hear, "It is unorthodox, but done properly, and I will get to feast on the spirits of many. These fools know not what they offer, nor the totality of their price."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "So many have answered the call, so many have come. With so many volunteers, the cost to each should be small. This will work."⸩ ⸨A seductive female voice echoes in your mind, "Yes, my love. Each will only have to offer a small shard of their spirit into the ritual itself."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "All have sworn to you, by blood and spirit, as you asked. Let's do this."⸩ ⸨The Book begins to glow more brightly, and a chant fills your mind, seeming to echo off the walls.⸩ ⸨After a moment, a red light begins to slowly emanate from Hoshino Kei's body. As the light slowly grows in intensity, the chanting grows louder, and voices seem to join in, until it seems an entire chorus is calling her back.⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "Rise, My love! Come back to me!"⸩ ⸨With a loud crack, a new body forms over the old.⸩ ⸨Apparition of Hoshino Kei says, "You have called to me, from beyond the depths, and I have come."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "My love? Is that you?"⸩ ⸨Apparition of Hoshino Kei says, "Of course, my love. Who else would come to such a summons?"⸩ ⸨As the ritual winds down, a strange coldness begins to radiate from Hoshino Kei.⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "What's wrong?"⸩ ⸨Borelean reaches out, but stops when he feels the cold radiating from Hoshino Kei.⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "You told me I could bring her back! What did you do to her!"⸩ ⸨An amused, mocking female voice echoes in your mind, "Foolish boy. I told her you could get her back, and you have. I never said I would return her to life."⸩ ⸨An amused, mocking female voice echoes in your mind, "She is to be my new Avatar in this world, and I have you to thank for wakening her. Moreso, thank you for all of these fine sacrifices. I will enjoy them slowly, and leave you for last, my love."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Hoshino Kei says, "Well done, indeed, my love. I have returned, and the strength of the Book flows through me. There is so much to do, and you have so little time."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Hoshino Kei says, "Until then, be well my love, and know that I will always be watching you."⸩ ⸨Apparition of Borelean Strathelar says, "NO!!!"⸩ ⸨A serene voice fills your mind, "Greetings, . I have been watching your progress."⸩ ⸨A serene voice fills your mind, "I do hope my friends did not cause you undue harm. The trial is necessary, as it weakens the hold that the page has gained upon you in the time you've been in contact with it."⸩ ⸨A serene voice fills your mind, "You bear a page of the dark tome, the bane of my people. Hand it to me, so it may be sealed away, and you may be cleansed."
L|1||Avatar of the Deru⸩ ⸨You allow Avatar of the Deru to examine your A Page of the Book of Eibhil.⸩ ⸨A serene voice fills your mind, "You have come, and you have seen visions of the darkness of that tome. It is only a small sample of the evil you now bear with you, but any wisdom gained is wisdom earned."⸩ ⸨A serene voice fills your mind, "This thing you bear, it can be sealed away, for a time."⸩ ⸨The Avatar of the Deru takes the page from you, and it vanishes immediately thereafter. When it is gone, you feel as if a great weight has been lifted from your shoulders.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your A Page of the Book of Eibhils.⸩ ⸨A serene voice fills your mind, "I can hold the book, once it has all come to me, for an Age, maybe two, but not forever. Its power is too great, and its ties to this world too many, for it to be contained forever, even by one such as me."⸩ ⸨A serene voice fills your mind, "We can only hope that the intervening millenia will be long enough for those who follow the path to shatter the book's hold on this world, and then to weaken it 'til it reaches a point where it may be sealed forever. In that, time will tell."⸩ ⸨A serene voice fills your mind, "For now, it is best to focus on getting the whole of the book here, which will be a lengthy process in and of itself."⸩ ⸨A serene voice fills your mind, "To that end, I thank you for braving the book to bring a page of it here. The corruption of even a single page would forever fill one of lesser stature than your own."⸩ ⸨A serene voice fills your mind, "But you have borne it here and survived. For that, I thank you. Please, accept my blessing and be healed of its touch."⸩ ⸨The Avatar of the Deru touches you, and a green light pours through your form, removing the taint of the Book from your spirit.⸩ ⸨A serene voice fills your mind, "Take this crystal to the one you call Asheron, so he may know of your success and your healing. Go now, with my blessing, and the blessings of all of the Deru."⸩ ⸨Avatar of the Deru gives you Deru Avatar's Gem.
L|1||Rewards Dialog⸩ ⸨You allow Asheron to examine your Deru Avatar's Gem.⸩ ⸨You hand over 1 of your Deru Avatar's Gems.⸩ ⸨Asheron studies the gem very carefully, almost reverently.⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "So, it is done then. If the Avatar will help, then there is hope."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "Though it may have seemed a simple enough task for one of your obvious skill, you have done a thing far braver than you can imagine, and I thank you for it."⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "Please, accept this in return for your bravery, and may all know you earned the right to be called a true 'Bearer of Darkness', in service to the Light."⸩ ⸨Asheron gives you Braced Mana Forge Key.⸩ ⸨You've earned 198,157,237 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 99,078,619 experience.⸩ ⸨You've earned 20,000 Luminance.⸩ ⸨You've earned 10,000 Luminance.⸩ ⸨You have been granted the title, "Bearer of Darkness".⸩ ⸨Asheron tells you, "Thank you once again for your help. Once I'm sure any damage done to you by bearing the page has passed, I can send you with another, if you wish to aid me further in this."⸩ ⸨You may repeat this quest in 20h.

Quest.name: Shackles_of_Obedience_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|20 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Stable Rift» at 8.0N, 50.4E I|Route|«Lytelthorpe» to «North Lytelthorpe Villas» at 2.2N, 50.5E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|This quest was one of the "appetizers" in the «The Rise of the New Singularity» Story Arc.
P|If you can survive the fall, much of the dungeon can be skipped by jumping into the pit rather than across it. If you can deal melee damage or magical damage that does not require line-of-sight, you can kill and loot Dirrich through the grates at the bottom of the pit. As long as its corpse is next to the grate you should be able to loot it.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Head to the «Stable Rift» at 8.0N, 50.4E. L|2|•|Route: «Lytelthorpe» to «North Lytelthorpe Villas» at 2.2N, 50.5E. From the settlement run northeast to the dungeon. L|1|2.|Kill the Rifts outside the dungeon until you get a message saying you feel changed. L|2|•|⟦VirindiChimera⟧ L|1|3.|Enter the mostly linear dungeon, do not jump into any pits L|1|4.|Kill «Dirrich, the Warden», loot the «Shackles of Obedience» and an «Obsidian Shard (Dirrich's Journal)¦Obsidian Shard» from his corpse. L|2|•|⟦VirindiManacles⟧ L|1|5.|Bring the Shard to «Diyas al-Yat» to get it translated and receive «Dirrich's Journal» L|1|6.|Bring the Shackles to «Josef» in «Martine's Retreat» for an experience reward.
H2|Dungeons & Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Stable Rift» 8.0N, 50.4E -- «map:0290¦0290» TE
H2|Rewards
R| RK|Items| RI|«Shackles of Obedience» RE
R|Give the «Shackles of Obedience» to «Josef» RK|Experience|7,000,000 (175% up to level 47) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Killing a Rift outside the dungeon⸩ ⸨You feel the energy released by the rift's destruction enter you. You feel changed...
L|1||Killing Dirrich, the Warden⸩ ⸨A flash of violet backlights the Virindi's mask, and in your mind, a hollow voice intones, "So this is my reward for following the Directive. Aerbax was right..."
L|1||Handing Obsidian Shard to Diyas al-Yat⸩ ⸨You give Diyas al-Yat Obsidian Shard.⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat tells you, "This really provides some insight into the inner workings of the impure Virindi. It is such a pity to see broken dolls where there was once such purity. Pity."⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat gives you Dirrich's Journal.
L|1||You give Josef Shackles of Obedience.⸩ ⸨Josef tells you, "These won't help me much, but..."⸩ ⸨You've earned 7,000,000 experience.⸩ ⸨Josef tells you, "That should help you a little. See, I want these for a specific reason. They'd remind Martine of what the Virindi did to him. We don't want that happening to him ever again. By we I mean the majority of us here. All of us had problems. Some greater than others, but we did all have problems and Martine gave us something that none of us had, Hope."⸩ ⸨Josef tells you, "In a sense he was our savior. He took us out of the darkest times that any of us had ever faced, brought us back from that brink and got us motivated to live again."⸩ ⸨Josef tells you, "Not easy to do with a bunch of ne'er do wells. But he did it. We started working with him to build places that we could call our own. Do things that we could have pride in. We struggled it's true but in the end we were feeling better and things were looking up. Until Gaerlan came back. And then the voice returned."⸩ ⸨Josef lowers his eyes.⸩ ⸨Josef tells you, "It was like watching your best friend disappear. He had beaten that thing back. It was gone, forever. But now it was back."⸩ ⸨Josef tells you, "Nothing more I can say about that."⸩

Quest.name: Swamp_Temple_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|15 | Recommended Level = I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Swamp Temple (Yanshi)¦Swamp Temple» I|Starts At|«Yanshi» I|Route|Yanshi to «Swamp Temple Place» settlement. I|Repeat|None H2|Overview P|Explore two ancient Falatacot temples to discover their treasures.
P|{WARN} No Quest Bonus stamps awarded
P|This very early quest is an example of the dungeon treasure hunting style of quests. Although this type of quest became fairly useless early on, the Swamp Temples are still interesting dungeons to explore, especially since they have gone untouched all these years and offer a glimpse of early Dereth.
L|1|•|Lockpicking is not required, but will allow you skip gathering some or all of the keys needed for this quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Blackmire Swamp Temple L|1|1.|{OPT} Head into the «Swamp Temple (Yanshi)¦Swamp Temple» (10+) and read the «Swamp Temple Tome». This will explain that you need a key from outside to get any further than the first room. L|1|2.|Head to 23.8S, 49.6E and enter the «23.8S, 49.6E - Carved Key Bunker¦Bunker» found there. Take the «Carved Key (Swamp Temple)¦Carved Key» found on the ground. L|1|3.|Head to 23.4S, 47.9E and enter the Swamp Temple. The first few levels of this dungeon are rotationally symmetric. L|1|4.|From the drop, head to one of the locked doors (resistance: 355) to the SW or NE and unlock it with the Carved Key or pick the lock. Proceed down one level (level -1). L|1|5.|From level -1, take the hall on the mid-northern or mid-southern walls down one level (level -2). L|1|6.|From level -2, head to the center of the level, and head either east or west. These two paths lead to a single room deeper down (in level -6) with an «Empyrean Stone Head», one of the Heads of Tafelicor, against one wall. L|1|7.|In the Empyrean Stone Head room, kill the special level 15 «Mosswart Shaman (Swamp Temple)¦Mosswart Shaman» and loot its «Skull-shaped key». Return up to level -2. L|1|8.|From level -2, proceed to the SW or NE cornes and take the hallways leading down one level (level -4). L|1|9.|On level -4 hug the right wall until you come across a hallway leading up one level (level -3). L|1|10.|On level -3 you will find a locked door (resistance: 432). Open this door with the Skull-shaped key or pick the lock. This leads to the throne room/treasure room with a Mosswart Chief, several Mosswart Shamans, and various lesser mosswarts. There are 6 chests to loot here, all unlocked. When you are done, proceed back down to level -4. L|1|11.|Back on level -4, hug the left wall to reach either a door to the north or to the south with a warning sign. This is a one-way travel warning. the doors will lock from the inside once they close (resistance: 242). Enter the doors to proceed into the cave area. L|1|12.|{OPT} In the cave area, head east an unlock a door (resistance: 40) to find a hidden underground lifestone. L|1|13.|In the cave area, head west, passing a portal to the Sho Roadside, to proceed to out of the cave area and into the final area of the temple. L|1|14.|Entering from the east, head north or south. You will come to a 5-way intersection. If you are on the north side, head south. If you are on the south side, head north. These two paths meet up in the center, where you will find two more hallways leading down even deeper. In this deepest area of the temple, you will find another chest to loot. Proceed back up to one of the 5-way intersections. L|1|15.|From the 5-way intersection, take the opposite direction as before - if you are north head north and if you are south head south. This leads to the final room of the temple. L|1|16.|In the final room, pick up the «Grotesquely Carved Key» from the ground and loot two more chests. Leave the temple.
H3|Part 2: Direlands Swamp Temple L|1|1.|Head to the «Swamp Temple (Wai Jhou)¦Swamp Temple» (15+) located at 37.6S, 46.1W in the «East Direlands Swamp». L|2|•|Route 1: «Dryreach» to «East Direlands Swamp Portal» (8.1S, 74.5E), run to temple. L|2|•|Route 2: «Sawato» to Mire Hill Portal (27.2S, 59.9E), Mire Hill to «Incunabula Vault» (23.0S, 60.0E), surface portal to 35.9S, 47.2W, run to temple. L|2|•|Route 3: Use the «Portal to Kivik Lir's Temple» at your mansion, run to temple. L|1|2.|From the drop, head east. You will find a locked door (resistance: 500). Open it with the Grotesquely Carved Key or pick the lock. L|1|3.|Head down. Passed the room with gromnies, you will come to a large room very similar to the final room of the Blackmire temple, with hallways in the NE and SE corners. L|2|•|The hallway in the NE corner leads to a chamber with Undead (zombie - revenant). In order to enter this champer you must jump down a small pit. If you choose to do so, there is a surface portal so you can re-enter the dungeon. The hallway in the SE corner leads on to the rest of the dungeon. L|1|4.|Take the hallway in the SE corner. This will lead you to the area high above the large room with doorways looking down. Proceed west to advance. This leads to a large, multi-level room with numerous ledges and doorways opening into the large, main chamber. L|1|5.|From the bottom of this room, head west into a hallway. Go north (right). At the next intersection go north (left). At the next intersection go east (right) to find two more treasure chests. Proceed back to the 2nd intersection, this time going south. This leads to the final room of the temple. L|1|6.|In the final room, there are 5 unlocked loot chests to loot and one SIK chest. Leave the temple.

Quest.name: Tesserae
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|50 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Marae Lassel Plateau» I|Route|«Timaru» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|This is an optional side quest of the «Olthoi Queen Quest» that gives items redeemable for one point in a particular skill (essentially being an experience reward equal to the cost of the next point in that skill). After the fifth and final bell has been handed, progressive olthoi spawns begin to appear across the entire «Marae Lassel Plateau». There are five regions and each is independent of the other. These regions remain active until all stages have been advanced and the tesserae bearing «Olthoi Brood Noble»s killed or when the Queen is killed.
L|1|•|There is a maximum of 5 Tessera allowed per character.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Hand in the five «Pyreal Bell»s as described in the «Olthoi Queen Quest». L|1|2.|After the final bell has been handed, the five regions of «Marae Lassel Plateau» start spawning swarm olthoi. These are named the same as normal olthoi but have higher stats. The spawns are progressive, meaning that in each region there is a random olthoi (cannot tell which one until killed) that will give a local on death and cause all current spawn in that region to disappear and be replaced by new higher level spawn. L|1|3.|The first random olthoi will be a Soldier, the next an Eviscerator, the next an Olthoi Noble, and finally the «Olthoi Brood Noble»s will spawn. Most people believe there are two tessera bearing broods per region, though some people believe there are three or even four. L|1|4.|If the queen dies while hunting broods, landblocks with players in them will continue to have spawn, but once they have been killed (or the landblock is left for a few minutes) it will reset to its normal non-swarm status. L|1|5.|Turn the tesserae in to «Aun Hareltah» in «Timaru» for one point in that skill. It is in your interest to have a high point cost, characters can turn in a maximum of five (5) tesserae. There is also a two week timer to hand in each tessera (so it would take two months to hand in all five). Also you cannot use a tessera for a skill that has been untrained in the past two weeks.

Quest.name: The_Healer's_Heart_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Ithaenc Cathedral» at 82.4S, 93.4E I|Route|«Invitation Ithanc Cathedral» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest is intended for a group, but it is possible to solo it. L|1|•|«Lockpick» skill is needed to complete this quest. L|1|•|It comes in handy if someone bugs the doors when one of the party is doing the lockpick and lever parts P|There are several stamina blight, mana blight and dispell traps in the dungeon.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Start the Quest by purchasing an Invitation Ithaenic Cathedrall from any wedding planner in the starter towns at the Agent of the Arcanum. L|1|2.|Go up the stairs one stock, up the ramps. Tab jump into the window, or onto the ledge (if your jump is high, and you target the window, you might just jump out of the window on the other side of the bedroom). L|1|3.|Go outside on the balcony. Stand in front of the portal to «Catacombs of Ithaenc» and do a shift jump into the portal. L|1|4.|Once inside, go down 1 level. There are two doors, to the S and the N one. Leave at least one person at the S door to bug it if necessary. The rest of the party, except the lockpicker, can gather in front of the N door. L|1|5.|The lockpicker has to go all the way down (the dungeon is rather circular, with ramps further down on the other side). Best is to hang left to avoid traps. L|1|6.|On the lowest level, there is a locked door (diff 322). Pick it, and pull the lever in a room at the end of the corridor. L|1|7.|The lockpicker can now join the rest of the party, the S door on the first level should have opened. L|1|8.|One person should go through the S door (watch the dispell trap at the T), and down a ramp into a room, where two levers are situated in a smaller room in the middle. L|1|9.|Pulling the East level opens the door to the N. L|1|10.|Clean the spawn in this room, and anyone dispelled can rebuff. L|1|11.|Go down another ramp, and there will be a locked door (diff 322) before a pit. L|1|12.|Pick the lock and jump down. L|1|13.|The «Ancient Key» can be found on the corpse of one of the «Putrid Moarsman». It drops one per kill, and the respawn is quite slow. L|2|•|⟦novquest1⟧ L|1|14.|When everyone has a key, you can use the surface portal which dumps you on the balcony of Ithaenc Cathedral. L|1|15.|Go back into the bedroom, and use your key on the «Mistress' Chest». Note: the key is no-give, but the chest is accessible for anyone when opened, so one person can open it, and another person loot. L|1|16.|Loot the «The Healer's Heart», the «Scroll of Sanctuary Recall» (level III item spell), and optional/lore the «Tear-Stained Parchment» and the «Damp Scroll». L|2|•|Recall Pick up: ⟦novquest5⟧ L|1|17.|The Parchment and the Scroll can be given to «Bretself the Translator» for translation.

Quest.name: The_Moars_(No_Restriction)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|73.1S, 81.3E near «Kryst» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to retrieve information for Sho translator «Fanzen San the Translator¦Fanzen San» on the Moarsmen and their ties with the ancient «Falatacot».
L|1|•|The information he needs consists of lore texts that can be obtained from sections of the «Sunken Mere». L|1|•|To reach the sections of the Mere, you must first collect items from all over the «Vesayen Isles» in various «Moarsmen» dungeons and combine them to create the portal gems needed. L|1|•|Alternatively, if you do not want the experience rewards, the items can be combined into other items rewards such as jewelry.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Go to the «Mud Cave» at 73.1S, 81.3E near «Kryst» and retrieve the «Adjanite Gem» and the «Labyrinthine Necklace». L|1|2.|The «Adjanite Gem» gives access to a non-restricted dungeon, the «Sunken Mere». L|1|3.|At the end of this dungeon, you will find the «Muddy Tome». L|1|4.|Give the tome to «Fanzen San the Translator» for your rewards.
