Quest.name: Trothyr's_Rest_Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|20+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Ringoshu the Apple Seller» I|Starts At|«Rithwic» I|Route|«Facility Hub» I|Repeat|None H2|Overview P|«Trothyr» was mortally wounded by an undead lord in «Trothyr's Rest». Reclaim his lost war hammer and shield that the mighty warrior left behind.
L|1|•|This quest can be completed with lockpick (skill req. 125) or by purchasing a key from a nearby apple seller.
P|{WARN} No Quest Bonus stamps awarded
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Use the Facility Hub portal in the level 20+ room south hall L|1|2.|If you don't have lockpick, at the portal drop visit «Ringoshu the Apple Seller» at 13.6N, 50.7E. Purchase «Trothyr's Rest Key» and «Trothyr's Rest Rumor» for some lore on Trothyr and the dungeon. L|1|3.|Run to 10.3N, 54.9E and enter «Trothyr's Rest». L|1|4.|From the drop, head east through the doors and left at the split. Jump down into the large room below. L|1|5.|Head west down the ramp and use Trothyr's Rest Key on the door to your right (resistance: 125). L|1|6.|At the next split head left and straight on until you reach a room with a «Lich Lord» and a chest. L|1|7.|Take the passage next to the chest heading east and tap jump into the room on your right. L|1|8.|From here, go northeast down two ramps and you will come to a room with four ledges. L|1|9.|Jump over to the west side and pick up «Trothyr's Shield» and «Trothyr's War Hammer» from the floor.
L|1||Notes L|1|•|Directly below the room with the hammer and shield is the «Altar of Asheron». This altar is one of the two «Shrine of Asheron¦Shrines of Asheron» that can be used to revert back to non PvP mode after turning «Player Killer» (See also «Altar of Asheron Rumor»).

Quest.name: Undead_Attack_on_Al-Jalima
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|150+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Trevor Shunderson» (Optional/Seasonal) I|Starts At|«Burial Temple» at 8.5N, 5.9E I|Route|«Al-Jalima» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|This is a seasonal quest. While the dungeon is available year round, players can only obtain the «Enchanted Bone Fragment»s during the fall season. In addition, the quest NPC, «Trevor Shunderson», is removed from «Al-Jalima» along with the undead raiders, making it impossible to get the experience and title reward.
L|1||Prerequisites L|1|•|Al-Jalima Burial Temple: Each person in your group must have an «Enchanted Bone Fragment», which are found on undead creatures spawning in «Al-Jalima». L|2|•|{TIP} «Enchanted Bone Fragment»s are givable and have no timer, so one person can collect bones for a group or for future runs.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Al-Jalima Zombie Incursion L|1|1.|Defeat Undead creatures attacking Al-Jalima. L|1|2.|Loot a «Decaying Zombie Brain Portion». L|2|•|Note: «Enchanted Bone Fragment»s can also be found. These are used to enter the Warded Portal in the «Burial Temple» (see below). L|2|•|⟦DecayingZombieBrainPickedUp⟧ L|1|3.|Give the decaying brain portion to «Ungrim the Unpleasant Smelling» at 29.4N, 27.2E in «Glenden Wood» for your «#Rewards¦rewards».
H3|Al-Jalima Burial Temple L|1|1.|Defeat creatures attacking «Al-Jalima» until you find a «Enchanted Bone Fragment». Everyone in the fellowship will need one. L|1|2.|From «Al-Jalima», head to the «Burial Temple» at 8.5N, 5.9E. L|1|3.|From the portal drop, take the North hall. Jump down and hug the left wall until you get to a room with a «Sarcophagus» in the East end. In the SE corner there is a false wall behind a bench leading to a hidden hallway. L|1|4.|Take the ramp down behind the false wall, make your first left, and open the lever-activated door on the East wall. L|2|•|The lever to open this door is on the North wall in the room to the North. L|1|5.|Each person should hand their «Enchanted Bone Fragment» to the «Warded Portal» located in the room behind the lever-activated door to be portaled into the next part. L|1|6.|Work your way through each of the 6 rooms to the Northeast. Each room is separated by attackable «Wall»s that must be knocked down (there are two possible paths, it makes no difference which path you use). L|2|•|{TIP} «Tusker Fists» works well at destroying the doors quickly. L|1|7.|When you get to the final room, you will see «Orisis», the boss. Be careful not to hit either of the exit portals (8.5N 5.9E) in the room, there is no way back without using another bone and destroying the walls again. If you have enough people you can fight him in his room, if you are few in number it may be preferably to lure Orisis to a side tunnel. He has very high health. L|2|•|{WARN} **DO NOT** cast vulns on Orisis, he will simply protect over them, requiring you to maintain the vulns just to break even. L|2|•|{WARN} «Orisis» casts several very debilitating vulns and debuffs that cannot be dispelled **AT ALL**, including spells that can reduce skills by 99%, attributes by 99%, fellow stamina by 50%, 1 Strength, and life vulns ranging from 200% to 300%. L|2|•|{WARN} «Orisis» cannot be resisted, even with a «Resister's Crystal» (Magic Defense Rare). L|1|8.|Kill «Orisis». Loot an «Ancient Crest», and one person can loot his «Chilling Ebony Staff». There is only 1 staff per kill. L|2|•|⟦AncientCrestPickedUp⟧ L|1|9.|Bring the «Ancient Crest» to «Trevor Shunderson» in the middle of «Al-Jalima» for your «#Rewards¦rewards». L|2|•|Note: Although Trevor goes away after the seasonal patch ends, bones (if you have any left) can still be used to enter the dungeon where «Orisis» is located.

H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Trevor Shunderson says, "I came to shoot zombies and chew monougat." L|1||Trevor Shunderson says, "And I'm all out of monougat." L|1||Trevor Shunderson says, "No one's getting up here without a pack of mana charges and a pulse!" L|1||Trevor Shunderson says, "Ooo! Head Shot!" L|1||Trevor Shunderson says, "I got one!" L|1||Trevor Shunderson says, "Take that you dead bastard!" L|1||Trevor Shunderson says, "That's right! You just got sent back to the grave by Trevor's magic!"
L|1||Trevor Shunderson tells you, "Oh, thank goodness! I almost shot you. It's good to see another living face. It feels like it's been days since I've seen anyone. How are the rest of the towns? Has the plague spread?" L|1||Trevor Shunderson tells you, "Just Al-Jalima? That's odd. I presumed they had taken over everywhere. I wonder what's so different about Al-Jalima." L|1||Trevor shiver violently. L|1||Trevor Shunderson tells you, "I can't seem to get away from the undead! First that Orisis in Mayoi and now here..." L|1||Trevor Shunderson tells you, "They must be after me!" L|1||Trevor Shunderson tells you, "Well, I'm not going down without a fight! That's why I'm up here on the roof." L|1||Trevor Shunderson tells you, "You better get out of here before they smell your brains."
H3|Handing in Decaying Zombie Brain Portion to Ungrim the Unpleasant Smelling L|1||You give Ungrim the Unpleasant Smelling Decaying Zombie Brain Portion. L|1||Ungrim the Unpleasant Smelling tells you, "What is this?" L|1||Ungrim the Unpleasant Smelling tells you, "No! I don't eat brains!" L|1||Ungrim the Unpleasant Smelling tells you, "What were you thinking?" L|1||Ungrim the Unpleasant Smelling tells you, "You must be one of those traumatized survivors of the recent zombie attack." L|1||You've earned 17,000,000 experience. L|1||You have been granted the title of Zombie Incursion Survivor L|1||Ungrim the Unpleasant Smelling tells you, "Zombies give me the creeps." L|1||You see Ungrim move his hand towards his mouth. L|1||Ungrim the Unpleasant Smelling tells you, "What? Was I going to eat that brain, you ask? Why, would you like some?" L|1||Ungrim the Unpleasant Smelling tells you, "... err, I mean, I was just about to dispose of it, don't want to leave these things just laying around."
H3|Handing in Ancient Crest to Trevor Shunderson L|1||Trevor Shunderson tells you, "This is from that Orisis fiend? I was running the news in Mayoi when he came to town. I knew he was bad news right from the start, but nobody wanted to hear it. They were all caught up in his sob story about being a poor helpless undead. If only those fools had listened to me..." L|1||Trevor Shunderson tells you, "Well, that's all in the past eh?" L|1||Trevor Shunderson tells you, "There do seem to be fewer undead now. For helping to clean up Al-Jalima I award you the title "Death Knight"." L|1||Trevor looks around and in a whisper tells you some secrets to fighting the undead. L|1||Trevor Shunderson tells you, "... and remember never ever give one of those to an undead. Ever." L|1||You've earned 165,000,000 experience.

Quest.name: Virindi_Masks
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|N/A I|Repeat|None I|Kill Task|False I|Quest Chain|Mask Maker I|1|Virindi Masks I|2|«Heritage Regalia Masks» H2|Overview P|Collect broken masks from Virindi, and bring them to «Diyas al-Yat», «Leopold», or «Vincadi» to be repaired.
P|This quest leads into the «Heritage Regalia Masks» quest.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Collect the broken Virindi mask: L|2|•|«Broken Virindi Mask» - Dropped by «Virindi Master»s and «Virindi Director»s. L|3|•|⟦RegaliaMask⟧ L|2|•|«Broken Virindi Inquisitor Mask» - Dropped by «Virindi Inquisitor»s. L|2|•|«Broken Virindi Observer Mask» - Dropped by «Virindi Observer»s and «Apostate Virindi Aggressor (Level 100)¦Apostate Virindi Aggressor»s. L|3|•|⟦RegaliaMaskUpper⟧ L|2|•|«Broken Virindi Profatrix Mask» - Dropped by «Virindi Profatrix¦Virindi Profatrices» L|3|•|⟦RegaliaMaskUber⟧ L|2|•|«Broken Virindi Consul Mask» - Dropped by «Virindi Consul»s. L|3|•|⟦RegaliaMaskExtreme⟧ L|2|•|«Broken Virindi Desecrator Mask» - Dropped by «Virindi Desecrator»s and «Apostate Virindi Aggressor (Level 135)¦Apostate Virindi Aggressor»s. L|3|•|⟦regaliamaskdesecrator!⟧
L|1|1.|Bring the broken mask to the appropriate NPC for repair: L|2|•|«Leopold» and «Diyas al-Yat» repair the Virindi, Inquisitor, and Observer masks. L|2|•|«Leopold» and «Vincadi» repair the Profatrix mask. L|2|•|«Vincadi» repairs the Consul and Desecrator masks. L|1|2.|{OPT} Continue on to the «Heritage Regalia Masks».
P|You can give the Virindi Consul Mask to Vincadi to change the style of the mask.
P|If you have an old style Virindi Profatrix mask, you can give it to one of the apprentice mask makers to update it to the new style.
P|Broken Virindi Masks have a low drop rate, and finding the correct ones in any density can be difficult
P|In order to get the Virindi Masks you can find Virindi Masters on a very fast respawn in the shard room at the bottom of the Singular Obsidian Repository
P|In order to get Virindi Inquisitor Masks you can find Apostate Virindi Aggressors near the Empyrean Device at 84.8N, 17.6E
P|Virindi Consuls, Descecrators, and Profatrix can be found in quantity in the Virindi wing of the Dark Monolith Caverns. The portal gem to Dark Monolith can be found on both high level Virindi and Raven Hand humans.

H2|Dialog H3|Rumors P|⸨;Rumors, Hollow Victory⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "That Virindi, Leopold, you want to watch out for him. Those masks he gives out will turn you into one of his people."
L|1||Rumors, Festivus⸩ ⸨Town Crier tells you, "I hear tell that the Singularity Caul has a few new defenders. One of them I heard is a Virindi that stalks with Shadows. What could that mean?"⸩
H3|Virindi Mask Interactions P|⸨;Giving Broken Virindi Mask to Leopold⸩ ⸨You give Leopold Broken Virindi Mask.⸩ ⸨Leopold tells you, "How do you expect to fool anyone with a disguise that poor? Quickly, my comrade, you are fortunate that I have proper magics with which to fix your mask! Go now, into the world and continue our mission!"⸩ ⸨Leopold gives you Virindi Mask.
L|1||Giving Broken Virindi Mask to Diyas al-Yat⸩ ⸨You give Diyas al-Yat Broken Virindi Mask.⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat tells you, "Oh, yes, very nice! Leopold gave me some repaired masks -- I will trade you one of those for this broken mask."⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat gives you Virindi Mask.
L|1||Giving Broken Virindi Mask to Vincadi⸩ ⸨You allow Vincadi to examine your Broken Virindi Mask.⸩ ⸨Vincadi tells you, "I am not interested in collecting bits of inferior creatures."
L|1||Giving Broken Virindi Mask to Alexander the Deft⸩ ⸨You allow Alexander the Deft to examine your Broken Virindi Mask.⸩ ⸨Alexander the Deft tells you, "This is a good find, however I can do nothing with such a flawed product. Now if you could find a whole mask, then I could work wonders with it ..."
L|1||Giving Broken Virindi Mask to Janda Sulifiya⸩ ⸨You allow Janda Sulifiya to examine your Broken Virindi Mask.⸩ ⸨Janda Sulifiya tells you, "This mask is interesting, yet it is too damaged for me to make use of."
L|1||Giving Broken Virindi Mask to Tsua Kagemata⸩ ⸨You allow Tsua Kagemata to examine your Broken Virindi Mask.⸩ ⸨Tsua Kagemata tells you, "Hmm, if I had a whole one of these, I could make a very nice mask. It's a pity it's broken."
L|1||Giving Broken Virindi Mask to Trilaine di Ricard L|1||Dialog needed
L|1||Giving Broken Virindi Mask to Collector⸩ ⸨You allow Collector to examine your Broken Virindi Mask.⸩ ⸨Collector tells you, "I have no need for a broken mask."

L|1||Giving Virindi Mask to Leopold⸩ ⸨You allow Leopold to examine your Virindi Mask.⸩ ⸨Leopold tells you, "Do not worry, my comrade. I have extras! You can keep that one."
L|1||Giving Virindi Mask to Diyas al-Yat⸩ ⸨You allow Diyas al-Yat to examine your Virindi Mask.⸩ ⸨Diyas al-Yat tells you, "Isn't it lovely? I do so like the Virindi countenance."
L|1||Giving Virindi Mask to Vincadi⸩ ⸨You allow Vincadi to examine your Virindi Mask.⸩ ⸨Vincadi tells you, "I am not interested in collecting bits of inferior creatures."⸩

Quest.name: Fishing
Quest.notes: Auto-generated from Qb List bucket that did not match a Quest List row by name. Needs manual review/merge.
Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|Activity I|QB|11 stamps H2|Overview P|Grab an ale, a stump, and a sweet spot next to a watering hole. Check your progress as you would your chess ranking. But make sure you remember your bait! Introduced in the «Discoveries» event.
H2|Guide to Fishing L|1|1.|Obtain a «Wood Heart» or «Golem Jo». L|1|2.|Head to one of the «Tackle Master»s (see list below) and hand him either of the two items to receive a «Fishing Pole». L|2|•|Talk to «Tackle Master»: ⟦TalkedToTackleMaster⟧ L|1|3.|Hand him a «Trade Note (10,000)» to obtain the right to fish for 20 hours. L|2|•|⟦HaveFishingLicense⟧ L|2|•|⟦HadFishingLicense⟧ L|1|4.|Equip the «Fishing Pole». L|2|•|⟦WieldingFishingPole⟧ L|1|5.|Target a «Fishing Hole» (using the "R" key works fine). L|2|•|⟦FishingDelay⟧ L|1|6.|Once you have caught fishes, you can hand them back to the fishing hole to increase your fishing skill. You can view your current skill on the «Character Information» panel (yellow backpack icon on the interface). L|1|7.|Skill points awarded vary by fish type (see below). As your fishing skill increases, you will be able to catch larger fish. L|1|8.|After a catching a certain amount of one fish type (see below), hand one of that type to the «Tackle Master» to receive a title token. L|2|•|**Important|** Once you have caught 400 «Minnow»s, talk to the Tackle Master immediately to receive your title! If you catch 600 «Minnow»s before talking to the NPC to receive your Pond Scum title, you will *ONLY* receive the Skipper title, and will not be able to receive the Pond Scum title! Once you pass 1,500 minnows you will be able to receive a second token from the Tackle Master. This token will state that you are earning the title of "??????????" - turn that token in for the title of "Skipper." L|1|9.|You can also fish other items out of the fishing holes including rusted weapons, jewelry and rare finds such as housing items. L|1|10.|Fishes can be given to the «Tackle Master» for expired potions and sometimes pyreals. The bigger the fish you hand in the better the reward will be.
H3|Raising your Skill P|Handing the fish you've caught back to the hole will often give you points in your fishing skill, depending on the message you receive upon doing so: L|1|1.|If the message comes that the fish is stunned, you get no points: L|2|•|It seems a bit stunned, but after a few seconds it swims away. L|1|2.|If the message comes that the fish swims away strongly, you get 1 point: L|2|•|The fish splashes happily into the water. It seems shaken, but swims away strongly. L|1|3.|If the message comes that the fish splashes happily (without the swimming), you get 2 points: L|2|•|The fish splashes happily into the water. L|2|•|The fish splashes happily into the water. It seems fine and swims away quickly.

I|Type|Armor I|QB|5 stamps L|1|•|Creatures on «Dark Isle» spawn in pods of 4 creatures. One of the four (impossible to tell which one before killing it) will spawn a mini-boss when killed. These mini-bosses drop Dark Isle Trophies 100% of the time. L|1|•|These trophies can be turned in for significant amounts of xp (13 - 16 million) and for every 100 turned in to a particular NPC, a piece of armor is given. Quest.name: The_Healer's_Heart
Quest.notes: Route: Invitation Ithanc Cathedral
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Ithaenc Cathedral» at 82.4S, 93.4E I|Route|«Invitation Ithanc Cathedral» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|This quest is intended for a group, but it is possible to solo it. L|1|•|«Lockpick» skill is needed to complete this quest. L|1|•|It comes in handy if someone bugs the doors when one of the party is doing the lockpick and lever parts P|There are several stamina blight, mana blight and dispell traps in the dungeon.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Start the Quest by purchasing an Invitation Ithaenic Cathedrall from any wedding planner in the starter towns at the Agent of the Arcanum. L|1|2.|Go up the stairs one stock, up the ramps. Tab jump into the window, or onto the ledge (if your jump is high, and you target the window, you might just jump out of the window on the other side of the bedroom). L|1|3.|Go outside on the balcony. Stand in front of the portal to «Catacombs of Ithaenc» and do a shift jump into the portal. L|1|4.|Once inside, go down 1 level. There are two doors, to the S and the N one. Leave at least one person at the S door to bug it if necessary. The rest of the party, except the lockpicker, can gather in front of the N door. L|1|5.|The lockpicker has to go all the way down (the dungeon is rather circular, with ramps further down on the other side). Best is to hang left to avoid traps. L|1|6.|On the lowest level, there is a locked door (diff 322). Pick it, and pull the lever in a room at the end of the corridor. L|1|7.|The lockpicker can now join the rest of the party, the S door on the first level should have opened. L|1|8.|One person should go through the S door (watch the dispell trap at the T), and down a ramp into a room, where two levers are situated in a smaller room in the middle. L|1|9.|Pulling the East level opens the door to the N. L|1|10.|Clean the spawn in this room, and anyone dispelled can rebuff. L|1|11.|Go down another ramp, and there will be a locked door (diff 322) before a pit. L|1|12.|Pick the lock and jump down. L|1|13.|The «Ancient Key» can be found on the corpse of one of the «Putrid Moarsman». It drops one per kill, and the respawn is quite slow. L|2|•|⟦novquest1⟧ L|1|14.|When everyone has a key, you can use the surface portal which dumps you on the balcony of Ithaenc Cathedral. L|1|15.|Go back into the bedroom, and use your key on the «Mistress' Chest». Note: the key is no-give, but the chest is accessible for anyone when opened, so one person can open it, and another person loot. L|1|16.|Loot the «The Healer's Heart», the «Scroll of Sanctuary Recall» (level III item spell), and optional/lore the «Tear-Stained Parchment» and the «Damp Scroll». L|2|•|Recall Pick up: ⟦novquest5⟧ L|1|17.|The Parchment and the Scroll can be given to «Bretself the Translator» for translation.

Quest.name: Tumerok_Banners_Quest
Quest.notes: North hall of the Facility Hub (40+ portal) or from the north hall of the Town Network.
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|40+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Dryreach» I|Route|North hall of the «Facility Hub» (40+ portal) or from the north hall of the «Town Network». I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|This quest involves collecting different parts from Tumerok clans and then combining them to build a banner weapon or caster device that can also be turned in for other rewards. Crested Tumerok banners can be handed in for Tumerok Slaying «Assault Weapons».
P|When the quest was introduced during the «Crests of a Turbulent Sea» event, the banner parts were found on Virindi controlled Tumerok clans that were invading different parts of Dereth. However, in a later event the clans moved in to six «Tumerok Banners Quest¦dungeons» near «Dryreach».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|If you're looking to obtain an Assault Weapon, you will first need to check which clan you require the banner from (See the «#Rewards¦tables» below). L|1|2.|Head to each of the «Tumerok Banners Quest¦Tumerok Training Camps» from «Dryreach». L|1|3.|Inside each clan's dungeon are five different types of Tumerok that each drop a particular component for the banner. L|1|4.|«Tumerok Standard Bearer»s drop the banner signs, «Tumerok Commander¦Commanders» drop the spearheads and symbols, and «Tumerok Controller¦Controllers» drop the crests. The lighter colored hafts are dropped by «Tumerok Lieutenant»s and the darker colored reinforced hafts are dropped by «Tumerok Major (50)¦Tumerok Majors». L|1|5.|Each component changes what type of banner it becomes; for example, spear-head tipped banners are spear weapons, the symbol-tipped banners are wands and crest-tipped banners are spears with very low damage. The crested weapons can be turned in for an «Assault Weapons¦Assault Weapon» (see table below). L|1|6.|Once you have a complete banner take it to an «Army Recruiter» in either of three capital towns for your rewards. L|2|•|«Lieutenant Kenneth» in «Cragstone» at 25.8N, 49.1E. L|2|•|«Shosa Kiroji Matanui» in «Hebian-To» at 39.0S, 83.2E. L|2|•|«Ufet, Prophet of Blades» in «Zaikhal» at 13.9N, 0.7E. L|1|7.|Hafted banners, unhafted banners and also Tumerok Insignia can be given into the recruiters for various xp rewards. L|1|8.|If you have any spare unhafted banners and do not want the xp for them, they can be given to house decorators for framing into a house item: L|2|•|«Jubei Minawoto» in «Hebian-To» at 39.4S, 82.8E. L|2|•|«Jordan Ibn'Ikia» in «Zaikhal» at 13.2N, 0.3E. L|1|9.|ILT Note: Stamps were added for each assault weapon. See «Assault Weapons».

H4|Placing your Bet L|1|•|Speak to the «Carenzi Race Bookie» at the race track on the hill overlooking «Ayan Baqur» (59.2S, 88.4W). L|1|•|At any time, you may give the «Carenzi Race Bookie» 5 MMDs in exchange for a «Carenzi Race Ticket». They are stackable and may be given to other players. L|1|•|If you have not started a race within the last 15 minutes, the «Carenzi Race Bookie» will ask you if you would like to start one now. L|1|•|Click YES to begin. 20 seconds after selecting YES, 8 «Carenzi Racer»s will spawn in the pen nearby. At this point, you have ONLY ~40 seconds to place your bet. (**Note:** You may only place 1 bet per character, per race. Placing more than one bet will override any previous bet!) L|1|•|Bets can be placed by handing a «Carenzi Race Ticket» to the «Carenzi Racer» of your choice until the race begins (~40 seconds). All racers have an equal chance of winning. L|1|•|As soon as you place your bet, you will receive your half of the ticket stub, which expires after 6 minutes (whether your character is logged in or not). L|1|•|Exactly 60 seconds after having selected YES to the bookie's race dialogue, a «Carenzi Race Announcer» will appear, summoning the racers to their marks on the track. At this point, no more bets may be placed. L|1|•|About 60 seconds after the announcer appears, the race will finish, and the winning «Carenzi Racer» will be announced. L|1|•|After the race is completed, hand in your «Carenzi Race Ticket Stub» to the «Carenzi Race Bookie» **before it expires**. If your carenzi was the winner, you're given a «Grand Casino Key», to be used on the «Grand Casino Chest»s located at the «Casino»s in «Holtburg», «Shoushi» or «Yaraq». Losing tickets receive nothing in return. L|1|•|For convenience, 3 VIP Casino Portals are located @ 58.8S, 88.7W (behind the race track) for winning ticket holders: L|2|•|«Yaraq Casino VIP Portal» L|2|•|«Shoushi Casino VIP Portal» L|2|•|«Holtburg Casino VIP Portal» L|1|•|Races can be started every 5 minutes. L|1|•|Any given character must wait 15 minutes (from the time the last race dialogue was completed) before the bookie will allow him or her to begin another race. If the 5-minute global race timer is up, but your character's 15-minute timer is not, the bookie will tell you how long you must wait to start another race. L|1|•|Winning 10 races will give you the «Carenzi Cup», a hookable trophy. L|1||Carenzi Race Bookie tells you, "For having backed so many winning Carenzi you get an award kid! L|1||Al-Shashqa tells you, "Of special concern to me is one that they have created using an Empyrean Beacon they've unearthed. Quest.name: "Pistol" Pete Trophy Hunts
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|? I|Rec. Augs|VOD I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«"Pistol" Pete» I|Starts At|«Halls of Introduction» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|QB|15 H2|Discord Description P|What's that sound? New DAILY hunts have entered ILT.
P|[15 New Stamps available]
P|"Pistol" Pete is looking for the trophies of 13 new Rare Monsters scattered across Dereth. In return for their trophies Pete will reward the player with a "Medallion of Heroism". These new Medallions are highly sought after by the Lugian Brothers who have also set up in the new hub.
P|In return for the Medallions: P|Skorgnak will reward players with Luminance (1.6B if ENL 31+ and 800M if below) P|Rarinnak will reward players with Coins (20 Coins if ENL 31+ and 10 Coins if below)
H2|Overview P|"Pistol" Pete can be found in the Halls of Introduction, which can be access in the Town Network from «Overseer Oliver», Oliver will give you a portal gem to the Halls of Introduction. Pete wants trophy's from rare monsters around the tier 8 questing areas found around Dereth. Here's the list of creatures he would like you to hunt:
P|Lushikatome
P|Nephrite Gromnie
P|Silken Grievver
P|Ghastly Carenzi
P|Mutated Margul
P|Edgar The Snowman
P|Superficial Sclavus
P|Rat King Ronald
P|K'nath Eltrey
P|Illusionary Vibration
P|Deceptive Monouga
P|Anathematized Mukkir
P|Winston the Goat
P|Goal of this rough wiki page is to update this as hunt targets are found to hopefully make it easier for others to find. Turning in the trophy rewards a «Medallion of Heroism», they stack, turning into Skorgnak or Rarinnak will either reward Luminance or enlightened coins based on enlighten level.

Quest.name: A Master and his Simulacrum
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180+ I|Rec. Level|275+ I|Type|Solo/Fellowship I|Starts With|«Mistreated Virindi» I|Starts At|«Zaikhal» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Time|30-60 Minutes H2|Overview P|Quest to upgrade Imbued Asteliary items from the old retail quest «Simulacra Infiltrators».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Talk to «Mistreated Virindi» in «Zaikhal» to start the quest. L|2|•|⟦Sneaky_Virindi⟧ L|1|2.|Run to the «Hidden Infiltrator Keep» dungeon at 28.5S, 90.9W (layout is a clone of «Northern Infiltrator Keep»). L|2|•|Run from «Mount Lethe» or «Ayan Baqur». Dungeon is tieable/recallable if you die. L|1|3.|Inside the dungeon, kill «Tortured Ravener»s and «Damaged Doll»s for a «Shiny Red Stone». L|2|•|⟦Shiny_Red_Stone_Found⟧ L|1|4.|Head to the end of the dungeon, where Guardian of the Asteliary is guarded by Alarming and Dark Simulacrum. He drops several «Guardian of the Asteliary's Message Shard» for QB. L|2|•|⟦Guardian_of_the_Asteliary_Message_Shard⟧ L|1|5.|Head through the portal to the next dungeon, Asteliary Contentment. L|2|•|From this point forward, if you die you'll have to run through the first dungeon again. L|1|6.|Proceed through this linear dungeon to the end and take the portal to the final dungeon, Asteliary Pique. L|2|•|In this dungeon you'll find Asteliary Counselors and Dark Simulacrum. Be careful of the Dark Simulacrum missile attacks, as they hit hard. L|1|7.|Inside Asteliary Pique, kill «The Architect» and loot «Vial of The Architect's Blood». L|2|•|⟦Powerful_Blood_Obtained⟧ L|1|8.|Return the «Vial of The Architect's Blood» to the Mistreated Virindi in Zaikhal for 80 Enlightened Coins and a Hero Token. L|2|•|⟦Blind_Revenge⟧ L|1|9.|Return the «Shiny Red Stone» to Ellie in Crater for 30 Enlightened Coins and 5 Mythical Keys. L|2|•|⟦Shiny_Red_Stone_Turnin⟧ L|1|10.|Instead of turning in the «Vial of The Architect's Blood» to the Mistreated Virindi, you can upgrade an «Imbued Helm of the Simulacra», «Imbued Shield of the Simulacra», or «Imbued Asteliary Orb» to upgrade those items.
H2|Rewards
R|«Vial of The Architect's Blood» RK|Items| RI|«Enlightened Coin» (x80) RI|«Hero Token» (x1) RI|«Enlightenment Token» (x2) OR the blood can instead be used to create one of the following: RI|«Blood Soaked Helm of the Simulacra» RI|«Blood Soaked Shield of the Simulacra» RI|«Blood Soaked Asteliary Orb» RE
R|«Shiny Red Stone» RK|Items| RI|«Enlightened Coin» (x30) RI|«Mythical Key» (x5) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨=== Opening Dialog ===⸩ ⸨Mistreated Virindi tells you, "Hello Isparian...Hopefully you're not one of those evil ones?"⸩ ⸨Mistreated Virindi tells you, "My apologies, I just have a hard time trusting your type. However, if you'll assist me, I believe I can actually help you too.."⸩ ⸨Mistreated Virindi tells you, "I once despised your kind, Isparian. I served under a very powerful being who only reported to Aerbax himself. You may not know of him, but his creations.. I believe you call them Simulacrum."⸩ ⸨Mistreated Virindi tells you, "With his power, we made these imposters and learned so much from your kind...Good, and evil. However, most of my kind believe to be the superior race, so once I began to question the morality of what we were doing..."⸩ ⸨Mistreated Virindi tells you, "It's funny that for so long our kind are fooled into thinking we are superior to all. You stand here as proof for your people..Thank you, warrior."⸩ ⸨Guardian of the Asteliary tells you, "What!? A human enters my chambers? After all this time you finally found us... Now prepare to die!"⸩

Quest.name: Alduressa Shadow Armor Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|None I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Silyun» I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Overview P|This quest was only available during the «Down Twisting Paths» event and is now retired. You had to help «Iian di Alduressa» get assistance from the «Master Armorers» so he learn to forge his own Alduressa Shadow armor. He started crafting the armor from the «Shining Runes and Shadowed Hands» event onwards.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to «Iian di Alduressa», at 89.0N, 67.6W in «Silyun», and receive «A letter to Jibril ibn Rashid». L|1|2.|Give the letter to «Jibril ibn Rashid» at 7.1N, 3.0E near «Al-Jalima» to receive a «Tome on the Metallurgy and Crafting of Shadow Armors». L|1|3.|Head back to «Silyun», and give Iian the tome. He will give you «A letter to Alean the Steel Forger» and «A letter to Koga Hideki» in return. L|1|4.|Bring «A letter to Alean the Steel Forger» to «Alean the Steel Forger» at 18.5N, 62.8E near «Eastham». He will give you a «Crystal Shard Sample». L|1|5.|Bring letter to «Koga Hideki» at 82.8S, 46.0E near «Kara» to receive a «Shadow Shard Sample». L|1|6.|Finally, head back to «Silyun» and give the Crystal Shard Sample and Shadow Shard Sample to Iian di Alduressa for your rewards.
H2|Dungeons & Maps P|No quest dungeons.
H2|Rewards
R|Give both shard samples to Iian di Alduressa RK|Experience|55,847,478 RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "Greetings."⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "If you have the time, I would like you to do a favor for me. I am seeking knowledge on the smithing of unusual armors in this world, and have heard tell of something called "Shadow Armor" that is made using crystal combined with steel. I would like to learn more of this method of armor creation."⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "I have drafted a letter asking for assistance from a Gharu'ndim Master Armorer by the name of Jibril ibn Rashid, who resides near a Life Stone outside of Al-Jalima. Alas, my work here for the Knights keeps me from making such a long journey to deliver this letter myself."⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "If you could deliver this letter for me, and bring back any response given to you, I'd be indebted to you for the kindness you have shown me."⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa gives you A letter to Jibril ibn Rashid.⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "Bring this letter to Jibril ibn Rashid, outside of Al-Jalima. I will await your return."
L|1||Turning in A letter to Jibril ibn Rashid⸩ ⸨You give Jibril ibn Rashid A letter to Jibril ibn Rashid.⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid tells you, "A letter for me?"⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid carefully reads the note.⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid tells you, "Hmmmm..."⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid tells you, "This is both a rare and risky opportunity. The skill of the Alduressa family is renowned through all of Ispar. And, historically, they have served only the royalty of Viamont. For one to be willing to act separate from Varicci is a rare thing indeed."⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid tells you, "Tell me about your meeting with this young Alduressa."⸩ ⸨You tell Jibril ibn Rashid about your discussion with Iian di Alduressa.⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid tells you, "Hmmm... It is a risk, but it is a worthy risk, and this young Alduressa seems genuine..."⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid pulls out a massive tome, quickly penning a long note into the front cover.⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid tells you, "Here, take this book to him, and tell him about the note in the cover. Let us hope that we do not come to regret this."⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid gives you Tome on the Metallurgy and Crafting of Shadow Armors.
L|1||Turning in Tome on the Metallurgy and Crafting of Shadow Armors⸩ ⸨You give Iian di Alduressa Tome on the Metallurgy and Crafting of Shadow Armors.⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "Is this the response?"⸩ ⸨You tell Iian di Alduressa about the note in the front of the book.⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa reads the note carefully, and then quickly skims the tome, stopping at a couple of the illustrations momentarily. A smile slowly grows on his face.⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "Amazing. The manner of crafting the Alloy used in creating these armors is absolutely amazing..."⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "The note placed in the front of this text says I should request samples from the Aluvian and Sho Master Armorers. You have been kind to me once, may I ask your indulgence a second time?"⸩ ⸨You say, "yes"⸩ ⸨Iian quickly writes out two more letters.⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "Take these letters to the two other Master Armorers. I've named each letter accordingly. Alean the Steel Forger can be found along the road North of Eastham, and Koga Hideki, according to this note, can be found along the lake below the town of Kara."⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa gives you A letter to Alean the Steel Forger.⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa gives you A letter to Koga Hideki.⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "Bring back whatever response or items they send. Hopefully, they will also see the value of sharing our collective knowledge, and we can better our craft as a whole."
L|1||Turning in A letter to Alean the Steel Forger⸩ ⸨You give Alean the Steel Forger A letter to Alean the Steel Forger.⸩ ⸨Alean the Steel Forger tells you, "What is this?"⸩ ⸨Alean the Steel Forger carefully reads the note.⸩ ⸨Alean the Steel Forger tells you, "Hmmmm..."⸩ ⸨Alean the Steel Forger tells you, "Well, a letter like this, I never expected to see. An Alduressa Master Armorer, asking me for aid."⸩ ⸨Alean the Steel Forger laughs quietly.⸩ ⸨Alean the Steel Forger tells you, "Though, his knowledge really is an asset to all of us, if his words are true. And, Jibril seems to be willing to take the risk..."⸩ ⸨Alean the Steel Forger tells you, "Here, take this sample to him, and let's hope for the best."⸩ ⸨Alean the Steel Forger gives you Crystal Shard Sample.
L|1||Turning in A letter to Koga Hideki⸩ ⸨You give Koga Hideki A letter to Koga Hideki.⸩ ⸨Koga Hideki tells you, "A letter?"⸩ ⸨Koga Hideki reads the note.⸩ ⸨Koga Hideki tells you, "Interesting."⸩ ⸨Koga Hideki tells you, "This is quite a risk. If this young Alduressa is lying to gain information, this could go poorly for us."⸩ ⸨Koga Hideki seems lost in thought for a moment.⸩ ⸨Koga Hideki tells you, "I will trust in Master Jibril's wisdom, take this sample to Master Iian"⸩ ⸨Koga Hideki gives you Shadow Shard Sample.
L|1||Turning in Shadow Shard Sample⸩ ⸨You give Iian di Alduressa Shadow Shard Sample.⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "So, this is a sample of these "Shadow" Shards."⸩ ⸨Iian examines the small shadow shard sample for a moment.⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "Very strange. I've never seen anything like this at all. This came from some sort of creature?"⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "Thank you for bringing me this shadow shard sample. Once I have both samples, I can begin to study the process of alloying these materials into the components for armor."
L|1||Turning in Crystal Shard Sample⸩ ⸨You give Iian di Alduressa Crystal Shard Sample.⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "So, this is a sample of these Crystal Shards."⸩ ⸨Iian examines the small crystal sample for a moment.⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "Very strange. This is very much so unlike anything I've ever seen used in the smithing of armor."⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "Thank you for bringing me this crystal sample. With these two samples, I can begin to study the process of alloying these materials into the components for armor."⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "Please, allow me to reward you for your time and efforts."⸩ ⸨You've earned 55,847,478 experience.
L|1||Returning Dialog (Quest Completed)⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "Return to me in a month or so, with the Gems needed for crafting Shadow Armors, and I should be able to craft Alduressa Shadow Armor pieces for you."⸩

Quest.name: Asheron Entreats Deewain Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|180+ I|Rec. Level|200+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Asheron's Castle» I|Repeat|27 Days I|Time|30 min H2|Quest Overview L|1|•|This quest is now **retired**. P|⸨Asheron tells you, "It appears Deewain has left his cave. I believe this to be a good sign" He does not hand you the letter.⸩ L|1|•|Asheron wishes to mollify the golem Deewain and hopes to win his assistance in the coming conflict. He sends you as his messenger.
H2|Walkthrough L|1|•|This quest shares its timer with «Deewain's Dark Cavern», so if you complete that one, you can't do this one also as Asheron will turn you away. P|⸨Asheron tells you, "I can only hope that Deewain does not hold the actions of a few against all of us."⸩ L|1|1.|Speak to «Asheron» located in his castle's courtyard at 21.1N 69.2E. H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Begin by heading to «Eastham» and flagging for the portal to «Asheron's Island» by handing a «Shadow Fragment» or «Makkar's Eye» (rare live event item) to «Asheron's Servant» (17.8N, 64.3E). L|1|4.|When you defeat the general, pick the «Confined Guardian Light» that appears on the floor. You now need to repeat this for the other two dungeons. L|1|5.|Once you have all three lights, you have to give one to each of the three Fonts of the Guardian Light in Asheron's Castle and then speak to «Asheron's Servant» back in Eastham again. L|1|7.|You now have to return to each of the mouths and kill the generals again, but this time loot a «Shadow Anchor Piece». L|1|8.|Give the three anchor pieces to the servant at the castle for a piece of the Carraida jewelry set. L|1|9.|You can do this an additional 2 times to get the remaining pieces of the set (in order) if you wish. P|- Keep in mind that during your conversation Elmer will mention needing a password for Gunther allowing him to help you. Good idea to copy his text into the journal to look over it near Gunther.

L|1|•|Go to Gunter Thunderstomp in Tou-Tou's lighthouse (26.4S, 97.0E), talk to Gunther, and say the password in "Chat". He'll look at you and teleport you the dungeon.
L|1|•|Make your way to the top of the small dungeon full of knath's. You'll need keys from the monsters to proceed through the locked doors. The keys have a high drop rate from the monsters, just not 100%. You'll have a to kill a few to make it to the top where the boss lies.
L|1|•|Kill the Guardian spirit for his core at top of the dungeon, he'll drop 3 cores.
L|1|•|Bring the core back to Elmer in Lin for your «Summon Essence Refill Charm» reward.
P|You've stamped GuardianOfSpirit!

The stones are combined in this order: L|2|1.|«Stone of the Falatacot» L|3|•|As the gem settles into the shroud, a rush of ancient wind whispers through the seams - fragments of sun-baked ruins and forgotten rites stir within. L|2|2.|«Stone of the High Desert Nomad» L|3|•|The gem clicks into place with a sharp pulse of heat. You feel dust-laden chants and the grit of endless journeys carried in its glow. L|2|3.|«Stone of the Haebrous» L|3|•|The shroud grows heavier as the gem fuses - a sensation like deep roots sinking into stone. The air thickens with primal silence. L|2|4.|«Stone of the Dericost» L|3|•|The light dims. When this gem binds, a cold breath escapes the shroud - like something long dead, stirring in memory only. L|2|5.|«Stone of the Yalaini» L|3|•|The final gem hums with distant elegance. Glowing sigils ripple across the shroud, echoing the arcane brilliance of a corrupted bloodline L|1|2.|Find «Syrethis Val'Eshar» again between «Hebian-To» and «Tou-Tou» and hand her the completed «Sanctum Shroud» L|2|•|⟦EmpyreanAssasinationShroudComplete⟧ L|1|3.|«Syrethis Val'Eshar» will give you a «Report to the Enclave» which must be delivered to «Aurelia Silvershade» at 25.9s, 94.7e L|2|•|Do not talk to Aurelia before delivering the Report. L|2|•|Do not talk to «Selynith the Signal-Seer» unless you want to be smited L|2|•|⟦EmpyreanAssasinationAurelia⟧ L|1|4.|Deliver «Commendation Letter» that was given to you by «Aurelia Silvershade» back to «Elyraen Duskweaver» near the «Flat Auberean» lifestone at 39.1N, 9.3E L|2|•|⟦EmpyreanAssasinationWait⟧ L|2|•|⟦EmpyreanAssasinationFlagged⟧

R| RK|Items| RI|«Enlightenment Medallion» (x10) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨=== Opening Dialog ===⸩ ⸨Elyraen Duskweaver tells you, "Keep your voice down, traveler. Not all Empyrean eyes are blind to the shadows."⸩ ⸨Elyraen Duskweaver pauses, her eyes narrowing as she tilts her head slightly - listening. For a moment, all is still. Only the wind moves, threading through the trees like a whispered warning.⸩ ⸨Elyraen Duskweaver tells you, "You're not the first to wander here, whispering about truth and rebellion. Most are bones now."⸩ ⸨Elyraen Duskweaver tells you, "Trust isn't free. But war doesn't wait. If you're here to bleed for the right side, you might yet earn your place."⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "You've been sent to me, and so I must take the risk - though trust, in these times, is more fragile than truth."⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "I am Syrethis Val'Eshar, historian to the Covenant of Ironthorn - and last witness to what the Empyreans chose to forget."⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "Five long forgotten gems is what the Resistance seeks. Each stone holds the crystallized essence of a fallen lineage - fragments of the Empyrean soul, preserved through pain, pride, and ruin."⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "These are not mere relics - they are wounds carved into the world. Hold them too long, and they will open you."⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "This Shroud can contain them, but only if you honor the ancient sequence. I do not know the order, but rumors swirl that the sequence is imbued into the gem itself."⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar gives you Sanctum Shroud.⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "I possess a surviving fragment from the Library of the Corrupted High Empyrean. Treat it with care - there are few left who can read what it remembers."⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "The text speaks in riddles and ruin, but it will guide you. Return to me when when the Shroud is full."⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar gives you On the Custodians of the Shards.⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar steps forward, her hood falling back just enough for you to see the shimmer of tears - whether from sorrow or triumph, you cannot say.⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "You have done more than gather relics. You have carried the burden of Empyrean corruption, and what we have allowed fester."⸩ ⸨A sudden hush falls over the coast. Mana stirs around you like wind before a storm.⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "With these, we may continue the war effort. You are no longer a stranger. But beyond them, there is no promise of mercy. Travel well."⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar gives you Report to the Enclave.⸩ ⸨Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "This letter must be delivered to Aurelia Silvershade, stationed north at the shore outpost. She is a Lieutenant Commander of the Covenant - one you can trust."⸩ ⸨Aurelia Silvershade scrunches her face as she reads the note, her expression unreadable - an impenetrable mask that reveals nothing of her thoughts.⸩ ⸨Aurelia Silvershade tells you, "The return of the Sanctum Shroud is a crucial victory - your efforts are appreciated."⸩ ⸨Aurelia Silvershade tells you, "You have earned the trust of the Ironthorn. Before I can induct you, take this to Elyraen Duskweaver - and return to me without delay."⸩ ⸨The flesh is a lie. Come closer, and I will peel the truth from your bones.⸩ ⸨Elyraen Duskweaver tells you, "What's this?"⸩ ⸨Elyraen Duskweaver carefully breaks the seal on the letter, her gaze sharp and unwavering. A rare flicker of approval crosses her face.⸩ ⸨Elyraen Duskweaver tells you, "I don't know all you've done, but it must be important if this has come to me. Thank you."⸩ ⸨Elyraen Duskweaver tells you, "Do not linger on my account. My duty is here. Go - lend your strength to the Covenant where it's needed most. Return to the outpost."⸩

Level|275+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Enlightened Facility Hub Portal Gem» I|Starts At|«Enlightened Facility Hub» I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Quest Overview P|This quest series combines new and existing quests, points of interest, and dungeons linked together via the «Enlightened Facility Hub» with new rewards.
P|To enter the hub, use the innate spell of the «Enlightened Facility Hub Portal Gem». This gem can be obtained at 89.3N 42.8E on «Aerlinthe Island». Inside the dungeon, take the third right, look up, jump to the platform, and proceed while avoiding Portal Traps. At the end, pick up the «Enlightened Facility Hub Portal Gem» from the floor.
P|The Facility Hub is divided into three wings: L|1|•|**East Wing** - Contains wardens and portals for lower to mid-level players with only a few enlightenments. L|1|•|**West Wing** - Includes wardens and portals for high-level players with advanced augmentations and typically more than 50 enlightenments. L|1|•|**North Wing** - Offers portals to side quests and hunting areas designed for players with lower enlightenment/augmentation levels. L|1|•|**East:** «#Siraluun Champion Claws¦Siraluun Champion Claws» L|1|•|**West:** «#Elite Carenzi Fangs¦Elite Carenzi Fangs» L|1|•|**North:** «#Royal Gromnie Teeth¦Royal Gromnie Teeth»
P|The quest numbers do not indicate level requirements but serve as navigational references.
P|It is recommended to add rare mob spawns to Virindi Sense when searching for them.

Quest.name: Gear Knight Construction (Server Quest)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|80 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|Xarabydun I|Repeat|Once per character H2|Overview P|«Master Craftsman Takahume» in «Xarabydun» has uncovered plans to the «Gold Gear Primus». He believes he may be able to broker peace with the invading «Gear Knight»s if he can build it and requests your assistance in securing the needed parts.
P|This is a server quest and as large numbers of parts are turned in the Gold Gear Primus slowly takes form next to Takahume. First the feet (1k), then the legs (10k), then the abdomen (20k), then the torso (30k), then the arms (40k), and finally «Atamarr», the Gold Primus, is activated at 50k.
P|Once activated Atamarr will accept the items and gives a quest to retrieve a «Storage Box» located inside a bunker at 10.41S, 75.19W from the Direlands Invasion Area.
P|During the «Lay of the Land» event, the tasks and rewards of Atamarr were taken over by a new friendly Gear Knight, «Kaytin»
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Speak to «Master Craftsman Takahume» in «Xarabydun». L|2|•|Route: Take portal at 21.8S 1.4W in «Yaraq». L|1|2.|Kill Gear Knights to collect parts you can turn in to Takahume/Kaytin. L|2|•|«Direlands Gear Knight Invasion Area¦High Level Area» (items worth 5 points each) L|3|•|«Aetherium Power Core» L|3|•|«Aetherium Ore» L|3|•|«Aetherium-infused Gear» L|2|•|«Inner Sea Gear Knight Invasion Area¦Low Level Area» (items worth 1 point each) L|3|•|«Gold Aetherium Core Fragment» (possibly worth more than 1 point) L|3|•|«Large Gold Aetherium Core Fragment» (possibly worth more than 1 point) L|3|•|«Depleted Aetherium Ore» L|3|•|«Scratched Gear» L|3|•|«Gear Knight Core Fragment» L|1|3.|You are given xp rewards at 50, 100, 150, and 200 points turned in. You also get a title at 200. L|1|4.|Past 200 you are no longer rewarded, however you can continue turning in items to advance the construction of the golem/supply Atamarr (though you might as well use another character). L|1|5.|Kaytin also asks you to get a «Storage Box» in the Direlands Invasion area, it is found in one of the little caves in the center. L|2|•|Respawn timer on the box is at least 15 minutes.

Quest.name: Guardian of Attribute Enlightenment
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|275 I|Rec. Level|275 I|Starts At|«Temple of Enlightenment» I|Repeat|7 Days per attribute - 2 hours per riddle H2|Overview P|The statue is found at the bottom of the «Temple of Enlightenment». You can get a new riddle every 20 hours for a «Gem of Attribute Enlightenment». Each attribute is on it's own individual 7 day timer.
P|Each riddle corresponds to a quest stamp and is answered by providing the correct spell component, potion, or talisman.
TH|NPC Attribute Stamp TR|«Fiun Luunere» Strength ⟦TempleAttributeStrengthWait⟧ TR|«Fiun Ruun» Endurance ⟦TempleAttributeEnduranceWait⟧ TR|«Fiun Bayaas» Coordination ⟦TempleAttributeCoordinationWait⟧ TR|«Fiun Riish» Quickness ⟦TempleAttributeQuicknessWait⟧ TR|«Fiun Vasherr» Focus ⟦TempleAttributeFocusWait⟧ TR|«Fiun Noress» Willpower ⟦TempleAttributeSelfWait⟧ TR|«Fiun Vaelesh» Health ⟦TempleAttributeHealthWait⟧ TR|«Fiun Torrun» Stamina ⟦TempleAttributeStamWait⟧ TR|«Fiun Saeluun» Mana ⟦TempleAttributeManaWait⟧ TE
H2|Riddles & Answers TH|Stamp Riddle Answer TR|⟦TempleAttributeRiddle1⟧ Born of night, I drink the light. My heart beats black with power's might. I lend my strength to spells that harm - What stone of shadow wields such arm? «Powdered Onyx» TR|⟦TempleAttributeRiddle2⟧ Dereth's kind friend, I enchant the flesh and soul the gods did lend. My strength is not to strike, but stay - What stone defends the mortal clay? «Powdered Agate» TR|⟦TempleAttributeRiddle3⟧ Iron's brother, dark and sure. My charm is strength, my gift is cure. To mortal frame I grant my shield - What heavy stone keeps adventurers healed? «Powdered Hematite» TR|⟦TempleAttributeRiddle4⟧ From ancient sun and sap I'm born. I heal the wear, mend the worn. In golden glow, lost strength I weave - What honeyed stone bids pain to leave? «Powdered Amber» TR|⟦TempleAttributeRiddle5⟧ I break the chains, the unseen tie. I strip the veil from truth and lie. No harm I bring, yet spells I end - What draught unweaves that mages send? «Chorizite» TR|⟦TempleAttributeRiddle6⟧ In crimson veins my power flows, a guardian when the battle grows. I lend my pulse to strengthen kin - What gem of life beats deep within? «Powdered Bloodstone» TR|⟦TempleAttributeRiddle7⟧ My heart is flame, my hue is fire, I rouse the will and spark desire. For flesh and spirit both I cry - What ruddy gem calls vigor nigh? «Powdered Carnelian» TR|⟦TempleAttributeRiddle8⟧ Pale as dreams and cool as night, I mirror souls in silver light. I calm the beast, I soothe, I bind - What lunar gem gives peace to mind? «Powdered Moonstone» TR|⟦TempleAttributeRiddle9⟧ Green paths I trace through unseen doors, I bridge the realms and distant shores. Quest.name: Halls of Introduction
Quest.startTown: Use the Halls of Introduction Gem
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|1 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Augment Andy» I|Starts At|Use the Halls of Introduction Gem I|Repeat|Initiate Tender Hoard: 20 Hours, Stipend: 43 Hours P|Placeholder Page for Halls of Introduction
H2|Overview P|The Halls of Introduction is the starting area for new characters on Infinite Leaftide. Tutorial NPCs explain the custom systems: Quest Bonus, banking, infinite augmentations, daily quests and auto-crafting. There are 8 stamps to collect, and 6 of them come from a single visit. The Halls also have starter vendors, a spell school, a buffer, a life stone and portals onward.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Use the **Halls of Introduction Gem**. You arrive in the main hall next to «Augment Andy». L|1|2.|Talk with «Augment Andy» to learn about Infinite Augmentations. Five gems spawn on the floor next to him (Creature, Item, Life, Duration and Offense Gem). Hand him each gem for a short explanation of that augmentation type. L|2|•|No stamp. Real augmentation gems are sold at the Tusker Statue in Arwic (33.5N, 56.9E; Town Network > Aluvian section > Arwic portal). They cost Enlighten Coins to buy and Luminance to use. L|1|3.|Talk with «Banker Bobby» (just north of the arrival room) to learn about /b (/bank) and /b d (deposit all). The **Guide to Banking** sign next to him has the details. L|2|•|Hand him a **Trade Note (50,000)** (he gives it back): ⟦BigDMoment⟧ L|1|4.|Talk with «Monroe» (west room) to collect your first **Stipend** and the title Derethian Newbie. Spend stipends at «Marid» next to him. L|2|•|⟦StipendTimer_0812⟧ L|2|•|⟦StipendsCollectedInAMonth⟧ L|2|•|⟦StipendTimer_Monthly⟧ L|1|5.|Talk with «Thalor Quickforge» (west room), then tell him **AutoCrafting** to him and answer **Yes**. This unlocks /clap, which bulk-crafts Enlightened and Weakly Enlightened coins anywhere (/clap all). It buys the desiccants from your bank, so keep enough MMDs deposited. L|2|•|⟦AutoCraftingEnabled⟧ L|2|•|⟦FreeAutoCraft⟧ L|1|6.|Talk with «QB Quinn» (north hall) to learn about Quest Bonus: clubs at 2,500 / 5,000 / 7,500 / 10,000 QB, and the commands /qb, /qb list, /bonus and /top qb. L|2|•|⟦ExampleQuestBonus⟧ L|1|7.|Open the **Initiate Tender Hoard** (north hall, beside «Matteo Fibernauchi») for **2 Initiate Tender**. It can be opened again every 20 hours. L|2|•|⟦TenderChest⟧ L|1|8.|Talk with «Daily Dominic» (north hall, by the Refreshing Fountain) to learn about daily quests. The **Daily Portals** portal behind him goes to a hub with a life stone and daily quests for lower-augmentation players. L|2|•|No stamp.
H3|Notes L|1|•|Stamps count toward Quest Bonus once per **account**, not once per character. L|1|•|**Stipends:** Monroe gives one Stipend per visit, at most once every 155,200 seconds (about 43 hours). His dialogue says "every week", but the server timer is about 43 hours. After every 4 stipends he also checks a "monthly" timer. That timer is the same length, so in practice it doesn't slow you down. L|1|•|**Stipend titles:** Monroe awards a title when your total stipend count reaches: TH|Stipends collected Title TR|1 Derethian Newbie TR|2 Novice Wanderer TR|5 Notable Citizen TR|9 Adept Adventurer TR|13 Intrepid Explorer TR|17 Supreme Soldier TR|21 Epic Warrior TR|25 Paragon of New Aluvia TR|50 An Auberean Legend TE L|1|•|**School of Magic Masters** (east room): the «Dean of Admissions» sells **Spell Aquisition Order** scrolls, levels 1 to 7. Give an order to the Professor of Creature, Item, Life, War or Void Magic to learn every spell of that school at that level. L|1|•|**Vendors and services:** L|2|•|«Marid»: stipend shop. Attribute / skill / mastery reset certificates, spell certificates (Item, Life, Creature, Combat, Ring, Wall), Luminance Certificate, Boxed Augmentation Gem, Box Of Ten Promissory Notes, Boxed Devoted Luminous Amber of the Paragon. L|2|•|«Infinite Leaftide Customs»: trade note shop. Infinite Town Network Portal Gem, Abandoned Mines Portal Sending Gem, sealed salvage bags (including Foolproof), healing and alchemy bags, Aetheria Desiccant, Decanter of Siphoning, Lugian Aetheria Hammer, Diamond Scarab, Leaftide Signet. L|2|•|«Aydra the Redistributor»: Gems of Raising / Lowering (attributes) and Gems of Enlightenment / Forgetfulness (skills) for rebuilding your character. She doesn't give the quest bonus for these. L|2|•|«Bags Goes The Bagger»: Packs. L|2|•|«Matteo Fibernauchi»: starter weapons and casters (Matteo's blades, Elysa's Aim bows, wands and orbs). L|2|•|**Infinite Leaftide Buffer**: buffs you when used. L|2|•|**Garbage Barrel**: hand it items to destroy them. L|2|•|**Life Stone**: east room. L|1|•|**Portals:** Portal to Shoushi (arrival room), Portal to Town Network (west room), Daily Portals (north hall, behind Daily Dominic), Enlightened Facility Hub (north hall, east end by the sewer grate).

H2|Rewards
R|Initiate Tender Hoard RK|Items| RI|2 «Initiate Tender» RE
R|Monroe's Stipend RK|Title|Derethian Newbie (first stipend; more titles at 2, 5, 9, 13, 17, 21, 25 and 50 stipends) RK|Items| RI|«Stipend» RE
R|Thalor Quickforge RK|Items| RI|The /clap command (auto-crafting) RE
H2|Dialog P|**QB Quinn** L|1||Welcome in I'm going to teach you about one of the best ways to invest into your own future in this magical world: Quest Bonus or "QB". L|1||QB gives you multiplier to all Luminance and all Experience you earn. Think of a "stamp" as +1% more to all you earn. I'll give you a stamp as an example. L|1||So you see that blue text? That means your received a stamp and your bonus has gone up forever. Almost every single quest in the game has stamps and a lot of pick up on items do too. L|1||It's extremely important you build your way up the "QB" ladder as there are special clubs at 2,500, 5,000, 7,500 and even 10,000 Quest Bonus! L|1||Some useful commands are: /qb, /qb list, /bonus and /top qb L|1||Best of luck, hunter! P|**Banker Bobby** (after you hand him a Trade Note (50,000)) L|1||Daaaang! You learn so quickly. Excellent work. Take this "stamp" as a reward and talk to QB Quinn to learn more about stamps and Quest Bonus. P|**Monroe** (first stipend) L|1||Welcome citizen! L|1||I have been tasked with rewarding citizens for their service to Dereth. L|1||I will reward you with one stipend every week. You may use them to purchase special goods from the vendor over there. L|1||May it serve you well. Best of luck citizen! P|**Thalor Quickforge** L|1||Welcome adventurer, I have the power to bestow a unique gift upon you. L|1||A gift that will allow you to automatically craft Enlightened coins in bulk! L|1||If you wish for me to bestow this gift upon you simply tell me AutoCrafting. L|1||(after answering Yes) Congratulations you now have the /clap. P|**Initiate Tender Hoard** (opened too soon) L|1||You've tried to claim your bounty too recently. Try tomorrow.

P|Use the «Infinite Casting Stone» to activate its ability to cast all spells without components. H2|Dialog P|{{Dialog L|1||Use Ancient Aluvian Tree P|| You shake the tree violently but nothing happens. P|| Okay, that wasn't the smartest idea you've had. You need the bark. L|1||Give Aluvian Bark P|| Enephior, Master of Magics tells you, "Yes, yes, yes! This is it. This Aluvian Bark is the perfect tailsmen base. We're ever closer to your own Infinite Casting Stone." P|| Enephior, Master of Magics tells you, "Next up is some Tropical Hyssop. This is an odd version of hyssop and is nothing like you'd expect. It THRIVES in warm tropical areas and surely won't be too hard to acquire."
L|1||Use «Tropical Hyssop(landscape)» P|| ... I don't know what I expected when Enephior said get Tropical Hyssop. This looks like a mushroom not a plant... Rumors are the Lugians recently stumbled across a new geode deep within the earth that sounds like it may be just what we need."
L|1||Use «Geode Deposit» P||This geode caught my eye from the second I caught a glimpse of it. Absoutely stunning. P||Now, how to get a scarab from it. You pull out your trusty pocket knife to chip a piece off. P||Your knife instantly shatters like it's made of glass. Out of frustration you kick the deposit with all your might. P||OUCH! ... but you hear a piece of the deposit fall off and land on the ground with a high pitched ding. P||Geode Deposit gives you Geode Scarab.
L|1||Give «Geode Scarab» P||You give Enephior, Master of Magics Geode Scarab. P||Enephior, Master of Magics tells you, "You're making amazing progress and faster than I thought you would. P||The wax reshapes itself based off the vocal violence nearby and as it does a clump of wax falls off. P||Sticky Large Clump of Wax gives you Ethereal Wax.

L|1||Use «Fountian of Unending» P||Quite literally the most beautiful pool of water I've ever laid my eyes upon. P||Surely I have time just to take a little skinny dip before returning back to Enephior? P||You dip your toes into the pristine waters. That'll do... for now. You'll have to return for leisure at some point. But for now? liquid. P||Pool of Unending gives you Unending Aqueous.

P||Enephior, Master of Magics tells you, "Truly amazing. Thank you for gathering these items for me. I was able to replicate exactly the Infinite Casting Stone." P||Enephior, Master of Magics tells you, "This stone enables its wielder to cast all magics without the aide of spell components. A wonder burden-lifting gift." P||Enephior, Master of Magics gives you Infinite Casting Stone. P||Enephior, Master of Magics tells you, "This Infinite Casting Stone is just a small glimpse of the power the masters of combat will be able to teach you when you achieve Prestige."

I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|100+ (High Magic Defense) I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Kor-Gursha» on «Bur» I|Repeat|13 Days I|Time|30 min H2|Quest Overview L|1|•|**This quest is now retired.** L|1|•|During the «Blood From Stone» event, this quest was removed from the game due to it being "hard on the servers and on players' machines". L|1|•|You can find more details about its removal on Turbine's forums [http|//forums.ac.turbine.com/showthread.php?t=52175 here].
H2|Walkthrough L|1|1.|Speak to «Kaurik» in «Kor-Gursha» on «Bur». L|1|2.|Enter the «Southern Catacombs», stick right until you come to a portal, use the large Rock next to the portal. L|1|3.|In the Upper Catacombs you'll soon come to a large square shaped hallway that is filled with doors. Go to the north wall and use the 5th door (counting from the NW corner of the square, room just past the one with the chest). Use the statue in that room to enter the «Messenger's Sanctuary». L|1|4.|Speak to «Tikreek» L|1|5.|Hunt the catacomb levels for the NPC "Ghostly Messenger". Each time you click him, he will teleport to a different location (see NPC Spawn Locations below). L|1|6.|Eventually the «Ghostly Messenger» will appear as an attackable creature in the upper room. Kill him and retrieve the "«Ghostly Messenger's Missive»" from the ground. L|1|7.|Return to Kaurik in «Kor-Gursha», upon speaking to him, he says "Human! There's a Falatacot messenger trapped in the Upper Catacomb right now! Please go and take dare of it if you can, for the sake of both our peoples! Bring the message it bears back to me once you are done." L|1|8.|Hand him the missive L|1|9.|You give Kaurik Ghostly Messenger's Missive. L|1|10.|You've earned 164,455,904 experience. (lvl 256) L|1|11.|Kaurik tells you, "Hail, speedy one! You have deprived the Falatacot on Dereth of the advice they need. This will hopefully cause confusion in their ranks, and who knows what the result will be. I shall watch for more messengers - return in a short time to help us again." L|1|12.|You have received the title Honorary Burun Scout!
L|1||NPC Spawn Locations L|1|1.|LOWER LEVEL - SW Corner L|1|2.|MIDDLE LEVEL - NW Corner L|1|3.|MIDDLE LEVEL - SE Corner L|1|4.|UPPER LEVEL - NE Corner L|1|5.|LOWER LEVEL - SW Corner L|1|6.|MIDDLE LEVEL - NW Corner L|1|7.|MIDDLE LEVEL - SE Corner L|1|8.|UPPER LEVEL - NE Corner
P|It repeats the pattern half way through. Once you talk to all 8 spawns, head to the highest level (above Upper).
H2|Rewards
R|Give the «Ghostly Messenger's Missive» to «Kaurik» RK|Experience|164,455,904 (25% up to level 180) RK|Title|Honorary Burun Scout RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨Kaurik tells you, "Greetings, human. You are just in time, if you can help."⸩ ⸨Kaurik tells you, "I am Kaurik - I follow Tmauruk's commands in all things. He is clever and quick, much more so than most of us."⸩ ⸨Kaurik tells you, "He has asked me to ask help of humans who come by in an important task."⸩ ⸨Kaurik tells you, "Recently, a ghost appeared at the spot that your portal sends people when they come here from your Dereth. As we scouts drew closer, it fled quickly away. It moved too quickly for us to catch it, but it sealed itself into one of the many ways hidden in the Upper Catacomb."⸩ ⸨Kaurik tells you, "Tmauruk thinks that it is a messenger, going to see the Falatacot which live in the catacombs. Anything which helps them is bad for us, so we want to catch the messenger, see what it plans."⸩ ⸨Kaurik tells you, "I will show you how to use the statue so that you may gain access to the ghost's hiding place. Help us - bring us the message - and we will hail you accordingly. You also help your own people - the Falatacot do not love the humans who have defeated them and freed their prisoner."⸩ ⸨Kaurik tells you, "Human! Quest.name: Lost Relics
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|275+ I|Type|Solo/Group I|Starts With|«Master Arthon» I|Starts At|«Holtburg» at 42.4N, 33.7E I|Route|«Town Network» I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Time|1 hour H2|Overview
P|To solo this quest, you need to be around the augmentation level of Breakfast So Deadly, and even at those augs, the quest can be difficult. If you are below those augs, it is recommended to bring a carry or a group.
P|This quest does NOT require you to talk to «Master Arthon» or any of the other NPCs prior to the start of the quest. You can go to each mob (order does not matter), kill, loot and then turn in after you have done all 8.
P|Go out and kill each of the leaders and loot the lost lore item (note that each item has a decay timer of approximately 6.5 hours!). Return each of the items to the corresponding NPC.
P|Upon completion of all of the relics, speak to «Master Arthon» in «Holtburg» (you must speak to him 2x to receive your reward).

Quest.name: Minor Shivering Stone Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«A Shivering Stone» (Rumor, optional) I|Starts At|«Holtburg» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview P|Quest to obtain one of «Lady Maila»'s elemental stones. See «Atlan Stones» for the other quest guides.
L|1|•|Minor stones can be used to upgrade «Atlan Weapons» and «Isparian Weapons».
L|1|•|Any combination of two minor stones can be given to an «Agent of the Arcanum» for a «Writ of Refuge».
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Travel to the «42.7N, 49.8E - Igloo¦igloo» at 42.7N, 49.8E. L|2|•|Route: From «Holtburg», take the «Holtburg Wilderness Settlement» portal at 40.2N, 35.1E. Run northeast to the igloo at 42.7N, 49.8E. L|1|2.|Once there you will see it is surrounded by «Frost (Elemental)¦Frost» elementals, you can run right past them into the cave where you will find the «Minor Shivering Stone». L|1|3.|{OPT} You can take the «Textbook (Atlan's Treatise)¦Textbook», that is found with the stone, to Bretself the Translator in «Cragstone» for translation at 26.0N, 47.0E.
H2|Rewards
R|Retrieve items from Igloo RK|Items| RI|«Minor Shivering Stone» RI|«Textbook (Atlan's Treatise)» RE
R|Give two minor stones to an Agent of the Arcanum RK|Items| RI|«Writ of Refuge» RE
R|Give Textbook to retself the Translator RK|Items| RI|«Atlan's Treatise» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Handing in Textbook to Bretself the Translator⸩ ⸨You give Bretself the Translator Textbook.⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "Do you realize what you have here? This appears to be nothing less than an Empyrean weapons manual! What a fabulous discovery! At long last, we have a glimpse into the lost arts of their great society."⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator tells you, "You certainly deserve a copy a this for yourself.".⸩ ⸨Bretself the Translator gives you Atlan's Treatise.
L|1||Handing in Minor Shivering Stone to an Agent of the Arcanum⸩ ⸨You give Agent of the Arcanum Minor Shivering Stone.⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum tells you, "These elemental stones have wonderful properties. The minor ones aren't quite as useful as the major stones, but I can reward you a writ if you bring me another minor stone."⸩ ⸨You give Agent of the Arcanum Minor Shivering Stone.⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum tells you, "Excellent, the second minor stone! We hope to tap those energies for other uses. Here, take this as a reward."⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum gives you Writ of Refuge.⸩

Quest.name: Missing Persons Investigation
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Guard Hrothgar» I|Starts At|«Kryst» at 74.3S, 84.6E I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Quest Overview P|During the «Ancient Enemies» event, various creatures were kidnapped from their homes and used as Virindi experiments; the outcome of which can be seen in the Aerbax's Prodigal quests. At each of the kidnap sites, could be found a «Shred of Blue Cloth» that when handed to «Guard Hrothgar» earned you an experience reward (now retired).
H2|Kidnap Sites/Victim L|1|1.|«Timaru» - «Aun Town Crier» L|2||Fate Unknown - possibly «Aerbax's Prodigal Tumerok» L|1|2.|«Holtburg» - Apple tree Drudge L|2||«Aerbax's Prodigal Drudge» L|1|3.|«Hidden Cavern» - Harraag, Banderling Champion L|2||«Aerbax's Prodigal Banderling» L|1|4.|«Candeth Keep» - Candeth Keep Grocer (Dojiro Sangi) L|2||«Aerbax's Prodigal Human» L|1|5.|«Ayan Baqur» - Claude the Archmage L|2||«Delving into Claude's Mind»
H2|Maps
TH|Dungeon Coordinates Wiki Map ACmaps TR|«Hidden Cavern» 37.9S, 65.5W -- «map:5F48¦5F48» TE
H2|Rewards
R|Give Shred of Blue Cloth (Timaru) to Guard Hrothgar RK|Experience|2,820,052 RE
R|Give Shred of Blue Cloth (Holtburg) to Guard Hrothgar RK|Experience|3,289,118 RE
R|Give Shred of Blue Cloth (Hidden Cavern) to Guard Hrothgar RK|Experience|32,891,180 (5% up to level 180) RE
R|Give Shred of Blue Cloth (Candeth Keep) to Guard Hrothgar RK|Experience|3,289,118 RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Timaru (Aun Town Crier)⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "Greetings, traveler. If you'll excuse me, I am in the middle of examining a crime scene here."⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "The Aun town crier has disappeared from the town, and no one seems to know where she is. Aun Hareltah requested that the Queen send someone to investigate. It was a harrowing trip to get through Viamontian lines unnoticed, but we've managed to do so."⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "Unfortunately, we have no clues. We'll keep looking, but I don't see much likely hope of finding anything."⸩ ⸨You give Guard Hrothgar Shred of Blue Cloth.⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "What's this? You found it in the grass by where the town crier had been? Well, we'll see if we can figure out anything by it."⸩ ⸨You've earned 2,820,052 experience.
L|1||Holtburg (BoneCrunch)⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "Greetings, traveler. If you'll excuse me, I am in the middle of examining a crime scene here."⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "This is the second crime scene I've been to this month. This one is certainly more unusual. Certainly countless adventurers have honed their weapons and spells on the drudges which used to lurk by this tree - but I cannot imagine anyone with the power to kill permanently would waste their efforts here."⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "In addition, you'll note that only one corpse is accounted for. Perhaps the drudge felt that the threat of permanent death was too frightining and ran off - but after how many years guarding the same apple tree? This is a strange scene indeed."⸩ ⸨You give Guard Hrothgar Shred of Blue Cloth.⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "You found it near the tree, hm? We'll take a closer look and see if it means anything to anyone. Good eye."⸩ ⸨You've earned 3,289,118 experience.
L|1||Hidden Cavern (Harraag, Banderling Champion)⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "Greetings, traveler. If you'll excuse me, I am in the middle of examining a crime scene here."⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "We had a report from Hendac and Jenavere that something strange occurred within this cavern. Apparently, they have on occasion visited the banderling chieftain of this place - one Harraag - to learn more about the conflict between the banderlings and the augmented drudges, with few results. However, they tried to pay a visit this last time, and he wasn't there."⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "As much as I hate to admit it...I can't seem to get in to investigate the site. Instead, we're investigating around here to see what we can find."⸩ ⸨You give Guard Hrothgar Shred of Blue Cloth.⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "Thank you for going through the caverns for us! We'll take a close look and see what this is."⸩ ⸨You've earned 32,891,180 experience.
L|1||Candeth Keep (Grocer - Dojiro Sargi)⸩ ⸨As the month rolls around to April on another world far away, the world of Dereth becomes...more surreal.⸩ ⸨Yet even amongst all the surreality, a tragedy occurs. Yet another kidnappin has occurred, this time in Candeth Keep itself!⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "Greetings, traveler. If you'll excuse me, I am in the middle of examining a crime scene here."⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "This is at least a more conventional crime, even if we have no leads yet. Dojiro Sargi has been the grocer here in Candeth Keep for some time, but no one is aware of any enemies that he may have made. One night, Talira Dain's servant, Gilly, went out to pick up cheese for her mistress's late night snack, and discovered that Grocer Sargi was missing."⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "The local guard report that they might have seen the purple glow of someone portalling earlier that evening, but they assumed it was one of the many adventurers who often come here to reprovision."⸩ ⸨You give Guard Hrothgar Shred of Blue Cloth.⸩ ⸨Guard Hrothgar tells you, "We're beginning to develop a collection of these, I must say. We'll take a look and see what it means." P|You've earned 3,289,118 experience.⸩

H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|•|Go to «Lin» at 54.8S, 73.1E, and talk to Mrs-Ruggan, she'll give you an order (a piece of paper) to go pick up a shipment of lens from Schneeb's minion. L|1|•|Go to 55.2S, 71.7E in the hills behind the house and give the order to «Schneaky Schneebs Minion». He'll give you a shipment crate of lens to give back to Mrs-Ruggan. P|Notes L|1|•|The «Monster-Dex» shows you a list of monsters you have capture with len's already that are either shiny or not. L|1|•|«Schneaky Schneebs» sells the Monster-Dex for 1 MMD and «Flawed Siphon Lens» for 10 MMD each.

Quest.name: Mystery of the Black Pool
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|4.4S, 14.9E I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Quest Overview L|1|•|The Black Pool seems to be Sentient. Obtain a sample for Asheron and be rewarded. (This quest was only active during «Plans Within Plans» and has since been retired.)
H2|Walkthrough L|1|1.|Stand at 4.3S, 14.8E, just outside «Samsur», and use the «Black Pool» to emit a response from it. L|1|2.|Go to «Asheron's Castle» via «Eastham» and talk to «Asheron». He will give you an empty «Vial». Note: The portal to get to Asheron's Island is at 17.9N, 64.3E. L|1|3.|Go back to the Black Pool and use the pool again to fill the Vial. L|1|4.|Return to Asheron with the «Filled Vial» for an experience reward. L|1|5.|{OPT} Go and speak to the Archons near the Black Pool. L|1|6.|{OPT} Go back to Asheron one last time.
H2|Items
R|Talk to Asheron once you have a Filled Vial RK|Experience|80,000,000 (50% up to level 125) RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨Town Crier tells you, "Rumors have it a strange dark pool has been discovered. What does it mean? I do not know."⸩ ⸨Town Crier tells you, "Out in the desert, around 4.3S 14.8E, a black substance has bubbled up into a mountain crevace. Whispers say that when the substance is touched it invades your mind. Tread lightly young adventurer, this seems like it is only the beginning."⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "A dark pool out in the desert? I was pretty drunk last night so I apologize for the mess."⸩ ⸨Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "Ya I checked out the black pool. I wanted to see what it was like having thoughts in your head. The only thoughts that I heard were along the lines of "Go grab another stout." Seems like a smart pool to me." L|1||Asheron's Dialog during «Hopes and Fears»⸩ ⸨⸨Asheron says, "The Archons went through with their plan to rid themselves of the Black Pool."⸩ ⸨Asheron says, "I fear that the damage the caused to the land may have spread further down then they expected. If so than we must prepare for the fight that will come."⸩ ⸨Asheron says, "This is exactly why I urged them to stop their plan. I can only imagine how his power may have grown while imprisoned so deep within the world."⸩⸩
