Quest.name: Project Thaelaryn
Quest.notes: Chain: Thaelaryn Lassel Flagging
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|275 I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Aurelia Silvershade» I|Starts At|25.9S, 94.7E I|Repeat|1 Week I|Quest Chain|Thaelaryn Lassel Flagging I|1|«Empyrean Assassination» I|2|«Project Thaelaryn» H2|Overview L|1|•|Second quest in the T10 Flagging quest chain for access to «Thaerlyn Lassel» L|1|•|Requires «Enlightenment» Level 100+ L|1|•|Requires Bur flagging, and access to the Prodigal Lugian dungeon
H2|Walkthrough & Notes
L|1|1.|Speak to «Aurelia Silvershade» 25.9s, 94.7e L|2|•|⟦BloodstonePartTwoBegin⟧ L|1|2.|Speak to «Selynith the Signal-Seer» to receive the tuning fork. L|2|•|⟦HarmonicRecordingsStarted⟧ L|1|3.|Hand «Asheron» the tuning fork. L|2|•|⟦HarmonicCollectionAuthorized⟧ L|1|4.|Speak to «Selynith the Signal-Seer» to receive the Bloodstone Recording Device. **(He may have given this to you in step 2, or Asheron may give it to you as well)** L|1|5.|Find resonance locations See the clues below! (They look like colorful lifestones) ⟦HarmonicRecordingsStarted⟧ ⟦HarmonicCollectionAuthorized⟧ ⟦Bloodstone-TunedForkWielded⟧ L|1|6.|Once found, equip the «Bloodstone-Tuned Fork» and use the «Bloodstone Recording Device», this will spawn 5 Virindi and upon killing you will receive your stamp and you can move on to the next clue. L|1|8.|**The investigation must be done in the order of the clues.** L|2|1.|Clue 1: Crowned high where the bloodied sky shatters, and flora twist in mockery of nature - geometry weeps beneath their roots. ⟦CollectedHarmonicField1⟧ L|3|•|**«Platforms of Sorrow» 63.2S, 66W This is the same path you would take to open The Curator of Torment (Route: Rynthid Recall to 62.6S, 65.4W, or take the Rynthid Platforms Base portal in the Korway to the start of the platform climb, work your way up and to the second platform and jump across left (South) up a ramp to the right (west) than turn right (North) down the ramp and turn left (West) Path of Torment should be at the end. Inside: go down to the left and take the western most exit out of the larger room , stay straight leaving this room (West) around a horseshoe and continue west again , when you come to second larger room continue down and take either the east or south exits (Both lead to the same hallway) and turn right , follow this path until you reach the Path of Torment Portal. Once outside head down the ramp and turn left to another down ramp , in the center turn left again (East) and take the Path of Rage portal. Once inside follow the path to a larger room , down the ramp and find the eastern most path. Follow this path straight across towards the criss-crossed path following this path into another larger room and taking the path south out. Stay straight at the cross (East) and continue to through the linear hall to the Platforms of Rage Portal. Once outside take the east path down and turn right (South). Straight forward, on a platform just below, you should see the Path of Sorrow portal. Jump down and enter. Follow the linear dungeon and exit via the Platforms of Sorrow portal. You'll be on a large platform with a red Lifestone in the middle, that does not show up on the minimap, and cannot be targeted. Go to it and use the Bloodstone Recording Device to summon 5 Virindi that are probably just below the low end of T10 monsters. Not hard for anyone who can survive T10, but if you're lower, you'll want to be ready to quickly swap to a weapon. ** L|3|•|(When complete you will have a Raw Resonance Fragment in your inventory) L|2|2.|Clue 2: Festering beneath the soil in a vault of failed containment. The Virindi's whispers clashed with his inner voice until only fragments remained. ⟦CollectedHarmonicField2⟧ L|3|•|**«Martinate Holding»** (Fairly short run from Ancient Empyrean Grotto portal in the Facility Hub) Route : Once inside keep left in the near linear dungeon, checking ledges along your route for a Lifestone look alike (Does not show in mini map) Stand next to this and equip the Bloodstone-Tuned Fork, click on your Bloodstone Recording Device. Kill Rynthid Attenuator - Only 1 will need to be killed to obtain the stamp and Tuned Resonance Fragment. L|3|•|(When complete you will have a Tuned Resonance Fragment in your inventory) L|2|3.|Clue 3: Where dreams are feasted on and the green maw breathes heavy above, silence sinks deep into stone. ⟦CollectedHarmonicField3⟧ L|3|•|**«Ithaenc Quiddity Seed»** Dungeon (Must be flagged for the dungeon from the quest. Quickest way is to talk to Emissary of Asheron at Asheron's Castle, inside the door, into the courtyard, turn right and enter the NW tower, and it is the Emissary on the bottom, in front of you. After you speak with the emissary, head to «Aun Aemaua» located at 1.5N, 71.7W in Fort Teth. Then you'll be flagged to enter the dungeon) L|3|•|Once inside, keep going straight until you enter a room where you see a green Lifestone behind a wall. Go to it with the tuning fork equipped and use the Bloodstone Recording Device to summon the next group of Rynthid Attenuators. It is fairly easy to trap them in the room and debuff them through the wall. Only one needs to be killed to receive the upgraded Resonance Fragment. L|3|•|(When complete you will have a Harmonic Resonance Fragment in your inventory) L|2|4.|Clue 4: Where the desert forgets its name and the sun dares not linger, a charred hollow drinks the silence - the sky's old wound, rimmed in ash. ⟦CollectedHarmonicField4⟧ L|3|•|**At 20.2N, 71.2W, you can take the Linvak Extas portal (S TN, down the ramp) and run** L|3|•|(When complete you will have a Crystalline Resonance Fragment in your inventory) L|2|5.|Clue 5: Beneath the bones of the mountain, where giants pace in echoes, the way forward bends not to force, but to reason. ⟦CollectedHarmonicField5⟧ L|3|•|**Inside the «Prodigal Lugian» dungeon. You will need to complete the quest or if you have already completed it, talk to «Oswent the Pale» in «Cragstone» then use «Kresovus' Lockbox» at «Linvak Tukal»** L|3|•|(When complete you will have a Finalized Harmonic Core in your inventory) L|1|10.|Return to 25.9S, 94.7E and give «Selynith the Signal-Seer» the Finalized Harmonic Core. ⟦HarmonicFieldActivated⟧ ⟦HarmonicFieldWait⟧ L|1|11.|You may now talk to Ashea Val'ren, slightly to the west, and pay 50 MMDs to go to the island.

H2|Dialog
L|1||Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "You have done more than gather relics. You have carried the burden of Empyrean corruption, and what we have allowed fester." L|1||Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "With these, we may continue the war effort. You are no longer a stranger. But beyond them, there is no promise of mercy. Travel well." L|1||Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "This letter must be delivered to Aurelia Silvershade, stationed north at the shore outpost. She is a Lieutenant Commander of the Covenant - one you can trust." L|1||Syrethis Val'Eshar tells you, "We must now part ways. For the safety of all, I cannot be connected to you. I hope you will forgive me."
L|1||Elyraen Duskweaver tells you, "What's this?" L|1||Elyraen Duskweaver tells you, "I don't know all you've done, but it must be important if this has come to me. Thank you." L|1||Elyraen Duskweaver tells you, "Do not linger on my account. My duty is here. Go - lend your strength to the Covenant where it's needed most. Return to the outpost."
L|1||Aurelia Silvershade tells you, "The return of the Sanctum Shroud is a crucial victory - your efforts are appreciated." L|1||Aurelia Silvershade tells you, "You have earned the trust of the Ironthorn. Before I can induct you, take this to Elyraen Duskweaver - and return to me without delay." L|1||Aurelia Silvershade tells you, "I command this outpost, my eyes fixed upon Thaelaryn Lassel to the north - a once-thriving research colony steeped in ancient magics." L|1||Aurelia Silvershade tells you, "When Empyrean corruption took hold, the colony was sealed away. Long ago, we sent a scouting party to pierce the darkness - but no word has returned." L|1||Aurelia Silvershade tells you, "The portal energies around those isles have twisted into something foul, rendering our summoning efforts erratic and unreliable." L|1||Aurelia Silvershade tells you, "To break this barrier, we need recovered energy; it is the cornerstone for powering the summoning device." L|1||Aurelia Silvershade tells you, "Speak to Selynith. L|1||Selynith the Signal-Seer tells you, "Aurelia has good instincts. If she sent you... then we haven't much time." L|1||Selynith the Signal-Seer tells you, "The harmonic fields are spiking again. Someone is channeling resonance into the ley layer... and it's anything but natural." L|1||Selynith the Signal-Seer tells you, "You'll need these - a Virindi artifact recovered from a shattered conduit node, and this harmonic shell. Take the Tuning Fork to Asheron. Only he can attune it to detect the harmonic imprints left behind by the bloodstone manipulations." L|1||Selynith the Signal-Seer tells you, "Once you've gathered them all, I can attempt to breach a rift - a fleeting, unstable tear - to the island they call Thaelaryn Lassel." L|1||Selynith the Signal-Seer tells you, "But to stabilize the rift, I'll need Asheron's guidance. Seek him out. Then return - ready to carve a brief path into a place few dare name: Thaelaryn Lassel."
L|1||Asheron tells you, "Yes... Virindi craftsmanship - crude in design, yet horrifyingly precise. And it's already saturated with resonance from the bloodstone lattice." L|1||Asheron tells you, "I've adjusted its resonant thresholds. With this, you'll be able to trace the anchored energy signatures scattered across Dereth." L|1||Asheron tells you, "Be warned: each signal you find will provoke a response - likely Rynthid. They guard these sites, though I doubt they truly understand what they're protecting." L|1||Asheron tells you, "Use this device to detect harmonic disturbances and begin the collection process." L|1||Asheron tells you, "Activate it at each resonance site. If the tuning fork is properly attuned, it will trigger a reaction - and extract a fragment of the signature left behind." L|1||Asheron tells you, "This is the Codex Harmoniae. A fragment of the original research - recovered at great cost. It contains clues to where the resonance nodes lie. Study it well."

Quest.name: Rescue Fiona Woron
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|150+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts With|«Carolyn Woron» I|Starts At|«Baishi» I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Quest Overview L|1|•|This quest is now **retired** as of the «Gears of Change» patch. Fiona Woron is now found in the bar in Baishi with Ries and Carolyn.
L|1|•|Part 3 in the series of Thug quests. L|1|•|This quest requires 350 lockpicking skill. L|1|•|This quest is now part of the «Gear Knight Parts» quest. Although this version of the quest (below) is now retired, «Fiona Woron» can still be rescued from the cage and everyone can still get a «Braced Mana Forge Key». Follow the instructions below on how to release and cure Fiona.
H2|Walkthrough
L|1|1.|Talk to «Carolyn Woron» in «Baishi». L|1|2.|Head to «39.2S, 77.2E - Abandoned Sho Building» to the west of «Hebian-To» and loot the «Strange Stone» from the chest (3 stones per chest pull). The chest is guarded by 6 «Thug Boss»es on a quick respawn. L|1|3.|Carolyn then redirects you to the «Thug Hideout» at 65.8S 77.2E. L|1|4.|Go to the dead end wall just beyond the Throne Room (where «Fiona's Charm» was found during July's Patch). L|1|5.|Use the «Strange Stone» and it should open the Brick Wall. There is a pit you have to jump over right after the wall. L|2|•|**Note:** The door sometimes will refuse to open when you use the stone. Its unknown why this happens and it can take a while to work. Just keep trying is my advice. L|1|6.|Run down to an area with a bunch of Thugs and NPCs in cages. Kill every single Thug in the area. Once every Thug is dead then the doors will open to the next part of the dungeon. L|1|7.|Not far a head you will find big room with «Fiona Woron» and a some various objects and items L|1|8.|Look on the set of tables on the right side of the room you will see| Mixing Bowls and 4 bottles labeled A through D. There is a Cooking Vat beside the table. On the left side of the room you will see a Recipe. **Ignore the recipe!** It will just get you killed. There is only one correct potion that will cure Fiona. Other combinations of potions will have various effects including| nothing happening, killing you, casting Poison Health on you, summoning a portal to the top of Palace at Sanamar, killing Fiona, or turning Fiona into a Wight Blade Sorcerer. L|2|•|Pick up bottles A, C, and D. L|2|•|Hand Bottle A to the mixing bowl followed by Bottle C. This should get you a Green Potion. L|2|•|Hand Bottle C to the mixing bowl followed by Bottle D. This should get you a Purple Potion. L|2|•|Hand both bottles to one of the Cooking Vats. This should get you a Black Potion. L|1|9.|Unlock the cage that holds Fiona (350 Lockpick). Then hand her the Black Potion (**only Black!**). You only need one person from the group to hand in a potion. L|1|10.|Have everyone talk to Fiona for your reward. Only talk to her once the potion has been handed in. Carolyn Woron has nothing new to say to you even after the rescue.
H3|Recipe results H4|Mixing Vat L|1|•|A+B: Blue potion (1) L|1|•|A+C: Green potion (2) L|1|•|A+D: Gray potion (3) L|1|•|B+C: Orange potion (4) L|1|•|B+D: Pink potion (5) L|1|•|C+D: Purple potion (6)

H2|Dialog P|⸨;Opening dialog⸩ ⸨Carolyn Woron tells you, "My friends have come up with some information that might prove useful. There are rumors of some Thugs that happen to be hanging out in an old abandonded building west of Hebian-to. Maybe they can lead us further in this mystery."
L|1||Rescuing Trapped Townpersons⸩ ⸨Trapped Townsperson tells you, "Please get me out of here! You don't know what they do to us, it is terrible!"⸩ ⸨This lock looks too intricate for your abilities.⸩ ⸨Your initial look at this lock ends only in confusion.⸩ ⸨Just as you're about to get the lock open... Your fingers slip forcing you to start over.⸩ ⸨You open the lock with ease.⸩ ⸨Trapped Townsperson tells you, "Thank you for getting me out of that cell. I need to get out of here before they grab me again."⸩ ⸨You have been awarded the title "No Cage Can Hold Me"⸩ ⸨You look at the Thrungus and feel like you can hear it think "Thank you adventurer but the princess is in another cage."
L|1||Rescuing Fiona Woron P|⸨Fiona Woron says, "He gave me something, something I think is killing me. I am feeling weaker by the minute, please find a cure."⸩⸩ ⸨Fiona Woron tells you, "I think I am dying, please save me!"
P|⸨Fiona Woron says, "Oh thank you, I'm feeling much better already, I think that did the trick."⸩⸩ ⸨Fiona Woron tells you, "Thank you ever so much for releasing me and finding the antidote to the poison."⸩ ⸨Fiona Woron tells you, "I must leave here quickly and find my family, please take this reward as a small token of my appreciation."⸩ ⸨Fiona Woron gives you Braced Mana Forge Key.⸩ ⸨Fiona Woron tells you, "Thank you once again for saving me, you are so kind."⸩

Quest.name: Resolute Roodmingo's Bullying (Dusty's Hovel)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|? I|Rec. Augs|slightly below VOD augs I|Type|Solo or Fellowship I|Starts With|«Resolute Roodmingo» I|Starts At|«Danby's Outpost» 23.3N, 28.6W I|Repeat|20 Hours I|QB|2 H2|Overview P|Talk with Resolute Roodmingo in Danby's Outpost and he'll ask you kill some bullies who have taken over his Hovel. Bring back the belt of Gleeqeo's in particular.
P|Recommended VOD level of augs for Solo. Can be done with less augs in a group.
P|Req ENL level: 31+
P|You get 2(?) QB from this quest. One from the pickup of the belt, and turning it into Roodmingo.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|•|Talk with «Resolute Roodmingo» in «Danby's Outpost» at: 23.3N, 28.6W ⟦You've stamped GleeqeoStart!⟧ L|1|•|Head to Dusty's Hovel just east of «Danby's Outpost» at: 23.4N, 25.6W - can't be tied or recalled to.
P|There are only two enemies in this dungeon, «Woros» and «Gleeqeo». «Gleeqeo» has the quest item you need to bring back to Roodmingo.
P|They have charge spells similar to enemies in the «Viridian Rise» that will one shot you if you let them complete the charge next to you. When you see the level up animation from either Woros or Gleeqeo, move away from them.
P|Both «Woros» and «Gleegeo» are immune to Life magic debuffs.
P|You can separate them both by using range attacks and pulling them away from their starting spot. They'll leash back to their spots pulling one of them on the next range hit.
P|The random loot from them are on par with Tier 9/10 with decent dam, resist ratings.
P|Once you kill «Gleegeo», pick up «Gleegeo's Belt» and return it to «Resolute Roodmingo» for 8 Billion lum. P|⟦GleeqeoBelt⟧ P|This stamp may be from a killing blow, or from turning in the belt to «Resolute Roodmingo» P|⟦GleeqeoDemolished⟧

Quest.name: Shadow Breach Quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|100+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Arwic» at 33.6N, 56.8E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Quest Overview P|Originally, this quest was part of a «2006/06 - Grael's Forces Attack¦Live Event» during the Grael Story Arc. The portal opened up during the «From the Darkest Depths» event and remained open until it was **retired** during the «Filling in the Blanks» event.
P|During the Shadow Raids, Shadow Shards could be gathered to obtain a device. Turning in this device and the Amulet after killing the «Shadow Vortex» to «Riordin Nightbane» gave the «Grael's Claw», a mukkir slaying UA weapon.
H2|Walkthrough L|1|1.|Travel to «Arwic». Near the town is a pit with the portal to «Shadow Breach» L|1|2.|In this pit, there are a few «Barbaric Panumbral Mukkir», higher level «Shadow»s and the «Makkar», a level 235 boss Mukkir. L|1|3.|Makkar and the Barbaric Panumbral Mukkir drop about 5 «Amulet of Dark Rage» each. L|1|4.|Wear this Amulet to be able to enter the portal L|1|5.|The dungeon is rather small. On the way, you encounter a few Shadows and Mukkir. L|1|6.|At the end of the corridor, the «Shadow Vortex» can be seen across a grate L|1|7.|Kill the Shadow Vortex. L|1|8.|Enter the portal back to Arwic which spawns when it dies, this flags you for the reward L|1|9.|Hand the Amulet to «Sarkin Killcrane» for your reward

L|1||Upon the death of the Shadow Vortex⸩ ⸨The Shadow Vortex dissipates in a howling fury of chaos.
L|1||Handing in Amulet⸩ ⸨You allow Sarkin Killcrane to examine your Amulet of Dark Rage.⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "Good job, you've rooted out Grael's main contingent. The breach you described won't be closed that easily, but you have insured a short respite for the poor folks in Arwic."⸩ ⸨Sarkin Killcrane tells you, "May Grael taste the fear of the forces he has brought down upon himself. Quest.name: Sins of Dereth
Quest.Wiki:
I|Rec. Level|275+ I|Type|Solo/Fellowship I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview
H2|Walkthrough & Notes
P|Head to the Sins of Dereth dungeon at 35.4S 61.1W by following the ridges east and then south from VOD camp.
P|The mobs in this dungeon have been tweaked to hit you harder if you have a shield out. Also, you can use weakness on them to make them hit for almost nothing.
P|Dungeon is laid out like Abandoned Mine (sub), Big boss is at the bottom. To get to the bottom you have to obtain keys for 3 doors; Copper, Iron, Steel. Keys are dropped with about a 20% chance by the mobs in the area. First key drops on Erasers. Second key drops on [The human mages, not the Raven Augurs replace with real name]. Third key drops on Operators.
P|The Big Boss has 990000128 hp, but a Shroud of Darkness (Magic) cloak can be used to lower his defense enough to land debuffs. Slash and Light worked well.
P|Rewards are L|1|•|a multi use key to a treasure chest that contains random Enlightenment Tokens, Foolproof Salvage, Luminance tokens L|1|•|ability to open the Enlightenment Chest that gives a Part of a Medallion

Quest.name: Summoning T'thuun
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|150+ I|Type|Fellowship I|Starts At|«Patriarch's Valley» I|Route|«Eastham» to Patriarch's Valley portal at 17.6N, 63.5E I|Repeat|20 Hours I|Contracts|«Contract for Summoning T'thuun» H2|Overview P|T'thuun is being summoned by the Patriarchs. This ritual must be stopped.
L|1|•|There is no limit to the number of people that can participate in the summoning; however, at least one person must collect three «Summoning Rituals» tomes beforehand in order to be able to start the quest spawns. L|1|•|Collecting the invoking stones is an optional side quest to gain many title rewards.
H2|Walkthrough H3|The Summoning H4|Part 1: Collecting the Summoning Ritual Tomes L|1|1.|From Patriarch's Valley, enter each of the three pyramids (see below), and work your way to the top of the pyramid. Each pyramid has a unique Raid Commander, which drops one of the three «Summoning Rituals» tomes. There is no timer on pickup and they can be dropped, however you can only pick up one of each at a time. (if you have two toons there, you can pick up with one and store them on another) Once you have all three versions you are ready to spawn the quest. L|2|1.|«Summoning Rituals (Kazyk Ri)¦Summoning Rituals» is dropped by the «Kazyk Ri's Raid Commander» in the southwest pyramid at 58.4N, 11.2W. L|3|•|⟦PickedUpSummoningRitualsKazykRi⟧ L|2|2.|«Summoning Rituals (Nivinizk)¦Summoning Rituals» is dropped by the «Nivinizk's Raid Commander» in the north pyramid at 58.4N, 9.5W. L|3|•|⟦PickedUpSummoningRitualsNivinizk⟧ L|2|3.|«Summoning Rituals (Minik Ra)¦Summoning Rituals» is dropped by the «Minik Ra's Raid Commander» in the southeast pyramid at 60.2N, 10.3W. L|3|•|⟦PickedUpSummoningRitualsMinikRa⟧
H4|Part 2: Starting the Ritual L|1|1.|Once you have all three Summoning Ritual tomes, gather your group in the «Patriarch's Valley». L|2|•|Anyone can use the «Patriarch's Valley Portal» in «Eastham» at 17.6N 63.5E. However, for low level characters and mules, this is not advised since they will likely not survive the jump down into the valley. L|2|•|The surface portal in each of the pyramids is tie-able. This portal drops outside the pyramids on the valley floor, a safe location for mules and low levels. L|2|•|A common occurence is for someone to announce the quest and then summon portals in marketplace, colosseum, Arwic, etc. for players to get their characters in position to receive the reward. L|2|•|Note: The bosses are high health, so the more people you have the quicker it will be to kill them. L|1|2.|When ready, hand any one of the three tomes to «Captain Tulmada» (he will take all three), and jump down into the valley to fight. L|1|3.|Killing the three named bosses spawns the reward NPC, killing the tentacles does not impact the NPC spawning, however thinning them down before killing the final boss will make it easier for people to speak to the NPC without being killed. L|1|4.|Talk to Captain Tulmada after the enemies have been killed for rewards. He only remains there for a short time after each completion. L|2|•|⟦DefeatedtthuunReward⟧ L|2|•|Most players quickly log out and log into another character stationed in the valley after getting reward. It is possible to get rewards on 4 or more characters per account for each summoning.
H3|Collecting the Invoking Stones P|Stone collecting is an entirely optional side quest. L|1|•|This portion of the quest was devised from the «T'Thuun's Marauders» live event quests. L|1|•|Within each pyramid, enemies can drop «Invoking Stone»s. These stones can be collected and turned in for titles and experience. Each pyramid has 4 different types of Invoking Stones which can be collected for a total of 12 different stones. L|1|•|Collected stones are turned in to a «Royal Scout» for experience and titles. There is a royal scout located at the drop of the Patriarch's Valley portal from Eastham. He is next to the NPC who takes the books for the summoning portion of the quest. L|1|•|The North pyramid has invoking stones from «Arwic Invoking Stone¦Arwic», «Isle of Tears Invoking Stone¦Isle of Tears», «Festival Stone of Midsong Invoking Stone¦Festival stone of Midsong» and «Mount Esper Invoking Stone¦Mount Esper». L|1|•|The Southeast pyramid has invoking stones from «Mayoi Invoking Stone¦Mayoi», «Silyun Invoking Stone¦Silyun», «Candeth Keep Invoking Stone¦Candeth Keep» and «Southern Osteth Invoking Stone¦Southern Osteth Menhir Ring». L|1|•|The Southwest pyramid has invoking stones from «Ayan Baqur Invoking Stone¦Ayan Baqur», «Colier Invoking Stone¦Colier», «Asheron's Island Invoking Stone¦Asheron's Island» and «Tou-Tou Invoking Stone¦Tou Tou». L|1|•|The royal scout will refuse to take less than 30 of any particular stone at one time, and will take any excess stones above 30 without counting them towards the total. Therefore, you must do 3 individual turn ins of 30 or more for each stone to get the full rewards (36 total turn ins). Turning in 90 of one stone all at once will only count as a single turn in of 30. L|1|•|A title is given for each stone when 30 are turned in, and when 90 are turned in (3 turn ins). L|1|•|The pyramids are identical to one another in terms of layout. See the «Pyramid» page for a wiki map. L|1|•|There are certain enemies in each pyramid which drop specific invoking stones 100% of the time. TH|Stone Location Floor/Room Enemy Invoking Stone TR|«Southern Osteth Invoking Stone» Southeast Pyramid 1F, NE Room «Patriarch's Executioner» Southern Osteth TR|«Southern Osteth Invoking Stone» Southeast Pyramid 1F, SW Room «Patriarch's Executioner» Southern Osteth TR|«Candeth Keep Invoking Stone» Southeast Pyramid 2F, NE Room «Patriarch's Champion» Candeth Keep TR|«Mayoi Invoking Stone» Southeast Pyramid 2F, SW Room «Patriarch's Elite Raider» Mayoi TR|«Candeth Keep Invoking Stone» Southeast Pyramid 3F «Patriarch's Champion» Candeth Keep TR|«Mayoi Invoking Stone» Southeast Pyramid 3F «Patriarch's Inquisitor» Mayoi TR|«Tou-Tou Invoking Stone» Southwest Pyramid 1F, NE Room «Patriarch's Executioner» Tou Tou TR|«Ayan Baqur Invoking Stone» Southwest Pyramid 1F, NW Room «Patriarch's Executioner» Ayan Baqur TR|«Colier Invoking Stone» Southwest Pyramid 2F, SW Room «Patriarch's Inquisitor» Colier TR|«Asheron's Island Invoking Stone» Southwest Pyramid 2F, NW Room «Patriarch's Elite Raider» Asheron's Island TR|«Tou-Tou Invoking Stone» Southwest Pyramid 3F «Patriarch's Champion» Tou Tou TR|«Colier Invoking Stone» Southwest Pyramid 3F «Patriarch's Champion» Colier TR|«Festival Stone of Midsong Invoking Stone» North Pyramid 3F «Patriarch's Champion» Festival Stone of Midsong TR|«Festival Stone of Midsong Invoking Stone» North Pyramid 1F, NW Room «Patriarch's Executioner» Festival Stone of Midsong TR|«Isle of Tears Invoking Stone» North Pyramid 2F, SW Room «Patriarch's Inquisitor» Isle of Tears TR|«Mount Esper Invoking Stone» North Pyramid 2F, NE Room «Patriarch's Executioner» Mount Esper TR|«Arwic Invoking Stone» North Pyramid 3F «Patriarch's Champion» Arwic TR|«Arwic Invoking Stone» North Pyramid 1F, NE Room «Patriarch's Executioner» Arwic TE L|1|•|Some stones are the same color, but can be distinguished by the difference in background color. L|1|•|Cold/Frost weapons work better than fire on all enemies. L|1|•|Inside the pyramids, «Falatacot Patrol»s are spawned in the hallways via floor traps. These can be mostly avoided by hugging the walls. L|1|•|«Sclavus Patrol»s spawn on the first 2 floors of each pyramid and walk a specific path through the 4 rooms. L|1|•|Neither of the patrol enemies have a chance to drop invoking stones, only the other spawns inside the pyramids. L|1|•|All enemies on the 3F of each pyramid drop stones 100% of the time. 2 of these enemies always drop the same stone (listed in table above), the others drop 1 of the 4 invoking stones for that pyramid randomly. L|1|•|The respawn rate in the pyramids is faster than normal. Enemies will respawn before their corpses decay. L|1|•|In the southeast pyramid, the Silyun invoking stone is not dropped 100% by any enemy in the pyramid. It must be collected from random enemy drops. L|1|•|**The best method for collecting stones is to run directly to the 3F of each pyramid and collect stones there.** L|2|•|Using this strategy, you can collect 30 of each of the 4 invoking stones for each pyramid in about an hour. This translates to 9-10 hours to get all the titles. L|1|•|The Mount Esper invoking stone in the north pyramid does not seem to randomly drop as often as the other stones. As a result, you may need to camp the Patriarch Executioner on the 2F to finish collecting them. L|1|•|After turning in 30 of each invoking stone, talking to Asheron's Investigator in Eastham will yield the Stone Collector title and 1 billion experience. L|1|•|There is no bonus/additional reward for turning in 90 of each invoking stone. L|1|•|There is no timer on picking up or turning in stones to a royal scout.

L|1|•|**Retired quest** L|1|•|«Carolyn Woron» originally appeared in Lin at 54.5S, 73.1E during the «Picking up the Pieces» event. She disappeared on July 27th until she later reappeared as a permanent NPC in «Baishi» during the «Reclamation» event.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes L|1|1.|Go to the «Thug Hideout» dungeon and pick up «Fiona's Charm» off the ground. It located in a hallway just beyond the Throne Room. You are now reliving past events that happened to Ries and his brother (aka The Unknown Warrior). L|2|•|Note: Only one person can be in the dungeon at a time. If you hand in the items then talk to Carolyn while someone is still doing the quest then she will say you are rude to interrupt. Quest.name: Training Halls
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|1-5 I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Starter Outposts» I|Repeat|Non Repeatable H2|Overview P|The Training Halls were the location of the original tutorial quest designed to familiarise players with the basic game mechanics of Asheron's Call.
P|The halls were officially retired during the «The First Strike» event when six of the «Starter Outposts» were destroyed. The old tutorial has since been replaced with the newer «Training Academy Quest».
H2|Walkthrough L|1|•|Read the «Welcome Letter» and Enter the Training Halls portal at the «Starter Outposts». L|1|•|Speak with the «Greeter» for instructions. L|1|•|Follow the glowing green arrows through the halls, you will come to a long hallway with rows of «Straw Target Drudge»s that you can practise your combat skills on. L|1|•|Continue on and pick the «Training Hall Key» up from off the floor and unlock the door directly in front of you. L|1|•|Hand your «Calling Stone (Retired)¦Calling Stone» to the «Training Master» for a «Healing Tonic» and 75 experience points. L|1|•|Exit the hall via the surface portal nearby when finished.

H3|Experience L|1|•|75
H2|Dialog H3|Opening Dialog L|1||Greeter tells you, "Welcome! The Training Master is at the end of these Halls. Please follow the GLOWING ARROWS to get to the end. DOUBLE-CLICK the signs along the way to read them."
H3|Training Master L|1||Training Master says, "If you come across a new monster or item, use the magnifying glass to try to learn more information. Since your assesssment or appraisal skills are used, you may not learn very much if those skills are low."

Quest.name: Treacherous Tumeroks
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|275+ I|Rec. Level|275+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts With|«Lieutenant Waloth» I|Starts At|«Linvak Tukal» I|Route|Town Network to Linvak Tukal I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Overview L|1|•|«Lieutenant Waloth» tasks you with saving the miners and defeating the foreman inside the «Renegade Tumerok Mine». L|1|•|This quest requires that you show Lt. Waloth an Enhanced Assault Weapon. He does not keep the weapon.
H2|Walkthrough & Notes H3|Part 1: Speak to Waloth L|1|1.|Inside «Linvak Tukal» find «Lieutenant Waloth» and speak to him. He will ask you to allow him to examine an Enhanced Assault Weapon. L|2|•|⟦TreacherousTumeroksStarted⟧
H3|Part 2: Renegade Tumerok Mine L|1|1.|Proceed to the «Renegade Fortress» at 29.5S 65.6W. L|2|•|Route: From «Mansion» use a «Lesser Direlands Device» until you get the «Renegade Fortress» drop or Baishi - Drunken Madman (Walled Portals) - Outside Accursed Halls (24.0S, 57.7W) L|1|2.|«Renegade Tumerok Mine» is located inside the fortress to the left. L|1|3.|Once inside kill the Renegade Front Door Guard and loot Front Door Key and use it on the door then proceed through the dungeon until you encounter Slabtrok. L|1|4.|Slabtrok will ask you to kill the foreman and to free his 3 brethren trapped in the mine. L|2|•|⟦RescueGotrokPrisonersStarted⟧ L|2|•|He will give you three portal gems (unusable) that you can hand to each of the trapped Lugians.
H3|Part 3: Free The Trapped Miners L|1|1.|Follow hallway down, at split go left. You will come to a dead end where a lugian named Glubbok is trapped behind a door. Give him one of the portal gems. L|2|•|⟦SavedGlubbok⟧ L|2|•|⟦GotrokPrisonersSavedCount⟧ L|1|2.|Backtrack to the main split and go right, taking your first left into a hallway. Straight ahead is another Lugian named Miner Quorsus. Hand him a gem. L|2|•|⟦SavedQuorsus⟧ L|1|3.|Backtrack again to the first split. Go left and you will see a cat walk above you. Jump up and head north. Follow this pathway and go left and first split. In a pit you will see Riketura. Kill him and run back to the room where you talked to Slabtrok. Backtrack slightly and to the East will be an open door. L|1|4.|Go in and follow the path. At the first split you can go East and loot a Wood of the Keh Fire from the Keh Fire. L|2|•|Note: There is a shortcut to the foremans room located in the room beyond the Keh Fire. L|1|5.|Exit that room and head south down the ramp, taking the first West turn will lead you to the final Lugian Enginner Marnak. L|2|•|⟦SavedMarnak⟧ L|1|6.|Located in the same area is an Oil Cask. Using it will give you a Flask of Oil which is required to destroy the foreman's door. L|1|7.|Backtrack to Slabtrok and talk to him to get your rewards for saving all the miners. L|2|•|Slabtrok gives you 20 Yellow Aetheria Powder. L|2|•|⟦RescueGotrokPrisonersFinished⟧ L|1|8.|Return to the doored area and take the remaining unexplored pathway. Having both the piece of wood and the oil, give the Flask of Oil to the minecart to destroy the door. L|2|•|⟦DestroyedForemanDoor⟧
H3|Part 4: Foreman L|1|1.|Jump down and in the room will be the Foreman. If lower end of VoD augs you may want to wear a shield as he hits decently hard. He will spawn Tumeroks throughout the fight. L|1|2.|Upon defeat he will drop 9 Karnaz Ore. L|2|•|⟦KarnazOrePickedUp⟧ L|1|3.|Return to Linvak Tukal and give Waloth the ore and he will give you a Purified Karnaz Ore. L|2|•|⟦TreacherousTumeroksFinished⟧
H2|Rewards
R|Freeing the 3 trapped miners by giving them a portal gem and then talking with Slabtrok afterwords. RK|Items| RI|«Aetheria Powder (Yellow)» x20 RE
R|Purified Karnaz Ore can be used on an Enhanced Assault Weapon to upgrade it to an Ultimate Assault Weapon. RK|Items| RI|«Purified Karnaz Ore» RE
H2|Dialog P|⸨;Lieutenant Waloth⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Waloth tells you, "Greetings. I was once a proud member of the Renegades, but the tumeroks have turned cruel and have begun to abuse my Gotrok brethren. I seeked asylum here at Linvak Tukal, however as you can see they do not yet trust me."⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Waloth tells you, "The Renegades have caused much chaos to your kind, it is true. If you can show me proof of your distrust of the Hea Tumeroks, perhaps we can help each other. Show me an Enhanced Assault weapon created for use against such tumeroks if you are interested."
L|1||Handing him an Enhanced Assault Weapon⸩ ⸨You allow Lieutenant Waloth to examine your Enhanced Assault Orb.⸩ ⸨The Renegade lugian inspects the orb closely.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Waloth tells you, "I see that I can trust you. In the Direlands north of the Valley of Death lies the greatest Renegade Fortress ever constructed. Disrupt their operations however you can, and if possible, save the Gotrok you find enslaved there. Slay the foreman and bring me proof of your deeds. It may be possible to further upgrade your weapon to slay even the mighty tumeroks that reside in the Valley of Death."
L|1||Handing Waloth Karnaz Ore⸩ ⸨You give Lieutenant Waloth Chunk of Karnaz Ore.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Waloth tells you, "Incredible...I did not expect one of your kind to be successful. I hope this means my brethren can escape safely now."⸩ ⸨The Gotrok begins to shape and carve the ore until it shines so bright you have to cover your eyes.⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Waloth tells you, "I am a Gotrok of my word. Combine this with one of your Enhanced Assault weapons and it will grow in power. Take it, and slay as many of the vile betrayers as you can!"⸩ ⸨Lieutenant Waloth gives you Purified Karnaz Ore.
L|1||Slabtrok⸩ ⸨Slabtrok tells you, "I did not expect one of your kind here. Could it be? Did Waloth send you?"⸩ ⸨Slabtrok tells you, "If you can dispose of the foreman of this wretched mine, most of my brethren will be able to escape. However, there are three who are imprisoned and will need assistance to get away safely. Please give these portal gems to them so that they can escape when the time is right and it is safe to do so."⸩ ⸨Slabtrok gives you 3 Linvak Mountains Portal Sending Gems.
L|1||Slabtrok after rescuing all three Lugians⸩ ⸨Slabtrok tells you, "Thank you for giving my brethren the means to escape. We have no use for these, so you can have them. Please, kill the foreman so we may all escape if you haven't already."⸩ ⸨Slabtrok gives you 20 Yellow Aetheria Powder.
L|1||Miner Quorsus⸩ ⸨Miner Quorsus tells you, "Thank you. Please rescue the others as well."
L|1||Miner Glubbok⸩ ⸨Glubbok tells you, "Thank you. Please rescue the others as well."
L|1||Engineer Marnak⸩ ⸨Engineer Marnak tells you, "To get to the foreman, you'll need to blow up the door to his chambers. There should be oil and fire nearby which you can use."⸩ ⸨Engineer Marnak tells you, "Please return to Slabtrok and inform him we are ready to escape. Thank you for your aid."
L|1||Oil Cask⸩ ⸨You fill up a flask with some of the oil.⸩ ⸨Oil Cask gives you Flask of Oil.
L|1||Full Wheel Cart of Karnaz Ore⸩ ⸨You allow Full Wheel Cart of Karnaz Ore to examine your Flask of Oil.⸩ ⸨Throwing the oil and burning wood into the mine cart triggers an explosion that destroys the door!⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Wood of the Keh Fires.⸩ ⸨You hand over all of your Flask of Oils.
L|1||Without Both Items (Wood of the Keh Fire and Flask of Oil)⸩ ⸨You allow Full Wheel Cart of Karnaz Ore to examine your Wood of the Keh Fire.⸩ ⸨You seem to be missing something to trigger the explosion.⸩

I was tired of all the the sun and relaxation, you know how it is. Anyway, I traveled around for awhile visiting pubs and inns and ended up in Dryreach, where I was astonished to find a wonderful house brew made by my friend Mordomor. He's downstairs." L|1||Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "I decided to spend awhile getting to know the drink better so I went to find the old lifestone NW of town. L|1||Ulgrim the Unpleasant tells you, "Now, I'm going to give you a very important bit of information here. Never ever, under ANY circumstances, bind to a lifestone when your drunk. Quest.name: Wedding Preparations
Quest.Wiki:
I|Level|Any I|Rec. Level|40+ I|Type|Solo I|Starts At|«Yanshi» at 12.9S, 41.6E I|Repeat|20 Hours H2|Quest Overview L|1||Retired.
P|Show your support for the upcoming marriage by bringing various items to the craftsman and florist.
H2|Walkthrough L|1|1.|Make your way to the «Wedding Chapel» near «Yanshi» at 12.9S, 41.6E. H3|Gazebo Craftsman L|1|1.|Hand a «Tree» to the «Gazebo Craftsman». L|2|•|Trees spawns can be found on the landscape in the woodland areas to the north (North of Glendon Wood is good area to find trees). L|1|2.|Hand trees to npc until you receive msg stating that the gazebo is complete. L|1|3.|Hand Argenory Dye to npc until he states he no longer needs more Argenory Dye (25 dyes). L|1|4.|Hand Minalim Dyes to npc until he states the Gazebo is finished (25 dyes).
H3|Tree Craftsman L|1|1.|Give «Tree»s to the «Tree Craftsman». L|2|•|Trees spawns can be found on the landscape near the woodland areas to the north high concentration of trees in the area north of Glendon Wood. L|1|2.|On handing the craftsman a 2nd tree, you get the option to exchange it for a «Shaped Tree».
H3|Stone Craftsman L|1|1.|Hand in «Rock (Wedding Preparations)¦Rocks» to the «Stone Craftsman». L|2|•|Rocks can be found to the south near «Linvak Tukal» in the mountains and in parts of the Direlands. They have been mistakenly named "Tree" so watch out for them. L|1|2.|Hand in a second rock for the option of exchanging it for a «Stone Bench» (approx 25 rocks per section of benches - 4 sections in total).
H3|Florist L|1|1.|Hand a «Tree» to the «Florist». L|2|•|Trees spawns can be found on the landscape near the woodland areas to the north. L|2|•|Tulips can be found around Danby's Outpost and on Western Aphus Lassel (purple, yellow, white, orange, red) L|1|2.|Hand trees to the NPC for the «Garden Box» to appear in the Wedding Chapel (25 Trees per set?) L|1|3.|After 4 rows on each side of the empty looking wooden boxes are there, you can start delivering «White Tulip¦Tulips» L|1|4.|If you hand in a second tulip, a pop-up box appears and asks if you want to change your trophy tulip for a hook-able one.
P|When all tasks are complete, the area is beautiful and fit for the coming wedding. NPCs are still there, and now we wait. If you would like to see finished chapel, Solclaim has completed it.
H3|Shedding Skin Update L|1|1.|Speak to the «Wedding Gifter» who will give you experience if you turned in 1 or 2 items and allow you to choose one of the six bracelets on the table next to her if you turned in 3?? or more items in the previous patch.

I leave the study of these nasty things to others though, you never know what might happen when you activate it. You should be rewarded for this find. Here you go!"⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum gives you Writ of Refuge.
L|1||Retired Dialog (from ??)⸩ ⸨The Agent bows their head low and speaks softly.⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum tells you, "It is a sad time my friend. Our leader, Nuhmudira, has left us and wandered into the northern wilds with her new apprentice. I cannot believe the rumors that are circulating about her having sacrificed her closest confidant, and protector...but..."⸩ ⸨The agent sighs and looks to meet your eyes.⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum tells you, "We want you to help us find her. Please. She headed to the north, somewhere deep into the mountains. We do not know exactly where, but there is a rumor of an ancient library that once belonged to the Gelidites hidden somewhere. If you can please find Nuhmudira."⸩ ⸨A tear falls from the Agent's eye. Their voice crackles and breaks.⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum tells you, "We shall be lost without her. Until she is found we shall still accept: any of the four elemental prisms, Regular and Quality Pyreal Ingots, Diamond Powder and Nuhmudira's Token."
L|1||Retired Dialog (from ??)⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum tells you, "Greetings, adventurer. I have been sent here by the Arcanum to provide Writs of Refuge in return for various items needed to prepare for any coming turmoil that threatens the Isparian presence here on Ispar. Nuhmudira has informed us that creatures of old may soon be stalking the earth. And these creatures hold items of value. Items that we can use. If you come across a Crest of the Falatacot, a Ring of Mummified Skin, or a Quiddity Crystal, I am able to exchange a Writ of Refuge for any one of these items. What we need may change at any time, so be prepared."⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum tells you, "Apparently the creatures who hold these items may not be abroad in the land quite yet. When they first appear, we shall herald their presence and repeat our warning for as long as they stalk the earth."⸩ ⸨Agent of the Arcanum tells you, "Once you possess the Writ of Refuge, then you have satisfied the main requirements for acquiring a home. The Covenant Crystals also require money and other minor items, but those items should not be in short supply. Enjoy your homestead! One Note: Nuhmudira has set aside a small number of palatial estates for those allegiances thought to be most worthy of their ownership, and the most generous with their resources. She has not opened them up yet, but she will soon."

You are very kind, but I have all I need to refashion my eyes. It may take some time, but you have helped me enough. Here, have this back in case you lose your eyes." P|Blind Snowman tells you, "Shoom! Shoom! Both my eyes go flying from my head and I can't see. Then I hear two distinct voices. One was chiding the other to apologize and the other one was laughing all crazy and mean. The loot isn't very good though. Note: You must be in a fellowship of at least one to activate this. That is if you are not in the fellow that killed the Lord, or if you were alone and not in a fellowship at all, Aun Tahuirea will not give you a key. (Creating a fellowship with only yourself works.) Quest.notes: from the wiki (no quest summary box)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|Trophy collector NPC I|QB|3 stamps H2|Notes L|1|•|Route: See «Kor-Gursha» and «Bur» L|1|•|First time talking with Furgal. L|2|•|⟦FurgalMushroomStarted⟧ L|1|•|Furgal collects Mushrooms in return for xp and titles. L|2|•|First Mushroom: ⟦FurgalMushroomTurnIn!⟧ L|2|•|200th Mushroom: ⟦FurgalMushroomTurnInMax⟧ L|1|•|The mushrooms spawn on the floor in the various Bur Catacombs. TH|Mushroom Catacombs Section TR|«Blue Glow Mushroom» «Northern Catacombs» Upper level TR|«Green Glow Mushroom» «Northern Catacombs» Lower level TR|«Red Glow Mushroom» «Eastern Catacombs» Upper level TR|«Red Glow Mushroom» «Eastern Catacombs» Lower level TR|«Blue Burning Mushroom» «Southern Catacombs» Upper level TR|«Red Burning Mushroom» «Southern Catacombs» Lower level TE
L|1|•|If you want a lot of mushrooms for titles and xps, see tactics for an explanation of a more long-term increase in finds. TH|Tactics TR|# The mushrooms spawn on the floor instead of a «Thrungus». # The dungeons have 4 different spawns: single Thrungus spawn, multiple Thrungus spawn, single Guruk spawn and multiple Guruk spawn. # The Thrungus spawns have of course, the highest chance of spawning a mushroom. The multiple more than the single ones. This can go up to 3 mushrooms in one Thrungus spawn. # The dungeons reset in a way upon leaving and re-entering. However, this does not change the kind of spawn on a certain spawnpoint. ## I.e. if there is a single Guruk spawn when you leave the dungeon, it will be a single Guruk spawn when you re-enter. ## If it is a multiple Thrungus spawn (with or without mushrooms), it will be a multiple Thrungus spawn (with or without mushrooms) when you re-enter. # Now, to increase your chances, kill any Guruk you meet. # The respawn will cycle randomly through the 4 different spawns. Keep killing all Guruk, until all spawns have changed to Thrungus. Leave all the Thrungus spawns (of course you can take all the mushrooms). # Upon re-entering, there will be more Thrungus spawn, and therefore, a higher chance for mushrooms. # If you find a single mushroom (i.e. without Thrungus surrounding it), this is a mushroom instead of a single Thrungus spawn. Taking the mushroom will mean, that the spawn will cycle again, and you might meet a Guruk spawn at that point again. # You can get a dungeon so far, it only spawns Thrungii, and therefore, a very high chance for mushrooms. # However, each patch day, the dungeons will truly reset, and spawns will be completely random. TE

Quest.name: Land Control
Quest.notes: from the wiki (no quest summary box)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|Quest / area I|Coordinates|64.0S 97.5E I|QB|2 stamps H2|Overview L|1|•|Introduced in the «Ancient Powers» event. L|1|•|There are two land control Fortresses (more commonly called Keeps), one called «Northwatch Castle» in «North Osteth» and the other is called «Freebooter Keep» found on «Freebooter Isle». L|1|•|The Keeps are normally occupied by the creature forces of the Creeping Blight («T'thuun»'s minions), however, Player Killers that are allied with either the «Celestial Hand», «Eldrytch Web» or «Radiant Blood», may claim the Keep for their faction. L|1|•|You must be also be «Player Killer» to participate in Land Control in any meaningful way. NPKs can help kill the Creeping Blight creatures but cannot attack banners and claim the Keeps nor can they receive the reward from the NPC after the Keep is claimed. L|1|•|You must also be level 180+ and a member of the faction that currently controls the keep to enter the «Black Market» portal. L|1|•|**Warning:** The land block of the Keeps and the Black Market are no log so if you log off too close to the Keep you will find yourself back at the lifestone when you log in.
H2|The Keeps H3|Freebooter Keep P|«Freebooter Keep» is located at 64.0S 97.5E on «Freebooter Isle». You must be at least a «Knight» in your faction to access the island. To reach the keep, use «Sanctuary Recall» or buy an «Invitation Ithanc Cathedral» from a «Wedding Planner». From the Cathedral run west and use the «Statue of Transport» found on a raised platform at 82.6S 88.8E to be portaled to «Freebooter Isle». The Keep is a short run to the southeast and up a hill.
P|There are three banner locations plus the Crystal Array: L|1|•|Courtyard - 81.6N 24.8E - On the ground in the middle of the courtyard near the north wall. L|1|•|Spire - 81.4N 24.9E - On the checkerboard landing by the spire tower (above the entrance). L|1|•|Tower - 81.5N 24.6E - On the top of a floating tower on the west side connected to the castle wall by a bridge. L|1|•|The Crystal Array spawns on the platform over the Courtyard.
TR| TE

L|1|•|«Dagger Vale» at 32.9N 59.6E in «Arwic», drops at 83.3N 28.8E L|1|•|«Neydisa Castle» in «Holtburg» that drops at 69.6N 17.6E L|1|•|«Patron's Honor Cottages» at 66.2N 14.2E in «Crater Lake Village», drops at 75.3N 27.2E. H2|Taking a Keep L|1|1.|Before the Keep reverts back the Creeping Blight and can be claimed again there are several global messages that go out to announce the change. The global messages start one hour before the Keep is available. L|1|2.|When you see the globals you should get ready and become a player killer then head out to whichever Keep is about to revert to the Creeping Blight. L|1|3.|When the Keep reverts back to the Creeping Blight the Society Soldiers will be replaced with Moarsmen and Armored Sclavus. Three Creeping Blight Banners will appear in the Keep: one in the Courtyard, the Spire, and the Tower. L|2|•|**Note:** The creatures there do not yield any xp nor do they have any loot or trophies. L|1|4.|Use one of the Banners to claim it for your society. A single player can only use one Banner every 5 minutes so unless you have 2 other people with you from the same society you will have to wait about 15 minutes to get every Banner solo. L|2|•|⟦KeepBannerClaimedWait⟧ L|1|5.|There is a 5 minute waiting period after you use a Banner till the time it is officially claimed. During this time the Banner can be destroyed by someone from a rival society. After 5 minutes the Banner is claimed but is still able to be killed but gains a regeneration rate making it harder to kill. If a player from a rival society claims a Banner you have to destroy their Banner in order to revert it back to the Creeping Blight then you can claim it. The best way to kill a banner is with archers using rended weapons and perching it from above (rended weps because the banners cannot be imped/vulned). L|1|6.|Once all three Banners have been claimed by the same society for five minutes then you have successfully captured the Keep. L|1|7.|Unless the «Crystal Array (Land Control)¦Crystal Array» (see below) is destroyed then your society will control the keep for roughly the next 3 days (68 hours).
P|Creeping Blight Banner of the Courtyard Creeping Blight Banner of the Spire Creeping Blight Banner of the Tower Celestial Hand Banner of the Courtyard Celestial Hand Banner of the Spire Celestial Hand Banner of the Tower Eldrytch Web Banner of the Courtyard Eldrytch Web Banner of the Spire Eldrytch Web Banner of the Tower Radiant Blood Banner of the Courtyard Radiant Blood Banner of the Spire Radiant Blood Banner of the Tower Creeping Blight Banner of the Courtyard Crystal Array
H3|Rewards P|Once your faction controls the keep, it will gain the following benefits: L|1|1.|In the Courtyard an NPC called «Mitsuhara Takeo» (CH), «Mitsuhara Kamekeka» (EW), or «Mitsuhara Ryuhi» (RB) will spawn. Talk to him and he will reward you with a «Braced Mana Forge Key». You must be a PK to receive the reward. The NPC remains at the Keep for 5 minutes. L|2|•|⟦KeepRewardsWait⟧ L|1|2.|Access to the «Black Market» (level 180+) which is found down the tunnel in the center of the Keep. L|1|3.|A «Buffing Array» crystal will appear next to the Black Market Cave entrance in the courtyard that will provide 90 minute level VIII life protections. L|1|4.|The Keep will fill with Soldiers that will defend your fort and attack players of the opposing factions.
P|Braced Mana Forge Key Buffing Array
H2|The Crystal Array P|The «Crystal Array (Land Control)¦Crystal Array» appears on a platform in the courtyard after 27 hours. The array has 1.5 million health and if destroyed will cause the fortress to revert to the Creeping Blight (instead of waiting for the 68 hour timer to expire). If the array is never destroyed, the 68 hour timer will simply expire and the fortress will become neutral as before.
L|1|1.|A global will go out signaling that an array has appeared at one of the Keeps. L|1|2.|The Crystal Array is located on the platform above the Keep's Courtyard. Run past all the soldiers of the opposing faction and get on the platform where there are only two soldiers. L|2|•|**Warning:** An archer on the ledge below may be able to hit you even though you are on the platform. L|1|3.|Use Archers and Melees with rended weapons to kill the the Crystal Array. Mages just provide support since they can't do much damage or debuff the Array. L|1|4.|The Array will spawn Satellite Fragments when it is attacked. These fragments only appear on the platform with the Array and will attack any player nearby regardless of what society they belong to. L|2|•|**Note:** If your society already controls the Keep and the soldiers won't attack then you can avoid the satellites. You can kill the Array with archers who fire from the wall near the bridge to the tower. If you have a couple archers it is probably easier to do this rather than fight the satellites. L|1|5.|When the Crystal Array dies it will be replaced with a «Creeping Blight Banner of the Courtyard Crystal Array¦Creeping Blight Banner of the Courtyard» that looks just like the Array you just killed. The "Banner" Crystal has a count down timer on it and will remain for 5 minutes. L|1|6.|If a member of an opposing faction uses the Banner Crystal then the Keep is reverted to the Creeping Blight and then it may be claimed normally in the manner written above. L|2|•|If 5 minutes passes and the Banner Crystal remains then a member the Defender Faction may use it to restore the old Crystal Array (unconfirmed how that actually works).
H2|Supply Crates L|1|•|Occasionally while destroying the Crystal Array or just after a a Keep has been claimed a Supply Chest will appear somewhere in the Keep. It is very rare and the circumstances surrounding its appearance are not currently known. It may be totally random. L|1|•|So far it has been seen in two places: L|2|•|In the courtyard behind the cave entrance to the «Black Market» L|2|•|In the attic of the house. L|1|•|It is guarded by 4 Society Soldiers. L|1|•|It always contains a single use «Mana Forge Key» and some pieces of tier 7 loot (often spell components).

H2|Dialog P|⸨After Hamud ibn Rafik struck during "To Raise a Banner of Flame"⸩ ⸨Koga Hideki tells you, "Please do not ask me to speak of the night when the darkness assaulted me."⸩ ⸨Koga Hideki tells you, "My ordeal has weakened me so much that the armor I craft is of lesser quality. But, I hope to improve my armor craft to how it once was."⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid tells you, "In one night I was slain a dozen times...I am now so weak I am unable to craft armor as strong as I once made..."⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid tells you, "But I will keep working...And if you continue to hunt shadows and crystal beasts, I will continue to improve my smithing skills."
P|Taste of Twilight⸩ ⸨Alean the Steel Forger tells you, "Regrettably, I still have not recovered from the shadows' attacks. But Aliester the Loquacious has found out a way to improve my armor with elemental stones. I will continue to make armor from the fused gems. Hopefully using Aliester's findings you will be able to improve the armor."
P|Speaking with the Master Armorers⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid tells you, "Nuhmudira has finally restored us to full health! She has also stocked us with some extra supplies that we needed, such that we can provide you with either a version of the original Shadow Armor, or its successor. If you wish to trade one version of your Amuli set for another, simply hand it to me. Please take out all Atlan stones from your armor before handing it to me."⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid tells you, "Also, if you wish to color your new Greater Shadow Armor, you may buy a vat of color from my assistant. If you do not like the color, please give me the armor piece and I will replace it with the standard piece, which you may then choose to recolor." P|⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "With the aid of the other Master Armorers, I have managed to master the basics of crafting Alduressa versions of the Shadow Armors. I've crafted both the versions that may be set with the "Atlan Stones", and the more resilient, non-elemental versions. If you wish to trade one version of your Alduressa armor set for another, simply hand it to me. Please take out all Atlan stones from your armor before handing it to me."⸩ ⸨Iian di Alduressa tells you, "Also, I have heard that the other Master Armorers have apprentices who sell paints for recoloring the Greater Shadow Armors. Those paints will also work upon the Greater Shadow Alduressa that I create. If you do not like the color, please give me the armor piece and I will restore the piece to its original colors, which you may then choose to recolor as you like."
P|Handing in Fused Gems⸩ ⸨You give Jibril ibn Rashid Glimmering Gem.⸩ ⸨Jibril ibn Rashid tells you, "A small gem... delightful. Take these leggings. Quest.name: Society Armor
Quest.notes: from the wiki (no quest summary box)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|Armor I|QB|1 stamp TR| TE
H2|General P|There is a unique set of Society Armor for the three factions of «Celestial Hand», «Eldrytch Web» and «Radiant Blood». Each piece is obtained with a respective armor writ, «Celestial Hand Armor Writ», «Eldrytch Web Armor Writ», and «Radiant Blood Armor Writ». There are nine pieces in each set and there's a one day timer on turning in an Armor Writ for the chest key. The armor can be tinked 10 times (all armor and item tinks available) and each piece is unique with random spells, material (bronze, gold, etc) and statistics (a hyrbrid quest/loot system). In other words, each time you loot a society chest for an armor piece, it will come out with random spells, workmanship, and AL. So sometimes the piece will be no good, sometimes great, and the items are tradable and wearable by anyone of that faction of the correct rank. Armor can be turned back in to the NPC (same one you got the key from) for 5 «Trade Token»s if the stats are bad and you have no use for it. During the «Sins of the Fathers» event the base AL of all newly pulled Society Armor was improved.
P|**WARNING:** Society Armor can be mana stoned or salvaged which will destroy the piece. It can be protected with «Salvaged Leather» just as normal loot armor can.
P|First Writ Turn In: ⟦SocietyArmorWritWait⟧
P|**Society rank requirements to earn and wear each piece:** TR|* **«Initiate»** (1) - **Sollerets** **Gauntlets** TR| TR| TR|* **«Adept»** (2) - **Greaves** **Tassets** TR| TR| TR|* **«Knight»** (3) - **Pauldrons** **Vambraces** TR| TR| TR|* **«Lord»** (4) - **Breastplate** **Girth** TR| TR| TR|* **«Master»** (5) - **Helm** TR| TE
H2|Set Bonus Spells P|**Wearing multiple pieces adds a bonus spell:** L|1|•|**2 Pieces** - «Society Initiate's Blessing» (All Attributes +3) L|1|•|**4 Pieces** - «Society Adept's Blessing» (All Attributes +6) L|1|•|**6 Pieces** - «Society Knight's Blessing» (All Attributes +9) L|1|•|**8 Pieces** - «Society Lord's Blessing» (All Attributes +12) L|1|•|**9 Pieces** - «Society Master's Blessing» (All Attributes +15)
H2|Armor Writs TR| «Celestial Hand Initiate Armor Writ» «Celestial Hand Armor Writ» TR| «Eldrytch Web Initiate Armor Writ» «Eldrytch Web Armor Writ» TR| «Radiant Blood Initiate Armor Writ» «Radiant Blood Armor Writ» TR| «Ornate Armor Writ» TE
P|**Ways to obtain Armor Writs:** L|1|•|Special Initiation Armor Writ given when joining a faction. L|1|•|Buy from Society Quartermaster in the «Faction Stronghold» for 25 «Trade Token»s. Quest.name: Society Rank
Quest.notes: from the wiki (no quest summary box)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|Quest / area I|QB|2 stamps P|Your **Society Rank** is an indicator of your current standing in your «Society». Players can ascend five ranks from Initiate to Master.
P|To gain rank, you must complete tasks given by Society NPCs that will take you to different locations around Dereth.
P|Gaining ranks in a Society unlocks more tasks and rewards such as pulls from «Society Chests» and access to unique «Society Armor».
P|Each Rank requires a number of ribbons be turned in to the «Commendations Officer» and completion of a special advancement test. L|1|•|First Ribbon Turn In: ⟦SocietyRibbonsPerDayTimer⟧ and ⟦SocietyRibbonsPerDayCounter⟧
H2|Ranks H3|Rank 1: Initiate P|To become an Initiate in your Society, you must complete either «Celestial Hand Initiation», «Eldrytch Web Initiation», or «Radiant Blood Initiation».
P|Once you're of Initiate Rank, you can access «Category:Society Quests: Initiate Rank¦Society Quests: Initiate Rank».
H3|Rank 2: Adept P|To become an Adept in your Society, you must hand in **95** total Commendation Ribbons and complete the «Adept Test».
P|Once you're of Adept Rank, you can access «Category:Society Quests: Adept Rank¦Society Quests: Adept Rank».
H3|Rank 3: Knight P|To become an Knight in your Society, you must hand in **295** total Commendation Ribbons and complete the «Knight Test».
P|Once you're of Knight Rank, you can access «Category:Society Quests: Knight Rank¦Society Quests: Knight Rank».
H3|Rank 4: Lord P|To become an Lord in your Society, you must hand in **595** total Commendation Ribbons and complete the «Lord Test».
P|Once you're of Lord Rank, you can access «Category:Society Quests: Lord Rank¦Society Quests: Lord Rank».
H3|Rank 5: Master P|To become an Master in your Society, you must hand in **995** total Commendation Ribbons and complete the «Master Test».
P|Once you're of Master Rank, you can access «Category:Society Quests: Master Rank¦Society Quests: Master Rank» and, as you're now at maximum rank, you can hand in **50** Commendation Ribbons in exchange for a «Trade Token». Additional ribbons (5) can also be used for the «Tactical Defense Game».

Quest.name: Thunder Chicken
Quest.notes: from the wiki (no quest summary box) - 1 of its 2 stamps weren't in a quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|Quest / area I|Starts At|«Colosseum» I|QB|1 stamp H2|Notes L|1|•|Made its first appearance during a Live Event (Under Cover of Night), now can be found in a special room in the «Colosseum». L|1|•|To access Thunder Chicken, give an «Egg» to the «Master Arbitrator» in the «Colosseum», then use the chicken statue behind the door in the southeast hall. L|2|•|⟦ArbitratorEggGivenComplete!⟧ L|1|•|Has extremely slow health regen, so you can take a long time to kill it. L|1|•|Loot «Thunder Chicken Token» L|2|•|⟦PickedUpThunderChickenToken⟧
H2|Strategy
P|This can be soloed by a meleer with almost max melee defense (513 with beers is adequate) and 400+ life, but is much easier with support. The Thunder Chicken does typeless melee damage, so the 80+ Olthoi Armor and a «Greater Olthoi Shield» work well. A major storm ward will help against the initial lightning war magic.
P|Send the meleer in to kill the small spawns until the Thunder Chicken appears. When it does, retreat in circles and heal, keeping the shield toward the chicken, until it runs out of mana and stops casting wars. Then kill the little chickens and push the Thunder Chicken into a corner opposite the door. With the Thunder Chicken backed into the corner, you'll only get hit about 1/5 of the time -- the rest it will try to back up to attack. If you stay like this, eventually it will try to run back to the spawn point and then teleport back, so you need to get its attention. Attack for a while (with a fire rend or something with a good melee def bonus), push it into the corner and see if it wants to reset.
P|Once it's not going to reset, it's time to debuff the Thunder Chicken. Push it into the corner, equip your Royal Runed Baton, and use that to cast Futility. Even with 450 spellcraft this will take several tries. Be sure to heal between attempts, because you'll get hit hard. Switch to a good melee d wand and cast imperil and fire vuln. There's no need to fester, since this has an extremely low regen rate. Attack with an AR fire weapon.
P|If you have support, send in the others when you are ready to debuff. Have them heal the meleer from the opposite corner while he casts. If the meleer dies, they might have enough time to portal recall without dying. Once debuffed, any healers should stay in that corner, and anyone who wants to attack should go up to the Thunder Chicken so that it doesn't get loose.
P|A brave mage can also debuff the chicken while the meleers keep its attention.
H2|Lore & Dialog
P|You give Master Arbitrator Egg. P|The Arbitrator looks confused for a second and then nods his head in apparent understanding. P|Master Arbitrator tells you, "You now have access to the Chicken Arena." P|Thunder Chicken blasts you for 267 points with Lightning Bomb. P|The thunder of Thunder Chicken crushing is followed by the deafening silence of death! P|Squakzzzt!!! P|Squakzzzt!!!
P|Thunder Chicken's seared corpse smolders before you! P|Bgaaaaaaaaawww...k
P|You give Master Arbitrator Thunder Chicken Token. P|You've earned 10,000,000 experience. P|Master Arbitrator tells you, "I see that you have proved you [sic] skill against the Thunder Chicken. Well done." P|Master Arbitrator tells you, "You shall be known to all as the "Thunder Chicken Slayer"."

Quest.name: Weapon Mastery
Quest.notes: from the wiki (no quest summary box)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|Game mechanic I|Coordinates|33.5N, 56.8E I|QB|4 stamps P|**NOTE: In Spring 2014, Weapon Masteries were updated. "Weapon masteries are now universal. All characters get the benefit of 5 DR when using a weapon with a mastery, regardless of the character's mastery. Weapon that previously had no mastery bonus at all still don't give 5 DR."**
P|Introduced in the «Master of Arms» event, **Weapon Mastery** allows a character to gain a +5 «Damage Rating» for a melee weapon and one ranged weapon type.
P|Characters can only have one melee mastery and one ranged mastery at any one time. Melee masteries include: «Axe», «Dagger», «Mace», «Spear», «Staff», «Sword», «Unarmed Combat» and «Two Handed Combat». Ranged masteries include: «Bow», «Crossbow», «Magic», and «Thrown Weapon».
P|Existing characters will get one free change to their melee weapon mastery and their ranged mastery.
H2|Weapon types and masteries P|«Heavy Weapons¦Heavy», «Finesse Weapons¦Finesse», «Light Weapons¦Light» and «Missile Weapons¦Missile» weapons list a weapon type after the skill on the stats (ID) panel. For example the «Amateur Explorer Dirk» displays Heavy Weapons (Dagger) so receives a damage bonus when the wielder has the dagger weapon mastery.
H3|Weapons that cannot be mastered P|Some weapons do not list their type such as the «Atlan Weapons» and «Isparian Weapons» sets and thus cannot be mastered. Weapons that cannot be mastered have the following description: "This weapon seems tough to master.".
P|**Note:** Two handed weapons and magic casters do not display a weapon type.
H2|Races, Heritages and their specific Masteries P|Races start with the following masteries:
TH|Race Melee mastery Ranged mastery TR|«Character Races¦Aluvian» «Daggers» «Bows» TR|«Character Races¦Sho» «Unarmed Weapons» «Bows» TR|«Character Races¦Gharu'ndim» «Staves» «Magic» (spells) TR|«Character Races¦Viamontian» «Swords» «Crossbows» TR|«Character Races¦Umbraen» «Character Races¦Penumbraen» «Unarmed Weapons» «Crossbows» TR|«Character Races¦Gear Knight» «Maces» «Crossbows» TR|«Character Races¦Empyrean» «Swords» «Magic» (spells) TR|«Character Races¦Undead» «Axes» «Thrown Weapons» TR|«Character Races¦Aun Tumeroks» «Spears» «Thrown Weapons» TE
P|This will also influence which «Training Weapons» a character starts out with. See «Training and Academy Weapons» and «Character Creation» for an overview.
H2|Changing your Weapon Mastery
L|1|•|After creation, you can change your Mastery at the Mastery Statues in «Arwic» at 33.5N, 56.8E. L|1|•|Players can receive one free Melee Mastery and one free Ranged Mastery change. L|2|•|Range: ⟦UsedFreeRangedMasteryReset⟧ and ⟦UsedRangedMasteryReset⟧ L|2|•|Melee: ⟦UsedFreeMeleeMasteryReset⟧ and ⟦UsedMeleeMasteryReset⟧ L|1|•|If you wish to change Weapon Masteries a 2nd time the following is the cost of making the change: L|2|•|You require 10 «MMD Note¦MMDs». L|2|•|You have to level 200. L|2|•|You have completed the «Nalicana's Test¦Luminance Flagging» quest. L|2|•|You have to have 100,000 «Luminance» spare.

H2|Lore & Dialog
P|Worcer, just like «Hardunna» and «Flinrala Ryndmad», was one of the children saved by «Celcynd the Dour» during the Tumerok invasion of Holtburg in PY 6. His mother, June, died defending «Holtburg Redoubt». Items belonging to her can be still be found there.2004/12 «The Calm» - «Letter to Ryndya» 1999/12 «Release» - «Worcer's Missing Heirlooms» 1999/11 «Release» - «Historical Marker» 1999/12 «Release» - «Directions to the Cave of Alabree»
P|⸨;Opening Dialog⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "I'd appreciate your help recovering some items from the old Redoubt."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "My parents were killed there when I was but a boy, when Holtburg was overrun with Tumeroks. I was saved, whisked away by the mage Celcynd at my parents' behest."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "The Redoubt is directly south of here. We put up an eternal flame at the site, in memory of all the townsfolk who died. Some of us are also trying to get together an exhibit to honor our parents. For instance, my mother had these heirloom dishes she was always polishing. She loved those dishes ..."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Anyway, if you could recover any of these items for our exhibit, I will reward you as well as I can."⸩ ⸨Worcer gives you A List of Items.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "If you need more help getting to the Redoubt, you can buy directions from Wilomine at the bar."
L|1||Handing in the Missing Heirlooms⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Antique Goblet.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Look, it's the old goblet I remember so well! Thank you for bringing it back to me!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Antique Mug.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "I never thought I'd see this again! You have my thanks!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Wedding Band.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "This wedding band belonged to the mother of my good friend Hardunna. She'll be thrilled to have this back!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Bronze Handbell.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Hardunna's mother would ring this bell to call us in to dinner. Thank you so much for bringing it back to us!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Antique Platter.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "My mother's antique platter! Thank you so much!"⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Antique Bowl.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "I always hated this bowl. But my mother loved it, bless her heart. It will make a great addition to our little memorial. Thank you."⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Bronze Candlestick.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Hardunna and I use to "borrow" this candlestick to go roaming about at night. Ah, those were innocent days."⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Bronze Lamp.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Hardunna's father, Roland, brought this with him from Ispar. He gave it to Hope, his wife, when they met. I am so glad to have this for our museum. You have my sincere thanks."⸩ ⸨You've earned 4,500 experience.
L|1||Receiving "Directions to the Cave of Alabree"⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "You know, since you've been so helpful to me, perhaps you could also help Flinrala. She doesn't talk about it much, but she still grieves for her father, Brogord. He died defending the Redoubt."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "One of his axes is rumored to be in the Cave of Alabree, a bit west of here. Perhaps you could go and take a look? Bring anything you find back to Flinrala - I'm sure she'll be happy to have it."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Here, here are the directions. Wilomine also sells them, in case you lose those."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "If you bring me rat tails, wasp wings, or drudge charms, I'll reward you - I hate those cursed pests! I'd also appreciate help recovering one of my family's antique dishes from the old Redoubt."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Many years ago, Holtburg was overrun by Tumeroks. I was but a boy myself, and whisked away to Rithwic by the mage Celcynd, at my parents' behest."⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "They died in the Redoubt east of the South Outpost, trying to hold the enemy at bay. There now burns an eternal flame at the site, in memory of those slain."⸩ ⸨Worcer gives you Worcer's Key.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Take this key, and see if you can recover one of my family's antique dishes!"
L|1||Giving Antique Platter to Worcer⸩ ⸨You give Worcer Antique Platter.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Bless you, friend! What a charitable deed you've done! If you have the time, I know Miss Ryndmad in Holtburg could also use your help."⸩ ⸨Worcer gives you Scrap of parchment.⸩ ⸨Worcer tells you, "Give this to her."⸩

I|Type|List / guide I|QB|7 stamps P|=The 500 QB by Level 50 Leveling Guide= P|Written by Abracadaver for Newbs
P|Use Sanamar as your starting location or you'll need to do some additional running around to complete your city's «Pathwarden Greeter» questline. P|Character creation recommendations: Missile Weapons (Bow), Two Handed, or Mage (Void or War) L|1|•|Missile Weapons (Bow) allows you to easily upgrade damage as you level via Fletching and does high damage early. L|1|•|Two Handed Combat's cleave mechanic helps quickly clear dungeons early on without sacrificing defense or stats. L|1|•|Mage (War or Void) increases damage as they learn higher spell levels, but scrolls and professor training get expensive quickly.
P|This guide was tested with a Finesse Lugian, a very sub-optimal build. P|Starting Stats: 10/100/100/100/10/10 P|Specialized: None P|Trained: Finesse Weapons, Item Enchantment, Life Magic, Missile Weapons, Melee Defense P|Train Later: Lockpick, Fletching
L|1|•|Lockpick is **essential** for this guide, so be sure to pick it up as soon as possible if your build doesn't start with it. You definitely do not want to miss bonus QB just for simply having a skill trained. L|1|•|Experiment early and often! «Aydra the Redistributor» in Arwic sells all gems to raise or lower stats and skills for **1 pyreal**, so you can change your build whenever you please.
L|1|•|Use the «Infinite Leaftide Buffer»! They give free level 8 buffs that last for 90 minutes, so take advantage if you're looking to skip some of the pain of lower level Asheron's Call content.

I|Type|List / guide I|QB|18 stamps H2|«Dungeon Luminance Augment Requirements» (Organized for progression inside their category) P|This is a general guideline for entering and killing efficiently for **Custom Dungeons**.
P|The most important guide-line for each dungeon is having the correct effective melee defense. The recommended augs are give or take because you can reach that effective melee defense by different combinations of augs and gear, the same applies for reaching maximum kills per hour (KPH). If you are wearing a suit with **Legendary** cantrips, you can access these dungeons sooner. It is also recommended that you equip a weapon with the corresponding slayer of each dungeon, as that gives a bonus of 50% to 75% more damage (depending on the item and if it is a rare or from a slayer gem).
P|The formula for **Effective Melee Defense** is **(Weapon Melee D Bonus + 1) * Buffed Melee Defense**. So if you have a **+250% melee defense weapon and 3,000 buffed melee defense**, the formula would be **(2.50+1) * 3000 = 10,500 effective melee defense**.
L|1|•|**Creature** - Essential for reaching 100% evasion, especially in mid-to-high-tier dungeons where mobs can deal 200+ non-critical damage per hit. Without enough evasion, you won't survive. **Creature** also improves your ability to land War, Void, Melee, and Missile attacks consistently. At higher tiers, this becomes less of an issue as mobs tend to either fully resist or never resist/evade.
L|1|•|**Item** - Contributes to both offense and defense. Increases damage for **War, Void, Melee, and Missile**, and also supports 100% evasion similarly to Creature.*
L|1|•|**Life** - Life can be a bit of a catch-22. If your **Creature** and **Item** are high enough to guarantee 100% evasion from Melee and Missile, Life becomes less critical. However, it remains highly valuable for reducing Magic damage and boosting Aetheria Surge power. Every 10 points in **Life** increases your **Protection** and **Destruction Surges** by 1 point - especially effective when paired with high **Duration**.
L|1|•|**War/Void/Melee/Missile** - These offensive metrics should be high enough to allow you to **one- or two-shot mobs consistently**, without relying on crits or sneak attack procs - provided you're using a proper **Slayer weapon** or a «Slayer Gem» for the dungeon's mob type. P|Each dungeon has a maximum achievable **Kills Per Hour (KPH)**. Your goal is to get as close to that number as possible. If you advance to a harder dungeon without maintaining high **KPH**, you may actually earn less than you would in an easier dungeon where your efficiency is higher.
P|Now we can all be on the same page, and when you make adjustments we will have a unified experience. Survival is not enough, we must Thrive. L|1|•|: «User:Doctor Strange¦Doctor Strange» («User talk:Doctor Strange¦talk»)
P|= Full Loot Dungeons = L|1|•|These are your introductory endgame dungeons, but they don't necessarily represent a strict progression order. Many players choose to use their free Enlightens early on, then head straight to their first auto-loot dungeon - either the «Mysterious Siraluun Nest» or the «Obvious Penguin Lair».
