P|=Miscellaneous Updates=
L|1|1.|«Dark Isle». It's Dark! Monsters are more challenging! Tier 8 loot, increased Experience, and Luminance per kill. L|1|2.|Penthouse (High QB Lounge) released. In its infancy, but has its own unique stipend and vendor on a 2 day timer, and a mage vendor cheaper than the Aun in «Marketplace» & «Candeth». Much more to come with this space. Portal in «Yanshi» for now. 5,000 QB to enter. L|1|3.|Added 3 new NPC's in «The QB Penthouse Lounge», «Asheron», «Martine» and «Levistras» Blessings. Can only get 1 total every 20 hours of the 3 blessings they offer. «Asheron» offers «Focus», «Levistras» offers «Coordination», and «Martine» offers «Strength». L|1|4.|Suvi shit talking target dummy up in High QB lounge, go take out some frustrations. «Chest of Chance» added, play your odds for some favourable rewards or some duds. L|1|5.|«The QB Penthouse Lounge» now has a new QoL item on the stipend vendor. L|1|6.|«Asheron» has made it easier to keep Gaerlan trapped by creating a re-usable Gem for fast travel to «Gaerlan's Library» that's now available at «Wicked Wares»! QB Hunters rejoice! L|1|7.|New Item: «Platinum Golem King Heart» dropped from «Platinum Mountain Kings» can be turned into Yula at VoD camp for a «Mythical Valley Keyring». Functions the same as retail keyrings - use keyring on a key to add the key to the ring, intricate carving tool to remove the key from the ring. QB awarded for picking up the PGK Heart and for for turning it into the NPC at camp. No longer will MVKs litter your packs! L|1|8.|«Mr. R, Rare Trophy Collector» has migrated from the coldness of «Eastwatch» to the beaches of «Kryst». He is looking for a new friend. He will reward you based on total trophy turn ins, and turn ins for each type as well. Has some unique rewards for certain thresholds that you'll have to figure out on your own! He accepts Babe's Bell, Kain's Skull, Kraken Guts, Marge's Memento, Broken Drum, Corrupted Mote, and Skull Crusher's skulls.

Quest.name: Rare Items
Quest.notes: from the wiki (no quest summary box) - 10 of its 75 stamps weren't in a quest
Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|List / guide I|QB|10 stamps P|During the «Throne of Destiny (expansion)¦Throne of Destiny» expansion in 2005, rare items, or **Rares**, were introduced to the loot generator. There are six tiers that increase in rarity ranging from the most common «Rares¦Tier 1» rares, which consist of consumable buff gems, to the least common «Rares¦Tier 6» rares which consist of weapons for each class. Consumable type items in tier 5 are eternal/infinite and have an unlimited number of uses.
P|Each time a player kills a rare eligible creature, there is a small chance that a rare will drop. To be rare eligible, the creature must drop a corpse/treasure pile, be a greater level than the player, or level 100+. Estimated drop rate of a rare item is one in 2,500 rare eligible creature kills. P|For every 1 weapon («Rares¦Tier 6») that drops the following should drop forums.ac.turbine.com/showpost.php?p=536837&postcount=3:
TH|Drop Rate Tier Average Kills Per Rare Found TR|1 «Rares¦Tier 6» 8,750,000 1:3500 TR|1.16 «Rares¦Tier 5» 7,543,103 1:3017 TR|2.8 «Rares¦Tier 4» 3,120,000 1:1,250 TR|35 «Rares¦Tier 3» 250,000 1:100 TR|350 «Rares¦Tier 2» 25,000 1:10 TR|3500 «Rares¦Tier 1» 2,500 1:1 TE
H2|Real Time Rares P|Also there is a real time rare timer for each character, this timer starts the first time you kill a rare eligible creature. A character such as a mule that has never killed anything will not have an active timer. It works by looking at the real time that has elapsed since the last rare was found, it increases as the time gets closer to two months (real life time) at which point it is a 100% chance. People have found that for characters that don't normally hunt, it's best to take them out at at the 30 day mark and a rare will drop after a few kills (although it sometimes can take longer since it's still a % chance at the 30 day mark).
H2|Rare Items H3|Tier 1 P|Spells cast by these rare gems do not stack with «Gems¦Spectral Mastery Crystals».

H2|Undead L|1|•|Obtain «Black Skull of Xikma» by finishing the «Lunnum's Return» quest L|1|•|«Black Skull of Xikma Gem» sold by «Weapon Imbue Vendor» for 1 «Imbue Swap Coin». L|2|•|Route: Inside building in NE corner of «Arwic». L|1|•|Apply the «Black Skull of Xikma» to a loot generated weapon. NOTE: This will set the item with the Wield requirement of the Player

Quest.name: Starter Guide
Quest.notes: from the wiki (no quest summary box)
Quest.Wiki:
I|Type|Guide I|QB|1 stamp P|= Starter Guide =
P|This guide is intended for veterans of Asheron's Call. If you've never played AC before, the «New Player Guide» may be a better place to start.
P|The first thing all new Infinite Leaftide players should understand is that this is not an End-of-Retail server. A large amount of content has been added to provide challenging and fun gameplay beyond the base game. There is no level or enlightenment cap, allowing for infinite character growth.
P|The two main currencies on ILT are «Enlightened Coin»s and «Luminance». Most activities revolve around farming these two currencies. Luminance isn't viable to farm efficiently until you have high Enlightenment and Quest Bonus, so early on you'll focus on earning «Enlightened Coin»s. When you need Luminance, you can purchase it from other players (or bots) who have it available for sale.
P|See «Custom Functionality on Infinite Leaftide» for more information.
P|= Character Creation =
P|When it comes to character creation, there's very little you can mess up. There's no cooldown on respecs, so if you start with suboptimal attributes or specs, you can easily change them later.
P|The only thing that's harder to change is your race and appearance. Admins can help to a degree, but for example, if you choose Lugian, they may not be able to change you to Aluvian later if that's what you want.
P|Here are a few things to keep in mind:
L|1|•|The «Old Man Willow Quest» starter quest line begins in «Shoushi». It is recommended that new players set «Shoushi» as their starter city. L|1|•|The robe and gauntlets acquired from «Old Man Willow Quest» will last a long time. You don't need to replace them right away. However, if you want to, you can try building a suit with legendary keys. (Note: most player power comes from Custom Augs.) L|1|•|Infinite Leaftide includes a Quest Bonus (QB) system that increases XP and Luminance gained from all actions based on the number of QB stamps you've collected.
P|These stamps show up in chat and look like this: ⟦OldManWillowStart!⟧
P|Each stamp earned increases your bonus. P|You can: L|1|•|View your total stamps using `/qb` L|1|•|View all current bonuses using `/bonus`
P|For more detail, see «Custom Functionality on Infinite Leaftide».
P|**Important:** The tutorial area contains QB stamps that cannot be obtained after leaving. (QB is account-wide, so you can still get them later by creating a new character and redoing the tutorial.)
P|= I've Completed the Tutorial. What Now? =
P|Once you've completed the tutorial, here are the recommended next steps:
L|1|•|Hand your «Pathwarden Token» to the «Pathwarden Greeter» and open the chest behind him to equip your **4% XP trinket** L|1|•|(Optional) Ask for help in general chat - vassals are in high demand, and most experienced players are happy to assist new players P|-> When choosing a patron, keep in mind that many quests require higher augmentations - a well-augmented patron can assist you with content that a less-augmented character may not be able to handle. P|It's strongly recommended to complete «500 by 50» early on! L|1|•|Buy spells and spell components P|-> The Aun Archmage from CK is also located in the **NE corner of the «Marketplace»** P|-> He buys most loot, making him a convenient vendor P|-> The Magic Professors in Arwic provide a convenient method of learning all spells lvl 1-7 L|1|•|From completing the «Old Man Willow Quest», you'll receive **5x «Enlightenment Token»**, which grants you **7 "free" Enlightenments** L|1|•|Start working on Quest Bonus and gear L|1|•|Once you're level 200+, complete «Nalicana's Test» to unlock your **Luminance flag** This allows for collections of luminance and is the entry into augmented play. A great goal is to achieve 1000 Quest Bonus by level 200. L|1|•|Begin collecting «Augmentation Gems» (see below)
L|1|•|Familiarize yourself with this Wiki - it contains guides, walkthroughs, and details for all major systems L|1|•|Join the Discord! P|-> Most common questions have already been asked P|-> Use the search feature to quickly find answers
P|= Augmentation Gems =
P|On ILT, there is a difference in Augmentation Gems or augs and Luminance augs or more commonly known as Custom Augs. Custom augs are unique to the server and provide the majority of your player power. Your goal on this server will be to increased your custom augs are much as possible. P|-> «Custom_Functionality_on_Infinite_Leaftide¦Custom Aug Gems»
P|Augmentation gems work the same as in retail and provide powerful benefits.
P|-> «XP_Augmentation¦Aug Gem Guide»
H3|Sir Bellas Augmentation Gem
L|1|1.|Use «Abandoned Mines Portal Gem» L|1|2.|Enter the first room on the right, and take the portal to «Augmentation Realm Main Level» L|1|3.|It is no longer required to turn in an Eater jaw before every Sir Bellas kill. L|1|4.|Jump down, run to the end, and kill **Sir Bellas** to obtain a Blank Augmentation Gem (2-day cooldown)
H3|«Farmer Noah's Assistance» P|Entry level quest
H3|Nalicana Augmentation Gem
P|Recommended after finishing «Custom_Quests/Areas_on_Infinite_Leaftide¦Boat», since you'll already be at «Asheron's Castle».
L|1|1.|Use «Abandoned Mines portal gem» (10 MMD purchase) to access the subway L|1|2.|Enter the «AC Storage Portal» L|1|3.|Use the «Asheron's Castle» portal device (room to the east) L|1|4.|Inside the castle, locate the «Token of Augmentation Gem» on a table in the far southeast L|1|5.|Hand it to «Nalicana» to trade 100,000 luminance for a «Blank Augmentation Gem» (2-day cooldown)
H3|Luminance Gambling
P|A fast way to earn «Blank Augmentation Gem»s:
L|1|1.|Use the «Crater Portal» in the subway L|1|2.|Enter the «Night Club» L|1|3.|Speak to the Game Masters to gamble Luminance L|1|4.|Blank Augmentation Gems are one of the possible rewards L|1|5.|Use a Vtank route to automate this for efficiency
P|= Enlightenment =
P|Enlightenment on ILT is different from retail. While Enlightenment is unlimited here, XP is not the only limiting factor as it is in retail. XP is easy to come by on ILT thanks to characters with high XP multipliers - however, you'll be limited by the number of «Enlightenment Token»s required after ENL 5.
P|Many players swear their main character to an alt (or vice versa) so that one can macro while the other continues gaining XP. There are also plenty of XP leech spots where another player can help power-level you - it can take just a few minutes to gain enough XP to Enlighten again.
L|1|•|VoD, Caulcano, outside of Candeth Keep, or many more
P|For more information, see the wiki page below-
P|«Custom_Functionality_on_Infinite_Leaftide¦Enlightenment»
P|While Enlightenment is important, most new players will focus on spending their «Enlightened Coin»s on custom augs rather than «Enlightenment Token»s, until their character has progressed a fair amount.
P|= Events=
P|ILT regularly features custom, admin-run events. These often happen daily and typically reward an «Event Coin».
P|Important: «Event Coin»s have a 20-minute expiration timer - whether you're online or not - so be sure to spend them immediately!
P|You can spend them at Events R Us in the «Marketplace» (look for the large Mu-Miyah).
P|Common high-value purchases include:
L|1|•|«Weakly Enlightened Coin» x500
L|1|•|«Enlightened Coin» x50
P|These two options are equivalent in value - 500 «Weakly Enlightened Coin»s can be traded for 50 «Enlightened Coin»s, but not the other way around. While items like MMDs and Luminance can be helpful, their value is generally lower than 50 «Enlightened Coin»s (as of writing this guide - 7/3/2025).
P|Events may also reward custom rare items or unique QB stamps. Be sure to check in and participate whenever you see an event running!
P|= Macroing Dungeons=
P|Infinite Leaftide features many custom dungeons specifically designed for farming the currencies needed to progress your character. P|You can find a full list here: «Custom Dungeons on Infinite Leaftide»
P|Most custom dungeons feature auto-loot - when you kill a mob, there's a chance an item will be directly placed in your inventory. The type of loot depends on the dungeon:
L|1|•|Some dungeons drop trinkets, aetheria, or custom items (which turn in to an NPC in return for a specific reward)
L|1|•|Others (ENL dungeons) reward higher Luminance per kill but do not drop loot L|2|•|These are only efficient with a large fellowship, otherwise they produce less currency than Coin dungeons of the same aug level
P|**Important:** P|You must be flagged for the dungeon's auto-loot to receive items. P|-> This means you need to enter using the actual portal. P|If you tie to the dungeon and use a portal recall to enter later, you will not get the stamp that enables loot drops.
P|= Alternate Currency Grinds =
P|See the following guide - «Currency Making Guide»
P|= Daily Activities =
H3|Collect Your Stipends
P|Talk to «Monroe» in «Arwic» (near the lifestone in town) or at «Marketplace» P|Can be collected **every other day**, but it's best to check daily so you don't miss a reset P|Once you finish your level 8 spells and «Augmentation Gem»s, stipends aren't as important.
H3|«Kinoko's Mushroom Collection» P|Entry level quest which rewards «Enlightened Coin»s
H3|«Lala's Treasure Hunt» P|Entry level quest which rewards an «Enlightenment Token»
H3|«Summoning T'thuun» (Books)
P|One of the easiest daily quests for an enlightenment token. The quest steps below can be skipped and you can go straight to Tulmada if you see someone in General announce "Books"
L|1|1.|Town Network -> «Eastham» L|1|2.|Go to **Patriarchs Valley** at 17.6N, 63.5E L|1|3.|From the drop, go straight, then to the portals to the West, North, and East L|1|4.|Each portal leads to a spiral dungeon - **NASCAR** up and kill the boss L|1|5.|Collect the three books L|1|6.|Recall, give **one** book to **Captain Tulmada** -> triggers **T'thuun event** L|1|7.|Return to pit, kill all humanoids L|1|8.|Tulmada spawns next to you - speak to receive reward
H3|«Saving Asheron»
P|This requires a quest chain but is a solid **entry-level enlightenment token quest**. P|No augmentations required, can be done daily once unlocked.
H3|«Defeating the Curator of Torment»
P|If you see "BROADCAST : Deep in the Catacombs of Torment, Inventive Exile has struck down the Curator of Torment, forcing him again for a time into his prison in the abyss of Portalspace." in General chat, then someone has killed all 4 of the sanctum crystals and you can skip to Part 2. P|Easy quest to complete with just a few Custom Augs
H3|«Deewain's Dark Cavern»
P|Easy quest for an Enl token.
H3|«Custom_Quests/Areas_on_Infinite_Leaftide¦Vicky»
P|Vicky is a quest that is often cleared and called out in General chat. Depending on if the person doing Vicky cleared the whole dungeon, or just killed Vicky. You might be able to survive running through (wear a shield and be in combat) and looting Vicky at the end.
P|The other mob that can be killed for Vicky is the Man Behind the Row. You might also see that called out in General.
H3|«Custom_Quests/Areas_on_Infinite_Leaftide¦Investigating VoD»
P|Like Vicky, often times players will announce when they are clearing the dungeon or going to do the quest and you can tag along.
H3|Killtasks
P|The end of retail kill tasks can be a good early source of currency for a new character. As a level 275, they can be very difficult but with 50 creature augs, you should be able to do them daily
L|1|•|Hoshino L|1|•|Tou-Tou L|1|•|Rynthid Plains L|1|•|Graveyard L|1|•|Snowy Valley L|1|•|Neftet
P|See also: L|1|•|«Custom Quests/Areas on Infinite Leaftide» L|1|•|«Category:Enlightenment Token Quests¦Enlightenment Token Quests» L|1|•|«Category:Enlightened Coin Quests¦Enlightened Coin Quests» L|1|•|«Category:ILT_Token_of_Luminance_Quests¦ILT Token of Luminance Quests» L|1|•|«Leaftide Retail +»
P|= Questing for QB =
P|**It is highly recommended that you make a copy of the ILT Mega Tracking book and keep track of your QB. Once you reach 6-7k QB, the spreadsheet will become less useful and you will need to find other ways to find quests for QB.**
P|Updates to this spreadsheet are posted in the leveling and qb guide channel on Discord. Not all stamps listed on the spreadsheet are obtainable.
L|1|•|ILT Mega Tracking Spreadsheet L|2|•|To make changes to your sheet, File > Make a copy > Name your Sheet and click Make a Copy
L|1|•|«500 by 50» is a great first guide to follow for the server
P|These resources help you raise Quest Bonus efficiently:
L|1|•|«Category:Stamped¦List of QB Stamps on Wiki»
P|= QB-Rich Quests =
L|1|•|«Bestowers' Guild of Dereth» L|1|•|«Bronze Statues Quest» L|1|•|«Attribute and Skill Redistribution» - Don't worry about build mistakes; you can reset via the Redistribution Gem vendor in «Arwic» L|1|•|«Glenden Wood Crafters» L|1|•|«Crystalline Adventurer» L|1|•|«Facility Hub Quests» L|1|•|«Enlightened Facility Hub Quests» L|1|•|«Invoking Stone» L|1|•|«Colosseum Bosses» L|1|•|«Harbinger» L|1|•|«Gaerlan's_Citadel_(Uber)»
P|= Equipment Quests =
H3|«Festival Stones of Empyrean Quest»
P|Easy quest to complete for a «Ring of History»
H3|«Custom Quests/Areas on Infinite Leaftide¦Shoushi Casino (Wetwater Bandits)»
P|This quest 100% requires a carry if you are new, but it only takes a few minutes for someone with high augs and it will give you a ring that will last you a long time- «Gan-zo's Upgraded Purple Society Band»
H3|«Lost Noble Armor»
P|This quest rewards «Loyalty Tunic» which can be very helpful. This quest is done in VoD, so you will need a carry who can clear VoD well.
H3|«Help the Pizza Maker»
P|Enl 10 to enter, this quest is very difficult and will require a very geared carry (choose your Patron wisely)
H3|«Yozor's Gift»
P|This necklace has Imperil 7 cast on strike, which is very nice to have as a melee or archer, as well as other powerful spells.
H3|«Wicked Wares»
P|This vendor features many custom rares that are very strong on the server. While you might not be able to afford them at the start, there are many items you will eventually want to purchase.
H3|«Aerbax's Prodigal Drudge»
P|Reward: «Protective Drudge Charm» - one of the best easy-to-get necklaces. P|This can easily be replaced by «Martine's Necklace», which is rewarded for doing «Enlightened Martine» which is a quest you won't be able to do until you are at soft cap custom augs, but the necklace is pretty widely available on the server to purchase.
P|Do these quests together (same location): L|1|•|«Drudge Plan» L|1|•|«Aerbax's Prodigal Drudge» L|1|•|«Drudge Lurker Kill Task» L|1|•|«Drudge Stalker Kill Task» L|1|•|«Drudge Ravener Kill Task» L|1|•|«Altered Drudge Kill Task» L|1|•|«Augmented Drudge Kill Task»
